records.zomi: I sang computer lab ah an leh dawn ding kiphal lo hi.

records.english: Our class collected all the lost property and returned it to the right owners before the holidays.
records.zomi: Tawlngakni ma-in i kilasi in van mangte khempeuh a kaikhawm a, a man neite kiangah a lohsak kik hi.

records.english: We made a small study corner for our daughter by clearing out the cupboard under the stairs.
records.zomi: Kaplei nuai-a bawm a sung kisiangsak-in i tanu adingin kisinna mun neu khat i bawl hi.

records.english: Students, nobody leaves until every paintbrush has been washed and put back in the jar.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, lim khaina brush khempeuh kisil-in bel sungah a kikoih kik dong kuamah pai kei ding hi.

records.english: If you clean the whiteboards for me after school, I'll give you a lift home.
records.zomi: Sang khit ciangin whiteboard te hong siangsak leh inn dong kong paipih ding hi.

records.english: Working in a tidy space makes it easier for me to concentrate.
records.zomi: Mun siang ah na sep in lungsim koih baihsak hi.

records.english: The files on the shared drive got so mixed up that nobody could find last year's reports.
records.zomi: Shared drive tung-a file te a kihel lua ahih manin kuamah in kum bei report a mu kei uh hi.

records.english: Can someone take these empty boxes to the recycling bins on your way out?
records.zomi: Na pai khiat lam ah hih bawm awngte recycling bawm ah kuamah in a puak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Please don't stack the chairs on the tables until the floor has been swept.
records.zomi: Lei a kiphiat ma-in tutnate dawhkan tungah tung kei un.

records.english: Would you help me label the drawers in the clinic so the new nurses know where everything is?
records.zomi: Nurse thakte in na khempeuh koi ah om hiam a theih theih nadingun clinic-a bawmte min koih huh thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: With a label maker and a few plastic boxes, I finally got the clinic's storeroom under control.
records.zomi: Label maker leh plastic bawm tawmno tawh clinic van koihna khan ka kem zo tawp hi.

records.english: Could we use the old filing cabinet from the office for the children's art supplies?
records.zomi: Naupangte' lim gelh van adingin office pan file bawm lui i zang thei ding hiam?

records.english: Rather than buying new folders every year, we reuse the old ones and change the labels.
records.zomi: Kum simin folder thak lei sangin a luite i zang kik a, a min i lai hi.

records.english: If the mess in your room keeps you from finding your homework, it's time to tidy it.
records.zomi: Na khan buaina in na inn-a sep ding na muh theih loh nadingin a khak leh siangsak hun ahi hi.

records.english: A fresh coat of paint was all the old classroom needed.
records.zomi: Kilasi lui in lim khai thak bek a kisam hi.

records.english: On the last day of term, the students wipe their desks and carry the chairs to the hall.
records.zomi: Term ni nunung pen-in sangnaupangte in a dawhkan uh a nul uh a, tutnate inn lian ah a puak uh hi.

records.english: I tidied my grandmother's sewing room for her, but she couldn't find anything afterward.
records.zomi: Ka pi' puan khuina khan ka siangsak sak a, ahi zongin a nung ciangin bangmah a mu nawn kei hi.

records.english: The dust gets into everything on the factory floor, so the machines are cleaned twice a day.
records.zomi: Factory lei ah leivui in na khempeuh a lut ahih manin machine te ni khat-in nihvei kisiangsak hi.

records.english: Someone cleaned the office kitchen over the weekend, but nobody knows who.
records.zomi: Kal tawp sungin kuamah in office anbuk a siangsak a, ahi zongin kua hiam kuamah in a thei kei hi.

records.english: The cleaners come to our office every evening after six.
records.zomi: Siangsakte nitak simin nai guk khit ciangin i office ah hong pai uh hi.

records.english: Can we throw out these old exam papers, or does the school need to keep them?
records.zomi: Hih sitna lai luite i pai thei ding hiam, sang in a kem kul hiam?

records.english: Please don't put anything on my desk while I'm away — I've just organized it.
records.zomi: Ka om lo sungin ka dawhkan tungah bangmah koih kei in — ka bawl siang thak hi.

records.english: My brother color-codes his homework folders: blue for math, green for science, and red for history.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal in a inn-a sep ding folder te lim tawh a khen hi: math adingin dum, science adingin eng, tangthu adingin san.

records.english: Kids, put your school things on the hooks by the door so we're not searching for them in the morning.
records.zomi: Naupangte, zingsangin i zon kul loh nadingin na sang van uh kongkhak kiang ngetna ah khai un.

records.english: Every Friday, I delete my old emails and sort the rest into folders.
records.zomi: Laithai ni simin ka email luite ka phiat a, a taang folder te ah ka khen hi.

records.english: Our teacher gives a small prize to the cleanest classroom at the end of each month.
records.zomi: I saya in kha simin a tawp ciangin kilasi siang pen laksap neu khat a pia hi.

records.english: The storeroom roof leaked during the night, and several boxes of textbooks got soaked.
records.zomi: Zanin van koihna khan inn tung a zuh a, laibu bawm tawmno a dip hi.

records.english: What's the best way to organize all my lecture notes before the exams?
records.zomi: Sitna ma-in ka hilhna gelhte khempeuh bangci-in ka bawl siang ding hiam?

records.english: Put them in order by date, then highlight anything the professor said would be tested.
records.zomi: Ni tawh kizui-in a kizui dan bangin koih inla, professor in sit ding a cih khempeuh kilang takin bawl in.

records.english: Having shared an office with someone very messy, I now appreciate my own small, tidy desk.
records.zomi: Mi buai mahmah khat tawh office ka kihawm ngei ahih manin tu-in keima' dawhkan neu siang ka lungdam sa hi.

records.english: Should I keep my old university notes, or is it time to let them go?
records.zomi: Sangpi gelh luite ka kem ding hiam, nusia hun ahi hiam?

records.english: I sorted my daughter's school papers into folders so that she can find her notes before exams.
records.zomi: Sitna ma-in a gelhte a muh theih nadingin ka tanu' sang laite folder ah ka khen hi.

records.english: Spring cleaning at our shop means emptying every shelf and checking the dates on all the products.
records.zomi: I dawl ah spring siansuahna pen dawh khempeuh a awngsak-in van khempeuh' ni kiteh en ahi hi.

records.english: The old invoices in the filing cabinet need to be kept for five more years, according to our accountant.
records.zomi: I sum gelhpa' gen dan in file bawm sung-a invoice luite kum nga behlap kikem kul hi.

records.english: If we sort the tools by size, the new mechanics might find them more easily.
records.zomi: Nasep vante a lianzah tawh i khen leh mawtaw bawlpa thakte in a mu baih zaw kha ding uh hi.

records.english: Where do you keep all your work receipts?
records.zomi: Na nasep receipt khempeuh koi ah na koih hiam?

records.english: In a shoebox labeled by month, until I have time to scan them.
records.zomi: Kha tawh kigelh khedap bawm khat sungah, scan ding hun ka neih dong.

records.english: When I cleared out my desk after twelve years at the bank, I found letters from customers I'd forgotten about.
records.zomi: Bank ah kum sawm leh nih khit ciangin ka dawhkan ka siangsak ciangin ka mangngilh van leite' laite ka mu hi.

records.english: You're welcome to borrow the vacuum cleaner from the staff room, as long as you bring it back.
records.zomi: Na lohsak kik phial leh nasemte' khan pan vacuum cleaner na leitawi thei hi.

records.english: The whiteboard markers had all dried out, so the teacher had to borrow chalk.
records.zomi: Whiteboard marker khempeuh a keu khin ahih manin saya in chalk a leitawi kul hi.

records.english: No one is allowed to move the patients' files without signing for them.
records.zomi: Min suaksak lo-in kuamah in damlote' file a pemsak thei kei hi.

records.english: How do you keep your workbench so tidy?
records.zomi: Na nasep dawhkan bangci-in na siangsak den hiam?

records.english: Every tool goes back on its hook the moment I've finished with it.
records.zomi: Nasep van khempeuh ka zat zawh pah-in a ngetna ah ka khai kik hi.

records.english: Before the new term starts, I empty my son's school bag and throw out the crumpled worksheets.
records.zomi: Term thak a kipat ma-in ka tapa' sang ip ka awngsak a, lai kituapte ka paai hi.

records.english: Who's in charge of cleaning the staff room this week?
records.zomi: Hih kal sungin nasemte' khan siangsak kua' nasep ahi hiam?

records.english: According to the list on the door, it's the science teachers.
records.zomi: Kongkhak tung-a list ah science sayate ahi hi.

records.english: My manager asked me to organize the supply room so that we stop ordering things we already have.
records.zomi: I neihsa van i sap kik nawn loh nadingin ka manager in van koihna khan bawl siang dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: My wife cleared out the spare room so that I could run my business from home.
records.zomi: Inn pan ka sumbawlna ka kem theih nadingin ka zi in khan awng a siangsak hi.

records.english: My daughter tidied her desk every evening so that she could start her homework straight away the next day.
records.zomi: A zing ciangin pahtakin a inn-a sep ding a kipat theih nadingin ka tanu in nitak simin a dawhkan a siangsak hi.

records.english: Do you think I could leave the meeting early to pick up the kids?
records.zomi: Naupangte ka lak theih nadingin kikhopna pan hun ma-in ka pai khia thei ding in na ngaihsun hiam?

records.english: Could I swap my Monday shift with your Wednesday one?
records.zomi: Ka Pizing ni nasep hun na Nilai ni tawh ka kilai thei ding hiam?

records.english: May I leave at four today to attend my son's school concert?
records.zomi: Ka tapa' sang la poai ah ka pai theih nadingin tuni-in nai li ciangin ka pai khia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Could you answer the phones for me while I take the visitors around the school?
records.zomi: Hong vehte sang sung ka etsak laitakin kei adingin phone na dawng sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Every evening before closing, I wipe down the barber's chairs and sweep up the hair.
records.zomi: Nitak simin ka khak ma-in sam atna tutnate ka nul a, sam ka phiat hi.

records.english: My aunt finishes her shift at the hospital and goes straight to her evening class.
records.zomi: Ka ni in zato-a a nasep hun a zawh khit pah-in a nitak sang ah a pai hi.

records.english: With the school holidays starting, the office will be quieter, since many parents are taking time off.
records.zomi: Sang tawlngakni a kipat ahih manin nu leh pa tampi in khawl a la uh ahih manin office a dai zaw ding hi.

records.english: The church office is open on weekday mornings for anyone who needs help with forms.
records.zomi: Laikhawm gelh huhna kisam mite adingin pawlpi office ni sem ni zingsang simin kihong hi.

records.english: On market days, I set up my vegetable stall by six and pack it away at two.
records.zomi: Zuakna ni-in nai guk ciangin ka anteh zuakna ka bawl a, nai nih ciangin ka thun kik hi.

records.english: Please don't park in front of the clinic entrance, because the ambulance needs the space.
records.zomi: Ambulance in mun a kisam ahih manin clinic lutna mai ah mawtaw koih kei un.

records.english: Is it okay if I study for my exams during quiet hours at the reception desk?
records.zomi: Reception dawhkan ah dai hun-in ka sitna adingin ka kisin leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: The nurse checked on each patient, wrote up her notes, and handed over to the evening team.
records.zomi: Nurse in damlo khat ciat a en a, a gelhnate a gelh a, nitak pawl kiangah a ap hi.

records.english: Working at the post office means I know almost everyone in town by name.
records.zomi: Post office ah na ka sep manin khuapi sung mi tam zaw min tawh ka thei hi.

records.english: As an apprentice electrician, I spend the first hour of every day loading the van with cables and tools.
records.zomi: Electrician kisinpa ka hih manin ni simin nai masa pen van sungah khau leh nasep van ka thun hi.

records.english: The farm workers break for tea under the mango tree at ten every morning.
records.zomi: Lo nasemte zingsang nai sawm simin theihai kung nuai ah tea dawn dingin a khawl uh hi.

records.english: The night shift leaves a written report for us so that nothing is missed at handover.
records.zomi: Bangmah a mansuah loh nadingin zan nasem pawl in kote adingin report gelh a nusia uh hi.

records.english: How many hours a week do you work at the restaurant during term time?
records.zomi: Sang kah hun sungin an zuakna dawl ah kal khat-in nai bangzah na na sem hiam?

records.english: The school bell rang ten minutes late because the clock had stopped.
records.zomi: Nai-ten a khawl ahih manin sang khawng minit sawm nunin a ging hi.

records.english: Are students allowed to work more than twenty hours a week here?
records.zomi: Hih ah sangnaupangte kal khat-in nai sawmnih val na a sem thei uh hiam?

records.english: Students on work placement must not use the machines without a supervisor present.
records.zomi: Nasep kisinna-a sangnaupangte in a enkaipa a om loh leh machine te a zang thei kei ding uh hi.

records.english: Our office was flooded overnight, and everyone was sent home by nine.
records.zomi: Zanin i office ah tui a lut a, nai kua ciangin mi khempeuh inn ah kisawl kik hi.

records.english: Most of my working day is spent on the phone with suppliers.
records.zomi: Ka nasep ni a tam zaw van piakte tawh phone tungah ka zang hi.

records.english: Why do the teachers stay so late on Wednesdays?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Nilai ni ciangin sayate nai sau a om uh hiam?

records.english: That's when they have their weekly staff meeting.
records.zomi: Tua ni-in a kal sim nasemte kikhopna a nei uh hi.

records.english: You can't wear jewelry in the workshop, because it could get caught in the machines.
records.zomi: Machine te ah a bet kha thei ahih manin nasepna inn ah zeemna van na bulh thei kei hi.

records.english: Before the shop opens, the baker sets aside a loaf for the old man who comes in at nine.
records.zomi: Dawl a kihon ma-in moh bawlpa in nai kua ciangin hong pai pu upa adingin moh khat a koih tuam hi.

records.english: Being self-employed means my workday ends whenever the last customer leaves.
records.zomi: Keimah' nasep ka sep manin van lei nunung pen a pai ciangin ka nasep ni a bei hi.

records.english: The power was cut in the middle of the afternoon, so the tailor finished the dress by hand.
records.zomi: Nitak kimlai-in meivak a kitan ahih manin puan khuipa in puan pen khut tawh a zo hi.

records.english: Every afternoon, I collect the post for my elderly neighbor on my way back from the office.
records.zomi: Nitak simin office pan ka ciah lam ah ka inn veng upa' lai ka la sak hi.

records.english: During harvest, the whole village works in the fields from sunrise to sunset.
records.zomi: Buh lak hun ciangin khua bup ni suah pan ni tum dong lo ah na a sem uh hi.

records.english: Let the cleaner finish mopping before you walk across the hall.
records.zomi: Inn lian na kantan ma-in siangsak nu in lei a nul zawh masa hen.

records.english: I write my to-do list on the bus so that I can start working the moment I arrive.
records.zomi: Ka tun pah-in nasep ka kipat theih nadingin bus tungah ka sep ding list ka gelh hi.

records.english: Every morning at seven, our foreman reads out the jobs for the day.
records.zomi: Zingsang nai sagih simin i nasep makaipa in ni sung nasepte a sim hi.

records.english: If you finish your work early, could you help the new trainee with the filing?
records.zomi: Na nasep hun ma-in na zawh leh kisinpa thak file koih na huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: The bus driver said, "I've driven this route for twenty years, and I still enjoy it."
records.zomi: Bus tuansakpa in, “Hih lampi kum sawmnih sung ka mawng a, ka nuam sa lai hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: The fishermen in our village go out before dawn so that the catch reaches the market fresh.
records.zomi: Nga a thak lai-in zuakna mun a tun theih nadingin i khua nga manmite khua a vak ma-in a pai khia uh hi.

records.english: Unless the boat comes in early, we won't have any fish to sell before noon.
records.zomi: Tembaw hun ma-in a tun kei leh sun ma-in zuak ding nga i nei kei ding hi.

records.english: Please lock the storeroom whenever you leave it, even for a minute.
records.zomi: Minit khat bek hi zongin van koihna khan na paisan simin khak in.

records.english: My first week as a waiter, I dropped a tray of glasses and wanted to disappear.
records.zomi: An zuakna dawl nasem ka hih kal masa pen-in khuang kuang khat ka khia a, ka mang nuam hi.

records.english: No one is allowed on the factory floor without safety glasses.
records.zomi: Mit kemna mitlimlang om lo-in kuamah factory lei ah lut thei lo hi.

records.english: What does a typical day look like for a primary school teacher?
records.zomi: Sang neu saya adingin ni sung khat bangci ahi hiam?

records.english: Marking before the children arrive, teaching until three, and planning lessons after they leave.
records.zomi: Naupangte a tun ma-in ciamte koih, nai thum dong hilh, a pai khit uh ciangin hilh ding gel.

records.english: My cousin drives a delivery truck, so she has her lunch wherever she happens to be at noon.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu in van puak mawtaw lian a mawng ahih manin sun ciangin a omna mun ah a sun an a ne hi.

records.english: A new schedule was introduced last month, and nobody likes it.
records.zomi: Kha bei-in nasep hun thak kibawl a, kuamah in a deih kei hi.

records.english: Our pastor visits sick members of the church every Tuesday and Thursday afternoon.
records.zomi: I pastor in Pithai ni leh Laizing ni nitak simin pawlpi-a damlote a veh hi.

records.english: Do interns usually get a lunch break here?
records.zomi: Hih ah intern te in sun an khawl hun a ngah zel uh hiam?

records.english: Yes, an hour, but most of them eat quickly and go back to their desks.
records.zomi: Ngah uh hi, nai khat, ahi zongin a tam zaw in manlang takin a ne uh a, a dawhkan uh ah a ciah kik uh hi.

records.english: The bakery's oven broke down during the morning rush, and customers had to wait for bread.
records.zomi: Zingsang buai hun-in moh bawlna inn' oven a sia a, van leite in moh a ngak kul uh hi.

records.english: Running a small tea shop means getting up early, but I never get bored.
records.zomi: Tea dawl neu khat kem in zingsang manlang thou kul hi, ahi zongin ka lungkia ngei kei hi.

records.english: Our school caretaker unlocks the gates at six and checks every classroom before the students arrive.
records.zomi: I sang kemnu in nai guk ciangin kongpi a hong a, sangnaupangte a tun ma-un kilasi khempeuh a en hi.

records.english: Every few minutes, the cashier was interrupted by someone asking for directions.
records.zomi: Minit tawmno simin sum la nu pen lampi dongte in a khaktan uh hi.

records.english: Our lecturer told us, "Treat your internship like a real job, because it might become one."
records.zomi: I lecturer in, “Na internship pen nasep taktak bangin sem un, tua bang a suak kha ding hi,” hong ci hi.

records.english: When did you start working at the bank?
records.zomi: Bank ah bang hun pan na sep kipan hiam?

records.english: Straight after university, which is nearly twenty years ago now.
records.zomi: Sangpi ka zawh pah-in, tu-in kum sawmnih dek a cing khin hi.

records.english: Our team leader brings in fruit on Fridays for everyone in the office.
records.zomi: I pawl makaipa in Laithai ni simin office-a mi khempeuh adingin singgah a tawi hi.

records.english: To get to the mine on time, the workers catch a truck from the village at five.
records.zomi: Suang tukna mun ah hun takah a tun theih nadingun nasemte in nai nga ciangin khua pan mawtaw lian a tuang uh hi.

records.english: Halfway through my shift, the computer system crashed, and we had to write the orders by hand.
records.zomi: Ka nasep hun kimlai-in computer system a sia a, van sapnate khut tawh i gelh kul hi.

records.english: Phones must stay in our lockers during the shift, according to our supervisor.
records.zomi: I enkaipa' gen dan in nasep hun sungin phone te i locker sungah a om den kul hi.

records.english: My boss told me, "Take the morning off and come in after your graduation."
records.zomi: Ka makaipa in, “Zingsang khawl inla na sang zawhna khit ciangin hong pai in,” hong ci hi.

records.english: On Fridays the office closes at three so that staff can travel home for the weekend.
records.zomi: Nasemte kal tawp-in inn a ciah theih nadingun Laithai ni ciangin office nai thum ciangin kikhak hi.

records.english: When I worked at the hotel, I often got home at midnight and fell asleep in my uniform.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk ah na ka sep lai-in zan lai ciangin inn ka tung zel a, ka nasep puan tawh ka ihmu hi.

records.english: Please don't call me after ten unless it's urgent, because I start work at six.
records.zomi: Nai guk ciangin nasep ka kipan ahih manin a kinawh kei leh nai sawm khit ciangin hong sam kei in.

records.english: My son practices his reading aloud to me in bed, and it has helped him a lot at school.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in lupna tungah kei kiangah aw ngaih takin lai sim a kisin a, sang ah a huh mahmah hi.

records.english: After teaching all day, I'm too tired to read anything longer than a magazine before bed.
records.zomi: Ni bup ka hilh khit ciangin ka gim lua ahih manin lup ma-in magazine sangin a sau zaw bangmah ka sim zo kei hi.

records.english: After a long day of teaching, I'm too tired to read much before bed.
records.zomi: Ni sau hilh khit ciangin ka gim lua ahih manin lup ma-in tampi ka sim zo kei hi.

records.english: Can I stay up a little later to finish my science project?
records.zomi: Ka science project ka zawh theih nadingin tawmno ka khanglo sau thei ding hiam?

records.english: My husband irons his work shirt every night before bed.
records.zomi: Ka pasal in zan simin a lup ma-in a nasep puan a tut hi.

records.english: The alarm on my phone didn't go off, and I missed the first bus to work.
records.zomi: Ka phone alarm a ging kei ahih manin nasep ah bus masa pen ka mansuah hi.

records.english: The night bus was so quiet that I fell asleep and missed my stop.
records.zomi: Zan bus a dai lua ahih manin ka ihmu a, ka khawlna ka mansuah hi.

records.english: Is it all right if I leave the lamp on while I finish marking these essays?
records.zomi: Hih laigelhte ciamte ka koih zawh dong meivak hon den leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: Go ahead, but please don't be too late — you have an early class.
records.zomi: Hoih hi, ahi zongin a zan lua kei hen — zingsang manlang kilasi na nei hi.

records.english: Every night, my grandfather writes the next day's jobs on the farm in a small notebook.
records.zomi: Zan simin ka pu in a zing ciang lo nasep ding notebook neu khat ah a gelh hi.

records.english: My wife plans her lessons in bed while I read the newspaper beside her.
records.zomi: Ka zi lupna tungah a hilh ding a gel laitakin a kiang ah thuthak lai ka sim hi.

records.english: Every night, I put my laptop in another room so that I won't check my work emails in bed.
records.zomi: Lupna tungah ka nasep email ka en loh nadingin zan simin ka laptop khan dang ah ka koih hi.

records.english: Switching off my work phone at seven helps me stop worrying about the office at night.
records.zomi: Nai sagih ciangin ka nasep phone ka phel manin zanin office thu ka lungkham nawn kei hi.

records.english: Were you able to sleep in the train on the way back from the conference?
records.zomi: Kikhopna lian pan ciahna lam meileng tungah na ihmu thei hiam?

records.english: Only for an hour, because the man beside me snored the whole way.
records.zomi: Nai khat bek, ka kiang-a pa in lampi bup a ngawi ahih manin.

records.english: The night before a job interview, I hardly slept at all.
records.zomi: Nasep dotna zan ma-in ka ihmu kei dek hi.

records.english: Don't let your little sister fall asleep before she's brushed her teeth.
records.zomi: Na nau numei a ha a nuai ma-in a ihmut sak kei in.

records.english: Since I started university, I've been going to bed much later than I should.
records.zomi: Sangpi ka kah kipan pan ka lup ding hun sangin zan zawin ka lum hi.

records.english: "I'll wake you at five so you can revise," Mom promised the night before my exam.
records.zomi: “Na kisin kik theih nadingin nai nga ciangin kong phongkhia ding hi,” ci-in ka sitna zan ma-in Nu in a kiciam hi.

records.english: When the boarding school bell rang at nine, the whole corridor went quiet.
records.zomi: Giak-a kahna sang khawng nai kua ciangin a ging ciangin lampi khan bup a dai hi.

records.english: What's keeping you up so late on a work night?
records.zomi: Nasep ni zan ah bang in hong khanglo sak hiam?

records.english: I keep thinking about the presentation I have to give tomorrow.
records.zomi: Zingciang ka gen ding presentation ka ngaihsun den hi.

records.english: What time do the lights go out in your dormitory?
records.zomi: Na giakna inn ah nai bangzah ciangin meivak kiphel hiam?

records.english: Ten o'clock on school nights, and eleven on Saturdays.
records.zomi: Sang kah zan ciangin nai sawm, Kiginni ciangin nai sawm leh khat.

records.english: After a night shift, I sleep with thick curtains and earplugs so that the daytime noise doesn't wake me.
records.zomi: Zan nasep khit ciangin sun-a ging in hong khanglosak loh nadingin kongkhak puan tuh leh bil khakna tawh ka ihmu hi.

records.english: By the time I'd got home from my evening class, the baby had long since fallen asleep.
records.zomi: Nitak sang pan inn ka tun ciangin naungek a ihmu khin sau hi.

records.english: Could you quietly take the dog out before you go to bed, so that he doesn't wake us at dawn?
records.zomi: Khua vak ciangin hong khanglosak loh nadingin na lup ma-in dai takin ui polam ah na paipih thei ding hiam?

records.english: I do want to put the kids to bed myself on the nights I'm not working.
records.zomi: Na ka sep loh zan ciangin naupangte kei mah in ka lupsak ka deih taktak hi.

records.english: Would you read your little brother a story while I finish this report?
records.zomi: Hih report ka zawh laitakin na nau pasal adingin tangthu khat na sim sak ding hiam?

records.english: Our teacher said, "Sleep is more useful than an extra hour of study the night before a test."
records.zomi: I saya in, “Sitna zan ma-in nai khat behlap kisin sangin ihmut a phatuam zaw hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: My aunt goes to bed at eight because she bakes bread for the shop at three in the morning.
records.zomi: Ka ni in zingsang nai thum ciangin dawl adingin moh a bawl ahih manin nai giat ciangin a lum hi.

records.english: Shall I make you a cup of tea to take up while you finish your essay?
records.zomi: Na laigelh na zawh laitakin na tawi tou dingin tea khuang khat kong bawl sak ding hiam?

records.english: In our house, no one uses a screen in the hour before bed on school nights.
records.zomi: I inn ah sang kah zan-in lup ma nai khat sungin kuamah in screen a zang kei hi.

records.english: My little brother was so tired after his first week at school that he fell asleep during dinner.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal sang a kah kal masa pen khit ciangin a gim lua ahih manin nitak an laitakin a ihmu hi.

records.english: No phones in the bedroom is the rule my husband and I made for ourselves, not just the kids.
records.zomi: Lupna khan ah phone om lo ding cih pen ka pasal leh kei in naupangte bek hi lo-in eimah adingin zong i bawl thukhun ahi hi.

records.english: Night after night, I sat up with my son while he practiced his speech for the school competition.
records.zomi: Zan simin sang kidemna adingin ka tapa in a thugen a kisin laitakin a kiang ah ka tu hi.

records.english: If I don't write my ideas down at night, they're gone by the morning.
records.zomi: Zanin ka ngaihsutnate ka gelh kei leh zingsang ciangin a mang khin hi.

records.english: Can you set the alarm for six thirty, since I have the early meeting?
records.zomi: Zingsang manlang kikhopna ka neih manin nai guk leh a kim ciangin alarm na koih sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Did you put your football boots by the door for tomorrow's match?
records.zomi: Zingciang kimawlna adingin na football khedap kongkhak kiang ah na koih khin hiam?

records.english: On nights when I'm on call, I keep my clothes and car keys right next to the bed.
records.zomi: Hong sam theih zan ciangin ka puan leh ka mawtaw tawh lupna kiang tak ah ka koih hi.

records.english: You two, stop whispering and go to sleep — you have a school trip in the morning.
records.zomi: Note nih, kihopih guk khawl unla ihmu un — zingciang sang khualzinna na nei uh hi.

records.english: A storm knocked the electricity out during exam week, so we studied by candlelight before bed.
records.zomi: Sitna kal sungin huihpi in meivak a tan ahih manin lup ma-in khawimeivaak tawh i kisin hi.

records.english: Kids, your school clothes need to go in the laundry basket, not on the floor.
records.zomi: Naupangte, na sang puan uh lei ah hi lo-in puan nin koihna bawm ah koih un.

records.english: Our daughter fell asleep at her desk with her head on her math book.
records.zomi: I tanu a math laibu tungah a lu koih-in a dawhkan ah a ihmu hi.

records.english: My cousin works nights at the airport, so his bedtime is ten in the morning.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam vanlengtual ah zanin na a sem ahih manin zingsang nai sawm ciangin a lum hi.

records.english: I'd rather get up early to finish the report than stay up until midnight.
records.zomi: Zan lai dong khanglo sangin report zawh dingin manlang takin thou ka deih zaw hi.

records.english: My roommate's late-night typing kept me awake for most of the semester.
records.zomi: Ka khan kihawm lawm' zan lai typing in semester a tam zaw ka ihmusak kei hi.

records.english: Before I lie down, I lay out my nursing uniform and my name badge for the morning.
records.zomi: Ka lup ma-in zingsang adingin ka nurse puan leh ka min badge ka koih khin hi.

records.english: Shift workers often find it hard to sleep when the rest of the family is awake.
records.zomi: Kilaih nasep semte in innkuan a dangte a khanglo laitakin ihmut a haksa sa zel uh hi.

records.english: Let's go over your spelling words once more, and then it's lights out.
records.zomi: Na lai gelh dan kammalte vei khat i sim kik ding a, tua khit ciangin meivak phel hun ahi hi.

records.english: Lying awake before her first day at the new office, she went over the names of her new colleagues.
records.zomi: Office thak ah a ni masa pen ma-in khanglo-in a lum laitakin a nasem lawm thakte' min a phawk kik hi.

records.english: My son packs his school bag every night so that mornings are less of a rush.
records.zomi: Zingsang a buai tawm zawk nadingin ka tapa in zan simin a sang ip a thun hi.

records.english: The building site next to our flat starts work at seven, so I can never sleep in.
records.zomi: I inn kiang-a inn lamna mun nai sagih ciangin na a sem kipan ahih manin ka ihmut sau thei ngei kei hi.

records.english: Don't study in bed, or you'll fall asleep before you've finished the chapter.
records.zomi: Lupna tungah kisin kei in, ahih kei leh cangpi na zawh ma-in na ihmu ding hi.

records.english: If you finish your homework before eight, you can watch one program before bed.
records.zomi: Nai giat ma-in na inn-a sep ding na zawh leh na lup ma-in program khat na en thei hi.

records.english: At my student hostel, we aren't allowed to cook in our rooms after nine.
records.zomi: Ka sangnaupang hostel ah nai kua khit ciangin i khan sungah an i huan thei kei hi.

records.english: The children were tucked in early so that we could prepare for the school fair in peace.
records.zomi: Sang poai adingin dai taka i kibawl theih nadingin naupangte hun ma-in kilupsak hi.

records.english: Before bed, I check the children's homework and sign anything the teacher has sent home.
records.zomi: Lup ma-in naupangte' inn-a sep ding ka en a, saya' khak lai khempeuh ah min ka suaksak hi.

records.english: No one was at the till, so I had to wait ten minutes before I could pay.
records.zomi: Sum piakna mun ah kuamah a om kei ahih manin ka piak ma-in minit sawm ka ngak kul hi.

records.english: When I worked at the supermarket, I spent most evenings refilling the shelves.
records.zomi: Supermarket ah na ka sep lai-in nitak tam zaw dawh tungah van ka dimsak kik hi.

records.english: My cousin delivers groceries on a motorbike to pay for his engineering course.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in a engineering kisinna man piak nadingin motorbike tawh an a puak hi.

records.english: My son added up the prices in his head while we shopped, just like his teacher had taught him.
records.zomi: An i lei laitakin ka tapa in a saya' hilh bangin a lungsim sungah a man a kiplup hi.

records.english: The restaurant owner goes to the wholesale market at four in the morning to buy fish and vegetables.
records.zomi: An zuakna dawl neipa in nga leh anteh lei dingin zingsang nai li ciangin a tam zuakna mun ah a pai hi.

records.english: Picking up groceries for my elderly neighbor takes me only a few extra minutes after work.
records.zomi: Nasep khit ciangin ka inn veng upa adingin an lei pen minit tawmno bek hong la hi.

records.english: Don't let the shopkeeper add things to the bill that you didn't ask for.
records.zomi: Na ngen loh van dawl neipa in a man gelhna ah a koih sak kei hen.

records.english: Our office kitchen is stocked with tea, sugar, and milk every Monday.
records.zomi: I office anbuk ah Pizing ni simin tea, sugar leh nawi kidimsak hi.

records.english: Do you think the bakery will still have bread after my shift?
records.zomi: Ka nasep hun khit ciangin moh bawlna inn ah moh a om lai ding in na ngaihsun hiam?

records.english: The cashier at our corner shop is a university student who studies between customers.
records.zomi: I lampi kiang dawl-a sum la nu pen van leite kikal ah a kisin sangpi sangnaupang ahi hi.

records.english: Who's buying the drinks for the office party?
records.zomi: Office pawi adingin dawn ding kua in a lei ding hiam?

records.english: Finance said they would, as long as we keep the receipts.
records.zomi: Receipt i kep leh, sum kemna lam in a lei ding uh hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: Can we stop at the market after school to buy the things for my cooking class?
records.zomi: Ka an huan kisinna adingin vante lei dingin sang khit ciangin zuakna mun ah i khawl thei ding hiam?

records.english: My first job was packing bags at the supermarket, and I learned which items should never go together.
records.zomi: Ka nasep masa pen supermarket ah ip thun ahi a, bang vante kituah ngei lo ding hiam ka sin hi.

records.english: You two carry the light bags, and I'll take the heavy ones.
records.zomi: Note nih in ip zang puak unla, kei in a gik te ka puak ding hi.

records.english: Our teacher took us to the market and gave each group a small budget to buy ingredients for a soup.
records.zomi: I saya in zuakna mun ah hong paipih a, an-tui adingin vante lei dingin pawl khat ciat sum tawmno a pia hi.

records.english: Let's write the shopping list together, and you can find each item in the shop.
records.zomi: An lei ding list khawm-in gelh ni, nang in dawl sungah khat ciat na zong thei hi.

records.english: As a student, I buy rice and eggs in bulk so that my money lasts until the end of the month.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang ka hih manin ka sum kha tawp dong a cin theih nadingin buh leh aktui a tam takin ka lei hi.

records.english: Prices at the market were raised after the floods, and many families couldn't afford meat.
records.zomi: Tuiciim khit ciangin zuakna mun-a van man a kikhangsak a, innkuan tampi in sa a lei zo kei uh hi.

records.english: Would you mind getting the groceries this week, since I have exams?
records.zomi: Sitna ka neih manin hih kal an na lei thei ding hiam?

records.english: I do my grocery shopping during my lunch break because the shops are empty at noon.
records.zomi: Sun ciangin dawlte a awng ahih manin ka sun an khawl hun-in an ka lei hi.

records.english: Living on a teacher's salary has taught me to compare prices in every shop.
records.zomi: Saya kha man tawh ka nuntak manin dawl khempeuh ah man kiteh ka sin hi.

records.english: Students mustn't leave the group during the market visit.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun veh laitakin sangnaupangte in a pawl uh a paisan kei ding uh hi.

records.english: Every month, our church collects groceries for students who are far from home.
records.zomi: Kha simin i pawlpi in inn pan gamla-a om sangnaupangte adingin an a kaikhawm hi.

records.english: My manager sends me to the shop every morning to buy milk for the office.
records.zomi: Ka manager in zingsang simin office adingin nawi lei dingin dawl ah hong sawl hi.

records.english: The milk delivery was late, so the shelves were empty when I arrived.
records.zomi: Nawi puakte a nun ahih manin ka tun ciangin dawhte a awng hi.

records.english: By the time my shift ended, the only shop still open was the little one at the gas station.
records.zomi: Ka nasep hun a bei ciangin a kihong lai dawl pen dat zuakna mun-a dawl neu bek ahi hi.

records.english: Buying for a family of six on one salary means I plan every meal before I shop.
records.zomi: Kha man khat tawh mi guk innkuan adingin van lei in ka lei ma-in an khempeuh ka gel hi.

records.english: Every Friday, my husband buys the week's groceries on his way back from the factory.
records.zomi: Laithai ni simin ka pasal in factory pan a ciah lam ah kal khat an a lei hi.

records.english: I bought my mother's groceries and paid her electricity bill with my first paycheck.
records.zomi: Ka kha man masa pen tawh ka nu' an ka lei a, a meivak man ka pia hi.

records.english: The eggs were all broken by the time I got them back from the market on my bicycle.
records.zomi: Siiksakol tawh zuakna mun pan ka tawi kik ciangin aktui khempeuh a kitam khin hi.

records.english: Could you buy some biscuits for the staff meeting on your way to the office?
records.zomi: Office na pai lam ah nasemte kikhopna adingin biscuit tawmno na lei thei ding hiam?

records.english: Doing the shopping together on Saturdays is the only time my teenage daughter and I really talk.
records.zomi: Kiginni simin khawm-a an lei pen ka tanu khangno leh kei i kiho taktak hun bek ahi hi.

records.english: We had a stall at the school fair, so I bought twenty kilos of flour and baked all weekend.
records.zomi: Sang poai ah dawl khat i nei ahih manin buh-mal kilo sawmnih ka lei a, kal tawp bup moh ka bawl hi.

records.english: The parents' committee bought all the food for the school picnic from one wholesaler to save money.
records.zomi: Sum a khol nadingin nu leh pate' committee in sang picnic an khempeuh a tam zuakpa khat pan a lei hi.

records.english: Children, nobody touches the fruit unless you're going to buy it.
records.zomi: Naupangte, na lei ding hi kei leh kuamah in singgah khoih kei un.

records.english: Running a small grocery shop means I'm always the last person in the village to eat dinner.
records.zomi: An dawl neu khat ka kem manin khua sung ah nitak an a ne nunung pen ka hi tawntung hi.

records.english: When the supermarket where I work closes on Sunday evening, the leftover bread is given to a shelter.
records.zomi: Ka sepna supermarket Nipini nitak a kikhak ciangin a taang moh mi gimte' om sakna ah kipia hi.

records.english: Grandma said, "Buy what's in season, and you'll never pay too much."
records.zomi: Pi in, “A hun a tung van lei in, a man tam lua na pia ngei lo ding hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: I ordered the groceries on my phone during the meeting, and they arrived before I got home.
records.zomi: Kikhopna laitakin ka phone tawh an ka sap a, inn ka tun ma-in a tung hi.

records.english: On payday, the supermarket is always much busier than usual.
records.zomi: Kha man ngah ni-in supermarket a dang sangin a buai zaw tawntung hi.

records.english: I left my shopping list at the office, so I had to guess what we needed.
records.zomi: An lei ding list office ah ka nusia ahih manin i kisap ka khen kul hi.

records.english: Kids, choose one snack each for your school bag, and then we're going.
records.zomi: Naupangte, na sang ip adingin nek ding neu khat ciat teel unla, i pai ding hi.

records.english: Can someone help me carry these boxes of supplies to the school kitchen?
records.zomi: Hih van bawmte sang anbuk ah ka puak nadingin kuamah in hong huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Please don't put the cold things in the same bag as the cleaning products.
records.zomi: Van vote siangsakna vante tawh ip khat ah koih kei in.

records.english: Since I started working nights, I buy my groceries at seven in the morning on my way home.
records.zomi: Zan nasep ka sep kipat pan inn ka ciah lam ah zingsang nai sagih ciangin an ka lei hi.

records.english: Is there a shop near the office where I can buy fresh fruit?
records.zomi: Office kiang ah singgah thak ka lei theihna dawl a om hiam?

records.english: The bags split on the way to the bus stop, and my apples rolled across the road.
records.zomi: Bus khawlna ka pai lam ah ip a kikek a, ka apple te lampi tungah a kiliamliam hi.

records.english: My wife buys fresh fish from the boats on her way to the clinic, then puts it in the fridge at work.
records.zomi: Ka zi in clinic a pai lam ah tembaw pan nga thak a lei a, nasepna khal bawm ah a koih hi.

records.english: Staff at the shop where I work get a small discount on bread at the end of the day.
records.zomi: Ka sepna dawl-a nasemte in ni tawp ciangin moh man niamsak a ngah uh hi.

records.english: Why does everything cost more in the shop next to the university?
records.zomi: Bang hangin sangpi kiang dawl ah na khempeuh a man sang zaw hiam?

records.english: If you're near the market after work, could you buy a kilo of tomatoes?
records.zomi: Nasep khit ciangin zuakna mun kiang ah na om leh khamtung kilo khat na lei thei ding hiam?

records.english: Are you allowed to use the company car for personal shopping?
records.zomi: Company mawtaw keimah' van lei dingin na zang thei hiam?

records.english: Only on the way home, and we have to pay for the extra fuel.
records.zomi: Inn ciahna lam ah bek, a behlap dat man i pia kul hi.

records.english: The rice I bought for the school kitchen had insects in it, so I took it back.
records.zomi: Sang anbuk adingin ka lei buh ah lawng a om ahih manin ka lohsak kik hi.

records.english: Where does the school kitchen buy its vegetables?
records.zomi: Sang anbuk in a anteh koi pan a lei hiam?

records.english: From two farmers nearby, who deliver every Monday and Thursday.
records.zomi: Kiang-a lo nei nih pan, Pizing ni leh Laizing ni simin hong tawi uh hi.

records.english: What do you usually buy for the children's school lunches?
records.zomi: Naupangte' sang sun an adingin bang na lei zel hiam?

records.english: Bread, cheese, fruit, and something small as a treat on Fridays.
records.zomi: Moh, cheese, singgah, Laithai ni ciangin nek nuam neu khat.

records.english: The new supermarket hired forty people from our town, including two of my former students.
records.zomi: Supermarket thak in i khuapi pan mi sawmli a sap a, ka sangnaupang lui nih zong kihel hi.

records.english: The price of the graduation photos was a shock to most of the parents.
records.zomi: Sang zawhna lim man in nu leh pa tam zaw a lamdangsak hi.

records.english: Asking the right price for your work is hard when you're just starting out.
records.zomi: Na kipat thak laitakin na nasep adingin a man dik ngen a haksa hi.

records.english: What's the difference in price between the morning and evening classes?
records.zomi: Zingsang leh nitak kilasite' man kikhiatna bang ahi hiam?

records.english: What do you charge per hour for math tutoring?
records.zomi: Math hilhna nai khat-in bangzah na ngen hiam?

records.english: Fifteen dollars, or twelve if you book a whole month.
records.zomi: Dollar sawm leh nga, ahih kei leh kha khat bup na bawl leh sawm leh nih.

records.english: Nobody at the office knew the price of the new printer ink, so we ordered it without asking.
records.zomi: Printer ink thak man office-a kuamah in a thei kei uh ahih manin dong lo-in i sap hi.

records.english: A new price list was printed for the café, but the old one was still on the wall.
records.zomi: Cafe adingin man list thak kisuaksak a, ahi zongin a lui bang tungah a om lai hi.

records.english: Don't be afraid to ask what a course costs before you apply.
records.zomi: Na ngen ma-in kisinna khat a man bangzah hiam dong lau kei in.

records.english: Comparing prices for school supplies, I found that the big shop wasn't always the cheapest.
records.zomi: Sang van man ka kiteh ciangin dawl lian in a man neu pen tawntung kei hi, ka mu hi.

records.english: The restaurant changes its prices so often that the waiters write them on a board each morning.
records.zomi: An zuakna dawl in a man a khel den lua ahih manin a nasemte in zingsang simin bang lai tungah a gelh uh hi.

records.english: Could you check whether the price includes delivery to our office?
records.zomi: A man ah i office dong puak man a kihel hiam na en thei ding hiam?

records.english: Can I get a discount if I buy uniforms for all three children at once?
records.zomi: Naupang thum tengteng adingin sang puan vei khat-in ka lei leh a man ka niamsak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Excuse me, is the price on this calculator correct, or is it a mistake?
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, hih calculator tung-a man a man hiam, a khial hiam?

records.english: Before I sign up, can you tell me what the exam fee is?
records.zomi: Ka min ka gelh ma-in sitna man bangzah hiam hong gen thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Is that the price per student or for the whole class?
records.zomi: Tua man pen sangnaupang khat ciat ading hiam, kilasi bup ading hiam?

records.english: The fees for my daughter's university were raised twice in three years.
records.zomi: Ka tanu' sangpi man kum thum sungin vei nih kikhangsak hi.

records.english: Students, please don't pay any money for the uniform until the school confirms the price.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, sang in a man a gen ma-in sang puan adingin sum pia nai kei un.

records.english: Is it cheaper to buy a monthly train ticket if I travel to work every day?
records.zomi: Ni simin meileng tawh nasep ah ka pai leh kha khat ticket lei a man neu zaw ding hiam?

records.english: Much cheaper — it pays for itself in about two weeks.
records.zomi: A neu zaw mahmah hi — kal nih bang sungin a man a kik hi.

records.english: My brother priced every item in his new shop by hand, using a pen and a pile of little stickers.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal in a dawl thak sung-a van khempeuh a man pen sticker neute tawh a khut mah in a koih hi.

records.english: Could you give me a written quote for repairing the school roof?
records.zomi: Sang inn tung bawlna man laikhawm tawh hong pia thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: The price of the school trip was announced, and several parents said they couldn't afford it.
records.zomi: Sang khualzinna man kigen a, nu leh pa tampi in a pia zo kei ding uh hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: The customer asked for a price before I'd even finished measuring the room.
records.zomi: Khan ka teh zawh ma-in van leipa in a man a dong hi.

records.english: How much do the textbooks for next term cost altogether?
records.zomi: Term zom laibute a vekpi-in bangzah a man hiam?

records.english: About sixty dollars, but you can borrow some of them from the library.
records.zomi: Dollar sawmguk bang, ahi zongin khenkhat laibu inn pan na leitawi thei hi.

records.english: Our boss asked three printing companies for prices before choosing one for the brochures.
records.zomi: Brochure te adingin khat a teel ma-in i makaipa in lai suaksak company thum kiangah a man a dong hi.

records.english: Mr. Kam asked the carpenter for a price, and then asked his brother-in-law for a cheaper one.
records.zomi: Mr. Kam in sing seempa kiangah a man a dong a, tua khit ciangin a man neu zaw khat a sanggam nu' pasal kiangah a dong hi.

records.english: Can you tell me how much the driving lessons are before I book?
records.zomi: Ka bawl ma-in mawtaw mawng kisinna bangzah a man hiam hong gen thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: When the mechanic told me the price of the repair, I asked him to explain each part of it.
records.zomi: Mawtaw bawlpa in a bawl man hong gen ciangin a tan khat ciat hong gen siang dingin ka ngen hi.

records.english: My first week at the shop, I told a customer the wrong price and had to pay the difference myself.
records.zomi: Dawl ah ka kal masa pen-in van leipa khat kiangah man khial ka gen a, a kikhiatna kei mah in ka pia kul hi.

records.english: Ask the price before you agree to anything, especially with a new supplier.
records.zomi: Bangmah na lem ma-in a man dong in, a tuam in van piakpa thak tawh.

records.english: Most of my customers ask the price first and then decide whether they want to hear about the product.
records.zomi: Ka van leite a tam zaw in a man a dong masa uh a, tua khit ciangin van thu a zak nuam uh hiam a khensat uh hi.

records.english: Our supervisor said, "If a customer asks about discounts, send them to me."
records.zomi: I enkaipa in, “Van leipa khat in man niamsak thu a dot leh kei kiangah sawl un,” a ci hi.

records.english: We really do need a new projector for the classroom, but not at that price.
records.zomi: Kilasi adingin projector thak i kisam taktak hi, ahi zongin tua man tawh hi lo-in.

records.english: How much do apprentices usually earn in their first year?
records.zomi: Nasep kisinte in a kum masa pen-in bangzah a ngah zel uh hiam?

records.english: It depends on the trade, so ask at the training center.
records.zomi: Nasep nam tawh kizui ahih manin kisinna mun ah dong in.

records.english: Is the price the same for international students?
records.zomi: Gamdang sangnaupangte adingin a man kibang hiam?

records.english: Why is the same lab coat cheaper in the shop outside the hospital?
records.zomi: Bang hangin lab coat kibang mah zato polam dawl ah a man neu zaw hiam?

records.english: A cup of tea in the staff canteen costs less than a bus ticket.
records.zomi: Nasemte' canteen ah tea khuang khat in bus ticket sangin a man neu zaw hi.

records.english: Hearing what the private school charged, we decided to stay with our local one.
records.zomi: Private sang' man i zak ciangin i khua sang ah om den dingin i khensat hi.

records.english: I do want to join the computer course, but I need to know the full cost first.
records.zomi: Computer kisinna ah ka kihel nuam taktak hi, ahi zongin a man bup ka theih masa kul hi.

records.english: Is lunch included in the price of the training day?
records.zomi: Kisinna ni man ah sun an a kihel hiam?

records.english: My manager doesn't let us change prices without her permission.
records.zomi: Ka manager in amah' phalna om lo-in man i khel ding a phal kei hi.

records.english: The book price went up halfway through the term, and nobody told the students.
records.zomi: Term kimlai-in laibu man a khang a, kuamah in sangnaupangte kiangah a gen kei uh hi.

records.english: Is printing expensive at the university library?
records.zomi: Sangpi laibu inn ah lai suaksak a man sang hiam?

records.english: At this restaurant we're not allowed to accept tips, so please don't leave any money on the table.
records.zomi: Hih an zuakna dawl ah tip i sang thei kei ahih manin dawhkan tungah sum nusia kei un.

records.english: Excuse me, everyone — the price for the workshop has changed, so please check your emails.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, hong maisak un — workshop man a kikhel ahih manin na email uh en un.

records.english: Do you charge extra for coming out on weekends?
records.zomi: Kal tawp-in na hong pai ciangin behlap na ngen hiam?

records.english: The cost of the conference was split between the company and the employees who went.
records.zomi: Kikhopna lian man pen company leh a pai nasemte' kikal ah kihawm hi.

records.english: When I started selling cakes from home, I had no idea how much to charge.
records.zomi: Inn pan cake ka zuak kipat ciangin bangzah ka ngen ding hiam ka thei kei hi.

records.english: If you tell me your budget, I can suggest a laptop that's good enough for university.
records.zomi: Na zat ding sum hong gen leh sangpi adingin a hoih zah laptop khat kong gen thei hi.

records.english: Do you give a student discount on bus passes?
records.zomi: Bus pass ah sangnaupang man niamsak na pia hiam?

records.english: How much does it cost to have my certificates translated for the job application?
records.zomi: Nasep ngetna adingin ka lai-ciamte let sak man bangzah hiam?

records.english: Did the school say how much the exam would cost?
records.zomi: Sitna man bangzah ding hiam sang in a gen hiam?

records.english: The farmer asked what the shop would pay him for a full truck of potatoes.
records.zomi: Lo neipa in alu mawtaw lian dim khat adingin dawl in bangzah a pia ding hiam a dong hi.

records.english: When I asked how much the nursing course cost, I nearly fell off my chair.
records.zomi: Nursing kisinna man bangzah hiam ka dot ciangin ka tutna pan ka kia dek hi.

records.english: Don't tell customers a price until you've checked it on the computer.
records.zomi: Computer tungah na en masa kei leh van leite kiangah man gen kei in.

records.english: Prices in the school canteen went up again, so more students are bringing food from home.
records.zomi: Sang canteen-a man a khang kik ahih manin sangnaupang tam zaw in inn pan an a tawi uh hi.

records.english: What would you charge for thirty T-shirts for our school team?
records.zomi: I sang pawl adingin T-shirt sawmthum bangzah na ngen ding hiam?

records.english: The music teacher told us that a good secondhand violin would cost less than a new cheap one.
records.zomi: Violin hoih kizang khin khat in a man neu thak khat sangin a man neu zaw ding hi, ci-in la saya in hong gen hi.

records.english: The coin machine in the laundry room swallowed my money again.
records.zomi: Puan sawpna khan-a dangka machine in ka sum a val kik hi.

records.english: I do want to pay you back for the textbook, so please tell me how much it cost.
records.zomi: Laibu man kong lohsak kik nuam taktak ahih manin bangzah a man hiam hong gen in.

records.english: The tips from the whole week were shared equally among the kitchen staff.
records.zomi: Kal bup tip te anbuk nasemte' kikal ah a kibang in kihawm hi.

records.english: When the tutor refused to take my money, I bought her a box of chocolates instead.
records.zomi: Hilhnu in ka sum a sang nuam kei ciangin a sikin chocolate bawm khat ka lei sak hi.

records.english: How do I get my money back for the bus tickets I bought for the conference?
records.zomi: Kikhopna lian adingin ka lei bus ticket man bangci-in ka la kik ding hiam?

records.english: Fill in this form, attach the tickets, and give it to the finance office.
records.zomi: Hih lai dimsak inla, ticket te behlap inla, sum kemna office ah pia in.

records.english: There's no change in the machine, so you'll need the exact amount.
records.zomi: Machine sungah sum kik om lo ahih manin a man kim ngiat na kisam ding hi.

records.english: Not until the new bursar arrived did anyone notice that the school's cash box had been miscounted for months.
records.zomi: Sang sum kemna thak a tun dong sang sum bawm kha tampi sung a kisim khialh kuamah in a thei kei uh hi.

records.english: I gave the boy at the market too much money, and he ran after me to return it.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun ah naupang pasal kiangah sum tam lua ka pia a, lohsak kik dingin hong delh hi.

records.english: Let the children pay, so they can practice counting the change.
records.zomi: Naupangte in sum kik sim a kisin theih nadingun amaute pia sak un.

records.english: My daughter's first job at the bakery taught her to give change quickly and politely.
records.zomi: Ka tanu' moh bawlna inn-a a nasep masa pen in manlang taka leh zahtak taka sum kik piak a hilh hi.

records.english: May I pay for the uniform in two parts, half now and half next month?
records.zomi: Sang puan man a nih in ka pia thei ding hiam, a kim tu-in, a kim kha hong ding ciangin?

records.english: Can you split the bill between the three departments?
records.zomi: A man pen department thum kikal ah na khen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Could you pay the electricity bill at the post office on your lunch break?
records.zomi: Na sun an khawl hun-in post office ah meivak man na pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: My boss said, "Count your till in front of a colleague so there's never any doubt."
records.zomi: Ka makaipa in, “Buaina a om ngei loh nadingin nasem lawm khat mai ah na sum bawm sim in,” a ci hi.

records.english: When I worked at the petrol station, I learned to spot a fake note by feeling the paper.
records.zomi: Dat zuakna mun ah na ka sep lai-in lai a khoih-in laidang zuau theih dan ka sin hi.

records.english: At the end of my shift, the money in the till was ten dollars short, and I had to count it all again.
records.zomi: Ka nasep hun tawp ciangin sum bawm sung-a sum dollar sawm a tawm a, a bup in ka sim kik kul hi.

records.english: The card machine stopped working at lunchtime, so we could only take cash for the rest of the day.
records.zomi: Sun an hun-in card machine a sem nawn kei ahih manin ni bup sum taktak bek i sang thei hi.

records.english: Students, check your change before you leave the canteen counter, because mistakes can't be fixed later.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, khialhnate a nung ciangin bawl kik theih lo ahih manin canteen dawhkan na paisan ma-un na sum kik uh en un.

records.english: Did the customer pay for the bread, or did she say she'd pay tomorrow?
records.zomi: Van leinu in moh man a pia hiam, zingciang ka pia ding a ci hiam?

records.english: Having worked in a bank for years, Grandpa still counts every note twice.
records.zomi: Kum tampi bank ah na a sep ngei ahih manin Pu in laidang khempeuh nihvei a sim lai hi.

records.english: The waiter brought back my change on a little plate and wished me a good evening.
records.zomi: An zuakna dawl nasem in kuang neu khat tungah ka sum kik hong tawi a, nitak nuam deihsakna hong gen hi.

records.english: Why does the school want the fees paid in cash this year?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tu kum sang in sang man sum taktak tawh piak a deih hiam?

records.english: Nobody had small change at the school fair, so sales were slow at first.
records.zomi: Sang poai ah kuamah in sum kik neu a nei kei uh ahih manin a kipatna ah zuakna a manlang kei hi.

records.english: Who pays for the taxi when we visit clients?
records.zomi: Clients i veh ciangin taxi man kua in a pia hiam?

records.english: You pay, keep the receipt, and the company pays you back at the end of the month.
records.zomi: Nang na pia a, receipt na kem a, kha tawp ciangin company in hong lohsak kik hi.

records.english: Can I pay for the photocopies with coins?
records.zomi: Photocopy man dangka tawh ka pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: When the canteen started using cards instead of cash, the queues got much shorter.
records.zomi: Canteen in sum taktak sangin card a zat kipat ciangin kizomte a tom zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: All of you need to bring the money for the museum trip in an envelope with your name on it.
records.zomi: Note khempeuh in museum khualzinna sum na min kigelh lai-ip sungah na tawi kul uh hi.

records.english: Excuse me, I think you've given me change for a twenty, but I gave you a fifty.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, sawmnih ading sum kik hong pia hi ka sa a, ahi zongin sawmnga kong pia hi.

records.english: Our office keeps a little petty cash for things like stamps and milk.
records.zomi: I office in stamp leh nawi bang adingin sum neu tawmno a kem hi.

records.english: If you pay your fees before the first day of term, you get a small discount.
records.zomi: Term ni masa pen ma-in na sang man na piak leh man tawmno kiniamsak hi.

records.english: Every Friday, the market traders count their coins and take them to the bank in cloth bags.
records.zomi: Laithai ni simin zuakna mun-a zuakte in a dangka uh a sim uh a, puan ip tawh bank ah a puak uh hi.

records.english: The bank took the course fee from my account twice.
records.zomi: Bank in ka account pan kisinna man vei nih a la hi.

records.english: Where do I pay the school fees?
records.zomi: Sang man koi ah ka pia ding hiam?

records.english: At the office next to the main gate, before the end of the month.
records.zomi: Kongpi lian kiang-a office ah, kha tawp ma-in.

records.english: You have to sign for your wages when you're paid in cash.
records.zomi: Sum taktak tawh na kha man kipiak ciangin min na suaksak kul hi.

records.english: Mr. Lian paid the carpenter half before the work started and half when it was finished.
records.zomi: Mr. Lian in sing seempa nasep a kipat ma-in a kim a pia a, a zawh ciangin a kim a pia hi.

records.english: My son paid for his own school shoes with the money he earned washing cars.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in mawtaw sil-a a ngah sum tawh amah' sang khedap man a pia hi.

records.english: If you've finished your shift, could you count the coins and put them in the safe?
records.zomi: Na nasep hun na zawh khin leh dangkate sim inla sum bawm hat sungah na koih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Do you have smaller notes, since I don't have change for a hundred yet this morning?
records.zomi: Tu zingsang za khat adingin sum kik ka nei nai kei ahih manin laidang neu zaw na nei hiam?

records.english: Our manager pays for the team's coffee when we've had a good month.
records.zomi: Kha hoih khat i neih ciangin i manager in pawl bup' kawfi man a pia hi.

records.english: My first paycheck was so small that I counted it three times to make sure.
records.zomi: Ka kha man masa pen a neu lua ahih manin a man hiam ka theih nadingin vei thum ka sim hi.

records.english: On my first day as a cashier, my manager taught me to count the change back into the customer's hand.
records.zomi: Sum la ka hih ni masa pen-in ka manager in sum kik van leipa' khut sungah sim kik-a piak dan hong hilh hi.

records.english: To help us learn about money, our teacher turned the classroom into a pretend shop for a day.
records.zomi: Sum thu i sin theih nadingin i saya in ni khat sung kilasi pen dawl ki-bawl tawh a bawl hi.

records.english: Our school shop is run by students, and they're very careful with the change.
records.zomi: I sang dawl sangnaupangte in a kem uh a, sum kik ah a pilvang mahmah uh hi.

records.english: Whoever takes money at the stall has to write every sale in the notebook.
records.zomi: Dawl-a sum a la kua peuh in zuak khempeuh notebook sungah a gelh kul hi.

records.english: Sorry, I'm new here — could you wait a moment while I check the price and your change?
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, hih ah ka thak hi — a man leh na sum kik ka en laitakin hun tawmno hong ngak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: My aunt pays the farm workers in cash every Saturday afternoon, under the tree by the house.
records.zomi: Ka ni in Kiginni nitak simin inn kiang singkung nuai ah lo nasemte sum taktak tawh a pia hi.

records.english: Please write your name on the back of every receipt before you hand it in.
records.zomi: Na piak ma-in receipt khempeuh' nung lam ah na min gelh in.

records.english: All the payments were recorded in the computer, but the printer was out of paper, so no receipts were printed.
records.zomi: Sum piakna khempeuh computer sungah kigelh a, ahi zongin printer ah lai a bei ahih manin receipt kisuaksak thei lo hi.

records.english: Kids, give the driver the exact fare so that he doesn't have to find change.
records.zomi: Naupangte, sum kik a zon kul loh nadingin tuansakpa kiangah a man kim ngiat pia un.

records.english: I really do trust our cashier, but we still check the till together every night.
records.zomi: I sum la nu ka muang taktak hi, ahi zongin zan simin sum bawm khawm-in i en lai hi.

records.english: Our wages are paid into our bank accounts on the last Friday of the month.
records.zomi: I kha man kha nunung Laithai ni ciangin i bank account ah kikoih hi.

records.english: Is there a fee for paying the tuition by card?
records.zomi: Sang man card tawh piak ciangin a behlap man a om hiam?

records.english: There's a small charge, so most parents pay by bank transfer instead.
records.zomi: Behlap man tawmno a om ahih manin nu leh pa a tam zaw in bank transfer tawh a pia uh hi.

records.english: We're paid weekly at the factory, which makes it easier to plan the family's spending.
records.zomi: Factory ah kal simin kha man i ngah ahih manin innkuan sum zat ding gel a baih zaw hi.

records.english: A customer left without her change, so I put it in an envelope in case she came back.
records.zomi: Van leinu khat a sum kik nusia-in a pai ahih manin a hong ciah kik kha leh ci-in lai-ip sungah ka koih hi.

records.english: The shop's float is counted every morning before the doors open.
records.zomi: Dawl kongkhak kihon ma-in zingsang simin sum bawm-a sum kipat ding kisim hi.

records.english: The salary was paid late this month because the bank's system was down.
records.zomi: Bank system a sia ahih manin tu kha kha man a nun hi.

records.english: When I worked at the returns desk, most of my day was spent checking boxes and printing refund slips.
records.zomi: Van lohsak kikna dawhkan ah na ka sep lai-in ka ni sung a tam zaw bawmte en leh sum lohsak kikna lai suaksak in ka zang hi.

records.english: My new work boots gave me blisters within a week, so I asked the shop whether they'd take them back.
records.zomi: Ka nasep khedap thak in kal khat sungin ka khe a vuisak ahih manin a la kik ding uh hiam dawl ah ka dong hi.

records.english: The shop wouldn't take back the school bag because my nephew had written his name on it in marker.
records.zomi: Ka tanau in marker tawh a min a gelh ahih manin dawl in sang ip a la kik kei hi.

records.english: You'll need the order number, so don't throw away the email.
records.zomi: Order nambat na kisam ding ahih manin email paai kei in.

records.english: If the company gave you the wrong uniform, you shouldn't have to pay to send it back.
records.zomi: Company in sang puan khial hong piak leh lohsak kik nadingin na pia kul kei ding hi.

records.english: Did you return the extra paint we didn't use on the classroom walls?
records.zomi: Kilasi bang tungah i zat loh lim khai behlap na lohsak kik hiam?

records.english: Not every shop will take back things that were bought for a business, so ask first.
records.zomi: Sumbawlna adinga a kilei vante dawl khempeuh in a la kik kei uh ahih manin a masa-in dong in.

records.english: Please check the textbooks carefully before you sign for the delivery.
records.zomi: Puakna adingin min na suaksak ma-in laibute limtakin en in.

records.english: If the course books aren't needed after all, can I get my money back?
records.zomi: Kisinna laibute kisam lo ahih leh ka sum ka ngah kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: The bookshop sold me last year's edition of the textbook, so I took it back the next morning.
records.zomi: Laibu dawl in kum bei-a suak laibu hong zuak ahih manin a zing zingsangin ka lohsak kik hi.

records.english: The bakery's new mixer was replaced after the motor burned out in the first week.
records.zomi: Kal masa pen-in a motor a kan khit ciangin moh bawlna inn' mixer thak a thak tawh kilai hi.

records.english: Our caretaker measured the doorway with a tape measure and found that the new cupboard would never fit.
records.zomi: I sang kemnu in tape measure tawh kongkhak a teh a, bawm thak a kilawm ngei lo ding a mu hi.

records.english: We sent the school photos back because every child's name was spelled wrong.
records.zomi: Naupang khempeuh' min kigelh khialh ahih manin sang limte i khak kik hi.

records.english: Why did the school send the new desks back?
records.zomi: Bang hangin sang in dawhkan thakte a khak kik hiam?

records.english: They were too low for the older children.
records.zomi: Naupang upa zawte adingin a niam lua hi.

records.english: The returns counter was so busy after the holidays that the shop hired extra staff.
records.zomi: Tawlngakni khit ciangin van lohsak kikna dawhkan a buai lua ahih manin dawl in nasem behlap a sap hi.

records.english: My first week in customer service, an angry man returned a kettle that he had clearly dropped.
records.zomi: Van leite huhna-a ka kal masa pen-in mi heh khat in a khiat kha kician tui-ukbel a lohsak kik hi.

records.english: Mr. Hau returned the suit he'd bought for his interview, because the trousers were too short.
records.zomi: Mr. Hau in a dotna adingin a lei suit pen a khebai a tom lua ahih manin a lohsak kik hi.

records.english: Is it easier to return things you've bought online or in a shop?
records.zomi: Online pan na lei vante hiam, dawl pan na lei hiam, bang a lohsak kik a baih zaw hiam?

records.english: Is it worth returning a pen that only cost a dollar?
records.zomi: Dollar khat bek a man ciangun khat lohsak kik a phatuam hiam?

records.english: All of you who received the wrong T-shirt size can swap it at the sports office.
records.zomi: T-shirt lianzah khial na ngah khempeuh kimawlna office ah na lai thei uh hi.

records.english: Taking back the uniform, my daughter realized she had cut off the label, and the shop refused it.
records.zomi: Sang puan a lohsak kik ciangin ka tanu in a label a at khin a thei a, dawl in a nial hi.

records.english: Students, if your uniform doesn't fit, bring it back in its bag by Friday.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, na sang puan uh a kilawm kei leh Laithai ni ma-in a ip tawh lohsak kik un.

records.english: Before you return the printer, could you print the last of my reports?
records.zomi: Printer na lohsak kik ma-in ka report nunungte hong suaksak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Can you tell me the shop's return policy before I order thirty desks?
records.zomi: Dawhkan sawmthum ka sap ma-in dawl' lohsak kikna thukhun hong gen thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: I do want to give the shop a chance to fix the problem before I ask for my money back.
records.zomi: Ka sum ka ngen kik ma-in dawl in buaina a bawl kik theih nading hun piak ka deih taktak hi.

records.english: Our teacher kept the receipt for the class microscope, which was lucky, because the light broke after a month.
records.zomi: I saya in kilasi microscope receipt a kem a, kha khat khit ciangin a meivak a sia ahih manin vangphatna ahi hi.

records.english: My boss asked me to return the projector because the meeting room already had one.
records.zomi: Kikhopna khan ah khat a om khin ahih manin ka makaipa in projector lohsak kik dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: I do want to return the laptop, but I've already saved my university assignments on it.
records.zomi: Laptop lohsak kik ka deih taktak hi, ahi zongin ka sangpi nasepte a tungah ka koih khin hi.

records.english: We really do want to keep your business, so we'll replace the broken tiles at no charge.
records.zomi: Na van leina i kem den nuam taktak ahih manin a kitam tile te a man om lo-in i lai ding hi.

records.english: Thanks to the shop's easy return policy, I could try three office chairs before I found the right one.
records.zomi: Dawl' lohsak kikna thukhun a baih manin a kilawm khat ka muh ma-in office tutna thum ka zang thei hi.

records.english: Do you know whether the company will pay for returning the chairs?
records.zomi: Tutnate lohsak kik man company in a pia ding hiam na thei hiam?

records.english: They will, because the chairs were damaged when they arrived.
records.zomi: Pia ding uh hi, tutnate a tun ciangin a siat khin manin.

records.english: What did you say to the shop to get a full refund?
records.zomi: Sum bup na ngah kik nadingin dawl kiangah bang na gen hiam?

records.english: I just explained, politely, that it broke the first time I used it.
records.zomi: Ka zat masa pen-in a sia hi, ci-in zahtak takin ka gen siang bek hi.

records.english: Kids, put the borrowed football back in the box before you go home.
records.zomi: Naupangte, inn na ciah ma-un leitawi football bawm sungah koih kik un.

records.english: Return the cables to the IT office when you've finished setting up the classroom.
records.zomi: Kilasi na bawl zawh khit ciangin cable te IT office ah lohsak kik in.

records.english: Returning the faulty oven meant our bakery couldn't make bread for three days.
records.zomi: Oven siat lohsak kik hang-in i moh bawlna inn in ni thum sung moh a bawl thei kei hi.

records.english: The farm returned the seeds to the supplier after most of them failed to grow.
records.zomi: A tam zaw a khang kei khit ciangin lo in cilte van piakpa kiangah a lohsak kik hi.

records.english: The art teacher returned the paints because half the tubes had dried out.
records.zomi: Lim khai bawm a kim a keu khin ahih manin lim gelh saya in lim khaite a lohsak kik hi.

records.english: Our office sent back three printers because they kept jamming.
records.zomi: A kibet den ahih manin i office in printer thum a khak kik hi.

records.english: The shop gave me store credit, which I used to buy my children's school supplies.
records.zomi: Dawl in van lei theihna sum hong pia a, ka tate' sang van lei nadingin ka zang hi.

records.english: The headphones I bought for my online classes stopped working after two days.
records.zomi: Ka online kilasi adingin ka lei headphone ni nih khit ciangin a sem nawn kei hi.

records.english: My cousin returned the expensive phone his company had given him when he left the job.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in nasep a nusia ciangin a company' piak phone man sang a lohsak kik hi.

records.english: Can I exchange this calculator if the teacher says it's the wrong model?
records.zomi: Saya in model khial ahi hi, a cih leh hih calculator ka lai thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, as long as you keep it in the packet and bring the receipt.
records.zomi: Thei hi, a ip sungah na kem a, receipt na tawi phial leh.

records.english: Could you check this drill before I take it back, in case I'm just using it wrongly?
records.zomi: Ka zat dan bek a khial kha leh ci-in ka lohsak kik ma-in hih drill na en sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: The store manager told us, "Always check a returned item before you put it back on the shelf."
records.zomi: Dawl manager in, “Kilohsak kik van khatpeuh dawh tungah na koih kik ma-in en masa tawntung in,” hong ci hi.

records.english: When the printer cartridges arrived in the wrong color, the office secretary laughed and called the supplier.
records.zomi: Printer cartridge te lim khial tawh a tun ciangin office secretary a nui a, van piakpa a sam hi.

records.english: Please don't open the software until the teacher confirms that it's the right version.
records.zomi: Saya in a man version ahi hi, a cih ma-in software hong kei in.

records.english: Unpacking the new computers, the technician found that two of them had cracked screens.
records.zomi: Computer thakte a hon ciangin technician in a nih' screen a kikek a mu hi.

records.english: How long does the school have to send back the chairs that don't match?
records.zomi: A kilawm lo tutnate khak kik nadingin sang in hun bangzah a nei hiam?

records.english: Could someone help me pack these returned items before the courier arrives?
records.zomi: Courier a tun ma-in hih kilohsak kik vante ka thun nadingin kuamah in hong huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: My aunt bought the wrong size of school shoes for her twins, and they had to be changed twice.
records.zomi: Ka ni in a apengte adingin sang khedap lianzah khial a lei a, vei nih kilai kul hi.

records.english: Workers at the warehouse sort the returned parcels into piles: resell, repair, or recycle.
records.zomi: Van koihna inn nasemte in kilohsak kik ip te a zuak kik ding, a bawl kik ding, a zang kik ding cih in a khen uh hi.

records.english: My husband returned the briefcase I gave him because it didn't fit his laptop.
records.zomi: Ka piak briefcase ah a laptop a kilawm kei ahih manin ka pasal in a lohsak kik hi.

records.english: The fish delivered to the restaurant smelled bad, so the chef sent the whole box back.
records.zomi: An zuakna dawl ah a tung nga a gim sia ahih manin an huanpa in bawm bup a khak kik hi.

records.english: When the sewing machine broke, the tailor took it back to the shop with the guarantee card.
records.zomi: Puan khuina machine a siat ciangin puan khuipa in guarantee card tawh dawl ah a puak kik hi.

records.english: The hospital returned a box of gloves after a nurse noticed they were the wrong size.
records.zomi: Nurse khat in a lianzah a man lo a muh khit ciangin zato in gloves bawm khat a lohsak kik hi.

records.english: The supplier said, "If any of the lab glass arrives broken, send us a photo and we'll replace it."
records.zomi: Van piakpa in, “Lab khuang khatpeuh a kitam tawh a tun leh lim hong khak unla kong lai ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: Students, here's a budget sheet — write down everything you spend for one week.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, hih pen sum zat ding gelhna lai ahi hi — kal khat sungin na zat khempeuh gelh un.

records.english: Kids, the school trip costs more than we planned, so we'll all need to cut back on treats this month.
records.zomi: Naupangte, sang khualzinna man i gel sangin a tam zaw ahih manin tu kha nek nuamte i khempeuh in i tawmsak kul ding hi.

records.english: My aunt said, "Pay your children's teachers first, and the shopkeepers second."
records.zomi: Ka ni in, “Na tate' sayate a masa-in pia inla, dawl neite a nung ciangin,” a ci hi.

records.english: Let's move closer to my office and save the money we spend on fuel.
records.zomi: Ka office kiang ah pem ni-in dat ah i zat sum khol ni.

records.english: We gave every child a small job at home and paid them a little, so they learned what money is worth.
records.zomi: Naupang khempeuh inn ah nasep neu khat ciat i pia a, tawmno i pia ahih manin sum manphatna a sin uh hi.

records.english: Can you show me how you plan your money each month?
records.zomi: Kha simin na sum gel dan hong etsak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: When the factory closed, we had to make one salary stretch across six people.
records.zomi: Factory a kikhak ciangin kha man khat pen mi guk adingin i zat kul hi.

records.english: Planning our budget around the school year, rather than the calendar year, has made things much easier.
records.zomi: Kum ni gelhna sangin sang kum tawh kizui-in sum zat ding i gel manin a baih zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: Do you think we should budget for a computer before the kids start secondary school?
records.zomi: Naupangte' sang lian kah ma-in computer adingin sum i gel ding in na ngaihsun hiam?

records.english: All of you need to tell me how much you'll need for school this term.
records.zomi: Hih term sang adingin bangzah na kisam ding uh hiam note khempeuh in hong gen kul uh hi.

records.english: Every Sunday evening, I check the banking app to see how much we spent that week.
records.zomi: Nipini nitak simin hih kal bangzah i zang hiam en dingin banking app ka en hi.

records.english: Could we use a calculator together and work out how much the new school will cost us each year?
records.zomi: Calculator khawm in zang inla sang thak in kum khat-in bangzah hong man ding hiam i tuat thei ding hiam?
