records.english: Would it be cheaper for me to work from home two days a week?
records.zomi: Kal khat sungin ni nih inn pan ka sep leh a man neu zaw ding hiam?

records.english: Keep the receipts from your work trips so that the money comes back into our budget.
records.zomi: Sum i zat ding sungah a ciah kik theih nadingin na nasep khualzinna receipt te kem in.

records.english: Freelance work pays well, but we keep three months of expenses in the bank just in case.
records.zomi: Freelance nasep in sum hoih a ngah sak a, ahi zongin a kisap kha leh ci-in kha thum zat ding sum bank ah i koih hi.

records.english: When the company stopped paying for our lunches, I had to add twenty dollars a week to the food budget.
records.zomi: Company in i sun an man a piak nawn loh ciangin an sum ah kal khat-in dollar sawmnih ka behlap kul hi.

records.english: Every month, I write the school fees, rent, and bus fares at the top of the list before anything else.
records.zomi: Kha simin na dang khempeuh ma-in sang man, inn man leh bus man list tung lam ah ka gelh hi.

records.english: Taking a lower-paid job closer to home meant giving up some luxuries, but I see the kids every evening now.
records.zomi: Inn kiang-a sum tawm zaw nasep ka la ciangin nek nuam tawmno ka nusia a, ahi zongin tu-in nitak simin naupangte ka mu hi.

records.english: Now that I've started my new job, we can finally stop borrowing money at the end of each month.
records.zomi: Ka nasep thak ka kipat khit ciangin kha tawp simin sum i leitawi tawp thei tawp hi.

records.english: Because I'm self-employed, some months are good and some are very lean.
records.zomi: Keimah' nasep ka sep manin kha khenkhat a hoih a, khenkhat a gim mahmah hi.

records.english: Why does the budget always go wrong in January?
records.zomi: Bang hangin January kha ciangin sum zat ding gelhna a khial tawntung hiam?

records.english: Because school fees, uniforms, and books all have to be paid at the same time.
records.zomi: Sang man, sang puan leh laibute khempeuh hun khat mah-in piak kul ahih manin.

records.english: The scholarship covered the fees, but we still had to plan for books, rent, and travel.
records.zomi: Scholarship in sang man a khuh a, ahi zongin laibu, inn man leh khualzinna adingin i gel kul lai hi.

records.english: If my contract isn't renewed, we could be in trouble by the summer.
records.zomi: Ka contract a thak kei leh khal ciangin buaina i nei kha ding hi.

records.english: Can we afford for you to stop working while you finish your degree?
records.zomi: Na degree na zawh laitakin na nasep khawl ding i zo ding hiam?

records.english: Only if we give up the car and I take extra shifts.
records.zomi: Mawtaw i nusia a, kei in nasep hun behlap ka sep leh bek.

records.english: If the harvest is good, we might pay off the loan for the tractor this year.
records.zomi: Buh a phat leh tu kum tractor leitawi i lohsak kik zo kha ding hi.

records.english: My sister-in-law pays my nephew's school fees, and we buy his uniforms.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal' zi in ka tanau' sang man a pia a, kote in a sang puan i lei hi.

records.english: My wife keeps our budget in a spreadsheet, with a separate column for every bill.
records.zomi: Ka zi in i sum zat ding gelhna spreadsheet sungah a kem a, man piak ding khat ciat adingin column tuam a nei hi.

records.english: My first paycheck went straight into the budget for my younger brother's schoolbooks.
records.zomi: Ka kha man masa pen ka nau pasal' sang laibu adingin pahtakin kizang hi.

records.english: My husband walks to work now, and the bus money goes into a savings jar.
records.zomi: Ka pasal tu-in nasep ah a kaai a, bus sum pen sum kholna bel sungah kikoih hi.

records.english: Should we pay for the evening course now or wait until I get my bonus?
records.zomi: Nitak kisinna man tu-in i pia ding hiam, ka bonus ka ngah dong i ngak ding hiam?

records.english: Students who work part-time often find it hard to plan for the months when they have exams and can't work.
records.zomi: Hun kim lo-a na sem sangnaupangte in sitna a neih uh a na a sep theih loh khate adingin gel a haksa sa zel uh hi.

records.english: Overtime pay is nice, but we try not to plan our budget around it.
records.zomi: Nai behlap man a hoih hi, ahi zongin tua tawh kizui-in sum zat ding gel lo dingin i hanciam hi.

records.english: I do want to buy you a new school bag, but it'll have to wait until payday.
records.zomi: Sang ip thak kong lei sak nuam taktak hi, ahi zongin kha man ngah ni dong a ngak kul ding hi.

records.english: How did your family manage when your father was out of work?
records.zomi: Na pa nasep a neih loh laitakin na innkuan bangci-in a om zo uh hiam?

records.english: The teacher's salary in our village is small, so many teachers also farm on weekends.
records.zomi: I khua-a saya kha man a neu ahih manin saya tampi in kal tawp-in lo zong a sem uh hi.

records.english: When my daughter started her part-time job, she offered to pay for her own phone.
records.zomi: Ka tanu hun kim lo nasep a kipat ciangin amah' phone man amah mah in a pia ding a ci hi.

records.english: My mother taught me to divide my wages into envelopes: food, rent, school, and church.
records.zomi: Ka nu in ka kha man lai-ip te ah khen dingin hong hilh hi: an, inn man, sang leh pawlpi.

records.english: Our family's rule is that nobody borrows money from a moneylender, however bad things get.
records.zomi: I innkuan thukhun pen bangzah a haksa zongin kuamah in sum leitawi sumpuk kiang pan leitawi lo ding ahi hi.

records.english: How much of your salary goes on getting to work?
records.zomi: Na kha man bangzah nasep a pai nadingin na zang hiam?

records.english: Almost a fifth, since I take two buses each way.
records.zomi: A nga-a-khat dek, pai leh ciah bus nih ciat ka tuan ahih manin.

records.english: There's no money for new uniforms this year, so the younger kids will wear their siblings' old ones.
records.zomi: Tu kum sang puan thak adingin sum om lo ahih manin naupang neu zawte in a u leh nau' puan luite a silh ding uh hi.

records.english: My cousin made a budget on her laptop the week she got her first job, and she still uses it.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu in a nasep masa pen a ngah kal-in a laptop tungah sum zat ding gelhna a bawl a, tu dong a zang lai hi.

records.english: The bonus from work was supposed to go into savings, but the car broke down the same week.
records.zomi: Nasep pan bonus pen sum kholna ah koih ding hi, ahi zongin kal khat mah-in mawtaw a sia hi.

records.english: In our money class at school, we each planned a budget for an imaginary family of four.
records.zomi: Sang-a sum thu kilasi ah innkuan mi li ngaihsut khat adingin i khat ciat in sum zat ding i gel hi.

records.english: My hours at the factory were cut, so we eat mostly rice and vegetables now.
records.zomi: Factory ah ka nasep hun kitawmsak ahih manin tu-in buh leh anteh a tam zaw i ne hi.

records.english: Starting my own business meant no salary for six months, so we planned for a whole year beforehand.
records.zomi: Keima' sumbawlna kipat in kha guk sung kha man om lo cihna ahih manin a ma ah kum khat bup i gel hi.

records.english: If I get the promotion, we might be able to save for a small house.
records.zomi: Kaisanna ka ngah leh inn neu khat adingin sum i khol thei kha ding hi.

records.english: Is it possible to pay the university fees in three parts instead of all at once?
records.zomi: Sangpi man vei khat thu-in hi lo-in a thum in piak theih ding hiam?

records.english: Your pocket money will go up when you start secondary school.
records.zomi: Sang lian na kah kipat ciangin na zat ding sum a khang ding hi.

records.english: I really do think we can manage on one salary if we're careful.
records.zomi: I pilvang leh kha man khat tawh i om zo ding hi, ka ci taktak hi.

records.english: We sat at the kitchen table with a notebook and wrote down every expense from the past month.
records.zomi: Anbuk dawhkan ah notebook khat tawh i tu a, kha bei sung sum zat khempeuh i gelh hi.

records.english: After the shop's best month, we finally bought a new freezer instead of repairing the old one again.
records.zomi: Dawl' kha hoih pen khit ciangin a lui bawl kik nawn lo-in freezer thak khat i lei tawp hi.

records.english: What's left after rent and school fees?
records.zomi: Inn man leh sang man khit ciangin bangzah a taang hiam?

records.english: Not much — about enough for food and the electricity bill.
records.zomi: Tam lo — an leh meivak man adingin a cin dek bek.

records.english: Do you get paid every week or every month?
records.zomi: Kal simin kha man na ngah hiam, kha simin hiam?

records.english: Let's look at your payslip together and see where the deductions are going.
records.zomi: Na kha man lai khawm-in en ni-in a kilakkhiat koi ah a pai hiam en ni.

records.english: Now that we both work, can we send more money to my parents?
records.zomi: Tu-in i nih in na i sep ahih manin ka nu leh ka pa kiangah sum tam zaw i khak thei ding hiam?

records.english: There might be enough left this month for the children's swimming lessons.
records.zomi: Tu kha naupangte' tui kidiah kisinna adingin a taang a cing kha ding hi.

records.english: May I give your number to the new nurse, since she's looking for someone to share a flat with?
records.zomi: Nurse thak in inn kihawm ding mi a zong ahih manin na phone nambat ka pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Should I accept my colleague's invitation to dinner, even though I barely know her?
records.zomi: Ka thei mahmah lo hangin ka nasem lawm' nitak an samna ka san ding hiam?

records.english: Is it okay if my friend from work comes to the church picnic with us?
records.zomi: Nasepna pan ka lawm pawlpi picnic ah i tawh a hong kihel leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: A friend from my first office job still calls me every year on my birthday.
records.zomi: Ka office nasep masa pen pan lawm khat in kum simin ka pianni-in hong sam lai hi.

records.english: My wife and her best friend met as cleaners at the same hospital thirty years ago.
records.zomi: Ka zi leh a lawm hoih pen kum sawmthum paisa-in zato khat mah ah siangsakte-in a kimu uh hi.

records.english: My daughter made friends with a girl at her new school by lending her a pencil sharpener.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in a sang thak ah numei naupang khat a khedap tat van leitawi-in a kilawm hi.

records.english: Working side by side at the market stall, the two sellers slowly became friends.
records.zomi: Zuakna dawl ah kiang ciat-in na a sep uh manin zuak nih zawi takin a kilawm uh hi.

records.english: Where did you and Grace first get to know each other?
records.zomi: Nang leh Grace koi ah na kitheih masa uh hiam?

records.english: In the first week of teacher training, when we got lost looking for the library.
records.zomi: Saya kisinna kal masa pen-in, laibu inn i zon laitakin lampi i mansuah ciangin.

records.english: Sharing a car to work every day turned three strangers into good friends.
records.zomi: Ni simin nasep ah mawtaw kihawm in mi thei lo thum lawm hoih a suaksak hi.

records.english: Why don't you sit next to someone new at the training day?
records.zomi: Kisinna ni ah bang hangin mi thak khat kiang ah na tu kei hiam?

records.english: How did you two become friends?
records.zomi: Note nih bangci-in na kilawm uh hiam?

records.english: We were the only two people in our night class who didn't own a computer.
records.zomi: I nitak kilasi ah computer a nei lo mi nih bek i hi hi.

records.english: My university roommate and I had nothing in common at first, but by the end of the year we were inseparable.
records.zomi: Ka sangpi khan kihawm lawm leh kei a kipatna ah i kibang bangmah om lo hi, ahi zongin kum tawp ciangin i kikhen thei nawn kei hi.

records.english: The exchange students were shy at first, but the football match broke the ice.
records.zomi: Gamdang sangnaupangte a kipatna ah a zahlak uh a, ahi zongin football kimawlna in a kikalnaih sak hi.

records.english: I met most of my close friends through my first job at the hotel.
records.zomi: Ka lawm kinai tam zaw zinbuuk-a ka nasep masa pen tungtawn-in ka thei hi.

records.english: The office running club was started by two new employees who wanted to meet people.
records.zomi: Office tai pawl pen mite theih nuam nasem thak nih in a phut uh hi.

records.english: We started chatting over the photocopier, and now we have lunch together every Thursday.
records.zomi: Photocopier kiang ah i kiho kipan a, tu-in Laizing ni simin sun an khawm in i ne hi.

records.english: Can I join your study group, or is it only for second-year students?
records.zomi: Na kisinna pawl ah ka kihel thei ding hiam, kum nihna sangnaupangte ading bek hiam?

records.english: My daughter's teacher paired her with a quiet girl for the project, and they've been close ever since.
records.zomi: Ka tanu' saya in project adingin numei naupang dai khat tawh a kizopsak a, tua pan a kinai mahmah uh hi.

records.english: My husband became friends with his boss's son, who now works in the same office.
records.zomi: Ka pasal in office khat mah ah na a sem a makaipa' tapa tawh a kilawm hi.

records.english: The volunteers at the school library became such good friends that they now go on holiday together.
records.zomi: Sang laibu inn-a thalawp nasemte a kilawm mahmah uh ahih manin tu-in tawlngakni khualzinna khawm in a pai uh hi.

records.english: On my first day at the factory, an older worker shared his lunch with me, and we've been friends ever since.
records.zomi: Factory ah ka ni masa pen-in nasem upa khat in a sun an hong hawm a, tua pan i kilawm hi.

records.english: When was the last time you made a new friend at work?
records.zomi: Nasepna ah lawm thak na ngah nunung pen bang hun ahi hiam?

records.english: We met in a queue for exam results, both shaking with nerves.
records.zomi: Sitna ciamte ngakna kizomna ah i kimu a, i nih in i lau-in i ling hi.

records.english: Joining the evening choir at work was the best way I found to meet people outside my department.
records.zomi: Nasepna-a nitak la sa pawl ah ka kihel pen ka department polam mite theih nading a hoih pen ahi hi.

records.english: Would you like to walk to the bus stop together after work?
records.zomi: Nasep khit ciangin bus khawlna dong khawm in i kaai ding hiam?

records.english: When I moved to the city for my apprenticeship, the mechanics at the garage became like a second family.
records.zomi: Nasep kisin dingin khuapi ah ka pem ciangin mawtaw bawlna mun-a mawtaw bawlte innkuan nihna bang a suak uh hi.

records.english: Ask the new apprentices whether they'd like to have lunch with us.
records.zomi: Nasep kisin thakte i tawh sun an a ne nuam uh hiam dong un.

records.english: It turned out that my new colleague had gone to the same primary school as my brother.
records.zomi: Ka nasem lawm thak ka sanggam pasal tawh sang neu khat mah ah a kah hi, cih kithei hi.

records.english: Using the translation app on my phone, I managed to have my first real conversation with my new coworker.
records.zomi: Ka phone tung-a laiteina app zang-in ka nasem lawm thak tawh kihona taktak masa pen ka nei thei hi.

records.english: Kids, be kind to the new girl in your class — she's come from another country and doesn't speak much English yet.
records.zomi: Naupangte, na kilasi-a numei naupang thak tungah hehpihna nei un — gam dang pan hong pai a, English a zang thei nai mahmah kei hi.

records.english: Do you want to come with us to the canteen?
records.zomi: Canteen ah i tawh na hong pai nuam hiam?

records.english: Moving to a school where nobody knew me, I promised myself I'd speak to one new person every day.
records.zomi: Kuamah in hong theih loh sang ah ka pem ciangin ni simin mi thak khat tawh kiho dingin ka kiciam hi.

records.english: Let's ask the new boy to be on our team for the science fair.
records.zomi: Science poai adingin naupang pasal thak i pawl ah kihel dingin ngen ni.

records.english: Do you think it would be strange to invite my manager to my birthday party?
records.zomi: Ka pianni pawi ah ka manager ka sam leh a lamdang ding in na ngaihsun hiam?

records.english: Not if you invite the rest of the team as well.
records.zomi: Pawl a dangte zong na sam leh lamdang lo ding hi.

records.english: If you're ever in town for work, you're welcome to stay with us.
records.zomi: Nasep adingin khuapi ah na tun ciangin i kiang ah hong om thei hi.

records.english: There's a chance we'll be in the same class again next year.
records.zomi: Kum hong ding ciangin kilasi khat mah ah i om kik kha ding hi.

records.english: Friendships made at work don't always last after someone leaves the job.
records.zomi: Nasepna-a kilawmnate mi khat a nasep a nusia khit ciangin a om den tawntung kei hi.

records.english: All of you new interns are welcome to join us for coffee on Friday afternoons.
records.zomi: Intern thak note khempeuh Laithai ni nitak simin kawfi dawn khawm dingin na hong kihel thei uh hi.

records.english: Could I sit with you at lunch, since I don't know anyone yet?
records.zomi: Kuamah ka thei nai kei ahih manin sun an hun-in na kiang ah ka tu thei ding hiam?

records.english: You might make friends more easily if you join the company football team.
records.zomi: Company football pawl ah na kihel leh lawm baih zawin na ngah kha ding hi.

records.english: Can I bring a friend to the office party?
records.zomi: Office pawi ah lawm khat ka paipih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, but let the organizers know so they can order enough food.
records.zomi: Thei hi, ahi zongin an cing sap theih nadingun a vaihawmte gen in.

records.english: The farmer next to our field became a friend after he lent us his water pump during the dry season.
records.zomi: Guah om lo hun ciangin i lo kiang-a lo neipa in a tui pump hong leitawi khit ciangin lawm a suak hi.

records.english: Our new neighbors turned out to be teachers at my children's school.
records.zomi: I inn veng thakte ka tate' sang-a sayate ahi uh hi, cih kithei hi.

records.english: My classmate from the nursing course and I still message each other every day, even though we work in different hospitals.
records.zomi: Nursing kisinna pan ka kilasi lawm leh kei zato tuam ciat ah na i sep hangin ni simin message i kikhak lai hi.

records.english: Everyone, this is Daniel — he's joining our department today, so please make him feel at home.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, hih pen Daniel ahi a — tuni-in i department ah a kihel ahih manin a inn ah om bangin a kisak theih nadingin bawl un.

records.english: My cousin found it hard to make friends at work because she was the only woman on the building site.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu inn lamna mun-a numei khat bek ahih manin nasepna ah lawm ngah a haksa sa hi.

records.english: My closest friend at university was the person who lent me her notes when I was sick.
records.zomi: Sangpi-a ka lawm kinai pen ka cina laitakin a gelhte hong leitawi mi ahi hi.

records.english: Students, find a partner you haven't worked with before.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, na sep khawm ngei loh lawm khat zong un.

records.english: The two boys who used to fight in the playground are now partners in a small business.
records.zomi: Kimawlna mun ah a kido zel pasal naupang nih tu-in sumbawlna neu khat ah a kithuah uh hi.

records.english: I do want to get to know my colleagues, but everyone eats lunch at their desk here.
records.zomi: Ka nasem lawmte ka theih ka deih taktak hi, ahi zongin hih ah mi khempeuh in a dawhkan uh ah sun an a ne uh hi.

records.english: When I worked abroad, a coworker invited me to her family's Sunday lunch every week.
records.zomi: Gamdang ah na ka sep lai-in nasem lawm khat in kal simin a innkuan Nipini sun an ah hong sam hi.

records.english: Two of the bakery staff became friends because they both started work at four in the morning.
records.zomi: Moh bawlna inn nasem nih zingsang nai li ciangin na a sep kipat khawm uh manin a kilawm uh hi.

records.english: My friendship with my old teacher began after I left school, when we found ourselves working at the same college.
records.zomi: Sang ka zawh khit ciangin college khat mah ah na i sep kha ciangin ka saya lui tawh i kilawmna a kipan hi.

records.english: The new teacher sat alone in the staff room until the music teacher offered her a cup of tea.
records.zomi: La saya in tea khuang khat a piak dong saya thak nasemte' khan ah amah bek a tu hi.

records.english: I really do miss my old classmates now that we've all started working in different towns.
records.zomi: Khua tuam ciat ah na i sep kipat khit ciangin ka kilasi lawm luite ka ngaih taktak hi.

records.english: Making friends at a new job takes time, so don't be discouraged if the first weeks feel lonely.
records.zomi: Nasep thak ah lawm ngah hun a sau ahih manin kal masa te a kikhawmlum leh lungkia kei in.

records.english: We invited the builders to the house blessing, because they had worked so hard on it.
records.zomi: Inn thupha piakna ah inn lamte i sam a, tua adingin hanciam takin na a sep manun.

records.english: We're inviting the whole village to the opening of the new school building.
records.zomi: Sang inn thak honna ah khua bup i sam hi.

records.english: My first invitation from a colleague came after I'd been at the bank for six months.
records.zomi: Bank ah kha guk ka sep khit ciangin nasem lawm khat pan samna masa pen ka ngah hi.

records.english: My cousin invited her classmates to her wedding by video call, because most of them live abroad.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu' kilasi lawmte a tam zaw gamdang ah a om uh ahih manin a kiteenna ah video call tawh a sam hi.

records.english: The farmers' cooperative invites all its members to a big meal after the harvest.
records.zomi: Lo nei pawl in buh lak khit ciangin a mite khempeuh an lian ah a sam hi.

records.english: Thank you for inviting me — I'll ask my boss whether I can leave work early that day.
records.zomi: Hong sap manin ka lungdam hi — tua ni-in nasepna pan hun ma-in ka pai khia thei ding hiam ka makaipa ka dong ding hi.

records.english: The whole class was invited to Lian's house to celebrate her scholarship.
records.zomi: Lian in scholarship a ngah poai bawl dingin kilasi bup a inn ah kisam hi.

records.english: We'd like to invite your whole team to our wedding, if they're free that Saturday.
records.zomi: Tua Kiginni a awng uh leh na pawl bup i kiteenna ah sam i deih hi.

records.english: Why didn't you invite anyone from your class to your party?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na pawi ah na kilasi pan kuamah na sam kei hiam?

records.english: The students were so excited to invite their parents to the art show that they made the invitations themselves.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte in lim gelh poai ah a nu leh pa uh sam a lungdam lua uh ahih manin samna laite amau mah in a bawl uh hi.

records.english: Invitations were sent to all the former students who had worked at the school library.
records.zomi: Sang laibu inn ah na sem ngei sangnaupang lui khempeuh samna lai kikhak hi.

records.english: Please invite the new teacher to the staff dinner, because she doesn't know anyone yet.
records.zomi: Saya thak in kuamah a thei nai kei ahih manin nasemte' nitak an ah sam un.

records.english: We decided to invite only family and close colleagues, so that the party wouldn't become too big.
records.zomi: Pawi a lian lua loh nadingin innkuan leh nasem lawm kinaite bek sam dingin i khensat hi.

records.english: The pastor was invited to pray at the opening of the new clinic.
records.zomi: Clinic thak honna ah thu ngen dingin pastor kisam hi.

records.english: Did the school invite the parents to the sports day?
records.zomi: Sang in kimawl ni ah nu leh pate a sam hiam?

records.english: My former boss came to my father's funeral even though I hadn't been able to invite her personally.
records.zomi: Amah mah ka sam thei kei hangin ka makaipa lui ka pa' misi vuina ah hong pai hi.

records.english: I really do hope your whole department can come to the opening of our shop.
records.zomi: I dawl honna ah na department bup in a hong thei ding uh ka lamen taktak hi.

records.english: Inviting your manager to a family event can feel awkward, but most managers are pleased to be asked.
records.zomi: Innkuan poai ah na manager sam in a zahlak hi kha ding a, ahi zongin manager tam zaw in sap a lungdam uh hi.

records.english: Our neighbor's son, who works as a chef, offered to cook for our guests at the anniversary dinner.
records.zomi: An huanpa-a na a sem i inn veng' tapa in i kiteen kum ni nitak an ah i khualte adingin a huan ding a ci hi.

records.english: If the hall is too small, we might have to invite fewer people from work.
records.zomi: Inn lian a neu lua leh nasepna pan mi tawm zaw i sam kul kha ding hi.

records.english: Would it be rude not to invite my desk neighbor if I invite the rest of the office?
records.zomi: Office a dangte ka sam a, ka dawhkan kiang mi ka sam kei leh zahtakna om lo ding hiam?

records.english: We printed the invitations at work, on the good paper the office uses for certificates.
records.zomi: Samna laite nasepna ah office in lai-ciam adinga a zat lai hoih tungah i suaksak hi.

records.english: Is it all right if I invite a client to the staff Christmas dinner?
records.zomi: Nasemte' Christmas nitak an ah client khat ka sam leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: I'd check with the manager first, since it's usually just for employees.
records.zomi: Nasemte ading bek ahi zel ahih manin manager kiangah a masa-in dong in.

records.english: My brother invited the doctors who had treated him to a thank-you dinner.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal in amah hong kem siavuante lungdam kohna nitak an ah a sam hi.

records.english: Would you and your husband like to come for dinner after the conference?
records.zomi: Kikhopna lian khit ciangin nang leh na pasal nitak an ah hong pai nuam na hi uh hiam?

records.english: Should I invite my boss to my graduation party?
records.zomi: Ka sang zawhna pawi ah ka makaipa ka sam ding hiam?

records.english: Why not, since she let you take time off to study?
records.zomi: Bang hang sam lo ding hiam, kisin dingin hun hong piak manin?

records.english: I do want to invite my old professor, but I'm not sure he'll remember me.
records.zomi: Ka professor lui ka sam nuam taktak hi, ahi zongin hong phawk ding hiam ka thei kei hi.

records.english: My aunt was invited to give a talk at the nursing college where she trained forty years ago.
records.zomi: Kum sawmli paisa-a a kisinna nursing college ah thugen dingin ka ni kisam hi.

records.english: When I invited my students to my wedding, I didn't expect all thirty of them to come.
records.zomi: Ka sangnaupangte ka kiteenna ah ka sap ciangin a sawmthum tengteng a hong pai ding uh ka lamen kei hi.

records.english: Invite your supervisor yourself, rather than asking someone else to do it for you.
records.zomi: Mi dang sawl sangin na enkaipa nangma' mah in sam in.

records.english: You two should invite your teachers to the party, since they helped you so much this year.
records.zomi: Tu kum na sayate in hong huh mahmah uh ahih manin note nih in pawi ah sam un.

records.english: Can I invite my new coworkers to our house, even though it's still full of boxes?
records.zomi: Ka inn bawm tawh a dim lai hangin ka nasem lawm thakte i inn ah ka sam thei ding hiam?

records.english: The headmaster invited a local farmer to explain to the students how rice is grown.
records.zomi: Sang makaipa in buh bangci-in a kisuan hiam sangnaupangte kiangah gen dingin khua sung lo nei khat a sam hi.

records.english: Mr. Kim invited every new employee to his office for tea during their first week.
records.zomi: Mr. Kim in nasem thak khempeuh a kal masa pen-un a office ah tea dawn dingin a sam hi.

records.english: When is the best time to invite colleagues to a wedding?
records.zomi: Kiteenna ah nasem lawmte sam nading hun hoih pen bang hun ahi hiam?

records.english: Two or three months before, so that they can ask for the day off.
records.zomi: Kha nih hiam thum hiam ma-in, a ni khawl a ngen theih nadingun.

records.english: There may be room for a few more guests if some of the teachers can't come.
records.zomi: Sayate khenkhat a hong thei kei uh leh khual tawmno behlap adingin mun om kha ding hi.

records.english: All parents are warmly invited to the school's open day next Thursday.
records.zomi: Laizing ni hong ding sang hon ni ah nu leh pa khempeuh lungsim lum takin kisam uh hi.

records.english: We sent the invitations by message rather than by post, since most of my colleagues are always on their phones.
records.zomi: Ka nasem lawm tam zaw a phone uh tung ah a om den uh ahih manin samna laite post sangin message tawh i khak hi.

records.english: The company invited the employees' children to see where their parents work.
records.zomi: Company in a nu leh pa uh' sepna a muh theih nadingun nasemte' tate a sam hi.

records.english: I'm writing to invite you to speak to our students about your work as a nurse.
records.zomi: Nurse-a na nasep thu i sangnaupangte kiangah gen dingin kong sam nadingin lai kong gelh hi.

records.english: Do you think the cleaners would like to come to the office party?
records.zomi: Siangsakte office pawi ah a hong nuam ding uh in na ngaihsun hiam?

records.english: If you invite your coworkers, remember that some of them don't eat meat.
records.zomi: Na nasem lawmte na sap leh khenkhatte in sa a ne kei uh hi, cih phawk in.

records.english: My husband invited his apprentices for Sunday lunch, and I cooked enough for twenty.
records.zomi: Ka pasal in a nasep kisinte Nipini sun an ah a sam a, kei in mi sawmnih vak zah ka huan hi.

records.english: I sent a calendar invitation for the farewell lunch to everyone in the department.
records.zomi: Department-a mi khempeuh kiangah kikhenna sun an adingin calendar samna ka khak hi.

records.english: My colleagues surprised me by inviting my parents to my award ceremony.
records.zomi: Ka nasem lawmte in ka laksap ngahna poai ah ka nu leh ka pa a sap uh tawh hong lamdangsak uh hi.

records.english: A good host remembers to invite the people who helped behind the scenes.
records.zomi: Khual dawn hoih in a nung lam ah a huh mite sam a phawk hi.

records.english: Let me phone your teacher and invite her to the graduation lunch for you.
records.zomi: Na adingin na saya phone tawh ka sam inla sang zawhna sun an ah ka sam ning.

records.english: Kids, if you want to invite your classmates, give the cards out after school, not during lessons.
records.zomi: Naupangte, na kilasi lawmte na sap nuam uh leh card te hilhna laitakin hi lo-in sang khit ciangin pia un.

records.english: My daughter invited her favorite teacher to her baptism, and to our delight, she came.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in a tuiphumna ah a saya deih pen a sam a, i lungdam mahmah dingin hong pai hi.

records.english: Students, you're welcome to invite your families to the end-of-year concert.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, kum tawp la poai ah na innkuan uh na sam thei uh hi.

records.english: Everyone, please put your names on the list by Friday if you're coming to Mr. Thang's retirement party.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, Mr. Thang' nasep khawlna pawi ah na hong pai ding uh leh Laithai ni ma-in list tungah na min uh gelh un.

records.english: Can you help me write the invitation to the parents' evening in simple English?
records.zomi: Nu leh pate' nitak kikhopna samna lai English baih tawh ka gelh nadingin hong huh thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Could you design the invitation on your computer for my father's seventieth birthday?
records.zomi: Ka pa' kum sawmsagih pianni adingin na computer tungah samna lai na bawl thei ding hiam?

records.english: Would it be possible to invite the night-shift workers to the lunch as well?
records.zomi: Zan nasem te zong sun an ah sam theih ding hiam?

records.english: Shall I send the invitation to your work email or your home address?
records.zomi: Samna lai na nasep email ah ka khak ding hiam, na inn teenna ah hiam?

records.english: May I invite a friend from my old job to the company picnic?
records.zomi: Company picnic ah ka nasep lui pan lawm khat ka sam thei ding hiam?

records.english: Certainly, as long as you let the organizers know.
records.zomi: Thei mahmah hi, a vaihawmte na gen phial leh.

records.english: How can we show our teachers that we appreciate them?
records.zomi: I sayate tungah i lungdam dan bangci-in i lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Each class could write a letter saying what they've learned this year.
records.zomi: Kilasi khat ciat in tu kum a sin uh thu gen-in lai khat a gelh thei uh hi.

records.english: Without your recommendation letter, I might never have got this job.
records.zomi: Na hong gen sakna lai om lo leh hih nasep ka ngah ngei lo kha ding hi.

records.english: Thank you all for your patience while the new computer system was being installed.
records.zomi: Computer system thak kikoih laitakin na thuakzawh manun note khempeuh tungah ka lungdam hi.

records.english: When the bus driver retired, the students he'd driven for twenty years lined the road and clapped.
records.zomi: Bus tuansakpa a khawl ciangin kum sawmnih sung a tuansak sangnaupangte lampi gei ah a kizom uh a, khut a beng uh hi.

records.english: My brother-in-law baked a cake for the night-shift nurses to thank them for caring for his wife.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu' pasal in a zi a kep manun zan nasem nurse te lungdam kohna-in cake khat a bawl hi.

records.english: We had the old school bell repaired and gave it to our retiring headmistress as a thank-you.
records.zomi: Sang khawng lui i bawlsak kik a, a khawl sang makaipa nu lungdam kohna-in i pia hi.

records.english: Grateful customers often leave notes on the counter of my cousin's little bakery.
records.zomi: Lungdam van leite in ka sanggam nu' moh bawlna inn neu dawhkan tungah lai a nusia zel uh hi.

records.english: The parents had the classroom roof fixed during the holidays to thank the school for a wonderful year.
records.zomi: Kum nuam mahmah khat adingin sang tungah lungdam kohna-in nu leh pate in tawlngakni sungin kilasi inn tung a bawlsak uh hi.

records.english: My colleague brought me soup every day when I was ill, and I'll never forget it.
records.zomi: Ka cina laitakin ka nasem lawm in ni simin an-tui hong tawi a, ka mangngilh ngei lo ding hi.

records.english: Can I take you out for lunch to say thank you for training me?
records.zomi: Hong hilh manin lungdam ka kohna-in sun an ne dingin kong paipih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Could I use the school printer to make thank-you cards for the volunteers?
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte adingin lungdam kohna card bawl dingin sang printer ka zang thei ding hiam?

records.english: The nurses were deeply moved when a former patient came back to thank them in person.
records.zomi: Damlo lui khat in lungdam ko dingin mai tum-in a hong ciah kik ciangin nurse te a lungsim uh a khoih mahmah hi.

records.english: May I say a few words of thanks to the kitchen staff before we leave?
records.zomi: I pai ma-in anbuk nasemte tungah lungdam kohna kammal tawmno ka gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Let's give a big round of applause to the volunteers who painted the school.
records.zomi: Sang lim a khai thalawp nasemte adingin lian takin khut beng ni.

records.english: When the company had the canteen renovated, the workers thanked the owner with a song.
records.zomi: Company in canteen a bawl thak ciangin nasemte in la khat tawh a neipa tungah lungdam a ko uh hi.

records.english: Thanks for lending me your notes — I wouldn't have passed without them.
records.zomi: Na gelhte hong leitawi manin ka lungdam hi — amaute om lo leh ka zo lo ding hi.

records.english: Thank you for staying calm when I made that mistake with the client — I learned a lot from it.
records.zomi: Client tawh ka khialh ciangin na lungsim dai den manin ka lungdam hi — tampi ka sin hi.

records.english: Do you think the drivers would appreciate it if we bought them breakfast?
records.zomi: Zingsang an i lei sak leh mawtaw tuansakte in a lungdam ding uh in na ngaihsun hiam?

records.english: The farm workers were thanked with a feast at the end of the harvest.
records.zomi: Buh lak tawp ciangin lo nasemte an lian tawh lungdam kohna kipia hi.

records.english: The students cleaned the teachers' cars as a surprise on Teachers' Day.
records.zomi: Sayate' Ni-in sangnaupangte in lamdang dingin sayate' mawtaw a sil uh hi.

records.english: Our coach made each of us thank the referee after the match, even though we had lost.
records.zomi: I zo kei hangin i kimawl khit ciangin i coach in i khat ciat in referee tungah lungdam hong kosak hi.

records.english: Our boss had a plaque made for the cleaner who had worked at the company for thirty years.
records.zomi: I makaipa in company ah kum sawmthum sung na sem siangsak nu adingin min kigelh zahtakna phek khat a bawl sak hi.

records.english: When I got my first promotion, I called my old teacher before I called anyone else.
records.zomi: Ka kaisanna masa pen ka ngah ciangin mi dang ka sap ma-in ka saya lui ka sam hi.

records.english: There's a chance the director will thank our department at the annual meeting.
records.zomi: Kum sim kikhopna ah director in i department tungah lungdam a ko kha ding hi.

records.english: Can you help me find the right words to thank my professor?
records.zomi: Ka professor tungah lungdam ka kohna dingin kammal kilawm ka zon nadingin hong huh thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Would you mind if I mentioned your help in my speech at the graduation?
records.zomi: Sang zawhna poai-a ka thugenna ah na huhna ka gen leh na lungkham ding hiam?

records.english: Our class recorded a video message for our teacher, who was in the hospital for a month.
records.zomi: Kha khat sung zato ah a om i saya adingin i kilasi in video message khat a la hi.

records.english: My aunt had her old students' letters framed and hung them in her living room.
records.zomi: Ka ni in a sangnaupang luite' laite bawngkhawng ah a koih a, a innsung khan ah a khai hi.

records.english: It might be nice to give the cooks a card signed by all the students.
records.zomi: An huante adingin sangnaupang khempeuh' min kigelh card khat piak a hoih kha ding hi.

records.english: My father-in-law sends the doctors at the clinic a basket of fruit every New Year.
records.zomi: Ka sungpa in Kum Thak simin clinic-a siavuante singgah bawm khat a khak hi.

records.english: My mentor made me call every customer who had complained, and I've thanked her for it ever since.
records.zomi: Hong makaih nu in a phunsan van lei khempeuh sam dingin hong sawl a, tua pan tu dong lungdam ka ko hi.

records.english: Your feedback on my report was so helpful that I've kept it to read again.
records.zomi: Ka report tungah na ngaihsutna a phatuam mahmah ahih manin sim kik dingin ka kem hi.

records.english: We pooled our money and bought the caretaker a new radio for his workshop.
records.zomi: I sum i kikhawm a, inn kemnu' nasep khan adingin radio thak khat i lei sak hi.

records.english: Teachers rarely hear how much they changed a student's life, so I wrote to mine twenty years later.
records.zomi: Sayate in sangnaupang khat' nuntakna bangzah a khel uh hiam a za tawm uh ahih manin kum sawmnih khit ciangin ka saya kiangah lai ka gelh hi.

records.english: I'd like to thank Mr. Pau, who stayed late every Thursday to help me with chemistry.
records.zomi: Chemistry ah hong huh dingin Laizing ni simin nai sau a om Mr. Pau tungah lungdam ka ko nuam hi.

records.english: Please thank your mother for the cakes she sent to the office.
records.zomi: Office ah na nu' khak cake te adingin na nu kiangah lungdam ka kohna gen sak in.

records.english: My manager's kind email after the difficult project meant more to me than the bonus.
records.zomi: Project haksa khit ciangin ka manager' email hoih in bonus sangin a thupi zaw hi.

records.english: I really appreciate that you explained the job to me so clearly on my first day.
records.zomi: Ka ni masa pen-in nasep siangtak taka hong gen siang manin ka lungdam taktak hi.

records.english: Every Friday, our manager writes one thank-you note to someone who helped the team that week.
records.zomi: Laithai ni simin i manager in hih kal sungin pawl huh mi khat adingin lungdam kohna lai khat a gelh hi.

records.english: Thank you for believing in me when nobody else in the office did.
records.zomi: Office-a kuamah in hong um loh lai-in hong um manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Is it appropriate to give my supervisor a gift at the end of my internship?
records.zomi: Ka internship tawp ciangin ka enkaipa letsong ka piak a kilawm hiam?

records.english: A handwritten card is usually better than an expensive present.
records.zomi: Letsong man sang sangin khut tawh kigelh card khat a hoih zaw zel hi.

records.english: My boss thanked me in front of the whole team, which made me blush.
records.zomi: Ka makaipa in pawl bup mai ah lungdam hong ko a, ka mai a san hi.

records.english: I just wanted to say that your advice about the interview really worked.
records.zomi: Dotna thu-a na thuhilhna a sem taktak hi, cih ka gen nuam bek hi.

records.english: A small thank-you from a customer can make a long day at the shop feel worthwhile.
records.zomi: Van leipa khat' lungdam kohna neu in dawl-a ni sau a manphatsak thei hi.

records.english: Mr. Lian thanked his apprentice by giving him his own set of tools.
records.zomi: Mr. Lian in a nasep kisinpa amah' nasep van tawh lungdam a ko hi.

records.english: Everyone, I want to thank you for working so hard to finish the order on time.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, van sapna hun takah zawh nadingin hanciam takin na sep manun lungdam kong ko nuam hi.

records.english: If it weren't for my first employer's patience, I would have given up in the first week.
records.zomi: Ka nasep piak masa pen' thuakzawhna om lo leh kal masa pen-in ka nusia kha ding hi.

records.english: Do you think a message is enough, or should I thank my old teacher in person?
records.zomi: Message khat a cing ding in na ngaihsun hiam, ka saya lui tungah mai tum-in lungdam ka ko ding hiam?

records.english: Kids, write a thank-you note to the farmer who let your class visit his farm.
records.zomi: Naupangte, na kilasi a lo a vehsak lo neipa kiangah lungdam kohna lai gelh un.

records.english: Who should I thank for organizing the training day?
records.zomi: Kisinna ni a vaihawm adingin kua tungah lungdam ka ko ding hiam?

records.english: Mostly Esther from the office, though the whole team helped.
records.zomi: A tam zaw office pan Esther, pawl bup in a huh uh hangin.

records.english: You've all made my first year as a teacher much easier than I expected.
records.zomi: Saya ka hih kum masa pen note khempeuh in ka lamen sangin a baih zawin na bawl uh hi.

records.english: Why do you always thank the cleaners by name?
records.zomi: Bang hangin siangsakte a min tawh lungdam na ko tawntung hiam?

records.english: Because their work is just as important as anyone else's in this building.
records.zomi: A nasep uh hih inn sung-a mi dang khempeuh' nasep bangmah in a thupi ahih manin.

records.english: The parents' gift of new library books was gratefully received by the school.
records.zomi: Nu leh pate' laibu inn laibu thak letsong sang in lungdam takin a sang hi.

records.english: Students, please stand and thank the visiting doctor for her talk.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, ding unla hong veh siavuan nu tungah a thugen adingin lungdam ko un.

records.english: Thank you for covering my shift while my daughter was in the hospital.
records.zomi: Ka tanu zato ah a om laitakin ka nasep hun hong laih sak manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: My daughter painted a picture for her kindergarten teacher on the last day of school.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in sang ni nunung pen-in a kindergarten saya adingin lim khat a gelh hi.

records.english: Sorry for the mess — we're painting the classroom this week.
records.zomi: Buaina adingin hong maisak in — hih kal kilasi lim i khai hi.

records.english: Sorry, but you can't park here — this space is for the school bus.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, hih ah mawtaw na koih thei kei hi — hih mun sang bus ading ahi hi.

records.english: Sorry for interrupting your lesson, but there's a phone call for you in the office.
records.zomi: Na hilhna ka khaktan manin hong maisak in, ahi zongin office ah phone hong sam hi.

records.english: If I've offended anyone in the team, I'd like to apologize now.
records.zomi: Pawl sung ah kuamah ka lungkhamsak kha leh tu-in maisak ka ngen nuam hi.

records.english: Saying sorry to a student when you've made a mistake can earn you more respect, not less.
records.zomi: Na khialh ciangin sangnaupang khat kiangah maisak ngen in zahtakna tam zaw hong ngahsak thei a, tawm zaw hi lo hi.

records.english: My boss said sorry to the whole team for shouting.
records.zomi: Ka makaipa in a kik a sam manin pawl bup kiangah maisak a ngen hi.

records.english: My cousin said sorry too late, and he lost his job anyway.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in maisak a ngen nun lua a, a nasep a mansuah veve hi.

records.english: Sorry, I didn't mean to take your seat in the staff room.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, nasemte' khan ah na tutna laak ka ut kei hi.

records.english: Would it help if I called the supplier and apologized for the late payment?
records.zomi: Van piakpa ka sam a, sum piak nun manin maisak ka ngen leh a huh ding hiam?

records.english: When I was a trainee, I forgot to lock the shop, and the owner forgave me the very next day.
records.zomi: Nasep kisin ka hih lai-in dawl khak ka mangngilh a, a neipa in a zing ni-in hong maisak hi.

records.english: Is it too late to apologize to my old teacher for how I behaved in school?

records.zomi: Lai puakpa ka hih kal masa pen-in a man kongkhak sangin kongkhak khial ka khawng tam zaw hi.

records.english: I asked three different people for directions to the office, and each gave me a different answer.
records.zomi: Office lampi mi thum kiangah ka dong a, khat ciat in dawnna tuam ciat hong pia uh hi.

records.english: Is there a staff entrance, or should I go through the main doors?
records.zomi: Nasemte' lutna a om hiam, kongkhak lian tawh ka lut ding hiam?

records.english: Sorry, I'm new here myself, but the information desk is just behind you.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, hih ah kei zong ka thak lai hi, ahi zongin thu kidotna dawhkan na nung lam tak ah om hi.

records.english: Can you show me the way to the nearest bank, since I need to pay my school fees?
records.zomi: Ka sang man ka piak kul ahih manin a kiang pen bank lampi hong lak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Students are asked not to use the teachers' staircase, so please go round to the other side.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte in sayate' kaplei a zang thei kei uh ahih manin a lam khat lam ah kawi un.

records.english: No phones are allowed in the exam building, so write down the room number before you go in.
records.zomi: Sitna inn ah phone kiphal lo ahih manin na lut ma-in khan nambat gelh in.

records.english: Is it okay if I leave my bike by the entrance while I ask inside for directions?
records.zomi: Sung ah lampi ka dong laitakin ka siiksakol lutna kiang ah ka koih leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: Could you point me toward the parking area for staff?
records.zomi: Nasemte' mawtaw koihna lam hong lak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Please don't walk across the building site; use the path along the fence.
records.zomi: Inn lamna mun tawng-in kaai kei in; kulh gei lampi zang in.

records.english: Where's the best place to wait for the company shuttle?
records.zomi: Company mawtaw ngak nading mun hoih pen koi ah om hiam?

records.english: Which entrance do parents use for the school concert?
records.zomi: Sang la poai adingin nu leh pate in bang lutna a zang uh hiam?

records.english: The side gate, because the main hall is being painted.
records.zomi: Kongpi gei lam, inn lian lim a khai lai ahih manin.

records.english: The lights in the corridor had gone out, so we found the office by following the sound of voices.
records.zomi: Lampi khan meivak a mit ahih manin aw ging zui-in office i mu hi.

records.english: May I walk through the factory to get to the loading area, or do I have to go around?
records.zomi: Van thunna mun ka tun theih nadingin factory tawng-in ka pai thei ding hiam, ka kawi kul hiam?

records.english: Follow the yellow line on the floor, and it will take you to the emergency exit.
records.zomi: Lei tung-a ngaan khau zui in, haksatna hun-a pai khiatna kongkhak ah hong paipih ding hi.

records.english: Our manager had a map of the warehouse printed for every new worker.
records.zomi: I manager in nasem thak khempeuh adingin van koihna inn map khat a suaksak hi.

records.english: Turn left at the old mill, and the cooperative's office will be on your right.
records.zomi: Buh suk mun lui ah veilam ah kiheei inla, lo nei pawl' office na taklam ah om ding hi.

records.english: The receptionist said, "Take the stairs on your left, and the training room is the second door."
records.zomi: Reception nu in, “Na veilam-a kaplei kah inla, kisinna khan pen a nihna kongkhak ahi hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: When the school moved to a new building, parents kept arriving at the old one for weeks.
records.zomi: Sang inn thak ah a pem ciangin nu leh pate kal tampi sung a lui ah a tung zel uh hi.

records.english: If you reach the petrol station, you've gone too far, so turn back and look for the school.
records.zomi: Dat zuakna mun na tun leh na pai gamla lua ahih manin kiheei kik inla sang zong in.

records.english: The guard told us, "You can't drive in here; park outside and walk to the office."
records.zomi: Kongpi kemtu in, “Hih ah na mawng lut thei kei hi; polam ah koih inla office dong kaai in,” hong ci hi.

records.english: Would you mind taking the new nurse to the children's ward on your way?
records.zomi: Na pai lam ah nurse thak naupangte' ward ah na paipih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Every new apprentice is taken on a tour of the workshop so that they know where everything is.
records.zomi: Nasep kisin thak khempeuh in na khempeuh koi ah om hiam a theih theih nadingun nasepna inn sung kietsak uh hi.

records.english: Courier drivers learn the back streets so well that they rarely need to ask for directions.
records.zomi: Van puak tuansakte in lampi neute a thei kim uh ahih manin lampi a dong ngei tawm uh hi.

records.english: When the road was flooded, the teachers had to walk the long way around to reach the school.
records.zomi: Lampi tui in a khuh ciangin sang a tun nadingun sayate lampi sau tawh a kaai kul uh hi.

records.english: My boss drew me a little map on the back of an envelope so that I could find the client's shop.
records.zomi: Client' dawl ka muh theih nadingin ka makaipa in lai-ip nung lam ah map neu khat hong gelh sak hi.

records.english: I had my brother drive past the office the day before the interview so that I'd know the way.
records.zomi: Lampi ka theih theih nadingin dotna ni ma-in office kiang ah ka sanggam pasal mawtaw ka mawngsak hi.

records.english: Students, if you get lost on the trip, go to the museum's front desk and wait for us there.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, khualzinna ah lampi na mansuah uh leh museum' mai dawhkan ah pai unla tua ah hong ngak un.

records.english: Our office is hard to find, so I always send visitors a photo of the front door.
records.zomi: I office zon a haksa ahih manin hong vehte kiangah mai kongkhak lim ka khak tawntung hi.

records.english: I arrived twenty minutes early for my interview so that I'd have time to find the right office.
records.zomi: Office man ka zon theih nading hun ka neih nadingin ka dotna ma minit sawmnih-in ka tung hi.

records.english: When my GPS stopped working, I asked a farmer how to get to the agricultural college.
records.zomi: Ka GPS a sem nawn kei ciangin lo nei khat kiangah lo sepna college lampi ka dong hi.

records.english: Ask at the reception desk, because the offices are numbered in a strange way.
records.zomi: Office te nambat a lamdang ahih manin reception dawhkan ah dong in.

records.english: How do I find the ward where my colleague is staying?
records.zomi: Ka nasem lawm a omna ward bangci-in ka zong ding hiam?

records.english: You might find it easier to use the side door, since the lift at the front is broken.
records.zomi: Mai lam lift a sia ahih manin gei lam kongkhak zat a baih zaw kha ding hi.

records.english: The signs on the campus were changed over the summer, and even the older students got lost.
records.zomi: Khal sungin sangpi mun sung-a lim gelhte kikhel a, sangnaupang upa zawte zong lampi a mansuah uh hi.

records.english: Could you tell me which floor the accounts department is on?
records.zomi: Accounts department dawl bang ah om hiam hong gen thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Which bus should I take to get to the industrial area?
records.zomi: Factory mun ah pai dingin bus bang ka tuang ding hiam?

records.english: Don't follow the app at night, because it sends you down a road that floods.
records.zomi: Zanin app zui kei in, tui in a khuh lampi ah hong paisak ahih manin.

records.english: A new map of the hospital was put up near the entrance last week.
records.zomi: Kal bei-in lutna kiang ah zato map thak khat kikhai hi.

records.english: Visitors aren't allowed past the security desk without a pass, so please wait here for your guide.
records.zomi: Hong vehte pass om lo-in kemna dawhkan a kantan thei kei uh ahih manin na makaipa ding hih ah ngak in.

records.english: On my first day at the new school, I got lost three times looking for my classroom.
records.zomi: Sang thak ah ka ni masa pen-in ka kilasi ka zon laitakin vei thum lampi ka mansuah hi.

records.english: Excuse me, where is the exam hall for first-year students?
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, kum khatna sangnaupangte' sitna inn koi ah om hiam?

records.english: Across the courtyard, in the building with the clock tower.
records.zomi: Inn mai mun kantan inla, nai-ten sang om inn ah.

records.english: Somebody had moved the sign for the conference room, so half of us ended up in the kitchen.
records.zomi: Kuamah in kikhopna khan lim gelh a pemsak ahih manin a kim pen anbuk ah i tung hi.

records.english: A police officer visited our class to teach us how to cross the road safely.
records.zomi: Lampi bitna taka kantan dan hong hilh dingin police khat i kilasi ah hong pai hi.

records.english: When the bridge was closed, the children had to be driven to school by a longer road through the hills.
records.zomi: Lei kikhak ciangin naupangte sang ah mual tawng lampi sau zaw tawh paipih kul hi.

records.english: Is it okay if I drive slowly for the first week until I get used to the new truck?
records.zomi: Mawtaw lian thak ka kizat dong kal masa pen zawi takin ka mawng leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: My first job was washing buses at the depot before the drivers arrived.
records.zomi: Ka nasep masa pen mawtaw tuansakte a tun ma-un bus koihna mun ah bus sil ahi hi.

records.english: Our teacher missed the first lesson because her car got stuck in the mud.
records.zomi: I saya' mawtaw buan sungah a kibet ahih manin hilhna masa pen a mansuah hi.

records.english: Students mustn't park their motorbikes in front of the main entrance.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte in a motorbike uh lutna lian mai ah a koih thei kei ding uh hi.

records.english: The speed limit near the school was lowered after a child was hit by a motorbike.
records.zomi: Naupang khat motorbike in a sat khit ciangin sang kiang-a mawtaw manlanna ciang kiniamsak hi.

records.english: Do you know whether the company pays for parking?
records.zomi: Company in mawtaw koihna man a pia hiam na thei hiam?

records.english: The night before my first day as a bus driver, I drove the route twice in my own car.
records.zomi: Bus tuansak ka hih ni masa pen zan ma-in keimah' mawtaw tawh lampi vei nih ka mawng hi.

records.english: Since the new road was opened, the farmers can get their crops to the market in half the time.
records.zomi: Lampi thak kihon pan lo neite in a lo gah uh zuakna mun ah hun kim sungin a tun sak thei uh hi.

records.english: My driving instructor made me practice reversing into a parking space twenty times before my test.
records.zomi: Ka mawtaw mawng hilhpa in ka sitna ma-in mawtaw koihna ah nung lam-a lut vei sawmnih hong kisinsak hi.

records.english: I got my job at the bakery partly because I could drive the delivery van.
records.zomi: Van puak van ka mawng thei ahih manin moh bawlna inn ah ka nasep ka ngah hi.

records.english: No one is allowed to use their phone while driving a company vehicle.
records.zomi: Company mawtaw a mawng laitakin kuamah in phone zang thei lo hi.

records.english: Why did the bus company stop the early morning service?
records.zomi: Bang hangin bus company in zingsang manlang bus a khawlsak hiam?

records.english: Not enough workers were using it after the factory changed its shifts.
records.zomi: Factory in nasep hun a khel khit ciangin nasem a cing a zang kei uh hi.

records.english: The company paid for my driving lessons because the job required a license.
records.zomi: Nasep in phalna lai a kisam ahih manin company in ka mawtaw mawng kisinna man a pia hi.

records.english: I failed my first driving test because I forgot to look in the mirror before turning.
records.zomi: Ka kiheei ma-in mai et mitlang ka en mangngilh ahih manin ka mawtaw mawng sitna masa pen ka zo kei hi.

records.english: Sitting in traffic every morning made me start listening to recorded lectures in the car.
records.zomi: Zingsang simin mawtaw tam lak ah ka tut manin mawtaw sungah hilhna kila ka ngai kipan hi.

records.english: Drivers working for our company have to report even a small scratch on the van.
records.zomi: I company adinga mawtaw mawngte in van tung ah kikhuai neu khat zong a gen kul uh hi.

records.english: How long does your drive to work usually take?
records.zomi: Nasep pai dingin na mawng hun bangzah a sau zel hiam?

records.english: Twenty minutes on a good day, but almost an hour when it rains.
records.zomi: Ni hoih ciangin minit sawmnih, ahi zongin guah a zuk ciangin nai khat dek.

records.english: Truck drivers at our company aren't allowed to drive for more than nine hours a day.
records.zomi: I company-a mawtaw lian mawngte ni khat-in nai kua val a mawng thei kei uh hi.

records.english: May I leave my car in the school parking lot during the parents' meeting?
records.zomi: Nu leh pate' kikhopna laitakin sang mawtaw koihna ah ka mawtaw ka nusia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our school bus driver checks the tires every morning.
records.zomi: I sang bus tuansakpa in zingsang simin a kawngkual te a en hi.

records.english: There was so much traffic that I called my boss from the car to say I'd be late.
records.zomi: Mawtaw a tam lua ahih manin ka nun ding thu gen dingin mawtaw sung pan ka makaipa ka sam hi.

records.english: Please don't drive the tractor on the main road during school hours.
records.zomi: Sang hun sungin lampi lian tungah tractor mawng kei in.

records.english: My car didn't start this morning, so I took the bus to work.
records.zomi: Tu zingsangin ka mawtaw a nung kei ahih manin nasep ah bus ka tuang hi.

records.english: We had the old school van repainted and given new seats so that it could be used for another five years.
records.zomi: Kum nga behlap a kizat theih nadingin sang van lui lim thak i khai sak a, tutna thak i koih sak hi.

records.english: Since I started driving a taxi, I know every shortcut in the city.
records.zomi: Taxi ka mawng kipat pan khuapi sung lampi tom khempeuh ka thei hi.

records.english: There's road work on the way to the college, so leave ten minutes earlier tomorrow.
records.zomi: College lampi ah lampi kibawl ahih manin zingciang minit sawm ma-in pai khia in.

records.english: Do you need a special license to drive the school minibus?
records.zomi: Sang minibus mawng dingin phalna lai tuam na kisam hiam?

records.english: At our school, yes, and the teachers have to take a short course as well.
records.zomi: I sang ah kisam hi, sayate in kisinna tom khat zong a la kul uh hi.

records.english: My boss had the company cars fitted with trackers after one of them was stolen.
records.zomi: Khat a kiguk khit ciangin ka makaipa in company mawtaw te ah tracker a koih sak hi.

records.english: Can someone move the red car that's blocking the delivery entrance?
records.zomi: Van thunna lutna a khak mawtaw san kuamah in a pemsak thei ding hiam?

records.english: On market days, the road into town is blocked by trucks unloading vegetables.
records.zomi: Zuakna ni-in khuapi lutna lampi anteh a khiat mawtaw lian te in a khak hi.

records.english: The school gate was locked early, so the parents had to park on the street.
records.zomi: Sang kongpi hun ma-in kikhak ahih manin nu leh pate in lampi tungah mawtaw a koih kul uh hi.

records.english: The mechanic told me, "Your brakes are almost gone — don't drive to work until I've fixed them."
records.zomi: Mawtaw bawlpa in, “Na brake te bei dek khin hi — ka bawl kik ma-in nasep ah mawng kei in,” hong ci hi.

records.english: Please don't park in the visitors' spaces, because they're needed for patients.
records.zomi: Hong vehte' mawtaw koihna ah koih kei un, damlote adingin kisam ahih manin.

records.english: The driver was so tired after the night shift that he pulled over and slept for an hour.
records.zomi: Mawtaw tuansakpa zan nasep khit ciangin a gim lua ahih manin lampi gei ah a khawl a, nai khat a ihmu hi.

records.english: When the traffic lights stopped working, a teacher directed the cars outside the school gate.
records.zomi: Lampi meivak a sem nawn kei ciangin saya khat in sang kongpi polam ah mawtaw te a makaih hi.

records.english: My wife was so nervous on her first day driving the school bus that she drove the whole route at twenty kilometers an hour.
records.zomi: Ka zi sang bus a mawng ni masa pen-in a lau lua ahih manin lampi bup nai khat-in kilomita sawmnih-in a mawng hi.

records.english: Kids, don't open the car doors until we're properly parked outside the school.
records.zomi: Naupangte, sang polam ah kilawm takin i koih ma-in mawtaw kongkhak hong kei un.

records.english: Can I take the company van home tonight, since I'm starting the deliveries at six?
records.zomi: Nai guk ciangin van puak ka kipat ding ahih manin tu zanin company van inn ah ka tawi thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our office moved to the city center, and now I spend more time looking for parking than working.
records.zomi: I office khuapi laizang ah a pem a, tu-in nasep sangin mawtaw koihna zon ah hun tam zaw ka zang hi.

records.english: My little sister passed her driving test on the first try and drove herself to her new job the next day.
records.zomi: Ka nau numei in a mawtaw mawng sitna a vei masa pen-in a zo a, a zing ni-in amah mah in a nasep thak ah a mawng hi.

records.english: My father-in-law taught driving for thirty years and still corrects my driving from the passenger seat.
records.zomi: Ka sungpa in kum sawmthum sung mawtaw mawng a hilh a, a kiang tutna pan ka mawng dan a puahsak lai hi.

records.english: Our manager made us all watch a road safety video before we were given the keys to the vans.
records.zomi: Van tawh i ngah ma-un i manager in lampi bitna video khat hong ensak hi.

records.english: The road outside the factory was repaired at night so that the trucks could keep running during the day.
records.zomi: Mawtaw lian te sun ciangin a pai den theih nadingin factory polam lampi zanin kibawl kik hi.

records.english: Could you drive me to the exam center, since I'll be too nervous to drive myself?
records.zomi: Kei mah in ka mawng zo lo dingin ka lau ding ahih manin sitna mun ah hong paipih thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: The taxi driver said, "I've been driving this city for twenty years, and the traffic has never been worse."
records.zomi: Taxi tuansakpa in, “Hih khuapi ah kum sawmnih sung ka mawng a, mawtaw tamna hih sangin a sia ngei kei hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: Can you teach me how to change a tire before I start my job as a delivery driver?
records.zomi: Van puak mawtaw mawngpa ka nasep ka kipat ma-in kawngkual laih dan hong hilh thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: A truck broke down on the bridge, and half the town was late for work.
records.zomi: Lei tungah mawtaw lian khat a sia a, khuapi a kim in nasep ah a nun uh hi.

records.english: The traffic police officer said, "Slow down — this is a school zone."
records.zomi: Lampi police in, “Zawi takin mawng in — hih pen sang mun ahi hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: Who drives the delivery truck when Thomas is on holiday?
records.zomi: Thomas tawlngakni a zat laitakin van puak mawtaw lian kua in a mawng hiam?

records.english: You'll need your staff card to drive through the gate at the port.
records.zomi: Tembaw tulpi kongpi tawng-in na mawng nadingin na nasem card na kisam ding hi.

records.english: My cousin earns extra money on weekends by driving people to the airport.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in kal tawp-in vanlengtual ah mite paipih-in sum behlap a ngah hi.

records.english: Would you mind sharing the drive to the training center this week?
records.zomi: Hih kal kisinna mun pai nadingin mawtaw mawng i kihawm leh na lungkham ding hiam?

records.english: What's the best way to avoid the traffic near the university at eight?
records.zomi: Nai giat ciangin sangpi kiang-a mawtaw tamna nawl nadingin lampi hoih pen bang ahi hiam?

records.english: Leave a little earlier, or take the road behind the hospital.
records.zomi: Tawmno manlang zawin pai khia in, ahih kei leh zato nung lam lampi zui in.

records.english: Can I come to work by motorbike now that there's no bus?
records.zomi: Bus om nawn lo ahih manin tu-in motorbike tawh nasep ah ka hong thei ding hiam?

records.english: Don't wait for the last bus alone after work; I'll come and meet you.
records.zomi: Nasep khit ciangin bus nunung nangma' bek in ngak kei in; kong dawn ding hi.

records.english: Ask the driver to let you off at the school gate; he usually doesn't mind.
records.zomi: Sang kongpi ah hong khiat sak dingin tuansakpa ngen in; a lungkham zel kei hi.

records.english: Is it all right if I take my bicycle on the train to work?
records.zomi: Nasep ka pai nadingin meileng tungah ka siiksakol ka tawi leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: Only outside rush hour, and only in the last carriage.
records.zomi: Mi tam hun polam bek, a nunung pen meileng tawl sungah bek.

records.english: No one is allowed to smoke at the bus station, not even outside the waiting room.
records.zomi: Bus station ah kuamah in meikhu dawn thei lo hi, ngakna khan polam zongin.

records.english: A woman fainted in the crowded train, and two students helped her off at the next station.
records.zomi: Mi a tam meileng sungah numei khat a kia a, sangnaupang nih in a zom station ah a kiaksak uh hi.

records.english: The last train leaves at eleven, so the night-shift workers have to take a taxi home.
records.zomi: Meileng nunung nai sawm leh khat ciangin a pai ahih manin zan nasemte in inn ah taxi tawh a ciah kul uh hi.

records.english: The morning bus is so crowded with workers that I often have to wait for the next one.
records.zomi: Zingsang bus nasemte tawh a dim lua ahih manin a zom khat ka ngak kul zel hi.

records.english: My wife and I met on the morning ferry, both on our way to work in the city.
records.zomi: Ka zi leh kei zingsang tembaw tungah i kimu a, i nih in khuapi ah nasep dingin i pai hi.

records.english: Can you lend me some coins for the bus, since I left my wallet at the office?
records.zomi: Ka sum ip office ah ka nusia ahih manin bus adingin dangka tawmno hong leitawi thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: My cousin became a train driver after years of watching the trains from his school window.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in kum tampi sang tawhkhawng pan meileng a en khit ciangin meileng mawngpa a suak hi.

records.english: When I worked at the ticket office, the hardest part was explaining delays to angry passengers.
records.zomi: Ticket office ah na ka sep lai-in a haksa pen tuangte heh kiangah a nun dan gen siang ahi hi.

records.english: If the train is late again, could you start the meeting without me?
records.zomi: Meileng a nun kik leh kei om lo-in kikhopna na kipat sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Would it be quicker to take the train or the bus to the conference center?
records.zomi: Kikhopna inn lian ah meileng tawh pai a manlang zaw ding hiam, bus tawh hiam?

records.english: The minibus to the factory was so full that two workers rode on the roof.
records.zomi: Factory pai minibus a dim lua ahih manin nasem nih a tung ah a tuang uh hi.

records.english: The bus fare went up again, and many students now walk to school instead.
records.zomi: Bus man a khang kik a, sangnaupang tampi in tu-in sang ah a kaai uh hi.

records.english: Does this tram go past the hospital where I work?
records.zomi: Hih tram in ka sepna zato kiang a kantan hiam?

records.english: When the trains were canceled, the university postponed the exam by a day.
records.zomi: Meileng te kiphiat ciangin sangpi in sitna ni khat a zekhia hi.

records.english: How do you get to work when the buses are on strike?
records.zomi: Bus te a kikhawl ciangin nasep ah bangci-in na pai hiam?

records.english: I walk, which takes an hour, but at least I get some exercise.
records.zomi: Ka kaai a, nai khat a sau hi, ahi zongin pumpi kisinna ka ngah hi.

records.english: The workers who built the new railway were the first to ride it on opening day.
records.zomi: Meileng lampi thak a lam nasemte a hon ni-in a tuang masa pen uh hi.

records.english: The schoolchildren were moved to a separate carriage so that commuters could get on.
records.zomi: Nasep pai mite a tuan theih nadingun sangnaupangte meileng tawl tuam ah kipemsak uh hi.

records.english: The driver waited for a breathless nurse who was running for the bus after her shift.
records.zomi: A nasep hun khit ciangin bus delh-a tai nurse khat tuansakpa in a ngak hi.

records.english: The bus was stuck behind a broken-down truck, and I arrived at the interview ten minutes late.
records.zomi: Bus pen mawtaw lian siat khat nung ah a kibet a, dotna ah minit sawm ka nun hi.

records.english: Which side of the road does the bus to the technical college leave from?
records.zomi: Technical college pai bus lampi lam bang pan a pai hiam?

records.english: I use the forty minutes on the train to read through my lecture notes.
records.zomi: Meileng tung-a minit sawmli sungin ka hilhna gelhte ka sim hi.

records.english: Missing the early bus means I lose half a day's pay at the market.
records.zomi: Zingsang bus masa ka mansuah leh zuakna mun ah ni kim man ka mansuah hi.

records.english: Can students get a cheaper monthly pass?
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte in kha khat pass man neu zaw a ngah thei uh hiam?

records.english: Yes, if you show your student card at the ticket office.
records.zomi: Ngah thei uh hi, ticket office ah na sangnaupang card na lak leh.

records.english: My son's teacher takes three buses to reach our village school every day.
records.zomi: Ka tapa' saya in ni simin i khua sang a tun nadingin bus thum a tuang hi.

records.english: Working on my laptop during the train journey means I have less to do when I get to the office.
records.zomi: Meileng khualzinna sungin ka laptop tungah na ka sep manin office ka tun ciangin ka sep ding a tawm zaw hi.

records.english: Students, stay together when we get off at the museum stop.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, museum khawlna ah i kiak ciangin khawm in om un.

records.english: Since the ferry started running every hour, more islanders have taken jobs in the town.
records.zomi: Tembaw nai khat simin a pai kipat pan tuikulh mi tam zaw in khuapi ah nasep a la uh hi.

records.english: The trains were so unreliable last winter that my boss let me start an hour later.
records.zomi: Khuavot bei-in meileng te a muan huai lua kei ahih manin ka makaipa in nai khat nunin hong kipatsak hi.

records.english: The ticket inspector said, "Your pass expired yesterday, so I'm afraid you'll have to buy a ticket."
records.zomi: Ticket enpa in, “Na pass zanni-in a bei khin ahih manin ticket khat na lei kul ding hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: Is there a bus that gets to the university before eight?
records.zomi: Nai giat ma-in sangpi a tung bus khat a om hiam?

records.english: My briefcase was left on the bus, but the driver brought it to my office the next day.
records.zomi: Ka briefcase bus tungah kinusia a, ahi zongin a zing ni-in tuansakpa in ka office ah hong tawi hi.

records.english: A new bus route was added for the students who live in the hill villages.
records.zomi: Mual khua-a om sangnaupangte adingin bus lampi thak khat kibehlap hi.

records.english: My teacher sat next to me on the bus one morning and helped me with my homework.
records.zomi: Zingsang khat ka saya bus tungah ka kiang ah a tu a, ka inn-a sep ding hong huh hi.

records.english: Eating isn't allowed on the city trains, so I finish my breakfast on the platform.
records.zomi: Khuapi meileng tungah an nek kiphal lo ahih manin platform tungah ka zingsang an ka ne zo hi.

records.english: The station announcer said, "Passengers for the university, please change at the next stop."
records.zomi: Station thu zasakpa in, “Sangpi pai tuangte, a zom khawlna ah lai un,” a ci hi.

records.english: Every morning the same old man gets on at the market and asks the students about their lessons.
records.zomi: Zingsang simin pasal upa kibang mah zuakna mun ah a tuang a, sangnaupangte kiangah a hilhna thu uh a dong hi.

records.english: My daughter's school bus was rerouted because a bridge had been washed away.
records.zomi: Lei khat tui in a lak manin ka tanu' sang bus lampi tuam ah kituah hi.

records.english: Why don't you take the express bus to the industrial area?
records.zomi: Bang hangin factory mun ah bus manlang na tuang kei hiam?

records.english: There's no bus to our village after six, so the teachers who live there leave school on time.
records.zomi: Nai guk khit ciangin i khua ah bus om lo ahih manin tua ah a om sayate in hun takah sang a paisan uh hi.

records.english: Commuters were given free coffee at the station to apologize for the week of delays.
records.zomi: Kal khat sung a nun manin maisak ngen nadingin nasep pai mite station ah kawfi a man om lo-in kipia uh hi.

records.english: Why are the trains always late on the first day of term?
records.zomi: Bang hangin term ni masa pen-in meileng te a nun tawntung hiam?

records.english: Bus drivers on our route mustn't leave the stop before the school children are seated.
records.zomi: I lampi-a bus tuansakte in sang naupangte a tut kim ma-un khawlna a paisan thei kei uh hi.

records.english: The station was closed for repairs, so we had to walk to the next one before work.
records.zomi: Station kibawl kik ahih manin kikhak a, nasep ma-in a zom station dong i kaai kul hi.

records.english: Please don't put your feet on the seats; other people have to sit there in their work clothes.
records.zomi: Tutna tungah na khe koih kei in; mi dangte in a nasep puan tawh tua ah a tu kul uh hi.

records.english: Students who travel by boat to our school sometimes arrive soaked after a rainy crossing.
records.zomi: I sang ah tembaw tawh hong pai sangnaupangte guah zuk kantan khit ciangin a dip kim-in a tung zel uh hi.

records.english: Can I use my old student pass until the new one arrives?
records.zomi: A thak a tun dong ka sangnaupang pass lui ka zang thei ding hiam?

records.english: Taking the bus to work instead of driving has saved us enough money for the children's school trip.
records.zomi: Mawtaw mawng sangin nasep ah bus tuan in naupangte' sang khualzinna adingin sum a cing hong khol sak hi.

records.english: Kids, give your seats to the people standing with heavy bags.
records.zomi: Naupangte, van gik tawh a ding mite na tutna uh pia un.

records.english: May I sit here, or are you saving the seat for a colleague?
records.zomi: Hih ah ka tu thei ding hiam, nasem lawm khat adingin na koih hiam?

records.english: Which bus goes closest to the job center?
records.zomi: Nasep zonna mun a kiang pen bus bang ahi hiam?

records.english: The number 12, but you'll need to walk the last five minutes.
records.zomi: Nambat 12, ahi zongin a nunung minit nga na kaai kul ding hi.

records.english: My uncle worked as a bus conductor for thirty years and knew every regular passenger by name.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu kum sawmthum sung bus ticket enpa-in na a sem a, a tuang den khempeuh a min tawh a thei hi.

records.english: On my first commute to the new job, I got on the train going the wrong way.
records.zomi: Nasep thak ah ka pai masa pen-in meileng lam khial a pai ka tuang hi.

records.english: Let the passengers get off first, and then get on.
records.zomi: Tuangte kia masa sak unla, tua khit ciangin tuang un.

records.english: On my first business trip, I left my suit in the hotel and had to give the presentation in jeans.
records.zomi: Ka sumbawlna khualzinna masa pen-in ka suit zinbuuk ah ka nusia a, jeans tawh presentation ka bawl kul hi.

records.english: Students on the trip aren't allowed to leave the hotel without a teacher.
records.zomi: Khualzinna-a sangnaupangte saya om lo-in zinbuuk a paisan thei kei uh hi.

records.english: Could we leave a little earlier, so that I'm not late for the afternoon meeting?
records.zomi: Nitak kikhopna ah ka nun loh nadingin tawmno manlang zawin i pai khia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Do you think we'll have time to visit my old classmate while we're in town for work?
records.zomi: Nasep adingin khuapi ah i om laitakin ka kilasi lawm lui veh nading hun i nei ding in na ngaihsun hiam?

records.english: My flight to the job interview was canceled, so I had to do the interview by video from the airport.
records.zomi: Nasep dotna ah ka pai nading vanleng kiphiat ahih manin vanlengtual pan video tawh dotna ka bawl kul hi.

records.english: The professor said, "If you come to the capital, visit our university and I'll show you the labs."
records.zomi: Professor in, “Gam khuapi lian ah na pai leh i sangpi hong veh inla lab te kong etsak ding hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: My daughter got so excited about starting university in the capital that she packed a week early.
records.zomi: Ka tanu gam khuapi lian ah sangpi kah ding a lungdam lua ahih manin kal khat ma-in a van a thun hi.

records.english: Our hotel room was so small that my colleague and I could only open one suitcase at a time.
records.zomi: I zinbuuk khan a neu lua ahih manin ka nasem lawm leh kei van bawm khat bek vei khat-in i hong thei hi.

records.english: When I moved to the city for my first job, I didn't know a single person there.
records.zomi: Ka nasep masa pen adingin khuapi ah ka pem ciangin tua ah mi khat zong ka thei kei hi.

records.english: Since the new highway was built, my brother can drive to his office in the city and back in one day.
records.zomi: Lam lianpi thak kilam pan ka sanggam pasal in khuapi-a a office ah ni khat sungin a mawng a, a ciah kik thei hi.

records.english: Our teacher made each of us write a short diary of the trip for our parents.
records.zomi: I saya in i nu leh pate adingin khualzinna diary tom khat i khat ciat gelhsak hi.

records.english: My aunt traveled to the city every month for her cancer treatment while still teaching.
