records.zomi: Khua makaipa kiangah lawm khat bangci-in na theisak hiam?

records.english: You say who their family is first, and then why they've come.
records.zomi: A innkuan uh a masa-in na gen a, tua khit ciangin bang hangin a hong pai uh hiam na gen hi.

records.english: Kids, say hello to Mrs. Kim — she runs the community garden, and she's going to show you the tomatoes.
records.zomi: Naupangte, Mrs. Kim kiangah hello ci un — mipi huan a kem a, khamtungte hong etsak ding hi.

records.english: I introduced my cousin to the youth club, and now he coaches the under-twelves.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam khangno pawl ah ka theisak a, tu-in kum sawm leh nih nuaite a hilh hi.

records.english: This is my friend Grace, who interprets for the deaf members of our community.
records.zomi: Hih pen ka lawm Grace ahi a, i mipi sung-a bilngong mite adingin a let sak hi.

records.english: Of everyone in our class, my old school friend seemed the least likely to become police chief, and yet he did.
records.zomi: I kilasi khempeuh lak ah ka sang lawm lui police makaipa a suak ding ka lamen pen hi, ahi zongin a suak hi.

records.english: I do want you to meet the nurse who looked after Grandpa, because she was so kind to him.
records.zomi: Pu a kem nurse amah tungah a hehpih mahmah ahih manin na theih ding ka deih taktak hi.

records.english: Have you two been introduced, or shall I do it now?
records.zomi: Note nih kitheisak khin na hi uh hiam, tu-in ka sem ding hiam?

records.english: Everyone, this is my sister Esther, who'll be helping at the food bank on Saturdays.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, hih pen ka sanggam nu Esther ahi a, Kiginni simin an kaikhawmna mun ah a huh ding hi.

records.english: I'd like you all to meet Thomas, my oldest friend and the best mechanic in town.
records.zomi: Thomas na theih uh ka deih hi, ka lawm lui pen leh khuapi-a mawtaw bawl siam pen.

records.english: Have you met my friend Daniel, the electrician who fixed the community hall lights?
records.zomi: Mipi inn lian meivak a bawl electrician, ka lawm Daniel na mu khin hiam?

records.english: Doctor, this is my mother, and I'll help explain her symptoms because her hearing isn't good.
records.zomi: Siavuan, hih pen ka nu ahi a, a za siang lo ahih manin a natna gen siang ka huh ding hi.

records.english: My friend's wheelchair didn't fit through the clinic door, so the staff showed us a side entrance.
records.zomi: Ka lawm' leeng tutna clinic kongkhak ah a kilawm kei ahih manin nasemte in gei lutna hong etsak uh hi.

records.english: At the church picnic, I introduced my new husband to every family in the congregation.
records.zomi: Pawlpi picnic ah ka pasal thak pawlpi innkuan khempeuh kiangah ka theisak hi.

records.english: Children, these are the firefighters who will teach you what to do if there's a fire at school.
records.zomi: Naupangte, hih te sang ah mei a kat leh bang na sep ding uh hiam hong hilh ding mei mitsakte ahi uh hi.

records.english: Would your friend like to meet the woman who runs the job center?
records.zomi: Na lawm in nasep zonna mun kem nu a theih nuam ding hiam?

records.english: Could I bring my brother to the clinic so that you can meet him before his operation?
records.zomi: A khamna ma-in na theih theih nadingin ka sanggam pasal clinic ah ka paipih thei ding hiam?

records.english: My best friend works at the post office, so she always introduces me to the new staff.
records.zomi: Ka lawm hoih pen post office ah na a sep ahih manin nasem thakte kiangah hong theisak tawntung hi.

records.english: Can you tell the receptionist who this is, so that she can add him to your family's file?
records.zomi: Na innkuan file ah a behlap theih nadingin reception nu kiangah hih kua ahi hiam na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Grandma was so pleased to be introduced to the new doctor that she brought him a basket of eggs.
records.zomi: Siavuan thak kiangah kitheisak in Pi a lungdamsak lua ahih manin aktui bawm khat a tawi sak hi.

records.english: Let me introduce my neighbor, Mrs. Lun, who started the reading group at the library.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng nu, laibu inn-a lai sim pawl a phut Mrs. Lun kong theisak ning.

records.english: Is it all right if I bring my friend to the library talk?
records.zomi: Laibu inn thugen ah ka lawm ka paipih leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: Mom, this is the bus driver who found my wallet and brought it back.
records.zomi: Nu, hih pen ka sum ip a mu a, hong lohsak kik bus tuansakpa ahi hi.

records.english: This is my husband, Paul, who repairs the town's water pumps.
records.zomi: Hih pen ka pasal Paul ahi a, khuapi tui pump te a bawl hi.

records.english: All of you, please put on your name tags so that the new families know who you are.
records.zomi: Note khempeuh, innkuan thakte in kua na hi uh hiam a theih theih nadingun na min tag uh bulh un.

records.english: Would you like me to introduce you to the head of the parents' association?
records.zomi: Nu leh pate' pawl makaipa kiangah kong theisak ding na deih hiam?

records.english: My uncle, who has volunteered at the shelter for twenty years, introduced me to the work.
records.zomi: Om sakna mun ah kum sawmnih sung thalawp nasem ka pa neu in tua nasep hong theisak hi.

records.english: Introducing my parents to my friends at the community choir was easier than I'd feared.
records.zomi: Mipi la sa pawl-a ka lawmte kiangah ka nu leh ka pa theisak ka lau sangin a baih zaw hi.

records.english: The volunteers' families were invited to the end-of-year dinner at the community hall.
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte' innkuante mipi inn lian ah kum tawp nitak an ah kisam uh hi.

records.english: Mr. Hau, I'd like you to meet my daughter, who's just finished her nursing course.
records.zomi: Mr. Hau, a nursing kisinna a zo thak ka tanu na theih ding ka deih hi.

records.english: Our new neighbors were welcomed to the street with a meal that everyone helped to cook.
records.zomi: I inn veng thakte mi khempeuh' huh-a kihuan an tawh lampi ah kimuak uh hi.

records.english: Once she had been introduced to the right people, my friend found a job at the health center within a week.
records.zomi: A man mite kiangah a kitheisak khit ciangin ka lawm in kal khat sungin damna inn ah nasep a ngah hi.

records.english: I'd like to introduce you to my mother, who has lived on this street longer than anyone.
records.zomi: Hih lampi ah kuamah sangin a om sau zaw ka nu kong theisak nuam hi.

records.english: Officer, this is my friend whose bicycle was stolen outside the market.
records.zomi: Police, hih pen zuakna mun polam ah a siiksakol kiguk ka lawm ahi hi.

records.english: Excuse me, Councilor, this is my neighbor, who's been waiting a month for her water to be connected.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, vaihawmpa, hih pen a tui kizopsak dingin kha khat a ngak ka inn veng nu ahi hi.

records.english: My cousin's story about the flood was so moving that the whole meeting went quiet when I introduced her.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu' tuiciim tangthu a lungsim khoih lua ahih manin ka theisak ciangin kikhopna bup a dai hi.

records.english: Who's the woman standing next to the mayor?
records.zomi: Khuapi ukpa nu kiang-a ding numei kua ahi hiam?

records.english: That's her mother — she was the town's first female councilor.
records.zomi: Tua pen a nu ahi — khuapi-a numei vaihawm masa pen ahi hi.

records.english: Let me show you a picture of my grandson, the one who drives the ambulance.
records.zomi: Ka tu pa, ambulance mawngpa' lim kong etsak ning.

records.english: When my friend arrived from abroad, I introduced her to the social worker who could help her find housing.
records.zomi: Ka lawm gamdang pan a tun ciangin inn a muh nadingin a huh thei mipi huhna nasempa kiangah ka theisak hi.

records.english: Should I introduce my mother to the doctor, or will she want to speak for herself?
records.zomi: Ka nu siavuan kiangah ka theisak ding hiam, amah mah in a gen nuam ding hiam?

records.english: My little brother was so excited to meet the police officer that he asked to try on her hat.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal police numei a muh a lungdam lua ahih manin a lukhu silh sin dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: My father-in-law was introduced to the whole village at the harvest festival.
records.zomi: Buh lak pawi ah ka sungpa khua bup kiangah kitheisak hi.

records.english: Could you tell my daughter about the nurses' training program?
records.zomi: Nurse kisinna program thu ka tanu kiangah na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Who's the man you brought to the community meeting?
records.zomi: Mipi kikhopna ah na paipih pa kua ahi hiam?

records.english: My cousin — he's just moved here and wants to join the street committee.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam — hih ah a pem thak a, lampi committee ah a kihel nuam hi.

records.english: The two families were introduced by the pastor, and they've been close ever since.
records.zomi: Innkuan nih pastor in a theisak a, tua pan a kinai mahmah uh hi.

records.english: Kids, show our visitors the vegetable garden you planted for the school kitchen.
records.zomi: Naupangte, sang anbuk adingin na suan anteh huan i khualte etsak un.

records.english: Let's take our visitors to see the new health post on the way to lunch.
records.zomi: Sun an i pai lam ah damna mun thak et dingin i khualte paipih ni.

records.english: However few visitors we get, each one is treated as an honored guest.
records.zomi: Khual bangzah tawm zongin khat ciat zahtak khual bangin kikoih hi.

records.english: Welcome to our village — the elders are waiting for you at the meeting house.
records.zomi: I khua ah kidawn un — upate in kikhopna inn ah hong ngak uh hi.

records.english: Could you translate the welcome speech for our guests from the partner town?
records.zomi: Kithuah khuapi pan i khualte adingin muakna thu na let sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Had we known the inspectors were coming, we would have cleaned the waiting room the night before.
records.zomi: Enkaktute a hong ding i theih leh a zan ma-in ngakna khan i siangsak ding hi.

records.english: Whoever leaves last should switch off the projector in the visitors' room.
records.zomi: A paisan nunung pen in hong vehte' khan-a projector a phel ding hi.

records.english: All of you are welcome to look around the library, but keep your voices down.
records.zomi: Note khempeuh laibu inn sung na en thei uh hi, ahi zongin na aw uh niamsak un.

records.english: The lost hikers were welcomed into the ranger's hut with blankets and hot soup.
records.zomi: Lampi mangthang mual kawikawite gam kemtu inn neu ah puanzial leh an-tui lum tawh kimuak uh hi.

records.english: Visitors to the museum are greeted by a volunteer who tells them the history of the town.
records.zomi: Museum hong vehte khuapi tangthu a gen thalawp nasem khat in a hopih hi.

records.english: By the time the refugee family arrived, the church members had furnished a small house for them, down to the curtains.
records.zomi: Gam taimang innkuan a tun ciangin pawlpi mite in kongkhak puan dong-in inn neu khat a bawl khin uh hi.

records.english: Welcome to the community radio station — mind the cables on the floor.
records.zomi: Mipi radio station ah kidawn un — lei tung-a cable te pilvang un.

records.english: Our neighbors welcomed the nurses from the city with a basket of fruit and a handwritten note.
records.zomi: I inn vengte in khuapi pan nurse te singgah bawm leh khut tawh kigelh lai khat tawh a muak uh hi.

records.english: The mayor met the visiting engineers at the bridge and walked them across it herself.
records.zomi: Khuapi ukpa nu in hong veh engineer te lei ah a dawn a, amah mah in a kantan pih hi.

records.english: Could you show the visitors around the water plant before lunch?
records.zomi: Sun an ma-in hong vehte tui bawlna mun sung na etsak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Why did the whole village come out to meet the truck?
records.zomi: Bang hangin khua bup in mawtaw lian dawn dingin a pai khia uh hiam?

records.english: It was bringing the first solar panels for the school.
records.zomi: Sang adingin solar panel masa pente a tawi ahih manin.

records.english: How did the town welcome the flood volunteers?
records.zomi: Tuiciim thalawp nasemte khuapi in bangci-in a muak hiam?

records.english: Every family cooked something, and the school hall became a dining room for a week.
records.zomi: Innkuan khempeuh in na khat ciat a huan uh a, kal khat sung sang inn lian an nekna khan a suak hi.

records.english: The welcome ceremony was cut short when the rain started, but nobody minded.
records.zomi: Guah a zuk kipat ciangin muakna poai tom takin a tawp a, ahi zongin kuamah a lungkham kei uh hi.

records.english: Is there a tourist office where visitors can pick up a map?
records.zomi: Hong vehte in map a lak theihna khualzinte office khat a om hiam?

records.english: Yes, next to the market, and the woman there speaks four languages.
records.zomi: Om hi, zuakna mun kiang ah, tua ah a om numei in pau li a zang thei hi.

records.english: Not only was the community hall repainted for the officials' visit, but the road to it was finally repaired.
records.zomi: Vaihawmte' veh adingin mipi inn lian lim kikhai kik bek hi lo-in a pai nading lampi zong a tawp-in kibawl kik hi.

records.english: Using a megaphone, the village chief welcomed the bus full of visitors from the city.
records.zomi: Megaphone zang-in khua makaipa in khuapi pan hong veh mite' bus a muak hi.

records.english: Students, line up at the gate and say good morning to the visitors from the ministry.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, kongpi ah kizom unla ministry pan hong vehte kiangah Zingpha ci un.

records.english: Thank you for visiting our cooperative, and please come back at harvest time.
records.zomi: I lo nei pawl hong veh manun ka lungdam hi, buh lak hun ciangin hong pai kik un.

records.english: The visiting minister was so moved by the children's songs that she promised a new classroom.
records.zomi: Hong veh minister nu in naupangte' la in a lungsim a khoih lua ahih manin kilasi thak khat a kiciam hi.

records.english: The firefighters let the children climb into the fire engine during the station's open day.
records.zomi: Mei mitsakna inn hon ni-in mei mitsakte in naupangte mei mitsakna mawtaw sungah a kahsak uh hi.

records.english: The dust from the road covered our visitors' clothes, so we offered them water to wash before the welcome meal.
records.zomi: Lampi leivui in i khualte' puan a khuh ahih manin muakna an ma-in kisil dingin tui i pia hi.

records.english: So impressed were the visiting officials by the clean market that they asked to meet the women who had organized it.
records.zomi: Hong veh vaihawmte in zuakna mun siang a lamdang sak lua uh ahih manin a vaihawm numeite mu dingin a ngen uh hi.

records.english: When the bishop visited our parish, the whole road was swept and lined with flowers.
records.zomi: Bishop in i pawlpi a veh ciangin lampi bup kiphiat a, pak tawh kizeem hi.

records.english: Everyone, please give a warm welcome to Dr. Lian, our new doctor at the health center.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, i damna inn-a siavuan thak Dr. Lian lungsim lum takin muak ni.

records.english: The police officer welcomed the students to the station and showed them the radio room.
records.zomi: Police in sangnaupangte station ah a muak a, radio khan a etsak hi.

records.english: Our town's first group of foreign tourists was welcomed with a dance in the square.
records.zomi: I khuapi-a gamdang khualzin pawl masa pen pen laizang ah lam tawh kimuak uh hi.

records.english: Welcoming journalists to the village was new for us, and the children followed them everywhere.
records.zomi: Thuthak gelhte khua ah muak pen kote adingin a thak ahi a, naupangte in koi ah zong a zui uh hi.

records.english: Who will greet the visitors at the community center tomorrow?
records.zomi: Zingciang mipi inn ah hong vehte kua in a hopih ding hiam?

records.english: Our librarian keeps a box of toys so that visiting children don't get bored while their parents read.
records.zomi: Hong veh naupangte a nu leh pa uh a sim laitakin a lungkiat loh nadingun i laibu inn kemnu in tawng bawm khat a kem hi.

records.english: The inspectors might arrive early, so the clinic should be ready by eight.
records.zomi: Enkaktute hun ma-in a tung kha ding uh ahih manin nai giat ma-in clinic kiman ding hi.

records.english: Visitors often tell me that the welcome they received in our market is what they remember most.
records.zomi: I zuakna mun ah a ngah muakna pen a phawk pen ahi hi, ci-in hong vehte in hong gen zel uh hi.

records.english: How should we welcome the medical team that's coming next month?
records.zomi: Kha hong ding ciangin hong pai ding zato pawl bangci-in i muak ding hiam?

records.english: Meet them at the bus stop, help with their equipment, and make sure their rooms are clean.
records.zomi: Bus khawlna ah dawn unla, a vante uh puak huh unla, a khan uh a siang hiam kician takin en un.

records.english: Having traveled for two days to reach us, the volunteer doctors were welcomed like family.
records.zomi: Kote hong tun nadingun ni nih a khualzin khit uh ciangin thalawp siavuante innkuan bangin kimuak uh hi.

records.english: What would make visitors want to come back to our town?
records.zomi: Bang in hong vehte i khuapi ah a hong kik nuam sak ding hiam?

records.english: Visitors aren't allowed into the clean water area without boots, so we keep spare pairs by the door.
records.zomi: Tui siangtho mun ah khedap sau om lo-in hong vehte lut thei lo ahih manin kongkhak kiang ah behlap i koih hi.

records.english: When the visiting choir's bus broke down, every car in town drove out to collect them.
records.zomi: Hong veh la sa pawl' bus a siat ciangin khuapi-a mawtaw khempeuh amaute la dingin a pai khia uh hi.

records.english: We do want visitors to feel safe here, so the guides walk with every group.
records.zomi: Hong vehte hih ah bitna takin a om ding uh i deih taktak ahih manin makaipate in pawl khempeuh a zui uh hi.

records.english: Thanks to the new road, visitors can reach our village in two hours instead of a whole day.
records.zomi: Lampi thak hang-in hong vehte in i khua ni bup sangin nai nih sungin a tung thei uh hi.

records.english: The new residents' welcome pack includes a map, the bus timetable, and the clinic's phone number.
records.zomi: Teeng thakte' muakna bawm sungah map, bus hun gelhna leh clinic phone nambat a om hi.

records.english: If the weather stays dry, we could welcome the visitors with a meal in the square.
records.zomi: Khua a keu den leh laizang ah an tawh hong vehte i muak thei hi.

records.english: My grandmother, who is the oldest woman in the village, always welcomes visitors first.
records.zomi: Khua sung-a numei upa pen ka pi in hong vehte a muak masa tawntung hi.

records.english: The volunteers were so tired when they arrived that we let them sleep before the welcome dinner.
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte a tun ciangun a gim lua uh ahih manin muakna nitak an ma-in i ihmusak hi.

records.english: Can we offer the visitors from the health ministry some tea before the meeting?
records.zomi: Kikhopna ma-in damna ministry pan hong vehte tea i pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: The bridge had been decorated with flags, and the children waved as the visitors crossed it.
records.zomi: Lei puanzan tawh kizeem a, hong vehte a kantan ciangin naupangte in khut a vaai uh hi.

records.english: We printed welcome signs in three languages so that every visitor would feel included.
records.zomi: Hong veh khempeuh kihel a kisak theih nadingun pau thum tawh muakna lai i suaksak hi.

records.english: Make yourselves comfortable in the waiting room, and the nurse will call you in a moment.
records.zomi: Ngakna khan ah nuam takin om un, nurse in hun tawmno khit ciangin hong sam ding hi.

records.english: Would the visitors like to see how we make the baskets?
records.zomi: Hong vehte in bawm i phiat dan a et nuam uh hiam?

records.english: There may not be enough chairs for everyone, so some visitors will have to stand.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh adingin tutna a cing kei kha ding ahih manin hong veh khenkhatte a ding kul ding uh hi.

records.english: The village was given a week's notice of the governor's visit, and every house was repaired in time.
records.zomi: Governor' veh ding kal khat ma-in khua kigen a, inn khempeuh hun takah kibawl kik hi.

records.english: Is it all right if the visitors take photos inside the church?
records.zomi: Hong vehte in pawlpi sungah lim a la uh leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: Welcome back — we've missed you at the community garden.
records.zomi: Hong ciah kik nai — mipi huan ah nong ngaih hi.

records.english: All of you who helped rebuild the school, thank you — we couldn't have done it without you.
records.zomi: Sang lam kik huh note khempeuh, ka lungdam hi — note om lo leh i sem thei lo ding hi.

records.english: It may be the last time we see Grandpa at the market, since he's moving in with my uncle.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu kiang ah a om ding ahih manin zuakna mun ah Pu i muh nunung pen hi kha ding hi.

records.english: On the library's last day in the old building, the children helped carry the books to the new one.
records.zomi: Laibu inn lui ah a ni nunung pen-in naupangte in laibute a thak ah a puak huh uh hi.

records.english: I recorded a goodbye message on my phone for the volunteers who couldn't come to the party.
records.zomi: Pawi ah a hong thei lo thalawp nasemte adingin ka phone tungah goodbye message khat ka la hi.

records.english: When the pastor said goodbye, he reminded us to keep visiting the elderly members of the church.
records.zomi: Pastor in goodbye a cih ciangin pawlpi-a upate veh den dingin hong phawksak hi.

records.english: When will the new doctor arrive?
records.zomi: Siavuan thak bang ciangin a tung ding hiam?

records.english: Our postman retired after thirty years, and every house on his route left a card in its mailbox for him.
records.zomi: I lai puakpa kum sawmthum khit ciangin a khawl a, a lampi-a inn khempeuh in a lai bawm sungah a adingin card khat a koih uh hi.

records.english: The volunteers left their tools behind for the village, so that the work could continue.
records.zomi: Nasep a om den theih nadingin thalawp nasemte in a nasep vante khua adingin a nusia uh hi.

records.english: Can I say goodbye to the nurses before we leave the hospital?
records.zomi: Zato i paisan ma-in nurse te kiangah goodbye ka ci thei ding hiam?

records.english: Saying goodbye to the patients she'd cared for over twenty years, the old nurse could hardly speak.
records.zomi: Kum sawmnih sung a kem damlote kiangah goodbye a cih ciangin nurse upa in kammal a gen zo kei hi.

records.english: Goodbye, Mr. Hau — thank you for fixing our water pump so many times.
records.zomi: Goodbye, Mr. Hau — i tui pump vei tampi na bawl manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: The choir sang her favorite hymn at the end of her last service as our pastor.
records.zomi: I pastor-a a pawlpi nunung pen tawp ciangin la sa pawl in a la deih pen a sa uh hi.

records.english: When the mobile clinic left, the nurses promised to come back in three months.
records.zomi: Kawikawi clinic a pai ciangin nurse te kha thum khit ciangin hong pai kik ding a kiciam uh hi.

records.english: Shall we make a farewell banner for the teachers who are leaving the village school?
records.zomi: Khua sang a paisan sayate adingin kikhenna lai lian khat i bawl ding hiam?

records.english: When is the volunteer team leaving?
records.zomi: Thalawp nasem pawl bang ciangin a pai ding uh hiam?

records.english: On Friday morning, so the farewell dinner is on Thursday night.
records.zomi: Laithai ni zingsangin, tua ahih manin kikhenna nitak an Laizing ni zan ciangin ahi hi.

records.english: Before you go, write your email address in the volunteers' notebook so that we can stay in touch.
records.zomi: Na pai ma-in i kizom den theih nadingin thalawp nasemte' notebook sungah na email gelh in.

records.english: My grandmother sewed a quilt for the young nurse who was leaving our village.
records.zomi: Ka pi in i khua a paisan nurse khangno adingin puanzial khat a khui hi.

records.english: Everyone, please sign this card for Officer Kim, who's being transferred to the capital.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, gam khuapi lian ah kisawn Officer Kim adingin hih card ah min suaksak un.

records.english: Students, give your goodbye cards to the visiting teachers before they get on the bus.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, hong veh sayate bus a tuan ma-un na goodbye card uh pia un.

records.english: When the aid workers left, the children ran after their truck all the way to the river.
records.zomi: Huhna nasemte a pai ciangin naupangte in a mawtaw lian uh gun dong a delh uh hi.

records.english: The whole village walked the doctor to the bus when she finished her two years at our clinic.
records.zomi: I clinic ah kum nih a zawh ciangin siavuan nu khua bup in bus dong a paipih uh hi.

records.english: Hardly had the bus left when we realized the doctor had forgotten her bag at the clinic.
records.zomi: Bus a pai pah-in siavuan nu in a ip clinic ah a mangngilh i thei hi.

records.english: The old market closed for good on Saturday, and the sellers hugged each other as they packed their stalls.
records.zomi: Kiginni ciangin zuakna mun lui kikhak tawntung a, zuakte in a dawl uh a thun laitakin a kikawi uh hi.

records.english: When should we tell the patients that the clinic is closing?
records.zomi: Clinic kikhak ding thu damlote kiangah bang ciangin i gen ding hiam?

records.english: Is it all right to give the doctor a small gift when she leaves?
records.zomi: Siavuan nu a pai ciangin letsong neu khat piak a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: Something homemade would mean more to her than anything from a shop.
records.zomi: Inn-a kibawl khat in dawl-a kilei khempeuh sangin a adingin a thupi zaw ding hi.

records.english: The people who'd been helped by the food bank came to say goodbye to it when it moved across town.
records.zomi: An kaikhawmna mun in a huhte khuapi lam dang ah a pem ciangin goodbye ci dingin a pai uh hi.

records.english: I can't believe this is the last time I'll walk through the town hall as mayor.
records.zomi: Khuapi ukpa-in khuapi office ka kaai nunung pen hi, cih ka um thei kei hi.

records.english: We held a small goodbye at the health post for the nurse who had delivered half the babies in the village.
records.zomi: Khua-a naungek kim a suahsak nurse adingin damna mun ah goodbye neu khat i bawl hi.

records.english: How do people in your village say goodbye to someone who's moving away?
records.zomi: Na khua ah pem ding mi khat kiangah mite in bangci-in goodbye a ci uh hiam?

records.english: Each family brings a little rice, and the elders pray for a safe journey.
records.zomi: Innkuan khat ciat in buh tawmno a tawi uh a, upate in khualzinna bitna adingin thu a ngen uh hi.

records.english: I promised the community garden volunteers that I'd send photos of my new garden.
records.zomi: Ka huan thak lim ka khak ding ci-in mipi huan thalawp nasemte kiangah ka kiciam hi.

records.english: Goodbye, everyone, and thank you for making a stranger feel like part of this town.
records.zomi: Goodbye, mi khempeuh, mi theih lo khat hih khuapi sung mi khat bangin hong kisaksak manun ka lungdam hi.

records.english: The social worker visited one last time to say goodbye and to give my mother her new caseworker's number.
records.zomi: Mipi huhna nasempa in goodbye ci dingin leh ka nu' kemtu thak phone nambat pia dingin a nunung pen-in hong veh hi.

records.english: Before he left, the departing headmaster planted a mango tree for the school.
records.zomi: A pai ma-in a paisan sang makaipa in sang adingin theihai kung khat a suan hi.

records.english: Were it not for the volunteers who are leaving tomorrow, half these houses would still have no roofs.
records.zomi: Zingciang a pai ding thalawp nasemte om lo leh hih inn a kimte inn tung om lo lai ding hi.

records.english: When the community radio station closed, the presenter said goodbye on air and played his favorite song.
records.zomi: Mipi radio station a kikhak ciangin thugenpa in radio tungah goodbye a ci a, a la deih pen a sak hi.

records.english: The old bridge was knocked down the week after the new one opened, and many people came to say goodbye to it.
records.zomi: Lei thak kihon khit kal khat-in lei lui kiphiat a, mi tampi in goodbye ci dingin a pai uh hi.

records.english: Our librarian is leaving, so could you help us choose a book to give her?
records.zomi: I laibu inn kemnu a pai ding ahih manin a piak ding laibu teel nadingin hong huh thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: The family we had sheltered for a year moved to the city, and the house felt very quiet without them.
records.zomi: Kum khat sung i om sak innkuan khuapi ah a pem a, amaute om lo-in inn a dai mahmah hi.

records.english: Could we name the new library room after the librarian who's retiring?
records.zomi: Laibu inn khan thak pen a khawl laibu inn kemnu' min i koih thei ding hiam?

records.english: The farewell for the retiring police chief was moved indoors when the storm started.
records.zomi: Huihpi a kipat ciangin a khawl police makaipa' kikhenna inn sungah kipem hi.

records.english: Who's organizing the farewell for the street cleaner who's retiring?
records.zomi: A khawl lampi siangsakpa' kikhenna kua in a vaihawm hiam?

records.english: The shopkeepers on the street — they've known him for decades.
records.zomi: Lampi-a dawl neite — kum tampi sung a thei khin uh hi.

records.english: We cooked a meal for the departing teachers to take on their long journey home.
records.zomi: A paisan sayate in a inn ciahna khualzinna sau ah a tawi theih nadingun an i huan sak hi.

records.english: Kids, wave goodbye to the firefighters and thank them for the visit.
records.zomi: Naupangte, mei mitsakte kiangah goodbye ci-in khut vaai unla, hong veh manun lungdam ko un.

records.english: After the farewell speeches, the old policeman handed his keys to the young officer who replaced him.
records.zomi: Kikhenna thugente khit ciangin police upa in a tawhte a laih police khangno a pia hi.

records.english: We do want to thank you properly before you go, so please come to the church hall on Sunday.
records.zomi: Na pai ma-in kilawm takin lungdam kong ko nuam taktak ahih manin Nipini ciangin pawlpi inn lian ah hong pai in.

records.english: The departing missionaries gave their bicycles to the village school.
records.zomi: A paisan missionary te in a siiksakol uh khua sang a pia uh hi.

records.english: Would you like me to drive you to the bus station after your last shift at the clinic?
records.zomi: Clinic ah na nasep hun nunung khit ciangin bus station ah kong paipih ding na deih hiam?

records.english: The town council gave the retiring bus driver a framed photo of his first bus.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in a khawl bus tuansakpa a bus masa pen lim bawngkhawng tawh a pia hi.

records.english: Let's sing for the doctor one last time.
records.zomi: Siavuan nu adingin vei nunung khat la sa ni.

records.english: Please give my regards to everyone at the community center.
records.zomi: Mipi inn-a mi khempeuh kiangah ka hopihna gen sak in.

records.english: The volunteers were given a farewell dinner and a basket of fruit for the road.
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte kikhenna nitak an leh lampi ading singgah bawm khat kipia uh hi.

records.english: See you next year, and thank you for teaching our children to swim.
records.zomi: Kum hong ding ciangin i kimu ding hi, i tate tui kidiah na hilh manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: We might never see the nurses from the medical team again, so let's say a proper goodbye.
records.zomi: Zato pawl pan nurse te i mu kik ngei lo kha ding ahih manin kilawm takin goodbye ci ni.

records.english: Waving goodbye to the departing team, the children shouted their names one by one.
records.zomi: A paisan pawl kiangah goodbye ci-in khut a vaai uh ciangin naupangte in a min uh khat khit khat a sam uh hi.

records.english: There's a chance the doctor will come back for the opening of the new clinic.
records.zomi: Clinic thak honna ah siavuan nu a hong kik kha ding hi.

records.english: Take care on the road, and call us when you reach the city.
records.zomi: Lampi ah pilvang inla, khuapi na tun ciangin hong sam in.

records.english: Are relatives allowed to visit outside visiting hours if the patient is very ill?
records.zomi: Damlo a dam lo mahmah leh veh hun polam ah beh leh phungte a veh thei uh hiam?

records.english: Yes, but only two at a time, and you must check with the nurse first.
records.zomi: Thei uh hi, ahi zongin nih ciat bek, a masa-in nurse kiangah na dong kul hi.

records.english: My husband's family has run the village post office since before electricity reached us.
records.zomi: Ka pasal' innkuan in i khua meivak a tun ma-in khua post office a kem uh hi.

records.english: The family support center found a counselor for my nephew after his parents separated.
records.zomi: Ka tanau' nu leh pa a kikhen khit ciangin innkuan huhna mun in a adingin thuhilhpa khat a zong sak hi.

records.english: Who can sign the form for my grandmother if she can't write?
records.zomi: Ka pi in a gelh thei kei leh a adingin lai ah kua in min a suaksak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Any close relative can, as long as they bring their own identity card.
records.zomi: Amau ID card a tawi uh phial leh beh leh phung kinai khatpeuh in a suaksak thei hi.

records.english: Do you need a letter from a relative to collect someone's medicine from the pharmacy?
records.zomi: Zatui dawl pan mi khat' zatui la dingin beh leh phung khat' lai na kisam hiam?

records.english: Who in your family works in the community?
records.zomi: Na innkuan ah kua in mipi lak ah na a sem hiam?

records.english: Everyone in our family helps at the church food bank, even the youngest.
records.zomi: I innkuan ah a neu pen dong mi khempeuh in pawlpi an kaikhawmna mun ah a huh uh hi.

records.english: We registered our son's birth at the town hall when he was three days old.
records.zomi: I tapa ni thum a phak ciangin khuapi office ah a suahna i gelhsak hi.

records.english: My father-in-law repairs bicycles for the schoolchildren free of charge.
records.zomi: Ka sungpa in sang naupangte' siiksakol man om lo-in a bawl sak hi.

records.english: Our family has kept the village well clean for three generations.
records.zomi: I innkuan in suak thum sung khua tuikhuk a siangsak hi.

records.english: The social worker helped my brother and his wife adopt a little girl from the children's home.
records.zomi: Mipi huhna nasempa in ka sanggam pasal leh a zi naupang kemna inn pan numei naupang khat kila dingin a huh hi.

records.english: Is your daughter the one who works at the bank in town?
records.zomi: Na tanu khuapi-a bank ah na a sem pen ahi hiam?

records.english: Please tell your brother that the community hall needs volunteers for Saturday's cleanup.
records.zomi: Kiginni siangsakna adingin mipi inn lian in thalawp nasem a kisam hi, ci-in na sanggam pasal gen sak in.

records.english: Your grandfather helped build this bridge, you know.
records.zomi: Na pu in hih lei a lam huh hi, na thei hiam.

records.english: I do want my children to know their grandparents, so we visit the care home every Sunday.
records.zomi: Ka tate in a pu leh pite uh a theih ding uh ka deih taktak ahih manin Nipini simin upate kemna inn i veh hi.

records.english: Growing up with a mother who was a midwife, I always knew I'd work in health care.
records.zomi: Naungek suahsak nu khat nu-a ka khan manin damna nasep ah ka sem ding ka thei den hi.

records.english: Since my mother became the village health volunteer, our phone rings at all hours.
records.zomi: Ka nu khua damna thalawp nasem a suak pan i phone hun khempeuh-in a ging hi.

records.english: Whose name should I write as the emergency contact on the form?
records.zomi: Haksatna hun-a sam ding mi-in lai tungah kua min ka gelh ding hiam?

records.english: You two should visit Grandma at the hospital together, so that she sees you're friends again.
records.zomi: Na kilawm kik uh hi, cih Pi in a muh theih nadingin note nih zato ah Pi khawm in na veh ding uh hi.

records.english: My sister drives our parents to their hospital appointments on Mondays, and I do it on Thursdays.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu in Pizing ni-in ka nu leh ka pa a zato pai nadingin a paipih a, Laizing ni-in kei in ka paipih hi.

records.english: When our house flooded, my in-laws and the neighbors shared their homes with us for a month.
records.zomi: I inn ah tui a lut ciangin ka sungte leh inn vengte in kha khat sung a inn uh hong kihawm uh hi.

records.english: My little sister wants to be a police officer like our uncle.
records.zomi: Ka nau numei in i pa neu bangin police a suak nuam hi.

records.english: May I stay with my mother on the ward tonight?
records.zomi: Tu zanin ward ah ka nu kiang ah ka om thei ding hiam?

records.english: My brother is a police officer in our town, which makes some of my friends very nervous.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal i khuapi ah police ahi a, ka lawm khenkhatte a lausak hi.

records.english: Our neighbors are like family to us — they even have a key to our house.
records.zomi: I inn vengte i adingin innkuan bang ahi uh hi — i inn tawh zong a nei uh hi.

records.english: My wife's parents live next to the health center, so they look after our kids when we're at work.
records.zomi: Ka zi' nu leh pa damna inn kiang ah a om uh ahih manin na i sep laitakin i tate a kem uh hi.

records.english: When my grandfather fell ill, the health worker taught the whole family how to care for him at home.
records.zomi: Ka pu a cina ciangin damna nasem in amah inn ah kep dan innkuan bup a hilh hi.

records.english: My brother and I built a ramp for our mother's wheelchair with wood from the community workshop.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal leh kei mipi nasepna inn pan sing tawh i nu' leeng tutna adingin kah nading a ngawi i bawl hi.

records.english: Everyone in the family was told about the new bus service by my little brother, who reads the town notices.
records.zomi: Khuapi thu kizasakte a sim ka nau pasal in bus thak thu innkuan sung mi khempeuh a gen hi.

records.english: Do you have any relatives on the village council?
records.zomi: Khua vaihawm ah na beh leh phung kuamah a om hiam?

records.english: My grandfather, though he says he'll retire at the next election.
records.zomi: Ka pu, vote a zom ciangin a khawl ding hi, a ci hangin.

records.english: Can my son wait in the clinic office while I see the doctor?
records.zomi: Siavuan ka muh laitakin ka tapa clinic office ah a ngak thei ding hiam?

records.english: My niece volunteers at the library, reading to children whose parents work late.
records.zomi: Ka tunu in laibu inn ah thalawp takin nai sau na a sem nu leh pate' tate adingin lai a sim sak hi.

records.english: Would you mind if my mother joined the women's group at the community center?
records.zomi: Mipi inn-a numei pawl ah ka nu a kihel leh na lungkham ding hiam?

records.english: Every member of our family has given blood at the town's blood drive.
records.zomi: I innkuan sung mi khempeuh in khuapi sisan piakna ah sisan a pia uh hi.

records.english: The health worker said that our family's history of heart disease means we should all have regular checkups.
records.zomi: I innkuan in lungtang natna a nei ngei ahih manin i khempeuh kal ciang-in i kien kul hi, ci-in damna nasem in a gen hi.

records.english: My uncle has been a volunteer firefighter for twenty years, and my aunt runs the first-aid course.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu kum sawmnih sung thalawp mei mitsakpa ahi a, ka ni in huhna masa kisinna a kem hi.

records.english: My sister is a nurse at the village clinic, so half the town knows our family.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu khua clinic ah nurse ahih manin khuapi a kim in i innkuan a thei uh hi.

records.english: Could you take Grandpa to the eye clinic on Thursday, since I'll be at work?
records.zomi: Ka nasep ah ka om ding ahih manin Laizing ni ciangin Pu mit clinic ah na paipih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Using the family's old Bible, the pastor checked the dates of my great-grandparents' marriage.
records.zomi: Innkuan Laisiangtho lui zang-in pastor in ka pu leh pite' nu leh pate kiteen ni a en hi.

records.english: My grandparents met while working at the same hospital, he as a cook and she as a nurse.
records.zomi: Ka pu leh ka pi zato khat mah ah na a sep laitakin a kimu uh a, amah an huanpa, numei nurse ahi hi.

records.english: All of you are welcome to bring your grandparents to the school's open day.
records.zomi: Sang hon ni ah note khempeuh na pu leh na pite uh na paipih thei uh hi.

records.english: Children, your grandmother is going to the senior center today, so let's walk her there.
records.zomi: Naupangte, tuni-in na pi upate inn ah a pai ding ahih manin paipih ni.

records.english: Families who have lost someone can talk to the counselor at the church on Wednesdays.
records.zomi: Mi a sihsan innkuante Nilai ni simin pawlpi ah thuhilhpa tawh a kiho thei uh hi.

records.english: Is it possible to list both parents' names on the school form?
records.zomi: Sang lai tungah nu leh pa nih tengteng min gelh theih ding hiam?

records.english: My grandfather's name is on the plaque at the school, because he gave the land it was built on.
records.zomi: Sang a kilamna lei a piak manin ka pu' min sang ah zahtakna phek tungah a om hi.

records.english: My brother lost his identity card, so my mother had to go with him to the office to confirm who he was.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal in a ID card a mansuah ahih manin kua ahi hiam a gen siang nadingin ka nu office ah a zui kul hi.

records.english: Can your sister translate for my grandmother at the clinic tomorrow?
records.zomi: Zingciang clinic ah na sanggam nu in ka pi adingin a let sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: The whole family was interviewed by the community radio about our three generations of bakers.
records.zomi: Mipi radio in i suak thum moh bawl innkuan thu innkuan bup a dong hi.

records.english: My aunt cooks for the elderly neighbors every Friday, and my daughter delivers the meals.
records.zomi: Ka ni in Laithai ni simin inn veng upate adingin an a huan a, ka tanu in an a puak hi.

records.english: There might be a place for your mother at the day center if you apply this month.
records.zomi: Hih kha sungin na ngen leh na nu adingin ni sung kemna mun ah mun om kha ding hi.

records.english: My grandmother taught the children of the whole street to read, including the man who's now our mayor.
records.zomi: Ka pi in lampi bup-a naupangte lai sim a hilh a, tu-a i khuapi ukpa zong kihel hi.

records.english: My mother-in-law and I met at the community choir before I ever met her son.
records.zomi: Ka sungnu leh kei a tapa ka theih ma-in mipi la sa pawl ah i kimu hi.

records.english: How do you prove you're someone's next of kin?
records.zomi: Mi khat' beh leh phung kinai pen na hihna bangci-in na lak hiam?

records.english: You usually need a birth or marriage certificate showing how you're related.
records.zomi: Bangci-in na kizom uh hiam a lak suahna hiam kiteenna lai-ciam hiam na kisam zel hi.

records.english: Having delivered most of the babies in the village, my grandmother is greeted like a relative in almost every home.
records.zomi: Khua-a naungek tam zaw a suahsak ahih manin inn tam zaw ah ka pi beh leh phung bangin kihopih hi.

records.english: Kids, write a thank-you note to the nurse who looked after your little sister.
records.zomi: Naupangte, na nau numei a kem nurse adingin lungdam kohna lai gelh un.

records.english: My aunt and uncle took in two children from the shelter, and now they're part of our family.
records.zomi: Ka ni leh ka pa neu in om sakna mun pan naupang nih a la uh a, tu-in i innkuan sung mi ahi uh hi.

records.english: Having a library card for each of our children was the best decision we made as parents.
records.zomi: I tate khat ciat adingin laibu inn card neih pen nu leh pa-a i khensatna hoih pen ahi hi.

records.english: How old do children have to be to join the community football club?
records.zomi: Mipi football pawl ah kihel dingin naupangte kum bangzah a pha kul uh hiam?

records.english: Six, but the coach lets younger brothers and sisters watch from the side.
records.zomi: Kum guk, ahi zongin coach in a nau zaw sanggam pasal leh nute gei pan en dingin a phal hi.

records.english: There's a chance the school bus will stop near our house next year.
records.zomi: Kum hong ding ciangin sang bus i inn kiang ah a khawl kha ding hi.

records.english: The health worker gave every new mother a mosquito net for her baby's bed.
records.zomi: Damna nasem in naungek nu thak khempeuh a naungek lupna adingin thangnemna a pia hi.

records.english: We got married at the town hall on Friday and in church on Saturday.
records.zomi: Laithai ni-in khuapi office ah i kiteen a, Kiginni-in pawlpi ah i kiteen hi.

records.english: We got married in the village square because the church was being repaired.
records.zomi: Pawlpi kibawl kik ahih manin khua laizang ah i kiteen hi.

records.english: Please keep your children close during the festival, because the streets will be very crowded.
records.zomi: Pawi laitakin lampite ah mi a tam mahmah ding ahih manin na tate uh kiang ah koih un.

records.english: My wife and I disagree about how much screen time the kids should have, so we asked the school nurse.
records.zomi: Naupangte' screen zat hun bangzah ding hiam ka zi leh kei i kilem kei ahih manin sang nurse kiangah i dong hi.

records.english: Kids, the dentist is coming to the school tomorrow, so brush your teeth well tonight.
records.zomi: Naupangte, zingciang ha siavuan sang ah hong pai ding ahih manin tu zanin na ha uh hoih takin nuai un.

records.english: Should we have the baby baptized in the village church or in the city where we live now?
records.zomi: Naungek khua pawlpi ah tuiphum sak ding i hi hiam, tu-a i teenna khuapi ah hiam?

records.english: Would the social worker be able to visit us at home, since we don't have a car?
records.zomi: Mawtaw i nei kei ahih manin mipi huhna nasempa in i inn ah hong veh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our son was given a free pair of glasses after the school eye test.
records.zomi: Sang mit sitna khit ciangin i tapa mitlimlang a man om lo-in kipia hi.

records.english: Before we were allowed to adopt, a social worker visited our home four times.
records.zomi: Naupang i lak theih ma-in mipi huhna nasempa in i inn vei li hong veh hi.

records.english: My husband and I took a first-aid course at the community center before our daughter started crawling.
records.zomi: I tanu a kibawk kipat ma-in ka pasal leh kei mipi inn ah huhna masa kisinna i la hi.

records.english: Children under five aren't allowed in the pool without an adult beside them.
records.zomi: Kum nga nuai naupangte upa khat a kiang ah a om kei leh tuidaipi ah lut thei lo uh hi.

records.english: The nurse used a little torch to look into our daughter's ears.
records.zomi: Nurse in i tanu' bil sung en dingin meivak neu khat a zang hi.

records.english: Is the clinic open on weekends for children who get sick?
records.zomi: Cina naupangte adingin kal tawp-in clinic a kihong hiam?

records.english: The couple were married by the mayor in a short ceremony at the town hall.
records.zomi: Zi leh pasal pen khuapi office ah poai tom khat ah khuapi ukpa in a kiteensak hi.

records.english: My wife's parents look after the kids on Saturdays so that we can help at the food bank.
records.zomi: An kaikhawmna mun ah i huh theih nadingin Kiginni simin ka zi' nu leh pa in naupangte a kem uh hi.

records.english: When our son was born early, the hospital's nurses showed us how to hold him without hurting the tubes.
records.zomi: I tapa hun ma-in a suak ciangin zato nurse te in tube te natsak lo-in pom dan hong etsak uh hi.

records.english: Every new parent in our town receives a box of baby clothes from the women's association.
records.zomi: I khuapi-a nu leh pa thak khempeuh in numei pawl pan naungek puan bawm khat a ngah uh hi.

records.english: The parents' committee raised money so that every child could go on the school trip.
records.zomi: Naupang khempeuh sang khualzinna ah a pai theih nadingun nu leh pate' committee in sum a kaikhawm hi.

records.english: May I feed my baby here, or is there a quieter room?
records.zomi: Hih ah ka naungek nawi ka hawp thei ding hiam, khan dai zaw khat a om hiam?

records.english: The village holds a blessing for every newborn at the community hall, with food for everyone.
records.zomi: Khua in naungek thak khempeuh adingin mipi inn lian ah mi khempeuh adingin an tawh thupha piakna a bawl hi.

records.english: Is it possible to change the baby's name on the birth certificate?
records.zomi: Naungek' suahna lai-ciam tung-a min kikhel thei hiam?

records.english: Only within the first year, and both parents have to sign the form.
records.zomi: Kum masa pen sungin bek, nu leh pa nih tengteng in lai ah min a suaksak kul uh hi.

records.english: Would it be all right if my husband came into the delivery room?
records.zomi: Naungek suahna khan ah ka pasal a lut leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: Ever since the new playground opened, the park has turned into the unofficial meeting place for the town's young parents.
records.zomi: Kimawlna mun thak kihon pan huan pen khuapi-a nu leh pa khangnote' kimuhna mun a suak hi.

records.english: Where can new parents get advice about feeding a baby?
records.zomi: Nu leh pa thakte in naungek an piak thu-ah koi ah thuhilhna a ngah thei uh hiam?

records.english: The health center runs a free class every Tuesday morning.
records.zomi: Damna inn in Pithai ni zingsang simin a man om lo kilasi khat a nei hi.

records.english: Parents, please bring your children's vaccination cards to the clinic on Saturday.
records.zomi: Nu leh pate, Kiginni ciangin na tate' vaccine card clinic ah tawi un.

records.english: Raising children in a small town means that every shopkeeper knows exactly who they are.
records.zomi: Khuapi neu ah naupang khak cihna dawl nei khempeuh in kua ahi uh hiam a thei kim uh cihna ahi hi.

records.english: Can someone from the clinic explain the vaccination schedule to my wife in our language?
records.zomi: Clinic pan kuamah in ka zi kiangah i pau tawh vaccine hun gelhna a gen siang thei ding hiam?

records.english: My wife and I volunteer at the youth center so that our teenagers have somewhere safe to go in the evenings.
records.zomi: I khangnote in nitak ciangin bitna taka a pai theihna mun a neih theih nadingun ka zi leh kei khangno inn ah thalawp takin na i sem hi.

records.english: The midwife weighed the baby on a little scale and wrote everything in the health booklet.
records.zomi: Naungek suahsak nu in naungek bukna neu tungah a buk a, damna laibu sungah khempeuh a gelh hi.

records.english: All of you new mothers are welcome to join the playgroup at the church hall on Thursdays.
records.zomi: Naungek nu thak note khempeuh Laizing ni simin pawlpi inn lian-a naupang kimawl pawl ah na kihel thei uh hi.

records.english: You might want to ask the health center about the free parenting class.
records.zomi: A man om lo naupang khak kisinna thu damna inn ah na dong nuam kha ding hi.

records.english: My parents say that in their day the whole village helped raise every child.
records.zomi: A hun lai-un khua bup in naupang khempeuh a khak khawm uh hi, ci-in ka nu leh ka pa in a gen uh hi.

records.english: The police officer who visited the school told parents how to keep children safe on the road.
records.zomi: Sang hong veh police in lampi tungah naupangte bitna taka a kep dan nu leh pate a hilh hi.

records.english: The day our first child started school, the teacher let us stay in the classroom for an hour.
records.zomi: I ta masa pen sang a kah kipat ni-in saya in kilasi sungah nai khat hong omsak hi.

records.english: What does the town do for families who can't afford school uniforms?
records.zomi: Sang puan a lei zo lo innkuante adingin khuapi in bang a sem hiam?

records.english: We were married by the same pastor who had baptized both of us as babies.
records.zomi: Naungek lai-in i nih hong tuiphum pastor mah in hong kiteensak hi.

records.english: We had our wedding photos taken in front of the old school where we first met.
records.zomi: I kimuh masa pen sang lui mai ah i kiteenna lim i la hi.

records.english: Not once in the month after our twins were born did we have to cook, thanks to the women from the church.
records.zomi: Pawlpi pan numeite hang-in i apengte a suah khit kha khat sungin vei khat zong an i huan kul kei hi.

records.english: As new parents in a strange town, we were grateful for every neighbor who knocked on our door.
records.zomi: Khuapi theih lo-a nu leh pa thak i hih manin i kongkhak a khawng inn veng khempeuh tungah i lungdam hi.

records.english: It might be easier to get a place at the nursery if you apply before the baby is born.
records.zomi: Naungek a suah ma-in na ngen leh nursery ah mun ngah a baih zaw kha ding hi.

records.english: My husband reads to the children at the library every Saturday so that other parents can shop.
records.zomi: Nu leh pa dangte in van a lei theih nadingun ka pasal in Kiginni simin laibu inn ah naupangte adingin a sim hi.

records.english: When our daughter was lost at the market, a police officer found her within ten minutes.
records.zomi: I tanu zuakna mun ah a mang ciangin police khat in minit sawm sungin a mu hi.

records.english: The community nursery looks after our baby while I work at the market.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun ah na ka sep laitakin mipi naupang kemna in i naungek a kem hi.

records.english: Our son's first visit to the library ended with him asleep on a pile of picture books.
records.zomi: I tapa' laibu inn veh masa pen lim laibu tung ah a ihmut tawh a tawp hi.

records.english: Can I bring my toddler to the library story time even if she's only two?
records.zomi: Kum nih bek a pha zongin ka naupang neu laibu inn tangthu hun ah ka paipih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Using the bus pass the council gave us, I can take all three children to the doctor for free.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm' piak bus pass zang-in naupang thum tengteng siavuan kiangah a man om lo-in ka paipih thei hi.

records.english: Before our wedding, the pastor met with us three times to talk about marriage.
records.zomi: I kiteen ma-in pastor in kiteenna thu kikum dingin vei thum hong mu hi.

records.english: The newly married couple planted a tree outside the community hall, as couples in our village do.
records.zomi: Kiteen thak zi leh pasal in i khua-a zi leh pasalte' sep bangin mipi inn lian polam ah sing khat a suan uh hi.

records.english: Do you know a good marriage counselor in town?
records.zomi: Khuapi ah kiteenna thuhilhpa hoih khat na thei hiam?

records.english: The church has one, and she helped my brother and his wife a lot.
records.zomi: Pawlpi in khat a nei a, ka sanggam pasal leh a zi a huh mahmah hi.

records.english: Could you look after our baby during the town meeting, so that we can both speak?
records.zomi: I nih in i gen theih nadingin khuapi kikhopna laitakin i naungek na kem sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Parents are asked to stay with their children until the swimming teacher arrives.
records.zomi: Tui kidiah saya a tun dong nu leh pate a tate uh kiang ah om dingin kingen uh hi.

records.english: If you're struggling with the baby, the parent support line is open all night.
records.zomi: Naungek tawh na haksat leh nu leh pa huhna phone zan bup kihong hi.

records.english: The old woman upstairs can't carry her shopping, so the boys take it up for her.
records.zomi: Tung lam-a numei upa in a van a puak zo kei ahih manin pasal naupangte in a puak tou sak uh hi.

records.english: We borrowed a ladder from the community tool library so that we could clear the gutters.
records.zomi: Inn tung tui luanna i siangsak theih nadingin mipi nasep van leitawina mun pan kaplei khat i leitawi hi.

records.english: Our water tank was cleaned by the health workers, who also tested the water for us.
records.zomi: I tui tank damna nasemte in a siangsak uh a, i adingin tui zong a sit uh hi.

records.english: Not until the neighbors complained did the landlord fix the broken stair rail.
records.zomi: Inn vengte a phunsan ma-un inn neipa in kaplei lenna kitat a bawl kei hi.

records.english: Every Saturday, my son mows the lawn for the elderly couple next door.
records.zomi: Kiginni simin ka tapa in inn kiang zi leh pasal upa adingin lopa a at hi.

records.english: The rubbish truck comes on Tuesday mornings, so the bins have to be outside by seven.
records.zomi: Van niin mawtaw Pithai ni zingsang simin a hong pai ahih manin niin bawmte nai sagih ma-in polam ah a om kul hi.

records.english: Let's take the clothes the kids have outgrown to the church donation box.
records.zomi: Naupangte' a khan khit puante pawlpi piakna bawm ah puak ni.

records.english: Would you mind watering our garden while we're away at the conference?
records.zomi: Kikhopna lian ah i om laitakin i huan tui na buak sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Before you move out, you'll need to have the gas and electricity meters read.
records.zomi: Na pem ma-in gas leh meivak tehnate na simsak kul ding hi.

records.english: When the river flooded, the whole street cleaned each other's houses before their own.
records.zomi: Gun a dim ciangin lampi bup in amau inn ma-in khat leh khat' inn a siangsak uh hi.

records.english: May I leave the old sofa outside for the council's bulky waste collection?
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm' van lian lakna adingin sofa lui polam ah ka nusia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Kids, it's community clean-up day, so put on your old clothes and bring your gloves.
records.zomi: Naupangte, tuni mipi siangsakna ni ahih manin na puan lui uh silh unla na khut-ngumna uh tawi un.

records.english: The gas cylinder is delivered every two weeks, but someone has to be home to sign for it.
records.zomi: Gas bel kal nih simin hong kipuak a, ahi zongin min suaksak dingin kuamah inn ah a om kul hi.

records.english: If everyone on the street gave an hour a month, the park would never be dirty.
records.zomi: Lampi-a mi khempeuh in kha khat-in nai khat a piak leh huan a nin ngei lo ding hi.

records.english: Everyone, the new bins are here: green for garden waste and blue for paper.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, niin bawm thakte hong tung hi: huan niin adingin eng, lai adingin dum.

records.english: Our neighbors share one lawnmower between four houses, and we keep it in our shed.
records.zomi: I inn vengte in inn li kikal ah lopa atna khat a kihawm uh a, i inn neu ah i koih hi.

records.english: My grandmother still sweeps the path in front of her house and the one in front of her neighbor's.
records.zomi: Ka pi in a inn mai lampi leh a inn veng' mai lampi a phiat lai hi.

records.english: My wife collects medicine from the pharmacy for our elderly neighbor every Friday.
records.zomi: Ka zi in Laithai ni simin i inn veng upa adingin zatui dawl pan zatui a la hi.

records.english: We sweep the church every Saturday so that it's ready for Sunday.
records.zomi: Nipini adingin a kiman theih nadingin Kiginni simin pawlpi i phiat hi.

records.english: Every family in the village gives one day a year to repair the road to the market.
records.zomi: Khua sung innkuan khempeuh in zuakna mun pai lampi bawl dingin kum khat-in ni khat a pia uh hi.

records.english: How do I report a broken water pipe in the street?
records.zomi: Lampi-a tui pipe kikek bangci-in ka gen ding hiam?

records.english: Call the water office, or tell the village leader, who'll call them for you.
records.zomi: Tui office sam in, ahih kei leh nang adingin a sam ding khua makaipa kiangah gen in.

records.english: Since the water is only on in the mornings, we fill every bucket before breakfast.
records.zomi: Zingsang bek tui a om ahih manin zingsang an ma-in khuang khempeuh i dimsak hi.

records.english: Is it our job or the council's to cut the tree that's leaning over the road?
records.zomi: Lampi tung a kun singkung at pen i nasep ahi hiam, khuapi vaihawm' nasep hiam?

records.english: We pay a small fee each month so that a man collects our rubbish from the door.
records.zomi: Pasal khat in kongkhak pan i niin a lak nadingin kha simin sum tawmno i pia hi.

records.english: Our building has a cleaning rota, so each family sweeps the stairs one week a month.
records.zomi: I inn lian ah siangsakna kilaihna a om ahih manin innkuan khat ciat in kha khat-in kal khat kaplei a phiat uh hi.

records.english: Who reads the electricity meter in your building?
records.zomi: Na inn lian ah meivak tehna kua in a sim hiam?

records.english: A man from the company comes once a month, and my mother writes the number in a notebook to check the bill.
records.zomi: Company pan pasal khat kha khat-in vei khat a hong a, ka nu in a man en nadingin nambat notebook sungah a gelh hi.

records.english: Glass and plastic go in separate bins at the recycling center, and nothing goes in without being rinsed.
records.zomi: Recycling mun ah khuang leh plastic bawm tuam ciat ah kikoih a, kisil lo-in bangmah kikoih thei lo hi.

records.english: When do we have to put the recycling out?
records.zomi: Recycling bang ciangin polam ah i koih kul hiam?

records.english: Every second Thursday, after six in the evening.
records.zomi: Laizing ni a nihna simin, nitak nai guk khit ciangin.

records.english: Can I put my name on the list for the free compost bins?
records.zomi: A man om lo compost bawm list tungah ka min ka koih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Taking the household rubbish to the village pit is my brother's job, and he does it before school.
records.zomi: Innsung niin khua kua ah puak pen ka sanggam pasal' nasep ahi a, sang a kah ma-in a sem hi.

records.english: You can borrow our wheelbarrow, as long as you bring it back before Saturday.
records.zomi: Kiginni ma-in na lohsak kik phial leh i leeng khat na leitawi thei hi.

records.english: The streets were swept by volunteers before the festival, and the town looked brand new.
records.zomi: Pawi ma-in thalawp nasemte in lampite a phiat uh a, khuapi a thak kim bang hi.

records.english: My daughter registered our house for the free energy check so that we could cut our electricity bill.
records.zomi: I meivak man i tawmsak theih nadingin ka tanu in a man om lo meivak kiennna adingin i inn a gelhsak hi.

records.english: The council sent a plumber to fix the leak in the public tap outside our house.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in i inn polam mipi tui kongkhak zuh bawl dingin tui pipe bawlpa a sawl hi.

records.english: When the power went off for three days, the neighbors with a generator charged everyone's phones.
records.zomi: Ni thum sung meivak a kitan ciangin generator nei inn vengte in mi khempeuh' phone a dimsak uh hi.

records.english: Can you take the old batteries to the shop that collects them?
records.zomi: Battery luite a kaikhawm dawl ah na puak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Please don't put food scraps in the recycling bin; they go in the compost.
records.zomi: Recycling bawm sungah an taang koih kei in; compost ah kikoih ding hi.

records.english: Using a long pole with a hook, my husband cleared the leaves that were blocking the street drain.
records.zomi: Sing sau ngetna nei zang-in ka pasal in lampi tui luanna a khak nah te a la khia hi.

records.english: Please keep the gate closed, because the neighbor's goats eat everything in the community garden.
records.zomi: Inn veng' kelte in mipi huan sung na khempeuh a ne uh ahih manin kongpi khak den in.

records.english: Could someone from the council check the wall that's cracking near the school?
records.zomi: Sang kiang-a a kikek bang khuapi vaihawm pan kuamah in a en thei ding hiam?

records.english: Whoever empties the last of the gas cylinder has to call for a new one.
records.zomi: Gas bel nunung a beisak kua peuh in a thak a sam ding hi.

records.english: Fixing the shared water pump is everyone's responsibility, so we each give a little money every month.
records.zomi: Kihawm tui pump bawl pen mi khempeuh' nasep ahih manin kha simin i khat ciat in sum tawmno i pia hi.

records.english: Is it all right if I leave the rent with your neighbor if you're not home?
records.zomi: Na om kei leh inn man na inn veng kiangah ka nusia leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: After the storm, the council helped us clear the fallen branches from our roof.
records.zomi: Huihpi khit ciangin khuapi vaihawm in i inn tung pan singnah kia te hong siangsak hi.

records.english: At the repair café, a volunteer fixed our kettle with a new switch in ten minutes.
records.zomi: Bawl kikna cafe ah thalawp nasem khat in switch thak tawh minit sawm sungin i tui-ukbel a bawl hi.

records.english: My teenagers run errands for the old people on our street, and they never take money for it.
records.zomi: Ka ta khangnote in i lampi-a upate adingin na sawl a sem uh a, sum a la ngei kei uh hi.

records.english: When the street light outside our house broke, I reported it to the council on their website.
records.zomi: I inn polam lampi meivak a siat ciangin khuapi vaihawm' website tungah ka gen hi.

records.english: There may be a fine if the bins are left out on the street after collection day.
records.zomi: Lak ni khit ciangin lampi tungah niin bawm a kinusia leh dan kitat om kha ding hi.

records.english: The bins were knocked over by dogs during the night, and the street was covered in rubbish.
records.zomi: Zanin ui in niin bawmte a hilh a, lampi niin tawh a dim hi.

records.english: The water might be cut tomorrow while they repair the main pipe, so let's fill the tank tonight.
records.zomi: Tui pipe lian a bawl laitakin zingciang tui kitan kha ding ahih manin tu zanin tank dimsak ni.

records.english: Could you pay the water bill at the post office on your way to school?
records.zomi: Sang na pai lam ah post office ah tui man na pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: No car washing is allowed on the street when the town is short of water.
records.zomi: Khuapi ah tui a tawm ciangin lampi tungah mawtaw sil kiphal lo hi.

records.english: Who's supposed to clean the drain in front of our house?
records.zomi: I inn mai tui luanna kua in a siangsak ding hiam?

records.english: Each household cleans its own stretch, and the council clears the big ones.
records.zomi: Inn khat ciat in amau tan a siangsak uh a, a lian te khuapi vaihawm in a siangsak hi.

records.english: Burning rubbish in the yard isn't allowed in our town, so we take it to the collection point.
records.zomi: I khuapi ah inn mai ah niin hal kiphal lo ahih manin a kaikhawmna mun ah i puak hi.

records.english: Children shouldn't play near the open drains, so we keep them in the yard during the rains.
records.zomi: Naupangte tui luanna kihong kiang ah kimawl lo ding uh ahih manin guah hun ciangin inn mai ah i koih hi.

records.english: The landlord sent a man to fix our door lock the same afternoon.
records.zomi: Inn neipa in tua nitak mahmah-in i kongkhak khakna bawl dingin pasal khat a sawl hi.

records.english: When the bank offered us a loan, my parents asked a teacher they trusted to read the papers first.
records.zomi: Bank in leitawi hong piak ciangin ka nu leh ka pa in a muan saya khat lai a sim masa dingin a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Thank you for coming to the family meeting — I know the drive from the city is long.
records.zomi: Innkuan kikhopna ah na hong pai manin ka lungdam hi — khuapi pan mawtaw mawng a sau hi, ka thei hi.

records.english: I'd rather we asked the village elders before we put up the fence.
records.zomi: Kulh i lam ma-in khua upate i dong ding ka deih zaw hi.

records.english: We sat around the kitchen table and filled in the census form together.
records.zomi: Anbuk dawhkan ah i tu kiim a, mihing simna lai khawm-in i dimsak hi.

records.english: Long before the town meeting, every family on our street had argued over the plan for the new market.
records.zomi: Khuapi kikhopna ma sau-in i lampi-a innkuan khempeuh in zuakna mun thak gelna thu a kinial uh hi.

records.english: Our family meeting was interrupted by a call from the hospital, and everyone went quiet.
records.zomi: I innkuan kikhopna zato pan phone khat in a khaktan a, mi khempeuh a dai uh hi.

records.english: Before we vote on anything, let's hear what Grandma thinks.
records.zomi: Bangmah ah vote i piak ma-in Pi in bang a ngaihsun hiam za ni.

records.english: Can the health workers test the water from our well?
records.zomi: I tuikhuk pan tui damna nasemte in a sit thei uh hiam?

records.english: Should we let our daughter volunteer at the shelter, or is she too young?
records.zomi: I tanu om sakna mun ah thalawp takin a sep ding i phal ding hiam, a neu lua hiam?

records.english: We decided as a family to give Dad's old wheelchair to the health center.
records.zomi: Pa' leeng tutna lui damna inn piak dingin innkuan-in i khensat hi.

records.english: Should we accept the council's offer of a bigger flat on the other side of town?
records.zomi: Khuapi lam dang-a inn lian zaw khuapi vaihawm in hong piak i san ding hiam?

records.english: Only if there's a school nearby, because the children have already changed schools twice.
records.zomi: A kiang ah sang a om leh bek, naupangte in vei nih sang a khel khin uh ahih manin.

records.english: Should Grandpa start going to the day center?
records.zomi: Pu ni sung kemna mun ah a pai kipan ding hiam?

records.english: Grandpa was so pleased that we'd asked for his opinion that he talked for an hour.
records.zomi: A ngaihsutna i dot manin Pu a lungdam lua ahih manin nai khat a gen hi.

records.english: There's a chance the government will pay for Grandma's hearing aid, so let's find out before we buy one.
records.zomi: Kumpi in Pi' bil zatna man a pia kha ding ahih manin i lei ma-in kan masa ni.

records.english: Who in the family should speak for us at the town meeting?
records.zomi: Khuapi kikhopna ah innkuan sung kua in i adingin a gen ding hiam?

records.english: My brother wants to become a police officer, and our mother is worried about the danger.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal police suak a deih a, i nu in a laukhuaina a lungkham hi.

records.english: Can we talk about whether to send Grandma's old clothes to the charity shop?
records.zomi: Pi' puan luite piakna dawl ah i khak ding hiam i kikum thei ding hiam?

records.english: Is it all right if I use some of our savings to help the church rebuild its roof?
records.zomi: Pawlpi in a inn tung a lam kik theih nadingin i sum kholsa tawmno ka zang leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: My uncle offered to drive Grandma to her dialysis three times a week.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu in kal khat-in vei thum dialysis adingin Pi a paipih ding a ci hi.

records.english: Let's write down all our questions before we meet the lawyer about the land.
records.zomi: Lei thu-ah lawyer i muh ma-in i dotna khempeuh gelh ni.

records.english: My father-in-law refused to discuss the nursing home until the doctor spoke to him.
records.zomi: Siavuan in a kiangah a gen ma-in ka sungpa in upate kemna inn thu a kikum nuam kei hi.

records.english: Would anyone mind if I gave my free bus pass to Grandpa?
records.zomi: Ka bus pass man om lo Pu ka piak leh kuamah in a lungkham ding uh hiam?

records.english: Nobody in the family understood the letter from the council.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm pan lai innkuan sung kuamah in a thei kei uh hi.

records.english: My husband and I disagree about whether our son should join the army.
records.zomi: I tapa galkap ah a lut ding hiam cih thu-ah ka pasal leh kei i kilem kei hi.

records.english: What would happen to our shop if the new road went around the town?
records.zomi: Lampi thak in khuapi a kawi leh i dawl bang a hi ding hiam?

records.english: We might lose half our customers, so we should talk to the council now.
records.zomi: I van lei a kim i mansuah kha ding ahih manin tu-in khuapi vaihawm tawh i kiho ding hi.

records.english: My aunt asked the pastor to help our family talk about selling the old house.
records.zomi: Inn lui zuak thu i innkuan in a kikum theih nadingin ka ni in pastor huhna a ngen hi.

records.english: The family decided to pay for the street light outside Grandpa's house, since the council couldn't afford it.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in a pia zo loh manin Pu' inn polam lampi meivak man innkuan in pia dingin a khensat uh hi.

records.english: Who are you going to vote for in the village election?
records.zomi: Khua vaihawm teelna ah kua na teel ding hiam?

records.english: The woman who promised to fix the road to the clinic.
records.zomi: Clinic pai lampi bawl ding a kiciam numei.

records.english: Let's ask the health worker to explain the operation to the whole family, not just to Dad.
records.zomi: Pa bek hi lo-in innkuan bup kiangah khamna gen siang dingin damna nasem ngen ni.

records.english: The doctor had us all come to the clinic so that she could explain Mom's treatment once.
records.zomi: Siavuan nu in Nu' damna vei khat-in a gen siang theih nadingin i khempeuh clinic ah hong sam hi.

records.english: You two can't keep arguing about the bus pass; let's ask the office who should have it.
records.zomi: Note nih bus pass thu na kinial den thei kei uh hi; kua in a nei ding hiam office ah dong ni.

records.english: So many neighbors joined our family discussion about the broken bridge that we moved it to the church hall.
records.zomi: Lei kitam thu-a i innkuan kikupna ah inn veng tampi a kihel lua uh ahih manin pawlpi inn lian ah i pemsak hi.

records.english: Can I join the volunteer fire brigade if I promise to keep up with my studies?
records.zomi: Ka kisinna ka kem den ding ci-in ka kiciam leh thalawp mei mitsak pawl ah ka kihel thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our parents made us sit down together and decide how to share the cost of Grandma's care.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in Pi' kepna man bangci-in i kihawm ding hiam khawm in hong tusak a, hong khensatsak uh hi.

records.english: My grandfather insisted that we vote together as a family, and then he told us not to tell anyone how we'd voted.
records.zomi: Ka pu in innkuan-in vote khawm-in i piak ding a ngiat a, tua khit ciangin bangci-in i piak hiam kuamah gen lo dingin hong gen hi.

records.english: Why does your family always talk about the election at dinner?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na innkuan in nitak an ciangin teelna thu a kikum tawntung uh hiam?

records.english: Because my father is on the council, so politics is part of every meal.
records.zomi: Ka pa khuapi vaihawm ah a om ahih manin ukna thu an khempeuh ah kihel hi.

records.english: How should we tell the children that the clinic where their mother works is closing?
records.zomi: A nu' sepna clinic kikhak ding thu naupangte kiangah bangci-in i gen ding hiam?

records.english: No one should feel ashamed to ask the food bank for help, and that's what I told my brother.
records.zomi: Kuamah in an kaikhawmna mun ah huhna ngen dingin a zahlak kul kei a, tua thu ka sanggam pasal kiangah ka gen hi.

records.english: Could we join the community savings group, so that we have money for emergencies?
records.zomi: Haksatna hun ading sum i neih theih nadingin mipi sum kholna pawl ah i kihel thei ding hiam?

records.english: After a family discussion, we had Grandpa's name added to the list for the home nursing service.
records.zomi: Innkuan kikupna khit ciangin inn-a damlo kemna list tungah Pu' min i behlap sak hi.

records.english: Nobody is allowed to sign anything for the bank until the whole family has read it.
records.zomi: Innkuan bup in a sim ma-un kuamah in bank adingin bangmah ah min suaksak thei lo hi.

records.english: We argued about whether to call the police about the noise next door, and in the end we talked to the neighbors first.
records.zomi: A kiang inn ging thu-ah police i sam ding hiam i kinial a, a tawp-in inn vengte tawh i kiho masa hi.

records.english: Grandma said, "If we give the land for the new school, our grandchildren will thank us."
records.zomi: Pi in, “Sang thak adingin lei i piak leh i tu-te in lungdam hong ko ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: Whatever we decide about the farm, we should ask the cooperative for advice first.
records.zomi: Lo thu-ah bang i khensat zongin a masa-in lo nei pawl kiangah thuhilhna i ngen ding hi.

records.english: If the clinic closes, could we manage the drive to the hospital every week?
records.zomi: Clinic a kikhak leh kal simin zato pai dingin mawtaw mawng i zo ding hiam?

records.english: Mom said, "We're not leaving this village, whatever happens to the school."
records.zomi: Nu in, “Sang bang a hi zongin hih khua i nusia lo ding hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: Everybody calmed down once the social worker explained what help was available.
records.zomi: Mipi huhna nasempa in huhna bang a om hiam a gen siang khit ciangin mi khempeuh' lungsim a dai hi.

records.english: My sister made Dad promise to see the doctor before the family trip.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu in innkuan khualzinna ma-in siavuan mu dingin Pa a kiciamsak hi.

records.english: My aunt doesn't want the town to name the library after her, but the rest of us think she deserves it.
records.zomi: Ka ni in khuapi in laibu inn amah' min a koih ding a deih kei a, ahi zongin i dangte in a kilawm hi, i sa hi.

records.english: The children aren't allowed to answer the door to strangers, and we discussed why with them.
records.zomi: Naupangte in mi theih lohte adingin kongkhak a hong thei kei uh a, bang hang hiam amaute tawh i kikum hi.

records.english: The social worker might help us with the hospital bills.
records.zomi: Mipi huhna nasempa in zato man ah hong huh kha ding hi.

records.english: Please don't make any decisions about Grandma's care until we've all talked to the doctor.
records.zomi: Siavuan tawh i khempeuh i kiho ma-in Pi' kepna thu bangmah khensat kei un.

records.english: Talking about our parents' wishes before they get ill has made the future less frightening.
records.zomi: A cina ma-un i nu leh pa' deihna thu i kikup manin a hong ding hun a lauhuai tawm zaw hi.

records.english: However hard the conversation was, it was better than letting the council decide for us.
records.zomi: Kikupna bangzah a haksa zongin khuapi vaihawm in hong khensat sak sangin a hoih zaw hi.

records.english: We had the doctor's letter translated so that Grandma could read it herself.
records.zomi: Pi in amah mah in a sim theih nadingin siavuan' lai i let sak hi.

records.english: Kids, we're thinking of fostering a child from the children's home, and we want to hear what you think.
records.zomi: Naupangte, naupang kemna inn pan naupang khat kem dingin i ngaihsun a, na ngaihsutna uh i zak nuam hi.

records.english: Please don't leave children alone in the waiting room, even for a moment.
records.zomi: Hun tawmno bek zongin ngakna khan ah naupangte a bek-in nusia kei un.

records.english: The health visitor weighed the baby and checked that she was feeding well.
records.zomi: Damna veh nasem in naungek a buk a, nawi hoih takin a dawn hiam a en hi.

records.english: The pharmacist explained to my grandmother, in her own language, when to take each pill.
records.zomi: Zatui zuakpa in ka pi kiangah amah' pau tawh zatui khat ciat bang hun ciangin nek ding hiam a gen siang hi.
