records.english: Is it all right if my daughter helps Grandpa at the clinic, even though she's only fourteen?
records.zomi: Kum sawm leh li bek a phak hangin ka tanu in clinic ah Pu a huh leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: The children's vaccinations were done at the school, so I didn't have to take time off work.
records.zomi: Naupangte' vaccine sang ah kibawl ahih manin nasep pan ka khawl kul kei hi.

records.english: Were it not for the lunch club at the community center, my father would eat every meal alone.
records.zomi: Mipi inn-a sun an pawl om lo leh ka pa in an khempeuh amah bek in a ne ding hi.

records.english: Do you know of a support group for people looking after parents with dementia?
records.zomi: Ngaihsutna mangngilh natna nei nu leh pa kemte adingin huhna pawl khat na thei hiam?

records.english: There's one at the church hall on Thursday evenings, and they serve tea.
records.zomi: Laizing ni nitak simin pawlpi inn lian ah khat a om a, tea a pia uh hi.

records.english: Every child in the village was given a free check at the eye clinic, and twelve of them needed glasses.
records.zomi: Khua sung naupang khempeuh mit clinic ah a man om lo-in kien uh a, a sawm leh nih in mitlimlang a kisam uh hi.

records.english: The nurse had my father practice using his walking frame in the corridor before he went home.
records.zomi: Ka pa inn a ciah ma-in nurse in a kaai nading van zat lampi khan ah a kisinsak hi.

records.english: Children aren't allowed to stay at the after-school club after six, so I leave work at half past five.
records.zomi: Nai guk khit ciangin naupangte sang khit pawl ah om thei lo uh ahih manin nai nga leh a kim ciangin nasep ka paisan hi.

records.english: No one may take a child out of the nursery without showing their parent's card.
records.zomi: A nu hiam a pa hiam' card lak lo-in kuamah in nursery pan naupang a la thei kei hi.

records.english: Teenagers from the youth club play cards with the old people at the care home every Sunday.
records.zomi: Nipini simin khangno pawl pan khangnote in upate kemna inn ah upate tawh kawlbawm a mawl uh hi.

records.english: Shall I ask the health visitor about the baby's rash?
records.zomi: Naungek' vun-natna thu damna veh nasem kiangah ka dong ding hiam?

records.english: My neighbor looks after my kids for an hour after school until I get back from the market.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun pan ka ciah kik dong ka inn veng in sang khit ciangin nai khat sung ka tate a kem hi.

records.english: My cousin trained as a carer so that she could look after old people in their own homes.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu in upate a inn uh ah a kep theih nadingin kemtu dingin a kisin hi.

records.english: Would the clinic let my mother see a female doctor?
records.zomi: Clinic in ka nu numei siavuan a muhsak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Whenever my aunt goes into hospital, a different neighbor cooks for my uncle each evening.
records.zomi: Ka ni zato ah a lut simin nitak simin inn veng tuam ciat in ka pa neu adingin an a huan uh hi.

records.english: The old man said, "I don't need help," but he smiled when the volunteers fixed his roof.
records.zomi: Pasal upa in, “Huhna ka kisam kei hi,” a ci a, ahi zongin thalawp nasemte in a inn tung a bawl ciangun a nui hi.

records.english: Can the community nurse come on Sundays too?
records.zomi: Mipi nurse Nipini ciangin zong a hong thei ding hiam?

records.english: Could the after-school club give my son his asthma inhaler if he needs it?
records.zomi: A kisap leh sang khit pawl in ka tapa' asthma inhaler a pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Every other Tuesday, the mobile library parks outside my grandfather's house, letting him choose his books without leaving the street.
records.zomi: Pithai ni a nihna simin kawikawi laibu inn mawtaw ka pu' inn polam ah a khawl a, lampi paisan lo-in a laibu a teel thei hi.

records.english: Can someone from the pharmacy deliver Grandpa's medicine, since he can't walk to town anymore?
records.zomi: Khuapi ah a kaai thei nawn kei ahih manin zatui dawl pan kuamah in Pu' zatui a puak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Let's ask the pastor whether the church can find someone to sit with Grandpa on Sunday mornings.
records.zomi: Nipini zingsang ciangin Pu kiang ah a om ding mi pawlpi in a zong thei ding hiam pastor kiangah dong ni.

records.english: When my mother came home from the hospital, a carer from the council helped her wash and dress each morning.
records.zomi: Ka nu zato pan inn a tun ciangin zingsang simin khuapi vaihawm pan kemtu khat in a kisil leh puan silh a huh hi.

records.english: My uncle drives the minibus that takes old people to the hospital.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu in upate zato ah a paipih minibus a mawng hi.

records.english: When the river rose, the elderly residents were moved to the school by the rescue team.
records.zomi: Gun a khan ciangin hum pawl in upa teengte sang ah a pemsak uh hi.

records.english: My grandmother was so lonely after Grandpa died that the pastor arranged for volunteers to visit her.
records.zomi: Pu a sih khit ciangin ka pi a kikhawmlum lua ahih manin pastor in a veh ding thalawp nasemte a vaihawm hi.

records.english: We had a handrail fitted by the bath after the occupational therapist visited.
records.zomi: Pumpi nasep huhpa hong veh khit ciangin kisilna kiang ah lenna khat i koih sak hi.

records.english: Now that there's a bus, Grandma goes to the day center by herself.
records.zomi: Tu-in bus a om ahih manin Pi amah mah in ni sung kemna mun ah a pai hi.

records.english: It's easier to care for children and old people when everyone in town helps.
records.zomi: Khuapi sung mi khempeuh in a huh ciangin naupangte leh upate kem a baih zaw hi.

records.english: All of you are welcome to bring your grandparents to the health fair on Saturday.
records.zomi: Kiginni damna poai ah note khempeuh na pu leh na pite uh na paipih thei uh hi.

records.english: Our doctor had a ramp built at the clinic so that wheelchair users could get in easily.
records.zomi: Leeng tutna zangte in a lut baih theih nadingun i siavuan in clinic ah kah nading a ngawi a bawlsak hi.

records.english: Kids, the lady from the library is coming to read stories, so please sit quietly on the mat.
records.zomi: Naupangte, laibu inn pan numei in tangthu sim dingin hong pai ding ahih manin phah tungah dai takin tu un.

records.english: Our village health volunteer checks on every person over eighty once a week.
records.zomi: I khua damna thalawp nasem in kum sawmgiat val mi khempeuh kal simin vei khat a en hi.

records.english: Can I bring my baby to the town meeting, or is there a crèche?
records.zomi: Khuapi kikhopna ah ka naungek ka paipih thei ding hiam, naupang kemna a om hiam?

records.english: When my mother couldn't manage the stairs anymore, the housing office moved her to a ground-floor flat.
records.zomi: Ka nu in kaplei a kah zo nawn kei ciangin inn thu office in lei tung dawl inn ah a pemsak hi.

records.english: Children should never be left in a car outside the shops, even for a minute.
records.zomi: Minit khat bek zongin dawl polam mawtaw sungah naupangte nusia ngei lo ding hi.

records.english: Visitors mustn't bring food into the children's ward without asking the nurses.
records.zomi: Hong vehte in nurse te a dot ma-un naupangte' ward ah an a tawi thei kei uh hi.

records.english: May I leave my mother at the respite center for the weekend while I attend my son's wedding?
records.zomi: Ka tapa' kiteenna ah ka kihel laitakin kal tawp sung ka nu kemtu tawlngakna mun ah ka nusia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Grandma's medicine was delivered to the wrong house, and a kind neighbor brought it over.
records.zomi: Pi' zatui inn khial ah kipuak a, inn veng hehpih mi khat in hong tawi hi.

records.english: Who can I call if Dad falls when I'm at work?
records.zomi: Nasep ah ka om laitakin Pa a puk leh kua ka sam thei ding hiam?

records.english: Press the button on his alarm pendant, and the emergency team will call you both.
records.zomi: A ngawng-a khai alarm button nen in, haksatna hun pawl in note nih hong sam ding uh hi.

records.english: The playground was closed for repairs, so the nursery took the children to the park instead.
records.zomi: Kimawlna mun kibawl kik ahih manin kikhak a, nursery in naupangte huan ah a paipih hi.

records.english: Grandpa's hearing aid was repaired for free at the health center.
records.zomi: Pu' bil zatna damna inn ah a man om lo-in kibawl kik hi.

records.english: The social worker made sure that my brother's children were never separated while their mother was ill.
records.zomi: A nu a dam loh laitakin ka sanggam pasal' tate kikhen ngei lo dingin mipi huhna nasempa in a en hi.

records.english: If you're caring for someone, the council might be able to give you a few hours off each week.
records.zomi: Mi khat na kep leh khuapi vaihawm in kal simin nai tawmno khawlna hong pia thei kha ding hi.

records.english: The fire officer made the children practice crawling under the smoke at the nursery.
records.zomi: Mei mitsakpa in nursery ah naupangte meikhu nuai ah kibawk dingin a kisinsak hi.

records.english: The power was off at the care home for two hours, but the staff kept everyone warm with blankets.
records.zomi: Upate kemna inn ah nai nih sung meivak kitan a, ahi zongin nasemte in puanzial tawh mi khempeuh a lumsak uh hi.

records.english: The community nurse said, "You're doing a wonderful job, but you need to rest too."
records.zomi: Mipi nurse in, “Nasep hoih mahmah na sem hi, ahi zongin nang zong na tawlngak kul hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: Where can I borrow crutches for my son?
records.zomi: Ka tapa adingin khe-pang singkual koi ah ka leitawi thei ding hiam?

records.english: Ask his doctor for a note, and the health center will lend you a pair.
records.zomi: A siavuan kiangah lai khat ngen inla, damna inn in khat hong leitawi ding hi.

records.english: The volunteers made the old people at the home laugh so much that one of them asked them to come back every day.
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte in upate kemna inn-a upate a nuisak lua uh ahih manin a khat in ni simin hong pai dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: The doctor told me to bring Grandma to the clinic early, before the waiting room gets crowded.
records.zomi: Ngakna khan ah mi a tam ma-in Pi hun ma-in clinic ah paipih dingin siavuan in hong gen hi.

records.english: My son learned first aid at the youth club and used it when his grandfather fainted.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in khangno pawl ah huhna masa a sin a, a pu a kiak ciangin a zang hi.

records.english: A volunteer brings Grandma a hot lunch every weekday through the meals-on-wheels service.
records.zomi: Ni sem ni simin thalawp nasem khat in an puakna pawl tungtawn-in Pi adingin sun an lum a tawi hi.

records.english: My little sister was given a reading tutor by the library's volunteer program.
records.zomi: Laibu inn' thalawp program in ka nau numei adingin lai sim hilhpa khat a pia hi.

records.english: We asked the school to tell us if our daughter ever seems unhappy, and they promised they would.
records.zomi: I tanu a lungdam kei bang leh hong gen dingin sang i ngen a, a gen ding uh a kiciam uh hi.

records.english: What does the home help do for your grandfather?
records.zomi: Inn huhnu in na pu adingin bang a sem hiam?

records.english: She cleans, does his shopping, and makes sure he takes his pills.
records.zomi: A siangsak a, a van a lei sak a, a zatui a ne hiam a en hi.

records.english: When the road was closed by a landslide, the doctor had to leave home two hours earlier to reach the clinic.
records.zomi: Leiminpuk in lampi a khak ciangin siavuan in clinic a tun nadingin inn nai nih ma-in a paisan kul hi.

records.english: I really do love walking through the market in the morning, before the crowds arrive.
records.zomi: Mi a tam ma-in zingsang zuakna mun ah kaai ka deih taktak hi.

records.english: There's no school bus today, so all of you will have to walk together with a teacher.
records.zomi: Tuni-in sang bus om lo ahih manin note khempeuh saya tawh khawm in na kaai kul ding uh hi.

records.english: Mom made us put on our best clothes for the visit to the town hall.
records.zomi: Khuapi office veh nadingin Nu in i puan hoih pen hong silhsak hi.

records.english: Is the clinic open early enough for me to get my blood test before work?
records.zomi: Nasep ma-in ka sisan sitna ka bawl theih nadingin clinic a manlang takin a kihong hiam?

records.english: Yes, it opens at seven, but remember not to eat anything first.
records.zomi: Kihong hi, nai sagih ciangin a kihong a, ahi zongin a masa-in bangmah ne lo ding phawk in.

records.english: The power was cut before dawn, so I got dressed by candlelight and ironed nothing.
records.zomi: Khua a vak ma-in meivak kitan ahih manin khawimeivaak tawh puan ka silh a, bangmah ka tut kei hi.

records.english: The bread van arrives at six, and the driver leaves a loaf on our step for the old woman next door.
records.zomi: Moh mawtaw nai guk ciangin a tung a, tuansakpa in i kaplei tungah inn kiang numei upa adingin moh khat a nusia hi.

records.english: Every morning the community radio announcer says, "Good morning, valley — here's today's weather."
records.zomi: Zingsang simin mipi radio thugenpa in, “Zingpha, guam — tuni-a khua thu hih ahi hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: You can't wear sandals in the hospital kitchen, so put your work shoes on before you leave.
records.zomi: Zato anbuk ah khedap kisu na silh thei kei ahih manin na pai ma-in na nasep khedap silh in.

records.english: Children shouldn't walk to the school bus alone in the dark, so a parent from our street goes with them each morning.
records.zomi: Naupangte khuamial sungah sang bus ah a bek-in a kaai kei ding uh ahih manin i lampi pan nu hiam pa hiam khat zingsang simin a zui hi.

records.english: The town's only pharmacist opens her shop at seven so that workers can collect their medicine on the way to the fields.
records.zomi: Khuapi-a zatui zuakpa khat bek in nasemte in lo a pai lam-un a zatui uh a lak theih nadingun nai sagih ciangin a dawl a hong hi.

records.english: My aunt makes my uncle check the gas before he leaves for his night watch.
records.zomi: Ka ni in ka pa neu zan kemna ah a pai ma-in gas a ensak hi.

records.english: I had my brother wake me at five so that I could be first in line at the job center.
records.zomi: Nasep zonna mun ah a masa pen-a ka kizom theih nadingin ka sanggam pasal in nai nga ciangin hong phongkhia hi.

records.english: Visitors mustn't park in front of the fire station, even early in the morning.
records.zomi: Zingsang manlang zongin hong vehte in mei mitsakna inn mai ah mawtaw a koih thei kei uh hi.

records.english: The street was flooded overnight, and we woke up to find water in the kitchen.
records.zomi: Zanin lampi tui in a dim a, i khanglo ciangin anbuk ah tui a om hi.

records.english: The early train was delayed by fog, so half the town's teachers arrived late.
records.zomi: Zingsang manlang meileng meiteik in a nunsak ahih manin khuapi sayate a kim a nun uh hi.

records.english: My little sister helps Grandma get dressed every morning before school.
records.zomi: Ka nau numei in sang a kah ma-in zingsang simin Pi' puan silh a huh hi.

records.english: The loud music from the festival kept the whole street awake, so everyone was grumpy the next morning.
records.zomi: Pawi pan la ging sang in lampi bup a ihmusak kei ahih manin a zingsang ciangin mi khempeuh a lungkia uh hi.

records.english: My neighbor always knocks on my door when she leaves for the market, in case I've overslept.
records.zomi: Ka ihmut sau kha leh ci-in ka inn veng nu in zuakna mun a pai ciangin ka kongkhak a khawng tawntung hi.

records.english: My neighbor, a firefighter, sleeps with his uniform and boots next to the bed in case he's called out.
records.zomi: Mei mitsakpa ka inn veng in a kisam kha leh ci-in a puan leh a khedap lupna kiang ah koih-in a ihmu hi.

records.english: Can I shower at the community center, since our water has been off for two days?
records.zomi: I tui ni nih sung a kitan ahih manin mipi inn ah ka kisil thei ding hiam?

records.english: Does your grandfather still shave every morning before he goes to the senior center?
records.zomi: Na pu in upate inn a pai ma-in zingsang simin a khamul a meh lai hiam?

records.english: What time do I need to get to the passport office to avoid the queue?
records.zomi: Kizomna nawl nadingin passport office ah bang hun ciangin ka tun kul hiam?

records.english: Before seven, if you want to be home by lunch.
records.zomi: Nai sagih ma-in, sun an ma-in inn na tun nuam leh.

records.english: Morning routines in our town follow the bus timetable more than the clock.
records.zomi: I khuapi zingsang ngeinate nai-ten sangin bus hun gelhna a zui zaw hi.

records.english: Why does the baker always start work in the middle of the night?
records.zomi: Bang hangin moh bawlpa in zan lai ciangin na a sep kipan tawntung hiam?

records.english: So that the town has fresh bread for breakfast.
records.zomi: Khuapi in zingsang an adingin moh thak a neih theih nadingin.

records.english: When the morning bus was canceled, the school sent a truck to collect the children.
records.zomi: Zingsang bus kiphiat ciangin sang in naupangte la dingin mawtaw lian khat a sawl hi.

records.english: Waking up to the sound of the new school being built made the whole village smile.
records.zomi: Sang thak kilamna ging za-in khanglo in khua bup a nuisak hi.

records.english: Who sweeps the streets before the town wakes up?
records.zomi: Khuapi a khanglo ma-in lampite kua in a phiat hiam?

records.english: My mother wakes the old man next door each morning by knocking twice on his window.
records.zomi: Ka nu in zingsang simin inn kiang pasal upa a tawhkhawng nihvei khawng-in a phongkhia hi.

records.english: Could you get up early tomorrow and take Grandma to the clinic before the queue gets long?
records.zomi: Zingciang hun ma-in na thou a, kizomna a sau ma-in Pi clinic ah na paipih thei ding hiam?

records.english: The morning queue at the clinic was so long that some patients brought chairs from home.
records.zomi: Clinic-a zingsang kizomna a sau lua ahih manin damlo khenkhatte inn pan tutna a tawi uh hi.

records.english: The mayor said, "I'll be at the market at six tomorrow to hear what people need."
records.zomi: Khuapi ukpa in, “Mite' kisapna za dingin zingciang nai guk ciangin zuakna mun ah ka om ding hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: The alarm on Grandpa's medicine box beeps at seven to remind him to take his pills.
records.zomi: Pu' zatui bawm tung-a alarm in a zatui nek ding phawksak dingin nai sagih ciangin a ging hi.

records.english: No one was allowed into the polling station before seven, so we waited outside in the cold.
records.zomi: Nai sagih ma-in vote piakna mun ah kuamah lut thei lo ahih manin vot sungah polam ah i ngak hi.

records.english: Our village health worker leaves home at dawn so that she can reach the farthest houses before the heat.
records.zomi: I khua damna nasem in sa a nasiat ma-in a gamla pen inn te a tun theih nadingin khua vak ciangin inn a paisan hi.

records.english: Do you have to get up early to catch the first ferry to the island clinic?
records.zomi: Tuikulh clinic pai tembaw masa pen tuang dingin hun ma-in na thou kul hiam?

records.english: Did the post office open on time this morning?
records.zomi: Tu zingsangin post office a hun takah a kihong hiam?

records.english: Why is the early ferry always full of market traders and nurses?
records.zomi: Bang hangin zingsang tembaw zuakna mun zuakte leh nurse te tawh a dim tawntung hiam?

records.english: Morning, everyone — the bus is twenty minutes late because of an accident on the bridge.
records.zomi: Zingpha, mi khempeuh — lei tungah kituakna a om ahih manin bus minit sawmnih a nun hi.

records.english: Our pastor gets up at five to pray for every family in the parish by name.
records.zomi: I pastor in pawlpi sung innkuan khempeuh min sim-in thu ngen dingin nai nga ciangin a thou hi.

records.english: The nurse who lives next door makes breakfast for her elderly father before every early shift.
records.zomi: Inn kiang-a om nurse in zingsang manlang nasep ma simin a pa upa adingin zingsang an a huan hi.

records.english: The water only comes on between five and seven, so we get up early to fill the buckets.
records.zomi: Nai nga leh nai sagih kikal bek-in tui a om ahih manin khuangte i dimsak nadingin hun ma-in i thou hi.

records.english: The rubbish truck woke the baby at half past five again.
records.zomi: Niin mawtaw in nai nga leh a kim ciangin naungek a phongkhia kik hi.

records.english: How early does the ambulance crew start their shift?
records.zomi: Ambulance nasemte in bang hun ciangin a nasep hun uh a kipan hiam?

records.english: At six, and they check every piece of equipment before the first call comes in.
records.zomi: Nai guk ciangin, sam masa pen a tun ma-in van khempeuh a en uh hi.

records.english: The volunteers at the shelter woke the guests at seven with tea and bread.
records.zomi: Om sakna mun-a thalawp nasemte in nai sagih ciangin tea leh moh tawh khualte a phongkhia uh hi.

records.english: The church bell wakes the whole village at six on Sunday mornings.
records.zomi: Nipini zingsang nai guk ciangin pawlpi khawng in khua bup a phongkhia hi.

records.english: The police officers on the morning shift check their radios and cars before they go out.
records.zomi: Zingsang nasep hun-a police te in a pai ma-un a radio leh mawtaw uh a en uh hi.

records.english: On market days, my grandmother wakes at four to load the vegetables onto the cart.
records.zomi: Zuakna ni-in ka pi nai li ciangin a thou a, leeng tungah anteh a thun hi.

records.english: Shall I drive you to the council office, so you're not late for your appointment?
records.zomi: Na kimuhna ah na nun loh nadingin khuapi vaihawm office ah kong paipih ding hiam?

records.english: Did the water come back on this morning?
records.zomi: Tu zingsangin tui a hong kik hiam?

records.english: My son got up at five to help the volunteers set up the stalls for the charity market.
records.zomi: Piakna zuakna mun dawlte bawl huh dingin ka tapa nai nga ciangin a thou hi.

records.english: Not until the electricity returned at eight could the hospital laundry start washing the sheets.
records.zomi: Nai giat ciangin meivak a hong kik dong zato puan sawpna in lupna puante a sawp thei kei hi.

records.english: Wake me up when the water truck arrives, please.
records.zomi: Tui mawtaw a tun ciangin hong phongkhia in.

records.english: The morning siren at the factory used to wake the whole town, but it was turned off years ago.
records.zomi: Factory-a zingsang khawng in khuapi bup a phongkhia ngei a, ahi zongin kum tampi paisa-in kiphel hi.

records.english: Make sure you have your identity card before you leave for the bank.
records.zomi: Bank na pai ma-in na ID card na nei hiam kician takin en in.

records.english: Kids, put on your rain boots, because the path to the bus stop is muddy.
records.zomi: Naupangte, bus khawlna lampi a buan ahih manin na guah khedap uh silh un.

records.english: If the donations keep coming, the community kitchen could open twice a week.
records.zomi: Piaknate a tung den leh mipi anbuk kal khat-in nihvei a kihong thei kha ding hi.

records.english: So many people came to the harvest meal that the cooks ran out of plates and served the rice on banana leaves.
records.zomi: Buh lak an ah mi a tam lua uh ahih manin an huante in kuang a bei a, banana nah tungah buh a koih uh hi.

records.english: The pastor blessed the food, and then the whole village sat down to eat together.
records.zomi: Pastor in an thupha a pia a, tua khit ciangin khua bup in an a ne khawm uh hi.

records.english: Could someone show the new volunteers how to use the big gas stove safely?
records.zomi: Thalawp nasem thakte gas meibuk lian bitna taka zat dan kuamah in a etsak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Would the restaurant give its leftover bread to the shelter at the end of the day?
records.zomi: An zuakna dawl in ni tawp ciangin a moh taang om sakna mun a pia ding hiam?

records.english: Nobody had remembered the salt, so the first batch of stew was eaten without it.
records.zomi: Kuamah in cii a phawk kei uh ahih manin an-tui masa pen cii om lo-in kine hi.

records.english: We burned the first pot of porridge at the shelter, so we had to start again at six in the morning.
records.zomi: Om sakna mun ah buh-an tui beel masa pen i kangsak ahih manin zingsang nai guk ciangin i kipan kik kul hi.

records.english: The cook at the health center prepares special meals for patients who can't eat salt or sugar.
records.zomi: Damna inn an huanpa in cii hiam sugar hiam ne thei lo damlote adingin an tuam a huan hi.

records.english: The organizers had the food tested before the festival, because two people had fallen ill the year before.
records.zomi: Kum bei-in mi nih a cina uh ahih manin pawi ma-in vaihawmte in an a sitsak uh hi.

records.english: Food isn't allowed to be sold at the market without a hygiene certificate, according to the new council rule.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm thukhun thak bangin siangthona lai-ciam om lo-in zuakna mun ah an zuak kiphal lo hi.

records.english: Let's ask the market sellers whether they'll donate vegetables for the community meal.
records.zomi: Mipi an adingin zuakna mun zuakte in anteh a pia thei ding uh hiam dong ni.

records.english: All the food for the clinic opening was cooked by mothers whose babies had been born there.
records.zomi: Clinic honna an khempeuh tua ah naungek a suak nute in a huan uh hi.

records.english: Why does the school cook start so early in the morning?
records.zomi: Bang hangin sang an huannu zingsang manlang takin a kipan hiam?

records.english: The chef from the hotel came to the school to teach the cooks a cheaper way to make soup.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk pan an huanpa sang ah hong pai a, an-tui man neu zawin bawl dan an huante a hilh hi.

records.english: We do want everyone to eat well at the shelter, even if the food is simple.
records.zomi: Om sakna mun ah an a baih zongin mi khempeuh in hoih takin a nek ding uh i deih taktak hi.

records.english: Does the school feeding program give every child a hot meal at lunchtime?
records.zomi: Sang an piakna program in sun an hun-in naupang khempeuh an lum a pia hiam?

records.english: Can I help cut vegetables at the community kitchen on Saturday?
records.zomi: Kiginni ciangin mipi anbuk ah anteh tan ka huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Using the solar cooker the aid workers left behind, we can cook beans without buying firewood.
records.zomi: Huhna nasemte' nusia ni meibuk zang-in sing lei lo-in be i huan thei hi.

records.english: Please don't take food home from the community lunch until everyone has eaten.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh in a nek zawh ma-un mipi sun an pan an inn ah tawi kei un.

records.english: Do the volunteers eat before or after the guests at the community lunch?
records.zomi: Mipi sun an ah thalawp nasemte khualte' ma-in a ne uh hiam, a nung ciangin hiam?

records.english: Raw meat must be kept apart from cooked food in the community kitchen fridge.
records.zomi: Mipi anbuk khal bawm sungah sa hing pen an kihuan khin tawh kikhen-in kikoih kul hi.

records.english: Could we cook for Grandpa on Fridays, since he lives alone now?
records.zomi: Pu tu-in amah bek a om ahih manin Laithai ni simin a adingin i huan thei ding hiam?

records.english: Kids, help carry the plates to the tables, and then you can eat with the others.
records.zomi: Naupangte, dawhkan ah kuangte puak huh unla, tua khit ciangin a dangte tawh na ne thei uh hi.

records.english: The children's lunch was late because the gas delivery hadn't arrived.
records.zomi: Gas puak a tun nai lo ahih manin naupangte' sun an a nun hi.

records.english: My grandmother taught the young mothers' group how to make baby food from pumpkins.
records.zomi: Ka pi in nu khangno pawl kiangah mai tawh naungek an bawl dan a hilh hi.

records.english: The nutrition talk at the clinic made my mother change the way she cooks for the whole family.
records.zomi: Clinic-a an hoih thugen in ka nu in innkuan bup adinga a an huan dan a khel hi.

records.english: Is it all right to give the shelter food that we cooked yesterday?
records.zomi: Zanni-a i huan an om sakna mun piak a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: Only if it was kept in the fridge, and you should tell them when it was made.
records.zomi: Khal bawm sungah kikoih bek leh, bang hun-a kihuan hiam amaute na gen kul hi.

records.english: Could you bring a big pot to the church on Sunday for the harvest meal?
records.zomi: Buh lak an adingin Nipini ciangin pawlpi ah beel lian khat na tawi thei ding hiam?

records.english: The boys who had complained about the soup ended up asking for second helpings.
records.zomi: An-tui a phunsan pasal naupangte in a tawp-in a behlap a ngen uh hi.

records.english: How many people come to the soup kitchen on a cold night?
records.zomi: Zan vot ciangin an-tui anbuk ah mi bangzah a hong uh hiam?

records.english: Around eighty, so we start cooking at three in the afternoon.
records.zomi: Sawmgiat bang, tua ahih manin nitak nai thum ciangin an i huan kipan hi.

records.english: We cooked so much rice for the volunteers that the leftovers fed the shelter for two days.
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte adingin buh tampi i huan a, a taang in om sakna mun ni nih a vak hi.

records.english: Every Thursday, volunteers cook a free lunch at the community kitchen for anyone who needs it.
records.zomi: Laizing ni simin thalawp nasemte in a kisam mi khempeuh adingin mipi anbuk ah a man om lo sun an a huan uh hi.

records.english: Did you see how proudly my little brother served soup at the lunch club?
records.zomi: Sun an pawl ah ka nau pasal a kisaktheih takin an-tui a hawm na mu hiam?

records.english: When the power went out at the school, the cooks finished lunch on a wood fire in the yard.
records.zomi: Sang ah meivak a kitan ciangin an huante in inn mai ah sing mei tawh sun an a zo uh hi.

records.english: The festival food was cooked in huge pans that the church lends out every year.
records.zomi: Pawi an pen kum simin pawlpi in a leitawi beel lian mahmah te ah kihuan hi.

records.english: At the cooking class in the community center, a retired chef showed us how to make bread without an oven.
records.zomi: Mipi inn-a an huan kilasi ah an huanpa khawl khat in oven om lo-in moh bawl dan hong etsak hi.

records.english: Who cooks for the funeral guests in your village?
records.zomi: Na khua ah misi vuina khualte adingin kua in an a huan hiam?

records.english: The neighbors do, so that the family doesn't have to think about food.
records.zomi: Innkuan in an thu a ngaihsut kul loh nadingin inn vengte in a huan uh hi.

records.english: Cooking together at the shelter has taught my teenagers more about gratitude than any lesson.
records.zomi: Om sakna mun ah khawm-a an huan in ka ta khangnote kilasi khempeuh sangin lungdamna thu tam zaw a hilh hi.

records.english: Every family in our street takes one evening a month to cook for the new mothers.
records.zomi: I lampi-a innkuan khempeuh in kha khat-in nitak khat naungek nu thakte adingin an a huan uh hi.

records.english: Children mustn't go near the big cooking fires at the festival.
records.zomi: Pawi ah naupangte an huanna mei lian kiang ah a pai kei ding uh hi.

records.english: Thank you for cooking for the volunteers — the food kept everyone going.
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte adingin an na huan manin ka lungdam hi — an in mi khempeuh a hatsak hi.

records.english: The town's cooking competition was won by a fourteen-year-old boy who learned from his grandmother.
records.zomi: Khuapi an huan kidemna pen a pi kiang pan a sin kum sawm leh li pasal naupang khat in a zo hi.

records.english: What should I cook for the volunteers who are repairing the school roof?
records.zomi: Sang inn tung bawl kik thalawp nasemte adingin bang ka huan ding hiam?

records.english: Something filling, like rice and beans, because they'll be working all day.
records.zomi: A vah thei khat, buh leh be bang, ni bup na a sep ding uh ahih manin.

records.english: The police officers on night duty were brought hot tea and noodles by the women from the market.
records.zomi: Zan kemna police te zuakna mun pan numeite in tea lum leh an-ngum a tawi uh hi.

records.english: The pot of soup boiled over while the cook was serving the first in line, and the stove went out.
records.zomi: An huanpa in a kizom masa pen a piak laitakin an-tui beel a lian a, meibuk mei a mit hi.

records.english: The farmers donated so many tomatoes that the community kitchen made sauce for a month.
records.zomi: Lo neite in khamtung tampi a piak uh ahih manin mipi anbuk in kha khat sung khamtung an-tui a bawl hi.

records.english: The inspector said, "Your kitchen is cleaner than mine," and the restaurant owner laughed with relief.
records.zomi: Enkaktu in, “Na anbuk kei' sangin a siang zaw hi,” a ci a, an zuakna dawl neipa a lungdam-in a nui hi.

records.english: The health worker made us taste the soup with less salt, and nobody could tell the difference.
records.zomi: Damna nasem in cii tawm zaw an-tui hong liimsak a, kuamah in a kikhiatna a thei kei uh hi.

records.english: Take some soup home with you, because there's plenty left.
records.zomi: An-tui tawmno inn ah tawi in, a taang tampi om lai hi.

records.english: When the rain flooded the community hall, the wedding meal was cooked and served in the school.
records.zomi: Guah in mipi inn lian a dimsak ciangin kiteenna an sang ah kihuan a, kipia hi.

records.english: Everyone, the food is ready, so please line up and take one plate each.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, an kiman khin ahih manin kizom unla kuang khat ciat la un.

records.english: My aunt said, "Cooking for a hundred is just cooking for ten, ten times."
records.zomi: Ka ni in, “Za khat adinga an huan pen sawm adinga huan vei sawm bek ahi hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: When the village oven was repaired, every family baked bread there for the festival.
records.zomi: Khua moh bawlna oven a kibawl kik ciangin innkuan khempeuh in pawi adingin tua ah moh a bawl uh hi.

records.english: The women's group cooks for the whole village on market day and sells the food to raise money for the school.
records.zomi: Numei pawl in zuakna ni-in khua bup adingin an a huan uh a, sang adingin sum kaikhawm dingin an a zuak uh hi.

records.english: No one is allowed in the community kitchen without washing their hands at the door.
records.zomi: Kongkhak ah khut sil lo-in kuamah mipi anbuk ah lut thei lo hi.

records.english: The new cooks were taught to measure everything with the big spoons hanging by the stove.
records.zomi: An huan thakte meibuk kiang-a khai kawm lian te tawh na khempeuh teh dingin kihilh uh hi.

records.english: Could you help me carry these boxes of files down to the basement of the town hall?
records.zomi: Hih file bawmte khuapi office nuai lam khan ah ka puak nadingin hong huh thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: The food bank shelves are organized by date so that nothing goes out of date before it's given away.
records.zomi: An kaikhawmna mun dawhte a ni tawh kibawl ahih manin bangmah kipiak ma-in a ni a bei kei hi.

records.english: Thanks to the volunteers, the old cemetery paths can be walked on again.
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte hang-in han mun lui lampite tu-in kikaai thei kik hi.

records.english: The storeroom at the community hall was so full that we couldn't find the extra chairs.
records.zomi: Mipi inn lian-a van koihna khan a dim lua ahih manin tutna behlapte i mu thei kei hi.

records.english: Bring a broom if you have one; the hall has only two.
records.zomi: Phiatna na nei leh tawi in; inn lian in nih bek a nei hi.

records.english: A clean street makes people proud of where they live.
records.zomi: Lampi siang in mite in a teenna uh a kisaktheihsak hi.

records.english: No one should leave their rubbish at the picnic site, even if the bins are full.
records.zomi: Niin bawm a dim zongin picnic mun ah kuamah in a niin a nusia kei ding hi.

records.english: Who keeps the keys to the church cupboard?
records.zomi: Pawlpi bawm tawh kua in a kem hiam?

records.english: The caretaker, but he lends them to anyone who's cleaning on Saturday.
records.zomi: Inn kemnu in, ahi zongin Kiginni-a siangsak kua peuh a leitawi hi.

records.english: Everyone, take a pair of gloves and a bag, and meet at the bridge at nine.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, khut-ngumna leh ip khat ciat la unla nai kua ciangin lei ah kimu ni.

records.english: We emptied the school storeroom and found thirty years of lost umbrellas.
records.zomi: Sang van koihna khan i awngsak a, kum sawmthum sung mang khaupite i mu hi.

records.english: The church hall was left so tidy after the wedding that the caretaker thanked the families.
records.zomi: Kiteenna khit ciangin pawlpi inn lian a siang lua ahih manin inn kemnu in innkuante tungah lungdam a ko hi.

records.english: Would you mind sweeping the clinic waiting room before the doctor arrives?
records.zomi: Siavuan a tun ma-in clinic ngakna khan na phiat sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Children aren't allowed to touch the broken glass, so the adults pick it up with tongs.
records.zomi: Naupangte in khuang kitam a khoih thei kei uh ahih manin upate in lenna tawh a la uh hi.

records.english: My daughter labeled every shelf in the library storeroom so that the volunteers can find things easily.
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte in na a muh baih theih nadingun ka tanu in laibu inn van koihna khan dawh khempeuh ah min a koih hi.

records.english: The old newspapers at the library were scanned so that they won't be lost.
records.zomi: A mang loh nadingin laibu inn-a thuthak lai luite scan kisam hi.

records.english: Shall we organize a clean-up day for the cemetery before All Saints' Day?
records.zomi: Misite Ni ma-in han mun siangsakna ni khat i vaihawm ding hiam?

records.english: What happens to the things nobody buys at the charity shop?
records.zomi: Piakna dawl ah kuamah in a lei loh vante bang a hi hiam?

records.english: We give the clothes to the shelter, and the rest goes for recycling.
records.zomi: Puante om sakna mun ah i pia a, a taang recycling ah a pai hi.

records.english: The graffiti on the school wall was painted over by the parents in one afternoon.
records.zomi: Sang bang tung-a lim gelhte nu leh pate in nitak khat sungin lim a khuh uh hi.

records.english: The clinic's medicine shelves were reorganized after a nurse nearly gave the wrong tablets.
records.zomi: Nurse khat in zatui khial a piak dek khit ciangin clinic zatui dawhte kibawl kik hi.

records.english: The community garden shed was finally organized, and nobody has lost a spade since.
records.zomi: Mipi huan inn neu kibawl siang tawp a, tua pan kuamah in tuthau a mansuah nawn kei hi.

records.english: Did anyone remember to lock the storeroom after the clean-up?
records.zomi: Siangsakna khit ciangin van koihna khan khak kuamah in a phawk hiam?

records.english: The recycling drive collected so many bottles that the truck had to come back twice.
records.zomi: Recycling kaikhawmna in bel tampi a kaikhawm ahih manin mawtaw lian vei nih a hong kul hi.

records.english: When the old post office was cleared out, boxes of letters from forty years ago were found under the floor.
records.zomi: Post office lui kisiangsak ciangin lei nuai ah kum sawmli paisa-a lai bawmte kimu hi.

records.english: Let's sort the donated toys before the children's home picks them up.
records.zomi: Naupang kemna inn in a lak ma-un kipia tawngte khen ni.

records.english: The playground was covered in leaves after the storm, so the children raked them into piles.
records.zomi: Huihpi khit ciangin kimawlna mun nah tawh a kikhuh ahih manin naupangte in a kaikhawm uh hi.

records.english: My grandfather keeps the village's hymn books in perfect order, numbered and wrapped in cloth.
records.zomi: Ka pu in khua-a la laibute a kizui dan bangin a kem a, nambat a koih a, puan tawh a tuam hi.

records.english: The town hall's records were put in order after the new clerk spent a month on them.
records.zomi: Lai kem thak in kha khat a zat khit ciangin khuapi office laite kibawl siang hi.

records.english: When the floodwater went down, every family in the village helped clean the school before their own homes.
records.zomi: Tui a kiam ciangin khua sung innkuan khempeuh in amau inn ma-in sang siangsak a huh uh hi.

records.english: The women's group reorganized the market so that the fish sellers are no longer next to the bread.
records.zomi: Nga zuakte moh tawh kikiang nawn lo dingin numei pawl in zuakna mun a bawl kik uh hi.

records.english: We spent the afternoon untangling the festival lights and testing every bulb.
records.zomi: Pawi meivakte kituah phel-in meivak khat ciat sit-in nitak i zang hi.

records.english: The school was cleaned from top to bottom before the inspectors' visit.
records.zomi: Enkaktute' veh ma-in sang a tung pan a nuai dong kisiangsak hi.

records.english: Medicines in the clinic cupboard must be kept in order, with the oldest at the front.
records.zomi: Clinic bawm sung-a zatuite a kizui dan bangin kikoih ding a, a lui pen mai lam ah.

records.english: Hardly anyone had used the old storeroom for years, so we turned it into a reading room.
records.zomi: Kum tampi sung van koihna khan lui kuamah in a zang kei ahih manin lai simna khan ah i bawl hi.

records.english: Please put the gloves and rubbish bags back in the box after the clean-up.
records.zomi: Siangsakna khit ciangin khut-ngumna leh niin ip te bawm sungah koih kik un.

records.english: Why are the river clean-ups always on Saturday mornings?
records.zomi: Bang hangin gun siangsakna Kiginni zingsang ciangin a om tawntung hiam?

records.english: Can I help sort the papers in the town hall archive this summer?
records.zomi: Tu khal ciangin khuapi office lai kemna-a laite khen ka huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our neighbor's yard was so overgrown that the volunteers spent a whole day clearing it for her.
records.zomi: I inn veng' inn mai a buai lua ahih manin thalawp nasemte in ni bup a adingin a siangsak uh hi.

records.english: The square was swept, the benches were washed, and the flowers were planted before the festival.
records.zomi: Pawi ma-in laizang kiphiat a, tutna sau te kisil a, pakte kisuan hi.

records.english: Can you show me where the cleaning supplies are kept at the community center?
records.zomi: Mipi inn ah siangsakna vante koi ah kikoih hiam hong lak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: My little brother found a lost wallet during the park clean-up and took it to the police station.
records.zomi: Huan siangsakna laitakin ka nau pasal in sum ip mangthang khat a mu a, police station ah a puak hi.

records.english: The librarian said, "Every donated book gets checked, cleaned, and labeled before it goes on the shelf."
records.zomi: Laibu inn kemnu in, “Kipia laibu khempeuh dawh tungah a om ma-in kien, kisiangsak a, min kikoih hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: The bus shelter was cleaned and repainted by the youth club, and the town council thanked them.
records.zomi: Bus ngakna inn khangno pawl in a siangsak uh a, lim thak a khai uh a, khuapi vaihawm in lungdam a ko hi.

records.english: How do you keep the food bank so well organized?
records.zomi: An kaikhawmna mun bangci-in na kem siang den hiam?

records.english: Every box has a label, and every volunteer learns the system on their first day.
records.zomi: Bawm khempeuh ah min a om a, thalawp nasem khempeuh in a ni masa pen-un a kizat dan a sin uh hi.

records.english: My mother still volunteers to clean the clinic windows every month, even at seventy.
records.zomi: Ka nu kum sawmsagih a pha napi kha simin clinic tawhkhawng siangsak dingin thalawp takin a sem lai hi.

records.english: Please don't put anything in the corridor of the clinic, because stretchers need to get through.
records.zomi: Damlo puakna a kantan theih nadingin clinic lampi khan ah bangmah koih kei un.

records.english: When the market closes, the sellers sweep their own spaces before the council truck comes.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun a kikhak ciangin khuapi vaihawm mawtaw a tun ma-in zuakte in amau mun a phiat uh hi.

records.english: Kids, pick up any plastic you see on the way to school, and we'll count it on Friday.
records.zomi: Naupangte, sang na pai lam ah plastic na muh khempeuh la unla, Laithai ni ciangin i sim ding hi.

records.english: Since the new bins were put along the main road, the town looks much cleaner.
records.zomi: Lampi lian gei ah niin bawm thakte kikoih pan khuapi a siang zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: I do want the church to look its best for the wedding, so let's polish the benches tonight.
records.zomi: Kiteenna adingin pawlpi a hoih pen-in a om ding ka deih taktak ahih manin tu zanin tutna saute nuai ni.

records.english: Is there a day when the council collects old furniture?
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in innsung van luite a lak ni a om hiam?

records.english: On Saturday morning, the whole street helped clear the rubbish out of the river.
records.zomi: Kiginni zingsangin lampi bup in gun sung pan niin a la khia huh uh hi.

records.english: The volunteers who cleaned the beach were exhausted but proud of how it looked.
records.zomi: Tuipi gei a siangsak thalawp nasemte a gim uh a, ahi zongin a lim tungah a kisaktheih uh hi.

records.english: In our town, dumping rubbish by the road is forbidden, and the council has put up cameras to stop it.
records.zomi: I khuapi ah lampi gei ah niin paai kiphal lo a, tua a khaktan nadingin khuapi vaihawm in camera a koih hi.

records.english: So much litter was collected on the first clean-up day that the council made it a monthly event.
records.zomi: Siangsakna ni masa pen-in niin tampi kikaikhawm ahih manin khuapi vaihawm in kha simin poai a bawl hi.

records.english: Where should we put the clothes people have donated?
records.zomi: Mite' piak puante koi ah i koih ding hiam?

records.english: Sort them by size first, and put the children's things in the blue boxes.
records.zomi: A lianzah tawh khen masa inla, naupangte' vante bawm dum sungah koih in.

records.english: The village well was cleaned by the health workers, and the water tasted fresh again.
records.zomi: Khua tuikhuk damna nasemte in a siangsak uh a, tui a thak kik hi.

records.english: The town hall was so busy on the last day for paying taxes that the staff skipped lunch.
records.zomi: Siah piak ni nunung pen-in khuapi office a buai lua ahih manin nasemte in sun an a ne zo kei uh hi.

records.english: When the computers crashed at the tax office, the queue grew until it reached the street.
records.zomi: Siah office ah computer te a siat ciangin kizomna a sau a, lampi dong a tung hi.

records.english: Can you cover the front desk while I take the visitors to the archive?
records.zomi: Hong vehte lai kemna ah ka paipih laitakin mai dawhkan na kem sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: My neighbor works nights at the hospital switchboard, connecting calls to the right wards.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng zato phone kizopna ah zanin na a sem a, ward man ah phone a zopsak hi.

records.english: Let's finish sorting the donations before the food bank opens at ten.
records.zomi: An kaikhawmna mun nai sawm ciangin a kihon ma-in piaknate khen zo ni.

records.english: Most people never see the night workers who keep the city's water clean.
records.zomi: Khuapi tui a siangsak zan nasemte mi tam zaw in a mu ngei kei uh hi.

records.english: When I started at the bank counter, my first task every Monday was counting coins for the market traders.
records.zomi: Bank dawhkan ah ka sep kipat ciangin Pizing ni simin ka nasep masa pen zuakna mun zuakte adingin dangka sim ahi hi.

records.english: Ask the pharmacist in the afternoon, when she has more time for questions.
records.zomi: Dotna adingin hun a neih tam zawk nitak lam ciangin zatui zuakpa dong in.

records.english: At the end of each day, the market inspector writes a short report on any problems she saw.
records.zomi: Ni khat ciat tawp ciangin zuakna mun enkaktu nu in a muh buainate report tom khat a gelh hi.

records.english: Who answers the phone at the clinic when the receptionist is on holiday?
records.zomi: Reception nu tawlngakni a zat ciangin clinic ah phone kua in a dawng hiam?

records.english: What does a firefighter do when there are no fires?
records.zomi: Mei kat a om loh ciangin mei mitsakpa in bang a sem hiam?

records.english: We check the equipment, train, visit schools, and clean the trucks until they shine.
records.zomi: Vante i en a, i kisin a, sangte i veh a, mawtaw te a tang dong i sil hi.

records.english: How long does it take the postman to finish his route?
records.zomi: Lai puakpa in a lampi zawh nadingin hun bangzah a sau hiam?

records.english: After eight hours of answering complaints at the water company, I just want silence on the bus home.
records.zomi: Tui company ah nai giat sung phunsannate ka dawn khit ciangin inn ciahna bus tungah daina bek ka deih hi.

records.english: A social worker's day often starts with phone calls and ends with home visits across the city.
records.zomi: Mipi huhna nasempa' ni pen phone sam tawh kipan a, khuapi bup inn vehna tawh tawp zel hi.

records.english: My cousin's job at the council is answering residents' emails, and some days there are hundreds.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm-a ka sanggam nu' nasep teengte' email dawn ahi a, ni khenkhatah za tampi a om hi.

records.english: Shall I bring lunch to the volunteers at the polling station?
records.zomi: Vote piakna mun-a thalawp nasemte adingin sun an ka tawi ding hiam?

records.english: Do the bus drivers get a break at the end of each route?
records.zomi: Bus tuansakte in lampi khat ciat tawp ciangin a khawl uh hiam?

records.english: Ten minutes, which is just enough for a cup of tea at the depot.
records.zomi: Minit sawm, bus koihna mun ah tea khuang khat dawn zah bek.

records.english: I do want to finish these benefit forms before lunch, so I'm not taking calls this morning.
records.zomi: Sun an ma-in hih huhna laite ka zawh ding ka deih taktak ahih manin tu zingsangin phone ka dawng kei ding hi.

records.english: No sooner had the clinic opened than a farmer arrived with a deep cut on his hand.
records.zomi: Clinic a kihon pah-in lo nei khat a khut tung ah liamna thuk tawh hong tung hi.

records.english: The school caretaker also repairs the children's broken chairs in his little workshop behind the hall.
records.zomi: Sang kemnu in inn lian nung lam a nasepna inn neu ah naupangte' tutna kitamte zong a bawl kik hi.

records.english: Every evening, the police officer on duty writes everything that happened in the station logbook.
records.zomi: Nitak simin a nasep hun-a police in station lai bu sungah a piang khempeuh a gelh hi.

records.english: Why do the park rangers walk the same trail every morning?
records.zomi: Bang hangin huan kemte zingsang simin lampi khat mah a kaai uh hiam?

records.english: When the new ticket machines were installed, the station staff spent all day helping passengers use them.
records.zomi: Ticket machine thakte kikoih ciangin station nasemte in tuangte a zat theih nadingun ni bup a huh uh hi.

records.english: Is it all right if I start my shift at the shelter an hour later on Fridays?
records.zomi: Laithai ni simin om sakna mun-a ka nasep hun nai khat nunin ka kipat leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: Does the emergency call center ever close?
records.zomi: Haksatna hun phone dawnna mun a kikhak ngei hiam?

records.english: Would you take these letters to the post office on your way to the clinic?
records.zomi: Clinic na pai lam ah hih laite post office ah na puak sak ding hiam?

records.english: Did the electricity company send someone to fix the power line yet?
records.zomi: Meivak company in meivak khau bawl dingin kuamah a sawl khin hiam?

records.english: At the health center, the first hour of the day is spent preparing the rooms and checking the medicines.
records.zomi: Damna inn ah ni sung nai masa pen khante bawl leh zatuite en in kizang hi.

records.english: What time does the librarian start sorting the returned books?
records.zomi: Laibu inn kemnu in kilohsak kik laibute nai bangzah ciangin a khen kipan hiam?

records.english: The court was closed for the day after a pipe burst in the main hall.
records.zomi: Inn lian sungah tui pipe a puak khit ciangin thukhenna inn tua ni-in kikhak hi.

records.english: My friend at the passport office says the busiest day is always Monday.
records.zomi: Passport office-a ka lawm in a buai pen ni Pizing ni tawntung ahi hi, a ci hi.

records.english: When the bridge was closed, the ambulance crews had to plan new routes for the whole week.
records.zomi: Lei kikhak ciangin ambulance nasemte in kal bup adingin lampi thakte a gel kul uh hi.

records.english: I really do enjoy my job at the tourist office, because no two days are the same.
records.zomi: Khualzinte office ah ka nasep ka nuam sa taktak hi, ni khat leh khat a kibang ngei kei ahih manin.

records.english: My boss told me, "Treat every person at the counter as if they were your grandmother."
records.zomi: Ka makaipa in, “Dawhkan-a mi khempeuh na pi bangin koih in,” hong ci hi.

records.english: The library van stops in a different village each weekday, and on Fridays the driver repairs damaged books.
records.zomi: Laibu inn mawtaw ni sem ni simin khua tuam ciat ah a khawl a, Laithai ni ciangin a tuansakpa in laibu siatte a bawl kik hi.

records.english: When the water main burst at dawn, the engineers worked through lunch to get the supply back.
records.zomi: Khua vak ciangin tui pipe lian a puak ciangin engineer te in tui a om kik nadingin sun an a ne lo-in na a sem uh hi.

records.english: All of you new officers will spend your first month on patrol with an experienced partner.
records.zomi: Officer thak note khempeuh na kha masa pen-in theihna nei lawm khat tawh na kawikawi ding uh hi.

records.english: When I worked at the job center, the hardest part of the day was telling people there was nothing for them yet.
records.zomi: Nasep zonna mun ah na ka sep lai-in ni sung-a a haksa pen mite kiangah tu-in bangmah om nai lo hi, ci-a gen ahi hi.

records.english: Kids, the bus driver has a schedule to keep, so please be at the stop on time.
records.zomi: Naupangte, bus tuansakpa in a zuih ding hun a nei ahih manin hun takah khawlna ah om un.

records.english: How does the museum guide tell the same stories four times a day without getting bored?
records.zomi: Museum makaipa in ni khat-in vei li tangthu kibang a gen a, bangci-in a lungkia kei hiam?

records.english: Watch for the traffic officer at the crossing, and wait until she waves you across.
records.zomi: Lampi kantanna ah mawtaw enkaktu nu en inla, a khut a vaai dong ngak in.

records.english: Everyone, the system will be down from twelve until two, so please write down all the requests by hand.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, sun nai sawm leh nih pan nai nih dong system a sem lo ding ahih manin ngetna khempeuh khut tawh gelh un.

records.english: Our council's cleaning crew was praised after the festival, because the square was spotless by six the next morning.
records.zomi: Zingsang nai guk ciangin laizang a siang kim ahih manin pawi khit ciangin khuapi vaihawm' siangsak pawl kiphat hi.

records.english: Could you check whether the recycling center is open on public holidays?
records.zomi: Recycling mun mipi tawlngakni-in a kihong hiam na en thei ding hiam?

records.english: Public servants like nurses and drivers keep the town running while most of us are asleep.
records.zomi: Nurse leh tuansakte bang mipi nasemte in i tam zaw a ihmut laitakin khuapi a kem uh hi.

records.english: The court clerk said, "Please stand when the judge enters," and the room went quiet.
records.zomi: Thukhenna inn laigelhpa in, “Thukhenpa a lut ciangin ding un,” a ci a, khan a dai hi.

records.english: During my first shift at the call center, a woman called because her husband had collapsed, and I could hardly breathe.
records.zomi: Phone dawnna mun ah ka nasep hun masa pen-in a pasal a kia ahih manin numei khat in hong sam a, ka huih ka la zo kei dek hi.

records.english: The street lights on our road are checked every Tuesday night by a council electrician.
records.zomi: Pithai ni zan simin khuapi vaihawm electrician khat in i lampi meivakte a en hi.

records.english: My manager at the post office lets me leave early on Fridays to collect my son.
records.zomi: Post office-a ka manager in ka tapa ka lak theih nadingin Laithai ni simin hun ma-in hong paisak hi.

records.english: My uncle checks the water levels at the dam twice a day, even on holidays.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu in tawlngakni zongin ni khat-in nihvei tui khakna mun-a tui sanna a en hi.

records.english: Why do the rubbish collectors start so early?
records.zomi: Bang hangin niin la mite manlang takin a kipan uh hiam?

records.english: So that the trucks aren't stuck in the morning traffic.
records.zomi: Zingsang mawtaw tamna ah mawtaw lian te a kibet loh nadingin.

records.english: How many patients does the nurse see on a normal day at the health post?
records.zomi: Damna mun ah ni sem ni khat-in nurse in damlo bangzah a mu hiam?

records.english: About forty, more if there's a fever going around the village.
records.zomi: Sawmli bang, khua sung ah lum natna a om leh a tam zaw hi.

records.english: The community health worker visits six villages a week on her motorbike.
records.zomi: Mipi damna nasem nu in a motorbike tawh kal khat-in khua guk a veh hi.

records.english: My grandfather delivered the post on a bicycle for thirty years, rain or shine.
records.zomi: Ka pu kum sawmthum sung guah zuk zongin ni sa zongin siiksakol tawh lai a puak hi.

records.english: Every morning at eight, the road crew is told which potholes to fix first.
records.zomi: Zingsang nai giat simin lampi bawl pawl in lampi kua bang a masa-in bawl ding hiam kigen hi.

records.english: The bank changed its opening hours, and the old people who came at eight found the doors closed.
records.zomi: Bank in a kihon hun a khel a, nai giat ciangin hong pai upate in kongkhak kikhak a mu uh hi.

records.english: The town's street lights are switched off at midnight to save money, so we walk home with a torch.
records.zomi: Sum khol dingin khuapi lampi meivakte zan lai ciangin kiphel ahih manin meivak neu tawh inn ah i ciah hi.

records.english: Kids, the care home residents go to bed early, so we'll sing for them at six and then go home.
records.zomi: Naupangte, upate kemna inn-a omte hun ma-in a lum uh ahih manin nai guk ciangin la i sak sak ding a, tua khit ciangin inn ah i ciah ding hi.

records.english: My husband works nights at the water plant, so I sleep alone and he sleeps in the afternoon.
records.zomi: Ka pasal tui bawlna mun ah zanin na a sem ahih manin kei ka bek in ka ihmu a, amah nitak lam ciangin a ihmu hi.

records.english: At the flood shelter, families slept on mats in the school hall while volunteers handed out blankets.
records.zomi: Tuiciim om sakna mun ah innkuante sang inn lian ah phah tungah a ihmu uh a, thalawp nasemte in puanzial a hawm uh hi.

records.english: My son fell asleep on my lap during the long meeting at the town hall.
records.zomi: Khuapi office-a kikhopna sau laitakin ka tapa ka khuk tungah a ihmu hi.

records.english: My daughter was so excited about the library sleepover that she packed her bag a week early.
records.zomi: Laibu inn zan giakna ading ka tanu a lungdam lua ahih manin kal khat ma-in a ip a thun hi.

records.english: Would the night bus stop near the hospital if I asked the driver?
records.zomi: Tuansakpa ka ngen leh zan bus zato kiang ah a khawl ding hiam?

records.english: Visitors have to leave the ward by eight so that the patients can rest.
records.zomi: Damlote a tawlngak theih nadingun hong vehte nai giat ciangin ward a paisan kul uh hi.

records.english: The library holds a pajama story night every Friday, and the children bring their own pillows.
records.zomi: Laithai ni simin laibu inn in ihmut puan tawh tangthu zan a bawl a, naupangte in amau lukhum a tawi uh hi.

records.english: The radio station plays quiet music after midnight for the night-shift workers.
records.zomi: Radio station in zan lai khit ciangin zan nasemte adingin la dai a sak hi.

records.english: Why are the lights in the station waiting room kept on all night?
records.zomi: Bang hangin station ngakna khan meivakte zan bup kihon den hiam?

records.english: Our village's old night watchman used to walk the streets with a lamp, calling out that all was well.
records.zomi: I khua-a zan kemtu lui in meivak tawh lampite a kawikawi a, khempeuh a hoih hi, ci-in a sam zel hi.

records.english: Where do the volunteers sleep when they stay overnight at the shelter?
records.zomi: Om sakna mun ah zan bup a om ciangun thalawp nasemte koi ah a ihmu uh hiam?

records.english: On a folding bed in the office, if they get to sleep at all.
records.zomi: Office sung-a lupna khiat theih tungah, a ihmut theih uh leh.

records.english: I do want to stay with my father tonight, even if I have to sleep in the chair.
records.zomi: Tutna tungah ka ihmut kul zongin tu zanin ka pa kiang ah om ka deih taktak hi.

records.english: When the alarm went off at the fire station at two, the crew was in the truck within ninety seconds.
records.zomi: Mei mitsakna inn ah nai nih ciangin alarm a ging ciangin a pawl second sawmkua sungin mawtaw sungah a om uh hi.

records.english: The town's festival fireworks went on so late that half the babies on our street were awake at midnight.
records.zomi: Khuapi pawi meiphual zan lai dong a sau ahih manin i lampi-a naungek a kim zan lai-in a khanglo uh hi.

records.english: When does the night shelter open its doors?
records.zomi: Zan om sakna mun bang hun ciangin a kongkhak a hong hiam?

records.english: Of all the people who work at night, the bakers are the only ones whose work you can smell.
records.zomi: Zan nasem mi khempeuh lak ah a nasep uh gim a nam thei pen moh bawlte bek ahi uh hi.

records.english: Will you say a prayer tonight for the people who work through the night?
records.zomi: Tu zanin zan bup na sem mite adingin thu na ngen ding hiam?

records.english: Not a single child at the shelter went to bed without a toothbrush and a story, thanks to the volunteers.
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte hang-in om sakna mun ah ha nuaina leh tangthu om lo-in naupang khat zong a lum kei hi.

records.english: All of you staying at the shelter tonight, please leave your shoes by the door and your bags under your beds.
records.zomi: Tu zanin om sakna mun ah om note khempeuh, na khedap uh kongkhak kiang ah nusia unla na ip uh na lupna nuai ah koih un.

records.english: My grandmother sleeps better since the community nurse gave her a bell to ring at night.
records.zomi: Mipi nurse in zanin a khawn ding khawng neu khat a piak pan ka pi a ihmu hoih zaw hi.

records.english: A baby was born at the health post at midnight, and the nurse slept on the bench afterward.
records.zomi: Damna mun ah zan lai-in naungek khat a suak a, a nung ciangin nurse tutna sau tungah a ihmu hi.

records.english: After the late council meeting, the last bus had gone, so the mayor drove three of us home.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm kikhopna zan nun khit ciangin bus nunung a pai khin ahih manin khuapi ukpa in kote thum inn dong hong paipih hi.

records.english: Let's leave the porch light on so the night nurse can find our house.
records.zomi: Zan nurse in i inn a muh theih nadingin inn mai meivak hon den ni.

records.english: Before going to bed, the shopkeepers on our street pull down their metal shutters and check each other's locks.
records.zomi: Lup ma-in i lampi-a dawl neite in a dawl kongkhak sik a khak uh a, khat leh khat' khakna a en uh hi.

records.english: At the night shelter, the lights go out at ten, and a volunteer stays awake until morning.
records.zomi: Zan om sakna mun ah nai sawm ciangin meivak kiphel a, thalawp nasem khat zingsang dong a khanglo hi.

records.english: I really do sleep better knowing the neighborhood watch walks past our house.
records.zomi: Inn veng kemna pawl i inn kiang a kantan uh ka theih manin ka ihmu hoih zaw taktak hi.

records.english: My little brother falls asleep to the sound of the trains passing the station.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal station kiang-a meileng kantan ging za-in a ihmu hi.

records.english: Could the hospital move my mother to a quieter room, so that she can sleep?
records.zomi: Ka nu a ihmut theih nadingin zato in khan dai zaw khat ah a pemsak thei ding hiam?

records.english: The church bell no longer rings at night, because people in the new flats complained.
records.zomi: Inn thak-a mite in a phunsan uh ahih manin pawlpi khawng zanin a ging nawn kei hi.

records.english: Had the night nurse not checked on him at four, my father might not have woken up.
records.zomi: Nai li ciangin zan nurse in a en kei leh ka pa a khanglo kik kei kha ding hi.

records.english: My mother lies awake whenever my brother is on night patrol.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal zan kawikawi ah a om simin ka nu a khanglo-in a lum hi.

records.english: The last ferry left the island at nine, and the doctor had to spend the night at the clinic.
records.zomi: Tembaw nunung nai kua ciangin tuikulh a paisan a, siavuan in clinic ah zan bup a om kul hi.

records.english: Do the firefighters on the night shift really sleep in their clothes?
records.zomi: Zan nasep mei mitsakte a puan tawh a ihmu taktak uh hiam?

records.english: The power was cut across the whole town at eleven, so we went to bed by candlelight.
records.zomi: Nai sawm leh khat ciangin khuapi bup meivak kitan ahih manin khawimeivaak tawh i lum hi.

records.english: Shall we ask the shelter if they need someone to stay overnight on Saturday?
records.zomi: Kiginni ciangin zan bup om ding mi a kisam hiam om sakna mun i dong ding hiam?

records.english: The hospital gave my mother earplugs and an eye mask so that she could sleep on the busy ward.
records.zomi: Ward buai ah a ihmut theih nadingin zato in ka nu bil khakna leh mit khuhna a pia hi.

records.english: Using a flashlight under the blanket, the boys at the scout camp read comics until midnight.
records.zomi: Scout camp ah pasal naupangte in puanzial nuai ah meivak neu zang-in zan lai dong lim laibu a sim uh hi.

records.english: How do the nurses on the night ward stay awake?
records.zomi: Zan ward-a nurse te bangci-in a khanglo den uh hiam?

records.english: Lots of tea, and they walk around to check on every patient each hour.
records.zomi: Tea tampi, nai khat ciat damlo khempeuh en dingin a kawikawi uh hi.

records.english: Everyone, lights out in five minutes — the bus to the city leaves at six.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, minit nga khit ciangin meivak phel ding hi — khuapi pai bus nai guk ciangin a pai ding hi.

records.english: Is there a pharmacy open at night if the baby's fever goes up?
records.zomi: Naungek' lum a khan leh zanin a kihong zatui dawl a om hiam?

records.english: The one next to the hospital stays open until midnight, and after that you can call the night doctor.
records.zomi: Zato kiang-a dawl zan lai dong a kihong a, tua khit ciangin zan siavuan na sam thei hi.

records.english: When the storm knocked down the power line, the whole village went to bed early.
records.zomi: Huihpi in meivak khau a puksak ciangin khua bup hun ma-in a lum uh hi.

records.english: Lying awake on the night before the hearing, I went over what I'd say to the judge.
records.zomi: Thukhenna ni zan ma-in ka khanglo-in ka lum laitakin thukhenpa kiangah ka gen ding thu ka ngaihsun kik hi.

records.english: Why are the police cars always out on the main road at night?
records.zomi: Bang hangin zanin lampi lian tungah police mawtaw te a om tawntung hiam?

records.english: Children shouldn't be out on the street after dark without an adult, our community leaders agreed.
records.zomi: Naupangte khua a mial khit ciangin upa om lo-in lampi tungah a om kei ding uh hi, ci-in i mipi makaite a kilem uh hi.

records.english: There might be a bed for you at the shelter if you get there before eight.
records.zomi: Nai giat ma-in na tun leh om sakna mun ah nang adingin lupna om kha ding hi.

records.english: The loud music from the bar kept the whole street awake until the police came.
records.zomi: Zu dawl pan la ging sang in police a tun dong lampi bup a ihmusak kei hi.

records.english: The night doctor came to the house at three and stayed until Grandpa was breathing easily.
records.zomi: Zan siavuan nai thum ciangin inn ah hong pai a, Pu a huih a baih dong a om hi.

records.english: Go to bed — the clinic opens early, and the queue will be long.
records.zomi: Lum in — clinic hun ma-in a kihon ding a, kizomna a sau ding hi.

records.english: Is it all right if I leave my phone on tonight, in case the hospital calls?
records.zomi: Zato in hong sam kha leh ci-in tu zanin ka phone hon den leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: Thank you for staying up with us at the shelter — the children slept better knowing you were there.
records.zomi: Om sakna mun ah i tawh na khanglo manin ka lungdam hi — na om na theih manun naupangte a ihmu hoih zaw uh hi.

records.english: The care home staff read to the residents who can't sleep, and some of them fall asleep holding hands.
records.zomi: Upate kemna inn nasemte in a ihmu thei lo upate adingin a sim uh a, khenkhatte khut kilen-in a ihmu uh hi.

records.english: Did the noise from the road works keep you awake last night?
records.zomi: Zanin lampi bawlna ging in hong khanglosak hiam?

records.english: Could you call the council about the street light that keeps flashing into the children's bedroom?
records.zomi: Naupangte' lupna khan ah a tang den lampi meivak thu khuapi vaihawm na sam thei ding hiam?

records.english: So generous was the hotel's donation that every bed at the shelter now has a new mattress.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk' piakna a tam lua ahih manin om sakna mun-a lupna khempeuh tu-in mattress thak a nei hi.

records.english: Can someone from the night patrol check on Mrs. Lun, since she's alone this week?
records.zomi: Hih kal amah bek a om ahih manin zan kawikawi pawl pan kuamah in Mrs. Lun a en thei ding hiam?

records.english: Why are the prices at the cooperative lower than at the supermarket?
records.zomi: Bang hangin lo nei pawl dawl ah supermarket sangin man a niam zaw hiam?

records.english: Because the members buy in bulk together and don't need to make a big profit.
records.zomi: A mite in khawm-in a tam takin a lei uh a, phatna lian a kisam kei ahih manin.

records.english: We might get a discount at the cooperative if we become members.
records.zomi: I kihel leh pawl dawl ah man niamsak i ngah kha ding hi.

records.english: Shall we buy the vegetables from the school garden instead of the supermarket?
records.zomi: Supermarket sangin sang huan pan anteh i lei ding hiam?

records.english: My son helps at the cooperative shop on Saturdays, stacking shelves and packing bags.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in Kiginni simin pawl dawl ah a huh a, dawh tungah van a koih a, ip a thun hi.

records.english: The council's new market opened on Friday, and the old women from the hills sold out of eggs by nine.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm' zuakna mun thak Laithai ni-in kihong a, mual pan numei upate nai kua ciangin aktui a zuak bei uh hi.

records.english: Prices at the market went up after the storm, and the council asked sellers to be fair.
records.zomi: Huihpi khit ciangin zuakna mun-a van man a khang a, khuapi vaihawm in zuakte a dik dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: The church collects groceries every Sunday for families who have just arrived in town.
records.zomi: Nipini simin pawlpi in khuapi ah a tung thak innkuante adingin an a kaikhawm hi.

records.english: All of you who signed up for the vegetable boxes can collect them at the church hall after four.
records.zomi: Anteh bawm adingin min na gelh note khempeuh nai li khit ciangin pawlpi inn lian ah na la thei uh hi.

records.english: Where can I buy fresh fish in this town?
records.zomi: Hih khuapi ah nga thak koi ah ka lei thei ding hiam?

records.english: At the harbor, early in the morning, straight from the boats.
records.zomi: Tembaw tulpi ah, zingsang manlang takin, tembaw te pan pahtakin.

records.english: Having a shop in the village again has made life much easier for the people without cars.
records.zomi: Khua ah dawl khat a om kik manin mawtaw nei lo mite' nuntakna a baih zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: How can I volunteer at the food bank on weekends?
records.zomi: Kal tawp-in an kaikhawmna mun ah bangci-in thalawp takin ka sem thei ding hiam?

records.english: Let's take Grandma to the market on Thursday, when it's quieter.
records.zomi: A dai zawk Laizing ni ciangin Pi zuakna mun ah paipih ni.

records.english: The new shop has a ramp and wide aisles, so my father can go in his wheelchair.
records.zomi: Dawl thak in kah nading a ngawi leh lampi zai a nei ahih manin ka pa a leeng tutna tawh a lut thei hi.

records.english: I do want to buy from the farmers' market, but it closes before I finish work.
records.zomi: Lo neite' zuakna mun pan lei ka deih taktak hi, ahi zongin ka nasep ka zawh ma-in a kikhak hi.

records.english: The shopkeeper lets the poorest families pay at the end of the month, when they have their wages.
records.zomi: Dawl neipa in a zawng pen innkuante a kha man uh a ngah ciangin kha tawp ciangin a piak dingin a phal hi.

records.english: Is it possible to order groceries by phone and collect them later?
records.zomi: Phone tawh an sap a, a nung ciangin lak theih ding hiam?

records.english: The food bank volunteer helped my mother carry her parcel to the bus stop.
records.zomi: An kaikhawmna mun thalawp nasem in ka nu' an ip bus khawlna dong a puak huh hi.

records.english: The food bank ran out of baby milk on Tuesday, so the pastor drove to the city to buy more.
records.zomi: Pithai ni ciangin an kaikhawmna mun ah naungek nawi a bei ahih manin pastor in behlap lei dingin khuapi ah mawtaw a mawng hi.

records.english: Every month, the council's market checks that the scales are accurate and the meat is kept cold.
records.zomi: Kha simin khuapi vaihawm' zuakna mun in bukna te a dik hiam, sa a vot den hiam a en hi.

records.english: Can I pay for my neighbor's groceries and let her pay me back next week?
records.zomi: Ka inn veng' an man ka pia a, kal hong ding ciangin hong lohsak kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: When the flood cut off the road, the army flew in sacks of rice and flour.
records.zomi: Tuiciim in lampi a tan ciangin galkap te in buh leh buh-mal ip vanleng tawh a puak uh hi.

records.english: The stall run by my aunt sells the cheapest eggs in the market, but it only opens on Fridays.
records.zomi: Ka ni' dawl in zuakna mun ah aktui man neu pen a zuak a, ahi zongin Laithai ni bek-in a kihong hi.

records.english: My teenage daughter does the shopping for our elderly neighbor every Saturday.
records.zomi: Ka tanu khangno in Kiginni simin i inn veng upa adingin van a lei sak hi.

records.english: When does the mobile shop come to our village?
records.zomi: Kawikawi dawl bang ciangin i khua ah a hong hiam?

records.english: Every Wednesday morning, and it parks next to the church.
records.zomi: Nilai ni zingsang simin, pawlpi kiang ah a khawl hi.

records.english: Let's check what the shelter needs before we go to the cooperative.
records.zomi: Pawl dawl i pai ma-in om sakna mun in bang a kisam hiam en ni.

records.english: The market inspector checked the scales of every seller on Monday morning.
records.zomi: Pizing ni zingsangin zuakna mun enkaktu in zuakpa khempeuh' bukna a en hi.

records.english: My grandmother was so pleased with the volunteer who did her shopping that she knitted him a scarf.
records.zomi: A van lei sak thalawp nasem tungah ka pi a lungdam lua ahih manin ngawng puan khat a khui sak hi.

records.english: Is the community garden selling vegetables this Saturday?
records.zomi: Hih Kiginni ciangin mipi huan in anteh a zuak ding hiam?

records.english: Could the cooperative order flour in larger sacks for the bakers?
records.zomi: Moh bawlte adingin pawl dawl in buh-mal ip lian zaw a sap thei ding hiam?

records.english: When the bridge was closed, the supermarket sent its delivery van to the village by the long road.
records.zomi: Lei a kikhak ciangin supermarket in lampi sau zang-in a van puak mawtaw khua ah a sawl hi.

records.english: There might not be any bread left at the shop if we wait until after church.
records.zomi: Pawlpi khit dong i ngak leh dawl ah moh a taang kei kha ding hi.

records.english: Have you tried the new shop that the youth group runs?
records.zomi: Khangno pawl' kem dawl thak na veh ngei hiam?

records.english: Kids, each of you can choose one thing to put in the food bank box.
records.zomi: Naupangte, an kaikhawmna bawm sungah koih dingin na khat ciat teel thei uh hi.

records.english: Do you know if the farmers' market takes cards?
records.zomi: Lo neite' zuakna mun in card a sang hiam na thei hiam?

records.english: Almost all the vegetables at the village market are grown within ten kilometers of it.
records.zomi: Khua zuakna mun-a anteh tam zaw pen tua pan kilomita sawm sung ah a kisuan ahi hi.

records.english: Buy your vegetables from the women at the corner stall; they grow everything themselves.
records.zomi: Ki-ngawi dawl-a numeite kiang pan na anteh lei in; khempeuh amau mah in a suan uh hi.

records.english: Did the mobile shop bring the medicine you ordered for Grandpa?
records.zomi: Kawikawi dawl in Pu adingin na sap zatui a tawi hiam?

records.english: What should I bring to the food bank?
records.zomi: An kaikhawmna mun ah bang ka tawi ding hiam?

records.english: Rice, oil, tinned food, and anything else that won't go bad.
records.zomi: Buh, sathau, thekbawm an leh a sia lo dang khempeuh.

records.english: Everyone, the food bank parcels are ready, so please bring your card to the table.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, an kaikhawmna ip te kiman khin ahih manin na card uh dawhkan ah tawi un.

records.english: The mobile shop driver knows what every family needs and sometimes brings it before they ask.
records.zomi: Kawikawi dawl tuansakpa in innkuan khempeuh' kisapna a thei a, hun khenkhatah a ngen ma-un a tawi hi.

records.english: Can you put my name down for the volunteer shopping service?
records.zomi: Thalawp van leisakna ah ka min na gelh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Thanks to the new bus route, people from the hill villages can get to the market and back in a morning.
records.zomi: Bus lampi thak hang-in mual khua-a mite zingsang khat sungin zuakna mun a pai thei uh a, a ciah kik thei uh hi.

records.english: So many people came to the opening of the new market that the stall owners ran out of change.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun thak honna ah mi a tam lua uh ahih manin dawl neite in sum kik a bei uh hi.

records.english: Could someone carry Mrs. Lun's shopping up to her flat?
records.zomi: Mrs. Lun' van a inn dong kuamah in a puak sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: The cooperative's prices were cut after members voted to share the savings.
records.zomi: Mite in kholna a kihawm dingin vote a piak uh khit ciangin pawl dawl van man kiniamsak hi.

records.english: Do they sell school uniforms at the cooperative too?
records.zomi: Pawl dawl ah sang puan zong a zuak uh hiam?
