records.english: Who delivers groceries to the people who can't leave their homes?
records.zomi: Inn a paisan thei lo mite kiangah kua in an a puak hiam?

records.english: No sooner had the market opened than the queue for the cheap rice reached the street.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun a kihon pah-in buh man neu kizomna lampi dong a tung hi.

records.english: Bring your own bags, because the market stopped giving out plastic ones last month.
records.zomi: Kha bei-in zuakna mun in plastic ip a piak nawn loh manin nangma' ip tawi in.

records.english: Would you take these spare loaves to the shelter after the meeting?
records.zomi: Kikhopna khit ciangin hih moh behlapte om sakna mun ah na puak ding hiam?

records.english: Can we leave the shopping at the community center for Mr. Hau to collect?
records.zomi: Mr. Hau a lak nadingin mipi inn ah van i nusia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Why don't we ask the cooperative to stock gluten-free flour for the children who need it?
records.zomi: A kisam naupangte adingin gluten om lo buh-mal pawl dawl in a koih ding i ngen kei hiam?

records.english: Buying locally keeps our farmers in work and our market alive.
records.zomi: Khua sung pan lei in i lo neite' nasep a omsak a, i zuakna mun a nungsak hi.

records.english: The shop at the end of our street closed, and now the old people have to take a bus for their bread.
records.zomi: I lampi tawp-a dawl kikhak a, tu-in upate in moh lei dingin bus a tuan kul uh hi.

records.english: We buy most of our groceries at the village cooperative, because the profits stay in the village.
records.zomi: Phatna khua sungah a om den ahih manin i an tam zaw khua pawl dawl pan i lei hi.

records.english: Using the card reader on the mobile shop van, people in the hills can pay without cash.
records.zomi: Kawikawi dawl van tung-a card machine zang-in mual-a mite in sum taktak om lo-in a pia thei uh hi.

records.english: My neighbor asked the price of the burial plot for her husband, and the church helped her pay.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng nu in a pasal' han mun man a dong a, pawlpi in a piak nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: The bus company lowered the fares for students after a petition from the youth group.
records.zomi: Khangno pawl' ngetna lai khit ciangin bus company in sangnaupangte adingin bus man a niamsak hi.

records.english: We might be able to get the community hall for less if we book it on a weekday.
records.zomi: Ni sem ni-in i bawl leh mipi inn lian man neu zaw-in i ngah thei kha ding hi.

records.english: So high was the price of the new market stalls that many sellers stayed in the street.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun thak-a dawl man a sang lua ahih manin zuak tampi lampi tungah a om den uh hi.

records.english: Can someone tell me why the fee for the clinic went up?
records.zomi: Bang hangin clinic man a khang hiam kuamah in hong gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: My father-in-law refuses to ask the price of anything at the market until he has looked at every stall.
records.zomi: Ka sungpa in zuakna mun-a dawl khempeuh a et ma-in na khatpeuh man a dong nuam kei hi.

records.english: My grandfather asked the price of the new hearing aids, and then the health center told him they were free for pensioners.
records.zomi: Ka pu in bil zatna thakte man a dong a, tua khit ciangin damna inn in pension ngahte adingin man om lo hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: No one at the council could tell me how much the building permit would cost.
records.zomi: Inn lamna phalna lai man bangzah ding hiam khuapi vaihawm-a kuamah in hong gen thei kei uh hi.

records.english: The price of everything at the old market was a little lower than in town, which is why we still go.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun lui-a van khempeuh' man khuapi sangin tawmno a niam zaw ahih manin i pai lai hi.

records.english: How much is it to rent the community hall for a wedding?
records.zomi: Kiteenna adingin mipi inn lian hal bangzah a man hiam?

records.english: It depends on the day, but members of the parish pay half price.
records.zomi: Ni tawh kizui hi, ahi zongin pawlpi mite in a kim a pia uh hi.

records.english: Is there a fee to see the doctor at the health center?
records.zomi: Damna inn ah siavuan muh man a om hiam?

records.english: Asking about prices at a government office can take all morning when the queue is long.
records.zomi: Kizomna a sau ciangin kumpi office ah man dong in zingsang bup a la thei hi.

records.english: Students, ask at the library desk how much it costs to print your project in color.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, na project lim tang tawh suaksak man bangzah hiam laibu inn dawhkan ah dong un.

records.english: Library membership is free for children, but adults pay a small amount each year.
records.zomi: Naupangte adingin laibu inn kihelna man om lo a, upate in kum simin tawmno a pia uh hi.

records.english: Using the price list on the clinic wall, I worked out how much the family's checkups would cost.
records.zomi: Clinic bang tung-a man list zang-in innkuan kienna man bangzah ding hiam ka tuat hi.

records.english: Could you ask the clinic how much the eye test costs for my mother?
records.zomi: Ka nu adingin mit sitna man bangzah hiam clinic kiangah na dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: How much does it cost to put a notice in the community newspaper?
records.zomi: Mipi thuthak lai ah thu kizasak khat koih man bangzah hiam?

records.english: How much does it cost to replace a lost identity card?
records.zomi: ID card mangthang khat thak bawl man bangzah hiam?

records.english: Ten dollars, and you'll need a photo and a letter from the police.
records.zomi: Dollar sawm, lim khat leh police pan lai khat na kisam ding hi.

records.english: Would you ask the electrician from the council what he charges for fixing a meter?
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm pan electrician kiangah tehna bawl man bangzah a ngen hiam na dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: We asked the pastor what a church wedding would cost, and he laughed and said, "Just a cake for the choir."
records.zomi: Pawlpi kiteenna man bangzah ding hiam pastor kiangah i dong a, a nui a, “La sa pawl adingin cake khat bek,” a ci hi.

records.english: The doctor asked my father what he could pay, and then charged him only half.
records.zomi: Siavuan in ka pa bangzah a pia thei hiam a dong a, tua khit ciangin a kim bek a ngen hi.

records.english: When the price of the school bus pass doubled, the parents went to the council meeting together.
records.zomi: Sang bus pass man a nih in a khan ciangin nu leh pate khawm-in khuapi vaihawm kikhopna ah a pai uh hi.

records.english: After the clinic printed its prices on the wall, patients stopped worrying about surprise bills.
records.zomi: Clinic in a man bang tungah a suaksak khit ciangin damlote in man lamdang a lungkham nawn kei uh hi.

records.english: Is there a charge for using the computers at the library?
records.zomi: Laibu inn-a computer zat man a om hiam?

records.english: Everyone over sixty-five can ride the town buses for free, so Grandma never asks the fare.
records.zomi: Kum sawmguk leh nga val mi khempeuh khuapi bus a man om lo-in a tuang thei uh ahih manin Pi in bus man a dong ngei kei hi.

records.english: Is the entry fee for the festival paid at the gate?
records.zomi: Pawi lutna man kongpi ah kipia hiam?

records.english: All of you who want to book the football field should check the prices on the notice board first.
records.zomi: Football mun bawl nuam note khempeuh in thu kizasakna bang tungah a man na en masa ding uh hi.

records.english: When my daughter asked the price of the dance classes, the teacher offered her a place for free if she helped with the little ones.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in lam kisinna man a dot ciangin saya in naupang neute a huh leh a man om lo-in mun khat a pia hi.

records.english: Let's call the community center and ask what the pottery class costs.
records.zomi: Mipi inn sam inla bel bawlna kilasi man bangzah hiam dong ni.

records.english: What does a passport cost these days?
records.zomi: Tu hun-in passport khat bangzah a man hiam?

records.english: More than it used to, but the price is on the government's website.
records.zomi: A ma-a sangin a tam zaw hi, ahi zongin a man kumpi' website tungah a om hi.

records.english: Does the council charge anything to collect an old fridge?
records.zomi: Khal bawm lui khat lak dingin khuapi vaihawm in man a ngen hiam?

records.english: Do you know how much a marriage license costs at the town hall?
records.zomi: Khuapi office ah kiteenna phalna lai bangzah a man hiam na thei hiam?

records.english: When I asked the vet at the council clinic how much the dog's vaccinations would cost, she said they were free this month.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm ganhing clinic-a ganhing siavuan kiangah ui' vaccine man ka dot ciangin tu kha sungin man om lo hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Is it cheaper to pay the water bill every month or once a year?
records.zomi: Tui man kha simin piak a man neu zaw hiam, kum khat-in vei khat hiam?

records.english: Once a year, because the council gives a small discount.
records.zomi: Kum khat-in vei khat, khuapi vaihawm in man tawmno a niamsak ahih manin.

records.english: I do want to join the swimming classes at the public pool, but I can only go after six.
records.zomi: Mipi tuidaipi-a tui kidiah kilasi ah ka kihel nuam taktak hi, ahi zongin nai guk khit ciangin bek ka pai thei hi.

records.english: Do children pay full price at the town's cinema?
records.zomi: Khuapi cinema ah naupangte in a man kim a pia uh hiam?

records.english: The price of the evening classes at the community center went up, and fewer people signed up.
records.zomi: Mipi inn-a nitak kilasi man a khang a, mi tawm zaw in a min a gelh uh hi.

records.english: The pharmacist checked the price of each medicine on her computer before I paid.
records.zomi: Ka piak ma-in zatui zuakpa in a computer tungah zatui khat ciat' man a en hi.

records.english: Could you check the price of the ferry to the island clinic for me?
records.zomi: Tuikulh clinic pai tembaw man hong en sak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: We asked the council how much it would cost to connect our house to the water supply.
records.zomi: I inn tui tawh kizopsak man bangzah ding hiam khuapi vaihawm kiangah i dong hi.

records.english: Do they charge for parking at the hospital?
records.zomi: Zato ah mawtaw koih man a ngen uh hiam?

records.english: Kids, the museum is free on Sundays, so we're going this weekend.
records.zomi: Naupangte, Nipini ciangin museum man om lo ahih manin hih kal tawp-in i pai ding hi.

records.english: Can I ask what the fee is for a home visit from the nurse?
records.zomi: Nurse' inn vehna man bangzah hiam ka dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: Fees for public services should be easy to find, our mayor promised.
records.zomi: Mipi nasepna mante muh a baih ding hi, ci-in i khuapi ukpa in a kiciam hi.

records.english: The council published the new prices for rubbish collection in the local newspaper.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in niin lakna man thakte khua sung thuthak lai ah a suaksak hi.

records.english: Is the night bus more expensive after midnight?
records.zomi: Zan lai khit ciangin zan bus man a sang zaw hiam?

records.english: There may be a cheaper option if you apply through the social worker.
records.zomi: Mipi huhna nasempa tungtawn-in na ngen leh a man neu zaw lampi om kha ding hi.

records.english: Could you find out how much a copy of my birth certificate costs?
records.zomi: Ka suahna lai-ciam kopi khat bangzah a man hiam na kan thei ding hiam?

records.english: My son found the price of the bus pass on the council's app in less than a minute.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in khuapi vaihawm app tungah minit khat sungin bus pass man a mu hi.

records.english: The town's new swimming pool is so cheap that the children go every afternoon.
records.zomi: Khuapi tuidaipi thak a man neu lua ahih manin naupangte nitak simin a pai uh hi.

records.english: Is the fee for the swimming pool the same on weekends?
records.zomi: Kal tawp-in tuidaipi man a kibang hiam?

records.english: The prices at the cooperative shop are written on a blackboard and changed every Monday.
records.zomi: Pawl dawl-a van man suang vom tungah kigelh a, Pizing ni simin kikhel hi.

records.english: My grandmother paid for her neighbor's library card without saying a word to anyone.
records.zomi: Ka pi in kuamah kiangah bangmah gen lo-in a inn veng' laibu inn card man a pia hi.

records.english: The church asked the families what they could afford, so that no one would be left out of the trip.
records.zomi: Kuamah kinusia lo nadingin pawlpi in innkuante bangzah a pia thei uh hiam a dong hi.

records.english: What would it cost to repair the church roof, and who would pay for it?
records.zomi: Pawlpi inn tung bawl kik bangzah a man ding a, kua in a pia ding hiam?

records.english: If the price is too high, the food bank might be able to help you.
records.zomi: A man a sang lua leh an kaikhawmna mun in hong huh thei kha ding hi.

records.english: Everyone, the treasurer is collecting this month's savings group money at the end of the meeting.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, kikhopna tawp ciangin sum kemmi in tu kha sum kholna pawl sum a kaikhawm ding hi.

records.english: Do I pay the nurse or the receptionist?
records.zomi: Nurse ka pia ding hiam, reception nu ka pia ding hiam?

records.english: The receipts from the festival were kept in a shoebox, and the treasurer spent a whole evening sorting them.
records.zomi: Pawi pan receipt te khedap bawm sungah kikem a, sum kemmi in nitak khat bup a khen hi.

records.english: The post office worker counted my change slowly, so that I could check every coin.
records.zomi: Post office nasempa in dangka khempeuh ka en theih nadingin zawi takin ka sum kik a sim hi.

records.english: Our savings group lent my aunt the money to fix her shop roof, and she paid it back in six months.
records.zomi: I sum kholna pawl in ka ni' dawl inn tung bawl nadingin sum a leitawi a, kha guk sungin a lohsak kik hi.

records.english: My neighbor's pension was paid late, so I lent her money for the bus until it arrived.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng' pension a nun ahih manin a tun dong bus adingin sum ka leitawi hi.

records.english: The volunteer at the charity shop gave me too much change, so I went back the next day to return it.
records.zomi: Piakna dawl-a thalawp nasem in sum kik tam lua hong pia ahih manin a zing ni-in lohsak kik dingin ka pai kik hi.

records.english: The council made the market sellers put their prices on boards so that nobody would be overcharged.
records.zomi: Kuamah in man tam lua a piak loh nadingin khuapi vaihawm in zuakna mun zuakte a man phek tungah a koihsak hi.

records.english: The money for the new bridge was collected from every family, and the names were painted on a board.
records.zomi: Lei thak sum innkuan khempeuh pan kikaikhawm a, a min uh phek tungah kigelh hi.

records.english: Let's split the cost of the taxi to the hospital between the three of us.
records.zomi: Zato pai taxi man i thum in kihawm ni.

records.english: Did the clinic give you a receipt for the vaccination?
records.zomi: Clinic in vaccine adingin receipt hong pia hiam?

records.english: The treasurer had every payment written in a notebook and checked by two other members.
records.zomi: Sum kemmi in piakna khempeuh notebook sungah a gelh a, mi nih in a en kik uh hi.

records.english: Keep your ticket after you pay, because the inspector might ask for it.
records.zomi: Na piak khit ciangin na ticket kem in, enkaktu in a dong kha ding hi.

records.english: Would the cooperative let me pay for the seeds after the harvest?
records.zomi: Pawl dawl in buh lak khit ciangin cil man ka piak a phal ding hiam?

records.english: Could you pay the water bill at the kiosk for Grandma while you're in town?
records.zomi: Khuapi ah na om laitakin Pi adingin dawl neu ah tui man na pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Shall I pay for the ferry tickets for the whole group and collect the money later?
records.zomi: Pawl bup ading tembaw ticket man ka pia inla a nung ciangin sum ka kaikhawm ding hiam?

records.english: Who keeps the money from the school fair until it's taken to the bank?
records.zomi: Sang poai sum bank ah a kipuak dong kua in a kem hiam?

records.english: The head teacher locks it in the office safe overnight.
records.zomi: Sang makaipa in zanin office sum bawm hat sungah a khak hi.

records.english: Is it possible to pay the rent at the housing office in two parts?
records.zomi: Inn thu office ah inn man a nih in piak theih ding hiam?

records.english: My neighbor pays her rent at the housing office every Monday, on her way to the clinic.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng nu in clinic a pai lam ah Pizing ni simin inn thu office ah a inn man a pia hi.

records.english: Have you paid for the community hall yet, or shall I do it?
records.zomi: Mipi inn lian man na pia khin hiam, kei in ka pia ding hiam?

records.english: The council had new card readers put in at the library, so we no longer need cash for printing.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in laibu inn ah card machine thakte a koih sak ahih manin lai suaksak adingin sum taktak i kisam nawn kei hi.

records.english: Can I pay the clinic fee by phone, or do I need cash?
records.zomi: Clinic man phone tawh ka pia thei ding hiam, sum taktak ka kisam hiam?

records.english: Either is fine, but the phone payment takes a minute longer.
records.zomi: A nih in a hoih hi, ahi zongin phone piakna minit khat a sau zaw hi.

records.english: Every receipt from the town hall has to be kept until the end of the year.
records.zomi: Khuapi office pan receipt khempeuh kum tawp dong kikem kul hi.

records.english: Kids, put a coin each in the church collection plate when it comes past.
records.zomi: Naupangte, pawlpi sum kaikhawmna kuang a hong kantan ciangin dangka khat ciat koih un.

records.english: Once the new payment kiosk was installed at the market, the queue at the council office disappeared.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun ah sum piakna dawl neu thak kikoih khit ciangin khuapi vaihawm office-a kizomna a bei hi.

records.english: Why does the market seller always round the price down for old people?
records.zomi: Bang hangin zuakna mun zuak nu in upate adingin a man a niamsak tawntung hiam?

records.english: She says they paid enough taxes in their lives already.
records.zomi: A nuntakna sungin siah a cing khin uh hi, a ci hi.

records.english: The old man at the kiosk gave the children their change in sweets instead of coins.
records.zomi: Dawl neu-a pasal upa in naupangte' sum kik dangka sangin a khum neu tawh a pia hi.

records.english: My mother makes us count the church collection twice before it's taken to the bank.
records.zomi: Bank ah kipuak ma-in pawlpi sum kaikhawm ka nu in nihvei hong simsak hi.

records.english: The church's donation box was emptied by the treasurer and the pastor together, as always.
records.zomi: A tawntung bangin pawlpi piakna bawm sum kemmi leh pastor in khawm-in a awngsak uh hi.

records.english: The bank queue was so long that people sat on the steps outside.
records.zomi: Bank kizomna a sau lua ahih manin mite polam kaplei tungah a tu uh hi.

records.english: Our pastor reads out how much was collected each month, so that everyone knows where the money went.
records.zomi: Sum koi ah a pai hiam mi khempeuh in a theih theih nadingun i pastor in kha simin bangzah kikaikhawm hiam a sim hi.

records.english: Could you check my receipt, because I think the clinic charged me for two visits?
records.zomi: Clinic in veh vei nih man hong ngen hi, ka sa ahih manin ka receipt na en thei ding hiam?

records.english: The wrong amount was taken from my account when I paid for the water connection, and the council refunded it within a week.
records.zomi: Tui kizopna man ka piak ciangin ka account pan sum a man lo kila a, khuapi vaihawm in kal khat sungin a lohsak kik hi.

records.english: How do I pay the fine for the library book I lost?
records.zomi: Laibu inn laibu ka mansuah man bangci-in ka pia ding hiam?

records.english: At the front desk, and they'll give you a receipt so you can borrow again.
records.zomi: Mai dawhkan ah, na leitawi kik theih nadingin receipt hong pia ding uh hi.

records.english: If the machine doesn't give change, you could ask the guard to break your note.
records.zomi: Machine in sum kik a piak kei leh na laidang khen sak dingin kongpi kemtu na ngen thei hi.

records.english: Do you take mobile money at this stall?
records.zomi: Hih dawl ah mobile money na sang hiam?

records.english: I do want to pay my share for the community hall, so tell me how much I owe.
records.zomi: Mipi inn lian ah ka tan ka pia nuam taktak ahih manin bangzah ka pia ding hiam hong gen in.

records.english: The parking meter outside the clinic swallowed my coins and gave me no ticket.
records.zomi: Clinic polam mawtaw koihna machine in ka dangkate a val a, ticket hong pia kei hi.

records.english: My father-in-law always pays for the whole table at the community lunch, though nobody asks him to.
records.zomi: Kuamah in a ngen kei hangin ka sungpa in mipi sun an ah dawhkan bup man a pia tawntung hi.

records.english: My son paid for his grandmother's prescription with his own pocket money.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in a zat ding sum tawh a pi' zatui man a pia hi.

records.english: Could someone count the money from the cake sale before the volunteers go home?
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte inn a ciah ma-un cake zuakna sum kuamah in a sim thei ding hiam?

records.english: Thanks for paying my bus fare — I'll give it back tomorrow at the library.
records.zomi: Ka bus man hong piak manin ka lungdam hi — zingciang laibu inn ah kong pia kik ding hi.

records.english: If you don't have the money today, you can pay the cooperative next week.
records.zomi: Tuni-in sum na nei kei leh kal hong ding ciangin pawl dawl na pia thei hi.

records.english: The payment machine at the town hall only takes coins, so bring plenty of small change.
records.zomi: Khuapi office-a sum piakna machine in dangka bek a sang ahih manin sum neu tampi tawi in.

records.english: Please give your change to the food bank box, if you don't need it.
records.zomi: Na sum kik na kisam kei leh an kaikhawmna bawm ah pia in.

records.english: All of you selling at the fair, keep the coins in the tin and the notes in the envelope.
records.zomi: Poai ah zuak note khempeuh, dangkate thekbawm sungah koih unla, laidangte lai-ip sungah koih un.

records.english: When the bank's computers went down, the clerk wrote receipts by hand for the whole afternoon.
records.zomi: Bank computer te a sia ciangin sum la nasempa in nitak bup khut tawh receipt a gelh hi.

records.english: Is there a fee for paying at the post office instead of at the bank?
records.zomi: Bank sangin post office ah piak man behlap a om hiam?

records.english: When the bus driver had no change, a passenger paid my fare and wouldn't take the money back.
records.zomi: Bus tuansakpa in sum kik a neih kei ciangin tuang khat in ka bus man a pia a, a sum a la kik nuam kei hi.

records.english: My grandmother keeps the exact bus fare in a small purse so that she never has to wait for change.
records.zomi: Sum kik a ngak kul ngei loh nadingin ka pi in bus man kim ngiat sum ip neu khat sungah a koih hi.

records.english: My little brother returned the extra change to the bakery, and the baker gave him a free bun.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal in sum kik behlap moh bawlna inn ah a lohsak kik a, moh bawlpa in moh neu khat a man om lo-in a pia hi.

records.english: There might not be any change at the post office this early in the morning.
records.zomi: Hih bang zingsang manlang ciangin post office ah sum kik a om kei kha ding hi.

records.english: Using the ticket machine at the station, my grandfather paid for his first train journey in forty years.
records.zomi: Station-a ticket machine zang-in ka pu in kum sawmli sung a meileng khualzinna masa pen man a pia hi.

records.english: Paying in cash at the cooperative helps the old members, who don't trust cards.
records.zomi: Pawl dawl ah sum taktak tawh piak in card a muang lo pawl mi upate a huh hi.

records.english: So many people paid their taxes on the last day that the town hall stayed open until eight.
records.zomi: Ni nunung pen-in mi tampi in siah a piak uh ahih manin khuapi office nai giat dong a kihong hi.

records.english: Can you show my mother how to pay the electricity bill on her phone?
records.zomi: Ka nu in a phone tungah meivak man a piak dan na etsak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Everyone who bought the cheap blankets at the fair can return them to the stall tomorrow.
records.zomi: Poai ah puanzial man neu a lei mi khempeuh zingciang dawl ah a lohsak kik thei uh hi.

records.english: The town library lends tools as well as books, but they have to be returned clean.
records.zomi: Khuapi laibu inn in laibu bek hi lo-in nasep van zong a leitawi a, ahi zongin a siang takin kilohsak kik kul hi.

records.english: Could the cooperative order a replacement for the broken water pump part?
records.zomi: Pawl dawl in tui pump tan siat laih ding a sap thei ding hiam?

records.english: When the solar panels on the clinic roof stopped working, the company was made to replace them.
records.zomi: Clinic inn tung-a solar panel te a sem nawn kei ciangin company in a lai kul hi.

records.english: The second-hand bookshop gives you half the price back if you return a book in good condition.
records.zomi: Kizang khin laibu dawl in a hoih lai-in laibu na lohsak kik leh a man a kim hong pia kik hi.

records.english: My mother had the faulty gas cylinder taken back by the delivery man before she would let him leave.
records.zomi: Ka nu in van puakpa a paisak ma-in gas bel siat a la kiksak hi.

records.english: All of you who received faulty solar lamps, bring them to the community hall on Friday to be exchanged.
records.zomi: Solar meivak siat na ngah note khempeuh Laithai ni ciangin lai dingin mipi inn lian ah tawi un.

records.english: When the bicycle from the community repair shop broke again, the volunteers fixed it for free.
records.zomi: Mipi bawl kikna mun pan siiksakol a sia kik ciangin thalawp nasemte in a man om lo-in a bawl uh hi.

records.english: The school sent the new textbooks back to the publisher after the teachers found dozens of mistakes.
records.zomi: Sayate in khialhna tampi a muh khit uh ciangin sang in laibu thakte a suaksakpa kiangah a khak kik hi.

records.english: Is the post office open on Saturday, so I can send back the parcel?
records.zomi: Ip ka lohsak kik theih nadingin Kiginni ciangin post office a kihong hiam?

records.english: Can someone return this lost wallet to the police station?
records.zomi: Hih sum ip mangthang kuamah in police station ah a lohsak kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: When the borrowed wheelchair was returned to the health center, it was cleaned and given to the next patient the same day.
records.zomi: Leitawi leeng tutna damna inn ah kilohsak kik ciangin kisiangsak a, tua ni mahmah-in damlo zom khat kipia hi.

records.english: My parcel to send back the shoes was weighed at the post office, and the clerk printed the return label.
records.zomi: Khedapte lohsak kikna ka ip post office ah kibuk a, nasempa in lohsak kikna label a suaksak hi.

records.english: My son took the faulty kettle back to the shop for his grandmother, since she can't walk that far.
records.zomi: Ka pi in tua zah gamla a kaai thei kei ahih manin ka tapa in tui-ukbel siat dawl ah a lohsak kik sak hi.

records.english: Returning things to the right place is part of being a good neighbor.
records.zomi: Vante a man mun ah lohsak kik pen inn veng hoih hihna tan khat ahi hi.

records.english: Can I return a coat to the charity shop if it doesn't fit?
records.zomi: A kilawm kei leh coat khat piakna dawl ah ka lohsak kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: You can swap it for something else, but they don't give money back.
records.zomi: Na dang khat tawh na lai thei hi, ahi zongin sum a pia kik kei uh hi.

records.english: Who do I talk to at the council if the new bin they delivered is broken?
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm' hong puak niin bawm thak a sia leh kua tawh ka kiho ding hiam?

records.english: Call the waste office, and they'll swap it on the next collection day.
records.zomi: Niin office sam in, a zom lak ni ciangin a lai ding uh hi.

records.english: Shall I return the folding tables to the school, or do you still need them?
records.zomi: Dawhkan khiat theihte sang ah ka lohsak kik ding hiam, na kisam lai hiam?

records.english: Where do I take a broken umbrella that I borrowed from the hotel's lost property?
records.zomi: Zinbuuk-a van mangte pan ka leitawi khaupi kitam koi ah ka puak ding hiam?

records.english: Thanks for bringing back my baking tins — I need them for the church sale tomorrow.
records.zomi: Ka moh bawlna thekbawmte hong lohsak kik manin ka lungdam hi — zingciang pawlpi zuakna adingin ka kisam hi.

records.english: Bring back the borrowed cups after the festival, or the church will run out next year.
records.zomi: Pawi khit ciangin leitawi khuangte lohsak kik un, ahih kei leh kum hong ding ciangin pawlpi in a bei ding hi.

records.english: Is it possible to return a school uniform to the second-hand uniform shop if my son outgrows it?
records.zomi: Ka tapa a khan khit ciangin sang puan kizang khin dawl ah ka lohsak kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: If you return the library card, they'll give you back your deposit.
records.zomi: Laibu inn card na lohsak kik leh na koih sum hong pia kik ding uh hi.

records.english: The food bank sent the dented tins back, because some of them had started to leak.
records.zomi: Khenkhatte a zuh kipat manin an kaikhawmna mun in thekbawm kingawite a khak kik hi.

records.english: The library fined me for returning the book late, but they let me off when I explained I'd been in hospital.
records.zomi: Laibu nun taka ka lohsak kik manin laibu inn in dan hong tat a, ahi zongin zato ah ka om hi, ka cih ciangin hong maisak uh hi.

records.english: May I bring back the rice if it has insects in it?
records.zomi: Buh sungah lawng a om leh ka lohsak kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: There may be a problem returning the fridge, because the council's delivery team has already left.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm' puak pawl a pai khin ahih manin khal bawm lohsak kik ah buaina om kha ding hi.

records.english: Can you help my neighbor return the faulty phone, since she doesn't speak the language well?
records.zomi: Ka inn veng in pau a zang siam kei ahih manin phone siat lohsak kik dingin na huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Why won't the charity shop take back the electrical things?
records.zomi: Bang hangin piakna dawl in meivak tawh kizang vante a la kik kei hiam?

records.english: They can't test them properly, so they sell them only as they are.
records.zomi: Hoih takin a sit thei kei uh ahih manin a om bangin bek a zuak uh hi.

records.english: The farmers returned the bad seeds to the cooperative, which sent them back to the supplier.
records.zomi: Lo neite in cil sia pawl dawl ah a lohsak kik uh a, pawl dawl in a piakpa kiangah a khak kik hi.

records.english: I do want my money back, but I also want the council to check the other shops that sold the faulty heaters.
records.zomi: Ka sum ka ngah kik ka deih taktak hi, ahi zongin khuapi vaihawm in heater siat a zuak dawl dangte a en ding zong ka deih hi.

records.english: Using a tape measure, the volunteer showed us that the second-hand desk wouldn't fit through the school door.
records.zomi: Tape measure zang-in thalawp nasem in kizang khin dawhkan sang kongkhak ah a lut thei lo ding hong etsak hi.

records.english: Would you mind if I returned the extra chairs to the church on Monday?
records.zomi: Pizing ni ciangin tutna behlapte pawlpi ah ka lohsak kik leh na lungkham ding hiam?

records.english: The church returned the donated sofa because it was too big for the shelter.
records.zomi: Om sakna mun adingin a lian lua ahih manin pawlpi in piak sofa a lohsak kik hi.

records.english: A man from the electricity company came and took back the old meter.
records.zomi: Meivak company pan pasal khat hong pai a, tehna lui a la kik hi.

records.english: The pharmacist let me return the unopened medicine after the doctor changed my prescription.
records.zomi: Siavuan in ka zatui a khel khit ciangin zatui zuakpa in a kihong nai lo zatui hong lohsak kiksak hi.

records.english: Counting its sports gear at the end of the year, the youth club discovered that a dozen balls had never come back.
records.zomi: Kum tawp ciangin a kimawlna vante a sim ciangin khangno pawl in bawl sawm leh nih a ciah kik ngei kei a mu hi.

records.english: The market's complaints desk made the seller give my mother her money back for the rotten potatoes.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun phunsanna dawhkan in alu siate adingin zuakpa in ka nu' sum a lohsak kiksak hi.

records.english: Please let the volunteers check the toys before you put them back on the shelf.
records.zomi: Dawh tungah na koih kik ma-in thalawp nasemte in tawngte en sak un.

records.english: The council's new rubbish bags tore so easily that half the street returned them.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm' niin ip thakte a kek baih lua ahih manin lampi a kim in a lohsak kik uh hi.

records.english: Did you return the ladder to the tool library?
records.zomi: Nasep van leitawina mun ah kaplei na lohsak kik hiam?

records.english: My grandmother's hearing aid was sent back to the clinic because it whistled every time she moved.
records.zomi: Ka pi a kilawn simin a vut ahih manin a bil zatna clinic ah kikhak kik hi.

records.english: Kids, the toys from the toy library have to go back on Saturday, so put them all in the bag.
records.zomi: Naupangte, tawng leitawina mun pan tawngte Kiginni ciangin lohsak kik ding ahih manin ip sungah koih khempeuh un.

records.english: How do I return a parcel that was delivered to the wrong address?
records.zomi: Teenna khial ah kipuak ip bangci-in ka lohsak kik ding hiam?

records.english: Take it to the post office with the label, and they'll send it on.
records.zomi: Label tawh post office ah puak in, a man ah a khak ding uh hi.

records.english: The council had the broken street bench sent back to the company that made it.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in lampi tutna sau kitam a bawl company ah a khak kik hi.

records.english: The woman at the consumer advice center helped my father write a letter to the shop that sold him a broken radio.
records.zomi: Van leite thuhilhna mun-a numei in ka pa' radio siat a zuak dawl kiangah lai gelh dingin a huh hi.

records.english: The health workers replaced every water filter that had stopped working, so nobody had to buy a new one.
records.zomi: Damna nasemte in tui siangsakna siat khempeuh a lai uh ahih manin kuamah in a thak a lei kul kei uh hi.

records.english: The cooperative took back the cracked water jar and gave me a new one without any questions.
records.zomi: Pawl dawl in tui bel kikek a la kik a, dotna om lo-in a thak khat hong pia hi.

records.english: The cooperative's rule is that anything bought by mistake can be returned within a week.
records.zomi: Pawl dawl' thukhun pen khialh taka kilei van khatpeuh kal khat sungin kilohsak kik thei hi.

records.english: We might be able to get a refund for the bus pass if we hand it in before the end of the month.
records.zomi: Kha tawp ma-in i lohsak kik leh bus pass man i ngah kik thei kha ding hi.

records.english: You're allowed to return a borrowed tool late if you call the library first.
records.zomi: Laibu inn na sam masa leh leitawi nasep van nun takin na lohsak kik thei hi.

records.english: So many people returned the faulty lamps that the aid organization sent a team to find out why.
records.zomi: Mi tampi in meivak siatte a lohsak kik uh ahih manin huhna pawl in bang hang hiam kan dingin pawl khat a sawl hi.

records.english: Could you return these library books for me on your way to the market?
records.zomi: Zuakna mun na pai lam ah hih laibu inn laibute hong lohsak kik sak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: My neighbor returned my lawnmower with a note saying the blade needed sharpening.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng in a temte tat a kisam hi, ci-in lai khat tawh ka lopa atna hong lohsak kik hi.

records.english: Hardly had the new bus passes been issued when people started returning them because the photos were wrong.
records.zomi: Bus pass thakte kipiak pah-in a lim a khial manin mite in a lohsak kik kipan uh hi.

records.english: What happens to the things people return to the community repair café?
records.zomi: Mipi bawl kikna cafe ah mite' lohsak kik vante bang a hi uh hiam?

records.english: When the price of gas went up, the community center opened its warm room so that people could spend less on heating.
records.zomi: Gas man a khan ciangin mite in lumna ah sum tawm zaw a zat theih nadingun mipi inn in khan lum a hong hi.

records.english: Since the council started a payment plan for school uniforms, many parents don't have to borrow in August.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in sang puan man piak nading gelna a kipat sak pan nu leh pa tampi in August ah a leitawi kul nawn kei uh hi.

records.english: Where can we get advice about paying off our debts?
records.zomi: I leiba lohsak nading thuhilhna koi ah i ngah thei ding hiam?

records.english: The debt advice service at the library meets people for free every Tuesday.
records.zomi: Laibu inn-a leiba thuhilhna in Pithai ni simin mite a man om lo-in a mu hi.

records.english: Shall we ask the bank for a meeting to plan how to pay the loan back slowly?
records.zomi: Leitawi zawi taka i lohsak kik nading gel dingin bank kiangah kimuhna i ngen ding hiam?

records.english: Can we pay the water bill in monthly parts instead of all at once?
records.zomi: Tui man vei khat-in hi lo-in kha simin tawmno ciat i pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: The adviser's spreadsheet showed us that we were spending more on phone credit than on bread.
records.zomi: Thuhilhpa' spreadsheet in moh sangin phone credit ah tam zaw i zang hi, hong lak hi.

records.english: Please keep the receipts from the clinic, so that we can claim the money back.
records.zomi: Sum i ngen kik theih nadingin clinic pan receipt te kem in.

records.english: Every member of the savings group signs the book when they pay in, so that nothing is forgotten.
records.zomi: Bangmah a mangngilh loh nadingin sum kholna pawl mi khempeuh in a piak ciangun laibu sungah min a suaksak uh hi.

records.english: Our savings group lets each member borrow a small amount once a year.
records.zomi: I sum kholna pawl in a mite kum khat-in vei khat sum tawmno a leitawi thei uh hi.

records.english: The community fridge outside the church saves our family money on milk and vegetables.
records.zomi: Pawlpi polam-a mipi khal bawm in i innkuan nawi leh anteh ah sum hong khol sak hi.

records.english: The library lends tools, so we didn't have to buy a drill to put up the shelves.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in nasep van a leitawi ahih manin dawh i koih nadingin drill i lei kul kei hi.

records.english: Since joining the credit union, we've been able to save a little every month.
records.zomi: Credit union ah i kihel pan kha simin tawmno i khol thei hi.

records.english: We might get help with the heating bill if we apply before winter.
records.zomi: Khuavot ma-in i ngen leh lumna man ah huhna i ngah kha ding hi.

records.english: The budget class was so useful that my mother took my father the following week.
records.zomi: Sum zat ding gelna kilasi a phatuam lua ahih manin a zom kal-in ka nu in ka pa a paipih hi.

records.english: The free budgeting class at the community center showed us where half our money was going.
records.zomi: Mipi inn-a man om lo sum zat gelna kilasi in i sum a kim koi ah a pai hiam hong lak hi.

records.english: Is there anyone at the town hall who can explain the new water charges?
records.zomi: Khuapi office ah tui man thakte a gen siang thei kuamah a om hiam?

records.english: The cooperative bank lent my mother enough to buy a sewing machine, and she paid it back from her sales.
records.zomi: Pawl bank in ka nu puan khuina machine lei zah a leitawi a, a zuak sum tawh a lohsak kik hi.

records.english: Not only did the community minibus cut our travel costs in half, but it also got Grandma out of the house.
records.zomi: Mipi minibus in i khualzinna man a kim a tawmsak bek hi lo-in Pi zong inn pan a paikhiatsak hi.

records.english: My aunt helped my cousin open his first bank account at the post office.
records.zomi: Ka ni in ka sanggam' bank account masa pen post office ah a hon huh hi.

records.english: The church helped three families pay their rent after the factory closed.
records.zomi: Factory a kikhak khit ciangin pawlpi in innkuan thum a inn man uh a piak huh hi.

records.english: A budget that works for the whole family is worth more than any loan.
records.zomi: Innkuan bup adingin a sem thei sum zat ding gelna in leitawi khempeuh sangin a manpha zaw hi.

records.english: Planning a budget with a stranger from the advice center felt strange at first, but it changed our lives.
records.zomi: Thuhilhna mun pan mi theih lo khat tawh sum zat ding gel a kipatna ah a lamdang hi, ahi zongin i nuntakna a khel hi.

records.english: My neighbor's electricity was nearly cut off, but the advice center called the company and stopped it.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng' meivak kitan dek a, ahi zongin thuhilhna mun in company a sam a, a khaktan hi.

records.english: Using the calculator on my phone, the volunteer worked out how much we could save on electricity.
records.zomi: Ka phone tung-a calculator zang-in thalawp nasem in meivak ah bangzah i khol thei ding hiam a tuat hi.

records.english: Parents at the school started a swap shop for uniforms, so that nobody has to buy new ones every year.
records.zomi: Kuamah in kum simin a thak a lei kul loh nadingin sang-a nu leh pate in sang puan kilaihna dawl a phut uh hi.

records.english: There may be a grant from the council for families who need a new boiler.
records.zomi: Boiler thak kisam innkuante adingin khuapi vaihawm pan sum huhna om kha ding hi.

records.english: My grandmother keeps her pension in three envelopes: rent, food, and the church.
records.zomi: Ka pi in a pension lai-ip thum ah a koih hi: inn man, an leh pawlpi.

records.english: The council sent someone to check our house for ways to cut the electricity bill.
records.zomi: Meivak man tawmsak nading lampite en dingin khuapi vaihawm in i inn ah kuamah a sawl hi.

records.english: The volunteers at the advice center made a budget plan for my mother on a single sheet of paper.
records.zomi: Thuhilhna mun-a thalawp nasemte in ka nu adingin lai phek khat tungah sum zat ding gelna a bawl sak uh hi.

records.english: The money we saved by buying through the cooperative paid for our daughter's school books.
records.zomi: Pawl dawl tungtawn-a i lei manin i khol sum in i tanu' sang laibu man a pia hi.

records.english: Did the credit union approve your loan for the new roof?
records.zomi: Credit union in inn tung thak adingin na leitawi a phal hiam?

records.english: How did your family manage when the council raised the rent?
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in inn man a khangsak ciangin na innkuan bangci-in a om zo uh hiam?

records.english: We stopped eating out and joined the community garden for vegetables.
records.zomi: Polam ah an ne nawn lo-in anteh adingin mipi huan ah i kihel hi.

records.english: My grandfather pays his bills at the town hall, because he doesn't trust the internet.
records.zomi: Ka pu in internet a muan loh manin khuapi office ah a man piak ding a pia hi.

records.english: Everyone in the savings group, please bring this month's money by Friday.
records.zomi: Sum kholna pawl mi khempeuh, Laithai ni ma-in tu kha sum tawi un.

records.english: Until the adviser went through our statements with us, none of us had realized how much the bank was charging in fees.
records.zomi: Thuhilhpa in i bank laite i tawh a en ma-in bank in bangzah a ngen hiam i lak pan kuamah in i thei kei hi.

records.english: Borrowing from moneylenders isn't allowed in our savings group, because the interest is so high.
records.zomi: Kikhangsak man a sang lua ahih manin i sum kholna pawl ah sumpuk kiang pan leitawi kiphal lo hi.

records.english: No one should feel embarrassed about asking the advice center for help with money.
records.zomi: Kuamah in sum thu-ah thuhilhna mun kiangah huhna ngen dingin a zahlak kul kei hi.

records.english: Would the council let us pay the overdue tax in small parts?
records.zomi: Hun bei siah pen tawmno ciat-in khuapi vaihawm in i piak a phal ding hiam?

records.english: Who looks after the savings group's money between meetings?
records.zomi: Kikhopnate kikal ah sum kholna pawl' sum kua in a kem hiam?

records.english: Do you know if the post office will cash my pension check?
records.zomi: Post office in ka pension check sum-in a lai sak ding hiam na thei hiam?

records.english: My father had the electricity meter checked after the bill doubled for no reason.
records.zomi: Hang om lo-in man a nih in a khan khit ciangin ka pa in meivak tehna a ensak hi.

records.english: When the food bank opened on our street, my mother's grocery money started lasting until the end of the month.
records.zomi: I lampi ah an kaikhawmna mun a kihon ciangin ka nu' an lei sum kha tawp dong a cing kipan hi.

records.english: Kids, the food bank helps us this month, so we won't need to spend so much on groceries.
records.zomi: Naupangte, tu kha an kaikhawmna mun in hong huh ahih manin an lei ah sum tam lua i zang kul kei ding hi.

records.english: Could you write down the advice center's phone number for my sister?
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu adingin thuhilhna mun phone nambat na gelh sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: You can't use the savings group's money for anything except emergencies and school fees.
records.zomi: Haksatna hun leh sang man bek tua lo bangmah adingin sum kholna pawl' sum na zang thei kei hi.

records.english: If the bus pass gets cheaper next year, we could save almost twenty dollars a month.
records.zomi: Kum hong ding ciangin bus pass man a niam leh kha khat-in dollar sawmnih dek i khol thei ding hi.

records.english: The adviser made us write down everything we bought for a month.
records.zomi: Thuhilhpa in kha khat sung i lei khempeuh hong gelhsak hi.

records.english: The volunteers fixed our leaking tap for free, which cut the water bill straight away.
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte in i tui kongkhak zuh a man om lo-in a bawl uh a, tui man pahtakin a kiam hi.

records.english: The council's energy team had insulation put in our roof, and the house stays warm with less heating.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm' meivak pawl in i inn tungah lumna kemna a koih sak a, lumna tawm zaw tawh inn a lum den hi.

records.english: Is it possible to get free school meals for my children?
records.zomi: Ka tate adingin a man om lo sang an ka ngah thei ding hiam?

records.english: Ask at the school office; they'll give you a short form to fill in.
records.zomi: Sang office ah dong in; dimsak ding lai tom khat hong pia ding uh hi.

records.english: Could someone from the advice center help my neighbor read her bank letters?
records.zomi: Thuhilhna mun pan kuamah in ka inn veng' bank laite sim nadingin a huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: My little brother puts every coin he finds into the church's charity jar.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal in a muh dangka khempeuh pawlpi' piakna bel sungah a koih hi.

records.english: Let's sit down with the adviser and see whether we're getting all the help we're entitled to.
records.zomi: Thuhilhpa tawh tu ni-in i ngah ding huhna khempeuh i ngah hiam en ni.

records.english: We do want to pay back the loan, but we need a little more time.
records.zomi: Leitawi lohsak kik i deih taktak hi, ahi zongin hun tawmno behlap i kisam hi.

records.english: Can I bring my husband to the budgeting class, since he does the shopping?
records.zomi: Ka pasal in van a lei ahih manin sum zat gelna kilasi ah ka paipih thei ding hiam?

records.english: How much do people usually pay into the savings group each month?
records.zomi: Kha simin sum kholna pawl ah mite in bangzah a koih zel uh hiam?

records.english: Whatever they can, even if it's only a few coins.
records.zomi: A koih theih zah uh, dangka tawmno bek zongin.

records.english: Children are welcome at the community dance, as long as an adult comes with them.
records.zomi: Upa khat in a zuih phial leh mipi lam poai ah naupangte kidawn uh hi.

records.english: The volunteers who cleaned the river last year still meet for tea every Saturday.
records.zomi: Kum bei-in gun a siangsak thalawp nasemte Kiginni simin tea dawn dingin a kimu lai uh hi.

records.english: Two of the women who sold vegetables next to each other at the market for years only became friends when they retired.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun ah kum tampi kikiang-a anteh a zuak numei nih a khawl khit uh ciangin bek a kilawm uh hi.

records.english: Let's walk to the market together on Saturday, so that I can introduce you to the sellers.
records.zomi: Zuakte kiangah kong theisak theih nadingin Kiginni ciangin zuakna mun ah khawm in kaai ni.

records.english: Kids, ask the new girl if she wants to join your team at the park.
records.zomi: Naupangte, huan ah na pawl uh ah a kihel nuam hiam numei naupang thak dong un.

records.english: My grandmother used to deliver the post, so she has friends in every house.
records.zomi: Ka pi in lai a puak ngei ahih manin inn khempeuh ah lawm a nei hi.

records.english: Did you meet anyone nice at the community center?
records.zomi: Mipi inn ah mi hoih khat na mu hiam?

records.english: The friendships made at the shelter didn't end when the families found homes.
records.zomi: Innkuante in inn a muh uh ciangin om sakna mun-a kilawmnate a tawp kei hi.

records.english: Using the community notice board, my wife found a group of women who meet to walk in the hills.
records.zomi: Mipi thu kizasakna bang zang-in ka zi in mual ah kaai dinga kimu numei pawl khat a mu hi.

records.english: The library's book club meets in a café, and the owner gives everyone a free biscuit.
records.zomi: Laibu inn' laibu pawl cafe ah a kimu uh a, a neipa in mi khempeuh biscuit khat a man om lo-in a pia hi.

records.english: If you help at the food stall at the festival, you'll meet half the town in one evening.
records.zomi: Pawi ah an dawl na huh leh nitak khat sungin khuapi a kim na mu ding hi.

records.english: My mother met her best friend in the queue at the passport office forty years ago.
records.zomi: Ka nu in kum sawmli paisa-in passport office kizomna ah a lawm hoih pen a mu hi.

records.english: New in town and knowing no one, I was grateful when the man at the hardware shop invited me to his family's lunch.
records.zomi: Khuapi ah ka thak a, kuamah ka theih loh lai-in nasep van dawl-a pasal in a innkuan sun an ah hong sap ciangin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Phones aren't allowed at the knitting circle, so people actually talk to each other.
records.zomi: Puan khuih pawl ah phone kiphal lo ahih manin mite in taktak in a kiho uh hi.

records.english: Let's invite the new teacher to the neighborhood barbecue.
records.zomi: Inn veng sa khuk pawi ah saya thak sam ni.

records.english: How do older people in your town make new friends?
records.zomi: Na khuapi ah upate in lawm thak bangci-in a ngah uh hiam?

records.english: Mostly at the lunch club and the church, where the same faces come every week.
records.zomi: A tam zaw sun an pawl leh pawlpi ah, kal simin mai kibang hong pai na mun ah.

records.english: When the power went out across the town, neighbors who had never spoken shared candles and stories on the steps.
records.zomi: Khuapi bup ah meivak a kitan ciangin kiho ngei lo inn vengte kaplei tungah khawimeivaak leh tangthu a kihawm uh hi.

records.english: Making friends in a new town is easier if you say yes to every invitation in the first month.
records.zomi: Kha masa pen sungin samna khempeuh na san leh khuapi thak ah lawm ngah a baih zaw hi.

records.english: May I join the men's group at the community center, even though I've only lived here a month?
records.zomi: Kha khat bek ka om lai hangin mipi inn-a pasal pawl ah ka kihel thei ding hiam?

records.english: Is it all right if my daughter brings her new friend from the youth club to dinner?
records.zomi: Ka tanu in khangno pawl pan a lawm thak nitak an ah a paipih leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: When I joined the volunteer fire brigade, I didn't expect to find friends for life.
records.zomi: Thalawp mei mitsak pawl ah ka kihel ciangin nuntak sung lawm ka ngah ding ka lamen kei hi.

records.english: The coach made the new boy captain for one match so that the team would get to know him.
records.zomi: Pawl in a theih theih nadingun coach in pasal naupang thak kimawlna khat ah makaipa-in a koih hi.

records.english: Our neighbor introduced us to everyone at the street party.
records.zomi: I inn veng in lampi pawi ah mi khempeuh kiangah hong theisak hi.

records.english: Making friends takes time, so come to the group again next week.
records.zomi: Lawm ngah hun a sau ahih manin kal hong ding ciangin pawl ah hong pai kik in.

records.english: Our neighbor's son taught my son to fish, and now they're inseparable.
records.zomi: I inn veng' tapa in ka tapa nga man a hilh a, tu-in a kikhen thei kei uh hi.

records.english: Can I bring my neighbor to the walking group, since she doesn't know anyone yet?
records.zomi: Ka inn veng in kuamah a thei nai kei ahih manin kaai pawl ah ka paipih thei ding hiam?

records.english: The leader of the parents' group said, "Nobody here is a stranger after the second meeting."
records.zomi: Nu leh pate pawl makaipa in, “Kikhopna nihna khit ciangin hih ah kuamah mi theih lo om lo hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: When the flood forced us into the school hall for a week, the families there became like relatives.
records.zomi: Tuiciim in kal khat sung sang inn lian ah hong omsak ciangin tua a om innkuante beh leh phung bang a suak uh hi.

records.english: Weeding side by side for a single summer turned the community garden volunteers into my closest friends.
records.zomi: Khal khat sung kikiang-a lopa i phul manin mipi huan thalawp nasemte ka lawm kinai pen a suak uh hi.

records.english: There's a chance you'll find someone from your home village at the community festival.
records.zomi: Mipi pawi ah na khua pan mi khat na mu kha ding hi.

records.english: Nobody should be left standing alone at the youth club, so the older kids look out for newcomers.
records.zomi: Khangno pawl ah kuamah a bek-in a ding loh nadingin naupang upa zawte in a tung thakte a en uh hi.

records.english: Who runs the welcome lunch for new families at the school?
records.zomi: Sang ah innkuan thakte' muakna sun an kua in a kem hiam?

records.english: The parents' committee, and anyone who wants to bring a dish is welcome.
records.zomi: Nu leh pate' committee, an khat tawi nuam kua peuh kidawn hi.

records.english: The social worker had my lonely uncle join a gardening club, and he's been happier ever since.
records.zomi: Mipi huhna nasempa in ka pa neu kikhawmlum huan kem pawl ah a kihelsak a, tua pan a lungdam zaw hi.

records.english: The volunteer who visited my grandfather every week became the friend he talked about most.
records.zomi: Kal simin ka pu a veh thalawp nasem pen a gen tam pen lawm a suak hi.

records.english: The newcomers' welcome group at the town hall helped my mother make her first friends in the city.
records.zomi: Khuapi office-a a tung thakte muakna pawl in ka nu khuapi ah a lawm masa pente a ngah nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Good friends in a new town can be as valuable as a good job.
records.zomi: Khuapi thak ah lawm hoihte nasep hoih bangmah in a manpha thei hi.

records.english: Our pastor makes every newcomer stand up and say their name at the end of the service.
records.zomi: I pastor in pawlpi tawp ciangin a tung thak khempeuh a ding-in a min gen dingin a sawl hi.

records.english: Thank you for inviting me to the choir — it's the best thing that's happened since I moved here.
records.zomi: La sa pawl ah hong sap manin ka lungdam hi — hih ah ka pem pan a piang hoih pen ahi hi.

records.english: Do you know anyone at the sports club who could show my nephew around?
records.zomi: Kimawlna pawl ah ka tanau a etsak thei kuamah na thei hiam?

records.english: Why do so many people at the community garden end up being friends?
records.zomi: Bang hangin mipi huan-a mi tampi in a tawp-in a kilawm uh hiam?

records.english: My first real friend in the city was the woman who ran the laundry where I washed my clothes.
records.zomi: Khuapi ah ka lawm taktak masa pen ka puan sawpna mun a kem numei ahi hi.

records.english: The library volunteers took the new arrivals on a walk around town to show them the clinic, the market, and the school.
records.zomi: Laibu inn thalawp nasemte in a tung thakte clinic, zuakna mun leh sang etsak dingin khuapi sung a paipih uh hi.

records.english: How did you meet so many people so quickly after you moved here?
records.zomi: Hih ah na pem khit ciangin bangci-in mi tampi manlang takin na thei hiam?

records.english: I joined the language café at the library, and half the town seems to go there.
records.zomi: Laibu inn-a pau kisinna cafe ah ka kihel a, khuapi a kim in tua ah a pai uh bang hi.

records.english: Shall we ask the youth club to organize a football match against the new families?
records.zomi: Innkuan thakte tawh football kimawlna khat bawl dingin khangno pawl i ngen ding hiam?

records.english: You might meet other young parents if you take the baby to the library's rhyme time.
records.zomi: Laibu inn-a la neu hun ah naungek na paipih leh nu leh pa khangno dangte na mu kha ding hi.

records.english: Would you like to come to the community choir with me on Thursday?
records.zomi: Laizing ni ciangin kei tawh mipi la sa pawl ah na hong nuam hiam?

records.english: The two families met at the clinic's waiting room every month and eventually started traveling there together.
records.zomi: Innkuan nih kha simin clinic ngakna khan ah a kimu uh a, a tawp-in khawm-in a pai kipan uh hi.

records.english: My brother met his best friend while they were both waiting for the night bus after a late shift.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal in nasep zan khit ciangin zan bus a ngak laitakin a lawm hoih pen a mu hi.

records.english: Joining the neighborhood watch, my father got to know every family on the street within a year.
records.zomi: Inn veng kemna pawl ah a kihel manin ka pa in kum khat sungin lampi-a innkuan khempeuh a thei hi.

records.english: Would the community center let us start a group for people learning the local language?
records.zomi: Khua pau kisin mite adingin pawl khat i phut ding mipi inn in a phal ding hiam?

records.english: My grandfather made friends with three other retired men at the repair café, and now they meet every week.
records.zomi: Ka pu in bawl kikna cafe ah khawl pasal thum tawh a kilawm a, tu-in kal simin a kimu uh hi.

records.english: The bus driver introduced the two old ladies who rode with him every day, and now they sit together.
records.zomi: Bus tuansakpa in ni simin a tawh a tuang numei upa nih a theisak a, tu-in khawm-in a tu uh hi.

records.english: Does the library have anything for teenagers who want to make friends?
records.zomi: Laibu inn in lawm ngah nuam khangnote adingin bangmah a nei hiam?

records.english: A games club on Saturday mornings, where the players range from seven to eighty.
records.zomi: Kiginni zingsang simin kimawlna pawl, a mawlte kum sagih pan sawmgiat dong.

records.english: My aunt says she made more friends as a volunteer at the hospital than in thirty years of office work.
records.zomi: Ka ni in kum sawmthum office nasep sangin zato-a thalawp nasem-in lawm tam zaw a ngah hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Could you introduce me to someone at the cooperative who knows about bees?
records.zomi: Pawl dawl ah khuaite thu a thei kuamah hong theisak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: The refugee family was paired with a local family through the church's friendship program.
records.zomi: Gam taimang innkuan pen pawlpi' kilawmna program tungtawn-in khua sung innkuan khat tawh kizop hi.

records.english: Using the community radio, the organizers invited everyone in the valley to the blood drive.
records.zomi: Mipi radio zang-in vaihawmte in guam sung mi khempeuh sisan piakna ah a sam uh hi.

records.english: The water plant invited the whole town to its open day, and hundreds of people came to see how their water is cleaned.
records.zomi: Tui bawlna mun in a hon ni ah khuapi bup a sam a, a tui uh bangci-in kisiangsak hiam en dingin mi za tampi hong pai uh hi.

records.english: We invited a local band to play at the opening of the clinic, and they refused to take any money.
records.zomi: Clinic honna ah tum dingin khua sung la tumpawl khat i sam a, sum a la nuam kei uh hi.

records.english: Can I invite my neighbor to the women's group, even though she doesn't speak much of the local language?
records.zomi: Ka inn veng in khua pau a zang tam kei hangin numei pawl ah ka sam thei ding hiam?

records.english: My father invited the young police officer to lunch after he found my brother's lost bicycle.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal' siiksakol mangthang a muh khit ciangin ka pa in police khangno sun an ah a sam hi.

records.english: Shall we invite the people who use the food bank to the Christmas dinner too?
records.zomi: An kaikhawmna mun zangte zong Christmas nitak an ah i sam ding hiam?

records.english: I'd like to invite you all to the clinic's tenth birthday, and to thank you for your support.
records.zomi: Clinic' kum sawmna pianni ah note khempeuh kong sam nuam a, na huhna uh adingin lungdam kong ko nuam hi.

records.english: A good invitation tells people what to bring, where to go, and why their presence matters.
records.zomi: Samna hoih in mite bang a tawi ding uh, koi ah a pai ding uh leh a om uh bang hangin a thupi hiam a gen hi.

records.english: So many people answered the invitation to the town meeting that it had to be moved to the football field.
records.zomi: Khuapi kikhopna samna mi tampi in a dawng uh ahih manin football mun ah kituah kul hi.

records.english: Can you put the invitation on the community notice board for me?
records.zomi: Samna lai mipi thu kizasakna bang tungah na koih sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: The mayor's office invited residents to a free health check in the town square.
records.zomi: Khuapi ukpa' office in khua mite khuapi laizang ah a man om lo damna kiennna ah a sam hi.

records.english: Thanks for inviting me to the lunch club — I haven't laughed so much in months.
records.zomi: Sun an pawl ah hong sap manin ka lungdam hi — kha tampi sung hih bang ka nui ngei kei hi.

records.english: The organizers had posters put up in the clinic, the school, and every shop on the main road.
records.zomi: Vaihawmte in clinic, sang leh lampi lian-a dawl khempeuh ah lai lian a khai sak uh hi.

records.english: When the invitation from the governor arrived, the whole village council read it aloud together.
records.zomi: Governor pan samna lai a tun ciangin khua vaihawm bup in khawm-in aw ngaih takin a sim uh hi.

records.english: When the new bridge was opened, everyone who had helped build it was invited to walk across first.
records.zomi: Lei thak a kihon ciangin a lam huh mi khempeuh a masa-in kantan dingin kisam uh hi.

records.english: The council invited residents to suggest names for the new park, and a ten-year-old's idea won.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in huan thak adingin min gen dingin khua mite a sam a, kum sawm naupang khat' ngaihsutna a zo hi.

records.english: The volunteers were invited to a thank-you dinner after the flood clean-up.
records.zomi: Tuiciim siangsakna khit ciangin thalawp nasemte lungdam kohna nitak an ah kisam uh hi.

records.english: The pastor invited every family in the parish to a meal after the new church roof was finished.
records.zomi: Pawlpi inn tung thak a zawh khit ciangin pastor in pawlpi sung innkuan khempeuh an ah a sam hi.

records.english: Children under twelve aren't allowed at the evening concert unless they come with an adult.
records.zomi: Upa khat a zuih kei leh kum sawm leh nih nuai naupangte nitak la poai ah kiphal lo uh hi.

records.english: The invitations were delivered by the postman, who also stayed for the party.
records.zomi: Samna laite lai puakpa in a puak a, pawi ah zong a om hi.

records.english: Did the youth club send an invitation to the old people's home?
records.zomi: Khangno pawl in upate inn ah samna lai a khak hiam?

records.english: The volunteers made the invitation cards themselves and delivered them on bicycles.
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte in samna card amau mah in a bawl uh a, siiksakol tawh a puak uh hi.

records.english: The invitations to the town's hundredth birthday were printed in three languages so that every family could read them.
records.zomi: Innkuan khempeuh in a sim theih nadingun khuapi kum za na pianni samna laite pau thum tawh kisuaksak hi.

records.english: Our neighbor pushed an invitation to the street party under every door.
records.zomi: I inn veng in lampi pawi samna lai kongkhak khempeuh nuai ah a sawh hi.

records.english: How do you invite people to an event when many of them don't have phones?
records.zomi: Mi tampi in phone a neih kei ciangun poai khat ah bangci-in na sam hiam?

records.english: We put a notice on the church door and ask the bus driver to tell his passengers.
records.zomi: Pawlpi kongkhak ah thu kizasakna i koih a, bus tuansakpa in a tuangte kiangah a gen dingin i ngen hi.

records.english: Our street invited the new doctor to dinner, and every family brought a different dish.
records.zomi: I lampi in siavuan thak nitak an ah a sam a, innkuan khat ciat in an tuam ciat a tawi uh hi.

records.english: Please invite the nurses from the night shift, since they always miss the daytime events.
records.zomi: Zan nasep nurse te in sun ciang poaite a mansuah tawntung uh ahih manin sam un.

records.english: Would it be possible to invite a speaker from the debt advice service to the parents' evening?
records.zomi: Nu leh pate' nitak kikhopna ah leiba thuhilhna pan thugen khat sam theih ding hiam?

records.english: My aunt's invitation to the church's anniversary was the first letter she'd received in years.
records.zomi: Pawlpi kum ni samna lai pen kum tampi sungin ka ni' ngah lai masa pen ahi hi.

records.english: Do you think the school would invite the parents to help paint the classrooms?
records.zomi: Sang in kilasi lim khai huh dingin nu leh pate a sam ding in na ngaihsun hiam?

records.english: The library invited the town's oldest residents to tell their stories to the schoolchildren.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in khuapi-a upa pente a tangthu uh sang naupangte kiangah gen dingin a sam hi.

records.english: Kids, write invitations for the elderly residents of the care home to come and see your play.
records.zomi: Naupangte, na lawng uh hong et dingin upate kemna inn-a upa teengte adingin samna lai gelh un.

records.english: Would the mayor accept an invitation to our school's graduation?
records.zomi: I sang zawhna poai samna khuapi ukpa in a san ding hiam?

records.english: Let's not invite anyone to speak for more than five minutes at the opening.
records.zomi: Honna ah minit nga val gen dingin kuamah sam kei ni.

records.english: Shall I invite the cleaners who look after the hall, or will they feel they have to work?
records.zomi: Inn lian a kem siangsakte ka sam ding hiam, a sep kul ding uh a kisa ding uh hiam?

records.english: My grandmother was invited to cut the ribbon at the new health center, because she had delivered half the town's babies.
records.zomi: Khuapi naungek a kim a suahsak ahih manin damna inn thak-a khau at dingin ka pi kisam hi.

records.english: Let's invite the old men from the lunch club to watch the football match at the youth center.
records.zomi: Khangno inn ah football kimawlna et dingin sun an pawl-a pasal upate sam ni.

records.english: Invitations to the blessing of the new well were sent to every family who had given money for it.
records.zomi: Tuikhuk thak thupha piakna samna laite sum a piak innkuan khempeuh kiangah kikhak hi.

records.english: Do residents need an invitation to attend the council meeting?
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm kikhopna ah kihel dingin khua mite in samna a kisam uh hiam?

records.english: No, the public part of the meeting is open to everyone.
records.zomi: Kisam kei hi, kikhopna mipi tan mi khempeuh adingin kihong hi.

records.english: My sister invited the whole fire brigade to her wedding, because they had saved her house.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu' inn a hum uh ahih manin mei mitsak pawl bup a kiteenna ah a sam hi.

records.english: Could you invite the librarian to join us for the reading festival planning meeting?
records.zomi: Lai sim pawi gelna kikhopna ah kihel dingin laibu inn kemnu na sam thei ding hiam?

records.english: The library's invitation said, "Bring a book you love and tell us why."
records.zomi: Laibu inn samna lai in, “Na it laibu khat tawi inla bang hang hiam hong gen in,” a ci hi.

records.english: No politicians were invited to the opening of the school, because the parents wanted it to be about the children.
records.zomi: Nu leh pate in naupangte thu ahi ding a deih uh ahih manin sang honna ah ukna mite kuamah kisam lo uh hi.

records.english: Everyone who volunteered this year is invited to the thank-you picnic by the river.
records.zomi: Tu kum thalawp takin na sem mi khempeuh gun gei lungdam kohna picnic ah kisam uh hi.

records.english: Everyone is invited to help clean the river on Saturday — bring gloves and a friend.
records.zomi: Kiginni ciangin gun siangsak huh dingin mi khempeuh kisam uh hi — khut-ngumna leh lawm khat tawi un.

records.english: For the first time in years, the hall was full, because the chess club had invited players from three villages.
records.zomi: Chess pawl in khua thum pan mawlte a sap manin kum tampi sungin a masa pen-in inn lian a dim hi.

records.english: The headmaster said, "We'd be honored if the firefighters could visit our school fair."
records.zomi: Sang makaipa in, “Mei mitsakte in i sang poai hong veh thei leh zahtakna i sa ding hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: Every household on our street got a letter inviting them to the meeting about the new bus route.
records.zomi: I lampi-a innkuan khempeuh bus lampi thak kikhopna ah sam lai khat a ngah uh hi.

records.english: No one in our village needs an invitation to a funeral; everyone simply comes.
records.zomi: I khua ah misi vuina ah kuamah in samna a kisam kei uh hi; mi khempeuh a pai bek uh hi.

records.english: Who should we invite to open the new library?
records.zomi: Laibu inn thak hong dingin kua i sam ding hiam?

records.english: The oldest reader in town, rather than the mayor — she's been borrowing books for seventy years.
records.zomi: Khuapi ukpa sangin khuapi-a lai sim upa pen — kum sawmsagih sung laibu a leitawi khin hi.

records.english: Could you invite the health worker to speak to the mothers' group about vaccinations?
records.zomi: Naungek nu pawl kiangah vaccine thu gen dingin damna nasem na sam thei ding hiam?

records.english: Is it all right to invite the police officer to our neighborhood meeting?
records.zomi: I inn veng kikhopna ah police sam a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: My mother made sure the new refugee families were invited to the harvest festival.
records.zomi: Ka nu in gam taimang innkuan thakte buh lak pawi ah a kisam uh hiam kician takin a en hi.

records.english: Who sends out the invitations for the town's festival?
records.zomi: Khuapi pawi samna laite kua in a khak hiam?

records.english: The festival committee, though most people just hear about it at the market.
records.zomi: Pawi committee, ahi zongin mi tam zaw in zuakna mun ah a za uh hi.

records.english: Is there anyone at the town hall we should invite to the opening of the community garden?
records.zomi: Mipi huan honna ah khuapi office pan i sap ding kuamah a om hiam?

records.english: If the hall isn't big enough, we could invite people to come in two groups.
records.zomi: Inn lian a lian lua kei leh mite pawl nih in hong pai dingin i sam thei hi.

records.english: The whole street came out to thank the firefighters who had saved the bakery.
records.zomi: Moh bawlna inn a hum mei mitsakte tungah lungdam ko dingin lampi bup a pai khia uh hi.

records.english: My aunt has kept every thank-you letter she received in her thirty years as a midwife.
records.zomi: Ka ni in a kum sawmthum naungek suahsak sungin a ngah lungdam kohna lai khempeuh a kem hi.

records.english: The parents had the school gate repainted in the teacher's favorite color as a surprise thank-you.
records.zomi: Lamdang lungdam kohna-in nu leh pate in saya' lim deih pen tawh sang kongpi a khaisak uh hi.

records.english: Thanks to the library's free computer classes, my mother can now video-call her grandchildren.
records.zomi: Laibu inn' man om lo computer kilasi hang-in ka nu in tu-in a tu-te tawh video call a sem thei hi.

records.english: Thank you for fixing our street light so quickly; the children feel much safer walking home.
records.zomi: I lampi meivak manlang takin na bawl manin ka lungdam hi; naupangte inn ciah ciangin a bit zaw uh hi.

records.english: Could you help me write a thank-you note to the social worker in simple English?
records.zomi: Mipi huhna nasempa adingin English baih tawh lungdam kohna lai ka gelh nadingin hong huh thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: How can we thank the paramedics who looked after Dad?
records.zomi: Pa a kem ambulance nasemte tungah bangci-in lungdam i ko ding hiam?

records.english: A letter to the ambulance station would mean a lot, because they rarely hear how patients are doing.
records.zomi: Damlote bangci om uh hiam a za tawm uh ahih manin ambulance station ah lai khat in a thupi mahmah ding hi.

records.english: My grandmother was given a certificate for fifty years of volunteering at the church kitchen, and she framed it.
records.zomi: Ka pi in pawlpi anbuk ah kum sawmnga thalawp takin a sep manin lai-ciam khat a ngah a, bawngkhawng ah a koih hi.

records.english: How do you thank someone who refuses to accept anything?
records.zomi: Bangmah sang nuam lo mi khat tungah bangci-in lungdam na ko hiam?

records.english: The town's volunteers were given a free dinner by the restaurant owners as a way of saying thank you.
records.zomi: Lungdam kohna-in an zuakna dawl neite in khuapi thalawp nasemte a man om lo nitak an a pia uh hi.

records.english: Hearing the patients sing for them on the last day, the departing nurses could hardly hold back their tears.
records.zomi: Ni nunung pen-in damlote in amaute adingin la a sak uh a zak ciangun a paisan nurse te a mittui uh a khaktan zo kei uh hi.

records.english: My grandfather thanks the street sweeper every morning and asks about her children.
records.zomi: Ka pu in zingsang simin lampi phiat nu tungah lungdam a ko a, a tate thu a dong hi.

records.english: Waving to the rubbish truck has become my daughter's way of saying thank you every Tuesday.
records.zomi: Pithai ni simin niin mawtaw kiangah khut vaai pen ka tanu' lungdam kohna dan a suak hi.

records.english: Appreciation doesn't have to be expensive; a sincere word can mean more than a gift.
records.zomi: Lungdamna a man sang kul kei hi; kammal taktak khat in letsong sangin a thupi zaw thei hi.

records.english: The schoolchildren painted a mural on the clinic wall to thank the health workers.
records.zomi: Damna nasemte tungah lungdam ko dingin sang naupangte in clinic bang tungah lim lian khat a gelh uh hi.

records.english: Kids, let's make cards for the people at the food bank who give up their Saturdays.
records.zomi: Naupangte, a Kiginni uh a pia an kaikhawmna mun-a mite adingin card bawl ni.

records.english: No one thanked the cleaners at the town hall until a new mayor started bringing them coffee on Mondays.
records.zomi: Khuapi ukpa thak in Pizing ni simin kawfi a tawi kipat dong khuapi office-a siangsakte tungah kuamah in lungdam a ko kei uh hi.

records.english: The council's thank-you letter to the volunteers was read aloud at the church service.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm' thalawp nasemte kiangah lungdam kohna lai pawlpi ah aw ngaih takin kisim hi.

records.english: Everyone, please give a big round of applause to the women who cooked for the festival.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, pawi adingin an a huan numeite adingin lian takin khut beng un.

records.english: When the postman retired, the children on his route lined the street and cheered.
records.zomi: Lai puakpa a khawl ciangin a lampi-a naupangte lampi gei ah a kizom uh a, a sam uh hi.

records.english: Is there a way to thank the blood donors who helped my wife during her operation?
records.zomi: Ka zi' khamna laitakin a huh sisan piakte tungah lungdam kohna dan a om hiam?

records.english: The blood bank passes on letters, though it can't tell you who the donors were.
records.zomi: Sisan koihna in lai a puak sak hi, ahi zongin a piakte kua ahi uh hiam a gen thei kei hi.

records.english: The whole village was thanked in the doctor's farewell speech, one family at a time.
records.zomi: Siavuan' kikhenna thugen ah khua bup innkuan khat khit khat-in lungdam kohna a ngah uh hi.

records.english: Students, write one sentence each about why our school caretaker matters to you.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, i sang kemnu bang hangin na adingin a thupi hiam kam khau khat ciat gelh un.

records.english: The flowers on the clinic desk were left by a mother whose baby was born there last night.
records.zomi: Clinic dawhkan tung-a pakte zanin tua ah a naungek a suak nu khat in a nusia hi.

records.english: Thank the bus driver when you get off, please.
records.zomi: Na kiak ciangin bus tuansakpa tungah lungdam ko in.

records.english: My son wrote a letter to the police officer who found his bicycle, and the officer wrote back.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in a siiksakol a mu police kiangah lai a gelh a, police in a dawng kik hi.

records.english: May I say a few words of thanks to the nurses at the end of the ceremony?
records.zomi: Poai tawp ciangin nurse te tungah lungdam kohna kammal tawmno ka gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: The mayor said, "This town would not have survived the floods without its volunteers."
records.zomi: Khuapi ukpa in, “Thalawp nasemte om lo leh hih khuapi tuiciim pan a nungta zo lo ding hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: Every Christmas, my grandmother leaves a box of biscuits on the bin for the rubbish collectors.
records.zomi: Christmas simin ka pi in niin la mite adingin niin bawm tungah biscuit bawm khat a nusia hi.

records.english: A town that thanks its helpers will always have more of them.
records.zomi: A huhte tungah lungdam a ko khuapi in a huh tam zaw a nei den ding hi.

records.english: Would you mind saying thank you to the pharmacist for me, since I can't get out today?
records.zomi: Tuni-in ka pai khia thei kei ahih manin kei adingin zatui zuakpa tungah lungdam na ko sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Is it all right to give the community nurse a small gift, or isn't she allowed to accept one?
records.zomi: Mipi nurse letsong neu khat piak a hoih ding hiam, a sang thei kei hiam?
