records.english: She can't take money, but a card or some homemade food is usually fine.
records.zomi: Sum a sang thei kei a, ahi zongin card hiam inn-a kibawl an hiam a hoih zel hi.

records.english: The town's first Volunteer of the Year award was given to a fifteen-year-old who teaches old people to read.
records.zomi: Khuapi' Kum Sung Thalawp Nasem laksap masa pen upate lai sim a hilh kum sawm leh nga khat kipia hi.

records.english: The volunteer firefighters were invited to the school to be thanked by the children they had rescued.
records.zomi: Thalawp mei mitsakte a hum naupangte' lungdam kohna ngah dingin sang ah kisam uh hi.

records.english: The bus company was flooded with thank-you letters after its driver stopped to help an injured cyclist.
records.zomi: A tuansakpa in siiksakol tuang liam khat huh dingin a khawl khit ciangin bus company in lungdam kohna lai tampi a ngah hi.

records.english: Shall we ask the council to name the new park after the volunteers who planted it?
records.zomi: Huan thak a suan thalawp nasemte' min koih dingin khuapi vaihawm i ngen ding hiam?

records.english: The council had a plaque put up at the clinic to thank the doctor who worked there for forty years.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in kum sawmli sung clinic ah na a sem siavuan tungah lungdam kohna phek khat clinic ah a koih sak hi.

records.english: The volunteers were so moved by the children's thank-you song that some of them cried.
records.zomi: Naupangte' lungdam kohna la in thalawp nasemte' lungsim a khoih lua ahih manin khenkhatte a kap uh hi.

records.english: Thank you for the vegetables from the community garden — they made the best soup we've had all year.
records.zomi: Mipi huan pan anteh adingin ka lungdam hi — tu kum sungin i neih an-tui hoih pen a suak hi.

records.english: The ambulance arrived in eight minutes, and we'll always be grateful to the crew.
records.zomi: Ambulance minit giat sungin hong tung a, a nasemte tungah i lungdam den ding hi.

records.english: Please pass on our thanks to the crew who repaired the bridge in the rain.
records.zomi: Guah zuk lai-a lei a bawl kik pawl kiangah i lungdamna gen sak in.

records.english: When the clinic reopened after the flood, patients brought gifts for the staff who had cleaned it.
records.zomi: Tuiciim khit ciangin clinic a kihon kik ciangin damlote in a siangsak nasemte adingin letsong a tawi uh hi.

records.english: When the old librarian retired, the street outside the library was renamed after her.
records.zomi: Laibu inn kem upa nu a khawl ciangin laibu inn polam lampi amah' min tawh kila hi.

records.english: The rescue team was thanked with a dinner, a song, and a promise that the village would never forget them.
records.zomi: Hum pawl in nitak an, la khat leh khua in a mangngilh ngei lo ding kiciamna tawh lungdam kohna a ngah uh hi.

records.english: My father still thanks the bus driver every morning, even after thirty years on the same route.
records.zomi: Ka pa in kum sawmthum lampi khat mah a zat khit zongin zingsang simin bus tuansakpa tungah lungdam a ko lai hi.

records.english: My neighbor's thank-you cake for the ambulance crew was so big that they shared it with the whole station.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng' ambulance nasemte adinga lungdam kohna cake a lian lua ahih manin station bup tawh a kihawm uh hi.

records.english: The old man was so grateful to the volunteers who fixed his roof that he gave each of them a basket of mangoes.
records.zomi: Pasal upa in a inn tung a bawl thalawp nasemte tungah a lungdam lua ahih manin a khat ciat theihai bawm khat a pia hi.

records.english: Can I leave a thank-you message for the night nurses at the desk?
records.zomi: Zan nurse te adingin dawhkan ah lungdam kohna message ka nusia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Staff at the health center aren't allowed to accept cash gifts, so we gave them flowers instead.
records.zomi: Damna inn nasemte in sum letsong a sang thei kei uh ahih manin a sikin pak i pia hi.

records.english: We were so grateful to the interpreter at the hospital that we invited her to my daughter's wedding.
records.zomi: Zato-a pau leipa nu tungah i lungdam lua ahih manin ka tanu' kiteenna ah i sam hi.

records.english: Let's thank the volunteers by name at the start of the meeting.
records.zomi: Kikhopna kipatna ah thalawp nasemte a min tawh lungdam ko ni.

records.english: We do want to thank everyone who gave money for the new well, so we've painted their names on it.
records.zomi: Tuikhuk thak adingin sum a pia mi khempeuh tungah lungdam i ko nuam taktak ahih manin a min uh a tung ah i khai hi.

records.english: Why does the village give the teachers a feast at the end of every school year?
records.zomi: Bang hangin khua in kum simin sang kum tawp ciangin sayate an lian a pia hiam?

records.english: To thank them for staying, because many teachers leave for the city after a year.
records.zomi: A om den manun lungdam kohna-in, sayate tampi kum khat khit ciangin khuapi ah a pai zel uh ahih manin.

records.english: The mayor made the whole hall stand and clap for the people who had kept the water running during the storm.
records.zomi: Khuapi ukpa in huihpi laitakin tui a om den nadingin a kem mite adingin inn lian bup a dingsak a, khut a bengsak hi.

records.english: Did anyone thank the man who cleared the road after the landslide?
records.zomi: Leiminpuk khit ciangin lampi a siangsak pasal tungah kuamah in lungdam a ko hiam?

records.english: Our family put a thank-you notice in the local newspaper for everyone who helped us after the fire.
records.zomi: Mei kat khit ciangin hong huh mi khempeuh adingin i innkuan in khua thuthak lai ah lungdam kohna thu a koih hi.

records.english: When my neighbor's goats ate the community garden, she brought a basket of eggs to every gardener to say sorry.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng' kelte in mipi huan a nek ciangin huan kemte khempeuh kiangah maisak ngen dingin aktui bawm khat ciat a tawi hi.

records.english: My grandmother has never forgiven the council for cutting down the old tree in the square.
records.zomi: Laizang-a singkung lui a at manin ka pi in khuapi vaihawm a maisak ngei kei hi.

records.english: When the hospital mixed up my mother's appointment, the head nurse came to apologize herself.
records.zomi: Zato in ka nu' kimuhna hun a khial ciangin nurse makai mah in maisak ngen dingin a hong pai hi.

records.english: The bakery apologized to the church for the burnt bread at the wedding and baked a new batch for free.
records.zomi: Moh bawlna inn in kiteenna-a moh kang adingin pawlpi kiangah maisak a ngen a, a thak a man om lo-in a bawl hi.

records.english: Excuse me — I'm sorry to interrupt, but the meeting room is booked for the next hour.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in — ka khaktan manin hong maisak in, ahi zongin kikhopna khan nai khat sung kibawl khin hi.

records.english: The tax office, having checked its records, admitted that the letter demanding money from my grandfather had been sent by mistake.
records.zomi: A lai te a en khit ciangin siah office in ka pu kiang-a sum ngetna lai khialh-in kikhak hi, ci-in a pulak hi.

records.english: Has the bank paid back the fee it wrongly charged your mother?
records.zomi: Khialh-a a ngen man bank in na nu a lohsak kik khin hiam?

records.english: The police officer apologized for knocking on the wrong door at midnight.
records.zomi: Zan lai-in kongkhak khial a khawng manin police in maisak a ngen hi.

records.english: May I apologize to the neighbors on behalf of the youth club for the noise last night?
records.zomi: Zanni zan ging adingin khangno pawl' min tawh inn vengte kiangah maisak ka ngen thei ding hiam?

records.english: The school apologized to the parents because the exam results had been sent to the wrong families.
records.zomi: Sitna ciamte innkuan khial kiangah kikhak ahih manin sang in nu leh pate kiangah maisak a ngen hi.

records.english: Can you tell the postman I'm sorry the dog chased him again?
records.zomi: Ui in a delh kik manin hong maisak in, ci-in lai puakpa kiangah na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Is it all right if I bring a cake to the fire station to apologize for the false alarm?
records.zomi: Alarm zuau adingin maisak ngen dingin mei mitsakna inn ah cake khat ka tawi leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: What's the best way to complain to the council politely?
records.zomi: Zahtak takin khuapi vaihawm kiangah phunsan dan hoih pen bang ahi hiam?

records.english: Write it down, keep a copy, and say what you'd like them to do.
records.zomi: Gelh inla, kopi khat kem inla, bang a sep ding uh na deih hiam gen in.

records.english: Shall we write to the council to accept their apology and thank them for fixing the road?
records.zomi: A maisak ngenna uh sang dingin leh lampi a bawl manun lungdam ko dingin khuapi vaihawm kiangah lai i gelh ding hiam?

records.english: My brother apologized to the volunteers for missing his shift and worked two the next week.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal in a nasep hun a mansuah manin thalawp nasemte kiangah maisak a ngen a, a zom kal-in nasep hun nih a sem hi.

records.english: Sorry, the pharmacy is closing, but the night pharmacy is only two streets away.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, zatui dawl kikhak ding hi, ahi zongin zan zatui dawl lampi nih bek a gamla hi.

records.english: We're sorry that the bus pass office is closed today; please come back tomorrow.
records.zomi: Tuni-in bus pass office kikhak ahih manin hong maisak un; zingciang hong pai kik un.

records.english: My little sister was so ashamed of breaking the library's globe that she saved her pocket money to pay for it.
records.zomi: Ka nau numei in laibu inn' leitung lim bawl a phiat manin a zahlak lua ahih manin a man piak nadingin a zat ding sum a khol hi.

records.english: Is it too late to apologize to the bus driver I shouted at last week?
records.zomi: Kal bei-a ka sap bus tuansakpa kiangah maisak ngen a nun lua khin hiam?

records.english: The council apologized to every household for the three-day water cut and promised it wouldn't happen again.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in ni thum tui kitan adingin innkuan khempeuh kiangah maisak a ngen a, a piang kik nawn lo ding a kiciam hi.

records.english: My grandfather forgave the boy who stole apples from his tree, and then gave him a job picking them.
records.zomi: Ka pu in a singkung pan apple a guk pasal naupang a maisak a, tua khit ciangin a lak dingin nasep a pia hi.

records.english: The volunteer who forgot to lock the food bank was forgiven, because nothing was taken.
records.zomi: Bangmah a kila kei ahih manin an kaikhawmna mun khak a mangngilh thalawp nasem kimaisak hi.

records.english: Forgiveness came slowly in our village after the dispute over the well, but it came.
records.zomi: Tuikhuk kinialna khit ciangin i khua ah maisakna zawi takin a tung a, ahi zongin a tung hi.

records.english: Sorry for the mess in the hall — the youth club party went on later than we planned.
records.zomi: Inn lian buaina adingin hong maisak in — khangno pawl pawi i gel sangin a sau zaw hi.

records.english: Did the water company ever apologize for the brown water?
records.zomi: Tui sam adingin tui company in maisak a ngen ngei hiam?

records.english: Only after the newspaper wrote about it, which made people even angrier.
records.zomi: Thuthak lai in a gelh khit bek ciangin, tua in mite a hehsak semsem hi.

records.english: Let's apologize to the cleaners for leaving the hall in such a state.
records.zomi: Inn lian hih bang-a i nusia manin siangsakte kiangah maisak ngen ni.

records.english: My son broke a window at the community hall, so he apologized to the caretaker and helped him fix it.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in mipi inn lian tawhkhawng khat a phiat ahih manin inn kemnu kiangah maisak a ngen a, a bawl kik a huh hi.

records.english: So sincere was the mayor's apology that even her fiercest critics accepted it.
records.zomi: Khuapi ukpa nu' maisak ngenna a taktak lua ahih manin a dou pente in zong a sang uh hi.

records.english: Thank you for accepting my apology — I'll be on time for my next shift at the shelter.
records.zomi: Ka maisak ngenna na san manin ka lungdam hi — om sakna mun-a ka zom nasep hun ah hun takah ka tung ding hi.

records.english: Why did the bus company send everyone a letter?
records.zomi: Bang hangin bus company in mi khempeuh kiangah lai a khak hiam?

records.english: To apologize for canceling so many morning buses last month.
records.zomi: Kha bei-in zingsang bus tampi a phiat manin maisak ngen dingin.

records.english: My parcel was lost by the post office, and the manager phoned to say sorry in person.
records.zomi: Post office in ka ip a mangsak a, manager in maisak ngen dingin amah mah in hong sam hi.

records.english: When the council's truck knocked down our wall, the driver came back the same evening to apologize.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm' mawtaw in i bang a puksak ciangin tuansakpa in maisak ngen dingin tua nitak mahmah-in a hong ciah kik hi.

records.english: We're sorry for the long wait today; two of our doctors are ill.
records.zomi: Tuni-in sau taka na ngak manun hong maisak un; i siavuan nih a dam kei uh hi.

records.english: Sorry, but the library computers are only for members.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, laibu inn computer te kihelte ading bek ahi hi.

records.english: The clinic's apology letter was short, but it explained exactly what had gone wrong and what had changed.
records.zomi: Clinic' maisak ngenna lai a tom a, ahi zongin bang a khial hiam leh bang a kikhel hiam kician takin a gen hi.

records.english: Kids, you'll need to apologize to the librarian for the noise, and then you can choose your books.
records.zomi: Naupangte, ging adingin laibu inn kemnu kiangah maisak na ngen kul ding uh a, tua khit ciangin na laibu uh na teel thei uh hi.

records.english: Could I say sorry to the clinic receptionist, since I was rude to her this morning?
records.zomi: Tu zingsangin clinic reception nu tungah ka gamtat sia manin a kiangah maisak ka ngen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Why did the electricity company send an apology with the bill?
records.zomi: Bang hangin meivak company in a man lai tawh maisak ngenna a khak hiam?

records.english: No apology was ever given for the closing of the village school, and many people are still hurt.
records.zomi: Khua sang kikhak thu-ah maisak ngenna kuamah in a pia ngei kei a, mi tampi a lungkham lai uh hi.

records.english: The mayor said, "I made a mistake about the market, and I'm sorry for the trouble it caused."
records.zomi: Khuapi ukpa nu in, “Zuakna mun thu-ah ka khial a, a piangsak buaina adingin hong maisak un,” a ci hi.

records.english: The man at the recycling center said sorry and gave me the right address for old fridges.
records.zomi: Recycling mun-a pasal in maisak a ngen a, khal bawm lui puak nading teenna man hong pia hi.

records.english: Had the bus company explained the delays sooner, people would have been far more forgiving.
records.zomi: Bus company in a nunnate hun ma-in a gen siang leh mite in a maisak zaw ding uh hi.

records.english: When the festival was canceled at the last minute, the organizers apologized on the community radio.
records.zomi: Pawi a nunung pen hun-in a kiphiat ciangin vaihawmte in mipi radio tungah maisak a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Visitors aren't allowed in the ward after eight, so I'm sorry, but you'll have to come back tomorrow.
records.zomi: Nai giat khit ciangin ward ah hong vehte kiphal lo ahih manin hong maisak in, zingciang hong pai kik kul ding hi.

records.english: Forgiving the young driver who hit our fence was easier once he came to fix it himself.
records.zomi: I kulh a sat mawtaw mawng khangno amah mah in hong bawl kik ciangin maisak a baih zaw hi.

records.english: The village elders helped two families stop arguing about a boundary.
records.zomi: Khua upate in innkuan nih lei ciang thu a kinial uh khawl nadingin a huh uh hi.

records.english: You don't have to apologize for asking the social worker for help; that's what she's there for.
records.zomi: Mipi huhna nasempa kiangah huhna na ngen manin maisak na ngen kul kei hi; tua adingin a om hi.

records.english: The road was dug up without warning, so the council apologized to the shopkeepers who lost business.
records.zomi: Gen lo-in lampi ki-tou ahih manin khuapi vaihawm in van zuakna a mansuah dawl neite kiangah maisak a ngen hi.

records.english: What should I say to the neighbor whose car I scratched in the market car park?
records.zomi: Zuakna mun mawtaw koihna ah ka mawtaw tawh a mawtaw ka khuai inn veng kiangah bang ka gen ding hiam?

records.english: Leave a note with your phone number and offer to pay for the repair.
records.zomi: Na phone nambat tawh lai khat nusia inla a bawl kik man pia dingin gen in.

records.english: The town hall apologized for the spelling mistake on the new street sign and had it replaced within a week.
records.zomi: Khuapi office in lampi min phek thak tung-a gelh khialhna adingin maisak a ngen a, kal khat sungin a laih sak hi.

records.english: No one should have to wait three hours at the clinic without an explanation.
records.zomi: Gen siangna om lo-in kuamah in clinic ah nai thum a ngak kul kei ding hi.

records.english: The pastor asked us to forgive the young men who had damaged the church fence.
records.zomi: Pastor in pawlpi kulh a suksia khangno pasalte maisak dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: Can you forgive the cooperative for the late delivery, since the truck broke down in the hills?
records.zomi: Mual ah mawtaw lian a siat ahih manin a nun van puak adingin pawl dawl na maisak thei ding hiam?

records.english: The library forgave all late fines for one month, and hundreds of overdue books came back.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in kha khat sung dan tat nun khempeuh a maisak a, a hun bei laibu za tampi a ciah kik hi.

records.english: Children mustn't climb on the statue in the square, so I'm sorry, but you'll have to get down.
records.zomi: Naupangte laizang-a lim lian tungah a kah kei ding uh ahih manin hong maisak in, ahi zongin na kum kul ding hi.

records.english: The doctor said sorry for the wait before she even asked my name.
records.zomi: Siavuan nu in ka min a dot ma-in hong ngaksak manin maisak a ngen hi.

records.english: Can we talk about the fence calmly, without bringing up last year's argument?
records.zomi: Kum bei kinialna gen lo-in kulh thu dai takin i kikum thei ding hiam?

records.english: The mayor's office was flooded with complaints until the noise rule for the bars was agreed.
records.zomi: Zu dawlte' ging thukhun a kilem dong khuapi ukpa' office phunsannate tawh a dim hi.

records.english: Shall we vote on it, so that everyone's view is counted?
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh' ngaihsutna a kisim theih nadingin vote i pia ding hiam?

records.english: Shouting isn't allowed at our residents' meetings, so the chair asked two men to leave.
records.zomi: I teengte kikhopna ah kik sam kiphal lo ahih manin makaipa in pasal nih a paisak hi.

records.english: Is it worth fighting the council over one parking space?
records.zomi: Mawtaw koihna khat adingin khuapi vaihawm tawh kinial a manpha hiam?

records.english: Is there anyone at the town hall who can help us settle the argument about the shared wall?
records.zomi: Kihawm bang thu-a i kinialna bawl siang dingin khuapi office ah hong huh thei kuamah a om hiam?

records.english: The argument about the noise from the bakery ended when the baker moved his machines to the back room.
records.zomi: Moh bawlpa in a machine te nung lam khan ah a pemsak ciangin moh bawlna inn pan ging thu kinialna a bei hi.

records.english: The town meeting about the new market grew so loud that the mayor had to ring a bell.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun thak thu-a khuapi kikhopna a ging lua ahih manin khuapi ukpa in khawng a khawn kul hi.

records.english: Agreeing to disagree kept the two families on speaking terms, and that mattered more than winning.
records.zomi: Kilem lo-in om ding a kilem uh manin innkuan nih a kiho den uh a, tua in zawhna sangin a thupi zaw hi.

records.english: Please let each person finish before anyone replies.
records.zomi: Kuamah a dawn ma-in mi khat ciat a gen zawh dong ngak un.

records.english: When the council finally listened, the new bus stop was moved to where the old people had asked for it.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in a tawp-in a ngaih ciangin bus khawlna thak upate' ngetna mun ah kipemsak hi.

records.english: Can I suggest that each side chooses one person to speak for them?
records.zomi: Lam khat ciat in a adinga gen ding mi khat a teel ding uh ka gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Once the shopkeepers saw the figures, they stopped arguing against the new parking rules.
records.zomi: Dawl neite in nambatte a muh uh ciangin mawtaw koihna thukhun thakte a kinial nawn kei uh hi.

records.english: No one was happy with the first plan for the market, so the council drew up a new one with the sellers.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun gelna masa pen ah kuamah a lungkim kei uh ahih manin khuapi vaihawm in zuakte tawh a thak khat a bawl hi.

records.english: The dispute over the football field was settled when the club agreed to pick up litter after every match.
records.zomi: Pawl in kimawlna khit simin niin a lak ding a kilem uh ciangin football mun kinialna a bei hi.

records.english: Do the young people and the old people ever agree about the town festival?
records.zomi: Khuapi pawi thu-ah khangnote leh upate a kilem ngei uh hiam?

records.english: The two youth groups fought over the same hall until the council gave them alternate weeks.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in kal kilaih-in a piak dong khangno pawl nih in inn lian khat mah a kinial uh hi.

records.english: Thank you both for staying calm — I think we've found an answer that works.
records.zomi: Note nih in na lungsim dai den manun ka lungdam hi — a sem thei dawnna khat i mu hi, ka sa hi.

records.english: Could the youth club use the football field on weekday evenings and leave the weekends quiet for the residents?
records.zomi: Khangno pawl in ni sem ni nitak ciangin football mun a zang thei uh a, kal tawp teengte adingin a dai thei ding hiam?

records.english: What can we do if the neighbors' dog barks all night?
records.zomi: Inn veng' ui zan bup a hawng leh bang i sem thei ding hiam?

records.english: Talk to them first, and if that doesn't work, the community center offers free mediation.
records.zomi: A masa-in amaute tawh kiho in, a sem kei leh mipi inn in a man om lo kilemsakna a pia hi.

records.english: Everyone, write your ideas for the empty lot on these cards, and we'll read them out.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, lei awng adingin na ngaihsutnate hih card tungah gelh unla, i sim ding hi.

records.english: Would the residents accept the bars closing an hour earlier on weeknights?
records.zomi: Ni sem ni zan ciangin zu dawlte nai khat ma-in a khak uh leh teengte a lungkim ding uh hiam?

records.english: Let the mediator speak first, and then each of you can explain your side.
records.zomi: Kilemsakpa a gen masa hen, tua khit ciangin note khat ciat in na lam uh na gen thei uh hi.

records.english: A compromise was reached: the market would open an hour later, and the street would be cleaned by the sellers.
records.zomi: Kilemna khat kingah hi: zuakna mun nai khat nunin kihong ding a, lampi zuakte in a siangsak ding uh hi.

records.english: Would you be willing to meet your neighbor at the community center with a mediator?
records.zomi: Kilemsakpa tawh mipi inn ah na inn veng na mu nuam ding hiam?

records.english: Did the mediator help, or are they still arguing?
records.zomi: Kilemsakpa in a huh hiam, a kinial lai uh hiam?

records.english: The argument about the new bus route made the whole street tense for weeks.
records.zomi: Bus lampi thak kinialna in kal tampi sung lampi bup a lungkhamsak hi.

records.english: So many people came to the meeting about the closing of the clinic that it had to be held in the square.
records.zomi: Clinic khak thu kikhopna ah mi tampi a hong uh ahih manin laizang ah kibawl kul hi.

records.english: The water committee was criticized at first, but its fair schedule ended years of quarrels.
records.zomi: Tui committee kipatna ah kimawhsak a, ahi zongin a hun gelhna dik in kum tampi kinialnate a tawpsak hi.

records.english: What would make this fair for the people who live closest to the factory?
records.zomi: Factory kiang a om mite adingin bang in hih a dik sak ding hiam?

records.english: My neighbors stopped speaking for a year over a parking space, until their children became best friends.
records.zomi: Ka inn vengte mawtaw koihna khat hang-in kum khat sung a kiho kei uh a, a tate uh lawm hoih pen a suak dong.

records.english: Shall we write down what we agreed, so that nobody remembers it differently later?
records.zomi: A nung ciangin kuamah in tuam takin a phawk loh nadingin i kilemna i gelh ding hiam?

records.english: Most arguments on our street are about parking, noise, or the bins.
records.zomi: I lampi-a kinialna tam zaw mawtaw koihna, ging hiam niin bawm thu ahi hi.

records.english: Tell the mediator what you need, not just what you're angry about.
records.zomi: Na hehna bek hi lo-in na kisapna kilemsakpa kiangah gen in.

records.english: Why are the market sellers angry with the council?
records.zomi: Bang hangin zuakna mun zuakte khuapi vaihawm tung ah a heh uh hiam?

records.english: The stall fees were doubled without anyone asking them first.
records.zomi: Kuamah dong masa lo-in dawl man a nih in kikhangsak hi.

records.english: Let's ask the village elders to listen to both sides before anyone goes to the police.
records.zomi: Kuamah police kiangah a pai ma-in khua upate in lam nih tengteng a ngaikhiat ding i ngen ni.

records.english: Is it fair that the families at the top of the hill get water only at night?
records.zomi: Mual tung-a innkuante zanin bek tui a ngah uh pen a dik ahi hiam?

records.english: The plan for the new road was changed after the whole village signed a letter against it.
records.zomi: Khua bup in a dou lai khat ah min a suaksak uh khit ciangin lampi thak gelna kikhel hi.

records.english: I do want to keep the old tree in the square, but I understand the shopkeepers' worries about the roots.
records.zomi: Laizang-a singkung lui kem ka deih taktak hi, ahi zongin a zung thu-a dawl neite' lungkhamna ka thei hi.

records.english: Could we ask the pastor to chair the meeting, since both sides trust him?
records.zomi: Lam nih tengteng in a muan manun kikhopna makaih dingin pastor i ngen thei ding hiam?

records.english: The community mediator met both neighbors separately before bringing them together.
records.zomi: Mipi kilemsakpa in a khawm-a a kimuhsak ma-in inn veng nih tuam ciat-in a mu hi.

records.english: The disagreement over the church bells was solved by ringing them later on Sundays.
records.zomi: Nipini ciangin nun zawin khawng a khawn uh tawh pawlpi khawng thu kilem lohna kibawl siang hi.

records.english: Why don't we try the council's plan for six months and see whether it works?
records.zomi: Bang hangin khuapi vaihawm' gelna kha guk sung i sem inla a sem hiam i en kei hiam?

records.english: The two churches that share the hall agreed on a timetable after a long evening of talking.
records.zomi: Inn lian kihawm pawlpi nih in nitak sau kikup khit ciangin hun gelhna khat ah a kilem uh hi.

records.english: Please don't put up posters about the dispute until both families have spoken.
records.zomi: Innkuan nih in a gen ma-un kinialna thu lai lian khai kei un.

records.english: When the street light was finally moved, both families thanked the council for listening.
records.zomi: Lampi meivak a tawp-in a kipemsak ciangin a ngaih manin innkuan nih in khuapi vaihawm tungah lungdam a ko uh hi.

records.english: The chair said, "We're neighbors, not enemies — let's find something we can all live with."
records.zomi: Makaipa in, “Inn veng i hi a, galte hi lo hi — i khempeuh in i thuak zawh khat zong ni,” a ci hi.

records.english: Do you think a petition would change the council's mind?
records.zomi: Ngetna lai khat in khuapi vaihawm' lungsim a khel ding in na ngaihsun hiam?

records.english: Can we agree that nobody parks in front of the clinic gate?
records.zomi: Kuamah in clinic kongpi mai ah mawtaw a koih lo ding i kilem thei ding hiam?

records.english: My grandmother settled the argument between two neighbors by sending each of them a basket of eggs from the other.
records.zomi: Ka pi in inn veng nih' kinialna khat leh khat pan aktui bawm khat ciat a sawl tawh a bawl siang hi.

records.english: Let's give the council a week to answer before we take the petition to the newspaper.
records.zomi: Ngetna lai thuthak lai kiangah i tawi ma-in khuapi vaihawm in a dawn nadingin kal khat pia ni.

records.english: Who decides when two farmers disagree about water from the same stream?
records.zomi: Lo nei nih in luipi khat mah pan tui thu-ah a kilem kei uh ciangin kua in a khensat hiam?

records.english: In our valley, the water committee does, and its decision is usually accepted.
records.zomi: I guam ah tui committee in a khensat a, a khensatna a tam zaw kisang hi.

records.english: When the river flooded, the families who had argued about the boundary helped each other carry their furniture out.
records.zomi: Gun a dim ciangin lei ciang thu a kinial ngei innkuante in a innsung vante uh a puak khiat nadingin a kihuh uh hi.

records.english: Children mustn't be sent to argue on behalf of their parents.
records.zomi: Naupangte a nu leh pa uh adingin kinial dingin kisawl kei ding uh hi.

records.english: How did the village solve the problem of goats eating the community garden?
records.zomi: Kelte in mipi huan a nek thu khua in bangci-in a bawl siang hiam?

records.english: The goat owners built a fence, and the gardeners paid for half of it.
records.zomi: Kel neite in kulh a lam uh a, huan kemte in a kim man a pia uh hi.

records.english: Why don't you invite your neighbor for tea before you complain to the council?
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm kiangah na phunsan ma-in bang hangin na inn veng tea dawn dingin na sam kei hiam?

records.english: Is the police station still next to the old cinema?
records.zomi: Police station cinema lui kiang ah a om lai hiam?

records.english: Let's write down the directions to the shelter and stick them by the phone.
records.zomi: Om sakna mun pai lampi gelh inla phone kiang ah kap ni.

records.english: My little brother proudly gave the visitors directions to the museum, drawing the way in the dust with a stick.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal in kisaktheih takin hong vehte museum lampi a gen a, sing tawh leivui tungah lampi a gelh hi.

records.english: Which bus goes to the new health center?
records.zomi: Damna inn thak ah bus bang a pai hiam?

records.english: Why are there so many arrows painted on the hospital floor?
records.zomi: Bang hangin zato lei tungah thal tampi a kigelh hiam?

records.english: Each color leads to a different department, so patients don't get lost.
records.zomi: Lim khat ciat in department tuam ciat ah a paipih a, damlote lampi a mang kei uh hi.

records.english: Why don't they put a sign at the turning for the health post?
records.zomi: Bang hangin damna mun kiheeina ah lim gelh khat a koih kei uh hiam?

records.english: Could you please speak slowly, since I'm new here and trying to find the council office?
records.zomi: Hih ah ka thak a, khuapi vaihawm office ka zong ahih manin zawi takin na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Where do I go to donate blood?
records.zomi: Sisan pia dingin koi ah ka pai ding hiam?

records.english: To the red tent in the square, but bring your identity card.
records.zomi: Laizang-a puan inn san ah, ahi zongin na ID card tawi in.

records.english: Is the tax office in the same building as the passport office?
records.zomi: Siah office passport office tawh inn khat mah ah om hiam?

records.english: Excuse me, where's the polling station for our street?
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, i lampi ading vote piakna mun koi ah om hiam?

records.english: In the primary school hall, just past the church.
records.zomi: Sang neu inn lian ah, pawlpi kantan khit pah ah.

records.english: When my mother's appointment was moved to the hospital annex, nobody told us where it was.
records.zomi: Ka nu' kimuhna zato inn behlap ah kipem ciangin koi ah om hiam kuamah in hong gen kei uh hi.

records.english: Do the buses still stop outside the old post office?
records.zomi: Post office lui polam ah bus te a khawl lai uh hiam?

records.english: Is the food bank still behind the town hall, or has it moved?
records.zomi: An kaikhawmna mun khuapi office nung lam ah a om lai hiam, a pem khin hiam?

records.english: A volunteer walks new refugee families around town on their first day, so that they know where the clinic and the school are.
records.zomi: Clinic leh sang koi ah om hiam a theih theih nadingun a ni masa pen-un thalawp nasem khat in gam taimang innkuan thakte khuapi sung a paipih hi.

records.english: Kids, if you get lost at the festival, go to the police tent by the fountain.
records.zomi: Naupangte, pawi ah lampi na mansuah uh leh tui kahna kiang-a police puan inn ah pai un.

records.english: Finding the right office at the town hall took us so long that it had closed by the time we got there.
records.zomi: Khuapi office ah office man zon a sau lua ahih manin i tun ciangin a kikhak khin hi.

records.english: Visitors mustn't drive into the market square on Saturdays, so please park by the river.
records.zomi: Kiginni ciangin hong vehte zuakna mun laizang ah mawtaw a mawng lut thei kei uh ahih manin gun kiang ah koih un.

records.english: The postman, who knows every street, is the best person to ask for directions in our town.
records.zomi: Lampi khempeuh a thei lai puakpa pen i khuapi ah lampi dong ding mi hoih pen ahi hi.

records.english: Ask at the library desk — they know where every office in the town hall is.
records.zomi: Laibu inn dawhkan ah dong in — khuapi office-a office khempeuh koi ah om hiam a thei uh hi.

records.english: Would you mind walking my grandmother to the bank, since she's never been to the new branch?
records.zomi: Ka pi bank khen thak ah a pai ngei kei ahih manin bank dong na paipih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Thanks for showing me the way — I'd never have found the clinic on my own.
records.zomi: Lampi hong lak manin ka lungdam hi — kei bek in clinic ka mu ngei lo ding hi.

records.english: The council's online map shows where every bus stop and public tap is in the town.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm' online map in khuapi sung-a bus khawlna leh mipi tui kongkhak khempeuh a lak hi.

records.english: A woman from the welcome group met us at the station and showed us the way to every office we needed.
records.zomi: Muakna pawl pan numei khat in station ah hong dawn a, i kisap office khempeuh lampi hong lak hi.

records.english: The volunteers drew a little map on the back of each food bank card.
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte in an kaikhawmna card khat ciat nung lam ah map neu khat a gelh uh hi.

records.english: Students, if you're helping visitors on open day, stand by the gate with the map.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, hon ni-in hong vehte na huh uh leh map tawh kongpi kiang ah ding un.

records.english: Everyone, follow me — the voting room is upstairs, and the lift is broken.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, hong zui un — vote piakna khan tung lam ah om a, lift a sia hi.

records.english: Could someone put up a sign for the new bus stop, since half the passengers wait at the old one?
records.zomi: Tuangte a kim bus khawlna lui ah a ngak uh ahih manin bus khawlna thak adingin kuamah in lim gelh khat a koih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Is there a sign for the community garden, or do I just look for the gate?
records.zomi: Mipi huan adingin lim gelh a om hiam, kongpi bek ka zong ding hiam?

records.english: Could you tell me how to get to the vaccination center?
records.zomi: Vaccine mun pai dan hong gen thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Directions in our village are given by landmarks: the well, the church, and the big mango tree.
records.zomi: I khua ah lampi pen mun theih nadingte tawh kigen hi: tuikhuk, pawlpi leh theihai kung lian.

records.english: Can you tell the new nurse how to find the houses at the top of the valley?
records.zomi: Guam tung lam-a inn te bangci-in a mu ding hiam nurse thak kiangah na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: The volunteer at the station said, "Follow the green signs, and you'll reach the emergency shelter in ten minutes."
records.zomi: Station-a thalawp nasem in, “Lim gelh eng zui inla, minit sawm sungin haksatna hun om sakna mun na tung ding hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: When the bridge was closed, the council printed maps showing the long way around to the market.
records.zomi: Lei a kikhak ciangin khuapi vaihawm in zuakna mun pai lampi sau a lak map te a suaksak hi.

records.english: All of you, please learn the evacuation route from the school to the hill before the rainy season.
records.zomi: Note khempeuh, guah hun ma-in sang pan mual dong taimang lampi sin un.

records.english: Clear signs are one of the simplest services a town can give its visitors.
records.zomi: Lim gelh kician pen khuapi in a hong vehte a piak theih nasep baih pen khat ahi hi.

records.english: How do I find the recycling center from the main road?
records.zomi: Lampi lian pan recycling mun bangci-in ka mu ding hiam?

records.english: Was the community center easy to find?
records.zomi: Mipi inn muh a baih hiam?

records.english: When the power went out at the station, the staff guided passengers to the exits with flashlights.
records.zomi: Station ah meivak a kitan ciangin nasemte in meivak neu tawh tuangte pai khiatna ah a makaih uh hi.

records.english: The girl at the tourist office not only gave us directions but also called the museum to tell them we were coming.
records.zomi: Khualzinte office-a numei naupang in lampi bek hi lo-in museum zong a sam a, i tun ding a gen sak hi.

records.english: The new street names confused everyone, so the council put the old names underneath for a year.
records.zomi: Lampi min thakte in mi khempeuh a buaisak ahih manin khuapi vaihawm in kum khat sung a nuai ah min luite a koih hi.

records.english: So confusing were the signs at the new hospital that volunteers stood in the corridors to guide people.
records.zomi: Zato thak-a lim gelhte a buaihuai lua ahih manin thalawp nasemte mite makaih dingin lampi khan ah a ding uh hi.

records.english: The tourist office gave us a free map with every public toilet, clinic, and pharmacy marked on it.
records.zomi: Khualzinte office in mipi ek inn, clinic leh zatui dawl khempeuh a kilakna map khat a man om lo-in hong pia hi.

records.english: When the road to the clinic was flooded, the police directed cars along the old farm track.
records.zomi: Clinic pai lampi tui in a dimsak ciangin police in lo lampi lui tawh mawtaw te a makaih hi.

records.english: Turn right at the fire station, and the community center is the yellow building on your left.
records.zomi: Mei mitsakna inn ah taklam kiheei inla, mipi inn pen na veilam-a inn ngaan ahi hi.

records.english: Where's the nearest pharmacy that's open on Sunday?
records.zomi: Nipini a kihong zatui dawl a kiang pen koi ah om hiam?

records.english: When the library moved, a sign was left on the old door with a map to the new building.
records.zomi: Laibu inn a pem ciangin kongkhak lui tungah inn thak pai nading map tawh lim gelh khat kinusia hi.

records.english: The ambulance driver couldn't find our house, so my son ran out to the road and waved.
records.zomi: Ambulance tuansakpa in i inn a mu kei ahih manin ka tapa lampi ah a tai khia a, khut a vaai hi.

records.english: I do want to find the courthouse myself, but could you point me in the right direction?
records.zomi: Thukhenna inn kei mah in zong ka deih taktak hi, ahi zongin a man lam hong lak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Which stop should I get off at for the employment office?
records.zomi: Nasep office pai dingin khawlna bang ah ka kiak ding hiam?

records.english: The one after the big clock — the driver will shout it out.
records.zomi: Nai-ten lian khit ciangin a om — tuansakpa in a sam ding hi.

records.english: The town's new signs are in three languages, so that every visitor can find the clinic.
records.zomi: Hong veh khempeuh in clinic a muh theih nadingun khuapi lim gelh thakte pau thum tawh ahi hi.

records.english: Where's the best place to wait for the night bus to the hospital?
records.zomi: Zato pai zan bus ngak nading mun hoih pen koi ah om hiam?

records.english: My grandfather gave the young doctor directions to every house in the village, along with the family histories.
records.zomi: Ka pu in siavuan khangno kiangah khua sung inn khempeuh lampi leh innkuan tangthu a gen hi.

records.english: Did you find the social services office, or did you get lost again?
records.zomi: Mipi huhna office na mu hiam, lampi na mansuah kik hiam?

records.english: Is the vaccination center open to people who don't live in this town?
records.zomi: Vaccine mun hih khuapi ah teeng lo mite adingin zong kihong hiam?

records.english: Would you like me to draw you a map to the shelter?
records.zomi: Om sakna mun pai nading map kong gelh sak ding na deih hiam?

records.english: A visitor asked me the way to the cemetery, so I walked with her, since it's hard to find.
records.zomi: Hong veh khat in han mun lampi hong dong a, a zon a haksa ahih manin amah tawh ka kaai hi.

records.english: Shall I report the broken traffic light to the council?
records.zomi: Lampi meivak siat khuapi vaihawm kiangah ka gen ding hiam?

records.english: Students, look both ways twice before you cross, even at the crossing.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, kantanna mun ah zong na kantan ma-un lam nih vei nih en un.

records.english: The council's road crew filled the potholes with a small machine that smells of hot tar.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm' lampi bawl pawl in khuak gim nam machine neu khat tawh lampi kua te a dimsak uh hi.

records.english: Everyone in the car club, please write your trips on the calendar so that two people don't book the same car.
records.zomi: Mawtaw pawl mi khempeuh, mi nih in mawtaw khat mah a bawl loh nadingun na khualzinna uh calendar tungah gelh un.

records.english: The town's first roundabout confused drivers so much that a police officer stood in the middle for a week.
records.zomi: Khuapi' mawtaw kiimna masa pen in mawtaw mawngte a buaisak lua ahih manin police khat kal khat sung a laizang ah a ding hi.

records.english: My grandfather gave up his driving license after the eye clinic said his sight was too poor.
records.zomi: Mit clinic in a mit a muh siang lua kei hi, a cih khit ciangin ka pu in a mawtaw mawng phalna lai a nusia hi.

records.english: Did the council ever fix the bump at the bottom of the hill?
records.zomi: Mual nuai lam-a lampi kisuan khuapi vaihawm in a bawl ngei hiam?

records.english: Did you remember to renew the car's road tax at the post office?
records.zomi: Post office ah mawtaw lampi siah thak dingin na phawk hiam?

records.english: Our neighbor's car was towed away from the clinic entrance, and she had to pay to get it back.
records.zomi: I inn veng' mawtaw clinic lutna pan kila a, a lak kik nadingin a pia kul hi.

records.english: Who should I call if I see a car parked in the disabled space at the clinic?
records.zomi: Clinic ah pumpi haksat mite' mawtaw koihna ah mawtaw khat a om ka muh leh kua ka sam ding hiam?

records.english: The clinic's security guard, who will ask the driver to move.
records.zomi: Clinic' kongpi kemtu, a mawng pa a pemsak dingin a ngen ding hi.

records.english: My cousin learned to drive at the community driving school, which charges less for young people.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in khangnote adingin man tawm zaw a ngen mipi mawtaw mawng sang ah mawtaw mawng a sin hi.

records.english: A tree fell across the main road during the storm, and the council cleared it before dawn.
records.zomi: Huihpi laitakin singkung khat lampi lian tungah a puk a, khua a vak ma-in khuapi vaihawm in a siangsak hi.

records.english: Safe roads depend as much on patient drivers as on good signs.
records.zomi: Lampi bitnate lim gelh hoih tung ah bangmah in thuakzawh-a mawng mite tung ah kinga hi.

records.english: Could we organize a car pool for the parents who drive to the clinic every week?
records.zomi: Kal simin clinic ah a mawng nu leh pate adingin mawtaw kihawm nading i vaihawm thei ding hiam?

records.english: Thank you for driving my father to his dialysis every week — we couldn't manage without you.
records.zomi: Kal simin ka pa dialysis ah na paipih manin ka lungdam hi — nang om lo leh i zo lo ding hi.

records.english: The police officer who came to our school showed us how to wear a bicycle helmet properly.
records.zomi: I sang hong veh police in siiksakol lukhu a dik taka khuk dan hong etsak hi.

records.english: When the new bypass opened, the trucks stopped coming through the village, and the children could walk to school safely again.
records.zomi: Kawi lampi thak kihon ciangin mawtaw lian te khua tawng-in a pai nawn kei uh a, naupangte bitna takin sang ah a kaai thei kik uh hi.

records.english: The parking fines from the market road pay for the street lights, according to the council.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm' gen dan in zuakna mun lampi-a mawtaw koih dan tatnate in lampi meivak man a pia hi.

records.english: When the snow blocked the mountain road, the council sent a plow so that the milk truck could reach the village.
records.zomi: Vuk in mual lampi a khak ciangin nawi mawtaw lian khua a tun theih nadingin khuapi vaihawm in vuk phiatna a sawl hi.

records.english: Since the town started a car-sharing club, my mother has been able to visit her sister every week.
records.zomi: Khuapi in mawtaw kihawm pawl a phut pan ka nu in kal simin a sanggam nu a veh thei hi.

records.english: The road to the health post was washed away, so the nurse came to the village on a motorbike.
records.zomi: Damna mun pai lampi tui in a lak ahih manin nurse motorbike tawh khua ah hong pai hi.

records.english: Let me drive you home after the meeting, since the last bus has gone.
records.zomi: Bus nunung a pai khin ahih manin kikhopna khit ciangin inn dong kong paipih ning.

records.english: Let's leave the car at home on festival day, because the center will be closed to traffic.
records.zomi: Pawi ni-in laizang mawtaw adingin kikhak ding ahih manin mawtaw inn ah nusia ni.

records.english: When the fire engine couldn't get down our street because of parked cars, the whole neighborhood agreed to keep one side clear.
records.zomi: Mawtaw kikoihte hang-in mei mitsakna mawtaw i lampi a tum thei kei ciangin inn veng bup in lam khat awng den dingin a kilem uh hi.

records.english: Can we ask the council for a pedestrian crossing outside the clinic?
records.zomi: Clinic polam ah lampi kantanna khat koih dingin khuapi vaihawm i ngen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Could the ambulance get through if we parked on both sides of the road?
records.zomi: Lampi lam nih tengteng ah mawtaw i koih leh ambulance a pai thei ding hiam?

records.english: I do want to give my neighbor a lift to the market, but my car only has two seats.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng zuakna mun ah paipih ka deih taktak hi, ahi zongin ka mawtaw ah tutna nih bek a om hi.

records.english: The tractor drivers were asked to keep off the main road during the morning school run.
records.zomi: Zingsang sang paipih hun-in tractor mawngte lampi lian tungah om lo dingin kingen uh hi.

records.english: The bus lane was painted red so that drivers would stop using it.
records.zomi: Mawtaw mawngte in a zat nawn loh nadingun bus lampi san takin kikhai hi.

records.english: Can you drive slowly past the school, since the children are just coming out?
records.zomi: Naupangte a pai khia uh ahih manin sang na kantan ciangin zawi takin na mawng thei ding hiam?

records.english: So many potholes were reported on the new app that the road crew worked weekends for a month.
records.zomi: App thak tungah lampi kua tampi kigen ahih manin lampi bawl pawl in kha khat sung kal tawp-in na a sem uh hi.

records.english: The new traffic lights at the market corner were installed after two accidents in one month.
records.zomi: Kha khat sungin kituakna nih a om khit ciangin zuakna mun ki-ngawi ah lampi meivak thakte kikoih hi.

records.english: The volunteer drivers were thanked with a lunch at the town hall.
records.zomi: Thalawp mawtaw mawngte khuapi office ah sun an tawh lungdam kohna kipia uh hi.

records.english: The council's road safety campaign made the young drivers in our town much more careful.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm' lampi bitna hanciamna in i khuapi-a mawtaw mawng khangnote a pilvang zaw mahmah sak hi.

records.english: Children mustn't play on the road while the trucks are bringing stones for the new bridge.
records.zomi: Lei thak adingin mawtaw lian te in suang a puak laitakin naupangte lampi tungah a mawl kei ding uh hi.

records.english: Is the road to the coast open again after the landslide?
records.zomi: Leiminpuk khit ciangin tuipi gei pai lampi a kihong kik hiam?

records.english: Would you drive Mrs. Lun to the clinic on Thursday, since her son is away?
records.zomi: A tapa a om kei ahih manin Laizing ni ciangin Mrs. Lun clinic ah na paipih ding hiam?

records.english: Drive around the back of the hospital, and you'll find the parking for visitors.
records.zomi: Zato nung lam kawi-in mawng inla, hong vehte' mawtaw koihna na mu ding hi.

records.english: Please don't park in front of the fire station; the engines need to get out quickly.
records.zomi: Mei mitsakna mawtaw te manlang takin a pai khiat kul uh ahih manin mei mitsakna inn mai ah mawtaw koih kei in.

records.english: Did you hear that the council is going to fix the road to the cemetery at last?
records.zomi: A tawp-in khuapi vaihawm in han mun pai lampi a bawl ding thu na za hiam?

records.english: Is it all right to park outside the church during the funeral?
records.zomi: Misi vuina laitakin pawlpi polam ah mawtaw koih a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: No trucks are allowed through the old town center, because the streets are too narrow.
records.zomi: Khuapi lui laizang ah lampi a zai kei ahih manin mawtaw lian te kiphal lo uh hi.

records.english: How do I book a driving test at the test center?
records.zomi: Sitna mun ah mawtaw mawng sitna bangci-in ka bawl ding hiam?

records.english: Online or at the counter, but the waiting list is about two months long.
records.zomi: Online ah hiam dawhkan ah hiam, ahi zongin ngak list kha nih bang a sau hi.

records.english: Why is the road outside the market always so crowded on Saturdays?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Kiginni ciangin zuakna mun polam lampi mi tam tawntung hiam?

records.english: Our street became quieter after the council turned it into a one-way road.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in lam khat pai lampi a suaksak khit ciangin i lampi a dai zaw hi.

records.english: Our car broke down outside the police station, and two officers pushed it to the garage.
records.zomi: I mawtaw police station polam ah a sia a, police nih in mawtaw bawlna mun ah a nawt uh hi.

records.english: The road was closed for the marathon, and every car was sent around the edge of town.
records.zomi: Tai kidemna adingin lampi kikhak a, mawtaw khempeuh khuapi gei tawng-in kisawl hi.

records.english: Who drives the old people to their hospital appointments?
records.zomi: Upate zato kimuhna ah kua in a paipih hiam?

records.english: Volunteer drivers from the church, and the council pays for their fuel.
records.zomi: Pawlpi pan thalawp mawtaw mawngte, khuapi vaihawm in a dat man a pia hi.

records.english: Can somebody move the car that's blocking the ambulance bay?
records.zomi: Ambulance koihna khak mawtaw kuamah in a pemsak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Do residents need a permit to park on this street?
records.zomi: Hih lampi tungah mawtaw koih dingin teengte in phalna lai a kisam uh hiam?

records.english: Using a long pole with a mirror, the security guard checked under every car at the gate.
records.zomi: Mitlang a kibulh sing sau zang-in kongpi kemtu in kongpi-a mawtaw khempeuh nuai a en hi.

records.english: After years of complaints, the council finally put speed bumps on the road outside the school.
records.zomi: Kum tampi phunsan khit ciangin khuapi vaihawm in a tawp-in sang polam lampi ah mawtaw zawisakna a koih hi.

records.english: Is there a bus for people who can no longer drive?
records.zomi: Mawtaw mawng zo nawn lo mite adingin bus a om hiam?

records.english: Kids, wait for the traffic warden to stop the cars before you cross.
records.zomi: Naupangte, na kantan ma-un mawtaw enkaktu in mawtaw te a khaktan dong ngak un.

records.english: Why are the police stopping every car at the bridge today?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tuni-in lei ah police te in mawtaw khempeuh a khaktan uh hiam?

records.english: They're checking that everyone is wearing a seatbelt, as part of road safety week.
records.zomi: Lampi bitna kal hang-in mi khempeuh in khau a khih uh hiam a en uh hi.

records.english: The ambulance arrived quickly because the drivers on the bridge all pulled to the side.
records.zomi: Lei tung-a mawtaw mawng khempeuh lampi gei ah a pem uh ahih manin ambulance manlang takin a tung hi.

records.english: If the trains are canceled, the council puts on buses so that people can still reach the hospital.
records.zomi: Meileng te kiphiat leh mite in zato a tun theih nadingun khuapi vaihawm in bus a koih hi.

records.english: Mind the step when you get off, because the pavement is lower here.
records.zomi: Na kiak ciangin khebulh pilvang in, hih ah lampi gei a niam zaw hi.

records.english: The station's lifts were repaired after the parents' group wrote to the railway company about the stairs.
records.zomi: Nu leh pate' pawl in kaplei thu meileng company kiangah a gelh khit uh ciangin station lift te kibawl kik hi.

records.english: Thanks for waiting for me — I'd have missed my hospital appointment otherwise.
records.zomi: Hong ngak manin ka lungdam hi — ahih kei leh ka zato kimuhna ka mansuah ding hi.

records.english: The train company gave free tickets to the volunteers who had helped after the flood.
records.zomi: Tuiciim khit ciangin a huh thalawp nasemte meileng company in ticket a man om lo-in a pia hi.

records.english: The bus pass office was so busy on the first day that they gave out numbers at the door.
records.zomi: Ni masa pen-in bus pass office a buai lua ahih manin kongkhak ah nambat a pia uh hi.

records.english: I do want the council to keep the Sunday bus, because it's the only way the old people get to church.
records.zomi: Upate pawlpi a tun theihna bek ahih manin Nipini bus khuapi vaihawm in a kem den ding ka deih taktak hi.

records.english: The town's buses were painted with the children's drawings for the school's hundredth birthday.
records.zomi: Sang kum za na pianni adingin khuapi bus te naupangte' lim gelh tawh kikhai hi.

records.english: Is the ferry free for people going to the island clinic?
records.zomi: Tuikulh clinic pai mite adingin tembaw man om lo hiam?

records.english: The bus driver waited for my grandfather to sit down before he drove off, as he always does.
records.zomi: A tawntung bangin bus tuansakpa in ka pu a tut dong a ngak a, tua khit ciangin a mawng hi.

records.english: The new buses have a ramp that lowers to the pavement, so my grandmother can get on with her walker.
records.zomi: Bus thakte in lampi gei dong a kiniamsak kah nading a nei ahih manin ka pi a kaaina tawh a tuang thei hi.

records.english: Since the new tram line opened, my aunt has been able to visit the hospital without asking anyone for a lift.
records.zomi: Tram lampi thak kihon pan ka ni in kuamah a ngen lo-in zato a veh thei hi.

records.english: Do you know whether the trains are running during the strike?
records.zomi: Khawlna laitakin meileng te a pai uh hiam na thei hiam?

records.english: Having a bus every hour has changed life in our village more than anything else in the past ten years.
records.zomi: Nai simin bus a om in kum sawm bei sungin i khua nuntakna na dang khempeuh sangin a khel zaw hi.

records.english: Everyone, the council wants to hear what you think about the new bus routes, so please fill in the form.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, bus lampi thakte thu-ah na ngaihsutna uh khuapi vaihawm in a zak nuam ahih manin lai dimsak un.

records.english: Good public transport lets older people stay part of their community for longer.
records.zomi: Mipi mawtaw hoih in upate a mipi uh sungah hun sau zaw a omsak hi.

records.english: Can I bring my bicycle on the train to the city?
records.zomi: Khuapi pai meileng tungah ka siiksakol ka tawi thei ding hiam?

records.english: When the new bus route opened, the first passengers were greeted with tea and cake at the terminus.
records.zomi: Bus lampi thak a kihon ciangin tuang masa pente bus tawpna mun ah tea leh cake tawh kimuak uh hi.

records.english: My neighbor's walker got stuck in the bus door, so the driver got out and lifted it free.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng' kaaina bus kongkhak ah a kibet a, tuansakpa a kiak a, a dom khia hi.

records.english: Guide dogs are allowed on all the town's buses and trains.
records.zomi: Mittaw makaih uite khuapi bus leh meileng khempeuh ah kiphal uh hi.

records.english: So few people knew about the free dial-a-ride service that the council advertised it on the community radio.
records.zomi: A man om lo phone-a sam mawtaw thu mi tawmno bek in a theih uh ahih manin khuapi vaihawm in mipi radio tungah a gen hi.

records.english: The night bus was started after the nurses complained that they couldn't get home safely after late shifts.
records.zomi: Nurse te in nasep zan khit ciangin bitna takin inn a tung thei lo uh hi, ci-in a phunsan uh khit ciangin zan bus kipat sak hi.

records.english: When the bridge closed, the bus company ran a small boat across the river for a month.
records.zomi: Lei a kikhak ciangin bus company in kha khat sung gun kantan dingin tembaw neu khat a paisak hi.

records.english: The buses were free on election day so that everyone could get to the polling stations.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh vote piakna mun a tun theih nadingun teelna ni-in bus te man om lo hi.

records.english: There's a chance the school bus will stop running if the council cuts its budget.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in a sum zat ding a tawmsak leh sang bus a khawl kha ding hi.

records.english: When the bus broke down in the hills, the driver called the community transport team, who came within an hour.
records.zomi: Mual ah bus a siat ciangin tuansakpa in mipi mawtaw pawl a sam a, nai khat sungin a tung uh hi.

records.english: Would you mind reading the timetable for me, since I've left my glasses at home?
records.zomi: Ka mitlimlang inn ah ka nusia ahih manin hun gelhna hong sim sak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Is the last bus to the village still at nine, or has it changed?
records.zomi: Khua pai bus nunung nai kua ciangin a om lai hiam, a kikhel hiam?

records.english: The dial-a-ride service picks my mother up at her door and takes her to the clinic.
records.zomi: Phone-a sam mawtaw in ka nu a kongkhak pan a la a, clinic ah a paipih hi.

records.english: Can you call the bus company and ask whether the Sunday service is being cut?
records.zomi: Bus company na sam inla Nipini bus a kiphiat ding hiam na dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: The volunteers at the station help people with heavy bags up the stairs.
records.zomi: Station-a thalawp nasemte in van gik nei mite kaplei tawh a huh uh hi.

records.english: A woman on the bus noticed that my grandfather looked ill and asked the driver to stop at the clinic.
records.zomi: Bus tungah numei khat in ka pu a dam lo bang a mu a, clinic ah khawl dingin tuansakpa a ngen hi.

records.english: My umbrella was handed in at the lost property office, and they kept it for three months.
records.zomi: Ka khaupi van mangte office ah kipia a, kha thum sung a kem uh hi.

records.english: My little brother was given a prize by the bus company for finding and returning a lost wallet.
records.zomi: Sum ip mangthang a muh a lohsak kik manin ka nau pasal bus company in laksap a pia hi.

records.english: We might get a new bus stop outside the clinic if enough people sign the petition.
records.zomi: Mi tampi in ngetna lai ah min a suaksak uh leh clinic polam ah bus khawlna thak i ngah kha ding hi.

records.english: Does the minibus go as far as the farms at the end of the valley?
records.zomi: Minibus in guam tawp-a lote dong a pai hiam?

records.english: Using the timetable app, I can see exactly when the next bus will reach our stop.
records.zomi: Hun gelhna app zang-in bus zom i khawlna a tun ding hun kician takin ka mu thei hi.

records.english: Can someone help the man with the pram get off at the next stop?
records.zomi: Naungek leeng tawi pasal a zom khawlna ah a kiak nadingin kuamah in a huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Why does the first bus of the day wait five minutes at the hospital gate?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ni sung bus masa pen zato kongpi ah minit nga a ngak hiam?

records.english: Is there a space for wheelchairs on the train to the regional hospital?
records.zomi: Gam zato pai meileng tungah leeng tutna adingin mun a om hiam?

records.english: Buses for the hill villages leave from the stop behind the market, not from the station.
records.zomi: Mual khua pai bus te station pan hi lo-in zuakna mun nung lam khawlna pan a pai uh hi.

records.english: My grandmother taught the young bus driver the names of every stop in our dialect.
records.zomi: Ka pi in bus tuansak khangno i pau tawh khawlna khempeuh min a hilh hi.

records.english: The bus company apologized after the driver left without the group of schoolchildren waiting at the stop.
records.zomi: Khawlna ah a ngak sangnaupang pawl nusia-in tuansakpa a pai khit ciangin bus company in maisak a ngen hi.

records.english: Could the council fix the bus shelter before winter, since the roof has been broken for a year?
records.zomi: Inn tung kum khat sung a sia ahih manin khuavot ma-in khuapi vaihawm in bus ngakna inn a bawl thei ding hiam?

records.english: Which bus stops nearest to the food bank?
records.zomi: An kaikhawmna mun kiang pen ah bus bang a khawl hiam?

records.english: The number 4, but ask the driver to tell you when you get there.
records.zomi: Nambat 4, ahi zongin na tun ciangin hong gen dingin tuansakpa ngen in.

records.english: The bus stop in front of the school was moved after the children kept running into the road.
records.zomi: Naupangte lampi ah a tai den uh khit ciangin sang mai-a bus khawlna kipemsak hi.

records.english: Please hold on to the rail, because the driver brakes suddenly on this hill.
records.zomi: Hih mual ah tuansakpa in pahtakin a khaktan zel ahih manin lenna len den in.

records.english: Shall I ask at the station whether the train has a toilet for disabled passengers?
records.zomi: Meileng ah pumpi haksat tuangte adingin ek inn a om hiam station ah ka dong ding hiam?

records.english: All of you going to the festival can take the extra buses that the council has put on.
records.zomi: Pawi pai note khempeuh khuapi vaihawm' koih bus behlapte na tuang thei uh hi.

records.english: Kids, hold the rail and stand to one side so that people can get off first.
records.zomi: Naupangte, mite a kiak masa theih nadingun lenna len unla gei lam ah ding un.

records.english: Does the bus wait for the ferry if it's late?
records.zomi: Tembaw a nun leh bus in a ngak hiam?

records.english: How did people in your village get to the hospital before the bus route existed?
records.zomi: Bus lampi om ma-in na khua mite bangci-in zato ah a pai uh hiam?

records.english: On a neighbor's cart, or by walking for half a day.
records.zomi: Inn veng' leeng tungah, ahih kei leh ni kim kaai-in.

records.english: How do I apply for the free bus pass for pensioners?
records.zomi: Pension ngahte adingin man om lo bus pass bangci-in ka ngen ding hiam?

records.english: Take your identity card and a photo to the town hall, and they'll make it while you wait.
records.zomi: Na ID card leh lim khat khuapi office ah tawi in, na ngak laitakin hong bawl sak ding uh hi.

records.english: Why did the village lose its train station?
records.zomi: Bang hangin khua in a meileng station a mansuah hiam?

records.english: Too few people used it, so the railway closed it and put on a bus instead.
records.zomi: A zang mi a tawm lua ahih manin meileng company in a khak a, a sikin bus khat a koih hi.

records.english: Students can use their school card as a bus pass after four o'clock.
records.zomi: Nai li khit ciangin sangnaupangte in a sang card bus pass-in a zang thei uh hi.

records.english: Let's take the community minibus to the market instead of paying for a taxi.
records.zomi: Taxi man pia sangin zuakna mun ah mipi minibus tuang ni.

records.english: We do hope the new train line will make trips to the hospital in the capital much easier.
records.zomi: Meileng lampi thak in gam khuapi lian-a zato pai a baihsak ding i lamen hi.

records.english: Everyone, keep your name badges on so that the city volunteers know which group you're with.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, khuapi thalawp nasemte in pawl bang ah na om hiam a theih theih nadingun na min badge bulh den un.

records.english: The trip to the regional court took a whole day, but the volunteer lawyer came with us.
records.zomi: Gam thukhenna inn pai ni bup a sau a, ahi zongin thalawp lawyer i tawh a pai hi.

records.english: My father had to travel to the capital to see a heart specialist, so the whole family helped pay for the trip.
records.zomi: Ka pa lungtang siavuan mu dingin gam khuapi lian ah a pai kul ahih manin innkuan bup in khualzinna man a piak huh uh hi.

records.english: All of you who are going to the job fair in the capital, meet at the town hall at six.
records.zomi: Gam khuapi lian-a nasep poai pai note khempeuh nai guk ciangin khuapi office ah kimu un.

records.english: Do they sell bus passes for visitors at the station in the city?
records.zomi: Khuapi station ah hong vehte adingin bus pass a zuak uh hiam?

records.english: Could you collect my mother's new glasses from the optician in town while you're there?
records.zomi: Khuapi ah na om laitakin mitlimlang bawlpa kiang pan ka nu' mitlimlang thak na la sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Would the youth club be able to borrow the church minibus for the trip to the capital?
records.zomi: Gam khuapi lian khualzinna adingin khangno pawl in pawlpi minibus a leitawi thei ding hiam?

records.english: When the train was canceled, a man from the tourist office found us seats on the evening bus.
records.zomi: Meileng a kiphiat ciangin khualzinte office pan pasal khat in nitak bus tungah tutna hong zong sak hi.

records.english: The help desk at the station printed us a map of the city with every bus route to the hospital.
records.zomi: Station huhna dawhkan in zato pai bus lampi khempeuh om khuapi map khat hong suaksak hi.

records.english: Our church choir traveled to the city for a competition, and the bus company gave us a discount.
records.zomi: I pawlpi la sa pawl kidemna adingin khuapi ah a pai a, bus company in man hong niamsak hi.

records.english: Had we known the city library was closed on Mondays, we would have gone on Tuesday.
records.zomi: Khuapi laibu inn Pizing ni ciangin kikhak hi, ci i theih leh Pithai ni ciangin i pai ding hi.

records.english: Shall I book the tickets at the travel agency, so that we can pay in cash?
records.zomi: Sum taktak tawh i piak theih nadingin khualzinna office ah ticket ka bawl ding hiam?

records.english: My neighbor's son, who works in the capital, met us at the station and took us to the clinic.
records.zomi: Gam khuapi lian ah na a sem ka inn veng' tapa in station ah hong dawn a, clinic ah hong paipih hi.

records.english: When we reached the capital, the volunteers from the refugee center were waiting with blankets and tea.
records.zomi: Gam khuapi lian i tun ciangin gam taimang inn pan thalawp nasemte puanzial leh tea tawh hong ngak uh hi.

records.english: What should I do if I get lost in the capital?
records.zomi: Gam khuapi lian ah lampi ka mansuah leh bang ka sem ding hiam?

records.english: Ask a police officer or go into any pharmacy, and they'll help you.
records.zomi: Police khat dong in hiam zatui dawl khatpeuh ah lut in, hong huh ding uh hi.

records.english: The mayor traveled to the capital with the petition, and the council finally got money for the bridge.
records.zomi: Khuapi ukpa in ngetna lai tawh gam khuapi lian ah a pai a, khuapi vaihawm in a tawp-in lei adingin sum a ngah hi.

records.english: Is it true that the city hospital has a special bus from the station?
records.zomi: Khuapi zato in station pan bus tuam khat a nei hi, cih a man hiam?

records.english: Thank you for letting my son stay with you while he takes his exams in the city.
records.zomi: Khuapi ah a sitna a bawl laitakin ka tapa na kiang ah na omsak manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Shall we ask the social worker whether the council can help with the travel costs?
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in khualzinna man ah a huh thei ding hiam mipi huhna nasempa i dong ding hiam?

records.english: Would you post this letter to my sister when you get to the city, since it'll arrive faster from there?
records.zomi: Tua pan a tung manlang zaw ding ahih manin khuapi na tun ciangin hih lai ka sanggam nu kiangah na khak sak ding hiam?

records.english: Why are you going to the city next week?
records.zomi: Bang hangin kal hong ding ciangin khuapi ah na pai ding hiam?

records.english: To collect my visa from the embassy and to visit my cousin in hospital.
records.zomi: Embassy pan ka visa la dingin leh zato-a ka sanggam veh dingin.

records.english: On the way back from the city, the bus stopped at every village so that the market traders could get off with their goods.
records.zomi: Khuapi pan ciahna lam ah zuakna mun zuakte a vante uh tawh a kiak theih nadingun bus khua khempeuh ah a khawl hi.

records.english: Is the city clinic open on Saturdays?
records.zomi: Khuapi clinic Kiginni ciangin a kihong hiam?

records.english: Only after three elders had traveled to the capital did the ministry agree to build a new school in the village.
records.zomi: Upa thum gam khuapi lian ah a pai khit uh ciangin bek ministry in khua ah sang thak lam dingin a lungkim hi.

records.english: My grandmother carried a letter from the village health worker to show the city doctors.
records.zomi: Ka pi in khuapi siavuante etsak dingin khua damna nasem' lai khat a tawi hi.

records.english: Can we take my uncle's medicine with us, in case the city pharmacy doesn't have it?
records.zomi: Khuapi zatui dawl in a nei kei kha leh ci-in ka pa neu' zatui i tawi thei ding hiam?

records.english: When my grandfather finally saw the capital, he said it was too noisy to think.
records.zomi: A tawp-in ka pu in gam khuapi lian a muh ciangin ngaihsun theih lo dong a buai hi, a ci hi.

records.english: The bus to the city was full of people going to hospitals, ministries, and markets.
records.zomi: Khuapi pai bus zato, ministry leh zuakna mun pai mite tawh a dim hi.

records.english: We brought back medicines from the city pharmacy for three families in our village.
records.zomi: I khua-a innkuan thum adingin khuapi zatui dawl pan zatui i tawi kik hi.

records.english: The council paid for the football team's bus to the national finals.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in gam bup kidemna tawpna ah football pawl' bus man a pia hi.

records.english: My little brother won a place on the school trip to the capital, and the whole street came to wave goodbye.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal in gam khuapi lian sang khualzinna ah mun khat a ngah a, lampi bup in goodbye ci-in khut vaai dingin a pai khia uh hi.

records.english: My cousin's whole village gave money so that she could travel to the city for her university interview.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu sangpi dotna adingin khuapi ah a pai theih nadingin a khua bup in sum a pia uh hi.

records.english: Why do the elders always bring a gift from the village when they visit the city officials?
records.zomi: Bang hangin upate in khuapi vaihawmte a veh ciangun khua pan letsong a tawi tawntung uh hiam?

records.english: Where do families stay when a child is treated at the city hospital?
records.zomi: Naupang khat khuapi zato ah damna a ngah laitakin innkuante koi ah a om uh hiam?

records.english: There's a small hostel next to the hospital, run by a charity, where parents can stay for free.
records.zomi: Zato kiang ah piakna pawl in a kem zinbuuk neu khat a om a, nu leh pate a man om lo-in a om thei uh hi.

records.english: Students, stay with your partner at the science museum and meet at the main door at two.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, science museum ah na lawm tawh om den unla nai nih ciangin kongkhak lian ah kimu un.

records.english: Grandma really does want to see the big church in the capital.
records.zomi: Pi in gam khuapi lian-a pawlpi lian a muh a deih taktak hi.

records.english: The women's cooperative sent two members to a fair in the city to sell their baskets.
records.zomi: Numei pawl dawl in a bawmte uh zuak dingin khuapi poai ah mi nih a sawl uh hi.

records.english: Kids, we're going to the museum first, and then we'll eat our packed lunches in the park.
records.zomi: Naupangte, a masa-in museum ah i pai ding a, tua khit ciangin huan ah i sun an thun i ne ding hi.

records.english: There may be a cheaper ticket if you show the letter from the hospital at the station.
records.zomi: Station ah zato lai na lak leh ticket man neu zaw khat om kha ding hi.

records.english: Let's call the hostel before we leave, so that they know we'll arrive late.
records.zomi: I nun ding a theih theih nadingun i pai ma-in hostel sam ni.

records.english: A day in the city taught my children how much our village relies on the bus.
records.zomi: Khuapi-a ni khat in ka tate i khua bus tung ah bangzah a kinga hiam a hilh hi.

records.english: So many people from our town now travel to the city for work that the council added an early bus.
records.zomi: I khuapi pan mi tampi tu-in nasep adingin khuapi ah a pai uh ahih manin khuapi vaihawm in zingsang manlang bus khat a behlap hi.

records.english: Bring your appointment letter, because the hospital won't see you without it.
records.zomi: Zato in a om lo-in hong mu lo ding ahih manin na kimuhna lai tawi in.

records.english: The trip to the city to collect our new identity cards was canceled when the office closed for a holiday.
records.zomi: Office tawlngakni adingin a kikhak ciangin i ID card thakte la dingin khuapi khualzinna kiphiat hi.

records.english: Could you show me how to buy a train ticket on this machine?
records.zomi: Hih machine tungah meileng ticket lei dan hong etsak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Using the city's transport app, my grandmother traveled across the capital by herself for the first time.
records.zomi: Khuapi mawtaw app zang-in ka pi a masa pen-in amah bek-in gam khuapi lian bup a khualzin hi.

records.english: Traveling to the city for treatment every month has worn my mother out, but she never complains.
records.zomi: Kha simin damna adingin khuapi ah khualzin in ka nu a gimsak a, ahi zongin a phunsan ngei kei hi.

records.english: The volunteers at the station looked after our luggage while we went to the hospital.
records.zomi: Zato ah i pai laitakin station-a thalawp nasemte in i vante a kem uh hi.

records.english: Can you ask at the tourist office where the cheapest place to stay is?
records.zomi: Om nading mun man neu pen koi ah om hiam khualzinte office ah na dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: We might need to stay overnight if the passport office in the regional city is busy.
records.zomi: Gam khuapi-a passport office a buai leh zan khat i om kul kha ding hi.

records.english: Our meeting at the ministry took only ten minutes.
records.zomi: Ministry-a i kikhopna minit sawm bek a sau hi.

records.english: My mother made me promise to call the minute I reached the hostel.
records.zomi: Hostel ka tun pah-in hong sam dingin ka nu in hong kiciamsak hi.

records.english: Our neighbor drove us to the airport at four in the morning and refused to take any money for fuel.
records.zomi: I inn veng in zingsang nai li ciangin vanlengtual ah hong paipih a, dat man a la nuam kei hi.

records.english: The first time I visited the city, I was so confused by the bus system that a stranger rode with me to my stop.
records.zomi: Khuapi ka veh masa pen-in bus lampite in hong buaisak lua ahih manin mi theih lo khat in ka khawlna dong hong zui hi.

records.english: Is there anyone in the city who could meet my son at the bus station?
records.zomi: Khuapi ah bus station ah ka tapa a dawn thei kuamah a om hiam?

records.english: The church there has a welcome team for young people arriving from the villages.
records.zomi: Tua-a pawlpi in khua pan hong tung khangnote adingin muakna pawl a nei hi.

records.english: The pilgrims' hostel by the church has housed travelers for more than a hundred years.
records.zomi: Pawlpi kiang-a biakna khualzinte' zinbuuk neu in kum za khat val khualzinte a omsak khin hi.

records.english: The town's youth hostel is cheap, clean, and run by volunteers from the youth club.
records.zomi: Khuapi khangno hostel in a man neu a, a siang a, khangno pawl pan thalawp nasemte in a kem uh hi.

records.english: The town's hotels agreed to keep two rooms free every night for emergencies.
records.zomi: Khuapi zinbuukte in haksatna hun adingin zan simin khan nih awng den dingin a kilem uh hi.

records.english: The volunteers made up the beds at the shelter and left a bar of soap on each pillow.
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte in om sakna mun-a lupnate a bawl uh a, lukhum khat ciat tungah satpiang khat a koih uh hi.

records.english: Families waiting for council housing sometimes stay in a hostel for months.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm inn ngak innkuante hun khenkhatah kha tampi sung hostel ah a om uh hi.

records.english: When the earthquake damaged the hostel, the guests were moved to the school gym for the night.
records.zomi: Ling in hostel a suksiat ciangin khualte zan khat adingin sang kimawlna inn lian ah kipemsak uh hi.

records.english: My little brother gave up his room so that the visiting student could have her own space.
records.zomi: Hong veh sangnaupang nu' amah mun a neih theih nadingin ka nau pasal in a khan a pia hi.

records.english: Let the housing office know as soon as the leak gets worse.
records.zomi: Tui zuh a sia semsem pah-in inn thu office kiangah gen in.

records.english: Would you mind sharing a room with another volunteer at the hostel?
records.zomi: Hostel ah thalawp nasem dang khat tawh khan na kihawm leh na lungkham ding hiam?

records.english: So comfortable was the little hostel run by the youth club that we stayed an extra night.
records.zomi: Khangno pawl' kem hostel neu a nuam lua ahih manin zan khat behlap i om hi.

records.english: The pastor had the old school building turned into rooms for families who had lost their homes.
records.zomi: Pastor in a inn a mansuah innkuante adingin sang inn lui khante-in a suaksak hi.

records.english: Shall I ask the housing office whether the flat near the clinic is still free?
