records.zomi: Clinic kiang-a inn a awng lai hiam inn thu office ka dong ding hiam?

records.english: Finding a room during the festival is almost impossible unless you book months ahead.
records.zomi: Kha tampi ma-in na bawl kei leh pawi laitakin khan muh a haksa mahmah hi.

records.english: The workers from the electricity company stayed at the village guesthouse while they repaired the lines.
records.zomi: Meivak company nasemte in meivak khaute a bawl laitakin khua zinbuuk neu ah a om uh hi.

records.english: Can the tourist office book us a room with a local family?
records.zomi: Khualzinte office in khua sung innkuan khat tawh khan khat hong bawl sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: We really do want visitors to feel welcome, so every guesthouse in town has a map of the clinic and the pharmacy.
records.zomi: Hong vehte kidawn a kisak ding uh i deih taktak ahih manin khuapi-a zinbuuk neu khempeuh in clinic leh zatui dawl map a nei uh hi.

records.english: Could you show the new family how to use the heating in the council flat?
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm inn-a lumna zat dan innkuan thak na etsak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Staying with a host family taught me more of the local language than any course.
records.zomi: Innkuan khat tawh om in kisinna khempeuh sangin khua pau tam zaw hong hilh hi.

records.english: Thank you for letting us stay with you after the flood — we'll never forget it.
records.zomi: Tuiciim khit ciangin na kiang ah hong omsak manin ka lungdam hi — i mangngilh ngei lo ding hi.

records.english: My cousin found a room in the student hostel through the university's housing office.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in sangpi inn thu office tungtawn-in sangnaupang hostel ah khan khat a mu hi.

records.english: Can we leave our bags at the tourist office while we look for a room?
records.zomi: Khan i zon laitakin khualzinte office ah i ip i nusia thei ding hiam?

records.english: The council's new rules mean that every guesthouse must have a fire alarm in each room.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm' thukhun thakte in zinbuuk neu khempeuh in khan khat ciat ah mei alarm a nei kul uh cihna ahi hi.

records.english: How do you become a host family for visiting students?
records.zomi: Hong veh sangnaupangte adingin om sakna innkuan bangci-in na suak hiam?

records.english: You fill in a form at the school, and someone visits your home to check it's suitable.
records.zomi: Sang ah lai khat na dimsak a, kuamah in a kilawm hiam en dingin na inn hong veh hi.

records.english: How long can people stay at the refugee reception center?
records.zomi: Gam taimang dawnna mun ah mite bangzah sung a om thei uh hiam?

records.english: Usually a few weeks, until the social workers find them a proper home.
records.zomi: A tam zaw kal tawmno, mipi huhna nasemte in inn kilawm khat a zon sak dong.

records.english: There may not be enough beds at the shelter tonight, because it's so cold.
records.zomi: Tu zanin a vot mahmah ahih manin om sakna mun ah lupna a cing kei kha ding hi.

records.english: Students, your host families will meet you at the community hall at five.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, na om sakna innkuan uh nai nga ciangin mipi inn lian ah hong dawn ding uh hi.

records.english: My grandmother offered her spare room to the young teacher who had nowhere to stay.
records.zomi: Ka pi in a omna ding om lo saya khangno adingin a khan awng a pia hi.

records.english: Is the church guesthouse only for people visiting the shrine?
records.zomi: Pawlpi zinbuuk neu mun siangtho hong vehte ading bek hiam?

records.english: We might be able to get a room at the hospital hostel if we call before noon.
records.zomi: Sun ma-in i sam leh zato hostel ah khan khat i ngah thei kha ding hi.

records.english: Do the seasonal workers have to pay for their beds at the farm hostel?
records.zomi: Kum hun nasemte in lo hostel ah a lupna man a pia kul uh hiam?

records.english: Is breakfast included at the church guesthouse?
records.zomi: Pawlpi zinbuuk neu ah zingsang an a kihel hiam?

records.english: Bread, tea, and eggs from the priest's own hens.
records.zomi: Moh, tea leh siampi' amah ak pan aktui.

records.english: My grandmother insists that guests at her guesthouse sign the visitors' book before they leave.
records.zomi: Ka pi in a zinbuuk neu-a khualte in a pai ma-un hong vehte laibu ah min a suaksak ding uh a ngiat hi.

records.english: Could the housing office send someone to fix the broken heater in our flat?
records.zomi: I inn-a heater siat bawl dingin inn thu office in kuamah a sawl thei ding hiam?

records.english: The guesthouse owner lent us her own umbrella when it started raining on our way to the station.
records.zomi: Station i pai lam ah guah a zuk kipat ciangin zinbuuk neu neinu in amah' khaupi hong leitawi hi.

records.english: A safe place to sleep is the first thing a town should offer anyone in trouble.
records.zomi: Ihmut nading mun bitna pen buaina nei mi khempeuh tungah khuapi in a piak masa ding ahi hi.

records.english: Where can a family stay if their home is flooded?
records.zomi: Innkuan khat' inn tui in a dimsak leh koi ah a om thei uh hiam?

records.english: The council opens the sports hall, and the Red Cross brings beds and blankets.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in kimawlna inn lian a hong a, Red Cross in lupna leh puanzial a tawi hi.

records.english: The seasonal workers stay in a hostel next to the orchards during the apple harvest.
records.zomi: Apple lak hun ciangin kum hun nasemte singgah huan kiang-a hostel ah a om uh hi.

records.english: Visitors aren't allowed to stay overnight at the shelter, so the volunteers go home at ten.
records.zomi: Hong vehte om sakna mun ah zan a giak thei kei uh ahih manin thalawp nasemte nai sawm ciangin inn ah a ciah uh hi.

records.english: The housing officer made the landlord repair the damp walls before we moved in.
records.zomi: Inn thu nasempa in i pem ma-in inn neipa bang dip a bawlsak hi.

records.english: Kids, the family we're hosting has had a long journey, so let them rest before you show them your toys.
records.zomi: Naupangte, i dawn innkuan khualzinna sau a nei uh ahih manin na tawngte uh na etsak ma-un tawlngak sak un.

records.english: After the fire, the council put our family in a small hotel until the house was safe again.
records.zomi: Mei kat khit ciangin inn a bit kik dong khuapi vaihawm in i innkuan zinbuuk neu khat ah a koih hi.

records.english: With help from the council, the old couple's house was adapted so that they could stay in it instead of moving to a care home.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm' huhna tawh upa zi leh pasal' inn upate kemna inn ah a pem kul loh nadingun kibawl kik hi.

records.english: All of you staying at the church guesthouse, breakfast is at seven and the doors are locked at ten.
records.zomi: Pawlpi zinbuuk neu-a om note khempeuh, zingsang an nai sagih ciangin ahi a, nai sawm ciangin kongkhak kikhak ding hi.

records.english: Let's ask the tourist office whether there's anywhere that takes dogs.
records.zomi: Ui a sang mun a om hiam khualzinte office dong ni.

records.english: Is there a cheaper place to stay for people visiting relatives in the hospital?
records.zomi: Zato-a beh leh phungte veh mite adingin om nading mun man neu zaw a om hiam?

records.english: Using the housing office's online form, we applied for a bigger flat in one evening.
records.zomi: Inn thu office' online lai zang-in nitak khat sungin inn lian zaw khat i ngen hi.

records.english: When the storm took off our roof, the neighbors took us in for two weeks.
records.zomi: Huihpi in i inn tung a lak ciangin inn vengte in kal nih sung hong dawn uh hi.

records.english: The hotel gave its empty rooms to the nurses who couldn't get home during the snowstorm.
records.zomi: Vuk huihpi laitakin inn a tung thei lo nurse te zinbuuk in a khan awngte a pia hi.

records.english: The council inspector had the hotel's kitchen cleaned before it was allowed to reopen.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm enkaktu in a kihon kik ma-in zinbuuk anbuk a siangsak sak hi.

records.english: Did the housing office ever answer your letter about the broken window?
records.zomi: Tawhkhawng kitam thu-a na lai inn thu office in a dawng ngei hiam?

records.english: If there's no room at the guesthouse, the priest says you can sleep in the church hall.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk neu ah mun a om kei leh pawlpi inn lian ah na ihmu thei hi, ci-in siampi in a gen hi.

records.english: Why are all the hotels full this weekend?
records.zomi: Bang hangin hih kal tawp zinbuuk khempeuh a dim uh hiam?

records.english: Is there a campsite near the lake that the council runs?
records.zomi: Dil kiang ah khuapi vaihawm' kem puan inn giakna mun a om hiam?

records.english: My neighbor rents rooms to visiting doctors, and she cooks them breakfast every morning.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng in hong veh siavuante khan a hal sak a, zingsang simin zingsang an a huan sak hi.

records.english: The family who hosted me during the exchange still keeps my room the way I left it.
records.zomi: Gamdang sang kilaih laitakin hong dawn innkuan in ka khan ka nusia bangin a kem lai uh hi.

records.english: The volunteers were so tired after setting up the beds in the sports hall that they slept on the mats themselves.
records.zomi: Kimawlna inn lian ah lupna a bawl khit uh ciangin thalawp nasemte a gim lua uh ahih manin phah tungah amau mah a ihmu uh hi.

records.english: Thank you for preparing all those meals for the new mothers — they really helped.
records.zomi: Naungek nu thakte adingin an tampi na bawl manin ka lungdam hi — hong huh mahmah uh hi.

records.english: The firefighter showed us how to put out a pan fire with a damp towel, never with water.
records.zomi: Mei mitsakpa in beel mei kat puan dip tawh mitsak dan hong etsak a, tui tawh ngei lo hi.

records.english: The market sellers were sent on a food safety course before they were allowed to cook at their stalls.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun zuakte a dawl uh ah an a huan theih ma-un an bitna kisinna ah kisawl uh hi.

records.english: The council had the community center's old stove replaced after it set off the smoke alarm twice.
records.zomi: Meikhu alarm vei nih a gingsak khit ciangin khuapi vaihawm in mipi inn' meibuk lui a laih sak hi.

records.english: Learning to cook at the community center gave my teenage son confidence he'd never had at school.
records.zomi: Mipi inn ah an huan a sin manin ka tapa khangno in sang ah a ngah ngei loh muanna a ngah hi.

records.english: When the cooking club visited the care home, the residents taught them their own recipes in return.
records.zomi: An huan pawl in upate kemna inn a veh ciangin upate in amau an huan dan a hilh kik uh hi.

records.english: The health worker taught the young mothers how to prepare baby food that would keep without a fridge.
records.zomi: Damna nasem in naungek nu khangnote khal bawm om lo-in a kem thei naungek an bawl dan a hilh hi.

records.english: My father learned to cook at the men's class after my mother became ill.
records.zomi: Ka nu a cina khit ciangin ka pa in pasal kilasi ah an huan a sin hi.

records.english: Who teaches the cooking class for men at the library?
records.zomi: Laibu inn ah pasalte' an huan kilasi kua in a hilh hiam?

records.english: A retired chef, who says most of his students have never boiled an egg.
records.zomi: An huanpa khawl khat, a sangnaupang tam zaw in aktui khat zong a tawng ngei kei uh hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Bring an apron and a container for your leftovers.
records.zomi: Puan khawng leh na an taang koihna khat tawi in.

records.english: So popular was the bread-making class that the community center had to start a waiting list.
records.zomi: Moh bawl kilasi a minthang lua ahih manin mipi inn in ngak list a kipat sak kul hi.

records.english: The doctor told my grandfather that cooking with less oil would help his heart.
records.zomi: Sathau tawm zaw tawh an huan in a lungtang a huh ding hi, ci-in siavuan in ka pu a hilh hi.

records.english: Why does the teacher always start the class by sharpening the knives?
records.zomi: Bang hangin saya in temte tat tawh kilasi a kipat sak tawntung hiam?

records.english: Every recipe in the clinic's booklet uses ingredients you can find at the village market.
records.zomi: Clinic laibu neu sung-a an huan dan khempeuh in khua zuakna mun-a muh theih vante a zang hi.

records.english: When the gas supply was cut, the community center cooked the festival meal on borrowed camping stoves.
records.zomi: Gas a kitan ciangin mipi inn in leitawi puan inn meibuk tawh pawi an a huan hi.

records.english: Shall we cook the beans tonight, so that they're ready for the shelter tomorrow?
records.zomi: Zingciang om sakna mun adingin a kiman theih nadingin tu zanin be i huan ding hiam?

records.english: Let's ask the school cook whether she'd teach the parents her famous lentil stew.
records.zomi: Sang an huannu in a minthang be an-tui nu leh pate a hilh ding hiam dong ni.

records.english: The library's cooking club turned its recipes into a little book and sold it to raise money for the children's ward.
records.zomi: Laibu inn an huan pawl in a an huan dante laibu neu khat-in a suaksak a, naupangte' ward adingin sum kaikhawm dingin a zuak uh hi.

records.english: At the health center's cooking class, patients with diabetes learn to make tasty meals with less sugar.
records.zomi: Damna inn-a an huan kilasi ah sung khum natna nei damlote in sugar tawm zaw tawh an lim bawl dan a sin uh hi.

records.english: We prepared a hundred sandwiches for the volunteers clearing the river, and every one was eaten.
records.zomi: Gun siangsak thalawp nasemte adingin sandwich za khat i bawl a, khempeuh kine hi.

records.english: Can I help prepare the vegetables for the community dinner, even though I'm not a member?
records.zomi: Pawl mi ka hih kei hangin mipi nitak an adingin anteh bawl ka huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: The scouts made enough soup to feed every family at the flood shelter.
records.zomi: Scout te in tuiciim om sakna mun-a innkuan khempeuh a vak zah an-tui a huan uh hi.

records.english: Can someone cut the vegetables for the old man at table four, since his hands shake?
records.zomi: A khut a ling ahih manin dawhkan nambat li-a pasal upa adingin kuamah in anteh a tan sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Would it help if the clinic gave out recipes along with the blood pressure leaflets?
records.zomi: Clinic in sisan natna laite tawh an huan dan a hawm leh a huh ding hiam?

records.english: Is it all right to bring my own knife to the cooking class?
records.zomi: An huan kilasi ah keimah' temte ka tawi leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: Students, the knives in the school kitchen must stay on the boards when you're not using them.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, na zat lai kei ciangun sang anbuk-a temte singphek tungah a om den kul hi.

records.english: The nutritionist had us weigh the rice on a kitchen scale to see how much we really eat.
records.zomi: An hoih siampa in bangzah i ne taktak hiam a muh theih nadingin anbuk bukna tawh buh hong buksak hi.

records.english: Everyone, wash your hands, tie back your hair, and put on an apron before we start.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, i kipat ma-in na khut uh sil unla, na sam uh khih unla, puan khawng silh un.

records.english: There's a chance the health center will run the class again in spring, if enough people sign up.
records.zomi: Mi a cing in a min a gelh uh leh damna inn in spring ciangin kilasi a bawl kik kha ding hi.

records.english: The health workers prepared a meal for the whole village to show how to cook beans with less fuel.
records.zomi: Sing tawm zaw tawh be huan dan lak dingin damna nasemte in khua bup adingin an a huan uh hi.

records.english: Using a thermometer, the health inspector checked that the chicken at the festival was properly cooked.
records.zomi: Thermometer zang-in damna enkaktu in pawi-a aksa a min hoih hiam a en hi.

records.english: My little sister burned the first batch of pancakes at the cooking club, and everyone laughed, including her.
records.zomi: An huan pawl ah ka nau numei in pancake masa pen a kangsak a, amah dong-in mi khempeuh a nui uh hi.

records.english: We might cook for the volunteers ourselves if the café can't send lunch.
records.zomi: Cafe in sun an a sawl thei kei leh thalawp nasemte adingin eimah in i huan kha ding hi.

records.english: Children aren't allowed near the stoves during the class, but they can help to wash the vegetables.
records.zomi: Kilasi laitakin naupangte meibuk kiang ah kiphal lo uh hi, ahi zongin anteh sil a huh thei uh hi.

records.english: The volunteers who prepared the harvest meal were thanked by name at the end of the evening.
records.zomi: Buh lak an a huan thalawp nasemte nitak tawp ciangin a min tawh lungdam kohna kipia uh hi.

records.english: How long should we cook the chicken so that it's safe?
records.zomi: Aksa a bit nadingin bangzah sau i huan ding hiam?

records.english: Until the juices run clear and the inside is no longer pink.
records.zomi: A tui a siang dong leh a sung a san nawn loh dong.

records.english: At the women's center, mothers swap recipes for cheap meals that still feel special.
records.zomi: Numei inn ah nute in man neu-a ahi zongin tuam-a kisa an huan dante a kihawm uh hi.

records.english: Can anyone join the cooking class at the community center?
records.zomi: Mipi inn-a an huan kilasi ah kuapeuh a kihel thei hiam?

records.english: Yes, and it's free for young parents, who learn to cook cheap, healthy dinners.
records.zomi: Thei hi, nu leh pa khangnote adingin man om lo a, man neu-a damna hoih nitak an huan a sin uh hi.

records.english: Did the fire service ever come back to give the kitchen safety talk?
records.zomi: Mei mitsak pawl in anbuk bitna thugen pia dingin a hong kik ngei hiam?

records.english: The cooking teacher made each of us taste the soup before and after adding salt, so that we'd notice the difference.
records.zomi: Cii kikhiatna i theih nadingin an huan saya in cii koih ma leh koih khit an-tui i khat ciat hong liimsak hi.

records.english: The council gave every family on our street a free fire blanket to keep in the kitchen.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in anbuk ah koih dingin i lampi-a innkuan khempeuh mei mitsakna puan khat a man om lo-in a pia hi.

records.english: My grandmother volunteers at the hospital kitchen, where she peels potatoes every Tuesday.
records.zomi: Ka pi in zato anbuk ah thalawp takin na a sem a, Pithai ni simin alu a phel hi.

records.english: Kids, you can each decorate one biscuit, and the rest will go to the old people's home.
records.zomi: Naupangte, note khat ciat in biscuit khat na zeem thei uh a, a taang upate inn ah kipia ding hi.

records.english: Could you show the new volunteers how to use the big rice cooker at the shelter?
records.zomi: Om sakna mun-a rice cooker lian zat dan thalawp nasem thakte na etsak thei ding hiam?

records.english: When the new kitchen at the youth club opened, the teenagers cooked a meal for their parents.
records.zomi: Khangno pawl' anbuk thak a kihon ciangin khangnote in a nu leh pa uh adingin an a huan uh hi.

records.english: Is it possible to make bread without an oven?
records.zomi: Oven om lo-in moh bawl thei hiam?

records.english: In a heavy pan with a lid, the way the teacher showed us last week.
records.zomi: A khuhna om beel gik khat sungah, kal bei-in saya in hong etsak bangin.

records.english: Could you bring your pressure cooker to the community lunch, since ours is broken?
records.zomi: I' a sia ahih manin mipi sun an ah na pressure cooker na tawi thei ding hiam?

records.english: Cooking classes at the community center are about more than food; they bring lonely people together.
records.zomi: Mipi inn-a an huan kilasite an bek hi lo-in kikhawmlum mite a kaikhawm hi.

records.english: Families who had just arrived in town taught the cooking class how to make dumplings from their home country.
records.zomi: Khuapi ah a tung thak innkuante in an huan kilasi kiangah amau gam sambuk bawl dan a hilh uh hi.

records.english: The scout troop prepared soup for the night shelter, using vegetables from the community garden.
records.zomi: Scout pawl in mipi huan pan anteh zang-in zan om sakna mun adingin an-tui a huan uh hi.

records.english: The class was moved to the church kitchen because the community center's ovens were being repaired.
records.zomi: Mipi inn' oven te kibawl kik ahih manin kilasi pawlpi anbuk ah kipemsak hi.

records.english: May I take some of the soup home for my mother, who couldn't come today?
records.zomi: Tuni-in a hong thei lo ka nu adingin an-tui tawmno inn ah ka tawi thei ding hiam?

records.english: Let the volunteers do the chopping, and you can stir the big pot.
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte in a tan uh hen, nang beel lian na sung thei hi.

records.english: My neighbor cooks extra rice every evening and leaves it in the community fridge for anyone who needs it.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng in nitak simin buh behlap a huan a, a kisam kuapeuh adingin mipi khal bawm sungah a koih hi.

records.english: Would the school let us use its kitchen on Saturdays for the parents' cooking club?
records.zomi: Nu leh pate' an huan pawl adingin Kiginni simin sang in a anbuk a zatsak ding hiam?

records.english: The chef from the hotel came to the school every Friday to help the students prepare lunch.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk pan an huanpa Laithai ni simin sangnaupangte' sun an bawl huh dingin sang ah a hong hi.

records.english: Please order your food at the counter and take a number to your table.
records.zomi: Dawhkan ah na an sap unla na dawhkan ah nambat khat la un.

records.english: Shall we order lunch from the community café, since the money goes to the youth club?
records.zomi: Sum khangno pawl ah a pai ahih manin mipi cafe pan sun an i sap ding hiam?

records.english: Does the hospital canteen stay open at night for visitors?
records.zomi: Zato canteen hong vehte adingin zanin a kihong hiam?

records.english: Only the drinks machine, but the nurses will usually find you a sandwich.
records.zomi: Dawn ding machine bek, ahi zongin nurse te in sandwich khat hong zong sak zel uh hi.

records.english: Every order at the community café comes with a smile, which costs nothing and means a lot.
records.zomi: Mipi cafe-a sapna khempeuh nuihna tawh a tung a, tua in bangmah a man kei a, a thupi mahmah hi.

records.english: What used to be the town's oldest bank is now its busiest community café, with a queue outside every morning.
records.zomi: Khuapi-a bank lui pen tu-in a buai pen mipi cafe ahi a, zingsang simin polam ah mi a kizom uh hi.

records.english: The nurse ordered a special soft meal for the patient who had just had an operation on her mouth.
records.zomi: Nurse in a kam khamna a bawl thak damlo nu adingin an nem tuam khat a sap hi.

records.english: How do the volunteers at the soup kitchen know how much food to order each week?
records.zomi: An-tui anbuk-a thalawp nasemte in kal khat-in an bangzah sap ding hiam bangci-in a thei uh hiam?

records.english: Because the hospital kitchen had mixed up the orders, my diabetic grandfather found himself looking at a slice of chocolate cake.
records.zomi: Zato anbuk in an sapnate a kihel sak manin sung khum natna nei ka pu in chocolate cake khat a mu hi.

records.english: The lunch club's orders are written in a notebook by the oldest member, who never forgets a name.
records.zomi: Sun an pawl' an sapnate min mangngilh ngei lo a upa pen in notebook sungah a gelh hi.

records.english: There might not be any lunch left at the canteen if we wait until the doctors finish their rounds.
records.zomi: Siavuante in a kawikawi uh a zawh dong i ngak leh canteen ah sun an a taang kei kha ding hi.

records.english: Thanks for ordering the food for the volunteers — it was exactly what everyone needed.
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte adingin an na sap manin ka lungdam hi — mi khempeuh' kisap tak ahi hi.

records.english: Is there a menu in large print for people with poor eyesight?
records.zomi: Mit muh siang lo mite adingin lai lian tawh menu a om hiam?

records.english: At the charity café, you can pay for an extra coffee so that someone who can't afford one gets it later.
records.zomi: Piakna cafe ah a lei zo lo mi khat in a nung ciangin a ngah theih nadingin kawfi behlap khat man na pia thei hi.

records.english: So many orders came in for the festival dumplings that the scouts asked their parents to help.
records.zomi: Pawi sambuk sapna a tam lua ahih manin scout te in a nu leh pa uh huh dingin a ngen uh hi.

records.english: What's the cheapest thing on the hospital canteen menu?
records.zomi: Zato canteen menu tungah a man neu pen bang ahi hiam?

records.english: The soup of the day, and it comes with free bread.
records.zomi: Tuni-a an-tui, moh man om lo tawh.

records.english: Could you order a taxi for Mrs. Lun after the lunch club, since her legs are bad today?
records.zomi: Tuni-in a khe a na ahih manin sun an pawl khit ciangin Mrs. Lun adingin taxi khat na sam sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: The library café lets people order a drink without buying food, so students can study there all afternoon.
records.zomi: Laibu inn cafe in an lei lo-in dawn ding bek sap a phal ahih manin sangnaupangte nitak bup tua ah a kisin thei uh hi.

records.english: Can someone help the old man at the counter, since he can't read the menu without his glasses?
records.zomi: A mitlimlang om lo-in menu a sim thei kei ahih manin dawhkan-a pasal upa kuamah in a huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Order the lunch special, because the money goes to the children's ward.
records.zomi: Sum naupangte' ward ah a pai ahih manin sun an tuam sap in.

records.english: My grandmother orders the same fish soup at the lunch club every Wednesday.
records.zomi: Ka pi in Nilai ni simin sun an pawl ah nga an-tui kibang mah a sap hi.

records.english: The town hall's canteen opened to the public, and now half the street eats lunch there.
records.zomi: Khuapi office' canteen mipi adingin a kihon a, tu-in lampi a kim tua ah sun an a ne uh hi.

records.english: The fire station's open day had a barbecue where the firefighters themselves took the orders.
records.zomi: Mei mitsakna inn hon ni-in sa khuk an a om a, mei mitsakte mah in an sapna a la uh hi.

records.english: Kids, choose your lunch from the picture menu, and point to it when you get to the counter.
records.zomi: Naupangte, lim menu pan na sun an uh teel unla, dawhkan na tun ciangun a lim lak un.

records.english: Would the school let us order hot meals for the children on the trip?
records.zomi: Khualzinna-a naupangte adingin an lum sap sang in a phal ding hiam?

records.english: My mother ordered a birthday cake for the night nurses who had looked after my father.
records.zomi: Ka nu in ka pa a kem zan nurse te adingin pianni cake khat a sap hi.

records.english: Hardly anyone ordered the new healthy menu at the canteen until the doctors started eating it too.
records.zomi: Siavuante in a nek kipat uh ma-in canteen-a damna menu thak kuamah in a sap kei uh hi.

records.english: Students, you can order your school lunches online, but only until nine o'clock.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, na sang sun an uh online tawh na sap thei uh a, ahi zongin nai kua dong bek.

records.english: Could the café deliver tea and biscuits to the town hall for the meeting on Thursday?
records.zomi: Laizing ni kikhopna adingin cafe in khuapi office ah tea leh biscuit a puak thei ding hiam?

records.english: No one at the community café is ever rushed to order, which is why the old people love it.
records.zomi: Mipi cafe ah kuamah in an sap dingin kinawhsak ngei lo ahih manin upate in a deih mahmah uh hi.

records.english: The scouts' food stall at the festival takes orders on a whiteboard and calls out names when the food is ready.
records.zomi: Pawi-a scout an dawl in whiteboard tungah sapnate a gelh a, an a kiman ciangin min a sam hi.

records.english: Let's order an extra meal for the security guard, since he's working all night.
records.zomi: Zan bup na a sep ding ahih manin kongpi kemtu adingin an behlap khat sap ni.

records.english: The canteen manager had the menu translated into three languages after complaints from patients' families.
records.zomi: Damlote' innkuan pan phunsanna a om khit ciangin canteen makaipa in menu pau thum tawh a let sak hi.

records.english: When you order at the charity café, the staff write your name on the cup and a kind message underneath.
records.zomi: Piakna cafe ah na sap ciangin nasemte in khuang tungah na min leh a nuai ah kammal hoih khat a gelh uh hi.

records.english: Children under ten aren't allowed to order energy drinks at the youth club café.
records.zomi: Khangno pawl cafe ah kum sawm nuai naupangte in energy drink a sap thei kei uh hi.

records.english: Run entirely by young people with learning disabilities, the community café serves what many say are the best cakes in town.
records.zomi: Sin baih lo khangnote in a kem mipi cafe in khuapi-a cake hoih pen a zuak hi, ci-in mi tampi in a gen uh hi.

records.english: Did you order the halal meals for the visiting families?
records.zomi: Hong veh innkuante adingin halal an na sap hiam?

records.english: Can I order on the phone and pick it up after my shift at the clinic?
records.zomi: Phone tawh ka sap inla clinic-a ka nasep khit ciangin ka la thei ding hiam?

records.english: My little brother ordered for the whole family at the festival stall and got every order right.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal in pawi dawl ah innkuan bup adingin a sap a, sapna khempeuh a man hi.

records.english: The council made every food stall at the market display its prices before taking orders.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in zuakna mun-a an dawl khempeuh in sapna a lak ma-un a man a lak dingin a sawl hi.

records.english: When the power went out, the café took orders by candlelight and served only cold food.
records.zomi: Meivak a kitan ciangin cafe in khawimeivaak tawh sapna a la a, an vot bek a pia hi.

records.english: Would you mind ordering for me, since I don't know what any of these dishes are?
records.zomi: Hih ante bang ahi hiam ka thei kei ahih manin kei adingin na sap sak leh na lungkham ding hiam?

records.english: Can I order a vegetarian meal for my mother while she's in the hospital?
records.zomi: Ka nu zato ah a om laitakin sa om lo an ka sap sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: The café on our corner gives a free meal to any child who comes in hungry after school.
records.zomi: I ki-ngawi mun-a cafe in sang khit ciangin gilkial-a hong lut naupang khatpeuh an a man om lo-in a pia hi.

records.english: How do I order meals for my father from the meals-on-wheels service?
records.zomi: An puakna pawl pan ka pa adingin an bangci-in ka sap ding hiam?

records.english: Fill in the weekly form at the town hall, and tick the days and dishes he wants.
records.zomi: Khuapi office ah kal sim lai dimsak inla, a deih ni leh ante tungah tel in.

records.english: Using the tablet by the bed, patients choose tomorrow's meals from the hospital menu.
records.zomi: Lupna kiang-a tablet zang-in damlote in zato menu pan zingciang ante a teel uh hi.

records.english: If the café can't deliver, we could send someone to collect the food for the meeting.
records.zomi: Cafe in a puak thei kei leh kikhopna adingin an la dingin kuamah i sawl thei hi.

records.english: Hot food isn't allowed in the library, so please finish your noodles outside.
records.zomi: Laibu inn ah an lum kiphal lo ahih manin na an-ngum polam ah ne zo in.

records.english: The café that hires refugees has a menu with dishes from six different countries.
records.zomi: Gam taimangte a sap cafe in gam guk pan an menu a nei hi.

records.english: Who orders the food for the church's Christmas lunch?
records.zomi: Pawlpi' Christmas sun an adingin kua in an a sap hiam?

records.english: The women's group, and they always order far too much.
records.zomi: Numei pawl, a tam lua-in a sap tawntung uh hi.

records.english: Is it all right to order just a cup of tea at the lunch club?
records.zomi: Sun an pawl ah tea khuang khat bek sap a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: The volunteers at the soup kitchen take orders for sandwiches to carry away for later.
records.zomi: An-tui anbuk-a thalawp nasemte in a nung ciang-a nek ding sandwich sapnate a la uh hi.

records.english: We ordered pizzas for the volunteers who had spent the day cleaning the river, and they cheered.
records.zomi: Ni bup gun a siangsak thalawp nasemte adingin pizza i sap a, a sam uh hi.

records.english: My cousin's job at the hospital is taking meal orders from the patients every morning.
records.zomi: Zato-a ka sanggam' nasep zingsang simin damlote kiang pan an sapna lak ahi hi.

records.english: Ordering at a community café feels different, because you know your money is helping someone.
records.zomi: Na sum in mi khat a huh hi, na theih manin mipi cafe ah sap a tuam hi.

records.english: Is it possible to order a cake from the bakery for the volunteers' party?
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte' pawi adingin moh bawlna inn pan cake khat sap theih ding hiam?

records.english: Can we order the food for the clinic's opening from the women's cooperative?
records.zomi: Clinic honna an numei pawl dawl pan i sap thei ding hiam?

records.english: Can we host the blood drive in the school hall during the holidays?
records.zomi: Tawlngakni laitakin sang inn lian ah sisan piakna i bawl thei ding hiam?

records.english: The women's cooperative hosted a market for visitors and sold every basket in two hours.
records.zomi: Numei pawl dawl in hong vehte adingin zuakna mun a bawl a, nai nih sungin bawm khempeuh a zuak bei hi.

records.english: The town's guests were taken on a tour of the new clinic, the school, and the water plant.
records.zomi: Khuapi' khualte clinic thak, sang leh tui bawlna mun et dingin kipaipih uh hi.

records.english: The volunteers who hosted the flood victims at the sports hall cooked three meals a day for a week.
records.zomi: Kimawlna inn lian ah tuiciim thuakte a dawn thalawp nasemte in kal khat sung ni khat-in an thum vei a huan uh hi.

records.english: Could the hall stay open later on Saturday for the farewell dinner?
records.zomi: Kiginni ciangin kikhenna nitak an adingin inn lian a nun zawin a kihong thei ding hiam?

records.english: My neighbor cooked dinner for the electricity workers who had been repairing the lines all day.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng in ni bup meivak khaute a bawl meivak nasemte adingin nitak an a huan hi.

records.english: Our town hosted a delegation from its twin town, and families took the visitors into their homes for a week.
records.zomi: I khuapi in a kithuah khuapi pan pawl khat a dawn a, innkuante in kal khat sung hong vehte a inn uh ah a dawn uh hi.

records.english: No one who comes to the community lunch is ever asked to pay, though many leave something in the box.
records.zomi: Mipi sun an ah hong kuapeuh kiangah sum ngen ngei lo a, ahi zongin mi tampi in bawm sungah bangmah a nusia uh hi.

records.english: Guests who came to the opening of the community garden went home with a bag of tomatoes each.
records.zomi: Mipi huan honna ah hong khualte khamtung ip khat ciat tawh inn ah a ciah uh hi.

records.english: Could someone meet the visiting doctors at the station and bring them to the guesthouse?
records.zomi: Hong veh siavuante station ah kuamah in a dawn a, zinbuuk neu ah a paipih thei ding hiam?

records.english: The health workers were so well looked after at the village meeting that they forgot to leave on time.
records.zomi: Khua kikhopna ah damna nasemte hoih mahmah-in kikem ahih manin a hun takah pai ding a mangngilh uh hi.

records.english: How many guests can the community hall hold?
records.zomi: Mipi inn lian in khual bangzah a tun thei hiam?

records.english: About two hundred, but the fire officer says no more than that.
records.zomi: Za nih bang, ahi zongin tua sangin tam lo ding hi, ci-in mei mitsak makai in a gen hi.

records.english: Hosting the regional choir festival meant that almost every family in our town had a stranger sleeping in the spare room.
records.zomi: Gam la sa pawl pawi i dawn in i khuapi-a innkuan khempeuh bang in a khan awng ah mi theih lo khat a ihmu hi.

records.english: Kids, the visitors from the refugee center are coming to lunch, so please set four extra places.
records.zomi: Naupangte, gam taimang inn pan hong vehte sun an ah hong pai ding uh ahih manin mun li behlap bawl un.

records.english: Using the church's loudspeaker, the pastor welcomed the visiting families in their own language.
records.zomi: Pawlpi' aw-sanna zang-in pastor in hong veh innkuante amau pau tawh a muak hi.

records.english: Hosting the doctors from the city taught our children that a guest can become a friend for life.
records.zomi: Khuapi pan siavuante i dawn in i tate in khual khat nuntak sung lawm suak thei hi, cih a hilh hi.

records.english: What do people in your village do when important guests visit?
records.zomi: Khual thupi te hong veh ciangin na khua mite bang a sem uh hiam?

records.english: The elders welcome them at the gate, and every family brings one dish to the meeting house.
records.zomi: Upate in kongpi ah a muak uh a, innkuan khempeuh in kikhopna inn ah an khat ciat a tawi uh hi.

records.english: Visitors aren't allowed into the kitchen at the community lunch, so please wait at your tables.
records.zomi: Mipi sun an ah hong vehte anbuk ah kiphal lo ahih manin na dawhkan uh ah ngak un.

records.english: The library hosted a reading by a local author, and the room was so full that people stood in the corridor.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in khua sung laibu gelhpa khat in a sim a, khan a dim lua ahih manin mite lampi khan ah a ding uh hi.

records.english: Why does the community center always put fresh flowers on the tables for guests?
records.zomi: Bang hangin mipi inn in khualte adingin dawhkan tungah pak thak a koih tawntung hiam?

records.english: Who's hosting the regional meeting of health workers this year?
records.zomi: Tu kum damna nasemte' gam kikhopna kua in a dawn ding hiam?

records.english: Our village, so the women's group is cooking lunch for sixty people.
records.zomi: I khua, tua ahih manin numei pawl in mi sawmguk adingin sun an a huan uh hi.

records.english: Students, please take our guests from the twin school to the library after lunch.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, sun an khit ciangin kithuah sang pan i khualte laibu inn ah paipih un.

records.english: My parents hosted the school's exchange teacher, who taught them to make bread from her country.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in sang' gamdang saya nu a dawn uh a, amah in a gam moh bawl dan a hilh hi.

records.english: My grandfather insisted on giving each of the visiting volunteers a jar of his honey.
records.zomi: Ka pu in hong veh thalawp nasemte khat ciat a khuaizu bel khat piak a ngiat hi.

records.english: Could your family host the visiting nurse for the two weeks she's working at the clinic?
records.zomi: Clinic ah kal nih na a sep sungin hong veh nurse na innkuan in a dawn thei ding hiam?

records.english: So warm was the welcome from the village that the visiting doctors asked to come back the following year.
records.zomi: Khua' muakna a lum lua ahih manin hong veh siavuante in a kum zom ciangin hong pai kik nuam uh a ci uh hi.

records.english: The visiting students were so moved by the welcome dinner that they sang a song from their country.
records.zomi: Hong veh sangnaupangte muakna nitak an in a lungsim uh a khoih lua ahih manin amau gam la khat a sa uh hi.

records.english: Did the visitors from the coast enjoy the fish we cooked for them?
records.zomi: Tuipi gei pan hong vehte in i huan sak nga a nuam sa uh hiam?

records.english: Thank you for hosting the volunteers — they said they've never been treated so kindly.
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte na dawn manin ka lungdam hi — hih bang hehpihna a ngah ngei kei uh hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: Everyone, our guests from the city will arrive at six, so the tea needs to be ready by half past five.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, khuapi pan i khualte nai guk ciangin hong tung ding uh ahih manin nai nga leh a kim ciangin tea kiman khin ding hi.

records.english: When the bishop came to visit, the parish hall was cleaned, painted, and filled with flowers.
records.zomi: Bishop hong veh ciangin pawlpi inn lian kisiangsak a, lim kikhai a, pak tawh kidimsak hi.

records.english: Please don't take photos of the guests from the refugee center without asking them first.
records.zomi: Gam taimang inn pan khualte dong masa lo-in a lim la kei un.

records.english: The fire brigade's open day was so popular that they ran out of lemonade by noon.
records.zomi: Mei mitsak pawl' hon ni minthang lua ahih manin sun ma-in lemonade a bei hi.

records.english: Let's write a card in their language for the visiting families.
records.zomi: Hong veh innkuante adingin amau pau tawh card khat gelh ni.

records.english: Would the youth club like to help us host the senior citizens' dance?
records.zomi: Upate' lam poai dawn nadingin khangno pawl in hong huh nuam ding uh hiam?

records.english: Is there anything the visitors can't eat?
records.zomi: Hong vehte in a ne thei lo bangmah a om hiam?

records.english: The pastor made the youth group serve the guests first and eat last.
records.zomi: Pastor in khangno pawl in khualte a masa-in a piak uh a, a nunung pen-in a nek dingin a sawl hi.

records.english: There may be room for a few more guests at the community lunch if some people don't come.
records.zomi: Mi khenkhatte a hong kei leh mipi sun an ah khual tawmno behlap adingin mun om kha ding hi.

records.english: We might host the youth choir from the coast if enough families offer a bed.
records.zomi: Innkuan cing in lupna a piak uh leh tuipi gei pan khangno la sa pawl i dawn kha ding hi.

records.english: Would it be possible to borrow the church's tables for the street party?
records.zomi: Lampi pawi adingin pawlpi dawhkante i leitawi thei ding hiam?

records.english: The council had the town square decorated before the visitors from the twin town arrived.
records.zomi: Kithuah khuapi pan hong vehte a tun ma-un khuapi vaihawm in khuapi laizang a zeemsak hi.

records.english: Let's offer the visiting firefighters a meal at the station before they drive home.
records.zomi: Hong veh mei mitsakte inn a ciah ma-un station ah an pia ni.

records.english: How does the council choose families to host the visitors from the twin town?
records.zomi: Kithuah khuapi pan hong vehte dawn ding innkuante khuapi vaihawm in bangci-in a teel hiam?

records.english: Families sign up at the town hall, and a volunteer visits each home first.
records.zomi: Innkuante khuapi office ah a min a gelh uh a, thalawp nasem khat in inn khat ciat a veh masa hi.

records.english: The community center hosts a Christmas lunch for everyone who would otherwise eat alone.
records.zomi: Mipi inn in a bek-in an ne ding mi khempeuh adingin Christmas sun an a bawl hi.

records.english: Shall I prepare the spare room for the social worker who's staying overnight?
records.zomi: Zan bup a om ding mipi huhna nasempa adingin khan awng ka bawl ding hiam?

records.english: Shall we ask the school whether we can host the parents' meeting in the gym?
records.zomi: Kimawlna inn lian ah nu leh pate' kikhopna i bawl thei ding hiam sang i dong ding hiam?

records.english: Is it all right if the visiting volunteers sleep in the church hall?
records.zomi: Hong veh thalawp nasemte pawlpi inn lian ah a ihmut uh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: The youth club hosted a games night for the children staying at the shelter.
records.zomi: Khangno pawl in om sakna mun-a om naupangte adingin kimawlna zan khat a bawl hi.

records.english: The day our cooperative was asked to host the governor's lunch was the proudest in its history.
records.zomi: I pawl dawl in governor' sun an dawn dingin a kingen ni pen a tangthu sung-a kisaktheih pen ni ahi hi.

records.english: My grandmother hosted the new pastor's family for a month while the parish house was repaired.
records.zomi: Pawlpi inn kibawl kik laitakin ka pi in pastor thak' innkuan kha khat sung a dawn hi.

records.english: Children under twelve can't attend the evening reception unless an adult comes with them.
records.zomi: Upa khat a zuih kei leh kum sawm leh nih nuai naupangte nitak dawnna ah a kihel thei kei uh hi.

records.english: The mayor made sure every visitor to the festival was given a map and a free drink.
records.zomi: Khuapi ukpa nu in pawi hong veh khempeuh map khat leh dawn ding khat a man om lo-in a ngah uh hiam a en hi.

records.english: When the school hosted the district football tournament, parents cooked for twelve teams.
records.zomi: Sang in gam football kidemna a dawn ciangin nu leh pate in pawl sawm leh nih adingin an a huan uh hi.

records.english: When the bus carrying the visitors broke down, the whole village drove out to fetch them.
records.zomi: Hong vehte puak bus a siat ciangin khua bup in la dingin mawtaw a mawng khia uh hi.

records.english: A town that welcomes visitors well often finds that they return to help it.
records.zomi: Hong vehte hoih taka a muak khuapi in amaute a huh dingin a hong kik uh cih a mu zel hi.

records.english: The librarian said, "Our author visit is free, so bring the whole family and plenty of questions."
records.zomi: Laibu inn kemnu in, “I laibu gelhpa veh man om lo ahih manin innkuan bup leh dotna tampi tawi un,” a ci hi.

records.english: Respecting what people can and can't eat is part of making them feel welcome.
records.zomi: Mite' nek theih leh nek theih lohte zahtak pen a kidawn a kisak nadan tan khat ahi hi.

records.english: When the food bank received fresh fruit for the first time, the children took it before anything else.
records.zomi: An kaikhawmna mun in a masa pen-in singgah thak a ngah ciangin naupangte in na dang ma-in a la uh hi.

records.english: The volunteers learned that most people at the soup kitchen preferred hot drinks to cold ones, even in summer.
records.zomi: An-tui anbuk-a mi tam zaw in khal hun zongin dawn ding vot sangin lum a deih zaw uh hi, ci-in thalawp nasemte in a thei uh hi.

records.english: Why do the children at the shelter always ask for noodles?
records.zomi: Bang hangin om sakna mun-a naupangte in an-ngum a ngen tawntung uh hiam?

records.english: Because noodles remind them of home, the social worker thinks.
records.zomi: An-ngum in a inn uh a phawksak ahih manin, ci-in mipi huhna nasempa in a ngaihsun hi.

records.english: My mother cooks without salt for my father, so the community center gave her a book of low-salt recipes.
records.zomi: Ka nu in ka pa adingin cii om lo-in an a huan ahih manin mipi inn in cii tawm an huan dan laibu khat a pia hi.

records.english: My cousin works at the hospital kitchen and cooks for patients who can't eat anything solid.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam zato anbuk ah na a sem a, a hak bangmah ne thei lo damlote adingin an a huan hi.

records.english: The headmaster had a water fountain put in the playground so that children would drink less soda.
records.zomi: Naupangte in soda a dawn tawm zawk nadingun sang makaipa in kimawlna mun ah tui dawnna khat a koih sak hi.

records.english: Do you know whether the hospital can make halal meals?
records.zomi: Zato in halal an a bawl thei hiam na thei hiam?

records.english: The food bank now asks every family whether there's anything they can't eat before packing their parcel.
records.zomi: An kaikhawmna mun in tu-in a ip uh a thun ma-in innkuan khempeuh kiangah a ne thei lo bangmah a om hiam a dong hi.

records.english: The church dinner was planned around what the oldest members could eat, so nothing was too hard or too spicy.
records.zomi: Pawlpi nitak an pen a upa pente' nek theih tawh kigel ahih manin bangmah a hak lua kei a, a hai lua kei hi.

records.english: Did the lunch club ever find out why nobody liked the new fish dish?
records.zomi: Bang hangin nga an thak kuamah in a deih kei uh hiam sun an pawl in a thei ngei hiam?

records.english: Is there a vegetarian option at the town's festival dinner?
records.zomi: Khuapi pawi nitak an ah sa om lo an a om hiam?

records.english: The community nurse asked my grandfather to give up salt, and he said he'd rather give up the nurse.
records.zomi: Mipi nurse in ka pu cii nusia dingin a ngen a, amah in nurse nusia ka deih zaw hi, a ci hi.

records.english: What do the refugee families most miss from home?
records.zomi: Gam taimang innkuante in a inn uh pan bang a ngaih pen uh hiam?

records.english: Fresh herbs and the bread their mothers used to bake, they told us.
records.zomi: An-lim-nah thak leh a nu uh' bawl ngei moh, hong ci uh hi.

records.english: My grandfather made the hospital kitchen send up chili sauce, because he said the food had no taste.
records.zomi: An in lim a nei kei hi, a cih manin ka pu in zato anbuk pan malcha tui a sawlsak hi.

records.english: At the care home, my grandmother is allowed to choose rice porridge instead of bread for breakfast.
records.zomi: Upate kemna inn ah ka pi in zingsang an-in moh sangin buh-an tui a teel thei hi.

records.english: Our community garden grows the herbs that the refugee families asked for.
records.zomi: I mipi huan in gam taimang innkuante' ngen an-lim-nah a suan hi.

records.english: Before changing the school menu, the council took the trouble to ask parents what their children actually liked to eat.
records.zomi: Sang menu a khel ma-in khuapi vaihawm in a tate uh in bang a deih taktak uh hiam nu leh pate a dong hi.

records.english: Kids, you don't have to finish everything, but please try one spoonful of each dish.
records.zomi: Naupangte, khempeuh na ne zo kul kei uh hi, ahi zongin an khat ciat kawm khat liim un.

records.english: Would you ask the café whether they can make the sandwich without onions?
records.zomi: Cafe kiangah lothaang om lo-in sandwich a bawl thei hiam na dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: The new market sells food from many countries, so everyone finds something they like.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun thak in gam tampi pan an a zuak ahih manin mi khempeuh in a deih uh a mu uh hi.

records.english: May I bring my own food to the community lunch, since I'm on a special diet?
records.zomi: An tuam ka ne ahih manin mipi sun an ah keima' an ka tawi thei ding hiam?

records.english: Fried food was taken off the hospital canteen menu after the doctors complained.
records.zomi: Siavuante in a phunsan uh khit ciangin zato canteen menu pan an kikang kila hi.

records.english: A survey was carried out in the town to find out what people wanted the new market to sell.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun thak in bang a zuak ding mite in a deih uh hiam theih nadingin khuapi ah dotna kibawl hi.

records.english: Peanuts are banned at the community nursery because two of the children have allergies.
records.zomi: Naupang nih in a kituak loh manun mipi nursery ah bekang kiphal lo hi.

records.english: Is there anything at the festival that's safe for someone with a nut allergy?
records.zomi: Pawi ah thei kituak lo mi khat adingin bitna bangmah a om hiam?

records.english: My little brother refuses anything green, even at the school lunch.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal in sang sun an ah zong eng bangmah a ne nuam kei hi.

records.english: Can someone ask the old man at table two how he likes his tea?
records.zomi: Dawhkan nambat nih-a pasal upa kiangah a tea bangci-in a deih hiam kuamah in a dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: The canteen's spicy fish was so popular with the night-shift nurses that it was kept on the menu all year.
records.zomi: Canteen' nga hai zan nasep nurse te' deih lua ahih manin kum bup menu tungah a om hi.

records.english: Children aren't allowed to swap lunches at the nursery, in case of allergies.
records.zomi: Kituak lohna a om kha ding ahih manin nursery ah naupangte in sun an a kilaih thei kei uh hi.

records.english: Had the council asked the market sellers first, it would have known that nobody wanted the new food court.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in zuakna mun zuakte a dong masa leh an nekna mun thak kuamah in a deih kei uh hi, a thei ding hi.

records.english: Shall I ask the caterer for more fruit and fewer cakes at the volunteers' party?
records.zomi: Thalawp nasemte' pawi ah cake tawm zaw leh singgah tam zaw an bawlpa kiangah ka ngen ding hiam?

records.english: Students, tell the canteen staff if a dish is too spicy, and they'll make a milder version.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, an khat a hai lua leh canteen nasemte kiangah gen un, a hai lo khat a bawl ding uh hi.

records.english: My aunt says the hospital soup is the only thing she misses about her stay there.
records.zomi: Zato an-tui bek a om sung pan ka ngaih hi, ci-in ka ni in a gen hi.

records.english: Is it all right to ask the school for a lunch without dairy for my son?
records.zomi: Ka tapa adingin nawi om lo sun an sang kiangah ngen a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: The soup was so salty that the volunteers made a second pot for the people with heart problems.
records.zomi: An-tui a al lua ahih manin lungtang natna nei mite adingin thalawp nasemte in beel dang khat a huan uh hi.

records.english: Thanks to the nutrition class, my mother now buys more vegetables than meat.
records.zomi: An hoih kilasi hang-in ka nu in tu-in sa sangin anteh tam zaw a lei hi.

records.english: Feeding a whole town is easier when you listen to what people actually like to eat.
records.zomi: Mite in bang a deih taktak uh hiam na ngaih ciangin khuapi bup vak a baih zaw hi.

records.english: My neighbor brings the pastor a jar of pickled vegetables every Sunday, because she knows he loves them.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng in pastor in a deih mahmah a theih manin Nipini simin anteh thuk bel khat a tawi sak hi.

records.english: No sugary drinks are sold at the youth club, so the kids bring water bottles instead.
records.zomi: Khangno pawl ah dawn ding khum zuak lo ahih manin naupangte in tui bel a tawi uh hi.

records.english: How do the cooks at the care home remember everyone's likes and dislikes?
records.zomi: Upate kemna inn an huante in mi khempeuh' deih leh deih lohte bangci-in a phawk uh hiam?

records.english: Each resident has a little card with their favorites written on it.
records.zomi: A om mi khat ciat in a deih pente kigelhna card neu khat a nei uh hi.

records.english: The community café keeps a small notebook where customers can suggest new cakes.
records.zomi: Mipi cafe in van leite in cake thak gen theihna notebook neu khat a kem hi.

records.english: Can the shelter provide meals without pork for the families who don't eat it?
records.zomi: Om sakna mun in vok sa ne lo innkuante adingin vok sa om lo an a pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, and the cook keeps a list of everyone's needs on the kitchen wall.
records.zomi: Thei hi, an huanpa in mi khempeuh' kisapna list anbuk bang tungah a kem hi.

records.english: So strongly did the residents dislike the new care-home menu that the manager brought back the old one within a week.
records.zomi: Upate kemna inn-a omte in menu thak a huat lua uh ahih manin makaipa in kal khat sungin a lui a koih kik hi.

records.english: Please don't give the dogs at the shelter any leftover food from the barbecue.
records.zomi: Om sakna mun-a uite sa khuk an taang pia kei un.

records.english: Do the old people at the lunch club prefer soup or a full meal?
records.zomi: Sun an pawl-a upate in an-tui a deih zaw uh hiam, an bup hiam?

records.english: When the school menu was changed, half the children stopped eating the lunch until the cooks added rice again.
records.zomi: Sang menu a kikhel ciangin an huante in buh a behlap kik uh dong naupangte' a kim in sun an a ne nawn kei uh hi.

records.english: The nurse said, "Your father can eat anything he likes, as long as it's soft."
records.zomi: Nurse in, “Na pa in a nem phial leh a deih bangbang a ne thei hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: Everyone, please write on the form if you have any allergies, so that the caterers can plan.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, an bawlpate in a gel theih nadingun na kituak lohna a om leh lai tungah gelh un.

records.english: My daughter, who's a vegetarian, helps the community kitchen think of new dishes without meat.
records.zomi: Sa ne lo ka tanu in mipi anbuk sa om lo an thak a ngaihsut nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Could the food bank give us lentils instead of pasta, since my children won't eat pasta?
records.zomi: Ka tate in pasta a ne nuam kei uh ahih manin an kaikhawmna mun in pasta sangin be hong pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: The volunteers cooked a separate pot of mild curry for the children at the community dinner.
records.zomi: Mipi nitak an ah thalawp nasemte in naupangte adingin curry a hai lo beel tuam khat a huan uh hi.

records.english: Would the clinic's nutritionist see my son, who eats almost nothing but bread?
records.zomi: Moh bek tua lo bangmah a ne kei ka tapa clinic' an hoih siampa in a mu thei ding hiam?

records.english: The festival cooks put the meat and the vegetable dishes on different tables.
records.zomi: Pawi an huante in sa an leh anteh an dawhkan tuam ciat ah a koih uh hi.

records.english: There's a chance the school will offer breakfast too, if enough parents ask for it.
records.zomi: Nu leh pa cing in a ngen uh leh sang in zingsang an zong a pia kha ding hi.

records.english: The health worker asked each family what they usually ate, and then suggested small changes.
records.zomi: Damna nasem in innkuan khat ciat in bang a ne zel uh hiam a dong a, tua khit ciangin kikhelna neute a gen hi.

records.english: When the council held a food heritage fair, every village sent its best traditional dish.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in an ngeina poai a bawl ciangin khua khempeuh in a ngeina an hoih pen a sawl uh hi.

records.english: Who keeps the recipes for the parish's traditional Christmas meal?
records.zomi: Pawlpi' Christmas ngeina an huan dante kua in a kem hiam?

records.english: The oldest member of the women's group, in a notebook nobody else is allowed to touch.
records.zomi: Numei pawl-a upa pen, mi dang khoih phal lo notebook khat sungah.

records.english: Would the museum like my great-grandmother's old cooking pot for the exhibition?
records.zomi: Lim etsakna adingin ka pu' nu' an huanna beel lui museum in a deih ding hiam?

records.english: The old women in the cooking club had the young cooks grind the spices by hand, the old way.
records.zomi: An huan pawl-a numei upate in an huan khangnote in ngeina lui bangin an-lim-nah khut tawh a sumsak uh hi.

records.english: The refugee families cooked a meal from their homeland for the whole street at the community hall.
records.zomi: Gam taimang innkuante in mipi inn lian ah lampi bup adingin a gam uh an a huan uh hi.

records.english: The village feast was moved to the school hall when the rain began, but the food was cooked outside as always.
records.zomi: Guah a zuk kipat ciangin khua poai sang inn lian ah kipem a, ahi zongin a tawntung bangin an polam ah kihuan hi.

records.english: The care home's residents voted for the dish they missed most, and the cooks made it on Sunday.
records.zomi: Upate kemna inn-a omte in a ngaih pen an vote a piak uh a, an huante in Nipini ciangin a huan uh hi.

records.english: Keeping old recipes alive is one way a community remembers who it is.
records.zomi: Ngeina an huan dan luite a nungsak pen mipi khat in amau hihna a phawk nadan khat ahi hi.

records.english: My mother cried when the hospital let her cook my grandfather's favorite dish in the staff kitchen.
records.zomi: Zato in nasemte' anbuk ah ka pu' an deih pen huan dingin a phal ciangin ka nu a kap hi.

records.english: Our family's New Year noodles were chosen to be cooked at the town festival this year.
records.zomi: Tu kum i innkuan' Kum Thak an-ngum khuapi pawi ah huan dingin kiteel hi.

records.english: No one at our community dinner starts eating until the oldest person has been served.
records.zomi: I mipi nitak an ah a upa pen a ngah ma-in kuamah in a ne kipan kei uh hi.

records.english: Students, interview someone in your family about a dish they cooked as a child, and bring the recipe to class.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, na innkuan sung mi khat kiangah a neu lai-a a huan an thu dong unla, a huan dan kilasi ah tawi un.

records.english: Every week, the community radio invites a grandmother to share one family recipe on air.
records.zomi: Kal simin mipi radio in pi khat a innkuan an huan dan khat radio tungah gen dingin a sam hi.

records.english: Children mustn't touch the festival pots until the elders have tasted the food.
records.zomi: Upate in an a liim ma-un naupangte in pawi beelte a khoih kei ding uh hi.

records.english: When the old baker retired, the cooperative bought his recipes so that the village bread would survive.
records.zomi: Moh bawlpa upa a khawl ciangin khua moh a om den nadingin pawl dawl in a moh bawl dante a lei hi.

records.english: Why do the oldest dishes always taste the best at festivals?
records.zomi: Bang hangin pawi ah an lui pente a lim pen tawntung hiam?

records.english: Please don't add sugar to the festival rice; the elders say it isn't done that way.
records.zomi: Pawi buh ah sugar koih kei un; tua bangin kibawl ngei lo hi, ci-in upate in a gen uh hi.

records.english: There might be a cooking class for the traditional dishes if enough young people sign up.
records.zomi: Khangno cing in a min a gelh uh leh ngeina an huan kilasi om kha ding hi.

records.english: Kids, the old woman from the care home is going to show you how she makes rice cakes, so watch carefully.
records.zomi: Naupangte, upate kemna inn pan numei upa in buh moh a bawl dan hong etsak ding ahih manin limtakin en un.

records.english: My father had the old family recipes typed up and sent to the library archive.
records.zomi: Ka pa in innkuan an huan dan luite a suaksak a, laibu inn lai kemna ah a khak hi.

records.english: Why does your family eat fish soup on the night before a wedding?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na innkuan in kiteenna zan ma-in nga an-tui a ne uh hiam?

records.english: My father says it's for good luck, though nobody remembers when it started.
records.zomi: Vangphatna adingin hi, ci-in ka pa in a gen a, ahi zongin bang hun pan a kipan hiam kuamah in a phawk kei uh hi.

records.english: Is there anyone at the care home who still knows how to make the old harvest porridge?
records.zomi: Upate kemna inn ah buh lak buh-an tui lui bawl dan a thei lai kuamah a om hiam?

records.english: Mrs. Niang does, and she's offered to teach the kitchen staff next week.
records.zomi: Mrs. Niang in a thei a, kal hong ding ciangin anbuk nasemte a hilh ding a ci hi.

records.english: The council asked the oldest families to cook at the town's anniversary, so that the young people could taste the past.
records.zomi: Khangnote in hun lui a liim theih nadingun khuapi vaihawm in khuapi kum ni ah innkuan lui pente an huan dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: The pastor made sure the old families' dishes were served first at the parish dinner.
records.zomi: Pastor in pawlpi nitak an ah innkuan luite' an a masa-in kipia hiam a en hi.

records.english: The heritage cookbook was printed by the council and given free to every family in town.
records.zomi: Ngeina an huan laibu khuapi vaihawm in a suaksak a, khuapi-a innkuan khempeuh a man om lo-in kipia hi.

records.english: The care home cooks one resident's family dish every Friday, and the resident tells the story behind it.
records.zomi: Upate kemna inn in Laithai ni simin a om mi khat' innkuan an a huan a, a om mi in a nung-a tangthu a gen hi.

records.english: Where can I buy a copy of the town's heritage cookbook?
records.zomi: Khuapi' ngeina an huan laibu koi ah ka lei thei ding hiam?

records.english: The volunteers at the shelter cooked the guests' festival dishes, using recipes the families wrote down.
records.zomi: Om sakna mun-a thalawp nasemte in innkuante' gelh an huan dan zang-in khualte' pawi ante a huan uh hi.

records.english: The church's harvest feast follows the same recipes it has used for three generations.
records.zomi: Pawlpi' buh lak poai an suak thum sung a zat an huan dan kibang mah a zui hi.

records.english: Thank you for sharing your family's dish — the residents at the care home loved it.
records.zomi: Na innkuan an na hawm manin ka lungdam hi — upate kemna inn-a omte in a nuam sa mahmah uh hi.

records.english: So many people came to the traditional harvest meal that the cooks had to borrow pots from three churches.
records.zomi: Ngeina buh lak an ah mi tampi a hong uh ahih manin an huante in pawlpi thum pan beel a leitawi kul uh hi.

records.english: The museum's new exhibition shows how village families cooked and ate a hundred years ago.
records.zomi: Museum' lim etsakna thak in kum za khat paisa-in khua innkuante in bangci-in an a huan a, a ne uh hiam a lak hi.

records.english: Are visitors allowed to help cook at the village feast?
records.zomi: Khua poai ah hong vehte in an huan a huh thei uh hiam?

records.english: Everyone, the festival meal is ready, so please wait for the elders to sit down first.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, pawi an kiman khin ahih manin upate a tut masa dong ngak un.

records.english: Can we bring a traditional dish to share at the school's family food day?
records.zomi: Sang' innkuan an ni ah kihawm dingin ngeina an khat i tawi thei ding hiam?

records.english: The smell of the traditional dishes at the festival brought my grandfather to tears.
records.zomi: Pawi-a ngeina ante gim in ka pu a kapsak hi.

records.english: Shall we ask the elders which dish should be served at the opening of the new hall?
records.zomi: Inn lian thak honna ah bang an kipia ding hiam upate i dong ding hiam?

records.english: The town's food museum was opened in the old mill, and its kitchen still bakes bread on Saturdays.
records.zomi: Khuapi' an museum buh suk mun lui ah kihong a, a anbuk in Kiginni simin moh a bawl lai hi.

records.english: Are these the same plates that the village used for feasts in the old days?
records.zomi: Hih te hun lui-in khua in poai adingin a zat kuang kibangte ahi hiam?

records.english: My little sister was proud to read our family's recipe aloud on the community radio.
records.zomi: Ka nau numei in mipi radio tungah i innkuan an huan dan aw ngaih takin a sim theih manin a kisaktheih hi.

records.english: My grandmother refused to share her recipe until the library promised to write her name on it.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in a tungah a min a gelh ding a kiciam dong ka pi in a an huan dan a hawm nuam kei hi.

records.english: Visitors to the museum can taste the old dishes at a little café run by the women's group.
records.zomi: Museum hong vehte in numei pawl' kem cafe neu khat ah an luite a liim thei uh hi.

records.english: My grandfather said, "This is exactly how my mother made it," when the care home served his village stew.
records.zomi: Upate kemna inn in a khua an-tui a piak ciangin ka pu in, “Ka nu' bawl bang kim ahi hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: Could you write down the recipe for the archive, with the measurements your grandmother used?
records.zomi: Na pi' zat tehnate tawh lai kemna adingin an huan dan na gelh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Do the schools still teach the traditional festival bread?
records.zomi: Sangte in ngeina pawi moh a hilh lai uh hiam?

records.english: My mother says the festival kitchen is where young people learn the old recipes from the elders.
records.zomi: Pawi anbuk pen khangnote in upate kiang pan an huan dan luite a sinna mun ahi hi, ci-in ka nu in a gen hi.

records.english: The heritage day was so successful that it became a yearly event.
records.zomi: Ngeina ni a hoih lua ahih manin kum sim poai a suak hi.

records.english: My grandfather's whole face changed when he tasted the soup his mother used to make.
records.zomi: A nu' bawl ngei an-tui a liim ciangin ka pu' mai bup a kikhel hi.

records.english: What did your family bring to the heritage food day at the community center?
records.zomi: Mipi inn-a ngeina an ni ah na innkuan in bang a tawi uh hiam?

records.english: My grandmother's bamboo shoot soup, which half the town remembered from their childhood.
records.zomi: Ka pi' mim an-tui, khuapi a kim in a naupan lai uh pan a phawk uh.

records.english: My cousin's restaurant serves his grandmother's dishes, and the council gave it an award for keeping traditions alive.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam' an zuakna dawl in a pi' ante a pia a, ngeinate a nungsak manin khuapi vaihawm in laksap a pia hi.

records.english: Can the school kitchen cook a traditional dish once a month, so that the children learn about it?
records.zomi: Naupangte in a sin theih nadingun sang anbuk in kha khat-in vei khat ngeina an khat a huan thei ding hiam?

records.english: Is it all right to film my grandmother cooking for the library's recipe archive?
records.zomi: Laibu inn' an huan dan lai kemna adingin ka pi' an huan video tawh ka la leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: Could you teach the young mothers' group how to make your family's chicken soup?
records.zomi: Nu khangno pawl kiangah na innkuan aksa an-tui bawl dan na hilh thei ding hiam?

records.english: When the library published our family recipes, my aunt bought ten copies for the relatives abroad.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in i innkuan an huan dante a suaksak ciangin ka ni in gamdang-a beh leh phungte adingin sawm a lei hi.

records.english: The library is recording the town's oldest cooks as they explain their family recipes.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in khuapi-a an huan upa pente in a innkuan an huan dan a gen siang uh a la hi.

records.english: At the community center, families from five countries swapped the dishes they cook for their biggest holidays.
records.zomi: Mipi inn ah gam nga pan innkuante in a poai lian pen uh adinga a huan ante a kilaih uh hi.

records.english: The bad news about the clinic closing was announced at the town meeting, and nobody spoke for a long time.
records.zomi: Clinic khak ding thu sia khuapi kikhopna ah kizasak a, hun sau kuamah a kiho kei uh hi.

records.english: When the lost boy was found safe in the forest, the whole village ran to the church to give thanks.
records.zomi: Pasal naupang mangthang gam sungah bitna takin a kimuh ciangin khua bup in lungdam ko dingin pawlpi ah a tai uh hi.

records.english: The closing of the village school left the streets strangely quiet in the mornings.
records.zomi: Khua sang kikhak in zingsang ciangin lampite a lamdang takin a daisak hi.

records.english: The mayor said, "Today we are sad together, and tomorrow we will rebuild together."
records.zomi: Khuapi ukpa nu in, “Tuni-in khawm-in i dah a, zingciang khawm-in i lam kik ding hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: Visiting the school a month later, the ambulance crew were given a drawing by the boy they had saved, and they couldn't stop smiling.
records.zomi: Kha khat khit ciangin sang a veh uh ciangin ambulance nasemte in a hum uh pasal naupang' lim gelh khat a ngah uh a, a nui tawp thei kei uh hi.

records.english: The day the clinic reopened, people brought cakes and flowers for the nurses.
records.zomi: Clinic a kihon kik ni-in mite in nurse te adingin cake leh pak a tawi uh hi.

records.english: How does the community remember the people it has lost?
records.zomi: Mipi in a sihsan mite bangci-in a phawk hiam?

records.english: Every autumn, we light candles on the bridge and read their names aloud.
records.zomi: Kum simin singnah kia hun ciangin lei tungah khawimeivaak i vak a, a min uh aw ngaih takin i sim hi.

records.english: May I leave a message in the book of condolence at the town hall?
records.zomi: Khuapi office-a lungkhamna laibu sungah thu khat ka nusia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Running isn't allowed in the cemetery, children, so walk quietly with us.
records.zomi: Naupangte, han mun ah tai kiphal lo ahih manin i tawh dai takin kaai un.

records.english: My little sister cried when the library's old cat died, so the librarian let her help plant a tree for it.
records.zomi: Laibu inn' zawhngeu lui a sih ciangin ka nau numei a kap ahih manin laibu inn kemnu in a adingin sing khat suan a huhsak hi.

records.english: My grandfather was lonely after Grandma died, until the lunch club gave him a reason to get dressed every morning.
records.zomi: Pi a sih khit ciangin ka pu a kikhawmlum a, sun an pawl in zingsang simin puan silh nading hang a piak dong.

records.english: The old men at the lunch club laughed until they cried at the children's play.
records.zomi: Sun an pawl-a pasal upate naupangte' lawng ah a kap dong a nui uh hi.

records.english: My grandmother was overjoyed when the council named the new library reading room after her mother.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in laibu inn lai simna khan thak a nu' min a koih ciangin ka pi a lungdam mahmah hi.

records.english: Shall we visit the care home on Sunday to cheer up the residents?
records.zomi: Omte' lungsim nuamsak dingin Nipini ciangin upate kemna inn i veh ding hiam?

records.english: No photographs are allowed during the memorial service, according to the family's wishes.
records.zomi: Innkuan' deihna bangin phawkna poai laitakin lim lak kiphal lo hi.

records.english: The whole town cheered when the first bus crossed the new bridge.
records.zomi: Bus masa pen in lei thak a kantan ciangin khuapi bup in a sam uh hi.

records.english: Could you sit with Mrs. Lun for a while, because she's been sad since her husband went into hospital?
records.zomi: A pasal zato ah a lut pan Mrs. Lun a dah ahih manin hun tawmno a kiang ah na tu thei ding hiam?

records.english: Can we hold the memorial in the school hall, since the church is too small?
records.zomi: Pawlpi a neu lua ahih manin phawkna poai sang inn lian ah i bawl thei ding hiam?

records.english: Would the counselor at the health center talk to my son, who hasn't smiled since his friend moved away?
records.zomi: A lawm a pem pan a nui ngei loh ka tapa damna inn-a thuhilhpa in a kiho pih ding hiam?

records.english: Ever since the new playground opened, the park has been full of children's laughter again.
records.zomi: Kimawlna mun thak kihon pan huan sungah naupangte' nuihna a dim kik hi.

records.english: Kids, the old man at the care home has no family, so be extra kind to him today.
records.zomi: Naupangte, upate kemna inn-a pasal upa innkuan nei lo ahih manin tuni-in a tung ah hehpih behlap un.

records.english: So happy were the villagers when the water pump finally worked that they danced around it.
records.zomi: Tui pump a tawp-in a sep ciangin khua mite a lungdam lua uh ahih manin a kiim ah a lam uh hi.

records.english: Everyone, please stand for a minute's silence for the volunteers who died in the flood.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, tuiciim ah a si thalawp nasemte adingin minit khat dai takin ding un.

records.english: Hardly a family in the valley was untouched by the floods, yet the festival went ahead with even more joy than usual.
records.zomi: Tuiciim in guam sung innkuan khempeuh dek a khoih hangin pawi a tawntung sangin lungdamna tam zaw tawh kibawl lai hi.

records.english: Why are there candles in all the windows tonight?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tu zanin tawhkhawng khempeuh ah khawimeivaak a om hiam?

records.english: The volunteers were so happy when the last family moved out of the flood shelter into a new home that they threw a party.
records.zomi: Innkuan nunung pen tuiciim om sakna mun pan inn thak ah a pem ciangin thalawp nasemte a lungdam lua uh ahih manin pawi a bawl uh hi.

records.english: My mother still feels sad whenever she passes the empty school where she used to teach.
records.zomi: Ka nu in a hilhna ngei sang awng a kantan simin a dah lai hi.

records.english: Lowered for a day after the bus accident, the town's flags showed how deeply everyone had been affected.
records.zomi: Bus kituakna khit ciangin ni khat sung a kiniamsak khuapi puanzante in mi khempeuh bangzah a lungkham uh hiam a lak hi.

records.english: Did the town ever hold a party for the nurses after the long winter?
records.zomi: Khuavot sau khit ciangin khuapi in nurse te adingin pawi a bawl ngei hiam?

records.english: Why does everyone seem so sad today?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tuni-in mi khempeuh a dah bang uh hiam?

records.english: The old post office closed this morning after ninety years.
records.zomi: Kum sawmkua khit ciangin post office lui tu zingsangin kikhak hi.

records.english: Children mustn't be left alone at the funeral reception; there are too many people.
records.zomi: Misi vuina-a mi a tam lua ahih manin naupangte a bek-in kinusia kei ding uh hi.

records.english: The pastor visits every family that has lost someone, often more than once.
records.zomi: Pastor in mi a sihsan innkuan khempeuh a veh a, vei khat val a veh zel hi.

records.english: The library's reopening after the fire made the whole street happy.
records.zomi: Mei kat khit ciangin laibu inn a kihon kik in lampi bup a lungdamsak hi.

records.english: The festival was canceled because of the storm, and the children were heartbroken.
records.zomi: Huihpi hang-in pawi kiphiat a, naupangte' lungtang a kitam hi.

records.english: My brother was so proud to be chosen as a volunteer firefighter that he wore the uniform to dinner.
records.zomi: Thalawp mei mitsakpa-in a kiteel manin ka sanggam pasal a kisaktheih lua ahih manin nitak an ah a puan a silh hi.

records.english: The first baby born at the new clinic was named after the nurse who delivered her.
records.zomi: Clinic thak ah naungek masa pen a suak pen a suahsak nurse' min kipia hi.

records.english: The community radio played the old man's favorite song on his hundredth birthday, and he wept.
records.zomi: A kum za na pianni-in mipi radio in pasal upa' la deih pen a sak a, amah a kap hi.

records.english: Is there anything we can do for the family whose house burned down?
records.zomi: Inn a kang innkuan adingin i sep thei bangmah a om hiam?

records.english: The church is collecting clothes and furniture, and they need help moving it all.
records.zomi: Pawlpi in puan leh innsung vante a kaikhawm a, a puak nadingin huhna a kisam uh hi.

records.english: Helping after the flood made the volunteers happier than they had been in years.
records.zomi: Tuiciim khit-a huh in thalawp nasemte kum tampi sungin a om ngei loh dan-in a lungdamsak hi.

records.english: My father says the happiest day of his life was the day the electricity reached our village.
records.zomi: Ka pa' nuntak sung-a ni lungdam pen i khua ah meivak a tun ni ahi hi, ci-in ka pa in a gen hi.

records.english: The church bells rang for an hour after the village team won the regional cup.
records.zomi: Khua pawl in gam kidemna a zawh khit ciangin pawlpi khawngte nai khat sung a ging hi.

records.english: Can I take some of the funeral flowers to the care home, where they'll be enjoyed?
records.zomi: Misi vuina pakte khenkhat a nuam sak ding uh upate kemna inn ah ka puak thei ding hiam?

records.english: The youth club painted a bright mural on the wall of the closed factory to cheer up the street.
records.zomi: Khangno pawl in lampi a nuamsak nadingin factory kikhak bang tungah lim tang lian khat a gelh uh hi.

records.english: Music is played in the hospital waiting room to calm people who are worried or sad.
records.zomi: Lungkham hiam dah hiam mite' lungsim daisak dingin zato ngakna khan ah la kisa hi.

records.english: Happiness in a small town spreads quickly, but so does sadness.
