records.zomi: Print bawlpa in samna lai za nih khempeuh tungah ni dik lo a gelh hi.

records.english: We sent a short message to every guest with the correct date and an apology.
records.zomi: Khual khempeuh kiangah ni dik leh maisak ngetna tawh thu tom khat i khak hi.

records.english: Our budget allowed for thirty guests, but the list kept growing.
records.zomi: I budget in khual sawmthum adingin a phal a, ahi zongin list a khang den hi.

records.english: We decided on a simple buffet instead of a sit-down dinner so that we could invite everyone.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh i sam theih nadingin tut-a nitak an sangin ama' teel-in lak an baih khat i khensat hi.

records.english: Did you tell the guests that the party starts at six, not seven?
records.zomi: Pawi nai sagih hi lo-in nai guk ciangin a kipan hi, ci-in khualte na hilh hiam?

records.english: Having hosted the family festival meal for twenty years, my mother finally asked her sons to take a turn.
records.zomi: Kum sawmnih sung innkuan pawi an a bawl khit ciangin ka nu in a tawp-in a tapate kikhel dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: Where will the guests sleep if they stay overnight?
records.zomi: Khualte zan khat a om uh leh koi ah a ihmu ding uh hiam?

records.english: An invitation is like a seed, because you never know what friendship might grow from it.
records.zomi: Samna pen khaici bang ahi a, a pan bang lawmta a khang ding hiam na thei ngei kei hi.

records.english: The rain started just as the guests arrived for the garden party.
records.zomi: Huan pawi adingin khualte a tun laitakun guah a zu kipan hi.

records.english: We moved everything into the garage and hung lanterns from the ceiling.
records.zomi: Khempeuh mawtaw inn sung ah i suan a, innkhum nuai ah meivak bawmte i khai hi.

records.english: What would you do if half the guests cancelled at the last minute?
records.zomi: Khualte a khen khat a nunung pen hun-in a khek uh leh bang na hih ding hiam?

records.english: Two of the guests I wanted to invite had fallen out with each other.
records.zomi: Ka sam nuam khual nih a kinial khin uh hi.

records.english: I invited them both and seated them at opposite ends of the table.
records.zomi: A nih un ka sam a, dawhkan tawp nih ah ka tusak hi.

records.english: In our village, guests are often invited in person rather than by message, as a sign of respect.
records.zomi: I khua ah zahtakna lahna-in thu khak sangin khualte amau mah kiangah a tamzaw-in kisam uh hi.

records.english: My son made the invitations himself with colored paper and glue.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in lai rongte leh belh tawh samna laite amah mah in a bawl hi.

records.english: Rather than inviting everyone to one huge party, we held three small dinners over the holiday.
records.zomi: Pawi lian mahmah khat ah mi khempeuh sam sangin nopsakna hun sungin nitak an neu thum i bawl hi.

records.english: If you're worried that guests won't mix, it may help to plan a simple game or activity.
records.zomi: Khualte a kithuah lo ding na lungkham leh kimawlna baih khat gel in a huh kha ding hi.

records.english: The more relaxed the invitation, the more people seem to feel comfortable bringing their children.
records.zomi: Samna a nuam semsem ciangin mi tam zaw in a tate paipih a nuam sa uh bang hi.

records.english: Is it possible to invite guests without making the people we leave out feel hurt?
records.zomi: I kinusiate a lungkhamsak lo-in khualte i sam thei ding hiam?

records.english: Although inviting guests takes effort, the conversations that follow are usually worth it.
records.zomi: Khualte sam in hanciamna a la hangin a zom kihonate a tamzaw-in a manphat hi.

records.english: The neighbor who helped us during the flood refused to take any money.
records.zomi: Tuiciim laitakin hong huh i inn veng in sum a sang nuam kei hi.

records.english: We repaired his fence for him the following spring instead.
records.zomi: Tua sangin a zom spring in a kulh i bawl siang sak hi.

records.english: Our team won the prize, but the coach who trained us was too ill to attend the ceremony.
records.zomi: I pawl in letsong a ngah a, ahi zongin hong hilhtu a dam lo lua ahih manin pawi ah a hong thei kei hi.

records.english: We took the trophy to her house, and she held it for a long time without speaking.
records.zomi: Letsong a inn ah i tawi a, gen lo-in hun sawt a len hi.

records.english: Having been helped by so many strangers on his journey, my uncle now helps every traveler he meets.
records.zomi: A khualzinna ah mi theih loh tampi in a huh khit ciangin ka pa neu in tu-in a muh khualzin khempeuh a huh hi.

records.english: I thanked my mother-in-law so often that she said I was making her feel like a stranger.
records.zomi: Ka sungnu kiangah lungdam ka gen tam lua ahih manin mi theih loh bangin hong kisaksak hi, a ci hi.

records.english: I wanted to thank my neighbor, but she'd already moved away.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng kiangah lungdam gen ka deih hi, ahi zongin a tuah khin hi.

records.english: The doctor who treated my father didn't speak our language.
records.zomi: Ka pa a zatui siavuan in i pau a thei kei hi.

records.english: My niece helped us write a thank-you card in his language, and he kept it on his desk.
records.zomi: Ka tunu in amah' pau tawh lungdamna card gelh dingin hong huh a, a dawhkan tungah a kem hi.

records.english: Kids, before you open your gifts, look at the card and say who it's from.
records.zomi: Naupangte, na letsongte uh na hon ma-un card en un a, kua pan ahi hiam gen un.

records.english: My little brother made our teacher a bookmark with a pair of scissors and some old wrapping paper.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal in namtemna leh tuamna lai lui tawh i saya adingin laibu kilahna khat a bawl hi.

records.english: If a gift isn't allowed, it may help to thank the person in writing to their manager.
records.zomi: Letsong kiphal kei leh tua mi' manager kiangah lai tawh lungdam gen in a huh kha ding hi.

records.english: I sent a thank-you message, but it went to the wrong number.
records.zomi: Lungdamna thu ka khak a, ahi zongin number dik lo ah a pai hi.

records.english: Could you help me organize a small lunch for the volunteers at the shelter?
records.zomi: Kemna inn-a thalawpte adingin sun an neu khat bawl dingin hong huh thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Our son's coach shook hands with every player on the other team after the final.
records.zomi: A nunung pen kimawlna khit ciangin i tapa' hilhtu in pawl dang' kimawl khempeuh tawh khut a kilen hi.

records.english: My father's friend paid for my first textbooks, and he died before I could repay him.
records.zomi: Ka pa' lawm in ka laibu masate man a pia sak a, ka pia kik ma-in a si hi.

records.english: I gave the same amount to a young student from his village, in his name.
records.zomi: A min tawh a khua pan sangnaupang khangno khat kiangah sum kibang ka pia hi.

records.english: Which teacher made the biggest difference to you?
records.zomi: Koi saya in nang adingin a laihna lian pen a bawl hiam?

records.english: Although some people brush off thanks, most of them remember a sincere word for years.
records.zomi: Mi khenkhatte in lungdam genna a phawk lo bang uh hangin a tamzaw in thuman taka kammal khat kum tampi a phawk uh hi.

records.english: Only three people signed the farewell card, because it was left in a drawer.
records.zomi: Kikhenna card bawm sung ah kinusia ahih manin mi thum bek in min a suaksak uh hi.

records.english: We put it by the coffee machine, and by lunchtime it was full of messages.
records.zomi: Khawfi set kiang ah i koih a, sun ciangin thu tawh a dim hi.

records.english: How do I thank a friend who always says it was nothing?
records.zomi: Bangmah hi lo hi, a ci den lawm khat kiangah bangci-in lungdam ka gen ding hiam?

records.english: Do something kind for her in return when she least expects it.
records.zomi: A lamen loh hun ciangin a tungah hehpihna khat bawl kik in.

records.english: My boss presented my idea as his own at the meeting.
records.zomi: Ka makai in kikhopna ah ka ngaihsutna amah' bangin a gen hi.

records.english: I asked him privately to mention my name next time, and he apologized.
records.zomi: A zom ciangin ka min gen dingin a tuam-in ka ngen a, maisak a ngen hi.

records.english: Everyone, please sign the card for Mrs. Dim before she leaves on Friday.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, Laithai ni-in a pai ma-in Mrs. Dim adingin card ah min suaksak un.

records.english: My colleague is so shy that public praise makes her uncomfortable.
records.zomi: Ka nasem lawm a zak lua ahih manin mipi mai-a phatna in a nuamsak kei hi.

records.english: Instead of thanking her at the meeting, the manager left a note on her desk.
records.zomi: Kikhopna ah lungdam gen sangin manager in a dawhkan tungah lai khat a nusia hi.

records.english: The farmer was so pleased with our thanks that he gave us a sack of rice.
records.zomi: Lo nei i lungdam genna ah a lungdam lua ahih manin buh ip khat hong pia hi.

records.english: In my family, we refuse a gift twice before accepting it, which visitors sometimes find confusing.
records.zomi: Ka innkuan ah letsong i sang ma-in nihvei i nial a, tua pen khual hongte in khatveivei a buaihuai sa uh hi.

records.english: Whoever organized the trip should be thanked at the start of the next meeting.
records.zomi: Khualzinna a gel peuhpeuh kikhopna zom kipat ciangin lungdam kigen ding hi.

records.english: Rather than buying the nurses chocolates, we made a donation to the children's ward in their names.
records.zomi: Nursete adingin chocolate lei sangin amaute' min tawh naupangte zato khan adingin sum i pia hi.

records.english: A stranger pushed our car out of the mud and drove off before we could ask his name.
records.zomi: Mi theih loh khat in i mawtaw bual sung pan a nawt khia a, a min i dot ma-in a pai khia hi.

records.english: We described him on the local radio, and his sister called to say it was him.
records.zomi: Khua radio tungah amah thu i gen a, a sanggam nu in amah ahi hi, ci-in a sam hi.

records.english: Did you remember to thank Aunt Mai for driving us to the airport?
records.zomi: Vanlengtual dong hong tuangsak manin Ni Mai kiangah lungdam gen na phawk hiam?

records.english: How can we thank the bus driver who waits for the schoolchildren every morning?
records.zomi: Zingsang simin sangnaupangte a ngak bus mawngpa kiangah bangci-in lungdam i gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: I never thanked the teacher who helped me most, and now she has retired to another town.
records.zomi: Hong huh pen saya kiangah lungdam ka gen ngei kei a, tu-in khuapi dang ah a tawl khin hi.

records.english: My old classmate found her address, and I finally wrote to her after twenty years.
records.zomi: Ka kilasi lawm lui in a omna a mu a, kum sawmnih khit ciangin a tawp-in lai ka gelh hi.

records.english: When is the best time to thank someone for a favor?
records.zomi: Huhna khat adingin lungdam gen hun hoih pen bang ciang ahi hiam?

records.english: What I find hardest is thanking people who helped me when I was too proud to admit I needed help.
records.zomi: Ka haksa sak pen pen huhna ka kisap pang dingin ka kisathei lai hun-a hong huhte kiangah lungdam gen ahi hi.

records.english: The whole office was thanked, but the cleaners were forgotten.
records.zomi: Office bup lungdam kigen a, ahi zongin siangsakte kimangngilh hi.

records.english: The next morning, the director went to see them and thanked them herself.
records.zomi: A zing zingsangin director in amaute a va mu a, amah mah in lungdam a gen hi.

records.english: Why don't we invite the volunteers to lunch to thank them?
records.zomi: Bang hangin lungdam gen dingin thalawpte sun an ah i sam kei ding hiam?

records.english: Not until my own business struggled did I appreciate the customers who had stayed loyal for years.
records.zomi: Keima' sumbawl a haksat ciang bek kum tampi sung a kip leite ka lungdampih hi.

records.english: Thanks that come late are like rain after a drought, because they still bring relief.
records.zomi: A nun lungdam genna pen khuakhal khit-a guah bang ahi a, hehnepna a tawi lai hi.

records.english: The children forgot to thank their grandfather for taking them fishing.
records.zomi: Nga man dingin a paipih manin naupangte in a pu uh kiangah lungdam gen a mangngilh uh hi.

records.english: I had them phone him that evening, and each of them told him what they'd enjoyed most.
records.zomi: Tua nitak in phone tawh ka samsak a, a khat ciat in a nuam sak pen a gen uh hi.

records.english: Why do people sometimes cry when they're thanked?
records.zomi: Bang hangin lungdam a kigen ciangin mite khatveivei a kap uh hiam?

records.english: Is it possible to thank someone too much?
records.zomi: Kuamah tungah lungdam gen tam lua thei hiam?

records.english: Who's going to make the speech thanking the cooks?
records.zomi: An huante lungdam genna thugen kua in a gen ding hiam?

records.english: Where can I buy a small gift for my supervisor?
records.zomi: Ka enkaipa adingin letsong neu khat koi ah ka lei thei ding hiam?

records.english: Would you mind passing this card to the night guard, since I'll be gone before he arrives?
records.zomi: Amah a tun ma-in ka pai khin ding ahih manin hih card zan kongpi kemtu na pia sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: What would you say to someone who saved your life?
records.zomi: Na nuntakna a hon mi khat kiangah bang na gen ding hiam?

records.english: Could the town put up a small sign thanking the caretaker who keeps the bus shelter clean?
records.zomi: Bus khuh inn a siangsak den kemtu kiangah lungdam genna lai neu khat khuapi in a khai thei ding hiam?

records.english: Who should sign the letter of thanks from the whole street?
records.zomi: Lampi bup pan lungdamna lai kua in a min a suaksak ding hiam?

records.english: Had I thanked my grandfather while he was alive, I wouldn't feel this regret today.
records.zomi: Ka pu a nuntak lai-in lungdam ka gen le, tuni-in hih kisikna ka nei kei ding hi.

records.english: Our hospital doesn't allow nurses to accept gifts from patients.
records.zomi: I zato in nursete natna pan letsong sang a phal kei hi.

records.english: We wrote a letter to the director praising the night nurses by name.
records.zomi: Zan nursete a min tawh phat-in director kiangah lai i gelh hi.

records.english: The more specific you are about what someone did, the more your thanks will mean to them.
records.zomi: Mi khat in bang a hih hiam kician zawin na gen semsem ciangin na lungdam genna in amah adingin a thupi semsem ding hi.

records.english: My mother sent the doctor a basket of mangoes from our garden.
records.zomi: Ka nu in i huan pan haigah bawm khat siavuan kiangah a khak hi.

records.english: Not until the last guest had left did my mother finally sit down and eat.
records.zomi: Khual nunung pen a pai khit ciang bek ka nu a tawp-in a tu a, an a ne hi.

records.english: Could you help me carry the extra chairs from the church hall?
records.zomi: Pawlpi inn pan tutna behlapte pua dingin hong huh thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: What I remember most about my sister's wedding is how my father danced with every guest.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu' mopawi ah ka phawk pen pen ka pa in khual khempeuh tawh a lam ahi hi.

records.english: We baked a cake for my sister so that she wouldn't have to spend her birthday cooking.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu a pianni an huan-in a zat lo nadingin amah adingin cake khat i bawl hi.

records.english: My uncle used his old camera to take photos of every guest at the party.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu in pawi-a khual khempeuh lim lak dingin a camera lui a zang hi.

records.english: Could we have avoided the argument at the wedding if we had seated the two families separately?
records.zomi: Innkuan nihte a tuam-in i tusak le, mopawi-a kinialna i pelh thei ding hiam?

records.english: At my cousin's wedding, the electricity went off just before the first dance.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam' mopawi ah lam masa pen ma-in meivak a mit hi.

records.english: Someone found a guitar, and my uncle started to play.
records.zomi: Kuamah in guitar khat a mu a, ka pa neu in a tum kipan hi.

records.english: Everyone sang by candlelight, and the bride said it was more beautiful than any band.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh khawimeivaak tawh la a sa uh a, moulai in la tumpawl khatpeuh sangin a hoih zaw hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Every New Year, my family gathers at my grandparents' house to eat and tell stories.
records.zomi: Kum thak simin ka innkuan ka pu leh pite inn ah an ne-in tangthu gen dingin a kikhawm uh hi.

records.english: My sister sewed matching dresses for all the girls in the family.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu in innkuan-a numei naupang khempeuh adingin puan kibang a khui hi.

records.english: May I invite my best friend to the wedding?
records.zomi: Mopawi ah ka lawm hoih pen ka sam thei ding hiam?

records.english: Fireworks aren't allowed in our village, so we light lanterns instead.
records.zomi: I khua ah meivak puak kiphal lo ahih manin tua sangin meivak bawmte i hal hi.

records.english: The more relatives came, the louder and happier the celebration became.
records.zomi: Sanggam tam semsem a hong ciangin pawi a ging semsem a, a nuam semsem hi.

records.english: The night before my wedding, my grandfather called me into his room.
records.zomi: Ka kiteen ma zan-in ka pu in a khan ah hong sam hi.

records.english: He gave me a small wooden box that had belonged to his own mother.
records.zomi: Amah' nu' ahi ngei sing bawm neu khat hong pia hi.

records.english: Inside was a letter she had written for whichever grandchild married first.
records.zomi: A sung ah tu khat a kiteen masa ding adingin a gelh lai khat a om hi.

records.english: On my parents' twenty-fifth anniversary, my brother and I planned a surprise dinner.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa' kum sawmnih leh nga kiteenna kum kimna-in kei leh ka sanggam pasal in lamdang nitak an khat i gel hi.

records.english: We told them we were taking them to the doctor, which made them very worried.
records.zomi: Siavuan kiang ah kong paipih ding uh hi, i ci a, tua in a lungkham mahmah sak hi.

records.english: Instead, the car stopped at a restaurant where all their old friends were waiting.
records.zomi: Tua sangin a lawm lui khempeuh a ngak uh anneekna inn khat ah mawtaw a tawp hi.

records.english: Although the party was small, it was the one my grandmother talked about for years.
records.zomi: Pawi a neu hangin ka pi in kum tampi sung a gen den pawi ahi hi.

records.english: We hung a long string of lights across the yard with a ladder and some wire.
records.zomi: Kahlei leh thih khau tawh tual kim ah meivak khau sau khat i khai hi.

records.english: Shall we ask the neighbors to join us for the harvest celebration?
records.zomi: Buh lak pawi ah kihel dingin inn vengte i ngen ding hiam?

records.english: How did your family celebrate when your brother came home from the army?
records.zomi: Na sanggam pasal galkap pan inn ah a hong ciah ciangin na innkuan in bangci-in pawi a bawl uh hiam?

records.english: We killed a chicken, invited the neighbors, and stayed up talking until midnight.
records.zomi: Ak khat i go a, inn vengte i sam a, zanlai dong i kiho hi.

records.english: Can I wear my new shoes to the party?
records.zomi: Pawi ah ka khedap thak ka bulh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Please don't open the presents until all the guests have arrived.
records.zomi: Khual khempeuh a tun dong letsongte hong kei un.

records.english: It might rain on Saturday, so we've borrowed a big tent from the neighbors.
records.zomi: Kiginni-in guah a zuk kha ding ahih manin inn vengte pan puan inn lian khat i ngetsak hi.

records.english: Rather than buying gifts, our family now writes letters to each other every New Year.
records.zomi: Letsong lei sangin tu-in i innkuan in kum thak simin khat leh khat lai i gelh hi.

records.english: The rain made us move the whole celebration into my aunt's small living room.
records.zomi: Guah in pawi bup ka ni' tutna khan neu sung ah hong suansak hi.

records.english: Had the bus not broken down, we would have arrived in time for the ceremony.
records.zomi: Bus a sia kei le, pawi adingin hun takin i tung ding hi.

records.english: Everyone, raise your glasses to the happy couple!
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, kiteen lungdam nihte adingin na haai uh lap un!

records.english: What did you bring to your cousin's naming ceremony?
records.zomi: Na sanggam' min phuakna pawi ah bang na tawi hiam?

records.english: Who is going to make the speech at Grandma's party?
records.zomi: Ka pi' pawi ah thu kua in a gen ding hiam?

records.english: Grandpa made us all stand still for an hour while the photographer arranged everyone.
records.zomi: Lim la pa in mi khempeuh a koih laitakin ka pu in nai khat sung hong dingsak uh hi.

records.english: Children, please don't touch the cake until Grandpa has cut it.
records.zomi: Naupangte, ka pu in a at ma-in cake khoih kei un.

records.english: Having saved for a whole year, my parents finally took the family to the sea for their anniversary.
records.zomi: Kum bup a khol khit ciangin ka nu leh ka pa in a kiteenna kum kimna adingin innkuan a tawp-in tuipi ah a paipih uh hi.

records.english: We had the family photo printed and framed for Grandpa's birthday.
records.zomi: Ka pu' pianni adingin innkuan lim i print sak a, frame tawh i koih hi.

records.english: We cooked enough rice for a hundred people, and nothing was left at the end.
records.zomi: Mi za khat adingin buh i huan a, a tawp ciangin bangmah a nusia kei hi.

records.english: My cousins and I wrote a short play to perform for our parents' anniversary.
records.zomi: Ka sanggamte leh kei i nu leh pa' kum kimna adingin lamna tangthu tom khat i gelh hi.

records.english: Would you like me to bake the cake for your son's birthday?
records.zomi: Na tapa' pianni adingin cake kong bawl sak ding hiam?

records.english: Why did your mother cry at the graduation ceremony?
records.zomi: Bang hangin sang zawhna pawi ah na nu a kap hiam?

records.english: She was the first in our family to finish school, so seeing me graduate meant everything to her.
records.zomi: I innkuan ah sang a zo masa pen ahi a, ka sang zawh a muh pen amah adingin khempeuh ahi hi.

records.english: Is it possible to hold the wedding in the garden if the weather is good?
records.zomi: Huihkhua a hoih leh huan sung ah mopawi i bawl thei ding hiam?

records.english: For my grandmother's eightieth birthday, the whole family came home from the city.
records.zomi: Ka pi' pianni kum sawmgiat-in innkuan bup khuapi pan inn ah a hong ciah uh hi.

records.english: My aunts cooked for two days, and the children decorated the yard with paper flowers.
records.zomi: Ka nite ni nih sung an a huan uh a, naupangte in lai pak tawh tual a zeel uh hi.

records.english: When Grandma saw everyone waiting for her, she covered her face and laughed.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh a ngak uh a muh ciangin ka pi in a mai a khuh a, a nui hi.

records.english: If the whole family helps with the cooking, the celebration costs much less and feels more like home.
records.zomi: Innkuan bup in an huan a huh uh leh pawi man a tawm zaw mahmah a, inn bang zaw-in a kisa hi.

records.english: Whoever finds the coin in the cake will be lucky all year, according to my aunt.
records.zomi: Ka ni' gen bangin cake sung ah dangka a mu peuhpeuh kum bup vangphatna a nei ding hi.

records.english: The cake was ruined when the dog jumped onto the table.
records.zomi: Ui dawhkan tungah a diang ciangin cake a sia hi.

records.english: We bought a new one from the bakery, and nobody else ever found out.
records.zomi: Moh bawlna pan a thak khat i lei a, kuamah dang in a thei ngei kei uh hi.

records.english: Looking at the old wedding photos, my mother suddenly remembered the name of every guest.
records.zomi: Mopawi lim luite a en-in ka nu in khual khempeuh' min a phawk kik pah hi.

records.english: Last Christmas, the snow blocked the road to our village.
records.zomi: Christmas nung in vuk in i khua lampi a khak hi.

records.english: Half the family couldn't come, so we set up a video call on the kitchen table.
records.zomi: Innkuan a khen khat a hong thei kei uh ahih manin an huanna dawhkan tungah video samna i bawl hi.

records.english: Grandpa talked to the screen as if they were sitting right next to him.
records.zomi: Ka pu in a kiang mahmah ah a tu bangin screen tawh a kiho hi.

records.english: When my baby brother was born, our house was full of visitors for a week.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal a suah ciangin kal khat sung i inn khual hongte tawh a dim hi.

records.english: Every neighbor brought something: rice, eggs, soup, or clothes for the baby.
records.zomi: Inn veng khempeuh in bangmah a tawi uh hi: buh, aktui, an tui, hiam naungek puan.

records.english: My mother said that she had never felt so looked after in her life.

records.english: My brother forgot the rings, so he had to drive all the way home before the ceremony.

records.english: Wouldn't it be lovely if every branch of the family brought one dish from their own region?
records.zomi: Innkuan khen khat ciat in amau gam pan an khat a tawi uh leh a hoih mahmah ding hi lo hiam?

records.english: The bus driver closed the doors on an old man's bag by mistake.
records.zomi: Bus mawngpa in khialh-in pasal upa khat' ip tungah kongkhak a khak hi.

records.english: He stopped the bus, opened the doors, and helped the man to a seat.

records.english: My text apology sounded cold, and my friend thought I was still angry.

records.english: I called her instead, and she could hear in my voice that I meant it.
records.zomi: Tua sangin ka sam a, a taktak ka hi hi, cih ka aw ah a za hi.

records.english: Could the school arrange a meeting so that the two boys can apologize to each other?
records.zomi: Naupang pasal nihte in khat leh khat maisak a ngen theih nadingun sang in kikhopna khat a bawl thei ding hiam?

records.english: The longer you wait to apologize, the harder it becomes to find the words.
records.zomi: Maisak ngen dingin na ngak sawt semsem ciangin kammal zon a haksa semsem hi.

records.english: How can I make amends with a cousin who refuses to answer my letters?
records.zomi: Ka lai te dawng nuam lo sanggam khat tawh bangci-in ka kilem kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: Whoever broke the window has to tell the neighbor and offer to pay for the glass.
records.zomi: Tukvuang a sukek peuhpeuh in inn veng a hilh ding a, glass man pia dingin a kipia ding hi.

records.english: Had I listened to my wife instead of interrupting her, we wouldn't have argued all evening.
records.zomi: A gen kikal ah ka gen sangin ka zi ka ngai le, nitak bup i kinial kei ding hi.

records.english: Which is harder for you, saying sorry or forgiving?
records.zomi: Koi in nang adingin a haksa zaw hiam, maisak ngen hiam maisak hiam?

records.english: The waiter spilled soup on my jacket and paid for it to be cleaned.
records.zomi: An zuakpa in ka kawt tungah an tui a sun a, siangsak man a pia hi.

records.english: You don't have to forgive him today, but you need to tell him how you feel.
records.zomi: Tuni-in na maisak kei zongin a hoih hi, ahi zongin bangci-in na kisa hiam na gen ding hi.

records.english: Would you mind telling your mother that I'm sorry I couldn't come?
records.zomi: Ka hong thei lo manin maisak ka ngen hi, ci-in na nu na hilh sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: I lost the book my neighbor had lent me.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng in hong ngetsak laibu ka mansuah hi.

records.english: I searched three bookshops until I found the same edition and gave it to her with a note.
records.zomi: Laibu kibang ka muh dong laibu dawr thum ah ka zong a, lai neu khat tawh ka pia hi.

records.english: The shop sent us the wrong furniture twice.
records.zomi: Dawr in nihvei inn van dik lo hong khak hi.

records.english: The manager apologized, delivered the right table himself, and refused to charge for delivery.
records.zomi: Manager in maisak a ngen a, dawhkan dik amah mah in a tawi a, puak man a la nuam kei hi.

records.english: Did your sister ever forgive you for missing her wedding?
records.zomi: A mopawi na mansuah manin na sanggam nu in hong maisak ngei hiam?

records.english: Who should apologize first when both people were rude?
records.zomi: A nih un zahtakna om lo-in a om uh leh kua in maisak a ngen masa ding hiam?

records.english: When did you last say sorry to your parents?
records.zomi: Na nu leh na pa kiangah maisak na ngen nunung bang ciang ahi hiam?

records.english: Rather than sending another message, I went round to her house and apologized face to face.
records.zomi: Thu dang khak sangin a inn ah ka pai a, a mai-in maisak ka ngen hi.

records.english: I shouted at my son for something his brother had done.
records.zomi: A sanggam pasal' hih thu-ah ka tapa ka kou hi.

records.english: I sat down with him that evening, said I was sorry, and asked what had really happened.
records.zomi: Tua nitak in a kiang ah ka tu a, maisak ka ngen a, bang a piang taktak hiam ka dong hi.

records.english: If an apology is not accepted at first, it may help to give the other person time and try again later.
records.zomi: Maisak ngetna a masa-in kisang kei leh a dang khat hun pia inla a nung ciangin kik-in sin in a huh kha ding hi.

records.english: An apology without a change in behavior is like a bandage on a broken leg.
records.zomi: Gamtatna laih om lo maisak ngetna pen khe guh kek tungah puan tuam bang ahi hi.

records.english: Do I need to apologize if I was only following my boss's instructions?
records.zomi: Ka makai' thupiak bek ka zuih leh maisak ka ngen ding hiam?

records.english: What I find hardest is apologizing to someone who refuses to admit that they were wrong too.
records.zomi: Ka haksa sak pen pen amah zong a khial hi, cih a pang nuam lo mi khat kiangah maisak ngen ahi hi.

records.english: I forgot to pick up my daughter from school, and she waited for an hour.
records.zomi: Sang pan ka tanu la ka mangngilh a, nai khat a ngak hi.

records.english: Now I set an alarm on my phone for three o'clock every weekday.
records.zomi: Tu-in kal sung ni simin nai thum ciangin ka phone ah alarm ka koih hi.

records.english: Could you help me find the right moment to apologize to my father?
records.zomi: Ka pa kiangah maisak ngen nading hun dik zong dingin hong huh thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Not until my friend stopped calling did I realize how much I had hurt her.
records.zomi: Ka lawm in a sam tawp ciang bek bangzah ka susia hiam ka thei hi.

records.english: I called my colleague by the wrong name during my farewell speech.
records.zomi: Ka kikhenna thugen ah ka nasem lawm min dik lo tawh ka sam hi.

records.english: I wrote to everyone the next day and thanked him properly by name.
records.zomi: A zing ni-in mi khempeuh kiangah lai ka gelh a, a min tawh dik takin lungdam ka gen hi.

records.english: The teacher blamed my son for a broken window that another boy had broken.
records.zomi: Naupang pasal dang khat in a sukek tukvuang thu-ah saya in ka tapa a mawhsak hi.

records.english: When she found out, she apologized to him privately and wrote a note to us.
records.zomi: A theih ciangin a tuam-in a kiangah maisak a ngen a, eite kiangah lai neu khat a gelh hi.

records.english: My wife forgave me as soon as she saw how hard I had worked to fix the gate.
records.zomi: Kongpi bawl siang dingin bangzah ka hanciam hiam a muh pah-in ka zi in hong maisak hi.

records.english: Although forgiving someone can take years, it often frees the person who forgives.
records.zomi: Mi khat maisak in kum tampi a la thei hangin a maisak mi a tamzaw-in a suaksak hi.

records.english: Having hurt so many people with his temper, my uncle finally went to a counselor for help.
records.zomi: A heh manlangna tawh mi tampi a sukha khit ciangin ka pa neu in a tawp-in huhna adingin thuhilhtu kiang ah a pai hi.

records.english: Why don't you write down what you want to say before you call her?
records.zomi: Amah na sam ma-in na gen nuam gelh masa ding hi lo hiam?

records.english: My grandfather is too proud to say sorry to my grandmother.
records.zomi: Ka pu in ka pi kiangah maisak ngen dingin a kisathei lua hi.

records.english: Instead, he makes her tea every morning for a week, and she understands.
records.zomi: Tua sangin kal khat sung zingsang simin tea a bawl sak a, ka pi in a thei hi.

records.english: I posted a photo of my friend online without asking her first.
records.zomi: Dong masa lo-in ka lawm' lim online ah ka koih hi.

records.english: I deleted it as soon as she asked, and I've asked before posting ever since.
records.zomi: A ngen pah-in ka phiat a, tua pan ka koih ma-in ka dong tawntung hi.

records.english: My little brother spoiled my drawing, so he spent the afternoon helping me paint a new one.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal in ka lim a susia ahih manin a thak khat zeek dingin nitak lam bup hong huh hi.

records.english: You mustn't make promises in an apology that you can't keep.
records.zomi: Maisak ngetna ah na zuih zawh loh ding kiciamna bawl kei in.

records.english: Children aren't allowed back into the game until they've said sorry to each other.
records.zomi: Naupangte in khat leh khat maisak a ngen ma-un kimawlna ah a kik thei kei uh hi.

records.english: Shall we send flowers with the apology letter?
records.zomi: Maisak ngetna lai tawh pak i khak ding hiam?

records.english: We must warn the neighbors before the building work starts, rather than apologizing afterward.
records.zomi: A nung ciangin maisak ngen sangin inn lamna a kipat ma-in inn vengte i hilh ding hi.

records.english: Why do some people find it impossible to admit a mistake?
records.zomi: Bang hangin mi khenkhatte in khialhna a pang thei lo uh hiam?

records.english: My brother and I hadn't spoken for a year after an argument about our parents' house.
records.zomi: I nu leh pa' inn thu-a kinialna khit ciangin kei leh ka sanggam pasal kum khat sung i kiho kei hi.

records.english: An elder from our church sat with us both, and we finally listened to each other.
records.zomi: I pawlpi pan upa khat i nih tawh a tu a, a tawp-in khat leh khat i kingai hi.

records.english: Is it possible to forgive someone who has never said sorry?
records.zomi: Maisak a ngen ngei lo mi khat maisak thei hiam?

records.english: I missed my best friend's mother's funeral because I was abroad.
records.zomi: Gamdang ah ka om ahih manin ka lawm hoih pen' nu mithi vuina ka mansuah hi.

records.english: When I came home, I visited him with food and sat with him for the whole evening.
records.zomi: Inn ka tun ciangin an tawh ka veh a, nitak bup a kiang ah ka tu hi.

records.english: Please don't apologize for the muddy shoes, since we have three children and we're used to it.
records.zomi: Naupang thum i nei a, i zia khin ahih manin bual khedap adingin maisak ngen kei in.

records.english: I told my sister's secret to our cousin without thinking.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu' thuguk ngaihsun lo-in i sanggam kiangah ka gen hi.

records.english: I had to tell my sister myself before she heard it from someone else.
records.zomi: Mi dang pan a zak ma-in ka sanggam nu keimah mah in ka hilh ding a kisam hi.

records.english: He said, "I'm sorry if you were offended," which only made her angrier.
records.zomi: Amah in, “Na lungkham kha leh hong maisak in,” a ci a, tua in a hehsak semsem bek hi.

records.english: A real apology must say what you did wrong, not just how the other person feels.
records.zomi: Maisak ngetna taktak in a dang khat bangci-in a kisa hiam bek hi lo-in bang na khialh hiam a gen ding hi.

records.english: What would you do if a friend apologized but kept doing the same thing?
records.zomi: Lawm khat in maisak a ngen a, ahi zongin a kibang mah a hih den leh bang na hih ding hiam?

records.english: Two of my colleagues kept arguing about which radio station to play in the workshop.
records.zomi: Ka nasem lawm nih nasepna inn ah koi radio a sak ding hiam a kinial den uh hi.

records.english: The manager let each of them choose the music on alternate days.
records.zomi: Manager in amaute nih ni kikhel-in la a teel dingin a phal hi.

records.english: We need to agree on one rule before the children start asking again.
records.zomi: Naupangte in kik-in a dot ma-un thupiak khat ah i kithukim ding hi.

records.english: Is it possible to disagree with your boss without damaging your job?
records.zomi: Na nasep susia lo-in na makai tawh kithukim lo thei hiam?

records.english: Had we spoken to each other directly instead of through our children, the quarrel would have ended much sooner.
records.zomi: I tate tungtawn sangin a tang takin i kiho le, kinialna a manlang zaw mahmah-in a bei ding hi.

records.english: My wife and I couldn't agree whether to paint the baby's room yellow or green.
records.zomi: Ka zi leh kei naungek' khan gial hiam eng hiam zeek ding i kithukim zo kei hi.

records.english: We painted two walls in each color, and everyone who visits says it looks lovely.
records.zomi: Rong khat ciat in bang nih i zeek a, a hong veh khempeuh in a hoih mahmah hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: Having argued about the same thing for years, my aunts finally agreed to let a neutral cousin decide.
records.zomi: Kum tampi sung thu kibang a kinial khit ciangin ka nite in a tawp-in lam pang lo sanggam khat in a khensat dingin a phal uh hi.

records.english: One student in our group never did any of the work for the project.
records.zomi: I pawl-a sangnaupang khat in project nasep khatpeuh a sem ngei kei hi.

records.english: We divided the tasks in writing, and the teacher marked each person's part separately.
records.zomi: Nasepte gelh-in i khen a, saya in mi khat ciat' khen a tuam-in ciamte a pia hi.

records.english: The landlord refused to return our deposit, saying the walls were damaged.
records.zomi: Bang te a sia hi, ci-in inn neipa in i koih khol sum a pia kik nuam kei hi.

records.english: We showed him the photos we had taken on the day we moved in, and he paid us back.
records.zomi: I tuah ni-a i lak limte i etsak a, hong pia kik hi.

records.english: Rather than arguing in front of the customers, the two cooks stepped outside for a moment.
records.zomi: Leite mai ah kinial sangin an huan nihte tawmno pua ah a pai khia uh hi.

records.english: Would you mind listening to my side before you decide who was wrong?
records.zomi: Kua in a khial hiam na khensat ma-in keima' lam hong ngai thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Half the office wanted the air conditioning colder, and the other half were wearing jackets.
records.zomi: Office a khen khat in air con a vot zaw a deih uh a, a khen khat in kawt a silh uh hi.

records.english: We moved the people who feel the cold to the desks by the window, and the complaints stopped.
records.zomi: A vot a thuak lote tukvuang kiang-a dawhkan ah i suan a, phunnate a tawp hi.

records.english: The church committee couldn't agree on how to spend the money from the harvest sale.
records.zomi: Buh lak zuakna pan sum bangci-in zang ding hiam pawlpi committee a kithukim zo kei hi.

records.english: They voted to split it between the roof repairs and the youth group.
records.zomi: Innkhum bawlsiang leh khangno pawl kikal ah khen dingin vote a pia uh hi.

records.english: Who decides when the family can't agree on a holiday?
records.zomi: Innkuan in nopsakna hun thu a kithukim zo kei ciangin kua in a khensat hiam?

records.english: My brothers disagreed about where our widowed mother should live.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasalte i nu meigong koi ah a om ding hiam a kithukim kei uh hi.

records.english: In the end, we just asked her what she wanted.
records.zomi: A tawp-in bang a deih hiam amah i dong bek hi.

records.english: Could you translate for us, since my neighbor and I don't share a language?
records.zomi: Ka inn veng leh kei pau kibang i nei kei ahih manin hong lehkik sak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: The neighbors' chickens kept coming into our vegetable garden.
records.zomi: Inn vengte' akte i anteh huan sung ah a lut den uh hi.

records.english: We helped them repair their fence, and the chickens stayed home after that.
records.zomi: A kulh bawl siang dingin i huh a, tua khit ciangin akte inn ah a om uh hi.

records.english: Do we really have to argue about this tonight?
records.zomi: Hih thu tuni zanin i kinial taktak ding hiam?

records.english: Although some disagreements can't be solved, they can still be discussed respectfully.
records.zomi: Kithukimlohna khenkhatte bawl siang theih lo hangin zahtak takin kiho thei lai hi.

records.english: Could the school arrange a meeting so that the two families can talk calmly?
records.zomi: Innkuan nihte dai takin a kiho theih nadingun sang in kikhopna khat a bawl thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our football team argued about who should be captain.
records.zomi: I football pawl in kua makai ding hiam a kinial uh hi.

records.english: The coach let each player vote secretly, and we all accepted the result.
records.zomi: Hilhtu in kimawl khat ciat in a sel-in vote a pia dingin a phal a, a kipaina i pom khempeuh hi.

records.english: Shall we take a walk and talk about it later?
records.zomi: Vak-in a nung ciangin tua thu i kiho ding hiam?

records.english: My uncle and my cousin argued for days in the comments under a photo online.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu leh ka sanggam online-a lim nuai-a gelhnate ah ni tampi a kinial uh hi.

records.english: My aunt phoned them both and said, "Stop typing and come to dinner on Sunday."
records.zomi: Ka ni in a nih un a sam a, “Gelh tawp un a, Nipini-in nitak an ah hong pai un,” a ci hi.

records.english: Four of us share a car to work, but we argued about who should pay for fuel.

records.english: Now each person pays for one week a month, and the driver gets a free week.
records.zomi: Tu-in mi khat ciat in kha khat ah kal khat a pia a, a mawngpa in kal khat a man om lo-in a ngah hi.

records.english: Did the two drivers ever agree about whose fault the accident was?
records.zomi: Accident pen kua mawh hiam mawng nihte a kithukim ngei uh hiam?

records.english: Why do small disagreements sometimes hurt more than big ones?
records.zomi: Bang hangin kithukimlohna neute in a liante sangin khatveivei a sukha zaw hiam?

records.english: Whoever disagrees with the plan has to suggest a better one.
records.zomi: Gelna a nial peuhpeuh in a hoih zaw khat a gen ding hi.

records.english: When did you two stop speaking to each other?
records.zomi: Bang ciangin na nih un na kiho tawp uh hiam?

records.english: You must listen to the whole complaint before you reply.
records.zomi: Na dawn ma-in phunna bup na ngai ding hi.

records.english: What I find hardest is staying calm when someone keeps changing the subject.
records.zomi: Ka haksa sak pen pen kuamah in thu a laih den laitakin dai taka om ahi hi.

records.english: The two shopkeepers agreed to open on different days so that they wouldn't compete.
records.zomi: A kidem lo nadingun dawr neipa nihte ni tuamtuam-in hong dingin a kithukim uh hi.

records.english: Nobody in our flat knew whose food was whose in the fridge.
records.zomi: I inn ah khal bawm sung-a an kua' hiam kuamah in a thei kei hi.

records.english: Each of us now has a shelf, and the milk is shared.
records.zomi: Tu-in i khat ciat in koihna khat i nei a, nawi i kihawm hi.

records.english: My grandfather says, "A quarrel lasts only as long as two people keep it going."
records.zomi: Ka pu in, “Kinialna pen mi nih in a zom sung bek a om hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: If you can't agree on a decision, it may help to write down what each person needs most.
records.zomi: Khensatna khat ah na kithukim zo kei leh mi khat ciat in a kisap pen gelh in a huh kha ding hi.

records.english: An argument is like a fire, because it grows if you keep adding to it.
records.zomi: Kinialna pen mei bang ahi a, na behlap den leh a khang hi.

records.english: My son and daughter fight about who sits in the front seat of the car.
records.zomi: Ka tapa leh ka tanu mawtaw mai lam tutna kua in a tu ding hiam a kido uh hi.

records.english: We made a simple rule: the front seat goes to whoever has the longer journey that day.
records.zomi: Thupiak baih khat i bawl hi: mai lam tutna tua ni-in khualzinna sau zaw nei peuhpeuh in a tu ding hi.

records.english: Not until we both stopped talking did we realize that we actually wanted the same thing.
records.zomi: I nih un i kiho tawp ciang bek a taktak in thu kibang mah i deih hi, cih i thei hi.

records.english: Our new neighbor practices the trumpet every evening, and the walls are thin.
records.zomi: I inn veng thak in nitak simin trumpet a kisin a, bangte a pai hi.

records.english: We agreed that she can practice between five and seven, when we're usually out.
records.zomi: I om lo tamzaw hun nai nga leh nai sagih kikal ah a kisin thei hi, ci-in i kithukim hi.

records.english: The disagreement about the wedding date was settled when the hall was only free on one Saturday.
records.zomi: Inn lian Kiginni khat bek ah a awng ciangin mopawi ni thu kithukimlohna a bei hi.

records.english: Do you really need to win every argument?
records.zomi: Kinialna khempeuh na zo ding na kisam taktak hiam?

records.english: Which of you wants to explain first?
records.zomi: Note lak ah kua in a masa-in gen siang a deih hiam?

records.english: How do you settle a disagreement when both people are equally stubborn?
records.zomi: Mi nih a kibang-in a lu a khauh uh ciangin kithukimlohna bangci-in na bawl siang hiam?

records.english: Please don't raise your voice at the referee, even if you think he's wrong.
records.zomi: Na ngaihsutna ah a khial hangin thukhenpa tungah ging sang takin gen kei in.

records.english: My mother wrote both sisters a letter asking them to make peace before her birthday.
records.zomi: Ka nu in a pianni ma-in a kilem kik dingin sanggam nu nihte lai a gelh sak hi.

records.english: The more tired people are, the more easily a small disagreement turns into a quarrel.
records.zomi: Mite a tawl semsem ciangin kithukimlohna neu khat kinialna-in a baih semsem hi.

records.english: What would you do if two friends asked you to take sides?
records.zomi: Lawm nihte in lam khat pang dingin hong ngen leh bang na hih ding hiam?

records.english: My parents disagree about how much television the children should watch.
records.zomi: Naupangte TV bangzah en ding hiam ka nu leh ka pa a kithukim kei uh hi.

records.english: Is it possible to walk to the beach from here, or do I need a taxi?
records.zomi: Hih pan tuipi gei dong kalsuan thei hiam, taxi ka kisam ding hiam?

records.english: The underground station has eight exits, and I came out on the wrong side of the motorway.
records.zomi: Leinuai meileng dinna in pai khiatna giat a nei a, lampi lian gal lam dik lo ah ka hong suak hi.

records.english: Next time, check which exit number is closest to where you're going.
records.zomi: A zom ciangin na pai nading mun a kiang pen pai khiatna number en in.

records.english: Could you draw me a simple map for my mother, since she doesn't use a phone?
