records.english: Please don't follow the footpath across the field, because the bull is out today.
records.zomi: Tuni-in bawngpa a pua ah a om ahih manin lo kan lampi neu zui kei in.

records.english: Whoever knows the way best should drive the first car, and the others can follow.
records.zomi: Lampi a thei pen peuhpeuh in mawtaw masa a mawng ding a, a dangte in a zui thei uh hi.

records.english: People kept telling me to turn left at the old cinema, but it had been knocked down years ago.
records.zomi: Cinema lui ah veilam ah kihei in, ci-in mite in hong hilh den uh a, ahi zongin kum tampi paisa-in kisuksia khin hi.

records.english: A shopkeeper explained that the cinema used to stand where the bank is now.
records.zomi: Bank a om mun ah cinema a ding ngei hi, ci-in dawr neipa khat in a gen siang hi.

records.english: Not until we reached the coast did we realize we had been driving in the wrong direction all morning.
records.zomi: Tuipi gei i tun ciang bek zingsang bup lam dik lo ah i mawng hi, cih i thei hi.

records.english: The university buildings are numbered in a way that makes no sense to new students.
records.zomi: Sangpi inn te sangnaupang thakte adingin a thei theih lo dan in number kipia uh hi.

records.english: The student union now gives every new student a simple map with the main buildings marked.
records.zomi: Tu-in sangnaupang pawl in sangnaupang thak khempeuh inn liante kikhai map baih khat a pia hi.

records.english: When does the last ferry leave for the island?
records.zomi: Tuikulh lam-a long nunung pen bang ciangin a pai hiam?

records.english: Directions from a stranger are like a borrowed coat, because they don't always fit perfectly.
records.zomi: Mi theih loh pan lampi hilhna pen ngetsak kawt bang ahi a, a tawntung-in a kituak kei hi.

records.english: Shall I send you a photo of our gate?
records.zomi: I kongpi lim kong khak ding hiam?

records.english: Who told you that the bridge was closed?
records.zomi: Lei a kikhak hi, ci-in kua in hong hilh hiam?

records.english: Do you have to show identification to enter the government building?
records.zomi: Kumpi inn ah lut dingin mimal lai etsak a kisam hiam?

records.english: Had I written down the address, I wouldn't have spent an hour knocking on the wrong doors.
records.zomi: Omna ka gelh le, kongkhak dik lo kiu-in nai khat ka zang kei ding hi.

records.english: What I find hardest is following directions that use landmarks I've never seen.
records.zomi: Ka haksa sak pen pen ka muh ngei loh lim tawh kigen lampi hilhna zuih ahi hi.

records.english: My grandmother was confused about which bus to take home from the clinic.
records.zomi: Siavuan inn pan inn ciahna bus koi tuang ding hiam ka pi a buai hi.

records.english: The nurse wrote the bus number and the name of her stop on a card for her.
records.zomi: Nurse in a adingin card khat tungah bus number leh a dinna min a gelh hi.

records.english: Although maps on phones are useful, they can't tell you that a road has turned to mud.
records.zomi: Phone tung-a map a manphat hangin lampi bual a suak hi, a gen thei kei hi.

records.english: There are no streetlights on the road to our village, so it's easy to miss the turning at night.
records.zomi: I khua lampi tungah lampi meivak a om kei ahih manin zan ah kiheina a mansuah baih hi.

records.english: My uncle painted a white stone at the corner so that drivers can see it in their headlights.
records.zomi: Mawngte in a mai meivak ah a muh theih nadingun ka pa neu in kil ah suang khat a kang-in a zeek hi.

records.english: If directions sound too complicated, it may help to ask the person to tell you only the first three turns.
records.zomi: Lampi hilhna a buaihuai lua leh a kiheina masa thum bek gen dingin ngen in a huh kha ding hi.

records.english: Where can I get a free map of the city?
records.zomi: Khuapi map a man om lo koi ah ka ngah thei ding hiam?

records.english: Could the council put up signs to the new clinic, since nobody can find it?
records.zomi: Kuamah in a mu thei kei uh ahih manin council in siavuan inn thak lam lahna lai a koih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Rather than relying on the app, my father always asks someone at the local tea shop.
records.zomi: App tungah kinga sangin ka pa in tua mun-a tea dawr ah kuamah a dong tawntung hi.

records.english: How do I find my way back if my phone dies?
records.zomi: Ka phone a mit leh bangci-in ka lampi ka mu kik ding hiam?

records.english: Take a photo of the map before you go, and remember one big landmark.
records.zomi: Na pai ma-in map lim la inla, lim lian khat phawk in.

records.english: The more nervous I am, the more quickly I forget what someone has just told me.
records.zomi: Ka lau semsem ciangin kuamah' hilh thak thu manlang takin ka mangngilh semsem hi.

records.english: What would you do if your phone died in a city you didn't know?
records.zomi: Na theih loh khuapi khat ah na phone a mit leh bang na hih ding hiam?

records.english: My aunt holds the map upside down and then wonders why we're lost.
records.zomi: Ka ni in map a ngei lam-in a len a, tua ciangin bang hangin i mang hiam a lamdang sa hi.

records.english: We need to leave early, because nobody knows the way to the farm in the dark.
records.zomi: Mial sung ah lo pai lampi kuamah in a thei kei ahih manin a ma-in i pai ding hi.

records.english: There are two streets with the same name in our town, and visitors often go to the wrong one.
records.zomi: I khuapi ah min kibang nei lampi nih a om a, khual hongte in a dik lo ah a pai den uh hi.

records.english: Now we tell guests to look for the one beside the river.
records.zomi: Tu-in gun kiang-a om lampi zong dingin khualte i hilh hi.

records.english: The bus stop was moved during the road works, and nobody told the passengers.
records.zomi: Lampi bawlna laitakin bus dinna kisuan a, kuamah in khualzinte a hilh kei hi.

records.english: Did the taxi driver know the way, or did you have to guide him?
records.zomi: Taxi mawngpa in lampi a thei hiam, na lak ding a kisam hiam?

records.english: Having been sent to the wrong village twice, my cousin now asks for the name of a nearby school as well.
records.zomi: Nihvei khua dik lo ah a kisawl khit ciangin ka sanggam in tu-in a kiang-a sang khat min zong a dong hi.

records.english: The road signs had been turned around by the wind, and we drove the wrong way for an hour.
records.zomi: Lampi lahna laite huih in a heisak a, nai khat lam dik lo ah i mawng hi.

records.english: You have to show your pass at the gate before the guard will tell you which building to go to.
records.zomi: Kongpi kemtu in koi inn ah pai ding hiam a hong hilh ma-in kongpi ah na pass na etsak ding hi.

records.english: Some people would rather give you wrong directions than admit they don't know the way.
records.zomi: Mi khenkhatte in lampi a thei kei uh hi, ci-in a pan sangin lampi dik lo hilh a deih zaw uh hi.

records.english: That's why I always ask a second person before I set off.
records.zomi: Tua ahih manin ka pai ma-in mi nihna khat ka dong tawntung hi.

records.english: My friend's directions were perfect, right down to the color of the gate.
records.zomi: Ka lawm' lampi hilhna a kicing mahmah a, kongpi rong dong in.

records.english: Would you mind waiting at the corner so that the taxi can find you?
records.zomi: Taxi in hong muh theih nadingin lampi kiheina ah na ngak thei ding hiam?

records.english: The tour group was split up in the crowded market.
records.zomi: Khualzin pawl mi tam zuakna mun ah a kikhen uh hi.

records.english: The guide had told us to meet at the fountain if that happened, so nobody panicked.
records.zomi: Tua bang a piang leh tuikhuk kiang ah kimu ding, ci-in lampi lak pa in a gen khin ahih manin kuamah a lau kei uh hi.

records.english: The house numbers on our street aren't in order, so delivery drivers often get confused.
records.zomi: I lampi-a inn number te a kizui kei ahih manin van puakte a buai den uh hi.

records.english: We painted our number in large letters on the gate.
records.zomi: I kongpi tungah i number laimal lian takin i zeek hi.

records.english: Why do directions in the countryside always sound simpler than they really are?
records.zomi: Bang hangin lo gam-a lampi hilhnate a taktak sangin a baih bang tawntung hiam?

records.english: Visitors mustn't walk across the airfield, even if it looks like the quickest way.
records.zomi: Khual hongte in a manlang pen lampi bang hangin vanleng tual a kan thei kei uh hi.

records.english: The shopkeeper sent me to his cousin's shop instead of the one I had asked for.
records.zomi: Dawr neipa in ka dot dawr sangin a sanggam' dawr ah hong sawl hi.

records.english: I asked a schoolboy, who walked me to the right shop and wouldn't accept a coin.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang pasal khat ka dong a, dawr dik dong hong paipih a, dangka a sang nuam kei hi.

records.english: Which road is safer for cycling at night?
records.zomi: Koi lampi in zan ah siiksakol tuang adingin a bit zaw hiam?

records.english: How do blind passengers find their way around such a busy station?
records.zomi: Mitcip khualzinte in hih bang mi tam meileng dinna ah bangci-in lampi a mu uh hiam?

records.english: The airport changed our flight to a different terminal, and nobody told us.
records.zomi: Vanlengtual in i vanleng mun dang ah a suan a, kuamah in hong hilh kei uh hi.

records.english: A cleaner noticed our worried faces and took us to the shuttle bus.
records.zomi: Siangsaktu khat in i mai lungkham a mu a, bus neu ah hong paipih hi.

records.english: Children, if we lose each other in the crowd, wait under the big clock.
records.zomi: Naupangte, mi tam lak ah i kimansuah leh nai lian nuai ah ngak un.

records.english: The hospital has so many corridors that visitors get lost all the time.
records.zomi: Zato in inn lam tam lua a nei a, khual hongte a mang den uh hi.

records.english: They painted colored lines on the floor, so you just follow the blue one to the children's ward.
records.zomi: Tual tungah rong tuamtuam khau a zeek uh a, naupangte zato khan dong a dum zui bek in.

records.english: The man at the bus stop said, "I'm going that way myself, so follow me."
records.zomi: Bus dinna-a pasal in, “Keimah zong tua lam ah ka pai ding ahih manin hong zui in,” a ci hi.

records.english: The potholes on our road damaged two of my tires in one month.
records.zomi: I lampi tung-a kua te in kha khat sungin ka tire nih a susia hi.

records.english: We wrote to the council with photos, and the road was repaired before the rainy season.
records.zomi: Lim tawh council kiangah lai i gelh a, guah hun ma-in lampi kibawl siang hi.

records.english: A driver behind us kept flashing his lights and driving far too close.
records.zomi: I nung-a mawngpa khat in meivak a vaksak den a, a kiang lua-in a mawng hi.

records.english: My father pulled over calmly and let him pass, instead of speeding up.
records.zomi: Ka pa in manlang zaw-a mawng sangin dai takin a tawlsak a, a khen dingin a phal hi.

records.english: Petrol was so scarce that the queue at the station stretched down the road.
records.zomi: Datsi a tawm lua ahih manin datsi zuakna-a mite kikhaina lampi dong a sau hi.

records.english: We shared one car with two other families until the deliveries came back.
records.zomi: Van puaknate a hong kik dong innkuan dang nih tawh mawtaw khat i kihawm hi.

records.english: The police officer said, "Your tax disc has expired, so you need to renew it this week."
records.zomi: Palik in, “Na mawtaw siah lai hun a bei khin ahih manin hih kal sungin a thak la in,” a ci hi.

records.english: Would you mind moving your car so that the rubbish truck can get past?
records.zomi: Nawi mawtaw a pai theih nadingin na mawtaw na suan thei ding hiam?

records.english: Could the school put up a sign asking parents not to park on the crossing?
records.zomi: Nu leh pate lampi kanna tungah mawtaw koih lo dingin sang in lai khat a koih thei ding hiam?

records.english: How do you teach a teenager to stay calm in heavy traffic?
records.zomi: Mawtaw tam sung ah dai taka om dingin khangno khat bangci-in na hilh hiam?

records.english: What would you do if your brakes felt soft halfway down a steep hill?
records.zomi: Mual ding kimlai-in na mawtaw tawlsakna a nem bang leh bang na hih ding hiam?

records.english: Had I checked the oil before the trip, the engine wouldn't have overheated halfway up the mountain.
records.zomi: Khualzinna ma-in sathau ka en le, mual kah kimlai-in set a sa lua kei ding hi.

records.english: Not until the mechanic lifted the car did we see how badly the exhaust pipe had rusted.
records.zomi: Set bawlpa in mawtaw a domsang ciang bek meikhu khuam a ngawn mahmah hi, cih i mu hi.

records.english: Grandpa's eyesight has got worse, but he still insists on driving.
records.zomi: Ka pu' mit a hoih lo semsem hangin mawng dingin a ngen lai hi.

records.english: The doctor told him he must have his eyes tested before he drives again.
records.zomi: A kik ma-in a mit en sak dingin a siavuan in a hilh hi.

records.english: Where's the nearest garage that's open on Sundays?
records.zomi: Nipini-in a kihong set bawlna inn a kiang pen koi ah a om hiam?

records.english: Do I have to pay the parking fine if the sign was hidden behind a tree?
records.zomi: Lai singkung nung ah a bu leh mawtaw koih man lak ka pia ding hiam?

records.english: The car was so covered in snow that we had to brush it off before we could see the windows.
records.zomi: Mawtaw vuk in a khuh lua ahih manin tukvuang i muh theih ma-in i phiat ding a kisam hi.

records.english: The more tired you are, the slower your reactions become behind the wheel.
records.zomi: Na tawl semsem ciangin mawtaw mawng laitakin na kidawk a zawi semsem hi.

records.english: Who left the headlights on all night?
records.zomi: Zan bup mai lam meivak kua in a nusia hiam?

records.english: Which road has fewer speed bumps?
records.zomi: Koi lampi in lampi tung-a kuang a tawm zaw hiam?

records.english: You mustn't leave children alone in a parked car, even for a minute.
records.zomi: Minit khat bek hi zongin koih mawtaw sung ah naupangte amau bek nusia kei in.

records.english: Why were the traffic lights outside the school changed?
records.zomi: Bang hangin sang pua-a mawtaw meivak lahnate kilai hiam?

records.english: My son gets car sick on mountain roads.
records.zomi: Ka tapa mual lampi ah mawtaw a lua nuam hi.

records.english: We stop every half hour and let him walk for a few minutes in the fresh air.
records.zomi: Nai khen khat simin i tawl a, huih siang sung ah minit tawmno a vak dingin i phal hi.

records.english: What I find hardest about driving in the city is guessing what the motorbikes will do next.
records.zomi: Khuapi ah mawtaw mawng ah ka haksa sak pen pen motorbike te in a zom bang a hih ding uh hiam ngaihsut ahi hi.

records.english: Although driving lessons are expensive, they're cheaper than repairing a car after an accident.
records.zomi: Mawtaw mawng kisinna a man tam hangin accident khit-a mawtaw bawl siang sangin a neem zaw hi.

records.english: Motorbike riders must wear helmets on all roads in our district.
records.zomi: I khua sung lampi khempeuh ah motorbike tuangte in lukhu khauh a bulh ding uh hi.

records.english: My brother lent me his car while mine was being repaired.
records.zomi: Keima' kibawl siang laitakin ka sanggam pasal in a mawtaw hong ngetsak hi.

records.english: The bridge was closed after a lorry hit one of its supports.
records.zomi: Lorry khat in a khuam khat a sut khit ciangin lei a kikhak hi.

records.english: Drivers had to use the old ferry for three months while it was repaired.
records.zomi: Kibawl siang laitakin kha thum sung mawngte in long lui a zang uh hi.

records.english: Our neighbor's car alarm went off every night for a week.
records.zomi: I inn veng' mawtaw alarm kal khat sung zan simin a ging hi.

records.english: We left a polite note on his windscreen, and he had the alarm fixed the next day.
records.zomi: A mai lam glass tungah lai nem khat i nusia a, a zing ni-in alarm a bawl siang sak hi.

records.english: Shall I drive, since you've been working all day?
records.zomi: Ni bup na sem khin ahih manin keimah ka mawng ding hiam?

records.english: The truck in front was so overloaded that boxes kept falling off.
records.zomi: Mai lam-a mawtaw lian a van gik lua ahih manin bawmte a kia den hi.

records.english: I kept well back and phoned the police from a safe place to report it.
records.zomi: Gamla takin ka om a, mun bit khat pan gen dingin palik ka sam hi.

records.english: Is it possible to change a tire without a jack?
records.zomi: Jack om lo-in tire khat lai thei hiam?

records.english: The low sun was so bright in the evening that I could hardly see the road.
records.zomi: Nitak lam-a ni niam a vak lua ahih manin lampi ka mu thei dek kei hi.

records.english: Now I keep sunglasses in the car and leave work a little earlier in winter.
records.zomi: Tu-in mawtaw sung ah mitkhuh mial ka koih a, khuavot ciangin nasepna tawmno ma-in ka nusia hi.

records.english: Can you teach me how to check the oil?
records.zomi: Sathau en dan hong hilh thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: The windows kept steaming up on the cold morning drive.
records.zomi: Zingsang vot mawtaw mawngna ah tukvuangte meikhu tawh a kikhuh den hi.

records.english: My wife turned on the fan and opened her window a little, and the glass cleared.
records.zomi: Ka zi in fan a vaksak a, a tukvuang tawmno a hon a, glass a siang hi.

records.english: Having driven the same road every day for twenty years, my uncle knows every pothole by heart.
records.zomi: Kum sawmnih sung ni simin lampi kibang a mawng khit ciangin ka pa neu in kua khempeuh a lungsim ah a thei hi.

records.english: Driving angry is like cooking with a blindfold on, because you can't see the danger coming.
records.zomi: Heh-a mawtaw mawng pen mit khuh-a an huan bang ahi a, lauhuaina a hong pai na mu thei kei hi.

records.english: I locked my keys inside the car at the petrol station.
records.zomi: Datsi zuakna ah ka tawh mawtaw sung ah ka khak kha hi.

records.english: A mechanic opened the door with a thin strip of metal in less than a minute.
records.zomi: Set bawlpa khat in minit khat sungin thih neu khat tawh kongkhak a hon hi.

records.english: The bus lane is only for buses and taxis between seven and ten in the morning.
records.zomi: Bus lampi pen zingsang nai sagih pan nai sawm dong bus leh taxi bek adingin ahi hi.

records.english: Did the garage say how long the repair would take?
records.zomi: Bawlsiangna bangzah a sawt ding hiam set bawlna inn in a gen hiam?

records.english: You need to switch on your hazard lights if you break down on a busy road.
records.zomi: Mawtaw tam lampi tungah na mawtaw a sia leh lauhuaina meivak na vaksak ding hi.

records.english: There was a long queue at the only charging point for electric cars.
records.zomi: Meivak mawtaw adingin mei khukna mun khat bek ah mite kikhaina sau a om hi.

records.english: I now charge the car at home overnight so that I don't have to wait.
records.zomi: Ka ngak lo nadingin tu-in zan bup inn ah mawtaw mei ka khuk hi.

records.english: My daughter kept stalling the car when she had to stop on a hill.
records.zomi: Mual tungah a tawlsak ciangin ka tanu' mawtaw a mit den hi.

records.english: Her instructor took her to a quiet slope and stayed calm until she could start without rolling back.
records.zomi: A hilhtu in mual neu dai khat ah a paipih a, a kiat kik lo-in a kipat theih dong dai takin a om hi.

records.english: Whoever drives home tonight mustn't drink any alcohol at the party.
records.zomi: Tuni zan inn lam a mawng peuhpeuh in pawi ah zu a dawn lo ding hi.

records.english: Rather than arguing with the driver who hit my car, I took photos and exchanged phone numbers.
records.zomi: Ka mawtaw a sut mawngpa tawh kinial sangin lim ka la a, phone number i kilai hi.

records.english: The reversing camera stopped working, and I almost hit a bicycle behind the car.
records.zomi: Nung lam camera a sem nawn kei a, mawtaw nung-a siiksakol khat ka sut dek hi.

records.english: I had it repaired the same week, and I always look over my shoulder now as well.
records.zomi: Kal kibang mah-in ka bawl siang sak a, tu-in ka liang tung pan ka en tawntung hi.

records.english: Why do so many drivers ignore the speed limit near the market?
records.zomi: Bang hangin mawng tampi in zuakna mun kiang ah a manlang theih pen a nial uh hiam?

records.english: When did you last check the spare tire?
records.zomi: Tire behlap bang ciangin na en nunung hiam?

records.english: If you feel sleepy while driving, it's safer to stop and rest than to keep going.
records.zomi: Mawtaw na mawng laitakin na ihmut nuam leh na mawng den sangin tawl-in tawldam a bit zaw hi.

records.english: My test was marked wrongly, so I asked the teacher to check it again.
records.zomi: Ka sitna dik lo-in kiciamte pia ahih manin kik-in en dingin saya ka ngen hi.

records.english: She found the mistake and added ten marks to my score.
records.zomi: Khialhna a mu a, ka ciamte ah sawm a behlap hi.

records.english: Rather than staying up all night, I reviewed my notes for an hour and then went to sleep.
records.zomi: Zan bup ka mit khak sangin nai khat sung ka thu gelhte ka en kik a, tua ciangin ka ihmu hi.

records.english: Is it possible to take the exam on a different day if I'm ill?
records.zomi: Ka dam kei leh sitna ni dang khat ah ka la thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, but you'll need a note from a doctor.
records.zomi: Thei hi, ahi zongin siavuan pan lai khat na kisam ding hi.

records.english: We have a math test on Friday.
records.zomi: Laithai ni-in math sitna i nei hi.

records.english: Although exams can be stressful, they also show students how much they have learned.
records.zomi: Sitnate in lungkhamna a piak thei hangin sangnaupangte in bangzah a sin khin uh hiam zong a lak hi.

records.english: I don't need to take the entrance exam again, because my results from last year still count.
records.zomi: Kum nung-a ka kipaina a kisim lai ahih manin sang lutna sitna ka la kik ding a kisam kei hi.

records.english: When do the exams start?
records.zomi: Bang ciangin sitnate a kipan ding hiam?

records.english: On the first Monday of June, with history in the morning.
records.zomi: June-a Pizing ni masa pen-in, zingsangin tangthu tawh.

records.english: Wouldn't it be fairer to assess students on their projects as well as on a single final exam?
records.zomi: A tawp sitna khat bek tawh sangin sangnaupangte a project uh tawh zong en a dik zaw ding hi lo hiam?

records.english: Copying another student's answers is considered cheating and can lead to a failing grade.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang dang' dawnnate copy pen zuauna-in kingaihsun a, zo lo ciamte a tawi thei hi.

records.english: I need to pass this test to move up to the next class.
records.zomi: A zom kilasi ah ka khan nadingin hih sitna ka zo ding a kisam hi.

records.english: How long do we have for the essay question?
records.zomi: Essay dotna adingin hun bangzah i nei hiam?

records.english: What worries me most is not the exam itself but the long wait for the results.
records.zomi: Hong lungkhamsak pen pen sitna mah hi lo-in kipaina sawt taka ngak ahi hi.

records.english: Why are the exam results taking so long this year?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tu kum sitna kipaina a sawt mahmah hiam?

records.english: Do we have to write in pen, or can we use pencil?
records.zomi: Khuai-mal tawh i gelh ding hiam, khedal i zang thei ding hiam?

records.english: My son's exam was cancelled because of the floods, and it was rescheduled for the following week.
records.zomi: Tuiciim hangin ka tapa' sitna kikhak a, a zom kal ah kisuan hi.

records.english: You must write your name and student number on the front of the paper.
records.zomi: Laimai mai lam ah na min leh na sangnaupang number na gelh ding hi.

records.english: The results will be posted on the notice board next Thursday.
records.zomi: A zom Laizing ni-in kipainate thu theihsakna bang tungah kikhai ding hi.

records.english: Did you finish all the questions in time?
records.zomi: Hun sung ah dotna khempeuh na zo hiam?

records.english: Not until I opened the envelope did I believe that I had passed.
records.zomi: Lai ip ka hon ciang bek ka zo hi, cih ka um hi.

records.english: Some teachers believe that regular small tests are more useful than one big exam at the end of the year.
records.zomi: Saya khenkhatte in kum tawp-a sitna lian khat sangin a tawntung-a sitna neute a manphat zaw hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: The exam papers were locked in the head teacher's office until the morning of the test.
records.zomi: Sitna laite sitna zingsang dong sang makaipa' office ah kikhak hi.

records.english: Could the school provide a quieter room for students who are easily distracted?
records.zomi: A lungsim kihei baih sangnaupangte adingin sang in khan dai zaw khat a pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: I studied with a friend so that we could explain the hard topics to each other.
records.zomi: Thu haksate khat leh khat i gen siang theih nadingin lawm khat tawh ka sin hi.

records.english: Who is going to mark the practical exam?
records.zomi: Sep taka sitna kua in ciamte a pia ding hiam?

records.english: At our school, phones are not allowed in the exam hall.
records.zomi: I sang ah sitna khan sung ah phone kiphal lo hi.

records.english: My hands were shaking when I turned over the first page.
records.zomi: Laimai masa pen ka heih ciangin ka khut a ling hi.

records.english: The more past papers you practice, the less surprised you'll be by the real exam.
records.zomi: Sitna lui na kisin tam semsem ciangin sitna taktak in hong lamdangsak tawm semsem ding hi.

records.english: My mother made me go to bed early the night before my final exam.
records.zomi: Ka sitna nunung pen ma zan-in ka nu in ma-in hong lumsak hi.

records.english: We finished the test by the light from the windows, and nobody complained.
records.zomi: Tukvuangte pan meivak tawh sitna i zo a, kuamah a phun kei hi.

records.english: I'm studying every evening this week so that I'm ready for my exams.
records.zomi: Ka sitnate adingin ka kiman nadingin hih kal sungin nitak simin ka sin hi.

records.english: The lights went out in the middle of the chemistry exam.
records.zomi: Chemistry sitna kimlai-in meivak a mit hi.

records.english: My little sister cried when she saw her test results, but they were actually very good.
records.zomi: Ka nau nu in a sitna kipaina a muh ciangin a kap a, ahi zongin a hoih mahmah hi.

records.english: Please put your pens down; the time is up.
records.zomi: Na khuai-mal uh koih un; hun a bei hi.

records.english: My grandfather wrote his exams by candlelight because his village had no electricity.
records.zomi: Ka pu' khua meivak a nei kei ahih manin khawimeivaak tawh a sitnate a gelh hi.

records.english: I had to take the driving test three times before I passed.
records.zomi: Ka zawh ma-in mawtaw mawng sitna thumvei ka la ding a kisam hi.

records.english: If a student is too anxious to sit an exam, the school may allow extra time or a quiet room.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang khat sitna la dingin a lau lua leh sang in hun behlap hiam khan dai khat a pia thei hi.

records.english: Having studied for months, my cousin felt calm and confident on the morning of the exam.
records.zomi: Kha tampi a sin khit ciangin ka sanggam sitna zingsangin a dai a, a kician hi.

records.english: Two students were sent out of the room for talking during the test.
records.zomi: Sitna laitakin a kiho manin sangnaupang nih khan pan kisawl khia uh hi.

records.english: An exam is like a snapshot, because it shows only one moment of what a student knows.
records.zomi: Sitna pen lim khat bang ahi a, sangnaupang khat in a theih hun khat bek a lak hi.

records.english: Our teacher gave us old exam papers so that we could practice at home.
records.zomi: Inn ah i kisin theih nadingin i saya in sitna lai luite hong pia hi.

records.english: Calculators are allowed in the physics exam but not in the math exam.
records.zomi: Physics sitna ah calculator kiphal a, ahi zongin math sitna ah kiphal lo hi.

records.english: How did the test go?
records.zomi: Sitna bangci-in a pai hiam?

records.english: Better than I expected, though the last question was very hard.
records.zomi: Ka lamen sangin a hoih zaw hi, dotna nunung pen a haksa mahmah hangin.

records.english: Tell me honestly whether you've studied for tomorrow's test.
records.zomi: Zingciang sitna adingin na sin hiam thuman takin hong gen in.

records.english: Which subject are you most worried about?
records.zomi: Koi laibu thu na lungkham pen hiam?

records.english: The listening test had to be repeated because the speakers stopped working.
records.zomi: Ging bawlnate a sem nawn loh manin ngaihna sitna kik-in kibawl ding a kisam hi.

records.english: Shall we study together in the library after school?
records.zomi: Sang khit ciangin laibu inn ah khawm-in i sin ding hiam?

records.english: My older brother helped me revise by asking me questions every night.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal in zan simin dotna hong dot-in hong kisinsak hi.

records.english: Class, you need to bring two pencils and an eraser on Monday.
records.zomi: Kilasi, Pizing ni-in khedal nih leh phiatna khat na tawi ding uh hi.

records.english: The teacher said, "You have one hour, and you may begin now."
records.zomi: Saya in, “Nai khat na nei uh a, tu-in na kipan thei uh hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: Would you mind testing me on these dates before dinner?
records.zomi: Nitak an ma-in hih nite tungah hong et thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: What would you do if you forgot everything the moment you sat down?
records.zomi: Na tut pah-in khempeuh na mangngilh leh bang na hih ding hiam?

records.english: Students who arrive more than half an hour late won't be allowed into the exam.
records.zomi: Nai khen khat sangin a nun zaw sangnaupangte sitna ah kiphal lo ding hi.

records.english: Whoever finishes early should check their answers instead of leaving the room.
records.zomi: A zo masa peuhpeuh in khan nusia sangin a dawnnate a en kik ding hi.

records.english: The questions were so unclear that half the class misunderstood the first one.
records.zomi: Dotnate a kician lo lua ahih manin kilasi a khen khat in a masa pen a thei khial uh hi.

records.english: Had I read the question more carefully, I wouldn't have answered the wrong part.
records.zomi: Dotna pilvang zawin ka sim le, a khen dik lo ka dawng kei ding hi.

records.english: Where do we collect our certificates?
records.zomi: I certificate te koi ah i la ding hiam?

records.english: Who left this umbrella on the seat?
records.zomi: Tutna tungah hih kawl lukhu kua in a nusia hiam?

records.english: The bus company made all the drivers take a course on helping disabled passengers.
records.zomi: Bus company in mawng khempeuh hatlohna nei khualzinte huh dan kisinna a kahsak hi.

records.english: Where can I report a problem with the ticket machine?
records.zomi: Ticket set buaina koi ah ka gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Why do the trains always slow down at this bridge?
records.zomi: Bang hangin hih lei ah meileng te a zawi den uh hiam?

records.english: My wallet was stolen on the crowded bus to the market.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun lam-a bus mi tam tungah ka sum ip kiguk hi.

records.english: Now I keep my money in an inside pocket and my bag in front of me.
records.zomi: Tu-in ka sum sung lam ip ah ka koih a, ka ip ka mai lam ah ka koih hi.

records.english: Although public transport can be crowded, it is much cheaper than running a car.
records.zomi: Mipi mawtaw a dim thei hangin mawtaw neih sangin a neem zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: A bus that never comes is like a promise that's never kept.
records.zomi: A hong ngei lo bus pen kizui ngei lo kiciamna bang ahi hi.

records.english: Is the night bus safe for a woman traveling alone?
records.zomi: Amah bek khualzin numei khat adingin zan bus a bit hiam?

records.english: Not until the trains stopped running during the strike did people realize how much the city depended on them.
records.zomi: Nasep tawpna laitakin meileng a tawp ciang bek khuapi in bangzah a kinga hiam mite in a thei uh hi.

records.english: Shall we get off here and walk the rest of the way?
records.zomi: Hih ah i tum ding a, a dang lampi i kalsuan ding hiam?

records.english: My son got off the train one stop too early and couldn't find me.
records.zomi: Ka tapa meileng pan dinna khat ma-in a tum a, hong mu thei kei hi.

records.english: He remembered what we had practiced and asked a station worker to call my number.
records.zomi: I kisin pen a phawk a, ka number sam dingin meileng dinna nasem khat a ngen hi.

records.english: Could the city run a late bus on Saturdays for the workers at the hospital?
records.zomi: Zato-a nasemte adingin khuapi in Kiginni simin bus nai khat a sem thei ding hiam?

records.english: The train was diverted because of flooding, and we arrived three hours late.
records.zomi: Tuiciim hangin meileng lampi dang ah a pai a, nai thum nun-in i tung hi.

records.english: If the timetable keeps changing, it may help to sign up for messages from the bus company.
records.zomi: Hun gelna a kilai den leh bus company pan thu khak ngah dingin min na gelh in a huh kha ding hi.

records.english: Please don't block the doors with your bags.
records.zomi: Na ip uh tawh kongkhak khak kei un.

records.english: What I find hardest about the subway is changing lines with a heavy suitcase.
records.zomi: Leinuai meileng ah ka haksa sak pen pen van bawm gik tawh lampi kilai ahi hi.

records.english: Which carriage is the quiet one?
records.zomi: Koi meileng khan in a dai hiam?

records.english: When does the first ferry leave in the morning?
records.zomi: Zingsangin long masa pen bang ciangin a pai hiam?

records.english: What would you do if the train stopped in a tunnel and the lights went out?
records.zomi: Meileng leinuai lampi sung ah a tawp a, meivak a mit leh bang na hih ding hiam?

records.english: The bus stops were moved during the road works, and nobody was told where the new ones were.
records.zomi: Lampi bawlna laitakin bus dinnate kisuan a, a thakte koi ah a om hiam kuamah kihilh lo hi.

records.english: Volunteers stood at the old stops for a week to send people in the right direction.
records.zomi: Mite lam dik ah a sawl nadingun kal khat sung thalawpte dinna lui ah a ding uh hi.

records.english: The ramp on the bus was broken, so my neighbor in her wheelchair couldn't get on.
records.zomi: Bus-a kahna a sia ahih manin tutna leng a tu ka inn veng a tuang thei kei hi.

records.english: The driver called the depot, and they sent another bus within twenty minutes.
records.zomi: Mawngpa in bus koihna a sam a, minit sawmnih sungin bus dang khat a sawl uh hi.

records.english: Did the driver say how long we'd be waiting?
records.zomi: Bangzah sawt i ngak ding hiam mawngpa in a gen hiam?

records.english: Having missed the last train twice, my brother now sets an alarm half an hour before it leaves.
records.zomi: Meileng nunung pen nihvei a mansuah khit ciangin ka sanggam pasal in tu-in a pai ma nai khen khat ah alarm a koih hi.

records.english: My aunt knitted a whole scarf on her way to the capital.
records.zomi: Ka ni in khuapi lian a pai lampi ah ngawngkhih bup a phiar hi.

records.english: The bus was so full that the driver had to refuse the last few passengers.
records.zomi: Bus a dim lua ahih manin mawngpa in khualzin nunung tawmno a nial ding a kisam hi.

records.english: A man was talking so loudly on his phone that nobody in the carriage could rest.
records.zomi: Pasal khat a phone tungah ging sang lua takin a kiho ahih manin meileng khan sung-a kuamah a tawldam thei kei uh hi.

records.english: The conductor politely asked him to move to the area between the carriages.
records.zomi: Meileng nasempa in meileng khan nih kikal mun ah pai dingin zahtak takin a ngen hi.

records.english: The timetable at our stop was printed so small that my grandfather couldn't read it.
records.zomi: I dinna-a hun gelna lai a neu lua-in kigelh ahih manin ka pu in a sim thei kei hi.

records.english: The council replaced it with a larger one after several older passengers complained.
records.zomi: Khualzin upa tampi in a phun khit uh ciangin council in a lian zaw khat tawh a lai hi.

records.english: I was fined because my ticket was for the wrong zone.
records.zomi: Ka ticket mun dik lo adingin ahih manin man hong la uh hi.

records.english: I wrote to the transport office, explaining that the machine had no zone instructions, and they cancelled the fine.
records.zomi: Set in mun thu a hilh kei hi, ci-in mawtaw office kiangah lai ka gelh a, man lak a khek uh hi.

records.english: Could you tell me whether this bus has space for a pram?
records.zomi: Hih bus in naungek leng adingin mun a nei hiam hong gen thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: The school bus was late almost every morning last term.
records.zomi: Term nung in sang bus zingsang dek simin a nun hi.

records.english: The parents wrote a letter together, and the company changed the route to avoid the market traffic.
records.zomi: Nu leh pate in khawm-in lai a gelh uh a, company in zuakna mun mawtaw tam pelh dingin a lampi a laih hi.

records.english: The overnight bus didn't stop for a toilet break for five hours.
records.zomi: Zan bus nai nga sung ek inn adingin a tawl kei hi.

records.english: The air conditioning broke down on the six-hour bus journey.
records.zomi: Nai guk bus khualzinna ah air con a sia hi.

records.english: At the next stop, the driver bought bottles of water for every passenger.
records.zomi: A zom dinna ah mawngpa in khualzin khempeuh adingin tui bel a lei hi.

records.english: The bus drove straight past me although I was waving at the stop.
records.zomi: Dinna ah ka khut ka vaai hangin bus in hong khen bek hi.

records.english: I complained to the bus company, and they had the driver retrained.
records.zomi: Bus company kiangah ka phun a, mawngpa kik-in a kisinsak uh hi.

records.english: Had the guard not noticed my bag on the platform, it would have been lost forever.
records.zomi: Platform tung-a ka ip kongpi kemtu in a mu kei le, a tawntung-in a mang ding hi.

records.english: The ticket app crashed just as the inspector reached our row.
records.zomi: Enkaktu i tan a tun laitakin ticket app a sia hi.

records.english: He said, "Show me the payment on your bank app instead," and that was enough.
records.zomi: Amah in, “Tua sangin na bank app tung-a piakna hong etsak in,” a ci a, tua a kicing hi.

records.english: Bicycles aren't allowed on the trams in our city during rush hour.
records.zomi: I khuapi ah mawtaw tam hun sungin tram tungah siiksakol kiphal lo hi.

records.english: How do you travel with three small children on the metro?
records.zomi: Naupang neu thum tawh metro tungah bangci-in na khualzin hiam?

records.english: The more often you travel on the same route, the more drivers and passengers you get to know.
records.zomi: Lampi kibang ah na khualzin den semsem ciangin mawngte leh khualzinte na thei tam semsem hi.

records.english: Do I have to buy a ticket for my little daughter?
records.zomi: Ka tanu neu adingin ticket ka lei ding hiam?

records.english: Two of us had been sold the same seat on the overnight train.
records.zomi: Zan meileng ah ei nih tutna kibang hong kizuak hi.

records.english: The guard found me a bed in the next carriage and apologized for the mistake.
records.zomi: Meileng nasempa in a kiang khan ah lupna khat hong mu sak a, khialhna adingin maisak a ngen hi.

records.english: Rather than waiting for a bus that might never come, we shared a taxi with two strangers.
records.zomi: A hong ngei lo kha ding bus ngak sangin mi theih loh nih tawh taxi khat i kihawm hi.

records.english: Kids, don't run on the platform, because it's slippery after the rain.
records.zomi: Naupangte, guah khit ciangin a nal ahih manin platform tungah tai kei un.

records.english: The ferry was so rough that half the passengers felt seasick.
records.zomi: Long a kihuk lua ahih manin khualzin a khen khat in lua a nuam uh hi.

records.english: A sailor told us to stand in the middle of the boat and look at the horizon.
records.zomi: Long nasem khat in long laizang ah ding-in van leh tuipi kikhopna en dingin hong hilh hi.

records.english: Whoever sees a passenger in trouble should press the red emergency button.
records.zomi: Buaina tuak khualzin khat a mu peuhpeuh in lauhuaina button san a nek ding hi.

records.english: My suitcase was too big for the luggage rack.
records.zomi: Ka van bawm van koihna adingin a lian lua hi.

records.english: A student helped me lift it onto the shelf at the end of the carriage.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang khat in meileng khan tawp-a koihna tungah koih dingin hong huh hi.

records.english: Would you mind keeping an eye on my bag while I buy a ticket?
records.zomi: Ticket ka lei laitakin ka ip na en sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Do we need to book seats on the express bus?
records.zomi: Bus manlang tungah tutna i koih khol ding hiam?

records.english: My bank card didn't work in any of the city's cash machines.
records.zomi: Khuapi-a sum lakna set khatpeuh ah ka bank card a sem kei hi.

records.english: I called the bank, and they explained that I had to tell them before traveling.
records.zomi: Bank ka sam a, khualzin ma-in ka hilh ding uh hi, ci-in a gen siang uh hi.

records.english: If you're visiting relatives in another city, it may help to bring your own bedding.
records.zomi: Khuapi dang-a sanggamte na veh leh nangma' lupna vante na tawi in a huh kha ding hi.

records.english: What would you do if you arrived in the middle of a festival with nowhere to stay?
records.zomi: Omna om lo-in pawi kimlai-in na tun leh bang na hih ding hiam?

records.english: The more you plan, the more time you have to enjoy the city once you arrive.
records.zomi: Na gel tam semsem ciangin na tun khit ciangin khuapi a nopsakna hun na nei tam semsem hi.

records.english: How do you travel with an elderly parent who tires easily?
records.zomi: Manlang taka a tawl nu hiam pa hiam upa khat tawh bangci-in na khualzin hiam?

records.english: When is the best season to visit the capital?
records.zomi: Khuapi lian veh nading hun hoih pen bang ciang ahi hiam?

records.english: What I find hardest about city trips is sleeping in a room with traffic outside all night.
records.zomi: Khuapi khualzinna ah ka haksa sak pen pen zan bup pua ah mawtaw ging om khan ah ihmut ahi hi.

records.english: People in the city speak so quickly that my grandmother couldn't understand them at first.
records.zomi: Khuapi-a mite manlang lua takin a gen uh ahih manin ka pi in a masa-in a thei kei hi.

records.english: Traveling with too much luggage is like running with stones in your pockets.
records.zomi: Van tam lua tawh khualzin pen na ip sung ah suang tawh tai bang ahi hi.

records.english: The cousins we stayed with gave up their beds and slept on the floor for a week.
records.zomi: I omna sanggamte in a lupna uh hong pia uh a, kal khat sung tual ah a ihmu uh hi.

records.english: Did your cousin meet you at the station?
records.zomi: Na sanggam in meileng dinna ah hong dawn hiam?

records.english: Whoever carries the tickets should check them before we leave each hotel.
records.zomi: Ticket a tawi peuhpeuh in zinbuuk khat ciat i nusiat ma-in a en ding hi.

records.english: The tap water in the city upset my stomach.
records.zomi: Khuapi-a tui khuk tui in ka gil a nasak hi.

records.english: After that, we drank only bottled water and had no more problems.
records.zomi: Tua khit ciangin bel-a tui bek i dawn a, buaina i nei nawn kei hi.

records.english: Had we checked the festival dates, we wouldn't have arrived when every hotel was full.
records.zomi: Pawi ni i en le, zinbuuk khempeuh a dim laitakin i tung kei ding hi.

records.english: The bus to the city was cancelled because the driver had fallen ill.
records.zomi: Mawngpa a dam loh manin khuapi lam bus a kikhak hi.

records.english: The company found another driver, but we left four hours late.
records.zomi: Company in mawngpa dang khat a mu a, ahi zongin nai li nun-in i pai khia hi.

records.english: Rather than paying for a tour, we asked a local student to show us around for the afternoon.
records.zomi: Khualzinna man pia sangin hih mun sangnaupang khat nitak lam khat hong etsak dingin i ngen hi.

records.english: Where can we leave our luggage after we check out?
records.zomi: I pai khiat khit ciangin i vante koi ah i nusia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our flight was moved to the next morning, so the airline paid for a hotel near the airport.
records.zomi: I vanleng a zing zingsang ah kisuan a, vanleng company in vanlengtual kiang-a zinbuuk man a pia hi.

records.english: Although the city looked frightening from the bus window, it felt friendly once we started walking.
records.zomi: Bus tukvuang pan khuapi a lauhuai bang hangin i vak kipat ciangin a nuam bang hi.

records.english: The main road into the city was blocked by a protest.
records.zomi: Khuapi lutna lampi lian kinialna pawl khat in a khak hi.

records.english: Our driver took a long detour through the villages, and we arrived just before dark.
records.zomi: I mawngpa in khuate tungtawn lampi sau khat a zang a, khua a mial ma pah-in i tung hi.

records.english: Our suitcase was sent to another city by mistake.
records.zomi: I van bawm khialh-in khuapi dang ah kikhak hi.

records.english: The airline delivered it to our hotel two days later, and we borrowed clothes from our cousins until then.
records.zomi: Ni nih khit ciangin vanleng company in i zinbuuk ah a puak a, tua dong i sanggamte pan puan i ngetsak hi.

records.english: Could the company pay for a night in a hotel, since the meeting finishes so late?
records.zomi: Kikhopna a nai mahmah-in a bei ahih manin company in zinbuuk-a zan khat man a pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: My phone was stolen in the busy market on our first afternoon.
records.zomi: I nitak lam masa pen-in mi tam zuakna mun ah ka phone kiguk hi.

records.english: We had written our hotel's address on paper, so we still found our way back.
records.zomi: I zinbuuk omna laipek tungah i gelh khin ahih manin i ciahna lampi i mu lai hi.

records.english: The address my uncle had given us was his old one.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu in hong piak omna pen a omna lui ahi hi.

records.english: The new family living there knew him and walked us to his flat three streets away.
records.zomi: Tua ah a om innkuan thak in a thei uh a, lampi thum gamla-a a inn dong hong paipih uh hi.

records.english: Shall we take the early bus and spend the whole day there?
records.zomi: Zingsang bus masa la-in tua ah ni bup i zang ding hiam?

records.english: The car we rented broke down on the motorway outside the city.
records.zomi: I hal mawtaw khuapi pua-a lampi lian tungah a sia hi.

records.english: The rental company sent a replacement within an hour, so we still reached the wedding.
records.zomi: Hal company in nai khat sungin a dang khat a sawl a, tua ahih manin mopawi ah i tung lai hi.

records.english: We bought the bus tickets for the wrong day and had to change them at the counter.
records.zomi: Ni dik lo adingin bus ticket i lei a, sum piakna mun ah i lai ding a kisam hi.

records.english: Who's going to open the shop on Saturday if we're still in the city?
records.zomi: Khuapi ah i om lai leh Kiginni-in dawr kua in a hong ding hiam?

records.english: Can we carry the baby's stroller onto the plane?
records.zomi: Vanleng tungah naungek leng i pua thei ding hiam?

records.english: Not until we reached the city did we realize that we had left the gifts on the bus.
records.zomi: Khuapi i tun ciang bek letsongte bus tungah i nusia hi, cih i thei hi.

records.english: Having traveled to the capital every month for work, my sister knows the cheapest places to eat.
records.zomi: Nasep adingin kha simin khuapi lian a pai khit ciangin ka sanggam nu in an nekna mun neem pen te a thei hi.

records.english: My son was so excited about the tall buildings that he took a hundred photos on the first day.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in inn sangte a lungdampih lua ahih manin ni masa pen-in lim za khat a la hi.

records.english: Everyone, please write the hotel's phone number on your hand in case we get separated.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, i kikhen kha leh na khut tungah zinbuuk' phone number gelh un.

records.english: We arrived on a public holiday, and every shop and restaurant was closed.
records.zomi: Mipi tawlngak ni-in i tung a, dawr leh anneekna inn khempeuh a kikhak hi.

records.english: Our host's mother cooked for all of us, and it turned out to be the best meal of the trip.
records.zomi: I hong kemtu' nu in i khempeuh adingin an a huan a, khualzinna-a an hoih pen a suak hi.

records.english: Fresh fruit isn't allowed across the regional checkpoint, so we had to leave our mangoes behind.
records.zomi: Gam khen etna mun ah theigah thak kiphal lo ahih manin i haigahte i nusia ding a kisam hi.

records.english: I forgot to bring a phone charger, so the hotel lent me one.
records.zomi: Phone charger tawi ka mangngilh ahih manin zinbuuk in khat hong zangsak hi.

records.english: Which city would you visit if you had only one weekend?
records.zomi: Kal tawp khat bek na neih leh koi khuapi na veh ding hiam?

records.english: The guard said, "You can't take that knife on the bus, even in your suitcase."
records.zomi: Kongpi kemtu in, “Na van bawm sung ah zong tua namsau bus tungah na tawi thei kei hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: You must keep your ticket until you leave the station, or you'll be fined.
records.zomi: Meileng dinna na nusiat dong na ticket na kem ding hi, a hi kei leh hong lai ding uh hi.

records.english: Please don't leave your bags unattended in the station, or they may be removed.
records.zomi: Meileng dinna ah na ipte kem lo-in nusia kei un, a hi kei leh kila kha ding hi.

records.english: Would you mind keeping our spare key while we're away?
records.zomi: I om loh laitakin i tawh behlap na kem sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: The city was so hot that we couldn't walk around in the afternoon.
records.zomi: Khuapi a sa lua ahih manin nitak lam ah i vak kawikawi thei kei hi.

records.english: We went sightseeing early in the morning and rested in the museums after lunch.
records.zomi: Zingsang tung ah mun en dingin i pai a, sun an khit ciangin museum te sung ah i tawldam hi.

records.english: I really do want to bring gifts for everyone, but my bag is already far too heavy.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh adingin letsong tawi ka deih mahmah hi, ahi zongin ka ip a gik lua khin hi.

records.english: My cousin suggested buying the gifts in the city and saving the space for the return journey.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in khuapi ah letsongte lei-in a kik lampi adingin mun kem dingin a gen hi.

records.english: Our friend in the city caught a fever the day we arrived.
records.zomi: Khuapi-a i lawm i tun ni-in cisa a nei hi.

records.english: We stayed in a guesthouse nearby and brought her soup every evening.
records.zomi: A kiang-a zinbuuk neu ah i om a, nitak simin an tui i tawi sak hi.

records.english: Our first train was delayed, so we missed the connection to the capital.
records.zomi: I meileng masa a sawt ahih manin khuapi lian lam-a kizom meileng i mansuah hi.

records.english: The station manager stamped our tickets so that we could take the next train without paying again.
records.zomi: Kik-in pia lo-in a zom meileng i tuan theih nadingin meileng dinna makaipa in i ticket te a nek sak hi.

records.english: Why are train tickets so expensive during the holidays?
records.zomi: Bang hangin nopsakna hun sungin meileng ticket man a tam mahmah hiam?

records.english: Our room had no curtains, and the sun woke us at five.
records.zomi: I khan in tukvuang puan a nei kei a, nai nga ciangin ni in hong phawngsak hi.

records.english: We pinned a spare blanket over the window until the hotel brought curtains.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk in tukvuang puan a tawi dong tukvuang tungah puannak behlap khat i belh hi.

records.english: Hot water was only available in the morning at the mountain guesthouse.
records.zomi: Mual tung zinbuuk neu ah zingsang bek tui lum a om hi.

records.english: We showered before breakfast and boiled water in a kettle in the evenings.
records.zomi: Zingsang an ma-in i kisil a, nitak lam ciangin tui suangna ah tui i suang hi.

records.english: The window in our room wouldn't close, and the wind blew in all night.
records.zomi: I khan-a tukvuang a kikhak thei kei a, zan bup huih a lut hi.

records.english: A maintenance worker fixed the latch the next morning with a small screwdriver.
records.zomi: A zing zingsangin bawlsiang nasem khat in screwdriver neu khat tawh a khakna a bawl siang hi.

records.english: What would you do if your room was dirty when you arrived?
records.zomi: Na tun ciangin na khan a nin leh bang na hih ding hiam?

records.english: Our flight left before breakfast was served.
records.zomi: Zingsang an a kipiak ma-in i vanleng a pai khia hi.

records.english: The kitchen staff packed sandwiches and fruit for us to take to the airport.
records.zomi: An huanna nasemte in vanlengtual ah i tawi dingin sandwich leh theigah hong thuk sak uh hi.

records.english: The safe in our room wouldn't open, and our passports were inside.
records.zomi: I khan-a sum bawm a kihong thei kei a, i passport te a sung ah a om hi.

records.english: A technician came with a special key and opened it in front of us.
records.zomi: Technician khat tawh tuam khat tawh a hong a, i mai ah a hon hi.

records.english: Rather than complaining at the front desk, my father wrote a polite note, and the problem was fixed within an hour.
records.zomi: Mai lam dawhkan ah phun sangin ka pa in lai nem khat a gelh a, nai khat sungin buaina kibawl siang hi.

records.english: Would you mind keeping our suitcases until the evening?
records.zomi: Nitak dong i van bawmte na kem sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: The guesthouse cat slept outside our door every night.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk neu' zawh zan simin i kongkhak pua ah a ihmu hi.

records.english: The fire alarm went off at three in the morning, and everyone had to wait outside.
records.zomi: Zingsang nai thum ciangin mei kang alarm a ging a, mi khempeuh pua ah a ngak uh hi.

records.english: It turned out that a guest had been smoking in the bathroom.
records.zomi: Khual khat in kisilna inn sung ah meidawn a dawn hi, cih a kimu hi.

records.english: Although the room was tiny, the friendly staff made our stay very comfortable.
records.zomi: Khan a neu mahmah hangin nasem hoihte in i omna a nuamsak mahmah uh hi.

records.english: The more remote the guesthouse, the more likely it is that the owners will cook for you.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk neu a gamla semsem ciangin a neite in an hong huan sak ding uh a om semsem hi.

records.english: Our son was frightened by the noise of the old lift.
records.zomi: Lift lui ging in ka tapa a lausak hi.

records.english: The porter let him press the buttons, and by the third day he loved it.
records.zomi: Van puakpa in button te nek dingin a phal a, ni thumna ciangin a deih mahmah hi.

records.english: Everyone, please meet in the lobby at eight with your bags already packed.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, nai giat ciangin na ip uh thuk khin-in mai lam inn lian ah kimu un.

records.english: Who should I speak to about a mistake on my bill?
records.zomi: Ka bill tung-a khialhna thu kua tawh ka kiho ding hiam?

records.english: Do we have to pay for parking at the hotel?
records.zomi: Zinbuuk ah mawtaw koih man i pia ding hiam?

records.english: The booking had been made under my maiden name, so the receptionist couldn't find it.
records.zomi: Ka kiteen ma-a ka min tawh kikoih ahih manin mi muakpa in a mu thei kei hi.

records.english: I showed her the confirmation email on my phone, and she checked us in at once.
records.zomi: Ka phone tung-a kician email ka etsak a, a man takin hong lutsak hi.

records.english: If you arrive late at night, it may help to warn the hotel so that your room isn't given away.
records.zomi: Zan nai mahmah-in na tun leh na khan a kipia lo nadingin zinbuuk na hilh khol in a huh kha ding hi.

records.english: Whoever leaves the room last should switch off the air conditioning.
records.zomi: Khan a nusia nunung peuhpeuh in air con a khek ding hi.

records.english: Where can I iron my shirt before the meeting?
records.zomi: Kikhopna ma-in koi ah ka angki ka phawk thei ding hiam?

records.english: Not until we arrived did we discover that the hotel was on top of a steep hill.
records.zomi: I tun ciang bek zinbuuk mual ding tungah a om hi, cih i thei hi.

records.english: Which floor is the restaurant on?
records.zomi: Anneekna inn koi tuang ah a om hiam?

records.english: Had we booked directly with the guesthouse, we wouldn't have paid the extra fee to the website.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk neu tawh a tang takin i koih le, website kiangah man behlap i pia kei ding hi.

records.english: Could the hotel arrange transport to the hospital for my mother's appointment?
records.zomi: Ka nu' siavuan muh hun adingin zinbuuk in zato pai mawtaw a bawl sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Shall we ask for a room with two beds?
records.zomi: Lupna nih nei khan khat i ngen ding hiam?

records.english: At the hostel where we stayed, cooking in the bedrooms was strictly forbidden.
records.zomi: I omna zinbuuk neu ah lupna khan sung ah an huan kikham mahmah hi.

records.english: My favorite sweater shrank in the hotel laundry.
records.zomi: Ka puan vot deih pen zinbuuk puan silna ah a neu hi.

records.english: The hotel paid for a new one and apologized in writing.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk in a thak khat man a pia a, lai tawh maisak a ngen hi.

records.english: Our room was cleaned while we were out, and all our shoes had been lined up neatly.
records.zomi: I om loh laitakin i khan kisiangsak a, i khedap khempeuh hoih takin kikoih hi.

records.english: The children were given coloring books and crayons when we checked in.
records.zomi: I lut ciangin naupangte lim zeek laibu leh crayon kipia uh hi.

records.english: Kids, please don't jump on the hotel beds.
records.zomi: Naupangte, zinbuuk lupnate tungah diang kei un.

records.english: What I find hardest about hotels is sleeping in a bed that isn't my own.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk ah ka haksa sak pen pen keima' hi lo lupna tungah ihmut ahi hi.

records.english: A good hotel is like a good host, because it notices what you need before you ask.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk hoih pen inn neipa hoih bang ahi a, na ngen ma-in na kisapna a thei hi.

records.english: I really do want a room that my father can reach in his wheelchair.
records.zomi: Ka pa in a tutna leng tawh a tun theih khan khat ka deih mahmah hi.

records.english: The hotel gave us a ground-floor room with a wide door and a shower without a step.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk in kongkhak zai leh kahlei om lo kisilna nei nuai lam khan khat hong pia hi.

records.english: The bill at checkout included two dinners we hadn't eaten.
records.zomi: Pai khiat ciangin bill ah i nek loh nitak an nih a kihel hi.

records.english: The manager checked the restaurant records and removed them from the bill.
records.zomi: Manager in anneekna inn laite a en a, bill pan a phiat hi.

records.english: The receptionist said, "I'm afraid the pool is closed for cleaning until Thursday."
records.zomi: Mi muakpa in, “Laizing ni dong tui kidiahna siangsak dingin a kikhak hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: Did the hotel give you a refund for the broken heater?
records.zomi: Mei lumna set sia adingin zinbuuk in sum hong pia kik hiam?

records.english: When does the restaurant stop serving dinner?
records.zomi: Anneekna inn in nitak an bang ciangin a zuak tawp hiam?

records.english: Could we have our sheets changed every day, since my son has a skin allergy?
records.zomi: Ka tapa vun natna a nei ahih manin ni simin i lupna puan i laih thei ding hiam?

records.english: How do you choose a hotel in a city you've never visited?
records.zomi: Na veh ngei loh khuapi khat ah zinbuuk bangci-in na teel hiam?

records.english: The shower flooded the bathroom floor every time we used it.
records.zomi: I zat simin kisilna mun in kisilna inn tual tui in a liamsak hi.

records.english: We put towels on the floor and told the receptionist, who sent a plumber.
records.zomi: Tual tungah puan nulte i koih a, mi muakpa i hilh a, tui khuam bawlpa a sawl hi.

records.english: We woke up covered in insect bites on our first night.
records.zomi: I zan masa pen-in ganneu sek tawh i kidim-in i khanglawh hi.

records.english: The manager moved us to a newer room and had the old one sprayed that afternoon.
records.zomi: Manager in khan thak zaw khat ah hong suan a, a lui pen tua nitak lam ah zatui a phul sak hi.

records.english: Having stayed in dozens of hotels for work, my brother always asks for a room away from the lift.
records.zomi: Nasep adingin zinbuuk tampi ah a om khit ciangin ka sanggam pasal in lift pan gamla khan a ngen tawntung hi.

records.english: The hotel held a large deposit on my card, and I couldn't pay for anything else.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk in ka card tungah koih khol sum tampi a len a, bangmah dang ka pia thei kei hi.

records.english: The receptionist released it as soon as I explained, and I paid the deposit in cash instead.
records.zomi: Ka gen siang pah-in mi muakpa in a khah a, tua sangin koih khol sum sum taktak tawh ka pia hi.

records.english: The hotel was overbooked, and there was no room for us.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk a dim lua a, eite adingin khan a om kei hi.

records.english: They paid for a taxi to their sister hotel down the road and gave us dinner for free.
records.zomi: Lampi nuai lam-a a sanggam zinbuuk ah taxi man a pia uh a, a man om lo-in nitak an hong pia uh hi.

records.english: Why is the hotel so much cheaper on weekdays?
records.zomi: Bang hangin kal sung ni-in zinbuuk a neem zaw mahmah hiam?

records.english: What would you cook if you had only potatoes and onions?
records.zomi: Alu leh lothaang bek na neih leh bang na huan ding hiam?

records.english: A neighbor lent us her large pot so that we could cook for the whole family.
records.zomi: Innkuan bup adingin an i huan theih nadingin inn veng khat in a beel lian hong ngetsak hi.

records.english: I really do want to cook for my new neighbors, but I don't know what they can eat.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng thakte adingin an huan ka deih mahmah hi, ahi zongin bang a ne thei uh hiam ka thei kei hi.

records.english: I simply asked them, and they told me they don't eat meat or eggs.
records.zomi: Ka dong bek a, sa leh aktui a ne kei uh hi, hong ci uh hi.

records.english: Whoever finishes cooking should wipe the stove before it gets sticky.
records.zomi: An huan a zo peuhpeuh in a belh ma-in meikhuk a nul ding hi.

records.english: How do you cook rice without it going sticky?
records.zomi: Buh a belh lo-in bangci-in na huan hiam?

records.english: Do you have to soak the beans overnight, or can you cook them straight away?
records.zomi: Be zan bup tui sung ah na koih ding hiam, a man takin na huan thei hiam?

records.english: Kids, you can each choose one topping for the pizza.
records.zomi: Naupangte, pizza tungah na khat ciat in behlap khat na teel thei uh hi.

records.english: Someone poured cooking oil down the sink, and it blocked the pipe.
records.zomi: Kuamah in an huan sathau kuang silna sung ah a sun a, tui khuam a khak hi.

records.english: We cleared it with hot water and soda, and now old oil goes into a jar.
records.zomi: Tui sa leh soda tawh i hon a, tu-in sathau lui bel sung ah a lut hi.

records.english: Which knife is best for cutting bread?
records.zomi: Moh at dingin koi namsau in a hoih pen hiam?

records.english: The cake stuck to the tin and broke into pieces when I turned it out.
records.zomi: Cake a bawm ah a belh a, ka heih ciangin a kek hi.

records.english: Next time, line the tin with paper, and let the cake cool for ten minutes first.
records.zomi: A zom ciangin bawm sung ah lai koih inla, a masa-in minit sawm cake a vot dong ngak in.

records.english: Why was the rice still hard in the middle?
records.zomi: Bang hangin buh a laizang ah a khauh lai hiam?

records.english: The spices had been in the cupboard for so long that they had no flavor left.
records.zomi: Antui namtuite van bawm sung ah sawt lua a om ahih manin a namtui a bei kim hi.

records.english: We buy small packets now and write the date on each one.
records.zomi: Tu-in pakat neute i lei a, a khat ciat tungah ni i gelh hi.

records.english: The rubber seal on the pressure cooker wore out, and steam leaked all over the stove.
records.zomi: Pressure cooker' rubber khakna a sia a, meikhu meikhuk bup ah a zu hi.

records.english: We bought a new seal at the market for a few coins, and it works like new.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun ah dangka tawmno tawh khakna thak khat i lei a, a thak bangin a sem hi.

records.english: Having cooked in a restaurant for ten years, my brother can prepare a meal for twenty in an hour.
records.zomi: Anneekna inn ah kum sawm an a huan khit ciangin ka sanggam pasal in nai khat sungin mi sawmnih adingin an a bawl thei hi.

records.english: Why does my bread always come out so hard?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ka moh a khauh tawntung hiam?

records.english: Grandma's recipe book says "a handful" and "a pinch" but never gives exact amounts.
records.zomi: Ka pi' an huan laibu in “khut dim khat” leh “tawmno” a ci a, ahi zongin a zah a gen ngei kei hi.

records.english: I cooked beside her for a month and wrote down what her handful actually weighed.
records.zomi: Kha khat sung a kiang ah an ka huan a, a khut dim taktak bangzah a gik hiam ka gelh hi.

records.english: The power went off halfway through baking the bread.
records.zomi: Moh em kimlai-in meivak a mit hi.

records.english: We finished it in a heavy pot on the gas stove, and it was delicious.
records.zomi: Gas meikhuk tungah beel gik khat sung ah i zo a, a tui mahmah hi.

records.english: Who used all the eggs?
records.zomi: Aktui khempeuh kua in a zang bei hiam?

records.english: The sauce burned because the heat was too high, so I started again with a lower flame.
records.zomi: Mei a sa lua ahih manin an tui a kang a, mei niam zaw tawh ka kipan kik hi.

records.english: The pasta was overcooked because I was talking on the phone.
records.zomi: Phone tungah ka kiho ahih manin pasta a min lua hi.

records.english: The cook in the video moved so fast that I couldn't follow the steps.
records.zomi: Video sung-a an huanpa a manlang lua ahih manin a khekhap te ka zui thei kei hi.

records.english: I slowed the video down and paused it after each step.
records.zomi: Video ka zawisak a, khekhap khat ciat khit ciangin ka tawlsak hi.

records.english: The milk was left out overnight, and in the morning it had gone sour.
records.zomi: Zan bup nawi pua ah kinusia a, zingsangin a thuk khin hi.

records.english: Cooking without tasting is like painting with your eyes closed.
records.zomi: Tet lo-a an huan pen mit khuh-a lim zeek bang ahi hi.

records.english: Flies kept landing on the food while we prepared lunch outside.
records.zomi: Pua ah sun an i bawl laitakin thangte an tungah a tu den uh hi.

records.english: We covered every dish with a clean cloth and cooked in the shade.
records.zomi: An khempeuh puan siang tawh i khuh a, a ngeng ah an i huan hi.

records.english: Flour was spilled all over the floor when the bag split.
records.zomi: Ip a kek ciangin buh-mal tual bup ah a zel hi.

records.english: Not until the guests had arrived did I notice that I had forgotten to cook the rice.
records.zomi: Khualte a tun khit ciang bek buh huan ka mangngilh hi, cih ka thei hi.

records.english: Rather than buying ready-made sauce, we now make a big batch and keep it in jars.
records.zomi: Bawl khin an tui lei sangin tu-in tampi i bawl a, bel sung ah i koih hi.

records.english: What I find hardest is cooking several dishes so that they're all ready at the same time.
records.zomi: Ka haksa sak pen pen an tuamtuam khempeuh hun kibang-a a kim theih nadingin huan ahi hi.

records.english: If the kitchen is small, it may help to prepare the vegetables the night before.
records.zomi: An huanna a neu leh zan ma-in anteh bawl khol in a huh kha ding hi.

records.english: My grandfather uses an old wooden board that he made himself to roll out the dough.
records.zomi: Ka pu in moh tawm nawlna dingin amah mah in a bawl sing phek lui khat a zang hi.

records.english: I forgot to take the chicken out of the freezer before work.
records.zomi: Nasep ka pai ma-in khal bawm pan aksa la khia ka mangngilh hi.

records.english: I defrosted it in a bowl of cold water and changed the water every half hour.
records.zomi: Tui vot kuang sung ah ka koih-in ka zak sak a, nai khen khat simin tui ka lai hi.

records.english: Did you remember to turn off the oven?
records.zomi: Oven khek na phawk hiam?

records.english: Everyone, please rinse your plates before you put them in the sink.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, kuang silna sung na koih ma-un na kuang uh sil un.

records.english: When should I add the salt to the soup?
records.zomi: An tui ah bang ciangin cii ka koih ding hiam?

records.english: The garlic smell stayed on my hands for the whole day.
records.zomi: Tumtak namtui ni bup ka khut ah a om hi.

records.english: My aunt told me to rub them on a steel spoon under cold water, and it worked.
records.zomi: Ka ni in tui vot nuai ah thih kawm tungah nul dingin hong hilh a, a sem hi.

records.english: My student flat has only one small electric ring for cooking.
records.zomi: Ka sangnaupang inn in an huan dingin meivak meikhuk neu khat bek a nei hi.

records.english: I cook one-pot meals and use a kettle to boil water for noodles and tea.
records.zomi: Beel khat-a an ka huan a, an-ngum leh tea adingin tui suangna tawh tui ka suang hi.

records.english: Can I use honey instead of sugar in this cake?
records.zomi: Hih cake ah sugar sangin khuaizu ka zang thei ding hiam?

records.english: Could the school kitchen teach the older students how to cook simple meals?
records.zomi: Sang an huanna in sangnaupang upa zawte an baih huan dan a hilh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Would you mind tasting this to see whether it needs more lemon?
records.zomi: Lemon behlap a kisam hiam hih na tet sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Shall I chop the vegetables now, or will they go soft before dinner?
records.zomi: Tu-in anteh ka at ding hiam, nitak an ma-in a nem ding hiam?

records.english: The more often children help in the kitchen, the more willing they are to try new food.
records.zomi: Naupangte an huanna ah a huh den semsem ciangin an thak tet a nuam semsem uh hi.

records.english: The recipe gave everything in grams, but we didn't have a kitchen scale.
records.zomi: An huan dan lai in khempeuh gram tawh a gen a, ahi zongin an huanna gikna khaina i nei kei hi.

records.english: My cousin looked up how many spoonfuls make a hundred grams, and the cake turned out fine.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in kawm bangzah in gram za khat a suak hiam a zong a, cake a hoih hi.

records.english: Ants got into the sugar jar during the rainy season.
records.zomi: Guah hun sungin sugar bel sung ah sikte a lut uh hi.

records.english: Now we keep the sugar in a sealed tin standing in a dish of water.
records.zomi: Tu-in tui kuang sung-a ding thih bawm khak cip sung ah sugar i koih hi.

records.english: Had I read the whole recipe first, I would have known that the dough needed to rest overnight.
records.zomi: An huan dan lai bup ka sim masa le, moh tawm zan bup a tawl ding a kisam hi, cih ka thei ding hi.

records.english: Although cooking from scratch takes longer, it lets you control exactly what goes into the food.
records.zomi: A kipat pan an huan in hun tam zaw a la hangin an sung ah bang a lut hiam kician takin na thei hi.

records.english: Where do you keep the baking tins?
records.zomi: Moh emna bawmte koi ah na koih hiam?

records.english: Each of my neighbors brought a meal on a different day after I came home from hospital.
records.zomi: Zato pan inn ka tun khit ciangin ka inn veng khempeuh in ni tuamtuam ah an a tawi uh hi.

records.english: Is it all right to go for a short walk while I'm still recovering?
records.zomi: Ka dam kik nai lo hangin vak tomno ka pai thei ding hiam?

records.english: Only around the garden at first, and stop as soon as you feel tired.
records.zomi: A masa-in huan kim bek, leh na tawl pah-in tawp in.

records.english: The doctor told me to rest for a week after the operation.
records.zomi: Zatui sat khit ciangin kal khat tawldam dingin siavuan in hong hilh hi.

records.english: Do I need a note from the doctor before I go back to work?
records.zomi: Nasep ah ka kik ma-in siavuan pan lai ka kisam ding hiam?

records.english: Could the school send my son's homework home while he's recovering?
records.zomi: Ka tapa a dam kik laitakin sang in a inn-a sep ding inn ah a khak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our church organized a rota so that someone visited my mother every afternoon.
records.zomi: Nitak lam simin kuamah in ka nu a veh nadingin i pawlpi in kikhel hun gelna khat a bawl hi.

records.english: Who is looking after the children while you're in hospital?
records.zomi: Zato ah na om laitakin naupangte kua in a kem hiam?

records.english: The physiotherapist gave me a walking frame to use until my leg is stronger.
records.zomi: Ka khe a hat zawk dong zat dingin tha kizap siam in kalsuanna sing hong pia hi.

records.english: Kids, please play quietly this afternoon, because Dad needs to rest.
records.zomi: Naupangte, Pa a tawldam ding ahih manin tuni nitak lam dai takin kimawl un.

records.english: Rather than rushing back to work, she took an extra week to recover fully.
records.zomi: Nasep ah manlang taka kik sangin a bup-a dam kik nadingin kal khat behlap a la hi.

records.english: Please don't wake your grandfather; he's finally sleeping.
records.zomi: Na pu phawngsak kei in; a tawp-in a ihmu hi.

records.english: The doctor said I could start driving again in two weeks.
records.zomi: Kal nih ciangin mawtaw ka mawng kik thei hi, ci-in siavuan in a ci hi.

records.english: The clinic lent us a wheelchair until my father could walk again.
