records.english: If no one cancels, the earliest date will be in the second week of next month.
records.zomi: Kuamah in a khak kei leh ni ma pen a zom kha-a kal nihna ah ahi ding hi.

records.english: Whatever time you book, it's worth writing it down somewhere you'll see it every day.
records.zomi: Hun bang na kilai zongin ni simin na muh theih mun khat ah gelh in a phattuam hi.

records.english: Just to confirm, that's Tuesday the fourteenth at ten in the morning.
records.zomi: Kician sak nadingin, tua pen Pithai ni ni sawm leh lina zingsang nai sawm ciangin ahi hi.

records.english: How long will I have to wait to see the eye doctor?
records.zomi: Mit siavuan muh dingin bangzah sawt ka ngak ding hiam?

records.english: You can now book appointments online, but you can still call if you prefer.
records.zomi: Tu-in online tawh kimuhna na kilai thei a, ahi zongin na deih leh na sam thei lai hi.

records.english: I booked my grandmother's eye test for next week so that she can get new glasses before winter.
records.zomi: Khuavot ma-in mitlimlang thak a ngah theih nadingin a zom kal-a ka pi' mit enna ka kilai sak hi.

records.english: Although online booking is convenient, older patients often prefer to speak to a person.
records.zomi: Online kilaina a baih hangin damlo upate in mi tawh kikum a deih zaw tam uh hi.

records.english: Is it urgent, or can it wait until next week?
records.zomi: A manlang ding a kisam hiam, a zom kal dong a ngak thei hiam?

records.english: I'd like an afternoon appointment, because I work in the mornings.
records.zomi: Zingsang lam ka sep ahih manin nitak lam kimuhna khat ka deih hi.

records.english: Booking an appointment can be stressful when you're already feeling unwell.
records.zomi: Na cina khin lai-in kimuhna kilai in lungbuaisak thei hi.

records.english: All the morning appointments had been taken by the time I called.
records.zomi: Ka sam ciangin zingsang kimuhna khempeuh kila khin hi.

records.english: You'll get a text message the day before to remind you.
records.zomi: A ma ni-in hong phawksak dingin text message khat na ngah ding hi.

records.english: The longer you leave a small problem, the harder it may be to get an appointment when it becomes urgent.
records.zomi: Haksatna neu khat na nusia sawt semsem ciangin manlang a kisam ciangin kimuhna ngah a haksa semsem thei hi.

records.english: Could you book the appointment for my son after school?
records.zomi: Ka tapa adingin sang khit ciangin kimuhna na kilai sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: The dentist is fully booked until the end of the month.
records.zomi: Ha siavuan kha tawp dong kimuhna a kim khin hi.

records.english: Rather than waiting for a cancellation, she decided to see a doctor at the next town's clinic.
records.zomi: Kikhakna ngak sangin a kiang khuapi siavuan inn ah siavuan khat muh dingin a thukhen hi.

records.english: What helped most was a receptionist who explained the options slowly and clearly.
records.zomi: A huh pen pen teelna te nawlkhin leh kician takin a gen siang mai lam ngaktu khat ahi hi.

records.english: My mother made the plumber write the price on paper before he started work.
records.zomi: Ka nu in tuikhuam bawlpa in nasep a kipat ma-in laidal tungah a man a gelh sak hi.

records.english: That's a fair price for a second-hand bicycle, isn't it?
records.zomi: Tua pen siiksakol lui khat adingin man dik ahi hi, a hi hiam?

records.english: Tomorrow I'll be phoning around to find the cheapest place to rent a van.
records.zomi: Zingciang ciangin van mawtaw hawl man neu pen mun zon dingin phone tawh ka sam kual ding hi.

records.english: It would help many families if the school told parents the cost of the trip earlier.
records.zomi: Sang in khualzinna man nu leh pate kiangah ma-in a gen leh innkuan tampi a huh ding hi.

records.english: If the price stays below $200, we might buy two tickets instead of one.
records.zomi: A man $200 nuai ah a om lai leh lakkhia ding lai khat sangin nih i lei kha ding hi.

records.english: Next year, when I start my own business, I'll have to decide what to charge.
records.zomi: A zom kum ciangin keimah sumbawlna ka kipat ciangin bangzah ngen ding hiam ka thukhen ding a kisam ding hi.

records.english: I'm going to find out the prices of a few wedding photographers for my sister.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu adingin mopawi lim la pawl khat' man ka zong ding hi.

records.english: Once the prices are on display, customers will feel more comfortable asking questions.
records.zomi: Van man te a kilak khit ciangin a lei mite in thu dong dingin a nuam zaw ding uh hi.

records.english: The shopkeeper told me, "Come back next week, and the new stock will be cheaper."
records.zomi: Zuakna inn neipa in, “A zom kal ciangin hong kik in, van thakte a man neu zaw ding hi,” hong ci hi.

records.english: I'm saving for an electric bicycle that costs $640, so I'll need another four months.
records.zomi: $640 a man mei-ok siiksakol khat adingin ka kikoih ahih manin kha li behlap ka kisam ding hi.

records.english: Please don't tell the seller how much we're willing to pay.
records.zomi: Bangzah pia nuam i hiam zuakpa kiangah gen kei in.

records.english: Just to check, that's $45 for both lamps, not each?
records.zomi: Kician sak nadingin, tua pen meivak nih adingin $45 ahi a, a khat ciat adingin hi lo hiam?

records.english: The new fruit stall will have all its prices written on a board, so there's no bargaining.
records.zomi: Theigah zuakna dawhkan thak in a van man khempeuh sing phek tungah a gelh ding ahih manin a man kisut om lo ding hi.

records.english: My brother always says, "Ask the price before you fall in love with the thing."
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal in, “Van khat na it ma-in a man dong in,” a ci tawntung hi.

records.english: Is it worth waiting for the sales, or will the price go up?
records.zomi: Van man kiamna ngak a kilawm ding hiam, a man a khang ding hiam?

records.english: Remind me to ask about the delivery charge before we pay.
records.zomi: I piak ma-in puak man thu dong dingin hong phawksak in.

records.english: I'll compare the prices online so that my grandfather doesn't pay too much for his new radio.
records.zomi: Ka pu in a radio thak adingin sum tam lua a piak lohna dingin online ah van man ka teh ding hi.

records.english: If the honey sells well at that price, I might take twice as many jars next week.
records.zomi: Tua man tawh khuaizu a kizuak hoih leh a zom kal ciangin bel nih zah ka tawi kha ding hi.

records.english: We could ask whether students get a lower price on weekdays.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte in kal sung ni te-in man neu zaw a ngah uh hiam i dong thei hi.

records.english: In a few years, I imagine prices at the market will be paid mostly by phone.
records.zomi: Kum tawmno khit ciangin zuakna mun-a van man a tamzaw phone tawh kipia ding hi, ka ngaihsun hi.

records.english: Is parking included in the price?
records.zomi: Mawtaw koihna man a sungah kihel hiam?

records.english: You mustn't agree to anything until you've seen the price in writing.
records.zomi: Laidal tungah a man na muh ma-in bangmah na phal lo ding hi.

records.english: However low the price is, I won't buy a phone without a proper guarantee.
records.zomi: A man bangzah in niam zongin ciamna hoih om lo-in phone ka lei lo ding hi.

records.english: Sorry, did you say 15 or 50?
records.zomi: Maisak ing, 15 na ci hiam, 50 na ci hiam?

records.english: Fifteen, but it's 50 if you take the whole box.
records.zomi: Sawm leh nga, ahi zongin bawm bup na la leh 50 ahi hi.

records.english: I really do hope the prices at the new supermarket are as low as the adverts say.
records.zomi: Supermarket thak-a van man te thu laikhai in a gen bangin a niam ding ka lametna taktak ahi hi.

records.english: To be honest, I think a slightly higher price is fair if the quality is better.
records.zomi: Thu man takin, a hoih zaw leh a man tawmno sang zaw pen a dik hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: Do you think they'll lower the price if we pay in cash?
records.zomi: Dangka-in i piak leh a man a kiamsak ding uh hiam, na ci hiam?

records.english: Whatever the price turns out to be, I'm going to get the roof fixed before the rains.
records.zomi: A man bangzah ahi zongin guah hun ma-in innkhum ka bawl dam sak ding hi.

records.english: Does that make sense, or should I explain the price list again?
records.zomi: Tua in khiatna a nei hiam, van man gelhna kong gen siang kik ding hiam?

records.english: This weekend, I'm selling honey at the market for the first time.
records.zomi: Hih kal tawp in a masa pen-in zuakna mun ah khuaizu ka zuak ding hi.

records.english: I think $8 a jar is fair, but my aunt says I should ask $10.
records.zomi: Bel khat $8 a dik hi, ka ci a, ahi zongin ka ni in $10 ngen in, a ci hi.

records.english: I'll start at 10, and if nobody buys by noon, I'll lower it.
records.zomi: 10 tawh ka kipan ding a, sun tak dong kuamah in a lei kei uh leh ka kiamsak ding hi.

records.english: If the fare goes up again, my daughter will have to walk to school twice a week.
records.zomi: Khualzin man a khang kik leh ka tanu in kal khat ah nih vei sang ah a pai ding a kisam ding hi.

records.english: Before my phone contract ends in March, I'm going to compare the prices of three plans.
records.zomi: March kha-in ka phone kiciamna a bei ma-in plan thum' man ka teh ding hi.

records.english: Can I ask how much you'd want for the old piano if you decide to sell it?
records.zomi: Zuak dingin na thukhen leh piano lui adingin bangzah na ngen ding hiam ka dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: Let me know the final price as soon as the shop calls you.
records.zomi: Zuakna inn in hong sam pah ciangin a man nunung hong hilh in.

records.english: I'll ask the painter how much he'd charge for the whole house, and then I'll have my uncle check the quote.
records.zomi: Nulpa kiangah inn bup adingin bangzah a ngen ding hiam ka dong ding a, tua ciangin ka pa neu in a man gelhna a en ding hi.

records.english: I'll have the price list translated so that our customers from abroad can read it.
records.zomi: Gamdang pan i lei mite in a sim theih nadingun van man gelhna ka let sak ding hi.

records.english: Asking several sellers before buying will probably save us a lot of money over the year.
records.zomi: Lei ma-in zuakpa tampi dong in kum khat sungin sum tampi hong kem sak kha ding hi.

records.english: From January, the bus fare is going up to $1.50.
records.zomi: January pan kipan bus man $1.50 ah a khang ding hi.

records.english: Will students still pay the old price?
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte in man lui a pia lai ding uh hiam?

records.english: We're going to get the old ring valued before we decide whether to sell it.
records.zomi: Zuak ding hiam i thukhen ma-in khutzungbuh lui a man i ensak ding hi.

records.english: This time next week, we'll know whether we can afford the bigger flat.
records.zomi: A zom kal tu hun ciangin inn lian zaw i lei zo ding hiam i thei ding hi.

records.english: Perhaps prices will come down after the harvest, when there's more rice in the market.
records.zomi: Kaihawl khit ciangin zuakna mun ah buh a tam zaw ciangin van man a kiam kha ding hi.

records.english: My friend has offered to bargain for me at the city market, because sellers always charge me more.
records.zomi: Zuakpate in hong ngen tam zaw tawntung uh ahih manin ka lawm in khuapi zuakna mun ah hong kisut sak dingin a ciam hi.

records.english: The cost of the repairs will be shared between the three flats.
records.zomi: Bawl dam man pen inn thum kikal ah kihawm ding hi.

records.english: Shall I ask the baker what he'd charge for 200 bread rolls?
records.zomi: Moh neu za nih adingin bangzah a ngen ding hiam moh bawlpa ka dong ding hiam?

records.english: By the time the shop opens on Saturday, I'll have checked every price on the list.
records.zomi: Kiginni ni-in zuakna inn a kihon ciangin gelhna-a van man khempeuh ka en khin ding hi.

records.english: Could you find out how much the train to the coast costs on 14 July?
records.zomi: July ni 14 ni-in tuipi gei lam meileng man bangzah ahi hiam na zong thei ding hiam?

records.english: I do want to buy the red jacket, but only if it's reduced in the sale.
records.zomi: Kawt san ka lei nuam taktak a, ahi zongin a man kiamna lai-in a kiam leh bek.

records.english: How much will the school trip cost, and does that include meals?
records.zomi: Sang khualzinna bangzah a bei ding a, an zong a sungah kihel hiam?

records.english: About $300 per pupil, with breakfast and dinner included.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang khat ciat $300 bang, zingsang an leh nitak an kihel-in.

records.english: What will the new swimming pool charge for a family ticket?
records.zomi: Tuiphuk thak in innkuan lakkhia ding lai adingin bangzah a ngen ding hiam?

records.english: I heard it'll be $20 a month, but nobody has confirmed it yet.
records.zomi: Kha khat $20 ahi ding hi, ka za a, ahi zongin kuamah in a kician sak nai kei hi.

records.english: What will the tickets cost if we buy them on the day?
records.zomi: Tua ni mah-in i lei leh lakkhia ding lai bangzah ahi ding hiam?

records.english: Next month, we're going to buy a laptop that the whole family can share.
records.zomi: A zom kha in innkuan bup in a zat khawm theih laptop khat i lei ding hi.

records.english: Before we decide, I'll ask the prices at three shops and write them all down.
records.zomi: I thukhen ma-in zuakna inn thum-a man ka dong ding a, ka gelh vek ding hi.

records.english: If the cheapest one has a good guarantee, we'll probably choose that.
records.zomi: A man neu pen in ciamna hoih a neih leh tua i teel kha ding hi.

records.english: The rent for each stall at the new market will be decided by a vote of the sellers.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun thak-a zuakna dawhkan khat ciat man pen zuakpate' teelna tawh kikhen ding hi.

records.english: However the payment is made, I'm going to ask for a receipt every time.
records.zomi: Sum bangci-in kipia zongin a vekpi-in laimal ka ngen ding hi.

records.english: Tomorrow I'll be paying for twelve lunches, so I'll ask for one receipt for the whole group.
records.zomi: Zingciang ciangin sun an sawm leh nih man ka pia ding ahih manin pawl bup adingin laimal khat ka ngen ding hi.

records.english: When I open my shop next week, I'll count the takings with my sister at the end of every day.
records.zomi: A zom kal ka zuakna inn ka hon ciangin ni tawp simin ka sanggam nu tawh ka ngah sum ka sim ding hi.

records.english: Next month, we're traveling abroad, so I'll need to learn what the coins are worth before we go.
records.zomi: A zom kha in gamdang ah i khualzin ding ahih manin i pai ma-in dangka sik te a man ka sin ding a kisam ding hi.

records.english: From next month, the café on our corner will only accept card payments.
records.zomi: A zom kha pan kipan i lampi kikona-a an zuakna inn in card tawh bek a la ding hi.

records.english: The owner says it'll be safer than keeping cash in the shop overnight.
records.zomi: Zuakna inn ah zanin dangka kem sangin a bit zaw ding hi, ci-in a neipa in a gen hi.

records.english: I think some of the older customers will stop coming, because they've always paid with coins.
records.zomi: Dangka sik tawh a pia tawntung uh ahih manin a lei mi upa pawl khat a hong nawn lo ding uh hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: Do you think the café will lose customers when it stops taking cash?
records.zomi: Dangka a lak khawl ciangin an zuakna inn in a lei mite a mansuah ding hiam, na ci hiam?

records.english: Please don't leave the cash tin open while you're serving.
records.zomi: Na pia laitakin sum bawm hong-in nusia kei in.

records.english: The shopkeeper said, "From Monday, I'll round every price to the nearest 50 cents."
records.zomi: Zuakna inn neipa in, “Pizing ni pan kipan van man khempeuh a kiang pen cent 50 ah ka bawl ding hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: We could ask the builder whether he'd accept a bank transfer for the last payment.
records.zomi: Piak nunung adingin bank pan khak a sang ding hiam inn bawlpa i dong thei hi.

records.english: By the end of the fair, the children will have learned more about change than in a whole term of lessons.
records.zomi: Pawi a bei ciangin naupangte in sum kilaih thu sang hun bup-a thusin sangin a sin tam zaw ding uh hi.

records.english: I'm going to put a small sign with a code on my stall, so that customers can pay with their phones.
records.zomi: A lei mite in a phone tawh a piak theih nadingun ka zuakna dawhkan ah code nei lai neu khat ka koih ding hi.

records.english: This time next week, I'll be counting the takings at my own shop for the first time.
records.zomi: A zom kal tu hun ciangin a masa pen-in keimah zuakna inn ah ka ngah sum ka sim ding hi.

records.english: The money from the fair will go toward new books for the school library.
records.zomi: Pawi pan sum pen sang laibu inn adingin laibu thak lei nadingin zat ding hi.

records.english: How will you pay the taxi driver if your card doesn't work abroad?
records.zomi: Gamdang ah na card a sep kei leh taxi mawngpa bangci-in na pia ding hiam?

records.english: I'll keep some local cash in my pocket, just in case.
records.zomi: Bang hi zongin cih adingin ka ip sungah gam sum tawmno ka kem ding hi.

records.english: I really do hope the new machines will be quicker than the old tills.
records.zomi: Setna thakte in sum lakna lui sangin a manlang zaw ding ka lametna taktak ahi hi.

records.english: Perhaps the market will put a cash machine near the entrance.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun in lutna kiang ah sum lakna setna khat a koih kha ding hi.

records.english: Is it all right if my daughter pays with her own pocket money?
records.zomi: Ka tanu in amah' zat ding sum tawh a pia leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: Shall I pay for the tickets now, and you can pay me back later?
records.zomi: Lakkhia ding lai man tu-in ka pia a, a nung ciangin hong pia kik ding hiam?

records.english: I'll pay my grandmother's phone bill for her while she's in hospital.
records.zomi: Ka pi siavuan inn ah a om sungin a phone laimal ka pia sak ding hi.

records.english: We've agreed to pay the builder in three stages, as each part of the work is finished.
records.zomi: Nasep khen khat ciat a zawh simin inn bawlpa thum vei-in pia dingin i kilem khin hi.

records.english: In a few years, I imagine children will hardly know what a coin looks like.
records.zomi: Kum tawmno khit ciangin naupangte in dangka sik bangci-in a om hiam a thei kik lo ding uh hi, ka ngaihsun hi.

records.english: My card is so worn that the machine can't read it, so I'll have the bank send me a new one.
records.zomi: Ka card a sia lua ahih manin setna in a sim zo kei a, tua ahih manin bank in a thak khat hong khak dingin ka ngen ding hi.

records.english: You've given me too much change, haven't you?
records.zomi: Sum kilaih tam lua hong pia hi, a hi hiam?

records.english: From next month, parking in the town center will have to be paid by phone.
records.zomi: A zom kha pan kipan khuapi laizang-a mawtaw koihna man phone tawh pia ding a kisam ding hi.

records.english: Once the stall has a payment code, I won't have to worry about running out of change.
records.zomi: Zuakna dawhkan in sum piakna code a neih khit ciangin sum kilaih a bei ding ka lungkham nawn lo ding hi.

records.english: To be honest, I'm not sure the card-only rule will last more than a few months.
records.zomi: Thu man takin, card bek thukham in kha tawmno sangin a sawt ding hiam ka thei kei hi.

records.english: I do want to pay by phone, but my phone keeps running out of battery.
records.zomi: Phone tawh pia ka deih taktak a, ahi zongin ka phone battery a bei den hi.

records.english: The supermarket is putting in self-checkout machines next month.
records.zomi: Supermarket in a zom kha in keimah sum piakna setna te a koih ding hi.

records.english: Will there still be someone to help if the machine won't take my coins?
records.zomi: Setna in ka dangka sik a sang kei leh hong huh ding mi khat a om lai ding hiam?

records.english: If the café goes card-only, we might start going to the bakery across the road instead.
records.zomi: An zuakna inn in card bek a lak leh lampi gal lam-a moh bawlna ah i pai kipan kha ding hi.

records.english: Next year, my daughter will start getting her pocket money by bank transfer.
records.zomi: A zom kum ciangin ka tanu in a zat ding sum bank pan a ngah kipan ding hi.

records.english: My brother is going to lend me the money for the deposit so that we don't lose the house.
records.zomi: Inn i mansuah lohna dingin ka sanggam pasal in a ma-a piak ding sum hong puk sak ding hi.

records.english: Could you change this $50 note into smaller ones before the market opens?
records.zomi: Zuakna mun a kihon ma-in hih $50 sum lai neu zaw te-in na laih sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Remind me to bring small change for the parking meter tomorrow.
records.zomi: Zingciang mawtaw koihna setna adingin dangka sik neute tawi dingin hong phawksak in.

records.english: If more shops go card-only, people without bank accounts could find it harder to buy food.
records.zomi: Zuakna inn tam zaw in card bek a lak uh leh bank sum koihna nei lo mite in an lei a haksa zaw thei ding uh hi.

records.english: My savings will be eaten up quickly if the bank keeps charging me for every withdrawal.
records.zomi: Ka sum lakkhiatna khempeuh adingin bank in sum hong ngen den leh ka sum kikoih manlang takin a bei ding hi.

records.english: Can I pay for the cake now and collect it on Friday?
records.zomi: Cake man tu-in ka pia a, Laithai ni-in ka la thei ding hiam?

records.english: Sorry, I didn't catch that — was it 13 or 30?
records.zomi: Maisak ing, ka za kei hi — 13 hiam 30 hiam?

records.english: How much should each family put in for the teacher's leaving present?
records.zomi: Saya' kikhenna letsong adingin innkuan khat ciat in bangzah a pia ding uh hiam?

records.english: About $5 each, and our class representative will give everyone a receipt.
records.zomi: Khat ciat $5 bang, leh i sang inndei aiawh in mi khempeuh laimal a pia ding hi.

records.english: The old coins will no longer be accepted after the end of the year.
records.zomi: Kum tawp khit ciangin dangka sik lui te kisang nawn lo ding hi.

records.english: We'll pay the deposit for the holiday house as soon as the owner sends the contract.
records.zomi: A neipa in kiciamna lai a khak pah ciangin nopsakna inn adingin a ma-a piak ding sum i pia ding hi.

records.english: My aunt will make the seller write down the total before she hands over any money.
records.zomi: Ka ni in sum a piak ma-in zuakpa in a kim a gelh dingin a sawl ding hi.

records.english: Keep the receipt, because we might need it to get our money back.
records.zomi: I sum i ngah kik nadingin i kisam kha ding ahih manin laimal kem in.

records.english: Shall we pay for your cousin's lunch, since she's just started her new job?
records.zomi: Na sanggam nu nasep thak a kipat khit tom ahih manin a sun an man i pia sak ding hiam?

records.english: It would help older customers a great deal if the self-checkouts were kept simple.
records.zomi: Keimah sum piakna setna te a baih leh a lei mi upate a huh mahmah ding hi.

records.english: Paying by phone will save time, but it may leave some older shoppers behind.
records.zomi: Phone tawh piak in hun a kem ding a, ahi zongin van lei mi upa pawl khat a nusia kha ding hi.

records.english: You mustn't give your card number to anyone who phones you.
records.zomi: Hong sam peuhpeuh kiangah na card nambat na pia lo ding hi.

records.english: Whatever the café decides, I'll keep a few coins in my pocket for the bus.
records.zomi: An zuakna inn in bang a khen zongin bus adingin ka ip sungah dangka sik tawmno ka kem ding hi.

records.english: So that's $20 back, right?
records.zomi: Tua ahih manin $20 hong pia kik ding hi, a man hiam?

records.english: Yes, $20 exactly, and here's your receipt.
records.zomi: Man hi, $20 tak, leh hih na laimal ahi hi.

records.english: On Saturday, my nine-year-old son is going to look after the cash tin at the school fair.
records.zomi: Kiginni ni-in ka tapa kum kua in sang pawi ah sum bawm a kem ding hi.

records.english: We've practiced giving change with toy money at the kitchen table all week.
records.zomi: Kal bup an huanna dawhkan ah kimawlna sum tawh sum kilaih piak i sin hi.

records.english: His teacher will sit beside him, just in case the queue gets long.
records.zomi: Mi tampi a dingkhawm uh leh cih adingin a saya in a kiang ah a tu ding hi.

records.english: My grandfather told me, "Always count your change before you walk away."
records.zomi: Ka pu in, “Na pai ma-in na sum kilaih sim tawntung in,” hong ci hi.

records.english: The new card will be posted to my home address within five working days.
records.zomi: Card thak nasep ni nga sungin ka inn ah laikhak tawh hong kikhak ding hi.

records.english: I'm going to have my salary paid into a new account that doesn't charge fees.
records.zomi: Sum ngen lo bank sum koihna thak ah ka khasum ka lut sak ding hi.

records.english: My aunt says, "Keep every receipt until the guarantee runs out."
records.zomi: Ka ni in, “Ciamna a bei mateng laimal khempeuh kem in,” a ci hi.

records.english: My grandfather will try his new hearing aid for a month, and he can return it if it doesn't help.
records.zomi: Ka pu in a bil zakna setna thak kha khat a zang sin ding a, a huh kei leh a pia kik thei hi.

records.english: I do want to keep the coat, but I'm not sure it'll be warm enough for the mountains.
records.zomi: Puan lum ka kem ka deih taktak a, ahi zongin mual tungah a lum kicing ding hiam ka thei kei hi.

records.english: In a few years, I imagine most returns will be handled without speaking to anyone.
records.zomi: Kum tawmno khit ciangin pia kik a tamzaw kuamah tawh kikum lo-in kibawl ding hi, ka ngaihsun hi.

records.english: I'll have the washing machine checked by the shop's own technician before I ask for a refund.
records.zomi: Sum ka ngen kik ma-in puan silna setna zuakna inn' bawl dampa in ka ensak ding hi.

records.english: Next year, all the shops in the mall will have the same return policy, according to the newspaper.
records.zomi: Laithak in a gen bangin a zom kum ciangin zuakna inn lian sung-a zuakna inn khempeuh in pia kikna thukham kibang a nei ding uh hi.

records.english: I'm writing the return policy for my small online shop this weekend.
records.zomi: Hih kal tawp in ka online zuakna inn neu adingin pia kikna thukham ka gelh ding hi.

records.english: Could your brother take the faulty television back in his car?
records.zomi: Na sanggam pasal in television sia a mawtaw tawh a pia kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: Tomorrow I'll be standing in the returns queue for an hour, I suspect.
records.zomi: Zingciang ciangin pia kik dingin nai khat sung ka dingkhawm kha ding hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: Any item returned after 30 days will be exchanged for store credit only.
records.zomi: Ni 30 khit ciangin kipia kik van khempeuh zuakna inn sum ciamtehna tawh bek kilaih ding hi.

records.english: If the shoes still hurt after a week, I'll have them stretched by the cobbler.
records.zomi: Kal khat khit ciangin khedap te a na lai leh khedap bawlpa in ka zaisak ding hi.

records.english: What happens if the guitar strings break during the trial week?
records.zomi: Sinna kal sungin guitar khau te a tan leh bang a piang ding hiam?

records.english: Then we'll replace them for free, and you can still bring the guitar back.
records.zomi: Tua ciangin a man lo-in i laih ding a, guitar na tawi kik thei lai hi.

records.english: To be honest, I'd rather pay a little more for something I won't need to return.
records.zomi: Thu man takin, ka pia kik ding a kisam lo van khat adingin tawmno tam zaw pia ka deih zaw hi.

records.english: The damaged chairs will be collected on Monday, and new ones delivered on Wednesday.
records.zomi: Tutna sia te Pizing ni-in kila ding a, a thak te Nilai ni-in hong kipuak ding hi.

records.english: This time next week, the new sofa should be in our living room, if the fabric is right.
records.zomi: A zom kal tu hun ciangin puan a kilawm leh sofa thak i tutna inn ah a om ding hi.

records.english: I'll keep the box and the receipt so that I can return the phone if it doesn't suit my mother.
records.zomi: Ka nu adingin a kilawm kei leh phone ka pia kik theih nadingin bawm leh laimal ka kem ding hi.

records.english: Only wear the new shoes on the carpet for the first few days, so that we can still exchange them.
records.zomi: I laih thei lai nadingin ni masa pawl khat sung khedap thak te phah tungah bek silh in.

records.english: At the hardware shop, they'll repair the drill instead of replacing it, as long as it's under guarantee.
records.zomi: Van zuakna inn ah ciamna sung a om lai teng thau-it bawlna laih sangin a bawl dam ding uh hi.

records.english: My daughter will be disappointed if we have to return her birthday bicycle.
records.zomi: A pianni siiksakol i pia kik ding a kisam leh ka tanu a lungkham ding hi.

records.english: You mustn't wash the shirt if you think you might return it.
records.zomi: Na pia kik kha ding hi, na ci leh puan-akhi na sil lo ding hi.

records.english: If the parcel isn't sealed properly, the jacket could be damaged on the way back.
records.zomi: Thuamhual hoih takin kikhak kei leh lampi ah kawt a sia thei hi.

records.english: Whatever the shop says, I'm not keeping a phone that switches itself off.
records.zomi: Zuakna inn in bang ci zongin amah mah in a kimut phone ka kem lo ding hi.

records.english: Who's going to take the broken lamp back on Saturday?
records.zomi: Kiginni ni-in meivak sia kua in a pia kik ding hiam?

records.english: Sorry, could you say that again — is it 14 days or 40?
records.zomi: Maisak ing, na gen kik thei ding hiam — ni 14 hiam 40 hiam?

records.english: The new mattress comes with a 100-night trial, which seems almost too generous.
records.zomi: Lupna phah thak in zan 100 sinna a nei a, a hoih lua bang hi.

records.english: The music shop is letting my son try a guitar at home for a week before we decide.
records.zomi: La zuakna inn in i thukhen ma-in kal khat sung inn ah guitar khat sin dingin ka tapa a phal hi.

records.english: We could ask the shop to repair the zip instead of giving us our money back.
records.zomi: Sum hong pia kik sangin zip bawl dam dingin zuakna inn i ngen thei hi.

records.english: It would help people without cars a great deal if the shop collected large returns.
records.zomi: Zuakna inn in van lian pia kik te a la leh mawtaw nei lo mite a huh mahmah ding hi.

records.english: Before we order the new sofa, we're going to ask for fabric samples.
records.zomi: Sofa thak i ngen ma-in a puan lim te i ngen ding hi.

records.english: We'll hold them up against the curtains in daylight and in the evening.
records.zomi: Sun vak lai leh nitak ciangin tukvuang puan te kiang ah i dawh ding hi.

records.english: That way, we won't have to send back a sofa that looked different on the screen.
records.zomi: Tua bangin screen tungah a kibang lo bang sofa khat i pia kik ding a kisam lo ding hi.

records.english: From 1 March, the shoe shop in our street is changing its return policy.
records.zomi: March ni 1 pan kipan i lampi-a khedap zuakna inn in pia kikna thukham a khek ding hi.

records.english: Customers will have 30 days instead of 14 to bring back anything that doesn't fit.
records.zomi: A lei mite in a kilawm lo khatpeuh tawi kik nadingin ni 14 sangin ni 30 a nei ding uh hi.

records.english: I think it's a clever idea, because people will feel safer buying shoes for their children.
records.zomi: Mite in a ta te adingin khedap lei a bit zaw sa ding uh ahih manin ngaihsutna pil khat ahi hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: However polite the assistant is, I'll insist on a written receipt for the return.
records.zomi: Huhpa bangzah in zahtak zongin pia kikna adingin laimal gelh ka ngen ngiat ding hi.

records.english: Trying things at home first could save us several trips back to the shop.
records.zomi: Inn ah a masa-in sin in zuakna inn ah ciah kik tampi hong kem sak thei hi.

records.english: Just to check, I bring the item, the receipt, and my bank card, right?
records.zomi: Kician sak nadingin, van, laimal, leh ka bank card ka tawi ding hi, a man hiam?

records.english: I really do hope the shop accepts the return without the box.
records.zomi: Zuakna inn in bawm om lo-in pia kik a sang ding ka lametna taktak ahi hi.

records.english: I'm going to return the blue paint so that we can buy the color my wife actually chose.
records.zomi: Ka zi in a teel taktak rong i lei theih nadingin rong dum ka pia kik ding hi.

records.english: If more shops offered repairs instead of refunds, far less would be thrown away.
records.zomi: Zuakna inn tam zaw in sum pia kik sangin bawl dam a pia uh leh tawm zaw kipaih ding hi.

records.english: Could you call the shop and ask whether they'll take it back without the box?
records.zomi: Zuakna inn phone tawh sam inla, bawm om lo-in a sang ding uh hiam na dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: I'm going to return the jacket I ordered online, because the sleeves are too short.
records.zomi: Ka ban puan a tom lua ahih manin online ah ka ngen kawt ka pia kik ding hi.

records.english: I'll print the label tonight and drop the parcel at the locker by the station on Thursday.
records.zomi: Tu zanin lai ka print ding a, Laizing ni-in meileng dinna kiang-a koihna bawm ah thuamhual ka koih ding hi.

records.english: If the shop hasn't received the parcel by Friday, I'll phone their customer service.
records.zomi: Laithai ni dong zuakna inn in thuamhual a ngah kei leh a lei mi huhna pawl ka sam ding hi.

records.english: Is it all right if I bring it back next week, since I'm away until Friday?
records.zomi: Laithai ni dong ka om lo ding ahih manin a zom kal ciangin ka tawi kik leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: Can I still return the dress if the label has come off?
records.zomi: A min ciamtehna a kikhiat zongin puan ka pia kik thei lai ding hiam?

records.english: My father is going to make the seller put the guarantee in writing.
records.zomi: Ka pa in zuakpa in ciamna laidal tungah a gelh dingin a sawl ding hi.

records.english: Should I keep the lamp after all, if I can find a better place for it?
records.zomi: A koihna hoih zaw ka muh leh meivak ka kem zaw ding hiam?

records.english: The refund is going to the card I paid with, isn't it?
records.zomi: Sum pia kik pen ka piak card ah a pai ding hi, a hi hiam?

records.english: By the time the replacement arrives, the original problem will have been forgotten.
records.zomi: A laih ding a tun ciangin a masa-a haksatna kimangngilh khin ding hi.

records.english: The assistant said, "If it breaks within the first year, we'll replace it, no questions asked."
records.zomi: Huhpa in, “Kum masa sungin a sia leh dotna om lo-in i laih ding hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: How long will you give your customers to send things back?
records.zomi: Na lei mite in van a khak kik nadingin hun bangzah na pia ding hiam?

records.english: Two weeks, and I'll pay the postage if the item arrives damaged.
records.zomi: Kal nih, leh van a sia-in a tun leh laikhak man ka pia ding hi.

records.english: Once the new policy starts, parents will be able to buy school shoes without worrying.
records.zomi: Thukham thak a kipat khit ciangin nu leh pate in lungkham lo-in sang khedap a lei thei ding uh hi.

records.english: Do shops really check the soles when you take shoes back?
records.zomi: Khedap na pia kik ciangin zuakna inn te in a nuai lam a en taktak uh hiam?

records.english: Remind me to take the receipt when I go back to the shop.
records.zomi: Zuakna inn ah ka ciah kik ciangin laimal tawi dingin hong phawksak in.

records.english: Will you need the original box, or is the receipt enough?
records.zomi: A masa bawm na kisam ding hiam, laimal bek a kicing hiam?

records.english: Just the receipt is fine.
records.zomi: Laimal bek a hoih hi.

records.english: Please don't remove the labels until you're sure you're keeping it.
records.zomi: Na kem ding na theih ciang mateng min ciamtehna te khia kei in.

records.english: My grandfather writes his letters in short paragraphs so that they're easy to read aloud.
records.zomi: Ka pu in aw-in sim a baih nadingin a laikhak te kammal khen tom tawh a gelh hi.

records.english: I do want to write well, but I always get stuck after the first sentence.
records.zomi: Hoih takin gelh ka deih taktak a, ahi zongin kammal tang masa pen khit ciangin ka khawl tawntung hi.

records.english: When I applied for my first job, my cover letter was one enormous paragraph.
records.zomi: Ka nasep masa pen ka ngen ciangin ka nasep ngetna lai kammal khen lian khat ahi hi.

records.english: A friend helped me divide it into three parts: who I am, what I can do, and why I want the job.
records.zomi: Lawm khat in khen thum-in hong huh hi: kua ka hi hiam, bang ka bawl thei hiam, leh bang hangin nasep ka deih hiam.

records.english: I was invited to an interview the following week.
records.zomi: A zom kal ciangin kidotna ah hong kisam hi.

records.english: The details in the middle should explain or prove the main idea.
records.zomi: A laizang-a thu neute in ngaihsutna lian a gen siang ding a, a lak ding hi.

records.english: Long paragraphs can tire the reader, especially on a phone screen.
records.zomi: Kammal khen sau te in simpa a olsak thei a, phone screen tungah a tuamin.

records.english: How many paragraphs should the essay have?
records.zomi: Laigelh in kammal khen bangzah a nei ding hiam?

records.english: At least three: one to introduce the topic, one for your ideas, and one to finish.
records.zomi: Thum bek hi zongin: thu a kipatsak khat, na ngaihsutna adingin khat, leh a tawp nading khat.

records.english: How do you know when a paragraph is finished?
records.zomi: Kammal khen khat a bei hi, cih bangci-in na thei hiam?

records.english: When you've said everything about one idea and you're ready to move to the next.
records.zomi: Ngaihsutna khat thu bangkim na gen khit a, a zom ah pai dingin na kiman ciangin.

records.english: Write a paragraph about your favorite place in your town.
records.zomi: Na khuapi-a na deih pen mun thu kammal khen khat gelh in.

records.english: If I had planned my paragraphs first, my essay would have been much easier to follow.
records.zomi: Ka kammal khen te a masa-in geel leng ka laigelh zui a baih zaw mahmah ding hi.

records.english: Use a highlighter to mark the main idea in each paragraph.
records.zomi: Kammal khen khat ciat-a ngaihsutna lian ciamteh nadingin khedal vak zang in.

records.english: We might lose marks if the paragraphs don't follow each other logically.
records.zomi: Kammal khen te a kizom dan a dik kei leh mak i mansuah kha ding hi.

records.english: I wrote a paragraph about my grandmother's garden.
records.zomi: Ka pi' huan thu kammal khen khat ka gelh hi.

records.english: By the end of the course, the students were organizing their ideas without being reminded.
records.zomi: Sinna a bei ciangin sangnaupangte in phawksak lo-in amau' ngaihsutna te a ngam thei uh hi.

records.english: Does that make sense, or should I explain it again?
records.zomi: Tua in khiatna a nei hiam, kong gen siang kik ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, it makes sense now, thank you.
records.zomi: Nei hi, tu-in ka thei khin hi, lungdam ing.

records.english: Although the paragraph was short, it explained the problem better than the whole page before it.
records.zomi: Kammal khen a tom hangin a ma-a phek bup sangin haksatna a gen siang zaw hi.

records.english: Each paragraph should be about one main idea.
records.zomi: Kammal khen khat ciat in ngaihsutna lian khat thu a gen ding hi.

records.english: Who would like to read their paragraph to the class?
records.zomi: Kua in a kammal khen sang inndei kiangah sim a deih hiam?

records.english: A good first sentence tells the reader what the paragraph is going to be about.
records.zomi: Kammal tang masa hoih in kammal khen in bang thu a gen ding hiam simpa a hilh hi.

records.english: I always write my ideas on sticky notes and move them around until the order feels right.
records.zomi: Ka ngaihsutna te laidal kibelh tungah ka gelh a, a kigual dan a kilawm mateng ka tawn hi.

records.english: Read your partner's paragraph and tell them one thing you liked.
records.zomi: Na lawm' kammal khen sim inla, na deih thu khat hilh in.

records.english: Your last sentence should remind the reader of your main point.
records.zomi: Na kammal tang nunung in simpa na ngaihsutna lian a phawksak ding hi.

records.english: It was only when I started writing for a newspaper that I learned how much a short paragraph can do.
records.zomi: Laithak adingin ka gelh kipat ciang bek kammal khen tom in bangzah a bawl thei hiam ka sin hi.

records.english: When you write an email, give each purpose its own short paragraph.
records.zomi: Email na gelh ciangin ngimna khat ciat adingin kammal khen tom khat ciat pia in.

records.english: Class, plan your paragraph in your notebook before you start writing.
records.zomi: Naupangte, na gelh kipat ma-un na laibu ah na kammal khen geel un.

records.english: Have you finished your paragraph about the market?
records.zomi: Zuakna mun thu na kammal khen na zo khin hiam?

records.english: My teacher said, "Your ideas are good, but they need to be in a clearer order."
records.zomi: Ka saya in, “Na ngaihsutnate a hoih hi, ahi zongin a kigual dan a kician zaw ding a kisam hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: Linking words help the reader follow your thinking from one paragraph to the next.
records.zomi: Zopna kammal te in simpa na ngaihsutna kammal khen khat pan khat ah a zui theih nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Please don't put two different topics in the same paragraph.
records.zomi: Kammal khen khat mah ah thu tuamtuam nih koih kei in.

records.english: My son's paragraph about his dog was read aloud in assembly.
records.zomi: Ka tapa' a ui thu kammal khen pen kikhopna ah aw-in kisim hi.

records.english: Rather than adding more sentences, try to make each one say more.
records.zomi: Kammal tang tam zaw behlap sangin a khat ciat in tam zaw a gen nadingin hanciam in.

records.english: Writing one paragraph a day helped my daughter grow more confident.
records.zomi: Ni khat kammal khen khat gelh in ka tanu a kimuang zaw sak hi.

records.english: Shall we write the first paragraph together on the board?
records.zomi: Suanglaipi tungah kammal khen masa pen khawm-in i gelh ding hiam?

records.english: You could use a mind map to collect your ideas before you start writing.
records.zomi: Na gelh kipat ma-in na ngaihsutna te khawm nadingin ngaihsutna map khat na zang thei hi.

records.english: I think the second paragraph would be stronger if you moved the example to the beginning.
records.zomi: Lahna pen a kipatna ah na tawn leh kammal khen nihna a hat zaw ding hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: I was disappointed when my favorite paragraph had to be cut because the essay was too long.
records.zomi: Laigelh a sau lua ahih manin ka deih pen kammal khen kikhiat ding a kisam ciangin ka lungkham hi.

records.english: My nephew stared at the blank page for twenty minutes, unable to begin.
records.zomi: Ka tanau in kipan zo lo-in minit sawm nih sung laidal ngawng a en hi.

records.english: His mother asked him to say his ideas out loud while she wrote them down.
records.zomi: A nu in a gelh laitakin a ngaihsutna te aw-in gen dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: Ten minutes later, he had three neat paragraphs and a big smile.
records.zomi: Minit sawm khit ciangin kammal khen hoih thum leh nuihna lian khat a nei khin hi.

records.english: The class wrote one paragraph each, and together they made a story.
records.zomi: Sang inndei in kammal khen khat ciat a gelh uh a, khawm-in tangthu khat a suak hi.

records.english: In my email to the school, the first paragraph will explain why I'm writing.
records.zomi: Sang kiangah ka email ah kammal khen masa pen in bang hangin ka gelh hiam a gen siang ding hi.

records.english: What makes a paragraph convincing is usually the quality of its examples.
records.zomi: Kammal khen khat a muanhuai sak pen a tamzaw-in a lahnate' hoihna ahi hi.

records.english: Having planned each paragraph in note form, she finished the essay in half the usual time.
records.zomi: Kammal khen khat ciat ciamtehna tom tawh a geel khit ciangin laigelh hun tavuan a kim sungin a zo hi.

records.english: The more carefully you plan, the less you will need to rewrite.
records.zomi: Limtakin na geel semsem ciangin na gelh kik ding a tawm semsem ding hi.

records.english: Which of your paragraphs do you think is the strongest?
records.zomi: Na kammal khen te lakah bang in a hat pen hi, na ci hiam?

records.english: Can I write my paragraph on the computer instead of on paper?
records.zomi: Laidal tungah sangin computer tungah ka kammal khen ka gelh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Start a new paragraph when you move on to a new idea.
records.zomi: Ngaihsutna thak khat ah na pai ciangin kammal khen thak kipan in.

records.english: Could you check whether my paragraphs are in the best order?
records.zomi: Ka kammal khen te a kigual dan hoih pen ah a om hiam na en thei ding hiam?

records.english: My first paragraph is too long, isn't it?
records.zomi: Ka kammal khen masa pen a sau lua hi, a hi hiam?

records.english: Show me the paragraph you're most proud of.
records.zomi: Na kipak pen kammal khen hong lak in.

records.english: The report was rewritten after the manager said it was one long paragraph.
records.zomi: Makaipa in kammal khen sau khat bek ahi hi, a cih khit ciangin report kigelh kik hi.

records.english: Can you give one more example to support your idea?
records.zomi: Na ngaihsutna huh nadingin lahna khat behlap na pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: To be honest, I find the last paragraph of any essay the hardest to write.
records.zomi: Thu man takin, laigelh khempeuh-a kammal khen nunung gelh ka haksa sa pen hi.

records.english: A clear paragraph guides the reader without making them work too hard.
records.zomi: Kammal khen kician in simpa a sem lua lo-in a pi hi.

records.english: My essay was handed back with arrows showing where each paragraph should begin.
records.zomi: Kammal khen khat ciat koi ah a kipan ding hiam a lak ciamtehna tawh ka laigelh hong kiciah hi.

records.english: Whatever you write, try reading it aloud to hear where one idea ends and the next begins.
records.zomi: Bang na gelh zongin ngaihsutna khat koi ah a bei a, a zom koi ah a kipan hiam zak nadingin aw-in sim in.

records.english: Can you tell me why the road is closed?
records.zomi: Bang hangin lampi kikhak hiam hong gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: They're repairing a water pipe, and it'll open again at 6 pm.
records.zomi: Tui khuam a bawl dam uh a, nitak nai guk ciangin kihong kik ding hi.

records.english: I'm not sure I follow — why does the form need two signatures?
records.zomi: Ka thei siang kei hi — bang hangin lai in min gelhna nih a kisam hiam?

records.english: What are we celebrating tonight?
records.zomi: Tu zanin bang i lungdam hiam?

records.english: I'd just like to understand the reason for the decision.
records.zomi: Thukhenna' hang bek theih ka deih hi.

records.english: Sorry to interrupt, but could I ask why the fee has changed?
records.zomi: Ka tan hangin maisak ing, ahi zongin bang hangin a man kikhek hiam ka dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: What people often want is not a long explanation but one honest reason.
records.zomi: Mite in a deih tam pen gen siangna sau hi lo-in hang man khat ahi hi.

records.english: My son always has a reason for everything, especially for staying up late.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in bangkim adingin hang a nei tawntung a, khanglawh dingin a tuamin.

records.english: Could you ask the clinic why my mother's appointment was cancelled, since she doesn't speak the language well?
records.zomi: Ka nu in pau hoih takin a thei kei ahih manin bang hangin a kimuhna kikhak hiam siavuan inn na dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: What's behind the decision to close the library on Sundays?
records.zomi: Nipini ni-in laibu inn khak dingin thukhenna nung ah bang a om hiam?

records.english: The council says it can't afford the extra staff, due to budget cuts.
records.zomi: Sum zat geel kiam ahih manin nasem behlap a pia zo kei hi, ci-in khua upate in a gen uh hi.

records.english: I asked my uncle why he used a level when he put up the shelf, and he showed me the bubble.
records.zomi: Van koihna a khai ciangin bang hangin a kibang setna a zang hiam ka pa neu ka dong a, a sungah a om huih bawl hong lak hi.

records.english: Could you give me a reason, so that I can explain it to my family?
records.zomi: Ka innkuan kiangah ka gen siang theih nadingin hang khat hong pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: I do want to know the reason, even if it's not good news.
records.zomi: Thu hoih hi lo zongin a hang theih ka deih taktak hi.

records.english: Do you mind telling me what made you change your mind?
records.zomi: Bang in na ngaihsutna hong khek sak hiam hong gen dingin na lungkham ding hiam?

records.english: The doctor explained why she wanted me to have another test, which made me feel calmer.
records.zomi: Siavuan in bang hangin sitna dang khat a deih hiam a gen siang a, tua in ka lungsim hong daisak hi.

records.english: What made you choose this school for your son?
records.zomi: Na tapa adingin bang in hih sang hong teelsak hiam?

records.english: It's close to home, and the teachers seemed to really listen.
records.zomi: Inn kiang ah a om a, saya te in a ngai taktak bang uh hi.

records.english: Is there a reason the children have to wear hats at school?
records.zomi: Naupangte in sang ah lukhu a khu ding uh a kisam pen hang khat a om hiam?

records.english: The sun is very strong at midday, and the school wants to protect them.
records.zomi: Sun laitak-in ni a hat mahmah a, sang in amaute a kem nuam hi.

records.english: Tell me why you like that song so much.
records.zomi: Bang hangin tua la na deih mahmah hiam hong gen in.

records.english: Is there a reason the meeting has been moved to Friday?
records.zomi: Kikhopna Laithai ni ah a kituan hang khat a om hiam?

records.english: The manager is away until Thursday, so we had to push it back.
records.zomi: Makaipa Laizing ni dong a om lo ding ahih manin i nawlkhin ding a kisam hi.

records.english: Can I ask why you're leaving so early?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ma lua-in na pai hiam ka dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: What's the reason for the delay?
records.zomi: A nunna hang bang ahi hiam?

records.english: There's a problem with the signals near the next station.
records.zomi: A zom meileng dinna kiang-a ciamtehna meivak ah haksatna khat a om hi.

records.english: If the company had explained the reason for the change, fewer customers would have complained.
records.zomi: Company in kikhekna hang a gen siang le lei mi tawm zaw in a phun kha ding uh hi.

records.english: How come you're so happy today?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tuni-in na kipak mahmah hiam?

records.english: Whatever reason they give, I think we should ask to see it in writing.
records.zomi: Bang hang a gen uh zongin laidal tungah et dingin i ngen ding hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: How come your brother didn't come to the party?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na sanggam pasal pawi ah a hong kei hiam?

records.english: He had to work late, since two of his colleagues were ill.
records.zomi: A nasem pawl nih a cina uh ahih manin nunung-in a sem ding a kisam hi.

records.english: How come the shop is closed on a Tuesday?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pithai ni-in zuakna inn kikhak hiam?

records.english: The owner is at his daughter's wedding, according to the sign on the door.
records.zomi: Kongkhak tung-a lai bangin a neipa a tanu' mopawi ah a om hi.

records.english: Is there any particular reason you want to sit by the window?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tukvuang kiang ah na tut nop hiam, hang tuam khat a om hiam?

records.english: I get travel sick, and looking outside helps.
records.zomi: Khualzin ciangin ka lu a hai a, pua lam en in a huh hi.

records.english: What made you decide to learn the guitar at sixty?
records.zomi: Bang in kum sawm guk na phak ciangin guitar sin dingin hong thukhensak hiam?

records.english: I've always wanted to, and now I finally have the time.
records.zomi: Ka deih tawntung a, tu-in a tawp-in hun ka nei hi.

records.english: Hearing the reason for a rule makes it much easier to accept.
records.zomi: Thukham khat' hang zak in sang a baih zaw mahmah sak hi.

records.english: Children, can anyone think of a reason why we wash our hands before eating?
records.zomi: Naupangte, bang hangin an i nek ma-in i khut i sil hiam, kua in hang khat a ngaihsun thei hiam?

records.english: The reason for the price rise was printed on a notice by the till.
records.zomi: Van man khanna hang pen sum lakna kiang-a lai khai ah kigelh hi.

records.english: My daughter asked why she had to go to bed earlier than her cousin.
records.zomi: Bang hangin a sanggam sangin ma zaw-in ihmu ding a kisam hiam ka tanu in hong dong hi.

records.english: When I said that she was younger, she asked why age should matter.
records.zomi: A neu zaw hi, ka cih ciangin bang hangin kum a thupi hiam a dong hi.

records.english: By the time I had finished explaining, it was well past both their bedtimes.
records.zomi: Ka gen siang zawh ciangin a nih in ihmut hun a kantan khin hi.

records.english: What made the price of tomatoes go up so much?
records.zomi: Bang in mehtuuk man a khangsak lua hiam?

records.english: The heavy rain ruined half the crop, so there are fewer in the market.
records.zomi: Guah tam in a kaihawl a kim a susia ahih manin zuakna mun ah a tawm zaw hi.

records.english: We might get a clearer answer if we ask the manager directly.
records.zomi: Makaipa i dong pah leh dawnna kician zaw i ngah kha ding hi.

records.english: How come you're not eating your rice?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na buh na ne kei hiam?

records.english: I had a big lunch at school, so I'm not very hungry.
records.zomi: Sang ah sun an tampi ka ne ahih manin ka gil a kial mahmah kei hi.

records.english: Although she didn't agree with the decision, she appreciated hearing the reasons behind it.
records.zomi: Thukhenna tawh a kilem kei hangin a nung-a hangte a zak a lungdam hi.

records.english: Asking for a reason politely usually gets a better answer than demanding one.
records.zomi: Zahtak takin hang dot in ngen khauh sangin dawnna hoih zaw a ngah tawntung hi.

records.english: Could you explain why there's an extra $12 on my bill?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ka laimal ah $12 behlap a om hiam na gen siang thei ding hiam?

records.english: That's the delivery charge, because the order was under $50.
records.zomi: Ngetna $50 nuai ahih manin tua pen puak man ahi hi.

records.english: My mother asked why the bus was so full.
records.zomi: Bang hangin bus a dim lua hiam ka nu in a dong hi.

records.english: Everyone, write down three reasons for your answer, not just one.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh aw, na dawnna adingin hang khat bek hi lo-in thum gelh un.

records.english: Is there a reason you're late?
records.zomi: Na nun hang khat a om hiam?

records.english: May I ask why my application was turned down?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ka ngetna kinial hiam ka dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: It arrived after the deadline, but you're welcome to apply again next year.
records.zomi: A tawpna ni khit ciangin a tung a, ahi zongin a zom kum ciangin na ngen kik thei hi.

records.english: My neighbor asked why we were cutting down the tree, so we showed her the cracked branch.
records.zomi: Bang hangin singkung i phuk hiam ka inn vengnu in a dong a, tua ahih manin a bawng kek i lak hi.

records.english: The more clearly you explain your reasons, the more likely people are to agree.
records.zomi: Na hangte kician takin na gen siang semsem ciangin mite in a kilem semsem uh hi.

records.english: The teacher wants to know why you missed school yesterday.
records.zomi: Bang hangin zanni-in sang na kia hiam saya in a theih nop hi.

records.english: Shall we start saving for Christmas now, so that December isn't so hard?
records.zomi: December a haksa lua lohna dingin Christmas adingin tu-in i kikoih kipan ding hiam?

records.english: Next month, we're going to try paying for everything in cash.
records.zomi: A zom kha in bangkim dangka tawh pia dingin i sin ding hi.

records.english: Every Sunday, I'll take out the week's money and keep it in an envelope in the drawer by the door.
records.zomi: Nipini simin kal sung sum ka lakhia ding a, kongkhak kiang-a kenkuan sung-a lai-ip ah ka koih ding hi.

records.english: Whatever is left in the envelope on Saturday will go into the children's savings box.
records.zomi: Kiginni ni-in lai-ip sungah a om lai peuhpeuh naupangte' sum kikoihna bawm ah a lut ding hi.

records.english: Don't promise the children a trip to the coast until we know what the car repair will cost.
records.zomi: Mawtaw bawl dam man bangzah ahi ding hiam i theih ma-in naupangte tuipi gei khualzinna ciam kei in.

records.english: If the bakery gives me more hours, we can stop borrowing from my brother.
records.zomi: Moh bawlna in nai tam zaw hong piak leh ka sanggam pasal pan i puk khawl thei ding hi.

records.english: My grandson is coming to stay for the summer, so the food budget will need to grow.
records.zomi: Ka tu pasal khal sung om dingin a hong ding ahih manin an adingin sum zat geel a khang ding a kisam ding hi.

records.english: You're going to keep the receipts this month, aren't you?
records.zomi: Hih kha in laimal te na kem ding hi, a hi hiam?

records.english: Will you help me make a budget for our trip to see Grandma?
records.zomi: Pi veh i khualzinna adingin sum zat geel bawl dingin hong huh ding hiam?

records.english: My parents are used to paying for everything in cash, so they'll need help with the banking app.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in bangkim dangka tawh piak a ngeina ahih manin bank app tawh huh a kisam ding uh hi.

records.english: In my view, every teenager should learn to manage a small budget before leaving home.
records.zomi: Ka ngaihsutna-in khangno khempeuh in inn a nusiat ma-un sum zat geel neu khat kem a sin ding uh hi.

records.english: Once the children have left home, our food bill will probably be half of what it is now.
records.zomi: Naupangte inn a nusiat khit uh ciangin i an man tu-a zah a kim bang ahi kha ding hi.

records.english: How would we manage if the car broke down and we needed another one?
records.zomi: Mawtaw a sia a, a dang khat i kisam leh bangci-in i bawl ding hiam?

records.english: We'd use the emergency savings and take the bus until we found a cheap one.
records.zomi: Lauhuai hun adingin kikoih sum i zang ding a, man neu khat i muh mateng bus i tuang ding hi.

records.english: By the end of the year, we should have saved enough to replace the leaking roof.
records.zomi: Kum tawp ciangin innkhum kua khek nadingin a kicing i kikoih khin ding hi.

records.english: Could we afford a second-hand fridge if we don't eat out for two months?
records.zomi: Kha nih sung pua ah an i ne kei leh vot sak setna lui khat i lei zo ding hiam?

records.english: We'll ask at the bank whether a savings account for children pays more interest.
records.zomi: Naupangte adingin sum kikoihna in tam zaw a pia hiam bank ah i dong ding hi.

records.english: My daughter wants to save for a bicycle by the end of the summer.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in khal tawp ma-in siiksakol khat adingin kikoih a deih hi.

records.english: We'll mend the children's jackets this year instead of buying new ones.
records.zomi: Hih kum in a thak lei sangin naupangte' kawt te i bawl dam ding hi.

records.english: Will we have enough for the car insurance in June?
records.zomi: June kha-in mawtaw insurance adingin a kicing i nei ding hiam?

records.english: Planning for money we might not have is harder than planning for money we already have.
records.zomi: I neih kha lo ding sum adingin geel pen i nei khin sum adingin geel sangin a haksa zaw hi.

records.english: Our old car will be sold in the spring, and we'll buy a smaller one.
records.zomi: I mawtaw lui spring ciangin kizuak ding a, a neu zaw khat i lei ding hi.

records.english: The plan is to save one month's rent before we look for a bigger flat.
records.zomi: Inn lian zaw i zon ma-in kha khat inn man i kikoih ding hi, i geelna ahi hi.

records.english: Starting next week, takeaway is for Friday nights only.
records.zomi: A zom kal pan kipan an lei Laithai ni zan bek ahi ding hi.

records.english: If we stick to this plan, we'll be free of debt before our daughter finishes primary school.
records.zomi: Hih geelna i zui leh i tanu sang neu a zawh ma-in leiba pan i suakta ding hi.

records.english: I'm thinking of starting a savings box for each of the grandchildren.
records.zomi: Tu khat ciat adingin sum kikoihna bawm khat ka bawl ding ka ngaihsun hi.

records.english: Shall we keep my birthday money for the start of the school year?
records.zomi: Sang kum kipatna adingin ka pianni sum i kem ding hiam?

records.english: I'll email the landlord tonight to ask whether we can pay the deposit in two parts.
records.zomi: A ma-a piak ding sum nih-in i pia thei ding hiam inn neipa kiangah tu zanin email ka khak ding hi.

records.english: Of the two plans, I prefer the one that leaves something for small pleasures.
records.zomi: Geelna nih lakah nopna neute adingin bangmah a nusia pen ka deih zaw hi.

records.english: From January, my wife and I are going to sit down together on the first Sunday of every month.
records.zomi: January pan kipan ka zi leh kei in kha khempeuh Nipini masa pen-in khawm-in i tu ding hi.

records.english: We'll go through the bank statement line by line over a cup of tea.
records.zomi: Tea haai khat tawh bank laimal pen tang khat ciat i en ding hi.

records.english: We hope it'll mean fewer surprises and fewer arguments.
records.zomi: Lamdang tawm zaw leh kinialna tawm zaw a om ding i lamen hi.

records.english: Which bills are we going to pay first when the money comes in?
records.zomi: Sum a hong tun ciangin laimal bang te i pia masa ding hiam?

records.english: We're going to write down every coin we spend for the whole of next month.
records.zomi: A zom kha bup sung i zat dangka sik khempeuh i gelh ding hi.

records.english: My mother made me promise to save part of my first salary.
records.zomi: Ka nu in ka khasum masa pen khen khat kikoih dingin hong ciamsak hi.

records.english: The rent is going up by $40 in March, so something else will have to give.
records.zomi: March kha-in inn man $40 a khang ding ahih manin a dang khat i kiamsak ding a kisam ding hi.

records.english: How much will we need for the baby in the first year?
records.zomi: Kum masa sungin naungek adingin bangzah i kisam ding hiam?

records.english: When the loan is paid off, I'm going to treat the whole family to a meal.
records.zomi: Leiba a kipiak zawh ciangin innkuan bup nitak an ka pia ding hi.

records.english: It would be wiser to build up some savings than to buy the new sofa on credit.
records.zomi: Leiba-in sofa thak lei sangin sum tawmno kikoih a pil zaw ding hi.

records.english: The more we plan ahead, the fewer nasty surprises we'll have at the end of the month.
records.zomi: Ma-in i geel semsem ciangin kha tawp ah lamdang hoih lo tawm zaw i nei ding hi.

records.english: I wish I could promise you a bigger allowance next year, but I can't.
records.zomi: A zom kum ciangin zat ding sum tam zaw kong ciam thei leng ka deih hi, ahi zongin ka ciam thei kei hi.

records.english: Assuming the shop keeps me on after Christmas, we'll start saving for a deposit in January.
records.zomi: Christmas khit ciangin zuakna inn in hong kem lai leh January pan a ma-a piak ding sum adingin i kikoih kipan ding hi.

records.english: I'm going to have my phone contract checked to see if there's a cheaper option.
records.zomi: A man neu zaw a om hiam en nadingin ka phone kiciamna ka ensak ding hi.

records.english: Even if the bank agrees to lower our payments, it'll be a while before we can save again.
records.zomi: Bank in i piak ding a kiamsak zongin i kikoih kik theih ma-in hun sawt a kisam ding hi.

records.english: Sorry, can I just stop you there — did you say the rent is going up in April?
records.zomi: Maisak ing, tua ah hong khawl sak tawm ning — April kha-in inn man a khang ding na ci hiam?

records.english: Not until the last school fee is paid will I feel that we can relax a little.
records.zomi: Sang man nunung a kipiak mateng tawmno i tawlnga thei hi, ci-in ka kisa lo ding hi.

records.english: Are you sure we can manage on my salary while you finish your training?
records.zomi: Na sinna na zawh sungin ka khasum tawh i nungta zo ding hi, ci-in na theih taktak hiam?

records.english: Yes, if we're careful, since the course only lasts nine months.
records.zomi: Zo ding hi, i kidawm leh, sinna kha kua bek a sawt ahih manin.

records.english: Were the price of rice to rise again, we'd have to rethink the whole food budget.
records.zomi: Buh man a khang kik leh an adingin sum zat geel bup i ngaihsun kik ding a kisam ding hi.

records.english: How long will it take to pay off the credit card if we pay $50 a month?
records.zomi: Kha khat $50 i pia leh credit card leiba bangzah sawt ah i pia zo ding hiam?

records.english: Is the water bill likely to be higher in the summer?
records.zomi: Khal ciangin tui laimal a sang zaw kha ding hiam?

records.english: Probably, because we'll be watering the vegetable garden every evening.
records.zomi: A sang zaw kha ding hi, nitak simin anteh huan tui i buak ding ahih manin.

records.english: So, just to check, we're paying the electricity first and the phone next week?
records.zomi: Tua ahih manin, kician sak nadingin, mei-ok man i pia masa ding a, phone man a zom kal ah, a hi hiam?

records.english: When my son starts university in September, he'll manage his own money for the first time.
records.zomi: September kha-in ka tapa sangpi a kah kipat ciangin a masa pen-in amah' sum amah in a kem ding hi.

records.english: Before he goes, we're going to work out his weekly costs together at the kitchen table.
records.zomi: A pai ma-in an huanna dawhkan ah a kal sim zat ding sum khawm-in i sim ding hi.

records.english: If he runs short, he's promised to call us before he borrows from anyone else.
records.zomi: A kiam leh mi dang kiang pan a puk ma-in hong sam dingin a ciam hi.

records.english: Dear Mr. Lian, I am writing to ask whether next term's school fees could be paid monthly.
records.zomi: Pu Lian, a zom hun-a sang man te kha simin kipia thei ding hiam dong dingin lai ka gelh hi.

records.english: Are we still going to give money to the church every month?
records.zomi: Kha simin pawlpi ah sum i pia lai ding hiam?

records.english: The new budget will be stuck on the fridge, where everyone can see it.
records.zomi: Sum zat geel thak pen mi khempeuh in a muh theih nadingin vot sak setna ah kikilh ding hi.

records.english: We'll have to stop buying bottled water and use the filter jug instead.
records.zomi: Bel sung tui lei i khawl ding a, tua sangin tui siangsakna um i zang ding hi.

records.english: I'm not used to making friends at work, but I'm going to try harder in this job.
records.zomi: Nasepna ah lawm bawl ka ngeina hi lo hi, ahi zongin hih nasep ah ka hanciam zaw ding hi.

records.english: My sister got me to agree to sit with someone new at lunch.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu in sun an hun ciangin mi thak khat tawh tu dingin hong phal sak hi.

records.english: By the time the holidays are over, I imagine the two girls will be inseparable.
records.zomi: Nopsakna hun a bei ciangin nungak nih kikhen thei lo-in a om ding uh hi, ka ngaihsun hi.

records.english: Having just arrived, she'll probably be glad of someone to show her around.
records.zomi: A tun tom ahih manin a kiim hong lakpa khat a nei leh a kipak kha ding hi.

records.english: Next week I'll bring photos of my village to show you.
records.zomi: A zom kal ciangin na et nadingin ka khua lim te ka tawi ding hi.

records.english: We should invite the new couple from upstairs before they think we're unfriendly.
records.zomi: Lawmhoih lo i hi hi, a ngaihsut ma-un a tung dawl-a inn kiteng thak i sam ding hi.

records.english: Our neighbor's son will be staying with us for a week, so the boys can get to know each other.
records.zomi: Tangvalte a kithei nadingun i inn vengpa' tapa kal khat sung i kiang ah a om ding hi.

records.english: My son is going to ask the boy from the flat below to come and fly kites after school.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in sang khit ciangin leng-ngam lengsak dingin a nuai dawl-a tangval a sam ding hi.

records.english: Will you be my friend at the new school too?
records.zomi: Sang thak ah zong ka lawm na hi ding hiam?

records.english: When the new family arrives, we'll take them some bread and show them where the market is.
records.zomi: Innkuan thak a tun ciangin moh pawl khat i tawi sak ding a, zuakna mun koi ah a om hiam i lak ding hi.

records.english: I'm sure you two will get on well, because you both love old films.
records.zomi: Na nih in film lui na deih uh ahih manin na kilawm ding uh hi, ka thei hi.

records.english: Are you coming to the barbecue for new families on Sunday?
records.zomi: Nipini ni-in innkuan thakte adingin sa kanna pawi ah na hong ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, and I'll bring my husband so that he can meet yours.
records.zomi: Hong ning, na pasal a kimuh nadingin ka pasal ka tawi ding hi.

records.english: The more often you turn up, the more people will start to recognize you.
records.zomi: Na hong tam semsem ciangin mite in hong thei kipan semsem ding uh hi.

records.english: Hello, I'm calling to ask when the newcomers' group meets next.
records.zomi: Lumen, hong thakte pawl bang ciangin a kimu kik ding uh hiam dong dingin kong sam hi.

records.english: We might ask the family from church to join us for the picnic.
records.zomi: Pawlpi pan innkuan khual zin an nekna ah hong kihel dingin i ngen kha ding hi.

records.english: What I'd like most is a friend who will still call me in ten years' time.
records.zomi: Ka deih pen kum sawm khit ciangin zong hong sam lai ding lawm khat ahi hi.

records.english: I really hope we'll see each other again after the course.
records.zomi: Sinna khit ciangin i kimu kik ding ka lametna taktak ahi hi.

records.english: If you're free on Saturday, would you like to come fishing with my cousins?
records.zomi: Kiginni ni-in na om ngawng leh ka sanggamte tawh nga man dingin na pai nuam hiam?

records.english: What will you say if the other children don't want to play with you?
records.zomi: Naupang dangte in nangma tawh kimawl a deih kei uh leh bang na gen ding hiam?

records.english: I'll ask them what they're playing and whether I can join in.
records.zomi: Bang a kimawl uh hiam ka dong ding a, ka kihel thei ding hiam ka dong ding hi.

records.english: Once the baby is a little older, I'm hoping to rejoin the choir and see my old friends.
records.zomi: Naungek tawmno a lian khit ciangin la pawl ah kihel kik-in ka lawm luite kimu dingin ka lamen hi.

records.english: The new teacher is going to be introduced to the staff at Monday's meeting.
records.zomi: Pizing ni kikhopna ah saya thak nasemte kiangah kitheisak ding hi.

records.english: Should you ever need a lift to the market, just knock on our door.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun pai dingin mawtaw na kisam leh i kongkhak kik bek in.

records.english: Who are you going to sit with on the school trip?
records.zomi: Sang khualzinna ah kua tawh na tu ding hiam?

records.english: Assuming the job in the city works out, I'll have to start making friends all over again.
records.zomi: Khuapi-a nasep a hoih leh lawm bawl a thak-in ka kipan kik ding a kisam ding hi.

records.english: I'm hoping the neighbors' children will become friends with ours.
records.zomi: Inn vengte' ta te in i ta te tawh lawm a suak ding uh ka lamen hi.

records.english: I'm going to lend the new boy my comics.
records.zomi: Tangval thak kiangah ka lim laibu te ka caih sak ding hi.

records.english: It'll be easier to make friends once I can speak the language better.
records.zomi: Pau hoih zaw-in ka theih khit ciangin lawm bawl a baih zaw ding hi.

records.english: Do you think we'll still be friends when we're old?
records.zomi: I upat ciangin lawm-in i om lai ding hiam, na ci hiam?

records.english: Next term, our evening class is going to cook a meal together on the last night.
records.zomi: A zom hun ciangin i nitak sinna pawl in zan nunung pen-in khawm-in an a huan ding uh hi.

records.english: Everyone will bring one dish from their own family.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh in amau' innkuan pan an khat ciat a tawi ding uh hi.

records.english: I think that's when we'll stop being classmates and start being friends.
records.zomi: Tua ciangin sang lawm hi lo-in lawm i suak ding hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: Can my friend from the park come to our house tomorrow?
records.zomi: Huanpi pan ka lawm zingciang i inn ah a hong thei ding hiam?

records.english: Only if her parents say it's all right.
records.zomi: A nu leh a pa in a hoih hi, a cih uh leh bek.

records.english: You've just moved into number 12, haven't you?
records.zomi: Nambat 12 ah na hong tum tom hi, a hi hiam?

records.english: My daughter starts at a new school on Monday, and she's nervous about finding friends.
records.zomi: Ka tanu Pizing ni-in sang thak ah a kah kipan ding a, lawm a muh ding a lau hi.

records.english: Tonight we're going to practice what she can say to someone who looks lonely at break time.
records.zomi: Tawlngakna hun-a a kia bang mi khat kiangah bang a gen thei ding hiam tu zanin i sin ding hi.

records.english: Tomorrow she'll take two extra pencils in case anyone forgets theirs.
records.zomi: Kuamah in a mangngilh leh cih adingin zingciang ciangin khedal nih behlap a tawi ding hi.

records.english: My grandmother says she's going to make one new friend every year, even at eighty.

records.english: Would you like to meet again next Thursday?
records.zomi: A zom Laizing ni ciangin i kimu kik ding na deih hiam?

records.english: Here's my number: 555-0148.
records.zomi: Ka nambat hih ahi hi: 555-0148.

records.english: I wish I lived closer, because I'd love to see more of you.
records.zomi: Kiang zaw-in om leng ka deih hi, na tam zaw-in ka mu nuam hi.

records.english: As an adult, making friends may be slower, but I think it can be just as rewarding.
records.zomi: Mi upa-in lawm bawl a nawlkhin zaw kha ding a, ahi zongin a phattuam kibang thei hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: If we keep meeting like this every week, I suspect we'll be close friends by the end of the year.
records.zomi: Kal simin hih bangin i kimu lai leh kum tawp ciangin lawm kinai i suak ding hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: It would mean a lot to my father if someone his age invited him round for tea now and then.
records.zomi: Ka pa' kum kibang mi khat in a kal ah tea adingin a sam ciangin ka pa adingin a thupi mahmah ding hi.

records.english: Is it too soon to invite her for dinner, do you think?
records.zomi: Nitak an adingin sam a ma lua ding hiam, na ci hiam?

records.english: Hi Grace, it was lovely meeting you at the workshop, and I'd be glad to keep in touch.
records.zomi: Grace, sinna kikhopna ah na kimuh a nuam mahmah a, kikum lai i ding ka deih hi.

records.english: Whether we stay friends after the course will depend on how hard we both try.
records.zomi: Sinna khit ciangin lawm-in i om lai ding hiam pen i nih in bangzah i hanciam hiam tungah a kinga ding hi.

records.english: Where shall we meet next time, at your place or mine?
records.zomi: A zom ciangin koi ah i kimu ding hiam, na inn ah hiam ka inn ah hiam?

records.english: I'll wave to the new girl at the gate so that she doesn't feel alone.

records.english: Don't worry if the first conversation feels awkward, because it'll get easier.
records.zomi: Kikupna masa a nuam lo bang leh lungkham kei in, a baih zaw ding hi.

records.english: Maybe next time you could bring your sister along.
records.zomi: A zom ciangin na sanggam nu na tawi thei kha ding hi.

records.english: Let me know if you ever want company on your walk to work.
records.zomi: Nasepna pai lampi ah lawm na deih leh hong hilh in.

records.english: When we move to the coast next spring, I'll introduce myself to every neighbor on our lane.
records.zomi: A zom spring ciangin tuipi gei ah i kitawn ciangin i lampi neu-a inn vengte khempeuh kiangah keimah ka kitheisak ding hi.

records.english: Even if I'm tired, I'll go to the street party and the meetings at the school.
records.zomi: Ka ol zongin lampi pawi leh sang-a kikhopna te ah ka pai ding hi.

records.english: By the summer, I hope at least one neighbor will feel like a real friend.
records.zomi: Khal ciangin inn vengpa khat bek hi zongin lawm taktak bangin a kisak ding ka lamen hi.

records.english: We're going to start a walking group for the new mothers on our street.
records.zomi: I lampi-a nu thakte adingin pai pawl khat i kipat sak ding hi.

records.english: In my opinion, the friends you make in your thirties are often the ones who stay.
records.zomi: Ka ngaihsutna-in kum sawm thum sung-a na bawl lawmte a tamzaw-in a om tawntung te ahi uh hi.

records.english: What worries me most is inviting so many people that we can't talk to any of them.
records.zomi: Ka lungkham pen mi tam lua i sam a, kuamah tawh i kikum zo loh ding ahi hi.

records.english: In my opinion, a handwritten invitation still means more than a message on the phone.
records.zomi: Ka ngaihsutna-in khut tawh kigelh samna lai in phone tung-a message sangin a khiatna tam zaw lai hi.

records.english: Do you know if your sister will be bringing her new husband?
records.zomi: Na sanggam nu in a pasal thak a tawi ding hiam na thei hiam?

records.english: Next month, my husband's colleagues from abroad will visit for three days.
