records.english: We'll invite them home on the second evening, when they've had time to rest.
records.zomi: A tawlngak hun a neih khit uh ciangin nitak nihna-in inn ah i sam ding hi.

records.english: Our daughter is going to make the dessert and explain what's in it.
records.zomi: I tanu in an lim a bawl ding a, a sungah bang a om hiam a gen siang ding hi.

records.english: Could you help me address the envelopes this evening?
records.zomi: Tu nitakin lai-ip te ah omna mun gelh dingin hong huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Who's going to pick up Grandpa on the day?
records.zomi: Tua ni-in kua in Pu a la ding hiam?

records.english: Having been invited to so many weddings this year, we'd like to return the hospitality.
records.zomi: Hih kum in mopawi tampi ah hong kisam ahih manin a kemna i pia kik nuam hi.

records.english: Do you think my aunt will be offended if we invite her sister and not her?
records.zomi: A sanggam nu i sam a, amah i sam kei leh ka ni a lungsim a na ding hiam, na ci hiam?

records.english: However many people come, there'll be enough rice for everyone.
records.zomi: Mi bangzah a hong zongin mi khempeuh adingin buh a kicing ding hi.

records.english: I'm going to invite my new colleague and her husband, since they arrived from abroad last month.
records.zomi: Kha nung in gamdang pan a tun uh ahih manin ka nasem pawl thak leh a pasal ka sam ding hi.

records.english: I'll send the invitations by text, since most of our friends never check their email.
records.zomi: I lawmte a tamzaw in email a en ngei kei uh ahih manin samna text tawh ka khak ding hi.

records.english: Once the new house is ready, I'd like to invite everyone who helped us move.
records.zomi: Inn thak a kiman khit ciangin kitawnna ah hong huh mi khempeuh sam ka deih hi.

records.english: Were we to hold the party at home, we could afford to invite twice as many people.
records.zomi: Inn ah pawi i bawl leh mi nih zah i sam zo ding hi.

records.english: Sorry, did you say the party is on the 12th or the 20th?
records.zomi: Maisak ing, pawi ni 12 ah hiam, ni 20 ah hiam na ci hiam?

records.zomi: Inn thak pawi adingin ni bang in hong kilawm zaw ding hiam, Kiginni hiam, Nipini hiam?

records.zomi: Kiginni, Nipini zingsang ka sep ding ahih manin.

records.english: Are we inviting your swimming coach as well?
records.zomi: Na tuipeek sin sakpa zong i sam ding hiam?

records.english: If the weather's good, we'll eat outside in the garden.
records.zomi: Huihkhua a hoih leh pua lam huan sungah i ne ding hi.

records.english: By the time the invitations go out, we'll have sorted out the menu and the music.

records.english: Whether we invite the neighbors depends on how noisy the party is likely to be.

records.english: I wish we had room to invite all of your cousins.

records.english: We're planning to invite the whole street for tea once the new kitchen is finished.
records.zomi: An huanna thak a zawh khit ciangin tea adingin lampi bup sam dingin i geel hi.

records.english: I'll put a note through every door the week before.
records.zomi: Kal khat ma-in kongkhak khempeuh ah laikhak neu khat ka koih ding hi.

records.english: Anyone who can't come on Saturday will be welcome on Sunday afternoon instead.

records.english: Assuming my parents' flight lands on time, we'll invite the relatives over that same evening.

records.english: Will your parents be able to come to the graduation lunch?

records.english: My parents are used to big gatherings, so they won't mind thirty guests.

records.english: The guests will be met at the bus station and driven to the village.

records.english: For my mother's seventieth birthday in May, we're going to invite her old classmates.

records.english: My brother will find their addresses through the village association.

records.english: If even five of them come, she'll be thrilled.

records.english: It would be thoughtful to invite the new nurse at the clinic, who has no family nearby.

records.english: We might keep the party small this year and invite only close family.

records.zomi: Browser hong inla, a tung lam ah address gelh in.

records.english: Not every website that looks professional can be trusted.
records.zomi: A siam bang website khempeuh muan theih lo hi.

records.english: Search results at the top of the page are sometimes adverts that companies have paid for.
records.zomi: Phek tung lam-a zonna dawnna te khatvei khat company te' sum pia thu laikhai ahi hi.

records.english: My grandfather is used to reading the news on paper, but he's starting to enjoy the website.
records.zomi: Ka pu in laidal tungah thu thak sim a ngeina a, ahi zongin website a nopsak kipan hi.

records.english: Can I watch videos on this site without making an account?
records.zomi: Account bawl lo-in hih site tungah video ka en thei ding hiam?

records.english: My brother said, "Never download anything from a website you don't trust."
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal in, “Na muan loh website pan bangmah download ngei kei in,” a ci hi.

records.english: When I search for a recipe, I usually open the first three results in new tabs.
records.zomi: An huan dan ka zon ciangin a masa thum tab thak ah ka hon tawntung hi.

records.english: Does this website have a dark mode?
records.zomi: Hih website in dark mode a nei hiam?

records.english: Before trusting a health website, check who wrote the article and when it was last updated.
records.zomi: Cidamna website khat na muan ma-in kua in a gelh a, bang ciangin a kibawl thak nunung hiam en in.

records.english: Whoever designed this website clearly never tried to use it on a slow connection.
records.zomi: Hih website a bawlpa in internet nawlkhin tungah a zang sin ngei kei hi, cih a kician hi.

records.english: The videos on this site start playing by themselves, which really annoys me.
records.zomi: Hih site tung-a video te amau' in a kipan uh a, tua in hong heh sak mahmah hi.

records.english: Grandma reads the news on the newspaper's website every morning.
records.zomi: Pi in zingsang simin laithak website tungah thu thak a sim hi.

records.english: Scroll down to the bottom of the page for the phone number.
records.zomi: Phone nambat adingin phek nuai pen ah suk in.

records.english: Don't click on that advert, because it might be a scam.
records.zomi: Tua thu laikhai nen kei in, khemna ahi kha ding hi.

records.english: Could you show me how to clear my browsing history?
records.zomi: Ka browsing history phiat dan hong lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: First open the settings menu, and then choose "Privacy".
records.zomi: A masa-in settings menu hong inla, tua ciangin “Privacy” teel in.

records.english: Is it safe to type my card number on this page?
records.zomi: Hih phek tungah ka card nambat gelh bit hiam?

records.english: Only if the address is correct and you know the shop is genuine.
records.zomi: Address a dik a, zuakna inn a taktak hi, na theih leh bek.

records.english: Is this the right website for paying the water bill?
records.zomi: Tui laimal piak nadingin website dik hih ahi hiam?

records.english: You can press the star icon to add this page to your favorites.
records.zomi: Hih phek na favorites ah behlap nadingin aksi lim nen thei hi.

records.english: I found the train timetable on the railway's website in less than a minute.
records.zomi: Meileng website tungah minit khat sungin meileng hun gelhna ka mu hi.

records.english: I'm looking for the page where you can book a vaccination appointment.
records.zomi: Zatui sutna kimuhna kilai theihna phek ka zong hi.

records.english: My daughter uses the library's website to renew her books.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in a laibu te khek kik nadingin laibu inn' website a zang hi.

records.english: Click the back arrow to return to the last page.
records.zomi: Phek nunung ah ciah kik nadingin nung lam lim nen in.

records.english: What frustrates me most is a page covered in adverts before you can read a single line.
records.zomi: Ka heh pen pen tang khat zong na sim ma-in thu laikhai tawh a kidim phek ahi hi.

records.english: I had my browser updated because some pages had stopped working.
records.zomi: Phek pawl khat a sem khawl ahih manin ka browser ka update sak hi.

records.english: A website that is hard to use on a phone will probably lose a lot of visitors.
records.zomi: Phone tungah zat a haksa website in vehpa tampi a mansuah kha ding hi.

records.english: Having spent an hour on comparison sites, I finally found a cheaper flight.
records.zomi: Kiteh nading site te ah nai khat ka zat khit ciangin a tawp-in vanleng man neu zaw ka mu hi.

records.english: In my view, children should learn how to judge a website before they're given a phone.
records.zomi: Ka ngaihsutna-in naupangte phone a kipiak ma-un website khat bangci-in thukhen ding hiam a sin ding uh hi.

records.english: I usually read the reviews on the shop's page before I buy anything.
records.zomi: Bangmah ka lei ma-in zuakna inn' phek tung-a reviews ka sim tawntung hi.

records.english: I keep the government website for my pension in my bookmarks.
records.zomi: Ka pension adingin kumpi website ka bookmarks ah ka kem hi.

records.english: Click the small cross in the corner to close the box.
records.zomi: Bawm khak nadingin kil-a cross neu nen in.

records.english: The online shop's website crashed on the first day of the sale.
records.zomi: Man kiamna ni masa pen-in online zuakna inn' website a sia hi.

records.english: Refresh the page if the pictures don't appear.
records.zomi: Lim te a kilak kei leh phek refresh in.

records.english: Just to check, do I click "Accept" or "Reject" to stop the website tracking me?
records.zomi: Kician sak nadingin, website in hong zui lohna dingin “Accept” ka nen ding hiam “Reject” ka nen ding hiam?

records.english: Save the page as a bookmark so that you can find it again.
records.zomi: Na muh kik theih nadingin phek bookmark-in kem in.

records.english: I've got too many tabs open, and the computer is getting slow.
records.zomi: Tab tampi ka hong a, computer a nawlkhin kipan hi.

records.english: The little padlock next to the address shows that the connection is encrypted, not that the site is honest.
records.zomi: Address kiang-a tawh khak neu in kizopna a kituam hi, cih a lak a, site a dik hi, cih a lak kei hi.

records.english: Where's the button to change the website's language?
records.zomi: Website pau khekna button koi ah a om hiam?

records.english: If a website looks strange or asks for your bank details, close it straight away.
records.zomi: Website khat a lamdang a, na bank thu a ngen leh tua pah-in khak in.

records.english: My son showed me how to open a new tab.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in tab thak hon dan hong lak hi.

records.english: Do you know how to zoom in on a phone screen?
records.zomi: Phone screen tungah zoom bangci-in na bawl hiam na thei hiam?

records.english: Put two fingers on the screen and spread them apart.
records.zomi: Screen tungah khut zung nih koih inla, kikhen sak in.

records.english: The pop-up window wouldn't close, so I had to restart the browser.
records.zomi: Pop-up window a kikhak nuam kei ahih manin browser ka kipat kik sak ding a kisam hi.

records.english: Everyone is free to choose their own religion here.
records.zomi: Hih ah mi khempeuh in amau' biakna a teel thei uh hi.

records.english: Is it possible to vote by post if I'm working away?
records.zomi: Gamla-ah ka sep leh laikhak tawh ka teel thei ding hiam?

records.english: In our country, the police can't search your home without a warrant, except in an emergency.
records.zomi: I gam ah palik te in phalna lai om lo-in na inn a zong thei kei uh a, lauhuai hun simloh.

records.english: Whether or not you agree with them, the protesters have a right to be heard.
records.zomi: Amaute tawh na kilem hiam kilem lo hiam, langpante in a thu uh kiza dingin thuneihna a nei uh hi.

records.english: Sorry, could you explain what "appeal" means here?
records.zomi: Maisak ing, hih ah “appeal” in bang a ci nopna hiam na gen siang thei ding hiam?

records.english: In our country, you have the right to know what you're being charged with.
records.zomi: I gam ah bang thu-in hong mawhsak uh hiam theih dingin thuneihna na nei hi.

records.english: Not only did the court protect his right to speak, but it also ordered an apology.
records.zomi: Thukhenna inn in a thu gen thuneihna a kem bek hi lo-in maisak ngen dingin zong a sawl hi.

records.english: Freedom of speech doesn't mean you can say anything without consequences.
records.zomi: Thu gen suahtakna in bang peuh gen-in a nung ah bangmah a om lo ding hi, cih hi lo hi.

records.english: A free leaflet explains what to do if your rights have been ignored.
records.zomi: A man om lo laidal khat in na thuneihna te kinawlkhin leh bang na bawl ding hiam a gen siang hi.

records.english: In my opinion, the right to vote should come with a duty to stay informed.
records.zomi: Ka ngaihsutna-in teelna thuneihna tawh thu thak theih mawhpuakna zong om ding hi.

records.english: Whatever your background, you're entitled to the same help at our public office.
records.zomi: Na hong suahna bang ahi zongin i mipi office ah huhna kibang na ngah thei hi.

records.english: Who can I complain to if the council ignores my letter?
records.zomi: Khua upate in ka lai a limsak kei uh leh kua kiangah ka phun thei ding hiam?

records.english: You could contact the ombudsman, who looks into complaints about public services.
records.zomi: Mipi nasepna thu-a phunnate a en ombudsman na sam thei hi.

records.english: What surprised me most was how many rights I had never heard of.
records.zomi: Ka lamdang sak pen ka zak ngei loh thuneihna bangzah ka nei hiam cih ahi hi.

records.english: I didn't know I could ask for an interpreter at the hospital.
records.zomi: Siavuan inn ah pau letpa ka ngen thei hi, cih ka thei kei hi.

records.english: Is the advice at the legal center free?
records.zomi: Thukham huhna inn-a thuhilhna man om lo hiam?

records.english: Yes, and they'll help you even if you can't pay anything.
records.zomi: Man om lo hi, leh bangmah na piak zawh kei zongin hong huh ding uh hi.

records.english: Are you allowed to record a conversation with an official?
records.zomi: Kumpi nasempa tawh kikupna na la thei hiam?

records.english: Having been refused a hearing, she asked a lawyer to appeal on her behalf.
records.zomi: Thu ngaihna a kinial khit ciangin amah aiawh-in appeal dingin lawyer khat a ngen hi.

records.english: I'm going to the meeting to speak about the new school.
records.zomi: Sang thak thu gen dingin kikhopna ah ka pai hi.

records.english: Thank you for explaining my rights so clearly.
records.zomi: Ka thuneihna te kician takin na gen siang manin lungdam ing.

records.english: I'd like to speak to a lawyer, please.
records.zomi: Lawyer khat tawh kikum ka deih hi.

records.english: Speak slowly, so that the officer can write down exactly what happened.
records.zomi: Nasempa in bang a piang hiam limtakin a gelh theih nadingin nawlkhin takin gen in.

records.english: Is this office open to the public?
records.zomi: Hih office mipi adingin kihong hiam?

records.english: My son wants to know what his rights are at work.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in nasepna ah a thuneihna te bang ahi hiam theih a deih hi.

records.english: Am I allowed to see the notes the officer wrote about me?
records.zomi: Nasempa in kei thu a gelh te ka et thei hiam?

records.english: She went to the town hall to find out whether she could get the land registered in her own name.
records.zomi: Gam pen amah' min tawh a gelh thei ding hiam theih dingin khuapi office ah a pai hi.

records.english: Do I have to answer these questions?
records.zomi: Hih dotna te ka dawng ding a kisam hiam?

records.english: In our city, groups may protest in the square if they inform the police in advance.
records.zomi: I khuapi ah pawl te in palik te ma-in a hilh uh leh khua laizang ah langpanna a bawl thei uh hi.

records.english: Rights mean very little if people are too afraid to use them.
records.zomi: Mite in zat dingin a lau lua uh leh thuneihna in khiatna tawmno bek a nei hi.

records.english: The poster at the job center says nobody can be refused a job because of their religion.
records.zomi: Nasep zonna inn-a lai khai in biakna hangin kuamah nasep nial thei lo hi, a ci hi.

records.english: My grandmother voted for the first time when she was forty.
records.zomi: Ka pi kum sawm li a phak ciangin a masa pen-in a teel hi.

records.english: You can still vote even if you've lost your identity card, as long as you bring another document.
records.zomi: Na ID card na mansuah zongin lai dang khat na tawi leh na teel thei lai hi.

records.english: The public meeting was cancelled without any explanation.
records.zomi: Mipi kikhopna gen siangna om lo-in kikhak hi.

records.english: Who can vote in the local election?
records.zomi: Khua teelna ah kua in a teel thei ding hiam?

records.english: Citizens over eighteen can vote here.
records.zomi: Hih ah kum sawm leh giat tung gam mite in a teel thei uh hi.

records.english: The more people know about their rights, the harder it is to ignore them.
records.zomi: Mite in a thuneihna uh a theih semsem ciangin a limsak loh a haksa semsem hi.

records.english: My cousin was helped by a volunteer to fill in the appeal form.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pen appeal lai gelh dingin thalawp khat in a huh hi.

records.english: Can I bring my own lawyer to the interview?
records.zomi: Kidotna ah keimah' lawyer ka tawi thei ding hiam?

records.english: In our town, anyone can attend the council meetings and listen.
records.zomi: I khuapi ah kua peuh in khua upa kikhopna ah a kihel-in a ngai thei hi.

records.english: My uncle said, "Knowing your rights is the first step to protecting them."
records.zomi: Ka pa neu in, “Na thuneihna te theih pen a kem nading kalsuan masa pen ahi hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: Can I ask the school to explain why my daughter was excluded?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ka tanu sang pan kihawl khia hiam sang in gen siang dingin ka ngen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Please write your complaint on this form, and we'll reply within two weeks.
records.zomi: Na phunna hih lai tungah gelh in, kal nih sungin i dawng ding hi.

records.english: Can I take photos at the public meeting?
records.zomi: Mipi kikhopna ah lim ka la thei ding hiam?

records.english: We asked the council to put the meeting notices in more than one language.
records.zomi: Kikhopna thu laikhai te pau khat sangin tam zaw-in koih dingin khua upate i ngen hi.

records.english: If the council had explained our rights earlier, we would have objected to the new road.
records.zomi: Khua upate in i thuneihna ma-in a gen siang uh leh lampi thak i nial ding hi.

records.english: If you're arrested, ask to call a family member.
records.zomi: Hong kiman leh innkuan mi khat sam dingin ngen in.

records.english: Don't sign anything until you understand it.
records.zomi: Na theih ma-in bangmah tungah na min gelh kei in.

records.english: Can I ask why I'm being stopped?
records.zomi: Bang hangin hong khawlsak hiam ka dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: Every adult citizen here can vote, whether they're rich or poor.
records.zomi: Hih ah gam mi upa khempeuh, a hau hiam zawng hiam, a teel thei uh hi.

records.english: When my grandmother was young, women in her village weren't allowed to speak at meetings.
records.zomi: Ka pi a khangno lai-in a khua ah numeite in kikhopna ah thu gen dingin kiphal lo hi.

records.english: The rules on filming police officers differ between countries, so check before you travel.
records.zomi: Palik te video lak thu-a thukham te gam tuamtuam ah a kibang kei ahih manin na khualzin ma-in en in.

records.english: I want to have my name corrected on the voter list.
records.zomi: Teelna min gelhna-a ka min bawl dik ka deih hi.

records.english: Can my employer really dismiss me for joining a union?
records.zomi: Nasem kipawlna ah ka kihel manin ka neipa in hong khawlsak thei taktak ding hiam?

records.english: The advice worker said they can't, and that I should keep a copy of every letter.
records.zomi: Thuhilhpa in a hih thei kei uh hi, a ci a, laikhak khempeuh a kawpi kem dingin hong hilh hi.

records.english: Do children have rights too?
records.zomi: Naupangte zong in thuneihna a nei uh hiam?

records.english: Yes, and in our country every child has the right to go to school.
records.zomi: Nei uh hi, leh i gam ah naupang khempeuh in sang kah thuneihna a nei uh hi.

records.english: You can ask for a copy of your file at the front desk.
records.zomi: Ma lam dawhkan ah na lai kawpi na ngen thei hi.

records.english: The guard made me open my bag, but he had no right to take my phone.
records.zomi: Kemtupa in ka ip hong hon sak a, ahi zongin ka phone la dingin thuneihna a nei kei hi.

records.english: It's worth asking for everything in writing, in case you need to prove what was promised.
records.zomi: Bang kiciam hiam na lak ding a kisam leh cih adingin bangkim laidal tungah ngen in a phattuam hi.

records.english: The headteacher will thank the parents at the end-of-year assembly.
records.zomi: Sang makaipa in kum tawp kikhopna ah nu leh pate lungdam a ci ding hi.

records.english: Just to check, are we each giving $5 towards the present for the caretaker?
records.zomi: Kician sak nadingin, sang kempa letsong adingin i khat ciat in $5 i pia ding hi, a hi hiam?

records.english: What I'd most like to do is thank the teacher who first believed in me.
records.zomi: Ka bawl nop pen hong um masa pen saya kiangah lungdam ci ahi hi.

records.english: I'd be very grateful if you could look over my application before Friday.
records.zomi: Laithai ni ma-in ka ngetna lai na en sak thei leh ka lungdam mahmah ding hi.

records.english: Were it not for your help, we'd still be living in that tiny room.
records.zomi: Na huhna om kei le tua inndei neu ah i om lai ding hi.

records.english: Everyone who helped will receive a small gift at the meeting.
records.zomi: A huh mi khempeuh in kikhopna ah letsong neu khat a ngah ding uh hi.

records.english: Tell your coach how much the extra training helped you.
records.zomi: Sinna behlap in bangzah in hong huh hiam na sin sakpa hilh in.

records.english: Could you remind me to thank the Lian family for the chairs?
records.zomi: Tutna te adingin Lian innkuan lungdam ci dingin hong phawksak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Whether or not she accepts the gift, I'm going to make sure she knows how grateful we are.
records.zomi: Letsong a sang hiam sang lo hiam, bangzah in i lungdam hiam a theih nadingin ka kidawm ding hi.

records.english: What will you say to the man who found your dog?
records.zomi: Na ui a mu pa kiangah bang na gen ding hiam?

records.english: I'll thank him and offer him a reward, even if he refuses it.
records.zomi: Lungdam ka ci ding a, a nial zongin laksap ka pia ding hi.

records.english: Would it be all right if I painted your fence to say thanks?
records.zomi: Lungdam ci nadingin na huang ka nul leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: I'll make sure your help is mentioned in the newsletter.
records.zomi: Na huhna thu thak laibu ah kigen nadingin ka kidawm ding hi.

records.english: Rather than buying a present, we'll offer to do her shopping every week until her leg heals.
records.zomi: Letsong lei sangin a khe a dam mateng kal simin a van lei sak dingin i ciam ding hi.

records.english: Dear Dr. Mang, I am writing to thank you for the care you gave my mother last month.
records.zomi: Dr. Mang, kha nung in ka nu na kemna adingin lungdam ci dingin lai ka gelh hi.

records.english: Not until I'm a parent myself, I suspect, will I fully appreciate what my mother did.
records.zomi: Keimah nu ka suah ciang bek ka nu' bawl ka thei kim ding hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: Who's going to buy the card for the cook?
records.zomi: An huanpa adingin card kua in a lei ding hiam?

records.english: Can I help you carry those bags, since you helped me last week?
records.zomi: Kal nung in hong huh na hih manin tua ip te puak dingin kong huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our class is planning to sing for the school cleaners at the Christmas assembly.
records.zomi: I sang inndei in Christmas kikhopna ah sang phiatte adingin la sak dingin a geel hi.

records.english: Tomorrow I'm going to write to the nurse who looked after my father last winter.
records.zomi: Zingciang khuavot nung-a ka pa a kem nurse kiangah lai ka gelh ding hi.

records.english: I'll tell her that he still talks about her jokes.
records.zomi: A nuihza thu te a gen lai hi, ci-in ka hilh ding hi.

records.english: If the hospital gives me her address, I'll post the letter on Monday.
records.zomi: Siavuan inn in a omna mun hong piak leh Pizing ni-in lai ka khak ding hi.

records.english: I wish I'd thanked my old teacher before she moved away, so this year I'm going to find her address.
records.zomi: Ka saya lui a kitawn ma-in lungdam ka ci kei hi, ka ci a, hih kum in a omna mun ka zong ding hi.

records.english: My mother made me write a thank-you letter to each of my aunts.
records.zomi: Ka nu in ka ni khat ciat kiangah lungdam laikhak gelh dingin hong sawl hi.

records.english: My grandfather isn't used to being thanked, so he'll probably just laugh.
records.zomi: Ka pu lungdam hong kici a ngeina hi lo ahih manin a nui bek kha ding hi.

records.english: Next Saturday, the children are going to wash our neighbor's car as a surprise.
records.zomi: A zom Kiginni ni-in naupangte in lamdang sak-in i inn vengpa' mawtaw a sil ding uh hi.

records.english: He's driven them to school every rainy morning this term.
records.zomi: Hih hun sungin guah zuk zingsang khempeuh in sang ah a tawi khin hi.

records.english: I hope he'll realize it's our way of saying thank you.
records.zomi: Tua pen i lungdam cihna ahi hi, cih a theih ding ka lamen hi.

records.english: I'd like to give something back to the clinic that treated my daughter.
records.zomi: Ka tanu a kem siavuan inn kiangah bangmah khat ka pia kik nuam hi.

records.english: Once the new roof is on, we'll invite all the neighbors who helped to a meal.
records.zomi: Innkhum thak a om khit ciangin a huh inn vengte khempeuh an nekna ah i sam ding hi.

records.english: I'm going to tell your manager how patient you were with me.
records.zomi: Kei tungah bangzah in thuakzawh hiam na makaipa kiangah ka gen ding hi.

records.english: We should send the firefighters a thank-you note, shouldn't we?
records.zomi: Mei mitte kiangah lungdam laikhak i khak ding hi, a hi hiam?

records.english: I'll bring you some of my mother's honey next time I visit.
records.zomi: A zom ka hong veh ciangin ka nu' khuaizu pawl khat kong tawi sak ding hi.

records.english: Are you going to thank the manager in person or by email?
records.zomi: Makaipa kiangah mimal-in lungdam na ci ding hiam, email tawh hiam?

records.english: In person, because she'll appreciate it more.
records.zomi: Mimal-in, a lungdam zaw ding ahih manin.

records.english: It would mean a great deal to the volunteers if the mayor came to thank them in person.
records.zomi: Khuapi makaipa amah mah in lungdam ci dingin a hong leh thalawpte adingin a thupi mahmah ding hi.

records.english: Sorry to interrupt, but I'd like to say thank you to Mrs. Kim for the flowers on every table.
records.zomi: Ka tan hangin maisak ing, ahi zongin dawhkan khempeuh tung-a pak te adingin Kim nu kiangah lungdam ka ci nuam hi.

records.english: We're going to have a small plaque made for the woman who ran the soup kitchen for twenty years.
records.zomi: Kum sawm nih sung an tui pawi a kem numei adingin min suang neu khat i bawl sak ding hi.

records.english: Having been helped so much this year, we're determined to help someone else next year.
records.zomi: Hih kum in huhna tampi i ngah ahih manin a zom kum ciangin mi dang khat huh dingin i kithukhen hi.

records.english: Do you think the neighbors would like a jar of our plum jam?
records.zomi: Inn vengte in i theipi jam bel khat a deih ding uh hiam, na ci hiam?

records.english: The young doctor will probably never know how much her kindness meant to us.
records.zomi: Siavuan khangno in a itna in i adingin bangzah a thupi hiam a thei ngei lo kha ding hi.

records.english: Shall we make a card for the crossing guard before the summer holidays?
records.zomi: Khal khawlna ma-in lampi kantan kempa adingin card khat i bawl ding hiam?

records.english: I'm going to thank your mother properly when I see her on Sunday.
records.zomi: Nipini ni-in na nu ka muh ciangin hoih takin lungdam ka ci ding hi.

records.english: Please thank Grandma for the scarf when you phone her.
records.zomi: Pi na sam ciangin ngawngkhih adingin lungdam ci sak in.

records.english: Thank you in advance for watering the plants during the wedding weekend.
records.zomi: Mopawi kal tawp sungin pak te tui na buak ding adingin a ma-in lungdam ing.

records.english: The more often we say thank you at home, the more naturally the children will say it elsewhere.
records.zomi: Inn ah lungdam i cih tam semsem ciangin naupangte in mun dang ah baih zaw-in a gen ding uh hi.

records.english: Assuming the weather holds, we'll have a picnic for everyone who helped clear the river.
records.zomi: Huihkhua a hoih lai leh gun a siang sak dingin a huh mi khempeuh adingin khualzin an nekna i bawl ding hi.

records.english: Will you thank your uncle for the books when you call him?
records.zomi: Na pa neu na sam ciangin laibu te adingin lungdam na ci ding hiam?

records.english: By the time we leave this town, I hope we'll have thanked everyone who made us welcome.
records.zomi: Hih khuapi i nusiat ma-in hong muak mi khempeuh kiangah lungdam i ci khin ding ka lamen hi.

records.english: When our son graduates in June, we're going to invite his old math tutor to the celebration.
records.zomi: June kha-in i tapa a laizawh ciangin a kisim saya lui pawi ah i sam ding hi.

records.english: He'll sit at the top table next to my husband.
records.zomi: Dawhkan tung lam ah ka pasal kiang ah a tu ding hi.

records.english: Our son wants to give him a copy of his final certificate with a note inside.
records.zomi: I tapa in a lai-ciam nunung kawpi khat laikhak tawh pia a deih hi.

records.english: How can we thank the volunteers at the end of the season?
records.zomi: Hun tawp ciangin thalawpte lungdam bangci-in i ci ding hiam?

records.english: Maybe we could cook them a meal on the last evening.
records.zomi: Nitak nunung pen-in an nekna khat i huan sak kha ding hi.

records.english: If the school agrees, we'll put up a board with the names of everyone who donated.
records.zomi: Sang in a phal leh a pia mi khempeuh min tawh sing phek khat i khai ding hi.

records.english: Hello, it's Esther calling, and I just wanted to say thank you for the lift yesterday.
records.zomi: Lumen, Esther ka hi a, zanni-a hong tawi adingin lungdam ci bek dingin kong sam hi.

records.english: In my view, a thank-you that comes a week later can mean more than one given on the spot.
records.zomi: Ka ngaihsutna-in kal khat nunung-in lungdam cih in tua pah-in cih sangin khiatna tam zaw a nei thei hi.

records.english: How are we going to thank the man who repaired the church roof for free?
records.zomi: Pawlpi innkhum a man lo-in a bawl dam pa bangci-in lungdam i ci ding hiam?

records.english: Next time you need help in the garden, call me first.
records.zomi: A zom ciangin huan ah huhna na kisam leh kei hong sam masa in.

records.english: When I get my first salary, I'm going to buy my parents dinner.
records.zomi: Ka khasum masa pen ka ngah ciangin ka nu leh ka pa nitak an ka pia ding hi.

records.english: The company is going to send every customer an apology and a voucher.
records.zomi: Company in a lei mi khempeuh kiangah maisak ngenna leh voucher khat a khak ding hi.

records.english: I'll have the window repaired by Friday, and I'll pay for it myself.
records.zomi: Laithai ni ma-in tukvuang ka bawl dam sak ding a, keimah in ka pia ding hi.

records.english: My father isn't used to apologizing, so it'll be hard for him.
records.zomi: Ka pa in maisak ngen a ngeina hi lo ahih manin amah adingin a haksa ding hi.

records.english: Sorry, can I just finish, because I'm trying to apologize properly?
records.zomi: Maisak ing, hoih takin maisak ngen dingin ka hanciam ahih manin ka gen zo masa thei ding hiam?

records.english: Not until he admits what he did will she agree to see him.
records.zomi: A bawl a pulak mateng amah a kimuh dingin a phal lo ding hi.

records.english: Dear Mrs. Thang, please accept our apologies for the damage our dog did to your garden.
records.zomi: Thang nu, i ui in na huan a susiat adingin maisak ngenna i sang in.

records.english: Hi, it's Paul, and I'm calling to apologize for missing our appointment this morning.
records.zomi: Lumen, Paul ka hi a, tu zingsang-a i kimuhna ka kiat manin maisak ngen dingin kong sam hi.

records.english: By the time you come home, I hope we'll both be ready to apologize.
records.zomi: Inn na tun ciangin i nih in maisak ngen dingin i kiman ding ka lamen hi.

records.english: What would be the best day to visit Aunt Mary and apologize?
records.zomi: Ni Mary veh-in maisak ngen dingin ni bang a hoih pen ding hiam?

records.english: If he says sorry, will you give him another chance?
records.zomi: Maisak a ngen leh hun dang khat na pia ding hiam?

records.english: Maybe, but he'll have to show me that he means it.
records.zomi: Pia kha ning, ahi zongin a lungsim takpi tawh a gen hi, cih hong lak ding a kisam ding hi.

records.english: Promise me you'll call next time you're going to be late.
records.zomi: A zom ciangin na nun ding leh hong sam ding hong ciam in.

records.english: Had he apologized at the time, none of this would have become so serious.
records.zomi: Tua hun lai-in maisak a ngen le hih thu khat zong a lian lua lo ding hi.

records.english: In my opinion, an apology followed by an excuse is hardly an apology at all.
records.zomi: Ka ngaihsutna-in maisak ngenna khit-a kilawmsakna in maisak ngenna hi kei dek hi.

records.english: I'm going to say sorry to Mum when she gets home.
records.zomi: Nu inn a tun ciangin maisak ka ngen ding hi.

records.english: Please forgive me for being so late with the rent this month.
records.zomi: Hih kha-a inn man piak ka nun lua manin hong maisak in.

records.english: Who's going to tell the teacher that we lost the ball?
records.zomi: Bawl i mansuah thu saya kiangah kua in a gen ding hiam?

records.english: However long it takes, I'll wait until you're ready to talk.
records.zomi: Bangzah sawt zongin kikup dingin na kiman mateng ka ngak ding hi.

records.english: Do you think Dad will forgive me for losing his good pen?
records.zomi: A khedal hoih ka mansuah manin Pa in hong maisak ding hiam, na ci hiam?

records.english: He'll probably forgive you once he's calmed down.
records.zomi: A lungsim a dai khit ciangin hong maisak kha ding hi.

records.english: Just to be clear, are you accepting my apology or do you need more time?
records.zomi: Kician sak nadingin, ka maisak ngenna na sang hiam, hun behlap na kisam hiam?

records.english: Shall we apologize to Grandma together, so that she knows we both mean it?
records.zomi: I nih in i lungsim takpi tawh i gen hi, cih a theih nadingin Pi kiangah khawm-in maisak i ngen ding hiam?

records.english: What will you say to her when you see her?
records.zomi: Na muh ciangin amah kiangah bang na gen ding hiam?

records.english: I'll tell her I was wrong and that I miss her.
records.zomi: Ka khial hi, leh ka lungngai hi, ka ci ding hi.

records.english: Our coach says we'll all apologize to the referee after the game.
records.zomi: Kimawl khit ciangin i khempeuh in thukhenpa kiangah maisak i ngen ding hi, ci-in i sin sakpa in a gen hi.

records.english: My son broke our neighbor's flowerpot, so this evening he's going to go round and say sorry.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in i inn vengnu' pak bel a susia ahih manin tu nitakin a pai ding a, maisak a ngen ding hi.

records.english: He'll offer to buy her a new one with the money from his paper round.
records.zomi: Laithak puak nasep pan a ngah sum tawh a thak khat lei sak dingin a ciam ding hi.

records.english: If she's still upset, he'll help her replant the flowers at the weekend.
records.zomi: A lungkham lai leh kal tawp ciangin pak suan kik dingin a huh ding hi.

records.english: We're going to apologize to the neighbors for the noise before the party even starts.
records.zomi: Pawi a kipat ma-in ging buaina adingin inn vengte kiangah maisak i ngen ding hi.

records.english: My aunt will forgive you eventually, but she won't forget.
records.zomi: Ka ni in a tawp-in hong maisak ding a, ahi zongin a mangngilh lo ding hi.

records.english: I'm going to buy my brother a new phone case, since I cracked his.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal' phone khuhna ka kek ahih manin a thak khat ka lei sak ding hi.

records.english: Is Grandpa still upset about the broken cup?
records.zomi: Haai kek thu-in Pu a lungkham lai hiam?

records.english: Next time, I'll ask before I borrow your clothes.
records.zomi: A zom ciangin na puan ka caih ma-in ka dong ding hi.

records.english: An apology will be sent to every family that was affected.
records.zomi: A thuakkha innkuan khempeuh kiangah maisak ngenna kikhak ding hi.

records.english: Shall I call your mother tonight and apologize?
records.zomi: Tu zanin na nu ka sam a, maisak ka ngen ding hiam?

records.english: I wish I could take back what I said at dinner.
records.zomi: Nitak an ah ka gen te la kik thei leng ka deih hi.

records.english: If he apologizes sincerely, I may be able to forgive him, though it will take time.
records.zomi: A lungsim takpi tawh maisak a ngen leh amah ka maisak thei kha ding a, ahi zongin hun a sawt ding hi.

records.english: The school made the boys apologize to the girl they had teased.
records.zomi: Sang in tangvalte in a nuihsan nungak kiangah maisak a ngen dingin a sawl hi.

records.english: Whether she forgives me or not, I'm going to keep trying to make things right.
records.zomi: Hong maisak hiam maisak lo hiam, a dik nadingin ka hanciam lai ding hi.

records.english: At our next team meeting, I'm going to admit that the mistake in the report was mine.
records.zomi: I pawl kikhopna zom ah report sung-a khialhna pen keimah' ahi hi, ci-in ka pulak ding hi.

records.english: I'd rather say it myself than let my colleague take the blame.
records.zomi: Ka nasem pawl in mawhna a puak sangin keimah in gen ka deih zaw hi.

records.english: After that, I hope we can all move on.
records.zomi: Tua khit ciangin i khempeuh in kalsuan zom thei ding i lamen hi.

records.english: Tell your cousin you're sorry before she goes home.
records.zomi: Na sanggam nu inn a ciah ma-in maisak na ngen hi, ci-in gen in.

records.english: Tomorrow I'm going to apologize to my sister for missing her engagement party.
records.zomi: Zingciang ciangin a kiteenna ciamna pawi ka kiat manin ka sanggam nu kiangah maisak ka ngen ding hi.

records.english: I'll explain that my train was cancelled, but I won't make excuses.
records.zomi: Ka meileng kikhak hi, ci-in ka gen siang ding a, ahi zongin ka kilawm sak lo ding hi.

records.english: Then I'll ask if I can take her out for lunch to make up for it.
records.zomi: Tua ciangin a sik nadingin sun an adingin ka pi thei ding hiam ka dong ding hi.

records.english: Having realized how much I hurt her, I'm going to apologize in person rather than by text.
records.zomi: Bangzah in ka lungsim nasak hiam ka theih khit ciangin text tawh sangin mimal-in maisak ka ngen ding hi.

records.english: I'm going to write him a letter, because I always cry when I try to say it out loud.
records.zomi: Aw-in ka gen sin simin ka kap tawntung ahih manin lai ka gelh sak ding hi.

records.english: Don't apologize to me, because it's your brother you need to say sorry to.
records.zomi: Kei kiangah maisak ngen kei in, na sanggam pasal kiangah na ngen ding hi.

records.english: What I'm hoping for most is that our children won't inherit this argument.
records.zomi: Ka lamen pen pen i ta te in hih kinialna a luah lo ding uh ahi hi.

records.english: You're going to say sorry to your teacher, aren't you?
records.zomi: Na saya kiangah maisak na ngen ding hi, a hi hiam?

records.english: From now on, I'll check the oven before we go out.
records.zomi: Tu pan kipan i pusuak ma-in meikhuk ka en ding hi.

records.english: Are you going to apologize to the lady whose trolley you bumped?
records.zomi: Na tawk van tawina leng numei kiangah maisak na ngen ding hiam?

records.english: Can I say sorry to Lily at school tomorrow?
records.zomi: Zingciang sang ah Lily kiangah maisak ka ngen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Forgiving my father won't change the past, but it might change the years we have left.
records.zomi: Ka pa maisak in hun lui a khek lo ding a, ahi zongin i neih lai kum te a khek kha ding hi.

records.english: Once the hurt has faded a little, I think they'll be able to talk again.
records.zomi: A natna tawmno a mang khit ciangin a kikum kik thei ding uh hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: Can we start again tomorrow as if this never happened?
records.zomi: Hih a piang ngei lo bangin zingciang ciangin i kipan kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: It would be easier to forgive him if he showed even a little regret.
records.zomi: Lungkhamna tawmno bek hi zongin a lak leh amah maisak a baih zaw ding hi.

records.english: Will you still come to my party, even after what I said?
records.zomi: Ka gen te khit ciangin zong ka pawi ah na hong lai ding hiam?

records.english: I'm sorry I shouted, and I'll try to stay calmer tomorrow.
records.zomi: Ka kiko ahih manin maisak ing, zingciang ciangin dai zaw-in om dingin ka hanciam ding hi.

records.english: Shall we ask a friend we both trust to help us decide?
records.zomi: Thukhen nadingin i nih in i muan lawm khat hong huh dingin i ngen ding hiam?

records.english: Are you willing to meet halfway on the price?
records.zomi: A man ah laizang ah kituak dingin na phal hiam?

records.english: Yes, if you can deliver the furniture yourself.
records.zomi: Phal ning, inn van te nangma mah in na puak thei leh.

records.english: Mum says she'll take away the tablet if you two fight over it again.
records.zomi: Na nih in kidou kik leh tablet a la ding hi, ci-in Nu in a gen hi.

records.english: Is there any way we could both get what we want?
records.zomi: I nih in i deih i ngah theih nading lampi a om hiam?

records.english: Will the new rules for the shared kitchen be agreed at Monday's meeting?
records.zomi: Kihawm an huanna adingin thukham thakte Pizing ni kikhopna ah kilem ding hiam?

records.english: Promise you'll hear me out tomorrow.
records.zomi: Zingciang ciangin ka thu hong ngai kim ding hong ciam in.

records.english: In my view, the best compromises leave both people a little unhappy.
records.zomi: Ka ngaihsutna-in kilemna hoih pen in mi nih tawmno a lungkhamsak hi.

records.english: Who's going to speak first at the meeting with the landlord?
records.zomi: Inn neipa tawh kikhopna ah kua in a gen masa ding hiam?

records.english: My husband and I are going to see a counselor to learn how to argue less.
records.zomi: Ka pasal leh kei in kinial tawm zaw dan sin dingin thuhilhpa khat i veh ding hi.

records.english: Don't decide anything tonight while you're both angry.
records.zomi: Na nih in na heh laitakun tu zanin bangmah khen kei un.

records.english: We're going to toss a coin if we can't decide.
records.zomi: I thukhen zawh kei leh dangka sik khat i khiak ding hi.

records.english: Having heard both sides, the chairwoman will make her decision next week.
records.zomi: Lam nih a zak khit ciangin makaipa numei in a zom kal ciangin a thukhenna a bawl ding hi.

records.english: We'll keep talking until we find a plan that suits everyone in the house.
records.zomi: Inn sung-a mi khempeuh adingin a kilawm geelna i muh mateng i kikum lai ding hi.

records.english: My parents aren't used to me disagreeing with them, so I'll choose my words carefully.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in ka kilem lohna uh a ngeina hi lo ahih manin ka kammal limtakin ka teel ding hi.

records.english: Do you want to go for a walk and talk about it?
records.zomi: Pai-in tua thu i kikum ding na deih hiam?

records.english: Are you still cross with me about the car?
records.zomi: Mawtaw thu-in na heh lai hiam?

records.english: I'll call him tomorrow and see if he's ready to talk.
records.zomi: Zingciang ciangin ka sam ding a, kikup dingin a kiman hiam ka en ding hi.

records.english: Dear Mr. Pau, I would like to suggest a meeting to discuss the parking problem on our street.
records.zomi: Pu Pau, i lampi-a mawtaw koihna haksatna kikum nadingin kikhopna khat bawl dingin ka gen nuam hi.

records.english: Next time we disagree, I'll try to ask questions before giving my opinion.
records.zomi: A zom ciangin i kilem kei ciangin ka ngaihsutna ka gen ma-in thu dong dingin ka hanciam ding hi.

records.english: Let my sister speak first, since she's the one who's upset.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu a lungkham pa ahih manin a gen masa sak in.

records.english: I think we'll both feel better once we've talked.
records.zomi: I kikup khit ciangin i nih in i kisa hoih zaw ding hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: The two teams will be asked to present their ideas, and the manager will choose one.
records.zomi: Pawl nih in a ngaihsutna uh a lak ding uh a, makaipa in khat a teel ding hi.

records.english: Hello, I'm calling about the hedge between our gardens, and I hope we can sort it out.
records.zomi: Lumen, i huan kikal-a huang singkung thu-in kong sam a, i bawl siang thei ding ka lamen hi.

records.english: Do you think they'll ever make up?
records.zomi: A kilem kik ngei ding uh hiam, na ci hiam?

records.english: Perhaps, once the wedding is over and everyone has calmed down.
records.zomi: A kilem kha ding uh hi, mopawi a bei khit a, mi khempeuh lungsim a dai khit ciangin.

records.english: What I want most is for the children not to have to take sides.
records.zomi: Ka deih pen pen naupangte in lam khat a teel ding a kisam lo ding ahi hi.

records.english: My partner wants a dog and I don't, so we're going to look after my cousin's dog for a month.
records.zomi: Ka zi in ui khat a deih a, kei ka deih kei ahih manin ka sanggam' ui kha khat sung i kem ding hi.

records.english: If it goes well, I might change my mind.
records.zomi: A hoih leh ka ngaihsutna ka khek kha ding hi.

records.english: If it doesn't, she'll agree to wait another year.
records.zomi: A hoih kei leh kum khat behlap ngak dingin a phal ding hi.

records.english: Can we finish this conversation on Saturday morning, after a good sleep?
records.zomi: Hoih takin i ihmut khit ciangin Kiginni zingsang ciangin hih kikupna i zo thei ding hiam?

records.english: It might help if someone outside the family listened to both of us.
records.zomi: Innkuan pua lam pan mi khat in i nih hong ngaih leh a huh kha ding hi.

records.english: By the end of the mediation, I hope both families will feel they've been heard.
records.zomi: Kilemsakna a bei ciangin innkuan nih in a thu uh kiza hi, a kisak ding uh ka lamen hi.

records.english: Hang on, let me finish what I was saying, and then you can answer.
records.zomi: Ngak in, ka gen zo masa ning, tua ciangin na dawng thei hi.

records.english: Assuming the landlord agrees, we'll split the cost of the new fence.
records.zomi: Inn neipa a phal leh huang thak man i hawm ding hi.

records.english: After lunch, our teacher is going to sit the two of us down and help us sort it out.
records.zomi: Sun an khit ciangin i saya in i nih hong tusak ding a, a bawl siang dingin hong huh ding hi.

records.english: Would you be happy to try my idea if we keep yours as a backup?
records.zomi: Nangma' te a kem i hih leh ka ngaihsutna na sin nuam ding hiam?

records.english: I'm going to have the boundary measured, so that nobody can argue about it again.
records.zomi: Kuamah in a kinial kik lohna dingin gam ciang ka teh sak ding hi.

records.english: So, if I've understood you correctly, you'd prefer to move in the spring rather than now?
records.zomi: Tua ahih manin, na gen ka theih dik leh, tu sangin spring ciangin kitawn na deih zaw hi, a hi hiam?

records.english: Not until both of you lower your voices will anyone be able to help.
records.zomi: Na nih in na aw na niam sak mateng kuamah in a huh thei lo ding hi.

records.english: I'm going to listen to his side of the story before I say anything.
records.zomi: Bangmah ka gen ma-in a tangthu lam ka ngai ding hi.

records.english: Tomorrow I'll explain why I disagree, but calmly this time.
records.zomi: Zingciang ciangin bang hangin ka kilem kei hiam ka gen siang ding a, ahi zongin tu-in dai takin.

records.english: What will you do if your brother refuses to talk?
records.zomi: Na sanggam pasal in kikup a nial leh bang na bawl ding hiam?

records.english: I'll ask our mother to bring us together at her house.
records.zomi: I nu in a inn ah hong kikhawmsak dingin ka ngen ding hi.

records.english: Next week, the residents' committee will vote on where the new bins should go.
records.zomi: A zom kal ciangin omte pawl in eek bawm thakte koi ah koih ding hiam a teel ding uh hi.

records.english: Before the vote, I'm going to walk round the building with the people who object.
records.zomi: Teelna ma-in a nial mite tawh inn a kiim ah ka pai ding hi.

records.english: Maybe they'll agree once they see how far some families have to carry their rubbish.
records.zomi: Innkuan pawl khat in a eek uh bangzah gamla a puak ding a kisam hiam a muh ciangun a phal kha ding uh hi.

records.english: I'll let you choose the film this time.
records.zomi: Tu-in film na teel thei hi.

records.english: Why don't you each tell me what you need, and I'll write it down?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na khat ciat un bang na kisam hiam hong gen unla, ka gelh ding hi lo ding hiam?

records.english: Will you two be able to work together after this?
records.zomi: Hih khit ciangin na nih khawm-in na sem thei ding uh hiam?

records.english: I wish we could talk about money without raising our voices.
records.zomi: Aw dawh lo-in sum thu i kikum thei leng ka deih hi.

records.english: Whatever we decide about the house, I don't want it to come between us.
records.zomi: Inn thu-ah bang i khen zongin i kikal ah a lut ding ka deih kei hi.

records.english: Rather than arguing about the past, we're going to plan the next five years together.
records.zomi: Hun lui thu kinial sangin kum nga zom khawm-in i geel ding hi.

records.english: Once we've both had time to think, I suspect the answer will seem obvious.
records.zomi: I nih in ngaihsut hun i neih khit ciangin dawnna a kician ding hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: If we can agree on the big things, I'm sure the small ones will sort themselves out.
records.zomi: Thu lian te-ah i kilem thei leh a neute amau' in a kibawl siang ding hi, ka thei hi.

records.english: Is it my turn to speak yet?
records.zomi: Ka gen hun a tung khin hiam?

records.english: On Sunday, my brothers and I are going to meet to decide who will look after Dad's shop.
records.zomi: Nipini ni-in ka sanggam pasalte leh kei in Pa' zuakna inn kua in a kem ding hiam khen dingin i kimu ding hi.

records.english: Each of us will say what we can offer before anyone says what they want.
records.zomi: Kuamah in bang a deih hiam a gen ma-in i khat ciat in bang i pia thei hiam i gen ding hi.

records.english: We've promised each other that nobody will leave the table angry.
records.zomi: Kuamah heh-in dawhkan a nusia lo ding hi, ci-in i kiciam khin hi.

records.english: Should the talks fail, the matter will go to the village court.
records.zomi: Kikupna a sit leh thu pen khua thukhenna ah a pai ding hi.

records.english: Thinking about the image of God made me see the homeless man on our street differently.
records.zomi: Pasian lim thu ka ngaihsut ciangin i lampi-a inn om lo pa ka mu dan a khek hi.

records.english: Some Christians argue that caring for the environment is part of reflecting God's image.
records.zomi: Khristian pawl khat in leitung kemna pen Pasian lim lahna khen khat ahi hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: Our Sunday school class talked about the image of God today.
records.zomi: I Nipini sang pawl in tuni-in Pasian lim thu a kikum uh hi.

records.english: Some Christians see the image of God in our ability to create beautiful things.
records.zomi: Khristian pawl khat in a hoih bawl theihna i neih ah Pasian lim a mu uh hi.

records.english: Many Christians understand the image of God as something deeper than a face or a body.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in Pasian lim pen mai leh pumpi sangin a thuk zaw khat bangin a thei uh hi.

records.english: Every person you meet today is made in the image of God, so treat them kindly.
records.zomi: Tuni-a na kimuh mi khempeuh Pasian lim bangin kibawl ahih manin lungsim hoih takin kem in.

records.english: The children sang a song about being made in God's image.
records.zomi: Naupangte in Pasian lim bangin kibawl thu la khat a sa uh hi.

records.english: What struck me most was how the idea gave value to people whom others ignored.
records.zomi: Ka lungsim a khoih pen tua ngaihsutna in mi dangte in a limsak loh mite manphatna a pia hi, cih ahi hi.

records.english: Shall we start the Bible study with the creation story?
records.zomi: Laisiangtho sinna piangsakna tangthu tawh i kipan ding hiam?

records.english: Can I ask you a question about the image of God after the service?
records.zomi: Kikhopna khit ciangin Pasian lim thu dotna khat ka dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: In the Letter to the Colossians, Jesus is described as the image of the invisible God.
records.zomi: Kolose Laikhak sungah Jesu pen mittang tawh a kimu theilo Pasian lim ahi hi, ci-in kigen hi.

records.english: Our church uses the teaching about God's image to explain why racism is wrong.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in bang hangin mi namkhat simmawhna a khial hiam gen siang nadingin Pasian lim thuhilhna a zang hi.

records.english: Were we to take this teaching seriously, our prisons might look very different.
records.zomi: Hih thuhilhna i limsak taktak leh i thong inn te a kibang lo mahmah kha ding hi.

records.english: Can a person lose the image of God?
records.zomi: Mi khat in Pasian lim a mansuah thei hiam?

records.english: Our church teaches that no one can lose it, however badly they behave.
records.zomi: Bangzah in a gamtat hoih lo zongin kuamah in a mansuah thei kei hi, ci-in i pawlpi in a hilh hi.

records.english: Is the image of God the same as having a soul?
records.zomi: Pasian lim pen kha neih tawh a kibang hiam?

records.english: Christian thinkers have answered that question in different ways.
records.zomi: Khristian ngaihsun mite in tua dotna lampi tuamtuam tawh a dawng uh hi.

records.english: Some Christians believe that sin damaged the image of God in people but didn't destroy it.
records.zomi: Khristian pawl khat in mawhna in mite sung-a Pasian lim a susia a, ahi zongin a hihmang kei hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Do you find it comforting to believe that you're made in God's image?
records.zomi: Pasian lim bangin kibawl na hih um in hong hehnem hiam?

records.english: We read Genesis 1:27 together at the start of the lesson.
records.zomi: Thusin kipatna ah Piancilna 1:27 khawm-in i sim hi.

records.english: Because of this belief, my grandmother treated every visitor as an honored guest.
records.zomi: Tua upna hangin ka pi in veh khual khempeuh zahtak khual bangin a kem hi.

records.english: My grandfather often said, "Look for God's image in every face."
records.zomi: Ka pu in, “Mai khempeuh ah Pasian lim zong in,” a ci ngei hi.

records.english: Remember that the person sitting next to you is made in God's image too.
records.zomi: Na kiang-a tu mi zong Pasian lim bangin kibawl ahi hi, cih phawk in.

records.english: I'd like to understand how the image of God fits with what scientists say about human beings.
records.zomi: Pasian lim pen science mite in mihingte thu a gen tawh bangci-in a kituak hiam theih ka deih hi.

records.english: The more I think about the image of God, the harder it is to look down on anyone.
records.zomi: Pasian lim thu ka ngaihsun semsem ciangin kuamah niamsak a haksa semsem hi.

records.english: Is the image of God one reason Christians care for the sick?
records.zomi: Pasian lim pen Khristiante in damlote a kem hang khat ahi hiam?

records.english: For many Christians it is, because every patient is seen as precious to God.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi adingin ahi hi, damlo khempeuh Pasian adingin manpha hi, ci-in kimu ahih manin.

records.english: In our church, children learn early that every person is made in God's image.
records.zomi: I pawlpi ah naupangte in mi khempeuh Pasian lim bangin kibawl hi, cih neu lai-in a sin uh hi.

records.english: The sermon about the image of God was printed in the church newsletter.
records.zomi: Pasian lim thu thugenna pen pawlpi thu thak laibu ah kikhen hi.

records.english: Who taught you about the image of God?
records.zomi: Pasian lim thu kua in hong sin sak hiam?

records.english: My aunt did, when she read me the creation story at bedtime.
records.zomi: Ka ni, ihmut ma-in piangsakna tangthu hong sim sak pa.

records.english: What was God's purpose in making people in his image?
records.zomi: Pasian in mite amah' lim bangin a bawl ngimna bang ahi hiam?

records.english: Many Christians say it was so that people could know God and care for his world.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in mite in Pasian a theih theih nadingun leh a leitung a kem nadingun ahi hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: My mother says we show God's image best when we are kind to strangers.
records.zomi: Theih loh mite tungah lungsim hoih i neih ciangin Pasian lim hoih pen-in i lak hi, ci-in ka nu in a gen hi.

records.english: Not every Christian tradition explains the image of God in the same way.
records.zomi: Khristian ngeina khempeuh in Pasian lim lampi kibang tawh a gen siang kei uh hi.

records.english: If every person is made in God's image, how should we treat people we disagree with?
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh Pasian lim bangin kibawl a hih uh leh i kilem lohpih mite bangci-in i kem ding hiam?

records.english: Let me read you the verse about the image of God before we pray.
records.zomi: Thu i ngen ma-in Pasian lim thu Laisiangtho tang kong sim sak ding hi.

records.english: Does the Bible say much about the image of God?
records.zomi: Laisiangtho in Pasian lim thu tampi a gen hiam?

records.english: It isn't mentioned often, but Christians see the idea throughout the Bible.
records.zomi: Tampi vei kigen kei a, ahi zongin Khristiante in tua ngaihsutna Laisiangtho bup ah a mu uh hi.

records.english: Whatever a person's abilities, Christian teaching holds that they bear the image of God fully.
records.zomi: Mi khat' siamna bang ahi zongin Khristian thuhilhna in Pasian lim a kim-in a puak hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Please don't call anyone worthless, because they are made in God's image.
records.zomi: Pasian lim bangin kibawl a hih manun kuamah phattuam lo ci-in sam kei in.

records.english: What does it mean to be made in God's image?
records.zomi: Pasian lim bangin kibawl cih in bang a ci nopna hiam?

records.english: Our pastor says it means that every human life has great worth.
records.zomi: Mihing nuntakna khempeuh a manpha mahmah hi, cihna ahi hi, ci-in i pastor in a gen hi.

records.english: The youth group discussed how the image of God affects the way we speak to each other online.
records.zomi: Khangno pawl in Pasian lim in online ah i kikup dan bangci-in a lam hiam a kikum uh hi.

records.english: Do animals bear the image of God too?
records.zomi: Ganhing te zong in Pasian lim a puak uh hiam?

records.english: In Genesis, only human beings are described that way.
records.zomi: Piancilna sungah mihingte bek tua bangin kigen uh hi.

records.english: If every person bears the image of God, then no one is beyond the reach of respect.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh in Pasian lim a puak uh leh kuamah zahtakna tun theih loh mun ah om lo hi.

records.english: According to Genesis, both male and female were created in God's image.
records.zomi: Piancilna bangin pasal leh numei a nih in Pasian lim bangin kipiangsak hi.

records.english: According to Christian teaching, even a newborn baby bears the image of God.
records.zomi: Khristian thuhilhna bangin naungek suak thak zong in Pasian lim a puak hi.

records.english: It was only when my brother became disabled that I understood what the image of God meant to our church.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal a cilkhak ciang bek i pawlpi adingin Pasian lim in bang a ci nopna hiam ka thei hi.

records.english: Having been taught that everyone bears God's image, she couldn't accept the way the workers were treated.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh in Pasian lim a puak uh hi, ci-in a kisin ahih manin nasemte kikem dan a sang zo kei hi.

records.english: For many Christians, the image of God is the foundation of human dignity.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi adingin Pasian lim pen mihing zahtakna suangphum ahi hi.

records.english: My son asked me whether God looks like us.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in Pasian i bang hiam hong dong hi.

records.english: Will we talk about the image of God again next week?
records.zomi: A zom kal ciangin Pasian lim thu i kikum kik ding hiam?

records.english: Our pastor explained that being made in God's image includes the ability to love and to choose.
records.zomi: Pasian lim bangin kibawl hihna in itna leh teelna siamna a kihel hi, ci-in i pastor in a gen siang hi.

records.english: My little sister thinks the image of God means we all have God's smile.
records.zomi: Ka nau nu in Pasian lim pen i khempeuh in Pasian' nuihna i nei hi, cihna ahi hi, a ci hi.

records.english: We were told to treat every guest at the shelter as someone made in God's image.
records.zomi: Kemna inn-a khual khempeuh Pasian lim bangin kibawl mi bangin kem dingin hong kigen hi.

records.english: The idea comes from the first chapter of Genesis.
records.zomi: Tua ngaihsutna Piancilna a masa pen pan a hong hi.

records.english: The teacher had each child look in a mirror and say, "I am made in God's image."
records.zomi: Saya in naupang khat ciat mai-et en-in, “Kei Pasian lim bangin kibawl ka hi hi,” ci dingin a sawl hi.

records.english: Theologians have long debated whether the image of God lies mainly in reason or in relationships.
records.zomi: Pasian thu siamte in Pasian lim pen ngaihsutna ah hiam, kizopna ah hiam a om zaw cih kum tampi a kinial uh hi.

records.english: My mother says it's rude to leave a house without saying a proper goodbye.
records.zomi: Hoih taka goodbye ci lo-in inn nusia zahtak lo hi, ci-in ka nu in a gen hi.

records.english: I'm full, thank you, and it was delicious.
records.zomi: Ka vah hi, lungdam ing, a lim mahmah hi.

records.english: My son wrote down the expressions his grandmother uses most, so that he wouldn't forget them.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in a mangngilh lohna dingin a pi' a zat tam pen kammal te a gelh hi.

records.english: Ask your grandmother to teach you how she blesses the children at bedtime.
records.zomi: Ihmut hun ciangin naupangte thupha a piak dan na pi kiangah sin sak dingin ngen in.

records.english: Can you say the blessing at dinner tonight?
records.zomi: Tu zanin nitak an ah thupha ngetna na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: If you're not sure how to address an older person, call them Uncle or Aunt.
records.zomi: Mi upa bangci-in sam ding hiam na thei kei leh Pa neu ahih kei leh Ni ci-in sam in.

records.english: Hearing my daughter thank her teacher the way my mother taught me made me unexpectedly proud.
records.zomi: Ka nu' hong sin sak bangin ka tanu in a saya lungdam a cih ka zak ciangin lamdang takin ka kipak hi.

records.english: Thank you very much for the meal.
records.zomi: An adingin lungdam mahmah ing.

records.english: My grandfather made me repeat the greeting until I said it properly.
records.zomi: Ka pu in hoih takin ka gen mateng kihopihna hong gen kik sak hi.

records.english: Auntie, can I help you carry that?
records.zomi: Ni, tua puak dingin kong huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Rest well tonight, and don't get up early for us.
records.zomi: Tu zanin hoih takin tawlnga in, kei te adingin ma-in thou kei in.

records.english: Whenever we meet, my uncle asks after every single member of the family.
records.zomi: I kimuh simin ka pa neu in innkuan mi khat ciat thu a dong hi.

records.english: Sorry to trouble you so late in the evening.
records.zomi: Nitak nunung lua-in kong buaisak manin maisak ing.

records.english: Please eat more, because there's plenty.
records.zomi: Tampi a om ahih manin ne behlap in.

records.english: Is everyone at home well?
records.zomi: Inn ah mi khempeuh a dam uh hiam?

records.english: Yes, everyone is well, thank God.
records.zomi: Dam uh hi, mi khempeuh a dam uh hi, Pasian kiangah lungdam hi.

records.english: Some of the sayings my father uses are hard to explain to friends from other countries.
records.zomi: Ka pa' a zat kammal pawl khat gamdang pan lawmte kiangah gen siang a haksa hi.

records.english: My grandmother's goodbyes were so long that visitors were often still at the gate an hour later.
records.zomi: Ka pi' goodbye te a sau lua ahih manin khualte nai khat khit ciangin kongpi ah a om lai uh hi.

records.english: Please give my greetings to your mother.
records.zomi: Na nu kiangah ka hopihna pia sak in.

records.english: My grandmother always greets visitors by asking whether they've eaten.
records.zomi: Ka pi in an na ne khin hiam ci-in khualte a hopih tawntung hi.

records.english: Happy New Year, and may it bring you good health.
records.zomi: Kum Thak nuam hen, leh cidamna hoih hong tunsak hen.

records.english: Long time no see!
records.zomi: Sawt i kimu kei hi!

records.english: We'll be going now, and thank you for everything.
records.zomi: Tu-in i pai ding hi, bangkim adingin lungdam ing.

records.english: Congratulations on your new baby!
records.zomi: Na naungek thak adingin kong lungdam pih hi!

records.english: Take care on the road home.
records.zomi: Inn ciahna lampi ah kidawm in.

records.english: Having grown up abroad, my cousin knows the words but not always when to use them.
records.zomi: Gamdang ah a khan ahih manin ka sanggam in kammal te a thei a, ahi zongin bang ciangin zang ding hiam a thei tawntung kei hi.

records.english: Don't worry, it doesn't matter at all.
records.zomi: Lungkham kei in, bangmah a thupi kei hi.

records.english: Could you teach my husband a few polite expressions before he meets your parents?
records.zomi: Na nu leh na pa a kimuh ma-in ka pasal zahtakna kammal tawmno na sin sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Wait a moment, and I'll be right back.
records.zomi: Tawmno ngak in, hong kik pah ning.

records.english: In my view, polite expressions show how much a community values its relationships.
records.zomi: Ka ngaihsutna-in zahtakna kammal te in mipi khat in a kizopnate bangzah a manpha sak hiam a lak hi.

records.english: When my children answer the phone, I want them to greet older relatives politely.
records.zomi: Ka ta te in phone a dawn ciangun sanggam upate zahtak takin a hopih ding uh ka deih hi.

records.english: By the time my son was five, he could greet every relative in the right way.
records.zomi: Ka tapa kum nga a phak ciangin sanggam khempeuh lampi dik tawh a hopih thei hi.

records.english: It would be a shame if the old ways of saying goodbye disappeared within one generation.
records.zomi: Goodbye cih dan lui te khang khat sungin a mang leh lungkhamhuai ding hi.

records.english: Every time I hear an older woman bless a child on the bus, I feel I'm back in my village.
records.zomi: Bus tungah numei upa khat in naupang thupha a piak ka zak simin ka khua ah ka ciah kik bangin ka kisa hi.

records.english: Have you eaten yet?
records.zomi: An na ne khin hiam?

records.english: Excuse me, Uncle, may I pass?
records.zomi: Maisak ing, Pa neu, ka kantan thei ding hiam?

records.english: It took me a while to learn which respectful words to use with older people.
records.zomi: Mi upate tawh zahtakna kammal bang zang ding hiam sin dingin hun hong sawt hi.

records.english: What I miss most about home is hearing people greet each other on the way to the market.
records.zomi: Inn-a ka lungngai pen zuakna mun pai lampi ah mite a kihopih uh za ahi hi.

records.english: What a surprise to see you here!
records.zomi: Hih ah kong muh bangzah in lamdang hiam!

records.english: Teaching children to greet people properly is one of the first things many parents in our community do.
records.zomi: Mite hoih takin hopih dingin naupangte sin sak pen i mipi-a nu leh pa tampi' a bawl masak te lakah khat ahi hi.

records.english: We might start a small class on Saturday mornings to teach children everyday expressions.
records.zomi: Naupangte ni sim kammal te sin sak nadingin Kiginni zingsang simin sinna neu khat i kipat sak kha ding hi.

records.english: Good morning, Grandfather — did you sleep well?
records.zomi: Pu, zingpha — hoih takin na ihmu hiam?

records.english: The new family on our street greeted us in our own language, which made us very happy.
records.zomi: I lampi-a innkuan thak in i pau mah tawh hong hopih ahih manin i kipak mahmah hi.

records.english: It was nothing, so please come again.
records.zomi: Bangmah hi lo hi, hong pai kik in.

records.english: Our pastor ends every phone call with a short blessing.
records.zomi: I pastor in phone sam khempeuh thupha tom khat tawh a khak hi.

records.english: I learned how to thank people properly by listening to my aunt at the market.
records.zomi: Zuakna mun ah ka ni a ngai-in mite hoih takin lungdam ci dan ka sin hi.

records.english: How are your parents keeping these days?
records.zomi: Tulai-in na nu leh na pa bangci-in a om uh hiam?

records.english: However busy they are, the people in my village always stop to ask how your family is.
records.zomi: Bangzah in buai zongin ka khua-a mite in na innkuan bangci-in a om hiam dong dingin a khawl tawntung uh hi.

records.english: Shall I greet your parents in our language or in the local one?
records.zomi: Na nu leh na pa i pau tawh ka hopih ding hiam, gam pau tawh hiam?

records.english: Greet them in our language, because they'll be delighted.
records.zomi: I pau tawh hopih in, a kipak mahmah ding uh ahih manin.

records.english: In our family, we never let a guest leave without telling them to go safely.
records.zomi: I innkuan ah khual khat bit takin pai dingin hilh lo-in a pai dingin i phal ngei kei hi.

records.english: My nephew laughs whenever I use the old expressions my grandfather taught me.
records.zomi: Ka pu' hong sin sak kammal lui te ka zat simin ka tanau a nui hi.

records.english: Don't answer your grandparents with a single word, but speak to them politely.
records.zomi: Na pu leh na pi kammal khat bek tawh dawng kei inla, zahtak takin gen in.

records.english: The youth group used a phone to record the elders' favorite sayings.
records.zomi: Khangno pawl in upate' a deih pen kammal te phone tawh a la uh hi.

records.english: See you at church on Sunday.
records.zomi: Nipini ni-in pawlpi ah i kimu ding hi.

records.english: Where are you off to this morning?
records.zomi: Tu zingsang koi ah na pai hiam?

records.english: If our children stop using these expressions, something of our way of life will be lost.
records.zomi: I ta te in hih kammal te a zat khawl uh leh i nuntak dan khen khat a mang ding hi.

records.english: May God bless you and your family.
records.zomi: Pasian in nang leh na innkuan thupha hong pia hen.

records.english: Go slowly, and come back soon.
records.zomi: Dai takin pai inla, manlang takin hong ciah kik in.

records.english: Come in and sit down, please.
records.zomi: Lut inla tu in.

records.english: Tomorrow I'm driving to my cousin's new house for the first time.
records.zomi: Zingciang ciangin ka sanggam nu' inn thak ah a masa pen-in ka mawng ding hi.

records.english: She's going to send me her location before I leave.
records.zomi: Ka pai ma-in a omna mun hong khak ding hi.

records.english: If the signal drops in the hills, I'll stop at the village shop and ask.
records.zomi: Mual tungah signal a om kei leh khua zuakna inn ah ka khawl ding a, ka dong ding hi.

records.english: Can you pin the meeting place on the map for me?
records.zomi: Map tungah kimuhna mun na ciamteh sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: What worries me most is that the new road isn't on anyone's map yet.
records.zomi: Ka lungkham pen lampi thak kuamah' map tungah om nai lo ahi hi.

records.english: What's the best way to get to the airport early on Sunday?
records.zomi: Nipini zingsang ciangin vanlengtual ah ma-in tun nading lampi hoih pen bang ahi hiam?

records.english: Once the new ring road opens, finding the hospital should be much easier.
records.zomi: Kiim lampi thak a kihon khit ciangin siavuan inn zon a baih zaw mahmah ding hi.

records.english: Should the bridge still be closed, the quickest route will be through the old town.
records.zomi: Lei a kikhak lai leh lampi manlang pen khuapi lui sung ah ahi ding hi.

records.english: How will I find your office when I get to the building?
records.zomi: Inn ka tun ciangin na office bangci-in ka mu ding hiam?

records.english: Take the lift to the fourth floor, and I'll meet you at reception.
records.zomi: Lift tawh dawl lina ah kai inla, mai lam ngakna ah kong dawn ding hi.

records.english: By the time you arrive, I'll have sent you a photo of the entrance.
records.zomi: Na tun ciangin lutna lim kong khak khin ding hi.

records.english: Could you send me the directions by text so that I don't forget them?
records.zomi: Ka mangngilh lohna dingin lampi lahna text tawh hong khak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Is it possible to walk from the station to the stadium, or is it too far?
records.zomi: Meileng dinna pan kimawlna mun lian dong pai theih hiam, a gamla lua hiam?

records.english: It's possible, but it'll take about forty minutes.
records.zomi: Pai theih hi, ahi zongin minit sawm li bang a sawt ding hi.

records.english: When you reach the church, wait there, and someone will come and fetch you.
records.zomi: Pawlpi na tun ciangin tua ah ngak in, mi khat in hong la ding hi.

records.english: We might take a wrong turning or two, but that's part of the adventure.
records.zomi: Lampi khial khat nih i zui kha ding a, ahi zongin tua pen lamdang khualzinna khen khat ahi hi.

records.english: Where exactly shall we meet on the first morning of the conference?
records.zomi: Kikhopna lian zingsang masa pen-in koi ah taktak i kimu ding hiam?

records.english: At the coffee stand just inside the main doors.
records.zomi: Lutna lian sung kiang-a coffee zuakna dawhkan ah.

records.english: Hello, I'm calling because I'm coming to your clinic tomorrow and I'm not sure where to park.
records.zomi: Lumen, zingciang na siavuan inn ah ka hong ding a, koi ah mawtaw koih ding hiam ka thei kei ahih manin kong sam hi.

records.english: Let me check I've got this right: past the hospital, and then right at the roundabout?
records.zomi: Ka theih a dik hiam en ning: siavuan inn kantan inla, tua ciangin lampi kual ah taklam ah pial in, a hi hiam?

records.english: The road to the lake will be closed next week, so you'll have to go round by the farm.
records.zomi: A zom kal ciangin tuili lam lampi kikhak ding ahih manin lo inn kiang pan na kiheikual ding a kisam ding hi.

records.english: Shall we look at the route together before we set off?
records.zomi: I pai ma-in lampi khawm-in i en ding hiam?

records.english: On Saturday, our walking group will try a new path through the forest.
records.zomi: Kiginni ni-in i pai pawl in gam sung tawn lampi thak khat a zui sin ding uh hi.

records.english: The leader is going to tie red ribbons on the trees at every turning.
records.zomi: Makaipa in kiheina khempeuh-a singkung te ah puan zang san a khih ding hi.

records.english: Anyone who gets lost will wait by the last ribbon until someone comes back.
records.zomi: A mangthang peuhpeuh in mi khat hong kik mateng puan zang nunung kiang ah a ngak ding hi.

records.english: Is the new café easy to find?
records.zomi: An zuakna inn thak muh a baih hiam?

records.english: It would save everyone time if the venue put a map on its website.
records.zomi: Kikhopna mun in a website tungah map a koih leh mi khempeuh' hun a kem ding hi.

records.english: If you get lost, just phone me and I'll talk you through it.
records.zomi: Na mangthang leh hong sam bek in, kong hilh ding hi.

records.english: Having never been to the capital, my mother wants clear directions written on paper.
records.zomi: Gam khuapi ah a pai ngei loh manin ka nu in laidal tungah kician taka kigelh lampi lahna a deih hi.

records.english: My son has offered to ride the bus with his grandmother until she knows the stops.
records.zomi: A pi in dinna te a theih mateng ka tapa in amah tawh bus tuang dingin a ciam hi.

records.english: I'll leave a light on outside, so you'll know which house is ours.
records.zomi: I inn bang ahi hiam na theih nadingin pua lam ah meivak khat ka nusia ding hi.

records.english: Do you think we'll be able to find the campsite in the dark?
records.zomi: Mial lai-in gam om mun i mu thei ding hiam, na ci hiam?

records.english: Probably not, so we should leave before four.
records.zomi: Mu thei lo kha ding hi, tua ahih manin nai li ma-in i pai ding hi.

records.english: The guide made us memorize the way back to the car before we started.
records.zomi: I kipat ma-in lampi lakpa in mawtaw lam ciahna lampi hong phawksak hi.

records.english: I'll print the map in case my phone battery dies.
records.zomi: Ka phone battery a bei leh cih adingin map ka print ding hi.

records.english: If there were more signs in the old town, visitors wouldn't have to stop and ask so often.
records.zomi: Khuapi lui ah lampi lahna tam zaw a om leh vehte in tampi vei a khawl-in a dong lo ding uh hi.

records.english: My grandfather is used to giving directions by landmarks, not street names.
records.zomi: Ka pu in lampi min sangin ciamtehna mun tawh lampi a lak ngeina hi.

records.english: A new sign will be put up at the corner before the festival.
records.zomi: Pawi ma-in lampi kikona ah lampi lahna thak khat kikoih ding hi.

records.english: Rather than relying on the app, I'll memorize the main turnings before I leave.
records.zomi: App muan sangin ka pai ma-in kiheina lian te ka phawk khol ding hi.

records.english: Next week, my parents are visiting me in the city, and they don't use smartphones.
records.zomi: A zom kal ciangin ka nu leh ka pa in khuapi ah hong veh ding uh a, smartphone a zang kei uh hi.

records.english: I'm going to walk the route with them on the first morning, so that they can do it alone later.
records.zomi: A nung ciangin amau' bek-in a pai theih nadingun zingsang masa pen-in amau' tawh lampi ka pai ding hi.

records.english: I'll also write my address in large letters, so that they can show it to a taxi driver.
records.zomi: Taxi mawngpa a lak theih nadingun ka omna mun laimal lian tawh ka gelh ding hi.

records.english: I'll wait for you outside the bank at ten.
records.zomi: Nai sawm ciangin bank pua ah kong ngak ding hi.

records.english: Which gate will you be waiting at?
records.zomi: Kongpi bang ah na ngak ding hiam?

records.english: Dear Ms. Hau, could you please send me directions to the interview, as I'll be arriving by train?
