records.english: She showed her card, took her ballot paper, and went behind the little curtain.
records.zomi: A card a lak a, a teelna lai a la a, puan khai neu nung ah a pai hi.

records.english: When she came out, she said, "I've voted in every election for sixty years, and I'm not stopping now."
records.zomi: A pai khiat ciangin, “Kum sawmguk sung teelna khempeuh ah ka teel a, tu-in ka khawl kei ding hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: My grandfather, who wasn't allowed to vote until he was forty, has never missed an election since.
records.zomi: Kum sawm li a phak dong teel phal a ngah lo ka pu in tua pan kipan teelna khat zong a mangngilh ngei kei hi.

records.english: The results will be announced on the radio tomorrow morning.
records.zomi: A dawnnate zingciang zingsang ciangin radio tungah kigen ding hi.

records.english: Where can I find out about the candidates?
records.zomi: Teel ding mite thu koi ah ka thei thei ding hiam?

records.english: Their leaflets are on the council website, and some came through the door.
records.zomi: Amau' laimaite khuapi vaihawm website ah a om a, pawl khat kongkhak tawh hong lut hi.

records.english: If more young people had registered, the result of the local election might have been different.
records.zomi: Khangno tam zaw in a min a gelh uh leh mun teelna dawnna a kibang lo kha ding hi.

records.english: The challenge for election officials is making sure that everyone who is entitled to vote can actually do so.
records.zomi: Teelna nasemte adingin haksatna pen teel thei mi khempeuh in a teel taktak theih nadingin kem ahi hi.

records.english: Good idea, see you later.
records.zomi: Ngaihsutna hoih hi, a nung ciangin kimu ni.

records.english: Campaign posters must be removed within a week of the election, according to the council.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm' gen bangin teelna khit kal khat sungin kampaan lim lai te kilak khia ding hi.

records.english: Turnout was higher than last time, possibly because the weather was good.
records.zomi: A nunung vei sangin teel mi a tam zaw a, huihkhua a hoih manin kha ding hi.

records.english: If you ask me, every vote matters most in close local elections.
records.zomi: Kei hong dong leh a kiniam kiang mun teelna ah teelna khempeuh a thupi pen hi.

records.english: I do want to vote, but I'm not sure which candidate represents my views.
records.zomi: Teel ka deih taktak a, ahi zongin teel ding mi bang in ka ngaihsutna a pua hiam ka thei kei hi.

records.english: Bring your polling card with you.
records.zomi: Na teelna card tawi in.

records.english: Which party won in our area?
records.zomi: I mun ah pawl bang in a zo hiam?

records.english: Personally, I find local elections more interesting, because the issues affect my street directly.
records.zomi: Keimah adingin mun teelna te a lamdang zaw hi, a thulu te in ka lampi a khawk ngal ahih manin.

records.english: Volunteers drove elderly voters to the polling station free of charge.
records.zomi: Thalawpte in upa teel mite teelna mun ah man om lo-in a paipih uh hi.

records.english: Clear information in several languages helped newer residents understand how to vote.
records.zomi: Pau tuamtuam-a thu kician in mun teeng thakte bangci-in teel ding hiam a theih nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Is your mother going to vote by post?
records.zomi: Na nu in laikhak tawh a teel ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, because she can't stand in a queue for long.
records.zomi: Hi hi, kigual sungah sawt a ding zo kei ahih manin.

records.english: Could you explain how postal voting works for people who are working abroad?
records.zomi: Gamdang ah nasem mite adingin laikhak tawh teelna bangci-in a sem hiam gen siang thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: In our country, you register online, receive the ballot by post, and send it back before the deadline.
records.zomi: I gam ah online-in min na gelh a, teelna lai laikhak tawh na ngah a, hun tawp ma-in na khak kik hi.

records.english: My daughter helped her grandfather fill in the form to register as a voter.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in a pu teel mi-a a min a gelh nadingin lai a dimsak huh hi.

records.english: Accessible polling stations, with ramps and large-print ballots, allow disabled voters to take part independently.
records.zomi: Kahtouna leh laimal lian teelna lai a nei teelna mun te in taksa haksatna nei teel mite amau le amau-in a kihel theih nadingin a phal hi.

records.english: Some voters decide only on the day, which makes the result difficult to predict.
records.zomi: Teel mi pawl khat in a ni ciangin bek a thukhen uh ahih manin a dawnna theih ma-a gen a haksa hi.

records.english: A secret ballot protects voters from pressure by their employers, families or neighbors.
records.zomi: Guk taka teelna in teel mite a nasepna neite, innkuante hiam inn vengte hiam' ngaihsutna sawlna pan a kemsak hi.

records.english: Explaining the voting process to new citizens before their first election can greatly reduce their anxiety.
records.zomi: Gam mi thakte kiangah a teelna masa ma-in teelna kalsuan dan gen siang in a lungkhamna uh a kiamsak mahmah thei hi.

records.english: Once the votes had been counted twice, the winning candidate thanked her opponents for a fair campaign.
records.zomi: Teelnate nihvei a kisim khit ciangin a zo teel ding nu in kampaan dik a bawl manun a langpang te kiangah lungdam a ci hi.

records.english: I'm afraid you're at the wrong polling station, but yours is only five minutes away.
records.zomi: Teelna mun khial ah na om hi, ci-in ka lau a, ahi zongin na teelna mun minit nga bek a gamla hi.

records.english: Thank you for voting, and have a good day.
records.zomi: Na teel manin lungdam ing, ni hoih nei in.

records.english: Please don't talk about the candidates inside the polling station.
records.zomi: Teelna mun sungah teel ding mite thu kikum kei un.

records.english: Can I vote if I've lost my polling card?
records.zomi: Ka teelna card ka mansuah leh ka teel thei ding hiam?

records.english: In our town you can, as long as you bring photo identification.
records.zomi: I khuapi ah na teel thei hi, na lim nei min-lai na tawi leh.

records.english: Free and fair elections depend on trust in the people who count the votes.
records.zomi: Suakta leh dik teelnate in teelna simte tungah upna tungah a kinga hi.

records.english: We're going to watch the results together at my uncle's house.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu' inn ah khawm-in teelna dawnna i en ding hi.

records.english: Put a cross in one box only, or your vote won't count.
records.zomi: Bawm khat bek sungah kros ciamteh in, ahih kei leh na teelna a kisim lo ding hi.

records.english: Where's the polling station for our street?
records.zomi: I lampi adingin teelna mun koi ah a om hiam?

records.english: It's in the primary school hall, the same as last time.
records.zomi: Sang neu kikhopna inn ah a om a, a nunung vei tawh kibang hi.

records.english: Fair enough, but sixteen-year-olds pay tax when they work, too.
records.zomi: Tua pen a dik hi, ahi zongin kum sawm leh guk a phak mite zong a nasep ciangun siah a pia uh hi.

records.english: Right, I'd better go and vote before it gets busy.
records.zomi: Hoih hi, mi a tam ma-in ka teel zaw ding hi.

records.english: Some families agree on a quiet hour each evening when nobody checks their phones.
records.zomi: Innkuan pawl khat in nitak simin kuamah in a phone a en lohna dai hun nai khat a kithukim uh hi.

records.english: I'll text you the address when I get home.
records.zomi: Inn ka tun ciangin teenna mun text kong khak ding hi.

records.english: The two blue ticks mean she's read it, so she's probably just busy.
records.zomi: Tick dum nih in a sim khin hi, ci nopna ahih manin a buai bek kha ding hi.

records.english: Please don't send messages to the work group after nine at night.
records.zomi: Zan nai kua khit ciangin nasep group ah message khak kei un.

records.english: I'm leaving the neighborhood group, because it's mostly arguments about parking.
records.zomi: Mawtaw koihna thu kinialna a tam zaw ahih manin inn veng group ka nusia ding hi.

records.english: Turning off read receipts can reduce the pressure to reply immediately.
records.zomi: Read receipt na khak leh pah-a dawng ding lungsim sawlna a kiamsak thei hi.

records.english: Can you add me to the class group?
records.zomi: Kilasi group ah hong behlap thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Who's the new person in our group chat?
records.zomi: I group chat sung-a mi thak kua ahi hiam?

records.english: It's my cousin's husband, who's helping to organize the reunion.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam' pasal ahi a, kikimuh kikna bawl dingin a huh hi.

records.english: Do you mind if I share your number with the football coach?
records.zomi: Football saya kiangah na nambat ka hawm leh na lungkham ding hiam?

records.english: Not at all, as long as he doesn't add me to another group.
records.zomi: Lungkham lo ing, group dang ah hong behlap kei leh.

records.english: Right, I'll let you go, so speak soon.
records.zomi: Hoih hi, kong khah ding a, kiho kik pah ni.

records.english: Personally, I'd rather receive one clear message than ten short ones in a row.
records.zomi: Keimah adingin message tom sawm kizom sangin message kician khat ngah ka deih zaw hi.

records.english: Hi, sorry to bother you, but is the pharmacy open late tonight?
records.zomi: Hi, hong buaipih ding maisak in, ahi zongin tu zanin zatui dawl a nunung dong a kihong hiam?

records.english: I'm going to mute the group during my exams.
records.zomi: Ka sitna hun sungin group ka daisak ding hi.

records.english: My grandmother, who never learned to read well, uses voice messages to keep up with all her grandchildren.
records.zomi: Lai sim hoih takin a sin ngei lo ka pi in a tute khempeuh tawh a kizop theih nadingin aw thu a zang hi.

records.english: I wish people wouldn't send long messages when a quick call would be easier.
records.zomi: Phone sam baih zaw ciangin mite in message sau a khak loh uh leh ka deih hi.

records.english: Last month, my aunt set up a group chat for the whole family.
records.zomi: Kha nung in ka ni in innkuan bup adingin group chat khat a bawl hi.

records.english: Within a week, it had forty members and hundreds of messages about recipes and weddings.
records.zomi: Kal khat sungin member sawm li a nei a, an huan dan leh mopawi thu message za tampi a om hi.

records.english: Now my uncle reads every message aloud to my grandmother after dinner.
records.zomi: Tu-in ka pa neu in nitak an khit ciangin message khempeuh ka pi kiangah aw-in a sim sak hi.

records.english: Messaging apps have made it far easier for families spread across countries to stay in touch.
records.zomi: Message app te in gam tuamtuam ah a kithekek innkuante kizom den nadingin a baihsak mahmah hi.

records.english: Clear group rules, such as no forwarded rumors, keep a neighborhood chat useful.
records.zomi: Thuzak zuau khak kik lo cih bang group thukham kician in inn veng chat a phattuamsak hi.

records.english: Thanks, that's really helpful, and have a good evening.
records.zomi: Lungdam ing, tua in hong huh mahmah a, nuam takin nitak zang in.

records.english: Did anyone reply to your question?
records.zomi: Na dotna kuamah in a dawng hiam?

records.english: Not yet, but it's still early.
records.zomi: Dawng nai lo hi, ahi zongin a hun a tung nai lo hi.

records.english: My phone keeps beeping with messages from the family group.
records.zomi: Innkuan group pan message te hangin ka phone a ging den hi.

records.english: My grandmother has learned to send voice notes, and now she sends one every morning.
records.zomi: Ka pi in aw thu khak a sin khin a, tu-in zingsang simin khat a khak hi.

records.english: Could you show me how to send a photo to the family group?
records.zomi: Innkuan group ah lim khak dan hong lak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Tap the paperclip, choose the photo, and press the little arrow.
records.zomi: Paperclip nek inla, lim teel inla, arrow neu nek in.

records.english: When I turned my phone on after the long flight, dozens of messages arrived at once, and it took me an hour to read them all.
records.zomi: Vanleng tawh sawt takin ka khualzin khit ciangin ka phone ka phong ciangin message tampi kikhawm-in hong tung a, a khempeuh sim dingin nai khat ka zang hi.

records.english: Did you see my message?
records.zomi: Ka message na mu hiam?

records.english: Sorry, I've only just seen it, because my phone was on silent.
records.zomi: Maisak in, ka phone a dai ahih manin tu-in bek ka mu hi.

records.english: Just to check, is the meeting still at three, or has it moved?
records.zomi: En kik ning, kikhopna nai thum ciangin a om lai hiam, a kikhel hiam?

records.english: Still at three, see you there.
records.zomi: Nai thum ciangin a om lai hi, tua ah kimu ni.

records.english: The difficulty with written messages is that tone is easily misunderstood.
records.zomi: Kigelh message te haksatna pen a gen dan a baih takin kitheih khial thei ahi hi.

records.english: Write a short message to say you've arrived safely, so that your mother doesn't worry.
records.zomi: Na nu a lungkham lohna dingin na tun bit hi, cih message tom khat gelh in.

records.english: Why didn't you reply to my message?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ka message na dawng kei hiam?

records.english: I'm sorry, I started typing and then the baby woke up.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, ka gelh kipan a, tua ciangin naungek a khanglawh hi.

records.english: What's your number?
records.zomi: Na nambat bang ahi hiam?

records.english: A short voice message can sometimes express kindness better than a long written one.
records.zomi: Aw thu tom khat in kigelh sau khat sangin itna a lak hoih zaw thei hi.

records.english: Which app do you use to talk to your cousins?
records.zomi: Na sanggamte tawh kikum dingin app bang na zang hiam?

records.english: Messages on this app disappear after a week unless you save them.
records.zomi: Hih app tungah message te na kem kei leh kal khat khit ciangin a mang hi.

records.english: If my aunt had checked the message before forwarding it, the false rumor wouldn't have spread.
records.zomi: Ka ni in a khak kik ma-in message a en leh thuzak zuau a kithang lo ding hi.

records.english: My father isn't used to typing on such a small screen, so he sends voice messages instead.
records.zomi: Ka pa screen neu tungah gelh a ngeina hi lo ahih manin a sangin aw thu a khak hi.

records.english: Send me a voice message if you're driving.
records.zomi: Mawtaw na mawng laitak ahih leh aw thu hong khak in.

records.english: Many scams begin with a message that seems to come from a relative asking urgently for money.
records.zomi: Khemna tampi in sanggam khat pan hong pai bang-a manlang takin sum ngen message tawh a kipan hi.

records.english: If a message asks you to click a link to claim a prize, delete it straight away.
records.zomi: Message khat in letsong la dingin link nek dingin a ngen leh pah-in phiat in.

records.english: Text me when you're outside.
records.zomi: Pua lam na tun ciangin text hong khak in.

records.english: I set up a group for the volunteers so that we can swap shifts more easily.
records.zomi: Nasep hun i kilaih baih nadingin thalawpte adingin group khat ka bawl hi.

records.english: Turn on notifications for the school group, because important news comes through it.
records.zomi: Thupi thuthak tua tawh a hong pai ahih manin sang group adingin notification phong in.

records.english: Once the school started using a messaging app, parents received news on the same day instead of a week later.
records.zomi: Sang in message app a zat kipat khit ciangin nu leh pate in kal khat nung hi lo-in ni kibang mah-in thuthak a ngah uh hi.

records.english: Can I call you back in five minutes?
records.zomi: Minit nga ciangin kong sam kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: No problem, I'll be here.
records.zomi: Buaina om lo hi, hih ah ka om ding hi.

records.english: Please send the photos to me, not to the whole group.
records.zomi: Limte group bup ah hi lo-in kei kiangah hong khak in.

records.english: Is this message really from the bank?
records.zomi: Hih message bank pan taktak ahi hiam?

records.english: Probably not, so don't reply until you've checked with them.
records.zomi: Hi lo kha ding hi, tua ahih manin amaute tawh na en ma-in dawng kei in.

records.english: The messages were sent to the wrong group, which caused a lot of embarrassment.
records.zomi: Message te group khial ah kikhak ahih manin zumna tampi a piang hi.

records.english: If you ask me, group chats need a few simple rules, or they become exhausting.
records.zomi: Kei hong dong leh group chat te in thukham baih tawmno a kisam a, ahih kei leh a tawlsak hi.

records.english: Answering work messages late at night can make it hard to switch off and rest.
records.zomi: Zan lai-in nasep message dawng in lungsim khawl leh tawldam a haksasak thei hi.

records.english: Our manager asked us to use the work app only for work, not for jokes and photos.
records.zomi: I manager in nasep app pen nuihzaakna leh lim adingin hi lo-in nasep bek adingin zang dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: Why does it take you so long to choose a shirt?
records.zomi: Bang hangin puan-ak khat teel dingin hun sau na zang hiam?

records.english: Personally, I'd rather skip breakfast than leave the house in a hurry.
records.zomi: Keimah adingin manlang-a inn nusia sangin zingsang an nusia ka deih zaw hi.

records.english: Why do you drink a glass of water before breakfast?
records.zomi: Bang hangin zingsang an ma-in tui haai khat na dawn hiam?

records.english: My doctor suggested it, and it helps me wake up.
records.zomi: Ka siavuan in a gen a, hong phawngsak hi.

records.english: I wish mornings in our house were a little calmer.
records.zomi: I inn-a zingsangte tawmno dai zaw leh ka deih hi.

records.english: Pack your gym bag tonight, so that you can go straight to the pool after work.
records.zomi: Nasep khit ciangin tuipeekna mun ah na pai pah theih nadingin tu zanin na gym ip kiman sak in.

records.english: Brush your hair before we leave.
records.zomi: I pai ma-in na sam khi in.

records.english: Once we agreed on a bathroom schedule, the shouting in the mornings almost stopped.
records.zomi: Kisilna inn zat hun i kithukim khit ciangin zingsang kikoukou a khawl dek hi.

records.english: Where did you put my school tie?
records.zomi: Ka sang tie koi ah na koih hiam?

records.english: It's on the chair by the door, where you left it.
records.zomi: Kongkhak kiang-a tutphah tungah na nusiatna mun ah a om hi.

records.english: We're going to try a no-phones rule at breakfast next week.
records.zomi: A zom kal zingsang an ah phone zat lo thukham i sin ding hi.

records.english: Well, I won't keep you, so have a good trip.
records.zomi: Hoih hi, kong khah lo ding a, khualzin hoih in.

records.english: I do apologize, and someone will look at it within the hour.
records.zomi: Hong maisak mahmah in, nai khat sungin mi khat in a en ding hi.

records.english: So the plan is that I wake the twins and you make breakfast?
records.zomi: Tua ahih leh geelna pen kei in apeng te ka phawngsak a, nang in zingsang an na huan ding hiam?

records.english: Exactly, and whoever finishes first packs the lunches.
records.zomi: Kician hi, a zo masa peuhpeuh in sun an a thun ding hi.

records.english: My son isn't used to getting up early, so the first week of term is always difficult.
records.zomi: Ka tapa zingsang tung-a thoh a ngeina hi lo ahih manin sang hun kipat kal masa a haksa tawntung hi.

records.english: The main issue in our house is that four people need the bathroom at exactly the same time.
records.zomi: I inn-a buaina lian pen mi li in kisilna inn hun kibang mah-in a kisap uh ahi hi.

records.english: My grandfather got up at five all his life, a habit he kept long after he had stopped farming.
records.zomi: Ka pu in a nuntak sung zingsang nai nga ciangin a thou a, lo a sep khawl khit sawt mahmah zongin tua ngeina a kem hi.

records.english: Night-shift workers often find it difficult to sleep during the day, especially in summer.
records.zomi: Zan nasemte in sun ah ihmut a haksa sa zel uh a, khal ciangin a haksa zaw hi.

records.english: Shall I bring you a coffee, or are you getting up now?
records.zomi: Coffee khat kong tawi sak ding hiam, ahih kei leh tu-in na thou ding hiam?

records.english: I heard it, and I'm getting up now, I promise.
records.zomi: Ka za khin a, tu-in ka thou ding hi, ka kiciam hi.

records.english: Grab your lunch from the fridge on your way out.
records.zomi: Na pai khiat lam ah khal bawm pan na sun an la in.

records.english: Explain to the children why they have to be dressed before they come down for breakfast.
records.zomi: Bang hangin zingsang an a nek ma-un puan a silh khin ding uh hiam naupangte kiangah gen siang in.

records.english: Turn the tap off while you brush your teeth.
records.zomi: Na ha na sil laitakin tui khuam khak in.

records.english: Don't leave the iron on while you answer the door.
records.zomi: Kongkhak na dawng laitakin puan meitut phong-in nusia kei in.

records.english: Excuse me, I'm sorry to complain, but there's been no hot water in room 12 this morning.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, thu ka hilh ding maisak in, ahi zongin tuni zingsang inndei 12 ah tui lum a om kei hi.

records.english: Who used my towel?
records.zomi: Ka puan keusakna kua in a zang hiam?

records.english: Here's how you tie your laces: make a loop, wrap the other lace round it, and pull it through.
records.zomi: Na khedap khau khih dan hih ahi hi: kual khat bawl inla, khau dang tawh tuam inla, a sung tawh la khia in.

records.english: The difficulty with winter mornings is that the children refuse to leave their warm beds.
records.zomi: Khuavot zingsangte haksatna pen naupangte in a lupna lum uh a nusia nuam kei uh ahi hi.

records.english: Sorry, I overslept, so I'll be there in twenty minutes.
records.zomi: Maisak in, ka ihmu sawt lua ahih manin minit sawm nih sungin ka tung ding hi.

records.english: If you check your phone as soon as you wake up, the whole morning feels rushed.
records.zomi: Na thoh pah-in na phone na en leh zingsang bup manlang taka om bang-in a kisa hi.

records.english: Teaching young children to dress themselves takes patience, but it saves a great deal of time later.
records.zomi: Naupang neute amau le amau puan silh dingin sin sak in thuakzawhna a kisam a, ahi zongin a nung ciangin hun tampi a khol hi.

records.english: If you ask me, a calm breakfast is worth more than an extra ten minutes in bed.
records.zomi: Kei hong dong leh zingsang an dai khat in lupna tung-a minit sawm behlap sangin a manpha zaw hi.

records.english: I'll make the porridge if you lay the table.
records.zomi: Dawhkan na kiman sak leh buh-an tui ka huan ding hi.

records.english: Could you check that I've switched off the hair straighteners?
records.zomi: Sam zaitsakna van ka khak khin hiam hong en sak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Neither of us is a morning person, so we prepare everything the night before.
records.zomi: I nih in zingsang tung-a thou ngeina mi hi lo ahih manin a zan ma-in khempeuh i kiman sak hi.

records.english: My daughter has started choosing her own clothes, which adds ten minutes but saves an argument.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in amah' puan teel a kipan a, minit sawm a behlap a, ahi zongin kinialna khat a kham hi.

records.english: Open the curtains as soon as you get up, because daylight helps you wake up.
records.zomi: Na thoh pah-in tukvuang puante hong in, sun vak in hong phawngsak ahih manin.

records.english: If the school started at nine instead of eight, teenagers might arrive more awake and ready to learn.
records.zomi: Sang nai giat hi lo-in nai kua ciangin a kipat leh khangnote phawng zaw-in sin dingin kiman zaw-in a tung kha ding uh hi.

records.english: Keep your shower to five minutes, because the hot water has to last for all four of us.
records.zomi: I mi li in tui lum i zat kim ding ahih manin minit nga sung bek kisil in.

records.english: Preparing lunches the night before means the morning can be spent on breakfast together.
records.zomi: Sun an a zan ma-in i kiman sak ciangin zingsang pen khawm-a zingsang an nek ah i zang thei hi.

records.english: No worries, we'll start without you.
records.zomi: Lungkham kei in, nang om lo-in i kipan ding hi.

records.english: Hang your coat on the hook, not over the chair.

records.zomi: Kanaan dotna hoih khat in a simpa a buaisak ding a kisam lo thu om lo-in a kicing thu bek a pia hi.

records.english: Once my daughter started drawing diagrams, she stopped getting lost in the longer questions.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in lim a gelh kipat khit ciangin dotna sau zawte ah a mang nawn kei hi.

records.english: Read the problem twice before you start calculating.
records.zomi: Na kanaan kipat ma-in dotna nihvei sim in.

records.english: My grandfather turned every trip to the market into a word problem for us.
records.zomi: Ka pu in zuakna mun ah i pai simin keite adingin kanaan dotna in a bawl hi.

records.english: Some students find it helpful to explain the problem aloud before they begin writing.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang pawl khat in a gelh kipat ma-un dotna aw-in gen siang pen a phattuam sa uh hi.

records.english: Personally, I enjoyed word problems more than plain sums, because they told a little story.
records.zomi: Keimah adingin kanaan dotnate tangthu neu khat a gen ahih manin kanaan baih bek sangin ka nuam sa zaw hi.

records.english: The teacher made us estimate the answer before we worked it out exactly.
records.zomi: Saya in a kician takin i sep ma-in a dawnna ngaihsun-in hong gen sak hi.

records.english: Which operation do you need here?
records.zomi: Hih ah kanaan lam bang na kisam hiam?

records.english: If the question had included the price per kilo, the problem would have been much easier to solve.
records.zomi: Dotna in kilo khat man a gen leh dotna dawn a baih zaw mahmah ding hi.

records.english: A garden is 8 metres long and 5 metres wide, so what is its area?
records.zomi: Huan khat metre 8 a sau a, metre 5 a zai a, tua ahih manin a zai bup bangzah ahi hiam?

records.english: It's 40 square metres.
records.zomi: Square metre 40 ahi hi.

records.english: Is the answer in metres or centimetres?
records.zomi: Dawnna metre hiam centimetre hiam?

records.english: I wrote a set of word problems about football for my nephew, who hates maths but loves sport.
records.zomi: Kanaan a huat a, kimawlna a it ka tanau adingin football thu kanaan dotna pawl khat ka gelh hi.

records.english: The challenge with word problems is often understanding the situation rather than doing the calculation.
records.zomi: Kanaan dotna haksatna pen kanaan sep sangin thu om dan theih ahi zel hi.

records.english: How many apples are left?
records.zomi: Apple bangzah a om lai hiam?

records.english: If three friends share a bill of $45 equally, how much does each of them pay?
records.zomi: Lawm thum in laimal $45 kibang takin a hawm uh leh khat ciat in bangzah a pia ding uh hiam?

records.english: Each of them pays $15.
records.zomi: Khat ciat in $15 a pia uh hi.

records.english: A class of 32 pupils is split into teams of four, so how many teams are there?
records.zomi: Sangnaupang 32 a om kilasi khat mi li ciat pawl-in a kikhen leh pawl bangzah a om ding hiam?

records.english: There are eight teams.
records.zomi: Pawl giat a om hi.

records.english: Tom reads 12 pages a day, so how many pages will he read in two weeks?

records.english: He'll read 168 pages.
records.zomi: Phek 168 a sim ding hi.

records.english: If the answer seems far too big or too small, check your working again.
records.zomi: Dawnna a lian lua hiam a neu lua bang a hih leh na kanaan en kik in.

records.english: Checking whether an answer makes sense is just as important as getting the arithmetic right.
records.zomi: Dawnna a kilawm hiam en pen kanaan dik ngah tawh a thupi kibang hi.

records.english: Breaking a long problem into smaller steps makes it far less frightening for most students.
records.zomi: Dotna sau khat kalsuan neu zawte-in khen in sangnaupang tamzaw adingin a lauhuai tawm zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: My son made up a word problem about our cat eating three tins of food a day.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in ni khat ah an bawm thum a ne i zawhngeu thu kanaan dotna khat a phuak hi.

records.english: I do want to understand word problems, but the long sentences confuse me.
records.zomi: Kanaan dotnate theih ka deih taktak a, ahi zongin kammal sau te in hong buaisak hi.

records.english: Underline the numbers and the question, so that you know what you're looking for.
records.zomi: Bang na zon hiam na theih nadingin nambatte leh dotna nuai ah ciamteh in.

records.english: Why did you multiply instead of adding?
records.zomi: Bang hangin behlap sangin na pung hiam?

records.english: Because the question says each box holds the same number, so it's quicker to multiply.
records.zomi: Dotna in bawm khat ciat in nambat kibang a koih hi, a ci ahih manin pung a manlang zaw hi.

records.english: Don't forget to write the units in your answer.
records.zomi: Na dawnna ah tehna min gelh mangngilh kei in.

records.english: If a car uses 6 litres of fuel for every 100 kilometres, how much does it need for 250 kilometres?
records.zomi: Mawtaw khat in kilometre 100 simin sathau litre 6 a zang leh kilometre 250 adingin bangzah a kisam ding hiam?

records.english: It needs 15 litres.

records.english: Comparing this year's results with last year's gave a much clearer picture of my mother's health.
records.zomi: Tu kum dawnnate kum nung-a te tawh i teh ciangin ka nu' cidamna a kician zaw mahmah-in i mu hi.

records.english: My father, who rarely complains, admitted at his follow-up that the pain had been keeping him awake.
records.zomi: Phun ngei lo ka pa in a en kikna ah a natna in a ihmusak kei hi, ci-in a pom hi.

records.english: My mother's follow-up visit was moved to Friday, because the specialist was ill.
records.zomi: Siavuan siam pen a cina ahih manin ka nu' en kikna Laithai ni ah kisuan hi.

records.english: How's your knee feeling now?

records.english: Better, but it still aches when it rains.
records.zomi: A hoih zaw hi, ahi zongin guah a zuk ciangin a na lai hi.

records.english: I'm sorry about the delay, and the doctor will see you in about ten minutes.
records.zomi: Na ngak sawt ding maisak in, siavuan in minit sawm bang ciangin hong mu ding hi.

records.english: The appointment reminder was sent by text two days before.

records.english: I'll see you again in six weeks.

records.english: Follow-up visits give doctors a chance to see whether a treatment is really working.
records.zomi: En kikna te in siavuante in zatui zatna a sem taktak hiam a et theih nadingun hun a pia hi.

records.english: My sister drove me to the follow-up visit, since I wasn't allowed to drive yet.
records.zomi: Mawtaw mawng kiphal nai lo ka hih manin ka sanggam numei in en kikna ah hong paipih hi.

records.english: If my aunt had kept her follow-up appointment, the problem might have been found sooner.
records.zomi: Ka ni in a en kikna kimuhna a pai leh buaina manlang zaw-in kimu kha ding hi.

records.english: Missing a follow-up appointment can mean starting the whole process again.
records.zomi: En kikna kimuhna khat mansuah in kalsuan bup kipan kik ding ci nopna a suak thei hi.

records.english: Can I change the time of my appointment?
records.zomi: Ka kimuhna hun ka khel thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, would Tuesday at two suit you?
records.zomi: Thei hi, Pithai ni nai nih ciangin na hun a kituak ding hiam?

records.english: Is it possible to have the follow-up appointment by phone instead of in person?
records.zomi: En kikna kimuhna mai leh mai sangin phone tawh nei theih hiam?

records.english: For this check, we need to see you, but the next one could be by phone.
records.zomi: Hih enna adingin kong mu ding a kisam a, ahi zongin a zom pen phone tawh hi thei hi.

records.english: I wish I'd written down the doctor's questions after my first visit.
records.zomi: Ka pai masa khit ciangin siavuan' dotnate ka gelh ngei leh ka deih hi.

records.english: My father's blood test results were compared with the ones from last year.
records.zomi: Ka pa' sisan enna dawnnate kum nung-a te tawh kiteh hi.

records.english: Excuse me, I don't want to make a fuss, but I've been waiting for over an hour.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, buaina bawl ka deih kei a, ahi zongin nai khat val ka ngak khin hi.

records.english: Everyone in the waiting room, please listen for your name, because the screen isn't working today.
records.zomi: Ngakna inndei-a mi khempeuh, tuni screen a sem kei ahih manin na min uh ngaikhia un.

records.english: Personally, I find it easier to be honest with a doctor who remembers my last visit.
records.zomi: Keimah adingin ka pai nunung a phawk siavuan kiangah thuman taka gen a baih zaw hi.

records.english: If you ask me, every clinic should offer evening appointments for people who work.
records.zomi: Kei hong dong leh siavuan inn khempeuh in nasem mite adingin nitak kimuhna a pia ding uh hi.

records.english: The nurse will ring you if your results need discussing.
records.zomi: Na dawnnate kikup a kisam leh nurse in hong sam ding hi.

records.english: The challenge for patients who live far away is finding transport for every appointment.
records.zomi: Gamla-a teeng damlote adingin haksatna pen kimuhna khempeuh adingin pai nading zon ahi hi.

records.english: Perfect, thank you.

records.english: Whether I need another scan will be decided at the next appointment.

records.english: Six weeks after my operation, I went back to the clinic for a check-up.

records.english: Have the new tablets made any difference?
records.zomi: Zatui thakte in kikhelna bangmah a bawl hiam?

records.english: A little, but I'd like to talk about the side effects.
records.zomi: Tawmno, ahi zongin a hoih lo lam thu kikum ka deih hi.

records.english: I do want to keep the appointment, but I may need to bring my son with me.
records.zomi: Kimuhna ka kem nuam taktak a, ahi zongin ka tapa ka tawi ding a kisam kha ding hi.

records.english: Could you send the results to my own doctor as well?
records.zomi: Dawnnate keimah' siavuan kiangah zong na khak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Could you write down what you'd like me to do before the next visit?

records.english: Video appointments are new to my grandfather, so I sit beside him and hold the screen.

records.english: Don't stop the treatment just because you feel better.
records.zomi: Na hoih zawh hang bek-in zatui zat khawl kei in.

records.english: Patients often feel more confident when they see the same doctor at each visit.
records.zomi: Damlote in pai simin siavuan kibang a muh ciangun a kingap zaw zel uh hi.

records.zomi: Tuni zingsang mi tam mahmah hi, a hi hiam?

records.english: It always is on Mondays, so I bring a book.
records.zomi: Pizing ni simin tua bang tawntung ahih manin laibu ka tawi hi.

records.zomi: Ka zom kimuhna ah bangmah ka tawi ding a kisam hiam?

records.english: A short list of changes since the last visit helps the doctor use the appointment well.
records.zomi: A nunung pai pan kikhelna list tom khat in siavuan in kimuhna hoih takin a zat nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Bring your glasses next time, please.
records.zomi: A zom vei ciangin na mitlimlang tawi in.

records.english: If the cough hasn't gone by the next appointment, the doctor will send you for an X-ray.
records.zomi: A zom kimuhna dong na khuh a dam kei leh siavuan in X-ray adingin hong sawl ding hi.

records.english: Once the clinic started sending text reminders, far fewer patients missed their appointments.
records.zomi: Siavuan inn in text phawksakna a khak kipat khit ciangin damlo tawm mahmah in a kimuhna uh a mansuah uh hi.

records.english: Please arrive ten minutes early so that we can take your blood pressure.
records.zomi: Na si khauhna i teh theih nadingin minit sawm ma-in hong tung in.

records.english: When is my next check-up?
records.zomi: Ka zom enna bang ciangin ahi hiam?

records.english: How have you been since your last visit?
records.zomi: Na pai nunung pan kipan bangci om na hi hiam?

records.english: Much better, thanks, although I still get tired in the afternoons.
records.zomi: A hoih zaw mahmah hi, lungdam ing, sun nung ciangin ka tawl lai hangin.

records.english: The physiotherapist checked how far I could bend my knee and wrote the number in my notes.
records.zomi: Taksa kibawl siatna siavuan in ka khuk bangzah ka kuai thei hiam a en a, ka laimal sungah nambat a gelh hi.

records.english: Please sit down, and the nurse will call you.
records.zomi: Tu in, nurse in hong sam ding hi.

records.english: I'd like to book a follow-up appointment for three months' time.
records.zomi: Kha thum khit ciang adingin en kikna kimuhna ka kilai nuam hi.

records.english: Who should I call if I have questions before then?
records.zomi: Tua ma-in dotna ka neih leh kua ka sam ding hiam?

records.english: The number is on your appointment card.
records.zomi: Nambat na kimuhna card tungah a om hi.

records.english: Thank you, doctor, and have a good afternoon.
records.zomi: Lungdam ing, siavuan, sun nung hoih nei in.

records.english: Did the doctor say anything about your results?
records.zomi: Siavuan in na dawnnate thu bangmah a gen hiam?

records.english: So, just to check, I come back in four weeks unless something changes?
records.zomi: Tua ahih leh, en kik ning, bangmah a kikhel kei leh kal li ciangin ka hong kik ding hiam?

records.zomi: Hi hi, leh na lungkham leh manlang zaw-in hong sam in.

records.english: I keep a diary of my symptoms between visits, so that I don't forget anything important.
records.zomi: Thupi bangmah ka mangngilh lohna dingin pai kikal ah ka natna lim te ka ciamteh hi.

records.english: Personally, I find it easier to agree a time by phone than through ten messages.
records.zomi: Keimah adingin message sawm tawh sangin phone tawh hun kithukim a baih zaw hi.

records.english: The teacher said, "I'm available after class every Tuesday if you have questions."

records.english: Would your brother be free to help us move on Sunday?

records.english: It's possible that the doctor will have a cancellation later today.
records.zomi: Tuni a nung ciangin siavuan in kimuhna kiphiat khat a nei kha thei hi.

records.english: When several people are involved, finding a date that suits everyone can be a real challenge.

records.zomi: Hih khedap size 40 na nei hiam?

records.english: My manager prefers to be asked about her availability in an email rather than in the corridor.

records.english: Is the swimming pool open to the public on Sunday mornings?

records.zomi: Kei hong dong leh mite in ngetna dawng lo-in nusia sangin kician takin nial zaw ding uh hi.

records.english: Checking availability early saves a great deal of disappointment later.
records.zomi: Ma-in a awng hiam en in a nung-a lungkiatna tampi a kham hi.

records.english: Are you free for a quick call this afternoon?

records.english: I'm afraid I'm in meetings until four, but I could do half past.

records.zomi: A zom kal bang ciangin na awng ding hiam?

records.english: The online calendar shows when each room is free.
records.zomi: Online ni kigelhna in inndei khat ciat bang ciangin a awng hiam a lak hi.
