records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in i laibu inn a khak dingin a geel ciangin nu leh pa pawl khat in min gelh ngetna a kipan uh hi.

records.english: Within a month, more than two thousand residents had signed it.
records.zomi: Kha khat sungin teeng tul nih val in a min uh a gelh uh hi.

records.english: The council agreed to keep the library open three days a week, run partly by volunteers.
records.zomi: Khuapi vaihawm in laibu inn kal khat ah ni thum a hon den dingin a thukim a, a khen khat thalawpte in a kem uh hi.

records.english: Anyone can speak at the public meeting, but you have to register beforehand.
records.zomi: Mipi kikhopna ah kuapeuh in thu a gen thei a, ahi zongin ma-in na min na gelh ding a kisam hi.

records.english: If more young people attended public meetings, the council would hear a wider range of views.
records.zomi: Khangno tam zaw in mipi kikhopna ah a kihel uh leh khuapi vaihawm in ngaihsutna tuamtuam a za tam zaw ding hi.

records.english: Thanks for coming, everyone, and see you next month.
records.zomi: Na hong manun lungdam ing, mi khempeuh, a zom kha ciangin kimu ni.

records.english: Could I join the community garden committee even though I'm new to the area?
records.zomi: Hih mun ah ka thak hangin mipi huan vaihawm pawl ah ka kihel thei ding hiam?

records.english: Absolutely, because we're always looking for fresh ideas.
records.zomi: Thei hi, ngaihsutna thak i zong tawntung ahih manin.

records.english: I'm not sure I have the time, but I'll ask my sister, who loves that kind of thing.
records.zomi: Hun ka nei ding hiam ka thei kei a, ahi zongin tua bang a deih ka sanggam numei ka dong ding hi.

records.english: Taking part in local decisions gives residents a sense that the town belongs to them.
records.zomi: Mun thukhenna ah kihelna in teengte in khuapi pen amau' ahi hi, ci a kisak nadingun a huh hi.

records.english: I see your point, but a car park would take away the only green space we have.
records.zomi: Na gen ka thei a, ahi zongin mawtaw koihna mun in i neih bek lopa mun a la ding hi.

records.english: Participation is easier when meetings are held at times that suit working parents.
records.zomi: Nasem nu leh pate adingin a kituak hun ah kikhopnate a om ciangin kihelna a baih zaw hi.

records.english: Community projects often depend on a few dedicated volunteers who quietly do most of the work.
records.zomi: Mipi nasepte in nasep a tamzaw dai takin a sem thalawp tawmno tungah a kinga zel hi.

records.english: We set up a neighborhood group to share tools instead of everyone buying their own.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh in amau' lei sangin nasep van kihawm nadingin inn veng pawl khat i bawl hi.

records.english: What's the residents' association working on this year?
records.zomi: Tu kum inn veng pawl in bang a sem uh hiam?

records.english: Mainly better lighting and a safer crossing near the school.
records.zomi: A tamzaw in meivak hoih zaw leh sang kiang-a kantanna bit zaw.

records.english: The plans for the new playground were changed after the children's suggestions were collected.
records.zomi: Naupangte' ngaihsutnate kikaikhawm khit ciangin kimawlna mun thak geelnate kikhel hi.

records.english: When is the next residents' meeting?
records.zomi: Inn veng kikhopna a zom bang ciangin ahi hiam?

records.english: Next Tuesday at seven, in the community room on the ground floor.
records.zomi: A zom Pithai ni nai sagih ciangin, nuai lam-a mipi inndei ah.

records.english: Please don't leave the meeting without filling in the feedback form.
records.zomi: Ngaihsutna lai dimsak lo-in kikhopna nusia kei un.

records.english: Sharing skills, such as bike repair or sewing, has brought very different neighbors together.
records.zomi: Siiksakol bawlsiat hiam puan khui hiam bang siamna kihawm in inn veng kibang lo mahmah te a kaikhawm hi.

records.english: That's fair, so maybe we should look for another site.
records.zomi: Tua pen a dik hi, tua ahih manin mun dang khat i zong zaw kha ding hi.

records.english: Bring your ideas for the empty shop on the corner.
records.zomi: A kiim-a dawl awng adingin na ngaihsutnate tawi un.

records.english: The youth council meets once a month to share young people's ideas with the mayor.
records.zomi: Khangno vaihawm pawl in khuapi ukpi kiangah khangnote' ngaihsutna hawm dingin kha simin a kikhop uh hi.

records.english: How can I volunteer at the community centre?
records.zomi: Mipi inn ah bangci-in thalawp-in ka sem thei ding hiam?

records.english: Just fill in the form at reception, and the coordinator will call you.
records.zomi: Mai lam ngakna ah lai dimsak bek in, makaipa in hong sam ding hi.

records.english: Could you explain how residents can comment on the plans for the new road?
records.zomi: Lampi thak geelnate tungah teengte in bangci-in ngaihsutna a pia thei uh hiam gen siang thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: You can write to the planning office or fill in the form online before the end of the month.
records.zomi: Kha a bei ma-in geelna office ah laikhak na gelh thei a, ahih kei leh online-in lai na dimsak thei hi.

records.english: Excuse me, I'm sorry to raise this again, but the streetlight outside the school still hasn't been repaired.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, hih thu gen kik ding maisak in, ahi zongin sang mai-a lampi meivak kibawl siang nai lo hi.

records.english: Good to see so many new faces tonight.
records.zomi: Tu zanin mai thak tampi muh a nuam hi.

records.english: Would you be willing to help translate the leaflet for families who are new to the area?
records.zomi: Hih mun ah a thak innkuante adingin laimai let dingin na huh nuam ding hiam?

records.english: If you ask me, every neighborhood should have a place where people can meet without spending money.
records.zomi: Kei hong dong leh inn veng khempeuh in sum zang lo-in mite a kimuh theih mun khat a nei ding uh hi.

records.english: I do want to get involved, but I can only help at weekends.
records.zomi: Ka kihel nuam taktak a, ahi zongin kal tawp ciangin bek ka huh thei hi.

records.english: We're going to plant fruit trees along the path by the school.
records.zomi: Sang kiang-a lampi neu kiim ah theigah kungte i suan ding hi.

records.english: Volunteers are needed to run the stalls at the summer fair.
records.zomi: Khal pawi ah zuakna dawhkante kem dingin thalawpte kisam hi.

records.english: Is there anything I can do to help?
records.zomi: Ka huh theih bangmah a om hiam?

records.english: Could you hand out the leaflets on your street?
records.zomi: Na lampi ah laimaite na hawm thei ding hiam?

records.english: We heard about it from the poster in the shop window.
records.zomi: Dawl tukvuang-a lim lai pan i za hi.

records.english: Sure, I'll do them on Saturday morning.
records.zomi: Thei hi, Kiginni zingsang ciangin ka hawm ding hi.

records.english: Who's chairing tonight's meeting?
records.zomi: Tu zan kikhopna kua in a makaih ding hiam?

records.english: I've joined the residents' association for our block of flats.
records.zomi: I inn bu adingin inn veng pawl ah ka kihel khin hi.

records.english: The bus route was restored after hundreds of people wrote to the transport company.
records.zomi: Mi za tampi in mawtaw puak company kiangah laikhak a gelh khit uh ciangin bus lampi kipia kik hi.

records.english: Did you sign the petition about the bus route?
records.zomi: Bus lampi thu min gelh ngetna na gelh hiam?

records.english: Yes, and I shared it with my whole street.
records.zomi: Ka gelh a, ka lampi bup tawh ka hawm hi.

records.english: Personally, I've learned more about my town from the residents' association than from any newspaper.
records.zomi: Keimah adingin thuthak lai bangpeuh sangin inn veng pawl pan ka khuapi thu tam zaw ka thei hi.

records.english: The street party was organized entirely by residents, with a small grant from the council.
records.zomi: Lampi pawi pen khuapi vaihawm pan sum huhna neu khat tawh teengte bek in a bawl uh hi.

records.english: Try restarting it, and then rejoin the call.
records.zomi: A kipan kik dingin phong kik inla, tua ciangin kisamna ah kihel kik in.

records.english: If the connection had dropped during the interview, I'd have had a phone number to call instead.
records.zomi: Kidotna laitakin a kizopna a tan kha leh a sangin sam ding phone nambat ka nei ding hi.

records.english: Turn your camera off if the connection keeps freezing.
records.zomi: A kizopna a khawl den leh na camera khak in.

records.english: Sorry to interrupt, but we lost you for a moment, so could you repeat the last point?
records.zomi: Hong khen ding maisak in, hun tawmno sung na aw a mang ahih manin na gen nunung gen kik thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Video calls have allowed families separated by thousands of kilometres to watch their children grow up.
records.zomi: Video call te in kilometre tul tampi-a kikhen innkuante in a tate uh a khan a et theih nadingun a phal hi.

records.english: We're going to call Grandpa after dinner.
records.zomi: Nitak an khit ciangin Pu i sam ding hi.

records.english: So the call is at three our time, which is nine in the evening for you?
records.zomi: Tua ahih leh kisamna i hun-in nai thum ciangin ahi a, nang adingin nitak nai kua ahi hiam?

records.english: That's right, so it suits me perfectly.
records.zomi: Hi hi, tua ahih manin hong kituak kim hi.

records.english: Sorry I'm late, because my internet was down.
records.zomi: Ka internet a sia ahih manin ka nun ding maisak in.

records.english: The main challenge in long video meetings is staying focused when you can't see people's reactions properly.
records.zomi: Video kikhopna sau-a haksatna lian pen mite' lungsim lahna hoih takin na muh theih loh ciangin na lungsim koih den ahi hi.

records.english: Can you see my screen now?
records.zomi: Tu-in ka screen na mu thei hiam?

records.english: Yes, it's clear now, thanks.
records.zomi: Mu thei ing, tu-in a kician hi, lungdam ing.

records.english: Yes, perfectly, thanks.
records.zomi: Mu thei ing, hoih kim hi, lungdam ing.

records.english: Once the team agreed to keep cameras on for the first five minutes, the meetings felt much friendlier.
records.zomi: Pawl in a kipatna minit nga sung camera phong-in om dingin a kithukim khit uh ciangin kikhopnate a nuam zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: Clear agendas are even more important online, because it's harder to interrupt politely.
records.zomi: Online ah kikhopna thu kician a thupi zaw hi, nemtaka khen a haksa zaw ahih manin.

records.english: The doctor's appointment will be held by video, so please find a quiet room.
records.zomi: Siavuan kimuhna video tawh kibawl ding ahih manin inndei dai khat zong in.

records.english: Is it all right if I join the meeting by phone, since I'm on the bus?
records.zomi: Bus tungah ka om ahih manin phone tawh kikhopna ah ka kihel leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: No problem, but keep yourself on mute when you're not talking.
records.zomi: Buaina om lo hi, ahi zongin na gen loh laitakin mute ah om in.

records.english: Click the link in the invitation a few minutes early, in case the app needs updating.
records.zomi: App in update a kisam kha leh ci-in minit tawmno ma-in sapna lai sung-a link nek in.

records.english: Who's hosting the meeting today?
records.zomi: Tuni kikhopna kua in a bawl hiam?

records.english: When colleagues in different time zones meet by video, someone always has to join very early or very late.
records.zomi: Hun kibang lo gam-a nasem pihte video tawh a kimuh ciangun kuamah khat in zingsang tung mahmah hiam zan sawt mahmah hiam kihel tawntung ding a kisam hi.

records.english: Move the phone closer so that I can see the cake.
records.zomi: Cake ka muh theih nadingin phone naih zaw-in koih in.

records.english: Lovely to see you all, and give the children a hug from me.
records.zomi: Note khempeuh kimuh a nuam hi, leh naupangte kei' kawikawina pia un.

records.english: If the sound is poor, try using headphones instead of the laptop speakers.
records.zomi: Aw a hoih kei leh laptop aw khahna sangin bil tung-a khu nading zang in.

records.english: Don't sit with your back to a bright window, or your face will be in shadow.
records.zomi: Tukvuang vak lam na nung ngat-in tu kei in, ahih kei leh na mai limliam sungah a om ding hi.

records.english: My grandmother, who had never used a computer, now organizes the family video call every month.
records.zomi: Computer zang ngei lo ka pi in tu-in kha simin innkuan video call a bawl hi.

records.english: Shall we have a video call on your birthday?
records.zomi: Na suahni-in video call i nei ding hiam?

records.english: I think we're out of time, so thanks, everyone, and I'll send the notes this afternoon.
records.zomi: I hun a bei khin hi, ka ci a, tua ahih manin lungdam ing, mi khempeuh, tu sun nung ciangin ciamtehnate ka khak ding hi.

records.english: A brief chat at the start of a call can make a remote team feel more connected.
records.zomi: Kisamna kipat ciangin kikupna tom khat in gamla-a nasem pawl a kizopna kisak zaw thei hi.

records.english: Grandma has learned to answer video calls by herself, and she rings us every Sunday.
records.zomi: Pi in amah bek-in video call dawng a sin khin a, Nipini simin hong sam hi.

records.english: Here's how to blur your background: click the three dots and choose "background effects".
records.zomi: Na nung lam a lan lohna dingin bawl dan hih ahi hi: dot thum nek inla, “background effects” teel in.

records.english: Oh, sorry about that, and can you hear me now?
records.zomi: Aw, tua thu maisak in, tu-in hong za thei hiam?

records.english: How's the weather over there today?
records.zomi: Tuni tua lam-a huihkhua bangci om hiam?

records.english: Freezing, but at least it's sunny.
records.zomi: Vot mahmah hi, ahi zongin ni a suak hi.

records.english: Could you share your screen, so that we can all see the document?
records.zomi: I khempeuh in document i muh theih nadingin na screen hong hawm thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Sure, I was saying that the deadline has moved to Friday.
records.zomi: Thei hi, a zawh ding ni Laithai ni ah kisuan hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: Your picture has frozen, so I'll call you back.
records.zomi: Na lim a khawl khin ahih manin kong sam kik ding hi.

records.english: The meeting was recorded, so anyone who missed it can watch it later.
records.zomi: Kikhopna kila ahih manin a mansuah kuapeuh in a nung ciangin a en thei hi.

records.english: Wave to Auntie, sweetheart!
records.zomi: Ka it, Ni kiangah khut kawp in!

records.english: I do want to see the baby, so could you turn the camera towards her?
records.zomi: Naungek mu ka deih taktak a, tua ahih manin camera amah lam ngat sak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Before my first video interview, my brother helped me test the camera and the sound.
records.zomi: Ka video kidotna masa ma-in ka sanggam pasal in camera leh aw en dingin hong huh hi.

records.english: We moved the laptop to the kitchen table, where the light from the window fell on my face.
records.zomi: Laptop an huanna dawhkan ah i suan a, tua ah tukvuang pan meivak ka mai tungah a tang hi.

records.english: When the interview started, I felt calm, because nothing technical went wrong.
records.zomi: Kidotna a kipat ciangin bangmah a khial kei ahih manin ka lungsim a dai hi.

records.english: Sorry, I think you're on mute.
records.zomi: Maisak in, mute ah na om hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: Mute yourself when you're not speaking, because we can hear your dog barking.
records.zomi: Na gen loh laitakin mute in, na ui hawm aw i za ahih manin.

records.english: I wish my parents had a faster internet connection, because the calls keep dropping.
records.zomi: Kisamna te a tan den ahih manin ka nu leh ka pa in internet manlang zaw a neih uh leh ka deih hi.

records.english: Neither of my cousins can join the call before nine, because of the time difference.
records.zomi: Hun kibanglohna hangin ka sanggam nih khat zong in nai kua ma-in kisamna ah a kihel thei kei uh hi.

records.english: If you ask me, every video meeting should end five minutes early.
records.zomi: Kei hong dong leh video kikhopna khempeuh minit nga ma-in a bei ding hi.

records.english: Don't worry, we've only just started.
records.zomi: Lungkham kei in, tu-in bek i kipan hi.

records.english: Thanks, bye for now.
records.zomi: Lungdam ing, tu adingin goodbye.

records.english: Personally, I'd rather have a short phone call than a long video meeting.
records.zomi: Keimah adingin video kikhopna sau sangin phone tom khat ka deih zaw hi.

records.english: Did you get the invitation for Monday's call?
records.zomi: Pizing ni kisamna adingin sapna lai na ngah hiam?

records.english: Yes, it's in my calendar.
records.zomi: Ngah ing, ka ni kigelhna ah a om hi.

records.english: Turn the volume up a little, please.
records.zomi: Aw tawmno khangsak in.

records.english: My son's class had a video call with a school in another country.
records.zomi: Ka tapa' kilasi in gam dang-a sang khat tawh video call a nei uh hi.

records.english: Taking a short break between video meetings helps people stay alert for the rest of the day.
records.zomi: Video kikhopna kikal ah tawlngak tom khat in mite ni bang ah a phawng den nadingun a huh hi.

records.english: My grandfather isn't used to seeing himself on a screen, so he keeps looking at his own picture.
records.zomi: Ka pu screen tungah amah le amah muh a ngeina hi lo ahih manin amah' lim a en den hi.

records.english: What's the link for tomorrow's call?
records.zomi: Zingciang kisamna adingin link bang ahi hiam?

records.english: Working from home with video meetings has saved many employees hours of travel every week.
records.zomi: Video kikhopna tawh inn pan nasep in nasem tampi kal simin khualzin nai tampi a khol sak hi.

records.english: My laptop camera isn't working.
records.zomi: Ka laptop camera a sem kei hi.

records.english: Christians use the term "general revelation" for what they believe God shows everyone through nature and conscience.
records.zomi: Khristiante in Pasian in leitung leh kitheihna lungsim tungtawn-in mi khempeuh a lak hi, ci-in a um uh pen “general revelation” ci-in a gen uh hi.

records.english: Our pastor explained that conscience is often described as part of general revelation.
records.zomi: I pastor in kitheihna lungsim pen Pasian' mi khempeuh tunga kilaksakna khen khat bangin kigen zel hi, ci-in a gen siang hi.

records.english: Can people know God just by looking at nature?
records.zomi: Mite in leitung et bek tawh Pasian a thei thei uh hiam?

records.english: Christians disagree about how much nature alone can show, but most say it points beyond itself.
records.zomi: Leitung bek in bangzah a lak thei hiam Khristiante a kilem kei uh a, ahi zongin a tamzaw in amah sang a thupi zaw a lak hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: If you ask me, wonder is the beginning of many good questions.
records.zomi: Kei hong dong leh lamdang sakna pen dotna hoih tampi' kipatna ahi hi.

records.english: It really is, and the singing sounded wonderful outside.
records.zomi: Hi taktak hi, leh la sak pua lam ah a hoih mahmah hi.

records.english: Look at how carefully a spider builds its web.
records.zomi: Maimbuh in a lambuh bangzah in limtakin a bawl hiam en in.

records.english: Do you think everyone has a sense of right and wrong?
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh in dik leh khial theihna a nei uh hi, na ci hiam?

records.english: I think most people do, even if they disagree about the details.
records.zomi: A tamzaw in a nei uh hi, ka ci hi, a thu neute ah a kilem kei uh hangin.

records.english: Some Christians believe that the beauty of the world is a gift meant to lead people to give thanks.
records.zomi: Khristian pawl khat in leitung hoihna pen mite lungdam a kohsak nading letsong ahi hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: What a beautiful evening!
records.zomi: Nitak nuam mahmah hi!

records.english: I do want to take the youth group to the mountains, so that they can see creation for themselves.
records.zomi: Khangno pawl in piangsakna amau mit tawh a muh theih nadingun mual tung ah paipih ka deih taktak hi.

records.english: On a camping trip, my father woke us at four to watch the sun rise over the mountains.
records.zomi: Puan inn khualzinna ah ka pa in mual tung-a ni suak en dingin nai li ciangin hong phawngsak hi.

records.english: Nobody spoke as the sky turned from grey to gold.
records.zomi: Van a sial pan kham bang a suak laitakin kuamah in thu a gen kei hi.

records.english: Afterwards he said quietly, "This is how I first started to believe in God."
records.zomi: A khit ciangin dai takin, “Hih bangin Pasian ka um masa hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: The idea of general revelation encourages Christians to respect people of other backgrounds who also seek what is good.
records.zomi: Pasian' mi khempeuh tunga kilaksakna ngaihsutna in Khristiante in hoihna a zong dang mite a zahtak nadingun a hanthawn hi.

records.english: Many Christians pray quietly when they are surrounded by beautiful scenery.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in mun hoih mahmah kiim ah a om ciangun dai takin thu a ngen uh hi.

records.english: If nature alone were enough, some theologians argue, there would be little need for Scripture.
records.zomi: Leitung bek in a tawk leh Laisiangtho kisapna tawm hi ding hi, ci-in Pasian thu siam pawl khat in a gen uh hi.

records.english: The children were taken outside to look at the leaves before the lesson on creation.
records.zomi: Piangsakna thu sinna ma-in naupangte singnah en dingin pua ah kipaipih hi.

records.english: A sense of fairness seems to appear even in very young children, my aunt observed.
records.zomi: Naupang neu mahmah te ah zong dik taka thukhenna theihna a kilang bang hi, ka ni in a ci hi.

records.english: Caring for the natural world makes sense to many Christians who see it as a sign of the Creator.
records.zomi: Leitung kemna pen Piangsakpa' lahna bangin a mu Khristian tampi adingin a kilawm hi.

records.english: Who wrote the psalm we read this morning?
records.zomi: Tuni zingsang i sim late kua in a gelh hiam?

records.english: Tradition links many of the psalms to King David, but not all of them.
records.zomi: Ngeina in late tampi David kumpipa tawh a zom a, ahi zongin a khempeuh hi lo hi.

records.english: Christian teachers usually distinguish general revelation from what they believe is revealed in Scripture and in Jesus.
records.zomi: Khristian saya te in Pasian' mi khempeuh tunga kilaksakna pen Laisiangtho leh Jesu ah kilak hi, a ci uh tawh a khen zel uh hi.

records.english: Shall we walk home the long way, by the river?
records.zomi: Gun kiang lam-a lampi sau zaw tawh inn ah i ciah ding hiam?

records.english: Explain what general revelation means in your own words.
records.zomi: Pasian' mi khempeuh tunga kilaksakna in bang a ci nopna hiam na kammal tawh gen siang in.

records.english: Our Sunday school class drew pictures of their favorite places in nature.
records.zomi: I Nipini sang kilasi in leitung-a a deih pen mun te lim a gelh uh hi.

records.english: In his letter to the Romans, Paul writes that God's power can be seen in what he has made.
records.zomi: Rom mite kianga a laikhak sungah Paul in Pasian' vangliatna a bawl te ah kimu thei hi, ci-in a gelh hi.

records.english: When I first saw the ocean, I understood why the psalm-writers spoke about the sea so often.
records.zomi: Tuipi ka muh masak ciangin bang hangin late gelhte in tuipi thu a gen tam uh hiam ka thei hi.

records.english: Some believers keep a nature journal, writing down what they notice each day.
records.zomi: Upmi pawl khat in ni simin a muh te ciamteh-in leitung ciamtehna laibu a nei uh hi.

records.english: My mother thanks God every time the first rain of the season arrives.
records.zomi: Ka nu in kum sung guah masa a zuk simin Pasian kiangah lungdam a ko hi.

records.english: Personally, I find it hard to look at a newborn baby without wondering about God.
records.zomi: Keimah adingin naungek piang thak khat en-in Pasian thu ngaihsun lo-in om a haksa hi.

records.english: The evening service was held outdoors, under the trees.
records.zomi: Nitak kikhopna pua ah singkungte nuai ah kibawl hi.

records.english: Can we stay and watch the stars a little longer?
records.zomi: Aksite tawmno sawt zaw en dingin i om thei ding hiam?

records.english: According to Genesis, God saw everything he had made and called it good.
records.zomi: Piancilna bangin Pasian in a bawl khempeuh a mu a, a hoih hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Many believers say they sense God's greatness when they look at the stars.
records.zomi: Upmi tampi in aksite a et ciangun Pasian' thupitna a kisa uh hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: Did you see the sunset over the hills last night?
records.zomi: Zan in mualte tung-a ni tum na mu hiam?

records.english: Please don't pick the flowers in the churchyard, because everyone enjoys them.
records.zomi: Pawlpi huang sung-a pakte lo kei in, mi khempeuh in a nuam sa uh ahih manin.

records.english: Walking in the hills each morning gives my father time to pray and to think.
records.zomi: Zingsang simin mual tung-a pai in ka pa thu ngen leh ngaihsun nading hun a pia hi.

records.english: Why do some people say they feel God in nature?
records.zomi: Bang hangin mi pawl khat in leitung ah Pasian a kisa uh hi, a ci uh hiam?

records.english: Where do you feel most at peace?
records.zomi: Koi ah na lungsim a dai pen hiam?

records.english: By the lake early in the morning, before anyone else is awake.
records.zomi: Zingsang tung takin dil kiang ah, mi dang a thoh ma-un.

records.english: Is that why you always stop to watch the birds?
records.zomi: Tua hang hiam vasate en dingin na khawl tawntung hiam?

records.english: Partly, and partly because they remind me to slow down.
records.zomi: A khen khat, leh a khen khat zawl zaw-in om dingin hong phawksak uh ahih manin.

records.english: Learning how the human body works has made my cousin, a nurse, more thoughtful about her faith.
records.zomi: Mihing taksa a sep dan sin in nurse ka sanggam a upna tungah a ngaihsun zaw sak hi.

records.english: We read a psalm about creation before the picnic.
records.zomi: Ankhopna ma-in piangsakna thu late khat i sim hi.

records.english: My uncle, a farmer all his life, says that watching seeds grow has taught him patience and gratitude.
records.zomi: A nuntak sung lo nei ka pa neu in khaici khang en in thuakzawhna leh lungdamna hong sin sak hi, a ci hi.

records.english: My grandmother says she feels closest to God when she's working in her garden.
records.zomi: Ka pi in a huan sungah a sep ciangin Pasian tawh a kinai pen-in a kisa hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Our church organized a walk in the woods followed by a short time of prayer.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in gam sung-a pai khat a bawl a, a khit ciangin thungetna hun tom khat a om hi.

records.english: The class collected leaves of different shapes and talked about the variety in creation.
records.zomi: Kilasi in a lim tuamtuam singnah te a kaikhawm uh a, piangsakna sung-a kibanglohna thu a kikum uh hi.

records.english: Theologians have long debated how much can be known about God without the Bible.
records.zomi: Pasian thu siamte in Laisiangtho om lo-in Pasian thu bangzah theih thei ding hiam sawt mahmah a kikum uh hi.

records.english: For many believers, a sense of wonder at the natural world is an invitation to ask deeper questions.
records.zomi: Upmi tampi adingin leitung tungah lamdang sakna pen dotna thuk zaw dong nading sapna ahi hi.

records.english: Psalm 19 begins by saying that the heavens declare the glory of God.
records.zomi: Late 19 in vante in Pasian' thupina a gen uh hi, ci-in a kipan hi.

records.english: Do you believe the stars tell us anything about God?
records.zomi: Aksite in Pasian thu bangmah hong hilh hi, na um hiam?

records.english: You're very welcome, and let's do it again in spring.
records.zomi: Bangmah hi lo hi, leh spring ciangin i bawl kik ding hi.

records.english: My science teacher, who is a Christian, says that studying nature deepens her faith rather than weakening it.
records.zomi: Khristian ahi ka science saya in leitung sin in a upna a hatsak zaw a, a kiamsak kei hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Christian traditions differ on how far conscience can be trusted as a guide.
records.zomi: Khristian ngeinate in kitheihna lungsim lampi lakna bangin bangzah muan theih hiam a kibang kei uh hi.

records.english: What do Christians mean by general revelation?
records.zomi: Khristiante in Pasian' mi khempeuh tunga kilaksakna a ci ciangun bang a ci nopna uh hiam?

records.english: They mean that something of God can be known by anyone, through the world and the human sense of right and wrong.
records.zomi: Leitung leh mihing' dik leh khial theihna tungtawn-in Pasian thu khat peuhpeuh kuapeuh in a thei thei hi, ci nopna ahi hi.

records.english: Thank you for leading the walk, because it was a lovely way to start the day.
records.zomi: Pai na makaih manin lungdam ing, sun kipatna nuam mahmah ahi hi.

records.english: I wish shops showed the full price, including tax, on every label.
records.zomi: Dawlte in ciamtehna khempeuh tungah siah kihel man bup a lak uh leh ka deih hi.

records.english: The electricity costs less at night, so we run the washing machine after ten.
records.zomi: Zan ah meivak man a neu zaw ahih manin nai sawm khit ciangin puan sawpna set i zang hi.

records.english: When a supplier won't explain what's included, it's sensible to look elsewhere.
records.zomi: Van piapa in bang a kihel hiam a gen siang nuam kei ciangin mun dang ah zong leh a pil hi.

records.english: Don't pay the full amount before the work is finished.
records.zomi: Nasep a zawh ma-in man bup pia kei in.

records.english: She asked whether the price would stay the same after the first year.
records.zomi: Kum masa khit ciangin man a kibang den ding hiam a dong hi.

records.english: My father isn't used to paying for water, because the village had a free well.
records.zomi: Ka pa tui man piak a ngeina hi lo hi, khua in tuikhuk man om lo a nei ahih manin.

records.english: No problem, and the offer is on until Sunday.
records.zomi: Buaina om lo hi, leh man kiamsakna Nipini dong a om hi.

records.english: If the gym had explained the joining fee clearly, I wouldn't have felt misled.
records.zomi: Gym in a kihelna man kician takin a gen siang leh khemna ka kisa lo ding hi.

records.english: Prices for the same flight can change several times a day, depending on demand.
records.zomi: Vanleng kibang khat man deih mi tam zah tungah kinga-in ni khat sungin vei tampi a kikhel thei hi.

records.english: Sorry, I didn't catch the last part, so was that $14 a month or $40?
records.zomi: Maisak in, a nunung ka za kician kei hi, tua ahih manin kha khat ah $14 hiam $40 hiam?

records.english: Forty, I'm afraid, but it includes unlimited calls.
records.zomi: Sawm li, ka lau hi, ahi zongin phone sam ciang om lo a kihel hi.

records.english: I'm sorry, but this isn't the price that was on the label.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, ahi zongin hih pen ciamtehna tung-a man hi lo hi.

records.english: I'll ask the plumber what he charges for a call-out.
records.zomi: Tui khuam bawlpa a hong man bangzah ahi hiam ka dong ding hi.

records.english: How much would it cost to have the bike repaired rather than buy a new one?
records.zomi: Siiksakol thak lei sangin bawl dam man bangzah ding hiam?

records.english: About $30, which is much less than a new one.
records.zomi: $30 bang, a thak sangin a neu zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: How much do you charge for delivery to the next village?
records.zomi: A zom khua dong van puak man bangzah na la hiam?

records.english: Are drinks included in the price?
records.zomi: Dawn ding te man sungah a kihel hiam?

records.english: Only water, but you can buy juice separately.
records.zomi: Tui bek, ahi zongin juice tuam-in na lei thei hi.

records.english: Prices are often lower at the end of the day at our market, because the stallholders don't want to carry everything home.
records.zomi: Zuakna dawhkan neite in van khempeuh inn ah a pua kik nuam kei uh ahih manin i zuakna mun ah ni tawp ciangin man a niam zaw zel hi.

records.english: Neither of the hotels would tell us the price without our exact dates.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk nih khat zong in ni kician om lo-in man hong gen kei uh hi.

records.english: If the price goes up, will you let us know before you order the parts?
records.zomi: Man a khan leh van khenkhatte na ngen ma-in hong hilh ding hiam?

records.english: Why is the same train ticket cheaper after half past nine?
records.zomi: Bang hangin meileng lai kibang mah nai kua leh a kim khit ciangin a man neu zaw hiam?

records.english: Because fewer people travel then, so the railway charges less to fill the seats.
records.zomi: Tua hun ciangin mi tawm zaw in khualzin uh ahih manin tutnate a dim nadingin meileng in man niam zaw a la hi.

records.english: Before the builder starts, ask him for a written quote rather than a rough estimate.
records.zomi: Inn lampa a kipat ma-in man ngaihsut sangin kigelh man gen ngen in.

records.english: A quote is a fixed price, while an estimate can go up once the work has begun.
records.zomi: Kigelh man pen man kician ahi a, man ngaihsut pen nasep a kipat khit ciangin a khang thei hi.

records.english: If he refuses to put anything in writing, find someone else.
records.zomi: Bangmah gelh nuam lo leh mi dang khat zong in.

records.english: Do you know whether the price on the website is the same as in the shop?
records.zomi: Website tung-a man leh dawl-a man a kibang hiam na thei hiam?

records.english: Understanding how a bill is calculated makes it much easier to spot a mistake.
records.zomi: Laimal bangci-in kisim hiam theih in khialhna muh a baihsak mahmah hi.

records.english: Is this price for one person or for two?
records.zomi: Hih man mi khat adingin ahi hiam, mi nih adingin ahi hiam?

records.english: For two, and breakfast is included.
records.zomi: Mi nih adingin, leh zingsang an a kihel hi.

records.english: The man at the garage told me the parts would cost more than the labor.
records.zomi: Mawtaw bawlna-a pasal in van khenkhat man in nasep man sangin a tam zaw ding hi, hong ci hi.

records.english: Could you tell me whether there are any extra fees on top of the monthly price?
records.zomi: Kha sim man tung ah man behlap bangmah a om hiam hong gen thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Only a one-off connection charge of $25, which is waived if you sign up online.
records.zomi: Vei khat bek kizopna man $25, online-in na min na gelh leh ki-ngaihsut lo hi.

records.english: My son asked why the same shoes were cheaper in the sale, and I explained that the shop needed space for new ones.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in bang hangin khedap kibang mah man kiamsakna sungah a man neu zaw hiam a dong a, dawl in a thakte adingin mun a kisam hi, ci-in ka gen siang hi.

records.english: Is there a charge for using the toilets?
records.zomi: Ek inn zat man a om hiam?

records.english: Could we pay for the course in three parts instead of all at once?
records.zomi: Sinna man vei khat-in pia sangin khen thum-in i pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, as long as each part is paid before the next term starts.
records.zomi: Thei hi, a zom sinna hun a kipat ma-in khen khat ciat a kipiak leh.

records.english: The discount was applied automatically at the checkout, which was a pleasant surprise.
records.zomi: Man piakna mun ah man kiamsakna amah mah-in a kihel a, tua in lamdang takin hong kipaksak hi.

records.english: Write the price on a sticker, so that the customer can see it.
records.zomi: Leipa in a muh theih nadingin sticker khat tungah man gelh in.

records.english: Thanks, that's very helpful, and I'll think about it.
records.zomi: Lungdam ing, tua in hong huh mahmah a, ka ngaihsun ding hi.

records.english: At the night market, people expect you to bargain, but in the shopping centre the prices are fixed.
records.zomi: Zan zuakna mun ah mite in man na kinial ding a lamen uh a, ahi zongin dawl lian ah man kician a om hi.

records.english: Explaining prices to children helps them understand why some things have to wait.
records.zomi: Naupangte kiangah man gen siang in bang hangin van pawl khat ngak ding a kisam hiam a thei nadingun a huh hi.

records.english: How do I find out how much my water bill will be before it arrives?
records.zomi: Ka tui laimal a tun ma-in bangzah ding hiam bangci-in ka thei thei ding hiam?

records.english: Check the meter on the first day of the month and compare it with last month's reading.
records.zomi: Kha ni masa pen-in meter en inla, kha nung-a tehna tawh teh in.

records.english: It's reasonable to ask a tradesperson how they arrived at their figure.
records.zomi: Nasep siam khat kiangah a man bangci-in a sim hiam dong pen a kilawm hi.

records.english: Why are cinema tickets more expensive on Friday nights?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Laithai ni zan ciangin limlah en lai a man tam zaw hiam?

records.english: Because that's when most people want to go out.
records.zomi: Tua hun ciangin mi tamzaw in pua ah pai a deih uh ahih manin.

records.english: You're right, and I'll correct it for you now.
records.zomi: Na gen a dik hi, tu-in kong bawl dik sak ding hi.

records.english: Ask how much it costs to cancel before you book anything for the holiday.
records.zomi: Tawlngakni adingin bangmah na kilai ma-in phiat man bangzah ahi hiam dong in.

records.english: Comparing what is included matters more than comparing the headline price.
records.zomi: A man lian pen teh sangin bang a kihel hiam teh a thupi zaw hi.

records.english: A very low price for a phone from a stranger online should make you ask where it came from.
records.zomi: Online-in theih loh mi khat pan phone man niam mahmah khat in koi pan hong pai hiam na dot ding hi.

records.english: The taxi fare is calculated by the meter, so ask the driver to switch it on.
records.zomi: Taxi man meter in a sim ahih manin mawtaw mawngpa kiangah phong dingin ngen in.

records.english: If we pay for the whole year at once, we'll get two months free.
records.zomi: Kum khat bup vei khat-in i piak leh kha nih man om lo-in i ngah ding hi.

records.english: Here's how the deposit works: you pay a third now, and the rest when the sofa is delivered.
records.zomi: Kipiak khol sum a sep dan hih ahi hi: tu-in khen thum sung khen khat na pia a, a bang tutphah a tun ciangin na pia ding hi.

records.english: Asking about cancellation fees before booking would have saved us a lot of money last summer.
records.zomi: Kilai ma-in phiat man thu dong leh khal nung in sum tampi i khol ding hi.

records.english: Students get half price at the cinema on Tuesdays if they show their card.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte in a card uh a lak uh leh Pithai ni-in limlah inn ah man kim bek a pia uh hi.

records.english: My aunt, who sold vegetables for thirty years, can still tell you the price of almost anything at the market.
records.zomi: Kum sawm thum sung anteh a zuak ka ni in zuakna mun-a van khempeuh dek a man a gen thei lai hi.

records.english: The mechanic explained each item on the bill, which made the total easier to accept.
records.zomi: Mawtaw bawlpa in laimal tung-a van khat ciat a gen siang a, tua in a vekpi man pom a baihsak zaw hi.

records.english: Excuse me, where can I find the price list for the photocopies?
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, photocopy man list koi ah ka mu thei ding hiam?

records.english: The price of the tour includes lunch, but not the entrance to the palace.
records.zomi: Khualzinna man ah sun an a kihel a, ahi zongin kumpi inn sung lut man kihel lo hi.

records.english: Keeping a digital copy of every receipt makes returns and warranty claims far simpler.
records.zomi: Laimal khempeuh copy computer sungah na kem leh van lohsak kikna leh kemsakna ngetna a baih zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: Online scams often ask for payment by bank transfer, because it's hard to reverse.
records.zomi: Online khemnate in bank pan sum khak tawh man pia dingin a ngen zel uh hi, lak kik a haksa ahih manin.

records.english: You too, bye.
records.zomi: Nang zong, goodbye.

records.english: Is there a cash machine near here?
records.zomi: Hih kiang ah sum lakna set a om hiam?

records.english: There's one inside the supermarket, by the entrance.
records.zomi: Dawl lian sung ah khat a om hi, a lutna kiang ah.

records.english: My grandfather isn't used to paying by phone, so he still keeps a few notes in his wallet.
records.zomi: Ka pu phone tawh man piak a ngeina hi lo ahih manin a sum ip sungah sum lai tawmno a kem lai hi.

records.english: The money was transferred to the wrong account, and it took a week to get it back.
records.zomi: Sum account khial ah kikhak a, a la kik dingin kal khat a sawt hi.

records.english: Check the amount on the card machine before you tap, because mistakes are easy to make.
records.zomi: Na nek ma-in card set tung-a sum zah en in, khialhna a baih ahih manin.

records.english: When will the refund appear on my card?
records.zomi: Sum lohsak kik ka card ah bang ciangin a hong lang ding hiam?

records.english: Usually within three to five working days, depending on your bank.
records.zomi: Na bank tungah kinga-in nasep ni thum pan nga sungin a lang zel hi.

records.english: My aunt, who ran a café for years, could tell whether the till was right just by looking at the coins.
records.zomi: Kum tampi sung cafe a kem ka ni in dangka en bek tawh sum bawm a dik hiam a thei thei hi.

records.english: If the shop says the machine is broken, ask whether there's a cash machine nearby.
records.zomi: Dawl in set a sia hi, a ci leh a kiang ah sum lakna set a om hiam dong in.

records.english: If the bank had warned me about the overseas fee, I would have paid in cash instead.
records.zomi: Bank in gamdang man behlap thu hong hilh leh sum tawh ka pia zaw ding hi.

records.english: Sorry, your card has been declined, so would you like to try another one?
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, na card kisang lo ahih manin a dang khat na sin ding hiam?

records.english: When a payment is declined, a calm word from the cashier can spare the customer a lot of embarrassment.
records.zomi: Man piakna a kisan loh ciangin sum sangpa' kammal dai khat in lei pa zumna tampi a kham thei hi.

records.english: I asked my employer to split my salary between two accounts, so that some of it is saved automatically.
records.zomi: Ka khasum a khen khat amah mah-in a kikoih theih nadingin account nih ah khen dingin ka nasepna neipa ka ngen hi.

records.english: My mother asked the cashier whether she could have some cash back with her shopping.
records.zomi: Ka nu in a van lei tawh sum tawmno a la thei ding hiam sum sangpa a dong hi.

records.english: To check your change quickly, start from the price and count up to the amount you paid.
records.zomi: Na sum lehkik manlang takin en nadingin a man pan kipan na piak zah dong sim tou in.

records.english: If something costs $7 and you pay with a $10 note, count eight, nine, ten as the coins go into your hand.
records.zomi: Van khat $7 a man a, $10 lai tawh na piak leh dangka na khut sungah a lut laitakin giat, kua, sawm ci-in sim in.

records.english: That way, you'll know you should have received $3.
records.zomi: Tua bangin $3 na ngah ding hi, ci na thei ding hi.

records.english: Don't let anyone stand too close behind you while you type your PIN.
records.zomi: Na PIN na gelh laitakin kuamah na nung ah a nai lua-in ding sak kei in.

records.english: Excuse me, I don't think the discount was taken off at the till.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, sum sangna ah man kiamsakna kila lo hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: How embarrassing, but let me pay in cash instead.
records.zomi: Zum huai mahmah hi, ahi zongin sum tawh pia zaw ning.

records.english: Small shops sometimes prefer cash, because card companies take a percentage of every payment.
records.zomi: Card company te in man piak khempeuh pan percent khat a lak uh ahih manin dawl neu pawl khat in sum a deih zaw uh hi.

records.english: Remember to cancel the gym payments before you move.
records.zomi: Na kitawn ma-in gym man piakna phiat phawk in.

records.english: To pay with your phone, open the app, scan the code on the counter, and type in the amount.
records.zomi: Na phone tawh man pia dingin app hon inla, dawhkan tung-a code scan inla, sum zah gelh in.

records.english: Claim your work expenses within a month, or the finance office may refuse them.
records.zomi: Na nasep zat sum kha khat sungin ngen in, ahih kei leh sum kemna office in a nial kha ding hi.

records.english: Here's how we'll split the bill: everyone pays for their own meal, and we share the dessert.
records.zomi: Laimal i hawm dan hih ahi hi: mi khempeuh in amau' an man a pia ding uh a, an khum i hawm ding hi.

records.english: Can you lend me a few coins for the locker?
records.zomi: Van koihna bawm adingin dangka tawmno hong ngetsak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: I'll pay you back tomorrow, I promise.
records.zomi: Zingciang kong pia kik ding hi, ka kiciam hi.

records.english: Put your PIN in, and then press the green button.
records.zomi: Na PIN gelh inla, tua ciangin a eng button nek in.

records.english: Neither of the taxis would take a card, so we had to stop at a cash machine.
records.zomi: Taxi nih khat zong in card a sang kei uh ahih manin sum lakna set ah i khawl ding a kisam hi.

records.english: Let me check the till, and I'll sort it out for you.
records.zomi: Sum bawm en ning a, kong bawl siang sak ding hi.

records.english: Could you explain why the bank charged me a fee for paying in a foreign currency?
records.zomi: Bang hangin gamdang sum tawh ka piak manin bank in man behlap hong la hiam gen siang thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Some cards add a small charge for every payment made abroad, so check before you travel.
records.zomi: Card pawl khat in gamdang-a man piak khempeuh adingin man neu khat a behlap ahih manin na khualzin ma-in en in.

records.english: Checking your statement each month helps you notice payments you didn't make.
records.zomi: Kha simin na sum lai na en leh na piak loh man piaknate na mu thei hi.

records.english: Paying in cash helps some people stay within their weekly budget.
records.zomi: Sum tawh man piak in mi pawl khat in kal sim sum zat geel a kem nadingun a huh hi.

records.english: Keep a photo of each receipt, in case the paper copy fades.
records.zomi: Laidal a ngo kha leh ci-in laimal khat ciat lim kem in.

records.english: The parking machine only takes coins, which is annoying when you have none.
records.zomi: Mawtaw koihna man set in dangka bek a sang a, na neih kei ciangin a lungkhamhuai hi.

records.english: Do you charge extra if I pay by card?
records.zomi: Card tawh ka piak leh man behlap na la hiam?

records.english: No, it's the same price whichever way you pay.
records.zomi: La lo hi, bangci-in na pia zongin man kibang hi.

records.english: Do you need a receipt?
records.zomi: Laimal na kisam hiam?

records.english: No, thanks, I've got the email.
records.zomi: Kisam lo hi, lungdam ing, email ka nei khin hi.

records.english: Is it all right if I pay you back on Friday, when I get paid?
records.zomi: Ka khasum ka ngah ciangin Laithai ni-in kong pia kik leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: No rush, Friday is fine.
records.zomi: Manlang kei in, Laithai ni a hoih hi.

records.english: I'll set up a standing order, so that the rent is paid automatically on the first of each month.
records.zomi: Kha simin ni masa pen-in inn man amah mah-in a kipiak nadingin bank ah thu ka koih ding hi.

records.english: The parking machine printed a ticket, but the barrier wouldn't open.
records.zomi: Mawtaw koihna man set in lai khat a khen a, ahi zongin a khakna a hong kei hi.

records.english: The convenience of paying by phone can make it easy to lose track of small amounts.
records.zomi: Phone tawh man piak a baih manin man neu te a mangngilh baih thei hi.

records.english: Is there a minimum amount for paying by card?
records.zomi: Card tawh man piak adingin a niam pen zah a om hiam?

records.english: Only for purchases under $5, I'm afraid.
records.zomi: $5 nuai-a van adingin bek, ka lau hi.

records.english: Teaching children to handle real coins gives them a better feel for money than any app.
records.zomi: Naupangte dangka taktak zat sin sak in app bangpeuh sangin sum theihna hoih zaw a pia hi.

records.english: I wish more market stalls took cards, because I never carry cash anymore.
records.zomi: Ka sum ka tawi ngei nawn kei ahih manin zuakna dawhkan tam zaw in card a sang leh ka deih hi.

records.english: Splitting a bill fairly can be surprisingly difficult when some people only had a salad.
records.zomi: Pawl khat in anteh hing bek a nek uh ciangin laimal dik takin hawm lamdang takin a haksa thei hi.

records.english: So you've taken $40 for the shoes, and the socks were free with them?

records.english: When you're abroad, it's often better to pay in the local currency rather than your own.

records.english: Teachers who use the agreed terms in class help children learn them naturally.

records.english: The health leaflets were translated using the same terms as the clinic's posters.

records.english: Some people prefer borrowed words, because everyone already understands them.
records.zomi: Mi pawl khat in mi khempeuh in a thei khin uh ahih manin kammal ngetsakte a deih zaw uh hi.

records.english: Online word lists have made it easier for translators in different countries to work together.
records.zomi: Online kammal list te in gam tuamtuam-a lai lettute khawm-a sep a baihsak zaw hi.

records.english: Don't invent a new term if an agreed one already exists.
records.zomi: Kithukim khat a om khin leh kammal thak phuak kei in.

records.english: The terminology list was updated after readers pointed out several confusing words.
records.zomi: Simte in kammal buaihuai tampi a lak khit uh ciangin kammal kithukim list kibawl thak hi.

records.english: Why does the dictionary list two words for the same tool?
records.zomi: Bang hangin kammal laibu in nasep van khat adingin kammal nih a gelh hiam?

records.english: Because each one is used in a different area, and both are correct.
records.zomi: Khat ciat mun tuamtuam ah kizang a, a nih in a dik ahih manin.

records.english: Others feel that creating new Zomi words keeps the language strong.
records.zomi: A dang te in Zomi kammal thak phuak in pau a hatsak hi, ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi.

records.english: Please check the glossary before you translate any medical words.
records.zomi: Siavuan lam kammal na let ma-in kammal gen siangna list en masa in.

records.english: Who decides which words become the standard ones?
records.zomi: Kammal bang in a kizat dan pen suak ding hiam kua in a thukhen hiam?

records.english: Usually a committee of teachers, pastors and writers, after asking the wider community.
records.zomi: A tamzaw in mipi a dot khit uh ciangin saya te, pastor te leh lai gelhte' vaihawm pawl in.

records.english: Last year, a group of teachers met to agree on the Zomi words for school subjects.
records.zomi: Kum nung in saya pawl khat in sang sinna lamte adingin Zomi kammal kithukim dingin a kikhop uh hi.

records.english: They listed the terms each school was using and compared them one by one.
records.zomi: Sang khat ciat in a zat kammalte a gelh uh a, khat zawh khat a kiteh uh hi.

records.english: By the end of the year, every school had the same short glossary for science and mathematics.
records.zomi: Kum a bei ciangin sang khempeuh in science leh kanaan adingin kammal gen siangna list tom kibang a nei uh hi.

records.english: My aunt helped write the first word list for the women's health group.
records.zomi: Ka ni in numei cidamna pawl adingin kammal list masa pen gelh a huh hi.

records.english: Could you send me the latest version of the church terminology list?
records.zomi: Pawlpi kammal kithukim list thak pen hong khak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: In formal texts, translators usually follow the glossary even when people use a different word at home.
records.zomi: Lai thupi te ah inn ah mite in kammal dang a zat uh hangin lai lettute in kammal gen siangna list a zui zel uh hi.

records.english: What do people in your community call a mobile phone in Zomi?
records.zomi: Na mipi in Zomi pau tawh mobile phone bang a ci uh hiam?

records.english: Most people use a borrowed word, but some prefer a newer Zomi term.
records.zomi: Mi tamzaw in kammal ngetsak a zang uh a, ahi zongin pawl khat in Zomi kammal thak zaw a deih zaw uh hi.

records.english: A shared list of terms makes it possible for many volunteers to translate one long book together.
records.zomi: Kammal kihawm list khat in thalawp tampi in laibu sau khat khawm-in a let theih nadingin a phal hi.

records.english: Which words were the hardest to agree on?
records.zomi: Kammal bangte kithukim a haksa pen hiam?

records.english: The ones for new technology, because they change so quickly.
records.zomi: Technology thak adingin te, manlang takin a kikhel uh ahih manin.

records.english: We need a simple word for this, because children will read it.
records.zomi: Naupangte in a sim ding uh ahih manin hih adingin kammal baih khat i kisam hi.

records.english: Can you help me check these terms?
records.zomi: Hih kammalte en dingin hong huh thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: The challenge for terminology committees is balancing tradition with the need for new words.
records.zomi: Kammal vaihawm pawlte adingin haksatna pen ngeina leh kammal thak kisapna kibang taka koih ahi hi.

records.english: Is it all right if I add a note when I'm not sure which term to use?
records.zomi: Kammal bang zat ding hiam ka theih kician loh ciangin ciamtehna khat ka behlap leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, please, because those notes help us improve the list.
records.zomi: Hoih hi, behlap in, tua ciamtehnate in list i hoihsak nadingin hong huh ahih manin.

records.english: If the medical terms had been agreed earlier, the first health leaflets would have been much clearer.
records.zomi: Siavuan lam kammalte manlang zaw-in kithukim leh damna laimai masa te a kician zaw mahmah ding hi.

records.english: Shall we add this word to the glossary?
records.zomi: Hih kammal kammal gen siangna list ah i behlap ding hiam?

records.english: Not yet, because we should ask a few more people first.
records.zomi: Behlap nai lo ni, mi tawmno beh i dot ding a kisam ahih manin.

records.english: A good glossary explains each term with a short example, so that readers know how to use it.
records.zomi: Kammal gen siangna list hoih khat in simte in bangci-in zang ding hiam a theih nadingun kammal khat ciat entelna tom tawh a gen siang hi.

records.english: Our translators keep a shared list of agreed terms, so that the same word is used every time.
records.zomi: I lai lettute in kammal kibang mah a kizat tawntung nadingin kammal kithukim kihawm list khat a kem uh hi.

records.english: A term only becomes standard when people actually start using it, not when a committee approves it.
records.zomi: Kammal khat pen vaihawm pawl in a phal ciangin hi lo-in mite in a zat taktak kipat ciangin bek a kizat dan pen a suak hi.

records.english: I do want to use the standard terms, but I'm not always sure what they are.
records.zomi: Kammal kithukimte zat ka deih taktak a, ahi zongin bangte ahi hiam ka thei kician ngei kei hi.

records.english: Once the glossary was printed, it became one of the most borrowed books in the church library.
records.zomi: Kammal gen siangna list a kikhen khit ciangin pawlpi laibu inn-a kingetsak tam pen laibu khat a suak hi.

records.english: Older speakers sometimes use different words from younger ones for the same thing.
records.zomi: Pau gen upate in a khangno te tawh thu kibang mah adingin kammal tuamtuam a zang zel uh hi.

records.english: Where can I find the agreed list of terms?
records.zomi: Kammal kithukim list koi ah ka mu thei ding hiam?

records.english: On the community website, in the section for translators.
records.zomi: Mipi website tungah, lai lettute adingin a khenna ah.

records.english: How long did it take to agree on the new terms?
records.zomi: Kammal thakte kithukim dingin hun bangzah a sawt hiam?

records.english: Almost two years, because everyone had strong opinions.
records.zomi: Kum nih dek, mi khempeuh in ngaihsutna khauh a nei uh ahih manin.

records.english: The new terms for computer parts were tested with students before they were published.
records.zomi: Computer khenkhat adingin kammal thakte a kikhen ma-in sangnaupangte tawh kisin masa hi.

records.english: You're welcome, and tell us if anything is missing.
records.zomi: Bangmah hi lo hi, leh bangmah a kiam leh hong hilh un.

records.english: Is this term used everywhere, or only in some places?
records.zomi: Hih kammal mun khempeuh ah kizang hiam, mun pawl khat bek ah kizang hiam?

records.english: Different views about new words are a sign that people care about the language.
records.zomi: Kammal thak tungah ngaihsutna tuamtuam pen mite in pau a ngaihsun uh hi, cih lahna ahi hi.

records.english: The translators' meeting was moved online, so that people in other countries could join.
records.zomi: Gam dang-a mite a kihel theih nadingin lai lettute' kikhopna online ah kisuan hi.

records.english: When two villages use different words, the glossary lists both and marks which one is preferred.
records.zomi: Khua nih in kammal tuamtuam a zat uh ciangin kammal gen siangna list in a nih a gelh a, a deih zaw a ciamteh hi.

records.english: I'll ask the elders which word they prefer.
records.zomi: Upate kiangah kammal bang a deih zaw uh hiam ka dong ding hi.

records.english: Agreeing on standard terms is slow work, but it makes translations much easier to read.
records.zomi: Kammal kithukim pen nasep zawl ahi a, ahi zongin lai letnate sim a baihsak mahmah hi.

records.english: Many in our community believe that a shared vocabulary helps people from different areas understand each other.
records.zomi: I mipi-a mi tampi in kihawm kammalte in mun tuamtuam pan mite a kitheih tuah nadingun a huh hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Some writers argue that borrowing a few international words is more practical than inventing new ones.
records.zomi: Lai gelh pawl khat in kammal thak phuak sangin gam tuamtuam kammal tawmno ngetsak a kizang zaw hi, ci-in a gen uh hi.

records.english: The list is updated every year.
records.zomi: List kum simin kibawl thak hi.

records.english: Please use the same word all the way through the document.
records.zomi: Document a kipat pan a bei dong kammal kibang mah zang in.

records.english: Thank you for the list, because it saved me hours of work.
records.zomi: List adingin lungdam ing, nai tampi hong khol sak hi.

records.english: If you're unsure which term to use, write both and let the reviewer decide.
records.zomi: Kammal bang zat ding hiam na theih kician kei leh a nih gelh inla, en kiktu in thukhen hen.

records.english: A young man carried my suitcase up the station stairs without being asked.

records.english: Oh, thank you so much, because that's my house key.
records.zomi: Aw, lungdam mahmah ing, tua pen ka inn tawh ahi hi.

records.english: Thank you for staying with me until the ambulance came.
records.zomi: Ambulance a tun dong ka kiang ah na om manin lungdam ing.

records.english: The bus driver waited for a woman who was running with two heavy bags.

records.english: Even now, I still think of the woman who lent me her phone that night.

records.english: Anyone would have done the same, and I'm glad you're all right.

records.english: When our car broke down, a farmer towed it to the village with his tractor.

records.english: I'd like to do something kind for the nurse who looked after my mother.

records.english: What did your teacher say that made you believe you could pass?

records.english: A stranger's small kindness can change the whole mood of a difficult day.

records.english: A shopkeeper let my mother take her medicine home and pay the next day.

records.english: The boy behind us in the queue gave his seat to an old man.

records.english: The children made cards for every resident of the care home at Christmas.

records.english: Can I help you with those bags?

records.english: My sister gave her winter coat to a woman at the shelter, and she came home shivering.

records.english: The firefighters rescued the neighbors' cat and brought it home in a blanket.
records.zomi: Meisi nasemte in inn vengte' zawhngeu a hawlkhia uh a, puannak tawh inn ah a tawi uh hi.

records.english: What touched me most was that she helped without expecting anyone to notice.
records.zomi: Ka lungsim a khoih pen kuamah in a muh ding a lamen lo-in a huh ahi hi.

records.english: Teaching children to notice when someone is struggling is the first step towards kindness.
records.zomi: Naupangte mi khat a haksat ciangin a muh nadingun sin sak pen hehpihna lampi kalsuan masa pen ahi hi.

records.english: Years later, the boy who had been given free lessons came back to teach in the same school.

records.english: The students cleaned the old teacher's garden while she was in hospital.

records.english: When my father was in hospital, a nurse stayed after her shift to sit with him.

records.english: She held his hand and talked to him about football until he fell asleep.

records.english: We never learned her surname, but our family still talks about her.

records.english: How can we thank the farmer who towed our car?
records.zomi: I mawtaw a kai lo neipa bangci-in lungdam i ko ding hiam?

records.english: A man at the bank helped my father fill in the form when he couldn't read the small print.

records.english: Kindness at work, such as covering a shift or sharing a task, makes a team far stronger.

records.english: Let me hold the door for you.

records.english: Did your brother really mend the fence for free?

records.english: Someone left an umbrella by the bus stop with a note saying, "Take it if you need it."

records.english: Children, think of one kind thing you can do for someone this week.

records.english: If the taxi driver hadn't returned my bag, I would have lost my passport and all my documents.

records.english: Who helped you when you were lost?
records.zomi: Na mang laitakin kua in hong huh hiam?

records.english: My son was helped across the road by a stranger when he dropped all his books.

records.english: A girl at school shared her lunch with my daughter when she forgot hers.

records.english: Has a stranger ever paid for something for you?

records.english: Why did the cook give us extra rice?

records.english: What is the next number after 1, 2, 4, 8?

records.english: My aunt, an engineer, says that most problems at work are logic puzzles in disguise.

records.english: I do want to get better at reasoning, but I always rush and miss a detail.

records.english: The difficulty with everyday arguments is that important assumptions are often left unsaid.

records.english: If the library opens only when the school is open, and the school is closed today, the library is closed too.
