records.zomi: Meivak mit leh charger phawi in hong hausak lo ding a, ahi zongin meivak laimal tawmno a niamsak hi.

records.english: My aunt, who raised four children on one salary, still plans every month in a small notebook.
records.zomi: Khasum khat tawh ta li a khansak ka ni in laibu neu khat sungah kha khempeuh a geel lai hi.

records.english: I'd say the hardest part of budgeting isn't the maths but the discipline.
records.zomi: Sum zat geelna ah a haksa pen kanaan hi lo-in kithununna ahi hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: How much should we keep for emergencies?
records.zomi: Haksatna hun adingin bangzah i kem ding hiam?

records.english: A budget works best when everyone in the household understands it, not just the person who wrote it.
records.zomi: Sum zat geelna pen a gelhpa bek hi lo-in innkuan sung-a mi khempeuh in a theih uh ciangin a sem hoih pen hi.

records.english: Recording every purchase for a month showed us how much we were spending on snacks.
records.zomi: Kha khat sung van lei khempeuh ciamteh in an neu te ah bangzah i zang hiam hong lak hi.

records.english: Is the phone bill paid yet?
records.zomi: Phone laimal kipia khin hiam?

records.english: Yes, I paid it online this morning.
records.zomi: Kipia khin hi, tuni zingsang online-in ka pia hi.

records.english: Thank you, that's really kind.
records.zomi: Lungdam ing, na hehpihna mahmah hi.

records.english: Is it cheaper to buy the bus pass monthly or weekly?
records.zomi: Bus lai kha sim-in lei a man neu zaw hiam, kal sim-in lei a man neu zaw hiam?

records.english: Monthly, if you travel every day.
records.zomi: Ni simin na khualzin leh kha sim-in.

records.english: Can we afford a new washing machine this year?
records.zomi: Tu kum puan sawpna set thak i lei zo ding hiam?

records.english: Only if we skip the holiday, I'm afraid.
records.zomi: Tawlngakni i nusiat leh bek, ka lau hi.

records.english: How did you manage when you were a student?
records.zomi: Sangnaupang na hih lai-in bangci-in na om hiam?

records.english: Mostly rice, beans and a lot of walking.
records.zomi: A tamzaw buh, be leh kalsuan tampi.

records.english: The money for the school trip was set aside in a separate pot, so that nobody spent it by mistake.
records.zomi: Kuamah in khialh-in a zat lohna dingin sang khualzinna sum bawm tuam khat sungah kikoih hi.

records.english: Let me add up the bills before we decide.
records.zomi: I thukhen ma-in laimalte ka sim khawm ding hi.

records.english: Budgeting apps can help, but they only work if you check them regularly.
records.zomi: Sum zat geelna app te in a huh thei a, ahi zongin a tawntung-in na en leh bek a sem hi.

records.english: Excuse me, I'd like to understand why I was charged a fee for going slightly overdrawn.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, account sum tawmno ka zat lua manin bang hangin man hong la uh hiam theih ka deih hi.

records.english: My brother keeps his whole budget on one sheet of paper stuck inside a cupboard door.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal in a sum zat geelna bup van bawm kongkhak sung-a laidal khat tungah a belh hi.

records.english: When our son started earning, we asked him to pay a small amount towards the household bills.
records.zomi: I tapa in sum a ngah kipat ciangin innkuan laimalte adingin sum neu khat pia dingin i ngen hi.

records.english: Do you mind if I ask how you plan for big expenses like a new roof?
records.zomi: Inn tung thak bang man lian adingin bangci-in na geel hiam ka dot leh na lungkham ding hiam?

records.english: Not at all, and we save a little every month in an account we never touch.
records.zomi: Lungkham lo ing, i khoih ngei loh account khat sungah kha simin tawmno i kikoih hi.

records.english: If the heating bill is higher than expected, we'll take the difference from the entertainment money.
records.zomi: Meilum laimal i lamen sangin a tam zaw leh nuamsakna sum pan a kibanglohna i la ding hi.

records.english: Only touch the emergency fund if one of us loses work or something essential breaks.
records.zomi: I lak-a khat in nasep a mansuah hiam a kisam taktak van khat a sia ciangin bek haksatna hun sum khoih in.

records.english: The reason we review the budget every January is that our bills often change at the start of the year.
records.zomi: January simin sum zat geelna i en kik hang pen kum kipat ciangin i laimalte a kikhel zel ahih manin ahi hi.

records.english: Why do we put a little money aside every month for the car insurance?
records.zomi: Bang hangin kha simin mawtaw insurance adingin sum tawmno i koih hiam?

records.english: Because it's due once a year, and it's much easier to pay if we've saved for it.
records.zomi: Kum khat ah vei khat a kipiak ding ahih manin, leh i kikoih khol leh piak a baih zaw mahmah ahih manin.

records.english: Please save the receipts in this box.
records.zomi: Laimalte hih bawm sungah koih in.

records.english: No problem, and it feels much better now we have a plan.
records.zomi: Buaina om lo hi, leh tu-in geelna i neih manin a nuam zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: Who's in charge of paying the bills this month?
records.zomi: Hih kha laimal piak kua in a kem ding hiam?

records.english: I am, so give me the electricity letter when it arrives.
records.zomi: Kei hi, tua ahih manin meivak laikhak a tun ciangin hong pia in.

records.english: If we had kept an emergency fund, the car repair wouldn't have gone on the credit card.
records.zomi: Haksatna hun adingin sum i kikoih leh mawtaw bawl dam man credit card tungah a om lo ding hi.

records.english: I can see that it was your first time, so I'll ask for the fee to be refunded.
records.zomi: Na masa vei ahi hi, ci ka mu thei ahih manin man kipia kik dingin ka ngen ding hi.

records.english: Thanks for sitting down with me to do this.
records.zomi: Hih bawl dingin kei tawh na tut khawm manin lungdam ing.

records.english: Write the dates when bills are due on the calendar, so that nothing is paid late.
records.zomi: Bangmah a nunung-a a kipiak lohna dingin laimal piak ding ni te ni kigelhna tungah gelh in.

records.english: When the children understood the budget, they stopped asking for something every time we went out.
records.zomi: Naupangte in sum zat geelna a theih khit uh ciangin pua ah i pai simin bangmah ngen a khawl uh hi.

records.english: My husband isn't used to checking prices, so he's agreed to let me do the weekly shop.
records.zomi: Ka pasal man en a ngeina hi lo ahih manin kal sim van lei kei in ka sep dingin a thukim hi.

records.english: Please read the label before you give the baby anything.
records.zomi: Naungek bangmah na piak ma-in a laimai sim masa in.

records.english: Never give your medicine to someone else, even if their symptoms seem the same.
records.zomi: Natna lim kibang bang a hih zongin na zatui mi dang pia ngei kei in.

records.english: My aunt isn't used to taking regular medicine, so she often forgets her evening dose.
records.zomi: Ka ni ni sim zatui nek a ngeina hi lo ahih manin a nitak zatui a mangngilh zel hi.

records.english: Don't keep medicines in the bathroom, because the steam can damage them.
records.zomi: Zatuite kisilna inn ah kem kei in, tui lum meikhu in a siatsak thei ahih manin.

records.english: If my father had kept a list of his medicines, the ambulance team could have treated him more quickly.
records.zomi: Ka pa in a zatuite list a kem leh ambulance pawl in manlang zaw-in a enkol thei ding uh hi.

records.english: Who prescribed this cream for you?
records.zomi: Hih zatui sathau kua in hong gelh sak hiam?

records.english: Keep all medicines in a high cupboard, where small children can't reach them.
records.zomi: Zatui khempeuh naupang neute in a tun theih loh van bawm sang ah kem in.

records.english: Following medication instructions carefully is just as important as getting the right prescription.
records.zomi: Zatui thuhilhna limtakin zuih pen zatui dik ngah tawh a thupi kibang hi.

records.english: Everyone in the class, please remember to tell the school if your child needs medicine during the day.
records.zomi: Kilasi sung-a mi khempeuh, na ta in sun sungin zatui a kisap leh sang hilh phawk un.

records.english: Excuse me, I think I've been given the wrong strength, because these tablets look different.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, zatui hat lo dan khial hong kipia hi, ka ci hi, hih zatuite a kibang lo ahih manin.

records.english: Neither of my parents likes taking tablets, so they ask a lot of questions first.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa khat zong in zatui nek a deih kei uh ahih manin a masa-in dotna tampi a dong uh hi.

records.english: Older patients often take many medicines, which makes a clear daily routine especially important.
records.zomi: Upa damlote in zatui tampi a ne zel uh a, tua in ni sim ngeina kician a thupisak mahmah hi.

records.english: Reminder apps have made it much easier for people with busy lives to take their medicines on time.
records.zomi: Phawksakna app te in buai mite in a hun takin a zatui uh a nek nadingun a baihsak mahmah hi.

records.english: I do want to stop taking the tablets, but my doctor says I must finish the course.
records.zomi: Zatui nek khawl ka deih taktak a, ahi zongin ka siavuan in a bei dong ka nek ding hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Thanks for explaining it so clearly.
records.zomi: Kician takin na gen siang manin lungdam ing.

records.english: Returning unused medicines to a pharmacy keeps them out of rivers and away from children.
records.zomi: Zat lo zatuite zatui dawl ah lohsak kik in gunte leh naupangte pan a kemsak hi.

records.english: Do these tablets make you sleepy?
records.zomi: Hih zatuite in hong ihmuthak sak hiam?

records.english: They might, so don't drive until you know how they affect you.
records.zomi: Ihmuthak sak kha thei hi, tua ahih manin nang tungah bangci-in a sem hiam na theih dong mawtaw mawng kei in.

records.english: You're welcome, and come back if you have any questions.
records.zomi: Bangmah hi lo hi, leh dotna na neih leh hong pai kik in.

records.english: So I take these before breakfast, and the others after dinner?
records.zomi: Tua ahih leh hih te zingsang an ma-in ka ne ding a, a dang te nitak an khit ciangin ka ne ding hiam?

records.english: That's right, and never both at the same time.
records.zomi: Hi hi, leh a nih hun kibang mah-in ne ngei kei in.

records.english: The pharmacist checked that my new tablets wouldn't react with the ones I already take.
records.zomi: Zatui zuakpa in ka zatui thakte ka nek khin te tawh a kituah lo ding hiam a en hi.

records.english: Have you taken your tablets today?
records.zomi: Tuni na zatuite na ne khin hiam?

records.english: Not yet, but I'll take them with lunch.
records.zomi: Ne nai lo ing, ahi zongin sun an tawh ka ne ding hi.

records.english: I set an alarm on my phone, so that I take my tablet at the same time every day.
records.zomi: Ni simin hun kibang mah-in ka zatui ka nek nadingin ka phone tungah alarm ka koih hi.

records.english: Clear pictures on medicine labels can help people who find reading difficult.
records.zomi: Zatui laimai tung-a lim kician te in lai sim a haksa sa mite a huh thei hi.

records.english: Some medicines work best with food, while others need an empty stomach, so the label matters.
records.zomi: Zatui pawl khat an tawh a sem hoih pen a, a dang te gil awng a kisam ahih manin a laimai a thupi hi.

records.english: A patient who understands why a medicine matters is far more likely to take it properly.
records.zomi: Bang hangin zatui khat a thupi hiam a thei damlo khat in hoih takin a ne tam zaw hi.

records.english: When my father came home from hospital, he had five different medicines to take.
records.zomi: Ka pa siavuan inn pan inn a hong tun ciangin zatui tuamtuam nga a nek ding a nei hi.

records.english: My sister made a chart with the times and stuck it on the kitchen cupboard.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam numei in hunte tawh lai phek khat a bawl a, an huanna van bawm tungah a belh hi.

records.english: Every evening, she ticked off each dose, so that nothing was missed or taken twice.
records.zomi: Nitak simin bangmah a kimansuah lohna leh nihvei a kinek lohna dingin a nek khat ciat a ciamteh hi.

records.english: If you find tablets hard to swallow, ask whether the medicine comes as a liquid.
records.zomi: Zatui tang dawlh a haksa na sak leh zatui in tui a om hiam dong in.

records.english: I asked the pharmacist to write the times on the box for my grandfather.
records.zomi: Ka pu adingin bawm tungah hunte gelh dingin zatui zuakpa ka ngen hi.

records.english: How long do I need to keep taking it?
records.zomi: Bangzah sung ka ne den ding hiam?

records.english: Until the box is finished, unless the doctor tells you otherwise.
records.zomi: Siavuan in a dang hong hilh kei leh bawm a bei dong.

records.english: Use the syringe that comes with the medicine, because a kitchen spoon isn't accurate.
records.zomi: Zatui tawh hong pai zatui sunna zang in, an huanna sikkeu a kician kei ahih manin.

records.english: Could you explain what this medicine is for?
records.zomi: Hih zatui bang adingin ahi hiam hong gen siang thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: What should I do if I forget a dose?
records.zomi: Zatui nek khat ka mangngilh leh bang ka bawl ding hiam?

records.english: Check the leaflet, and if you're still unsure, ring us or your doctor before taking the next one.
records.zomi: Laimai en inla, na theih kician lai kei leh a zom na nek ma-in kei hiam na siavuan hiam sam in.

records.english: Where's the nearest late-night pharmacy?
records.zomi: Zan sawt dong a kihong zatui dawl a nai pen koi ah a om hiam?

records.english: Next to the bus station, and it's open until midnight.
records.zomi: Bus dinna kiang ah, leh zanlai dong a kihong hi.

records.english: You were right, so I'm sorry, and here are the correct ones.
records.zomi: Na gen a dik hi, tua ahih manin hong maisak in, hih te a dik te ahi hi.

records.english: My cousin, a nurse, says the most common mistake is stopping a course of medicine too early.
records.zomi: Nurse ka sanggam in khialhna tam pen pen zatui nek manlang lua-a khawl ahi hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Can you collect my prescription on your way home?
records.zomi: Na inn ciahna lam ah ka siavuan zatui gelhna-a zatui na la sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Medicines should always be kept in their original boxes, so that the instructions don't get lost.
records.zomi: Thuhilhnate a mang lohna dingin zatuite a kipatna bawm sungah kem tawntung ding hi.

records.english: Liquid medicine for babies is measured in millilitres, so read the marks on the syringe carefully.
records.zomi: Naungek adingin zatui tui pen millilitre tawh kiteh ahih manin zatui sunna tung-a ciamtehnate limtakin sim in.

records.english: When several doctors prescribe medicines, a pharmacist can check whether they work safely together.
records.zomi: Siavuan tampi in zatui a gelh uh ciangin zatui zuakpa in bit takin a kituak hiam a en thei hi.

records.english: The cream was prescribed for my son's eczema, and it worked within a week.
records.zomi: Zatui sathau pen ka tapa' vun natna adingin kigelh a, kal khat sungin a sem hi.

records.english: The pharmacist will call you when your medicine is ready.
records.zomi: Na zatui a kiman ciangin zatui zuakpa in hong sam ding hi.

records.english: Bring every medicine you take to your appointment, including anything you bought without a prescription.
records.zomi: Siavuan zatui gelhna om lo-a na lei te kihel-in na nek zatui khempeuh na kimuhna ah tawi in.

records.english: Take any old or unwanted medicines back to the pharmacy, instead of throwing them in the bin.
records.zomi: Zatui lui hiam deih nawn lo te eek bawm sungah paih sangin zatui dawl ah tawi kik in.

records.english: I wish the instructions were printed in larger letters, because my eyesight isn't good.
records.zomi: Ka mit a muh hoih kei ahih manin thuhilhnate laimal lian zaw-in kikhen leh ka deih hi.

records.english: Thank you for checking, and let me look at your prescription again.
records.zomi: Na en manin lungdam ing, na siavuan zatui gelhna en kik ning.

records.english: The new medicine was explained to my mother in her own language by a hospital interpreter.
records.zomi: Zatui thak pen siavuan inn-a pau lettu khat in ka nu kiangah amah' pau tawh a gen siang hi.

records.english: Can I drink alcohol while I'm taking these antibiotics?
records.zomi: Hih antibiotic te ka nek laitakin zu ka dawn thei ding hiam?

records.english: Some antibiotics mustn't be mixed with alcohol, so it's best to avoid it until you finish the course.
records.zomi: Antibiotic pawl khat zu tawh kihel lo ding ahih manin na nek zawh dong pelh in a hoih pen hi.

records.english: Is it all right to cut this tablet in half?
records.zomi: Hih zatui a laizang ah at a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: Only if it has a line across the middle, so ask the pharmacist first.
records.zomi: A laizang ah tang khat a om leh bek, tua ahih manin zatui zuakpa dong masa in.

records.english: When you travel abroad, carry your medicines in your hand luggage with a copy of the prescription.
records.zomi: Gamdang ah na khualzin ciangin na zatuite siavuan zatui gelhna copy khat tawh na khut ip sungah tawi in.

records.english: Put your medicine next to your toothbrush, so that you remember it every morning.
records.zomi: Zingsang simin na phawk nadingin na zatui na ha sil kiang ah koih in.

records.english: My father made me double-check the address before we set off.
records.zomi: I pai khiat ma-in ka pa in teenna mun nihvei hong en sak hi.

records.english: Do you know where the keys are?
records.zomi: Tawh te koi ah a om hiam na thei hiam?

records.english: No idea, sorry, so have you checked your coat pocket?
records.zomi: Ka thei kei hi, maisak in, tua ahih manin na puan lum ip na en hiam?

records.english: When the evidence is incomplete, it's wiser to say "probably" than "definitely".
records.zomi: Lahnate a kicin kei ciangin “a kician” sangin “hi kha ding” ci a pil zaw hi.

records.english: The scientists stressed that their findings were preliminary and needed further testing.
records.zomi: Science siamte in a muhnate uh a kipatna bek ahi a, sin beh a kisam hi, ci-in a gen uh hi.

records.english: Do you think she'll accept the job offer?
records.zomi: Nasep a sang ding hi, na ci hiam?

records.english: She seemed keen, but she hasn't made up her mind yet.
records.zomi: A deih bang hi, ahi zongin a thukhen nai kei hi.

records.english: In an emergency, it's better to call for help when you're unsure than to wait.
records.zomi: Haksatna hun ah na theih kician kei ciangin ngak sangin huhna sam a hoih zaw hi.

records.english: There's a chance that the concert will be moved indoors if the weather is bad.
records.zomi: Huihkhua a hoih kei leh la kikhopna inn sung ah kisuan kha thei hi.

records.english: Many people find it easier to guess than to admit that they don't know.
records.zomi: Mi tampi in ka thei kei hi, ci sangin ngaihsun-in gen a baih sa uh hi.

records.english: It seems that the bus timetable has changed, but nobody has told us officially.
records.zomi: Bus hun gelhna kikhel bang hi, ahi zongin kuamah in hong hilh kei uh hi.

records.english: Maybe, but don't quote me on that.
records.zomi: Hi kha ding hi, ahi zongin ka gen ahi hi, ci-in gen kei in.

records.english: My brother, who works in finance, says nobody can predict exchange rates with any accuracy.
records.zomi: Sum lam ah a sem ka sanggam pasal in kuamah in gamdang sum man kician takin a gen khol thei kei uh hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Uncertainty about the future makes some families delay big decisions, such as moving house.
records.zomi: Ma lam thu theih kician loh in innkuan pawl khat in inn kitawn bang thukhenna lian a ngaksak hi.

records.english: Is he coming or not?
records.zomi: Amah a hong ding hiam hong lo ding hiam?

records.english: He said he'd try, so we'll see.
records.zomi: Ka hanciam ding hi, a ci ahih manin i mu ding hi.

records.english: If the forecast had been more certain, the organizers might not have cancelled the market.
records.zomi: Huihkhua thu genna a kician zaw leh bawltute in zuakna mun a phiat kha lo ding uh hi.

records.english: Please don't tell the children until we're sure.
records.zomi: I theih kician dong naupangte kiangah gen kei in.

records.english: The cause of the fire is still being investigated.
records.zomi: Meikang hang pen kikankhia lai hi.

records.english: Is your manager likely to agree to the plan?
records.zomi: Na manager in geelna a thukim kha ding hiam?

records.english: It's difficult to predict, because she hasn't seen the figures yet.
records.zomi: Gen khol a haksa hi, nambatte a mu nai kei ahih manin.

records.english: Will the price of rice go up again next month?
records.zomi: A zom kha ciangin buh man a khang kik ding hiam?

records.english: Nobody really knows, but many people expect it to.
records.zomi: Kuamah in a thei taktak kei uh a, ahi zongin mi tampi in a khang ding a lamen uh hi.

records.english: Did the meeting finish on time?
records.zomi: Kikhopna a hun takin a bei hiam?

records.english: I'm not certain, because I had to leave early.
records.zomi: Ka thei kician kei hi, a tung takin ka pai khiat ding a kisam ahih manin.

records.english: Who left this umbrella in the hall?
records.zomi: Inn sung lampi ah hih khuamuk kua in a nusia hiam?

records.english: It might be Grandpa's, because he was here this morning.
records.zomi: Pu' ahi kha ding hi, tuni zingsang hih ah a om ahih manin.

records.english: I can't remember whether I locked the back door.
records.zomi: Nung lam kongkhak ka khak hiam ka phawk thei kei hi.

records.english: Is this the right road for the airport?
records.zomi: Hih vanlengtual pai lampi dik ahi hiam?

records.english: I think so, but I might be wrong, so let's check the map.
records.zomi: Hi ding hi, ka ci a, ahi zongin ka khial kha thei ahih manin map i en ni.

records.english: Is the restaurant still open, or has it closed down?
records.zomi: An zuakna inn a kihong lai hiam, a kikhak khin hiam?

records.english: I've heard it closed, but I can't say for sure.
records.zomi: A kikhak hi, ka za a, ahi zongin ka gen kician thei kei hi.

records.english: I may have left my glasses at your house, so could you check the sofa?
records.zomi: Na inn ah ka mitlimlang ka nusia kha ding a, tua ahih manin tutphah hong en sak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: A good teacher shows students how to say what they don't know as clearly as what they do.
records.zomi: Saya hoih khat in sangnaupangte in a theih bangun a theih loh zong kician takin gen dan a lak hi.

records.english: The doctor said the test was probably nothing serious, but she wanted to be certain.
records.zomi: Siavuan in enna pen thupi lo bang hi, a ci a, ahi zongin a theih kician a deih hi.

records.english: I'll let you know once I'm sure.
records.zomi: Ka theih kician ciangin kong hilh ding hi.

records.english: If I'm not sure of an answer at work, I say so instead of guessing.
records.zomi: Nasepna ah dawnna ka theih kician kei leh ngaihsun-in gen sangin ka thei kei hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: I'm not sure, so let me ask someone who knows.
records.zomi: Ka thei kician kei hi, tua ahih manin a thei mi khat dong ning.

records.english: Will the train be delayed because of the snow?
records.zomi: Vuk hangin meileng a nun ding hiam?

records.english: Possibly, so I'd leave a little earlier to be safe.
records.zomi: Nun kha ding hi, tua ahih manin a bit nadingin tawmno ma-in ka pai khia ding hi.

records.english: Is the post office open on Saturday afternoons?
records.zomi: Laikhak inn Kiginni sun nung ciangin a kihong hiam?

records.english: I'm not sure, but I think it closes at noon.
records.zomi: Ka thei kician kei a, ahi zongin sun ciangin a kikhak hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: Is it all right to say "I don't know" in an interview?
records.zomi: Kidotna ah “ka thei kei” ci a hoih hiam?

records.english: Yes, if you add how you would find out, because that shows good judgement.
records.zomi: Hoih hi, bangci-in na kan ding hiam na behlap leh, tua in thukhen siamna a lak ahih manin.

records.english: Telling people honestly that numbers are limited is kinder than inviting everyone out of obligation.
records.zomi: Mi zah a ciang hi, ci-in thuman takin gen pen mawhpuakna hangin mi khempeuh sam sangin a hehpihna zaw hi.

records.english: Thank you so much for the invitation, but I'm afraid we're away that weekend.
records.zomi: Hong sam manin lungdam mahmah ing, ahi zongin tua kal tawp-in i om kei ding hi, ci-in ka lau hi.

records.english: How many people have said yes?
records.zomi: Mi bangzah in hi hi a ci uh hiam?

records.english: About thirty, and a few are still deciding.
records.zomi: Sawm thum bang, leh pawl khat in a thukhen lai uh hi.

records.english: Is it a surprise party, or does she know?
records.zomi: Lamdang sakna pawi ahi hiam, ahih kei leh amah in a thei hiam?

records.english: It's a surprise, so please don't say anything.
records.zomi: Lamdang sakna ahih manin bangmah gen kei in.

records.english: I'm not used to formal invitations, so I wasn't sure whether I had to reply in writing.
records.zomi: Kician taka sapna lai a ngeina hi lo ing, tua ahih manin gelh-in ka dawng ding hiam ka thei kei hi.

records.english: Oh no, thank you for telling me, and I'll send a correction tonight.
records.zomi: Aw, lungdam ing, hong hilh manin, tu zanin a dik khat kong khak ding hi.

records.english: A polite refusal should thank the host and, ideally, suggest another time to meet.
records.zomi: Nemtaka nialna in a sampa kiangah lungdam a ci ding a, a hoih pen in kimuh nading hun dang khat a gen ding hi.

records.english: My aunt, who has organized dozens of weddings, says the guest list causes more arguments than the menu.
records.zomi: Mopawi tampi a bawl ka ni in an teelna sangin khual list in kinialna tam zaw a piangsak hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Can I bring my new partner, or is the party just for family?
records.zomi: Ka it thak ka tawi thei ding hiam, ahih kei leh pawi pen innkuan adingin bek ahi hiam?

records.english: Bring him along, because we'd love to meet him.
records.zomi: Tawi in, amah kimuh i deih mahmah ahih manin.

records.english: If your guests are coming from far away, offer them somewhere to stay.
records.zomi: Na khualte gamla pan a hong uh leh a giah nading mun pia in.

records.english: Can you text everyone the new time?
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh kiangah hun thak text hong khak sak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: How do I tell my cousins that we can only invite close family to the wedding?
records.zomi: Mopawi ah innkuan kinai bek i sam thei hi, ci-in ka sanggamte bangci-in ka hilh ding hiam?

records.english: Tell them honestly that the hall is small, and invite them to a picnic afterwards.
records.zomi: Kikhopna inn a neu hi, ci-in thuman takin hilh inla, a khit ciangin ankhopna ah sam in.

records.english: A clear reply date gives hosts time to order the right amount of food.
records.zomi: Dawn ding ni kician khat in a sampate in an dik zah ngen nading hun a pia hi.

records.english: Why didn't you invite your colleagues?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na nasep pihte na sam kei hiam?

records.english: Because it's a family party, and I'll celebrate with them at work on Monday.
records.zomi: Innkuan pawi ahih manin, leh Pizing ni ciangin nasepna ah amaute tawh ka lungdam ding hi.

records.english: If we had sent the invitations earlier, more of our relatives abroad could have come.
records.zomi: Sapna lai manlang zaw-in i khak leh gamdang-a i sanggam tam zaw a hong thei ding uh hi.

records.english: We loved having you, so come again soon.
records.zomi: Na hong manin i nuam mahmah a, tua ahih manin manlang takin hong pai kik in.

records.english: Before you invite colleagues, check whether anyone else in the team would feel left out.
records.zomi: Nasep pihte na sam ma-in pawl sung-a kuamah a kinusia kisa ding a om hiam en in.

records.english: Write the gate code on the invitation.
records.zomi: Sapna lai tungah kongpi code gelh in.

records.english: In some families, every relative expects an invitation, which makes small celebrations difficult.
records.zomi: Innkuan pawl khat ah sanggam khempeuh in sapna lai a lamen uh a, tua in pawi neute a haksasak hi.

records.english: The invitations were printed on recycled card, which my daughter chose herself.
records.zomi: Sapna laite ka tanu amah mah a teel zat kik laidal tungah kikhen hi.

records.english: Can children come to the wedding?
records.zomi: Naupangte mopawi ah a hong thei uh hiam?

records.english: Yes, and there'll be a separate room with games for them.
records.zomi: Thei uh hi, leh amaute adingin kimawlna nei inndei tuam khat a om ding hi.

records.english: Inviting newcomers to a celebration can help them feel part of the community.
records.zomi: Pawi ah a thak te sam in mipi khen khat bangin a kisak nadingun a huh thei hi.

records.english: Guests are asked to park on the main road, because the lane is too narrow.
records.zomi: Lampi neu a zau lua kei ahih manin khualte lampi lian ah mawtaw koih dingin kingen hi.

records.english: My sister accidentally sent the party invitation to the whole office.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam numei in khialh-in pawi sapna lai office bup kiangah a khak hi.

records.english: A short phone call is sometimes a warmer way to invite an elderly neighbor than a message.
records.zomi: Upa inn veng khat sam nadingin message sangin phone tom khat in a lum zaw thei hi.

records.english: Who's on the guest list so far?
records.zomi: Tu dong khual list ah kua om hiam?

records.english: Just family and a few neighbors.
records.zomi: Innkuan leh inn veng tawmno bek.

records.english: She asked whether she could arrive late, because she finishes work at eight.
records.zomi: Nitak nai giat ciangin a nasep a zo ahih manin a nunung-in a tung thei ding hiam a dong hi.

records.english: We'll invite them for coffee first, before we plan anything bigger.
records.zomi: A lian zaw bangmah i geel ma-in coffee adingin amaute i sam masa ding hi.

records.english: Let me know if you need directions.
records.zomi: Lampi lakna na kisam leh hong hilh in.

records.english: Online invitations are convenient, but older relatives may still prefer a printed card.
records.zomi: Online sapna laite a baih a, ahi zongin upa sanggamte in kikhen card a deih zaw lai kha uh hi.

records.english: Mention the dress code if there is one, so that nobody turns up in the wrong clothes.
records.zomi: Silh ding puan thukham a om leh gen in, kuamah puan khial silh-in a hong lohna dingin.

records.english: What a shame, but let's find another date soon.
records.zomi: Lungkham huai hi, ahi zongin manlang takin ni dang khat i zong ni.

records.english: I'd say most guests appreciate knowing exactly when a party is likely to finish.
records.zomi: Khual tamzaw in pawi bang ciangin a bei kha ding hiam a kician takin theih a lungdam uh hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: If the hall has steps at the entrance, mention it, so that guests who use wheelchairs can plan ahead.
records.zomi: Kikhopna inn lutna ah kahlei a om leh gen in, tutna leng zang khualte in ma-in a geel thei nadingun.

records.english: Excuse me, I don't want to be awkward, but the invitation says the wrong date.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, buaina bawl ka deih kei a, ahi zongin sapna lai in ni khial a gen hi.

records.english: Neither of my parents likes big parties, so we'll invite only a few old friends.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa khat zong in pawi lian a deih kei uh ahih manin lawm lui tawmno bek i sam ding hi.

records.english: A good invitation tells guests the date, the time and the address in the first two lines.
records.zomi: Sapna lai hoih khat in a tang nih masa ah ni, hun leh teenna mun khualte a hilh hi.

records.english: Then it says whether children are welcome and whether there will be food.
records.zomi: Tua ciangin naupangte kimuak hiam leh an a om ding hiam a gen hi.

records.english: Finally, it gives a date by which people should reply, so that you can plan properly.
records.zomi: A tawp-in na geel hoih theih nadingin mite' dawn ding ni a gen hi.

records.english: So everyone brings a dish, and we provide the drinks and the plates?
records.zomi: Tua ahih leh mi khempeuh in an khat ciat a tawi ding a, i dawn ding leh kuang te i kiman sak ding hiam?

records.english: That's right, and I'll ask people what they're bringing so that we get a balance.
records.zomi: Hi hi, leh a kibang nadingin mite kiangah bang a tawi ding uh hiam ka dong ding hi.

records.english: Thanks for having us, and it was a lovely evening.
records.zomi: Hong sam manin lungdam ing, nitak nuam mahmah ahi hi.

records.english: We asked guests not to bring presents, because we already have everything we need.
records.zomi: I kisap khempeuh i nei khin ahih manin khualte letsong tawi lo dingin i ngen hi.

records.english: My neighbor wanted to know if dogs were allowed in the garden during the party.
records.zomi: Ka inn vengpa in pawi sungin huan sungah ui te kiphal hiam theih a deih hi.

records.english: Shall I invite your brother, or will you?
records.zomi: Na sanggam pasal ka sam ding hiam, nang in na sam ding hiam?

records.english: I'll call him tonight.
records.zomi: Tu zanin ka sam ding hi.

records.english: Send a short reminder two days before, with the address and the parking details.
records.zomi: Ni nih ma-in teenna mun leh mawtaw koihna thu tawh phawksakna tom khat khak in.

records.english: If you want guests to bring something, say so clearly on the invitation.
records.zomi: Khualte bangmah a tawi nadingun na deih leh sapna lai tungah kician takin gen in.

records.english: Do you mind if we invite the neighbors too, since the music might keep them awake?
records.zomi: La aw in a ihmusak lo kha ahih manin inn vengte zong i sam leh na lungkham ding hiam?

records.english: Good idea, because they're much less likely to complain if they're there.
records.zomi: Ngaihsutna hoih hi, tua ah a om uh leh a phun tawm zaw ding uh ahih manin.

records.english: Asking guests about allergies in advance avoids embarrassing moments at the table.
records.zomi: Khualte kiangah a ne thei lo an ma-in dong in dawhkan-a zumhuai hunte a kham hi.

records.english: Could you come for lunch on the 28th, if you're not working?
records.zomi: Na sep kei leh ni 28 ciangin sun an adingin na hong thei ding hiam?

records.english: I'd love to, and I'll bring a salad.
records.zomi: Hong nuam ing, leh anteh hing ka tawi ding hi.

records.english: A password manager can generate strong passwords and remember them for you.
records.zomi: Password manager khat in password hat te a bawl thei a, nang adingin a phawk sak thei hi.

records.english: Do I need a separate account for each child?
records.zomi: Naupang khat ciat adingin account tuam ka kisam hiam?

records.english: Yes, but you can manage all of them from your own login.
records.zomi: Kisam hi, ahi zongin nangmah' login pan a khempeuh na kem thei hi.

records.english: Use the reset link on the login page, and they'll email you a new one.
records.zomi: Login phek tung-a reset link zang in, a thak khat email tawh hong khak ding uh hi.

records.english: A code was sent to my phone, and I had to type it in before I could log in.
records.zomi: Ka phone ah code khat hong kikhak a, ka log in ma-in ka gelh ding a kisam hi.

records.english: How do I close my old account on this shopping site?
records.zomi: Hih van lei website tung-a ka account lui bangci-in ka khak ding hiam?

records.english: Go to the settings page, scroll to the bottom, and choose the option to delete the account.
records.zomi: Settings phek ah pai inla, a nuai pen dong khal inla, account phiat nading teel in.

records.english: If you share a family account, agree who is allowed to buy things with it.
records.zomi: Innkuan account khat na hawm uh leh tua tawh van lei kua kiphal ding hiam kithukim un.

records.english: When the library moved its system online, every member had to create a new account.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in a kalsuan dan online ah a suan ciangin member khempeuh in account thak khat a bawl ding uh a kisam hi.

records.english: If I had closed the old account, my details wouldn't have been exposed in the data breach.
records.zomi: Account lui ka khak leh data kiguk-na ah ka thute a kilang lo ding hi.

records.english: The company sent an email to say that my account details had been changed, which I hadn't done.
records.zomi: Company in ka bawl lo ka account thu a kikhel hi, ci-in email hong khak hi.

records.english: What's your username?
records.zomi: Na username bang ahi hiam?

records.english: Who set up this account?
records.zomi: Hih account kua in a bawl hiam?

records.english: So I log in with my phone number, not my email?
records.zomi: Tua ahih leh ka email hi lo-in ka phone nambat tawh ka log in ding hiam?

records.english: That's right, and the code arrives by text.
records.zomi: Hi hi, leh code text tawh a hong tung hi.

records.english: Thanks for sorting out my account, because I'd been stuck for days.
records.zomi: Ka account na bawl siang sak manin lungdam ing, ni tampi ka buai khin hi.

records.english: Turn off the setting that shows your birthday to everyone.
records.zomi: Na suahni mi khempeuh a lak setting khak in.

records.english: Don't use the same password for your bank and your email.
records.zomi: Na bank leh na email adingin password kibang zang kei in.

records.english: My cousin, who works in IT, checks his old accounts every year and deletes the ones he no longer needs.
records.zomi: IT ah a sem ka sanggam in kum simin a account luite a en a, a kisap nawn lo te a phiat hi.

records.english: My son made an account for his grandfather so that he could watch the football online.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in a pu online-in football a et theih nadingin account khat a bawl sak hi.

records.english: Online accounts make daily life easier, but each one is another door that needs to be locked.
records.zomi: Online account te in ni sim nuntak a baihsak a, ahi zongin khat ciat pen khak kisam kongkhak dang khat ahi hi.

records.english: The challenge for older users is remembering which email address belongs to which account.
records.zomi: Upa zangte adingin haksatna pen email bang in account bang' ahi hiam phawk ahi hi.

records.english: To create an account, enter your email address and choose a password.
records.zomi: Account khat bawl dingin na email teenna gelh inla, password khat teel in.

records.english: No problem, and call me if it happens again.
records.zomi: Buaina om lo hi, leh a piang kik leh hong sam in.

records.english: I'll make you an account for the school portal tonight.
records.zomi: Tu zanin sang portal adingin account khat kong bawl sak ding hi.

records.english: Many websites ask you to create an account, even when you only want to buy one thing.
records.zomi: Website tampi in van khat bek na lei nuam zongin account khat bawl dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: Signing up with a single email for everything makes it easier to manage, but riskier if that email is compromised.
records.zomi: Bangkim adingin email khat bek tawh min gelh in kem a baih zaw a, ahi zongin tua email a kiguk leh a lauhuai zaw hi.

records.english: Neither of the apps would let me sign up without giving my phone number.
records.zomi: App nih khat zong in ka phone nambat ka piak kei leh min hong gelh sak kei hi.

records.english: If an account asks for more personal details than it needs, think twice before signing up.
records.zomi: Account khat in a kisap sangin keimah thu tam zaw a ngen leh min na gelh ma-in nihvei ngaihsun in.

records.english: Recovery codes are only useful if you keep them somewhere safe and can find them again.
records.zomi: Recovery code te mun bit khat ah na kem a, na muh kik theih leh bek a phattuam hi.

records.english: I apologize for the delay, and I'll activate it for you right now.
records.zomi: Na ngak sawt ding maisak in, tu-in kong phong pah sak ding hi.

records.english: Is it safe to save my card details on this website?
records.zomi: Hih website tungah ka card thute koih a bit hiam?

records.english: It's safer not to, especially on a shared computer.
records.zomi: Koih lo a bit zaw hi, a diak in kihawm computer tungah.

records.english: Last week, I helped my mother set up her first online account for her pension.
records.zomi: Kal nung in ka nu a pension adingin a online account masa pen bawl ka huh hi.

records.english: We chose a password together, and I wrote the recovery code on a card for her drawer.
records.zomi: Khawm-in password khat i teel a, a van bawm adingin card khat tungah recovery code ka gelh hi.

records.english: Now she checks her payments herself and phones me only when she wants a chat.
records.zomi: Tu-in amah mah in a sum piaknate a en a, kikup a deih ciangin bek hong sam hi.

records.english: Closing accounts you no longer use reduces the amount of personal information stored online.
records.zomi: Na zat nawn loh account te khak in online-a kikoih keimah thu zah a kiamsak hi.

records.english: I can't log in, because I've forgotten my password.
records.zomi: Ka password ka mangngilh ahih manin ka log in thei kei hi.

records.english: Everyone, please log in with your new student number from Monday.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, Pizing ni pan kipan na sangnaupang nambat thak tawh log in un.

records.english: Thank you, that's a great help.
records.zomi: Lungdam ing, tua in hong huh mahmah hi.

records.english: Please log out when you've finished.
records.zomi: Na zawh ciangin log out in.

records.english: I wish there were fewer accounts to keep track of.
records.zomi: Kem ding account a tawm zaw leh ka deih hi.

records.english: Did you get the confirmation email?
records.zomi: Kician sakna email na ngah hiam?

records.english: Not yet, so I'll check my spam folder.
records.zomi: Ngah nai lo ing, tua ahih manin ka spam folder ka en ding hi.

records.english: My grandfather isn't used to online accounts, so he keeps his login details in a notebook in a locked drawer.
records.zomi: Ka pu online account a ngeina hi lo ahih manin a login thute kikhak van bawm sung-a laibu neu khat sungah a kem hi.

records.english: Check your inbox for the confirmation email, and click the link to activate the account.
records.zomi: Kician sakna email adingin na inbox en inla, account phong dingin link nek in.

records.english: When I saw the email, I changed my password immediately and called the bank.
records.zomi: Email ka muh ciangin pah-in ka password ka khel a, bank ka sam hi.

records.english: I'd say a few minutes spent on settings can save hours of trouble later.
records.zomi: Settings tungah minit tawmno zat in a nung ciangin buaina nai tampi a kham thei hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: I do want to keep my accounts safe, but I can never remember all the passwords.
records.zomi: Ka account te bit takin kem ka deih taktak a, ahi zongin password khempeuh ka phawk thei ngei kei hi.

records.english: Could you help me change my email address on the library account?
records.zomi: Laibu inn account tung-a ka email teenna khel dingin hong huh thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Why do I have to verify my email address?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ka email teenna ka kician sak ding a kisam hiam?

records.english: So that they know the account really belongs to you.
records.zomi: Account pen nang' taktak ahi hi, ci a theih nadingun.

records.english: Excuse me, I'm sorry to bother you, but I've been waiting three days for my account to be approved.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, hong buaipih ding maisak in, ahi zongin ka account kiphal nadingin ni thum ka ngak khin hi.

records.english: Can I log in on my phone as well?
records.zomi: Ka phone tungah zong ka log in thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, just download the app and use the same details.
records.zomi: Thei hi, app download inla, thu kibang mah zang in.

records.english: Write down which email address you used for each account, so that you can recover it later.
records.zomi: A nung ciangin na lak kik theih nadingin account khat ciat adingin email bang na zang hiam gelh in.

records.english: Accounts shared by several family members need clear rules about spending and privacy.
records.zomi: Innkuan mi tampi in a hawm account te in sum zat leh guk thu tungah thukham kician a kisam hi.

records.english: Many people never read the privacy settings, which means they share far more than they intend.
records.zomi: Mi tampi in privacy settings a sim ngei kei uh a, tua in a deih sangun tam zaw a hawm uh hi.

records.english: You can often check out as a guest instead of creating a full account.
records.zomi: Account bup bawl sangin khual bangin van na lei thei zel hi.

records.english: My account was locked after I typed the wrong password three times.
records.zomi: Password khial vei thum ka gelh khit ciangin ka account kikhak hi.

records.english: What does this verse mean?
records.zomi: Hih Laisiangtho tang in bang a ci nopna hiam?

records.english: Is there a children's Bible in our language?
records.zomi: I pau tawh naupang Laisiangtho a om hiam?

records.english: Yes, the church library has two copies.
records.zomi: Om hi, pawlpi laibu inn ah nih a om hi.

records.english: Our Bible study group reads one chapter of a Gospel every week.
records.zomi: I Laisiangtho sinna pawl in kal simin Lungdamna Thu laibu khat' khen khat a sim uh hi.

records.english: Our pastor said, "Read the Bible as a letter from someone who loves you."
records.zomi: I pastor in, “Laisiangtho pen hong it mi khat' laikhak bangin sim un,” a ci hi.

records.english: A new translation was published so that young people could understand the language more easily.
records.zomi: Khangnote in a pau baih zaw-in a theih theih nadingun lai letna thak khat kikhen hi.

records.english: How was the Bible study tonight?
records.zomi: Tu zan Laisiangtho sinna bangci om hiam?

records.english: Really good, and we spent the whole hour on just three verses.
records.zomi: Hoih mahmah hi, leh nai bup tang thum bek tungah i zang hi.

records.english: Turn to the Gospel of Luke, chapter two.
records.zomi: Luka Lungdamna Thu, a khen nihna pheng un.

records.english: The early Christians shared letters from the apostles, which later became part of the New Testament.
records.zomi: Khristian masate in sawltakte' laikhak te a hawm uh a, tua te a nung ciangin Thuciam Thak khen khat a suak hi.

records.english: The Bible app reads the passage aloud, which helps my grandfather.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho app in a khen aw-in a sim a, tua in ka pu a huh hi.

records.english: Who's reading the Gospel this Sunday?
records.zomi: Hih Nipini Lungdamna Thu kua in a sim ding hiam?

records.english: Does God still speak to people through dreams?
records.zomi: Pasian in mang tungtawn-in mite kiangah thu a gen lai hiam?

records.english: Some Christians believe so, while others say any message must be tested against Scripture.
records.zomi: Khristian pawl khat in tua bangin a um uh a, a dang te in thu bangpeuh Laisiangtho tawh en ding hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: Please don't talk during the reading, because people want to listen.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho sim laitakin kikum kei un, mite in ngaikhia a deih uh ahih manin.

records.english: Which book of the Bible should I start with?
records.zomi: Laisiangtho sung-a laibu bang pan ka kipan ding hiam?

records.english: Many people begin with the Gospel of Mark, because it's short.
records.zomi: A tom ahih manin mi tampi in Mark Lungdamna Thu pan a kipan uh hi.

records.english: When my brother began reading the Gospels for the first time, he asked a lot of questions.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal in a masa pen-in Lungdamna Thu laibute a sim kipat ciangin dotna tampi a dong hi.

records.english: Our pastor met him every Thursday to read a short passage together.
records.zomi: I pastor in khen tom khat khawm-in sim dingin Laizing ni simin a kimu hi.

records.english: By the end of the year, he said he understood why Christians call Jesus the clearest picture of God.
records.zomi: Kum a bei ciangin bang hangin Khristiante in Jesu pen Pasian' lim kician pen a ci uh hiam a thei hi, a ci hi.

records.english: I do want to read the whole Bible, but I keep getting stuck in the long lists of names.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho bup sim ka deih taktak a, ahi zongin min list sau te ah ka khawl den hi.

records.english: For most Christians, special revelation answers questions that nature alone cannot, such as how a person can be forgiven.
records.zomi: Khristian tamzaw adingin Pasian' a tuam-a kilaksakna in mi khat bangci-in maisakna a ngah thei hiam bang leitung bek in a dawn theih loh dotnate a dawng hi.

records.english: Christians use the term "special revelation" for what they believe God has shown through Scripture and through Jesus.
records.zomi: Khristiante in Pasian in Laisiangtho leh Jesu tungtawn-in a lak hi, a ci uh pen “special revelation” ci-in a gen uh hi.

records.english: Personally, I find the Gospels the easiest place to start, because they tell the story of Jesus directly.
records.zomi: Keimah adingin Jesu tangthu a gen ngal uh ahih manin Lungdamna Thu laibute kipatna a baih pen hi.

records.english: The Letter to the Hebrews begins by saying that God spoke through the prophets and then through his Son.
records.zomi: Hebru laikhak in Pasian in kamsangte tungtawn-in thu a gen a, tua ciangin a Tapa tungtawn-in thu a gen hi, ci-in a kipan hi.

records.english: Christians believe the Bible tells one big story from creation to new creation.
records.zomi: Khristiante in Laisiangtho in piangsakna pan piangsakna thak dong tangthu lian khat a gen hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Studying Scripture with others can protect readers from misunderstanding a passage on their own.
records.zomi: Mi dangte tawh Laisiangtho sin in simte amau bek-in khen khat a theih khial lohna dingin a kemsak thei hi.

records.english: The story of Moses and the burning bush is read in many churches as an example of God revealing himself.
records.zomi: Moses leh mei kang singkung tangthu pawlpi tampi ah Pasian in amah le amah a kilak entelna bangin kisim hi.

records.english: Some Christians see dreams and visions as possible ways God speaks, while others are more cautious.
records.zomi: Khristian pawl khat in mang leh mangmu pen Pasian thu a gen theih lampi bangin a mu uh a, a dang te in a kidop zaw uh hi.

records.english: Can I borrow your Bible for the service?
records.zomi: Kikhopna adingin na Laisiangtho ka ngetsak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Sure, and you can keep it if you like.
records.zomi: Thei hi, leh na deih leh na kem thei hi.

records.english: Christians differ on how God speaks today, but most agree that Scripture is central.
records.zomi: Tu hun-in Pasian bangci-in thu a gen hiam Khristiante a kibang kei uh a, ahi zongin a tamzaw in Laisiangtho a laizang ahi hi, ci-in a kithukim uh hi.

records.english: Theologians have long discussed how the Bible can be both a human book and the word of God.
records.zomi: Pasian thu siamte in Laisiangtho pen mihing laibu leh Pasian' thu a nih bangci-in hi thei hiam sawt mahmah a kikum uh hi.

records.english: The Gospels were written by different authors, each with their own way of telling the story of Jesus.
records.zomi: Lungdamna Thu laibute gelhtu tuamtuam in a gelh uh a, khat ciat in Jesu tangthu gen dan tuam a nei uh hi.

records.english: Did you understand the sermon this morning?
records.zomi: Tuni zingsang thugenna na thei hiam?

records.english: Most of it, but I'd like to ask the pastor about the part on the prophets.
records.zomi: A tamzaw ka thei a, ahi zongin kamsangte thu khen pastor dong ka deih hi.

records.english: Why are there four Gospels instead of one?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Lungdamna Thu laibu khat sangin li a om hiam?

records.english: Many Christians believe each writer told the story for a different group of readers.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in gelhtu khat ciat in sim pawl tuamtuam adingin tangthu a gen hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: We read a psalm together every morning.
records.zomi: Zingsang simin late khat khawm-in i sim hi.

records.english: Read slowly, and stop to ask what the passage says about God.
records.zomi: Zawl takin sim inla, a khen in Pasian thu bang a gen hiam dong dingin khawl in.

records.english: My aunt, who has read the Bible through many times, says she still notices something new each year.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho vei tampi a sim khin ka ni in kum simin thu thak khat a mu lai hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Why do Christians read the Bible every day?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Khristiante in ni simin Laisiangtho a sim uh hiam?

records.english: Many of us believe it's one of the main ways God speaks to people.
records.zomi: Kei te tampi in Pasian in mite kiangah thu a gen lampi lian khat ahi hi, ci-in i um hi.

records.english: Thank you for explaining that passage, because it finally makes sense.
records.zomi: Tua khen na gen siang manin lungdam ing, tu-in a tawp-in ka thei hi.

records.english: A missionary nurse first brought the Gospel of John to my great-grandparents' village, according to family tradition.
records.zomi: Innkuan ngeina tangthu bangin nurse thugen khat in Johan Lungdamna Thu ka pu' pute' khua ah a tawi masa hi.

records.english: In the Old Testament, the prophets often begin their messages with the words "This is what the Lord says".
records.zomi: Thuciam Lui ah kamsangte in a thu uh “Topa in hih bangin a ci hi” ci-in a kipan zel uh hi.

records.english: Reading a passage in its historical context helps readers understand what it meant to its first audience.
records.zomi: Khen khat a hun lai-a om dan tawh sim in simte in a sim masate adingin bang a ci nopna hiam a thei nadingun a huh hi.

records.english: Many Christians believe that Jesus is God's fullest revelation of himself.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in Jesu pen Pasian in amah le amah a kilak kicin pen ahi hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Children, today we're going to read the story of Samuel hearing God call his name at night.
records.zomi: Naupangte, tuni Samuel in zan ah Pasian in a min a sam a zak tangthu i sim ding hi.

records.english: My son is learning a Bible verse every week.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in kal simin Laisiangtho tang khat a sin hi.

records.english: Many churches print the Bible readings in the weekly newsletter, so that families can read them at home.
records.zomi: Pawlpi tampi in innkuante in inn ah a sim theih nadingun kal sim thuthak lai ah Laisiangtho simna te a khen uh hi.

records.english: The Bible was translated into my grandparents' language long before I was born.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho ka suah ma sawt mahmah-in ka pu leh ka pite' pau tawh kilet khin hi.

records.english: I'm glad, and come back next week if you have more questions.
records.zomi: Ka lungdam hi, leh dotna tam zaw na neih leh a zom kal ciangin hong pai kik in.

records.english: Many believers say that the life and teaching of Jesus make the character of God clear in a way nothing else does.
records.zomi: Upmi tampi in Jesu' nuntak leh a thuhilhna in Pasian' omzia bangmah dang in a lak theih loh bangin a kician sak hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: Christian traditions differ on whether Scripture alone, or Scripture together with church tradition, is the final authority.
records.zomi: Khristian ngeinate in Laisiangtho bek hiam, Laisiangtho leh pawlpi ngeina khawm hiam, thuneihna nunung pen ahi hiam a kibang kei uh hi.

records.english: We're going to read the Christmas story together on Christmas Eve.
records.zomi: Christmas zan ciangin Christmas tangthu khawm-in i sim ding hi.

records.english: If the Bible had not been translated into everyday languages, most believers could never have read it for themselves.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho ni sim pau ah kilet kei leh upmi tamzaw in amau mah in a sim thei ngei kei ding uh hi.

records.english: What is the difference between general and special revelation?
records.zomi: Pasian' mi khempeuh tunga kilaksakna leh a tuam-a kilaksakna kikal ah bang a kibang lo hiam?

records.english: General revelation is what Christians believe nature shows everyone, while special revelation comes through the Bible and Jesus.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh tunga kilaksakna pen leitung in mi khempeuh a lak hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh a, a tuam-a kilaksakna pen Laisiangtho leh Jesu tungtawn-in a hong pai hi.

records.english: Christians believe that the Holy Spirit helps them understand what they read in Scripture.
records.zomi: Khristiante in Kha Siangtho in Laisiangtho sung-a a sim uh a theih nadingun a huh hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Teaching children through games makes them associate the language with pleasure, not pressure.
records.zomi: Kimawlna tawh naupangte sin sak in pau pen sawlna hi lo-in nuamna tawh a kizom sak uh hi.

records.english: Can you teach me a Zomi song for Grandpa's birthday?
records.zomi: Pu' suahni adingin Zomi la khat hong sin sak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Small, regular practice at home does more than an hour of class once a week.
records.zomi: Inn-a tawmno-a ni sim sinna in kal khat ah vei khat kilasi nai khat sangin tam zaw a sem hi.

records.english: My daughter teaches her friends a new Zomi word every week.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in kal simin a lawmte Zomi kammal thak khat a sin sak hi.

records.english: Some parents in our community worry that speaking Zomi at home will slow their children's progress at school.
records.zomi: I mipi-a nu leh pa pawl khat in inn ah Zomi pau gen in a tate uh sang-a a khantohna a zawlsak ding hi, ci-in a lungkham uh hi.

records.english: Please bring a family photo to next week's lesson, so that we can learn words for relatives.
records.zomi: Sanggamte adingin kammal i sin theih nadingin a zom kal sinna ah innkuan lim khat tawi un.

records.english: Teaching a language works best when children hear it used for real things, not only in lessons.
records.zomi: Pau sin sak pen naupangte in sinna bek hi lo-in na taktak adingin a kizang a zak ciangun a sem hoih pen hi.

records.english: The lessons were recorded, so that families who couldn't attend could watch them at home.
records.zomi: Hong thei lo innkuante in inn ah a et theih nadingun sinnate kila hi.

records.english: Children rarely learn a language from correction alone, but they learn a great deal from encouragement.
records.zomi: Naupangte in bawl dikna bek pan pau a sin tawm uh a, ahi zongin hanthawnna pan tampi a sin uh hi.

records.english: My brother had his children's school certificates translated, so that their grandparents could read them.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal in a pu leh a pite in a sim theih nadingun a tate' sang lai-ciamte a letsak hi.

records.english: What's the best way to start at home?
records.zomi: Inn ah kipat nading lampi hoih pen bang ahi hiam?

records.english: Use Zomi for one routine first, such as bedtime or meals, and build from there.
records.zomi: Ihmut hun hiam an nek hun bang ngeina khat adingin Zomi pau zang masa inla, tua pan khang sak in.

records.english: Shall we watch a Zomi cartoon together tonight?
records.zomi: Tu zanin Zomi cartoon khat khawm-in i en ding hiam?

records.english: The children were so proud when they sang in Zomi at the festival.
records.zomi: Pawi ah Zomi pau tawh la a sak uh ciangin naupangte a kisaktheih mahmah uh hi.

records.english: So the class is for children aged five to twelve, and parents can stay if they like?
records.zomi: Tua ahih leh kilasi pen kum nga pan sawm leh nih naupangte adingin ahi a, nu leh pate a deih leh a om thei uh hiam?

records.english: That's right, and older children can help the younger ones.
records.zomi: Hi hi, leh naupang upa zawte in a neu zawte a huh thei uh hi.

records.english: I do want my children to speak Zomi, but I'm not sure I'm a good enough teacher.
records.zomi: Ka tate in Zomi pau a gen ding uh ka deih taktak a, ahi zongin saya hoih ka hi hiam ka thei kei hi.

records.english: Ask your grandfather to tell you a story in Zomi tonight.
records.zomi: Tu zanin Zomi pau tawh tangthu khat gen dingin na pu ngen in.

records.english: Our class starts every week with a short game, so that the children relax before they learn.
records.zomi: I kilasi in naupangte a sin ma-un a lungsim uh a dai nadingin kal simin kimawlna tom khat tawh a kipan hi.

records.english: The challenge for parents abroad is that school and friends pull children towards the local language.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a nu leh pate adingin haksatna pen sang leh lawmte in naupangte gam pau lam ah a kai uh ahi hi.

records.english: Praise children when they try, even if their Zomi isn't perfect.
records.zomi: Naupangte a Zomi pau uh a kicin kei zongin a sin ciangun phat un.

records.english: It's a pleasure, and he's doing really well.
records.zomi: Nuam ing, leh amah hoih mahmah-in a sem hi.

records.english: Who teaches the youngest group?
records.zomi: A neu pen pawl kua in a sin sak hiam?

records.english: A student from the university, who grew up speaking Zomi at home.
records.zomi: Inn ah Zomi pau gen-in a khang sangpi sangnaupang khat in.

records.english: We label things around the house so that the children see the words every day.
records.zomi: Naupangte in ni simin kammalte a muh nadingun inn kiim-a vante min i ciamteh hi.

records.english: Children, today you'll each teach a friend three words you learned at home.
records.zomi: Naupangte, tuni note khat ciat in inn ah na sin kammal thum lawm khat na sin sak ding uh hi.

records.english: My aunt, who has taught the Saturday class for ten years, says patience matters more than any textbook.
records.zomi: Kum sawm sung Kiginni kilasi a sin sak ka ni in laibu bangpeuh sangin thuakzawhna a thupi zaw hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Neither of my children likes the grammar exercises, but both love the singing.
records.zomi: Ka ta nih khat zong in pau gen dan sinna a deih kei uh a, ahi zongin a nih in la sak a it uh hi.

records.english: Parents don't need to be perfect speakers to pass the language on; they just need to keep using it.
records.zomi: Nu leh pate in pau a ap thei nadingun pau gen siam kicin kul lo uh a, a zang den uh bek a kisam hi.

records.english: Grandparents abroad teach their grandchildren short phrases over video calls every Sunday.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a pu leh pite in Nipini simin video call tawh a tute uh kammal tom te a sin sak uh hi.

records.english: If a child answers in the local language, reply in Zomi and carry on the conversation.
records.zomi: Naupang khat in gam pau tawh a dawn leh Zomi pau tawh dawng inla, kikupna zom in.

records.english: Are there any Zomi books for small children?
records.zomi: Naupang neute adingin Zomi laibu a om hiam?

records.english: A few, and the community is writing more each year.
records.zomi: Tawmno a om a, leh mipi in kum simin tam zaw a gelh uh hi.

records.english: Many in our community believe that children who know their parents' language feel more confident about who they are.
records.zomi: I mipi-a mi tampi in a nu leh a pa' pau a thei naupangte in amau kua ahi uh hiam tungah a kingap zaw uh hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Don't laugh at their mistakes, or they'll stop speaking.
records.zomi: A khialhnate uh nuihsan kei un, ahih kei leh a gen nawn kei ding uh hi.

records.english: When a child uses the wrong word, simply repeat the sentence correctly, without pointing out the mistake.
records.zomi: Naupang khat in kammal khial a zat ciangin a khialhna lak lo-in kammal dik tawh gen kik bek in.

records.english: I wish I had spoken more Zomi with my son when he was small.
records.zomi: Ka tapa a neu lai-in Zomi pau tam zaw ka gen leh ka deih hi.

records.english: How can I get my teenagers interested in learning Zomi?
records.zomi: Ka ta khangnote Zomi pau sin a deih nadingun bangci-in ka bawl ding hiam?

records.english: Connect it to things they already enjoy, such as music, cooking or sport.
records.zomi: La, an huan hiam kimawlna bang a it khin te uh tawh zom in.

records.english: My son was given a sticker every time he answered a question in Zomi.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in Zomi pau tawh dotna khat a dawn simin sticker khat a ngah hi.

records.english: We speak Zomi at dinner and the local language for homework, so the children use both every day.
records.zomi: An nekna ah Zomi pau i gen a, innlai adingin gam pau i zang ahih manin naupangte in ni simin a nih a zang uh hi.

records.english: Thank you for teaching my son so patiently.
records.zomi: Ka tapa thuakzawh takin na sin sak manin lungdam ing.

records.english: My nephew isn't used to hearing Zomi outside the house, so he was shy at the community festival.
records.zomi: Ka tanau inn pua ah Zomi pau zak a ngeina hi lo ahih manin mipi pawi ah a zum hi.

records.english: Is it too late for my ten-year-old to start learning?
records.zomi: Kum sawm ka tapa sin kipat dingin a nunung lua hiam?

records.english: Not at all, because children that age learn very quickly.
records.zomi: Nunung lua lo hi, tua kum naupangte in manlang takin a sin uh ahih manin.

records.english: The teachers explained that children can learn two or three languages at once without falling behind.
records.zomi: Saya te in naupangte in a nung lam ah om lo-in pau nih hiam thum hiam khawm-in a sin thei uh hi, ci-in a gen siang uh hi.

records.english: If my parents hadn't insisted on Zomi at home, I wouldn't be able to talk to my grandmother today.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in inn ah Zomi pau a ngen kei uh leh tuni ka pi tawh ka kikum thei kei ding hi.

records.english: Our church trained six young volunteers to help with the children's classes.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in naupangte' kilasi huh dingin thalawp khangno guk a sin sak hi.

records.english: When one parent isn't Zomi, families often find their own balance between languages.
records.zomi: Nu hiam pa hiam khat Zomi a hih kei ciangin innkuante in paute kikal ah amau' kituakna a mu zel uh hi.

records.english: When my daughter refused to speak Zomi at home, we stopped forcing her.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in inn ah Zomi pau a gen nuam kei ciangin i sawl khawl hi.

records.english: Instead, her uncle started teaching her the words for the football positions, because she loves the game.
records.zomi: A sangin kimawlna a it ahih manin a pa neu in football dinna mun kammalte a sin sak kipan hi.

records.english: A few months later, she was shouting instructions to her cousins in Zomi during matches.
records.zomi: Kha tawmno khit ciangin kimawlna laitakin a sanggamte Zomi pau tawh thu a pia kiko hi.

records.english: When teenagers see the language used in songs and online videos, it stops feeling old-fashioned to them.
records.zomi: Khangnote in la leh online video ah pau a kizat a muh ciangun amaute adingin a lui bang kisa nawn lo hi.

records.english: Speak Zomi to your little brother while you play.
records.zomi: Na kimawl laitakin na nau pasal tawh Zomi pau gen in.

records.english: Old riddles and stories make lessons more fun than lists of words.
records.zomi: Paunak lui leh tangthu te in kammal list sangin sinna a nuamsak zaw hi.

records.english: Young volunteers who grew up abroad are often the best teachers, because they know what children find hard.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a khang thalawp khangnote saya hoih pen ahi zel uh hi, bang in naupangte adingin a haksa hiam a thei uh ahih manin.

records.english: Helping children feel proud of the language matters more than correcting every mistake.
records.zomi: Naupangte pau tungah a kisaktheih nadingun huh pen khialhna khempeuh bawl dik sangin a thupi zaw hi.

records.english: The teacher said, "Speak to them in Zomi first, and only translate if they really don't understand."
records.zomi: Saya in, “Zomi pau tawh a masa-in gen un, a theih taktak kei uh leh bek let un,” a ci hi.

records.english: May I sit in on the children's class to see how you teach?
records.zomi: Bangci-in na sin sak hiam en dingin naupangte' kilasi ah ka tu thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, please, and you're welcome to join in the songs.
records.zomi: Thei hi, tu in, leh lasakna ah kihel dingin kimuak hi.

records.english: Teachers were thanked at the end-of-year assembly with songs written by the pupils.
records.zomi: Kum tawp kikhopna ah sangnaupangte' phuak la tawh saya te kiangah lungdam kohna kipia hi.

records.english: Gratitude expressed in writing can be read again on difficult days, which is part of its value.
records.zomi: Gelh-a lungdam kohna pen ni haksa ciangin sim kik theih a, tua pen a manphatna khen khat ahi hi.

records.english: The reason I thank the bus driver every morning is that his job can't be easy.
records.zomi: Zingsang simin bus mawngpa kiangah lungdam ka ci hang pen a nasep a baih kei ding ahih manin ahi hi.

records.english: Could you read my thank-you letter before I send it to my old teacher?
records.zomi: Ka saya lui kiangah ka khak ma-in ka lungdam kohna laikhak hong sim sak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: It's lovely, but add one thing she taught you that you still use.
records.zomi: Hoih mahmah hi, ahi zongin hong sin sak a, tu dong na zat thu khat behlap in.

records.english: Excuse me, I just wanted to say how much your kindness meant to my mother during her stay.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, ka nu a om sungin na hehpihna in amah adingin bangzah a thupi hiam gen ka deih bek hi.

records.english: Don't mention it, because it only took me ten minutes.
records.zomi: Gen kei in, minit sawm bek a la ahih manin.

records.english: Is it all right if I name you in the acknowledgments of my thesis?
records.zomi: Ka thesis lungdam kohna khen ah na min ka gelh leh a hoih ding hiam?

records.english: Please do, and I'd be honored.
records.zomi: Gelh in, leh zahtakna ka sa ding hi.

records.english: You really didn't need to bring anything!
records.zomi: Bangmah na tawi kul lo taktak hi!

records.english: Taking time to thank the people behind the scenes, such as cleaners and drivers, builds a kinder workplace.
records.zomi: Inn siangsakte leh mawtaw mawngte bang nung lam-a nasemte kiangah lungdam ko dingin hun zang in nasepna mun hehpihna zaw a lam hi.

records.english: Here's how we thank the cooks at our church: everyone stands and claps before the meal begins.
records.zomi: I pawlpi-a an huante kiangah lungdam i kohna dan hih ahi hi: an a kipat ma-in mi khempeuh a ding uh a, khut a beng uh hi.

records.english: Thank your sister for helping you with your homework.
records.zomi: Na innlai sem huh manin na sanggam numei kiangah lungdam ci in.

records.english: I really appreciate you driving all this way to help us move.
records.zomi: Kitawn hong huh dingin gamla mahmah pan mawtaw na mawng manin ka lungdam mahmah hi.

records.english: Glad I could help, because you'd have done the same for me.
records.zomi: Ka huh thei manin ka lungdam hi, nang zong in kei adingin tua bangin na bawl ding ahih manin.

records.english: Could you pass on our thanks to the whole team?
records.zomi: Pawl bup kiangah i lungdam kohna na gen sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: I will, and they'll be delighted to hear it.
records.zomi: Ka gen ding a, a zak uh ciangin a kipak mahmah ding uh hi.

records.english: Some cultures express thanks more through actions than through words, so a meal can mean as much as a card.
records.zomi: Ngeina pawl khat in kammal sangin sepna tawh lungdam a ko zaw uh ahih manin an khat in card khat zah a thupi thei hi.

records.english: Neither of the neighbors would take any money for clearing our drive, so we gave them a cake.
records.zomi: I mawtaw lampi a siangsak inn veng nih khat zong in sum a sang nuam kei uh ahih manin cake khat i pia hi.

records.english: My aunt, who volunteers at the hospital, keeps every card that patients have sent her.
records.zomi: Siavuan inn ah thalawp-in a sem ka ni in damlote' hong khak card khempeuh a kem hi.

records.english: So we're each writing one line in the card, and I'll buy the flowers?
records.zomi: Tua ahih leh i khat ciat in card sungah tang khat i gelh ding a, kei in pakte ka lei ding hiam?

records.english: Exactly, and make sure everyone has signed it by Friday.
records.zomi: Kician hi, leh Laithai ni ma-in mi khempeuh in a min a gelh khin nadingun en in.

records.english: If I had known how much my letter would mean to her, I would have written it years earlier.
records.zomi: Ka laikhak in amah adingin bangzah a thupi ding hiam ka theih leh kum tampi ma-in ka gelh ding hi.

records.english: The nurses were thanked by name in the hospital newsletter.
records.zomi: Siavuan inn thuthak lai ah nurse te a min uh tawh lungdam kohna kipia hi.

records.english: I wouldn't have managed the move without you.
records.zomi: Nang om lo-in kitawn ka zo kei ding hi.

records.english: My father isn't used to being thanked in public, so he went quite red.
records.zomi: Ka pa mipi mai ah lungdam kohna sang a ngeina hi lo ahih manin a mai a san mahmah hi.

records.english: You've been such a help this week.
records.zomi: Hih kal na hong huh mahmah hi.

records.english: You're a lifesaver!
records.zomi: Nang in hong hotkhia hi!

records.english: We're going to make a card for the school caretaker.
records.zomi: Sang kemtu adingin card khat i bawl ding hi.

records.english: That's very kind of you to come round.
records.zomi: Hong pai manin na hehpihna mahmah hi.

records.english: That's lovely to hear, and please give her my best wishes.

records.english: Volunteers at the community center help elderly residents read and organize their medicine labels.

records.english: Our neighbor's lawyer warned that the hedge was not to be cut back without permission.

records.english: Strictly speaking, the rulebook allows it, but it goes against the spirit of the game.

records.english: Why does the counselor make couples sit side by side instead of facing each other?

records.english: Should we ask the club secretary to settle it, or can we sort this out ourselves?
