records.zomi: I insurance company in, “A pianna mun ah na mawh hi, ci pom kei inla, thu kilaih unla, lim la un,” hong ci hi.

records.english: Drivers who rush through amber lights rarely save more than a few seconds.
records.zomi: Meivak gial ah manlang-a pai mawtaw mawngte in second tawmno sangin a khol ngei kei uh hi.

records.english: Reversing with a trailer is confusing, because you have to turn the wheel the opposite way.
records.zomi: Trailer tawh nung lam-a pai a buaihuai a, mawtaw kual a langpang lam ah na lehhei ding ahih manin.

records.english: Can you show me how to open the bonnet?
records.zomi: Mawtaw mai lam khuhna bangci-in kihong hiam hong lak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Pull the little lever under the steering wheel.
records.zomi: Mawtaw kual nuai-a ciahna neu khat dawn in.

records.english: Keeping a blanket, water and a torch in the boot can make a winter breakdown much less frightening.
records.zomi: Mawtaw nung lam bawm sungah puannak, tui leh tawmei koih in khuavot-a mawtaw siatna a lauhuai tawm zaw sak thei hi.

records.english: What's the difference between a give-way sign and a stop sign?
records.zomi: Lampi pia lim lai leh khawl lim lai kikal ah bang a kibang lo hiam?

records.english: At a stop sign you must stop completely, but at a give-way sign you only stop if something is coming.
records.zomi: Khawl lim lai ah na khawl kim ding a, ahi zongin lampi pia lim lai ah bangmah a hong leh bek na khawl hi.

records.english: Learner drivers in our country aren't allowed on the motorway without an instructor.
records.zomi: I gam ah mawtaw mawng sin mite saya om lo-in lampi lian ah kiphal lo uh hi.

records.english: Before a long trip, my mother walks round the car to check the lights, the tyres and the wipers.
records.zomi: Khualzin sau ma-in ka nu in meivakte, ke te leh tukvuang nulna te en dingin mawtaw a kiimvel hi.

records.english: Tie the mattress down with two straps, not one, or the wind will lift it off the roof.
records.zomi: Mattress pen khau khat sangin khau nih tawh khih in, ahih kei leh huih in inn tung pan a la ding hi.

records.english: Park close to the kerb in this street, because the lorries need the whole lane.
records.zomi: Mawtaw lian te in lampi bup a kisap uh ahih manin hih lampi ah lampi gei nai takin mawtaw koih in.

records.english: Dipping your headlights for oncoming traffic stops other drivers from being dazzled.
records.zomi: Mai lam hong pai mawtaw adingin na meivak niamsak in mawtaw mawng dangte' mit a mitcip sak lo hi.

records.english: Our car was hit while it was parked outside the bakery.
records.zomi: Moh bawlna pua ah a om laitakin i mawtaw kisu hi.

records.english: Do I need to indicate on an empty road?
records.zomi: Lampi awng tungah zong meivak tawh ka lak ding a kisam hiam?

records.english: Yes, because someone may be there that you haven't seen.
records.zomi: Kisam hi, na muh loh mi khat a om kha thei ahih manin.

records.english: Signal early, so that the drivers behind have time to slow down.
records.zomi: Na nung-a mawtaw mawngte zawl takin a pai nadingun manlang takin lak in.

records.english: Wait for the green arrow before you turn right.
records.zomi: Taklam na ngat ma-in arrow eng ngak in.

records.english: A good instructor explains not only what to do but why a mistake could be dangerous.
records.zomi: Saya hoih khat in bang bawl ding hiam bek hi lo-in bang hangin khialhna khat a lauhuai thei hiam a gen siang hi.

records.english: Ease off the accelerator if the car starts to slide on water, and don't brake hard.
records.zomi: Mawtaw tui tungah a kitheih kipat leh accelerator khah inla, brake khauh takin nek kei in.

records.english: Where does the water for the windscreen wipers go?
records.zomi: Mai lam tukvuang nulna adingin tui koi ah a lut hiam?

records.english: Keep both hands on the wheel at the sides, not at the top.
records.zomi: Na khut nih mawtaw kual tungah a tung lam hi lo-in a ciang nih ah koih in.

records.english: Children learn how to behave near traffic largely by watching the adults they walk with.
records.zomi: Naupangte in mawtaw kiang ah bangci-in om ding hiam a tamzaw a kiang ah a kalsuan khawm upate en-in a sin uh hi.

records.english: My son had the tyres rotated so that they would wear evenly.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in a kibang takin a ziat nadingin ke te a laih sak hi.

records.english: Put the handbrake on before you get out.
records.zomi: Na kum ma-in handbrake koih in.

records.english: Why do you turn your head before changing lanes?
records.zomi: Lampi na khel ma-in bang hangin na lu na ngat hiam?

records.english: Because the mirrors don't show the blind spot just behind your shoulder.
records.zomi: Mirror te in na liang nung pah-a mun a lak kei ahih manin.

records.english: Which pedal is the clutch?
records.zomi: Pedal bang in clutch ahi hiam?

records.english: The one on the left, and you only have it in a manual car.
records.zomi: Veilam lam pen, leh manual mawtaw ah bek a om hi.

records.english: Why do you leave the car in gear when you park on a hill?
records.zomi: Mual tungah mawtaw na koih ciangin bang hangin gear sungah na nusia hiam?

records.english: So that it can't roll away if the handbrake fails.
records.zomi: Handbrake a sia kha leh a liam thei lohna dingin.

records.english: Electric cars are so quiet that pedestrians sometimes don't hear them coming.
records.zomi: Meivak mawtaw te a dai lua ahih manin kalsuan mite in a hong a za kei zel uh hi.

records.english: To jump-start a car, first connect the red cable to the positive terminal of the flat battery.
records.zomi: Mawtaw khat jump-start dingin a masa-in khau san battery bei' positive lam ah zom in.

records.english: Attach the other red clip to the good battery, then the black cable to the good battery and to bare metal on the dead car.
records.zomi: Khau san a dang tawp battery hoih ah zom inla, tua ciangin khau vom battery hoih leh mawtaw si' sik awng ah zom in.

records.english: Start the working car, wait a few minutes, and then try the engine that wouldn't start.
records.zomi: A sem mawtaw phong inla, minit tawmno ngak inla, tua ciangin a kipan thei lo engine sin kik in.

records.english: A car's stopping distance doubles on a wet road, so slow down long before the junction.
records.zomi: Lampi nin ah mawtaw khawl nading a gamla zah nihvei a khang ahih manin lampi kikona ma sawt mahmah-in niamsak in.

records.english: Switch on your headlights in the tunnel, even in the middle of the day.
records.zomi: Sun laitak zongin tunnel sungah na meivak phong in.

records.english: What surprised me about driving abroad was how differently people use their horns.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a mawtaw mawng ah ka lamdang sak pen mite in a mawtaw ging tuamtuam-in a zat uh ahi hi.

records.english: What does the orange light with the exclamation mark mean?
records.zomi: Meivak gial ciamtehna nei pen bang a ci nopna hiam?

records.english: It usually means that one of the tyres is low on air.
records.zomi: A tamzaw in ke khat ah huih a tawm hi, ci nopna ahi zel hi.

records.english: Why won't the steering wheel turn, and why is the key stuck?
records.zomi: Bang hangin mawtaw kual a lehhei thei kei a, bang hangin tawh a kitang hiam?

records.english: Turn the wheel gently while you turn the key, because the steering lock is on.
records.zomi: Tawh na lehhei laitakin mawtaw kual nemtakin lehhei in, steering lock a kikhak ahih manin.

records.english: In order to save fuel, drive smoothly and don't keep the engine running while you wait.
records.zomi: Sathau khol nadingin nemtakin mawng inla, na ngak laitakin engine phong-in nusia kei in.

records.english: Shall I sit beside you for your first drive on the motorway?
records.zomi: Lampi lian tungah na mawng masak ciangin na kiang ah ka tu ding hiam?

records.english: When you hear a siren, pull over to the side so that the ambulance can pass.
records.zomi: Siren na zak ciangin ambulance a pai theih nadingin lampi gei ah koih in.

records.english: Learning to read the road ahead, rather than just the car in front, makes driving far less stressful.
records.zomi: Na mai-a mawtaw bek hi lo-in ma lam lampi et sin in mawtaw mawng a lungkhamhuai tawm zaw sak mahmah hi.

records.english: Snow chains were fitted to all the buses before they were allowed over the pass.
records.zomi: Mual kantan a kiphal ma-un bus khempeuh ah vuk khau te kibulh hi.

records.english: The instructor explained that the two-second rule means leaving two seconds between you and the car in front.
records.zomi: Saya in second nih thukham pen nang leh na mai-a mawtaw kikal ah second nih nusia ci nopna hi, ci-in a gen siang hi.

records.english: The car was written off by the insurers, even though the damage looked small.
records.zomi: A siatna a neu bang hangin insurance te in mawtaw zat theih lo hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: The noise from the brakes made me pull into a lay-by and phone the garage.
records.zomi: Brake aw hangin lampi gei mun ah ka koih a, mawtaw bawlna ka sam hi.

records.english: I put petrol in a diesel car by mistake, and the garage had to drain the whole tank.
records.zomi: Diesel mawtaw ah khialh-in petrol ka koih a, mawtaw bawlna in sathau bawm bup a phiat ding a kisam hi.

records.english: When two lanes become one, the cars should merge in turn, one from each lane.
records.zomi: Lampi nih khat a suah ciangin mawtaw te lampi khat ciat pan khat ciat-in a kihel ding uh hi.

records.english: Stop before the barrier at a level crossing, and don't move until the lights stop flashing.
records.zomi: Meileng kantanna-a khakna ma-in khawl inla, meivakte a vak khawl dong pai kei in.

records.english: Satnavs save time, but they don't know about the goats that wander onto our village road at dusk.
records.zomi: Satnav te in hun a khol a, ahi zongin nitak ciangin i khua lampi tungah a vak kel te thu a thei kei hi.

records.english: Explaining the rules of a roundabout to a nervous learner takes more patience than any other lesson.
records.zomi: Lau mawng sinpa kiangah roundabout thukhamte gen siang in sinna dang khempeuh sangin thuakzawhna tam zaw a kisam hi.

records.english: Cyclists stick out their left arm to show they're turning left.
records.zomi: Siiksakol tuangte in veilam ah a ki-ngat ding uh a lak nadingun a veilam ban a zak uh hi.

records.english: The reason my grandfather never overtook on a bend was simple: you can't see what's coming.
records.zomi: Ka pu in lampi kawi ah mawtaw dang a khel ngei lo hang a baih hi: bang a hong hiam na mu thei kei hi.

records.english: Never leave the keys in the car, even outside your own house.
records.zomi: Nangmah' inn pua ah zong mawtaw sungah tawh nusia ngei kei in.

records.english: The guard had the heating turned up after several passengers complained about the cold.
records.zomi: Khualzinte tampi in vot thu a phun khit uh ciangin meileng kemtu in meilum a khangsak hi.

records.english: Does this ticket include the tram?
records.zomi: Hih lai in tram a huam hiam?

records.english: Only inside the city center.
records.zomi: Khuapi laizang sung bek.

records.english: Your ticket is valid on any train today, but not on the express.
records.zomi: Na lai tuni meileng khempeuh ah a kizang thei a, ahi zongin manlang meileng ah zang thei lo hi.

records.english: Is there a toilet on this train?
records.zomi: Hih meileng ah ek inn a om hiam?

records.english: Off-peak fares encourage people who can travel later to leave space for those who have to start work early.
records.zomi: Mi tam lo hun-a man niamte in nunung-a pai thei mite a hanthawn a, nasep tung taka kipan mite adingin mun a nusia hi.

records.english: When the doors begin to beep, step back, because they won't open again for you.
records.zomi: Kongkhakte a ging kipat ciangin nung lam ah ding in, nang adingin a kihong kik nawn lo ding uh ahih manin.

records.english: Explaining a city's ticket system to a visitor is harder than giving them directions.
records.zomi: Khual khat kiangah khuapi khat' lai kalsuan gen siang pen lampi lak sangin a haksa zaw hi.

records.english: Fold the pushchair before you get on, because there's no space for it at this time of day.
records.zomi: Na tuan ma-in naupang tawlengna khul in, hih hun ah a koihna mun a om kei ahih manin.

records.english: The reason the morning bus is so slow is that it stops at every school on the way.
records.zomi: Zingsang bus a zawl hang pen lampi-a sang khempeuh ah a khawl ahih manin ahi hi.

records.english: You can't use your phone in the quiet carriage, not even for a short call.
records.zomi: Dai meileng khan ah phone tom zong na zang thei kei hi.

records.english: The guard opened the side gate for us and printed a new ticket.
records.zomi: Meileng kemtu in ciang lam kongkhak hong hong sak a, lai thak khat a khen hi.

records.english: Tap your card when you get on and again when you get off, or you'll be charged the full fare.
records.zomi: Na tuan ciangin leh na kum ciangin na card nek in, ahih kei leh man bup kila ding hi.

records.english: Was the earlier train cancelled or just delayed?
records.zomi: A ma-a meileng kiphiat hiam, a nun bek hiam?

records.english: Cancelled, so this one will be very crowded.
records.zomi: Kiphiat, tua ahih manin hih pen mi a dim mahmah ding hi.

records.english: I've lost my return ticket, so do I have to buy a new one, or can you print it again?
records.zomi: Ka ciah kik nading lai ka mansuah ahih manin a thak khat ka lei ding hiam, ahih kei leh na khen kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: Why does the timetable say "school days only" next to some buses?
records.zomi: Bang hangin hun gelhna in bus pawl khat kiang ah “sang ni bek” a ci hiam?

records.english: Those buses run only during term, mainly for the students, so they don't come in the holidays.
records.zomi: Tua bus te sang hun sungin bek, a tamzaw sangnaupangte adingin a pai uh ahih manin tawlngakni sungin a hong kei uh hi.

records.english: How can I tell which carriage is first class?
records.zomi: Meileng khan bang in first class ahi hiam bangci-in ka thei ding hiam?

records.english: At the taxi rank, you have to wait in the queue and take the first taxi in the line.
records.zomi: Taxi ngakna mun ah kigual sungah na ngak ding a, tang sung-a taxi masa pen na tuang ding hi.

records.english: Stand behind the yellow line until the train has stopped.
records.zomi: Meileng a khawl dong tang gial nung ah ding in.

records.english: Should the line close for engineering work, replacement buses will leave from the front of the station.
records.zomi: Bawlna nasep adingin meileng lampi a kikhak leh a laihna bus te meileng dinna mai pan a pai ding uh hi.

records.english: The conductor made us move our suitcases so that a woman in a wheelchair could get through.
records.zomi: Tutna leng tung-a numei khat a pai theih nadingin meileng kemtu in i van ip te hong suan sak hi.

records.english: A single timetable that shows buses, trains and ferries together would save travelers a great deal of confusion.
records.zomi: Bus, meileng leh tembaw khawm-a lak hun gelhna khat in khualzinte buaina tampi a khol ding hi.

records.english: Many passengers don't realize that a return ticket can be cheaper than two singles.
records.zomi: Khualzin tampi in ciah kik lai khat in lai khat ciat nih sangin a man neu zaw thei hi, ci a thei kei uh hi.

records.english: The 14 goes to the hospital, but the 14A turns off before the river.
records.zomi: 14 in siavuan inn ah a pai a, ahi zongin 14A in gun ma-in a ki-ngat hi.

records.english: We were told to leave the train because it had been taken out of service.
records.zomi: Meileng zat theih lo-in a kikoih manin kum dingin hong hilh uh hi.

records.english: This train divides at the junction, so check which part you're sitting in.
records.zomi: Hih meileng lampi kikona ah a kikhen ahih manin a khen bang ah na tut hiam en in.

records.english: The front four carriages continue to the coast, and the rear four go to the hills.
records.zomi: Mai lam khan li tuipi gei lam ah a zom a, nung lam khan li mual lam ah a pai hi.

records.english: Passengers for the hills should move to the back of the train before the junction.
records.zomi: Mual lam pai khualzinte in lampi kikona a tun ma-in meileng nung lam ah pai un.

records.english: Can I get my money back if the train is very late?
records.zomi: Meileng a nun mahmah leh ka sum ka ngah kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: You can claim part of the fare online if it arrives more than half an hour late.
records.zomi: Nai khen khat val a nun leh online-in man khen khat na ngen thei hi.

records.english: Contactless payment has made buses quicker to board, although older passengers sometimes find it confusing.
records.zomi: Contactless man piakna in bus tuan a manlang sak a, upa khualzinte in a buaihuai sa zel uh hi.

records.english: Night buses take longer routes, because they replace several daytime lines with a single loop.
records.zomi: Zan bus te in sun bus lampi tampi kual khat bek tawh a laih uh ahih manin lampi sau zaw a zui uh hi.

records.english: The barrier won't open because my ticket is bent.
records.zomi: Ka lai a kawi ahih manin khakna a kihong kei hi.

records.english: Where do I change for the airport?
records.zomi: Vanlengtual pai nadingin koi ah ka kikhek ding hiam?

records.english: At the next stop, and follow the blue signs.
records.zomi: A zom dinna ah, leh lim lai dumte zui in.

records.english: Hold on to the strap when the tram goes round the corner by the cathedral.
records.zomi: Pawlpi lian kiang-a kawi ah tram a pai ciangin khau len in.

records.english: The ticket on the seat means it's been reserved from the next station.
records.zomi: Tutna tung-a lai in a zom meileng dinna pan kilai khin hi, ci nopna hi.

records.english: Put your big bag in the rack by the door.
records.zomi: Na ip lian kongkhak kiang-a koihna ah koih in.

records.english: Which end of the platform should I wait at?
records.zomi: Dinna tawp bang ah ka ngak ding hiam?

records.english: Please take your rubbish with you.
records.zomi: Na eek te tawi in.

records.english: Keep your ticket until the end of the journey, because inspectors sometimes check it at the exit.
records.zomi: Enkaktute in pai khiatna ah a en zel uh ahih manin khualzinna a bei dong na lai kem in.

records.english: After nine thirty, the tickets are cheaper, so we waited for the later train.
records.zomi: Nai kua leh nai khen khit ciangin lai a man neu zaw ahih manin a nunung meileng i ngak hi.

records.english: Why does the bus sometimes drive past the stop without stopping?
records.zomi: Bang hangin bus in dinna ah khawl lo-in a pelh zel hiam?

records.english: It's a request stop, so you have to hold out your arm when you see the bus coming.
records.zomi: Ngetna dinna ahih manin bus a hong na muh ciangin na ban na zak ding a kisam hi.

records.english: Ring the bell once, not three times.
records.zomi: Ging vei khat bek nek in, vei thum hi lo-in.

records.english: What confuses most visitors is that one ticket covers the metro but not the airport train.
records.zomi: Khual tamzaw a buaisak pen lai khat in metro a huam a, ahi zongin vanlengtual meileng a huam kei ahi hi.

records.english: The daily cap means you never pay more than the price of a day ticket, however many buses you take.
records.zomi: Ni sim man ciang in bus bangzah na tuang zongin ni khat lai man sangin tam zaw na pia ngei kei ding hi, ci nopna hi.

records.english: In order to catch the first ferry, we slept at a guesthouse beside the harbor.
records.zomi: Tembaw masa pen i tuan theih nadingin tembaw dinna kiang-a zinbuuk neu khat ah i giak hi.

records.english: What does "expected 14:32" mean on the departure board?
records.zomi: Pai khiatna lim lai tungah “lamen 14:32” cih bang a ci nopna hiam?

records.english: It means the train is late and should now arrive at 14:32.
records.zomi: Meileng a nun a, tu-in 14:32 ciangin a tung ding hi, ci nopna hi.

records.english: Making the trains free for children during the holidays filled the carriages and emptied the roads.
records.zomi: Tawlngakni sungin naupangte adingin meileng man om lo-in a kibawl ciangin meileng khante a dim a, lampite a awng hi.

records.english: This bus terminates here, so please take all your belongings with you.
records.zomi: Hih bus hih ah a tawp ahih manin na van khempeuh tawi un.

records.english: Top up your card at the kiosk, because the machines on the bus don't take cash.
records.zomi: Bus tung-a set te in sum a sang kei uh ahih manin zuakna inn neu ah na card ah sum behlap in.

records.english: Does my seven-year-old need her own ticket for the ferry?
records.zomi: Ka tanu kum sagih in tembaw adingin amah' lai a kisam hiam?

records.english: Yes, but children pay half the adult fare on this route.
records.zomi: Kisam hi, ahi zongin hih lampi ah naupangte in upa man kim bek a pia uh hi.

records.english: A good announcement tells passengers not only what has happened but also what they should do next.
records.zomi: Thu genna hoih khat in khualzinte kiangah bang a piang hiam bek hi lo-in a zom-in bang a bawl ding uh hiam zong a hilh hi.

records.english: I forgot to tap out yesterday, and the machine charged me for the longest possible journey.
records.zomi: Zanni ka kumna ah card ka nek mangngilh a, set in a sau pen khualzinna man hong la hi.

records.english: My travel card was blocked after I reported it lost, so nobody else could use the money on it.
records.zomi: Ka khualzin card ka mansuah hi, ka cih khit ciangin kikhak a, a tung-a sum kuamah in a zang thei lo hi.

records.english: My son asked me who wrote the Psalms, and I didn't know what to say.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in Late laibu kua in a gelh hiam hong dong a, bang ka gen ding hiam ka thei kei hi.

records.english: Our youth leader showed us how the same story is told in two of the Gospels.
records.zomi: I khangno makaipa in tangthu kibang mah Lungdamna Thu laibu nih ah bangci-in kigen hiam hong lak hi.

records.english: Many of the psalms were sung as prayers long before they were collected into a book.
records.zomi: Late tampi laibu khat-in a kikaikhawm ma sawt mahmah-in thungetna bangin kisa hi.

records.english: Calling a book inspired is a claim about where its message comes from, not just praise for its beauty.
records.zomi: Laibu khat Pasian humop hi, ci pen a hoihna phatna bek hi lo-in a thu koi pan a hong pai hiam thugen ahi hi.

records.english: Some of the earliest copies of the Gospels were found in the dry sands of Egypt.
records.zomi: Lungdamna Thu laibu copy masa pen pawl khat Egypt gam-a piakneel keu sungah kimu hi.

records.english: The Bible was written by many different people over hundreds of years.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho pen kum za tampi sungin mi tuamtuam tampi in a gelh hi.

records.english: Who wrote the book of Acts?
records.zomi: Sawltakte' Sepna laibu kua in a gelh hiam?

records.english: Many believe it was Luke, the same writer as the Gospel.
records.zomi: Mi tampi in Lungdamna Thu gelhtu kibang mah Luka ahi hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: In our Bible study group, a new member asked how a book written by people could also be God's word.
records.zomi: I Laisiangtho sinna pawl ah member thak khat in mite' gelh laibu khat Pasian' thu zong bangci-in hi thei hiam a dong hi.

records.english: Our pastor explained that Christians believe God guided the human writers while they used their own words and styles.
records.zomi: I pastor in mihing gelhtute in amau' kammal leh gelh dan a zat uh laitakin Pasian in a makaih hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi, ci-in a gen siang hi.

records.english: She went home and began reading the letters of Paul, looking for signs of the writer's own personality.
records.zomi: Inn ah a ciah a, gelhtu' omzia lahna zong-in Paul' laikhakte a sim kipan hi.

records.english: Is the Old Testament also inspired?
records.zomi: Thuciam Lui zong Pasian humop ahi hiam?

records.english: Christians believe so, and Jesus himself often quoted from it.
records.zomi: Khristiante in tua bangin a um uh a, Jesu amah mah in a tamvei-in a gen kik hi.

records.english: What does "inspired" mean when people talk about the Bible?
records.zomi: Mite in Laisiangtho thu a gen ciangun “Pasian humop” cih in bang a ci nopna hiam?

records.english: Many Christians mean that God guided the writers, so that the message is his as well as theirs.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in Pasian in gelhtute a makaih ahih manin a thu pen amau' bek hi lo-in amah' zong ahi hi, ci-in a ci nopna uh hi.

records.english: Did the writers know they were writing Scripture?
records.zomi: Gelhtute in Laisiangtho a gelh uh hi, ci a thei uh hiam?

records.english: Some, like the prophets, seem to have known, but many Christians think others simply wrote to meet a need.
records.zomi: Kamsangte bang pawl khat in a thei bang uh a, ahi zongin Khristian tampi in a dangte in kisapna khat adingin a gelh bek uh hi, ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi.

records.english: Many believers say that a familiar verse can speak to them in a new way at different times in their lives.
records.zomi: Upmi tampi in a theih khin tang khat in a nuntak sung hun tuamtuam ah lampi thak-in a kiangah thu a gen thei hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: Please open your Bibles to the book of Psalms.
records.zomi: Na Laisiangtho uh Late laibu ah hong un.

records.english: Do you read the Bible on your own or with your family?
records.zomi: Laisiangtho nangmah bek-in na sim hiam, na innkuan tawh na sim hiam?

records.english: Some passages were passed down by word of mouth before they were written down.
records.zomi: Khen pawl khat a kigelh ma-in kam tawh kigen suk hi.

records.english: What struck the students most was how honestly the Bible describes the failures of its heroes.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte a lamdang sak pen Laisiangtho in a mi thupite' khialhna thuman takin a gen ahi hi.

records.english: The letters in the New Testament were written to real churches facing real problems.
records.zomi: Thuciam Thak sung-a laikhakte buaina taktak a tuah pawlpi taktak te kiangah kigelh hi.

records.english: Is it true that the Bible was first written in Hebrew and Greek?
records.zomi: Laisiangtho a masa-in Hebru leh Greek pau tawh kigelh hi, cih a tak hiam?

records.english: Mostly, yes, although a few passages are in Aramaic.
records.zomi: A tamzaw ahi hi, khen tawmno Aramaic pau tawh a om hangin.

records.english: Our church gives a Bible to every child who finishes Sunday school.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in Nipini sang a zo naupang khempeuh Laisiangtho a pia hi.

records.english: The early church collected the books that it believed were inspired into what became the New Testament.
records.zomi: Pawlpi masa in Pasian humop hi, a ci laibute a kaikhawm a, tua in Thuciam Thak a suak hi.

records.english: Please read the passage aloud for the rest of us.
records.zomi: A dang i khempeuh adingin khen aw-in hong sim sak in.

records.english: Different Christian traditions hold different views on how inspiration relates to the history behind each book.
records.zomi: Khristian ngeina tuamtuam in Pasian humopna leh laibu khat ciat nung-a tangthu bangci-in a kizom hiam ngaihsutna tuamtuam a nei uh hi.

records.english: Rather than dictation, many theologians describe inspiration as a partnership between God and human authors.
records.zomi: Pasian thu siam tampi in Pasian humopna pen gen-a gelh sak sangin Pasian leh mihing gelhtute kikal-a nasep khawmna bangin a gen uh hi.

records.english: Scholars study the ancient manuscripts carefully to discover the most reliable wording of the original texts.
records.zomi: Thu siamte in a kipatna gelh-a kammal muanhuai pen a theih nadingun lai lui gelhte limtakin a sin uh hi.

records.english: Children, who can tell me how many books there are in the Bible?
records.zomi: Naupangte, Laisiangtho sungah laibu bangzah a om hiam kua in hong gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: For many believers, the authority of the Bible comes from the conviction that God himself stands behind its message.
records.zomi: Upmi tampi adingin Laisiangtho' thuneihna pen a thu nung ah Pasian amah mah a ding hi, cih muanna pan a hong pai hi.

records.english: Believing that Scripture is inspired does not mean that every passage is easy to understand.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho Pasian humop hi, ci-a um in khen khempeuh theih a baih hi, ci nopna hi lo hi.

records.english: Christians believe the Bible is inspired by God.
records.zomi: Khristiante in Laisiangtho pen Pasian humop ahi hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Paul seems to have dictated some of his letters to a helper and then added a greeting in his own hand.
records.zomi: Paul in a laikhak pawl khat huhpa khat kiangah a gen-a gelhsak a, tua ciangin amah' khut mah tawh hopihna a behlap bang hi.

records.english: My grandfather's Bible is full of notes he wrote in the margins over fifty years.
records.zomi: Ka pu' Laisiangtho kum sawm nga sung a dawng-a a gelh ciamtehnate a dim hi.

records.english: Christians often refer to a verse in Paul's second letter to Timothy that calls all Scripture "God-breathed".
records.zomi: Khristiante in Laisiangtho khempeuh “Pasian a humop” a ci, Paul' Timoti kianga a laikhak nihna sung-a tang khat a gen zel uh hi.

records.english: Who decided which books belong in the Bible?
records.zomi: Laibu bangte Laisiangtho sungah a kihel ding hiam kua in a thukhen hiam?

records.english: Church leaders over several centuries, who recognized the books already used in worship.
records.zomi: Pakna sungah a kizang khinte a pom kum za tampi sung-a pawlpi makaite in.

records.english: Our pastor encourages us to read the Bible slowly and to pray before we begin.
records.zomi: I pastor in Laisiangtho zawl takin sim dingin leh i kipat ma-in thu ngen dingin hong hanthawn hi.

records.english: Which book of the Bible do you like best?
records.zomi: Laisiangtho sung-a laibu bang na deih pen hiam?

records.english: The Gospel of Luke, because of its stories about ordinary people.
records.zomi: Luka Lungdamna Thu, a sung-a mi ngeina tangthute hangin.

records.english: Can you help me find the verse our pastor mentioned on Sunday?
records.zomi: I pastor in Nipini ciangin a gen tang zong dingin hong huh thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: I do want to understand the Bible better, so I've joined a study group on Wednesday evenings.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho tam zaw-in theih ka deih taktak ahih manin Nilai ni nitak simin sinna pawl khat ah ka kihel hi.

records.english: The doctrine of inspiration is closely connected to how a church decides what is taught and practiced.
records.zomi: Pasian humopna thuhilhna in pawlpi khat in bang hilh ding leh bang sem ding hiam a thukhen dan tawh a kizom mahmah hi.

records.english: Can a translation be inspired too?
records.zomi: Lai letna khat zong Pasian humop hi thei hiam?

records.english: Many churches teach that the original writings were inspired and that faithful translations carry the same message.
records.zomi: Pawlpi tampi in a kipatna gelhte Pasian humop ahi a, citak taka lai letnate in thu kibang a pua uh hi, ci-in a hilh uh hi.

records.english: My mother gave me my first Bible when I was ten.
records.zomi: Kum sawm ka phak ciangin ka nu in ka Laisiangtho masa pen hong pia hi.

records.english: Do all Christians understand inspiration in the same way?
records.zomi: Khristian khempeuh in Pasian humopna kibang takin a thei uh hiam?

records.english: No, some believe every word was guided, while others focus on the message rather than the exact wording.
records.zomi: Hi lo hi, pawl khat in kammal khempeuh kimakaih hi, ci-in a um uh a, a dang te in kammal kician sangin thu tungah a lungsim uh a koih zaw uh hi.

records.english: Don't skip the parts you find difficult.
records.zomi: Na haksat sak khente pelh kei in.

records.english: The old family Bible was rebound so that it would last another generation.
records.zomi: Innkuan Laisiangtho lui khang dang khat a cin nadingin kituam kik hi.

records.english: Why do you call the Bible holy?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Laisiangtho pen siangtho na ci hiam?

records.english: Because we believe God speaks to us through it.
records.zomi: Pasian in tua tungtawn-in hong kikum hi, ci-in i um ahih manin.

records.english: The Bible contains poems, letters, laws, stories and prophecies.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho sungah late, laikhak, thukham, tangthu leh kamsang thu te a om hi.

records.english: Why did God use human writers instead of giving the Bible in some other way?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pasian in lampi dang tawh Laisiangtho pia sangin mihing gelhtute a zang hiam?

records.english: Christians answer this differently, but many say it shows that God works through ordinary people.
records.zomi: Khristiante in tuamtuam-in a dawng uh a, ahi zongin tampi in Pasian in mi ngeinate tungtawn-in a sem hi, ci a lak hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: A verse quoted out of context can be used to support almost any opinion, which is why careful study matters.
records.zomi: A kiim thu om lo-a kigen tang khat ngaihsutna bangpeuh khauhsak nadingin kizang thei ahih manin limtaka sin a thupi hi.

records.english: Our church reads from the Bible at every service.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in kikhopna khempeuh ah Laisiangtho pan a sim hi.

records.english: When I was little, my parents taught me to shake hands with my right hand while touching my right arm with my left.
records.zomi: Ka neu lai-in ka nu leh ka pa in ka veilam khut tawh ka taklam ban khoih kawm-in ka taklam khut tawh khut len dingin hong sin sak uh hi.

records.english: The old man was so pleased by the children's polite greeting that he gave each of them a sweet.
records.zomi: Naupangte' zahtak taka hopihna in pasal upa a kipaksak lua ahih manin a khat ciat thei khum khat a pia hi.

records.english: My son was praised by our neighbors because he greeted every elder at the wedding.
records.zomi: Mopawi ah upa khempeuh a hopih manin ka tapa i inn vengte in a phat uh hi.

records.english: Learning how a community greets people is often the first step to being accepted by it.
records.zomi: Mipi khat in mite bangci-in a hopih uh hiam sin pen amaute' kiang-a kisan nading kalsuan masa ahi zel hi.

records.english: Do I have to say where I'm really going when someone asks me on the path?
records.zomi: Lampi ah mi khat in hong dot ciangin koi ka pai taktak hiam ka gen ding a kisam hiam?

records.english: No, it's only a friendly greeting, so "just to the market" is enough.
records.zomi: Kisam lo hi, lawmtaka hopihna bek ahih manin “zuakna mun bek” ci in a tawk hi.

records.english: When my cousin bowed too low to a young guest, everyone laughed kindly, and he laughed too.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in khual khangno khat kiangah a niam lua-in a kun ciangin mi khempeuh hehpih takin a nui uh a, amah zong a nui hi.

records.english: What surprised my children most on their first visit home was how long every greeting took.
records.zomi: Ka tate a inn masa veh ciangun a lamdang sak pen hopihna khat ciat bangzah a sawt hiam ahi hi.

records.english: Say good morning to your grandmother.
records.zomi: Na pi kiangah zingpha ci in.

records.english: Why do some people bow while they shake hands?
records.zomi: Bang hangin mi pawl khat in khut a len laitakin a kun uh hiam?

records.english: It's a small sign of respect, especially to older people.
records.zomi: Zahtakna lahna neu khat ahi a, a diak in upate kiangah.

records.english: We always greet the neighbors on the way to church, even the ones we've hardly ever spoken to.
records.zomi: Pawlpi pai lampi ah i kikum ngei loh dek te zong kihel-in inn vengte i hopih tawntung hi.

records.english: Wave goodbye to your grandparents before we drive away.
records.zomi: I pai khiat ma-in na pu leh na pite kiangah khut kawp in.

records.english: How should I greet your parents when I meet them on Sunday?
records.zomi: Nipini ciangin na nu leh na pa ka kimuh ciangin bangci-in ka hopih ding hiam?

records.english: Shake my father's hand gently, smile, and wait for my mother to speak first.
records.zomi: Ka pa' khut nemtakin len inla, nui inla, ka nu in a gen masa dong ngak in.

records.english: Who should greet first, the younger person or the older one?
records.zomi: Kua in a hopih masa ding hiam, a neu zaw hiam a upa zaw hiam?

records.english: The younger one, in our village.
records.zomi: A neu zaw, i khua ah.

records.english: Children in our community call older neighbors "uncle" or "auntie", even when they aren't related.
records.zomi: I mipi-a naupangte in a kizop kei uh zongin upa inn vengte “pa neu” hiam “ni” ci-in a sam uh hi.

records.english: When relatives arrive from far away, we greet them at the gate, not inside the house.
records.zomi: Gamla pan sanggamte a tun ciangin inn sungah hi lo-in kongpi ah i hopih uh hi.

records.english: Visitors to my uncle's house are always offered tea before anyone asks why they've come.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu' inn-a khualte bang hangin a hong uh hiam kuamah in a dot ma-in tea a kipia tawntung uh hi.

records.english: In our village, failing to greet an elder you have passed on the path might be remembered for years.
records.zomi: I khua ah lampi ah na pelh upa khat na hopih kei leh kum tampi sung a kiphawk kha thei hi.

records.english: Greet the oldest person in the room first, even if you know the younger ones better.
records.zomi: Naupang zawte na theih zawk zongin inndei sung-a upa pen hopih masa in.

records.english: A respectful greeting can matter more to an elder than an expensive gift.
records.zomi: Zahtak taka hopihna khat in upa khat adingin letsong man tam sangin a thupi zaw thei hi.

records.english: At our church, everyone shakes hands with the pastor at the door after the service.
records.zomi: I pawlpi ah kikhopna khit ciangin mi khempeuh in kongkhak ah pastor tawh khut a len uh hi.

records.english: Take off your hat when you greet the elders.
records.zomi: Upate na hopih ciangin na lukhu suah in.

records.english: The first time my Australian husband visited our village, he greeted everyone with a quick wave.
records.zomi: Australia ka pasal i khua a veh masak ciangin mi khempeuh khut kawp manlang tawh a hopih hi.

records.english: My father quietly showed him how our elders like to be greeted, with a handshake and a slight bow.
records.zomi: Ka pa in i upate in khut len leh kun neu tawh hopih a deih uh dan dai takin a lak hi.

records.english: By the end of the week, he was greeting the old men so respectfully that they invited him to sit with them.
records.zomi: Kal a bei ciangin pasal upate zahtak takin a hopih ahih manin amaute tawh tu dingin a sam uh hi.

records.english: In our village, people often greet each other by asking, "Have you eaten yet?"
records.zomi: I khua ah mite in “An na ne khin hiam?” ci-in a kihopih zel uh hi.

records.english: Did you greet the guests properly?
records.zomi: Khualte hoih takin na hopih hiam?

records.english: I shook hands with everyone except the baby.
records.zomi: Naungek simloh mi khempeuh tawh khut ka len hi.

records.english: Don't greet an elder with your hands in your pockets.
records.zomi: Na khut na ip sungah koih-in upa khat hopih kei in.

records.english: Give your uncle a hug.
records.zomi: Na pa neu kawi in.

records.english: Why do your neighbors greet you by asking whether you've eaten?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na inn vengte in an na ne khin hiam ci-in hong hopih uh hiam?

records.english: It's a way of showing that they care, not a real question about lunch.
records.zomi: Hong lungsim uh lahna ahi a, sun an thu dotna taktak hi lo hi.

records.english: How do you greet someone older at the market?
records.zomi: Zuakna mun ah upa zaw khat bangci-in na hopih hiam?

records.english: With a small bow and a polite question about their family.
records.zomi: Kun neu leh a innkuan thu dotna zahtak taka dotna tawh.

records.english: The way a greeting changes with age and relationship shows how carefully our community thinks about respect.
records.zomi: Kum leh kizopna bangin hopihna a kikhel dan in i mipi in zahtakna thu bangzah limtakin a ngaihsun hiam a lak hi.

records.english: Is it rude to greet an elder by his first name?
records.zomi: Upa khat a min tawh hopih pen zahtak lo ahi hiam?

records.english: In our family, yes, so use "grandfather" or "uncle" instead.
records.zomi: I innkuan ah ahi hi, tua ahih manin a sangin “pu” hiam “pa neu” zang in.

records.english: Greetings in our community were never written down; they were learned by watching parents and grandparents.
records.zomi: I mipi-a hopihnate kigelh ngei lo a, nu leh pa leh pu leh pite en-in kisin hi.

records.english: Some greetings that once marked respect are now used mainly at weddings, funerals and festivals.
records.zomi: Zahtakna lahna a hih ngei hopihna pawl khat tu-in mopawi, sihna leh pawite ah bek a tamzaw-in kizang hi.

records.english: Stand up, please, the pastor is here.
records.zomi: Ding un, pastor a hong tung hi.

records.english: Asking "Where are you going?" is often just a friendly greeting on the village path.
records.zomi: “Koi na pai hiam?” cih pen khua lampi ah lawmtaka hopihna bek ahi zel hi.

records.english: Can you teach my friend how we greet elders?
records.zomi: Upate bangci-in i hopih hiam ka lawm na sin sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: We greet relatives abroad on a video call every Sunday, and the children wave to their grandparents one by one.
records.zomi: Nipini simin video call tawh gamdang-a sanggamte i hopih a, naupangte in a pu leh a pite kiangah khat zawh khat khut a kawp uh hi.

records.english: Would it be disrespectful to greet my partner's grandmother with a hug instead of a handshake?
records.zomi: Ka it' pi khut len sangin kawi-in ka hopih leh zahtak lo ding hiam?

records.english: Greetings that seem formal to outsiders often express a deep sense of belonging within a family.
records.zomi: Pua lam mite adingin a kician lua bang hopihnate in innkuan sungah kizopna thuk a lak zel hi.

records.english: My mother always stands up when an older visitor comes into the room.
records.zomi: Upa zaw khual khat inndei sungah a hong lut ciangin ka nu a ding tawntung hi.

records.english: Teaching children the old greetings at home helps them feel confident when they visit relatives.
records.zomi: Inn ah naupangte hopihna luite sin sak in sanggamte a veh ciangun a kingap nadingun a huh hi.

records.english: The elders were greeted first, and then the children were allowed to eat.
records.zomi: Upate kihopih masa a, tua ciangin naupangte an ne dingin kiphal hi.

records.english: Young people in the city sometimes greet elders with a quick nod, which upsets some of the older generation.
records.zomi: Khuapi-a khangnote in upate lu sing manlang tawh a hopih zel uh a, tua in upa khang pawl khat a lungkhamsak hi.

records.english: Why does your grandfather hold your hand with both of his when he greets you?
records.zomi: Na pu in hong hopih ciangin bang hangin a khut nih tawh na khut a len hiam?

records.english: In our family, it shows extra warmth and respect.
records.zomi: I innkuan ah lungsim lumna leh zahtakna behlap a lak hi.

records.english: Everyone, please stand when the elders come in, and wait until they sit down.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, upate a lut ciangun ding unla, a tut dong uh ngak un.

records.english: A visitor from another town was greeted by the whole family at the door.
records.zomi: Khuapi dang pan khual khat innkuan bup in kongkhak ah a hopih uh hi.

records.english: My grandfather says that a greeting tells you more about a family than any conversation.
records.zomi: Ka pu in hopihna khat in kikupna bangpeuh sangin innkuan khat thu tam zaw hong hilh hi, a ci hi.

records.english: At a funeral, people greet the family quietly and hold their hands for a long time.
records.zomi: Sihna ah mite in innkuan dai takin a hopih uh a, a khut uh sawt mahmah a len uh hi.

records.english: Many Zomi families abroad worry that their children will lose the habit of greeting elders respectfully.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a Zomi innkuan tampi in a tate uh in upate zahtak taka hopih ngeina a mangngilh ding uh hi, ci-in a lungkham uh hi.

records.english: Our youth group practices traditional greetings before the cultural festival, so that visitors are welcomed properly.
records.zomi: I khangno pawl in ngeina pawi ma-in khualte hoih taka muak nadingin ngeina hopihnate a sin uh hi.

records.english: Shall we climb to the top of the tower together, so that you don't feel scared?
records.zomi: Na lau lohna dingin innsang tung pen dong khawm-in i kah ding hiam?

records.english: Was the boy who saved the dog hurt?
records.zomi: Ui a hotkhia pasal naupang a liam hiam?

records.english: Only a few scratches, and the dog licked his face all the way home.
records.zomi: Kinawlna tawmno bek, leh ui in inn dong a mai a liak hi.

records.english: The firefighters went back into the burning house to look for the family's grandmother.
records.zomi: Meisi nasemte in innkuan' pi zong dingin meikang inn sungah a lut kik uh hi.

records.english: Children, can you think of a time when you did something even though you were scared?
records.zomi: Naupangte, na lau napi bangmah khat na bawl hun khat na ngaihsun thei uh hiam?

records.english: Standing up to a friend who is doing something wrong can be harder than facing a stranger.
records.zomi: Thu khial a bawl lawm khat langpan pen theih loh mi khat langpan sangin a haksa zaw thei hi.

records.english: You don't have to pretend you're not frightened.
records.zomi: Na lau kei hi, ci-in na kisa kul kei hi.

records.english: The old woman refused to leave her house until every animal had been taken to safety.
records.zomi: Numei upa in ganhing khempeuh bit mun ah a kipuak dong a inn a nusia nuam kei hi.

records.english: How did you find the strength to start again after losing the shop?
records.zomi: Dawl na mansuah khit ciangin kipan kik nadingin hatna bangci-in na mu hiam?

records.english: My children needed me, and that gave me courage on the days I wanted to give up.
records.zomi: Ka tate in hong kisam uh a, tua in ka khawl nuam niten hangsanna hong pia hi.

records.english: It took real courage for my friend to tell her parents she wanted to change her studies.
records.zomi: Ka lawm in a sinna khel nuam hi, ci-in a nu leh a pa kiangah a gen nadingin hangsanna taktak a kisam hi.

records.english: Courage without wisdom can turn into recklessness, which puts others in danger as well.
records.zomi: Pilna om lo hangsanna in kidopna om lo-a suak thei a, tua in mi dangte zong a lauhuai sak hi.

records.english: The shy girl raised her hand and asked the question everyone else was afraid to ask.
records.zomi: Zumthak numei naupang in a khut a lap a, mi dang khempeuh in a dot ngam loh uh dotna a dong hi.

records.english: After the accident, it took my cousin months to find the courage to ride a bicycle again.
records.zomi: Kipalhna khit ciangin ka sanggam siiksakol a tuan kik nadingin hangsanna a muh dingin kha tampi a sawt hi.

records.english: Are you nervous about the operation tomorrow?
records.zomi: Zingciang zai adingin na lau hiam?

records.english: I'm proud of you for speaking up.
records.zomi: Na gen ngam manin nang tungah ka kipak hi.

records.english: How do firefighters stay so calm when a building is on fire?
records.zomi: Inn khat a kang ciangin meisi nasemte bangci-in a lungsim dai den uh hiam?

records.english: What's the bravest thing you've ever done?
records.zomi: Na bawl ngei hangsan pen bang ahi hiam?

records.english: Don't be afraid to ask.
records.zomi: Dong ding lau kei in.

records.english: Had the teacher not spoken up, the bullying might have gone on for the whole year.
records.zomi: Saya in a gen kei leh khak-a nawngkaisakna kum bup a om lai kha ding hi.

records.english: My sister finally told the bully to stop.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam numei in a tawp-in a nawngkaisakpa khawl dingin a hilh hi.

records.english: Try once more, and I'll stand right here.
records.zomi: Vei khat sin kik in, hih mah ah ka ding ding hi.

records.english: The people who helped their neighbors during the war rarely described themselves as heroes.
records.zomi: Galdona sungin a inn vengte a huh mite in amau le amau mi hangsan ci-in a kigen ngei kei uh hi.

records.english: My younger brother was terrified of speaking in front of the class.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal in kilasi mai ah thugen a lau mahmah hi.

records.english: He practiced his speech every evening in front of our dog, who never once interrupted him.
records.zomi: Nitak simin i ui mai ah a thugen a sin a, i ui in vei khat zong a khen kei hi.

records.english: Why did the air conditioning stop when I left the room?
records.zomi: Inndei ka nusiat ciangin bang hangin air conditioning a khawl hiam?

records.english: It switches off automatically when the card is taken out, to save electricity.
records.zomi: Meivak khol nadingin card kila khiat ciangin amah mah-in a mit hi.

records.english: Switch on the water heater half an hour before you want a shower.
records.zomi: Na kisil ding hun ma nai khen khat ah tui lumsakna phong in.

records.english: You can cancel free of charge until two days before you arrive.
records.zomi: Na tun ma ni nih dong man om lo-in na phiat thei hi.

records.english: The host said, "Don't worry about the washing up; the cleaner comes on Monday."
records.zomi: Inn neipa in, “Kuang sil thu-ah lungkham kei in, inn siangsakpa Pizing ni-in a hong ding hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: Bring your own padlock for the locker, because the hostel doesn't provide one.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk neu in a pia kei ahih manin van koihna bawm adingin nangmah' khakna tawi in.

records.english: Reading the cancellation terms before you book can save you a great deal of money if your plans change.
records.zomi: Na kilai ma-in phiatna thukhamte sim in na geelnate a kikhel leh sum tampi a khol thei hi.

records.english: Do we need to book dinner, or can we just come down?
records.zomi: Nitak an i kilai ding a kisam hiam, ahih kei leh i kum bek thei ding hiam?

records.english: You'd better book, because there's a wedding party tonight.
records.zomi: Na kilai zaw ding hi, tu zanin mopawi pawl khat a om ahih manin.

records.english: Our booking was moved to the hotel's sister building, which nobody had mentioned to us.
records.zomi: I kilaina zinbuuk' sanggam inn ah kisuan a, tua thu kuamah in hong hilh kei uh hi.

records.english: Breakfast is served on the terrace when the weather is fine.
records.zomi: Huihkhua a hoih ciangin zingsang an inn dawh tungah kipia hi.

records.english: The hotel taxi will wait outside at five, so set an alarm in case you oversleep.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk taxi nai nga ciangin pua ah a ngak ding ahih manin na ihmu sawt kha leh ci-in alarm koih in.

records.english: Could you write the hotel's name down for the taxi driver?
records.zomi: Taxi mawngpa adingin zinbuuk min hong gelh sak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: How do I turn the heating up in the room?
records.zomi: Inndei sungah meilum bangci-in ka khangsak ding hiam?

records.english: Use the dial beside the bed, and give it twenty minutes to warm up.
records.zomi: Lupna kiang-a kualna zang inla, a lum nadingin minit sawm nih pia in.

records.english: In some guesthouses you're expected to strip the bed on your last morning, so check the notice by the door.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk neu pawl khat ah na zingsang nunung pen-in lupna puan na lak khiat ding kilamen ahih manin kongkhak kiang-a thu genna en in.

records.english: To set the safe, choose any four numbers, press the lock button and close the door.
records.zomi: Sum bawm koih dingin nambat li bangpeuh teel inla, khakna button nek inla, kongkhak khak in.

records.english: Hostels with shared kitchens let travelers save money and meet people from all over the world.
records.zomi: An huanna kihawm nei zinbuuk neute in khualzinte sum a khol sak a, leitung mun tuamtuam pan mite a kimu sak hi.

records.english: Could I have a second key card for my husband?
records.zomi: Ka pasal adingin tawh card nihna ka ngah thei ding hiam?

records.english: Put your key card in the slot by the door, or the lights won't come on.
records.zomi: Kongkhak kiang-a kua sungah na tawh card koih in, ahih kei leh meivakte a vak lo ding hi.

records.english: The more detailed a host's instructions are, the less likely guests are to phone at midnight.
records.zomi: Inn neipa' thuhilhna a kician zawk ciangin khualte in zanlai ciangin a sam tawm zaw uh hi.

records.english: What's the weather like today?
records.zomi: Tuni huihkhua bangci om hiam?

records.english: Windy, with a few showers this afternoon.
records.zomi: Huih a nung a, tu sun nungin guah tawmno a zuk ding hi.

records.english: Dew forms on the grass at night when the ground cools and water in the air turns to droplets.
records.zomi: Zan ah lei a vot a, huih sung-a tui in tui tang a suah ciangin lopa tungah dai a kiak hi.

records.english: Is a hurricane the same as a typhoon?
records.zomi: Hurricane leh typhoon a kibang hiam?

records.english: Yes, they are the same kind of storm, but they have different names in different oceans.
records.zomi: Kibang hi, huihpi kibang mah ahi a, ahi zongin tuipi tuamtuam ah min tuamtuam a nei uh hi.

records.english: How often should we read the thermometer?
records.zomi: Thermometer bangzah vei i sim ding hiam?

records.english: Twice a day, at nine and at three.
records.zomi: Ni khat ah nihvei, nai kua leh nai thum ciangin.

records.english: Rather than describe the climate as hot, a geographer would give the average temperature and rainfall for each month.
records.zomi: Huihkhua ngeina a lum hi, ci sangin leitung thu siam khat in kha khat ciat-a a lum dan leh guah zuk zah a gen ding hi.

records.english: In our region, the monsoon brings most of the year's rain in just a few months.
records.zomi: I gam ah guah hun in kum sung-a guah a tamzaw kha tawmno sungin a tun hi.

records.english: Communities that depend on farming are often the first to notice when rainfall patterns begin to change.
records.zomi: Lo nasep tungah a kinga mipite in guah zuk dan a kikhel kipat ciangin a mu masa pen zel uh hi.

records.english: Planting trees on hillsides can reduce soil erosion during heavy rain.
records.zomi: Mual gei ah singkung suan in guah zuk nasia lai-in lei a ziat lohna dingin a huh thei hi.

records.english: My grandfather used to predict rain by looking at how low the swallows were flying.
records.zomi: Ka pu in vasa neute bangzah niam takin a leng uh hiam en-in guah a zuk ding a gen thei hi.

records.english: Fog is a cloud that touches the ground.
records.zomi: Meii pen leitung a tun meipi khat ahi hi.

records.english: Count the seconds between the flash and the thunder to estimate how far away the storm is.
records.zomi: Huihpi bangzah a gamla hiam theih nadingin khuavak leh van ging kikal-a second te sim in.

records.english: Scientists agree that the average temperature of the Earth has risen over the past century.
records.zomi: Science siamte in kum za nung sungin Leitung a lum dan laizang a khang hi, ci-in a kithukim uh hi.

records.english: Weather forecasts are made by computers that use measurements from all over the world.
records.zomi: Huihkhua thu genna te leitung mun khempeuh pan tehnate a zang computer te in a bawl uh hi.

records.english: Write today's temperature on the board.
records.zomi: Tuni a lum dan suanglaipi tungah gelh in.

records.english: When the air feels sticky, it usually means the humidity is high.
records.zomi: Huih a kibet bang a kisak ciangin huih sung-a tui a tam hi, ci nopna ahi zel hi.

records.english: Desert nights can be very cold, because there are few clouds to keep the heat in.
records.zomi: Lum a kem ding meipi a tawm ahih manin gam keu zan te a vot mahmah thei hi.

records.english: Forecasts are more reliable for tomorrow than for next week, because small changes in the atmosphere grow over time.
records.zomi: Van huih sung-a kikhelna neute hun sawt sungin a khang ahih manin huihkhua thu genna in a zom kal sangin zingciang adingin a muanhuai zaw hi.

records.english: Snow falls instead of rain when the air near the ground is cold enough.
records.zomi: Lei kiang-a huih a vot tawk ciangin guah sangin vuk a kia hi.

records.english: Mountains can create a rain shadow, leaving one side green and the other almost dry.
records.zomi: Mualte in guah limliam a bawl thei a, lam khat a eng a, a dang lam a keu dek hi.

records.english: Which month is the hottest here?
records.zomi: Hih ah kha bang a lum pen hiam?

records.english: A thermometer tells us how hot or cold the air is.
records.zomi: Thermometer in huih bangzah a lum hiam a vot hiam hong hilh hi.

records.english: The roof of the school was damaged by strong winds last winter.
records.zomi: Khuavot nung in huih hat in sang inn tung a susia hi.

records.english: Please don't stand under a tall tree during a thunderstorm.
records.zomi: Van ging huihpi sungin singkung sang nuai ah ding kei un.

records.english: Ice cores drilled from glaciers contain bubbles of ancient air that show what the climate was like long ago.
records.zomi: Tuikhal lian pan kitou tuikhal te in tanglai huihkhua ngeina bangci a hih hiam a lak tanglai huih kuangkuaite a nei hi.

records.english: Children, look out of the window and tell me what kind of clouds you can see.
records.zomi: Naupangte, tukvuang pan en unla, meipi bangci te na mu uh hiam hong hilh un.

records.english: Thick cloud at night keeps the ground warmer, so frost is less likely.
records.zomi: Zan-a meipi tau in lei a lumsak zaw ahih manin khuhtui a kia tawm zaw hi.

records.english: A rainbow appears when sunlight shines through raindrops.
records.zomi: Guah tang tungtawn-in ni vak a tan ciangin guahzaang a kilang hi.

records.english: It's colder today than it was yesterday.
records.zomi: Tuni zanni sangin a vot zaw hi.

records.english: Clouds form when warm, moist air rises and cools.
records.zomi: Huih lum leh nin a kahtou a, a vot ciangin meipi a suak hi.

records.english: What's the difference between weather and climate?
records.zomi: Huihkhua leh huihkhua ngeina kikal ah bang a kibang lo hiam?

records.english: Weather is what happens on one day, while climate is the usual pattern over many years.
records.zomi: Huihkhua pen ni khat sung-a piang ahi a, huihkhua ngeina pen kum tampi sung-a a ngeina ahi hi.

records.english: Why is the sky blue?
records.zomi: Bang hangin van a dum hiam?

records.english: The air scatters the blue part of sunlight more than the other colors, so blue reaches our eyes from every direction.
records.zomi: Huih in ni vak sung-a dum khen pen rong dangte sangin a thehthang zaw ahih manin dum pen lam khempeuh pan i mit ah a tung hi.

records.english: Why do we see lightning before we hear the thunder?
records.zomi: Bang hangin van ging i zak ma-in khuavak i mu hiam?

records.english: Because light travels much faster than sound.
records.zomi: Vak in aw sangin a manlang zaw mahmah ahih manin.

records.english: Leave a glass of iced water on the table, and drops will soon appear on the outside.
records.zomi: Dawhkan tungah tuikhal tui haai khat nusia in, tua ciangin a pua lam ah tui tang manlang takin a kilang ding hi.

records.english: Our school weather station measures the temperature, the wind speed and the rainfall.
records.zomi: I sang huihkhua tehna mun in a lum dan, huih manlang dan leh guah zuk zah a teh hi.

records.english: Water evaporates from the sea, forms clouds, and falls again as rain.
records.zomi: Tuipi pan tui a kahtou a, meipi a suak a, guah bangin a kia kik hi.

records.english: A weather vane shows which direction the wind is coming from.
records.zomi: Huih lak sik in huih koi lam pan a hong hiam a lak hi.

records.english: Our class made a simple rain gauge from a plastic bottle with a ruler taped to the side.
records.zomi: I kilasi in plastic bel khat ciang lam ah teh-na belh-in guah tehna baih khat a bawl hi.

records.english: Every morning at nine, one pupil read the water level and wrote it in the class diary.
records.zomi: Zingsang nai kua simin sangnaupang khat in tui zah a sim a, kilasi ciamtehna laibu sungah a gelh hi.

records.english: At the end of the month, we drew a bar chart and found that the wettest week had been the one with the school sports day.
records.zomi: Kha a bei ciangin bar chart khat i gelh a, guah tam pen kal pen sang kimawlna ni nei kal ahi hi, ci i mu hi.

records.english: Burning coal, oil and gas releases carbon dioxide, which traps heat in the atmosphere.
records.zomi: Suangtaang, sathau leh gas hal in carbon dioxide a suah sak a, tua in van huih sungah lum a khak hi.

records.english: Why is it colder at the top of a mountain?
records.zomi: Bang hangin mual tung pen ah a vot zaw hiam?

records.english: The air higher up is thinner, so it holds less heat.
records.zomi: A tung lam-a huih a pal zaw ahih manin lum tawm zaw a kem hi.

records.english: Draw the water cycle in your notebook.
records.zomi: Na laibu neu sungah tui kualvel dan gelh in.

records.english: How do you measure the wind?
records.zomi: Huih bangci-in na teh hiam?

records.english: With an instrument called an anemometer, which has little cups that spin.
records.zomi: Anemometer a kici, a kual haai neute nei van khat tawh.

records.english: Coastal towns often have milder winters than towns inland, because the sea cools down slowly.
records.zomi: Tuipi gei khuapite in tuipi a vot zawl ahih manin gam sung khuapite sangin khuavot nem zaw a nei zel uh hi.

records.english: The seasons change because the Earth is tilted as it travels around the sun.
records.zomi: Leitung ni a kiim a vel laitakin a ngaksai ahih manin hun te a kikhel hi.

records.english: Understanding the local climate helps families decide when to plant, harvest and store food.
records.zomi: Mun huihkhua ngeina theih in innkuante in bang ciangin suan ding, lak ding leh an kem ding hiam a thukhen nadingun a huh hi.

records.english: The forecast was wrong, so the farmers' hay got wet in the field.
records.zomi: Huihkhua thu genna a khial ahih manin lo neite' lopa keu lo sungah a nin hi.

records.english: Does it ever snow in your country?
records.zomi: Na gam ah vuk a kia ngei hiam?

records.english: Only on the highest mountains.
records.zomi: Mual sang pente tungah bek.

records.english: Shall we check the rain gauge after lunch?
records.zomi: Sun an khit ciangin guah tehna i en ding hiam?

records.english: A warmer climate can make heatwaves more frequent and some storms more intense.
records.zomi: Huihkhua ngeina lum zaw in lum nasia hunte a tam zaw sak a, huihpi pawl khat a nasia zaw sak thei hi.

records.english: A drought happens when an area gets much less rain than usual for a long time.
records.zomi: Mun khat in hun sawt sungin a ngeina sangin guah tawm mahmah a ngah ciangin khuakhal a piang hi.

records.english: A week after starting her new tablets, my mother noticed a dry cough that wouldn't go away.
records.zomi: A zatui thakte a nek kipat khit kal khat ciangin ka nu in a dam lo khuh keu khat a mu hi.

records.english: She mentioned it to her doctor, who said it was a known side effect of that particular medicine.
records.zomi: A siavuan kiangah a gen a, tua zatui' hoih lo lam kithei khat ahi hi, a ci hi.

records.english: He switched her to a different one, and the cough had gone within a fortnight.
records.zomi: A dang khat ah a khel sak a, kal nih sungin a khuh a dam hi.

records.english: Which of my medicines could be causing this?
records.zomi: Ka zatui bang in hih a piangsak thei hiam?

records.english: Since the dose was reduced, my father has had much more energy.
records.zomi: Zatui zah a kiam pan kipan ka pa in hatna tam zaw a nei hi.

records.english: My skin burns easily since I started this cream.
records.zomi: Hih zatui sathau ka zat kipat pan ka vun ni-in a kang baih hi.

records.english: Is it normal to feel dizzy after the injection?
records.zomi: Zatui sun khit ciangin ka lu a hei pen a ngeina mah hiam?

records.english: It can happen, so sit down for a few minutes before you get up.
records.zomi: A piang thei hi, tua ahih manin na thoh ma-in minit tawmno tu in.

records.english: When will the itching stop?
records.zomi: Thak bang ciangin a khawl ding hiam?

records.english: The leaflet says it should settle within a few days.
records.zomi: Laimai in ni tawmno sungin a dai ding hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Could the side effects get worse if I keep taking it?
records.zomi: Ka ne den leh zatui' hoih lo lam a nasia zaw thei hiam?

records.english: My mouth has been very dry this week.
records.zomi: Hih kal ka kam a keu mahmah hi.

records.english: Do these make you sleepy?
records.zomi: Hih te in hong ihmuthak sak hiam?

records.english: They make me thirsty, but not sleepy.
records.zomi: Hong dangtak sak a, ahi zongin hong ihmuthak sak kei hi.

records.english: Please tell the nurse if you feel unwell during the treatment.
records.zomi: Zatui zat laitakin na dam kei leh nurse hilh in.

records.english: What worries me most is that I can't tell whether the tiredness comes from the illness or the treatment.
records.zomi: Ka lungkham pen tawlna natna pan a hong pai hiam zatui pan a hong pai hiam ka thei thei kei ahi hi.

records.english: The pharmacist explained that most of the side effects on the list are very rare.
records.zomi: Zatui zuakpa in list tung-a zatui' hoih lo lam a tamzaw pen a piang tawm mahmah hi, ci-in a gen siang hi.

records.english: My grandfather's ankles started swelling after his blood pressure medicine was changed.
records.zomi: A si khauhna zatui a kikhel khit ciangin ka pu' khe zungkhuk a vung kipan hi.

records.english: Write down any side effects you notice, with the date, and bring the list to your next appointment.
records.zomi: Na muh zatui' hoih lo lam khempeuh ni tawh gelh inla, a zom na kimuhna ah list tawi in.

records.english: Rather than skipping doses quietly, patients should tell the doctor that a side effect is bothering them.
records.zomi: Dai takin zatui nek nusia sangin damlote in zatui' hoih lo lam khat in a buaisak hi, ci-in siavuan a hilh ding uh hi.

records.english: Could you check whether my new tablets are safe with my inhaler?
records.zomi: Ka zatui thakte ka inhaler tawh a bit hiam hong en sak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: I'd like to ask whether this cough syrup will affect my sleep.
records.zomi: Hih khuh zatui tui in ka ihmut a khawk ding hiam ka dong nuam hi.

records.english: My daughter was given a different antibiotic because the first one made her sick.
records.zomi: A masa pen in a lungzuak sak ahih manin ka tanu antibiotic dang khat kipia hi.

records.english: Mention even small side effects, such as a mild rash, at your next appointment.
records.zomi: A zom na kimuhna ah vun san neu bang zatui' hoih lo lam neu te zong gen in.

records.english: Can I stop taking it if I feel better?
records.zomi: Ka hoih zawh leh ka ne khawl thei ding hiam?

records.english: Ask your doctor first, because some medicines shouldn't be stopped suddenly.
records.zomi: Na siavuan dong masa in, zatui pawl khat pah-in khawl lo ding ahih manin.

records.english: Older people who take several medicines need their prescriptions reviewed regularly, because the effects can combine.
records.zomi: Zatui tampi a ne upate in a sepna a kihel thei ahih manin a zatui gelhnate a tawntung-in kien kik ding a kisam hi.

records.english: I'd rather keep taking it, but the tiredness is making it hard to work.
records.zomi: Ka ne den nuam zaw a, ahi zongin tawlna in nasep a haksasak hi.

records.english: Could you ask the doctor whether there's a version of this medicine that's gentler on the stomach?
records.zomi: Hih zatui' gil tungah nem zaw a om hiam siavuan na dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: Side effects were reported to the pharmacy, and the doctor reviewed the prescription the same week.
records.zomi: Zatui' hoih lo lamte zatui dawl kiangah kigen a, siavuan in kal kibang mah-in zatui gelhna a en kik hi.

records.english: Do these tablets react badly with alcohol?
records.zomi: Hih zatuite zu tawh a kituak lo hiam?

records.english: With this one, yes, so the pharmacist advised avoiding alcohol completely.
records.zomi: Hih tawh kituak lo hi, tua ahih manin zatui zuakpa in zu kim takin pelh dingin a hilh hi.

records.english: Thank you for explaining the side effects so clearly.
records.zomi: Zatui' hoih lo lam kician takin na gen siang manin lungdam ing.

records.english: My brother had his medicine changed after it kept him awake every night.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal' zatui zan simin a ihmusak kei khit ciangin a kikhel hi.

records.english: Are there any side effects I should know about?
records.zomi: Ka theih ding zatui' hoih lo lam a om hiam?

records.english: Some people get an upset stomach at first, so the leaflet suggests taking it with food.
records.zomi: Mi pawl khat a kipat ciangin a gil a buai a, tua ahih manin laimai in an tawh ne dingin a gen hi.

records.english: A side effect that is mild for one person can be very troublesome for another.
records.zomi: Mi khat adingin a neu zatui' hoih lo lam khat in mi dang khat adingin a buaihuai mahmah thei hi.

records.english: I've had a headache every day since I started these tablets.
records.zomi: Hih zatuite ka nek kipat pan ni simin ka lu a na hi.

records.english: The leaflet with my mother's tablets lists the side effects from the most common to the rarest.
records.zomi: Ka nu' zatui tawh hong pai laimai in zatui' hoih lo lam a tam pen pan a tawm pen dong a gelh hi.

records.english: I feel a bit sick in the mornings.
records.zomi: Zingsang ciangin tawmno ka lungzuak hi.

records.english: Has the new medicine helped?
records.zomi: Zatui thak in hong huh hiam?

records.english: Yes, and the side effects have been milder than I feared.
records.zomi: Huh hi, leh zatui' hoih lo lam ka lau sangin a nem zaw hi.

records.english: Honesty with your doctor about side effects is the surest way to find a treatment that suits you.
records.zomi: Zatui' hoih lo lam thu-ah na siavuan tungah thuman pen nang tawh a kituak zatui zat dan muh nading lampi muanhuai pen ahi hi.

records.english: The nurse rang the next day to ask whether the injection had caused any swelling.
records.zomi: Nurse in a zing ciangin zatui sun in vung a piangsak hiam dong dingin a sam hi.

records.english: Which side effects are serious enough to go to the hospital?
records.zomi: Zatui' hoih lo lam bang te siavuan inn ah pai dingin a nasia hiam?

records.english: The doctor said that swelling of the face or trouble breathing would need emergency help.
records.zomi: Siavuan in mai vung hiam huih dawn haksatna in haksatna huhna a kisam ding hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Is a metal taste in the mouth a side effect, or is it something else?
records.zomi: Kam sung-a sik lim pen zatui' hoih lo lam ahi hiam, a dang ahi hiam?

records.english: What should I do if I get a rash?
records.zomi: Vun san ka neih leh bang ka bawl ding hiam?

records.english: Stop taking it and call the surgery straight away, as your doctor told you.
records.zomi: Na siavuan in a hilh bangin ne khawl inla, siavuan inn pah-in sam in.

records.english: Call me if you feel sick.
records.zomi: Na lungzuak leh hong sam in.

records.english: Is this side effect common?
records.zomi: Hih zatui' hoih lo lam a piang tam hiam?

records.english: Doctors weigh the benefits of a medicine against its possible side effects before prescribing it.
records.zomi: Siavuante in zatui khat a gelh ma-un a phattuamna leh a hoih lo lam a teh uh hi.

records.english: Patients who are told what to expect are often less worried when a minor side effect appears.
records.zomi: Bang a lamen ding hiam kihilh damlote in zatui' hoih lo lam neu khat a kilan ciangin a lungkham tawm zaw zel uh hi.

records.english: Had my uncle mentioned the dizziness sooner, his medicine could have been adjusted before he fell.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu in a lu hei thu manlang zaw-in a gen leh a kiak ma-in a zatui kibawl dik kha ding hi.

records.english: Many people put up with side effects for months because they don't realize there may be alternatives.
records.zomi: Mi tampi in a dang a om thei hi, ci a theih kei uh manin kha tampi sung zatui' hoih lo lam a thuak uh hi.

records.english: My aunt's doctor warned her that the treatment might make her hair thinner for a while.
records.zomi: Ka ni' siavuan in zatui zat in hun tawmno sung a sam a pal sak kha ding hi, ci-in a kidopsak hi.

records.english: My son's new medicine has made him very hungry.
records.zomi: Ka tapa' zatui thak in a gil kial mahmah sak hi.

records.english: Don't drive until you know how this medicine affects you.
records.zomi: Hih zatui in nang tungah bangci-in a sem hiam na theih dong mawtaw mawng kei in.
