records.english: Don't keep it all inside.
records.zomi: Na sungah khempeuh kem kei in.

records.english: Talking about a sad experience doesn't make it worse; for many people it slowly makes it lighter.
records.zomi: Dahhuai thu khat gen in a siasak zaw kei a, mi tampi adingin zawl takin a zang zaw sak hi.

records.english: Children often show sadness through anger or tiredness rather than tears.
records.zomi: Naupangte in a dahna uh khitui sangin heh hiam tawlna tawh a lak zel uh hi.

records.english: Why do you keep a jar of notes on the kitchen table?
records.zomi: Bang hangin an huanna dawhkan tungah ciamtehna bel khat na kem hiam?

records.english: Every evening we each write one good thing that happened, and we read them together at New Year.
records.zomi: Nitak simin i khat ciat in thu hoih khat i gelh a, Kum Thak ciangin khawm-in i sim hi.

records.english: Please don't tell someone who is grieving that everything happens for a reason.
records.zomi: Lungkham mi khat kiangah thu khempeuh hang nei-in a piang hi, ci-in gen kei un.

records.english: Why does music make some people cry?
records.zomi: Bang hangin la in mi pawl khat a kapsak hiam?

records.english: It can bring back a memory or a feeling before we even realize it.
records.zomi: I theih ma-in phawkna hiam kisakna khat a hong tun kik thei hi.

records.english: Did something good happen today?
records.zomi: Tuni thu hoih bangmah a piang hiam?

records.english: The sun came out, and my son called from abroad.
records.zomi: Ni a suak a, ka tapa in gamdang pan hong sam hi.

records.english: Many people feel numb at first after a death, and the tears come later.
records.zomi: Mi tampi in sihna khit ciangin a kipat ciangin bangmah a kisa kei uh a, khitui a nung ciangin a hong pai hi.

records.english: Ring me when you get home.
records.zomi: Inn na tun ciangin hong sam in.

records.english: Would you like a cup of tea while we talk?

records.english: Please, I'd like that.

records.english: Why shouldn't I say "I know how you feel"?
records.zomi: Bang hangin “Na kisak dan ka thei hi” ka ci lo ding hiam?

records.english: Go outside and get some fresh air.
records.zomi: Pua ah pai inla, huih thak la in.

records.english: Rather than asking "How are you?", try asking "How has today been?", which is easier to answer honestly.

records.english: Explaining your feelings in a letter can be easier than saying them out loud.
records.zomi: Laikhak tawh na kisak dan gen siang pen aw-a gen sangin a baih zaw thei hi.

records.english: How do I know if my friend needs more help than I can give?
records.zomi: Ka lawm in ka piak theih sangin huhna tam zaw a kisam hiam bangci-in ka thei ding hiam?

records.english: If she stops eating, sleeping or going out for weeks, encourage her to see a doctor.

records.english: Comparing your happiness with other people's photos online is unfair, because they rarely post their bad days.

records.english: The anniversary of my father's death is always hard, so my sister and I spend it together at his favorite lake.

records.english: You don't have to talk if you don't want to.
records.zomi: Na gen nuam kei leh na gen kul kei hi.

records.english: Write down three things you're grateful for.
records.zomi: Na lungdam thu thum gelh in.

records.english: Tell the children honestly that the dog has died, rather than saying he went to sleep.

records.english: A short text, such as "Thinking of you today", can mean a lot to someone who's struggling.

records.english: My doctor told me that regular sleep and meals can make low moods easier to manage.

records.english: The class was told about their classmate's illness gently, and each child drew him a picture.
records.zomi: Kilasi kiangah a kilasi pih' cinatna thu nemtakin kigen a, naupang khat ciat in a adingin lim khat a gelh uh hi.

records.english: Shall I come over and keep you company?
records.zomi: Na kiang ah om dingin ka hong ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, please, just for an hour.
records.zomi: Hong in, nai khat sung bek.

records.english: Her neighbor's visits made her feel less alone during the long first winter.
records.zomi: A inn veng' pai te in khuavot sau masa sungin amah bek a om bang-in a kisa tawm zaw sak hi.

records.english: Explaining death to a young child requires simple, honest words and plenty of patience.
records.zomi: Naupang neu khat kiangah sihna gen siang in kammal baih leh thuman leh thuakzawhna tampi a kisam hi.

records.english: Your message cheered me up more than you know.

records.english: Happiness that comes from helping others often lasts longer than the pleasure of buying something new.
records.zomi: Mi dangte huh pan hong pai lungdamna in van thak lei nuamna sangin a sawt zaw zel hi.

records.english: In our country, there's a free helpline you can call at any time if you feel desperate.

records.english: Sadness tends to come in waves, so a good day followed by a bad one doesn't mean you're going backwards.

records.english: Had my uncle followed the exercise plan more closely, his recovery might have been much faster.

records.english: Treatment plans for long-term illnesses are usually reviewed and adjusted over many years.

records.english: Each patient is given a booklet that explains their plan in simple words.

records.english: Our neighbor's plan includes walking for half an hour every day and cutting down on salt.

records.english: Doctors increasingly involve patients in choosing between treatments, rather than simply telling them what to do.

records.english: Could you write the plan down for me, please?
records.zomi: Geelna hong gelh sak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: I'd like a second opinion before I agree to the operation.

records.english: Rather than stopping a treatment that feels difficult, patients should ask whether it can be adapted.

records.english: Clear, written instructions reduce the risk of mistakes when several people care for the same patient.

records.english: Keep a note of how you feel each day.
records.zomi: Ni simin na kisak dan ciamteh in.

records.english: Families often play a large part in helping a patient stick to a long treatment.
records.zomi: Innkuante in damlo khat zatui zat sau a zuih den nadingin a huh mahmah zel uh hi.

records.english: Please call me if anything in the plan isn't clear.
records.zomi: Geelna sung-a bangmah a kician kei leh hong sam in.

records.english: My grandmother needs someone to take her to the clinic every week.
records.zomi: Ka pi in kal simin siavuan inn ah a paipih ding mi khat a kisam hi.

records.english: The treatment was changed after the blood test showed little improvement.
records.zomi: Sisan enna in hoihna tawmno bek a lak khit ciangin zatui zat kikhel hi.

records.english: Write down your questions before the appointment, so that you don't forget them.
records.zomi: Kimuhna ma-in na mangngilh lohna dingin na dotnate gelh in.

records.english: My doctor explained each step of the plan and then asked me to repeat it back, which is why I remember it so well.

records.english: A plan that ignores a patient's working hours or family duties is unlikely to succeed.

records.english: My next appointment is on 14 March, at ten o'clock.

records.english: The nurse, at the first visit.

records.english: Small goals, such as walking to the gate, can make a long recovery feel more manageable.

records.english: Could my daughter come into the appointment with me, so that she understands the plan too?

records.english: I've finished the first part of my treatment.
records.zomi: Ka zatui zat khen masa ka zo khin hi.

records.english: If the pain gets worse instead of better, the physiotherapist wants us to stop the exercises and call her.
records.zomi: Natna a hoih zawh sangin a sia zaw leh taksa kibawl siatna siavuan in kitawlnate khawl-a amah sam dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: Bring your plan to every appointment.
records.zomi: Kimuhna khempeuh ah na geelna tawi in.

records.english: The plan was explained to us in our own language.
records.zomi: Geelna i pau mah tawh hong kigen siang hi.

records.english: How long will the treatment take?
records.zomi: Zatui zat bangzah a sawt ding hiam?

records.english: The doctor thinks about six months, but it depends on how you respond.
records.zomi: Siavuan in kha guk bang hi ding hi, a ci a, ahi zongin na dawn dan tungah a kinga hi.

records.english: Can I go back to work during the treatment?
records.zomi: Zatui zat sungin nasep ah ka kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: Please don't change your plan without talking to your doctor first.
records.zomi: Na siavuan tawh kikum masa lo-in na geelna khel kei in.

records.english: What does the treatment plan involve?
records.zomi: Zatui zat geelna in bang a huam hiam?

records.english: Weekly visits to the clinic, daily exercises at home, and a check-up after three months.
records.zomi: Kal simin siavuan inn pai, inn ah ni sim kitawlna, leh kha thum khit ciangin enna.

records.english: Do the exercises twice a day.
records.zomi: Ni khat ah nihvei kitawlnate sem in.

records.english: I'll need about ten sessions, according to the doctor.
records.zomi: Siavuan' gen bangin hun sawm bang ka kisam ding hi.

records.english: Why does the plan include so many check-ups?
records.zomi: Bang hangin geelna in enna tampi a huam hiam?

records.english: So that the doctor can see early whether the treatment needs changing.
records.zomi: Zatui zat a kikhel kisam hiam siavuan in tung takin a muh theih nadingin.

records.english: The physiotherapist made my father practice climbing stairs before he was allowed home.
records.zomi: Taksa kibawl siatna siavuan in inn ah a kiphal ma-in ka pa kahlei kah a sin sak hi.

records.english: The community health worker visits my grandfather every Tuesday to check that the plan is working.
records.zomi: Mipi cidamna nasem khat in geelna a sem hiam en dingin Pithai ni simin ka pu a veh hi.

records.english: The best treatment plan is one that a patient understands and can actually follow at home.
records.zomi: Zatui zat geelna hoih pen damlo khat in a theih a, inn ah a zuih taktak theih ahi hi.

records.english: How will we know whether the plan is working?
records.zomi: Geelna a sem hiam bangci-in i thei ding hiam?

records.english: The doctor will check your blood pressure at each visit and compare the results.
records.zomi: Siavuan in na pai simin na si khauhna a teh ding a, a dawnnate a teh ding hi.

records.english: My mother keeps her treatment plan on the fridge so that the whole family can see it.
records.zomi: Ka nu in innkuan bup in a muh theih nadingun a zatui zat geelna khal bawm tungah a koih hi.

records.english: Have you tried the new café by the bus station?
records.zomi: Bus dinna kiang-a cafe thak na sin khin hiam?

records.english: Once, and the cakes were better than the coffee.
records.zomi: Vei khat, leh cake te coffee sangin a hoih zaw hi.

records.english: What kind of phone would you suggest for my grandmother?
records.zomi: Ka pi adingin phone bang na gen ding hiam?

records.english: One with large buttons and a loud ringtone, rather than the newest model.
records.zomi: A thak pen sangin button lian leh ging ngaih nei khat.

records.english: What would you recommend for a first-time visitor to the city?
records.zomi: Khuapi a veh masa khual khat adingin bang na gen ding hiam?

records.english: Start with the old market in the morning, before it gets too hot.
records.zomi: A sat lua ma-in zingsang ah zuakna mun lui tawh kipan in.

records.english: Could you suggest a gift for my teacher?
records.zomi: Ka saya adingin letsong khat hong gen thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: A card written by the whole class would mean more to her than anything expensive.
records.zomi: Kilasi bup in a gelh card khat in man tam bangpeuh sangin amah adingin tam zaw a ci nopna hi ding hi.

records.english: What would you suggest we do with the extra money the club raised?
records.zomi: Pawl in a kaikhawm sum behlap bangci-in i zang ding hi, na gen ding hiam?

records.english: Buy equipment the whole club can use, rather than something only a few members will enjoy.
records.zomi: Member tawmno bek in a nuam sak ding van sangin pawl bup in a zat theih van lei in.

records.english: Who should I ask about renting a flat in this area?
records.zomi: Hih mun ah inn hawl thu-ah kua ka dong ding hiam?

records.english: The woman at the post office, because she knows every landlord on the street.
records.zomi: Laikhak inn-a numei, lampi-a inn neipa khempeuh a thei ahih manin.

records.english: Before recommending anything, it helps to ask what the person actually needs.
records.zomi: Bangmah na gen ma-in mi pa in bang a kisam taktak hiam dot a phattuam hi.

records.english: What would you advise a student who wants to study abroad?
records.zomi: Gamdang ah sin nuam sangnaupang khat bang na hilh ding hiam?

records.english: Save more money than you think you'll need, and learn the basics of the language first.
records.zomi: Na kisap ding na ngaihsut sangin sum tam zaw kikoih inla, pau' kipatna sin masa in.

records.english: Would you recommend the course you took last year?
records.zomi: Kum nung-a na sin sinna na gen ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, but only if you have time to do the homework every week.
records.zomi: Gen ding ing, ahi zongin kal simin innlai sep nading hun na neih leh bek.

records.english: Recommendations from friends are useful, but it's wise to remember that people's tastes differ.
records.zomi: Lawmte' thu genna a phattuam a, ahi zongin mite' deihna a kibang kei hi, ci phawk a pil hi.

records.english: Which of the local schools would you recommend for a child who loves music?
records.zomi: La a it naupang khat adingin mun sang bang na gen ding hiam?

records.english: Which hotel would you choose for my parents?
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa adingin zinbuuk bang na teel ding hiam?

records.english: Do you know a good hairdresser?
records.zomi: Sam at siam hoih khat na thei hiam?

records.english: Which bank would you suggest for someone who's just arrived in the country?
records.zomi: Gam ah tu-a hong tung mi khat adingin bank bang na gen ding hiam?

records.english: The one near the station, since its staff can explain things in several languages.
records.zomi: Meileng dinna kiang-a pen, a nasemte in pau tuamtuam-in thu a gen siang thei uh ahih manin.

records.english: Which film should we watch tonight?
records.zomi: Tu zanin limlah bang i en ding hiam?

records.english: Something funny, because it's been a long week.
records.zomi: Nuihzaak huai khat, kal sau mahmah a hih manin.

records.english: Which book should I read first if I want to learn about our history?
records.zomi: I tangthu sin ka deih leh laibu bang ka sim masa ding hiam?

records.english: The short one by the local teacher, because it's written in simple language.
records.zomi: Mun saya' gelh a tom pen, kammal baih tawh kigelh ahih manin.

records.english: Can you suggest a quiet place to study?
records.zomi: Laisimna mun dai khat hong gen thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Could you recommend someone who repairs old watches?
records.zomi: Nai lui bawl dam siam mi khat hong gen thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Any good books for a long journey?
records.zomi: Khualzinna sau adingin laibu hoih a om hiam?

records.english: Is there a good walk near the town for a family with small children?
records.zomi: Khuapi kiang ah naupang neu nei innkuan adingin kalsuan nading lampi hoih a om hiam?

records.english: The path along the river is flat and has a playground halfway.
records.zomi: Gun gei lampi a phiang a, a laizang ah kimawlna mun a nei hi.

records.english: Is there a website you'd trust for news about the elections?
records.zomi: Teelna thuthak adingin na muan website khat a om hiam?

records.english: The election commission's own site, since it publishes the official results directly.
records.zomi: Teelna vaihawm pawl' website mah, kumpi dawnnate a ngal-in a khen ahih manin.

records.english: Where's the best place to buy shoes for school?
records.zomi: Sang adingin khedap lei nading mun hoih pen koi ah ahi hiam?

records.english: Is there a doctor you'd recommend for children?
records.zomi: Naupangte adingin na gen theih siavuan khat a om hiam?

records.english: Dr. Mang at the clinic, who's very patient with nervous children.
records.zomi: Siavuan inn-a Dr. Mang, a lau naupangte tungah thuakzawhna nei mahmah.

records.english: How would you go about finding a trustworthy builder?
records.zomi: Muan theih inn lam siam khat bangci-in na zong ding hiam?

records.english: Ask to see work he has finished for people you know, and never pay everything in advance.
records.zomi: Na theih mite adingin a zawh nasep et ngen inla, a ma-in khempeuh pia ngei kei in.

records.english: Who would you recommend as the speaker for our graduation ceremony?
records.zomi: I sang zawhna poai adingin kua thugen dingin na gen ding hiam?

records.english: Someone from the town who has done something useful, rather than a famous name nobody here knows.
records.zomi: Hih mun-a kuamah in a theih loh min thang khat sangin khuapi pan a phattuam bangmah a bawl khin mi khat.

records.english: Do you know anyone who could teach my son to swim?
records.zomi: Ka tapa tuipeek a sin sak thei kuamah na thei hiam?

records.english: Ask at the sports center, because they have a coach who works with beginners.
records.zomi: Kimawlna inn ah dong in, a kipan sinte tawh a sem saya khat a nei uh ahih manin.

records.english: Do you know a reliable mechanic?
records.zomi: Muan theih mawtaw bawl siam khat na thei hiam?

records.english: My cousin's garage, because he always explains what's wrong before he fixes it.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam' mawtaw bawlna, a bawl dam ma-in bang a sia hiam a gen siang tawntung ahih manin.

records.english: What do you think I should order here?
records.zomi: Hih ah bang ka ngen ding hiam na ci hiam?

records.english: Who fixed your roof so well?
records.zomi: Na inn tung kua in hoih takin a bawl dam hiam?

records.english: A man from the next village, and I'll give you his number.
records.zomi: A zom khua pan pasal khat, leh a nambat kong pia ding hi.

records.english: When we moved to the town, I asked three neighbors to recommend a good dentist.
records.zomi: Khuapi ah i kitawn ciangin inn veng thum kiangah ha siavuan hoih khat gen dingin ka ngen hi.

records.english: Two of them named the same woman, and the third said only that she was hard to get an appointment with.
records.zomi: A nih in numei kibang mah a gen uh a, a thumna in amah tawh kimuhna ngah a haksa hi, a ci bek hi.

records.english: That told me she was popular, so I booked a visit for the following month and was glad I waited.
records.zomi: Tua in mi tampi deih ahi hi, ci hong hilh ahih manin a zom kha adingin ka kilai a, ka ngak manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Where do you buy your vegetables?
records.zomi: Na anteh koi ah na lei hiam?

records.english: At the Saturday market, because the farmers bring them in that morning.
records.zomi: Kiginni zuakna mun ah, lo neite in tua zingsang a tawi uh ahih manin.

records.english: Can you recommend a good place to eat near here?
records.zomi: Hih kiang ah an nek nading mun hoih khat hong gen thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: The noodle shop on the corner, if you don't mind queuing.
records.zomi: Kiim lam-a noodle dawl, kigual na lungkham kei leh.

records.english: I do want a laptop that will last, so what would you recommend for under 500 dollars?
records.zomi: A sawt thei laptop khat ka deih taktak a, tua ahih manin dollar 500 nuai ah bang na gen ding hiam?

records.english: What's the best way to learn to cook if I've never done it before?
records.zomi: An huan ngei lo ka hih leh an huan sin nading lampi hoih pen bang ahi hiam?

records.english: Start with three simple dishes and make each one several times until you're confident.
records.zomi: An baih thum tawh kipan inla, na kingap dong khat ciat vei tampi huan in.

records.english: What would you do in my place?
records.zomi: Ka mun ah na om leh bang na bawl ding hiam?

records.english: I'd wait a few weeks before deciding, because the prices often fall after the holidays.
records.zomi: Tawlngakni khit ciangin man a niam zel ahih manin ka thukhen ma-in kal tawmno ka ngak ding hi.

records.english: My cousin had her marriage certificate translated and certified for the visa office.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam numei in visa office adingin a kiteenna lai-ciam a letsak a, a kician sak hi.

records.english: Keep all the receipts in one folder.
records.zomi: Laimal khempeuh ip khat sungah kem in.

records.english: The lawyer explained that the other side has the right to reply before the judge decides.
records.zomi: Thukham siam in thukhenpa a thukhen ma-in lam dang in dawnna pia thuneihna a nei hi, ci-in a gen siang hi.

records.english: Many people give up on a fair claim simply because the forms seem too complicated.
records.zomi: Mi tampi in lai te a buaihuai bang ahih manin dikna ngetna a nusia uh hi.

records.english: Please arrive at the court half an hour early, because there's a security check.
records.zomi: Bitna enna a om ahih manin thukhenna inn ah nai khen khat ma-in hong tung un.

records.english: Legal procedures exist so that both sides are heard before any decision is made.
records.zomi: Thukham kalsuan dante thukhenna bangmah a kibawl ma-in lam nih in a gen uh a kizak nadingin a om hi.

records.english: Sign here and here, please.
records.zomi: Hih ah leh hih ah min gelh in.

records.english: Copies of all the documents must be sent to the other party before the hearing.
records.zomi: Thukhenna ma-in lai khempeuh copy lam dang kiangah kikhak ding hi.

records.english: Don't sign anything at the police station until you've read it carefully.
records.zomi: Palik inn ah limtakin na sim ma-in bangmah tungah min gelh kei in.

records.english: My brother was asked to give a written statement about the accident he saw.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal a muh kipalhna thu kigelh thugen khat pia dingin kingen hi.

records.english: Mediation is often quicker and cheaper than going to court, though it doesn't suit every dispute.
records.zomi: Kilemsakna pen thukhenna inn pai sangin a manlang zaw a, a man neu zaw zel a, ahi zongin kinialna khempeuh adingin a kituak kei hi.

records.english: When is the hearing?
records.zomi: Thukhenna bang ciangin ahi hiam?

records.english: Next Tuesday, at nine in the morning.
records.zomi: A zom Pithai ni, zingsang nai kua ciangin.

records.english: The witness was reminded that she had promised to tell the truth.
records.zomi: Teci nu kiangah thuman gen dingin a kiciam hi, ci-in kiphawksak hi.

records.english: Can I bring my son as a witness?
records.zomi: Ka tapa teci-in ka tawi thei ding hiam?

records.english: Following the correct procedure can matter as much as being in the right.
records.zomi: Kalsuan dan dik zuih pen na dik tawh a thupi kibang thei hi.

records.english: Bring two copies of every document.
records.zomi: Lai khempeuh copy nih ciat tawi in.

records.english: How long does a case like this usually take?
records.zomi: Hih bang thu khat a tamzaw bangzah a sawt hiam?

records.english: Several months at least, according to our lawyer.
records.zomi: I thukham siam' gen bangin kha tampi bang.

records.english: Do I need a lawyer for this?
records.zomi: Hih adingin thukham siam ka kisam hiam?

records.english: For a small claim like yours, probably not.
records.zomi: Nangmah' bang ngetna neu adingin kisam lo kha ding hi.

records.english: Where do I go to register my baby's birth?
records.zomi: Ka naungek' suahna min gelh dingin koi ah ka pai ding hiam?

records.english: To the registry office at the town hall, within six weeks of the birth.
records.zomi: Khuapi office-a min gelhna inn ah, a suah khit kal guk sungin.

records.english: Write down exactly what you saw.
records.zomi: Na muh taktak gelh in.

records.english: Deadlines in legal cases are strict, which is why a missed letter can have serious consequences.
records.zomi: Thukham thu-ah hun ciangte a khauh ahih manin laikhak khat mansuahna in nasia takin a tun thei hi.

records.english: What surprised my father most was how calm and polite the courtroom was.
records.zomi: Ka pa a lamdang sak pen thukhenna inndei bangzah a dai a, zahtakna a om hiam ahi hi.

records.english: The judge's decision was read out at the end of the hearing and sent to both sides in writing.
records.zomi: Thukhenpa' thukhenna thukhenna tawp ciangin kisim a, lam nih kiangah gelh-in kikhak hi.

records.english: Is it possible to pay the fine in several parts?
records.zomi: Sum dan khen tampi-in ka pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, if you fill in the form at the court office and explain your situation.
records.zomi: Thei hi, thukhenna inn office ah lai na dimsak a, na om dan na gen siang leh.

records.english: What happens if I don't agree with the decision?
records.zomi: Thukhenna tawh ka kithukim kei leh bang a piang ding hiam?

records.english: Your lawyer can explain whether you're allowed to ask a higher court to look at it.
records.zomi: Na thukham siam in thukhenna inn sang zaw khat kiangah en dingin na ngen thei hiam a gen siang thei hi.

records.english: In our country, a signature on some documents has to be witnessed by a notary.
records.zomi: I gam ah lai pawl khat tung-a min gelhna notary in a en ding hi.

records.english: Ordinary people often feel more confident in court when someone has explained the procedure beforehand.
records.zomi: Mi ngeinate in ma-in kuamah in kalsuan dan a gen siang ciangin thukhenna inn ah a kingap zaw zel uh hi.

records.english: When a builder took my aunt's money and never finished her roof, she decided to take him to the small claims court.
records.zomi: Inn lampa khat in ka ni' sum a la a, a inn tung a zo ngei kei ciangin thukhenna inn neu ah tawi dingin a thukhen hi.

records.english: A clerk helped her fill in the form and told her to bring every receipt and photo to the hearing.
records.zomi: Lai kemtu khat in lai dimsak a huh a, laimal leh lim khempeuh thukhenna ah tawi dingin a hilh hi.

records.english: Three months later, the judge ordered the builder to return most of the money.
records.zomi: Kha thum khit ciangin thukhenpa in inn lampa sum a tamzaw lohsak kik dingin thu a pia hi.

records.english: The court officer said, "Please stand when the judge comes in."
records.zomi: Thukhenna inn nasem in, “Thukhenpa a lut ciangin ding un,” a ci hi.

records.english: A clear timeline of events helps a lawyer understand a case far more quickly.
records.zomi: Thu a piang dan kizui kician khat in thukham siam khat in thu khat manlang zaw-in a theih nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Turn off your phone before you go in.
records.zomi: Na lut ma-in na phone khak in.

records.english: The papers were stamped and returned to me the same day.
records.zomi: Laite ni kibang mah-in ciamtehna kibawl-in hong kipia kik hi.

records.english: Where is courtroom three?
records.zomi: Thukhenna inndei thumna koi ah a om hiam?

records.english: Had my uncle kept copies of his letters, his case would have been much easier to prove.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu in a laikhakte copy a kem leh a thu lak a baih zaw mahmah ding hi.

records.english: The hearing was postponed because one of the witnesses was ill.
records.zomi: Teci khat a cina ahih manin thukhenna kinungta hi.

records.english: If you can't attend the hearing, write to the court before the date and explain why.
records.zomi: Thukhenna ah na hong thei kei leh ni a tun ma-in thukhenna inn kiangah laikhak gelh inla, bang hang hiam gen siang in.

records.english: Keep the reference number, because the insurance company will ask for it.
records.zomi: Insurance company in a dong ding ahih manin ciamtehna nambat kem in.

records.english: Before going to court, the two neighbors were asked to try mediation at the town hall.
records.zomi: Thukhenna inn a pai ma-un inn veng nih khuapi office ah kilemsakna sin dingin kingen uh hi.

records.english: Our neighbor's case was dismissed because he had missed the deadline for filing it.
records.zomi: I inn veng' thu a piak nading hun ciang a mansuah manin kiphiat hi.

records.english: The court sent a letter with the date and time of the hearing.
records.zomi: Thukhenna inn in thukhenna ni leh hun tawh laikhak khat a khak hi.

records.english: Who is the judge today?
records.zomi: Tuni thukhenpa kua ahi hiam?

records.english: Rather than arguing at the counter, ask the clerk to explain the next step in writing.
records.zomi: Dawhkan ah kinial sangin lai kemtu kiangah a zom kalsuan gelh-in gen siang dingin ngen in.

records.english: Who pays the court fees if I win?
records.zomi: Ka zo leh thukhenna inn man kua in a pia ding hiam?

records.english: Usually the other side, but the judge decides that at the end.
records.zomi: A tamzaw in lam dang in, ahi zongin a tawp ciangin thukhenpa in a thukhen hi.

records.english: How do I report a theft to the police?
records.zomi: Guk thu palik kiangah bangci-in ka gen ding hiam?

records.english: Go to the station with your identity card, and they'll write down a statement and give you a reference number.
records.zomi: Na min-lai tawh palik inn ah pai in, tua ciangin thugen a gelh ding uh a, ciamtehna nambat hong pia ding uh hi.

records.english: What should I bring to my first meeting with the lawyer?
records.zomi: Thukham siam tawh ka kimuh masak ciangin bang ka tawi ding hiam?

records.english: Any letters, contracts or messages that relate to the case, in date order.
records.zomi: Thu tawh kizom laikhak, contract hiam message bangpeuh, ni kizui dan bangin.

records.english: You must answer the court's letter within fourteen days, or a decision may be made without you.
records.zomi: Thukhenna inn' laikhak ni sawm leh li sungin na dawng ding hi, ahih kei leh nang om lo-in thukhenna kibawl kha thei hi.

records.english: The judge asked each side to explain what had happened, one at a time.
records.zomi: Thukhenpa in lam khat ciat kiangah bang a piang hiam khat zawh khat gen siang dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: The police gave me a copy of my statement.
records.zomi: Palik in ka thugen copy khat hong pia hi.

records.english: The clerk checked that every page had been signed before she accepted the application.
records.zomi: Lai kemtu in ngetna a sang ma-in phek khempeuh tungah min kigelh hiam a en hi.

records.english: Are you worried about the results, or is it something else?
records.zomi: Dawnnate thu-ah na lunghimawh hiam, ahih kei leh thu dang khat hiam?

records.english: It's the waiting, really, not the results.
records.zomi: Ngak ahi zaw hi, taktak in, dawnnate hi lo-in.

records.english: My daughter is less frightened of storms since we explained how far away the lightning was.
records.zomi: Khuavak bangzah a gamla hiam i gen siang khit pan ka tanu in huihpi a lau tawm zaw hi.

records.english: Let's leave it there for tonight, and you can tell me how it went tomorrow.
records.zomi: Tu zan adingin hih ah i khawl ni, leh zingciang bangci-in a om hiam hong hilh thei ding hi.

records.english: Reassuring someone works better when you acknowledge their fear before offering facts.
records.zomi: Thu kician na gen ma-in a lauhna pom masa in mi khat lungsim nemsak a sem hoih zaw hi.

records.english: Have you ever been so nervous that you couldn't remember your own phone number?
records.zomi: Na lau lua ahih manin na phone nambat mah na phawk thei lo hun a om ngei hiam?

records.english: Have you told anyone else how you feel?
records.zomi: Na kisak dan mi dang na hilh ngei hiam?

records.english: When you talk to children about frightening news, keep it short and tell them who is helping.
records.zomi: Naupangte kiangah thuthak lauhuai na gen ciangin tom takin gen inla, kua in a huh hiam hilh in.

records.english: Breathe in for four counts, hold for four, breathe out for four, and wait for four.

records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, pawl khat ciat in science sinna khat gen siangna minit nih video khat na la ding uh hi.

records.english: The wedding was filmed by a cousin who had never used a proper camera before.
records.zomi: Mopawi pen camera taktak zang ngei lo sanggam khat in a la hi.

records.english: Teachers increasingly ask students to record videos, because explaining an idea aloud shows how well they understand it.
records.zomi: Ngaihsutna khat aw-in gen siang in bangzah hoih takin a thei uh hiam a lak ahih manin saya te in sangnaupangte video la dingin a ngen tam zaw uh hi.

records.english: Keep your videos short, and cut the parts where nothing happens.
records.zomi: Na video te tom takin bawl inla, bangmah a piang lohna khente at in.

records.english: Hold the shot for at least five seconds before moving the camera.
records.zomi: Camera na suan ma-in second nga val khat dai takin la in.

records.english: Recording someone without their permission can damage trust, even if the video is never shared.
records.zomi: A phalna om lo-in mi khat la in video a kihawm ngei kei zongin muanna a susia thei hi.

records.english: Clean the lens with a soft cloth before you start filming.
records.zomi: Na lak kipat ma-in lens puan nem tawh nul in.

records.english: Editing a long recording down to a few minutes takes far longer than most beginners expect.
records.zomi: Lak sau khat minit tawmno dong bawl tom pen a kipan sin tamzaw' lamen sangin a sawt zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: Copy the videos to a computer every month, in case your phone is lost.
records.zomi: Na phone a mang kha leh ci-in kha simin computer ah video te copy in.

records.english: Can you record the school play for Grandma?
records.zomi: Pi adingin sang lawn na la thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, but I'll need to sit near the front so that the sound is clear.
records.zomi: Thei hi, ahi zongin aw a kician nadingin mai lam nai ah ka tut ding a kisam hi.

records.english: Who recorded this lovely video?
records.zomi: Hih video hoih kua in a la hiam?

records.english: Our neighbor's son, on his new phone.
records.zomi: I inn veng' tapa in, a phone thak tawh.

records.english: Is it recording now?
records.zomi: Tu-in a la lai hiam?

records.english: Yes, the timer has started.
records.zomi: La hi, timer a kipan khin hi.

records.english: Why does my video look so shaky?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ka video a ling lua hiam?

records.english: Because you're walking while you film, so try standing still or holding the phone with both hands.
records.zomi: Na lak laitakin na kalsuan ahih manin ding den inla, phone khut nih tawh len in.

records.english: Many people forget that the sound matters as much as the picture, especially when someone is speaking.
records.zomi: Mi tampi in a diak in mi khat a gen laitakin aw pen lim tawh a thupi kibang hi, ci a mangngilh uh hi.

records.english: I do want to make videos for my cooking channel, but I'm not sure my kitchen is bright enough.
records.zomi: Ka an huan channel adingin video bawl ka deih taktak a, ahi zongin ka an huanna a vak tawk hiam ka thei kei hi.

records.english: Turn on airplane mode while you record, so that a phone call doesn't interrupt you.
records.zomi: Phone sam in hong khen lohna dingin na lak laitakin airplane mode phong in.

records.english: Families who record their elders' stories often say the videos become their most treasured possessions.
records.zomi: A upate uh' tangthu a la innkuante in video te a van manphat pen a suak hi, ci-in a gen zel uh hi.

records.english: Don't film inside the museum; there's a sign at the door.
records.zomi: Museum sungah video la kei in; kongkhak ah lim lai khat a om hi.

records.english: A short, clear video often explains how to repair something better than pages of written instructions.
records.zomi: Video tom kician khat in kigelh thuhilhna phek tampi sangin bangmah bawl dam dan a gen siang hoih zaw zel hi.

records.english: What makes a home video worth watching years later is usually the ordinary moments rather than the special occasions.
records.zomi: Inn video khat kum tampi khit ciangin et phu a suaksak pen poai tuamtuam sangin ni sim hunte ahi zel hi.

records.english: Film with the window in front of the person, not behind them, or their face will be dark.
records.zomi: Mi pa' nung lam ah hi lo-in a mai lam ah tukvuang koih-in la in, ahih kei leh a mai a mial ding hi.

records.english: My daughter made a time-lapse of the sunset by leaving her phone on the balcony for an hour.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in nai khat sung inn dawh tungah a phone nusia-in ni tum time-lapse khat a bawl hi.

records.english: Which is better for recording interviews, the front camera or the back one?
records.zomi: Kidotna la nadingin bang a hoih zaw hiam, mai lam camera hiam nung lam camera hiam?

records.english: The back one usually has better quality, so ask a friend to hold it for you.
records.zomi: Nung lam pen a hoih zaw zel ahih manin lawm khat len sak dingin ngen in.

records.english: Frame your friend a little to one side of the picture, not exactly in the middle.
records.zomi: Na lawm lim laizang tak ah hi lo-in lam khat ah tawmno koih in.

records.english: Applying a passage to daily life is often harder than understanding what it originally meant.
records.zomi: Khen khat ni sim nuntak tungah zat pen a kipatna-a a ci nopna theih sangin a haksa zaw zel hi.

records.english: A proverb describes what usually happens, not a promise that it will always happen.
records.zomi: Paunak khat in a tamzaw-in a piang thu a gen a, a tawntung-in a piang ding kiciamna hi lo hi.

records.english: Some interpreters focus on what the original author intended, while others also consider how the church has read it over time.
records.zomi: Gen siangtu pawl khat in a kipatna gelhtu' ci nopna tungah a lungsim uh a koih uh a, a dangte in pawlpi in hun sawt sungin bangci-in a sim hiam zong a ngaihsun uh hi.

records.english: Who was this letter written to?
records.zomi: Hih laikhak kua kiangah kigelh hiam?

records.english: The church in Corinth, which was having many problems.
records.zomi: Buaina tampi a nei Korin khua-a pawlpi kiangah.

records.english: The book of Revelation uses vivid symbols, so Christians interpret its images in very different ways.
records.zomi: Mangmuhna laibu in lim kician tampi a zang ahih manin Khristiante in a lim te tuamtuam mahmah-in a gen siang uh hi.

records.english: Look at the verses before and after it.
records.zomi: A ma leh a nung-a tangte en in.

records.english: The story of the lost son is one of the most loved parables in our church.
records.zomi: Mang tapa tangthu pen i pawlpi-a a kideih pen thugentehna khat ahi hi.

records.english: My mother reads a commentary alongside her Bible every morning.
records.zomi: Ka nu in zingsang simin a Laisiangtho tawh gen siangna laibu khat a sim hi.

records.english: Why did Jesus teach in parables?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Jesu in thugentehna tawh thu a hilh hiam?

records.english: Many scholars think the stories made people think for themselves and remember the lesson.
records.zomi: Thu siam tampi in tangthute in mite amau le amau ngaihsun sak a, sinna a phawksak hi, ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi.

records.english: Did the prophets write mainly about the future?
records.zomi: Kamsangte in a tamzaw-in ma lam thu a gelh uh hiam?

records.english: Much of their message was about how people should live in their own time.
records.zomi: A thu uh a tamzaw pen amau' hun-a mite bangci-in nungta ding hiam thu ahi hi.

records.english: Can a passage have more than one meaning?
records.zomi: Khen khat in a ci nopna khat val a nei thei hiam?

records.english: Some say a passage has a single central sense but can be applied in many different situations.
records.zomi: Pawl khat in khen khat in a ci nopna laizang khat a nei a, ahi zongin mun tuamtuam ah kizang thei hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: The same parable was explained in three different ways in our study group, and each made sense.
records.zomi: I sinna pawl ah thugentehna kibang mah lam thum-in kigen siang a, khat ciat a kilawm hi.

records.english: Many of the psalms are laments, in which the writer pours out grief and complaint to God.
records.zomi: Late tampi pen kahna late ahi a, tua sungah gelhtu in a dahna leh phunna Pasian kiangah a sung khia hi.

records.english: Our group meets on Thursdays to study one book at a time.
records.zomi: I pawl in vei khat ah laibu khat sin dingin Laizing ni simin a kikhop hi.

records.english: Is this a story or a poem?
records.zomi: Hih pen tangthu hiam late hiam?

records.english: The pastor explained the parable in simple words for the children.
records.zomi: Pastor in naupangte adingin kammal baih tawh thugentehna a gen siang hi.

records.english: When Jesus calls himself a door, most Christians understand it as a picture, not a literal description.
records.zomi: Jesu in amah le amah kongkhak a ci ciangin Khristian tamzaw in a taktak gen hi lo-in lim khat bangin a thei uh hi.

records.english: Our pastor uses a commentary to check what other scholars have said about a difficult verse.
records.zomi: I pastor in tang haksa khat tungah thu siam dangte in bang a gen uh hiam en dingin gen siangna laibu khat a zang hi.

records.english: The letters of Paul answer questions from specific churches, so we sometimes have to guess what the questions were.
records.zomi: Paul' laikhakte in pawlpi tuamtuam pan dotnate a dawng ahih manin hun pawl khat ah dotnate bang ahi hiam i ngaihsun ding a kisam hi.

records.english: Reading the Bible alongside believers from other cultures can reveal meanings that one group alone might miss.
records.zomi: Ngeina dang-a upmite tawh Laisiangtho sim in pawl khat bek in a mansuah kha ding ci nopnate a lak thei hi.

records.english: Good interpretation pays attention to grammar, context and the purpose of the whole book.
records.zomi: Gen siangna hoih in kammal gelh dan, a kiim thu leh laibu bup' deihna a ngaihsun hi.

records.english: Some passages tell us what people did, not necessarily what God wanted them to do.
records.zomi: Khen pawl khat in mite in bang a bawl uh hiam a gen a, Pasian in bang a bawl ding uh a deih hiam a gen tawntung kei hi.

records.english: According to many scholars, the rule of "an eye for an eye" was originally meant to limit revenge, not to encourage it.
records.zomi: Thu siam tampi' gen bangin “mittang khat tangin mittang khat” thukham pen phu lakna kiamsak nadingin a om masa a, hanthawn nadingin hi lo hi.

records.english: What do you think this story is really about?
records.zomi: Hih tangthu in bang thu a gen taktak hi, na ci hiam?

records.english: Kindness to strangers, probably, since that's what the ending stresses.
records.zomi: Zin mite tungah hehpihna, kha ding hi, a tawpna in tua a gen thupi ahih manin.

records.english: We were asked to retell the parable as if it happened in our own village.
records.zomi: Thugentehna i khua-ah a piang bangin gen kik dingin hong ngen uh hi.

records.english: Knowing whether a passage is law, history, poetry or letter changes how a careful reader approaches it.
records.zomi: Khen khat thukham, tangthu, late hiam laikhak ahi hiam theih in sim pil khat in bangci-in a sim hiam a khel hi.

records.english: Can you explain what a cross-reference is?
records.zomi: Cross-reference bang ahi hiam gen siang thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: It's a note that points you to another passage on the same subject.
records.zomi: Thulu kibang mah tungtang-a khen dang khat ah hong lak ciamtehna khat ahi hi.

records.english: Why do Christians disagree about some verses?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Khristiante tang pawl khat tungah a kilem kei uh hiam?

records.english: Because some passages are hard to understand, and readers bring different questions to them.
records.zomi: Khen pawl khat theih a haksa a, simte in dotna tuamtuam a tawi uh ahih manin.

records.english: A parable usually has one main point, so it can be misleading to give every detail a hidden meaning.
records.zomi: Thugentehna khat in thu laizang khat a nei zel ahih manin thu neu khempeuh ah ci nopna kisel piak pen khemna ahi thei hi.

records.english: Children, can you guess what the lost sheep in the story might stand for?
records.zomi: Naupangte, tangthu sung-a tuu mang in bang a lak kha ding hiam na ngaihsun thei uh hiam?

records.english: Different Christian traditions interpret some passages differently while still reading the same Bible.
records.zomi: Khristian ngeina tuamtuam in Laisiangtho kibang mah a sim uh hangin khen pawl khat tuamtuam-in a gen siang uh hi.

records.english: Ask the question again in your own words.
records.zomi: Dotna na kammal tawh dong kik in.

records.english: In our Bible study, we ask three questions about every passage.
records.zomi: I Laisiangtho sinna ah khen khempeuh tungah dotna thum i dong hi.

records.english: First, what does it actually say, and second, what did it mean to the people who first heard it?
records.zomi: A masa, bang a gen taktak hiam, a nihna, a za masa mite adingin bang a ci nopna hiam?

records.english: Only then do we ask what it might mean for our own lives today.
records.zomi: Tua khit ciangin bek tu hun-a i nuntak adingin bang a ci nopna kha ding hiam i dong hi.

records.english: Which part of the passage confused you?
records.zomi: Khen sung-a bang khen in hong buaisak hiam?

records.english: The ending, because it seems so harsh.
records.zomi: A tawpna, a khauh lua bang ahih manin.

records.english: Notice which words are repeated in the passage.
records.zomi: Khen sungah kammal bangte a kigen kik hiam limtakin en in.

records.english: My study Bible has notes at the bottom of each page that explain unfamiliar words.
records.zomi: Ka sinna Laisiangtho in phek khat ciat' nuai ah theih loh kammalte gen siangna ciamtehna a nei hi.

records.english: Many Bibles mark the poetry by printing it in short lines.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho tampi in late pen tang tom-in a khen ahih manin a ciamteh hi.

records.english: Interpretation requires humility, because sincere readers have often reached different conclusions.
records.zomi: Citak simte in ngaihsutna tuamtuam a tun zel uh ahih manin gen siangna in kiniamkhiatna a kisam hi.

records.english: My grandfather taught us to ask who was speaking and to whom before deciding what a verse meant.
records.zomi: Ka pu in tang khat in bang a ci nopna hiam na thukhen ma-in kua in kua kiangah thu a gen hiam dong dingin hong sin sak hi.

records.english: Reading a passage aloud in a group often helps people notice details they missed when reading alone.
records.zomi: Pawl khat ah khen khat aw-in sim in mite in amau bek-in a sim lai-un a mansuah thu neute a mu nadingun a huh zel hi.

records.english: A psalm is a poem or a prayer, so it shouldn't be read like a news report.
records.zomi: Late khat pen late hiam thungetna hiam ahih manin thuthak genna bangin kisim lo ding hi.

records.english: A word study helps you see how the same word is used in other parts of the Bible.
records.zomi: Kammal sinna in kammal kibang mah Laisiangtho mun dang ah bangci-in kizang hiam na muh nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Read the whole chapter, not just the single verse someone quotes to you.
records.zomi: Mi khat in hong gen tang khat bek hi lo-in khen bup sim in.

records.english: Is every verse meant to be taken literally?
records.zomi: Tang khempeuh a taktak bangin kila ding hiam?

records.english: Most Christians say no, because the Bible contains poetry, parables and prophecy as well as history.
records.zomi: Khristian tamzaw in hi lo hi, a ci uh hi, Laisiangtho in tangthu bek hi lo-in late, thugentehna leh kamsang thu zong a nei ahih manin.

records.english: Write down any word you don't understand.
records.zomi: Na theih loh kammal khatpeuh gelh in.

records.english: When two passages seem to disagree, many interpreters let the clearer one guide the reading of the harder one.
records.zomi: Khen nih a kilem lo bang ciangin gen siangtu tampi in a kician zaw pen in a haksa zaw sim dan a makaih hi.

records.english: Interpreting the Bible well takes time, patience and a willingness to learn from others.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho hoih taka gen siang in hun, thuakzawhna leh mi dangte pan sin nopna a kisam hi.

records.english: Please don't build a whole belief on one verse.
records.zomi: Tang khat bek tungah upna bup lam kei in.

records.english: Translators sometimes have to choose between following the original words closely and making the meaning clearer.
records.zomi: Lai lettute in a kipatna kammalte nai taka zuih leh a ci nopna a kician zawk sak kikal ah a teel ding uh a kisam zel hi.

records.english: Thank you for organizing such a lovely day.
records.zomi: Ni nuam mahmah khat na bawl manin lungdam ing.

records.english: Please sign up to help with the cooking.
records.zomi: An huan huh dingin min gelh un.

records.english: I'd like my children to feel proud of these celebrations, not embarrassed by them.
records.zomi: Ka tate in hih poaite tungah a zum sangin a kisaktheih ding uh ka deih hi.

records.english: Please don't sit in the front row, because those seats are kept for the elders.
records.zomi: Mai lam tang pen ah tu kei un, tua tutnate upate adingin kikem ahih manin.

records.english: Our church celebrates its anniversary with a long service and a meal for the whole village.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in kum ciang poai pen kikhopna sau leh khua bup adingin an tawh a bawl hi.

records.english: Did you enjoy the dancing?
records.zomi: Lamna na nuam sa hiam?

records.english: Very much, although I kept stepping on my cousin's feet.
records.zomi: Nuam sa mahmah ing, ka sanggam' khe ka suh den hangin.

records.english: Our community's Christmas celebration lasts almost a week in the village.
records.zomi: I mipi' Christmas poai khua ah kal khat dek a sawt hi.

records.english: The singing competition between the churches is the highlight of the evening.
records.zomi: Pawlpi tuamtuam kikal-a la kidemna pen nitak' thupi pen ahi hi.

records.english: Shall we make a banner for the celebration?
records.zomi: Poai adingin puanzial khat i bawl ding hiam?

records.english: Inviting neighbors from other backgrounds helps them understand the community, and they usually come back the next year.
records.zomi: Mun dang pan inn vengte sam in mipi a theih nadingun a huh a, a zom kum ciangin a hong kik zel uh hi.

records.english: The elders are honored first, and each one is given a small gift.
records.zomi: Upate kipahtawi masa a, khat ciat letsong neu khat kipia hi.

records.english: The celebration was filmed so that relatives in the home villages could watch it later.
records.zomi: Inn khua-a sanggamte in a nung ciangin a et theih nadingun poai kila hi.

records.english: Holding the celebration in a rented hall abroad is very different from celebrating in the open fields at home.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a kikhopna inn hawl khat ah poai bawl pen inn-a lo awng ah poai bawl tawh a kibang lo mahmah hi.

records.english: Children, practice your song once more, because the guests will arrive in an hour.
records.zomi: Naupangte, khualte nai khat sungin a tung ding uh ahih manin na la uh vei khat sin kik un.

records.english: Young people who grew up abroad often learn the traditional songs just for the celebration.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a khang khangnote in poai adingin bek ngeina la te a sin zel uh hi.

records.english: The youngest children are given small jobs, such as handing out programs, so that they feel part of the day.
records.zomi: Naupang neu pente ni khen khat bangin a kisak nadingun programme hawm bang nasep neu kipia hi.

records.english: Our pastor reminds everyone that the celebration is a time to give thanks, not just to eat.
records.zomi: I pastor in poai pen an nek bek hi lo-in lungdam kohna hun ahi hi, ci-in mi khempeuh a phawksak hi.

records.english: Take some food home for your parents.
records.zomi: Na nu leh na pa adingin an tawmno inn ah tawi in.

records.english: Volunteers set up the chairs on Friday night and stay late on Saturday to clean up.
records.zomi: Thalawpte in Laithai ni zan ciangin tutphahte a koih uh a, Kiginni ciangin siangsak dingin a om sawt uh hi.

records.english: Next year, we'll invite the mayor.
records.zomi: A zom kum ciangin khuapi ukpi i sam ding hi.

records.english: Many families wear traditional clothes for the celebration, even the youngest children.
records.zomi: Innkuan tampi in poai adingin naupang neu pente zong kihel-in ngeina puan a silh uh hi.

records.english: Put the drums by the stage.
records.zomi: Khuangte lawn mun kiang ah koih in.

records.english: Had the young people not volunteered to organize the music, the celebration might have been cancelled.
records.zomi: Khangnote in la bawl dingin thalawp-in a kipiak kei uh leh poai kiphiat kha ding hi.

records.english: We sang until midnight.
records.zomi: Zanlai dong la i sa hi.

records.english: Celebrations bring together relatives who might otherwise drift apart over the years.
records.zomi: Poaite in kum tampi sungin a kigamla kha ding sanggamte a kaikhawm hi.

records.english: Some celebrations have changed abroad, with shorter speeches and more music for the young people.
records.zomi: Poai pawl khat gamdang ah a kikhel a, thugen tom zaw leh khangnote adingin la tam zaw a om hi.

records.english: When is the big celebration this year?
records.zomi: Tu kum poai lian bang ciangin ahi hiam?

records.english: On the last Saturday of the month, at the community hall.
records.zomi: Kha nunung Kiginni ciangin, mipi kikhopna inn ah.

records.english: For communities living far from home, a shared celebration can be a way of keeping their identity alive.
records.zomi: Inn pan gamla-a teeng mipite adingin kihawm poai khat in amau kua ahi uh hiam a nungta sak nading lampi khat ahi thei hi.

records.english: Everyone brings a dish to share, so there's always far too much food.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh in hawm ding an khat a tawi uh ahih manin an a tam lua tawntung hi.

records.english: When the celebration had to be held online one year, families joined from five countries.
records.zomi: Kum khat poai online-a kibawl ding a kisam ciangin gam nga pan innkuante a kihel uh hi.

records.english: The traditional sports, such as wrestling and tug of war, are popular with the young men.
records.zomi: Kipalh leh khau kai bang ngeina kimawlnate pasal khangnote in a deih mahmah uh hi.

records.english: Every year, our community abroad hires a school hall for the harvest celebration.
records.zomi: Kum simin gamdang-a i mipi in lo lak poai adingin sang kikhopna inn a hawl hi.

records.english: The older women cook all morning, while the young people practice the traditional dances in the car park.
records.zomi: Numei upate zingsang bup an a huan uh a, khangnote in mawtaw koihna mun ah ngeina lamnate a sin uh hi.

records.english: By evening the hall is full of families who live hours apart and see each other only on this day.
records.zomi: Nitak ciangin kikhopna inn pen nai tampi kigamla-a teeng a, hih ni bek-a kimu innkuante in a dim hi.

records.english: Who's going to lead the dance this year?
records.zomi: Tu kum lamna kua in a makaih ding hiam?

records.english: My sister, because she knows all the steps.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam numei, kalsuan khempeuh a thei ahih manin.

records.english: What impressed the visitors most was how the whole community worked together without being told.
records.zomi: Khualte a lamdang sak pen kihilh lo-in mipi bup khawm-in a sem uh ahi hi.

records.english: The food was served after the prayers.
records.zomi: Thungetna khit ciangin an kipia hi.

records.english: In our village, the whole community celebrates the end of the harvest together.
records.zomi: I khua ah mipi bup in lo lak tawpna khawm-in a lungdam uh hi.

records.english: Why do the drums always start the celebration?
records.zomi: Bang hangin khuangte in poai a kipatsak tawntung hiam?

records.english: In our village, the drums call everyone together, as they did before there were phones.
records.zomi: I khua ah phone om ma-a a bawl bangin khuangte in mi khempeuh a kaikhawm hi.

records.english: Is there a celebration in your town too?
records.zomi: Na khuapi ah zong poai a om hiam?

records.english: A small one, at the church hall in December.
records.zomi: Neu khat, December kha ah pawlpi kikhopna inn ah.

records.english: Honoring the elders publicly reminds younger people where the community's traditions come from.
records.zomi: Upate mipi mai ah pahtawi in khangno zawte kiangah mipi' ngeinate koi pan a hong pai hiam a phawksak hi.

records.english: Can I bring my friends from work to the cultural evening?
records.zomi: Ngeina nitak ah ka nasepna lawmte ka tawi thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, everyone is welcome, and tell them to come hungry.
records.zomi: Thei hi, mi khempeuh kimuak hi, leh gilkial-in hong pai dingin hilh in.

records.english: Help your grandmother find a seat.
records.zomi: Na pi tutna zong dingin huh in.
