records.english: Why did you choose that name for your daughter?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na tanu adingin tua min na teel hiam?

records.english: It was the name of my best friend at school, who died when we were young.
records.zomi: I neu lai-a a si sang-a ka lawm pen' min ahi hi.

records.english: Why are you crying?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na kap hiam?

records.english: Because the puppy chewed my favourite book.
records.zomi: Ui-no in ka laibu it pen a ngawi ahih manin.

records.english: Please don't ask Grandma why Grandpa isn't here; she'll explain when she's ready.
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pu hih ah om lo hiam Pi kiangah dong kei un; a kiginkhol ciangin a genteh ding hi.

records.english: When I asked my father why he had never learned to swim, he said there was no time for it on the farm.
records.zomi: Bang hangin tuipeek a sin ngei kei hiam ka pa ka dot ciangin, lo ah tua adingin hun a om kei hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Why do you always phone your mother at exactly seven o'clock?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na nu nai sagih taktak ciangin na sam tawntung hiam?

records.english: Because that's when she has finished dinner and is sitting by the phone.
records.zomi: Tua hun ciangin nitak an a ne zo-in phone kiangah a tu ahih manin.

records.english: Why do I always have to share my room with my little brother?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ka khan ka nau pasal tawh ka kihawm tawntung kul hiam?

records.english: A teenager who asks why they can't stay out late is often asking whether they are trusted.
records.zomi: Bang hangin zan ciang dong a pusuak thei kei hiam a dong tangval-tangnu khat in a tamzaw-in a kimuang hiam a dong hi.

records.english: Asking your parents why they made certain choices can help you understand them as people, not only as parents.
records.zomi: Bang hangin teelna pawl khat a bawl uh hiam na nu leh na pa dot in nu leh pa bek hi lo-in mihing bangin a theih nadingin hong huh thei hi.

records.english: Explaining to a young child why a grandparent has died is one of the hardest conversations a parent can have.
records.zomi: Bang hangin pu hiam pi khat a sih hiam naupang neu khat kiangah genteh pen nu leh pa khat in a neih theih kihopihna haksa pen khat ahi hi.

records.english: Why do we have to take our shoes off at Auntie's house?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Ni' inn ah i khedap i suah kul uh hiam?

records.english: My brother still won't say why he and his wife decided not to have children.
records.zomi: Bang hangin amah leh a zi in ta nei lo dingin a khensat uh hiam ka sanggam pasal in a gen nuam lai kei hi.

records.english: What made you decide to become a vegetarian?
records.zomi: Bang in sa ne lo dingin hong khensatsak hiam?

records.english: I visited a farm with my cousin, and I couldn't eat meat after that.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam tawh ganhing vulhna lo khat ka veh a, tua khit ciangin sa ka ne zo nawn kei hi.

records.english: Why did you never tell us that you had a twin brother?
records.zomi: Bang hangin apeng sanggam pasal na nei hi, ci-in eite hong gen ngei kei hiam?

records.english: Only last year did my sister finally explain why she had left home so suddenly all those years ago.
records.zomi: Kum nunung ciang bek-in ka u numei in tua kum tampi lai-in bang hangin inn thakhatin a nusia hiam a tawpna-ah a genteh hi.

records.english: I'd like to understand why you're so against your sister's wedding.
records.zomi: Bang hangin na sanggam numei' mopawi na langpan mahmah hiam ka theih nuam hi.

records.english: My grandfather says pupils in his day stood up whenever an adult entered the room.
records.zomi: A hun lai-in mi upa khat khan sungah a lut ciangin sangnaupangte a ding tawntung uh hi, ka pu in a ci hi.

records.english: Who told Grandma that I'd been sent out of class?
records.zomi: Sangkhan pan hong kihawlkhia hi, kua in Pi hong gen hiam?

records.english: The teacher wrote in my report that I was polite but easily distracted, which made my father laugh.
records.zomi: Saya in ka report ah zahtak thei a, ahi zongin baih takin a lungsim kiheimang hi, ci-in a gelh a, tua in ka pa a nuihsak hi.

records.english: Mum, please don't tell Grandpa about the warning I got today.
records.zomi: Nu aw, tuni-a ka ngah vaihilhna thu Pu kiangah gen kei in.

records.english: We stopped giving our daughter sweets as a reward, because the teacher said it caused arguments in class.
records.zomi: Saya in sangkhan sungah kinialna a piangsak hi, a ci ahih manin i tanu laksapna-in an tuithak piak i khawlsak uh hi.

records.english: My son's teacher phoned us because he had been distracting the children around him.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in a kiim-a naupangte a buaisak ahih manin a saya in hong sam hi.

records.english: I was so embarrassed when my own mother turned out to be our new class teacher.
records.zomi: Ka nu mah i sangkhan saya thak hong suak ciangin ka zum mahmah hi.

records.english: Behave yourself at your cousin's school concert, or we'll leave early.
records.zomi: Na sanggam' sang lakna kikhopna ah hoih takin om in, a kei leh hun ma-in i pai ding hi.

records.english: Let's practise waiting for your turn to speak at dinner, just like in class.
records.zomi: Sangkhan bangin nitak an ne laitakin na gen ding hun ngak sin ni.

records.english: My twin sisters were put in separate classes so that they would stop chatting to each other all day.
records.zomi: Ka u numei apengte ni bup a kihopih nawn loh nadingin sangkhan tuam ah kikoih uh hi.

records.english: Children who are teased about their families sometimes react with anger that looks like bad behaviour.
records.zomi: A innkuan thu tawh kisimmawh naupangte in om dan hoih lo bang a kilang hehna tawh a dawng zel uh hi.

records.english: You mustn't tell the teacher that I helped you with the test.
records.zomi: Sitna ah kong huh hi, ci-in saya kiangah na gen kei ding hi.

records.english: I behaved well all week because my father had promised to come to the school assembly.
records.zomi: Ka pa in sang kikhopna ah hong pai dingin a kiciam ahih manin kal bup hoih takin ka om hi.

records.english: The head teacher invited us in to talk about our son's fighting in the playground.
records.zomi: Sang makaipa in i tapa' kimawlna mun-a a kidona thu kihopih dingin hong sam hi.

records.english: My son was so ashamed of being sent to the head teacher that he told us himself at dinner.
records.zomi: Sang makaipa kiangah kipaisak a zum mahmah ahih manin ka tapa mah in nitak an ne laitakin hong gen hi.

records.english: What did your teacher say about your behaviour this term?
records.zomi: Hih sang hun sungin na om dan tungtang na saya in bang a ci hiam?

records.english: That I've become much calmer, especially after lunch.
records.zomi: A diak in sun an khit ciangin ka nuam zaw mahmah hi, a ci hi.

records.english: We agreed with the teacher to use the same reward chart at home and at school.
records.zomi: Inn ah leh sang ah laksapna ciamtehna kibang mah zang dingin saya tawh i kituak uh hi.

records.english: Telling the teacher honestly about our problems at home made her much more patient with our son.
records.zomi: Inn-a i buainate saya kiangah dikin i gen ciangin i tapa tungah a thuakzawh zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: My brother was always the class clown, and my mother was always the one called in to see the head.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal sangkhan sungah nuihzakna bawl mi ahi tawntung a, sang makaipa muh dingin a kisam tawntung pen ka nu ahi hi.

records.english: My parents never punished us for low marks, but they were very strict about manners.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in mak niam adingin hong gawt ngei kei uh a, ahi zongin om dan hoih tungah a khauh mahmah uh hi.

records.english: Teachers notice which children have someone at home asking about their day.
records.zomi: Kua naupang in inn ah a ni uh tungtang a dong mi a nei uh hiam saya te in a thei uh hi.

records.english: Dad made me write a letter of apology to my teacher after I was rude to her.
records.zomi: Ka saya tungah ka zahtak loh khit ciangin Pa in maisakna ngetna lai khat hong gelhsak hi.

records.english: My older sister was always the good one, so the teachers expected the same from me.
records.zomi: Ka u numei hoih pa ahi tawntung ahih manin saya te in kei tungah zong tua bang mah a lamen uh hi.

records.english: Children, remember that you're representing the family when you're at school.
records.zomi: Naupangte, sang na om ciangin innkuan na aipuseh uh hi, ci-in phawk un.

records.english: My parents always said that being kind in class mattered more than being clever.
records.zomi: Sangkhan sungah mi hoih hi in pil sangin a thupi zaw hi, ka nu leh ka pa in a ci tawntung uh hi.

records.english: At home, we never shout, so it surprised me when the teacher said my son shouts in class.
records.zomi: Inn ah i kikou ngei kei uh ahih manin ka tapa sangkhan sungah a kikou hi, saya in a ci ciangin lamdang ka sa hi.

records.english: Children who care for younger siblings at home are sometimes the most responsible pupils in the class.
records.zomi: Inn ah a nau neute a kem naupangte sangkhan sung-a mawhpuakna thei pen te ahi zel uh hi.

records.english: Children often bring the moods of home into the classroom, so a difficult morning can turn into a difficult lesson.
records.zomi: Naupangte in inn-a a lungsim uh sangkhan sungah a tawi zel uh ahih manin zingsang haksa khat sinna haksa ah a kikheel thei hi.

records.english: Did anything go wrong at school today?
records.zomi: Tuni-in sang ah khat peuhpeuh a khial hiam?

records.english: A little, because I forgot my homework again.
records.zomi: Tawmno, ka inn sinna ka mangngilh kik ahih manin.

records.english: Please don't let your brother copy your homework, even if he begs.
records.zomi: Na sanggam pasal in a ngen zongin na inn sinna a la kik sak kei in.

records.english: When a child's behaviour suddenly changes, the first question to ask is what has changed at home.
records.zomi: Naupang khat' om dan thakhatin a kikheel ciangin a masa-a dot ding pen inn ah bang a kikheel hiam ahi hi.

records.english: My son needs to learn that interrupting is rude, at home and at school.
records.zomi: Mi thu gen laitak-a kikhal in inn ah leh sang ah zahtak lohna ahi hi, ci-in ka tapa in a sin kisam hi.

records.english: My mother still remembers the teacher who made her stand in the corner for whispering.
records.zomi: Ka nu in a kisapsuap manin kil ah a dinsak saya a phawk lai hi.

records.english: I'm proud of you for telling the teacher the truth, even though it was hard.
records.zomi: Haksa hangin saya kiangah thu dik na gen manin nang tungah ka kipak hi.

records.english: When my parents divorced, my behaviour at school changed, but nobody guessed why.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa a kikhen uh ciangin sang ah ka om dan a kikheel a, ahi zongin bang hang hiam kuamah in a thei kei uh hi.

records.english: When parents and teachers send the same message about behaviour, children usually settle down much faster.
records.zomi: Nu leh pate leh saya te in om dan tungtang thu kibang a gen uh ciangin naupangte manlang zaw takin a dai uh hi.

records.english: A new baby at home can make an older child seek attention in class, even if they were calm before.
records.zomi: Inn ah naungek thak khat in a ma-in a dai ngei zongin naupang upa zaw khat sangkhan sungah limsak a zong sak thei hi.

records.english: My daughter was moved to a table by the window, and her concentration improved straight away.
records.zomi: Ka tanu tukkhuak kiang dawhkan ah kisuan a, a lungsim a ngaihsutna a hoih pah hi.

records.english: Shall we ask your teacher how we can help you sit still in lessons?
records.zomi: Sinna hun sungin daitak-a na tut theih nadingin bangci i huh thei ding hiam na saya i dong ding hiam?

records.english: How was your behaviour at school today?
records.zomi: Tuni-in sang ah na om dan bangci hiam?

records.english: Good, apart from one warning for talking during maths.
records.zomi: A hoih, maths hun sungin kihopih manin vaihilhna khat bek ka ngah hi.

records.english: Did your mum really get sent out of class for laughing at the teacher's hat?
records.zomi: Saya' lukhu nuihsan manin na nu sangkhan pan kihawlkhia taktak hiam?

records.english: Tell your teacher that you're sorry, and mean it.
records.zomi: Na saya kiangah maisak in, ci in a, na lungsim tawh ci in.

records.english: Our son's behaviour improved a great deal once he started sleeping properly.
records.zomi: I tapa hoih takin a ihmut kipat ciangin a om dan a hoih mahmah hi.

records.english: A child who behaves perfectly at school may let all their frustration out as soon as they get home.
records.zomi: Sang ah a kicing taka om naupang khat in inn a tun pah ciangin a lungkiatna khempeuh a pusuaksak thei hi.

records.english: Please behave nicely for the supply teacher tomorrow.
records.zomi: Zingciang saya taisan adingin hoih takin om in.

records.english: Is it fair that the whole family hears about one bad day at school?
records.zomi: Sang-a ni hoih lo khat thu innkuan bup in a zak a dik hiam?

records.english: Can you promise me that you'll listen to the teacher tomorrow?
records.zomi: Zingciang saya thu na ngaihkhiat ding hong kiciamsak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Why are you smiling?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na nuih hiam?

records.english: I got a gold star for being helpful, and the teacher wants to tell you about it.
records.zomi: Mi huh manin aksi kham khat ka ngah a, saya in a tungtang hong gen nuam hi.

records.english: At the parents' evening, the teacher said our daughter helps the younger ones without being asked.
records.zomi: Nu leh pate' nitak kikhopna ah saya in i tanu in kingen lo-in a neu zawte a huh hi, a ci hi.

records.english: We praised our daughter for every calm day, and soon the calm days outnumbered the difficult ones.
records.zomi: Ni dai khempeuh adingin i tanu i phat uh a, sawt lo-in ni daite in ni haksate a pha khin hi.

records.english: Why did the teacher send a note home about you?
records.zomi: Bang hangin saya in nang tungtang lai neu khat inn ah a khak hiam?

records.english: Children who see adults apologize at home find it easier to apologize at school.
records.zomi: Inn ah mi upate maisakna a ngen a muh naupangte in sang ah maisakna ngen a baih zaw uh hi.

records.english: Do your parents ever talk to your teacher about how you behave?
records.zomi: Na nu leh na pa in na om dan tungtang na saya tawh a kihopih ngei uh hiam?

records.english: My father was called in to the school so often during my first year that the receptionist greeted him by name.
records.zomi: Ka kum masa sungin ka pa sang ah a tamvei kisam ahih manin a kimuakna nasempa in a min tawh a muak hi.

records.english: My father went to the school himself to apologize after I broke a window with a ball.
records.zomi: Ball tawh tukkhuak lahna khat ka hiam khit ciangin ka pa mah sang ah maisakna ngen dingin a pai hi.

records.english: The teacher said, "Your son is a natural leader, so let's help him lead in the right direction."
records.zomi: Saya in, “Na tapa pen pianpih makaipa ahi a, lampi dik lam ah a makaih nadingin i huh ni,” a ci hi.

records.english: Machine translation saves time for people who need only a rough idea of what a document says.
records.zomi: Lai khat in bang a ci hiam ngaihsutna tawmno bek a kisam mite adingin seet in let in hun a khol hi.

records.english: The machine-translated sign in the hotel lobby was so strange that guests kept stopping to photograph it, and the manager eventually had it replaced.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk lutna-a seet in let ciamtehna lamdang lua ahih manin mikhualte a khawl-in lim a la den uh a, a tawpna ah makaipa in a kheelsak hi.

records.english: Hold the phone closer, because it can't hear you over the music.
records.zomi: Phone nai zaw-in len in, la aw hangin na aw a za thei kei hi.

records.english: Names of people and places are often translated wrongly by machines.
records.zomi: Mite leh munte' minte seet in a khialhin a let zel hi.

records.english: Turn on the conversation mode, and the app will translate both of you in turn.
records.zomi: Kihopihna mode hong inla, app in na nih a kizui-in hong let ding hi.

records.english: My cousin translated her CV with an app, and a friend corrected the mistakes afterwards.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in a CV app tawh a let a, a lawm khat in a nung ciangin a khialhnate a puahsak hi.

records.english: The voice in the app sounds so natural that my uncle thought a real person was speaking.
records.zomi: App sung-a aw a taktak mahmah ahih manin ka pa neu in mihing taktak khat a gen hi, a sa hi.

records.english: Our phone turned a simple warning on the stairs into a sentence that made no sense, and we all laughed.
records.zomi: I phone in kahlei tung-a vaihilhna baih khat a khiatna om lo kammal khat ah a kheel a, i nuih khempeuh uh hi.

records.english: Translation apps usually work better for widely spoken languages than for smaller ones with less written material.
records.zomi: Let app te in a kizang tamzaw pau tampi te adingin, lai tawm kigelh pau neute sangin a hoih zaw zel hi.

records.english: The tourist held up her phone, and the app read the question aloud in our language.
records.zomi: Khualzin numei in a phone a liap a, app in i pau tawh dotna aw ngaih takin a sim hi.

records.english: My grandfather speaks to his new neighbour through a translation app on his tablet.
records.zomi: Ka pu in a tablet tung-a let app tawh a innveng thak tawh a kihopih hi.

records.english: Shall I use the app, or would you rather I asked someone who speaks the language?
records.zomi: App ka zang ding hiam, pau a gen thei mi khat ka dot na deih zaw hiam?

records.english: Is the translation correct?
records.zomi: Let a dik hiam?

records.english: Mostly, but the second sentence sounds very strange.
records.zomi: A tamzaw, ahi zongin a nihna kammal a lamdang mahmah hi.

records.english: Turn the screen round so that she can read the translation.
records.zomi: Let a sim theih nadingin screen hei in.

records.english: AI translation has made it easier for families separated by language to keep in touch.
records.zomi: AI let in pau hangin kikhen innkuante kizopna a baihsak zaw hi.

records.english: Type your message here, and the translation will appear underneath.
records.zomi: Na thu hih ah gelh inla, let a nuai ah hong kilang ding hi.

records.english: You need an internet connection for the app to work, unless you download the language first.
records.zomi: App a nasep theih nadingin internet na kisam a, pau na download masak leh a kisam kei hi.

records.english: Could you check what the app has written before I send this message to my landlord?
records.zomi: Ka inn neipa kiangah hih thu ka khak ma-in app in bang a gelh hiam hong en sak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Our neighbour's phone translated the birthday card so badly that she rang me to ask what it meant.
records.zomi: I innveng' phone in pianni card a hoih lo mahmah-in a let ahih manin bang a ci nopna hiam dong dingin hong sam hi.

records.english: A translation that is grammatically correct can still sound unnatural to a native speaker.
records.zomi: Pau zia dik khat zong pau a pianpih mi khat adingin a ngeina hi lo bangin a kiza thei hi.

records.english: Is it rude to use a translation app when you're speaking to someone face to face?
records.zomi: Mi khat tawh maitang kituak-a na kihopih laitakin let app zat a zahtak loh hiam?

records.english: Why does the app keep translating my name as a word?
records.zomi: Bang hangin app in ka min kammal khat bangin a let den hiam?

records.english: Because your name is also an ordinary word in that language.
records.zomi: Na min tua pau ah kammal tavuan khat zong ahih manin.

records.english: The shopkeeper typed his answer into his phone and turned the screen towards me.
records.zomi: Dawl neipa in a dawnna a phone ah a gelh a, screen kei lam ah a heisak hi.

records.english: Please don't rely on an app to translate your medical forms; ask for a professional interpreter.
records.zomi: Na damdawi form te let dingin app tungah kinga kei inla, pau lettu kician khat ngen in.

records.english: Some words have no direct translation, so the machine chooses the nearest one, even if it's wrong.
records.zomi: Kammal pawl khat in a tang-a let theih a nei kei ahih manin a khialh zongin seet in a nai pen a teel hi.

records.english: Legal documents should be translated by a qualified person, not only by a machine.
records.zomi: Thukham lai te seet bek in hi lo-in a kicing mi khat in a let ding hi.

records.english: A whole page of text was translated in less than a second.
records.zomi: Lai phek bup khat second khat sungin kilet hi.

records.english: A good translation keeps the meaning, not just the words.
records.zomi: Let hoih khat in kammalte bek hi lo-in a khiatna a kem hi.

records.english: I used a translation app to read the menu in the restaurant.
records.zomi: An zuakna inn-a an min laite sim dingin let app khat ka zang hi.

records.english: After the update, the app finally understood my accent.
records.zomi: Update khit ciangin app in a tawpna ah ka gen dan a thei ta hi.

records.english: When a translation sounds too formal, I add a friendly sentence of my own.
records.zomi: Let khat a pomzawh lua ciangin keimah' kammal nuam khat ka behlap hi.

records.english: Machine translation is useful for getting the general idea of a text, but it can miss tone and politeness.
records.zomi: Seet in let in lai khat' ngaihsutna tawmpi theih nadingin a phatuam a, ahi zongin aw leh zahtakna a mangsak thei hi.

records.english: Children who grow up with translation apps may find it harder to see why learning a language matters.
records.zomi: Let app te tawh a khang naupangte in pau sin bang hangin a thupi hiam a theih a haksa zaw thei uh hi.

records.english: My phone can translate signs if I point the camera at them.
records.zomi: Camera tawh ka liap leh ka phone in ciamtehnate a let thei hi.

records.english: The app's translation was polite enough, but it sounded like a government letter.
records.zomi: App' let a zahtak kicing a, ahi zongin kumpi lai khat bang hi.

records.english: Students, you mustn't use translation tools during the language exam.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, pau sitna sungin let vanzatte zang lo ding hi.

records.english: Short, simple sentences are usually translated more accurately than long ones full of idioms.
records.zomi: Kammal tomno leh baihte kammal sau kammalpi tawh dimte sangin a dik zawk-in kilet zel hi.

records.english: The teacher said, "Use the app to check a word, but write the sentence yourself."
records.zomi: Saya in, “Kammal khat en dingin app zang un, ahi zongin kammal bup nangmah in gelh un,” a ci hi.

records.english: Translation apps have improved a lot, but they still make mistakes that a person would never make.
records.zomi: Let app te a hoih semsem mahmah a, ahi zongin mihing khat in a bawl ngei loh ding khialhnate a bawl lai uh hi.

records.english: Do you trust machine translation for anything important?
records.zomi: Thu thupi khatpeuh adingin seet in let na muang hiam?

records.english: The app kept confusing the men and women in the story, because my language uses the same word for both.
records.zomi: Ka pau in pasal leh numei adingin kammal kibang a zat ahih manin app in tangthu sung-a pasalte leh numeite a khialhsak den hi.

records.english: We still need human translators, because meaning depends so much on culture and situation.
records.zomi: Khiatna in ngeina leh dinmun tungah a kinga mahmah ahih manin mihing pau lettu i kisam lai uh hi.

records.english: Can this app translate what I say out loud?
records.zomi: Hih app in ka gen aw ngaih a let thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, just press the microphone and speak slowly.
records.zomi: Thei hi, microphone nek inla nuam takin gen in.

records.english: Machine translation can be helpful in an emergency, but a mistake in a doctor's instructions could be dangerous.
records.zomi: Seet in let in haksatna hun ah a phatuam thei a, ahi zongin siavuan' thuhilhna-a khialhna khat a lauhuai thei hi.

records.english: My mother uses an app to understand the letters from my school.
records.zomi: Ka nu in ka sang pan lai te a theih nadingin app khat a zang hi.

records.english: I always ask a native speaker to read anything important after the machine has translated it.
records.zomi: Seet in a let khit ciangin thu thupi khempeuh a pau pianpih mi khat in a sim dingin ka ngen tawntung hi.

records.english: I wrote the message slowly and simply, so that the app would translate it correctly.
records.zomi: App in a dik takin a let theih nadingin thu nuam leh baih takin ka gelh hi.

records.english: The app helped my parents talk to the nurse when there was no interpreter available.
records.zomi: Pau lettu a om loh ciangin app in ka nu leh ka pa nurse tawh a kihopih theih nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: My little sister uses a translation app to chat with a pen friend in Japan.
records.zomi: Ka nau numei in Japan gam-a lai kikhak lawm khat tawh kihopih dingin let app khat a zang hi.

records.english: Can you show my father how to use the camera to translate labels in the shop?
records.zomi: Dawl-a van tung-a laite let dingin camera bangci zang ding hiam ka pa hong lak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: The translated instructions for the washing machine were so confusing that we gave up and watched a video.
records.zomi: Puan sawpna seet adingin kilet zatdan a buaihuai lua ahih manin i khawl uh a, video khat i en uh hi.

records.english: Could someone check the translation of my allergy card very carefully before I travel?
records.zomi: Ka khualzin ma-in ka allergy card' let kuamah in limtak mahmah-in a en thei ding hiam?

records.english: My son checks his homework in a translation app, but his teacher can always tell.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in a inn sinna let app ah a en a, ahi zongin a saya in a thei tawntung hi.

records.english: Does this app work without the internet?
records.zomi: Hih app internet om lo-in a sem thei hiam?

records.english: A machine can translate the words of a joke without understanding why it's funny.
records.zomi: Seet khat in nuihzakna thu khat' kammalte bang hangin a nuihhuai hiam theih lo-in a let thei hi.

records.english: Who should check the translation before we print the posters?
records.zomi: Poster te i khet ma-un kua in let a en ding hiam?

records.english: The app doesn't know my grandmother's language at all.
records.zomi: App in ka pi' pau a thei khol kei hi.

records.english: A day ticket is only worth it for three or more trips.
records.zomi: Ni khat lai pen vei thum hiam a tam zaw khualzinna adingin bek a phatuam hi.

records.english: Taking the boat instead of the bus meant an extra hour, but nobody felt sick on the winding road.
records.zomi: Bus sangin tembaw tuang in nai khat a behlap a, ahi zongin lampi kawikawi tungah kuamah a lua kei uh hi.

records.english: Children, choose your seats now, and nobody is changing seats once we've left.
records.zomi: Naupangte, tu-in na tutna uh teel un, i kipat khit ciangin kuamah in tutna a kheel kei ding uh hi.

records.english: Choosing the earlier bus means arriving tired, but choosing the later one means arriving in the dark.
records.zomi: Bus masa zaw teel in gim taka tun cihna ahi a, a nung zaw teel in mial ah tun cihna ahi hi.

records.english: The airport express costs three times as much as the ordinary bus, but it doesn't get stuck in traffic.
records.zomi: Vanlengtual bus manlang in bus tavuan sangin a man a thum pha a, ahi zongin mawtaw buaina sungah a tang kei hi.

records.english: Do you two want to take the bus with me, or would you rather take a taxi together?
records.zomi: Na nih in kei tawh bus tuang na deih uh hiam, khawmin taxi na tuang zaw uh hiam?

records.english: Do you think it's better to travel overnight or to lose a whole day on the train?
records.zomi: Zan bup khualzin a hoih zaw hiam, meileng tungah ni bup mansuah a hoih zaw hiam na ci hiam?

records.english: Should we buy single tickets now or wait and see how often we use the bus?
records.zomi: Tu-in khatvei lai i lei ding hiam, bus bangzah in i zang hiam i en ding hiam?

records.english: For a family travelling with a pushchair and several suitcases, a direct coach can be far easier than two trains and a rushed change.
records.zomi: Naungek leeng leh van bawm tampi tawh khualzin innkuan khat adingin bus lianpi tang khat in meileng nih leh manlang taka kikheel sangin a baih zaw mahmah thei hi.

records.english: I'd rather wait ten minutes for an emptier bus than squeeze onto this one.
records.zomi: Hih bus ah kinek-a lut sangin bus a awng zaw minit sawm ngak ka deih zaw hi.

records.english: The cable car is faster, but my mother would rather take the road up the mountain.
records.zomi: Khau tung mawtaw in a manlang zaw a, ahi zongin ka nu in mual tung lampi zui a deih zaw hi.

records.english: My brother always chooses the bus with free internet, even if it's slower.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal in a nuam zongin internet man om lo bus a teel tawntung hi.

records.english: The lower berth is easier to climb into, but the upper one feels more private.
records.zomi: Lupna nuai lam lut a baih zaw a, ahi zongin a tung lam in a guk zaw bangin a kisa hi.

records.english: Do you think the tram or the bus is easier with a wheelchair?
records.zomi: Tram hiam bus hiam, wheelchair tawh koi in a baih zaw ding na ci hiam?

records.english: A fixed-time ticket is much cheaper, but a flexible one lets you catch any train on the same day.
records.zomi: Hun kiciang lai a man neem zaw mahmah a, ahi zongin kikheel thei lai in ni kibang sungah meileng khatpeuh na tuang theisak hi.

records.english: Which do you prefer on long trips, the window or the aisle?
records.zomi: Khualzin sau ah koi na deih zaw hiam, tukkhuak kiang hiam, a lai lampi kiang hiam?

records.english: The aisle, so I can get up without climbing over anyone.
records.zomi: A lai lampi kiang, kuamah ka kaan kul lo-in ka thou theih nadingin.

records.english: On rainy days I take the bus, and on sunny days I walk.
records.zomi: Guah zuk ni te ah bus ka tuang a, ni sa ni te ah ka kal hi.

records.english: The airport is easier to reach by train, though the bus drops you closer to the terminal.
records.zomi: Vanlengtual meileng tawh tun a baih zaw a, ahi zongin bus in vanlengtual inn tawh a nai zaw ah hong khiasak hi.

records.english: A change with only four minutes to spare is risky, so I chose the later connection with a longer wait.
records.zomi: Minit li bek a om kikheelna khat a lauhuai ahih manin ngak sawt zaw kizopna a nung zaw ka teel hi.

records.english: I really did think the ferry would be slower, but it beat the bus by half an hour.
records.zomi: Tembaw a nuam zaw ding ka sa taktak a, ahi zongin bus sangin nai langkhat a manlang zaw hi.

records.english: Choosing a seat facing forward can help passengers who get travel sick.
records.zomi: Mai lam a ngat tutna teel in khualzin-a a lua mi te a huh thei hi.

records.english: Standing on the express is still faster than sitting on the slow train.
records.zomi: Meileng manlang tungah ding zong meileng nuam tungah tut sangin a manlang zaw lai hi.

records.english: Booking a month ahead saved us half the fare, though we couldn't change the date.
records.zomi: Kha khat ma-in kilai in khualzin man a langkhat i khol uh a, ahi zongin ni i kheel thei kei uh hi.

records.english: The ticket office worker helped my grandfather find the cheapest fare for his journey.
records.zomi: Lai zuakna office nasempa in ka pu a khualzinna adingin man neem pen a zon nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: From the top deck you can see the whole city, so the children always want to sit upstairs.
records.zomi: A tung lam khan pan khuapi bup na mu thei ahih manin naupangte in a tung lam ah tu a deih tawntung uh hi.

records.english: For short trips across the city, a bike-share bicycle can be faster than any bus.
records.zomi: Khuapi sung khualzin tomte adingin kihawm siiksakol in bus khatpeuh sangin a manlang zaw thei hi.

records.english: Shall we book a sleeper berth or just sit up all night in a reclining seat?
records.zomi: Ihmutna lupna i lai ding hiam, tutna kingak thei tungah zan bup i tu ding hiam?

records.english: Is first class worth the extra money on such a short journey?
records.zomi: Hih bang khualzin tom tungah first class in sum behlap a phu hiam?

records.english: Not really, unless you need a quiet table to work at.
records.zomi: A phu khol kei hi, nasep na sepna dingin dawhkan dai khat na kisam kei leh.

records.english: The cheapest flight lands at midnight, so we'd have no bus into town.
records.zomi: Vanleng man neem pen zan lai ciangin a tung ahih manin khuapi sung pai dingin bus i nei kei ding uh hi.

records.english: Many commuters choose a slower route simply because they're more likely to get a seat.
records.zomi: Ni simin nasep pai mi tampi in tutna a ngah theih zawk manin lampi nuam zaw a teel uh hi.

records.english: When the bus is cheaper but the train is more comfortable, my parents always choose comfort.
records.zomi: Bus in a man neem zaw a, meileng in a nuam zaw ciangin ka nu leh ka pa in nuamna a teel tawntung uh hi.

records.english: Would you sit at the front or the back of the bus with a baby?
records.zomi: Naungek tawh bus' mai lam ah na tu ding hiam, nung lam ah hiam?

records.english: Near the front, so the driver can see us and we can get off quickly.
records.zomi: Mai lam kiang, mawngpa in hong muh theih nadingin leh manlang takin i kiak theih nadingin.

records.english: Choosing between the fast bus and the cheap one often comes down to whether you value time or money more on a particular morning.
records.zomi: Bus manlang leh man neem kikal teelna in zingsang khat ah hun hiam sum hiam koi na lianlam zaw hiam tungah a kinga zel hi.

records.english: For a nervous traveller, a direct bus may be better than a quicker route with two changes.
records.zomi: A lau khualzin mi khat adingin bus tang khat in kikheelna nih nei lampi manlang zaw sangin a hoih zaw thei hi.

records.english: When there are three ways to the same place, I usually choose the one with the fewest changes.
records.zomi: Mun kibang tun nading lampi thum a om ciangin kikheelna tawm pen nei lampi ka teel zel hi.

records.english: The coach is cheaper than the train, but it takes twice as long and stops at every service station.
records.zomi: Bus lianpi in meileng sangin a man neem zaw a, ahi zongin a hun a nih pha a la a, khawlna mun khempeuh ah a khawl hi.

records.english: Upgrading to a sleeper cabin felt like an extravagance at the time, but after a fourteen-hour day it was worth every penny.
records.zomi: Ihmutna khan ah kah tohna in tua hun ciangin sum zat luatna bangin a kisa a, ahi zongin nai sawmlehli nasep ni khat khit ciangin a man a phu khempeuh hi.

records.english: Is it better to buy a ticket from the machine or from the ticket office?
records.zomi: Lai seet pan lei a hoih zaw hiam, lai zuakna office pan lei a hoih zaw hiam?

records.english: Would you rather sit on a train for six hours or fly for one and wait at the airport for two?
records.zomi: Meileng tungah nai guk tut na deih zaw hiam, nai khat leng-in vanlengtual ah nai nih ngak na deih zaw hiam?

records.english: Which is cheaper for a group of five, separate tickets or a group pass?
records.zomi: Mi nga pawl khat adingin koi in a man neem zaw hiam, lai tuamtuam hiam, pawl lai hiam?

records.english: A ticket with a seat reservation costs a little more, but it guarantees you won't stand for four hours.
records.zomi: Tutna kilai lai in a man tam deuh a, ahi zongin nai li sung na din loh ding a kiciamsak hi.

records.english: Walking two stops is often quicker than waiting for the tram in the evening.
records.zomi: Nitak lam tram ngak sangin khawlna nih kal in a manlang zaw zel hi.

records.english: A late-night tram may be slower, but it feels safer than waiting at a dark bus stop.
records.zomi: Zan lai tram a nuam zaw kha thei a, ahi zongin bus khawlna mial khat ah ngak sangin a bit zaw bangin a kisa hi.

records.english: The slow train stops at every village, while the express goes straight through, so it depends where you want to get off.
records.zomi: Meileng nuam in khua khempeuh ah a khawl a, meileng manlang in a tang-in a pai ahih manin na kiak nop mun tungah a kinga hi.

records.english: The minibus leaves when it's full, whereas the big bus keeps to the timetable even when it's half empty.
records.zomi: Bus neu in a dim ciangin a pai a, bus lian in a langkhat bek a dim ciangin zong hun ciamteh a zui hi.

records.english: The overnight coach saves the price of a hotel, but you arrive feeling as if you haven't slept at all.
records.zomi: Zan bus lianpi in zinbuuk man a khol a, ahi zongin na ihmu khol lo bangin na kisa-in na tung hi.

records.english: Shall we take the scenic railway or the faster line through the tunnel?
records.zomi: Muhnop meileng lampi i zui ding hiam, mual kua tawng lampi manlang zaw i zui ding hiam?

records.english: Should I print my ticket or keep it on my phone?
records.zomi: Ka lai ka khet ding hiam, ka phone ah ka kem ding hiam?

records.english: Keep it on your phone, but take a screenshot in case the signal goes.
records.zomi: Na phone ah kem in, ahi zongin signal a mang leh ci-in screenshot khat la in.

records.english: A pass for the whole region costs more, but it lets you take buses and trains without buying separate tickets.
records.zomi: Gamkhen bup adingin lai khat in a man tam zaw a, ahi zongin lai tuamtuam lei lo-in bus leh meileng na tuang theisak hi.

records.english: We switched from the bus to the train, and our journey became much more predictable.
records.zomi: Bus pan meileng ah i kheel uh a, i khualzinna a kiciamteh theih zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: We picked the family carriage, because the quiet carriage is no place for a toddler.
records.zomi: Daina khan pen naupang neu adingin mun hi lo ahih manin innkuan khan i teel uh hi.

records.english: We let our son choose between the boat and the train, and of course he chose the boat.
records.zomi: I tapa tembaw leh meileng kikal ah teel dingin i phal uh a, tembaw mah a teel hi.

records.english: Last winter, we had to choose between the last train and a night in the city.
records.zomi: Phalbi nunung in meileng nunung pen leh khuapi-a zan khat kikal ah i teel kul uh hi.

records.english: We ran for the train and caught it with seconds to spare.
records.zomi: Meileng i taitai uh a, second tawmno bek kiangin i tuang zo uh hi.

records.english: Halfway home, it broke down, and we spent the night in a cold carriage after all.
records.zomi: Inn i tun ma lamkal ah a siat a, a tawpna ah khan vot khat sungah zan i giak uh hi.

records.english: A ferry ticket with a cabin costs more, but the children can sleep properly.
records.zomi: Khan nei tembaw lai in a man tam zaw a, ahi zongin naupangte hoih takin a ihmu thei uh hi.

records.english: In Luke's account, Jesus prays for the forgiveness of the people who crucified him.
records.zomi: Luka' gelh ah Jesu in amah singlamteh tunga khaite' maisakna adingin thu a ngen hi.

records.english: The Gospels say that an angel told the women that Jesus had risen.
records.zomi: Lungdamna Thu te in vantung mi khat in numeite kiangah Jesu a thokik hi, a ci hi, ci-in a gen hi.

records.english: Jesus was crucified outside the city walls of Jerusalem, according to the Gospels.
records.zomi: Lungdamna Thu te bangin Jesu Jerusalem khuapi kulh pua lam ah singlamteh tungah kikhai hi.

records.english: Has the cross on the church roof been fixed yet?
records.zomi: Pawlpi inn tungvum-a singlamteh a kibawl kik khin hiam?

records.english: Was Peter really the disciple who denied knowing Jesus three times?
records.zomi: Jesu a theih loh hi, ci-in vei thum a nial nungzui pen Piter taktak hiam?

records.english: In our church, nobody is allowed to talk during the silent hour on Good Friday afternoon.
records.zomi: I pawlpi ah Good Friday nitak lam daina nai sungin kuamah kihopih thei lo hi.

records.english: How would you explain the meaning of the resurrection to someone who has never been to church?
records.zomi: Pawlpi ah a pai ngei lo mi khat kiangah thawhkikna' khiatna bangci na genteh ding hiam?

records.english: On Good Friday, our church is kept almost bare, with no flowers on the altar.
records.zomi: Good Friday ciangin i pawlpi a awng zah dek-in kikem a, maitam tungah pakte om lo hi.

records.english: Our pastor said, "The cross reminds us how far God's love was willing to go."
records.zomi: I pastor in, “Singlamteh in Pasian' itna bangzah dong a pai nuam hiam hong phawksak hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: We need to set out the chairs early, because the Easter service is always crowded.
records.zomi: Easter kikhopna mi tam tawntung ahih manin tutphahte hun ma-in i koih kisam hi.

records.english: Did the soldiers really divide Jesus' clothes among themselves?
records.zomi: Galkapte in Jesu' puante a kihawm uh taktak hiam?

records.english: The children decorated eggs on Saturday for the Easter breakfast.
records.zomi: Easter zingsang an adingin naupangte in Kiginni ni-in aktuite a zeek uh hi.

records.english: Many believers fast or eat simply on Good Friday.
records.zomi: Upmi tampi in Good Friday ni-in an ngawl a ul uh hiam, nuamtak-in an ne uh hi.

records.english: My grandmother always cried during the Good Friday service and sang loudly on Easter morning.
records.zomi: Ka pi in Good Friday kikhopna ah a kap tawntung a, Easter zingsang ciangin aw ngaih takin la a sa hi.

records.english: Shall we invite our neighbours to the Easter breakfast after church?
records.zomi: Pawlpi khit-a Easter zingsang an adingin i innvengte i sam ding hiam?

records.english: Do you go to church on Good Friday as well as on Easter Sunday?
records.zomi: Easter Nipini bek hi lo-in Good Friday ni-in zong pawlpi na pai hiam?

records.english: The Gospels describe a darkness that covered the land in the hours before Jesus died.
records.zomi: Lungdamna Thu te in Jesu a sih ma-a nai tawmno sung gam a khuh khuamialna khat a gen hi.

records.english: On Easter Sunday, the church was filled with white flowers.
records.zomi: Easter Nipini ciangin pawlpi pak kang tawh a dim hi.

records.english: Some churches cover their crosses with dark cloth during the last week before Easter.
records.zomi: Pawlpi pawl khat in Easter ma-a kal nunung sungin a singlamtehte uh puan dum tawh a khuh uh hi.

records.english: My little brother asked whether Jesus had felt pain on the cross, and I realised I didn't know how to answer him gently.
records.zomi: Singlamteh tungah Jesu a na sa hiam ci-in ka nau pasal in hong dong a, nem takin bangci ka dawng ding hiam ka thei kei hi, ci ka phawk hi.

records.english: Every Good Friday, my mother lights a single candle by the window.
records.zomi: Good Friday simin ka nu in tukkhuak kiangah khawimeivaak khat bek a tawisak hi.

records.english: At the Easter service, the whole church stood up when the choir began to sing.
records.zomi: Easter kikhopna ah la sa pawl in la a sak kipat ciangin pawlpi bup a ding hi.

records.english: According to the Gospels, women who had followed Jesus were the first to find the tomb empty.
records.zomi: Lungdamna Thu te bangin Jesu a zui numeite in han a awng a mu masa pen uh hi.

records.english: Christians understand the resurrection in different ways, but most see it as the centre of their faith.
records.zomi: Khristiante in thawhkikna tuamtuam-in a theih uh a, ahi zongin a tamzaw in a upna uh' lailung bangin a mu uh hi.

records.english: The story of Thomas, who doubted until he saw the wounds, comforts many people who struggle with belief.
records.zomi: Liamnate a muh dong a lungmang Thomas' tangthu in upna tungah a buai mi tampi a hehnem hi.

records.english: In many churches, the cross is a reminder not only of suffering but also of love.
records.zomi: Pawlpi tampi ah singlamteh in thuakna bek hi lo-in itna zong a phawksak hi.

records.english: The pastor made the children act out the walk to the empty tomb.
records.zomi: Pastor in naupangte han awng lam pai dan a lak sak hi.

records.english: Christians around the world celebrate Easter on different dates, depending on their church calendar.
records.zomi: Leitung bup-a Khristiante in a pawlpi uh' calendar tungah kinga-in Easter ni tuamtuam ah a lawp uh hi.

records.english: Can you tell me the story of the first Easter?
records.zomi: Easter masa pen' tangthu hong gen thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Why is the Friday before Easter called Good Friday?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Easter ma-a Laithai ni Good Friday kici hiam?

records.english: Christians remember it as the day Jesus died, and they believe his death brought something good for the world.
records.zomi: Khristiante in Jesu a sih ni bangin a phawk uh a, a sihna in leitung adingin thu hoih khat hong tun hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Two followers walking to a village called Emmaus did not recognise the risen Jesus at first, according to Luke.
records.zomi: Luka bangin Emaus kici khua lam a pai nungzui nih in a masa-in a thokik Jesu a thei kei uh hi.

records.english: Children, please walk quietly into the church this morning, because it's Good Friday.
records.zomi: Naupangte, Good Friday ahih manin tu zingsang pawlpi sungah dai takin lut un.

records.english: Christians believe that Jesus died on the cross and rose from the dead on the third day.
records.zomi: Khristiante in Jesu singlamteh tungah a si a, ni thumna ni-in misi lak pan a thokik hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Theologians have long discussed why Jesus' death on the cross is understood as being for others.
records.zomi: Bang hangin Jesu' singlamteh tunga sihna mi dangte adingin ahi hi, ci-in kithei hiam pen Pasian thu siamte in hun sawt pi kinial uh hi.

records.english: For Christians, the resurrection means that death does not have the final word.
records.zomi: Khristiante adingin thawhkikna in sihna in thu nunung a nei kei hi, cihna ahi hi.

records.english: Our church gives flowers to the elderly members who can't come to the Easter service.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in Easter kikhopna ah a pai zo lo pawlpi mi upate pak a pia hi.

records.english: The disciples were afraid and hid after Jesus was arrested, according to the Gospels.
records.zomi: Lungdamna Thu te bangin Jesu a kiman khit ciangin nungzuite a lau uh a, a bu uh hi.

records.english: Many Christians believe that through the cross, people can be forgiven and made right with God.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in singlamteh tungtawnin mite a mawhnate uh kimaisak-a Pasian tawh kilem thei uh hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: What does the empty tomb mean to you?
records.zomi: Han awng in nangma adingin bang khiatna a nei hiam?

records.english: It gives me hope that the people I've lost are not lost forever.
records.zomi: Ka mansuah mite khantawn-in a mang lo uh hi, ci lametna hong pia hi.

records.english: The Easter greeting in our church is answered by the whole congregation at once.
records.zomi: I pawlpi-a Easter kihopihna kammal pawlpi bup in khatvei-in a dawng uh hi.

records.english: The choir practised the Easter songs every evening for a week.
records.zomi: La sa pawl in Easter late kal khat sung nitak simin a sin uh hi.

records.english: Seeing the cross in our village church still moves me after all these years.
records.zomi: I khua pawlpi-a singlamteh muh in kum tampi khit ciangin zong hong lungdam sak lai hi.

records.english: Understanding why the crucifixion is central to Christian belief takes more than one Sunday lesson.
records.zomi: Bang hangin singlamteh tunga sihna Khristian upna ah lailung hiam theih in Nipini sinna khat sangin a tam zaw a kisam hi.

records.english: We had the old wooden cross in the church repainted before Easter.
records.zomi: Easter ma-in pawlpi sung-a sing singlamteh lui i zeek kik uh hi.

records.english: Why did the women go to the tomb so early in the morning?
records.zomi: Bang hangin numeite zingsang tung mahmah-in han ah a pai uh hiam?

records.english: We use a simple wooden cross on the table for our family prayers at Easter.
records.zomi: Easter-a i innkuan thungetna adingin dawhkan tungah sing singlamteh baih khat i zang uh hi.

records.english: On Easter morning, my father greets everyone at the door with a smile and a handshake.
records.zomi: Easter zingsang ciangin ka pa in kongkhak ah mi khempeuh nuih tawh, khut kilen tawh a muak hi.

records.english: Believers who have suffered great losses often find special meaning in the story of the crucifixion.
records.zomi: Mansuahna lianpi a thuak upmite in singlamteh tunga sihna tangthu ah khiatna tuam a mu zel uh hi.

records.english: Christians speak of the resurrection as the beginning of a new kind of life, not simply a return to the old one.
records.zomi: Khristiante in thawhkikna pen nuntakna lui ah ciah kikna bek hi lo-in nuntakna thak' kipatna bangin a gen uh hi.

records.english: Some churches hold a dawn service on Easter Sunday, so that people can greet the sunrise together.
records.zomi: Pawlpi pawl khat in mite in nisuahna khawm a muak theih nadingin Easter Nipini ah khuavak kikhopna a nei uh hi.

records.english: Who will read the Easter story this year?
records.zomi: Tu kum Easter tangthu kua in a sim ding hiam?

records.english: What happened on the first Easter morning?
records.zomi: Easter zingsang masa pen ah bang a piang hiam?

records.english: The Gospels say that the tomb was found empty and that Jesus appeared to his followers.
records.zomi: Lungdamna Thu te in han a awng a kimu a, Jesu in a nungzuite kiangah a kilak hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Who rolled the stone away from the tomb?
records.zomi: Han kongkhakna suangpi kua in a lik khia hiam?

records.english: Please don't play loud music in the house on Good Friday; it's a quiet day for our family.
records.zomi: Good Friday ni-in inn sungah la aw ngaih takin hong kei un; i innkuan adingin ni dai ahi hi.

records.english: Easter Sunday is the most joyful day of the year in our church.
records.zomi: Easter Nipini pen i pawlpi ah kum sung-a nuam pen ni ahi hi.

records.english: The resurrection is celebrated not only on Easter Sunday but, for many believers, every Sunday.
records.zomi: Thawhkikna Easter Nipini bek hi lo-in upmi tampi adingin Nipini khempeuh ah kilawp hi.

records.english: Our youth group carried a large wooden cross through the town on Good Friday.
records.zomi: I khangno pawl in Good Friday ni-in khuapi tawngin sing singlamteh lianpi khat a pua uh hi.

records.english: Did your parents ever explain why they moved here?
records.zomi: Bang hangin hih ah a hong pai uh hiam na nu leh na pa in a genteh ngei uh hiam?

records.english: We've decided that the children will spend one weekend with each grandparent in turn.
records.zomi: Naupangte pu leh pi khatciat kiangah kal tawp khat a om ding uh hi, ci-in i khensat uh hi.

records.english: My mother explained that she wasn't remarrying, but that she was happy to have a companion.
records.zomi: Ka nu in kiteen kik lo ding a, ahi zongin a lawm khat a neih a lungdam hi, ci-in a genteh hi.

records.english: Why did you name the baby after your grandfather?
records.zomi: Bang hangin naungek na pu' min na phuak hiam?

records.english: He was the kindest person I've ever known.
records.zomi: Ka theih ngeina mi lak ah a hehpihna thei pen ahi hi.

records.english: Please don't ask Dad about his decision to leave the band; he'll talk about it when he's ready.
records.zomi: Pa' la sa pawl nusiat ding thukhenna tungtang dong kei un; a kiginkhol ciangin a gen ding hi.

records.english: You mustn't take it personally that we've decided to have a small wedding.
records.zomi: Mopawi neu khat nei dingin i khensat uh thu na tungah na la kei ding hi.

records.english: How come you two are sharing a car now?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tu-in na nih in mawtaw khat na kihawm uh hiam?

records.english: We only drive at weekends, and one car is cheaper to insure.
records.zomi: Kal tawp ciang bek i mawng uh a, mawtaw khat insurance a man neem zaw hi.

records.english: Rather than let my parents hear it from the neighbours, I decided to tell them the truth myself that same evening.
records.zomi: Innvengte pan ka nu leh ka pa in a zak sangin tua nitak mah-in keimah mah in thu dik gen dingin ka khensat hi.

records.english: We explained to the twins that they would be in different classes so that each could make their own friends.
records.zomi: Khatciat in amau' lawm a ngah theih nadingin sangkhan tuam ah a om ding uh hi, ci-in apengte kiangah i genteh uh hi.

records.english: When my sister decided not to have children, she explained her reasons once and then refused to discuss it again.
records.zomi: Ka u numei in ta nei lo dingin a khensat ciangin a hangte vei khat a genteh a, tua khit ciangin kihopih nawn a nuam kei hi.

records.english: Grandma has decided to stop driving, and she says she feels relieved.
records.zomi: Pi in mawtaw mawng khawl dingin a khensat a, a lungdam hi, a ci hi.

records.english: A decision that is explained to the whole family is usually easier for everyone to accept.
records.zomi: Innkuan bup kiangah kigenteh thukhenna khat mi khempeuh in a pom baih zaw zel uh hi.

records.english: Why are you letting your son take a year off before university?
records.zomi: Bang hangin sangpi a pai ma-in na tapa kum khat tawl dingin na phal hiam?

records.english: He's worked hard for years, and we think a year of work and travel will help him choose well.
records.zomi: Kum tampi hanciam takin nasep a sem a, kum khat nasep leh khualzinna in hoih takin a teel nadingin a huh ding hi, i ci uh hi.

records.english: We let the cat sleep on the bed once, and now she won't sleep anywhere else.
records.zomi: Zawhngeu khatvei lupna tungah a ihmut i phal uh a, tu-in mun dang ah a ihmu nuam nawn kei hi.

records.english: My brother explained that he was changing careers because he wanted to work outdoors.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal in a pua lam ah nasep sep a deih manin nasep a kheel hi, ci-in a genteh hi.

records.english: What was the reason for getting married abroad?
records.zomi: Gamdang ah kiteen nading hang bang ahi hiam?

records.english: Half of our families live there, and it was cheaper for two of us to travel than for forty.
records.zomi: I innkuan langkhat tua ah a teeng uh a, sawmli pai sangin i nih pai a man neem zaw hi.

records.english: We decided to keep the news of the baby quiet until after the first scan.
records.zomi: A masa scan khit dong naungek thu daitak-a kem dingin i khensat uh hi.

records.english: We've decided to move to a smaller flat now that the children have left home.
records.zomi: Naupangte inn a nusiat khit uh ciangin inn neu zaw ah pai dingin i khensat uh hi.

records.english: When parents explain the reasons for a hard decision, children may still be upset, but they rarely feel betrayed.
records.zomi: Nu leh pate in thukhenna haksa khat' hangte a genteh uh ciangin naupangte a lungkham lai thei uh a, ahi zongin a kizuausak bangin a kisa tawm mahmah uh hi.

records.english: My father said, "I've made my decision, and I'd like you to respect it, even if you disagree."
records.zomi: Ka pa in, “Ka thukhenna ka bawl khin a, na kituak kei zongin na zahtak ka deih hi,” a ci hi.

records.english: What made you stop your daughter's piano lessons?
records.zomi: Bang in na tanu' piano sinna hong khawlsak hiam?

records.english: She was miserable every week, and we didn't want her to hate music forever.
records.zomi: Kal simin a lungkham mahmah a, la khantawn-in a huat nadingin i deih kei uh hi.

records.english: We chose the hospital nearer home, even though the other one has a better reputation, because daily visits mattered more to my father than a famous name.
records.zomi: A dang khat in min hoih zaw a neih hangin inn tawh a nai zaw damdawi inn i teel uh hi, ka pa adingin ni simin veh in min thang sangin a thupi zaw ahih manin.

records.english: Weren't you worried about letting your daughter travel alone to see her cousins?
records.zomi: Na tanu a sanggamte veh dingin amah kia khualzin dingin na phal ciangin na lungkham kei hiam?

records.english: She's sixteen, she knows the route, and her cousins were waiting at the other end.
records.zomi: Kum sawm leh guk a cing a, lampi a thei a, a sanggamte a dang lam ah a ngak uh hi.

records.english: The decision to sell my mother's piano was made only after everyone in the family had been asked.
records.zomi: Ka nu' piano zuak ding thukhenna innkuan sung-a mi khempeuh kidot khit ciang bek-in kibawl hi.

records.english: Some families decide together, while in others the eldest person still has the final say.
records.zomi: Innkuan pawl khat khawmin a khensat uh a, a dangte ah mi upa pen in thu nunung a nei lai hi.

records.english: We chose my sister as our son's godmother because she's always been there for us.
records.zomi: Ka u numei eite adingin a om tawntung ahih manin i tapa' pasian nu dingin i teel uh hi.

records.english: Why aren't we going to Grandma's for the holidays this year?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tu kum tawlngakni ah Pi kiangah i pai kei ding uh hiam?

records.english: Grandma is going to visit Uncle Thomas abroad, so we'll have a quiet holiday at home.
records.zomi: Pi in gamdang ah Pa neu Thomas a veh ding ahih manin inn ah tawlngakni dai khat i nei ding hi.

records.english: I've decided to give up smoking for my children's sake.
records.zomi: Ka tate hangin meizial dawn ka khawl dingin ka khensat hi.

records.english: My husband and I decided to take turns cooking dinner every other night.
records.zomi: Ka pasal leh kei nitak an zan khat zawh khat kikheel-in huan dingin i khensat hi.

records.english: We won't buy the children phones until they start secondary school.
records.zomi: Sang lai lian a kipat ma-un naupangte phone i lei sak kei ding uh hi.

records.english: We decided to adopt an older dog from the shelter, so that it would have a home for its last years.
records.zomi: Ui upa khat in a kum nunungte ah inn a neih nadingin khawina mun pan i la dingin i khensat uh hi.

records.english: When I told my family I was retiring early, I explained that my health mattered more than the extra money.
records.zomi: Ka innkuan kiangah hun ma-in ka nasep ka tawp ding hi, ka gen ciangin ka damna sum behlap sangin a thupi zaw hi, ci-in ka genteh hi.

records.english: My parents explained that they were giving the farm to my younger brother, since he was the only one who wanted to farm it.
records.zomi: Lo a kho nuam amah bek ahih manin ka nau pasal kiangah lo a pia ding uh hi, ci-in ka nu leh ka pa in a genteh uh hi.

records.english: Why did you decide to sell the family house?
records.zomi: Bang hangin innkuan inn zuak dingin na khensat hiam?

records.english: It was too big for Mum on her own, and the stairs had become dangerous for her.
records.zomi: Nu amah kia adingin a lian lua a, kahlei in amah adingin a lauhuai ta hi.

records.english: We decided that Grandpa would move in with us, because he shouldn't be alone after his fall.
records.zomi: Pu a kiak khit ciangin amah kia a om loh ding ahih manin eite tawh hong teeng ding hi, ci-in i khensat uh hi.

records.english: I decided to take my children out of the football club after the coach shouted at them.
records.zomi: Coach in ka tate tungah a kikou khit ciangin bawlung kimawlna pawl pan ka la khia hi.

records.english: Why have you chosen to stay at home with the baby instead of going back to work?
records.zomi: Bang hangin nasep ah ciah kik sangin naungek tawh inn ah om dingin na teel hiam?

records.english: We added up the cost of childcare, and it was almost the same as my salary.
records.zomi: Naupang kemna man i kituah uh a, ka khasum tawh kibang dek hi.

records.english: Would you like to hear why we made this decision before you judge it?
records.zomi: Na thukhen ma-in bang hangin hih thukhenna i bawl uh hiam na zak nuam hiam?

records.english: Calmly giving your reasons is often more persuasive than repeating your decision louder.
records.zomi: Daitak-a na hangte gen in na thukhenna aw ngaih zaw-a gen kik den sangin a lungsim kheel thei zaw zel hi.

records.english: Why are you moving back to your home town?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na khua ah na ciah kik hiam?

records.english: My parents are getting older, and I'd like to be near them.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa a upa semsem uh a, amaute kiang-a om ka deih hi.

records.english: Why did you decide to have the operation now?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tu-in zatui dingin na khensat hiam?

records.english: The pain was getting worse, and I didn't want to miss my grandson's wedding next year.
records.zomi: Natna a gik semsem a, kum zom-a ka tupa' mopawi ka tel loh ding ka deih kei hi.

records.english: I'm sorry, but we've decided that you can't go to the concert on a school night.
records.zomi: Hong maisak in, ahi zongin sang zan ah la kikhopna ah na pai thei kei ding hi, ci-in i khensat uh hi.

records.english: We can't afford the trip this year, and our son needs to understand that.
records.zomi: Tu kum khualzinna man i pia zo kei uh a, i tapa in tua a theih kisam hi.

records.english: Our family decided to give money to the school instead of buying birthday presents this year.
records.zomi: Tu kum i innkuan in pianni letsong lei sangin sang ah sum pia dingin i khensat uh hi.

records.english: Explaining a divorce to young children requires honesty, simple words and a lot of reassurance.
records.zomi: Naupang neute kiangah kikhenna genteh dingin thudik, kammal baih leh hehnepna tampi a kisam hi.

records.english: For my fiftieth birthday, I just want dinner with the family.
records.zomi: Ka kum sawmnga pianni adingin innkuan tawh nitak an bek ka deih hi.

records.english: My parents explained that they were separating, but that nothing would change in how much they loved us.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in a kikhen ding uh hi, ahi zongin eite a it dan uh ah bangmah kikheel lo ding hi, ci-in a genteh uh hi.

records.english: Why have you decided to learn your grandparents' language now?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tu-in na pu leh pi' pau sin dingin na khensat hiam?

records.english: I want to be able to talk to them properly before it's too late.
records.zomi: A hun a nunung lua ma-in amaute tawh hoih takin ka kihopih theih ka deih hi.

records.english: We read the letter from the school together, because my parents find the formal language confusing.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in pau kizahtak a buaihuai sa uh ahih manin sang pan lai khawmin i sim uh hi.

records.english: My daughter keeps a notebook of new words from the books she reads.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in a sim laibu te pan kammal thakte lai neu khat ah a gelh hi.

records.english: The twins read the same book but understood the main character in completely different ways.
records.zomi: Apengte in laibu kibang a sim uh a, ahi zongin a lian pen mi tuamtuam-in a thei uh hi.

records.english: Can you explain to me what this form from the bank is asking for?
records.zomi: Bank pan hih form in bang a ngen hiam hong genteh thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: The bedtime story was so exciting that nobody wanted to go to sleep.
records.zomi: Ihmut ma-a tangthu a lungphamuan mahmah ahih manin kuamah ihmut a nuam kei uh hi.

records.english: My son understood the story about a village without electricity far better after Grandma told him about her own childhood.
records.zomi: Pi in amah' naupan lai thu a gen khit ciangin ka tapa in meivaak om lo khua tungtang tangthu a thei zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: Children often understand a story's feelings long before they can explain them in words.
records.zomi: Naupangte in kammal tawh a genteh theih ma-un tangthu khat' lungsim thute a thei masa zel uh hi.

records.english: Do you remember the first book you ever read on your own?
records.zomi: Nangmah kia-in na sim masa pen laibu na phawk hiam?

records.english: Parents can help children understand stories simply by asking what they think will happen next.
records.zomi: Nu leh pate in a zom ah bang a piang ding na ci hiam ci-in dot bek tawh naupangte tangthu a theih nadingin a huh thei uh hi.

records.english: Shall we read the next chapter together tonight?
records.zomi: Tu zanin a zom chapter khawmin i sim ding hiam?

records.english: Ask your father to explain that part, since he's the one who chose the book.
records.zomi: Laibu a teel amah ahih manin tua mun genteh dingin na pa ngen in.

records.english: My son asked why the writer never said whether the dog came back, and we talked about it for an hour.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in bang hangin laigelhpa in ui a ciah kik hiam cih a gen ngei kei hiam a dong a, nai khat sung i kihopih uh hi.

records.english: Please don't tell me how the book ends; I've only read half of it.
records.zomi: Laibu bangci a bei hiam hong gen kei in; a langkhat bek ka sim nai hi.

records.english: Reading the same story in two languages helped my son understand it better in both.
records.zomi: Tangthu kibang pau nih-a sim in ka tapa in pau nih ah a theih zawk nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Who in your family reads the most?
records.zomi: Na innkuan ah kua in a sim tam pen hiam?

records.english: Do you read with your children before they go to sleep?
records.zomi: Na tate a ihmut ma-un amaute tawh na sim hiam?

records.english: Thank you for reading with my son every week while I was in hospital.
records.zomi: Damdawi inn ka om laitakin kal simin ka tapa tawh na sim manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Children who talk about books at home learn to notice things that aren't written directly.
records.zomi: Inn ah laibu thu a kihopih naupangte in a tang-a kigelh lo thute muh a sin uh hi.

records.english: When I was a child, my aunt gave me a book every birthday and asked me about it the next time she visited.
records.zomi: Ka neu lai-in ka ni in pianni simin laibu khat hong pia a, a veh zom vei ciangin a tungtang hong dong hi.

records.english: Mum, what does the writer mean when he says the house was holding its breath?
records.zomi: Nu aw, inn in a hu a hal hi, a ci ciangin laigelhpa in bang a ci nopna hiam?

records.english: When parents admit that they don't understand something in a text, children learn that asking questions is normal.
records.zomi: Nu leh pate in lai sung thu khat a theih loh uh a pom uh ciangin naupangte in dotna dot pen a ngeina ahi hi, ci a sin uh hi.

records.english: My mother asks me three questions about every chapter I read, just to check that I've understood it.
records.zomi: Ka theih hiam en dingin ka sim chapter khempeuh tungtang ka nu in dotna thum hong dong hi.

records.english: Every evening, my father and I take turns reading a page of the book aloud.
records.zomi: Nitak simin ka pa leh kei laibu phek khat aw ngaih takin a kizui-in i sim hi.

records.english: The book was so sad that my mother and I both cried at the same page.
records.zomi: Laibu a lungkhamhuai mahmah ahih manin ka nu leh kei phek kibang ah i kap hi.

records.english: Did you understand why the girl in the story ran away from home?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tangthu sung-a numei naupang inn pan a tai hiam na thei hiam?

records.english: We read the holiday brochure together and found a mistake in the prices.
records.zomi: Tawlngakni brochure khawmin i sim uh a, man ah khialhna khat i mu hi.

records.english: Talking about a story while you read it is one of the simplest ways to deepen understanding.
records.zomi: Na sim laitakin tangthu tungtang kihopih pen theihna thuk zaw-a ngah nading baih pen khat ahi hi.

records.english: On long car journeys, our family listens to recorded stories and then argues cheerfully over lunch about what the characters should have done.
records.zomi: Mawtaw-a khualzin sau ciangin i innkuan in tangthu kila te i ngaikhia a, tua khit ciangin sun an ne laitakin tangthu sung-a mite in bang a bawl ding uh hiam nuam takin i kinial uh hi.

records.english: My parents and I read the same novel and talked about it every Sunday, like a little family book club.
records.zomi: Innkuan laibu pawl neu khat bangin ka nu leh ka pa leh kei tangthu laibu kibang i sim a, Nipini simin i kihopih hi.

records.english: You need to read the questions first, so you know what to look for in the text.
records.zomi: Lai sung ah bang zong ding hiam na theih nadingin dotnate na sim masa kisam hi.

records.english: Reading the family's old letters helped me understand why my grandparents had left their village.
records.zomi: Innkuan' lai luite sim in bang hangin ka pu leh pi in a khua uh a nusia uh hiam ka theih nadingin hong huh hi.

records.english: My parents didn't go to school for long, but they always asked me to explain what I was reading.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa sang ah sawtpi a kah kei uh a, ahi zongin ka sim thute genteh dingin hong ngen tawntung uh hi.

records.english: My sister and I argued about whether the ending of the book was happy or sad.
records.zomi: Laibu' tawpna a nuam hiam a lungkham hiam ka u numei leh kei i kinial hi.

records.english: I read the same chapter three times before I understood why the brothers stopped speaking.
records.zomi: Bang hangin sanggam pasalte kihopih nawn lo uh hiam ka theih ma-in chapter kibang vei thum ka sim hi.

records.english: At the dinner table, my father likes to ask us what the newspaper article really meant, not just what it said.
records.zomi: An ne dawhkan ah ka pa in thuthak lai sung-a thu bang a ci bek hi lo-in bang a ci nopna taktak hiam hong dong nuam hi.

records.english: Read the letter from your uncle out loud, so that everyone can hear it.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh in a zak theih nadingin na pa neu' lai aw ngaih takin sim in.

records.english: My father reads the news to my grandmother every morning, because her eyesight is poor.
records.zomi: Ka pi' mit a hoih lo ahih manin ka pa in zingsang simin thuthak a sim sak hi.

records.english: Please read the medicine label to me again, slowly.
records.zomi: Damdawi tung-a lai hong sim kik in, nuam takin.

records.english: Some parents worry when their children only read comics, but understanding a comic still takes real skill.
records.zomi: Nu leh pa pawl khat in a tate in comic bek a sim uh ciangin a lungkham uh a, ahi zongin comic khat theih in zong siamna taktak a kisam hi.

records.english: Can you help me with this reading question?
records.zomi: Hih simna dotna ah hong huh thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Read the paragraph again, and look for the sentence that gives the reason.
records.zomi: Paragraph sim kik inla, a hang a pia kammal zong in.

records.english: Turn off the television and read for twenty minutes before dinner.
records.zomi: Television phel inla nitak an ma-in minit sawmnih sim in.

records.english: My son reads remarkably fast, but he often races past the moments when the characters' feelings change, so we slow down and talk about them.
records.zomi: Ka tapa manlang mahmah-in a sim a, ahi zongin tangthu sung-a mite' lungsim a kikheelna munte a kantan pah zel ahih manin nuam takin i sim-in i kihopih uh hi.

records.english: What was the story about?
records.zomi: Tangthu in bang tungtang hiam?

records.english: A boy who finds a lost dog and has to decide whether to give it back.
records.zomi: Ui mang khat a mu-a, a pia kik ding hiam a teel kul pasal naupang khat.

records.english: Why do you think the old man in the story gave away his house?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tangthu sung-a pasal upa in a inn a pia khia hiam na ci hiam?

records.english: Because he wanted his neighbours to have a place to gather after he was gone.
records.zomi: Amah a om nawn loh ciangin a innvengte in a kikhopna mun a neih nadingun a deih ahih manin.

records.english: Grandpa tells stories so well that we understand them better than the ones in books.
records.zomi: Pu in tangthu hoih mahmah-in a gen ahih manin laibu sung-a tangthute sangin i thei zaw uh hi.

records.english: When my daughter retells a story in her own words, I know she has really understood it.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in tangthu khat amah' kammal tawh a gen kik ciangin a thei taktak hi, ka thei hi.

records.english: Reading the recipe aloud with my son turned into a lesson in following instructions.
records.zomi: Ka tapa tawh an huan dan lai aw ngaih takin i sim ciangin thuhilhna zuih sinna ah a kikheel hi.

records.english: My grandfather can't read well, so I read his letters aloud and explain them to him.
records.zomi: Ka pu hoih takin lai a sim thei kei ahih manin a laite aw ngaih takin ka sim sak a, ka genteh hi.

records.english: I didn't realise how much my son understood until he explained the story to his grandmother in great detail.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in a pi kiangah tangthu kicing mahmah-in a genteh ma-in bangzah a theih hiam ka thei kei hi.

records.english: Reading aloud to a younger sibling can improve an older child's understanding as well.
records.zomi: Nau neu khat kiangah aw ngaih taka sim in naupang upa zaw khat' theihna zong a hoihsak thei hi.

records.english: A good question at bedtime can turn a simple story into a real conversation.
records.zomi: Ihmut ma-a dotna hoih khat in tangthu baih khat kihopihna taktak ah a kheel thei hi.

records.english: My son says he can't concentrate on reading when his sisters are watching television.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in a u numeite television a en uh ciangin simna ah a lungsim a koih zo kei hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Did you enjoy the book Grandpa gave you?
records.zomi: Pu' hong piak laibu na nuam sa hiam?

records.english: Yes, and I want to ask him why the ending was so sad.
records.zomi: Nuam ka sa hi, bang hangin a tawpna a lungkhamhuai mahmah hiam amah ka dong nuam hi.

records.english: My grandmother could read only a little, but she always listened carefully and asked the cleverest questions.
records.zomi: Ka pi tawmno bek a sim thei a, ahi zongin limtakin a ngaikhia tawntung a, dotna pil pente a dong hi.

records.english: My mother circles the hard words in the newspaper, and I help her understand them.
records.zomi: Ka nu in thuthak lai sung-a kammal haksate a kual a, a theih nadingin ka huh hi.

records.english: My little brother reads the same picture book every night, and he knows every word by heart.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal in zan simin lim laibu kibang a sim a, kammal khempeuh a phawk khin hi.

records.english: When a parent's residency is uncertain, children may feel that their whole future is uncertain too.
records.zomi: Nu hiam pa khat' teenna phalna a kician loh ciangin naupangte in amau' hun zom bup zong a kician lo bangin a kisa thei uh hi.

records.english: For a family with small children, a park and a playground can be a better choice than another museum.

records.english: My father insists that he takes his tablets every morning, but the box in the kitchen drawer is still almost full, which worries all of us.

records.english: Parents who ask for evidence calmly teach children that the truth matters more than winning an argument.

records.english: Families often repeat stories for generations without anyone asking where they came from.
records.zomi: Innkuante in koi pan hong pai hiam kuamah in dong lo-in khangthu tampi tangthu a gen kik den zel uh hi.

records.english: Do you have a photo of our great-grandmother, or is everything we know just stories?
records.zomi: I pi' nu lim khat na nei hiam, i theih khempeuh tangthu bek ahi hiam?

records.english: Whenever Grandpa tells his old stories about the war, my cousin politely asks for dates and places, which Grandpa pretends not to hear.

records.english: Who said you could have a sleepover on Friday?
records.zomi: Laithai ni-in lawm inn ah na giak thei hi, kua in a ci hiam?

records.english: Have you really brushed your teeth?

records.english: Yes, and you can feel that my toothbrush is still wet.

records.english: My daughter showed me her bus ticket to prove she had gone straight home after school.

records.english: My mother says she can tell when I'm lying, but she has never explained how.
records.zomi: Ka zuau ciangin ka nu in a thei thei hi, a ci a, ahi zongin bangci-in hiam a genteh ngei kei hi.

records.english: My grandfather kept every receipt for forty years, so we could always check what he had paid for.
records.zomi: Ka pu in kum sawmli sung man piakna lai khempeuh a kem ahih manin bang a man a pia hiam i en thei tawntung uh hi.

records.english: My son showed me the scratch on his knee as proof that he had fallen and not been fighting.

records.english: When grandparents speak a different language, grandchildren may lose words unless the family makes an effort to keep them.

records.english: Which word from today made you laugh?

records.english: Watching nature films together gave our family a whole new set of words for animals.

records.english: My daughter writes the new words she learns from her cousins in a little notebook with a lock.

records.english: Dad said, "Whoever uses the new word correctly at dinner gets to choose dessert."

records.english: My toddler learns a new word almost every day, usually one I didn't want her to hear.

records.english: Children who are read to every night often surprise their parents with the words they know.
records.zomi: Zan simin kisim sak naupangte in a theih kammalte tawh a nu leh a pa uh lamdang a sak zel uh hi.

records.english: When my grandmother died, we wrote down all the old words she used, so that they wouldn't be lost.
records.zomi: Ka pi a sih ciangin a mang loh nadingin a zat kammal lui khempeuh i gelh uh hi.

records.english: Kids, no phones at dinner tonight; we're going to talk instead.

records.english: My son came home from his first day at a new school with words I had never heard him say.

records.english: My teenage daughter corrected my grandmother's vocabulary, and nobody spoke at dinner after that.

records.english: Do you know the names of all the trees in our garden?

records.english: The more a family talks together at meals, the wider the children's vocabulary tends to become.

records.english: Every family has a few words of its own that outsiders would never understand.

records.english: We bought a picture dictionary for our neighbours' children when they arrived from abroad.

records.english: I didn't know the names of half the things in the hardware shop until my uncle took me there.

records.english: Ask your mother what that word means; she studied law.

records.english: Public transport services must be planned for people without cars, not just for commuters.

records.english: Seats near the doors are reserved for passengers who are elderly, pregnant or disabled.
records.zomi: Kongkhak kiang-a tutnate mi upa, nau pai hiam pumpi haksatna nei khualzinte adingin kikoih hi.

records.english: The station has a quiet room for passengers who feel overwhelmed by crowds and noise.
records.zomi: Dinna ah mi tam leh aw ngaih in a buaisak khualzinte adingin daina khan khat a om hi.

records.english: Do the buses run on public holidays?
