records.english: The transport office answers questions about routes, fares and timetables from eight until six.
records.zomi: Khualzinna office in lampi, man leh hun ciamteh tungtang dotnate zingsang nai giat pan nitak nai guk dong a dawng hi.

records.english: Bicycles can be hired from stands near most stations.
records.zomi: Dinna a tamzaw kiang-a koihna te pan siiksakol na luah thei hi.

records.english: Could you send me a refund for the ticket I couldn't use because of the strike?
records.zomi: Nasep khawlna hangin ka zat zawh loh lai' man hong khak kik thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: The lost property office keeps items for a month before they are given to charity.
records.zomi: Van mang kemna office in charity kiangah a piak ma-un van te kha khat a kem hi.

records.english: When fares rise faster than wages, the people who depend most on buses are hit hardest.
records.zomi: Khualzin man in khasum sangin manlang zaw-a a khan ciangin bus tungah a kinga pen mite in a gik pen-in a thuak uh hi.

records.english: Everyone, please fill in the survey about the new timetable before the end of the month.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, kha tawp ma-in hun ciamteh thak tungtang survey dim un.

records.english: Can I book help at the station if I use a wheelchair?
records.zomi: Wheelchair ka zat leh dinna ah huhna ka lai thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, call the assistance line a day before, and a member of staff will meet you at the entrance.
records.zomi: Thei hi, ni khat ma-in huhna phone sam in, nasem khat in lutna ah hong muak ding hi.

records.english: The operator offered free travel for a week to thank passengers for their patience during the repairs.
records.zomi: Bawlkikna sungin a thuakzawhna uh adingin lungdam a gen nadingin bus company in kal khat sung man om lo khualzinna a pia hi.

records.english: The ferry service is free for islanders who need to reach the mainland hospital.
records.zomi: Gam lian lam damdawi inn a tun kisam tuikulh mite adingin tembaw nasep man om lo hi.

records.english: Good transport services allow older people to stay independent for longer.
records.zomi: Khualzinna nasep hoih in mi upate hun sawt zaw amau kia-a om theisak hi.

records.english: Children under five travel free on all the town's buses.
records.zomi: Kum nga nuai naupangte khuapi bus khempeuh ah man om lo-in khualzin uh hi.

records.english: Please don't eat hot food on the buses; it's against the operator's rules.
records.zomi: Bus tungah an lum ne kei un; bus company' thukham palsatna ahi hi.

records.english: Buses with low floors make life easier for parents with pushchairs and older passengers.
records.zomi: Lei tung niam bus te in naungek leeng tawi nu leh pate leh khualzin upate adingin nuntakna a baihsak zaw hi.

records.english: You might be able to get a refund if your train was more than an hour late.
records.zomi: Na meileng nai khat sang a sawt leh na man na la kik thei kha ding hi.

records.english: Large-print timetables are available at the library for anyone who needs them.
records.zomi: A kisam mi khempeuh adingin laibu inn ah lai lian-a kigelh hun ciamteh a om hi.

records.english: Discounted fares are available for students, pensioners and people looking for work.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, pension ngah mite leh nasep zong mite adingin man neem zaw a om hi.

records.english: Shall we write to the council asking for a bus shelter at our stop?
records.zomi: I bus khawlna ah guah khuhna khat ngen dingin khuapi office kiangah lai i gelh ding hiam?

records.english: The transport authority has added three late buses on Fridays for hospital and restaurant staff.
records.zomi: Khualzinna makaite in damdawi inn leh an zuakna inn nasemte adingin Laithai ni ah zan bus thum a behlap uh hi.

records.english: A good transport service listens to its passengers, not only to its accountants.
records.zomi: Khualzinna nasep hoih khat in a sum kemte bek hi lo-in a khualzinte' thu zong a ngaikhia hi.

records.english: Ticket inspectors may ask you to show proof of a discount, such as a student card.
records.zomi: Lai en nasemte in student card bang man neemna lakna na lak dingin hong ngen thei uh hi.

records.english: Is there a service that picks up older people from their homes?
records.zomi: Mi upate a inn uh pan a la nasep khat a om hiam?

records.english: The bus company sends text alerts to subscribers when routes are diverted.
records.zomi: Bus lampi a kikheel ciangin bus company in a kigelh mite kiangah text thuzaksak a khak hi.

records.english: Could the bus stop outside the clinic be moved closer to the entrance?
records.zomi: Clinic pua-a bus khawlna lutna tawh a nai zawk-in kisuan thei ding hiam?

records.english: Ask the driver for a printed receipt if you need it for your employer.
records.zomi: Na nasep piaktu adingin na kisam leh mawngpa kiangah man piakna lai kikhet ngen in.

records.english: On our city's buses, drivers are not allowed to refuse passengers with prams unless the bus is completely full.
records.zomi: I khuapi bus te ah bus a dim kim loh leh mawngte in naungek leeng tawi khualzinte nial theih kei uh hi.

records.english: The council uses passenger counts from the ticket machines to decide where new routes are needed.
records.zomi: Khuapi office in lampi thak koi ah kisam hiam khensat dingin lai seet pan khualzin simna a zang hi.

records.english: When a service is cancelled, the operator should tell passengers quickly and offer an alternative.
records.zomi: Nasep khat a kiphiat ciangin bus company in khualzinte kiangah manlang takin a gen-a lampi dang khat a pia ding hi.

records.english: In our region, smoking is not permitted on any bus, train or ferry.
records.zomi: I gamkhen ah bus, meileng hiam tembaw khatpeuh tungah meizial dawn kiphal lo hi.

records.english: Are guide dogs allowed on the trams?
records.zomi: Tram tungah lampi lakna ui te kiphal hiam?

records.english: A regular, frequent service often attracts more passengers than a cheap but unreliable one.
records.zomi: A kip leh a tamvei pai nasep khat in man neem a muanhuai lo khat sangin khualzin tam zaw a lak zel hi.

records.english: Information screens at the stops show how many minutes until the next bus arrives.
records.zomi: Khawlna mun-a thuhilhna screen te in a zom bus a tun dong minit bangzah a om hiam a lak hi.

records.english: You can pay with a phone or a bank card on every bus in the city.
records.zomi: Khuapi-a bus khempeuh ah phone hiam bank card tawh na pia thei hi.

records.english: Is there a phone number I can call to check whether the trains are running?
records.zomi: Meileng a kalsuan hiam en dingin ka sam theih phone nambat khat a om hiam?

records.english: The park-and-ride car park lets drivers leave their cars outside town and take a bus to the centre.
records.zomi: Koih-in tuang mawtaw koihna mun in mawtaw mawngte' mawtaw khuapi pua ah koih-in lailung lam ah bus tuang dingin a phal hi.

records.english: Public transport services in some areas are run by private companies under contract to the council.
records.zomi: Mun pawl khat ah mipi khualzinna nasepte khuapi office tawh kiciamna nei company tuamte in a sem uh hi.

records.english: On Saturdays the night buses run every half hour, which has made it much easier for young people to get home safely after midnight.
records.zomi: Kiginni ah zan bus te nai langkhat simin a pai uh a, tua in khangnote zan lai khit ciangin bit takin inn a tun theih nadingin a baihsak mahmah hi.

records.english: Passenger groups were invited to help design the new bus stops.
records.zomi: Bus khawlna thakte a bawl nadingin khualzin pawlte huh dingin kisam uh hi.

records.english: The council runs a free shuttle between the train station and the hospital.
records.zomi: Khuapi office in meileng dinna leh damdawi inn kikal-ah man om lo bus a mawngsak hi.

records.english: A reliable bus service can decide whether people in outlying villages can keep their jobs.
records.zomi: Bus nasep muanhuai khat in khua gamla-a mite in a nasep uh a kem thei ding uh hiam a khensat thei hi.

records.english: Volunteers at the bus station help people who can't read the signs or the screens.
records.zomi: Bus dinna-a deihsakna nasemte in ciamtehnate hiam screen te a sim zo lo mite a huh uh hi.

records.english: Free travel for carers means they can accompany disabled passengers at no extra cost.
records.zomi: Kemte adingin man om lo khualzinna in pumpi haksatna nei khualzinte man behlap om lo-in a zui thei uh cihna hi.

records.english: The new app shows the location of every bus on a map in real time.
records.zomi: App thak in bus khempeuh' omna map tungah a hun taktak-in a lak hi.

records.english: The council is consulting residents on whether to extend the tram line to the university.
records.zomi: Khuapi office in tram lampi sangpi dong a sawnsak ding hiam teeng mite a dong hi.

records.english: A shared celebration can bring together people who would otherwise never meet.
records.zomi: Kipahna kihawm khat in a kimu ngei lo ding mite a kikhawmsak thei hi.

records.english: The money raised at the festival will be used to repair the community hall.
records.zomi: Pawi ah kikaikhawm sum mipi inn bawlphat nadingin kizang ding hi.

records.english: The choir sang songs from five different countries at the multicultural evening.
records.zomi: Ngeina tuamtuam nitak kikhopna ah la sa pawl in gam nga pan late a sa uh hi.

records.english: The festival might move to a bigger park next year if it keeps growing.
records.zomi: Pawi a khang den leh kum zom ciangin huan lian zaw khat ah a suan kha ding hi.

records.english: Behind every festival there are months of planning by people who rarely get thanked.
records.zomi: Pawi khempeuh' nung ah lungdam kigen tawm mite' kha tampi gelna a om hi.

records.english: The streets were closed to traffic so that the procession could pass.
records.zomi: Pai khawmna a kantan theih nadingin lampite mawtaw adingin kikhak hi.

records.english: Who's going to help clean the square after the festival?
records.zomi: Pawi khit ciangin mun siangsak dingin kua in a huh ding hiam?

records.english: New arrivals sometimes feel homesick during their own festivals, especially when they celebrate them far from family.
records.zomi: Hong tung thakte in a diak in innkuan pan gamla taka a lawp uh ciangin amau' pawi hun sungin inn a ngaih zel uh hi.

records.english: The organisers had the stage moved closer to the river so that more people could see the dancers.
records.zomi: Lamte mi tam zaw in a muh theih nadingin makaite in lamna mun lui tawh a nai zaw ah a suansak uh hi.

records.english: How long did the drummers practise before the parade?
records.zomi: Pai khawmna ma-in khuang tumte bangzah sawt a sin uh hiam?

records.english: Shall we take the children to see the dragon dance this afternoon?
records.zomi: Tu nitak lam naupangte dragon lam en dingin i paipih ding hiam?

records.english: Some families travel for days to be home for the most important celebration of the year.
records.zomi: Innkuan pawl khat in kum sung-a kipahna thupi pen adingin inn a tun nadingun ni tampi a khualzin uh hi.

records.english: The parade route was decorated with flowers grown by the town's gardeners.
records.zomi: Pai khawmna lampi khuapi huan kemte' suan pakte tawh kizeek hi.

records.english: Our community centre hosts a different cultural celebration almost every month.
records.zomi: I mipi inn in kha simin ngeina kipahna tuamtuam khat a bawl dek hi.

records.english: The school invited parents to bring a dish from their home culture for the international lunch.
records.zomi: Sang in gam tuamtuam sun an adingin nu leh pate amau' ngeina an khat tawi dingin a sam hi.

records.english: The celebration ended with a long table in the street, where everyone shared food.
records.zomi: Kipahna lampi sungah dawhkan sau khat tawh a bei a, tua ah mi khempeuh an a kihawm uh hi.

records.english: What do people usually eat at the New Year celebration here?
records.zomi: Hih ah Kum Thak kipahna ah mite in bang a ne zel uh hiam?

records.english: Sticky rice cakes, roast pork and plenty of fruit, because they're meant to bring a good year.
records.zomi: Kum hoih hong tunsak ding a kici ahih manin buh moh, vok sa kang leh singgah tampi.

records.english: Please don't throw rubbish in the river during the lantern festival.
records.zomi: Meivaak bawm pawi sungin lui sungah eek pai kei un.

records.english: The organisers made every stallholder sign an agreement to keep noise down after ten.
records.zomi: Makaite in van zuakna mun neite khempeuh nai sawm khit ciangin aw a niamsak ding kituakna khat ah min a khetsak uh hi.

records.english: We used bamboo poles and strong string to hang the decorations across the street.
records.zomi: Lampi tung-a kizeekna te bulh dingin gua khuamte leh khau hat i zang uh hi.

records.english: Everyone, please wear something colourful to the festival on Saturday.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, Kiginni-a pawi ah rong tampi nei puan silh un.

records.english: Each celebration has its own customs, and visitors are wise to ask before taking photos.
records.zomi: Kipahna khempeuh in amau' ngeina a nei a, mikhualte in lim a lak ma-un dot a pil hi.

records.english: Who is organising the music for the community celebration this year?
records.zomi: Tu kum mipi kipahna adingin la kua in a makaih hiam?

records.english: We stayed up until well past midnight to watch the lights drift down the river, and the children fell asleep on the way home.
records.zomi: Lui tungah meivaakte a luan dan en dingin zan lai khit dong i ihmu kei uh a, naupangte inn ciahna lampi ah a ihmu uh hi.

records.english: My son was chosen to carry the flag at the front of the parade.
records.zomi: Ka tapa pai khawmna' mai lam ah flag pua dingin kiteel hi.

records.english: In our town, fireworks are not allowed near the old wooden houses during the festival.
records.zomi: I khuapi ah pawi sungin sing inn luite kiangah fireworks kiphal lo hi.

records.english: Tell your friends that everyone is welcome at the celebration, not just people from our community.
records.zomi: I mipi bek hi lo-in mi khempeuh kipahna ah kimuak hi, ci-in na lawmte gen in.

records.english: Can visitors join the dancing at the festival?
records.zomi: Mikhualte pawi-a lamna ah a kihel thei uh hiam?

records.english: Yes, and the older dancers love teaching newcomers the steps.
records.zomi: Thei uh hi, lam siam upate in hong tung thakte lam dan sinsak a nuam sa mahmah uh hi.

records.english: Next year, we're going to help organise the harvest festival ourselves.
records.zomi: Kum zom ciangin Khuado pawi eite mah in makaih dingin i huh ding hi.

records.english: When a celebration grows very popular, some people worry that it is losing its original meaning.
records.zomi: Kipahna khat mi tampi in a deih mahmah ciangin mi pawl khat in a khiatna masa a mangsak hi, ci-in a lungkham uh hi.

records.english: What time does the procession start tomorrow?
records.zomi: Zingciang pai khawmna bang hun-in a kipan ding hiam?

records.english: The children made paper lanterns at school for the evening procession.
records.zomi: Nitak pai khawmna adingin naupangte in sang ah lai tawh meivaak bawm a bawl uh hi.

records.english: Every year, the oldest resident lights the first lamp at the festival of lights.
records.zomi: Kum simin meivaak pawi ah a upa pen teeng mi in meivaak masa pen a tawisak hi.

records.english: Celebrating someone else's festival with respect can be the beginning of a real friendship.
records.zomi: Mi dang' pawi zahtak taka lawp in lawmta taktak kipatna a hi thei hi.

records.english: The mayor said, "This festival belongs to everyone who lives in our town, whatever their background."
records.zomi: Khuapi makaipa in, “Hih pawi pen i khuapi-a teeng mi khempeuh' a hi a, koi pan hong pai uh hi zongin,” a ci hi.

records.english: Respecting the quiet parts of a festival, such as prayers or moments of silence, matters as much as joining the fun.
records.zomi: Thungetna hiam daina hun bang pawi' dai munte zahtak in a nuam munte-a kihel tawh kibang-in a thupi hi.

records.english: Can we bring our own food to the festival, or do we have to buy it there?
records.zomi: Pawi ah eimau' an i tawi thei ding uh hiam, tua ah i lei kul ding uh hiam?

records.english: Children, stay with your group during the parade, because the crowds will be huge.
records.zomi: Naupangte, mi a tam mahmah ding ahih manin pai khawmna sungin na pawlte uh tawh om un.

records.english: Some celebrations mark the seasons, while others remember important events in a community's history.
records.zomi: Kipahna pawl khat in hun khenna a ciamteh a, a dangte in mipi khat' tangthu-a thupiang thupite a phawk hi.

records.english: Our town holds a harvest festival every autumn in the main square.
records.zomi: I khuapi in kum simin a lailung mun ah Khuado pawi a bawl hi.

records.english: You need a ticket for the concert, but the street celebration is free.
records.zomi: La kikhopna adingin lai na kisam a, ahi zongin lampi kipahna man om lo hi.

records.english: The festival committee asked the local bakers to make a giant cake for the anniversary.
records.zomi: Pawi makaipawl in kum cinna adingin mun-a moh bawlte cake lianpi khat bawl dingin a ngen uh hi.

records.english: When the music started, even the shy guests got up to dance.
records.zomi: La a kipat ciangin mikhual zumte zong lam dingin a thou uh hi.

records.english: Celebrations are remembered not for their size but for the warmth people feel when they share them.
records.zomi: Kipahnate a lianna hangin hi lo-in a kihawm uh ciangin mite' kisak lumna hangin kiphawk hi.

records.english: Food stalls from a dozen countries lined the street during the culture fair.
records.zomi: Ngeina zuakna kipahna sungin gam sawm leh nih pan an zuakna munte lampi ah a kituat hi.

records.english: My neighbours invited us to their family's spring festival, and we were treated like relatives.
records.zomi: Ka innvengte in a innkuan uh' spring pawi ah hong sam uh a, sanggam bangin hong bawl uh hi.

records.english: Where can I find a calendar of this year's festivals?
records.zomi: Tu kum pawite' calendar koi ah ka mu thei ding hiam?

records.english: Did they really cook enough soup for five hundred people?
records.zomi: Mi za nga adingin an tui kicing a huan taktak uh hiam?

records.english: It might rain on the day of the parade, so the organisers have prepared a covered stage.
records.zomi: Pai khawmna ni-in guah a zu kha ding ahih manin makaite in a khuh nei lamna mun khat a kiginkholh uh hi.

records.english: We brought folding chairs so that Grandpa could sit and watch the procession.
records.zomi: Pu in a tut-in pai khawmna a en theih nadingin tutphah kituap thei i tawi uh hi.

records.english: Cultural celebrations give people a chance to share their traditions with neighbours from different backgrounds.
records.zomi: Ngeina kipahnate in mite' ngeinate innveng tuamtuamte tawh a kihawm nading hun a pia hi.

records.english: Celebrations that once belonged to a single village are now enjoyed by people from all over the region.
records.zomi: Khua khat bek' hi ngei kipahnate tu-in gamkhen bup pan mite in a nuam sa uh hi.

records.english: As the sun went down, hundreds of candles were lit along the riverbank, and for a few minutes the whole crowd fell silent.
records.zomi: Ni a tum ciangin lui gei ah khawimeivaak za tampi kitawisak a, minit tawmno sung mipi bup a dai hi.

records.english: Cultural celebrations can be a good way for schools to teach children about their classmates' families.
records.zomi: Ngeina kipahnate in sangte adingin naupangte a sangkhan lawmte' innkuan tungtang a sinsak nading hoih khat a hi thei hi.

records.english: Did you see the fireworks over the bay last night?
records.zomi: Zan in tuipi khuk tungah fireworks na mu hiam?

records.english: At the festival, the young people wore traditional dress for the opening and changed into jeans for the concert.
records.zomi: Pawi ah khangnote in a kipatna adingin ngeina puan a silh uh a, la kikhopna adingin jeans ah a kheel uh hi.

records.english: Is the festival suitable for small children?
records.zomi: Pawi pen naupang neute adingin a kilawm hiam?

records.english: The dancers wore bells on their ankles, so the whole square rang with every step.
records.zomi: Lamte in a khe dawng ah khawl neute a bulh uh ahih manin a khehlap khempeuh tawh mun bup a ging hi.

records.english: Spending two nights in one place is far less tiring than one night each in three.
records.zomi: Mun khat ah zan nih om in mun thum ah zan khat ciat om sangin a gim tawm zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: When a hotel is fully booked, a nearby guesthouse may offer better value anyway.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk a dim ciangin a kiang-a zinbuuk neu khat in man hoih zaw a pia kha thei hi.

records.english: A room above the restaurant was cheaper, though we went to bed smelling of garlic.
records.zomi: An zuakna inn tung-a khan khat a man neem zaw a, ahi zongin tumtak gim tawh i ihmu uh hi.

records.english: A room on the ground floor is easier with luggage, but the top floor is usually quieter.
records.zomi: Lei tung khan in van tawh a baih zaw a, a tung pen khan a tamzaw-in a dai zaw hi.

records.english: The traditional inn had mats on the floor instead of beds, which my grandfather loved and my back hated.
records.zomi: Ngeina zinbuuk in lupna sangin lei tungah phah a nei a, tua pen ka pu in a it mahmah a, ka nung in a huat hi.

records.english: Shall I ask for a room away from the street?
records.zomi: Lampi tawh a gamla khan khat ka ngen ding hiam?

records.english: A room near the lift is convenient, but you hear the doors all night.
records.zomi: Lift kiang-a khan khat a baih a, ahi zongin zan bup kongkhakte na za hi.

records.english: Staying in a monastery guesthouse was cheaper than a hotel and far more peaceful.
records.zomi: Siampi inn-a zinbuuk neu ah giak in zinbuuk sangin a man neem zaw a, a dai zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: A room facing the courtyard is darker but much cooler in summer.
records.zomi: Inn lai huang lam ngat khan in a mial zaw a, ahi zongin khal ciangin a vot zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: Do you prefer a hotel that cleans every day or one that leaves you alone?
records.zomi: Ni simin a siangsak zinbuuk na deih zaw hiam, hong nusia zinbuuk na deih zaw hiam?

records.english: A hotel's location affects every day of a trip, while its decoration affects only the first impression.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk' omna mun in khualzinna ni khempeuh a lawh a, a kizeekna in a muh masa bek a lawh hi.

records.english: The cheaper hotel didn't include towels, so in the end it cost almost the same.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk man neem zaw ah puan nawtna om lo ahih manin a tawpna ah man kibang dek ahi hi.

records.english: My parents always ask for a room on a low floor, partly in case the lift breaks down and partly because my father simply doesn't trust lifts.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in lift a siat leh ci-in leh ka pa in lift a muan loh manin khan niam khat a ngen tawntung uh hi.

records.english: Free cancellation costs a little more, which is worth it when plans are uncertain.
records.zomi: Man om lo-a phiat theihna in man tam deuh a la a, gelna a kician loh ciangin a phu hi.

records.english: For a business trip, a reliable internet connection matters more than a nice view.
records.zomi: Sumbawlna khualzinna adingin internet muanhuai in muhnop hoih sangin a thupi zaw hi.

records.english: Children, choose which bed you want now, and no swapping in the middle of the night.
records.zomi: Naupangte, tu-in koi lupna na deih uh hiam teel un, zan lai ah kikheel lo ding hi.

records.english: Do you think the cheaper room without a bathroom would be a problem for your mother?
records.zomi: Kisilna inn om lo khan man neem zaw na nu adingin buaina a hi ding na ci hiam?

records.english: Is it better to have breakfast at the hotel or find a café nearby?
records.zomi: Zinbuuk ah zingsang an ne a hoih zaw hiam, a kiang-a cafe khat zong a hoih zaw hiam?

records.english: Try a café, because the hotel breakfast costs nearly twice as much.
records.zomi: Cafe khat en in, zinbuuk zingsang an man a nih dek a pha hi.

records.english: Do you prefer a big chain hotel or a small independent one?
records.zomi: Zinbuuk lian kizom khat na deih zaw hiam, zinbuuk neu amah kia khat na deih zaw hiam?

records.english: Should we pay extra for a sea view?
records.zomi: Tuipi muhna adingin sum behlap i pia ding hiam?

records.english: Only if we'll actually be in the room during the day.

records.english: A hotel with parking costs more, but it saves you walking across town with suitcases.
records.zomi: Mawtaw koihna nei zinbuuk in a man tam zaw a, ahi zongin van bawm tawh khuapi kantan-a kal pan hong hondoh hi.

records.english: We really did prefer the little family hotel to the big resort we tried the year before.

records.english: Do you two want a twin room or a double?
records.zomi: Na nih in lupna nih nei khan na deih uh hiam, lupna lian khat nei khan na deih uh hiam?

records.english: Choosing a hotel near a night market means great food but very little sleep.
records.zomi: Zan zuakna mun kiang-a zinbuuk teel in an hoih mahmah a, ihmut tawm mahmah cihna hi.

records.english: A star rating tells you about facilities, not about how kindly the staff will treat you.
records.zomi: Aksi ciamtehna in nasemte in bangzah hehpih takin hong bawl ding uh hiam hi lo-in a neih vante tungtang hong gen hi.

records.english: Some travellers choose accommodation by its breakfast, and they're not entirely wrong.
records.zomi: Khualzin mi pawl khat in a zingsang an hangin teenna mun a teel uh a, a khial vekpi kei uh hi.

records.english: Should I book the first night only and decide the rest when we see the place?
records.zomi: Zan masa bek ka lai-in a mun i muh ciangin a dang i khensat ding hiam?

records.english: For one night, the cheapest clean bed is usually good enough.
records.zomi: Zan khat adingin lupna siangtho man neem pen in a tamzaw-in a kicing hi.

records.english: I'd pay a little more for a room with a window that actually opens.
records.zomi: A kihong taktak tukkhuak nei khan adingin tawmno tam zaw ka pia ding hi.

records.english: Next time I'll choose a room with blackout curtains, since I couldn't sleep after sunrise.
records.zomi: Ni suak khit ciangin ka ihmu thei kei ahih manin a zom vei ciangin tukkhuak puan mial nei khan ka teel ding hi.

records.english: Whichever hotel you choose, check where the nearest pharmacy is.

records.english: Choosing between a cheap room far away and an expensive one nearby depends on the cost of getting around.

records.english: A fan is cheaper and quieter than air conditioning, but on the hottest, stickiest nights of the summer it does little more than move warm air around the room.

records.english: Is it worth joining the hotel's loyalty scheme if we only travel twice a year?

records.english: A treehouse sounded romantic until we realised the bathroom was across a field.
records.zomi: Sing tung inn pen kisilna inn lo kantan ah a om hi, i theih dong a nuamhuai bangin a kiza hi.

records.english: Would you rather stay somewhere ordinary in a wonderful location, or somewhere wonderful in an ordinary location?
records.zomi: Mun lamdang khat-a mun tavuan khat ah om na deih zaw hiam, mun tavuan khat-a mun lamdang khat ah om na deih zaw hiam?

records.english: When you're travelling for a hospital appointment, staying close to the hospital matters more than comfort.
records.zomi: Damdawi inn kimuhna adingin na khualzin ciangin nuamna sangin damdawi inn kiang-a om a thupi zaw hi.

records.english: Choosing a hotel with a pool kept the children happy every evening.
records.zomi: Tuipeekna nei zinbuuk teel in naupangte nitak simin a lungdamsak hi.

records.english: A quiet guesthouse suits a writer, whereas a lively hostel suits a young traveller looking for company.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk neu dai khat laigelhpa khat adingin a kilawm a, hostel nuam khat lawm zong khangno khualzin mi adingin a kilawm hi.

records.english: A family room is cheaper than two doubles, though nobody gets much sleep when the baby wakes up.
records.zomi: Innkuan khan khat lupna lian nei khan nih sangin a man neem zaw a, naungek a khanglawh ciangin kuamah hoih takin a ihmu kei uh hi.

records.english: We chose the hotel with a doctor on call, because my father's health is uncertain.
records.zomi: Ka pa' damna a kician loh ahih manin siavuan a ngak den zinbuuk i teel uh hi.

records.english: Breakfast in bed or breakfast in the garden?
records.zomi: Lupna tungah zingsang an hiam, huan sungah zingsang an hiam?

records.english: Outside under the trees, while the air is cool.
records.zomi: Huih a vot laitakin pua lam sing nuai ah.

records.english: A bed and breakfast feels personal, while a self-catering cottage gives you more freedom.
records.zomi: Zingsang an pia giakna inn in a kinai bangin a kisa a, amau-in an huan inn neu in zalenna tam zaw hong pia hi.

records.english: We chose the inn in the old town over the motel by the motorway, and it was worth the extra drive.
records.zomi: Mawtaw lampi lian kiang-a zinbuuk sangin khuapi lui-a zinbuuk i teel uh a, mawng behlap a phu hi.

records.english: Reviews from other guests can help, but a friend's honest advice is often more useful.
records.zomi: Mikhual dangte' gen dan in a huh thei a, ahi zongin lawm khat' thuhilhna dik in a phatuam zaw zel hi.

records.english: Hotels in the centre cost more, but you save hours of travelling every day.
records.zomi: Lailung-a zinbuukte a man tam zaw a, ahi zongin ni simin khualzin nai tampi na khol hi.

records.english: A hotel with a small kitchen saved us a fortune on meals during the long stay.
records.zomi: An huanna inn neu nei zinbuuk khat in om sawtna sungin an man tampi hong khol sak hi.

records.english: Which is better for a large family, a holiday flat or two hotel rooms next to each other?
records.zomi: Innkuan lian khat adingin koi in a hoih zaw hiam, tawlngakni inn hiam, a kiang kiang-a zinbuuk khan nih hiam?

records.english: Shall we stay near the airport the night before our early flight?
records.zomi: I vanleng zingsang tung ma-a zan ah vanlengtual kiangah i om ding hiam?

records.english: We let the children pick the hotel this year, and they chose the one with the water slide.
records.zomi: Tu kum naupangte zinbuuk i teelsak uh a, tui-a kitolhna nei pen a teel uh hi.

records.english: The boutique hotel was beautiful, but the beds were so hard that we moved after one night.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk neu kizeek pen a kilawm a, ahi zongin lupnate a khauh mahmah ahih manin zan khat khit ciangin i suan uh hi.

records.english: A hotel that lets you check in at noon can be worth more than a slightly cheaper one that makes you wait until four.
records.zomi: Sun lai ah lut theih zinbuuk khat in nai li dong hong ngaksak man neem deuh khat sangin a phu zaw thei hi.

records.english: Do we need a room with a cot, or will the baby sleep in the travel bed?
records.zomi: Naungek lupna nei khan i kisam ding hiam, naungek in khualzin lupna ah a ihmu ding hiam?

records.english: On our honeymoon we had to choose between a luxury hotel and a small farm stay.
records.zomi: I kiteen thak khualzinna ah zinbuuk lianpi leh lo-a giakna neu kikal-ah i teel kul uh hi.

records.english: We chose the farm, which had no television and only one shower.
records.zomi: Lo i teel uh a, television om lo a, kisilna khat bek a om hi.

records.english: Twenty years later, it's still the holiday we talk about most.
records.zomi: Kum sawmnih khit ciangin zong i gen tam pen tawlngakni ahi lai hi.

records.english: Double-check that the baby's car seat is fastened properly before you drive off.
records.zomi: Na mawng ma-in naungek' mawtaw tutna kician takin a kikhih hiam en kik in.

records.english: When I asked my son to confirm that his homework was done, he suddenly remembered a whole project.
records.zomi: Ka tapa a inn sinna a zo hiam ka dot ciangin nasep lianpi khat thakhatin a phawk hi.

records.english: Are you still okay to look after the dog this weekend?
records.zomi: Hih kal tawp ui na kem thei lai hiam?

records.english: Happily; the children have been counting the days.
records.zomi: Lungdam takin; naupangte in ni a sim khin uh hi.

records.english: Before the funeral, we confirmed the order of the readings with every member of the family.
records.zomi: Misi vuina ma-in innkuan mi khempeuh tawh sim ding thu sim ding dan i kiciamteh uh hi.

records.english: Am I right that the children have no school on Friday?
records.zomi: Laithai ni-in naupangte sang om lo hi, ka ci a dik hiam?

records.english: Yes, the teachers have a training day.
records.zomi: Dik hi, saya te sinna ni a nei uh hi.

records.english: Would it be wise to check with your parents before I book the restaurant, given how particular they are about food?
records.zomi: Na nu leh na pa an tungah a dot tam mahmah uh ahih manin an zuakna inn ka lai ma-in amaute dong a pil ding hiam?

records.english: My mother always repeats the time of a family gathering twice, and then writes it on the calendar anyway.
records.zomi: Ka nu in innkuan kikhopna hun nihvei a gen kik tawntung a, tua khit ciangin calendar tungah a gelh mah lai hi.

records.english: So the twins' birthday party starts at three, not two?
records.zomi: Tua ahih leh apengte' pianni kipahna nai thum ciangin a kipan ding, nai nih hi lo hiam?

records.english: Three, because a dance class has the hall until then.
records.zomi: Nai thum, tua hun dong lamna sinna pawl in inn a zang uh ahih manin.

records.english: Before every trip, my mother lines us up by the door and makes each of us hold up our passport, like soldiers at an inspection.
records.zomi: Khualzinna khempeuh ma-in ka nu in kongkhak kiangah hong tuatsak a, galkapte kisitna bangin passport khatciat hong liapsak hi.

records.english: Before the wedding, my aunt phoned every guest to confirm how many people were coming.
records.zomi: Mopawi ma-in ka ni in mikhual khempeuh a sam a, mi bangzah hong pai ding uh hiam a kiciamteh hi.

records.english: Did Grandpa really say he wants to move in with us?
records.zomi: Pu in eite tawh teeng dingin a deih hi, a ci taktak hiam?

records.english: He did, but he said it quietly, so let's not make a fuss yet.
records.zomi: A ci hi, ahi zongin daitak-in a gen ahih manin tu-in buaina bawl nai lo ni.

records.english: My aunt confirmed the date of the family reunion in a letter to every household.
records.zomi: Ka ni in innkuan kikhopna ni innkuan khempeuh kiangah lai tawh a kiciamteh hi.

records.english: So you'll stay with us until the end of the month?
records.zomi: Tua ahih leh kha tawp dong eite tawh na om ding hiam?

records.english: If that's still all right with you, until the twenty-eighth.
records.zomi: Na adingin a hoih lai leh, sawmnih leh giat ni dong.

records.english: My grandmother asked me three times whether I had really passed my driving test.
records.zomi: Ka pi in mawtaw mawng sitna ka zo taktak hiam vei thum hong dong hi.

records.english: Asking a teenager to confirm their plans for the evening is easier than worrying all night.
records.zomi: Tangval-tangnu khat kiangah a nitak gelnate kiciamteh dingin ngen in zan bup lungkham sangin a baih zaw hi.

records.english: You're sure the cousins are vegetarian?
records.zomi: Sanggamte sa ne lo uh hi, na ci kician hiam?

records.english: Quite sure, because their mother told me last week that the whole family stopped eating meat years ago.
records.zomi: A kician mahmah hi, a nu uh in innkuan bup kum tampi lai-in sa a ne nawn kei uh hi, ci-in kal nunung in hong gen hi.

records.english: Could you double-check that the oven is off and the windows are shut, because last time we were halfway to the airport before anyone remembered?
records.zomi: A vei nunung in vanlengtual lam a langkhat i pai khit ciangin kuamah in a phawk uh ahih manin oven a kiphel hiam, tukkhuakte a kikhak hiam hong en kik thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: You haven't told Mum about the broken window yet, have you?
records.zomi: Tukkhuak kitan thu Nu kiangah na gen nai kei hi maw?

records.english: Not yet, because I'd rather tell her myself once she's had a quiet cup of tea.
records.zomi: Gen nai kei hi, niangtui haai khat dai taka a dawn khit ciangin keimah mah in gen ka deih zaw ahih manin.

records.english: Is Uncle Thomas still coming for lunch on Sunday?

records.english: He rang this morning to say he'll bring dessert.
records.zomi: An khit-a ne ding hong tawi ding hi, ci-in tu zingsang in hong sam hi.

records.english: Did you say the baby is due in March?
records.zomi: Naungek March kha ah a suak ding hi, na ci hiam?

records.english: Early March, though the doctor says first babies are often late.
records.zomi: March kha kipat lam, ahi zongin siavuan in naungek masate a nung zel uh hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Is the spare key still under the flowerpot?
records.zomi: Tawh behlap pak bel nuai ah a om lai hiam?

records.english: No, we moved it to the neighbour's after the break-in.
records.zomi: Om nawn lo hi, guta in a lut khit ciangin innveng kiangah i koih uh hi.

records.english: The party is a surprise, so Dad doesn't know anything, does he?

records.english: Not a thing, unless your little brother has told him.
records.zomi: Bangmah thei lo hi, na nau pasal in a gen kei leh.

records.english: Is this your son's school bag or your daughter's?

records.zomi: Ka tanu' ahi hi, sticker nei pen amah ahih manin.

records.english: Is it Lia who's allergic to cats, or her sister?

records.zomi: A u leh nau numei, tua ahih manin a hong pai uh ciangin zawhngeu inn tung khan ah i kem ding hi.

records.english: So Grandma's train arrives at four on Tuesday, right?
records.zomi: Tua ahih leh Pi' meileng Pithai ni nai li ciangin a tung ding hi, maw?

records.english: Yes, and she'll be in the last carriage with two big bags.
records.zomi: Hi, ip lian nih tawh a nunung pen khan ah a om ding hi.

records.english: Let me just check that I've written your new address correctly in my book.
records.zomi: Na teenna mun thak ka laibu sungah a dik takin ka gelh hiam en kik ning.

records.english: So your brother's flight lands at midnight, and you're collecting him?
records.zomi: Tua ahih leh na sanggam pasal' vanleng zan lai ciangin a tung a, nang in na la ding hiam?

records.english: That's the plan, unless he finds a friend to drive him.
records.zomi: Tua bangin kigel hi, amah hong paipih ding lawm khat a muh kei leh.

records.english: You're picking the children up from school today, aren't you?
records.zomi: Tuni-in naupangte sang pan na la ding hi maw?

records.english: I am, although a meeting may keep me at work until half past three.
records.zomi: Ka la ding hi, kikhopna khat in nai thum leh a langkhat dong nasep ah hong khawlsak kha ding hi.

records.english: I phoned my sister to confirm the name of the hospital where our father had been taken.
records.zomi: I pa a kipaipihna damdawi inn' min kiciamteh dingin ka u numei ka sam hi.

records.english: I texted my daughter twice to confirm that she had arrived safely at her friend's house, and she replied only after I had started to panic.

records.english: In a busy family, a quick message confirming who is doing what can prevent a lot of arguments.

records.english: Confirming plans twice with elderly relatives is not fussy; it's simply kind.

records.english: Checking a relative's dates of birth for a form can turn into a long family argument about who was born first.

records.english: Just to be sure, your brother is allergic to peanuts, not to all nuts?

records.english: Is it the 12th or the 13th that your parents are celebrating their anniversary?

records.english: Yes, and never on an empty stomach.
records.zomi: Dik hi, gil awng tawh ne ngei lo hi.

records.english: My father said, "Text me when you arrive, so that I can stop pacing up and down the kitchen."
records.zomi: Ka pa in, “An huanna inn sungah ka kal vialvial khawl theih nadingin na tun ciangin text hong khak in,” a ci hi.

records.english: When my cousin confirmed that she would be godmother to our son, my wife cried with relief, because we had been afraid to ask.

records.english: When my parents moved house, I rang the doctor's surgery to confirm that their new address had been recorded.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa inn a suan uh ciangin a teenna mun thak uh kigelh hiam kiciamteh dingin siavuan' office ka sam hi.

records.english: Can you confirm that the wedding photos have been sent to everyone, including the relatives who don't use email?
records.zomi: Mopawi lim te email zang lo sanggamte kihel-in mi khempeuh kiangah kikhak khin hiam na kiciamteh thei ding hiam?

records.english: You did remember to buy the birthday cake, didn't you?
records.zomi: Pianni cake lei na phawk hi maw?

records.english: I really did, and it's hidden at the back of the fridge.
records.zomi: Ka phawk taktak a, fridge' nung lam ah ka sel hi.

records.english: The best sentence in my cousin's wedding speech was the one about his late father.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam' mopawi thugenna-a kammal hoih pen a pa a si khin tungtang ahi hi.

records.english: My son's teacher said, "Your mother clearly reads with you, because your sentences are wonderful."
records.zomi: Ka tapa' saya in, “Na nu in nang tawh a sim kician hi, na kammalte a hoih mahmah ahih manin,” a ci hi.

records.english: Write one sentence about your day for your grandfather, and we'll post it tomorrow.
records.zomi: Na pu adingin na ni tungtang kammal khat gelh inla, zingciang i khak ding hi.

records.english: My little brother writes his sentences backwards, starting with the ending.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal in a kammalte a nunglam pan a gelh a, a tawpna pan a kipan hi.

records.english: The children wrote sentences about their favourite family memories for the anniversary book.
records.zomi: Naupangte in kum cinna laibu adingin a it pen innkuan phawknate tungtang kammalte a gelh uh hi.

records.english: We helped my uncle write a clear letter of complaint to the electricity company.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu meivaak company kiangah phunna lai kician khat a gelh nadingin i huh uh hi.

records.english: Writing a short note to a relative is a good way for a child to practise clear sentences.
records.zomi: Sanggam khat kiangah lai tomno khat gelh in naupang khat adingin kammal kician sinna hoih khat ahi hi.

records.english: Can you check my sentences before I send this email to my landlord?
records.zomi: Ka inn neipa kiangah hih email ka khak ma-in ka kammalte hong en sak thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Dad, does this sentence sound polite enough for a letter to my teacher?
records.zomi: Pa aw, ka saya kiangah lai adingin hih kammal a zahtak kicing hiam?

records.english: Grandpa's postcards always end with the same sentence, and we all wait for it.
records.zomi: Pu' postcard te kammal kibang mah tawh a bei tawntung a, i khempeuh in i ngak uh hi.

records.english: A short handwritten sentence in a lunch box can brighten a child's whole day.
records.zomi: An bawm sungah khut tawh kigelh kammal tomno khat in naupang khat' ni bup a nuamsak thei hi.

records.english: My daughter reads every message aloud before she sends it, to check that it makes sense.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in a khak ma-in a khiatna a om hiam en dingin thu khempeuh aw ngaih takin a sim hi.

records.english: Did your son write that sentence all by himself?
records.zomi: Na tapa in tua kammal amah kia-in a gelh taktak hiam?

records.english: My sister writes such short, sharp sentences that her letters sound angry, even when she's happy.
records.zomi: Ka u numei in kammal tom leh hiam a gelh ahih manin a lungdam laitakin zong a laite a heh bangin a kiza hi.

records.english: Our little girl talks in long, breathless sentences that never seem to end.
records.zomi: I numei naupang neu in a bei ngei lo bang kammal sau, hu hal lo-in a gen hi.

records.english: Writing a sympathy card is hard, because every sentence seems either too much or too little.
records.zomi: Lungkhamna card gelh a haksa hi, kammal khempeuh a tam lua hiam a tawm lua hiam bangin a kilang hi.

records.english: When my father writes to the council, he asks me to make his sentences shorter.
records.zomi: Ka pa in khuapi office kiangah lai a gelh ciangin a kammalte tomsak dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: When my father lost his speech after the stroke, he slowly learned to write simple sentences again.
records.zomi: Lungsim natna khit ciangin ka pa a pau a mansuah ciangin nuam takin kammal baih gelh a sin kik hi.

records.english: Shall we help your brother finish his story before bedtime?

records.english: Practising writing with family members can make children less afraid of making mistakes.

records.english: Mum, would you look over my job application one more time?
records.zomi: Nu aw, ka nasep ngetna lai khatvei hong en kik thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: I wrote a sentence of apology to my sister, but I couldn't bring myself to send it.
records.zomi: Ka u numei kiangah maisakna ngetna kammal khat ka gelh a, ahi zongin ka khak zo kei hi.

records.english: My son wrote his first complete sentence on a birthday card for his grandfather.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in a pu adingin pianni card khat tungah a kammal kicing masa pen a gelh hi.

records.english: Can you help me write a sentence for Grandma's card?
records.zomi: Pi' card adingin kammal khat gelh dingin hong huh thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Start with something you remember doing together, and then say thank you.
records.zomi: Khawmin na bawl uh na phawk khat tawh kipan inla, tua khit ciangin lungdam gen in.

records.english: My sister corrected my sentence so many times that I stopped asking her for help.

records.english: Because I hadn't asked permission, I had to apologise to my aunt, who had already reported her bike stolen by the time I brought it back.

records.english: Would you mind if I invited my colleague's family to our anniversary dinner?
records.zomi: I kiteenna kum cinna nitak an ah ka nasep lawm' innkuan ka sam leh na lungkham ding hiam?

records.english: I'd be delighted, as long as you warn the restaurant.
records.zomi: Ka lungdam mahmah ding hi, an zuakna inn na vaihilh leh.

records.english: If you want to have friends over while we're out, you'll need to ask us first.
records.zomi: I om lo laitakin lawmte sam na deih leh eite na dong masa kisam ding hi.

records.english: Our son asked whether he could bring his rabbit to his grandmother's house for the weekend.
records.zomi: I tapa in a pi' inn ah kal tawp adingin a rabbit a paipih thei ding hiam a dong hi.

records.english: Mum, could I have a quiet word with you about my plans for the summer holidays?
records.zomi: Nu aw, khal tawlngakni-a ka gelnate tungtang nang tawh daitak-in ka kihopih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Why didn't you ask before you took my charger?
records.zomi: Ka charger na lak ma-in bang hangin na dong kei hiam?

records.english: May I give your phone number to my cousin, who's looking for a tutor?
records.zomi: Saya a zong ka sanggam numei kiangah na phone nambat ka pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Please do, but tell her I only teach at weekends.
records.zomi: Pia in, ahi zongin kal tawp ciang bek-in ka hilh hi, ci-in gen in.

records.english: Please ask your grandfather before you play his old records.
records.zomi: Na pu' record luite na hon ma-in amah dong in.

records.english: Our teenage son has started asking whether he can cook dinner for the whole family on Fridays, which none of us is going to refuse.
records.zomi: I tapa tangval neu in Laithai ni simin innkuan bup adingin nitak an huan thei ding hiam a dong kipan a, tua pen i lak ah kuamah in kinial lo ding hi.

records.english: Did you ask Mum before you gave away your old bicycle?
records.zomi: Na siiksakol lui na piak ma-in Nu na dong hiam?

records.english: My younger sister always asks me before she wears any of my jewellery.
records.zomi: Ka nau numei in ka kizeekna van khatpeuh a silh ma-in hong dong tawntung hi.

records.english: Children who are allowed to ask for things freely often learn to accept a refusal more calmly.
records.zomi: Zalen taka nate ngen theih naupangte in nialna dai zaw-in a pom sin zel uh hi.

records.english: In some families, a couple still asks the elders' blessing before they announce their engagement.
records.zomi: Innkuan pawl khat ah zi leh pasal dingte in a kiteen kiciamna uh a gen ma-un mi upate' thupha a ngen lai uh hi.

records.english: Parents who explain why they've said no are usually asked again less often.
records.zomi: Bang hangin nial hiam a genteh nu leh pate a tamzaw-in tawm zaw a kingen kik uh hi.

records.english: Grandma, may I take your recipe book home to copy a few recipes?
records.zomi: Pi aw, an huan dan pawl khat la kik dingin na an huan dan laibu inn ah ka tawi thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, but bring it back on Sunday, because I use it every day.
records.zomi: Thei hi, ahi zongin ni simin ka zat ahih manin Nipini ciangin hong tawi kik in.

records.english: You two need to ask your father before you take the boat out on the lake.
records.zomi: Dil ah tembaw na tuang ma-un na nih in na pa na dot kisam uh hi.

records.english: In our house, you can eat anything in the fridge, except what has a name written on it.
records.zomi: I inn ah min kigelh nei a om loh leh fridge sung-a na khempeuh na ne thei hi.

records.english: My daughter wrote a paragraph about our dog for her school project, and the dog seemed proud.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in a sang nasep adingin i ui tungtang paragraph khat a gelh a, ui a kipak bang hi.

records.english: Writing a paragraph about our family recipes helped my children understand where we come from.
records.zomi: I innkuan an huan dan tungtang paragraph khat gelh in ka tate in koi pan i hong pai hiam a theih nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: When you write about your family for school, you don't have to share anything that feels private.
records.zomi: Sang adingin na innkuan tungtang na gelh ciangin a guk bangin a kisa thu khatpeuh na hawm kul kei hi.

records.english: Can we write the paragraph about Grandma's life together this weekend?
records.zomi: Hih kal tawp ciangin Pi' nuntakna tungtang paragraph khawmin i gelh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our family blog started with one paragraph about our move and grew into a record of ten years.
records.zomi: I innkuan blog i suanna tungtang paragraph khat tawh a kipan a, kum sawm' ciamtehna ah a khang hi.

records.english: A paragraph about a difficult family time can be painful to write but healing to read years later.
records.zomi: Innkuan hun haksa khat tungtang paragraph khat gelh a nat thei a, ahi zongin kum tampi khit ciangin sim in a damsak thei hi.

records.english: Mum, is my paragraph too long for the card?
records.zomi: Nu aw, ka paragraph card adingin a sau lua hiam?

records.english: A well-written paragraph in a condolence letter can comfort a grieving family more than flowers.
records.zomi: Lungkhamna lai sung-a hoih taka kigelh paragraph khat in pakte sangin a kap innkuan khat a hehnem zaw thei hi.

records.english: Please don't let your sister write your paragraph for you.
records.zomi: Na u numei in na paragraph hong gelh sak dingin phal kei in.

records.english: Every December, my mother writes a short paragraph about each of us for the family newsletter.
records.zomi: December simin ka nu in innkuan thuthak lai adingin eite khatciat tungtang paragraph tomno khat a gelh hi.

records.english: The paragraph I wrote for my grandfather's funeral was the hardest thing I've ever written.
records.zomi: Ka pu' misi vuina adingin ka gelh paragraph pen ka gelh ngei sung-a haksa pen ahi hi.

records.english: The family Christmas letter is easier to read since we gave each child their own paragraph.
records.zomi: Naupang khatciat amau' paragraph i piak pan innkuan Christmas lai sim a baih zaw hi.

records.english: Writing a paragraph of thanks to the nurses who cared for my mother was the least we could do.
records.zomi: Ka nu a kem nurse te kiangah lungdamna paragraph khat gelh pen i bawl theih tawm pen ahi hi.

records.english: Have you written your paragraph for Grandma's card yet?
records.zomi: Pi' card adingin na paragraph na gelh khin hiam?

records.english: Our son's paragraph about his summer holiday was mostly about ice cream.
records.zomi: I tapa' khal tawlngakni tungtang paragraph a tamzaw ice cream tungtang ahi hi.

records.english: Helping my son with his paragraph about his grandfather turned into an evening of family stories.
records.zomi: Ka tapa' a pu tungtang paragraph adingin ka huh in innkuan tangthu nitak khat ah a kikheel hi.

records.english: My daughter's paragraph about her baby brother was full of complaints and love in equal amounts.
records.zomi: Ka tanu' a nau pasal neu tungtang paragraph phunna leh itna a kibang zah-in a dim hi.

records.english: Our children write a paragraph every Sunday about the best thing that happened that week.
records.zomi: I tate in Nipini simin tua kal-a thu piang hoih pen tungtang paragraph khat a gelh uh hi.

records.english: You two can write the paragraph about the trip, and I'll add the photos.
records.zomi: Na nih in khualzinna tungtang paragraph na gelh thei uh a, kei in lim te ka behlap ding hi.

records.english: The paragraph my grandfather wrote about his childhood was found in a drawer after he died.
records.zomi: Ka pu in a naupan lai tungtang a gelh paragraph a sih khit ciangin bawm khat sungah kimu hi.

records.english: Dad, can you read my paragraph before I hand it in?
records.zomi: Pa aw, ka pia ma-in ka paragraph hong sim thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Writing a paragraph about a family member forces you to choose what matters most about them.
records.zomi: Innkuan mi khat tungtang paragraph khat gelh in amah tungtang a thupi pen bang ahi hiam hong teelsak hi.

records.english: Shall I write the paragraph about the wedding for the newsletter?
records.zomi: Thuthak lai adingin mopawi tungtang paragraph ka gelh ding hiam?

records.english: Reading my old school paragraphs, I realised how much my handwriting has changed.
records.zomi: Ka sang lai-a paragraph luite ka sim ciangin ka laigelh bangzah a kikheel hiam ka thei hi.

records.english: My cousin's paragraph about our grandmother made everyone at the reunion laugh and then go quiet.
records.zomi: I pi tungtang ka sanggam' paragraph in innkuan kikhopna-a mi khempeuh a nuihsak a, tua khit ciangin a daisak hi.

records.english: When my uncle retired, each of his children wrote a paragraph for a book of memories.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu a nasep a tawp ciangin a tate khatciat in phawkna laibu khat adingin paragraph khat ciat a gelh uh hi.

records.english: When my parents applied for their new flat, I helped them write a paragraph explaining their situation.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in a inn thak uh a nget uh ciangin a dinmun uh a genteh paragraph khat a gelh nadingun ka huh hi.

records.english: My mother's paragraph about her first day in this country was read at her citizenship ceremony.
records.zomi: Hih gam-a a ni masa tungtang ka nu' paragraph a gam mi suahna pawi ah kisim hi.

records.english: Last year, my grandmother asked me to write down the story of how she met my grandfather.
records.zomi: Kum nunung in ka pi in ka pu a kimuh dan tangthu gelh dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: I wrote the first paragraph three times, because she kept remembering new details.
records.zomi: Thu thakte a phawk den ahih manin paragraph masa vei thum ka gelh hi.

records.english: When I finally read it aloud to her, she said it was exactly how it had happened, and then she cried.
records.zomi: A tawpna-ah amah kiangah aw ngaih takin ka sim ciangin a piang bang taktak ahi hi, a ci a, tua khit ciangin a kap hi.

records.english: The best paragraphs about families are often about small moments, not big events.
records.zomi: Innkuante tungtang paragraph hoih pente thupiang lianpite hi lo-in hun neunote tungtang ahi zel hi.

records.english: My father writes one long paragraph in every birthday card, as if it were a letter.
records.zomi: Ka pa in pianni card khempeuh ah lai bangin paragraph sau khat a gelh hi.

records.english: My parents still keep the paragraph I wrote about them when I was seven.
records.zomi: Kum sagih ka cin lai-a amaute tungtang ka gelh paragraph ka nu leh ka pa in a kem lai uh hi.

records.english: Thank you for writing such a kind paragraph about my father in the parish newsletter.
records.zomi: Pawlpi thuthak lai ah ka pa tungtang paragraph hoih tak na gelh manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Did you finish your paragraph about the family tree?
records.zomi: Innkuan zung tungtang na paragraph na zo khin hiam?

records.english: Will you write something warm for me to read at the family celebration?
records.zomi: Innkuan kipahna ah ka sim dingin thu lum khat hong gelhsak ding na hi hiam?

records.english: A paragraph of apology to a sibling can open a door that years of silence have closed.
records.zomi: Sanggam khat kiangah maisakna ngetna paragraph khat in kum tampi daina in a khak kongkhak a hong thei hi.

records.english: My mother rewrote my paragraph about the family farm until it sounded like her, not me.
records.zomi: Ka nu in innkuan lo tungtang ka paragraph kei bang hi lo-in amah bang a hih dong a gelh kik hi.

records.english: When my parents divorced, my mother wrote each of us a paragraph explaining that nothing would change her love for us.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa a kikhen uh ciangin ka nu in eite khatciat kiangah a itna bangmah in a kheel lo ding hi, ci-in paragraph khat ciat a gelh hi.

records.english: Could you help me write a paragraph about Grandpa for the memorial service?
records.zomi: Phawkna kikhopna adingin Pu tungtang paragraph khat gelh dingin hong huh thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: Start with one story that shows who he was, and let the rest follow from it.
records.zomi: Amah kua ahi hiam a lak tangthu khat tawh kipan inla, a dangte tua pan zui sak in.

records.english: Every paragraph in my mother's diary starts with the weather and ends with the children.
records.zomi: Ka nu' ni simin laibu sung-a paragraph khempeuh huihkhua tawh a kipan a, naupangte tawh a bei hi.

records.english: We printed my grandmother's paragraph about the old village and framed it for the hall.
records.zomi: Khua lui tungtang ka pi' paragraph i khet uh a, inn lutna adingin bawm sungah i koih uh hi.

records.english: My sister and I wrote one paragraph each for our parents' anniversary card.
records.zomi: Ka u numei leh kei i nu leh i pa' kiteenna kum cinna card adingin paragraph khat ciat i gelh hi.

records.english: Let's each write a paragraph for the guest book before we leave the cottage.
records.zomi: Inn neu i nusiat ma-in mikhual laibu adingin paragraph khat ciat i gelh ni.

records.english: Write a paragraph for your grandmother about what you did at school this week.
records.zomi: Hih kal sungin sang ah na bawl tungtang na pi adingin paragraph khat gelh in.

records.english: Our youngest was so pleased with his paragraph that he read it to the whole family at dinner.
records.zomi: I neu pen in a paragraph a lungdam mahmah ahih manin nitak an ah innkuan bup kiangah a sim hi.

records.english: My daughter wrote a paragraph thanking her teacher, and the teacher pinned it on the wall.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in a saya kiangah lungdamna paragraph khat a gelh a, saya in bang tungah a bulh hi.

records.english: Don't worry about the spelling; just write what you remember about Grandpa.
records.zomi: Laimal gelh dan lungkham kei in; Pu tungtang na phawk gelh mah in.

records.english: Writing about your family in a clear paragraph can be harder than writing about any other subject.
records.zomi: Paragraph kician khat ah na innkuan tungtang gelh in thu dang khatpeuh tungtang gelh sangin a haksa zaw thei hi.

records.english: A short paragraph in a letter to an elderly relative can mean more than a long phone call.
records.zomi: Sanggam upa khat kiangah lai sung-a paragraph tomno khat in phone sam sau khat sangin a thupi zaw thei hi.

records.english: My aunt's letters always have a paragraph for news, a paragraph for advice and a paragraph for worries.
records.zomi: Ka ni' laite in thuthak adingin paragraph khat, thuhilhna adingin paragraph khat leh lungkhamna adingin paragraph khat a nei tawntung hi.

records.english: When we wrote to the school about our son's illness, we kept each paragraph to one clear point.
records.zomi: I tapa' natna tungtang sang kiangah lai i gelh ciangin paragraph khatciat ah thu kician khat bek i koih hi.

records.english: Our family history book has one paragraph for every relative we could find.
records.zomi: I innkuan tangthu laibu in i muh theih sanggam khatciat adingin paragraph khat a nei hi.

records.english: Who wrote this beautiful paragraph about Mum on the birthday card?
records.zomi: Pianni card tungah Nu tungtang hih paragraph hoih kua in a gelh hiam?

records.english: My father asked me to help him write a clear paragraph for his pension application.
records.zomi: Ka pa in a pension ngetna adingin paragraph kician khat gelh nadingin hong huh dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: Can you write a paragraph about your family's favourite tradition?
records.zomi: Na innkuan' ngeina it pen tungtang paragraph khat na gelh thei ding hiam?

records.english: My brother's university application was rejected the first time, so he rewrote his personal statement.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasal' sangpi ngetna a masa-in kinial ahih manin amah tungtang lai a gelh kik hi.

records.english: My little brother's paragraph had only one full stop, at the very end.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal' paragraph in a tawp pen ah khawlna khat bek a nei hi.

records.english: The centre made all its staff take a first-aid course.
records.zomi: Mipi inn in a nasemte khempeuh khatvei damna huh sinna a sinsak hi.

records.english: Classes may be cancelled if fewer than five people sign up.
records.zomi: Mi nga sangin tawm zaw a kigelh leh sinnate kiphiat kha ding hi.

records.english: Which classes are running at the community centre this term?
records.zomi: Hih sang hun sungin mipi inn ah koi sinnate a om hiam?

records.english: Language classes, computer lessons, yoga for older people and a homework club for children.
records.zomi: Pau sinna, computer sinna, mi upate adingin yoga leh naupangte adingin inn sinna pawl.

records.english: The community centre hosted a vaccination clinic during the winter.
records.zomi: Phalbi sungin mipi inn in natna hihna damdawi sutna mun khat a bawl hi.

records.english: There's a free legal advice session at the centre on the first Monday of each month.
records.zomi: Kha simin Pizing ni masa ah mipi inn ah man om lo thukham thuhilhna a om hi.

records.english: Is the community centre accessible for people who use wheelchairs?
records.zomi: Mipi inn wheelchair zang mite adingin lut theih ahi hiam?

records.english: Running a community centre means balancing what people want with what the budget allows.
records.zomi: Mipi inn khat kem in mite' deih leh sum zat ding' phal kikal-ah kibatsak cihna hi.

records.english: Every Wednesday, volunteers cook a free lunch for older residents, many of whom would otherwise eat alone.
records.zomi: Nilai ni simin deihsakna nasemte in mi upa teeng mite adingin man om lo sun an a huan uh a, amaute tampi in tua bang hi lo hi leh amau kia-in an ne ding uh hi.

records.english: Alcohol may not be served at children's events in the centre.
records.zomi: Mipi inn-a naupangte' kikhopna ah zu kipia thei lo hi.

records.english: Does the centre manager really know every family in the area by name?
records.zomi: Mipi inn makaipa in mun sung-a innkuan khempeuh' min a thei taktak hiam?

records.english: Parents organised a toy library at the centre, so that children could borrow toys instead of buying them.
records.zomi: Naupangte in kimawlna van lei sangin a leitawi theih nadingin nu leh pate in mipi inn ah kimawlna van koihna khat a bawl uh hi.

records.english: The kitchen at the centre is used to cook meals for families in need.
records.zomi: Mipi inn-a an huanna inn kisam innkuante adingin an huanna-in kizang hi.

records.english: We used the centre's projector to show photos of the village at our reunion.
records.zomi: I innkuan kikhopna ah khua lim te lak dingin mipi inn' projector i zang uh hi.

records.english: A community centre can give newcomers their first chance to make friends in a strange town.
records.zomi: Mipi inn khat in hong tung thakte khuapi theih loh khat ah lawm ngah nading hun masa pen a pia thei hi.

records.english: The community centre is where our family celebrates every big occasion.
records.zomi: Mipi inn pen i innkuan in pawi lianpi khempeuh a lawpna mun ahi hi.

records.english: Can I volunteer at the centre if I only have one free afternoon a week?
records.zomi: Kal khat ah nitak lam khat bek ka awng leh mipi inn ah deihsakna nasep ka sem thei ding hiam?

records.english: Some community centres now offer counselling, debt advice and job support under one roof.
records.zomi: Mipi inn pawl khat in tu-in lungsim thuhilhna, leiba thuhilhna leh nasep huhna inn khat sungah a pia uh hi.

records.english: The manager said, "This building belongs to everyone who uses it, so please treat it with care."
records.zomi: Makaipa in, “Hih inn a zang mi khempeuh' a hi ahih manin limtakin kem un,” a ci hi.

records.english: The noticeboard by the door lists every activity for the month.
records.zomi: Kongkhak kiang-a thuzaksak phek in kha sung-a sepna khempeuh a lak hi.

records.english: The community centre is open every day except Sunday.
records.zomi: Mipi inn Nipini bek hi lo ni khempeuh a kihong hi.

records.english: Although they had lived next door to each other for years, our neighbours only met properly at a coffee morning in the community centre.
records.zomi: Kum tampi kiang kiang-a a teen uh hangin i innvengte mipi inn-a zingsang coffee kikhopna khat ah hoih takin a kimu masa uh hi.

records.english: Community centres often depend on a small number of tireless volunteers.
records.zomi: Mipi inn te a gim ngei lo deihsakna nasem tawmno tungah a kinga zel uh hi.

records.english: A community centre that listens to young people is more likely to keep them coming back.
records.zomi: Khangnote thu a ngaikhia mipi inn khat in amaute a hong kik den nadingun a lak zo zaw hi.

records.english: A good community centre gives people of all ages a reason to meet their neighbours.
records.zomi: Mipi inn hoih khat in kum tuamtuam mi khempeuh a innvengte a kimuh nading hang khat a pia hi.

records.english: Don't leave your belongings in the hall after the class has finished.
records.zomi: Sinna a bei khit ciangin inn sungah na vante nusia kei un.

records.english: Free internet at the centre helps people who can't afford it at home to apply for jobs.
records.zomi: Mipi inn-a internet man om lo in inn ah a man a pia zo lo mite nasep ngen nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: If the roof isn't repaired soon, the hall may have to close for the winter.
records.zomi: Inn tungvum manlang takin a kibawl phat kei leh phalbi sungin inn a kikhak kul kha ding hi.

records.english: Once a week, the centre's minibus takes older residents to the supermarket.
records.zomi: Kal khat ah vei khat mipi inn' bus neu in mi upa teeng mite supermarket ah a paipih hi.

records.english: The council cut the centre's funding, so the opening hours were reduced.
records.zomi: Khuapi office in mipi inn' sum a tawmsak ahih manin a kihonna hun a kiamsak hi.

records.english: For many lonely people, a weekly visit to the community centre is the highlight of their week.
records.zomi: Amau kia-a om mi tampi adingin kal simin mipi inn veh pen a kal uh sung-a nuam pen ahi hi.

records.english: Residents who can't afford their own tools can borrow drills and ladders from the centre.
records.zomi: Amau' vanzat lei zo lo teeng mite in mipi inn pan drill leh kahlei a leitawi thei uh hi.

records.english: Children under twelve must be accompanied by an adult in the games room.
records.zomi: Kum sawm leh nih nuai naupangte kimawlna khan ah mi upa khat in a zui ding hi.

records.english: We had the old piano in the hall tuned for the Christmas concert.
records.zomi: Christmas la kikhopna adingin inn sung-a piano lui i bawlphat uh hi.

records.english: Could the centre stay open later during the exam period so that students can study?
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte a sin theih nadingin sitna hun sungin mipi inn hun sawt zaw-in a kihong thei ding hiam?

records.english: Smoking is not allowed anywhere in the building or the garden, according to the centre's rules.
records.zomi: Mipi inn' thukham bangin inn sung leh huan sung koi ah zong meizial dawn kiphal lo hi.

records.english: Is there a fee to join the community centre?
records.zomi: Mipi inn ah kihel dingin man a om hiam?

records.english: No, membership is free, but some classes cost a little.
records.zomi: Om lo hi, kihelna man om lo a, ahi zongin sinna pawl khat in man tawmno a la hi.

records.english: Can I leave my child at the homework club while I'm at work?
records.zomi: Nasep ka om laitakin inn sinna pawl ah ka ta ka nusia thei ding hiam?

records.english: A room at the centre was given to the refugee support group free of charge.
records.zomi: Mipi inn-a khan khat taikhia mite huh pawl kiangah man om lo-in kipia hi.

records.english: Teenagers aren't allowed to use the gym without a trained adult present.
records.zomi: Tangval-tangnute kisinna kicing mi upa khat om lo-in gym a zang thei kei uh hi.

records.english: Who do I talk to about renting a room for our choir practice?
records.zomi: I la sa pawl' la sinna adingin khan luah thu kua tawh ka kihopih ding hiam?

records.english: Volunteers are thanked every year with a dinner cooked by the people they help.
records.zomi: Deihsakna nasemte kum simin amaute' huh mite' huan nitak an tawh lungdam kigen hi.

records.english: A community centre works best when people feel it belongs to them, not to the council.
records.zomi: Mipi inn khat pen mite in khuapi office' hi lo-in amau' ahi hi, ci-in a kisak uh ciangin a hoih pen-in a sem hi.

records.english: Everyone, please stack your chairs at the side of the hall before you go.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, na pai ma-un na tutphahte uh inn' a sih lam ah kithuah sak un.

records.english: The art class uses the centre's large tables for painting and pottery.
records.zomi: Lim zeekna sinna in zeek leh leibel bawl adingin mipi inn' dawhkan lianpite a zang hi.

records.english: When the library closed, the community centre became the only public space left in our neighbourhood.
records.zomi: Laibu inn a kikhak ciangin mipi inn i mun-a mipi mun om lai khat bek a hi ta hi.

records.english: My mother learned to use a computer at the community centre when she was seventy.

records.english: My father volunteers at the centre's repair café, fixing radios and lamps for free.
