records.zomi: Thailand-a guahkhua i guahkhua tawh a kibang lo mahmah hiam?

records.english: My grandmother keeps a map with a circle around every town where her children live.
records.zomi: Ka pi in a tate a tenna khua khatciat kiim ah kulh khat tawh map khat a kem hi.

records.english: Having family in other countries makes the news from those places feel personal.
records.zomi: Gamdang ah innkuan neih in tua mun pan thu thakte nangmah thu bangin a om sak hi.

records.english: Which country does Auntie Cing live in now?
records.zomi: Ni Cing tu-in bang gam ah a teng hiam?

records.english: She moved to New Zealand last year.
records.zomi: Kum bei-in New Zealand ah a pem hi.

records.english: Our children were surprised that people in their cousins' country drive on the other side of the road.
records.zomi: A sanggamte' gam ah mite lampi lang dang ah mawtaw a mawng uh ci-in i tate lamdang a sa uh hi.

records.english: My father drove us through three regions in one day to visit his old school friends.
records.zomi: A sang lawm luite veh dingin ka pa in ni khat sungin gam lam thum ah hong paipih hi.

records.english: Did you know that our relatives in Brazil speak Portuguese?
records.zomi: Brazil-a i sanggamte in Portuguese pau a zang uh hi, ci na thei hiam?

records.english: My husband's family comes from the south, so we spend every summer there.
records.zomi: Ka pasal' innkuan sim lam pan ahi uh ahih manin khal simin tua ah i om uh hi.

records.english: We stuck a little flag on the map for every country where a relative lives.
records.zomi: Sanggam khat a tenna gam khatciat adingin map tungah flag neu khat i lakap uh hi.

records.english: My grandmother remembers when the border between the two countries was easy to cross.
records.zomi: Gam nih kikal-a gam gi kantan a baih lai hun ka pi in a phawk hi.

records.english: My parents' two home regions have different traditions for weddings.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa' gam lam nih in mopawi ngeina tuam a nei uh hi.

records.english: Our family is spread across four countries, so we have a world map on the kitchen wall.
records.zomi: I innkuan gam li ah a zeek uh ahih manin anbuk bang tungah leitung map khat i nei uh hi.

records.english: Grandpa can describe every village in his region from memory.
records.zomi: Pu in a gam lam sung-a khua khempeuh a phawkna tawh a gen thei hi.

records.english: We drew the route my grandparents took when they moved from one region to another.
records.zomi: Ka pu leh ka pi gam lam khat pan khat ah a pem uh ciangin a paina lampi uh i gelh uh hi.

records.english: My grandparents have never left their home region, but their grandchildren live on three continents.
records.zomi: Ka pu leh ka pi in a gam lam uh a nusia ngei kei uh a, ahi zongin a tute uh leitung gam lian thum ah a teng uh hi.

records.english: My parents like to compare the prices in our region with prices in the capital.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in i gam lam-a van man gam khuapi lian-a van man tawh a kitehkak nuam uh hi.

records.english: My brother lives in Norway, where it stays light almost all night in summer.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal Norway ah a teng a, tua ah khal sungin zan bup dek a vak hi.

records.english: When will we visit the region where Grandma was born?
records.zomi: Pi' suahna gam lam bang hun-in i veh ding uh hiam?

records.english: Our son's pen friend lives in Kenya, and they write to each other every month.
records.zomi: I tapa' lai kikhak lawm Kenya ah a teng a, kha simin lai a kikhak uh hi.

records.english: Our family's region is famous for its tea, and we always take some to relatives abroad.
records.zomi: I innkuan' gam lam a niangtui-in a minthang a, gamdang-a sanggamte kiangah i paipih tawntung uh hi.

records.english: Mum, which region of the country did your grandparents come from?
records.zomi: Nu, na pu leh na pi gam bang lam pan ahi uh hiam?

records.english: Do you know what the weather is like in Australia at Christmas?
records.zomi: Christmas ciangin Australia ah huihkhua bangci om hiam na thei hiam?

records.english: Our family recipe book includes dishes from every country where a relative has lived.
records.zomi: I innkuan an huanzia bu in sanggam khat a tenna gam khatciat pan ante a nei hi.

records.english: We learned a lot about Korea from the family who lived next door for two years.
records.zomi: Kum nih sung i kiang inn ah a teng innkuan pan Korea tungtang tampi i sin uh hi.

records.english: Do our relatives in Malaysia celebrate the same festivals as we do?
records.zomi: Malaysia-a i sanggamte in eite bangin pawi kibang a lawm uh hiam?

records.english: My little brother thinks every country is as hot as ours.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal neu in gam khempeuh i gam bangin a lum hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Let's find the country where your pen friend lives on the map.
records.zomi: Na lai kikhak lawm' tenna gam map tungah i zong ding.

records.english: Every time a relative moves, my daughter adds a new pin to her map.
records.zomi: Sanggam khat a pem simin ka tanu in a map tungah pin thak khat a behlap hi.

records.english: Learning about the countries where our relatives live has made geography my favourite subject.
records.zomi: I sanggamte' tenna gamte tungtang sin in leitung zia ka sinna it pen ah a suaksak hi.

records.english: Dad, have you ever been to the mountains in the north?
records.zomi: Pa, mal lam-a mualte ah na pai ngei hiam?

records.english: Is Canada colder than where Uncle Pau lives?
records.zomi: Canada pen Pa neu Pau' tenna sangin a vot zaw hiam?

records.english: Much colder in winter, so he says.
records.zomi: Phalbi ciangin a vot zaw mahmah hi, a ci hi.

records.english: My aunt in India sent us a parcel of spices from her region.
records.zomi: India-a ka ni in a gam lam pan anlimte bawm khat hong khak hi.

records.english: My cousin in Germany sends us postcards of the mountains near her town.
records.zomi: Germany-a ka sanggam in a khua kiang-a mualte postcard hong khak hi.

records.english: When my sister moved to Japan, we knew almost nothing about the country.
records.zomi: Ka u numei Japan ah a pem ciangin tua gam tungtang bangmah i thei dek kei uh hi.

records.english: Every week she sent us photos of temples, trains and food we had never seen.
records.zomi: Kal simin i muh ngeih loh biakinnte, meilengte leh ante lim hong khak hi.

records.english: Now my children can name more Japanese cities than cities in our own region.
records.zomi: Tu-in ka tate in i gam lam-a khuapite sangin Japan khuapite a min tam zaw a thei uh hi.

records.english: My parents chose to settle in this region because the land was good for farming.
records.zomi: Lei in lou bawl dingin a hoih ahih manin ka nu leh ka pa in hih gam lam ah teng dingin a teel uh hi.

records.english: Which countries have you visited with your family?
records.zomi: Na innkuan tawh bang gamte na veh khin hiam?

records.english: Could you please confirm the date of the next meter reading?
records.zomi: Meter tehna a zom ni na kipsak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Each flat owner pays a monthly service charge for the cleaning of shared areas.
records.zomi: Inn neite in mun kihawm siangsakna adingin kha simin nasep man a pia uh hi.

records.english: Our building requires every new resident to register with the management office.
records.zomi: I building in tenna thak khempeuh management office ah a min a gelh dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: Under the tenancy agreement, the tenant is responsible for keeping the garden tidy.
records.zomi: Inn hawh kituakna bangin inn hawhpa in huan siangtho takin a kem ding hi.

records.english: May I request a copy of the building's house rules?
records.zomi: Building' inn thukham copy khat ka ngen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Household bills must be paid by the date shown on the invoice.
records.zomi: Inn sung man piak dingte invoice tung-a ni lang ma-in kipia ding hi.

records.english: The council will remove the abandoned furniture within five working days.
records.zomi: Khuapi office in kinusia innsung vante nasep ni nga sungin a la ding hi.

records.english: Noisy household repairs are only permitted between eight in the morning and six in the evening.
records.zomi: Ging tampi bawl inn bawl hoihnate zingsang nai giat pan nitak nai guk kikal bek ah kiphal hi.

records.english: Any damage to the property should be reported to the landlord immediately.
records.zomi: Inn tung-a siatna khempeuh inn neipa kiangah manlang takin gen ding hi.

records.english: A deposit equal to one month's rent will be returned when you leave, provided there is no damage.
records.zomi: Kha khat inn man kibang kemsa sum siatna a om kei leh na pai ciangin kipia kik ding hi.

records.english: Please return the spare keys to the office when you move out.
records.zomi: Na pem ciangin tawh behlapte office ah pia kik in.

records.english: Responsibility for maintaining a shared wall is usually divided equally between the neighbouring owners.
records.zomi: Kikhen kulh kihawm kemna mawhpuakna a tamzaw-in inn veng neite kikal ah kibang takin kikhen hi.

records.english: Is there a penalty if the service charge is paid late?
records.zomi: Nasep man a nunung leh lekhak a om hiam?

records.english: Is the owner of the flat required to have the gas appliances checked every year?
records.zomi: Inn neipa in kum simin gas vante a sitsak kul hiam?

records.english: Yes, a yearly safety check by a registered engineer is a legal requirement here.
records.zomi: Kul hi, hih mun ah kigelh engineer khat' kum sim bitna sitna thukham in a ngen hi.

records.english: Residents may not hang washing from the balconies facing the street.
records.zomi: Tenna mite in lampi lam-a balcony pan puan a lap thei kei uh hi.

records.english: The building management will inspect the smoke alarms on Thursday.
records.zomi: Building management in Laizing ni ciangin meikhu alarm te a en ding hi.

records.english: Please read the house rules carefully before signing the contract.
records.zomi: Contract tungah min na gelh ma-in inn thukhamte kidawm takin sim in.

records.english: The housing officer will carry out an inspection of the property next month.
records.zomi: Inn office nasempa in a zom kha ciangin inn a en ding hi.

records.english: Children must not play in the car park, by order of the residents' committee.
records.zomi: Tenna mite' makaipawl thupiak bangin naupangte mawtaw koihna mun ah a kimawl thei kei uh hi.

records.english: Residents are responsible for their own household insurance.
records.zomi: Tenna mite in amau inn insurance mawhpuakna a nei uh hi.

records.english: The council offers free collection of garden waste during the autumn months.
records.zomi: Kumphal kha sungin khuapi office in huan nawi man om lo-in a la hi.

records.english: Report any broken lights in the stairwell to the caretaker.
records.zomi: Kahlei mun-a meivak siate inn kemtu kiangah gen un.

records.english: Residents are reminded that rubbish bins must be placed outside by seven o'clock on Monday morning.
records.zomi: Pizing ni zingsang nai sagih ma-in nawi bin te pualam ah koih ding hi, ci-in tenna mite phawk sak hi.

records.english: Occupants must not store bicycles in the communal hallway.
records.zomi: Tenna mite in kihawm lampi kong sungah siiksakol a koih thei kei uh hi.

records.english: A late payment fee will be added to overdue accounts.
records.zomi: A hun pelh account te ah a nunung man piakna lekhak kibehlap ding hi.

records.english: The council requires every household to separate recyclable waste from general waste.
records.zomi: Khuapi office in inn khatciat in zat kik theih nawite nawi dang tawh a khen ding uh a ngen hi.

records.english: Kindly inform the office if you will be away from the property for more than a month.
records.zomi: Kha khat val inn na nusiat ding leh office kiangah hong gen in.

records.english: I am writing to report a leak in the bathroom ceiling of flat 4B.
records.zomi: Flat 4B-a kisilna inn innkhum tung-a tui zuina gen dingin ka gelh hi.

records.english: The landlord must give at least twenty-four hours' notice before entering the flat.
records.zomi: Inn neipa in inn a lut ma-in nai sawmnih leh li pan a gen masa ding hi.

records.english: Please sign the inventory to confirm the condition of the furniture.
records.zomi: Innsung vante dinmun kipsak nadingin van list tungah min gelh in.

records.english: Do I need permission from the council to build a shed in my garden?
records.zomi: Ka huan sungah inn neu khat lam dingin khuapi office pan phalna ka kisam hiam?

records.english: Tenants must give one month's written notice before moving out.
records.zomi: Inn hawhte in a pem ma-un kha khat pan lai tawh a gen masa ding uh hi.

records.english: Households that fail to separate their recycling may receive a warning letter.
records.zomi: Zat kik theih nawi a khen loh inn te in lau sak lai a ngah thei uh hi.

records.english: Cleaning duties for the shared kitchen are listed on the rota by the door.
records.zomi: Anbuk kihawm siangsakna nasepte kongkhak kiang-a hun kizui list ah kigelh hi.

records.english: The housing association has published new rules on keeping pets in the flats.
records.zomi: Inn pawl in flat sungah ganhing vulh thu-ah thukham thakte a suaksak hi.

records.english: Please complete the change of address form if anyone moves out of the household.
records.zomi: Kuamah inn sung pan a pem leh tenna mun kheelna lai gelh in.

records.english: Kindly ensure that the main door is locked after nine o'clock at night.
records.zomi: Zan nai kua khit ciangin kongpi lian a kikhak hiam en in.

records.english: Who signs the tenancy agreement if both of us are paying the rent?
records.zomi: Inn man i nih in i piak leh inn hawh kituakna tungah kua in min a gelh ding hiam?

records.english: Homeowners are legally required to clear snow and ice from the pavement in front of their homes in some cities.
records.zomi: Khuapi pawl khat ah inn neite in a inn mai-a lampi pang tung-a vuuk leh tuikhal thukham bangin a phiat ding uh hi.

records.english: The domestic helper's contract includes one full day off every week.
records.zomi: Inn sung nasem' contract in kal simin ni khat bup tawlngak a nei hi.

records.english: Please do not leave bulky items next to the bins; book a special collection instead.
records.zomi: Van lian te nawi bin kiangah koih kei un; a tuam-a lak dingin ngen zaw un.

records.english: Please ensure that all windows are closed before leaving the building.
records.zomi: Building na nusiat ma-in tohkhawng khempeuh a kikhak hiam en in.

records.english: Who should I contact to report a fault with the shared lift?
records.zomi: Lift kihawm a sia thu gen dingin kua ka sam ding hiam?

records.english: The caretaker is responsible for cleaning the stairs every Friday.
records.zomi: Laithai ni simin kahlei siangsak pen inn kemtu' mawhpuakna ahi hi.

records.english: Owners are reminded that dogs must be kept on a lead in the shared garden.
records.zomi: Huan kihawm sungah ui khau tawh kem ding hi, ci-in ui neite phawk sak hi.

records.english: Can the landlord increase the rent in the middle of a contract?
records.zomi: Contract laizang-in inn neipa in inn man a khangsak thei hiam?

records.english: All residents are asked to keep noise to a minimum after ten o'clock at night.
records.zomi: Tenna mi khempeuh zan nai sawm khit ciangin ging a neu thei pen-in bawl dingin kingen hi.

records.english: Parents are legally responsible for any damage their children cause to the building.
records.zomi: Nu leh pate in a tate uh in building tungah a bawl siatna khempeuh thukham bangin mawhpuak uh hi.

records.english: Do tenants have to pay for replacing broken light bulbs?
records.zomi: Inn hawhte in meivak bulb siate a kheelna man a pia kul uh hiam?

records.english: Domestic workers are entitled to a written contract that lists their duties and hours.
records.zomi: Inn sung nasemte in a nasep leh a hun uh a kigelh contract lai a ngah thei uh hi.

records.english: All chimneys must be swept at least once a year to reduce the risk of fire.
records.zomi: Mei kan a lau huai kiamsak nadingin meikhu khuk khempeuh kum khat-in khatvei kisiangsak ding hi.

records.english: Who is responsible for repairing the boiler, the landlord or the tenant?
records.zomi: Boiler bawl hoih kua in mawhpuak hiam, inn neipa hiam inn hawhpa hiam?

records.english: The landlord, unless the damage was caused by the tenant.
records.zomi: Inn neipa, inn hawhpa in a siatsak hi lo leh.

records.english: The household registration form must list every person who normally lives at the address.
records.zomi: Innkuan min gelhna lai in tenna mun ah a teng den mi khempeuh a gelh ding hi.

records.english: Water charges are calculated according to the number of people in the household.
records.zomi: Tui man innkuan sung-a mi zah zui-in kituat hi.

records.english: Thank you for keeping the shared areas clean and tidy.
records.zomi: Mun kihawmte siangtho leh kician takin na kem manun ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Shared areas must be kept free of personal belongings for safety reasons.
records.zomi: Bitna hangin mun kihawmte ah mimal van koih lo ding hi.

records.english: The terms of the lease forbid tenants from subletting rooms without written consent.
records.zomi: Inn hawh kituakna in inn hawhte lai tawh phalna om lo-in khan dangte hawhsak kik thei lo hi, ci-in a phal kei hi.

records.english: Hot water is provided by the building's central system and included in the rent.
records.zomi: Tui lum building' a kizom system pan kipia a, inn man sungah kihel hi.

records.english: Do all Christians agree about which gifts are still given today?
records.zomi: Khristian khempeuh in tu-in kipia lai hehpihnate tungtang a kituak uh hiam?

records.english: No, churches hold different views, especially about gifts such as prophecy and speaking in tongues.
records.zomi: Kituak kei uh, pawlpite in a ngaihsutna tuam a nei uh a, a hoih pen-in kamsanna leh kamtuam pau bang hehpihnate tungtang ahi hi.

records.english: Discovering a spiritual gift can give a believer a new sense of purpose.
records.zomi: Kha lam hehpihna khat muh in upmi khat ngimna thak a pia thei hi.

records.english: Would you like to join the spring class on spiritual gifts?
records.zomi: Spring hun-a Kha lam hehpihna sinna ah na kihel nuam hiam?

records.english: Generosity is described as a gift of the Spirit in Paul's letter to the Romans.
records.zomi: Paul' Rom mite kianga lai sungah pia nuamna Kha Siangtho' hehpihna khat bangin kigen hi.

records.english: How does a church decide who should use the gift of teaching?
records.zomi: Pawlpi khat in hilhna hehpihna kua in zang ding hiam bangci a khensat hiam?

records.english: Some traditions place more emphasis on spiritual gifts in worship than others do.
records.zomi: Ngeina pawl khat in biakna sungah Kha lam hehpihnate dangte sangin a ngaihsut thupi zaw uh hi.

records.english: My aunt's gift of hospitality makes everyone feel welcome in her home.
records.zomi: Ka ni' zindo hehpihna in mi khempeuh a inn ah a kimuak bangin a om sak hi.

records.english: The gift of healing is understood differently in different Christian traditions.
records.zomi: Damsakna hehpihna Khristian ngeina tuamtuam ah kithei tuamtuam hi.

records.english: Is speaking in tongues mentioned in the Bible?
records.zomi: Laisiangtho sungah kamtuam pau gen kigen hiam?

records.english: Yes, it appears in the book of Acts and in Paul's letters.
records.zomi: Kigen hi, Sawltakte Thu laibu leh Paul' laite sungah a om hi.

records.english: Christians often say that spiritual gifts are meant for building others up.
records.zomi: Kha lam hehpihnate midangte lam khang nadingin ahi hi, ci-in Khristiante in a gen zel uh hi.

records.english: According to the book of Acts, the disciples spoke in other languages when the Spirit came at Pentecost.
records.zomi: Sawltakte Thu laibu bangin Pentecost ciangin Kha Siangtho a tun ciangin nungzuite in kamtuam pau tawh thu a gen uh hi.

records.english: Do you think a child can have a spiritual gift?
records.zomi: Naupang khat in Kha lam hehpihna a nei thei hi, na ci hiam?

records.english: Some Christians pray to discover what their spiritual gifts are.
records.zomi: Khristian pawl khat in a Kha lam hehpihnate uh bang hiam a theih nadingun thu a ngen uh hi.

records.english: The pastor reminded us that gifts are for serving, not for showing off.
records.zomi: Hehpihnate na sem nadingin ahi a, kilahna dingin hi lo hi, ci-in pastor in hong phawk sak hi.

records.english: What gifts do you think our church needs most?
records.zomi: I pawlpi in bang hehpihnate a kisam pen hiam na ci hiam?

records.english: Christians are taught to use their gifts with love, not pride.
records.zomi: Khristiante in a hehpihnate uh kiphatsakna tawh hi lo-in ki-itna tawh zang dingin kihilh uh hi.

records.english: Many Christians believe that gifts can grow stronger with practice.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in hehpihnate a zat tam ciangin a hat zaw thei hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Thank you for sharing your gift of music with us this morning.
records.zomi: Tu zingsang la hehpihna nang' kei tawh na kihawm manin ka lungdam uh hi.

records.english: The Sunday school children talked about using their gifts to help at home.
records.zomi: Nipini sang naupangte in inn ah huh nadingin a hehpihnate uh zat thu a kihopih uh hi.

records.english: Our church's cleaning team believes that practical work can also be a spiritual gift.
records.zomi: I pawlpi' siangsakna pawl in khut nasep zong Kha lam hehpihna khat ahi thei hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Ask people who know you well where they see you serving others best.
records.zomi: Nang hong thei mahmah mite kiangah midangte na sep hoih pen koi ah a mu uh hiam dong in.

records.english: When we use our gifts together, the whole church benefits.
records.zomi: I hehpihnate khawm-in i zat ciangin pawlpi bup in a phatuampih hi.

records.english: The youth leader helped us think about how we could serve with our gifts.
records.zomi: Khangno makaipa in i hehpihnate tawh bangci na i sem thei ding hiam ngaihsun dingin hong huh hi.

records.english: Should a spiritual gift be used outside the church as well as inside it?
records.zomi: Kha lam hehpihna pawlpi sung bek hi lo-in pualam ah zong zat ding hiam?

records.english: In Christian teaching, spiritual gifts are given for the good of the whole church.
records.zomi: Khristian hilhna ah Kha lam hehpihnate pawlpi bup' hoihna dingin kipia hi.

records.english: In the church where I grew up, older members helped younger people discover their gifts.
records.zomi: Ka khanglian pawlpi ah mi upate in khangnote a hehpihnate uh a muh nadingin a huh uh hi.

records.english: Our church thanks God for the gifts of every volunteer.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in kipia nasem khempeuh' hehpihnate adingin Pasian lungdam a gen hi.

records.english: My mother has a gift for listening, and people often come to her for advice.
records.zomi: Ka nu in ngaihkhiatna hehpihna a nei a, mite thuhilhna ngen dingin a kiang ah a pai zel uh hi.

records.english: How can I find out what my gift is?
records.zomi: Ka hehpihna bang hiam bangci ka thei thei ding hiam?

records.english: Christians are encouraged not to compare their gifts with those of others.
records.zomi: Khristiante in a hehpihnate uh midangte' hehpihna tawh kiteh lo dingin kihanthawn uh hi.

records.english: According to Paul, the gifts are different, but they come from the same Spirit.
records.zomi: Paul' gen bangin hehpihnate a tuamtuam a, ahi zongin Kha Siangtho khat mah pan hong pai hi.

records.english: Paul writes that the Spirit distributes gifts to each person as he wills.
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho in a deihna bangin mi khatciat tungah hehpihnate a hawmsak hi, ci-in Paul in a gelh hi.

records.english: Why do churches disagree about the gift of prophecy?
records.zomi: Bang hangin pawlpite kamsanna hehpihna tungtang a kituak kei uh hiam?

records.english: Let's thank God for the different gifts in our church family.
records.zomi: I pawlpi innkuan sung-a hehpihna tuamtuamte adingin Pasian lungdam i gen ni.

records.english: In many churches, hospitality is also seen as a gift from God.
records.zomi: Pawlpi tampi ah zindo zong Pasian pan hehpihna khat bangin kimu hi.

records.english: My grandmother believes her gift is encouraging people.
records.zomi: Ka pi in a hehpihna pen mite hanthawn ahi hi, ci-in a um hi.

records.english: Christians believe that gifts are given freely, not earned.
records.zomi: Hehpihnate man om lo-in kipia a, ngah dingin kisem hi lo hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: Paul teaches that no gift is more important than love.
records.zomi: Ki-itna sangin a thupi zaw hehpihna om lo hi, ci-in Paul in a hilh hi.

records.english: The early church shared its gifts so that no one was left in need.
records.zomi: A kipat lai pawlpi in kuamah a tasam a om loh nadingin a hehpihnate uh a kihawm uh hi.

records.english: What is a spiritual gift?
records.zomi: Kha lam hehpihna bang hiam?

records.english: In Christian teaching, it is an ability given by the Holy Spirit to serve others.
records.zomi: Khristian hilhna ah midangte na sep nadingin Kha Siangtho in a piak theihna ahi hi.

records.english: Many Christians see teaching as one of the gifts of the Spirit.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in hilhna Kha Siangtho' hehpihna khat bangin a mu uh hi.

records.english: Faith is listed by Paul as one of the gifts of the Spirit.
records.zomi: Paul in upna Kha Siangtho' hehpihna khat bangin a gelh hi.

records.english: Please pray that each of us will use our gifts faithfully.
records.zomi: I khatciat in i hehpihnate ginat takin i zat nadingin thu hong ngetsak un.

records.english: Leaders in many churches encourage members to serve where their gifts fit best.
records.zomi: Pawlpi tampi-a makaite in mite a hehpihna uh tawh a kilawm pen mun ah na sem dingin a hanthawn uh hi.

records.english: In the Bible, wisdom and knowledge are listed among the gifts of the Spirit.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho sungah pilna leh siamna Kha Siangtho' hehpihnate lak ah kigelh hi.

records.english: Paul warns that gifts used without love are like a noisy gong.
records.zomi: Ki-itna om lo-in kizang hehpihnate daak ging thei bang ahi hi, ci-in Paul in a lau sak hi.

records.english: In some churches, members fill in a short questionnaire to help them identify their gifts.
records.zomi: Pawlpi pawl khat ah mite in a hehpihnate uh a theih nadingin dotna lai tomno khat a gelh uh hi.

records.english: Our pastor says that everyone in the church has a gift to share.
records.zomi: Pawlpi sung mi khempeuh in kihawm ding hehpihna khat ciat a nei uh hi, ci-in i pastor in a gen hi.

records.english: Spiritual gifts are discussed in several of Paul's letters.
records.zomi: Kha lam hehpihnate Paul' lai tampi sungah kigen hi.

records.english: My brother found his gift in teaching the Bible to young people.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal in khangnote Laisiangtho hilhna ah a hehpihna a mu hi.

records.english: According to the New Testament, every believer receives at least one gift.
records.zomi: Thukhun Thak bangin upmi khatciat in a tawm pen-in hehpihna khat a ngah ciat uh hi.

records.english: Could serving tea after church be a spiritual gift?
records.zomi: Pawlpi khit ciangin niangtui hawm Kha lam hehpihna khat hi thei ding hiam?

records.english: Paul writes about spiritual gifts in his first letter to the Corinthians.
records.zomi: Paul in Korin mite kianga a lai masa pen sungah Kha lam hehpihnate tungtang a gelh hi.

records.english: Christians often pray for wisdom to use their gifts well.
records.zomi: Khristiante in a hehpihnate uh hoih takin a zat theih nadingun pilna adingin thu a ngen zel uh hi.

records.english: My uncle uses his gift of music to lead worship at church.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu in pawlpi ah biakna makaih dingin a la hehpihna a zang hi.

records.english: Some Christians distinguish between natural talents and spiritual gifts, while others see them as closely connected.
records.zomi: Khristian pawl khat in pianpih siamnate leh Kha lam hehpihnate a khen uh a, midang in a kizom mahmah bangin a mu uh hi.

records.english: According to Paul's letter to the Romans, gifts include serving, giving and showing mercy.
records.zomi: Paul' Rom mite kianga lai bangin hehpihnate ah na sepna, piakna leh hehpihna lahna a kihel hi.

records.english: Why didn't you tell me you were unhappy at school?
records.zomi: Bang hangin sang ah na lungkim kei hi, hong gen kei hiam?

records.english: I didn't want you to worry.
records.zomi: Na lungkham ding ka deih kei hi.

records.english: Do you know why your sister has been so quiet since the weekend?
records.zomi: Kal tawp pan kipan bang hangin na u numei a dai mahmah hiam na thei hiam?

records.english: When my son started coughing at night, the doctor asked whether anyone in the house smoked.
records.zomi: Ka tapa zanin a khuk kipan ciangin inn sungah kuamah in meizial a dawn hiam siavuan in a dong hi.

records.english: Asking why a family tradition started can lead to wonderful stories.
records.zomi: Innkuan ngeina khat bang hangin a kipan hiam dot in tangthu nuam takte a tun thei hi.

records.english: What caused all the arguments between the twins this week?
records.zomi: Hih kal apengte kikal kielna khempeuh bang in a piangsak hiam?

records.english: They both want the bottom bunk now that the new bed has arrived.
records.zomi: Lupna thak a tun ciangin a nih in lupna nuai lam a deih uh hi.

records.english: Why did you and Dad stop talking at dinner?
records.zomi: Bang hangin nang leh Pa nitak an ne ciangin na kihopih nawn kei uh hiam?

records.english: We had a small disagreement about the holiday, but it's sorted now.
records.zomi: Tawlngak hun tungtang kituak lo neu khat i nei uh hi, ahi zongin tu-in a hoih ta hi.

records.english: Why does the baby always cry when we put her in the car seat?
records.zomi: Bang hangin naungek mawtaw tutna ah i koih ciangin a kap den hiam?

records.english: How did our water bill get so much higher than last year?
records.zomi: Bang hangin i tui man kum bei sangin a sang zaw mahmah hiam?

records.english: Because the toilet has been running all night.
records.zomi: Eek inn tui zan bup a luang den ahih manin.

records.english: Finding the real cause of a family quarrel often means listening to both sides very patiently.
records.zomi: Innkuan kielna khat' a hang taktak muh in a lang nih thuakzawhna tawh ngaihkhiat a kisam zel hi.

records.english: What's behind your decision to work part-time?
records.zomi: Hun kim nasep na sep ding na khensatna bang in a hang hiam?

records.english: The long hours meant I never saw the children.
records.zomi: Nasep hun sau hangin naupangte ka mu ngei kei hi.

records.english: Why are you always so hungry after school?
records.zomi: Bang hangin sang khit ciangin na gilkial den hiam?

records.english: Because I don't have time to eat my lunch.
records.zomi: Ka sun an nek hun ka neih loh manin.

records.english: Why is my little brother allowed to stay up later than I was at his age?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ka nau pasal kei a kum lai-a ka om sangin zan nung zaw-in a om thei hiam?

records.english: When Grandma started forgetting things, we wanted to know if her medicine was the cause.
records.zomi: Pi in na a mangngilh kipat ciangin a damdawi in a hang ahi hiam i theih nop uh hi.

records.english: My husband and I traced most of our arguments back to the same cause: we were both exhausted.
records.zomi: Ka pasal leh kei i kielnate a tamzaw a hang kibang ah i zui kik uh hi: i nih in i gim lua uh hi.

records.english: My parents wondered why I'd stopped calling, and the reason was simply that I'd been working nights.
records.zomi: Bang hangin ka sam nawn kei hiam ka nu leh ka pa lamdang a sa uh a, a hang pen zanin na ka sep bek ahi hi.

records.english: My daughter wanted to know why her hair is curly when nobody else's is.
records.zomi: Midang khempeuh' sam a kawi lo-in bang hangin a sam a kawi hiam ka tanu in a thei nuam hi.

records.english: Why do you think the cat is hiding under the bed?
records.zomi: Bang hangin zawhngeu lupna nuai ah a bu hi, na ci hiam?

records.english: She's frightened of the fireworks outside.
records.zomi: Pualam-a meipiak puakte a lau hi.

records.english: Why do you think your brother is afraid of the dark all of a sudden?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na nau pasal thakhatthu-in mial a lau hi, na ci hiam?

records.english: He watched a scary film at his friend's house.
records.zomi: A lawm' inn ah film lauhuai khat a en hi.

records.english: What's making the house so cold in the mornings?
records.zomi: Bang in zingsang simin inn a votsak hiam?

records.english: The heating timer was reset when the clocks changed.
records.zomi: Nai kikheel ciangin inn lumsakna hun tehna kibawl kik hi.

records.english: We still don't know why the old photos were missing from Grandma's album.
records.zomi: Pi' lim bu sung pan bang hangin lim luite a mang hiam i thei nai kei uh hi.

records.english: We realised the plants were dying because nobody had been watering them while we were away.
records.zomi: I om loh lai-in kuamah in tui a buak loh manin singnote a si hi, ci i thei uh hi.

records.english: Mum worked out that my headaches were caused by not drinking enough water.
records.zomi: Ka lu natna tui tam a ka dawn loh hangin ahi hi, ci Nu in a thei hi.

records.english: Asking why someone feels lonely is the first step to helping them.
records.zomi: Mi khat bang hangin a kia-in a om sa hiam dot pen amah huh nadingin a kalsuan masa pen ahi hi.

records.english: When our son's grades dropped, we tried to find out what had changed at school.
records.zomi: I tapa' sinna nambat a kiam ciangin sang ah bang a kikheel hiam i zong uh hi.

records.english: Why do we always eat noodles on birthdays?
records.zomi: Bang hangin suahni simin khauzang i ne den uh hiam?

records.english: Grandma says long noodles are a wish for a long life.
records.zomi: Khauzang sau pen nuntakna sau deihsakna ahi hi, Pi in a ci hi.

records.english: Why do you always visit Grandpa on Thursdays?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Laizing ni simin Pu na veh den hiam?

records.english: Because that's the day his carer has off.
records.zomi: Tua ni a kemtu' tawlngak ni ahih manin.

records.english: What caused the crack in the bedroom ceiling?
records.zomi: Lupna khan innkhum tung-a kiphel bang in a piangsak hiam?

records.english: The builder thinks the house is slowly settling.
records.zomi: Inn a nuai lam ah dahdah-in a kiniam hi, ci-in inn lamtu in a ngaihsun hi.

records.english: What do you think caused the bad feeling between your father and his brother?
records.zomi: Na pa leh a sanggam pasal kikal-a lungsim hoih lo bang in a piangsak hiam na ci hiam?

records.english: Asking a teenager why they're upset works better after they've had something to eat.
records.zomi: Tangval-tangnu khat bang hangin a lungkham hiam dot pen an a nek khit ciangin a hoih zaw hi.

records.english: What made the baby's rash flare up again?
records.zomi: Bang in naungek' vun san a kipan kiksak hiam?

records.english: Probably the new washing powder, so we've gone back to the old one.
records.zomi: Puan silna leivui thak hi ding a, tua ahih manin a lui ah i ciah kik uh hi.

records.english: Why did your cousins move to another city?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na sanggamte khuapi dang ah a pem uh hiam?

records.english: Why has Auntie stopped coming to family dinners?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Ni innkuan nitak an ah a hong pai nawn kei hiam?

records.english: I think she feels hurt by something Uncle said at Christmas.
records.zomi: Christmas ciangin Pa neu' gen thu khat hangin a lungkham hi ding hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: What has put everyone in such a bad mood today?
records.zomi: Tuni-in bang in mi khempeuh a lungsim hoih lo sak hiam?

records.english: Do you know why your grandparents never talk about that village?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na pu leh na pi in tua khua thu a gen ngei kei uh hiam na thei hiam?

records.english: They lost their home there, and it still makes them sad.
records.zomi: Tua ah a inn uh a mansuah uh a, tu dong a lungkhamsak lai hi.

records.english: We finally realised that the reason the dog was digging was boredom.
records.zomi: Ui a tou a hang pen a lungkhamsak hangin ahi hi, ci i thei tawp uh hi.

records.english: Looking for the cause of a child's bad mood is often more useful than punishing it.
records.zomi: Naupang khat' lungsim hoih lo a hang zong pen a gawtna sangin a phatuam zaw zel hi.

records.english: Sometimes the reason a child won't eat is simply that they ate too many snacks earlier.
records.zomi: Naupang khat in an a nek loh hang pen a ma-in an neu tampi a nek hang bek ahi zel hi.

records.english: Why is Grandma so tired these days?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tu laitakin Pi a gim mahmah hiam?

records.english: The doctor thinks her new tablets are making her sleepy.
records.zomi: A damdawi thakte in a ihmut sak hi, ci-in siavuan in a ngaihsun hi.

records.english: Why did the milk go off so quickly?
records.zomi: Bang hangin nawitui manlang takin a sia hiam?

records.english: The fridge door wasn't closed properly.
records.zomi: Fridge kongkhak hoih takin a kikhak kei hi.

records.english: How come you were so late coming home?
records.zomi: Bang hangin inn na tunna a nunung mahmah hiam?

records.english: I missed the bus and had to walk.
records.zomi: Bus ka mansuah a, ka pai kul hi.

records.english: Why did Grandpa stop going to church?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pu pawlpi ah a pai nawn kei hiam?

records.english: Our daughter's nightmares started when her best friend moved away.
records.zomi: A lawm hoih pen a pem ciangin i tanu' mangmuh lauhuaite a kipan hi.

records.english: Should Grandpa stop his other tablets before the operation?
records.zomi: Zatui ma-in Pu in a damdawi dangte a ne tawp ding hiam?

records.english: Only the blood thinners, three days beforehand.
records.zomi: Sisan nemsak damdawi bek, ni thum ma-in.

records.english: Where's the notebook where we write down Mum's doses?
records.zomi: Nu' damdawi zah i gelhna lai neu koi ah a om hiam?

records.english: Ignoring the instructions once made my father's recovery take twice as long.
records.zomi: Khatvei thuhilhna a zuih loh manin ka pa' damna a sawt zaw nih sak hi.

records.english: When parents follow medical instructions calmly, children learn to take their health seriously.
records.zomi: Nu leh pate in damdawi thuhilhna lungnem takin a zui uh ciangin naupangte in a damna uh thupi takin a ngaihsun dingin a sin uh hi.

records.english: I asked the pharmacist to put larger labels on Dad's tablet boxes.
records.zomi: Pa' damdawi bawmte tungah min gelhna lian zaw koih dingin damdawi zuakpa ka ngen hi.

records.english: Our son's inhaler came with a spacer, and the nurse showed him how to use it.
records.zomi: I tapa' inhaler spacer tawh a hong pai a, nurse in bangci zang ding hiam a lak hi.

records.english: Taking care of an elderly parent often means understanding instructions from several different doctors.
records.zomi: Nu hiam pa upa khat kem pen siavuan tuamtuam pan thuhilhnate theih kul cihna ahi zel hi.

records.english: The instructions said to give the medicine with food, so we waited until after supper.
records.zomi: Thuhilhna in damdawi an tawh pia in, a ci ahih manin nitak an khit dong i ngak uh hi.

records.english: Can you read me the instructions again, darling, because the writing is too small?
records.zomi: Ka it, laimal a neu lua ahih manin zatzia thu hong sim kik thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: My wife translated the hospital leaflet into simple words for her parents.
records.zomi: Ka zi in damdawi inn lai neu a nu leh a pa adingin kammal baih-in a let hi.

records.english: Dad pretends he understands the doctor, so I always ask for the instructions in writing.
records.zomi: Pa in siavuan' gen a thei bangin a kibawl ahih manin thuhilhna lai tawh gelh dingin ka ngen tawntung hi.

records.english: Dad wrote the instructions in big letters and taped them to the bathroom mirror.
records.zomi: Pa in thuhilhnate laimal lian tawh a gelh a, kisilna inn mailang tungah a kap hi.

records.english: My wife's mother trusts her own remedies more than the doctor's instructions.
records.zomi: Ka zi' nu in siavuan' thuhilhna sangin amah mah damdawi a muang zaw hi.

records.english: We read the instructions together before giving the baby her first dose.
records.zomi: Naungek' damdawi masa pen i piak ma-in zatzia thu khawm-in i sim uh hi.

records.english: Could you help me understand what the doctor meant by light exercise?
records.zomi: Thadah kisinsakna nem, siavuan in bang a ci nuam hiam ka theih nadingin hong huh thei ding na hi hiam?

records.english: My husband never reads instructions, so I read them for both of us.
records.zomi: Ka pasal in zatzia thu a sim ngei loh manin i nih adingin kei in ka sim hi.

records.english: My grandmother couldn't open the childproof caps, so the pharmacist gave her easy ones.
records.zomi: Ka pi in naupang hon theih loh khuhte a hong zo kei ahih manin damdawi zuakpa in hong baih khuh a pia hi.

records.english: Our family doctor writes down every instruction because she knows Dad forgets.
records.zomi: Pa a mangngilh zel a theih manin i innkuan siavuan in thuhilhna khempeuh a gelh hi.

records.english: We made a picture chart for our youngest so he could see when to use his cream.
records.zomi: I naupang neu pen in a cream bang hun-in a zat ding a theih nadingin lim tawh chart khat i bawl uh hi.

records.english: We made sure the babysitter knew exactly when to give the medicine.
records.zomi: Naupang cingtu in damdawi bang hun taktak-in a piak ding hiam a theih nadingin i en uh hi.

records.english: After the dentist, the instructions said no hot drinks for two hours.
records.zomi: Ha siavuan khit ciangin thuhilhna in nai nih sung dawn ding lum dawn kei in, a ci hi.

records.english: My cousin and I divided the instructions so that one of us did mornings and the other evenings.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam leh kei in thuhilhnate i kihawm a, khat in zingsang, khat in nitak a kem hi.

records.english: Auntie Mang nearly took her sleeping tablets in the morning because the labels looked alike.
records.zomi: Min gelhnate a kibat manin Ni Mang in a ihmut damdawi zingsang-in a ne kha dek hi.

records.english: My grandfather insists on reading every word of the leaflet before he takes anything.
records.zomi: Ka pu in bangmah a nek ma-in lai neu sung-a kammal khempeuh a sim tawntung hi.

records.english: When we didn't understand the instructions, our neighbour, who is a nurse, explained them to us.
records.zomi: Thuhilhnate i theih loh ciangin nurse hi i inn veng in hong genteh hi.

records.english: Did you remember to give the dog his tablet with his breakfast?
records.zomi: Ui' zingsang an tawh a damdawi pia ding na phawk hiam?

records.english: Let's write the times for each medicine on the calendar.
records.zomi: Calendar tungah damdawi khatciat' nek hun i gelh ding.

records.english: The nurse checked that my daughter could use the eye drops by herself before we went home.
records.zomi: Inn i ciah ma-in ka tanu in amah mah in mit damdawi a zang thei hiam nurse in a en hi.

records.english: How many drops did the nurse say for Grandma's ears?
records.zomi: Pi' bil adingin nurse in a tak bangzah a ci hiam?

records.english: Three in each ear, twice a day.
records.zomi: Bil khatciat ah thum, ni khat-in nihvei.

records.english: I set the oven timer to remind me when my son's next dose was due.
records.zomi: Ka tapa' damdawi a zom nek hun phawk nadingin oven timer ka koih hi.

records.english: My sister set alarms on Mum's phone for each of her doses.
records.zomi: Ka u numei in Nu' phone tungah damdawi nek hun khatciat adingin alarm a koih hi.

records.english: Understanding instructions properly is one of the best ways families can support a sick relative.
records.zomi: Thuhilhnate dik takin theih pen innkuante in sanggam natpa khat a huh theihna lampi hoih pen khat ahi hi.

records.english: After my mother's knee operation, the nurse gave us a long list of exercises.
records.zomi: Ka nu' khuk zatui khit ciangin nurse in thadah kisinsakna list sau khat hong pia hi.

records.english: Every evening, my brother read the list aloud while Mum did each exercise slowly.
records.zomi: Nitak simin Nu in kisinsakna khatciat dahdah-in a bawl laitakin ka u pasal in list aw ngaih takin a sim hi.

records.english: By the end of the month, she could walk to the shop again without a stick.
records.zomi: Kha tawp ciangin ciangkhut om lo-in sumbuk ah a pai kik thei hi.

records.english: Grandma keeps her instructions in a plastic folder in her handbag.
records.zomi: Pi in a thuhilhnate a khutpawh sung-a plastic folder khat sungah a kem hi.

records.english: Mum, why can't I have juice with this medicine?
records.zomi: Nu, bang hangin hih damdawi tawh theigah tui ka dawn thei kei hiam?

records.english: The doctor said juice stops it from working properly.
records.zomi: Theigah tui in a nasep a dal hi, siavuan in a ci hi.

records.english: Families who share the job of reading instructions make fewer mistakes with medicines.
records.zomi: Zatzia thu sim nasep a kihawm innkuante in damdawi tawh khialhna tawm zaw a nei uh hi.

records.english: Our son keeps his allergy instructions in his school bag.
records.zomi: I tapa in a natna ciat lahna thuhilhnate a sang ip sungah a kem hi.

records.english: My son copied the physiotherapist's drawings so that he wouldn't forget the stretches.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in a kizanna kisinsaknate a mangngilh loh nadingin physiotherapist' lim gelhte a gelh kik hi.

records.english: When instructions from two doctors seemed to contradict each other, we called the surgery to check.
records.zomi: Siavuan nih' thuhilhnate a kituak lo bangin a kilat ciangin en kik dingin clinic i sam uh hi.

records.english: Following the doctor's instructions became a family project when Grandma came to live with us.
records.zomi: Pi i kiang ah a hong teng ciangin siavuan' thuhilhnate zui pen innkuan nasep khat ah a suak hi.

records.english: Please don't give your brother any more of the syrup until four o'clock.
records.zomi: Nai li ma-in na nau pasal damdawi tui pia nawn kei in.

records.english: My wife and I kept rereading the instructions for the baby's medicine at three in the morning.
records.zomi: Zingkal nai thum-in ka zi leh kei in naungek' damdawi zatzia thu i sim kik den uh hi.

records.english: Do you understand when you should take each tablet, Grandma?
records.zomi: Pi, damdawi khatciat bang hun-in na nek ding hiam na thei hiam?

records.english: When my father came home from hospital, the instructions filled three pages.
records.zomi: Ka pa damdawi inn pan inn a tun ciangin thuhilhnate page thum a dim hi.

records.english: My parents finally understood the new diet after the dietitian visited them at home.
records.zomi: An nek ding thuhilhpa in inn ah a veh khit ciangin ka nu leh ka pa in an nekzia thak a thei tawp uh hi.

records.english: Thank you for making Grandpa's instructions so easy to follow.
records.zomi: Pu' thuhilhnate zui baih takin na bawl manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Our children know never to take medicine without asking an adult first.
records.zomi: I tate in mi upa dot masa lo-in damdawi ne ngei lo dingin a thei uh hi.

records.english: Shall we ask the nurse to show Grandpa how the pump works?
records.zomi: Pump bangci a sem hiam Pu kiangah lak dingin nurse i ngen ding hiam?

records.english: Is it two spoonfuls or one for a child of her age?
records.zomi: A kum naupang khat adingin keu nih hiam khat hiam?

records.english: My daughter explained the doctor's instructions to her grandmother in their own language.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in siavuan' thuhilhnate a pi kiangah amau pau tawh a genteh hi.

records.english: I stuck Grandpa's tablet chart on the fridge so that everyone could check he'd taken them.
records.zomi: Pu in a damdawi a ne khin hiam mi khempeuh in a en theih nadingin a damdawi chart fridge tungah ka kap hi.

records.english: Clear written instructions gave our whole family confidence when Dad came home from hospital.
records.zomi: Pa damdawi inn pan inn a tun ciangin kician taka kigelh thuhilhnate in i innkuan bup kimuanna hong pia hi.

records.english: Shall I call the clinic and ask what this instruction means?
records.zomi: Clinic sam-in hih thuhilhna bang a ci nuam hiam ka dong ding hiam?

records.english: Did the doctor say Grandpa could have a bath yet?
records.zomi: Pu kisil thei ta hi, siavuan in a ci hiam?

records.english: Not until the stitches come out next week.
records.zomi: Zom kal-a a liamna khui khauhte a kilak ma-in hi lo.

records.english: My parents saved money in a tin under the bed, but I use an app on my phone.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in lupna nuai-a sik bawm khat sungah sum a kem uh a, kei in ka phone tungah app khat ka zang hi.

records.english: Can our children even imagine a time when nobody had a mobile phone?
records.zomi: Kuamah in mobile phone a neih loh hun khat i tate in a ngaihsun thei uh hiam?

records.english: Shall we ask Grandma to teach us the songs she sang as a girl?
records.zomi: A nungak lai-a a sak late hong sinsak dingin Pi i ngen ding hiam?

records.english: My mother's generation was the first in our village to finish secondary school.
records.zomi: Ka nu' khang pen i khua-a high school a zo masa pen ahi uh hi.

records.english: My mother still writes shopping lists on the back of old envelopes.
