records.english: Dad, have you remembered your evening tablets?
records.zomi: Pa, na nitak damdawi na phawk hiam?

records.english: We bought a pill organiser with separate boxes for morning, lunch and evening.
records.zomi: Zingsang, sun leh nitak adingin bawm tuam nei damdawi koihna khat i lei uh hi.

records.english: We threw away all the old medicines we found when we cleared out Grandma's cupboard.
records.zomi: Pi' van koihna i siangsak ciangin i muh damdawi lui khempeuh i paikhia uh hi.

records.english: Our family keeps a basic first-aid box with plasters, a thermometer and children's painkillers.
records.zomi: I innkuan in plaster, lumna tehna leh naupang na-dalna damdawi tawh damsakna masa bawm khat a kem hi.

records.english: Why does Grandpa have to take his tablets at exactly the same time each day?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pu in ni simin hun kibang taktak-in a damdawi a ne kul hiam?

records.english: Does your little brother know which inhaler is for emergencies?
records.zomi: Na nau pasal in bang inhaler lauhuai hun adingin hiam a thei hiam?

records.english: Children's medicine should always be given with the measuring spoon that comes in the box.
records.zomi: Naupang damdawi bawm sung-a hong pai tehna keu tawh kipia den ding hi.

records.english: Can you remind me whether Grandma takes the white tablet before or after breakfast?
records.zomi: Pi in damdawi kang zingsang an ma hiam khit hiam a ne hiam hong phawk sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Please put the medicine back in the high cupboard when you've finished.
records.zomi: Na zawh ciangin damdawi van koihna sang ah koih kik in.

records.english: Grandpa's medicines travel with us in a small bag that never leaves my side.
records.zomi: Pu' damdawite ka kiang pan a pai ngei lo ip neu khat sungah hong zui uh hi.

records.english: The pharmacist warned us that the baby's medicine must be shaken well each time.
records.zomi: Naungek' damdawi khatvei simin hoih takin hih ding hi, ci-in damdawi zuakpa in hong lau sak hi.

records.english: My mother found the money I had taken from her purse and asked me to explain.
records.zomi: Ka nu in a sum ip pan ka lak sum a mu a, genteh dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: My sister told our parents she had dented the car before they could notice.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa a phawk ma-un mawtaw a sukkhiap hi, ci-in ka u numei in a gen hi.

records.english: Our son admitted that he had broken the neighbour's window, and he paid for it from his pocket money.
records.zomi: I tapa in inn veng' tohkhawng a tam hi, ci-in a pom a, a khut sum tawh a man a pia hi.

records.english: I'm sorry I lied to you, Mum.
records.zomi: Nu, kong zuauthei manin hong maisak in.

records.english: Is it wrong to tell Grandpa his cooking is lovely when it isn't?
records.zomi: Pu' an huan a lim kei napi-in a lim hi, ci-a gen a khial hiam?

records.english: It's kind, but it might be better to praise what you really liked.
records.zomi: A hehpihhuai hi, ahi zongin na uk taktak na phat a hoih zaw thei hi.

records.english: When I was seven, I hid my school report, and Mum found it under my mattress.
records.zomi: Kum sagih ka hih lai-in ka sang ciamtehna ka sel a, Nu in ka lupna phah nuai ah a mu hi.

records.english: My grandfather handed a stranger's lost bag in at the police station, even though our family was very poor.
records.zomi: I innkuan a zawng mahmah napi-in ka pu in mi theih ngei lo khat' ip mangsa police inn ah a ap hi.

records.english: Did you eat the biscuits I was saving for Grandma?
records.zomi: Pi adingin ka kem biscuit na ne hiam?

records.english: Yes, I'm sorry; I'll help you bake some more.
records.zomi: Ka ne hi, hong maisak in; a dang na bawl dingin kong huh ding hi.

records.english: I told Grandma that I had broken her teapot, and she just hugged me.
records.zomi: A niangtui bel ka sukkham hi, ci-in Pi ka gen a, hong kawi bek hi.

records.english: My cousin returned the extra money the bank had paid into his account.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in bank in a account ah a behlap-a a piak sum a ap kik hi.

records.english: When my brother was a teenager, he borrowed Dad's watch without asking and lost it.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal tangval no a hih lai-in dot lo-in Pa' khutkhai a la a, a mansuah hi.

records.english: He spent a week trying to find it before he finally told Dad the truth.
records.zomi: Pa kiangah thu dik a gen ma-in kal khat sung a zong hi.

records.english: Dad said he was sad about the watch but proud that my brother had been honest.
records.zomi: Khutkhai tungtang a lungkham hi, ahi zongin ka u pasal' thu dik genna adingin a kipak hi, Pa in a ci hi.

records.english: My sister admitted she'd read my diary, and I forgave her eventually.
records.zomi: Ka u numei in ka nitum ciamtehna bu a sim hi, ci-in a pom a, a tawpna-ah ka maisak hi.

records.english: Who left the gate open, children?
records.zomi: Naupangte, kongpi kua in a hong nusia hiam?

records.english: Dad, I have to tell you something, and please don't be angry.
records.zomi: Pa, thu khat kong gen kul hi, na heh kei in.

records.english: My brother and I agreed never to lie to our parents about where we were going.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal leh kei koi ah i pai ding uh hiam ka nu leh ka pa i zuau ngei lo dingin i kituak uh hi.

records.english: We were proud when our son told the referee that the ball had touched his hand.
records.zomi: I tapa in ball in a khut a khoih hi, ci-in thukhenpa a gen ciangin i kipak uh hi.

records.english: Tell me the truth, and I promise I won't shout.
records.zomi: Thu dik hong gen in, ka kikou kei ding hi, kong kiciam hi.

records.english: Who told you that it was all right to lie to your sister?
records.zomi: Na u numei zuau a pha hi, kua in hong gen hiam?

records.english: Our daughter told her friend's mother that the friend was in trouble, because she was worried about her.
records.zomi: I tanu in a lawm tungtang a lungkham ahih manin a lawm buaina sungah a om hi, ci-in a lawm' nu kiangah a gen hi.

records.english: Shall we tell Mum together that we lost the house key?
records.zomi: Inn tawh i mansuah hi, ci-in Nu i khawm-in i gen ding hiam?

records.english: My husband admitted that he had forgotten our anniversary, and we laughed about it.
records.zomi: I kitenna kum lawmni a mangngilh hi, ci-in ka pasal in a pom a, i nuih uh hi.

records.english: My father taught us that a promise is something you keep even when nobody is watching.
records.zomi: Kiciamna pen kuamah in a en kei zongin kem ding na ahi hi, ci-in ka pa in hong sinsak hi.

records.english: Grandpa says honesty is the only thing he ever had to give his children.
records.zomi: Thu dik gen pen a tate a piak theih na khat bek ahi hi, Pu in a ci hi.

records.english: My daughter pointed out to the waiter that he had forgotten to charge us for the drinks.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in an zuakpa dawn ding man a pia lo hi, ci-in a lak hi.

records.english: My grandmother never pretended to like food she didn't enjoy, but she always said it politely.
records.zomi: Ka pi in a uk loh an a uk bangin a kibawl ngei kei a, ahi zongin nem takin a gen tawntung hi.

records.english: Honest answers from parents help children feel safe, even when the news is bad.
records.zomi: Thu a hoih kei zongin nu leh pate' dik taka dawnna in naupangte a bitsak hi.

records.english: Can I trust you to tell me the truth about tonight?
records.zomi: Tu zan thu dik hong gen ding kong muang thei ding hiam?

records.english: Thank you for telling me the truth, darling.
records.zomi: Ka it, thu dik hong gen manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Children trust parents who are honest with them about difficult things.
records.zomi: Haksa thute tungtang dik taka a gen nu leh pate naupangte in a muang uh hi.

records.english: In our family, the worst punishments were always for lying, not for mistakes.
records.zomi: I innkuan ah gawtna gik pen pen khialhna adingin hi lo-in zuauna adingin ahi tawntung hi.

records.english: Is it ever right to keep a secret from your family?
records.zomi: Na innkuan pan thuguk sel a dik ngei hiam?

records.english: Admitting my own mistakes to my children has made them more honest with me.
records.zomi: Ka khialhnate ka tate kiangah ka pom in kei tawh a dik zaw uh hi.

records.english: Owning up was hard, but Mum's face told me it had been worth it.
records.zomi: Pom a haksa hi, ahi zongin Nu' maitang in a phatuam hi, ci hong lak hi.

records.english: How do we teach our children to own up to small mistakes?
records.zomi: Khialhna neute pom dingin i tate bangci i sinsak ding uh hiam?

records.english: My wife's honesty about our money worries helped us make a plan together.
records.zomi: I sum lungkhamna tungtang ka zi' thu dik genna in khawm-in ngaihsutna khat i bawl theih nadingin hong huh hi.

records.english: Why is it so hard to admit a mistake to your parents?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na nu leh na pa kiangah khialhna pom a haksa mahmah hiam?

records.english: Our son confessed that he had copied his friend's answers, and he asked to retake the test.
records.zomi: I tapa in a lawm' dawnnate a gelh kik hi, ci-in a pom a, sitna kik dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: My parents always told us the truth about where babies came from, in simple words.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in naungekte koi pan hong pai hiam kammal baih takin thu dik hong gen tawntung uh hi.

records.english: When Grandpa was ill, my parents were honest with us about how serious it was.
records.zomi: Pu a nat ciangin ka nu leh ka pa in bangzah a gik hiam dik takin hong gen uh hi.

records.english: My son told his teacher that he hadn't done his homework instead of making up an excuse.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in a hang khat a gelh sangin a inn nasep a bawl kei hi, ci-in a saya kiangah a gen hi.

records.english: It's better that I heard it from you than from Dad.

records.english: Telling my parents the truth about my grades was the hardest thing I did at secondary school.

records.english: Can you be honest with me about whether you liked the present?
records.zomi: Letsong na uk hiam dik takin hong gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our grandparents never kept secrets from each other in sixty years of marriage, or so they say.
records.zomi: I pu leh i pi in a kitenna kum sawmguk sungin thuguk a kisel ngei kei uh hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: My father lost a good business deal because he refused to lie about the quality of his rice.

records.english: My aunt has always been honest with her children about the family's money problems.
records.zomi: Ka ni in innkuan sum buainate tungtang a tate kiangah thu dik a gen tawntung hi.

records.english: Mum always says that a hard truth is better than a kind lie.
records.zomi: Thu dik haksa pen zuau hehpihhuai sangin a hoih zaw hi, Nu in a ci tawntung hi.

records.english: My uncle refused to sign a false document for his boss, even though he lost his job.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu in a nasep a mansuah zongin a makaipa adingin lai zuau khat ah a min gelh a nial hi.

records.english: I was punished for lying, not for breaking the vase, and I've never forgotten that lesson.
records.zomi: Paak bel ka sukkham hangin hi lo-in ka zuau hangin kigawt hi ka hi a, tua sinna ka mangngilh ngei kei hi.

records.english: My little brother confessed that he had fed his vegetables to the dog.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal neu in a anteh ui a nek sak hi, ci-in a pom hi.

records.english: Honesty in a marriage means telling each other the small worries as well as the big ones.
records.zomi: Kitenna sung-a thu dik gen in lungkhamna neu leh lian a nih kigen cihna ahi hi.

records.english: Why didn't you tell us you'd lost your job?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na nasep na mansuah hi, hong gen kei hiam?

records.english: I was ashamed, and I hoped I'd find another one first.
records.zomi: Ka zum a, a dang khat ka mu masa ding ka lamen hi.

records.english: What would you do if you found out your brother had lied to you?
records.zomi: Na u pasal in hong zuau hi, ci na theih leh bang na bawl ding hiam?

records.english: Grandma used to say that people forget your money but remember your honesty.

records.english: Did you tell your father the truth about the party?

records.english: Students may bring a packed lunch or buy a meal in the canteen.

records.english: The catering contract includes breakfast, lunch and two coffee breaks each day.

records.english: The kitchen closes at ten, but light meals are available from room service until midnight.
records.zomi: Anbuk nai sawm ciangin kikhak a, ahi zongin an neu deuhte room service pan zan laizang dong kingah thei hi.

records.english: May I ask what the dress code is for the formal dinner?

records.english: Black tie, and dinner jackets can be hired in the hotel.
records.zomi: Black tie, dinner jacket te zinbuuk ah kihawh thei hi.

records.english: The menu for the official dinner was approved by the protocol office.

records.english: All staff handling food must complete a food safety course.

records.english: The dinner was followed by speeches and a formal toast to the bride and groom.
records.zomi: Nitak an khit ciangin thugennate leh mo leh mopa adingin haai kilap kizahtakna a om hi.

records.english: Shall we ask the caterers to provide a cake for the retirement lunch?
records.zomi: Nasep tawpna sun an adingin an huante cake khat bawl dingin i ngen ding hiam?

records.english: The seating plan places the guest of honour to the right of the host.

records.english: Formal place settings have the forks on the left and the knives on the right.

records.english: The government has introduced new rules on the amount of sugar in school meals.

records.english: Water and fruit juice will be served throughout the ceremony.
records.zomi: Pawi sung bup tui leh theigah tui kipia ding hi.

records.english: Do you have a children's menu?
records.zomi: Naupangte adingin menu na nei uh hiam?

records.english: The army provides three meals a day to every soldier on duty.
records.zomi: Galkap in nasep sung-a galkap khempeuh ni khat-in an thum a pia hi.

records.english: Dinner is included for guests who book the full-board package.

records.english: Food labels must list every ingredient in order of weight.

records.english: Allergen information for every dish is available from the serving staff.
records.zomi: An khatciat-a natna ciat piangsak thei na thu an hawmte kiang pan kingah thei hi.

records.english: The state banquet was attended by two hundred guests from twelve countries.

records.english: Restaurants must tell customers if a dish contains nuts.

records.english: Please indicate any dietary requirements on the registration form.

records.english: School lunches must meet the national standards for healthy eating.

records.english: Is there a fee for bringing your own cake to the restaurant?
records.zomi: An nekna inn ah na cake na paipih leh man a om hiam?

records.english: Free school meals are available to children from families on low incomes.

records.english: Please confirm your menu choices by Friday.

records.english: Ladies and gentlemen, please raise your glasses to our guests.

records.zomi: Zinbuuk mikhualte in inn kemte sam-in hun bangkim ah puan zawl thak a ngen thei uh hi.

records.english: Is clean bedding provided for each new guest at the hostel?
records.zomi: Hostel ah mikhual thak khatciat adingin lupna puan siangtho kipia hiam?

records.english: Hazardous products are kept in a locked store with a list of their contents on the door.
records.zomi: Lauhuai vante kikhak van koihna ah koih-in a sung-a omte list kongkhak tungah kap hi.

records.english: A clean and orderly workplace is part of the company's health and safety policy.
records.zomi: Nasepna mun siangtho leh kician pen company' damna leh bitna thukham sung-a khat ahi hi.

records.english: Is the cleaning of the windows included in the service charge?
records.zomi: Tohkhawng siangsakna nasep man sungah kihel hiam?

records.english: The paper recycling is collected from each floor on Thursday mornings.
records.zomi: Zat kik theih laite Laizing ni zingsang simin dawh khatciat pan kila hi.

records.english: The school inspector checked that the toilets were cleaned regularly.
records.zomi: Sang entu in eek innte ciangtan-in a kisiangsak hiam a en hi.

records.english: Do I need to wear gloves when using this cleaning product?
records.zomi: Hih siangsakna van ka zat ciangin khut-ip ka bulh kul hiam?

records.english: Yes, the safety sheet says gloves and eye protection are required.
records.zomi: Bulh kul hi, bitna lai in khut-ip leh mit kemna a kisam hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Are visitors allowed to leave their bags in the corridor?
records.zomi: Vehte in a ip uh lampi kong ah a nusia thei uh hiam?

records.english: The building's rules require tenants to keep balconies free of rubbish.
records.zomi: Building thukhamte in inn hawhte in balcony nawi om lo-in a kem ding uh a ngen hi.

records.english: Old electrical equipment must be taken to an approved recycling point.
records.zomi: Meivak vanzat luite kipom zat kik theihna mun ah kipaipih ding hi.

records.english: Litter bins in the park are emptied every morning by council workers.
records.zomi: Huan lian sung-a nawi binte zingsang simin khuapi office nasemte in a sung uh a lakhia uh hi.

records.english: All rooms will be cleaned between ten and two; please put out the sign if you do not wish to be disturbed.
records.zomi: Khan khempeuh nai sawm leh nai nih kikal ah kisiangsak ding a; buaisak na deih kei leh lim lai pualam ah koih in.

records.english: The office cleaning contract covers vacuuming, emptying bins and cleaning the toilets.
records.zomi: Office siangsakna contract in vacuum, nawi bin lakhiatna leh eek inn siangsakna a huam hi.

records.english: Who should I inform if the cleaning hasn't been done properly?
records.zomi: Siangsakna a hoih takin a kibawl kei leh kua kiangah ka gen ding hiam?

records.english: Please sign the cleaning record each time you clean the staff kitchen.
records.zomi: Nasemte anbuk na siangsak simin siangsakna ciamtehna ah min gelh in.

records.english: The kitchen must be deep-cleaned once a month, according to the food safety plan.
records.zomi: An bitna gelhna bangin anbuk kha simin khatvei kisiangsak bup ding hi.

records.english: The hotel's housekeeping standards require every room to be inspected after cleaning.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk' inn kemna gi in khan khatciat a kisiangsak khit ciangin kien ding hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Records must be stored in labelled boxes for at least seven years.
records.zomi: Ciamtehnate min gelh bawmte sungah a tawm pen-in kum sagih sung kikem ding hi.

records.english: The school caretaker follows a written timetable for cleaning the toilets and corridors.
records.zomi: Sang inn kemtu in eek inn leh lampi kongte siangsakna adingin a kigelh hun ciamteh a zui hi.

records.english: Kindly return the cleaning equipment to the storeroom after use.
records.zomi: Na zat khit ciangin siangsakna vanzatte van koihna khan ah koih kik in.

records.english: Which cupboard are the mops and buckets stored in?
records.zomi: Leilak nawtna leh tui bawmte bang van koihna ah kikoih hiam?

records.english: We appreciate your help in keeping the building clean.
records.zomi: Building siangtho-a i kem nadingin na huh manin ka lungdam uh hi.

records.english: The lost property office keeps items for thirty days before they are disposed of.
records.zomi: Van mangsa office in van te a paikhiat ma-un ni sawmthum sung a kem hi.

records.english: Contract cleaners must sign in and out at the security desk.
records.zomi: Contract siangsakte in bitna dawhkan ah a lut leh a pusuak ciangin a min uh a gelh ding uh hi.

records.english: The market traders are required to sweep their pitches before they leave.
records.zomi: Sumbuk mun van zuakte in a pai ma-un a mun uh a phiat ding uh hi.

records.english: Please do not leave dirty cups in the meeting rooms.
records.zomi: Kikhopna khante ah haai nin nusia kei un.

records.english: The council collects hazardous household waste, such as old paint and batteries, by appointment.
records.zomi: Khuapi office in sathau rong lui leh battery bang inn sung lauhuai nawite kimuhna tawh a la hi.

records.english: The town hall is cleaned every evening after public meetings.
records.zomi: Mipi kikhopna khit ciangin nitak simin khuapi inn kisiangsak hi.

records.english: Personal belongings left in the changing room overnight will be removed.
records.zomi: Puan kheelna khan ah zan bup a kinusia mimal vante kila ding hi.

records.english: A safety data sheet must be kept for every chemical used on the premises.
records.zomi: Mun sungah a kizang zatui khatciat adingin bitna thu lai khat kikem ding hi.

records.english: Rubbish must be tied in bags before it is placed in the communal bins.
records.zomi: Nawite mipi nawi bin ah na koih ma-in ip sungah khih in.

records.english: The housekeeping manager checks each floor before the guests return.
records.zomi: Mikhualte a ciah kik ma-un inn kemte makaipa in dawh khatciat a en hi.

records.english: All surfaces in the laboratory must be wiped down at the end of each experiment.
records.zomi: Sitna khatciat tawpna ciangin laboratory sung-a dawhkan tung khempeuh kisiangsak ding hi.

records.english: Will the office be closed on Saturday for the carpet clean?
records.zomi: Carpet siangsakna adingin Kiginni ciangin office kikhak ding hiam?

records.english: Each patient's room is disinfected after they are discharged.
records.zomi: Natpa khatciat damdawi inn a nusiat khit ciangin a khan natna lungno thahna tawh kisiangsak hi.

records.english: Each department is responsible for keeping its own filing system in order.
records.zomi: Department khatciat in amau lai koihna system kician-in a kem ding uh hi.

records.english: Spillages of oil must be covered with sand and reported to the site manager.
records.zomi: Sathau buakte nel tawh khuh-in mun makaipa kiangah gen ding hi.

records.english: Gloves and aprons are provided for all staff who clean the toilets.
records.zomi: Eek inn siangsak nasem khempeuh adingin khut-ip leh puan khuh kipia hi.

records.english: Christians often say that holiness is seen most clearly in love.
records.zomi: Siangthona pen kiitna ah kician pen-in kimu hi, ci-in Khristiante in a gen zel uh hi.

records.english: Does a Christian become perfect straight away?
records.zomi: Khristian khat pha pah-in a kicing hiam?

records.english: Growth in holiness takes a whole lifetime, according to most Christian traditions.
records.zomi: Khristian ngeina tamzaw bangin siangthona-a khanna in nuntakna bup a la hi.

records.english: In the Bible, Paul tells the Thessalonians that God wants them to be holy.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho sungah Paul in Thessalonika mite kiangah Pasian in na siangthona uh a deih hi, a ci hi.

records.english: My grandmother says she has become more patient every year since she became a Christian.
records.zomi: Khristian a suah pan kipan kum simin ka lungduai semsem hi, ka pi in a ci hi.

records.english: Gentleness and faithfulness are also listed among the fruit of the Spirit.
records.zomi: Lungnemna leh diktatna zong Kha Siangtho gah lak ah kigelh hi.

records.english: Christians believe that holiness is a gift from God, not a reward for good behaviour.
records.zomi: Siangthona pen Pasian' letsong ahi a, gamtat hoih man hi lo hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: Please pray for me as I try to become more forgiving.
records.zomi: Mi maisak theih zawk nadingin ka hanciam laitakin hong thungetsak un.

records.english: Christians believe that forgiveness is part of growing in holiness.
records.zomi: Maisakna pen siangthona-a khanna sung-a khat ahi hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: Our church teaches that every believer is a work in progress.
records.zomi: Upmi khatciat pen nasep a kizom lai khat ahi hi, ci-in i pawlpi in a hilh hi.

records.english: Love, joy and peace are the first three qualities in Paul's list of the fruit of the Spirit.
records.zomi: Kiitna, lungdamna leh kilemna pen Paul' Kha Siangtho gah list sung-a a masa thumte ahi hi.

records.english: Many Christians say that the Spirit changes people from the inside.
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho in mite a sung lam pan a kheel hi, ci-in Khristian tampi in a gen uh hi.

records.english: What does it mean to be sanctified?
records.zomi: Siangthosak cih bang cihna hiam?

records.english: In the Bible, it means to set something apart for God.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho sungah Pasian adingin na khat a tuam-a koih cihna ahi hi.

records.english: Spiritual growth is usually slow and quiet, like seeds growing in the ground.
records.zomi: Kha lam khanna a tamzaw-in leilak-a khaici a khan bangin dahdah leh dai takin a om hi.

records.english: In Christian teaching, growing in holiness includes both stopping wrong things and doing good ones.
records.zomi: Khristian hilhna ah siangthona-a khanna in na khial bawl tawp leh na hoih bawl a nih a huam hi.

records.english: The Sunday school children made a poster of the fruit of the Spirit.
records.zomi: Nipini sang naupangte in Kha Siangtho gah poster khat a bawl uh hi.

records.english: In the end, Christian teaching says, being made holy is the work of the Holy Spirit.
records.zomi: A tawpna-ah siangthosak pen Kha Siangtho' nasep ahi hi, ci-in Khristian hilhna in a gen hi.

records.english: Is sanctification something a person does, or something God does?
records.zomi: Siangthosakna pen mi khat in a bawl hiam, Pasian in a bawl hiam?

records.english: Many Christian teachers say it is the work of God, but that believers are called to cooperate.
records.zomi: Khristian hilhpa tampi in Pasian' nasep ahi a, ahi zongin upmite in a kithuah dingin kisam uh hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: Is it possible to grow in holiness without belonging to a church?
records.zomi: Pawlpi khat ah kihel lo-in siangthona ah khang thei hiam?

records.english: The pastor reminded us that holiness is not the same as looking serious.
records.zomi: Siangthona pen maitang khauh tawh kibang lo hi, ci-in pastor in hong phawk sak hi.

records.english: Let's pray that God will help us become more patient this week.
records.zomi: Hih kal sungin lungduai zawk nadingin Pasian in hong huh nadingin thu i ngen ni.

records.english: Can the Spirit help a Christian love someone they find difficult?
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho in Khristian khat a it haksat mi khat it dingin a huh thei hiam?

records.english: Some churches stress gradual growth, while others speak of a decisive moment of change.
records.zomi: Pawlpi pawl khat in dahdah-a khanna a ngaihsut thupi uh a, a dangte in kikheelna hun thupi khat thu a gen uh hi.

records.english: Why do Christians talk about holiness as a journey?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Khristiante in siangthona khualzinna bangin a gen uh hiam?

records.english: Christian teaching speaks of the Spirit giving strength to resist temptation.
records.zomi: Khristian hilhna in Kha Siangtho in sitna a do theih nadingin hatna a pia hi, ci-in a gen hi.

records.english: Christians often pray for help to overcome bad habits.
records.zomi: Khristiante in ngeina hoih lote a zawh theih nadingun huhna adingin thu a ngen zel uh hi.

records.english: Christians pray that the Holy Spirit will make them more loving.
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho in a it zawk nadingin hong bawl hen, ci-in Khristiante in thu a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Some Christians fast as a way of focusing on spiritual growth.
records.zomi: Khristian pawl khat in Kha lam khanna ah lungsim a kaikhawm nadingin an a ngawl uh hi.

records.english: Many believers say that they notice their growth only when they look back over many years.
records.zomi: Upmi tampi in kum tampi a en kik uh ciangin bek a khanna uh a mu uh hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: Christians often meet in small groups to encourage each other's spiritual growth.
records.zomi: Khristiante in khat leh khat Kha lam khanna a kihanthawn nadingun pawl neu-in a kikhawm zel uh hi.

records.english: In the Orthodox tradition, the goal of the Christian life is often described as union with God.
records.zomi: Orthodox ngeina ah Khristian nuntakna ngimna pen Pasian tawh kipumkhatna bangin kigen zel hi.

records.english: Some churches teach that believers can reach a deeper stage of holiness in this life.
records.zomi: Pawlpi pawl khat in upmite hih nuntakna sungah siangthona thuk zaw khat a tun thei uh hi, ci-in a hilh uh hi.

records.english: My father says he used to lose his temper easily, but prayer has changed him.
records.zomi: Ka pa in ka heh baih ngei hi, a ci a, ahi zongin thungetna in amah a kheel hi.

records.english: According to many Christians, the Holy Spirit is slowly shaping believers to be more like Jesus.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi' gen bangin Kha Siangtho in upmite Jesu bang zaw-in dahdah-in a bawl hi.

records.english: Can a person become kinder by praying for it?
records.zomi: Mi khat in a ngetna tawh a hehpih zaw thei hiam?

records.english: Could an older church member help you grow in your faith?
records.zomi: Pawlpi mi upa khat in na upna sungah khang dingin hong huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Do Christians believe that they can lose their holiness?
records.zomi: Khristiante in a siangthona uh a mansuah thei uh hi, ci-in a um uh hiam?

records.english: Christian traditions give different answers to that question.
records.zomi: Khristian ngeina tuamtuamte in tua dotna adingin dawnna tuamtuam a pia uh hi.

records.english: Thank you for praying that I would grow in patience.
records.zomi: Lungduaina ah ka khan nadingin thu hong ngetsak manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Christians often describe sanctification as a lifelong process.
records.zomi: Khristiante in siangthosakna nuntak sung kalsuan khat bangin a gen zel uh hi.

records.english: Christians are encouraged to confess their sins and ask for help to change.
records.zomi: Khristiante a mawhnate uh pulak-in kikheel nadingin huhna ngen dingin kihanthawn uh hi.

records.english: How can young people grow in faith at school?
records.zomi: Khangnote sang ah a upna uh ah bangci a khang thei uh hiam?

records.english: How does holiness show itself in the way people treat others?
records.zomi: Siangthona in mite' midangte a bawlzia ah bangci a kilang hiam?

records.english: Growing in holiness does not mean that a Christian stops making mistakes.
records.zomi: Siangthona-a khanna in Khristian khat in khialhna bawl a tawp hi, cihna hi lo hi.

records.english: Our youth group talked about what it means to live a holy life at school.
records.zomi: I khangno pawl in sang ah siangtho nuntakna nuntak cih bang cihna hiam a kihopih uh hi.

records.english: Paul writes that believers are being changed from one degree of glory to another.
records.zomi: Upmite vangliatna khat pan khat ah a kikheel uh hi, ci-in Paul in a gelh hi.

records.english: Many believers say that suffering has helped them grow closer to God.
records.zomi: Upmi tampi in thuakna in Pasian kiangah naih zaw dingin hong huh hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: Prayer and Bible reading are seen by many Christians as ways to grow in faith.
records.zomi: Thungetna leh Laisiangtho sim pen Khristian tampi in upna-a khanna lampi bangin a mu uh hi.

records.english: Some traditions emphasise the role of the sacraments in a believer's growth in grace.
records.zomi: Ngeina pawl khat in upmi khat' hehpihna-a khanna ah sacrament te nasep a ngaihsut thupi uh hi.

records.english: How can a person tell whether they are growing in holiness?
records.zomi: Mi khat in siangthona ah a khang hiam bangci a thei thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our pastor says that becoming holy is like a tree growing slowly.
records.zomi: Siangtho suah pen sing khat dahdah-a khan bang ahi hi, ci-in i pastor in a gen hi.

records.english: Many Christians see daily choices as part of the Spirit's work in them.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in ni sim teelnate amaute sung-a Kha Siangtho' nasep sung-a khat bangin a mu uh hi.

records.english: Self-control is the last quality in Paul's list of the fruit of the Spirit.
records.zomi: Pumpi deihna khamna pen Paul' Kha Siangtho gah list sung-a a nunung pen ahi hi.

records.english: In Christian teaching, sanctification means being made holy.
records.zomi: Khristian hilhna ah siangthosakna in siangtho-a kibawl cihna ahi hi.

records.english: Holiness in everyday life might mean being honest at work or patient with children.
records.zomi: Ni sim nuntakna sung-a siangthona pen nasep mun ah thu dik gen hiam naupangte tungah lungduai cihna ahi thei hi.

records.english: Which qualities does Paul call the fruit of the Spirit?
records.zomi: Paul in bang hoihnate Kha Siangtho gah a ci hiam?

records.english: Our pastor said that small acts of kindness are signs of spiritual growth.
records.zomi: Hehpihna neu deuhte pen Kha lam khanna lahna ahi hi, ci-in i pastor in a gen hi.

records.english: According to Paul, patience and kindness are also signs of the Spirit at work.
records.zomi: Paul' gen bangin lungduaina leh mite hehpihna zong Kha Siangtho' nasep lahna ahi hi.

records.english: What do I need to bring to the exam?
records.zomi: Sitna adingin bang ka paipih ding hiam?

records.english: Two pens, a pencil, a ruler and your student card.
records.zomi: Pen nih, khedawng khat, tehna khat leh na sangnaupang card.

records.english: What password do I use for the classroom computer?
records.zomi: Khan sung-a computer adingin password bang ka zang ding hiam?

records.english: Ask the IT office, because it changes every month.
records.zomi: IT office dong in, kha simin a kikheel ahih manin.

records.english: What should I do if I finish the test early?
records.zomi: Sitna ka zawh ma leh bang ka bawl ding hiam?

records.english: Check your answers, and then read quietly until everyone has finished.
records.zomi: Na dawnnate en kik in, tua khit ciangin mi khempeuh a zawh dong dai takin sim in.

records.english: Students who ask what the marking criteria are usually write more focused essays.
records.zomi: Nambat piakna thukhamte a dong sangnaupangte in a tamzaw-in lai kician zaw a gelh uh hi.

records.english: What steps would you take if a colleague kept missing deadlines?
records.zomi: Nasep lawm khat in hun tawpnate a mansuah den leh bang na bawl ding hiam?

records.english: I'd speak to them privately first and ask whether something was wrong.
records.zomi: A masa-in amah kia tawh ka kihopih ding a, bangmah a sia hiam ka dong ding hi.

records.english: What equipment do we need for the experiment?
records.zomi: Sitna adingin bang vanzatte i kisam uh hiam?

records.english: Two beakers, a thermometer and some ice.
records.zomi: Beaker nih, lumna tehna khat leh tuikhal tawmno.

records.english: What a teacher asks at the start of a lesson often shapes how students think about the topic.
records.zomi: Sinna kipat ciangin saya in a dot thu in sangnaupangte in thu tungtang bangci a ngaihsun uh hiam a kheel zel hi.

records.english: What a manager praises in public often tells employees what the company really values.
records.zomi: Makaipa khat in mipi mai-a a phat in company in bang taktak a ngaihsut thupi hiam nasemte a lak zel hi.

records.english: What would be the best way to revise for the history exam?
records.zomi: Tangthu sitna adingin sinkik nading lampi hoih pen bang hi ding hiam?

records.english: Make a timeline of the main events and test yourself on it.
records.zomi: Thupiang thupite hun kizui lim khat bawl-in nangmah mah kisit in.

records.english: What happened at the meeting this morning?
records.zomi: Tu zingsang kikhopna ah bang a piang hiam?

records.english: The manager announced that the office will move next year.
records.zomi: Kum zom ciangin office a pem ding hi, ci-in makaipa in a gen hi.

records.english: What grade did you get for your essay?
records.zomi: Na lai gelh adingin bang nambat na ngah hiam?

records.english: A B, but the teacher said my conclusion was excellent.
records.zomi: B khat, ahi zongin ka tawpna a hoih mahmah hi, saya in a ci hi.

records.english: What page are we on?
records.zomi: Bang page ah i om uh hiam?

records.english: Page forty-two, the exercise at the top.
records.zomi: Page sawmli leh nih, a tung-a kisinna.

records.english: What homework did we get for tomorrow?
records.zomi: Zingciang adingin bang inn nasep i ngah uh hiam?

records.english: Read chapter three and answer the questions at the end.
records.zomi: Dawh thumna sim-in a tawpna-a dotnate dawng in.

records.english: Interviewers often ask what you learned from a mistake, because the answer shows how you think.
records.zomi: Kidotna bawlte in khialhna khat pan bang na sin hiam a dong zel uh a, a dawnna in na ngaihsutzia a lak hi.

records.english: What's the name of the new manager?
records.zomi: Makaipa thak' min bang hiam?

records.english: Mrs. Ngaih, and she starts on Monday.
records.zomi: Nu Ngaih, Pizing ni ciangin a kipan ding hi.

records.english: What time should we arrive for the staff meeting?
records.zomi: Nasemte kikhopna adingin bang hun-in i tun ding uh hiam?

records.english: At half past three, in the library.
records.zomi: Nai thum leh a lang ciangin, laibu inn ah.

records.english: What are the main duties of a lab assistant?
records.zomi: Lab huhtu' nasep thupite bang hiam?

records.english: Preparing equipment, cleaning up after experiments and ordering supplies.
records.zomi: Vanzatte kiginsak, sitna khit ciangin siangsak leh van ngetna.

records.english: What are your strengths, would you say?
records.zomi: Na hatnate bang hi ding hiam, na ci hiam?

records.english: I'm organised and good at explaining things clearly.
records.zomi: Ka kician a, na kician takin genteh ka siam hi.

records.english: What does this word in the second paragraph mean?
records.zomi: Paragraph nihna sung-a hih kammal bang cihna hiam?

records.english: It means very old, so try to guess from the sentence.
records.zomi: A lui mahmah cihna ahi a, tua ahih manin thugen pan ngaihsun in.

records.english: What subject do you have first on Monday?
records.zomi: Pizing ni ciangin bang sinna a masa pen-in na nei hiam?

records.english: Maths, and then a double lesson of science.
records.zomi: Maths, tua khit ciangin science sinna nih kizom.

records.english: What did the head teacher say in assembly?
records.zomi: Sang makaipa in zingsang kikhopna ah bang a gen hiam?

records.english: That sports day has been moved to next Thursday.
records.zomi: Tai kidemna ni a zom Laizing ni ah kisuan hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Asking what exactly is expected before starting a task can save hours of work.
records.zomi: Nasep khat na kipat ma-in bang taktak kingaklah hiam dot in nasep nai tampi a kemsak thei hi.

records.english: What day is the project due?
records.zomi: Project bang ni ciangin kipia ding hiam?

records.english: Friday at five, by email.
records.zomi: Laithai ni nai nga ciangin, email tawh.

records.english: Asking a new colleague what they did in their previous job is a friendly way to begin.
records.zomi: Nasep lawm thak khat a nasep lui ah bang a sem hiam dot pen lawmta zia-a kipatna ahi hi.

records.english: What did you think of the training course?
records.zomi: Sinna hun tungtang bang na ci hiam?

records.english: It was useful, although the afternoon session was too long.
records.zomi: A phatuam hi, ahi zongin nitak lam sinna a sau lua hi.

records.english: What kind of experience are you looking for in a new employee?
records.zomi: Nasem thak khat ah bang theihna na zong hiam?

records.english: Someone who has worked with customers and can stay calm under pressure.
records.zomi: Vanleite tawh na a sem ngei a, nawhna nuai ah lungnem thei mi khat.

records.english: What qualifications do I need to apply for this job?
records.zomi: Hih nasep nget nadingin bang sinna ka kisam hiam?

records.zomi: A website leh nasep magazine nih ah.

records.english: Where do you see the biggest problem in our current system?
records.zomi: I tu-a system ah buaina lian pen koi ah na mu hiam?

records.english: In the way orders are passed between the two departments.
records.zomi: Department nih kikal-a van ngetnate kipia zia ah.

records.english: Where exactly did you leave the projector remote?
records.zomi: Projector remote koi taktak ah na nusia hiam?

records.english: A student who asks where an idea comes from is beginning to think like a researcher.
records.zomi: Ngaihsutna khat koi pan hong pai hiam a dong sangnaupang khat in thu suipa bangin a ngaihsun kipan hi.

records.english: New employees who ask where things are kept settle in much faster.
records.zomi: Vante koi ah kikem hiam a dong nasem thakte manlang zaw takin a kituak uh hi.

records.english: Where did you get the information for your presentation?
records.zomi: Na presentation adingin thute koi pan na ngah hiam?

records.english: From two textbooks and an interview with a local farmer.
records.zomi: Laibu nih leh khua-a loubawl khat tawh kidotna pan.

records.english: Where is the staff room?
records.zomi: Nasemte khan koi ah a om hiam?

records.english: On the second floor, opposite the library.
records.zomi: Dawh nihna ah, laibu inn maituah ah.

records.english: Grandpa thought his tiredness was just old age, but it was his new medicine.
records.zomi: Pu in a gimna pen upat hang bek hi, a ci a, ahi zongin a damdawi thak hang ahi hi.

records.english: My grandmother's new medicine gives her a strange taste in her mouth.
records.zomi: Ka pi' damdawi thak in a kam sungah limna lamdang a pia hi.

records.english: My brother didn't want to admit that his medicine was making him dizzy.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal in a damdawi in lu a kual sak hi, ci pom a nuam kei hi.

records.english: Ask Grandma whether her new eye drops sting.
records.zomi: Pi' mit damdawi thak in a mit a hal sak hiam dong in.

records.english: When Dad's mood changed after starting his tablets, we encouraged him to see the doctor.
records.zomi: Pa' damdawi a nek kipat khit ciangin a lungsim a kikheel ciangin siavuan mu dingin i hanthawn uh hi.

records.english: Keeping a family note of everyone's side effects helped the new doctor choose the right medicines.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh' natna behlapte innkuan ciamtehna khat ah kem in siavuan thak in damdawi dik a teel nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: The children know to tell us if their medicine makes them feel strange.
records.zomi: A damdawi uh in lamdang taka a sak uh leh hong gen dingin naupangte in a thei uh hi.

records.english: The doctor told us that the baby's tiredness after the injection would pass in a day.
records.zomi: Damdawi sutna khit-a naungek' gimna ni khat sungin a bei ding hi, ci-in siavuan in hong gen hi.

records.english: Please tell me if you notice anything unusual after you take it.
records.zomi: Na nek khit ciangin na lamdang khat na phawk leh hong gen in.

records.english: Our son's antibiotics gave him a tummy ache, so we asked whether he should take them with food.
records.zomi: I tapa' antibiotics in a gil a na sak ahih manin an tawh a nek ding hiam i dong uh hi.

records.english: Shall we ask whether there's a medicine with fewer side effects for Dad?
records.zomi: Pa adingin natna behlap tawm zaw damdawi a om hiam i dong ding hiam?

records.english: Talking openly about side effects at home helps relatives notice changes early.
records.zomi: Inn ah natna behlapte tungtang kihong takin kihopih in sanggamte kikheelnate ma takin a muh nadingun a huh hi.

records.english: Dad noticed that his new tablets were giving him strange dreams, so he called the surgery.
records.zomi: Pa' damdawi thakte in mangmuh lamdang a pia hi, ci a phawk ahih manin clinic a sam hi.

records.english: Our son's teacher noticed that he was sleepy in the mornings and asked us about his medicine.
records.zomi: I tapa' saya in zingsang ciangin a ihmut gim hi, ci a phawk a, a damdawi tungtang hong dong hi.

records.english: The doctor reassured my mother that the mild headache was common and usually passed.
records.zomi: Lu natna neu pen a tam a, a tamzaw-in a bei zel hi, ci-in siavuan in ka nu a hehnem hi.

records.english: Grandma's new heart tablets made her ankles swell, so the doctor changed the dose.
records.zomi: Pi' lungtang damdawi thakte in a khe-ngawng a vawksak ahih manin siavuan in damdawi zah a kheel hi.

records.english: Dad worries so much about side effects that he sometimes skips his tablets.
records.zomi: Pa natna behlapte tungtang a lungkham lua ahih manin khatvei khat a damdawi a ne lo hi.

records.english: Is it a side effect, or is the baby just teething?
records.zomi: Natna behlap hiam, naungek' ha a suak bek hiam?

records.english: We kept a diary of the baby's sleep after she started her new medicine.
records.zomi: Naungek in damdawi thak a nek kipat khit ciangin a ihmut tungtang nitum ciamtehna i kem uh hi.

records.english: We stopped giving our son the cough syrup when it made him too excited to sleep, and the doctor agreed.
records.zomi: Khuk damdawi tui in i tapa a ihmut theih lohna dongin a lungkimsak lua ciangin i piak tawp uh a, siavuan in a pom hi.

records.english: Grandpa complains about a dry mouth, so we keep a bottle of water by his bed.
records.zomi: Pu in a kam a keu hi, ci-in a phun ahih manin a lupna kiangah tui bel khat i koih uh hi.

records.english: Did the new tablets upset your stomach, Dad?
records.zomi: Pa, damdawi thakte in na gil a nat sak hiam?

records.english: Only for the first few days, and now I'm fine.
records.zomi: Ni tawmno masa sung bek, tu-in ka hoih ta hi.

records.english: We were glad we asked about side effects before our son's operation.
records.zomi: I tapa' zatui ma-in natna behlapte tungtang i dot manin i lungdam uh hi.

records.english: Our daughter's eczema cream made her skin sting, so the nurse suggested a gentler one.
records.zomi: I tanu' vun natna cream in a vun a hal sak ahih manin nurse in a nem zaw khat a gen hi.

records.english: When Grandma felt dizzy, we made her sit down and brought her a glass of water.
records.zomi: Pi a lu a kual ciangin i tutsak uh a, tui haai khat i paipih uh hi.

records.english: Why has Grandpa been coughing since he started the new pills?
records.zomi: Bang hangin damdawi thak a nek kipat pan Pu a khuk den hiam?

records.english: Can you check whether Mum's new tablets react with her blood pressure pills?
records.zomi: Nu' damdawi thakte in a sisan nek damdawi tawh a kibuai kha hiam na en thei ding hiam?

records.english: My husband felt much better once the doctor lowered his dose.
records.zomi: Siavuan in a damdawi zah a kiamsak khit ciangin ka pasal a hoih zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: Who should we call if Grandpa feels unwell in the middle of the night?
records.zomi: Pu zan laizang-in a cidam kei leh kua i sam ding uh hiam?

records.english: How have you been feeling on the new tablets, Mum?
records.zomi: Nu, damdawi thakte tawh bangci na om hiam?

records.english: When our daughter's medicine changed her appetite, we told her paediatrician at the next visit.
records.zomi: I tanu' damdawi in a an nek nopna a kheel ciangin a zom vehna ah naupang siavuan kiangah i gen uh hi.

records.english: I keep a note of any side effects Grandpa mentions, because he forgets to tell the doctor.
records.zomi: Pu in siavuan kiangah gen a mangngilh ahih manin a gen natna behlap khempeuh ka ciamteh hi.

records.english: Our son's hay fever tablets made him so drowsy that he fell asleep in class.
records.zomi: I tapa' natna ciat damdawi in a ihmut sak lua ahih manin khan sungah a ihmu hi.

records.english: Can you ask the doctor whether this medicine will affect my exams?
records.zomi: Hih damdawi in ka sitnate a khoih ding hiam siavuan na dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our daughter's inhaler sometimes makes her hands shake a little, which the doctor says is normal.
records.zomi: I tanu' inhaler in khatvei khat a khut tawmno a ling sak a, siavuan in a pha hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Reading the leaflet together made my parents less anxious about the new treatment.
records.zomi: Lai neu khawm-a sim in ka nu leh ka pa damdawi zatna thak tungtang a lungkham tawm zaw sak hi.

records.english: When Mum started her new treatment, the whole family read the leaflet together.
records.zomi: Nu in damdawi zatna thak a kipat ciangin innkuan bup in lai neu khawm-in i sim uh hi.

records.english: My brother's acne treatment dried his lips so much that they cracked.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal' mai sakhuai damdawi in a muk a keu lua ahih manin a kiphel hi.

records.english: Did the pharmacist say the tablets might change the colour of your urine?
records.zomi: Damdawi in na zun rong a kheel thei hi, ci-in damdawi zuakpa in a gen hiam?

records.english: Thank you for ringing to check on Grandpa after his first dose.
records.zomi: A damdawi masa pen khit ciangin Pu en dingin na sam manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: My husband refused to read the side effects, so I read them to him.
records.zomi: Ka pasal in natna behlapte sim a nial ahih manin kei in ka sim sak hi.

records.english: My sister was relieved to hear that her nausea would probably fade after a few weeks.
records.zomi: A lok nopna kal tawmno khit ciangin a bei kha ding hi, ci a zak ciangin ka u numei a lungmuang hi.

records.english: Mum's new medicine made her sensitive to sunlight, so she wears a hat in the garden.
records.zomi: Nu' damdawi thak in ni sa a thuak zo lo sak ahih manin huan sungah lukhu a silh hi.

records.english: Asking about side effects should be as normal in a family as asking about school.
records.zomi: Natna behlap dot pen innkuan sungah sang thu dot bangin a pha den ding hi.

records.english: My wife asked the pharmacist whether her new medicine would make her tired at work.
records.zomi: Ka zi in a damdawi thak in nasep mun ah a gimsak ding hiam damdawi zuakpa a dong hi.

records.english: Did the nurse say what to do if the baby gets a fever after the vaccine?
records.zomi: Kidawnna damdawi khit ciangin naungek a lum leh bang bawl ding hiam nurse in a gen hiam?

records.english: Has anyone noticed whether Grandpa is more confused since his tablets changed?
records.zomi: A damdawi a kikheel khit pan Pu a buai zaw hiam kuamah in a phawk hiam?

records.english: Dad finally admitted that the tablets were making him feel low.
records.zomi: Damdawi in a lungsim a niamsak hi, ci-in Pa in a tawpna-ah a pom hi.

records.english: I feel sick after taking my medicine; should I lie down?
records.zomi: Ka damdawi ka nek khit ciangin ka lok nuam hi; ka lum ding hiam?

records.english: Shall I call the pharmacy to ask if Grandma's headache could be caused by her new pills?
records.zomi: Pi' lu natna a damdawi thakte hangin a piang thei hiam dong dingin damdawi zuakna ka sam ding hiam?

records.english: My aunt's hair grew back after her treatment ended, just as the doctor had promised.
records.zomi: Siavuan' kiciam bangin a damdawi zatna a bei khit ciangin ka ni' sam a khang kik hi.

records.english: My cousin, a nurse, explained the difference between a side effect and an allergy to our parents.
records.zomi: Nurse hi ka sanggam in ka nu leh ka pa kiangah natna behlap leh natna ciat kikal kibat lohna a genteh hi.

records.english: Our family doctor always asks the children how their medicine makes them feel.
records.zomi: I innkuan siavuan in naupangte' damdawi in bangci a sak hiam a dong tawntung hi.

records.english: Mum, is it normal that my medicine makes me feel sleepy?
records.zomi: Nu, ka damdawi in hong ihmut sak pen a pha hiam?

records.english: It can happen at first, so let's ask the pharmacist tomorrow.
records.zomi: A kipat ciangin a piang thei hi, tua ahih manin zingciang damdawi zuakpa i dong ding.

records.english: We were told that the side effects of the vaccine are usually mild and short.
records.zomi: Kidawnna damdawi' natna behlapte a tamzaw-in a neu a, a tom hi, ci kigen hi.

records.english: Mum always asks what side effects to watch for before she gives us anything new.
records.zomi: Nu in na thak bangmah hong piak ma-in bang natna behlap en ding hiam a dong tawntung hi.

records.english: Should we be worried about the rash on the baby's arm?
records.zomi: Naungek' ban tung-a vun san tungtang i lungkham ding hiam?

records.english: Call the doctor today, because it started after her new medicine.
records.zomi: Tuni-in siavuan sam in, a damdawi thak khit ciangin a kipan ahih manin.

records.english: Did our daughter really pay for the vase with her own pocket money?
records.zomi: I tanu in paak bel a khut sum mah tawh a man a pia taktak hiam?

records.english: Did you remember to give the baby her medicine at six?
records.zomi: Nai guk ciangin naungek a damdawi pia na phawk hiam?

records.english: A big brother is responsible for setting a good example.
records.zomi: U pasal khat in entehna hoih lak ding mawhpuakna a nei hi.

records.english: My husband takes full responsibility for the children's homework on weekdays.
records.zomi: Ka pasal in nasep nite-in naupangte' inn nasep mawhpuakna bup a la hi.

records.english: Looking after the family land is a responsibility my father takes very seriously.
records.zomi: Innkuan gam kem pen ka pa in thupi takin a ngaihsut mawhpuakna khat ahi hi.

records.english: Taking care of a sick parent taught my sister more about responsibility than any job.
records.zomi: Nu hiam pa natpa khat kem in ka u numei nasep khatpeuh sangin mawhpuakna tungtang tam zaw a sinsak hi.

records.english: Can you be in charge of the little ones while I cook?
records.zomi: An ka huan laitakin naupang neute na cing thei ding hiam?

records.english: Which weekends are you cooking, and which are mine?
records.zomi: Bang kal tawpte-in an na huan ding a, bangte kei' ahi hiam?

records.english: Whose turn is it to walk the dog tonight?
records.zomi: Tu zanin ui paipih kua' hun ahi hiam?

records.english: I'm proud of how you looked after your sister today.
records.zomi: Tuni-in na u numei na kem manin ka kipak hi.

records.english: When I lost my sister's bicycle, Dad made me work in his shop to pay for a new one.
records.zomi: Ka u numei' siiksakol ka mansuah ciangin a thak lei nadingin Pa in a sumbuk ah na hong sem sak hi.

records.english: Our teenage son now does the family shopping every Saturday with a list and a budget.
records.zomi: I tapa tangval no in tu-in Kiginni simin list leh sum zat ding tawh innkuan van a lei hi.

records.english: Our son admitted that he had forgotten to feed the fish, and he bought new ones with his own money.
records.zomi: I tapa in nga an pia a mangngilh hi, ci-in a pom a, a sum mah tawh nga thak a lei hi.

records.english: Is it your job to set the table this evening?
records.zomi: Tu nitak an dawhkan bawl na nasep ahi hiam?

records.english: Who will look after Grandpa's goats while he's in hospital?
records.zomi: Pu damdawi inn ah a om lai-in a keelte kua in a kem ding hiam?

records.english: I will, every morning before school.
records.zomi: Kei, sang ka kah ma-in zingsang simin.

records.english: I'm grateful that you kept the house running while we were away.
records.zomi: I om loh lai-in inn na kem manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: When Mum went into hospital, my older sister took charge of the house for a month.
records.zomi: Nu damdawi inn ah a lut ciangin ka u numei upa in kha khat sung inn a kem hi.

records.english: When I was ten, my parents gave me a puppy and said it was my job to look after him.
records.zomi: Kum sawm ka hih lai-in ka nu leh ka pa in ui no khat hong pia a, amah kem pen ka nasep ahi hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: For the first few weeks, I often forgot to fill his water bowl.
records.zomi: Kal tawmno masa sungin a tui kuang ka dimsak mangngilh zel hi.

records.english: One hot afternoon I found him panting by the empty bowl, and I never forgot again.
records.zomi: Sun lum khat ciangin kuang awng kiang ah a huih a kai-in ka mu a, ka mangngilh ngei nawn kei hi.

records.english: When Grandpa could no longer drive, my cousin took responsibility for his shopping.
records.zomi: Pu in mawtaw a mawng zo nawn loh ciangin ka sanggam in a van leina mawhpuakna a la hi.

records.english: Grandma made each grandchild responsible for one row of vegetables in her garden.
records.zomi: Pi in tu khatciat a huan sung-a anteh tang khat ciat kem dingin a sawl hi.

records.english: Let's write a rota for the jobs Mum usually does.
records.zomi: Nu in a bawl zel nasepte adingin hun kizui list khat i gelh ding.

records.english: My grandmother says that responsibility starts with small things, like hanging up your coat.
records.zomi: Mawhpuakna pen na puansilh lian khai bang na neute pan a kipan hi, ci-in ka pi in a gen hi.

records.english: Did you clean up the kitchen after your friends left?
records.zomi: Na lawmte a pai khit ciangin anbuk na siangsak hiam?

records.english: My brother forgot to collect our grandmother from the station, and she has never let him forget it.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal in i pi meileng khawlna mun pan la a mangngilh a, Pi in tu dong a mangngilh sak ngei kei hi.

records.english: Dad has looked after his mother every Sunday for twenty years.
records.zomi: Pa in kum sawmnih sung Nipini simin a nu a kem hi.

records.english: Who left the hose running in the garden?
records.zomi: Huan sungah tui khau kua in a luang nusia hiam?

records.english: My parents expected us to make our beds before breakfast, even on holidays.
records.zomi: Tawlngak nite-in zong zingsang an ma-in i lupna bawl kician dingin ka nu leh ka pa in a lamen uh hi.

records.english: Grandpa never let a promise to his family go unkept.
records.zomi: Pu in a innkuan kiangah a kiciamna khat zong a kem lo ngei kei hi.

records.english: Dad taught us that if we break something, we fix it or pay for it.
records.zomi: Na khat i sukkham leh i bawl hoih ding hiam i man pia ding hi, ci-in Pa in hong sinsak hi.

records.english: Will you two wash the car together on Sunday?
records.zomi: Nipini ciangin na nih in khawm-in mawtaw na sil ding uh hiam?

records.english: Holding the shop keys made my cousin very careful.
records.zomi: Sumbuk tawhte a len in ka sanggam a kidawm mahmah sak hi.

records.english: When the twins turned eight, each of them got one chore to do every day.
records.zomi: Apengte kum giat a phak ciangun khatciat in ni simin bawl ding inn nasep khat a ngah uh hi.

records.english: Auntie Ciin became responsible for the whole family when her parents died young.
records.zomi: A nu leh a pa uh khangno-in a sih ciangin Ni Ciin innkuan bup mawhpuakna a nei hi.

records.english: Raising children to be responsible starts with trusting them with real tasks.
records.zomi: Naupangte mawhpuakna nei dingin vulh pen nasep taktak tawh muan pan a kipan hi.

records.english: When our dog got out, our daughter spent all afternoon searching the neighbourhood.
records.zomi: I ui a pusuak ciangin i tanu in khua sung bup sun bup a zong hi.

records.english: It's your responsibility to call Grandma on her birthday.
records.zomi: A suahni ciangin Pi sam pen na mawhpuakna ahi hi.

records.english: Our son asked if he could be responsible for watering the plants while we were away.
records.zomi: I om loh lai-in singnote tui buak mawhpuakna a la thei hiam i tapa in a dong hi.

records.english: Children who help at home learn that their actions affect everyone else.
records.zomi: Inn ah a huh naupangte in a gamtatnate uh in midang khempeuh a khoih hi, ci a sin uh hi.

records.english: My uncle took responsibility for his brother's children after a tragic accident.
records.zomi: Thupiang lauhuai khat khit ciangin ka pa neu in a sanggam pasal' tate mawhpuakna a la hi.

records.english: When my parents divorced, my older brother made sure we always had breakfast.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa a kikhen uh ciangin ka u pasal upa in zingsang an i ne den nadingin a en hi.

records.english: Mum never blamed others for her problems, and she taught us to do the same.
records.zomi: Nu in a buainate adingin midangte a mawhsak ngei kei a, kei zong tua bangin hong sinsak hi.

records.english: Can I trust you to come home before dark?
records.zomi: A mial ma-in inn ah na tung ding kong muang thei ding hiam?

records.english: When you borrow Dad's tools, put them back where you found them.
records.zomi: Pa' vanzatte na leitawi ciangin na muhna mun ah koih kik in.

records.english: Who's responsible for taking the bins out this week?
records.zomi: Hih kal nawi bin pualam ah koih kua in mawhpuak hiam?

records.english: Our children learned responsibility by caring for Grandpa's goats each summer.
records.zomi: I tate in khal simin Pu' keelte kem tawh mawhpuakna a sin uh hi.

records.english: My cousin's first job taught him to take responsibility for his own mistakes.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam' nasep masa pen in amah' khialhnate mawhpuakna la dingin a sinsak hi.

records.english: My brother pays part of our parents' rent since he started working.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal na a sep kipat pan i nu leh i pa' inn man pawl khat a pia hi.

records.english: Responsibility in our family is shared, but everyone knows their own tasks.
records.zomi: I innkuan ah mawhpuakna kikhawm a, ahi zongin mi khempeuh in a nasep uh a thei uh hi.

records.english: When the baby arrived, our older son started helping without being asked.
records.zomi: Naungek a tun ciangin i tapa upa in kingen lo-in a huh kipan hi.

records.english: Why did you offer to look after your little cousins all weekend?
records.zomi: Bang hangin kal tawp bup na sanggam neute cing dingin na kipia hiam?

records.english: Because Auntie had to work, and nobody else was free.
records.zomi: Ni na a sem kul a, kuamah a awng kei uh ahih manin.

records.english: Our son was given his first house key on his twelfth birthday.
records.zomi: I tapa a kum sawm leh nih suahni-in a inn tawh masa pen kipia hi.

records.english: Dad always says that a family works only if everyone does their share.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh in a tuam a bawl uh leh bek innkuan khat a sem hi, ci-in Pa in a gen tawntung hi.

records.english: Mum handed me the family accounts when she went back to work, and I felt very grown up.
records.zomi: Nu na sem dingin a ciah kik ciangin innkuan sum ciamtehna hong ap a, ka khang mahmah bangin ka sa hi.

records.english: As the eldest, I was responsible for my brothers whenever our parents worked late.
records.zomi: A upa pen ka hih manin ka nu leh ka pa zan nung dong na a sep simun ka nau pasalte mawhpuakna ka nei hi.

records.english: What part do you play in keeping our home running?
records.zomi: I inn kem ah bang tuam na la hiam?

records.english: My wife and I share the responsibility for visiting her elderly parents.
records.zomi: Ka zi leh kei in a nu leh a pa upate veh mawhpuakna i kihawm uh hi.

records.english: The store manager apologised in writing for the incorrect price on the shelf.
records.zomi: Dawhkan tung-a man khial adingin sumbuk makaipa in lai tawh maisak a ngen hi.

records.english: Cash, cards and mobile payments are all accepted at the checkouts.
records.zomi: Man piakna mun ah sum, card leh mobile payment khempeuh kipom hi.

records.english: The supermarket donates unsold food to the local food bank every evening.
records.zomi: Supermarket in nitak simin a zuak lo ante khua an huhna mun ah a pia hi.

records.english: A minimum spend of ten pounds applies to card payments in this shop.
records.zomi: Hih sumbuk ah card tawh man piak adingin pound sawm a tawm pen-in zat kul hi.

records.english: Prices are correct at the time of printing but may change without notice.
records.zomi: Van man kigelh hun-in a dik a, ahi zongin gen lo-in a kikheel thei hi.

records.english: The store's opening hours will change during the public holidays.
records.zomi: Mipi tawlngak nite-in sumbuk' kihon hunte a kikheel ding hi.

records.english: Do you accept food vouchers from the government scheme?
records.zomi: Kumpi nasep pan an voucher te na pom uh hiam?

records.english: Do you sell halal or kosher products?
records.zomi: Halal hiam kosher van na zuak uh hiam?

records.english: Please note that the self-service tills do not accept cash.

records.english: The family court decided that my nephew would live with his grandparents.

records.english: Grandpa believes that a good judge listens more than they speak.

records.english: The court case about my grandfather's pension took three years to settle.

records.english: Is it true that Uncle Thang once argued a case in the supreme court?

records.english: My husband was fined by the court for driving too fast near a school.

records.english: My cousin's custody case was heard in a private room, away from the public.

records.english: My parents explained to us why the court had decided against them, without any bitterness.

records.english: My brother's case was dismissed, and we all went out to celebrate.
