records.english: My wife's cancer treatment meant that I took over the cooking for six months.
records.zomi: Ka zi' cancer damdawi zatna hangin kha guk sung an huan kei in ka la hi.

records.english: We changed the family's meals when Dad's treatment plan included less salt.
records.zomi: Pa' damdawi zatna kalsuan in cii tawm zaw a huam ciangin innkuan an i kheel uh hi.

records.english: Can you ask whether Grandpa's plan allows him to travel in the summer?
records.zomi: Pu' kalsuan in khal ciangin khualzin dingin a phal hiam na dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: We moved Grandpa's bed downstairs as part of his recovery plan.
records.zomi: Pu' damna kalsuan sung-a khat bangin a lupna nuai lam ah i suan uh hi.

records.english: My brother rearranged his work so he could be at every one of Mum's treatments.
records.zomi: Nu' damdawi zatna khempeuh ah a om theih nadingin ka u pasal in a nasep a kheel hi.

records.english: Our daughter's plan for her allergy includes carrying an injection pen everywhere.
records.zomi: I tanu' natna ciat kalsuan in koi-ah zong damdawi sutna pen a paipih ding a huam hi.

records.english: My sister set up a group chat so the family could share updates on Mum's treatment.
records.zomi: Nu' damdawi zatna thu thak innkuan in a kihawm theih nadingin ka u numei in group chat khat a bawl hi.

records.english: When Grandpa came home from hospital, the nurse went through his plan with all of us.
records.zomi: Pu damdawi inn pan inn a tun ciangin nurse in i khempeuh tawh a kalsuan a en hi.

records.english: When our daughter started her treatment, her school agreed to let her rest in the afternoons.
records.zomi: I tanu in a damdawi zatna a kipat ciangin a sang in nitak lam a tawlngak dingin a phal hi.

records.english: Is it all right if Grandpa misses one session because of the wedding?
records.zomi: Mopawi hangin Pu in hun khat a mansuah leh a pha ding hiam?

records.english: When my sister lost her job, she waited patiently for the right one instead of taking the first offer.
records.zomi: Ka u numei in a nasep a mansuah ciangin a masa-a kipia la lo-in a dik pen thuakzawh takin a ngak hi.

records.english: My grandparents' marriage was built on decades of patience with each other.
records.zomi: Ka pu leh ka pi' kitenna kum sawm tampi sung khat leh khat tungah thuakzawhna tungah kilam hi.

records.english: My wife's father took months to accept me, but my patience was rewarded.
records.zomi: Ka zi' pa in kha tampi sung hong pom zo kei a, ahi zongin ka thuakzawhna in gah a nei hi.

records.english: Our children waited patiently in the car while we visited Uncle in hospital.
records.zomi: Damdawi inn ah Pa neu i veh laitakin i tate mawtaw sungah thuakzawh takin a ngak uh hi.

records.english: Try to be patient with your little brother; he's only four.
records.zomi: Na nau pasal neu tungah thuakzawh dingin hanciam in; kum li bek a hi hi.

records.english: My cousin waited two years for his visa, and he never stopped hoping.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in a visa kum nih sung a ngak a, a lamen tawp ngei kei hi.

records.english: When will the cake be ready, Grandma?
records.zomi: Pi, cake bang hun-in a min ding hiam?

records.english: Not until it smells right, so go and play for a little longer.
records.zomi: A gim a dik ma-in min lo ding a, tua ahih manin pai in tawmno kimawl lai in.

records.english: Teaching my son to tie his shoes took weeks, but he was so proud when he did it.
records.zomi: Ka tapa a khedap khau khih sinsak in kal tampi a la a, ahi zongin a bawl theih ciangin a kipak mahmah hi.

records.english: I'm sorry I was impatient with you this morning.
records.zomi: Tu zingsang nang tungah thuakzawhna ka neih loh manin hong maisak in.

records.english: We waited months for Grandpa's operation, and the whole family supported him.
records.zomi: Pu' zatui kha tampi i ngak uh a, innkuan bup in amah a huh uh hi.

records.english: Can you wait a few minutes while I help your sister?
records.zomi: Na u numei ka huh laitakin minit tawmno na ngak thei ding hiam?

records.english: My sister's patience with our elderly neighbour made them close friends.
records.zomi: I inn veng upa tungah ka u numei' thuakzawhna in amaute lawm naih a suaksak hi.

records.english: My parents saved patiently for ten years to build our house.
records.zomi: I inn lam nadingin ka nu leh ka pa kum sawm sung thuakzawh takin sum a kem uh hi.

records.english: Waiting for good news together brought our family closer.
records.zomi: Thu hoih khawm-a ngak in i innkuan hong kinaih zaw sak hi.

records.english: Mum always says that bread and children both need time to rise.
records.zomi: Moh leh naupangte a nih in khan dingin hun a kisam hi, Nu in a ci tawntung hi.

records.english: My son has finally learned to wait until everyone is served before he starts eating.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in mi khempeuh an a ngah dong ngak-in a nek kipat ding a sin tawp hi.

records.english: Patience is easier when you know what you are waiting for.
records.zomi: Bang na ngak hiam na theih ciangin thuakzawhna a baih zaw hi.

records.english: Is it time to open the presents yet, Mum?
records.zomi: Nu, letsongte hon ding hun a tung ta hiam?

records.english: Hold on, love; Dad will be home soon.
records.zomi: Ka it, ngak in; Pa inn ah a tung pah ding hi.

records.english: Can you be patient while I finish this phone call?
records.zomi: Hih phone sam ka zawh laitakin thuakzawh takin na ngak thei ding hiam?

records.english: When my grandfather planted the walnut trees, my father was still a small boy.
records.zomi: Ka pu in walnut singte a suan ciangin ka pa naupang neu ahi lai hi.

records.english: For years the trees gave nothing, and the neighbours laughed at him.
records.zomi: Kum tampi sung singte in bangmah a gah kei a, inn vengte in amah a nuihsan uh hi.

records.english: Today those trees feed three generations of our family, and nobody is laughing.
records.zomi: Tuni-in tua singte in i innkuan khang thum a vak a, kuamah a nuih kei uh hi.

records.english: My little sister is learning to wait her turn, but it isn't easy for her.
records.zomi: Ka nau numei in a hun ngak a sin lai a, ahi zongin amah adingin a baih kei hi.

records.english: Thank you for being so patient with me while I was ill.
records.zomi: Ka nat lai-in kei tungah thuakzawhna na neih manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: How much longer until your braces come off, love?
records.zomi: Ka it, na ha khihna a kilak ding hun bangzah a om lai hiam?

records.english: Why are you always so patient with the baby?
records.zomi: Bang hangin naungek tungah thuakzawhna na nei tawntung hiam?

records.english: Because I remember how hard it was for you at that age.
records.zomi: Tua kum na hih lai-in nang adingin bangzah a haksa hiam ka phawk ahih manin.

records.english: When Grandma moved in with us, we all had to learn to slow down.
records.zomi: Pi i kiang ah a hong teng ciangin i khempeuh in dahdah-in om a sin kul uh hi.

records.english: Patience with teenagers often pays off years later.
records.zomi: Tangval-tangnute tungah thuakzawhna in kum tampi khit ciangin gah a nei zel hi.

records.english: How many sleeps until Christmas now?
records.zomi: Christmas dong tu-in zan bangzah ihmut a om lai hiam?

records.english: Auntie Cing waited ten years for a child, and now she has twins.
records.zomi: Ni Cing kum sawm sung ta a ngak a, tu-in apeng a nei hi.

records.english: Dad's patience while fishing taught me to enjoy the quiet.
records.zomi: Nga a man laitakin Pa' thuakzawhna in daina nuam sa dingin hong sinsak hi.

records.english: My wife waited patiently while I finished my studies in another city.
records.zomi: Khuapi dang ah ka sinna ka zawh laitakin ka zi in thuakzawh takin a ngak hi.

records.english: Our children learned patience by waiting for the hens to lay their first eggs.
records.zomi: Akpite in aktui masa pen a neih dong ngak tawh i tate in thuakzawhna a sin uh hi.

records.english: Patience with yourself is as important as patience with others.
records.zomi: Nangmah tungah thuakzawhna pen midangte tungah thuakzawhna bangin a thupi hi.

records.english: Patience with an elderly parent is a gift that both of you will remember.
records.zomi: Nu hiam pa upa khat tungah thuakzawhna pen na nih in na phawk ding letsong khat ahi hi.

records.english: Mum waited at the window every evening until my father came home from the mine.
records.zomi: Ka pa lei kua tou nasep pan inn a tun dong nitak simin Nu tohkhawng kiang ah a ngak hi.

records.english: My brother's patience with his autistic son has taught the whole family a lot.
records.zomi: Autism nei a tapa tungah ka u pasal' thuakzawhna in innkuan bup tampi a sinsak hi.

records.english: Grandma taught me to knit, and she never once lost her patience with my dropped stitches.
records.zomi: Pi in puan khuih hong sinsak a, ka khuih khialhnate tungah khatvei zong a thuakzawhna a mansuah kei hi.

records.english: Our son practised the piano every evening for a year before he could play his favourite song.
records.zomi: I tapa in a la it pen a tum theih ma-in kum khat sung nitak simin piano a kisin hi.

records.english: Why can't we leave now?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tu-in i pai thei kei uh hiam?

records.english: Because Grandma walks slowly, and we're going to wait for her.
records.zomi: Pi dahdah-in a pai ahih manin, amah i ngak ding uh hi.

records.english: Grandpa repeated the same story to us many times, and we learned to listen kindly each time.
records.zomi: Pu in tangthu kibang mah hong gen kik tampi a, khatvei simin hehpih takin ngaikhia i sin uh hi.

records.english: How did you stay calm while teaching me to drive?
records.zomi: Mawtaw mawng hong sinsak laitakin bangci na lungnem thei hiam?

records.english: I took deep breaths and remembered that I was nervous once too.
records.zomi: Huih thuk takin ka kai a, kei zong khatvei ka lau hi, ci ka phawk hi.

records.english: Patience in a family means letting each person grow at their own speed.
records.zomi: Innkuan sung-a thuakzawhna in mi khatciat amau kalsuan bangin khang dingin phal cihna ahi hi.

records.english: Are your tomatoes red yet, or do we have to wait a bit longer?
records.zomi: Na mehtuukte a san ta hiam, tawmno i ngak lai ding hiam?

records.english: Dad never raised his voice, however long we took to understand our homework.
records.zomi: I inn nasep i theih nadingin bangzah hun i zat zongin Pa in a aw a sang ngei kei hi.

records.english: Please don't rush your grandfather; let him finish his sentence.
records.zomi: Na pu nawh kei in; a thugen a zawh dingin phal in.

records.english: Learning our language as an adult took my wife years of patient study.
records.zomi: Upa hun-in i pau sin in ka zi kum tampi thuakzawh taka sinna a la hi.

records.english: Every family needs one patient person, and in ours it is Grandpa.
records.zomi: Innkuan khatciat in thuakzawhna nei mi khat a kisam a, eite ah Pu ahi hi.

records.english: Dad waited for three years before the farm made any profit.
records.zomi: Lou in sum ngahna a neih ma-in Pa kum thum a ngak hi.

records.english: Our baby took a long time to sleep through the night, and we learned to be patient.
records.zomi: I naungek in zan bup ihmut sin ding hun sawt a la a, thuakzawh dingin i sin uh hi.

records.english: My husband waits for me every evening so that we can eat dinner together.
records.zomi: Nitak an khawm-a i nek theih nadingin ka pasal in nitak simin hong ngak hi.

records.english: Shall we wait for Dad before we open the presents?
records.zomi: Letsongte i hon ma-in Pa i ngak ding hiam?

records.english: Waiting for the results of Mum's tests was the longest week of our lives.
records.zomi: Nu' sitna gahte ngak pen i nuntakna-a kal sau pen ahi hi.

records.english: Mum's patience with Dad's illness amazed the doctors.
records.zomi: Pa' natna tungah Nu' thuakzawhna in siavuante lamdang a sak hi.

records.english: Grandma's patience with her garden produced the best roses in the village.
records.zomi: Pi' a huan tunga thuakzawhna in khua sungah rose hoih pen a suaksak hi.

records.english: My husband's goal is to spend more time with the children and less time at work.
records.zomi: Ka pasal' ngimna pen nasep mun ah hun tawm zaw zang-in naupangte tawh hun tam zaw zat ahi hi.

records.english: Shall we all tidy the house together every Saturday morning?
records.zomi: Kiginni zingsang simin i khempeuh in inn khawm-in i siangsak ding hiam?

records.english: Our children each choose one goal at New Year and tell the rest of the family.
records.zomi: Kum Thak ciangin i tate khatciat in ngimna khat a teel uh a, innkuan sung mi dangte kiangah a gen uh hi.

records.english: When our family reached its savings goal, we let the children choose where to go.
records.zomi: I innkuan in i sum kemna ngimna i tun ciangin koi ah pai ding hiam naupangte i teel sak uh hi.

records.english: Our family's goal this year is to eat dinner together at least five nights a week.
records.zomi: Hih kum i innkuan ngimna pen kal khat-in a tawm pen-in zan nga nitak an khawm-in nek ahi hi.

records.english: My grandmother's goal is to write down all her recipes before she forgets them.
records.zomi: Ka pi' ngimna pen a mangngilh ma-in a an huanzia khempeuh gelh ahi hi.

records.english: How much do we need to save for the trip to the coast next year?
records.zomi: Kum zom-a tuipi gei khualzinna adingin bangzah sum i kem kul ding hiam?

records.english: Did you and Mum have goals when you were my age, Dad?
records.zomi: Pa, ka kum na hih lai-in nang leh Nu in ngimna na nei uh hiam?

records.english: Did Grandma reach her goal of growing all our vegetables this summer?
records.zomi: Hih khal Pi in i anteh khempeuh suan ding a ngimna a tun hiam?

records.english: My aunt's goal is to start a small bakery in the village.
records.zomi: Ka ni' ngimna pen khua sungah moh bawlna neu khat kipat ahi hi.

records.english: Helping children set goals teaches them to plan and to keep going.
records.zomi: Naupangte ngimna koih huh in gelh leh zom den a sinsak hi.

records.english: When our daughter reached her swimming goal, we celebrated with ice cream.
records.zomi: I tanu in a tuipeek ngimna a tun ciangin ice cream tawh i lawm uh hi.

records.english: Grandma says that a goal without a plan is only a wish.
records.zomi: Gelhna om lo ngimna pen deihna bek ahi hi, ci-in Pi in a gen hi.

records.english: Is your goal realistic, or should we make it a little smaller?
records.zomi: Na ngimna a tun theih hiam, a neu zaw deuh-in i bawl ding hiam?

records.english: Goals that the whole family shares are harder to abandon.
records.zomi: Innkuan bup' kihawm ngimnate nusiat a haksa zaw hi.

records.english: Mum's goal of learning to swim at sixty surprised everyone.
records.zomi: Kum sawmguk-in tuipeek sin ding Nu' ngimna in mi khempeuh lamdang a sak hi.

records.english: When my sister failed to get the grades she wanted, our parents sat down with her to think again.
records.zomi: Ka u numei in a deih nambat a ngah kei ciangin i nu leh i pa in amah tawh a tu uh a, a ngaihsun kik uh hi.

records.english: Our nephew changed his goal from becoming a pilot to becoming a vet.
records.zomi: I tanau in vanleng mawngpa suah ding a ngimna gan siavuan suah dingin a kheel hi.

records.english: Shall we check our goals at the end of each month?
records.zomi: Kha khatciat tawpna ciangin i ngimnate i en kik ding hiam?

records.english: What's your goal for the summer holidays?
records.zomi: Khal tawlngak hun adingin na ngimna bang hiam?

records.english: To learn to ride my bike without stabilisers.
records.zomi: Khe nih nei siiksakol tuang sin ding.

records.english: Did you keep your promise to practise the guitar every day?
records.zomi: Ni simin guitar kisin ding na kiciamna na kem hiam?

records.english: Almost; I missed only two days.
records.zomi: Kem dek ing; ni nih bek ka mansuah hi.

records.english: Could we have flowers in the garden in every season?
records.zomi: Hun khempeuh ah huan sungah paak i nei thei ding hiam?

records.english: A goal shared with a grandparent can become a special bond between generations.
records.zomi: Pu hiam pi tawh kihawm ngimna khat khang kikal-a kizopna tuam khat ah a suak thei hi.

records.english: Our son's other goal is to read a chapter to his little sister every night.
records.zomi: I tapa' ngimna dang khat pen a nau numei kiangah zan simin dawh khat sim sak ahi hi.

records.english: My parents set a goal of retiring to the village where they grew up.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in a khanglian uh khua ah nasep tawp-a teng ding ngimna a koih uh hi.

records.english: Can you help me break my goal into smaller steps?
records.zomi: Ka ngimna kalsuan neu deuhte-in khen dingin hong huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Talking about goals at dinner has helped our teenagers plan their futures.
records.zomi: Nitak an ah ngimnate kihopih in i tangval-tangnute a nung hun uh gelh dingin a huh hi.

records.english: Will you teach each of us to cook one family dish, Dad?
records.zomi: Pa, i khatciat innkuan an khat ciat huan hong sinsak ding hiam?

records.english: Setting goals as a family helps children see that adults are still learning too.
records.zomi: Innkuan-in ngimna koih in mi upate zong a sin lai uh hi, ci naupangte a mu sak hi.

records.english: My parents' goal of building a house took twenty years, but they never stopped.
records.zomi: Inn lam ding ka nu leh ka pa' ngimna kum sawmnih a la a, ahi zongin a tawp ngei kei uh hi.

records.english: Why did you write your goals on the fridge?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na ngimnate fridge tungah na gelh hiam?

records.english: So that everyone in the family can remind me when I forget.
records.zomi: Ka mangngilh ciangin innkuan sung mi khempeuh in hong phawk sak theih nadingun.

records.english: My brother's goal is to buy a car with his own money by his eighteenth birthday.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal' ngimna pen a kum sawm leh giat suahni ma-in amah' sum tawh mawtaw khat lei ahi hi.

records.english: My wife hopes to qualify as a teacher while the children are still young.
records.zomi: Ka zi in naupangte a neu lai-in saya suak dingin a lamen hi.

records.english: Dad's goal at fifty was to run a marathon, and he finished in under five hours.
records.zomi: Kum sawmnga-in Pa' ngimna pen marathon tai ahi a, nai nga nuai-in a zo hi.

records.english: My little brother's goal is to stay dry at night, and we're all cheering him on.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal neu' ngimna pen zanin lupna zun lo-in om ahi a, i khempeuh in i hanthawn uh hi.

records.english: My cousin set herself the goal of saving enough to buy her parents a new roof.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in a nu leh a pa adingin innkhum thak lei theih ding sum kem dingin amah mah ngimna a koih hi.

records.english: Our daughter's goal of speaking our language fluently makes her grandparents very happy.
records.zomi: I pau a kician taka gen theih ding i tanu' ngimna in a pu leh a pite a lungdam mahmah sak hi.

records.english: My sister's goal is to visit every one of our cousins abroad before she turns thirty.
records.zomi: Ka u numei' ngimna pen kum sawmthum a phak ma-in gamdang-a i sanggam khempeuh veh ahi hi.

records.english: Mum and Dad set a goal of paying off the house before they retire.
records.zomi: Nu leh Pa in nasep a tawp ma-un inn leiba khempeuh piak ding ngimna a koih uh hi.

records.english: My husband and I set a goal to spend one evening a week without phones.
records.zomi: Ka pasal leh kei in kal khat-in nitak khat phone om lo-in zat ding ngimna i koih uh hi.

records.english: Our family has a goal chart with a sticker for every step completed.
records.zomi: I innkuan in kalsuan khatciat zawh simin sticker khat a koih ngimna chart khat a nei hi.

records.english: Shall we try to call Grandma every day this month?
records.zomi: Hih kha sungin ni simin Pi sam dingin i hanciam ding hiam?

records.english: Mum's goal is to learn enough English to speak to our teachers herself.
records.zomi: Nu' ngimna pen amah mah in i sayate tawh a kihopih theih ding English a sin ahi hi.

records.english: Write down one goal, and I'll write down mine.
records.zomi: Ngimna khat gelh in, keimah' zong ka gelh ding hi.

records.english: A family goal works best when every member has a part to play.
records.zomi: Innkuan mi khatciat in a bawl ding tuam a neih ciangin innkuan ngimna khat a hoih pen hi.

records.english: My daughter keeps a goal diary and shows it to me every Sunday.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in ngimna nitum ciamtehna bu khat a kem a, Nipini simin hong lak hi.

records.english: Our son's goal is to make the school football team, so he practises every evening.
records.zomi: I tapa' ngimna pen sang football pawl ah lut ahi a, tua ahih manin nitak simin a kisin hi.

records.english: Grandpa's goal at eighty is to see all his great-grandchildren baptised.
records.zomi: Kum sawmgiat-in Pu' ngimna pen a tu' tate khempeuh tuiphum a muh ahi hi.

records.english: We set the goal of visiting Grandpa every Sunday, and we've kept it for a year.
records.zomi: Nipini simin Pu veh ding ngimna i koih uh a, kum khat sung i kem uh hi.

records.english: When my father reached his goal of quitting smoking, my mother cried with relief.
records.zomi: Ka pa in meizial dawn nusia ding a ngimna a tun ciangin ka nu a lungmuang lua ahih manin a kap hi.

records.english: We all cheered when Grandpa reached his goal of a hundred steps on the stairs.
records.zomi: Pu in kahlei tungah khe za khat ding ngimna a tun ciangin i khempeuh i kikou uh hi.

records.english: My parents' goal was always to give us the education they never had.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa' ngimna pen amaute in a ngah ngei loh sinna hong pia ding ahi tawntung hi.

records.english: Grandpa's goal is to walk to the church and back without stopping.
records.zomi: Pu' ngimna pen tawlngak lo-in pawlpi ah pai-a ciah kik ahi hi.

records.english: What should our family work towards together next?
records.zomi: A zom-in i innkuan in bang khawm-in i hanciam ding hiam?

records.english: Family goals sometimes change when life changes, and that's all right.
records.zomi: Nuntakna a kikheel ciangin innkuan ngimnate khatvei khat a kikheel a, tua a pha hi.

records.english: My brother's goal of becoming a doctor seemed impossible, but he never gave up.
records.zomi: Siavuan suah ding ka u pasal' ngimna a theih loh bangin a om a, ahi zongin a lungkia ngei kei hi.

records.english: Our family's goal of reducing waste began with a compost heap in the garden.
records.zomi: Nawi kiamsak ding i innkuan ngimna huan sung-a ek bawlna khat tawh a kipan hi.

records.english: In Christian teaching, the Spirit's work is seen in changed hearts more than in great displays.
records.zomi: Khristian hilhna ah Kha Siangtho' nasep lahna lian sangin lungsim kikheel ah kimu zaw hi.

records.english: Our pastor teaches that generosity is one sign of the Spirit at work.
records.zomi: Pia nuamna pen Kha Siangtho' nasep lahna khat ahi hi, ci-in i pastor in a hilh hi.

records.english: How do you know when the Spirit is leading you?
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho in hong makaih hi, ci bangci na thei hiam?

records.english: Our church encourages members to pause and pray quietly before they make a difficult choice.
records.zomi: Teelna haksa khat a bawl ma-un i pawlpi in a mite tawlngak-in dai takin thu ngen dingin a hanthawn hi.

records.english: Can the Spirit help me be kinder to my brother?
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho in ka u pasal tungah hehpih zaw dingin hong huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Many Christians believe so, but you still have to choose kindness each day.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in huh thei hi, ci-in a um uh a, ahi zongin ni simin hehpihna na teel kul lai hi.

records.english: Some believers sense the Spirit most clearly in silence, others in singing.
records.zomi: Upmi pawl khat in daina sungah, a dangte in la sakna sungah Kha Siangtho kician pen-in a phawk uh hi.

records.english: When my brother forgave the man who cheated him, he said it was the Spirit's doing.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal in amah a khemte a maisak ciangin Kha Siangtho' nasep ahi hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Does the choir pray together before singing on Sunday?
records.zomi: Nipini ciangin la sa pawl in la a sak ma-un khawm-in thu a ngen uh hiam?

records.english: My grandmother taught me to say a quiet prayer before speaking in anger.
records.zomi: Heh-in thu ka gen ma-in dai takin thu ngen dingin ka pi in hong sinsak hi.

records.english: Paul tells the Thessalonians not to put out the Spirit's fire.
records.zomi: Paul in Thessalonika mite kiangah Kha Siangtho huhna na mitsak kei un, a ci hi.

records.english: Grandma keeps a verse about the Spirit taped inside her kitchen cupboard.
records.zomi: Pi in Kha Siangtho tungtang Laisiangtho cang khat a anbuk van koihna sungah a kap hi.

records.english: My cousin says that the Spirit gave her the strength to care for her mother.
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho in a nu kem nadingin hatna a pia hi, ci-in ka sanggam in a gen hi.

records.english: In Acts, Jesus tells his followers that they will receive power when the Spirit comes on them.
records.zomi: Sawltakte Thu sungah Jesu in a nungzuite kiangah Kha Siangtho na tungah hong kumsuk ciangin vangliatna na ngah ding uh hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Sunday school children drew pictures of the ways the Spirit helps them.
records.zomi: Nipini sang naupangte in Kha Siangtho in amaute a huhzia limte a gelh uh hi.

records.english: My wife says that the Spirit helped her through the first year in a new country.
records.zomi: Gam thak-a kum masa pen sungah Kha Siangtho in hong huh hi, ci-in ka zi in a gen hi.

records.english: Christian life, as many believers describe it, is a partnership with the Spirit that lasts a lifetime.
records.zomi: Upmi tampi' genzia bangin Khristian nuntakna pen nuntak sung bup Kha Siangtho tawh kithuahna ahi hi.

records.english: A farmer in our church thanks the Spirit for patience during the long dry season.
records.zomi: I pawlpi-a loubawl khat in khuakhal hun sau sung thuakzawhna adingin Kha Siangtho lungdam a gen hi.

records.english: What does it mean to live by the Spirit in an ordinary job?
records.zomi: Nasep nautang khat sungah Kha Siangtho hangin gamta cih bang cihna hiam?

records.english: For many believers, it means being honest, patient and fair at work, even when nobody is watching.
records.zomi: Upmi tampi adingin kuamah in a en kei zongin nasep mun ah thu dik gen, thuakzawh leh dik cihna ahi hi.

records.english: Paul writes in Romans that those who are led by the Spirit are children of God.
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho thuhilhna a mang mi khempeuh Pasian tate ahi uh hi, ci-in Paul in Rom laibu sungah a gelh hi.

records.english: Let's pray together for the people who are grieving in our village.
records.zomi: I khua-a kahna nei mite adingin khawm-in thu i ngen ni.

records.english: Who prays at the start of the youth meeting this week?
records.zomi: Hih kal khangno kikhopna kipatna-ah kua in thu a ngen ding hiam?

records.english: Grandpa says that the Spirit taught him to hold his tongue when he was angry.
records.zomi: A heh ciangin a lei khak dingin Kha Siangtho in a sinsak hi, ci-in Pu in a gen hi.

records.english: When my neighbour lost his job, our prayer group asked the Spirit to comfort him.
records.zomi: I inn veng in a nasep a mansuah ciangin i thungetna pawl in amah hehnem dingin Kha Siangtho a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Our pastor explained that the Spirit helps believers serve their families at home.
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho in upmite a innkuan uh inn ah a sem theih nadingun a huh hi, ci-in i pastor in a genteh hi.

records.english: Dad prays for the Spirit's help before every hard conversation with his boss.
records.zomi: A makaipa tawh kihopihna haksa khatciat ma-in Pa in Kha Siangtho' huhna a ngen hi.

records.english: In Christian teaching, the Spirit gives believers the courage to speak about their faith.
records.zomi: Khristian hilhna ah Kha Siangtho in upmite a upna uh gen dingin hangsanna a pia hi.

records.english: Do you feel the Spirit's help more in church or in everyday life?
records.zomi: Pawlpi sungah hiam ni sim nuntakna sungah hiam Kha Siangtho' huhna na phawk zaw hiam?

records.english: Many church members find that serving others brings them closer to the Spirit.
records.zomi: Pawlpi mi tampi in midangte na sep in Kha Siangtho kiangah a naih zawsak hi, ci a mu uh hi.

records.english: We prayed for the Spirit's comfort when our baby was in hospital.
records.zomi: I naungek damdawi inn ah a om ciangin Kha Siangtho' hehnemna i ngen uh hi.

records.english: Mum believes that the Spirit nudged her to visit a lonely neighbour that day.
records.zomi: Tua ni-in inn veng a kia-a om khat veh dingin Kha Siangtho in a sawl hi, ci-in Nu in a um hi.

records.english: Different churches express their reliance on the Spirit in different styles of worship.
records.zomi: Pawlpi tuamtuamte in Kha Siangtho tunga a kingakna uh biakna zia tuamtuam tawh a lak uh hi.

records.english: Christian teaching links the Spirit's work with hope, according to Paul's letter to the Romans.
records.zomi: Paul' Rom laibu bangin Khristian hilhna in Kha Siangtho' nasep lametna tawh a kizopsak hi.

records.english: Our children pray each night for the Spirit to help them at school.
records.zomi: I tate in zan simin sang ah hong huh nadingin Kha Siangtho a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Should Christians expect the Spirit's guidance in decisions about work and marriage?
records.zomi: Khristiante in nasep leh kitenna tungtang khensatna ah Kha Siangtho' makaihna a lamen ding uh hiam?

records.english: Thank you for praying with me before my interview.
records.zomi: Ka kidotna ma-in kei tawh thu na ngen manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Why do you stop and pray before answering an angry email?
records.zomi: Bang hangin heh email khat na dawn ma-in na tawlngak-in thu na ngen hiam?

records.english: I want the Spirit to calm me down so that I reply wisely.
records.zomi: Pil takin ka dawn theih nadingin Kha Siangtho in hong lungnem sak ding ka deih hi.

records.english: Paul contrasts the works of selfish desire with the fruit of the Spirit.
records.zomi: Paul in mimal deihna gamtatnate Kha Siangtho gah tawh a kiteh hi.

records.english: The Spirit helps us to be truthful, our teacher said.
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho in thu dik gen dingin hong huh hi, ci-in i saya in a gen hi.

records.english: Living by the Spirit, some Christians say, means letting love decide how you spend your time.
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho hangin gamta pen na hun bangci zang ding hiam itna in a khensat cihna ahi hi, ci-in Khristian pawl khat in a gen uh hi.

records.english: My friend says she became more patient with her children after she started praying each morning.
records.zomi: Zingsang simin thu a ngen kipat khit ciangin a tate tungah thuakzawhna tam zaw a nei hi, ci-in ka lawm in a gen hi.

records.english: In his letter to the Ephesians, Paul warns believers not to grieve the Holy Spirit.
records.zomi: Paul in Efesa mite kianga a lai sungah upmite Pasian Kha Siangtho na daksak kei un, ci-in a lau sak hi.

records.english: Living by the Spirit, our pastor says, begins with listening.
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho hangin gamta pen ngaihkhiatna pan a kipan hi, ci-in i pastor in a gen hi.

records.english: Believers in many traditions ask the Spirit to help them love their enemies.
records.zomi: Ngeina tampi-a upmite in a galte uh a it theih nadingun Kha Siangtho huhna a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Before every night shift, my sister asks the Spirit to make her gentle with tired patients.
records.zomi: Zan nasep khatciat ma-in ka u numei in natpa gim te tungah a nem nadingin Kha Siangtho a ngen hi.

records.english: The church in our village holds a short prayer meeting for the sick every Wednesday.
records.zomi: I khua-a pawlpi in Nilai ni simin natpate adingin thungetna kikhopna tomno a bawl hi.

records.english: Our pastor said that the Spirit can work through ordinary kindness at the market or in the fields.
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho in sumbuk mun hiam lou-a hehpihna nautang tungtawn-in na a sem thei hi, ci-in i pastor in a gen hi.

records.english: Some believers say that a troubled conscience can be the Spirit's warning.
records.zomi: Lungsim kician lo khat Kha Siangtho' lau sakna ahi thei hi, ci-in upmi pawl khat in a gen uh hi.

records.english: My uncle, a bus driver, asks the Spirit for patience in heavy traffic.
records.zomi: Bus mawngpa hi ka pa neu in mawtaw tam lua lampi ah thuakzawhna adingin Kha Siangtho a ngen hi.

records.english: Shall we start the family meeting with a short prayer for guidance?
records.zomi: Innkuan kikhopna makaihna adinga thungetna tomno tawh i kipan ding hiam?

records.english: Please pray that I'll be patient with my students tomorrow.
records.zomi: Zingciang ka sangnaupangte tungah thuakzawhna ka neih nadingin thu hong ngetsak in.

records.english: Can a child understand what the Holy Spirit does?
records.zomi: Naupang khat in Kha Siangtho' nasep a thei thei hiam?

records.english: Believers often describe the Spirit's guidance as gentle rather than forceful.
records.zomi: Upmite in Kha Siangtho' makaihna hat sangin nem bangin a gen zel uh hi.

records.english: Is it right to ask the Spirit for help with small things, like finding my keys?
records.zomi: Ka tawh zong bang na neute adingin Kha Siangtho huhna ngen a dik hiam?

records.english: Living by the Spirit is described in the New Testament as a daily walk, not a single event.
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho hangin gamta pen Thukhun Thak sungah ni sim pai bangin kigen a, thupiang khat bek bangin hi lo hi.

records.english: Our youth group asks the Spirit for courage before visiting the old people's home.
records.zomi: I khangno pawl in upa kemna inn a veh ma-un hangsanna adingin Kha Siangtho a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Our family thanks God for the Spirit's help at the end of each day.
records.zomi: Ni khatciat tawpna ciangin i innkuan in Kha Siangtho' huhna adingin Pasian lungdam a gen hi.

records.english: Ask the Spirit to help you, and then do your best.
records.zomi: Hong huh dingin Kha Siangtho ngen in, tua khit ciangin na theih tawp na bawl in.

records.english: Why weren't you at the training session?
records.zomi: Bang hangin sinna hun ah na om kei hiam?

records.english: I was ill, but I've asked a colleague for the notes.
records.zomi: Ka cidam kei a, ahi zongin nasep lawm khat kiangah thu ciamtehnate ka ngen hi.

records.english: Why do you always arrive so early?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ma takin na tung den hiam?

records.english: Why this job, and why now?
records.zomi: Bang hangin hih nasep, bang hangin tu-in?

records.english: Because I want to work with children, and your school has a good reputation.
records.zomi: Naupangte tawh na sem ka deih a, na sang min a hoih ahih manin.

records.english: Why are the results of the staff survey being kept confidential?
records.zomi: Bang hangin nasemte dotna gahte kisel hiam?

records.english: A good manager explains why a change is happening, not only what will change.
records.zomi: Makaipa hoih khat in bang a kikheel ding hiam bek hi lo-in bang hangin kikheelna a om hiam a genteh hi.

records.english: Why are the science lessons in the hall this week?
records.zomi: Bang hangin hih kal science sinnate khan lian ah a om hiam?

records.english: The labs are being painted.
records.zomi: Lab te kikhuh lai hi.

records.english: Why not send the report by email instead?
records.zomi: Bang hangin report email-in khak lo hiam?

records.english: Why was I given the evening shift again?
records.zomi: Bang hangin nitak nasep hun hong pia kik hiam?

records.english: You asked for Mondays off, so the rota had to change.
records.zomi: Pizing ni tawlngak na ngen ahih manin hun kizui list a kikheel kul hi.

records.english: Why did the company change its working hours?
records.zomi: Bang hangin company in a nasep hunte a kheel hiam?

records.english: Most of our customers call in the morning, so we start earlier now.
records.zomi: I vanlei tamzaw in zingsang ah hong sam uh ahih manin tu-in ma deuh-in i kipan uh hi.

records.english: Why should we study history?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tangthu i sin ding hiam?

records.english: Because it helps us understand how the present came to be.
records.zomi: Tu-a om bangci a suak hiam i theih nadingin hong huh ahih manin.

records.english: Why do we need two signatures on this form?
records.zomi: Bang hangin hih lai ah min gelhna nih i kisam hiam?

records.english: It's company policy for any payment over a thousand.
records.zomi: Tul khat val sum piakna khempeuh adingin company thukham ahi hi.

records.english: Why is the office moving to the new building?
records.zomi: Bang hangin office building thak ah a pem hiam?

records.english: The rent is lower, and it's closer to the train station.
records.zomi: Inn man a niam zaw a, meileng khawlna mun tawh a kinaih zaw hi.

records.english: Why are we changing the software?
records.zomi: Bang hangin software i kheel uh hiam?

records.english: The old system can't handle the number of orders we now receive.
records.zomi: System lui in tu-a i ngah van ngetna zah a kem zo kei hi.

records.english: Why has the school banned phones in lessons?
records.zomi: Bang hangin sang in sinna sungah phone a phal kei hiam?

records.english: Teachers found that pupils were distracted and that some were being bullied online.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte a lungsim kilak uh a, pawl khat online-in kinuamsa uh hi, ci sayate in a mu uh hi.

records.english: Why did the client reject our proposal?
records.zomi: Bang hangin vanlei in i deihna gen a nial hiam?

records.english: They felt the budget was too high and the timetable too long.
records.zomi: Sum zat ding a sang lua a, hun ciamteh a sau lua hi, ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi.

records.english: Asking why a rule exists at work often leads to a better rule.
records.zomi: Nasep mun ah thukham khat bang hangin a om hiam dot in thukham hoih zaw a tun zel hi.

records.english: Why do you think so many staff are leaving?
records.zomi: Bang hangin nasem tampi a pai uh hi, na ci hiam?

records.english: Many feel that their hard work isn't recognised.
records.zomi: Tampi in a hanciamna uh kuamah in a phawk kei hi, ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi.

records.english: Why is a helmet required on the site?
records.zomi: Bang hangin mun ah lukhu khauh a kisam hiam?

records.english: Because things can fall from above at any moment.
records.zomi: Hun bangkim ah a tung pan na khat a kia thei ahih manin.

records.english: Why is the meeting so early tomorrow?
records.zomi: Bang hangin zingciang kikhopna a ma mahmah hiam?

records.english: The director has to leave for the airport at ten.
records.zomi: Director in nai sawm ciangin vanlengtual ah a pai kul hi.

records.english: Why did you choose to study medicine?
records.zomi: Bang hangin damdawi sinna na teel hiam?

records.english: My grandmother was a nurse, and her stories inspired me.
records.zomi: Ka pi nurse ahi a, a tangthute in hong hanthawn hi.

records.english: Why do you think the experiment failed?
records.zomi: Bang hangin sitna a lawhcin kei hi, na ci hiam?

records.english: We didn't keep the temperature the same for each sample.
records.zomi: Sample khatciat adingin lumna kibang i kem kei uh hi.

records.english: Why don't we ask the students themselves what they think?
records.zomi: Bang hangin sangnaupangte mah a ngaihsutna uh i dong kei ding uh hiam?

records.english: When managers explain why a deadline matters, teams are more likely to meet it.
records.zomi: Makaite in hun tawpna khat bang hangin a thupi hiam a genteh uh ciangin pawlte in a tun zaw uh hi.

records.english: How come the canteen is closed today?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tuni-in canteen a kikhak hiam?

records.english: The kitchen is being inspected.
records.zomi: Anbuk kien lai hi.

records.english: Why is the printer always out of paper?
records.zomi: Bang hangin printer in lai a nei den kei hiam?

records.english: Nobody refills it after printing large documents.
records.zomi: Document lian a print khit uh ciangin kuamah in a dimsak kik kei uh hi.

records.english: Why was the exam moved to Thursday?
records.zomi: Bang hangin sitna Laizing ni ah kisuan hiam?

records.english: The main hall is being used for a conference on Wednesday.
records.zomi: Nilai ni ciangin khan lian kikhopna lian khat adingin kizang ding hi.

records.english: Why did you leave your last job?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na nasep lui na nusia hiam?

records.english: I wanted a role with more responsibility and the chance to train others.
records.zomi: Mawhpuakna tam zaw leh midangte sinsak theihna nei nasep khat ka deih hi.

records.english: Why are uniforms compulsory at our school?
records.zomi: Bang hangin i sang ah puan kibang silh a kisam hiam?

records.english: The school believes they help pupils focus on learning rather than fashion.
records.zomi: Sang in sangnaupangte in puan sangin sinna ah lungsim a koih theih nadingun a huh hi, ci-in a um hi.

records.english: Students who ask why, not just how, usually understand a subject more deeply.
records.zomi: Bangci bek hi lo-in bang hang hiam a dong sangnaupangte in sinna khat a thei thuk zaw zel uh hi.

records.english: Why has my grade dropped this term?
records.zomi: Bang hangin hih sang hun-in ka nambat a kiam hiam?

records.english: You missed two assignments, and your test scores were lower.
records.zomi: Nasep nih na mansuah a, na sitna nambatte a niam zaw hi.

records.english: Why isn't the library open on Sundays?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Nipini ciangin laibu inn a kihong kei hiam?

records.english: There aren't enough staff to cover the weekend.
records.zomi: Kal tawp adingin nasem a tawk kei uh hi.

records.english: Why is it important to cite your sources?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na thu bulte gen a thupi hiam?

records.english: So that readers can check the information and give credit to the original writers.
records.zomi: Simte in thute a en theih nadingun leh a bul gelhpate zahtakna a piak theih nadingun.

records.english: Why was the project delayed?
records.zomi: Bang hangin project a phawng hiam?

records.english: The supplier sent the wrong parts, and we had to wait for replacements.
records.zomi: Van piaktu in van tuam khial a khak a, a thak i ngak kul uh hi.

records.english: Why must we show our working in maths?
records.zomi: Bang hangin maths ah i nasep i lak kul uh hiam?

records.english: So that the teacher can see where your method goes wrong.
records.zomi: Saya in na lampi koi ah a khial hiam a muh theih nadingin.

records.english: My brother still carries his old passport as a reminder of where we came from.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal in koi pan hong pai i hi hiam a phawk nadingin a passport lui a paipih den lai hi.

records.english: The citizenship ceremony was the first time I saw my father wear a tie.
records.zomi: Gam mi suahna pawi pen ka pa tie a silh ka muh masak pen ahi hi.

records.english: Our children understand that being citizens comes with duties as well as rights.
records.zomi: I tate in gam mi hihna in thuneihna bek hi lo-in mawhpuakna zong a huam hi, ci a thei uh hi.

records.english: Citizenship has allowed our family to travel back to visit relatives safely.
records.zomi: Gam mi hihna in i innkuan bit takin sanggamte veh dingin ciah kik theihna a pia hi.

records.english: My cousin's citizenship application took four years because of missing papers.
records.zomi: Lai mangte hangin ka sanggam' gam mi hihna ngetna kum li a la hi.

records.english: Shall we hang the flag at the window again this year?
records.zomi: Hih kum zong tohkhawng ah flag i khai kik ding hiam?

records.english: Is our baby a citizen of both countries?
records.zomi: I naungek gam nih' mi ahi hiam?

records.english: Who will look after the children while we go to the citizenship interview?
records.zomi: Gam mi hihna kidotna ah i pai laitakin naupangte kua in a kem ding hiam?

records.english: New citizens in our family always choose a special meal to celebrate.
records.zomi: I innkuan-a gam mi thakte in lawmna dingin an tuam khat a teel tawntung uh hi.

records.english: Holding the new passport, my mother said she finally felt she belonged.
records.zomi: Passport thak a len ciangin ka nu in ka tawpna-ah hih gam mi ka hi ta hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Thank you for helping my parents with their citizenship forms.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa' gam mi hihna lai ah na huh manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: My brother's citizenship came through just in time for him to vote in the election.
records.zomi: Teelna ah vote a khiat theih nadingin ka u pasal' gam mi hihna a hun tak-in a tung hi.

records.english: Our youngest wanted to know whether she needed a test, too, since she was born here.
records.zomi: I tanu neu pen hih gam ah a suak ahih manin amah zong sitna a kisam hiam a theih nop hi.

records.english: Our family still celebrates the day we all became citizens.
records.zomi: I innkuan in i khempeuh gam mi i suah ni tu dong i lawm lai uh hi.

records.english: My sister works at the citizenship office and helps families like ours.
records.zomi: Ka u numei gam mi hihna office ah na a sem a, eite bang innkuante a huh hi.

records.english: Mum, why do you have two passports?
records.zomi: Nu, bang hangin passport nih na nei hiam?

records.english: Because I was born in one country and became a citizen of another.
records.zomi: Gam khat ah ka suak a, gam dang khat' mi ka suah manin.

records.english: Did Grandpa ever become a citizen here?
records.zomi: Pu hih gam ah gam mi a suak ngei hiam?

records.english: My grandparents never became citizens, but they always called this country home.
records.zomi: Ka pu leh ka pi gam mi a suak ngei kei uh a, ahi zongin hih gam inn bangin a sam tawntung uh hi.

records.english: My parents still keep the letter that told them their application had been approved.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in a ngetna uh kipom hi, ci a gen lai a kem lai uh hi.

records.english: Our family's first trip abroad as citizens was to visit Grandma's village.
records.zomi: Gam mi-in i innkuan gamdang khualzinna masa pen Pi' khua veh ahi hi.

records.english: My husband became a citizen the same year our first child was born.
records.zomi: I ta masa pen a suah kum mah-in ka pasal gam mi a suak hi.

records.english: Our family's citizenship story is one we tell the children every year.
records.zomi: I innkuan gam mi suahna tangthu kum simin i tate kiangah i gen uh hi.

records.english: My parents' citizenship meant we no longer had to renew our visas every year.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa' gam mi hihna in kum simin i visa i bawl thak kul nawn kei uh hi.

records.english: Our children were born here, so they became citizens automatically.
records.zomi: I tate hih gam ah a suak uh ahih manin amah mah-in gam mi a suak uh hi.

records.english: When my uncle became a citizen, he invited the whole street to a party.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu gam mi a suah ciangin lampi bup pawi ah a sam hi.

records.english: My wife and I took the oath together, holding hands.
records.zomi: Ka zi leh kei khut kilen-in kiciamna i bawl khawm uh hi.

records.english: Shall we take a family photo at the ceremony?
records.zomi: Pawi ah innkuan lim khat i la ding hiam?

records.english: Do I have to give up my old passport?
records.zomi: Ka passport lui ka nusia kul hiam?

records.english: That depends on the rules of both countries, so let's ask the embassy.
records.zomi: Tua pen gam nih' thukham tungah kinga ahih manin embassy i dong ding.

records.english: Grandma learned the national anthem for her citizenship ceremony.
records.zomi: Pi in a gam mi suahna pawi adingin gam la a sin hi.

records.english: Dad framed his citizenship certificate and hung it next to our wedding photos.
records.zomi: Pa in a gam mi hihna lai kipsakna lim kuang ah a koih a, i mopawi limte kiangah a khai hi.

records.english: When my parents became citizens, they started reading the local newspaper every day.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa gam mi a suah uh ciangin ni simin khua sung thuthak lai a sim kipan uh hi.

records.english: Auntie Ngun waited in the queue at the passport office with all her documents in a plastic folder.
records.zomi: Ni Ngun in a lai khempeuh plastic folder khat sungah koih-in passport office ah a kizom-in a ngak hi.

records.english: Can you help me fill in the citizenship application for Grandpa?

records.zomi: Pawi ah i kimansuah ciangin i gelh bangin sing lian kiang ah i kimu uh hi.

records.english: Did anyone write down the name of the hotel?
records.zomi: Zinbuuk min kuamah in a gelh hiam?

records.english: My husband refused to admit we were lost until the road ended at a river.
records.zomi: Lampi gun ah a bei dong ka pasal in i pial uh hi, ci a pom nuam kei hi.

records.english: Grandpa told us how he once found his way home through the hills by following the stars.
records.zomi: Pu in aksite zui-in mual kal-a inn paina lampi khatvei a muh thu hong gen hi.

records.english: Shall we ask that farmer for directions?
records.zomi: Tua loubawlpa lampi i dong ding hiam?

records.english: Our son learned our phone number by heart after getting lost at the beach.
records.zomi: Tuipi gei ah a pial khit ciangin i tapa in i phone nambat a ngaihkhiat a sin hi.

records.english: Which exit did we come in by?
records.zomi: Bang kongkhak pan i lut uh hiam?

records.english: My cousin got lost in the forest and followed a stream until she found a road.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam gammang ah a pial a, lampi a muh dong luidung khat a zui hi.

records.english: An hour of being lost felt like a whole day to the children.
records.zomi: Nai khat pial pen naupangte adingin ni khat bup bangin a om hi.

records.english: When the fog came down on the hill, Dad made us hold onto each other's coats.
records.zomi: Mual tungah meiphum a kiat ciangin Pa in khat leh khat puansilh len dingin hong gen hi.

records.english: My uncle laughs that he has been lost in every country he has visited.
records.zomi: A veh gam khempeuh ah a pial ngei hi, ci-in ka pa neu a nuih hi.

records.english: Grandma laughs about the day she took the wrong bus and ended up in another town.
records.zomi: Bus khial a tuang-a khua dang ah a tun ni thu Pi in a nuihsan hi.

records.english: The kids drew a map of our route so that we wouldn't get lost again.
records.zomi: I pial kik loh nadingin naupangte in i lampi map khat a gelh uh hi.

records.english: Our grandparents never used maps, yet they always found their way.
records.zomi: I pu leh i pite in map a zang ngei kei uh a, ahi zongin a lampi uh a mu tawntung uh hi.

records.english: Turn around; I think we missed the exit.
records.zomi: Kiheei in; kongkhak i pelh hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: Who has the better sense of direction, you or Mum?
records.zomi: Nang hiam Nu hiam kua in lampi theihna hoih zaw a nei hiam?

records.english: Getting lost in a new city taught my parents to trust the kindness of strangers.
records.zomi: Khuapi thak ah pial in ka nu leh ka pa mi theih ngeih lote' hehpihna muang dingin a sinsak hi.

records.english: When we finally found the campsite, it was dark and everyone was hungry.
records.zomi: Lum mun i muh tawp ciangin a mial ta a, mi khempeuh a gilkial uh hi.

records.english: Getting lost made us discover a café we still visit every summer.
records.zomi: Pial in khal simin i veh lai cafe khat i muh nadingin hong huh hi.

records.english: Did we miss the turning again?
records.zomi: Lampi kiheina i pelh kik uh hiam?

records.english: Grandpa got lost in the city because all the old landmarks had gone.
records.zomi: Theihtheihna luite khempeuh a mang ahih manin Pu khuapi ah a pial hi.

records.english: Dad, are we lost?
records.zomi: Pa, i pial uh hiam?

records.english: Not lost, just taking the long way round.
records.zomi: Pial lo, lampi sau zaw i zui bek hi.

records.english: Let's stop and look at the map before we go any further.
records.zomi: I pai zom ma-in i khawl a, map i en ding.

records.english: We got lost on the way to Grandma's new house, and the children loved the adventure.
records.zomi: Pi' inn thak paina lampi ah i pial uh a, naupangte in khualzinna lamdang a uk mahmah uh hi.

records.english: Our family argued about directions until we all laughed at ourselves.
records.zomi: I khempeuh i kinuihsan dong lampi tungtang i innkuan a kiel uh hi.

records.english: When we got lost in the snow, we waited in the car until the plough came.
records.zomi: Vuuk sungah i pial ciangin vuuk phiatna mawtaw a tun dong mawtaw sungah i ngak uh hi.

records.english: Mum still tells the story of the night she got lost walking home from church.
records.zomi: Pawlpi pan inn ah a pai laitakin a pial zan tangthu Nu in tu dong a gen lai hi.

records.english: What did you do when you got separated from the family?
records.zomi: Innkuan pan na kikhen ciangin bang na bawl hiam?

records.english: I stood still by the fountain, just like you told me.
records.zomi: Nang hong gen mah bangin tui khuk kiang ah ka ding den hi.

records.english: Getting lost with children is frightening, but staying calm helps everyone.
records.zomi: Naupangte tawh pial pen a lauhuai a, ahi zongin lungnem in mi khempeuh a huh hi.

records.english: With no signal, we had to stop at a petrol station to ask the way.
records.zomi: Signal a om loh ciangin lampi dong dingin datsi zuakna mun ah i khawl kul uh hi.

records.english: Our daughter called us from the wrong station, and we talked her back step by step.
records.zomi: I tanu in meileng khawlna mun khial pan hong sam a, kalsuan khatciat-in i paipih kik uh hi.

records.english: When the children were small, we dressed them in bright colours at crowded places.
records.zomi: Naupangte a neu lai-un mi tam munte ah rong taang puan i silh sak uh hi.

records.english: I'm sure we've been down this road before.
records.zomi: Hih lampi ah i pai ngei hi, ka um hi.

records.english: Did you tell the children where to wait if they lose us?
records.zomi: Eite a mansuah uh leh koi ah a ngak ding uh hiam naupangte na gen hiam?

records.english: We teach our children to look for someone in a uniform if they get lost.
records.zomi: A pial uh leh puan kibang silh mi khat zong dingin i tate i sinsak uh hi.

records.english: Getting lost together has given our family some of our best stories.
records.zomi: Khawm-in pial in i innkuan tangthu hoih pen pawl khat a pia hi.

records.english: Did you leave the trail markers where we can see them?
records.zomi: Lampi ciamtehnate i muh theih mun ah na nusia hiam?

records.english: My brother got lost on his first day at secondary school and arrived late to every lesson.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal a high school ni masa pen-in a pial a, sinna khempeuh ah a nunung hi.

records.english: Dad was so sure of the way that he didn't notice we had passed the same church twice.
records.zomi: Pa in lampi a thei taktak hi, a ci ahih manin pawlpi kibang nihvei i pelh uh a phawk kei hi.

records.english: Teaching children what to do if they get lost is one of the first safety lessons.
records.zomi: Naupangte a pial uh leh bang a bawl ding uh hiam sinsak pen bitna sinna masa pente lak ah khat ahi hi.

records.english: When Grandma's eyesight got worse, she started getting lost in her own neighbourhood.
records.zomi: Pi' mit a hoih nawn loh ciangin amah mah khua sung ah a pial kipan hi.

records.english: The Ten Commandments list some of the actions that the Bible treats as sin.
records.zomi: Thupiak Sawm in Laisiangtho in mawhna bangin a ngaihsut gamtatna pawl khat a gelh hi.

records.english: Christians often say that sin begins in the heart before it shows in actions.
records.zomi: Mawhna gamtatna ah a kilat ma-in lungtang sungah a kipan hi, ci-in Khristiante in a gen zel uh hi.

records.english: Jealousy is one of the sins that Paul warns about in his letters.
records.zomi: Hazatna pen Paul in a laite sungah a lau sak mawhna khat ahi hi.

records.english: Christians often teach children to say sorry to God and to the person they have hurt.
records.zomi: Khristiante in naupangte Pasian leh a na sak mi kiangah maisak ngen dingin a sinsak zel uh hi.

records.english: Our pastor said that refusing to forgive others can also be a kind of sin.
records.zomi: Midangte maisak nial zong mawhna khat ahi thei hi, ci-in i pastor in a gen hi.

records.english: Do Christians think some sins are worse than others?
records.zomi: Khristiante in mawhna pawl khat a dangte sangin a gik zaw hi, ci-in a ngaihsun uh hiam?

records.english: Does everyone struggle with sin, even pastors?
records.zomi: Pastorte zong mi khempeuh in mawhna a do uh hiam?

records.english: Some Christians keep a quiet moment each evening to think about where they have gone wrong.
records.zomi: Khristian pawl khat in nitak simin koi ah a khial uh hiam ngaihsun dingin dai hun tomno a nei uh hi.

records.english: Our pastor explained that pride is often seen as the root of many other sins.
records.zomi: Kiphatsakna pen mawhna dang tampi' bulpi bangin kingaihsun zel hi, ci-in i pastor in a genteh hi.

records.english: Christians speak of sins of commission, which are wrong things done, and sins of omission, which are good things left undone.
records.zomi: Khristiante in na khial bawl mawhna leh na hoih bawl lo mawhna tungtang a gen uh hi.

records.english: Jesus told a parable about a son who left home and wasted his money, then came back to his father.
records.zomi: Jesu in inn nusia-a a sum paikhia, tua khit ciangin a pa kiangah a ciah kik tapa khat tungtang tangthu gentehna khat a gen hi.

records.english: The Psalms include prayers in which the writer confesses his sins and asks for mercy.
records.zomi: Late Laibu sungah a gelhpa in a mawhnate pulak-a hehpihna a ngetna thungetnate a om hi.

records.english: The Bible uses many pictures for sin, such as missing a target or going astray.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho in ngim khial hiam lampi pial bang mawhna adingin lim tampi a zang hi.

records.english: According to Christian teaching, nobody except Jesus has lived without sin.
records.zomi: Khristian hilhna bangin Jesu simloh kuamah mawhna om lo-in a nungta ngei kei hi.

records.english: Many Christians believe that God's love is greater than any sin.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in Pasian' itna mawhna khatpeuh sangin a lian zaw hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: In Christian teaching, recognising sin is the first step towards forgiveness.
records.zomi: Khristian hilhna ah mawhna theih pen maisakna lam-a kalsuan masa pen ahi hi.

records.english: Ask your pastor if you have questions about what the Bible says about sin.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho in mawhna tungtang bang a gen hiam dotna na neih leh na pastor dong in.

records.english: Gossip and unkind words are also described as sins in the letters of the New Testament.
records.zomi: Thu phiatna leh kammal hoih lote zong Thukhun Thak laite sungah mawhna bangin kigen hi.

records.english: Different Christian traditions explain original sin in different ways.
records.zomi: Khristian ngeina tuamtuamte in a bul mawhna zia tuamtuam-in a genteh uh hi.

records.english: Can sin become a habit if it is not resisted?
records.zomi: Mawhna a kidal kei leh ngeina ah a suak thei hiam?

records.english: Can sin be in thoughts and words, not only in actions?
records.zomi: Mawhna gamtatna bek hi lo-in ngaihsutna leh kammal sungah zong a om thei hiam?

records.english: Do you confess your sins when you pray?
records.zomi: Thu na ngen ciangin na mawhnate na pulak hiam?

records.english: Is it a sin to be angry?
records.zomi: Heh pen mawhna hiam?

records.english: Many Christian teachers say that anger itself isn't always sin, but what we do with it can be.
records.zomi: Khristian hilhpa tampi in heh mah pen mawhna hi tawntung kei a, ahi zongin a tunga i bawl pen mawhna ahi thei hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: Why does the Bible warn so often about greed?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Laisiangtho in duhopna tungtang tampi vei a lau sak hiam?

records.english: Many Christians believe that sin affects the whole world, not just individual people.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in mawhna in mimal bek hi lo-in leitung bup a khoih hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Some traditions distinguish between serious sins and lesser ones, while others treat all sin as serious before God.
records.zomi: Ngeina pawl khat in mawhna gik leh neu a khen uh a, a dangte in Pasian mai ah mawhna khempeuh a gik hi, ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi.

records.english: Christians believe that the cross shows both how serious sin is and how much God loves people.
records.zomi: Singlamteh in mawhna bangzah a gik hiam leh Pasian in mite bangzah a it hiam a lak hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: Does everyone need God's forgiveness, whatever their background?
records.zomi: A khanglian bangci om zongin mi khempeuh in Pasian' maisakna a kisam uh hiam?

records.english: The Bible describes sin as something that entered the world and spread to all people.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho in mawhna leitung ah hong lut-a mi khempeuh tungah a kizeek na khat bangin a gen hi.

records.english: Our youth leader said that sin is often a matter of loving the wrong things more than God.
records.zomi: Mawhna pen Pasian sangin na khial tam zaw it ahi zel hi, ci-in i khangno makaipa in a gen hi.

records.english: How should parents explain sin to young children?
records.zomi: Nu leh pate in naupang neute kiangah mawhna bangci a genteh ding uh hiam?

records.english: Christians believe that sin is real, but that it does not have the final word.
records.zomi: Mawhna a om taktak a, ahi zongin a nunung thu gen pen hi lo hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: Is it a sin to forget to pray?
records.zomi: Thu ngen mangngilh pen mawhna hiam?

records.english: Jesus taught that hatred in the heart is serious, even if it never leads to violence.
records.zomi: Lungtang sung-a mudahna gamtatna hat ah a tun kei zongin a gik hi, ci-in Jesu in a hilh hi.

records.english: Christians believe that sin separates people from God, but that God offers forgiveness.
records.zomi: Mawhna in mite Pasian pan a khen a, ahi zongin Pasian in maisakna a pia hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: Is it ever too late to ask God for forgiveness?
records.zomi: Pasian kiangah maisakna ngen a nunung lua ngei hiam?

records.english: According to the Gospels, Jesus ate with people whom others called sinners.
records.zomi: Lungdamna Laibute bangin midangte in mawhnei a cih mite tawh Jesu an a ne hi.

records.english: In Christian teaching, sin means anything that breaks a person's relationship with God.
records.zomi: Khristian hilhna ah mawhna in mi khat leh Pasian kikal kizopna a phelsak na khempeuh cihna ahi hi.

records.english: Our Bible study group talked about how small dishonest habits can grow over time.
records.zomi: I Laisiangtho sinna pawl in zuauna neu ngeinate hun sawt-in bangci a khang thei hiam a kihopih uh hi.

records.english: Lying, stealing and cruelty are examples of sin in many Christian teachings.
records.zomi: Khristian hilhna tampi ah zuau, guk leh gilouna pen mawhna entehna ahi hi.

records.english: Christian teaching says that sin is not only about breaking rules but about broken relationships.
records.zomi: Mawhna pen thukham phelh bek hi lo-in kizopna kitan tungtang ahi hi, ci-in Khristian hilhna in a gen hi.

records.english: Our Sunday school teacher said that sin is like a stain that only God can wash away.
records.zomi: Mawhna pen Pasian bek in a sil siangthosak thei nin khat bang ahi hi, ci-in i Nipini sang saya in a gen hi.

records.english: In the Bible, King David is shown both as a man of faith and as a man who sinned seriously.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho sungah kumpipa David upna nei mi leh mawhna gik a bawl mi a nih bangin kilak hi.

records.english: Selfishness is a common way of describing the nature of sin.
records.zomi: Mimal deihna kibawl pen mawhna zia gen nading lampi tam khat ahi hi.

records.english: Many churches teach that sin can be forgiven through faith in Jesus.
records.zomi: Pawlpi tampi in Jesu upna tungtawn-in mawhna kimaisak thei hi, ci-in a hilh uh hi.

records.english: Sin is a serious subject, but Christian teaching never presents it without hope.
records.zomi: Mawhna pen thu gik ahi a, ahi zongin Khristian hilhna in lametna om lo-in a gen ngei kei hi.

records.english: Children often learn about sin through simple stories about choices and their consequences.
records.zomi: Naupangte in teelna leh a gahte tungtang tangthu baihte tungtawn-in mawhna tungtang a sin zel uh hi.

records.english: In many hymns, sin is described as a burden that is lifted by God's grace.
records.zomi: La tampi sungah mawhna pen Pasian' hehpihna in a lak puakgik khat bangin kigen hi.

records.english: In the story of Adam and Eve, the first sin is described as disobeying God's command.
records.zomi: Adam leh Eve tangthu sungah mawhna masa pen Pasian thupiak nial bangin kigen hi.

records.english: Thank you for explaining sin to the children in such a gentle way.
records.zomi: Naupangte kiangah mawhna nem takin na genteh manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: The Lord's Prayer asks God to forgive us as we forgive others.
records.zomi: Topa' Thungetna in midangte i maisak bangin Pasian hong maisak dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: What does sin mean, Mum?
records.zomi: Nu, mawhna bang cihna hiam?

records.english: Christians often describe it as doing wrong against God and other people.
records.zomi: Khristiante in Pasian leh midangte tungah na khial bawl bangin a gen zel uh hi.

records.english: Christians understand temptation as the pull towards sin, not as sin itself.
records.zomi: Khristiante in sitna pen mawhna lam-a kaihna bangin a thei uh a, mawhna mah bangin a thei kei uh hi.

records.english: Do children inherit sin from their parents, according to Christian teaching?
records.zomi: Khristian hilhna bangin naupangte in a nu leh a pa uh pan mawhna a luah uh hiam?

records.english: Many believers say that sin hurts the person who commits it as well as others.
records.zomi: Upmi tampi in mawhna in midangte bek hi lo-in a bawlpa zong a na sak hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: Talk of sin can make people feel guilty, but Christians also link it with the hope of forgiveness.
records.zomi: Mawhna thu gen in mite a mawh sak thei a, ahi zongin Khristiante in maisakna lametna tawh zong a kizopsak uh hi.

records.english: According to Paul's letter to the Romans, all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.
records.zomi: Paul' Rom laibu bangin mi khempeuh a mawh uh a, Pasian maipha ngahna dingin kisia uh hi.

records.english: Many Christians pray a prayer of confession together at the start of the church service.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in pawlpi biakna kipatna ciangin mawhna pulakna thungetna khawm-in a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Good evidence can be checked by someone else.
records.zomi: Kipsakna hoih mi dang khat in a en thei hi.

records.english: What sources did you use for your presentation?
records.zomi: Na presentation adingin bang thu bulte na zang hiam?

records.english: Two textbooks, a newspaper article and an interview with a local engineer.
records.zomi: Laibu nih, thuthak lai lai khat leh khua sung engineer khat tawh kidotna.

records.english: Can anyone find evidence in the text that the character was lying?
records.zomi: Lai sung pan mi khat a zuau hi, ci kipsakna kuamah in a mu thei hiam?

records.english: What proof is there that the training improved performance?
records.zomi: Sinna in nasep a hoih zawsak hi, ci bang kipsakna a om hiam?

records.english: Sales rose by ten per cent in the three months after the course.
records.zomi: Sinna khit kha thum sungin van zuak za sim sawm a khang hi.

records.english: Can you prove that the shipment arrived damaged?
records.zomi: Van khak a sia-in a tung hi, ci na kipsak thei ding hiam?

records.english: We took photos as soon as we opened the boxes.
records.zomi: Bawmte i hon pakin lim i la uh hi.

records.english: Where's your evidence that the new timetable is working?
records.zomi: Hun ciamteh thak a sem hi, ci na kipsakna koi ah a om hiam?

records.english: Attendance has gone up, and fewer pupils are late.
records.zomi: Sang kahte a khang a, a nunung sangnaupang a tawm zaw hi.

records.english: Can you show me the email where the client agreed to the price?
records.zomi: Vanlei in man a pom email hong lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Do you have any data from previous years to compare?
records.zomi: Kiteh nadingin kum beisate pan data na nei hiam?

records.english: Teachers ask for evidence because a strong opinion is not the same as a strong argument.
records.zomi: Ngaihsutna hat pen a hang hat tawh a kibang kei ahih manin sayate in kipsakna a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Can you give an example to support your argument?
records.zomi: Na a hang panpih nadingin entehna khat na pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, the school in our town saved money by switching to solar power.
records.zomi: Pia thei ing, i khua-a sang in ni meivak tha ah a kheel tawh sum a kem hi.

records.english: A claim without evidence is only an opinion, our lecturer reminds us.
records.zomi: Kipsakna om lo thu genna pen ngaihsutna bek ahi hi, ci-in i sangpi saya in hong phawk sak hi.

records.english: Managers who ask for evidence make better decisions than those who rely on rumours.
records.zomi: Kipsakna a ngen makaite in thu zak tungah a kinga makaite sangin khensatna hoih zaw a bawl uh hi.

records.english: Researchers must show how they collected their evidence so that others can check it.
records.zomi: Thu suite in midangte in a en theih nadingun a kipsaknate uh bangci a kaikhawm uh hiam a lak ding uh hi.

records.english: The auditor asked to see the original invoices, not copies.
records.zomi: Sum entu in copy hi lo-in a bul invoice te en dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: Do you have a source for that statistic?
records.zomi: Tua nambat adingin thu bul na nei hiam?

records.english: It comes from last year's national census.
records.zomi: Kum bei-a gam mi simna pan hong pai hi.

records.english: Students learn to question sources before they trust them.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte in thu bulte a muan ma-un dot a sin uh hi.

records.english: What evidence would change your mind?
records.zomi: Bang kipsakna in na ngaihsutna a kheel ding hiam?

records.english: Do you have photos of the problem with the equipment?
records.zomi: Vanzat buaina lim na nei hiam?

records.english: Could you send me a screenshot of the error message?
records.zomi: Error message' screenshot khat hong khak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Students should support each point with a quotation from the text.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte in a thu khatciat lai sung pan kammal khat tawh a panpih ding uh hi.

records.english: Without evidence, the complaint against the supplier could not go any further.
records.zomi: Kipsakna om lo-in van piaktu tunga phunna a pai zom thei kei hi.

records.english: Please attach your receipts to the expenses form as evidence.
records.zomi: Kipsakna dingin sum zat lai ah na man laite behlap in.

records.english: Did you check the figures before you sent the report?
records.zomi: Report na khak ma-in nambatte na en hiam?

records.english: Twice, and my colleague checked them too.
records.zomi: Nihvei, ka nasep lawm in zong a en hi.

records.english: How do we know the survey wasn't biased?
records.zomi: Dotna in lang khat a panpih kei hi, ci bangci i thei uh hiam?

records.english: The teacher returned my essay with a note asking for more evidence in the second paragraph.
records.zomi: Saya in paragraph nihna ah kipsakna behlap ngenna ciamtehna tawh ka lai gelh hong pia kik hi.

records.english: A good report always explains where its numbers come from.
records.zomi: Report hoih khat in a nambatte koi pan hong pai hiam a genteh tawntung hi.

records.english: When evidence and expectations disagree, it's usually the expectations that should change.
records.zomi: Kipsakna leh lamen a kituak loh ciangin a kheel ding pen a tamzaw-in lamente ahi hi.

records.english: Is there any record of the meeting?
records.zomi: Kikhopna ciamtehna bangmah a om hiam?

records.english: Yes, the minutes were sent to everyone on Friday.
records.zomi: Om hi, kikhopna ciamtehna Laithai ni ciangin mi khempeuh kiangah kikhak hi.

records.english: Is there a reference for this quotation?
records.zomi: Hih kammal adingin thu bul a om hiam?

records.english: What makes you think the machine is faulty?

records.english: Shall I call the repair shop or try to fix it myself?

records.english: Grandpa says that words are like seeds, and you must be careful where you plant them.
