records.english: We prop the tablet against the fruit bowl so that Grandma can see the whole table.
records.zomi: Pi in ankuang bup a muh theih nadingin theigah bel tungah tablet i kaap uh hi.

records.english: My sister showed us her new flat on a video call, room by room.
records.zomi: Ka u numei in video call tungah a inn thak inndan khat ciat hong lak hi.

records.english: It's hard to have a private conversation on a video call when the whole family is in the room.
records.zomi: Innkuan bup inndan sung a om ciangin video call tungah mimal kihopihna nei a haksa hi.

records.english: Why does the picture freeze whenever Auntie Hoih moves?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Ni Hoih a kitawn simin lim a khawl hiam?

records.english: During the call, the children held up the drawings they had made for their grandparents.
records.zomi: Call lai-in naupangte in a pu leh pi te adingin a lai lim te a lak uh hi.

records.english: Our son read his school story aloud to his grandparents over video.
records.zomi: I tapa in a sang tangthu video tungtawnin a pu leh pi te kiangah aw tawh a sim hi.

records.english: We video-call my brother in the army every Sunday evening.
records.zomi: Nipini nitak simin galkap-a om ka u pasal video call i sam uh hi.

records.english: Seeing my father's face on a screen made me miss home even more.
records.zomi: Screen tungah ka pa' mai ka muh in inn hong ngaisak zaw hi.

records.english: My daughter helps her cousin with his homework over a video call.
records.zomi: I tanu in video call tungah a sanggam inn-a sin ding a huh hi.

records.english: Can Grandma see us if the room is this dark?
records.zomi: Inndan hih bangzah a mial ciangin Pi in kote hong mu thei hiam?

records.english: Not really, so let's turn on the big light.
records.zomi: Mu thei lo hi, tua ahih manin meivak lian hal ni.

records.english: My little brother practises his piano pieces for our aunt on video.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal in ka ni adingin video tungah a piano la te a kisin hi.

records.english: When Mum was in hospital, video calls were the only way the grandchildren could see her.
records.zomi: Nu damdawi inn a om lai-in video call bek in a tute in amah a muh theihna lam ahi hi.

records.english: Our daughter introduced her fiancé to the family on a video call before they met in person.
records.zomi: Kimaituah-a a kimuh ma-un i tanu in a kiteen ding pasal video call tungah innkuan kiangah a theisak hi.

records.english: Family video calls work best when everyone gets a turn to speak.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh in gen hun a ngah ciangin innkuan video call te a hoih pen hi.

records.english: Grandma likes to end every call by blessing each of us by name.
records.zomi: Pi in call khempeuh kote khatciat' min tawh thupha piak-in a tawpsak nuam hi.

records.english: Before the call, we tidied the part of the room that the camera could see.
records.zomi: Call ma-in camera in a muh theih inndan khen i siangsak uh hi.

records.english: Our whole family prays together on a video call every Friday night.
records.zomi: I innkuan bup in Laithai nitak simin video call tungah khawm-in a thungen uh hi.

records.english: My brother joined my wedding by video from a hospital bed, and the guests cheered when he waved.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal in damdawi inn lupna tung pan video tawh ka mopawi ah a kihel a, khut a vai ciangin khualte a kiko uh hi.

records.english: We set up a video call so that Grandpa could watch our daughter's school play.
records.zomi: Pu in i tanu' sang lam-en a en theih nadingin video call khat i bawl uh hi.

records.english: The children love making silly faces at their cousins during video calls.
records.zomi: Video call lai-in naupangte in a sanggamte' tungah mai lamdang bawl a it uh hi.

records.english: Did you manage to watch the wedding on the video call?
records.zomi: Video call tungah mopawi na en thei hiam?

records.english: Yes, my cousin held her phone up during the whole ceremony.
records.zomi: Thei hi, ka sanggam in kikhop bup sung a phone a dom hi.

records.english: Could you turn the camera round so that I can see Dad?
records.zomi: Pa ka muh theih nadingin camera na hei thei ding hiam?

records.english: When the baby saw Grandpa's face on the screen, she reached out to touch it.
records.zomi: Naungek in screen tungah Pu' mai a muh ciangin a khoih dingin a khut a zan hi.

records.english: Please say goodbye properly before you hang up.
records.zomi: Na khak ma-in goodbye dik takin ci in.

records.english: Is your camera on, Grandpa?
records.zomi: Pu, na camera a kihon hiam?

records.english: My little sister asked whether God's grace ever runs out.
records.zomi: Pasian' hehpihna a bei ngei hiam ci-in ka nau numei in a dong hi.

records.english: Thank you for showing me grace when I didn't deserve it.
records.zomi: Ka tham loh lai-in hong hehpih manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Grace and justice can seem to pull in opposite directions.
records.zomi: Hehpihna leh dikna te lam tuam-in a kidiak bang hi thei hi.

records.english: Our Bible study group spent the evening talking about grace.
records.zomi: I Laisiangtho kisinna pawl in hehpihna tawh kisai nitak bup a kikum uh hi.

records.english: Can you explain grace in simple words?
records.zomi: Hehpihna kammal baih tawh na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: In our church, new believers learn about grace in their first class.
records.zomi: I pawlpi ah um mi thakte in a class masa pen-in hehpihna tawh kisai a sin uh hi.

records.english: Do Christians believe they can earn God's forgiveness?
records.zomi: Khristiante in Pasian' maisakna a sep tawh a ngah thei uh hi, ci-in a um uh hiam?

records.english: Most Christian teaching says that forgiveness is a gift, not a reward for good works.
records.zomi: Khristian thuhilhna tamzaw in maisakna pen nasep hoih thaman hi lo-in letsong ahi hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Is grace the same as mercy?
records.zomi: Hehpihna leh zawnghuaisakna a kibang hiam?

records.english: Our youth leader drew a picture on the board to show what justification means.
records.zomi: I khangno makaipa in dikkisakna a cihna lak nadingin board tungah lim khat a lai hi.

records.english: Our choir sang a hymn about grace at my grandfather's funeral.
records.zomi: Ka pu' mithi vuina ah i la sa pawl in hehpihna tawh kisai la khat a sa uh hi.

records.english: I do want to show others the same grace that I have received.
records.zomi: Ka ngah hehpihna kibang midangte tungah lak ka deih taktak hi.

records.english: What does grace mean in church?
records.zomi: Pawlpi ah hehpihna in bang cihna hiam?

records.english: Our pastor says it means God's love that we haven't earned.
records.zomi: I tham loh Pasian' itna cihna ahi hi, ci-in i pastor in a gen hi.

records.english: If grace is free, why does our pastor say it changes how we live?
records.zomi: Hehpihna man om lo ahih leh bang hangin i nuntakzia a khek hi, ci-in i pastor in a gen hiam?

records.english: The more I learn about grace, the more humble I feel.
records.zomi: Hehpihna tawh kisai ka sin tam ciangin ka kiniamkhiat zaw hi.

records.english: Having been forgiven himself, my brother found it easier to forgive others.
records.zomi: Amah kimaisak khin ahih manin ka u pasal in midangte maisak a baih zaw-in a mu hi.

records.english: Grandpa often said that he was saved by grace, not by his own goodness.
records.zomi: Amah' hoihna hangin hi lo-in hehpihna hangin hotkhiatna a ngah hi, ci-in Pu in a gen zel hi.

records.english: Shall we thank God for his grace at the end of the service?
records.zomi: Pawlpi kikhop tawp ciangin Pasian' hehpihna adingin i lungdam ding hiam?

records.english: We say grace before every meal in our family.
records.zomi: I innkuan in an khempeuh nek ma-in an thu i ngen uh hi.

records.english: The sermon on grace made my father call his brother after years of silence.
records.zomi: Hehpihna tawh kisai thugen in ka pa kum tampi a dai khit ciangin a u pasal a sam sak hi.

records.english: Our grandmother called every good thing in her life a sign of God's grace.
records.zomi: I pi in a nuntakna-a hoih khempeuh Pasian' hehpihna lim-in a gen hi.

records.english: Why did you forgive him so quickly?
records.zomi: Bang hangin a hun-in amah na maisak hiam?

records.english: Because I've been forgiven so much myself.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah zong tampi kimaisak ka hi hi.

records.english: To be justified, according to Christian teaching, is to be put right with God.
records.zomi: Khristian thuhilhna bangin dikkisakna pen Pasian tawh a dik-a kikoih kik cihna ahi hi.

records.english: What does it mean to live by grace?
records.zomi: Hehpihna-in nungta in bang cihna hiam?

records.english: Children, God's grace is for each one of you.
records.zomi: Naupangte, Pasian' hehpihna pen note khatciat adingin ahi hi.

records.english: Many Christians describe justification as being declared not guilty before God.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in dikkisakna pen Pasian maiah mawhna nei lo-in kiphuang cihna-in a gen uh hi.

records.english: The Protestant Reformation is known for its strong teaching on justification by faith.
records.zomi: Protestant Reformation pen upna tawh dikkisakna thuhilhna hat a nei hangin a kithei hi.

records.english: Let's pray for God's grace for our sick neighbour.
records.zomi: I inn veng cina adingin Pasian' hehpihna i thungen ni.

records.english: Christians believe that grace is a gift from God.
records.zomi: Khristiante in hehpihna pen Pasian pan letsong ahi hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Why do some Christians find it hard to accept a gift they cannot pay back?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Khristian khenkhat in a thuk kik theih loh letsong khat sang a haksa sa uh hiam?

records.english: I felt God's grace most clearly during the hardest year of my life.
records.zomi: Ka nuntakna-a kum haksa pen sung-in Pasian' hehpihna kician pen-in ka thei hi.

records.english: What is justification?
records.zomi: Dikkisakna bang hiam?

records.english: In Christian teaching, it means being made right with God.
records.zomi: Khristian thuhilhna ah Pasian tawh a dik-a kibawl cihna ahi hi.

records.english: In Sunday school, we learned that grace is like a gift with no price tag.
records.zomi: Nipini sang ah hehpihna pen man ciamtehna om lo letsong bang ahi hi, cih i sin uh hi.

records.english: Do you pray for grace to be patient, as my mother does?
records.zomi: Ka nu bangin thuakzawh nadingin hehpihna na thungen hiam?

records.english: Many Protestant churches teach that faith alone is the way to receive salvation.
records.zomi: Protestant pawlpi tampi in upna bek pen hotkhiatna ngah nading lam ahi hi, ci-in a hilh uh hi.

records.english: Please read the verse about grace aloud for the class.
records.zomi: Class adingin hehpihna tawh kisai Laisiangtho cang aw tawh sim in.

records.english: Grace does not mean that wrong choices have no consequences.
records.zomi: Hehpihna in teelna khialte gah a nei kei hi, cihna hi lo hi.

records.english: Grace means receiving kindness that we do not deserve.
records.zomi: Hehpihna pen i tham loh hehpihna ngah cihna ahi hi.

records.english: For many Christians, the idea that God accepts us before we change is at the heart of grace.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi adingin i kikhek ma-in Pasian in hong sang hi, cih ngaihsutna pen hehpihna' lungsim ahi hi.

records.english: In his letter to the Romans, Paul writes that people are justified through faith.
records.zomi: Rom mite kiang-a a laikhak ah mite upna tungtawnin dikkisakna a ngah uh hi, ci-in Paul in a gelh hi.

records.english: Do you think you deserve God's love?
records.zomi: Pasian' itna na tham hi na ci hiam?

records.english: Can anyone receive grace?
records.zomi: Kuapeuh in hehpihna a ngah thei hiam?

records.english: Our church teaches that it is offered to everyone.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in mi khempeuh tungah kipia hi, ci-in a hilh hi.

records.english: When I was young, I broke my grandmother's favourite cup and hid the pieces.
records.zomi: Ka neu lai-in ka pi' it pen haai ka khiat sak a, a kitamte ka sel hi.

records.english: A week later, I told her the truth and waited for her to be angry.
records.zomi: Kal khat khit ciangin thuman ka gen a, a heh ding ka ngak hi.

records.english: Instead, she hugged me and said that this was a small picture of grace.
records.zomi: Ahi zongin hong pawm a, hih pen hehpihna lim neuno khat ahi hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Our pastor preached about grace on Sunday.
records.zomi: I pastor in Nipini-in hehpihna tawh kisai thu a hilh hi.

records.english: My friend cried when she first understood that she was forgiven.
records.zomi: Ka lawm in kimaisak ka hi hi, cih a theisiam masak pen-in a kap hi.

records.english: Who wants to share a story about grace?
records.zomi: Hehpihna tawh kisai tangthu hawm nuam kua om hiam?

records.english: Catholic and Protestant churches have long discussed how faith and good works relate to justification.
records.zomi: Catholic leh Protestant pawlpi te in upna leh nasep hoih in dikkisakna tawh bangci-in a kizom hiam cih hun sawt a kikum uh hi.

records.english: I'm grateful for God's grace every single day.
records.zomi: Ni simin Pasian' hehpihna adingin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: The pastor used a simple story to explain justification to the children.
records.zomi: Pastor in naupangte kiangah dikkisakna gen nadingin tangthu baih khat a zang hi.

records.english: The parable of the prodigal son is often used to explain grace.
records.zomi: Tapa mangthang thugentehna pen hehpihna gen nadingin a kizang zel hi.

records.english: Our church teaches that no one is too far away to be forgiven.
records.zomi: Kuamah kimaisak theih loh dongin a gamla kei hi, ci-in i pawlpi in a hilh hi.

records.english: Christians believe that Jesus died so that sinners could be forgiven.
records.zomi: Mawhna neite a kimaisak theih nadingin Jesu a si hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: Grace teaches us to be generous with people who have hurt us.
records.zomi: Hehpihna in hong liamsak mite tungah a piakhiat siam dingin hong sinsak hi.

records.english: We can't buy grace, and we can't earn it.
records.zomi: Hehpihna i lei thei kei a, i sep tawh i ngah thei kei hi.

records.english: Can you say that again a little louder for the people at the back?
records.zomi: Nunglam-a mite adingin tawmno kiko zaw-in na gen kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: When a radio message is unclear, pilots ask for it to be repeated before they act.
records.zomi: Radio thuthak khat a kician loh ciangin vanleng tawlte in a kalsuan ma-un gen kik dingin a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Rather than asking again, the new employee guessed and set up the wrong room.
records.zomi: Nasem thak in dong kik sangin a ngaihsun a, inndan khial khat a kiginsak hi.

records.english: Could you go over the last step of the procedure again?
records.zomi: Kalsuanna' a tawp pen kalsuan na gen kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: Sure, after you save the file, close the program before you restart.
records.zomi: Thei hi, file na save khit ciangin na phut kik ma-in program khak in.

records.english: I nodded during the briefing, but afterwards I had to ask a colleague what had been decided.
records.zomi: Thuhilhna lai-in ka lu ka ngit a, ahi zongin a khit ciangin bang khensat hiam cih nasem pih khat ka dong kul hi.

records.english: Please don't be afraid to ask me to explain something twice.
records.zomi: Bangkhat nihvei gen dingin hong ngen ding na lau kei ding hi.

records.english: I asked the interviewer to repeat the question because I wanted to answer it properly.
records.zomi: Dik takin ka dawn nop manin interview bawlpa in dotna a dong kik dingin ka ngen hi.

records.english: When English isn't your first language, asking for repetition at work takes courage.
records.zomi: English pen na pau masa a hih loh ciangin nasepna ah gen kik ngen pen hangsanna a kisam hi.

records.english: Could you slow down a little when you give the dates?
records.zomi: Ni te na gen ciangin tawmno zawi zaw-in na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: The receptionist read my appointment time back to me to make sure it was correct.
records.zomi: Receptionist in a dik hiam cih theih nadingin ka kimuhna hun hong sim kik hi.

records.english: Sorry, I was taking notes, so what was the last date you mentioned?
records.zomi: Maisak in, ciamtehna ka gelh lai ahih manin na gen nunung pen ni bang hiam?

records.english: Could you put the main points in an email after the meeting?
records.zomi: Kikhopna khit ciangin thupi bulpi te email-in na koih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Sorry, I missed the second part of the instructions.
records.zomi: Maisak in, thuhilhna kikhen nihna ka za kei hi.

records.english: If you didn't hear the announcement, ask the person next to you.
records.zomi: Thuthak na zak kei leh na kiang-a om mi dong in.

records.english: Did I understand correctly that we need two references?
records.zomi: Reference nih i kisam hi, cih ka theisiam dik hiam?

records.english: When the line broke up, I asked the customer to repeat the delivery address.
records.zomi: Phone a kitat-kitat ciangin customer in van tunsakna inn mun a gen kik dingin ka ngen hi.

records.english: Please repeat the safety rules before the students start the experiment.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte in experiment a kipat ma-un bitna thukhunte gen kik in.

records.english: Sorry, the projector fan is so loud that I couldn't hear you.
records.zomi: Maisak in, projector' huihmut ging a hat mahmah ahih manin ka za kei hi.

records.english: I always repeat the customer's order before I send it to the kitchen.
records.zomi: An huanna ah ka khak ma-in customer' order ka gen kik den hi.

records.english: Please read the code out slowly, one digit at a time.
records.zomi: Code nambat khat ciat-in zawi takin sim in.

records.english: The safety officer made each of us repeat the emergency procedure aloud.
records.zomi: Bitna makaipa in kote khatciat lauhuai hun kalsuanna aw tawh gen kik dingin hong sawl hi.

records.english: In the factory, the noise is so loud that we use hand signals when someone needs a message repeated.
records.zomi: Factory ah ging a hat mahmah ahih manin mi khat in thuthak a gen kik kisap ciangin khut ciamtehna i zang uh hi.

records.english: During the phone interview, I asked them to repeat a question because the connection was poor.
records.zomi: Phone interview lai-in connection a hoih loh manin dotna khat a dong kik dingin ka ngen hi.

records.english: Our lecturer speaks so fast that we often ask her to repeat key points.
records.zomi: I sinsakpa a pau hun mahmah ahih manin thupi bulpi te a gen kik dingin i ngen zel uh hi.

records.english: I didn't quite follow your point about the budget, so could you explain it again?
records.zomi: Budget tawh kisai na gen ka zui zo kei ahih manin na gen kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: Could you say the last sentence again so that I can write it down?
records.zomi: Ka gelh theih nadingin kammal tang nunung pen na gen kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: The examiner agreed to read the listening passage a third time.
records.zomi: Sitna entupa in ngaih sitna laigelh a thumvei sim dingin a phal hi.

records.english: Could you write the key words on the board while you explain?
records.zomi: Na gen kawm-in board tungah kammal thupi te na gelh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Did you say the deadline was Friday or Monday?
records.zomi: Hun bei pen Laithai ni hiam, Pizing ni hiam na ci hiam?

records.english: Monday at noon, so you have the weekend.
records.zomi: Pizing ni sun-in, tua ahih manin kal tawp na nei hi.

records.english: Excuse me, did you say the meeting starts at two or at ten?
records.zomi: Maisak in, kikhopna nai nih-in hiam, nai sawm-in hiam a kipan ding na ci hiam?

records.english: Would you mind going through the figures one more time?
records.zomi: Nambat te vei khat beh na sim kik nuam ding hiam?

records.english: Would you mind repeating the order number?
records.zomi: Order nambat na gen kik nuam ding hiam?

records.english: It's 4471, and the reference is on the invoice.
records.zomi: 4471 ahi a, reference pen invoice tungah a om hi.

records.english: When I didn't understand the inspector's question, I asked her to put it another way.
records.zomi: Entupa' dotna ka theisiam loh ciangin lam dang-in a dong dingin ka ngen hi.

records.english: Sorry, I'm still not sure which form I need to fill in.
records.zomi: Maisak in, bang form ka dimsak ding hiam cih ka thei kip nai kei hi.

records.english: Would it help if I repeated the questions at the end of the lesson?
records.zomi: Sinna tawp ciangin dotna te ka dong kik leh a huh ding hiam?

records.english: Students who never ask for repetition sometimes miss important details.
records.zomi: Gen kik ngen ngei lo sangnaupangte in thu thupi te a mawh kha zel uh hi.

records.english: In meetings with many accents, people often ask each other to repeat what they've said.
records.zomi: Pau gen zia tuamtuam nei kikhopna te ah mite in a gen te uh gen kik dingin a kingen tuah zel uh hi.

records.english: The nurse repeated the doctor's instructions to make sure she had heard them correctly.
records.zomi: Dik takin a zak hiam cih a theih nadingin nurse in siavuan' thuhilhnate a gen kik hi.

records.english: Asking for something to be repeated shows that you care about getting it right.
records.zomi: Bangkhat gen kik dingin ngen in a dik taka bawl na deih hi, cih a lak hi.

records.english: Would you be kind enough to say the name of the company again?
records.zomi: Company min na gen kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: Can we replay the recording of the lecture to check what he said?
records.zomi: Bang a gen hiam cih en nadingin thuhilhna khumna i ngai kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: Sorry, could you tell me your name once more?
records.zomi: Maisak in, na min vei khat beh hong gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: It's Mang, from the finance team.
records.zomi: Mang ka hi hi, finance team pan.

records.english: Asking a colleague to repeat a phone number is better than writing it down wrong.
records.zomi: Nasem pih khat in phone nambat a gen kik dingin ngen pen a khial-a gelh sangin a hoih zaw hi.

records.english: Our manager always asks new staff to summarise her instructions in their own words.
records.zomi: I manager in nasem thakte a thuhilhnate amau kammal tawh tomkim dingin a ngen den hi.

records.english: Sorry, which room did you say the exam is in?
records.zomi: Maisak in, sitna bang inndan ah om hi na ci hiam?

records.english: Sorry, I lost you after the part about the new schedule.
records.zomi: Maisak in, hun ciamtehna thak tawh kisai na gen khit ciangin ka zui zo nawn kei hi.

records.english: Could you read the question again, please?
records.zomi: Dotna na sim kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our trainer pauses after each step and asks whether anyone needs it repeated.
records.zomi: I trainer in kalsuan khatciat khit ciangin a khawl a, kuamah in gen kik a kisam hiam ci-in a dong hi.

records.english: Sorry to interrupt, but could you repeat the last figure?
records.zomi: Maisak in, ahi zongin nambat nunung pen na gen kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our teacher never minds repeating an explanation if the class looks confused.
records.zomi: Class a buai bang ciangin i saya in thugenna khat gen kik a lungkham ngei kei hi.

records.english: What was the name of the software you recommended?
records.zomi: Na gen software min bang hiam?

records.english: Did the head teacher say the trip is next week or the week after?
records.zomi: Sangpi saya in khualzinna kal hong tung ding hiam, a khit kal hiam a ci hiam?

records.english: Hearing something twice can be the difference between a correct answer and a careless mistake.
records.zomi: Bangkhat nihvei zak in dawnna dik leh kidawm lohna khialhna kikal ah a kibat lohna a suak thei hi.

records.english: Sorry, could you repeat the page number?
records.zomi: Maisak in, a sim nambat na gen kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: Page 42, the exercise at the bottom.
records.zomi: A sim 42, a nuai-a kisinna.

records.english: My boss gets impatient when people ask him to repeat himself, so I take careful notes.
records.zomi: Mite in gen kik dingin a ngen ciangun ka boss a thuak zo lo ahih manin kidawm takin ciamtehna ka gelh hi.

records.english: The parcel is 40 centimetres long, 30 wide and 20 deep.
records.zomi: Van tom pen centimetre 40 a sau a, 30 a zai a, 20 a thuk hi.

records.english: The farmer measures the rainfall to decide when to plant.
records.zomi: Loubawlpa in bang ciangin chi suan ding hiam cih khensat nadingin guah zah a teh hi.

records.english: Use the metal ruler, because the plastic one has warped.
records.zomi: Sik tehna zang in, bang hang hiam cih leh plastic tehna a kikawi hi.

records.english: Could you check the temperature of the fridge in the storeroom?
records.zomi: Van kemna dan-a fridge' lum-vot na en thei ding hiam?

records.english: The inspector measured the fire exit to make sure it was wide enough.
records.zomi: Entupa in a zai a tham hiam cih theih nadingin mei-a taikhiatna kongkhak a teh hi.

records.english: Our science teacher showed us how to read a thermometer accurately.
records.zomi: I science saya in thermometer dik takin bangci-in sim ding cih hong lak hi.

records.english: The nurse measures every patient's temperature at 6 a.m.
records.zomi: Nurse in zingsang nai 6-in natpa khempeuh' lum-vot a teh hi.

records.english: What's the maximum weight this shelf can hold?
records.zomi: Hih dawh in gikna bangzah dong a pua thei hiam?

records.english: The builder used a spirit level to check that the shelf was straight.
records.zomi: Inn lampa in dawh a tang hiam cih en nadingin spirit level a zang hi.

records.english: The engineer used a laser to measure the height of the ceiling.
records.zomi: Engineer in inn tungzang sanna teh nadingin laser a zang hi.

records.english: Is this measuring cylinder clean?
records.zomi: Hih tehna um a siang hiam?

records.english: Can you measure the length of the corridor for the new handrail?
records.zomi: Khut den thak adingin paina lam' sauna na teh thei ding hiam?

records.english: In chemistry, we read the liquid level at eye level to avoid mistakes.
records.zomi: Chemistry ah khialhna pial nadingin tui sanna mit dawh-in i sim uh hi.

records.english: Our maths teacher brought in a trundle wheel to measure the playground.
records.zomi: Naupang kimawlna mun teh nadingin i maths saya in trundle wheel a paipih hi.

records.english: Our project failed because two teams used different units for the same measurement.
records.zomi: Team nih in tehna kibang adingin unit tuam a zat manin i project a lawhsam hi.

records.english: My grandparents were the first in their village to leave, and many followed them.
records.zomi: Ka pu leh pi te a khua uh pan a pai masa pen ahi uh a, mi tampi in a zui uh hi.

records.english: Every summer, we send money home to help my grandparents repair their house.
records.zomi: Khal simin ka pu leh pi te' inn bawlphat nadingin inn ah sum i khak uh hi.

records.english: Tell us how you met Dad after you moved here.
records.zomi: Hih mun ah na tai khit ciangin Pa bangci-in na kimuh hiam cih hong gen in.

records.english: Isn't it lovely that our home is full of things from two countries?
records.zomi: I inn gam nih pan van te tawh a dim pen a hoih hi lo hiam?

records.english: Do you think of yourself as coming from here or from there?
records.zomi: Hih mun pan hong ka hi na kisa hiam, tua mun pan hiam?

records.english: Both, depending on who's asking.
records.zomi: A nih in, kua in a dong hiam cih tungah kinga-in.

records.english: How did you and Dad stay in touch when he worked abroad?
records.zomi: Gamdang ah a sep lai-in Pa leh nang bangci-in na kizom uh hiam?

records.english: We wrote letters, and once a month he phoned the shop in the village.
records.zomi: Laikhak i kigelh tuah uh a, kha khat ah khatvei khua-a sumbuk ah phone a sam hi.

records.english: Auntie Lun says she left home as a girl and came back as a stranger.
records.zomi: Nungak neu-in inn a paisan a, mi theih ngeih lo khat-in a ciah kik hi, Ni Lun in a ci hi.

records.english: My parents saved for years to buy the tickets for all six of us.
records.zomi: Kote guk khempeuh adingin lakkhak lei nadingin ka nu leh ka pa in kum tampi sum a kem uh hi.

records.english: Dad learned to drive in his forties, after we moved to the countryside.
records.zomi: Lou gam ah i tai khit ciangin Pa in kum sawmli val-in mawtaw tawl a sin hi.

records.english: Why did Grandpa leave his village?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pu in a khua a paisan hiam?

records.english: There was no work there, and he wanted his children to go to school.
records.zomi: Tua-ah nasep a om kei a, a tate sang a kah nadingin a deih hi.

records.english: Uncle Thang returned home to marry, then brought his wife back here a year later.
records.zomi: Pa neu Thang kiteen dingin inn ah a ciah kik a, kum khat khit ciangin a zi hih mun ah a paipih hi.

records.english: Whenever someone new arrives from home, our flat becomes their first address.
records.zomi: Inn lam pan mi thak khat a tun ciangin i inn pen amaute' inn mun masa pen a suak hi.

records.english: Did your father's brother stay behind to look after their parents?
records.zomi: Na pa' u pasal ahi zongin nau pasal in a nu leh pa kem dingin a om lai hiam?

records.english: My aunt's family settled in three different countries, so our reunions are always online.
records.zomi: Ka ni' innkuan gam tuam thum ah a teng uh ahih manin i kikhopnate online-in a om den hi.

records.english: Every family photo from those first years shows us wearing borrowed clothes.
records.zomi: Tua kum masa te-a innkuan photo khempeuh in kileiba puan silh-in hong lak hi.

records.english: Will we ever visit the town where Grandma was born?
records.zomi: Pi a suahna khuapi i veh ngei ding hiam?

records.english: I hope so, maybe next summer if we can save enough.
records.zomi: Ka lamen hi, i kem tham leh khal hong tung ding-in hi kha ding hi.

records.english: Was Dad's first job here really washing dishes in a hotel kitchen?
records.zomi: Hih mun-a Pa' nasep masa pen zinbuuk an huanna ah kuang sil ahi taktak hiam?

records.english: My little brother was born here, so he has a different passport from the rest of us.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal hih mun ah a suah ahih manin kote dang sangin passport tuam a nei hi.

records.english: Our family's migration story is a mixture of courage, luck and help from strangers.
records.zomi: I innkuan' gam taina tangthu pen hangsanna, vangphatna leh mi theih ngeih lo te' huhna a kihel ahi hi.

records.english: Which of these two methods did you want us to use?
records.zomi: Hih lam nih lak-ah bang i zat dingin na deih hiam?

records.english: Technical words can mean one thing to engineers and another to customers.
records.zomi: Technical kammal te in engineer te adingin sullam khat a nei a, customer te adingin a dang khat a nei thei hi.

records.english: When my boss said the job was urgent, I wasn't sure whether she meant today or this week.
records.zomi: Ka boss in nasep a hanciam hi a cih ciangin tuni a cihna hiam, hih kal a cihna hiam cih ka thei kip kei hi.

records.english: Does the price include installation?
records.zomi: Man sungah koihna nasep a kihel hiam?

records.english: The instructions were so vague that each team built something different.
records.zomi: Thuhilhnate a kician lo mahmah ahih manin team khatciat in bang tuam a bawl uh hi.

records.english: Are we supposed to answer all the questions, or choose three?
records.zomi: Dotna khempeuh i dawn ding hiam, thum i teel ding hiam?

records.english: Just to be clear, the exam is open-book, isn't it?
records.zomi: Kician nadingin, sitna pen laibu en theih sitna ahi hi lo hiam?

records.english: When you say the report is due at the end of the week, do you mean Friday or Sunday?
records.zomi: Report kal tawp ciangin pia ding hi na cih ciangin Laithai ni na ci hiam, Nipini na ci hiam?

records.english: Friday, before the office closes.
records.zomi: Laithai ni, office a khak ma-in.

records.english: Sorry, I'm not sure which form you mean.
records.zomi: Maisak in, bang form na ci hiam cih ka thei kip kei hi.

records.english: Is the dress code formal for the conference, or can we wear jeans?
records.zomi: Conference adingin puan silh zia a khauh hiam, jeans i silh thei hiam?

records.english: When the teacher said to keep it short, did she mean one page or two?
records.zomi: Saya in a tom-in gelh un a cih ciangin lai-ek khat hiam nih hiam a cihna hiam?

records.english: Is the bonus paid monthly or at the end of the year?
records.zomi: Bonus kha simin kipia hiam, kum tawp ciangin hiam?

records.english: Could you put your request in writing, so that there's no confusion later?
records.zomi: A nungin buaina a om loh nadingin na ngetna laigelh-in na koih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our teacher asked us to define every technical term in our reports.
records.zomi: I saya in i report te-a technical kammal khempeuh a sullam gen dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: Clarifying the scope of a project at the start prevents arguments at the end.
records.zomi: A kipat ciangin project' gamgi kician sak in a tawp ciangin kitelna a kham hi.

records.english: Is that a firm order, or are you just asking for a quote?
records.zomi: Tua pen order kip ahi hiam, man genna bek na ngen hiam?

records.english: When the director said that changes were coming, half the staff feared for their jobs.
records.zomi: Khekna te a hong ding hi, ci-in director in a gen ciangin nasemte a kim in a nasep uh a lau uh hi.

records.english: Do you want the figures by department or by month?
records.zomi: Nambat te department-in na deih hiam, kha-in hiam?

records.english: By month, so that we can see the trend.
records.zomi: Kha-in, kalsuanzia i muh theih nadingin.

records.english: The contract mentions reasonable notice without saying how many days that means.
records.zomi: Contract in hun kilawm-a theisakna a gen a, ni bangzah cihna ahi hiam cih a gen kei hi.

records.english: Should the essay include references, or just our own ideas?
records.zomi: Essay sungah reference te kihel ding hiam, eimah ngaihsutna bek hiam?

records.english: Both, but put the references at the end.
records.zomi: A nih in, ahi zongin reference te a tawp ah koih un.

records.english: Who exactly is responsible for locking the building at night?
records.zomi: Zan-in inn khak ding kua mawhpuakna taktak ahi hiam?

records.english: The students asked whether they had to give both sides of the argument in their essays.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte in a essay uh ah ngaihsutna lam nih a gen kul hiam ci-in a dong uh hi.

records.english: Did you mean only our department when you mentioned the team?
records.zomi: Team na gen ciangin i department bek na ci hiam?

records.english: In my first job, I learned that urgent requests meant very different things to different people.
records.zomi: Ka nasep masa pen ah hanciam ngetnate in mi tuamtuam adingin sullam tuam a nei hi, cih ka sin hi.

records.english: Please explain the new policy again for those who joined late.
records.zomi: A nunung-a kihelte adingin thukhun thak gen kik in.

records.english: Rather than guessing what the examiner wanted, I asked my teacher to explain the question.
records.zomi: Sitna entupa in bang a deih hiam cih ngaihsun sangin ka saya kiangah dotna gen dingin ka ngen hi.

records.english: Sorry, could you rephrase that, because I'm not sure what you're asking?
records.zomi: Maisak in, bang na dong hiam cih ka thei kip loh manin lam dang-in na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: When a colleague's message seems rude, it's worth asking what they meant before replying.
records.zomi: Nasem pih khat' message zahtakna om lo bang a kilang ciangin na dawn ma-in bang a cihna hiam cih dong pen a hoih hi.

records.english: The new employee nodded, but it was clear she hadn't understood the procedure.
records.zomi: Nasem thak in a lu a ngit a, ahi zongin kalsuanna a theisiam kei hi, cih a kilang hi.

records.english: Are you asking for my opinion or for a decision?
records.zomi: Ka ngaihsutna na dong hiam, thukhensatna na ngen hiam?

records.english: Asking a client what success looks like for them avoids a lot of wasted work.
records.zomi: Client kiangah amaute adingin a lawhna bang ci hiam cih dong in nasep mang tampi a kham hi.

records.english: I thought the training was optional, but it turned out to be required.
records.zomi: Training pen deih leh kihel ding hi ka sa a, ahi zongin kihel ngei ding ahi hi.

records.english: Could you show us what a good answer looks like?
records.zomi: Dawnna hoih khat bang ci hiam cih hong lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: If I've understood you correctly, we need two extra people for the weekend shift.
records.zomi: Ka theisiam dik leh kal tawp nasep hun adingin mi nih beh i kisam hi.

records.english: Could you explain how flexible the working hours really are?
records.zomi: Nasep hun bangzah a kikhek thei taktak hiam cih na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: What does the abbreviation on this invoice stand for?
records.zomi: Hih invoice tunga kammal tom in bang a ciapteh hiam?

records.english: The lecturer paused to explain the difference between the two terms before continuing.
records.zomi: Sinsakpa in a kalsuan ma-in kammal nih kikal-a kibat lohna gen dingin a khawl hi.

records.english: Our manager clarified that working from home is allowed only on Fridays.
records.zomi: Inn pan nasep pen Laithai ni bek-in kiphal hi, ci-in i manager in a kician sak hi.

records.english: Are you asking me to lead the project or just to join the team?
records.zomi: Project makaih dingin hong ngen hiam, team ah kihel bek dingin hiam?

records.english: To lead it, if you feel ready.
records.zomi: Makaih dingin, na kiging leh.

records.english: Before the meeting ended, the chair checked that everyone understood the decision.
records.zomi: Kikhopna a tawp ma-in makaipa in mi khempeuh in thukhensatna a theisiam uh hiam cih a en hi.

records.english: Is the training compulsory for everyone, or only for new staff?
records.zomi: Training pen mi khempeuh adingin kihel ngei ding hiam, nasem thakte adingin bek hiam?

records.english: Everyone, including the managers.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh, manager te zong kihel-in.

records.english: I misunderstood the task and wrote about the wrong topic.
records.zomi: Nasep ka theisiam khial a, thupi khial khat tawh kisai ka gelh hi.

records.english: Please clarify which rooms the cleaners should do first.
records.zomi: Siangsakna nasemte in bang inndan te a siangsak masa ding uh hiam cih kician sak in.

records.english: A misunderstanding about the delivery date cost the company an important client.
records.zomi: Van tunna ni tawh kisai theisiam khialhna khat in company client thupi khat a mansuah sak hi.

records.english: So the deadline applies to the draft, not the final version?
records.zomi: Tua ahih leh hun bei pen gelh masa adingin ahi a, a tawp pen adingin hi lo hiam?

records.english: Unclear job descriptions often lead to disappointment on both sides.
records.zomi: Nasep genzia kician lo te in lam nih ah lungkiatna a piangsak zel hi.

records.english: Good managers check that their instructions mean the same thing to everyone.
records.zomi: Manager hoih te in a thuhilhnate mi khempeuh adingin sullam kibang a nei hiam cih a en uh hi.

records.english: Do you mean the old version of the software or the new one?
records.zomi: Software lui na ci hiam, a thak na ci hiam?

records.english: Our supplier misunderstood the order and sent ten boxes instead of ten items.
records.zomi: I van zuakpa in order a theisiam khial a, van sawm sangin bawm sawm a khak hi.

records.english: Do you need the slides printed, or will you show them on the screen?
records.zomi: Slide te print na kisam hiam, screen tungah na lak ding hiam?

records.english: My tutor explained that a summary and a review are not the same thing.
records.zomi: Tomkimna leh ngaihsutna genna a kibang kei hi, ci-in ka tutor in a gen hi.

records.english: When the client says the design is too busy, what exactly do they mean?
records.zomi: Design a buai luat hi, ci-in client in a gen ciangin bang a cihna taktak hiam?

records.english: They want fewer colours and more white space.
records.zomi: Pianzia tuamtuam tawm zaw leh mun awng kang tam zaw a deih uh hi.

records.english: When the inspector said the kitchen needed attention, she meant the floors, not the equipment.
records.zomi: An huanna in limlim a kisam hi, ci-in entupa in a gen ciangin vanzat hi lo-in lei te a cihna ahi hi.

records.english: Just to confirm, the interview is online, not in the office?
records.zomi: Kician nadingin, interview pen office ah hi lo-in online ah ahi hi lo hiam?

records.english: Children, never send photos to strangers online, and tell us if anyone asks.
records.zomi: Naupangte, online ah mi theih ngeih lo te kiangah photo khak ngei kei un, kuamah in a ngen leh hong gen un.

records.english: Our family's complaint about the noisy bar led to a change in its opening hours.
records.zomi: Ging hat zu zuakna inn tawh kisai i innkuan phunna in a hong hun a kikhek sak hi.

records.english: Has anyone reported the dead tree that's leaning over the road?
records.zomi: Lampi tung-a kun sing kung si kuamah in a theisak khin hiam?

records.english: Why did you photograph the lorry?
records.zomi: Bang hangin mawtaw lian photo na lak hiam?

records.english: Because it was dumping oil in the ditch, and I needed proof for the council.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh guam sungah sathau a sung a, council adingin kipsakna ka kisam hi.

records.english: Who did you call about the man selling fireworks to children?
records.zomi: Naupangte kiangah meipuak a zuak pasal tawh kisai kua na sam hiam?

records.english: The police, and they came within the hour.
records.zomi: Police, nai khat sung-in a hong uh hi.

records.english: Mum keeps a notebook for every complaint she makes to the council.
records.zomi: Nu in council kiangah a phun phunna khempeuh adingin ciamtehna laibu khat a kem hi.

records.english: It took courage for my mother to report the man who had been following her.
records.zomi: Amah a zui den pasal theisak dingin ka nu hangsanna a kisam hi.

records.english: My brother was nervous about reporting his boss, but he did it anyway.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal in a boss theisak ding a lau a, ahi zongin a theisak lai hi.

records.english: When the factory near our village polluted the stream, the families reported it together.
records.zomi: I khua kiang-a factory in guh a niinsak ciangin innkuante in khawm-in a theisak uh hi.

records.english: We told the police about the strangers checking car doors in our street.
records.zomi: I lampi-a mawtaw kongkhak en mi theih ngeih lo te tawh kisai police kiangah i gen uh hi.

records.english: Who do we tell about the rats in the empty flat next door?
records.zomi: I kiang-a inn awng sung-a zusa te tawh kisai kua i theisak ding hiam?

records.english: My parents taught us that reporting wrongdoing is a duty, not a betrayal.
records.zomi: Gamtat hoih lo theisak pen leh zuauna hi lo-in mawhpuakna ahi hi, ci-in ka nu leh ka pa in hong sinsak uh hi.

records.english: Mum, is it telling tales if I report the boy who steals lunch money?
records.zomi: Nu, sun an sum a guk tangval neu ka theisak leh thu ka tun hiam?

records.english: No, it's protecting the younger children.
records.zomi: Hi lo hi, naupang neu zawte kemna ahi hi.

records.english: My daughter saw a boy writing on the bus seats and told the driver.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in tangval neu khat bus tutna tungah a gelh a mu a, mawtaw tawlpa a gen hi.

records.english: My grandmother wrote down the number plate of the car that hit our wall.
records.zomi: Ka pi in i bang a sat mawtaw' nambat lai a gelh hi.

records.english: Shall we report the broken traffic light, or has someone already done it?
records.zomi: Mawtaw meivak khawlna kisia i theisak ding hiam, kuamah in a theisak khin hiam?

records.english: Dad reported a driver who was speeding past the school every morning.
records.zomi: Zingsang simin sang kiangah manlang taka a tawl mawtaw tawlpa khat Pa in a theisak hi.

records.english: My sister reported her employer for not paying the minimum wage.
records.zomi: Ka u numei in a nasep neipa khasum niam pen a piak loh manin a theisak hi.

records.english: Did Grandma report the fake charity collector?
records.zomi: Pi in charity lepkhem sum kaikhawmpa a theisak hiam?

records.english: Yes, she gave the police his description and the leaflet he left.
records.zomi: Theisak hi, a pianzia leh a nusiat laikhak neu police a pia hi.

records.english: We reported our landlord because the gas boiler had not been checked for years.
records.zomi: Kum tampi sung gas boiler kuamah in a en loh manin i inn neipa i theisak uh hi.

records.english: Grandpa reported the broken streetlight outside his house three times before anyone fixed it.
records.zomi: Kuamah in a bawlphat ma-in Pu in a inn mai-a lampi meivak kisia thumvei a theisak hi.

records.english: The school asked parents to report drivers who park in the drop-off zone.
records.zomi: Sang in naupang khiatna mun ah mawtaw khawl tawlte theisak dingin nu leh pate a ngen hi.

records.english: After my father reported the unsafe wiring, the whole building was inspected.
records.zomi: Ka pa in a bit lo meivak khau a theisak khit ciangin inn bup a kisit hi.

records.english: A report from a worried parent can stop an accident before it happens.
records.zomi: A lungkham nu ahi zongin pa khat' theisakna in siatna a piang ma-in a khawlsak thei hi.

records.english: We didn't want to get our neighbour into trouble, but the smoke was making the children ill.
records.zomi: I inn veng haksatna ah koih i deih kei uh a, ahi zongin meikhu in naupangte a cina sak hi.

records.english: Grandpa phoned the electricity company when he saw sparks coming from the pole.
records.zomi: Meivak khuam pan meitang a pawt a muh ciangin Pu in meivak company a sam hi.

records.english: Our son was proud when his report about the broken fence was taken seriously.
records.zomi: Huang kisia tawh kisai a theisakna a thupi taka a kingaihsut ciangin i tapa a kipak hi.

records.english: Grandma doesn't like to make a fuss, so I reported the overcharging for her.
records.zomi: Pi in buaina bawl a deih kei ahih manin man tam luat lakna amah adingin ka theisak hi.

records.english: My wife reported the cracked pavement after Grandma tripped on it.
records.zomi: Pi a khe a kikhaih khit ciangin ka zi in lampi gei kitam a theisak hi.

records.english: Our family reported the broken playground swing to the council.
records.zomi: I innkuan in naupang kimawlna mun-a kizawl kisia council kiangah a theisak hi.

records.english: I do want to report the dangerous parking, but I'm afraid the driver will recognise me.
records.zomi: Lauhuai taka mawtaw khawlna theisak ka deih taktak hi, ahi zongin mawtaw tawlpa in hong thei ding ka lau hi.

records.english: The council sent my father a letter thanking him for his report.
records.zomi: Council in a theisakna adingin ka pa kiangah lungdamna laikhak khat a khak hi.

records.english: Should we report the neighbour's dog for barking all night?
records.zomi: Zan bup a hau inn veng' ui i theisak ding hiam?

records.english: Let's talk to them first, and report it only if nothing changes.
records.zomi: A masa-in amaute tawh kihopih ni, bangmah a kikhel kei leh bek theisak ni.

records.english: I reported a scam website that had copied my bank's logo.
records.zomi: Ka bank' logo a kaih khemna website khat ka theisak hi.

records.english: Reporting a problem anonymously can protect a family from arguments with the neighbours.
records.zomi: Min gen lo-a haksatna khat theisak in innkuan khat inn vengte tawh kitelna pan a kem thei hi.

records.english: My aunt reported the care home after she found her mother unwashed and hungry.
records.zomi: A nu a kisil lo a, a gilkial a muh khit ciangin ka ni in upa kemna inn a theisak hi.

records.english: My cousin reported the illegal fishing nets in the lake to the wildlife office.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in dil sung-a thukham tawh kituak lo ngalkhau te gammang ganhing office kiangah a theisak hi.

records.english: When the bus driver was rude to my grandfather, we sent a complaint to the bus company.
records.zomi: Bus tawlpa in ka pu tungah zahtakna om lo-in a gamtat ciangin bus company kiangah phunna i khak uh hi.

records.english: Our family keeps the council's reporting number on the fridge.
records.zomi: I innkuan in council' theisakna nambat fridge tungah a kem hi.

records.english: The police asked my brother to describe exactly what he had seen.
records.zomi: Police in ka u pasal a muh te kician takin gen dingin a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Report it to the shop manager if the price on the shelf is wrong.
records.zomi: Dawh tung-a man a khial leh sumbuk manager kiangah theisak in.

records.english: We reported the stray dogs because they had bitten two children in our street.
records.zomi: I lampi-a naupang nih a kek ahih manin ui mangthang te i theisak uh hi.

records.english: Our neighbour asked us not to report her son, but the damage was too serious to ignore.
records.zomi: I inn veng in a tapa theisak lo dingin hong ngen a, ahi zongin a siatna a lian luat manin i limlim lo thei kei uh hi.

records.english: When my uncle saw someone selling fake medicine at the market, he told the health inspector.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu in sumbuk ah damdawi lepkhem a zuak mi khat a muh ciangin damna entupa kiangah a gen hi.

records.english: Reporting a family member is one of the hardest decisions anyone can make.
records.zomi: Innkuan sung mi khat theisak pen kuapeuh in a bawl thei thukhensatna haksa pen te lak-ah khat ahi hi.

records.english: Can you help me fill in the council's online form about the rubbish someone dumped by the river?
records.zomi: Lui gei-ah kuamah in a paai eek tawh kisai council' online form dimsak dingin hong huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Should I report my neighbour's builder for working on Sundays?
records.zomi: Nipini-in na a sem ahih manin ka inn veng' inn lampa ka theisak ding hiam?

records.english: Our neighbours thanked us for reporting the fire in their garden shed.
records.zomi: A huan inn neu-a mei kang i theisak manin i inn vengte in hong lungdampih uh hi.

records.english: Did you tell anyone about the dog that was left in the hot car?
records.zomi: Mawtaw sa sungah a kinusia ui tawh kisai kuamah na gen hiam?

records.english: Mum called the water company when the pipe in the street burst.
records.zomi: Lampi-a tuikhau a puak ciangin Nu in tui company a sam hi.

records.english: Thank you for reporting the leak before it ruined our kitchen ceiling.
records.zomi: I an huanna inn tungzang a siat ma-in tui luang na theisak manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Would you report a friend who was cheating in an exam?
records.zomi: Sitna ah a kem lawm khat na theisak ding hiam?

records.english: Our son reported a bully at school, and the teachers dealt with it quietly.
records.zomi: I tapa in sang ah midang bawlsia khat a theisak a, sayate in dai takin a bawl uh hi.

records.english: Is it our job to report the empty house that's being used for parties?
