records.zomi: Pa dinmun sang a ngah ciangin cake tawh lamdang i sak uh na phawk hiam?

records.english: My teacher came to my sister's wedding because she had taught all of us.
records.zomi: Ka saya in i khempeuh hong sinsak khin ahih manin ka u numei' mopawi ah a hong hi.

records.english: Are your colleagues coming to your wedding?
records.zomi: Na nasem pihte na mopawi ah a hong ding uh hiam?

records.english: Only the ones from my own team, or the hall would be too small.
records.zomi: Keimah team pan te bek, a hih kei leh inn lian a neu lua ding hi.

records.english: When my mother received her teaching certificate, she framed it and hung it in the kitchen.
records.zomi: Ka nu in a sinsakna lai-ciam a ngah ciangin frame-in a koih a, an huanna inn ah a khai hi.

records.english: Our son's school celebrated his team's win, and we went to cheer him on.
records.zomi: I tapa' sang in a team' zawhna a lungdampih a, amah thapia dingin i pai uh hi.

records.english: The whole village came to celebrate when my cousin became the first doctor from our family.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam i innkuan pan siavuan masa pen a suah ciangin khua bup in lungdampih dingin a hong uh hi.

records.english: My uncle took a week off work to help prepare his daughter's wedding.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu in a tanu' mopawi kiginkholh huh dingin nasep pan kal khat a tawl hi.

records.english: The school held a small party for my grandmother when she retired as head cook.
records.zomi: Ka pi an huanpa lian pen a hih pan a tawlngak ciangin sang in amah adingin poai neuno khat a bawl hi.

records.english: My little brother wore his school uniform to our cousin's wedding because it was his smartest outfit.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal in i sanggam' mopawi ah a sang uniform a silh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh tua in a puan hoih pen ahi hi.

records.english: Did your boss let you leave early for your sister's wedding?
records.zomi: Na u numei' mopawi adingin na makaipa in hun ma-in hong paisan sak hiam?

records.english: Shall we invite your teacher to your graduation lunch?
records.zomi: Na sang zawhna sun an ah na saya i sam ding hiam?

records.english: My cousin's colleagues surprised him with a cake when his first child was born.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam' ta masa a suah ciangin a nasem pihte in cake tawh lamdang a sak uh hi.

records.english: We made a banner to welcome Dad home after his first year working abroad.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a a nasep kum masa pen khit-a Pa inn hong tun kisan nadingin banner khat i bawl uh hi.

records.english: The school concert was also my grandmother's birthday, so we celebrated twice.
records.zomi: Sang concert ni pen ka pi' suahni zong ahih manin nihvei i lungdampih uh hi.

records.english: Did your company give you a present when your baby was born?
records.zomi: Na naungek a suah ciangin na company in letsong hong pia hiam?

records.english: Mum's first promotion was celebrated with a cake shaped like a computer.
records.zomi: Nu' dinmun sang masa pen ngahna computer bang-a kibawl cake khat tawh kilungdampih hi.

records.english: The office threw my sister a farewell party before she started her maternity leave.
records.zomi: Naungek tawlngakna a kipat ma-in office in ka u numei adingin kikhenna poai khat a bawl hi.

records.english: Mum's colleagues sent flowers for her fiftieth birthday.
records.zomi: Nu' kum sawmnga suahni adingin a nasem pihte in pak a khak uh hi.

records.english: Dad's boss gave a speech at his retirement party, and Dad cried.
records.zomi: Pa' nasep pan tawlngakna poai ah a makaipa in thu a gen a, Pa a kap hi.

records.english: Thank you for coming to my graduation, because it meant a lot to my parents.
records.zomi: Ka sang zawhna ah na hong manin ka lungdam hi, bang hang hiam cih leh ka nu leh ka pa adingin a thupi mahmah hi.

records.english: Every time one of us gets a new job, Grandma bakes a loaf of her special bread.
records.zomi: Ei lak-a khat in nasep thak a ngah simin Pi in a moh tuamtak khat a em hi.

records.english: When I got my first job, my brother drove the whole family to the beach to celebrate.
records.zomi: Ka nasep masa pen ka ngah ciangin ka u pasal in lungdampih dingin innkuan bup tuipi gei ah a tawipih hi.

records.english: We had a small celebration at home when Mum passed her nursing exams.
records.zomi: Nu in a nurse sitna a zawh ciangin inn-ah lungdampihna neuno khat i nei uh hi.

records.english: My parents met at a colleague's wedding, so they always enjoy going to other people's.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa nasem pih khat' mopawi ah a kimu uh ahih manin midangte' mopawi pai a nuam sa den uh hi.

records.english: Our family's celebrations always include Dad's oldest friends from the factory.
records.zomi: I innkuan' lungdampihna khempeuh ah factory pan Pa' lawm lui pen te a kihel den uh hi.

records.english: Did your sister's school friends really sing at her wedding?
records.zomi: Na u numei' sang lawmte in a mopawi ah la a sa taktak uh hiam?

records.english: Having worked to pay for my studies, I wanted my whole family at my graduation.
records.zomi: Ka sinna man pia dingin na ka sep khit ciangin ka sang zawhna ah ka innkuan bup a om ka deih hi.

records.english: The factory gave my grandfather a gold watch when he retired, and he still wears it.
records.zomi: Ka pu a tawlngak ciangin factory in kham nai-et khat a pia a, tu dong a bulh lai hi.

records.english: Who's going to give the speech at your graduation party?
records.zomi: Na sang zawhna poai ah kua in thu a gen ding hiam?

records.english: I had to work on the evening of my cousin's engagement, so I arrived just in time for dessert.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam' kiteen ding kiciamna nitak-in na ka sep kul ahih manin an khit-a an neuno hun ciang bek ka tung hi.

records.english: My aunt's shop closed for a day so that she could attend her son's graduation.
records.zomi: Ka ni' a tapa' sang zawhna ah a pai theih nadingin a sumbuk ni khat a khak hi.

records.english: Can you take the afternoon off for Grandpa's birthday lunch?
records.zomi: Pu' suahni sun an adingin sun nung lam na tawl thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our family's biggest party was the day my sister qualified as a lawyer.
records.zomi: I innkuan' poai lian pen ka u numei thukham siam a suah ni ahi hi.

records.english: Mum's colleagues helped her decorate the hall for my brother's wedding.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal' mopawi adingin inn lian kizepna-ah Nu' nasem pihte in a huh uh hi.

records.english: Who organised the party for Dad's retirement?
records.zomi: Pa' nasep pan tawlngakna poai kua in a vaihawm hiam?

records.english: His colleagues did, and they invited all of us to the factory canteen.
records.zomi: A nasem pihte in a vaihawm uh a, i khempeuh factory canteen ah hong sam uh hi.

records.english: When my aunt retired from the hospital, her patients sent cards from all over town.
records.zomi: Ka ni damdawi inn pan a tawlngak ciangin a cinate in khuapi bup pan card a khak uh hi.

records.english: We celebrated my father's recovery by going back to the restaurant where he and Mum got engaged.
records.zomi: Ka pa' damna, amah leh Nu a kiteen ding kiciamna restaurant ah kik-in i lungdampih uh hi.

records.english: The head teacher sent my parents a card when I won the national science prize.
records.zomi: Gam bup science letsong ka ngah ciangin sangpi saya in ka nu leh ka pa kiangah card khat a khak hi.

records.english: The night before my exam results came out, nobody in the family could sleep.
records.zomi: Ka sitna gah a suah ma zan-in innkuan sungah kuamah a ihmu thei kei uh hi.

records.english: We celebrated my daughter's first pay cheque by letting her choose the restaurant.
records.zomi: Ka tanu' khasum masa pen restaurant a teel sak-in i lungdampih uh hi.

records.english: When my brother opened his own garage, we celebrated with a barbecue in the yard.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal in amah garage a hon ciangin inn mai-ah barbecue tawh i lungdampih uh hi.

records.english: We celebrated my sister's exam results with a picnic in the park.
records.zomi: Ka u numei' sitna gah park sungah picnic tawh i lungdampih uh hi.

records.english: Our family celebrated my mother's new business with a meal for everyone who helped her.
records.zomi: Ka nu' sumbawlna thak amah a huh mi khempeuh adingin an nekkhawm tawh i innkuan in a lungdampih hi.

records.english: My brother's graduation photo hangs in the living room next to our parents' wedding picture.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal' sang zawhna photo tutna inn ah i nu leh i pa' mopawi lim kiang-ah a kikhai hi.

records.english: How did you celebrate your graduation?
records.zomi: Na sang zawhna bangci-in na lungdampih hiam?

records.english: My parents took the whole family out for dinner, and my teacher came too.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in innkuan bup nitak an nek dingin a paipih uh a, ka saya zong a hong hi.

records.english: Our family celebrated when my father finally got his driving licence for work.
records.zomi: Ka pa in nasep adingin mawtaw tawl lai-ciam a ngah tawp ciangin i innkuan a lungdampih hi.

records.english: Why are there balloons on Mum's office door?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Nu' office kongkhak tungah balloon te a om hiam?

records.english: Her colleagues are celebrating her twenty years at the company.
records.zomi: Company ah kum sawmnih a sep manin a nasem pihte in a lungdampih uh hi.

records.english: Our family keeps every school certificate in a box that we open at New Year.
records.zomi: I innkuan in sang lai-ciam khempeuh Kum Thak ciangin i hon bawm khat sungah a kem hi.

records.english: Let's put the graduation photos in the family album tonight.
records.zomi: Tuzan-in sang zawhna photo te innkuan album sungah koih ni.

records.english: What did your family do when you got the job?
records.zomi: Nasep na ngah ciangin na innkuan in bang a bawl hiam?

records.english: Mum cooked my favourite meal, and Grandpa made a little speech.
records.zomi: Nu in an ka deih pen a huan a, Pu in thu tomno khat a gen hi.

records.english: Grandpa's retirement after forty years as a teacher was celebrated by the whole school.
records.zomi: Saya hihna kum sawmli khit-a Pu' nasep pan tawlngakna sang bup in a lungdampih hi.

records.english: My brother-in-law is now like a real brother to me.
records.zomi: Ka makpa tu-in keimah adingin ka u pasal taktak bang ahi hi.

records.english: When my grandmother turned eighty, relatives came from five villages to visit her.
records.zomi: Ka pi kum sawmgiat a cin ciangin amah veh dingin khua nga pan sanggamte a hong uh hi.

records.english: Each family brought rice, a chicken or a basket of vegetables.
records.zomi: Innkuan khatciat in buh, ak khat, a hih kei leh anteh bawm khat a paipih uh hi.

records.english: By evening, the yard was full of people who had not seen each other for years.
records.zomi: Nitak lam ciangin inn mai kum tampi sung a kimu nai lo mite tawh a dim hi.

records.english: Auntie Hoih keeps a list of every relative's birthday and calls each one.
records.zomi: Ni Hoih in sanggam khempeuh' suahni ciamtehna khat a kem a, khatciat a sam hi.

records.english: Grandpa taught us to treat our cousins' children as our own.
records.zomi: Pu in i sanggamte' tate eimah tate bang-in en dingin hong sinsak hi.

records.english: Who helped you build your house?
records.zomi: Na inn lam dingin kua in hong huh hiam?

records.english: My brothers, my uncles and three cousins, over two dry seasons.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pasalte, ka pa neute leh sanggam thum in, khal nih sung.

records.english: My uncle's wife is from another village, and she taught us her family's songs.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu' zi pen khua dang pan ahi a, a innkuan' late hong sinsak hi.

records.english: Our family's oldest relative is my great-aunt, who is 96.
records.zomi: I innkuan-a sanggam upa pen ka pu leh pi' sanggam numei ahi a, kum 96 a cing hi.

records.english: Our family helps each other with weddings, funerals and building houses.
records.zomi: I innkuan in mopawi, misi vuina leh inn lamna-ah khat leh khat a kihuh uh hi.

records.english: When my parents married, both families met for the first time over a long meal.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa a kiteen ciangin innkuan nih an nekkhawm sau khat-ah a kimu masa pen uh hi.

records.english: Thank you for looking after my children as if they were your own.
records.zomi: Ka tate na tate bang-in na kem manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Why did your whole clan come to the wedding?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na phung bup mopawi ah a hong uh hiam?

records.english: In our community, a wedding belongs to the whole extended family, not just to the couple.
records.zomi: I khuasung ah mopawi pen tenpih nih' bek hi lo-in innkuan zaipi bup' ahi hi.

records.english: Our cousins stay with us every summer, so the house is always full.
records.zomi: I sanggamte khal simin eite kiangah a teng uh ahih manin inn a dim den hi.

records.english: My uncle paid for my school uniform when my father was ill.
records.zomi: Ka pa a cina lai-in ka pa neu in ka sang uniform man a pia hi.

records.english: Mum's sisters share the cooking at every big family meal.
records.zomi: Innkuan an nekkhawm lian khempeuh ah Nu' sanggam numeite in an huan a kihawm uh hi.

records.english: Why does your little brother always sit next to Grandpa at family meals?
records.zomi: Bang hangin innkuan an nekkhawm ciangin na nau pasal Pu kiang-ah a tu den hiam?

records.english: My sister and I promised that our children would grow up knowing each other.
records.zomi: Ka u numei leh kei i tate in khat leh khat a kitheikhawm-in a khanglian ding uh hi, ci-in i kiciam uh hi.

records.english: Whenever there's a family problem, my grandmother calls everyone together.
records.zomi: Innkuan buaina a om simin ka pi in mi khempeuh a kaikhawm hi.

records.english: Dad's cousins helped him find his first job in the city.
records.zomi: Pa' sanggamte in khuapi-a a nasep masa pen zong dingin a huh uh hi.

records.english: My cousins in the city send money home to help their grandparents.
records.zomi: Khuapi-a ka sanggamte in a pu leh pi huh dingin inn-ah sum a khak uh hi.

records.english: Dad always reminds us that our relatives are our first friends.
records.zomi: I sanggamte pen i lawm masa pen ahi uh hi, ci-in Pa in hong phawksak den hi.

records.english: Who chose your baby's name?
records.zomi: Na naungek' min kua in a phuak hiam?

records.english: My husband's mother, as is the custom in his family.
records.zomi: Ka sungnu, a innkuan' ngeina bang-in.

records.english: Why are our cousins so much like brothers and sisters to us?
records.zomi: Bang hangin i sanggamte eite adingin u le nau bang mahmah ahi uh hiam?

records.english: Family gatherings are where the children learn who everyone is.
records.zomi: Innkuan kikhopna te pen naupangte in mi khempeuh kua hiam cih a sinna mun ahi hi.

records.english: Can you remember the names of all your great-aunts?
records.zomi: Na pu leh pi' sanggam numei khempeuh' min na phawk thei hiam?

records.english: Let's call Auntie Mang to tell her about the baby.
records.zomi: Ni Mang naungek thu gen dingin sam ni.

records.english: In our family, the eldest brother speaks for everyone at weddings and funerals.
records.zomi: I innkuan ah mopawi leh misi vuina ciangin u pasal upa pen in mi khempeuh aiawh-in thu a gen hi.

records.english: I do want my son to know his relatives on both sides of the family.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in innkuan lam nih-a a sanggamte a theih ding ka deih taktak hi.

records.english: Respecting our elders is the first thing my parents taught us.
records.zomi: I upate zahtak pen ka nu leh ka pa in hong sinsak masa pen ahi hi.

records.english: Our family has a tradition of naming a child after a grandparent.
records.zomi: I innkuan in naupang khat a pu a hih kei leh a pi' min tawh phuak ngeina a nei hi.

records.english: Auntie Lun took care of me for a whole year when my mother was in hospital.
records.zomi: Ka nu damdawi inn a om lai-in Ni Lun in kum khat bup hong kem hi.

records.english: How often do you see your cousins?
records.zomi: Na sanggamte bangzah vei na mu hiam?

records.english: Every Christmas, when the whole family gathers at Grandpa's house.
records.zomi: Christmas simin, innkuan bup Pu' inn-ah a kikhop ciangin.

records.english: Do your children know which village their grandfather came from?
records.zomi: Na tate in a pu bang khua pan hong pai hiam cih a thei uh hiam?

records.english: Shall we visit your grandmother's sister while we're in the village?
records.zomi: Khua-ah i om lai-in na pi' sanggam numei i veh ding hiam?

records.english: My cousin's wedding was the first time I met half of my relatives.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam' mopawi pen ka sanggam a kim ka muh masa pen ahi hi.

records.english: In my family, we greet the oldest person in the room first.
records.zomi: Ka innkuan ah inndan sung-a mi upa pen i kikhamsak masa uh hi.

records.english: Grandpa can name every relative who came to his wedding sixty years ago.
records.zomi: Kum sawmguk paisa-a a mopawi-a hong sanggam khempeuh' min Pu in a gen thei hi.

records.english: My great-grandmother had eleven children, so I have cousins everywhere.
records.zomi: Ka pu-pi' nu in ta sawm le khat a nei ahih manin mun khempeuh ah sanggam ka nei hi.

records.english: In our village, everyone knows how they are related to everyone else.
records.zomi: I khua ah mi khempeuh in mi dang khempeuh tawh bangci-in a kizopna uh hiam cih a thei uh hi.

records.english: Our family tree has more than two hundred names on it.
records.zomi: I innkuan khangthu ah min za nih sang a tam a om hi.

records.english: When a baby is born in our family, the grandparents are the first to visit.
records.zomi: I innkuan ah naungek a suah ciangin a pu leh pi in a veh masa pen uh hi.

records.english: Living far from our relatives, we make an effort to visit them every year.
records.zomi: I sanggamte pan gamla-ah i teen manin kum simin veh dingin i hanciam uh hi.

records.english: When my uncle died, his brothers took care of his children's education.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu a sih ciangin a u le naute in a tate' sinna a kem uh hi.

records.english: Who is the oldest person in your family?
records.zomi: Na innkuan ah kua in a upa pen hiam?

records.english: Family quarrels are usually settled by the eldest members of our family.
records.zomi: Innkuan kiselna te i innkuan-a upa pen te in a khen zel uh hi.

records.english: Who takes care of your grandparents now?
records.zomi: Tu-in na pu leh pi kua in a kem hiam?

records.english: My youngest uncle, because he lives in their house with his family.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu naupang pen, bang hang hiam cih leh a innkuan tawh amaute' inn-ah a teng hi.

records.english: My brothers and I share the cost of our parents' medicine.
records.zomi: Ka u le naute leh kei in i nu leh i pa' damdawi man i kihawm uh hi.

records.english: Having lost his parents young, my father was raised by his aunt and uncle.
records.zomi: A neu lai-in a nu leh a pa a sih manin ka pa pen a ni leh a pa neu in a khanggui uh hi.

records.english: In our family, a new daughter-in-law is welcomed with a special meal.
records.zomi: I innkuan ah monu thak an tuamtak tawh kisang hi.

records.english: Why do Grandma and Grandpa keep a photo of every grandchild on the wall?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pi leh Pu in tu khatciat' photo bang tungah a khai uh hiam?

records.english: My grandmother says that a family without elders is like a house without a roof.
records.zomi: Upa om lo innkuan pen inn tungkhuh om lo inn bang ahi hi, ci-in ka pi in a gen hi.

records.english: Do our relatives abroad still call every Sunday to hear the family news?
records.zomi: Gamdang-a i sanggamte in innkuan thuthak za dingin Nipini simin a sam lai uh hiam?

records.english: Dad still asks his older brother for advice before any big decision.
records.zomi: Thu lian khensat ma-in Pa in a u pasal kiangah thuhilhna a ngen lai hi.

records.english: The older cousins in our family are expected to help the younger ones with their studies.
records.zomi: I innkuan-a sanggam upate in a neute a sinna-ah a huh ding uh hi, ci-in kilamen hi.

records.english: When will the council decide about the new playground?
records.zomi: Naupang kimawlna mun thak tawh kisai-in council in bang hun-in a khensat ding hiam?

records.english: When can I collect my new library card?
records.zomi: Ka laibu inn card thak bang hun-in ka la thei ding hiam?

records.english: Any time after Wednesday, from the front desk.
records.zomi: Nilai ni khit hun khempeuh-in, mai lam taupi pan.

records.english: When the alarm sounds in the library, please leave by the nearest exit.
records.zomi: Laibu inn sungah alarm a ging ciangin a kiang pen paikhiatna kongkhak tawh pusuak un.

records.english: When will the road outside the school be repaired?
records.zomi: Sang mai-a lampi bang hun-in a kibawl kik ding hiam?

records.english: The council says the work will start in the summer holidays.
records.zomi: Khal tawlngak hun-in nasep a kipan ding hi, ci-in council in a gen hi.

records.english: When the library introduced longer opening hours, many more students came to study.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in a kihonna hun a sausak ciangin sangnaupang tam zaw kisin dingin a hong uh hi.

records.english: When will we hear whether the grant for the community garden has been approved?
records.zomi: Khuasung huan adingin sum huhna a kiphal hiam cih bang hun-in i za ding hiam?

records.english: When the new bridge opens, the journey into town will be much shorter.
records.zomi: Lei thak a kihon ciangin khuapi pai lampi a tom mahmah zaw ding hi.

records.english: Nobody has told us when the empty shops on the high street will be rented again.
records.zomi: Lampi lian tunga sumbuk awng te bang hun-in kik-in kihaai ding hiam cih kuamah in hong gen nai kei hi.

records.english: When should residents expect the water to be turned back on?
records.zomi: Teng mite in tui bang hun-in a hong pai kik ding a ngak ding uh hiam?

records.english: When the snow is heavy, the council grits the main roads first.
records.zomi: Vuuk a tam ciangin council in lampi lian te tungah cii a theh masa hi.

records.english: When will the council send out the new rubbish calendar?
records.zomi: Council in eek lakna calendar thak bang hun-in a khak ding hiam?

records.english: When do the night buses start running?
records.zomi: Zan bus te bang hun-in a pai kipan ding uh hiam?

records.english: Just after midnight, every half hour until five.
records.zomi: Zanlai khit ciangin, nai nga dong minit sawmthum simin.

records.english: How soon can the doctor see my mother?
records.zomi: Siavuan in ka nu bangzah manlang-in a en thei ding hiam?

records.english: When did the post office move to the new building?
records.zomi: Post office inn thak ah bang hun-in a kisawn hiam?

records.english: Please let us know as soon as the new bus times are confirmed.
records.zomi: Bus hun thak a kipsak ciangin hong theisak pah un.

records.english: When did you report the broken bench in the square?
records.zomi: Khuapi laizang-a tutphah sau kitam bang hun-in na theisak hiam?

records.english: When are the free eye tests for children available?
records.zomi: Naupangte adingin a man om lo mit enna bang hun-in a om ding hiam?

records.english: When the queue at the post office is long, staff open a second counter.
records.zomi: Post office-a kigual a sau ciangin nasemte in taupi nihna khat a hong uh hi.

records.english: When will the fireworks start on Saturday night?
records.zomi: Kiginni zan-in meipuak bang hun-in a kipan ding hiam?

records.english: When will the swimming pool reopen after the repairs?
records.zomi: Bawlkikna khit ciangin tuipeek mun bang hun-in a kihong kik ding hiam?

records.english: When exactly was the decision to close the youth club made?
records.zomi: Tangvalte' kipawlna khak ding thukhensatna bang hun taktak-in kibawl hiam?

records.english: When the council consulted residents about the park, almost nobody replied.
records.zomi: Park tawh kisai-in council in teng mite a dot ciangin kuamah a dawng dek kei uh hi.

records.english: When is the next blood donation session in town?
records.zomi: Khuapi sungah sisan piakna a nungzui ding bang hun-in hiam?

records.english: On the first Monday of next month, in the community hall.
records.zomi: Kha hong tung ding Pizing ni masa pen-in, khuasung inn lian ah.

records.english: When does the food bank open this week?
records.zomi: Hih kal-in an huhna mun bang hun-in a kihong hiam?

records.english: When the town hall closes early, people who work all day find it hard to get help.
records.zomi: Khuapi office a kikhak manlang ciangin ni bup nasem mite in huhna a ngah haksa uh hi.

records.english: When can the children use the new sports hall?
records.zomi: Naupangte in kimawlna inn lian thak bang hun-in a zang thei ding uh hiam?

records.english: When does the recycling centre open on Sundays?
records.zomi: Nipini-in recycling centre bang hun-in a kihong hiam?

records.english: At ten in the morning, and it closes at four.
records.zomi: Zingsang nai 10-in, a kikhak nai 4-in.

records.english: When does the pharmacy stop taking prescriptions in the evening?
records.zomi: Nitak lam-in damdawi zuakna in damdawi lai bang hun-in a sang khawl hiam?

records.english: Has anyone said when the planning decision will be made public?
records.zomi: Inn lam phalna thukhensatna bang hun-in kilangsak ding hiam cih kuamah in a gen hiam?

records.english: When should I apply for a place at the nursery?
records.zomi: Naupang kemna mun-a mun khat adingin bang hun-in ka ngen ding hiam?

records.english: As soon as possible, because the waiting list is already long.
records.zomi: A manlang thei pen-in, bang hang hiam cih leh ngakna ciamtehna a sau khin hi.

records.english: When the volunteers finish their training, they'll help at the hospital reception.
records.zomi: Thalawpte in a kisinna a zawh ciangun damdawi inn reception ah a huh ding uh hi.

records.english: When does the residents' association usually meet?
records.zomi: Teng mite' kipawlna bang hun-in a kikhop zel uh hiam?

records.english: Could you tell me when the next council meeting is open to the public?
records.zomi: Council kikhopna a nungzui, mipite a pai theih bang hun-in hiam cih hong gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: When was the community centre first built?
records.zomi: Khuasung inn lian bang hun-in a kilam masa hiam?

records.english: When does the lunch club for older residents meet?
records.zomi: Mi upate' sun an kikhopna bang hun-in a kikhop hiam?

records.english: When should we put the bins out for collection?
records.zomi: Eek bawm te lakna adingin bang hun-in i koih khia ding uh hiam?

records.english: When did they last empty the bins in the park?
records.zomi: Park sung-a eek bawm te bang hun-in a nunung pen-in a sung a lak uh hiam?

records.english: Ask at reception when the next first-aid course begins.
records.zomi: First-aid kisinna a nungzui bang hun-in a kipan ding hiam cih reception ah dong in.

records.english: When does the market start in the summer?
records.zomi: Khal-in sumbuk mun bang hun-in a kipan hiam?

records.english: Do you know when they're moving the bus stop outside the clinic?
records.zomi: Clinic pualam-a bus khawlna bang hun-in a sawn ding uh hiam cih na thei hiam?

records.english: When was the last time the street lights were checked?
records.zomi: Lampi meivak te a nunung pen-in bang hun-in kien hiam?

records.english: Do you know when the community bus comes back from the market?
records.zomi: Khuasung bus sumbuk mun pan bang hun-in a kik ding hiam cih na thei hiam?

records.english: When are the volunteers coming to clean the river bank?
records.zomi: Lui gei siangsak dingin thalawpte bang hun-in a hong ding uh hiam?

records.english: When should I call the police instead of the council?
records.zomi: Council sang a pai lo-in bang hun-in police ka sam ding hiam?

records.english: When does the mobile library visit our village?
records.zomi: Pai thei laibu inn in i khua bang hun-in a veh hiam?

records.english: When is the health centre least busy?
records.zomi: Cidamna office bang hun-in a buai lo pen hiam?

records.english: When did the council last raise the price of parking?
records.zomi: Council in mawtaw khawlna man bang hun-in a nunung pen-in a khang sak hiam?

records.english: When will the town hall publish the results of the survey?
records.zomi: Khuapi office in dotna kankanna' gah bang hun-in a suaksak ding hiam?

records.english: When do I need to renew my parking permit?
records.zomi: Ka mawtaw khawlna phalna bang hun-in ka thak kul hiam?

records.english: When the museum is closed on Mondays, school groups can still book visits.
records.zomi: Pizing ni-in museum a kikhak ciangin zong sang pawlte in veh nading a koih khol thei lai uh hi.

records.english: Since when has the bakery on the corner been closed?
records.zomi: Ken lam-a moh zuakna bang hun pan a kikhak hiam?

records.english: When are the recycling bags delivered to each house?
records.zomi: Recycling ip te inn khatciat ah bang hun-in a kipia hiam?

records.english: When is the deadline for registering to vote?
records.zomi: Vote nadingin min ciamtehna hun tawp bang hun hiam?

records.english: When does the advice centre have someone who speaks Burmese?
records.zomi: Thuhilhna office ah Kawl pau a gen thei mi bang hun-in a om hiam?

records.english: Can you show the new staff where the meeting rooms are?
records.zomi: Nasem thakte kikhopna inndan te koi-ah om hiam cih na lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Who drew the map on the noticeboard in the staff room?
records.zomi: Nasemte' inndan-a thuthak tunsakna board tunga map kua in a lai hiam?

records.english: Which entrance should the delivery drivers use?
records.zomi: Van khakpate in bang kongkhak a zat ding uh hiam?

records.english: The side gate on Station Road, next to the loading bay.
records.zomi: Station Road-a kongkhak lam, van dawnna mun kiang-ah.

records.english: The delivery driver plans his route on a map before he leaves the depot.
records.zomi: Van khakpa in depot a paisan ma-in map tungah a lampi a ciamteh hi.

records.english: The council's map shows which areas are most likely to have problems in heavy rain.
records.zomi: Council' map in guah tam ciangin bang mun te ah buaina a om thei pen hiam cih a lak hi.

records.english: The hikers lost their way when the fog came down and hid the path.
records.zomi: Meiphu a hong tuak a lampi a selh ciangin mualtung pai mite in a lampi uh a mangsak uh hi.

records.english: Why do pilots use special maps called charts?
records.zomi: Bang hangin vanleng tawlpate in chart a kici map tuamtak a zang uh hiam?

records.english: Because charts show the information pilots need, such as airports, heights and radio signals.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh chart te in vanleng tawlpate' kul thute, vanlengtual, a sanna leh radio ciamtehna bangte, a lak hi.

records.english: The bus company redrew its route map after the new road opened.
records.zomi: Lampi thak a kihon khit ciangin bus company in a lampi map a lai kik hi.

records.english: Rather than relying on the phone, our teacher made us find the museum with a paper map.
records.zomi: Phone tungah kinga lo-in i saya in laimai map tawh museum zong dingin hong sawl hi.

records.english: Can you draw me a quick map of how to get to the warehouse?
records.zomi: Van koihna inn ah bangci-in pai ding hiam cih map tomno khat hong lai thei ding hiam?

records.english: The fire service keeps maps showing where every water supply in the town is.
records.zomi: Mei-sih nasepna in khuapi sung-a tui ngahna mun khempeuh a lak map te a kem hi.

records.english: The engineers needed a detailed map of the pipes before they could dig.
records.zomi: Engineer te in a tou ma-un tuipi khau te' map kicing khat a kul uh hi.

records.english: The taxi driver knows every street in the city without looking at a map.
records.zomi: Taxi tawlpa in map en lo-in khuapi sung-a lampi khempeuh a thei hi.

records.english: Thank you for giving such clear directions to the visitors.
records.zomi: Khualte kiangah lampi tak takin na lak manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Which floor is the accounts department on?
records.zomi: Sum ciamtehna department bang inntung ah a om hiam?

records.english: The postman knows a shortcut through the park that isn't on any map.
records.zomi: Laikhak tawipa in map khat peuh tungah om lo park sung pai lampi tom khat a thei hi.

records.english: The software company makes maps that show traffic in real time.
records.zomi: Software company in tu-a lampi tunga mawtaw tamna a lak map te a bawl hi.

records.english: The students designed a map of the town for tourists, with all the best cafés marked.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte in khualzinte adingin cafe hoih pen khempeuh ciamteh-in khuapi map khat a bawl uh hi.

records.english: The scale on this map shows that one centimetre equals five hundred metres.
records.zomi: Hih map tunga teh-na in centimetre khat in metre za nga a kibang hi, cih a lak hi.

records.english: The geography exam included a question on contour lines and steep slopes.
records.zomi: Geography sitna sungah contour line leh mual-awn tawh kisai dotna khat a kihel hi.

records.english: Our geography teacher showed us how to use a compass on the school field.
records.zomi: I geography saya in sang mual ah compass bangci-in zang ding hiam cih hong lak hi.

records.english: The cleaner showed me the quickest way from the kitchen to the lecture hall.
records.zomi: Siangsakna nasempa in an huanna inn pan thuhilhna inn lian pai nading lampi manlang pen hong lak hi.

records.english: Our class compared a map from 1900 with a satellite image of the same area.
records.zomi: I class in kum 1900 map khat leh mun kibang' satellite lim khat a kiteh uh hi.

records.english: Every direction in the instructions was clear except the last one.
records.zomi: Lampi lakna sung-a lampi khempeuh a tak hi, a nunung pen bek a tak kei hi.

records.english: Accurate maps of the sea floor help engineers lay cables between continents.
records.zomi: Tuipi nuai lei' map dik te in engineer te tuileng gam kikal-ah khau a koih theih nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Our school has signs in three colours to help new pupils find their way.
records.zomi: I sang in sangnaupang thakte a lampi a zon theih nadingin pianzia thum tawh ciamtehna te a nei hi.

records.english: Shall we print a map of the site for the new workers?
records.zomi: Nasem thakte adingin mun' map khat i print ding hiam?

records.english: Can you give the new nurse directions to the children's ward?
records.zomi: Nurse thak kiangah naupangte' ward pai nading lampi na lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Take the blue corridor to the end, and it's the second door on the right.
records.zomi: Corridor dum tawh a tawp dong pai inla, a taklam kongkhak nihna ahi hi.

records.english: Map reading is a skill that many jobs still require.
records.zomi: Map simna pen nasep tampi in a kul lai siamna khat ahi hi.

records.english: Our tour guide used an old map to show how the city walls once looked.
records.zomi: I khualzin lampi lakpa in map lui khat zang-in khuapi kulhte' lim a lak hi.

records.english: Our class used grid references to find the old castle on the map.
records.zomi: I class in map tungah kulhpi lui zong dingin grid reference a zang uh hi.

records.english: Ship captains still learn to plot a course on a paper chart.
records.zomi: Tembaw makaite in laimai chart tungah lampi ciamteh a sin lai uh hi.

records.english: Ask at the front desk if you can't find the conference room.
records.zomi: Conference inndan na zon theih kei leh mai lam taupi ah dong in.

records.english: How do I get to the main office from the car park?
records.zomi: Mawtaw khawlna mun pan office lian ah bangci-in ka pai ding hiam?

records.english: Go through the glass doors, turn left and take the lift to the third floor.
records.zomi: Glass kongkhak tawh lut inla, veilam ah kiheih inla, lift tawh inntung thumna ah kah in.

records.english: The farmer showed the surveyors where his land ended on the map.
records.zomi: Lo neipa in a gam bang mun-ah a tawp hiam cih map tungah gam tehpate a lak hi.

records.english: Our teacher asked us to give directions to the station using only landmarks.
records.zomi: I saya in mun theih huai te bek zang-in station pai nading lampi lak dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: The hotel receptionist gives every guest a small map of the town centre.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk receptionist in khualzin khempeuh khuapi lai map neuno khat a pia hi.

records.english: The town planners used maps to decide where the new school should be built.
records.zomi: Khuapi ciamtehpate in sang thak koi-ah lam ding hiam cih khensat nadingin map a zang uh hi.

records.english: Our team uses a large wall map to plan the week's deliveries.
records.zomi: I team in kal sung van khakna ciamteh nadingin bang map lian khat a zang hi.

records.english: The architect's plan shows the building as if you were looking down from above.
records.zomi: Inn lam siampa' plan in inn pen a tung pan na en bang-in a lak hi.

records.english: The archaeologists mapped every stone before they moved anything.
records.zomi: Tangthu lui kankante in bangpeuh a sawn ma-un suang khempeuh a map uh hi.

records.english: How does a surveyor make an accurate map?
records.zomi: Gam tehpa in map dik khat bangci-in a bawl hiam?

records.english: By measuring angles and distances very carefully and checking them against satellite data.
records.zomi: Ken leh gamlatna te dawmtakin teh-in satellite thu tawh kiteh-in.

records.english: The new hospital wing has so many corridors that volunteers wait at the entrance to guide visitors.
records.zomi: Damdawi inn khen thak in corridor tam mahmah a nei ahih manin thalawpte in khualte lampi lak dingin kongkhak ah a ngak uh hi.

records.english: The ambulance driver checked the map twice before turning into the narrow lane.
records.zomi: Ambulance tawlpa in lampi neu ah a kiheih ma-in map nihvei a en hi.

records.english: The new employee got lost three times on her first day in the big office.
records.zomi: Nasem thak numei in office lian ah a ni masa pen-in thumvei a mang hi.

records.english: A good floor plan helps visitors find their way around a hospital.
records.zomi: Inntung plan hoih khat in khualte damdawi inn sungah a lampi zon theihna a huh hi.

records.english: Where's the nearest exit from this room?
records.zomi: Hih inndan pan paikhiatna kongkhak a kiang pen koi-ah a om hiam?

records.english: Students, draw a map of the school and mark the fire exits.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte, sang map khat lai unla, mei-sih paikhiatna kongkhak te ciamteh un.

records.english: Is the science building north or south of the library?
records.zomi: Science inn pen laibu inn' mal lam hiam, a sim lam ah a om hiam?

records.english: The lorry driver's navigation system sent him down a road that was too narrow for his vehicle.
records.zomi: Lorry tawlpa' navigation system in a mawtaw adingin a neu lua lampi khat ah a pai sak hi.

records.english: When you give directions over the phone, describe what the person will see.
records.zomi: Phone tawh lampi na lak ciangin mi in bang a muh ding hiam cih gen in.

records.english: Turn left out of the station and walk until you reach the river.
records.zomi: Station pan veilam ah kiheih inla, lui na tun dong pai in.

records.english: Field workers use maps on tablets to record exactly where each sample was taken.
records.zomi: Gam nasemte in sample khatciat koi-ah a lak uh hiam cih tak takin ciamteh nadingin tablet tunga map a zang uh hi.

records.english: The rescue team used a detailed map to search the mountain for the missing climber.
records.zomi: Hotkhiatna team in a mang mualtung kahpa zong dingin mual tungah map kicing khat a zang uh hi.

records.english: Turn right at the end of the corridor, and the staff room is on your left.
records.zomi: Corridor tawp ah taklam ah kiheih inla, nasemte' inndan na veilam ah a om hi.

records.english: Our family prays together before we eat.
records.zomi: I innkuan in an i nek ma-in thu i ngen khawm uh hi.

records.english: When I'm worried, praying helps me feel calm.
records.zomi: Ka lungkham ciangin thu ngen in hong lungnuam sak hi.

records.english: According to the Gospels, Jesus often went to quiet places to pray.
records.zomi: Lungdamna Thu te bang-in Jesu in thungetna dingin mun dai te ah a pai zel hi.

records.english: Many Christians kneel when they pray, while others stand or sit.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in thu a ngen ciangun a khukdin uh a, midangte in a ding uh hiam, a tu uh hi.

records.english: My little brother prays for his dog every night.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal in zan simin a ui adingin thu a ngen hi.

records.english: Our church has a prayer meeting every Wednesday morning.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in Nilai ni zingsang simin thungetna kikhopna a nei hi.

records.english: Our church starts every service with a song of praise.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in biakna khempeuh phatna la khat tawh a kipan hi.

records.english: The Lord's Prayer is said in many churches around the world.
records.zomi: Topa' Thungetna pen leitung bup-a pawlpi tampi ah kigen hi.

records.english: Worship brings people together who might otherwise never meet.
records.zomi: Biakna in a kimu ngei lo ding mite a kikhawmsak hi.

records.english: Do Christians have to go to church to pray?
records.zomi: Khristiante in thu ngen nadingin pawlpi ah a pai kul uh hiam?

records.english: No, many Christians pray at home, at work or even while they walk.
records.zomi: Kul lo hi, Khristian tampi in inn ah, nasepna ah, a hih kei leh lampi a zin lai-un zong thu a ngen uh hi.

records.english: In our church, the pastor leads the prayers, and everyone answers together.
records.zomi: I pawlpi ah pastor in thungetna a makaih a, mi khempeuh in a kidawng khawm uh hi.

records.english: Shall we pray for our relatives who live far away?
records.zomi: Gamla-a teng i sanggamte adingin thu i ngen ding hiam?

records.english: Many Christians believe that worship is a response to God's love.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in biakna pen Pasian' itna dawnna ahi hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Please remember us in your prayers.
records.zomi: Na thungetna-ah hong phawk in.

records.english: Prayer is an important part of daily life for many Christian families.
records.zomi: Thungetna pen Khristian innkuan tampi' ni sim nuntakna-a a thupi khat ahi hi.

records.english: Why do we pray before meals?
records.zomi: Bang hangin an i nek ma-in thu i ngen uh hiam?

records.english: To thank God for the food and for the people who made it.
records.zomi: An leh a huan mite adingin Pasian kiangah lungdam gen nadingin.

records.english: We light a candle when we pray for someone who has died.
records.zomi: A si khin mi khat adingin thu i ngen ciangin khawimeivaak khat i tawk uh hi.

records.english: The whole congregation stood up to sing the final hymn.
records.zomi: Pawlpi mite khempeuh in a nunung pen Pasian phatna la sa dingin a ding uh hi.

records.english: Grandpa prays quietly every morning before he goes to the fields.
records.zomi: Pu in lo a pai ma-in zingsang simin dai takin thu a ngen hi.

records.english: We pray before every journey, asking God to keep us safe on the road.
records.zomi: Khualzinna khempeuh ma-in lampi tungah hong ken dingin Pasian ngen-in thu i ngen uh hi.

records.english: Christians believe that prayer is talking with God.
records.zomi: Khristiante in thungetna pen Pasian tawh kihoupihna ahi hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Thank you for praying for us when we were going through a hard time.
records.zomi: Hun haksa i thuak lai-un hong thu ngetsak manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Why do Christians often stand when they sing hymns?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Khristiante in Pasian phatna la a sak ciangun a ding zel uh hiam?

records.english: Having prayed together for years, the two families became very close.
records.zomi: Kum tampi thu a ngen khawm khit ciangin innkuan nih a kinai mahmah uh hi.

records.english: Let's pray together before the exam tomorrow.
records.zomi: Zingciang sitna ma-in thu i ngen khawm ni.

records.english: Some Christians write their prayers in a notebook, so that they can see how they were answered.
records.zomi: Khristian khenkhat in a thungetna uh notebook sungah a gelh uh a, tua in bangci-in kidawng hiam cih a muh theih nadingun ahi hi.

records.english: Dad taught me to pray for people I disagree with.
records.zomi: Pa in ka lungtup kibang lo mite adingin thu ngen dingin hong sinsak hi.

records.english: My aunt always prays in our home language, even at the international church.
records.zomi: Gam tuamtuam mite' pawlpi ah zong ka ni in i inn pau-in thu a ngen den hi.

records.english: Can I pray in my own words?
records.zomi: Keimah kammal-in thu ka ngen thei hiam?

records.english: Yes, Christians believe that God listens to simple, honest prayers.
records.zomi: Thei hi, Khristiante in Pasian in thungetna baihlam leh thuman te a ngai hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Some Christian traditions pray at fixed times of day, while others pray whenever they feel the need.
records.zomi: Khristian ngeina khenkhat in ni sung hun kiciamteh-in thu a ngen uh a, midangte in a kul a kisak simun thu a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Many Christians believe that God hears prayers even when they are not answered as we hope.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in i lametna bang-in a kidawn kei zongin Pasian in thungetna a za hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Mum says that worship is not only singing but also how we treat other people.
records.zomi: Biakna pen la sak bek hi lo-in midangte tungah bangci-in i om uh hiam cih zong ahi hi, ci-in Nu in a gen hi.

records.english: Who will lead the prayer at the start of the meeting?
records.zomi: Kikhopna kipat ciangin kua in thungetna a makaih ding hiam?

records.english: Praying for others, many Christians believe, is a way of showing love.
records.zomi: Midangte adingin thu ngen pen itna lakna lampi khat ahi hi, ci-in Khristian tampi in a um uh hi.

records.english: Our pastor encourages us to pray for the whole town, not only for our church.
records.zomi: I pastor in i pawlpi adingin bek hi lo-in khuapi bup adingin thu ngen dingin hong hanthawn hi.

records.english: Some churches use music with drums and guitars, while others prefer an organ.
records.zomi: Pawlpi khenkhat in khuang leh guitar tawh la a zang uh a, midangte in organ a deih zaw uh hi.

records.english: Prayer can be a way of asking for help, saying sorry or giving thanks.
records.zomi: Thungetna pen huhna ngetna, maisakna ngetna, a hih kei leh lungdam genna lampi khat ahi thei hi.

records.english: Children, let's close our eyes and say thank you to God.
records.zomi: Naupangte aw, i mit i mi ding a, Pasian kiangah lungdam i gen ding hi.

records.english: Our choir practises the hymns every Thursday evening.
records.zomi: I la-sa pawl in Laizing ni nitak simin Pasian phatna la te a kisin uh hi.

records.english: Can you pray for my mother, who is in hospital?
records.zomi: Damdawi inn-a om ka nu adingin thu na ngen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Every evening, my grandmother gathers the family in the living room to pray.
records.zomi: Nitak simin ka pi in thu ngen dingin tutna inn ah innkuan a kaikhawm hi.

records.english: Each of us thanks God for one good thing that happened that day.
records.zomi: I khatciat in tua ni-a a piang thu hoih khat adingin Pasian kiangah lungdam i gen uh hi.

records.english: Then Grandma prays for everyone who is ill or far from home.
records.zomi: Tua khit ciangin Pi in a cina mite leh inn pan gamla-a om mi khempeuh adingin thu a ngen hi.

records.english: I do want to pray more regularly.
records.zomi: Tawntung zaw-in thu ngen ka deih taktak hi.

records.english: Some Christians pray using the psalms from the Bible.
records.zomi: Khristian khenkhat in Laisiangtho sung-a Late te zang-in thu a ngen uh hi.

records.english: During the service, there was a quiet moment for everyone to pray silently.
records.zomi: Biakna lai-in mi khempeuh dai taka thu a ngen theih nadingin hun dai neuno khat a om hi.

records.english: Shall we pray for our neighbour before we visit her?
records.zomi: I inn veng numei i veh ma-in amah adingin thu i ngen ding hiam?

records.english: My grandmother keeps a list of the people she prays for every day.
records.zomi: Ka pi in ni simin a thu ngetsak mite' ciamtehna khat a kem hi.

records.english: The more my grandfather prayed, the more peaceful he seemed.
records.zomi: Ka pu in thu a ngen tam semsem ciangin a lungnuam semsem bang-in a kilang hi.

records.english: Is it all right to pray when you're angry?
records.zomi: Na heh lai-in thu ngen a hoih hiam?

records.english: In our family, the youngest child usually says the prayer before Sunday lunch.
records.zomi: I innkuan ah Nipini sun an ma-in naupang neu pen in thungetna a gen zel hi.

records.english: Why do some people close their eyes when they pray?
records.zomi: Bang hangin mi khenkhat in thu a ngen ciangun a mit a mi uh hiam?

records.english: It helps them to concentrate and shut out other things.
records.zomi: Lungsim a koih khawm thei a, thu dangte a nial thei nadingun a huh hi.

records.english: Our youth group meets on Friday nights to sing and pray together.
records.zomi: I tangvalte' pawl in Laithai ni zan simin la sa-in thu ngen khawm dingin a kikhop uh hi.

records.english: What does worship mean?
records.zomi: Biakna in bang a lak hiam?

records.english: In our church, it means praising God with songs, prayers and our whole lives.
records.zomi: I pawlpi ah la te, thungetna te leh i nuntakna bup tawh Pasian phat cihna ahi hi.

records.english: The children sang a song of thanks at the harvest service.
records.zomi: Gah lakna biakna ah naupangte in lungdamna la khat a sa uh hi.

records.english: Auntie Lun needed a medical certificate before her long-term visa was approved.
records.zomi: A kum sau visa a kiphal ma-in Ni Lun in siavuan lai-ciam khat a kul hi.

records.english: Who in the family filled in the visa forms for Grandpa?
records.zomi: Innkuan sungah Pu adingin visa form te kua in a dimsak hiam?

records.english: Does the baby need a visa too?
records.zomi: Naungek in zong visa a kul hiam?

records.english: Yes, every member of the family needs their own visa, even a newborn.
records.zomi: Kul hi, innkuan sung mi khempeuh in, a suak thak naungek zong, amah visa a kul hi.

records.english: Is a tourist visa enough for a family holiday of three weeks?
records.zomi: Kal thum sung innkuan tawlngakni adingin khualzin visa a cing hiam?

records.english: My sister got a visa to visit us, but her husband's application was still being checked.
records.zomi: Ka u numei in eite veh dingin visa a ngah a, ahi zongin a pasal' ngetna kien lai hi.

records.english: Dad keeps all our visas and passports in one folder.
records.zomi: Pa in i visa leh passport khempeuh folder khat sungah a kem hi.

records.english: Our son's visa was delayed because his name was spelled differently on two documents.
records.zomi: I tapa' min lai nih tungah a kigelh kibang loh manin a visa a phawng hi.

records.english: Did you remember to bring the letter from your employer for the visa interview?
records.zomi: Visa interview adingin na nasepsakpa' lai na paipih ding na phawk hiam?

records.english: We paid extra for a faster visa because my father was ill.
records.zomi: Ka pa a cina ahih manin visa manlang zaw adingin sum beh i pia uh hi.

records.english: Shall we ask the visa centre whether Grandma can apply online?
records.zomi: Pi in online-in a ngen thei hiam cih visa centre ah i dong ding hiam?

records.english: My parents got their visas just two days before their flight.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in a vanleng zinna ni nih ma bek-in a visa uh a ngah uh hi.

records.english: The family reunion visa took almost two years, but now we live together again.
records.zomi: Innkuan kikhopkikna visa kum nih dek a la a, ahi zongin tu-in kik-in i teen khawm uh hi.

records.english: Our children were thrilled when they saw their first visa stickers in their passports.
records.zomi: I tate in a passport uh sungah a visa sticker masa pen uh a muh ciangun a lungdam mahmah uh hi.

records.english: Dad had to show his bank statements to prove he could pay for the trip.
records.zomi: Khualzinna man a pia thei hi, cih kipsak nadingin Pa in a bank laipek te a lak kul hi.

records.english: Our family sponsored my grandmother so that she could visit for the wedding.
records.zomi: I innkuan in mopawi adingin ka pi a hong theih nadingin amah a pang uh hi.

records.english: We applied for the visas six months before the wedding, just to be safe.
records.zomi: Lauhuai lo nadingin mopawi ma kha guk-in visa te i ngen uh hi.

records.english: Did the embassy say how long the visa would take?
records.zomi: Visa bangzah sawt ding hiam cih embassy in a gen hiam?

records.english: Why was Uncle Thang's visa refused?
records.zomi: Bang hangin pa neu Thang' visa a kinial hiam?

records.english: The letter says he didn't show enough proof that he would return home.
records.zomi: Inn ah a ciah kik ding kipsakna a cing a lak kei hi, ci-in lai in a gen hi.

records.english: Grandpa was so nervous at the visa interview that he forgot his own address.
records.zomi: Visa interview ah Pu a lau lua ahih manin amah teenna mun a mangngilh hi.

records.english: Can you check the expiry date on my visa?
records.zomi: Ka visa' a bei ni na en sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our family celebrated when my father's permanent residence was finally approved.
records.zomi: Ka pa' a tawntung teenna phalna a kiphal tawp ciangin i innkuan a lungdampih hi.

records.english: Please keep a copy of your visa in your bag when you travel.
records.zomi: Na khualzin ciangin na visa copy khat na ip sungah kem in.

records.english: Thank you for helping us understand the visa letter.
records.zomi: Visa lai i theisiam nadingin hong huh manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Having been refused once, my uncle prepared every document twice for his second visa application.
records.zomi: Khatvei a kinial khit ciangin ka pa neu in a visa ngetna nihna adingin lai khempeuh nihvei a kiginkholh hi.

records.english: My cousin's transit visa let him change planes without leaving the airport.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam' transit visa in vanlengtual a paisan lo-in vanleng a khek thei sak hi.

records.english: Because the visa rules changed, my cousin's family had to apply again from the beginning.
records.zomi: Visa thukhunte a kikhek manin ka sanggam' innkuan in a kipatna pan kik-in a ngen kul uh hi.

records.english: When the visas finally arrived, Mum put them on the table and cried with relief.
records.zomi: Visa te a tun tawp ciangin Nu in taupi tungah a koih a, lungnuam takin a kap hi.

records.english: My husband's visa depends on his job, so changing employers worried us.
records.zomi: Ka pasal' visa a nasep tungah kinga ahih manin nasepsakpa a khek ding in hong lungkhamsak hi.

records.english: My sister's residence permit allows her to bring her children to live with her.
records.zomi: Ka u numei' teenna phalna in a tate amah tawh teng dingin a paipih thei sak hi.

records.english: My brother overstayed his visa by a week and had to pay a fine.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal in a visa sangin kal khat a tam-in a om a, sum lepna a pia kul hi.

records.english: When my wife's visa was refused, we asked an adviser to help with the appeal.
records.zomi: Ka zi' visa a kinial ciangin a ngetkikna-ah huh dingin thuhilhpa khat i ngen uh hi.

records.english: When my aunt's visa expired, she had to go home for a few months.
records.zomi: Ka ni' visa a bei ciangin kha tawm khat sung inn ah a ciah kul hi.

records.english: Waiting for a family visa can feel like waiting for your life to begin again.
records.zomi: Innkuan visa ngakna in na nuntakna kik-in a kipat ding ngak bang a kisa thei hi.

records.english: We had to show our marriage certificate for the family visa.
records.zomi: Innkuan visa adingin i kiteenna lai-ciam i lak kul uh hi.

records.english: My grandparents were given a visa that allows them to visit us twice a year.
records.zomi: Ka pu leh pi in kum khat-in nihvei eite hong veh thei sakna visa khat a ngah uh hi.

records.english: Mum still keeps the visa from her first trip abroad in an old passport.
records.zomi: Nu in gamdang-a a khualzinna masa pen visa passport lui khat sungah a kem lai hi.

records.english: Our family's visas were stamped at the border, and the children cheered.
records.zomi: Gamgi ah i innkuan' visa te stamp a kibawl a, naupangte in a kikou uh hi.

records.english: Has Grandma's visa arrived yet?
records.zomi: Pi' visa a tung khin hiam?

records.english: Can my sister leave the country and come back on her current visa?
records.zomi: Ka u numei in a tu-a visa tawh gam a paisan-in a hong kik thei hiam?

records.english: Yes, because it allows her to enter as many times as she likes before it expires.
records.zomi: Thei hi, bang hang hiam cih leh a bei ma-in a deih zah-in a lut thei sak hi.

records.english: Do our relatives need a visa to come to the christening?
records.zomi: I sanggamte in naungek kibaptaizna-ah hong dingin visa a kul uh hiam?

records.english: My parents' visitor visas don't allow them to work while they stay with us.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa' khual visa in eite tawh a om lai-un na sep a phal kei hi.

records.english: The embassy needed proof that I could support my mother during her visit.
records.zomi: A hong veh lai-in ka nu ka huh thei hi, cih kipsakna embassy in a kul hi.

records.english: My brother is applying for a work visa so that he can join his company's office abroad.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a a company office ah a kihel theih nadingin ka u pasal in work visa a ngen hi.

records.english: What kind of visa does Grandma need to visit us?
records.zomi: Eite hong veh dingin Pi in bang visa a kul hiam?

records.english: A visitor visa, which usually lets her stay for up to three months.
records.zomi: Khual visa, tua in kha thum dong a om sak zel hi.

records.english: My husband's visa sponsor is the hospital where he works.
records.zomi: Ka pasal' visa a pang pen a nasepna damdawi inn ahi hi.

records.english: My cousin's student visa lets her work part-time during the holidays.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam' sangnaupang visa in tawlngakni lai-in hun khenkhat na a sem thei sak hi.

records.english: My uncle's work permit lets him work only for the hospital that sponsored him.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu' work permit in amah a pang damdawi inn adingin bek na a sem thei sak hi.

records.english: The single-entry visa meant that my cousin couldn't visit home during her course.
records.zomi: Khatvei lutna visa hangin ka sanggam a kisinna sungin inn a veh thei kei hi.

records.english: Can my brother bring his wife on his work visa?
records.zomi: Ka u pasal in a work visa tawh a zi a paipih thei hiam?

records.english: Only if her name is added as a dependant on his application.
records.zomi: A ngetna-ah a min amah tungah kinga mi-in a kibehlap leh bek.

records.english: We hired an adviser because the visa terms were too complicated for us to understand.
records.zomi: Visa thukhunte i theisiam theih loh dingin a buai lua ahih manin thuhilhpa khat i man uh hi.

records.english: A visa extension let my sister stay until her baby was born.
records.zomi: Visa sausakna in ka u numei a naungek a suah dong a om thei sak hi.

records.english: My little brother thinks a visa is a kind of ticket for the plane.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal in visa pen vanleng ticket bang khat hi, ci-in a ngaihsun hi.

records.english: The visa officer asked my mother how many children she had and where they lived.
records.zomi: Visa nasempa in ka nu kiangah ta bangzah a nei a, koi-ah a teng uh hiam cih a dong hi.

records.english: My cousin asked the embassy whether her visa would still be valid with her new passport.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in a passport thak tawh a visa a zat theih lai ding hiam cih embassy a dong hi.

records.english: My brother's student visa will end three months after he finishes his degree.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal' sangnaupang visa a degree a zawh khit kha thum-in a bei ding hi.

records.english: Who told you that the school was closing?
records.zomi: Sang a kikhak ding hi, ci-in kua in hong gen hiam?

records.english: A message in the parents' group, but I haven't checked it with the school yet.
records.zomi: Nu leh pate' group sung-a message khat, ahi zongin sang tawh ka kien nai kei hi.

records.english: Is it fair to share a screenshot of a private message from Auntie?
records.zomi: Ni' kiang pan mimal message khat' screenshot hawm a dik hiam?

records.english: My parents now ask us whether a story is real before they pass it on.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in tu-in thu khat a hawm ma-un a taktak hiam cih hong dong uh hi.

records.english: The family group has one rule: check before you share.
records.zomi: Innkuan group in thukhun khat a nei hi: na hawm ma-in en masa in.

records.english: Not every family photo needs to be shared with the world.
records.zomi: Innkuan photo khempeuh leitung bup tawh kihawm kul lo hi.

records.english: Sharing a friend's sad news without permission can hurt them deeply.
records.zomi: Phalna om lo-in lawm khat' lungkham thuthak hawm in a lungsim nasia takin a natsak thei hi.

records.english: My wife never shares pictures that show where the children go to school.
records.zomi: Ka zi in naupangte' sang a lak lim te a hawm ngei kei hi.

records.english: Who posted the picture of Grandpa asleep on the sofa?
records.zomi: Sofa tungah a ihmu Pu' lim kua in a post hiam?

records.english: We don't tell anyone online when the house will be empty.
records.zomi: Inn bang hun-in a awng ding hiam cih online-ah kuamah i gen kei uh hi.

records.english: Did you ask your grandmother before posting her recipe?
records.zomi: Na pi' an huan dan na post ma-in amah na dong hiam?

records.english: Before posting a video of the family party, I asked everyone who appeared in it.
records.zomi: Innkuan poai video ka post ma-in a sungah a kilang mi khempeuh ka dong hi.

records.english: Uncle Thang now asks the doctor before he passes on any health advice.
records.zomi: Tu-in pa neu Thang in cidamna thuhilhna a hawm ma-in siavuan a dong hi.

records.english: My cousin shared a rumour about our neighbour, and the whole street heard it.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in i inn veng tawh kisai thu-kiza khat a hawm a, lampi bup in a za uh hi.

records.english: Grandpa forwarded a warning about a fake charity, and it turned out to be true.
records.zomi: Pu in hehpihna pawl lem tawh kisai kidopna khat a khak a, tua a taktak hi.

records.english: Should we share the news about the baby yet?
records.zomi: Naungek thuthak tu-in i hawm ding hiam?

records.english: Not until my sister has told her husband's family herself.
records.zomi: Ka u numei in amah mahmah a pasal' innkuan a gen ma-in hi lo.

records.english: When Grandma died, we waited until every relative had been told before posting anything.
records.zomi: Pi a sih ciangin bangmah i post ma-un sanggam khempeuh a theih dong i ngak uh hi.

records.english: Can I post the photo of Grandpa in his hospital bed?
records.zomi: Damdawi inn lupna tunga Pu' photo ka post thei hiam?

records.english: No, ask him first, because he might not want people to see him like that.
records.zomi: Thei lo, amah dong masa in, bang hang hiam cih leh tua bang-a mite' muh a deih kei kha thei hi.

records.english: I deleted the photo when my brother said it showed his car's number plate.
records.zomi: Tua in a mawtaw nambat a lak hi, ci-in ka u pasal in a gen ciangin photo ka phiat hi.

records.english: Dad apologised in the family group after he shared a fake story about the floods.
records.zomi: Tuiliat tawh kisai thu lem khat a hawm khit ciangin Pa in innkuan group ah maisakna a ngen hi.

records.english: Dad shares old family photos only after asking the people in them.
records.zomi: Pa in innkuan photo lui te a sung-a mite a dot khit ciang bek-in a hawm hi.

records.english: My teenage son taught me how to tell whether a photo has been edited.
records.zomi: Ka tapa tangval no in photo khat kibawlkik hiam cih bangci-in theih ding hiam cih hong sinsak hi.

records.english: My husband always credits the person who took a photo when he shares it.
records.zomi: Ka pasal in photo khat a hawm ciangin a la mi' min a gen den hi.

records.english: Mum shares only good news online and keeps the difficult news for phone calls.
records.zomi: Nu in thuthak hoih bek online-ah a hawm a, thu haksa te phone sam-in a gen hi.

records.english: Why did you ask me before posting the family photo?
records.zomi: Bang hangin innkuan photo na post ma-in hong dong hiam?

records.english: Because you once told me you didn't like seeing yourself online.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh online-ah nangmah na kimuh na deih kei hi, ci-in khatvei hong gen ngei hi.

records.english: Our family's private group is the only place we post pictures of the children.
records.zomi: I innkuan' mimal group bek in naupangte' lim i post na mun ahi hi.

records.english: Our son asked his sister's permission before posting her drawing.
records.zomi: I tapa in a sanggam numei' lim a post ma-in phalna a ngen hi.

records.english: Let's wait until the doctor confirms the news before telling the relatives.
records.zomi: Sanggamte i gen ma-un siavuan in thuthak a kipsak dong ngak ni.

records.english: My sister shares her baby's photos only with close family.
records.zomi: Ka u numei in a naungek' photo te innkuan nai te tawh bek a hawm hi.

records.english: We taught our children never to share their address or phone number online.
records.zomi: I tate in a teenna mun leh phone nambat online-ah hawm ngei lo dingin i sinsak uh hi.

records.english: Having seen how fast false stories spread, my grandparents now check everything twice.
records.zomi: Thu lem te bangzah manlang-in a kizel hiam cih a muh khit ciangun ka pu leh pi in tu-in bangkim nihvei a en uh hi.

records.english: Our son was upset when his cousin posted a funny video of him without asking.
records.zomi: A sanggam in dot lo-in amah tawh kisai nuihzak video khat a post ciangin i tapa a lungkham hi.

records.english: When my daughter's friend posted a mean comment about her, we talked about it together instead of replying online.
records.zomi: Ka tanu' lawm in amah tawh kisai comment gilo khat a post ciangin online-ah dawng lo-in tua thu i kihoupih uh hi.

records.english: My sister removed the photo as soon as I told her I didn't like it.
records.zomi: Ka deih kei hi, ci-in ka gen pah ciangin ka u numei in photo a phiat hi.

records.english: Mum always checks with the family before she posts a picture of us.
records.zomi: Nu in ei' lim a post ma-in innkuan a dong den hi.

records.english: Do you mind if I share the photo of your new house?
records.zomi: Na inn thak' photo ka hawm leh na lungkham ding hiam?

records.english: We try to share news about family members only when they are happy for us to do so.
records.zomi: Innkuan mite tawh kisai thuthak, amaute in a lungdampih ciang bek-in i hawm sawm uh hi.

records.english: My daughter asked me not to post her school report online.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in a sang report online-ah post lo dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: Responsible sharing in our family starts with one simple question: would they mind?
records.zomi: I innkuan-a dik taka hawmna pen dotna baihlam khat tawh a kipan hi: amaute a lungkham ding uh hiam?

records.english: Our family checks every scam warning with the bank before passing it on.
records.zomi: I innkuan in a hawm ma-un mi-khem kidopna khempeuh bank tawh a en hi.

records.english: Can you ask your friend to take down the photo of our daughter?
records.zomi: I tanu' photo phiat dingin na lawm na ngen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Children, ask Mum or Dad before you send anyone a photo of the house.
records.zomi: Naupangte aw, inn' photo kua peuh kiangah na khak ma-un Nu a hih kei leh Pa dong un.

records.english: Auntie Mang sends every news story to the whole family without reading it first.
records.zomi: Ni Mang in thuthak khempeuh sim masa lo-in innkuan bup kiangah a khak hi.

records.english: Please don't post my exam results, because I want to tell people myself.
records.zomi: Ka sitna gah post kei un, bang hang hiam cih leh keimah mahmah in mite gen ka deih hi.

records.english: Auntie Hoih shared a news story that turned out to be several years old.
records.zomi: Ni Hoih in thuthak khat a hawm a, tua pen kum tampi a lui khin ahi hi.

records.english: My brother was embarrassed when his old school photo was posted at his wedding.
records.zomi: A mopawi ah a sang lui photo a kipost ciangin ka u pasal a zum hi.

records.english: My niece forwarded a chain message that promised good luck if she shared it.
records.zomi: Ka tunu in a hawm leh vanglian ngah ding hi, a ci chain message khat a khak hi.

records.english: We agreed not to share any photos of the children in their swimming clothes.
records.zomi: Tuipeek puan a silh naupangte' photo hawm lo dingin i kilem uh hi.

records.english: My cousin always says where she found a story when she shares it with the family.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in innkuan tawh thu khat a hawm ciangin koi pan a muh hiam cih a gen den hi.

records.english: Wait until we've sent the wedding photos to our parents before you share them.
records.zomi: Na hawm ma-in mopawi photo te i nu leh i pa kiangah i khak dong ngak in.

records.english: Before forwarding anything to the family group, I check it on a reliable website.
records.zomi: Innkuan group ah bangpeuh ka khak ma-in kingak huai website khat ah ka en hi.

records.english: Grandma thought the picture was real until my son showed her it was made by a computer.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in computer in a bawl hi, ci-in a lak mateng Pi in lim pen a taktak hi, ci-in a ngaihsun hi.

records.english: Is this message about free money from the bank true?
records.zomi: Bank pan sum a man om lo tawh kisai hih message a taktak hiam?

records.english: Almost certainly not, so please don't forward it to anyone.
records.zomi: A taktak lo dek tak hi, tua ahih manin kua kiangah zong khak kei in.

records.english: Thank you for asking before you shared the video of my speech.
records.zomi: Ka thugen video na hawm ma-in hong dot manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Thinking carefully about what we share protects the people we love.
records.zomi: I hawm ding pen dawm taka ngaihsutna in i it mite a ken hi.

records.english: Shall we ask your brother whether he wants his engagement photos shared?
records.zomi: Na u pasal in a kiteen ding kiciamna photo te a kihawm a deih hiam cih i dong ding hiam?

records.english: Where should I wait for the patient transport?
records.zomi: Cina tawipih mawtaw koi-ah ka ngak ding hiam?

records.english: Where can families get help with school uniforms?
records.zomi: Sang uniform adingin innkuante in koi-ah huhna a ngah thei uh hiam?

records.english: Where should we take the old fridge?
records.zomi: Fridge lui koi-ah i paipih ding uh hiam?

records.english: To the recycling centre, or the council will collect it for a small fee.
records.zomi: Recycling centre ah, a hih kei leh council in man neuno tawh a hong la ding hi.

records.english: Where's the closest pharmacy that's open at night?
records.zomi: Zan-in a kihong damdawi zuakna a kiang pen koi-ah om hiam?

records.english: Where can I report a dog that has been left alone for days?
records.zomi: Ni tampi sung amah bek a kinusia ui khat koi-ah ka theisak thei hiam?

records.english: Where would be the safest place for a new pedestrian crossing?
records.zomi: Lampi kantanna thak adingin koi mun in a lauhuai lo pen ding hiam?

records.english: Where did the council get the money for the new swimming pool?
records.zomi: Tuipeek mun thak adingin council in koi pan sum a ngah hiam?

records.english: Do you know where the timetable for the new tram line is posted?
records.zomi: Tram lampi thak' hun lai koi-ah kikhai hiam cih na thei hiam?

records.english: Where is the nearest bus stop for the hospital?
records.zomi: Damdawi inn adingin bus khawlna a kiang pen koi-ah om hiam?

records.english: Wherever you go in the town centre, you'll see posters for the festival.
records.zomi: Khuapi lai sung koi-ah na pai zongin pawi poster te na mu ding hi.

records.english: Where can children play safely after school in this area?
records.zomi: Hih mun ah sang khit ciangin naupangte koi-ah lauhuai lo takin a kimawl thei uh hiam?

records.english: Where is the town's emergency shelter during storms?
records.zomi: Huihpi hun-in khuapi' lauhuai hun kihimna mun koi-ah om hiam?

records.english: Where is the lost property office at the station?
records.zomi: Station ah van mangthang office koi-ah om hiam?

records.english: Where does the money from the charity shop go?
records.zomi: Hehpihna sumbuk pan sum koi-ah a pai hiam?

records.english: Where can I get a replacement bus pass?
records.zomi: Bus pass thak khat koi-ah ka ngah thei hiam?

records.english: At the travel office inside the main bus station.
records.zomi: Bus station lian sung-a khualzinna office ah.

records.english: Is there somewhere I can donate old clothes and toys?
records.zomi: Puan lui leh naupang kimawlna van te ka piak theihna mun khat a om hiam?

records.english: Where exactly is the entrance to the new health centre?

records.english: I chose the smaller university because the teachers knew every student by name.
