records.english: Do people in your village still share their harvest?
records.zomi: Na khua-a mite in a gah lak uh a kihawm lai uh hiam?

records.english: Yes, especially with families whose crops failed that year.
records.zomi: Kihawm lai uh hi, a tuamtuam-in tua kum-a a lo gah a siat innkuante tawh.

records.english: When our neighbour's son was in hospital, his parents had no money for the bus.
records.zomi: I inn veng' tapa damdawi inn a om lai-in a nu leh a pa in bus man a nei kei uh hi.

records.english: Without being asked, the families on our street collected enough for a whole month of journeys.
records.zomi: Ngen lo-in i lampi-a innkuante in kha khat bup khualzinna adingin a cing sum a kaikhawm uh hi.

records.english: Years later, that son became a nurse, and he still visits our street every Christmas.
records.zomi: Kum tampi khit ciangin tua tapa nurse a suak a, Christmas simin i lampi a veh lai hi.

records.english: Sharing food is the first thing my children learned about being a good neighbour.
records.zomi: An hawm pen inn veng hoih hihna tawh kisai ka tate in a sin masa pen ahi hi.

records.english: Children, help Grandpa carry the chairs to the church hall.
records.zomi: Naupangte aw, pawlpi inn lian ah tutphah te puak dingin Pu huh un.

records.english: Why do we take food to the neighbours when someone dies?
records.zomi: Mi khat a sih ciangin bang hangin inn vengte kiangah an i paipih uh hiam?

records.english: In our community, nobody should have to cook while they are grieving.
records.zomi: I khuasung ah a dahna lai-un kuamah in an a huan kul ding hi lo hi.

records.english: Who taught you to greet the elders first?
records.zomi: Upate kikhamsak masa dingin kua in hong sinsak hiam?

records.english: My grandmother, who would scold us gently if we forgot.
records.zomi: Ka pi, i mangngilh leh nem takin hong tai zel pa.

records.english: Why was the market moved to the car park?
records.zomi: Bang hangin sumbuk mun mawtaw khawlna mun ah a kisawn hiam?

records.english: Why did the food bank run out of rice this week?
records.zomi: Bang hangin hih kal-in an huhna mun ah buh a bei hiam?

records.english: Why is the library closed today?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tuni-in laibu inn a kikhak hiam?

records.english: The heating broke down, so it should reopen tomorrow.
records.zomi: Meisa khawl a sia ahih manin zingciang a kihong kik ding hi.

records.english: Why was the festival cancelled this year?
records.zomi: Bang hangin hih kum-in pawi a kiphiat hiam?

records.english: Why is there a police car outside the school?
records.zomi: Bang hangin sang pualam-ah police mawtaw khat a om hiam?

records.english: The officers are teaching the children about road safety.
records.zomi: Police te in naupangte kiangah lampi tunga lauhuai lo nading thu a sinsak uh hi.

records.english: Why do so few young people go to the residents' meetings?
records.zomi: Bang hangin teng mite' kikhopna te ah tangvalte tawm mahmah a pai uh hiam?

records.english: Why should residents report broken pavements?
records.zomi: Bang hangin teng mite in lampi gei kisia te a theisak ding uh hiam?

records.english: Why has the ambulance station moved to the edge of town?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ambulance station khuapi gei ah a kisawn hiam?

records.english: Why was the park gate locked this morning?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tuni zingsang-in park kongkhak a kikhak hiam?

records.english: Why are the bins collected later than usual?
records.zomi: Bang hangin eek bawm te a tavuan sangin a phawng-in a kila hiam?

records.english: Why do so many families use the library's computers?
records.zomi: Bang hangin innkuan tampi in laibu inn' computer te a zang uh hiam?

records.english: Why do we need to book a slot at the recycling centre?
records.zomi: Bang hangin recycling centre ah hun khat i koih khol kul uh hiam?

records.english: It stops long queues of cars from forming on the main road.
records.zomi: Lampi lian tungah mawtaw kigual sau a om loh nadingin ahi hi.

records.english: Why did the council plant trees along the main road?
records.zomi: Bang hangin council in lampi lian gei-ah singkung a suan hiam?

records.english: Why do some neighbourhoods get better bus services than others?
records.zomi: Bang hangin khuasung khenkhat in a dangte sangin bus nasepna hoih zaw a ngah uh hiam?

records.english: Why was the old bridge closed to lorries?
records.zomi: Bang hangin lei lui lorry te adingin a kikhak hiam?

records.english: Why does the new library have so few books in other languages?
records.zomi: Bang hangin laibu inn thak in pau dangte-a laibu tawm mahmah a nei hiam?

records.english: Why is the waiting list for council flats so long?
records.zomi: Bang hangin council inn adingin ngakna ciamtehna a sau mahmah hiam?

records.english: Why doesn't the town have a cinema any more?
records.zomi: Bang hangin khuapi in cinema a nei nawn kei hiam?

records.english: Why is the dentist only taking new patients on Tuesdays?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ha siavuan in Pithai ni bek-in cina thakte a sang hiam?

records.english: Why did the town choose that site for the new hospital?
records.zomi: Bang hangin khuapi in damdawi inn thak adingin tua mun a teel hiam?

records.english: Why does the town hall need a copy of my passport?
records.zomi: Bang hangin khuapi office in ka passport copy khat a kul hiam?

records.english: Why are the clinic's phone lines always busy at the start of the week?
records.zomi: Bang hangin kal kipat ciangin clinic' phone line te a buai den hiam?

records.english: Why did the council put speed bumps outside the school?
records.zomi: Bang hangin council in sang pualam-ah mawtaw zawisakna te a koih hiam?

records.english: Why does the health centre ask patients to arrive ten minutes early?
records.zomi: Bang hangin cidamna office in cinate minit sawm ma-in tung dingin a ngen hiam?

records.english: Why did the post office close early today?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tuni-in post office a manlang-in a kikhak hiam?

records.english: Why do the shops close so early in the villages?
records.zomi: Bang hangin khua te-ah sumbukte a manlang mahmah-in a kikhak uh hiam?

records.english: Why did the library start lending tools?
records.zomi: Bang hangin laibu inn in nasepna van te a pukip kipan hiam?

records.english: Why do volunteers run so many of the town's services?
records.zomi: Bang hangin khuapi' nasepna tampi thalawpte in a kalsuan uh hiam?

records.english: Why is the town clock always five minutes fast?
records.zomi: Bang hangin khuapi nai-et minit nga a pai ma den hiam?

records.english: Why are the trains always late on Monday mornings?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pizing ni zingsang-in meileng te a phawng den uh hiam?

records.english: Why can't residents park on the high street after six?
records.zomi: Bang hangin nitak nai 6 khit ciangin teng mite in lampi lian tungah mawtaw a khawl thei kei uh hiam?

records.english: Why did the council stop collecting garden waste in winter?
records.zomi: Bang hangin council in phalbi-in huan eek lak a khawl hiam?

records.english: Why don't more people use the recycling centre?
records.zomi: Bang hangin mi tam zaw in recycling centre a zang kei uh hiam?

records.english: Why has the monthly bus pass become so expensive?
records.zomi: Bang hangin kha sim bus pass a man sang mahmah hiam?

records.english: Why did the council move the bus stop?
records.zomi: Bang hangin council in bus khawlna a sawn hiam?

records.english: Buses were blocking the junction when they stopped there.
records.zomi: Bus te tua-ah a khawl ciangun lampi kikalna a khak uh hi.

records.english: Why do the street cleaners come so early?
records.zomi: Bang hangin lampi siangsakna nasemte a manlang mahmah-in a hong uh hiam?

records.english: Why is the advice centre so busy at the start of the month?
records.zomi: Bang hangin kha kipat ciangin thuhilhna office a buai mahmah hiam?

records.english: Why was the community centre's funding cut?
records.zomi: Bang hangin khuasung inn lian' sum a kiamsak hiam?

records.english: Why does the market start so early in the morning?
records.zomi: Bang hangin sumbuk mun zingsang a manlang mahmah-in a kipan hiam?

records.english: Why did the council decide to close the youth club?
records.zomi: Bang hangin council in tangvalte' kipawlna khak dingin a khensat hiam?

records.english: Why do the volunteers at the food bank ask for a referral letter?
records.zomi: Bang hangin an huhna mun-a thalawpte in hong sawlna lai a ngen uh hiam?

records.english: Why are the street lights switched off after midnight?
records.zomi: Bang hangin zanlai khit ciangin lampi meivak te a kimit hiam?

records.english: The council says it saves money and energy on quiet roads.
records.zomi: Tua in lampi dai te tungah sum leh meivak tha a khol hi, ci-in council in a gen hi.

records.english: Why has the bakery on the corner closed?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ken lam-a moh zuakna a kikhak hiam?

records.english: Why is the swimming pool so crowded on Saturdays?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Kiginni-in tuipeek mun ah mi a tam mahmah hiam?

records.english: Why do the night buses stop running in the summer?
records.zomi: Bang hangin khal-in zan bus te a pai khawl uh hiam?

records.english: Why do the firefighters test the alarm every Monday?
records.zomi: Bang hangin mei-sih nasemte in Pizing ni simin alarm a sit uh hiam?

records.english: Why should the council listen to children when it plans new parks?
records.zomi: Bang hangin council in park thakte a ciamteh ciangin naupangte' thu a ngaikhiat ding hiam?

records.english: Why does the clinic ask for proof of address?
records.zomi: Bang hangin clinic in teenna kipsakna a ngen hiam?

records.english: It only serves people who live in this part of the town.
records.zomi: Khuapi' hih lam-a teng mite bek a huh hi.

records.english: Why should we vote in the local elections?
records.zomi: Bang hangin mun-a teelna te-ah vote i a ding uh hiam?

records.english: Why do we have to pay for parking at the hospital?
records.zomi: Bang hangin damdawi inn ah mawtaw khawlna man i pia kul uh hiam?

records.english: Why did nobody tell residents about the new building plans?
records.zomi: Bang hangin inn lam plan thakte tawh kisai teng mite kuamah in a gen kei uh hiam?

records.english: Why are they digging up the road outside the bank?
records.zomi: Bang hangin bank pualam-a lampi a tou uh hiam?

records.english: Why should children learn to swim at the public pool?
records.zomi: Bang hangin naupangte in mipite' tuipeek mun ah tuipeek a sin ding uh hiam?

records.english: Why aren't dogs allowed in the children's playground?
records.zomi: Bang hangin naupang kimawlna mun ah ui te kiphal lo hiam?

records.english: The best essays answer the question with clear claims and good evidence.
records.zomi: Essay hoih pen te in thugen tak leh kipsakna hoih tawh dotna a dawng uh hi.

records.english: Evidence from many small studies can be stronger than one large claim.
records.zomi: Kankanna neu tampi pan kipsakna in thugen lian khat sangin a hat zaw thei hi.

records.english: The lab results proved that the water was clean.
records.zomi: Lab gah te in tui a siang hi, cih a kipsak hi.

records.english: The doctor said that there was no evidence that the vitamin helped.
records.zomi: Vitamin in a huh hi, cih kipsakna om lo hi, ci-in siavuan in a gen hi.

records.english: The police needed more evidence before they could charge anyone.
records.zomi: Kua peuh a mawhsak ma-un police te in kipsakna tam zaw a kul uh hi.

records.english: Our boss made us test every claim on the new supplier's website.
records.zomi: I makaipa in van piakpa thak' website tunga thugen khempeuh sit dingin hong sawl hi.

records.english: Customer surveys are useful evidence, but they don't tell the whole story.
records.zomi: Khualzinte' dotna kankanna te kipsakna phattuam ahi a, ahi zongin tangthu bup a gen kei hi.

records.english: Underline the claim in each paragraph and circle its evidence.
records.zomi: Kammal khen khatciat sung-a thugen a nuai-ah khau khai unla, a kipsakna kual un.

records.english: My manager asked for evidence before she would believe the rumour.
records.zomi: Ka manager in thu-kiza a up ma-in kipsakna a ngen hi.

records.english: The witness's statement supported the driver's claim.
records.zomi: Theihpihpa' thugen in mawtaw tawlpa' thugen a thapia hi.

records.english: The historian's claim was based on letters written at the time.
records.zomi: Tangthu siampa' thugen tua hun-a kigelh laikhak te tungah kinga hi.

records.english: The safety inspector's claim was backed up by photographs and measurements.
records.zomi: Lauhuai lo nading ennapa' thugen photo leh tehna te in a thapia hi.

records.english: The accountant found evidence that the figures had been entered twice.
records.zomi: Sum ciamtehpa in nambat te nihvei kigelh hi, cih kipsakna a mu hi.

records.english: Our teacher asked us to find two pieces of evidence for each argument.
records.zomi: I saya in kipsakna thu khatciat adingin kipsakna nih zong dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: Our science teacher asked us what evidence would change our minds.
records.zomi: I science saya in bang kipsakna in i ngaihsutna hong khek ding hiam cih hong dong hi.

records.english: The receipts proved that the hotel had charged us twice.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk in nihvei man hong la hi, cih man piakna lai te in a kipsak hi.

records.english: The engineer's report gave clear evidence that the wall was unsafe.
records.zomi: Engineer' report in bang a lauhuai hi, cih kipsakna tak khat a pia hi.

records.english: The students tested the advert's claim that the battery lasted a full week.
records.zomi: Battery in kal bup a sau hi, ci advert' thugen sangnaupangte in a sit uh hi.

records.english: Bring any evidence of the problem, such as photos or emails, to the meeting.
records.zomi: Photo a hih kei leh email bang buaina' kipsakna peuhmah kikhopna ah paipih in.

records.english: Please attach receipts to support every expense claim.
records.zomi: Sum zatna ngetna khempeuh thapia nadingin man piakna lai te zom in.

records.english: Thank you for bringing such clear evidence to the meeting.
records.zomi: Kikhopna ah hih bang kipsakna tak na paipih manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: The nurse's notes were used as evidence in the hospital's review.
records.zomi: Damdawi inn' enkikna sungah nurse' ciamtehna te kipsakna-in kizang hi.

records.english: The security camera showed who had left the gate open.
records.zomi: Security camera in kongkhak kua in a hong nusia hiam cih a lak hi.

records.english: A good research paper explains how its evidence was collected.
records.zomi: Kankanna lai hoih khat in a kipsakna bangci-in a kaikhawm hiam cih a gen hi.

records.english: Our debate team lost because we made claims without enough evidence.
records.zomi: Kipsakna a cing om lo-in thugen i bawl manin i kiniamna team a zo kei hi.

records.english: Is there any evidence that the training works?
records.zomi: Kisinsakna in na a sem hi, cih kipsakna khat peuh a om hiam?

records.english: Yes, staff who took it made far fewer errors in the following month.
records.zomi: Om hi, a sin nasemte in a nungzui kha sungin khialhna tawm mahmah a bawl uh hi.

records.english: The museum checked the claim that the sword had belonged to a famous general.
records.zomi: Namsau pen galkap makai minthang khat' ahi hi, ci thugen museum in a en hi.

records.english: Every student must list the sources behind each claim in their project.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang khempeuh in a project sung-a thugen khatciat nung-a mun te a ciamteh ding uh hi.

records.english: Without evidence, the complaint could not be investigated.
records.zomi: Kipsakna om lo-in phunna kankan theih hi lo hi.

records.english: The trainee claimed he had checked the stock, but the list was blank.
records.zomi: Kisin nasem in van te ka en khin hi, a ci a, ahi zongin ciamtehna a awng hi.

records.english: Why did the judge reject the claim?
records.zomi: Bang hangin thukhenpa in thugen a nial hiam?

records.english: The company couldn't show any documents to support it.
records.zomi: Company in a thapia lai khat peuh a lak thei kei hi.

records.english: The engineers' claim that the bridge was safe was supported by load tests.
records.zomi: Lei a lauhuai kei hi, ci engineer te' thugen gikna sitna te in a thapia hi.

records.english: The student's claim that the website was reliable didn't survive a quick check.
records.zomi: Website a kingak huai hi, ci sangnaupang' thugen en tomno khat in a man kei hi.

records.english: Evidence that is easy to check is more convincing than evidence that isn't.
records.zomi: En baih kipsakna in en haksa kipsakna sangin mi a umsak zaw hi.

records.english: Is this evidence reliable, or could it have been changed?
records.zomi: Hih kipsakna a kingak huai hiam, a hih kei leh kikhek thei hiam?

records.english: Which evidence in the report is the strongest?
records.zomi: Report sung-a bang kipsakna in a hat pen hiam?

records.english: The detective collected fingerprints from the broken window.
records.zomi: Thukankanpa in tawhkhang kitam pan khut ciamtehna te a la hi.

records.english: Shall we look for evidence before we accuse anyone?
records.zomi: Kua peuh i mawhsak ma-un kipsakna i zong ding hiam?

records.english: The archaeologists' claim about the old village was based on pottery they found.
records.zomi: Khua lui tawh kisai tangthu lui kankante' thugen a muh uh beel kitam te tungah kinga hi.

records.english: The doctor wanted evidence from a blood test before changing the medicine.
records.zomi: Siavuan in damdawi a khek ma-in sisan sitna pan kipsakna a deih hi.

records.english: Can you show me the data behind that claim?
records.zomi: Tua thugen nung-a data hong lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: The judge said that the evidence was not strong enough to convict him.
records.zomi: Amah mawhsak nadingin kipsakna a hat zo kei hi, ci-in thukhenpa in a gen hi.

records.english: The scientist's claim was accepted only after other labs repeated her results.
records.zomi: Lab dangte in a gah te a bawl kik khit ciang bek-in science siam numei' thugen kisang hi.

records.english: Strong claims need strong evidence, our teacher always says.
records.zomi: Thugen hat te in kipsakna hat a kul hi, ci-in i saya in a gen den hi.

records.english: Our tutor marked us down for claims that weren't supported by evidence.
records.zomi: Kipsakna in a thapia loh thugen te hangin i saya in mark hong kiamsak hi.

records.english: The company's claim to be the cheapest in town was checked by a newspaper.
records.zomi: Khuapi sungah a man neem pen ka hi hi, ci company' thugen thuthak lai khat in a en hi.

records.english: How do I support my claim in the essay?
records.zomi: Essay sungah ka thugen bangci-in ka thapia ding hiam?

records.english: Use a quotation from the text and explain why it proves your point.
records.zomi: Laigelh pan kammal khat la inla, bang hangin na ngaihsutna a kipsak hiam cih gen in.

records.english: Can you prove that the machine was faulty?
records.zomi: Khawl a sia hi, cih na kipsak thei hiam?

records.english: Yes, the repair report shows that a part had cracked.
records.zomi: Thei hi, bawlkikna report in a tawm khat a kek hi, cih a lak hi.

records.english: The advert claimed the cream removed wrinkles in a week, but there was no proof.
records.zomi: Cream in kal khat sungin vun ngul te a phiat hi, ci-in advert in a gen a, ahi zongin kipsakna om lo hi.

records.english: What evidence do you have that the new layout increased sales?
records.zomi: Koihna thak in zuakna a khangsak hi, cih bang kipsakna na nei hiam?

records.english: Sales in the rearranged aisles rose by a fifth, while the others stayed the same.
records.zomi: Kikoih kik lampi te-ah zuakna za-a 20 a khang a, a dangte a kibang lai hi.

records.english: Did the inspector find any evidence of damp?
records.zomi: Ennapa in tui-et kipsakna khat peuh a mu hiam?

records.english: The report's main claim was supported by figures from three different years.
records.zomi: Report' thugen lian pen kum tuamtuam thum pan nambat te in a thapia hi.

records.english: Is a single customer complaint enough evidence to change the product?
records.zomi: Khualzin khat' phunna khat bek van khek nadingin kipsakna a cing hiam?

records.english: The insurance company asked for photos as evidence of the damage.
records.zomi: Insurance company in siatna kipsakna adingin photo te a ngen hi.

records.english: The company withdrew its claim after a customer showed the full contract.
records.zomi: Khualzin khat in contract bup a lak khit ciangin company in a thugen a la kik hi.

records.english: Many Christians believe that baptism should happen only once in a person's life.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in kibaptaizna pen mi khat' nuntakna sungah khatvei bek a piang ding hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: My grandmother says that her baptism was the most important day of her life.
records.zomi: Ka kibaptaizna ni pen ka nuntakna-a ni thupi pen ahi hi, ci-in ka pi in a gen hi.

records.english: Our family celebrated the baby's baptism with a big lunch.
records.zomi: I innkuan in naungek' kibaptaizna sun an lian khat tawh a lungdampih hi.

records.english: The church was full for the baptism of five young people.
records.zomi: Tangval nga' kibaptaizna adingin pawlpi inn a dim hi.

records.english: In many churches, the Lord's Supper is also known as Holy Communion.
records.zomi: Pawlpi tampi ah Topa' Nitak An pen Holy Communion zong kici hi.

records.english: Dad was baptised in the same river as his father.
records.zomi: Pa pen a pa' kibaptaizna lui mahmah ah kibaptaiz hi.

records.english: I do want to be baptised when I'm old enough to decide for myself.
records.zomi: Keimah adingin ka khensat theih kum ka cin ciangin kibaptaiz ka deih taktak hi.

records.english: In some churches, people are baptised by being put completely under the water.
records.zomi: Pawlpi khenkhat ah mite tui nuai-ah a bup-in kiphum-in a kibaptaiz uh hi.

records.english: Different Christian traditions understand the Lord's Supper in different ways.
records.zomi: Khristian ngeina tuamtuam in Topa' Nitak An lampi tuamtuam-in a theisiam uh hi.

records.english: Our church holds baptisms at Easter and at Christmas.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in Easter leh Christmas-in kibaptaizna a bawl hi.

records.english: Bread and wine are shared during the Lord's Supper.
records.zomi: Topa' Nitak An lai-in khomun leh leenggahtui kihawm hi.

records.english: Who will be the baby's godparents?
records.zomi: Naungek' kibaptaizna-a a kemtu ding nu leh pa te kua ahi ding uh hiam?

records.english: The baptism service ended with a song and a prayer for the new believers.
records.zomi: Kibaptaizna biakna la khat leh upa thakte adingin thungetna khat tawh a tawp hi.

records.english: Our family gathered at the church for my cousin's baptism.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam' kibaptaizna adingin i innkuan pawlpi ah a kikhop uh hi.

records.english: Can children take communion in your church?
records.zomi: Na pawlpi ah naupangte in Topa' Nitak An a ne thei uh hiam?

records.english: In our church, they can after they have been confirmed.
records.zomi: I pawlpi ah upna kipsakna a ngah khit uh ciangin a ne thei uh hi.

records.english: Does your mother still keep the white dress you wore at your baptism?
records.zomi: Na kibaptaizna-a na silh puan kang na nu in a kem lai hiam?

records.english: The Lord's Supper is shared in silence in some churches and with singing in others.
records.zomi: Topa' Nitak An pawlpi khenkhat ah dai takin a kihawm a, a dangte ah la tawh kihawm hi.

records.english: Thank you for coming to my daughter's baptism.
records.zomi: Ka tanu' kibaptaizna-ah na hong manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: The deacons carried the bread and the cup to each row.
records.zomi: Deacon te in khomun leh haai te kigual khatciat ah a tawi uh hi.

records.english: The pastor poured water over the baby's head three times.
records.zomi: Pastor in naungek' lu tungah thumvei tui a sung hi.

records.english: In the Gospels, Jesus gives his disciples bread at the last supper and calls it his body.
records.zomi: Lungdamna Thu te-ah Jesu in nitak an nunung pen-in a nungzuite khomun a pia a, tua pen a pumpi ahi hi, ci-in a gen hi.

records.english: Where were you baptised?
records.zomi: Koi-ah na kibaptaiz hiam?

records.english: In the river below our village, when I was 15.
records.zomi: I khua nuai lam-a lui ah, kum 15 ka cin ciangin.

records.english: Why do some churches baptise babies and others only adults?
records.zomi: Bang hangin pawlpi khenkhat in naungekte a baptaiz uh a, khenkhat in upate bek a baptaiz uh hiam?

records.english: Churches understand baptism differently, so some baptise infants and others wait until a person can choose for themselves.
records.zomi: Pawlpite in kibaptaizna tuamtuam-in a theisiam uh ahih manin khenkhat in naungekte a baptaiz uh a, khenkhat in mi khat amah mahmah a teel theih dong a ngak uh hi.

records.english: The children watched quietly as the adults went forward for communion.
records.zomi: Upate Topa' Nitak An adingin mai lam-ah a pai ciangun naupangte in dai takin a en uh hi.

records.english: Our pastor explained what the bread and the cup mean before we shared them.
records.zomi: I pastor in a kihawm ma-un khomun leh haai in bang a lak hiam cih a gen hi.

records.english: The new believers wore white clothes to show that they were starting a new life.
records.zomi: Upa thakte in nuntakna thak a kipat uh lak nadingin puan kang a silh uh hi.

records.english: Was your little sister baptised last Sunday?
records.zomi: Nipini bei-in na nau numei kibaptaiz hiam?

records.english: On the morning of my baptism, my whole family walked with me to the church.
records.zomi: Ka kibaptaizna ni zingsang-in ka innkuan bup kei tawh pawlpi ah a pai uh hi.

records.english: The pastor asked me a few questions, and I answered them in front of everyone.
records.zomi: Pastor in dotna tawm khat hong dong a, mi khempeuh mai-ah ka dawng hi.

records.english: Afterwards, we shared a meal with the church, and my grandmother cried with happiness.
records.zomi: A khit ciangin pawlpi tawh an i nekkhawm uh a, ka pi lungdam mahmah-in a kap hi.

records.english: The children's choir sang at the baptism service.
records.zomi: Naupangte' la-sa pawl in kibaptaizna biakna ah la a sa uh hi.

records.english: According to the book of Acts, many of the first Christians were baptised on the same day.
records.zomi: Sawltakte' Sepna laibu bang-in Khristian masate tampi ni kibang-in a kibaptaiz uh hi.

records.english: What is baptism?
records.zomi: Kibaptaizna pen bang hiam?

records.english: Christians see it as a sign of new life and of joining the church.
records.zomi: Khristiante in nuntakna thak leh pawlpi-a kihelna lakna-in a mu uh hi.

records.english: My grandparents still remember the day they were baptised together.
records.zomi: Ka pu leh pi in a kibaptaiz khawm ni uh a phawk lai uh hi.

records.english: Before his baptism, my brother met the pastor every week to talk about his faith.
records.zomi: A kibaptaiz ma-in ka u pasal in a upna tawh kisai kihoupih dingin kal simin pastor a mu hi.

records.english: The church keeps a record of every baptism in a large old book.
records.zomi: Pawlpi in kibaptaizna khempeuh laibu lian lui khat sungah a ciamteh hi.

records.english: Many Christians see the Lord's Supper as a time to remember and give thanks.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in Topa' Nitak An pen phawkna leh lungdam genna hun-in a mu uh hi.

records.english: My uncle was baptised as an adult, after he became a Christian.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu Khristian a suah khit ciangin upa a hih khit-in kibaptaiz hi.

records.english: Some Christians take communion every week, while others take it only a few times a year.
records.zomi: Khristian khenkhat in kal simin Topa' Nitak An a ne uh a, a dangte in kum khat-in vei tawm khat bek a ne uh hi.

records.english: In many churches, communion is shared by everyone, rich and poor, at the same table.
records.zomi: Pawlpi tampi ah Topa' Nitak An pen mi khempeuh, a hau leh a zawng, taupi kibang tungah a kihawm uh hi.

records.english: Christians believe that Jesus himself was baptised in the River Jordan.
records.zomi: Jesu mahmah Jordan gun sungah kibaptaiz hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: Grandpa, do you remember your own baptism?
records.zomi: Pu aw, na kibaptaizna na phawk hiam?

records.english: Why did the pastor use water from the river?
records.zomi: Bang hangin pastor in lui pan tui a zang hiam?

records.english: Shall we buy a Bible for your cousin's baptism?
records.zomi: Na sanggam' kibaptaizna adingin Laisiangtho khat i lei ding hiam?

records.english: In some churches, the minister brings communion to sick members at home.
records.zomi: Pawlpi khenkhat ah pastor in a cina pawlpi mite kiangah inn-ah Topa' Nitak An a tawi hi.

records.english: Why do some churches use grape juice instead of wine?
records.zomi: Bang hangin pawlpi khenkhat in leenggahtui sang-in grape juice a zang uh hiam?

records.english: Can you explain why Christians eat bread at communion?
records.zomi: Topa' Nitak An ah bang hangin Khristiante in khomun a ne uh hiam cih na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our church celebrates the Lord's Supper on the first Sunday of every month.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in kha khatciat' Nipini masa pen-in Topa' Nitak An a bawl hi.

records.english: The pastor broke the bread and gave thanks before sharing it.
records.zomi: Pastor in khomun a balnen a, a hawm ma-in lungdam a gen hi.

records.english: For many Christians, baptism and the Lord's Supper are signs of belonging to the church.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi adingin kibaptaizna leh Topa' Nitak An pen pawlpi-a kihelna lakna te ahi hi.

records.english: Children, today we're going to learn why Christians are baptised.
records.zomi: Naupangte aw, tuni-in bang hangin Khristiante a kibaptaiz uh hiam cih i sin ding uh hi.

records.english: Having been baptised as a baby, my sister later chose to confirm her faith.
records.zomi: Naungek a hih lai-in a kibaptaiz khit ciangin ka u numei in a nunglam-ah a upna kipsak dingin a teel hi.

records.english: We prayed for the people who were going to be baptised the next week.
records.zomi: A kal nungzui-a kibaptaiz ding mite adingin thu i ngen uh hi.

records.english: What do Christians remember at the Lord's Supper?
records.zomi: Topa' Nitak An ah Khristiante in bang a phawk uh hiam?

records.english: They remember the last meal Jesus shared with his disciples before he died.
records.zomi: Jesu' a sih ma-a a nungzuite tawh a nek khawm an nunung pen a phawk uh hi.

records.english: Is it all right if visitors take part in the Lord's Supper?
records.zomi: Khualte in Topa' Nitak An ah a kihel leh a hoih hiam?

records.english: AI learns from examples, a bit like children learn from what they see.
records.zomi: AI in entehna te pan a sin a, naupangte in a muh uh pan a sin bang tawm khat ahi hi.

records.english: Can AI think like a person?
records.zomi: AI in mihing bang-in a ngaihsun thei hiam?

records.english: Not really, because it mostly finds patterns in huge amounts of information.
records.zomi: Thei taktak lo hi, bang hang hiam cih leh a tamzaw-in thu tam mahmah sung-a a kibang dan te a zong hi.

records.english: Our son asked the voice assistant to tell him a joke.
records.zomi: I tapa in voice assistant kiangah nuihzak thu khat gen dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: My sister's phone uses AI to make the photos look brighter.
records.zomi: Ka u numei' phone in photo te a tan zaw nadingin AI a zang hi.

records.english: The spam filter in my email is a simple kind of AI.
records.zomi: Ka email sung-a spam filter pen AI baihlam khat ahi hi.

records.english: The photo app sorts our family pictures by the faces it recognises.
records.zomi: Photo app in a theih mai te tawh i innkuan lim te a khen hi.

records.english: Grandma says the chatbot is cleverer than her but less kind.
records.zomi: Chatbot pen kei sangin a pil zaw a, ahi zongin a hehpih tawm zaw hi, ci-in Pi in a gen hi.

records.english: Is the robot vacuum cleaner a kind of AI?
records.zomi: Robot vacuum cleaner pen AI khat ahi hiam?

records.english: Do AI tools always need the internet to work?
records.zomi: AI van te in na a sep nadingin internet a kul den hiam?

records.english: Who taught you so much about AI?
records.zomi: AI tawh kisai tam takin kua in hong sinsak hiam?

records.english: My husband uses AI at work to sort thousands of documents.
records.zomi: Ka pasal in nasepna-ah lai tul tampi khen dingin AI a zang hi.

records.english: Shall we ask the AI to plan a route for our family holiday?
records.zomi: I innkuan tawlngakni adingin lampi ciamteh dingin AI i ngen ding hiam?

records.english: Not every app that calls itself AI is actually using it.
records.zomi: AI ka hi hi, a kici app khempeuh in a zang taktak kei uh hi.

records.english: The children used an AI drawing app to make cards for the family.
records.zomi: Naupangte in innkuan adingin card bawl dingin AI lim lai app khat a zang uh hi.

records.english: The more examples an AI program sees, the better it usually becomes.
records.zomi: AI program khat in entehna tam a muh semsem ciangin a hoih semsem zel hi.

records.english: Dad was surprised that AI could recognise birds from their songs.
records.zomi: AI in vasate a la uh tawh a thei thei hi, cih Pa a lamdang sa hi.

records.english: Talking about AI at dinner helped the children understand the news.
records.zomi: Nitak an lai-a AI tawh kisai kihoupihna in naupangte thuthak a theisiam sak hi.

records.english: Some AI programs are trained on so much text that they seem to know everything.
records.zomi: AI program khenkhat laigelh tam mahmah tawh kisinsak ahih manin bangkim a thei bang-in a kilang hi.

records.english: My uncle uses AI to check his crops for diseases from photos.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu in photo te pan a lo gah te' natna en dingin AI a zang hi.

records.english: Mum asked the chatbot for a recipe and then changed half of it.
records.zomi: Nu in chatbot kiangah an huan dan khat a ngen a, tua khit ciangin a kim a khek hi.

records.english: Mum uses AI to read out the news because her eyes are tired.
records.zomi: A mit a gim ahih manin Nu in thuthak sim sak dingin AI a zang hi.

records.english: My daughter asked the AI why the sky is blue and then checked the answer in a book.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in bang hangin van a dum hiam cih AI a dong a, tua khit ciangin laibu khat sungah dawnna a en hi.

records.english: We turned off the smart speaker when the children were sleeping.
records.zomi: Naupangte a ihmut lai-un smart speaker i mitsak uh hi.

records.english: Should I believe everything the chatbot tells me?
records.zomi: Chatbot in hong gen khempeuh ka um ding hiam?

records.english: No, always check important facts with a reliable source.
records.zomi: Um kei in, thu taktak thupi te kingak huai mun khat tawh en den in.

records.english: Would you trust AI with anything about your bank account?
records.zomi: Na bank account tawh kisai bangpeuh AI na ap ding hiam?

records.english: Our family agreed that homework must be done without asking AI for the answers.
records.zomi: Inn nasep AI kiangah dawnna ngen lo-in bawl ding hi, ci-in i innkuan in i kilem uh hi.

records.english: My grandmother thinks the AI on her phone is listening to her all the time.
records.zomi: A phone tunga AI in hun khempeuh-in a ngaikhia hi, ci-in ka pi in a ngaihsun hi.

records.english: My little sister was surprised that the AI could describe her drawing.
records.zomi: AI in a lim lai a gen thei hi, cih ka nau numei a lamdang sa hi.

records.english: Does the AI in the translation app understand our language well?
records.zomi: Letna app-a AI in i pau hoih takin a theisiam hiam?

records.english: My brother uses AI to check the spelling in his work emails.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal in a nasep email te-a laimal gelh dan en dingin AI a zang hi.

records.english: My parents were amazed when the app turned Grandpa's old photo into colour.
records.zomi: App in Pu' photo lui pianzia nei-in a bawl ciangin ka nu leh ka pa a lamdang sa mahmah uh hi.

records.english: Understanding what AI can and cannot do helps our family use it safely.
records.zomi: AI in bang a bawl thei a, bang a bawl theih loh hiam cih theisiamna in i innkuan lauhuai lo takin a zang thei sak hi.

records.english: Grandpa asked whether there is a little person inside the speaker.
records.zomi: Speaker sungah mihing neuno khat a om hiam, ci-in Pu in a dong hi.

records.english: My brother showed us how AI can turn spoken words into text.
records.zomi: AI in kampau te laigelh-in bangci-in a khek thei hiam cih ka u pasal in hong lak hi.

records.english: My niece wants to study AI at university.
records.zomi: Ka tunu in university ah AI sin a deih hi.

records.english: How does the music app choose songs for me?
records.zomi: Music app in kei adingin la te bangci-in a teel hiam?

records.english: It notices what you listen to and suggests songs that similar people enjoy.
records.zomi: Na ngaih te a et a, mi kibang te' deih la te hong ngen hi.

records.english: Our son tried to trick the AI with a riddle, and it got the answer wrong.
records.zomi: I tapa in thu-ekhua khat tawh AI khem dingin a sawm a, a dawnna a khial hi.

records.english: AI makes mistakes when it hasn't seen enough examples of something.
records.zomi: AI in bangkhat' entehna a cing a muh loh ciangin a khial zel hi.

records.english: My cousin works for a company that teaches computers to recognise voices.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in computer te aw thei dingin a sinsak company khat ah na a sem hi.

records.english: My daughter explained AI to her grandfather using a cooking recipe.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in a pu kiangah an huan dan khat zang-in AI a gen hi.

records.english: Can AI write a birthday poem for Grandma?
records.zomi: AI in Pi adingin suahni la khat a gelh thei hiam?

records.english: AI can suggest words as you type, but it can also make silly mistakes.
records.zomi: Na type lai-in AI in kammal te a ngen thei a, ahi zongin khialhna nuihzak huai a bawl thei hi.

records.english: Could you explain to Grandma what AI actually does?
records.zomi: AI in bang taktak a bawl hiam cih Pi kiangah na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our neighbour uses an AI hearing aid that filters out background noise.
records.zomi: I inn veng in pualam ging a khen AI bil khat a zang hi.

records.english: Even a very clever AI can only work with the information it has been given.
records.zomi: AI pil mahmah khat zong a kipiak thu tawh bek na a sem thei hi.

records.english: AI can't feel happy or sad, even when its words sound friendly.
records.zomi: A kammal te lawm bang-in a za zongin AI a lungdam thei kei a, a lungkham thei kei hi.

records.english: Mum, is the voice assistant a real person?
records.zomi: Nu aw, voice assistant pen mihing taktak hiam?

records.english: No, it's a computer program that has learned to understand speech.
records.zomi: Hi lo hi, kampau theisiam dingin a kisin computer program khat ahi hi.

records.english: We told the children that AI is a tool, not a friend.
records.zomi: AI pen van khat ahi a, lawm hi lo hi, ci-in naupangte i gen uh hi.

records.english: My parents worry that the children will believe everything AI tells them.
records.zomi: Naupangte in AI in a gen khempeuh a um ding uh hi, ci-in ka nu leh ka pa a lungkham uh hi.

records.english: Does Dad use an AI app to translate letters from his relatives abroad?
records.zomi: Pa in gamdang-a a sanggamte pan laikhak let dingin AI app khat a zang hiam?

records.english: Our family argued about whether AI will take away people's jobs.
records.zomi: AI in mite' nasep a la ding hiam cih i innkuan in i kiniam uh hi.

records.english: Grandpa wonders what AI will be able to do when his great-grandchildren are grown up.
records.zomi: A tu' tate a khanglian ciangun AI in bang a bawl thei ding hiam cih Pu in a ngaihsun hi.

records.english: Thank you for showing Grandma how to use the AI assistant.
records.zomi: AI assistant bangci-in zang ding hiam cih Pi na lak manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Our son thinks the car's navigation system is very clever, but it's just following maps and data.
records.zomi: Mawtaw' navigation system pil mahmah hi, ci-in i tapa in a ngaihsun a, ahi zongin map leh data a zui bek hi.

records.english: Why did Grandpa's phone recognise his face?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pu' phone in a mai a thei hiam?

records.english: Because it uses AI to compare his face with the picture it has saved.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh a mai a kem lim tawh kiteh nadingin AI a zang hi.

records.english: I booked my eye test for my day off.
records.zomi: Ka tawlngak ni-in ka mit enna ka koih khol hi.

records.english: Is there an appointment before work tomorrow?
records.zomi: Zingciang nasep ma-in kimuhna khat a om hiam?

records.english: Let's find a time that suits both your schedule and the doctor's.
records.zomi: Na hun lai leh siavuan' hun lai a kilawm hun khat zong ni.

records.english: Students can book a session with the school counsellor through the office.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte in office tungtawn-in sang lungsim huhpa tawh hun khat a koih khol thei uh hi.

records.english: Could I book a check-up during my lunch break?
records.zomi: Ka sun an tawlngak hun-in cidamna enna khat ka koih khol thei ding hiam?

records.english: Do I need an appointment for the work health check?
records.zomi: Nasepna cidamna enna adingin kimuhna ka kul hiam?

records.english: Yes, book a slot online through the staff website.
records.zomi: Kul hi, nasemte' website tungtawn-in online-in hun khat koih khol in.

records.english: Can you cover my class while I'm at the hospital on Friday?
records.zomi: Laithai ni-in damdawi inn ka om lai-in ka class na sinsak sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: I had to cancel my appointment because of a last-minute meeting.
records.zomi: Nunung pen-a hong piang kikhopna khat hangin ka kimuhna ka phiat kul hi.

records.english: The trainee forgot to tell the manager about her appointment and was marked absent.
records.zomi: Kisin nasem in a kimuhna thu manager kiangah gen a mangngilh ahih manin om lo-in kiciamteh hi.

records.english: The careers adviser has appointments every Thursday for final-year students.
records.zomi: Nasep lampi thuhilhpa in Laizing ni simin kum nunung pen sangnaupangte adingin kimuhna te a nei hi.

records.english: Do I need to show my appointment card to get time off?
records.zomi: Hun tawlngak ngah nadingin ka kimuhna card ka lak kul hiam?

records.english: My employer pays for an annual health check, but I have to book it myself.
records.zomi: Ka nasepsakpa in kum khat-in khatvei cidamna enna man a pia a, ahi zongin keimah in ka koih khol kul hi.

records.english: When can the school nurse see my son?
records.zomi: Sang nurse in ka tapa bang hun-in a en thei ding hiam?

records.english: She's free on Tuesday morning, before the first lesson.
records.zomi: Pithai ni zingsang, sinna masa pen ma-in a awng hi.

records.english: Flexible working hours make it much easier to get to appointments.
records.zomi: Kikhek thei nasep hun te in kimuhna te-ah pai a baih zaw mahmah sak hi.

records.english: My appointment ran late, so I missed the start of my lecture.
records.zomi: Ka kimuhna a sau ahih manin ka thuhilhna kipatna ka mansuah hi.

records.english: Shall I ask the clinic for two slots in a row so that we only take one afternoon off?
records.zomi: Sun nung lam khat bek i tawl theih nadingin clinic kiangah a kizom hun nih ka ngen ding hiam?

records.english: The teacher arranged extra time for the student who had a hospital appointment during the exam.
records.zomi: Sitna lai-in damdawi inn kimuhna a nei sangnaupang adingin saya in hun beh a bawl sak hi.

records.english: Missing an appointment can mean waiting another month for the next one.
records.zomi: Kimuhna khat mansuah in a nungzui khat adingin kha khat beh ngak cihna ahi thei hi.

records.english: The university health centre was so busy that I waited two weeks for an appointment.
records.zomi: University cidamna office a buai lua ahih manin kimuhna khat adingin kal nih ka ngak hi.

records.english: The online system lets nurses book their own vaccination slots.
records.zomi: Online system in nurse te keimah tawh a vaccine hun uh a koih khol thei sak hi.

records.english: The hospital gave me a morning appointment, so I asked to work the late shift that day.
records.zomi: Damdawi inn in zingsang kimuhna hong pia ahih manin tua ni-in shift nunung pen sem dingin ka ngen hi.

records.english: Shift workers often struggle to get appointments that fit their hours.
records.zomi: Shift nasemte in a hun uh tawh a kilawm kimuhna ngah a haksa sa zel uh hi.

records.english: The head teacher asked staff to tell the office about any appointments in advance.
records.zomi: Sangpi saya in nasemte kiangah kimuhna khat peuh a om leh a ma-in office kiangah gen dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: Thank you for letting me go to my appointment during work hours.
records.zomi: Nasep hun sungin ka kimuhna-ah hong paisak manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Our team leader plans the rota around everyone's appointments.
records.zomi: I team makaipa in mi khempeuh' kimuhna te en-in nasep hun lai a ciamteh hi.

records.english: The appointment system at the factory clinic is simple: write your name on the list.
records.zomi: Factory clinic-a kimuhna dan a baih hi: ciamtehna tungah na min gelh in.

records.english: Who books the appointments for the new staff medicals?
records.zomi: Nasem thakte' cidamna enna adingin kimuhna te kua in a koih khol hiam?

records.english: The receptionist moved my appointment so that I wouldn't miss my exam.
records.zomi: Ka sitna ka mansuah loh nadingin receptionist in ka kimuhna a sawn hi.

records.english: My appointment letter arrived after the date, so I had to book again.
records.zomi: Ka kimuhna laikhak ni a bei khit ciangin a tung ahih manin kik-in ka koih khol kul hi.

records.english: We need to schedule the staff eye tests before the end of the month.
records.zomi: Kha a bei ma-in nasemte' mit enna te i ciamteh kul uh hi.

records.english: Please let the office know the date of your follow-up appointment.
records.zomi: Na kimuhna nungzui ni office kiangah hong theisak un.

records.english: Our school nurse keeps a list of pupils who need regular check-ups.
records.zomi: I sang nurse in cidamna enna tawntung a kul sangnaupangte' ciamtehna khat a kem hi.

records.english: The dental hygienist works late on Mondays for people who can't come during the day.
records.zomi: Ha siangsakna nasempa in sun lai-a hong theih lo mite adingin Pizing ni-in zan dong na a sem hi.

records.english: I'm afraid I need to leave the meeting early for an appointment.
records.zomi: Kimuhna khat adingin kikhopna pan a ma-in ka paisan kul ding hi, maisak in.

records.english: Why are all the evening appointments already booked?
records.zomi: Bang hangin nitak lam kimuhna khempeuh kikoih khol khin hiam?

records.english: Most people who work during the day want them, so they go first.
records.zomi: Sun lai-a na sem mi tamzaw in a deih uh ahih manin a masa-in a bei hi.

records.english: Our team keeps a shared calendar so that nobody books appointments on busy days.
records.zomi: Ni buai te-ah kuamah in kimuhna a koih khol loh nadingin i team in kihawm calendar khat a kem hi.

records.english: I asked the receptionist for an appointment that wouldn't clash with my exams.
records.zomi: Ka sitna te tawh a kituak lo kimuhna khat receptionist kiangah ka ngen hi.

records.english: The physiotherapist offers early-morning slots for people who work in offices.
records.zomi: Physiotherapist in office-a na sem mite adingin zingsang manlang hun te a pia hi.

records.english: My manager let me start late because of my hospital appointment.
records.zomi: Ka damdawi inn kimuhna hangin ka manager in phawng-in hong kipansak hi.

records.english: The dentist near our office opens early so that workers can come before their shifts.
records.zomi: I office kiang-a ha siavuan in nasemte a shift uh ma-in a hong theih nadingin a manlang-in a hong hi.

records.english: The occupational health nurse can see staff on Wednesday afternoons.
records.zomi: Nasepna cidamna nurse in Nilai ni sun nung lam-in nasemte a mu thei hi.

records.english: The clinic in the shopping centre is convenient for people who work nearby.
records.zomi: Sumbuk mun lian sung-a clinic pen a kiang-a na sem mite adingin a baih hi.

records.english: The company's doctor visits the factory every second Thursday.

records.english: It was only at the gathering that I realised how many teachers there are in our family.
records.zomi: I innkuan ah saya bangzah a om uh hiam cih kikhopna ciang bek-in ka thei hi.

records.english: Grandpa gave a speech about the jobs he had done in his life.
records.zomi: Pu in a nuntakna sungah a sep nasep te tawh kisai thu a gen hi.

records.english: Thank you for organising the reunion around everyone's work schedules.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh' nasep hun lai en-in innkuan kikhopna na vaihawm manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: We video-called my brother, who was on duty at the fire station.
records.zomi: Mei-sih inn-ah nasep a sep lai ka u pasal video call tawh i sam uh hi.

records.english: How did you manage to get everyone together this year?
records.zomi: Hih kum-in mi khempeuh bangci-in na kaikhawm thei hiam?

records.english: I chose the date three months ahead, so that everyone could ask for time off.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh in tawlngakna a ngen theih nadingun kha thum ma-in ni ka teel hi.

records.english: Who looks after the farm when you all go to the gathering?
records.zomi: Na khempeuh uh kikhopna-ah na pai ciangun lo kua in a kem hiam?

records.english: A neighbour feeds the animals, and we do the same for him in return.
records.zomi: Inn veng khat in ganhing te an a pia a, eite in zong amah adingin tua bang mahmah i bawl kik uh hi.

records.english: Grandpa, who was a carpenter, made the long table we eat at every year.
records.zomi: Singkhen siampa a hih ngei Pu in kum simin an i nekna taupi sau a bawl hi.

records.english: Will you be home for the family gathering on Sunday?
records.zomi: Nipini-a innkuan kikhopna adingin inn ah na om ding hiam?

records.english: Only after lunch, because I'm working the morning shift.
records.zomi: Sun an khit ciang bek, bang hang hiam cih leh zingsang shift ka sem hi.

records.english: Shall we hold the reunion after the harvest, when everyone has more time?
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh in hun tam zaw a neih ciangun gah lak khit ciangin innkuan kikhopna i bawl ding hiam?

records.english: My brother drove straight from his night shift to the family lunch.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal in a zan shift pan innkuan sun an ah a tawi tang hi.

records.english: Mum took a day off work to cook for the whole family.
records.zomi: Nu in innkuan bup adingin an huan dingin nasep pan ni khat a tawl hi.

records.english: Let's choose a date for the next gathering that works for everyone's jobs.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh' nasep tawh a kilawm kikhopna nungzui ni khat i teel ni.

records.english: Our gathering is always held during the school holidays so that the children can come.
records.zomi: Naupangte a hong theih nadingun i kikhopna sang tawlngakni lai-in a kibawl den hi.

records.english: The new teacher in our family was teased about her first week at school.
records.zomi: I innkuan-a saya thak a sang kal masa pen tawh kisai a kizawl hi.

records.english: Shall we celebrate your sister's new job at the weekend gathering?
records.zomi: Kal tawp kikhopna ah na u numei' nasep thak i lungdampih ding hiam?

records.english: My grandmother asked every teenager what they wanted to be when they grew up.
records.zomi: Ka pi in tangvalno khempeuh a khanglian ciangun bang suak a deih uh hiam cih a dong hi.

records.english: We held the family dinner on a Sunday so that nobody had to work.
records.zomi: Kuamah na a sep kul loh nadingin Nipini khat-in innkuan nitak an i nei uh hi.

records.english: The gathering was quieter this year because three cousins had just started university.
records.zomi: Sanggam thum university a kipan thak uh ahih manin hih kum-in kikhopna a dai zaw hi.

records.english: We sent a plate of food to my uncle, who was working at the hospital that evening.
records.zomi: Tua nitak-in damdawi inn-a na a sem ka pa neu adingin an kuang khat i khak uh hi.

records.english: Because my uncle runs a restaurant, the gathering is always at his place on a Monday, when it's closed.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu in restaurant khat a kalsuan ahih manin a kikhak Pizing ni-in a mun ah kikhopna a kibawl den hi.

records.english: My cousin's boss gave him the afternoon off when he heard it was his grandmother's ninetieth.
records.zomi: A pi' kum sawmkua suahni ahi hi, cih a zak ciangin ka sanggam' makaipa in sun nung lam tawlngakna a pia hi.

records.english: Did the younger cousins show their school prizes to the grandparents?
records.zomi: Sanggam neute in a sang letsong te uh a pu leh pi a lak uh hiam?

records.english: My uncle, who is a chef, cooked most of the food for the reunion.
records.zomi: An huanpa a hih ka pa neu in innkuan kikhopna-a an tamzaw a huan hi.

records.english: Our family gatherings help the young people understand the work their parents and grandparents did.
records.zomi: I innkuan kikhopna te in tangvalte a nu leh pa leh a pu leh pi' sep nasep te a theisiam sak hi.

records.english: Grandma asked each grandchild about their school results at the gathering.
records.zomi: Kikhopna ah Pi in tu khatciat a sang gah uh a dong hi.

records.english: The family gathering turned into a careers fair as the older cousins gave advice to the younger ones.
records.zomi: Sanggam upate in a neute thuhilhna a piak uh ciangin innkuan kikhopna nasep lampi kikhopna-in a kikhek hi.

records.english: My aunt brought her colleagues from the hospital to our family party.
records.zomi: Ka ni in damdawi inn pan a nasem pihte i innkuan poai ah a paipih hi.

records.english: Why did Uncle Thang miss the reunion?
records.zomi: Bang hangin pa neu Thang in innkuan kikhopna a mansuah hiam?

records.english: His company sent him abroad for a training course that week.
records.zomi: Tua kal-in a company in kisinsakna adingin gamdang-ah a sawl hi.

records.english: My brother brought his laptop to the gathering and worked in the corner, which annoyed Mum.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal in kikhopna ah a laptop a paipih a, ken lam-ah na a sem a, tua in Nu a hehsak hi.

records.english: My brother arrived in his work clothes, straight from the building site.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal inn lamna mun pan a nasep puan tawh a tang-in a tung hi.

records.english: We rearranged the gathering twice because of my sister's hospital shifts.
records.zomi: Ka u numei' damdawi inn shift te hangin kikhopna nihvei i koih kik uh hi.

records.english: Our gathering was planned around my cousin's exam timetable.
records.zomi: I kikhopna ka sanggam' sitna hun lai en-in kiciamteh hi.

records.english: My exams finished the day before the reunion, so I could finally relax.
records.zomi: Innkuan kikhopna ma ni-in ka sitna te a bei ahih manin a tawp-in ka tawlngak thei hi.

records.english: Can we move the gathering to Saturday?
records.zomi: Kikhopna Kiginni ah i sawn thei ding hiam?

records.english: No, because my exams finish on Friday and I need to rest.
records.zomi: Thei lo, bang hang hiam cih leh ka sitna te Laithai ni-in a bei a, ka tawlngak kul hi.

records.english: My cousin took photos for her school project on family history.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in innkuan tangthu tawh kisai a sang project adingin photo a la hi.

records.english: At the gathering, my aunt announced that she had been promoted.
records.zomi: Kikhopna ah ka ni in dinmun sang a ngah hi, cih a gen hi.

records.english: The teachers in our family always host the summer gathering, because they have long holidays.
records.zomi: I innkuan-a sayate in tawlngakni sau a neih manun khal kikhopna a bawl den uh hi.

records.english: The children performed a short play they had practised at school.
records.zomi: Naupangte in sang ah a kisin lam-en tomno khat a lak uh hi.

records.english: Working parents often find it hard to host big family gatherings.
records.zomi: Na sem nu leh pate in innkuan kikhopna lian bawl a haksa sa zel uh hi.

records.english: My sister asked her employer for a letter to bring to the appointment.
records.zomi: Ka u numei in kimuhna-ah paipih dingin a nasepsakpa kiangah lai khat a ngen hi.

records.english: Our appointment was for 9 in the morning, but we weren't seen until noon.
records.zomi: I kimuhna zingsang nai 9-in ahi a, ahi zongin sun lai dong hong mu nai kei uh hi.

records.english: Did you bring the copies of the children's birth certificates?
records.zomi: Naupangte' pianna lai copy te na paipih hiam?

records.english: Thank you for coming with us to the immigration office.
records.zomi: Gamdang mi office ah hong pai pih manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: What did the officer ask at your appointment?
records.zomi: Na kimuhna ah nasempa in bang a dong hiam?

records.english: Mostly about where we live and how long we plan to stay.
records.zomi: A tamzaw-in i teenna mun leh bangzah sawt i om ding hiam cih tawh kisai.

records.english: Do we need to bring photos of the whole family?
records.zomi: Innkuan bup' photo i paipih kul uh hiam?

records.english: Please keep the appointment letter safe, because the guard will ask to see it.
records.zomi: Kimuhna laikhak hoih takin kem un, bang hang hiam cih leh kongkhak ngakpa in a et nop ding hi.

records.english: Who has the folder with all our documents?
records.zomi: I lai khempeuh om folder kua in a nei hiam?

records.english: The officer was kind to my grandmother and spoke slowly so that she could understand.
records.zomi: Nasempa ka pi tungah a hehpih a, a theisiam theih nadingin zawi takin a pau hi.

records.english: We checked every document twice the night before the appointment.
records.zomi: Kimuhna ma zan-in lai khempeuh nihvei i en uh hi.

records.english: Mum still remembers every question the officer asked her at her first appointment.
records.zomi: A kimuhna masa pen-a nasempa in a dot dotna khempeuh Nu in a phawk lai hi.

records.english: My cousin booked the appointment online at midnight, when new slots appear.
records.zomi: Hun thakte a kilat zanlai-in ka sanggam in online-in kimuhna a koih khol hi.

records.english: My cousin's lawyer came to the appointment because her case was complicated.
records.zomi: A thu a buai ahih manin ka sanggam' thukham siam kimuhna-ah a hong hi.

records.english: Auntie Lun's appointment lasted three hours because the computer system kept failing.
records.zomi: Computer system a sia zel ahih manin Ni Lun' kimuhna nai thum a sau hi.

records.english: My sister cried with relief when her permit was renewed at the appointment.
records.zomi: Kimuhna ah a phalna a kithak ciangin ka u numei lungnuam takin a kap hi.

records.english: My husband's fingerprints were taken twice because the machine didn't work.
records.zomi: Khawl in na a sep loh manin ka pasal' khut ciamtehna nihvei kila hi.

records.english: My uncle forgot his passport at home and had to rebook his appointment.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu in a passport inn ah a mangngilh a, a kimuhna kik-in a koih khol kul hi.

records.english: Mum was so nervous that she couldn't eat breakfast before the appointment.
records.zomi: Nu a lau mahmah ahih manin kimuhna ma-in zingsang an a ne thei kei hi.

records.english: Our family has been to the immigration office so often that the guard knows our names.
records.zomi: I innkuan gamdang mi office ah tam vei mahmah a pai ahih manin kongkhak ngakpa in i min uh a thei hi.

records.english: Mum's appointment went smoothly because my sister had organised every paper in order.
records.zomi: Ka u numei in lai khempeuh a kizui-in a koih ahih manin Nu' kimuhna a nem takin a kalsuan hi.

records.english: Can the children draw in the waiting room while we fill in the forms?
records.zomi: Form te i dimsak lai-un naupangte in ngakna dan ah lim a lai thei uh hiam?

records.english: Dad practised his answers in front of the mirror the night before.
records.zomi: A ma zan-in Pa in mai-et mai-ah a dawnna te a kisin hi.

records.english: Families who help each other through immigration appointments often stay close for years.
records.zomi: Gamdang mi kimuhna te-ah khat leh khat a kihuh innkuante kum tampi sung a kinai zel uh hi.

records.english: After the appointment, we treated the children to ice cream for being so patient.
records.zomi: Kimuhna khit ciangin a thuakzawh mahmah manun naupangte ice cream i pia uh hi.

records.english: The volunteer from our church came with us because she knew the process well.
records.zomi: I pawlpi pan thalawp numei in a kalsuan dan a thei hoih ahih manin eite tawh a hong hi.

records.english: My parents have an appointment at the immigration office on Thursday.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in Laizing ni-in gamdang mi office ah kimuhna a nei uh hi.

records.english: Having waited months for the appointment, my parents arrived an hour early.
records.zomi: Kimuhna adingin kha tampi a ngak khit ciangun ka nu leh ka pa nai khat ma-in a tung uh hi.

records.english: Do the children need to come to the appointment too?
records.zomi: Naupangte zong kimuhna-ah a hong kul uh hiam?

records.english: Yes, because they have to give their fingerprints as well.
records.zomi: Kul hi, bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in zong a khut ciamtehna uh a pia kul uh hi.

records.english: Not until the officer stamped the passports did we let ourselves relax.
records.zomi: Nasempa in passport te stamp a bawl mateng i kinuamsak kei uh hi.

records.english: My grandparents' appointment was in a building with no lift, so a guard carried Grandpa's bag upstairs.
records.zomi: Ka pu leh pi' kimuhna lift om lo inn khat ah ahih manin kongkhak ngakpa in Pu' ip inntung ah a puak hi.

records.english: Bringing an interpreter made my grandmother's appointment much less stressful.
records.zomi: Pau letpa khat paipih in ka pi' kimuhna a lungkham huai lo zaw mahmah sak hi.

records.english: We practised the officer's likely questions with Grandpa the evening before.
records.zomi: A ma nitak-in nasempa' a dot thei ding dotna te Pu tawh i kisin uh hi.

records.english: Our family's new permits were ready to collect two weeks after the appointment.
records.zomi: Kimuhna khit kal nih-in i innkuan' phalna thakte lak dingin a kiging khin hi.

records.english: Dad wore his best shirt to the appointment, as if it were a job interview.
records.zomi: Pa in nasep interview bang-in kimuhna ah a puan-ak hoih pen a silh hi.

records.english: My cousin was told to bring her marriage certificate to the next appointment.
records.zomi: Kimuhna nungzui-ah a kiteenna lai-ciam paipih dingin ka sanggam kigen hi.

records.english: Was the waiting room full of families with small children again?
records.zomi: Ngakna dan naupang neute tawh innkuante tawh a dim kik hiam?

records.english: Did your uncle take the whole day off work for his appointment?
records.zomi: Na pa neu in a kimuhna adingin nasep pan ni bup a tawl hiam?

records.english: Why was our appointment moved to next month?
records.zomi: Bang hangin i kimuhna kha hong tung ding ah a kisawn hiam?

records.english: The office said a document from the embassy hadn't arrived yet.
records.zomi: Embassy pan lai khat a tung nai kei hi, ci-in office in a gen hi.

records.english: My brother translated for our parents at their appointment.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal in ka nu leh ka pa' kimuhna-ah amaute adingin a let sak hi.

records.english: The children were very patient during the long wait at the office.
records.zomi: Office-a ngakna sau sungin naupangte a thuakzawh mahmah uh hi.

records.english: Our son was born while we were waiting for my residence appointment, so we had to add him to the forms.
records.zomi: Ka teenna phalna kimuhna i ngak lai-un i tapa a suak ahih manin form te ah amah i behlap kul uh hi.

records.english: The officer asked my father how long he had worked for his company.
records.zomi: Nasempa in ka pa kiangah a company adingin bangzah sawt na a sem khin hiam cih a dong hi.

records.english: When the officer said everything was in order, my mother finally smiled.
records.zomi: Nasempa in bangkim a kizui hi, a ci ciangin ka nu a tawp-in a nui hi.

records.english: Each of the older children had to sign their own form.
records.zomi: Naupang upa khatciat in amah form a signature kul hi.

records.english: We had to go back a second time because one form was missing a signature.
records.zomi: Form khat ah signature a om loh manin nihvei i pai kik kul uh hi.

records.english: My brother's appointment clashed with his exam, so he asked to change it.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal' kimuhna a sitna tawh a kituak ahih manin a khek dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: Shall we take the early bus so that we're not late for the appointment?
records.zomi: Kimuhna ah i phawng loh nadingin zingsang manlang bus i la ding hiam?

records.english: The officer explained that the decision could take up to three months.
records.zomi: Thukhensatna in kha thum dong a la thei hi, ci-in nasempa in a gen hi.

records.english: We waited outside in the rain because the office opened late.
records.zomi: Office a phawng-in a kihon manin pualam-ah guah sungah i ngak uh hi.

records.english: Dad keeps every appointment letter from the immigration office in a box.
records.zomi: Pa in gamdang mi office pan kimuhna laikhak khempeuh bawm khat sungah a kem hi.

records.english: How did your brother's appointment go?
records.zomi: Na u pasal' kimuhna bangci-in a kalsuan hiam?

records.english: Better than he feared, and his permit was renewed on the spot.
records.zomi: A lauh sangin a hoih zaw a, a phalna mun mahmah-ah a kithak hi.

records.english: Why did your parents arrive so early that the office wasn't even open?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na nu leh na pa office a kihon nai lo dong a manlang mahmah-in a tung uh hiam?

records.english: We were relieved when the officer told us the decision would come by post.
records.zomi: Thukhensatna laikhak tawh hong tung ding hi, ci-in nasempa in hong gen ciangin i lungnuam uh hi.

records.english: Who's coming with Grandma to her immigration appointment?
records.zomi: Pi' gamdang mi kimuhna-ah kua in a paipih ding hiam?

records.english: I am, because she'll need someone to translate.
records.zomi: Kei, bang hang hiam cih leh amah adingin a let sakpa khat a kul ding hi.

records.english: My wife's appointment was moved to a different office across town.
records.zomi: Ka zi' kimuhna khuapi dang lam-a office tuam khat ah a kisawn hi.

records.english: Residents have the right to ask why decisions about their area are made.
records.zomi: Teng mite in a mun uh tawh kisai thukhensatna te bang hangin kibawl hiam cih dot thuneihna a nei uh hi.

records.english: Is there a reason the health centre doesn't open on Saturdays?
records.zomi: Kiginni-in cidamna office a kihon loh hang khat a om hiam?

records.english: Why is the pharmacy so busy on Monday mornings?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pizing ni zingsang-in damdawi zuakna a buai mahmah hiam?

records.english: Could you tell me why the swimming pool is closed this week?
records.zomi: Bang hangin hih kal-in tuipeek mun a kikhak hiam cih hong gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: The pool is being cleaned, and the changing rooms are being repaired.
records.zomi: Tuipeek mun kisiangsak a, puan khekna inndan te kibawl kik hi.

records.english: What's the reason for the new speed limit near the hospital?
records.zomi: Damdawi inn kiang-a manlanna thukhun thak' a hang bang hiam?

records.english: Why is there no doctor at the clinic on Wednesday afternoons?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Nilai ni sun nung lam-in clinic ah siavuan om lo hiam?

records.english: What's behind the long queues at the post office this week?
records.zomi: Hih kal-in post office-a kigual sau te' a hang bang hiam?

records.english: Why has the town's only cinema closed?
records.zomi: Bang hangin khuapi' cinema khat bek a kikhak hiam?

records.english: When the reasons for a change are explained clearly, most people accept it.
records.zomi: Kikhekna khat' a hang te tak takin kigen ciangin mi tamzaw in a sang uh hi.

records.english: Is there a reason why the playground gate is always locked?
records.zomi: Naupang kimawlna mun kongkhak a kikhak den hang khat a om hiam?

records.english: May I ask why my application for a parking permit was refused?
records.zomi: Mawtaw khawlna phalna adingin ka ngetna bang hangin a kinial hiam cih ka dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: Why do we need a permit for the street party?
records.zomi: Bang hangin lampi poai adingin phalna i kul uh hiam?

records.english: Could you give me a reason I can pass on to the other residents?
records.zomi: Teng mi dangte kiangah ka gen kik theih ding a hang khat hong pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Why has the market moved to Thursdays?
records.zomi: Bang hangin sumbuk mun Laizing ni ah a kisawn hiam?

records.english: Is there a good reason for the noise from the building site at night?
records.zomi: Zan-in inn lamna mun pan ging adingin a hang hoih khat a om hiam?

records.english: Why did the bank close the branch in our village?
records.zomi: Bang hangin bank in i khua sung-a branch a khak hiam?

records.english: Can you explain why the swimming lessons for children are so expensive?
records.zomi: Bang hangin naupangte' tuipeek sinna te a man sang mahmah hiam cih na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Why did the dentist cancel my appointment?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ha siavuan in ka kimuhna a phiat hiam?

records.english: Do you mind explaining why the library no longer sells second-hand books?
records.zomi: Bang hangin laibu inn in laibu kizangsa a zuak nawn kei hiam cih na gen leh na lungkham ding hiam?

records.english: Can you tell me why the street lights are off on our road?
records.zomi: Bang hangin i lampi tungah lampi meivak te a mit hiam cih hong gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Could someone explain why the youth club is closing?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tangvalte' kipawlna a kikhak ding hiam cih kuamah in a gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: May I ask why the clinic stopped taking walk-in patients?
records.zomi: Bang hangin clinic in kimuhna om lo cinate a sang khawl hiam cih ka dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: Too many people were waiting for hours, so an appointment system seemed fairer.
records.zomi: Mi tampi nai tampi a ngak uh ahih manin kimuhna dan khat a dik zaw bang-in a kilang hi.

records.english: What's the reason for closing the post office on Saturdays?
records.zomi: Kiginni-in post office khak' a hang bang hiam?

records.english: I'd like to know the reason for the delay in repairing the bridge.
records.zomi: Lei bawlkikna-a phawngna' a hang ka theih nop hi.

records.english: Without a clear reason, residents feel that their concerns are being ignored.
records.zomi: A hang tak om lo-in teng mite in a lungkhamna uh kilimsak lo hi, ci-in a kisa uh hi.

records.english: Could the officer tell us why the road was closed so suddenly?
records.zomi: Bang hangin lampi a kikhak bulh hiam cih nasempa in hong gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: I'm writing to ask why the bins on our street weren't emptied last week.
records.zomi: Bang hangin kal bei-in i lampi tunga eek bawm te sung a kila kei hiam cih dot dingin lai ka gelh hi.

records.english: What made the housing office change its opening hours?
records.zomi: Bang in inn office' kihonna hun a khek sak hiam?

records.english: Was there a reason the ambulance took so long last night?
records.zomi: Zan-in ambulance a sawt mahmah hang khat a om hiam?

records.english: Could you tell me why my child wasn't given a place at the nearest school?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ka ta a kiang pen sang ah mun a kipia kei hiam cih hong gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: What's the reason for the new parking charges?
records.zomi: Mawtaw khawlna man thak' a hang bang hiam?

records.english: The council says the money will pay for repairs to the car park.
records.zomi: Sum te mawtaw khawlna mun bawlkikna adingin kizang ding hi, ci-in council in a gen hi.

records.english: Could you explain why the water bill is so much higher this month?
records.zomi: Bang hangin hih kha-in tui man a sang mahmah zaw hiam cih na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: What reasons did the council give for refusing the new bakery?
records.zomi: Moh zuakna thak nial nadingin council in bang hang te a gen hiam?

records.english: Is there a reason the bus no longer stops at the market?
records.zomi: Bus sumbuk mun ah a khawl nawn loh hang khat a om hiam?

records.english: The road there is too narrow for the new buses.
records.zomi: Tua-a lampi bus thakte adingin a neu lua hi.

records.english: Why was my parcel sent back to the depot?
