records.zomi: Ka liamna a lauhuai kei hi, ci-in siavuan in a gen ciangin ka makaipa a lungnuam hi.

records.english: My manager asked me to bring a letter from the doctor about my injury.
records.zomi: Ka manager in ka liamna tawh kisai siavuan pan lai khat paipih dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: I explained that my back pain started when I began lifting boxes at work.
records.zomi: Nasepna-ah bawm ka dawn kipat ciangin ka nungzang natna a kipan hi, ci-in ka gen hi.

records.english: Shall I ask the doctor about a letter for your school?
records.zomi: Na sang adingin lai khat siavuan ka dong ding hiam?

records.english: I didn't want to admit how tired I was, but the doctor guessed anyway.
records.zomi: Ka gim mahmah cih pulak ka deih kei a, ahi zongin siavuan in a thei hi.

records.english: The doctor asked me to keep a diary of my symptoms during the working week.
records.zomi: Nasep kal sungin ka natna lim te diary sungah ciamteh dingin siavuan in hong ngen hi.

records.english: The pharmacist told me to ask my doctor before mixing the two medicines.
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakpa in damdawi nih ka kigawm ma-in ka siavuan dong dingin hong gen hi.

records.english: My colleague went with me to the doctor because I was too nervous to go alone.
records.zomi: Keimah bek-in pai dingin ka lau lua ahih manin ka nasem pih kei tawh siavuan kiangah a pai hi.

records.english: I'm a teacher, so I need my voice to work properly.
records.zomi: Saya ka hih manin ka aw hoih takin a nasep ka kul hi.

records.english: The doctor said I could return to work, but only on lighter tasks.
records.zomi: Nasepna-ah ka kik thei hi, ci-in siavuan in a gen a, ahi zongin nasep zang zaw te bek.

records.english: The doctor's questions about my job helped her understand my symptoms.
records.zomi: Ka nasep tawh kisai siavuan' dotna te in ka natna lim a theisiam sak hi.

records.english: When can I start teaching again after the operation?
records.zomi: Zatui khit ciangin bang hun-in sinsak ka kipan kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: After two weeks, if your voice has fully recovered.
records.zomi: Kal nih khit ciangin, na aw a dam kim khin leh.

records.english: I told the doctor that my eyes hurt after long days at the computer.
records.zomi: Computer mai-ah ni sau khit ciangin ka mit a na hi, ci-in siavuan kiangah ka gen hi.

records.english: The doctor asked what kind of work I do.
records.zomi: Siavuan in bang nasep ka sem hiam cih a dong hi.

records.english: Can I still drive the delivery van while I'm taking these tablets?
records.zomi: Hih damdawi te ka nek lai-in van khak mawtaw ka tawl thei lai ding hiam?

records.english: The doctor advised me to change jobs if the dust kept affecting my breathing.
records.zomi: Leivui in ka huih dawnna a khoih lai leh nasep khek dingin siavuan in hong hilh hi.

records.english: The company doctor checked my hearing because the factory is so noisy.
records.zomi: Factory a ging mahmah ahih manin company siavuan in ka bil zakna a en hi.

records.english: The doctor said that the night shifts were probably affecting my sleep.
records.zomi: Zan shift te in ka ihmut a khoih kha ding hi, ci-in siavuan in a gen hi.

records.english: Should I mention that I work with animals?
records.zomi: Ganhing te tawh na ka sem cih ka gen ding hiam?

records.english: Should I tell the doctor that I work night shifts?
records.zomi: Zan shift ka sem cih siavuan kiangah ka gen ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, because it might explain why you're sleeping so badly.
records.zomi: Gen in, bang hang hiam cih leh bang hangin na ihmut a hoih lo mahmah hiam cih a gen thei kha hi.

records.english: Please speak slowly, Doctor, because I'm still learning the language.
records.zomi: Siavuan aw, zawi takin pau in, bang hang hiam cih leh pau ka sin lai hi.

records.english: The school nurse told the doctor about the pupil's fainting during PE.
records.zomi: Sang nurse in PE lai-a sangnaupang' kipukna tawh kisai siavuan kiangah a gen hi.

records.english: Can I have a copy of the report for my employer?
records.zomi: Ka nasepsakpa adingin report copy khat ka ngah thei ding hiam?

records.english: Your clear explanation made me much less worried, Doctor.
records.zomi: Siavuan aw, na gen tak in hong lungkham tawm zaw mahmah sak hi.

records.english: I asked whether I could work part-time while I recovered.
records.zomi: Ka dam kik lai-in hun khenkhat na ka sem thei hiam cih ka dong hi.

records.english: The nurse explained what the doctor would ask, so that I could prepare.
records.zomi: Ka kiginkholh theih nadingin siavuan in bang a dot ding hiam cih nurse in a gen hi.

records.english: The doctor asked whether anyone else at work had the same symptoms.
records.zomi: Nasepna-ah mi dang khat peuh in natna lim kibang a nei hiam cih siavuan in a dong hi.

records.english: I wondered whether the chemicals at work were making me cough, so I asked the doctor.
records.zomi: Nasepna-a zatui hat te in hong khuksak hiam cih ka ngaihsun ahih manin siavuan ka dong hi.

records.english: What should I tell my manager about my condition?
records.zomi: Ka cidamna dinmun tawh kisai ka manager kiangah bang ka gen ding hiam?

records.english: Only what you're comfortable sharing, and that you may need regular breaks.
records.zomi: Na hawm nuam zah bek, leh tawlngakna tawntung na kul kha hi, cih.

records.english: The nurse told me to ask the doctor about the rash on my arms.
records.zomi: Ka ban tunga vun puakna tawh kisai siavuan dong dingin nurse in hong gen hi.

records.english: The results were explained to me in words I could understand.
records.zomi: Gah te ka theisiam theih kammal te-in hong gen uh hi.

records.english: Before the appointment, I made a list of everything that hurts at the end of the day.
records.zomi: Kimuhna ma-in ni tawp ciangin a na khempeuh ka ciamteh hi.

records.english: The doctor said that my headaches might be caused by stress at work.
records.zomi: Ka lu natna te nasepna-a lungkhamna hangin a piang kha ding hi, ci-in siavuan in a gen hi.

records.english: Do I need to tell my school about the new medicine?
records.zomi: Damdawi thak tawh kisai ka sang kiangah ka gen kul hiam?

records.english: The doctor reminded me that my health matters more than any deadline.
records.zomi: Ka cidamna pen hun tawp khat peuh sangin a thupi zaw hi, ci-in siavuan in hong phawksak hi.

records.english: Doctor, will this medicine make me sleepy at work?
records.zomi: Siavuan aw, hih damdawi in nasepna-ah hong ihmut sak ding hiam?

records.english: I recorded the doctor's advice on my phone so that I could explain it to my manager.
records.zomi: Ka manager kiangah ka gen theih nadingin siavuan' thuhilhna ka phone tungah ka khum hi.

records.english: Is it all right to exercise during my lunch break with this knee?
records.zomi: Hih khuk tawh ka sun an tawlngak hun-in cidamna kisinna ka bawl leh a hoih hiam?

records.english: Could you tell my employer how long I need to rest?
records.zomi: Bangzah sawt ka tawlngak kul hiam cih ka nasepsakpa kiangah na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: I told the doctor honestly that I had been working sixty hours a week.
records.zomi: Kal khat-in nai sawmguk na ka sem hi, ci-in siavuan kiangah thuman takin ka gen hi.

records.english: Could you spell the name of the new medicine for me?
records.zomi: Damdawi thak' min hong gelh sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Can you give me a note for my employer?
records.zomi: Ka nasepsakpa adingin lai khat hong pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, I'll write that you need a week off to rest.
records.zomi: Thei hi, tawlngak dingin kal khat na kul hi, ci-in ka gelh ding hi.

records.english: I asked the doctor to explain the medical words on my sick note.
records.zomi: Ka cina lai tunga damdawi kammal te gen dingin siavuan ka ngen hi.

records.english: The school doctor asked my son whether he could see the board clearly.
records.zomi: Sang siavuan in ka tapa kiangah board tak takin a mu thei hiam cih a dong hi.

records.english: The trainee nurse watched how the doctor spoke gently to frightened patients.
records.zomi: Kisin nurse in siavuan in a lau cinate tungah nem takin bangci-in a pau hiam cih a en hi.

records.english: The doctor recommended a short break from teaching to rest my throat.
records.zomi: Ka dang tawlngak nadingin sinsakna pan hun tom tawlngak dingin siavuan in hong ngen hi.

records.english: The doctor gave me exercises to do at my desk to protect my wrists.
records.zomi: Ka khut ngawng te ken nadingin ka taupi-ah ka bawl ding kisinna te siavuan in hong pia hi.

records.english: The occupational doctor asked me to describe a normal working day.
records.zomi: Nasepna siavuan in ka nasep ni tavuan khat gen dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: The student was embarrassed to tell the doctor about his stress before exams.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang in sitna ma-a a lungkhamna tawh kisai siavuan kiangah gen dingin a zum hi.

records.english: After school, I help the old man next door carry water up the stairs.
records.zomi: Sang khit ciangin ka kiang-a teng pu upa kahlei tungah tui puak dingin ka huh hi.

records.english: The teenager next door helps my grandmother with her online shopping.
records.zomi: I kiang-a teng tangvalno in ka pi a online van leina-ah a huh hi.

records.english: The retired engineer next door helped my son build his science project.
records.zomi: I kiang-a teng a tawlngak engineer in ka tapa a science project lam dingin a huh hi.

records.english: Can you help Mr. Lal with his computer after school?
records.zomi: Sang khit ciangin Pu Lal a computer tawh na huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, I'll go round as soon as I've finished my homework.
records.zomi: Thei hi, ka inn nasep ka zawh pah ciangin ka pai ding hi.

records.english: Mum translated the school letters for the new family next door.
records.zomi: Nu in kiang-a teng innkuan thak adingin sang laikhak te a let sak hi.

records.english: When my father lost his job, our neighbours told him about every vacancy they heard of.
records.zomi: Ka pa nasep a mansuah ciangin i inn vengte in a zak uh nasep awng khempeuh a gen uh hi.

records.english: Doesn't our neighbour take in everyone's parcels because she works from home?
records.zomi: I inn veng in inn pan na a sep manin mi khempeuh' van-ip a la sak hi lo maw?

records.english: Shall I ask our neighbour, the accountant, to look at your tax form?
records.zomi: Na siah form en dingin i inn veng sum ciamtehpa ka ngen ding hiam?

records.english: Our neighbour's son, who works at the bank, explained our mortgage letter to us.
records.zomi: Bank-a na sem i inn veng' tapa in i inn leina sum laikhak hong gen hi.

records.english: We collected our neighbour's children from school when she was stuck at work.
records.zomi: Nasepna-ah a khawl kul lai-in i inn veng' tate sang pan i la uh hi.

records.english: The builder next door showed my father how to fix the roof himself.
records.zomi: Kiang-a teng inn lampa in ka pa keimah in inn tungkhuh bangci-in bawl ding hiam cih a lak hi.

records.english: Our neighbour's daughter, who studies law, helped my parents understand their contract.
records.zomi: Thukham a sin i inn veng' tanu in ka nu leh ka pa a contract uh a theisiam nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Did our neighbour really lend you his laptop before your exams?
records.zomi: Na sitna ma-in i inn veng in a laptop hong pukip taktak hiam?

records.english: The nurse who lives next door showed us how to use Grandma's new inhaler.
records.zomi: Kiang-a teng nurse in Pi' inhaler thak bangci-in zang ding hiam cih hong lak hi.

records.english: Who's going to feed the neighbours' cat while they're away on a work trip?
records.zomi: Nasep khualzinna-ah a pai lai-un inn vengte' zawhngeu kua in an a pia ding hiam?

records.english: Helping neighbours with their homework taught my daughter that she wanted to be a teacher.
records.zomi: Inn vengte a inn nasep uh huh in ka tanu saya suak a deih hi, cih hong sinsak hi.

records.english: Our neighbour wrote a reference for my sister's job application.
records.zomi: I inn veng in ka u numei' nasep ngetna adingin kipsakna lai khat a gelh hi.

records.english: Our son cuts the hedge for the elderly couple and refuses to take any money.
records.zomi: I tapa in pu leh pi upa nih adingin huang a at a, sum la nuam lo hi.

records.english: The firefighter who lives on our street taught the children about smoke alarms.
records.zomi: I lampi tunga teng mei-sih nasempa in naupangte meikhu alarm tawh kisai a sinsak hi.

records.english: The man downstairs, a mechanic, kept our old car running for years.
records.zomi: Nuai lam-a teng mawtaw bawlpa in kum tampi sung i mawtaw lui a pai sak hi.

records.english: Mum's colleague lives next door, so they walk to the hospital together.
records.zomi: Nu' nasem pih kiang-ah a teng ahih manin damdawi inn ah khe-in a pai khawm uh hi.

records.english: Why did the nurse from next door come over last night?
records.zomi: Bang hangin zan-in kiang-a teng nurse a hong hiam?

records.english: Grandpa was feeling dizzy, and she checked his blood pressure.
records.zomi: Pu a lu a vei ahih manin a sisan nawtna a en hi.

records.english: Could your son help my daughter with her science project?
records.zomi: Na tapa in ka tanu a science project-ah a huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: He'd be happy to, since he studied the same topic last year.
records.zomi: A nuam sa ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh kum bei-in thu kibang a sin hi.

records.english: Our neighbour, a retired teacher, helps the children on our street with their reading.
records.zomi: Saya a hih ngei i inn veng in i lampi tunga naupangte laisimna-ah a huh hi.

records.english: Helping a neighbour can also teach you skills for your own job.
records.zomi: Inn veng huh in na nasep adingin siamna zong hong sinsak thei hi.

records.english: The teacher who lives next door helped my cousin prepare for her interview.
records.zomi: Kiang-a teng saya in ka sanggam a interview adingin kiginkholh dingin a huh hi.

records.english: My aunt cooks for the night-shift workers in our building.
records.zomi: Ka ni in i inn sung-a zan shift nasemte adingin an a huan hi.

records.english: Could the student next door walk our dog when we work late?
records.zomi: Zan dong na i sep ciangin kiang-a teng sangnaupang in i ui a paipih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Who fixed the neighbour's broken fence?
records.zomi: Inn veng' huang kitam kua in a bawl kik hiam?

records.english: My brother, who's training to be a carpenter, did it after work.
records.zomi: Singkhen siampa suak dingin a kisin ka u pasal in nasep khit ciangin a bawl hi.

records.english: The shopkeeper on the corner keeps spare keys for half the street.
records.zomi: Ken lam-a sumbuk neipa in lampi kim' tawh beh a kem hi.

records.english: My brother tutors the neighbours' son in maths in exchange for help with his car.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal in a mawtaw huhna kikhek-in inn vengte' tapa maths a sinsak hi.

records.english: Our neighbour, a doctor, came round in the middle of the night when the baby had a fever.
records.zomi: Naungek a cisa ciangin siavuan i inn veng zanlai-in a hong hi.

records.english: The neighbours' son brought us soup when my wife was too tired after her night shift.
records.zomi: Ka zi a zan shift khit ciangin a gim lua lai-in inn vengte' tapa in an tui hong paipih hi.

records.english: When I was studying for exams, the family upstairs kept their music quiet.
records.zomi: Sitna adingin ka kisin lai-in a tung lam-a innkuan in a la uh dai takin a kem uh hi.

records.english: Can you ask the neighbour to sign for my parcel while I'm at work?
records.zomi: Nasepna-ah ka om lai-in ka van-ip adingin signature dingin inn veng na ngen thei ding hiam?

records.english: My uncle, who is a plumber, repaired the leaking pipe for the family across the road.
records.zomi: Tui khau bawlpa a hih ka pa neu in lampi dang lam-a innkuan' tui khau zuak a bawl kik hi.

records.english: Did the neighbour's daughter get the job she applied for?
records.zomi: Inn veng' tanu in a ngetsa nasep a ngah hiam?

records.english: Our neighbour, a tailor, shortened my school trousers the night before term began.
records.zomi: Puan khui siampa i inn veng in term a kipat ma zan-in ka sang pantaw a tomsak hi.

records.english: Mum looks after the neighbours' baby while they're at work.
records.zomi: Inn vengte nasepna-ah a om lai-un Nu in a naungek uh a kem hi.

records.english: Grandpa taught the boy next door to repair bicycles, and now he has his own shop.
records.zomi: Pu in kiang-a teng tangvalno siiksakol bawlkik a sinsak a, tu-in amah sumbuk a nei hi.

records.english: How did you find your first job?
records.zomi: Na nasep masa pen bangci-in na ngah hiam?

records.english: Our neighbour told me that the bakery on the corner needed someone on Saturdays.
records.zomi: Ken lam-a moh zuakna in Kiginni-in mi khat a kul hi, ci-in i inn veng in hong gen hi.

records.english: The students next door painted our elderly neighbour's fence during their holidays.
records.zomi: Kiang-a teng sangnaupangte in a tawlngakni lai-un i inn veng upa' huang a zum uh hi.

records.english: Could you water our plants while we're at the conference next week?
records.zomi: Kal hong tung ding-a conference ah i om lai-un i singno te tui na pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our neighbour gave my brother his first job in his garage.
records.zomi: I inn veng in ka u pasal a garage ah a nasep masa pen a pia hi.

records.english: Thank you for helping my son with his job application.
records.zomi: Ka tapa a nasep ngetna-ah na huh manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Our neighbour's bakery gives the street its leftover bread every evening.
records.zomi: I inn veng' moh zuakna in nitak simin a taang moh te lampi kiangah a pia hi.

records.english: Working long hours, my parents relied on our neighbours more than they liked to admit.
records.zomi: Nai sau na a sep manin ka nu leh ka pa in a pulak nop sangin i inn vengte tungah a kinga zaw uh hi.

records.english: Our neighbours organised a rota to drive my mother to her treatment while we were at work.
records.zomi: Nasepna-ah i om lai-un ka nu a damsakna-ah tawipih dingin i inn vengte in hun kikhekna khat a vaihawm uh hi.

records.english: Do the children on our street still help the shopkeeper unpack deliveries?
records.zomi: I lampi tunga naupangte in sumbuk neipa van hong tung te a hon sak lai uh hiam?

records.english: Our neighbour, a nurse, checks on Grandpa every evening after her shift.
records.zomi: Nurse i inn veng in a shift khit ciangin nitak simin Pu a en hi.

records.english: The neighbour's daughter babysits for us when we both have meetings.
records.zomi: I nih kikhopna i neih ciangin inn veng' tanu in i naupangte a kem sak hi.

records.english: Our street has a list of who can help with what, from computers to cooking.
records.zomi: I lampi in computer pan an huan dong kua in bang a huh thei hiam cih ciamtehna khat a nei hi.

records.english: When my sister started her first job, our neighbour drove her to the station every morning.
records.zomi: Ka u numei a nasep masa pen a kipat ciangin i inn veng in zingsang simin station ah a tawipih hi.

records.english: Dad, an electrician, fixed the lights in the old lady's flat for free.
records.zomi: Electrician a hih Pa in nu upa' inn sung-a meivak te man om lo-in a bawl kik hi.

records.english: My brother repaired the neighbour's washing machine as practice for his apprenticeship.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal in a khutsiam kisinna adingin kisinna-in inn veng' puan silna khawl a bawl kik hi.

records.english: The fire service explained why it was moving the station closer to the motorway.
records.zomi: Mei-sih nasepna in bang hangin station motorway kiang zaw-ah a sawn hiam cih a gen hi.

records.english: The library explained that it had stopped the late fines to encourage more children to visit.
records.zomi: Naupang tam zaw hong veh nadingin phawng sum lepna a khawl hi, ci-in laibu inn in a gen hi.

records.english: Thank you for explaining the decision so clearly at the meeting.
records.zomi: Kikhopna ah thukhensatna tak takin na gen manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: The town decided to hold the festival in the park this year because the square was too small.
records.zomi: Khuapi laizang a neu lua ahih manin hih kum-in khuapi in park sungah pawi bawl dingin a khensat hi.

records.english: The hospital decided to stop visiting after eight in the evening to let patients rest.
records.zomi: Cinate a tawlngak theih nadingin nitak nai 8 khit ciangin veh khak dingin damdawi inn in a khensat hi.

records.english: The library has decided to open later on Sundays.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in Nipini-in a phawng zaw-in hong dingin a khensat hi.

records.english: We decided as a community to save the old bakery from being closed.
records.zomi: Moh zuakna lui a kikhak loh nadingin khuasung-in i khensat uh hi.

records.english: Why did they decide to paint the bridge green?
records.zomi: Bang hangin lei eng-in zum dingin a khensat uh hiam?

records.english: The council's decision to cut the bus service caused anger in the villages.
records.zomi: Bus nasepna kiamsak ding council' thukhensatna in khua te-ah hehna a piangsak hi.

records.english: Why has the library started charging for printing?
records.zomi: Bang hangin laibu inn in print adingin man a la kipan hiam?

records.english: The free service cost too much, and the money now pays for new books.
records.zomi: Man om lo nasepna sum tam lua a bei sak ahih manin tu-in sum in laibu thak te man a pia hi.

records.english: The museum decided to make entry free on Sundays for local families.
records.zomi: Museum in mun-a innkuante adingin Nipini-in lut man om lo dingin a khensat hi.

records.english: The community centre decided to share its kitchen with the food bank.
records.zomi: Khuasung inn lian in a an huanna inn an huhna mun tawh hawm dingin a khensat hi.

records.english: Why was the decision about the new school delayed again?
records.zomi: Bang hangin sang thak tawh kisai thukhensatna kik-in a phawng hiam?

records.english: The police explained their decision to close the road during the festival.
records.zomi: Pawi lai-in lampi khak nading a thukhensatna uh police te in a gen uh hi.

records.english: The council decided to plant trees instead of building a car park.
records.zomi: Council in mawtaw khawlna mun lam sang-in singkung suan dingin a khensat hi.

records.english: Why did the council choose that company to collect the rubbish?
records.zomi: Bang hangin council in eek la dingin tua company a teel hiam?

records.english: Why did the council decide to close the swimming pool on Mondays?
records.zomi: Bang hangin council in Pizing ni-in tuipeek mun khak dingin a khensat hiam?

records.english: Very few people came on Mondays, so closing saved money for longer weekend hours.
records.zomi: Pizing ni-in mi tawm mahmah a hong uh ahih manin khak in kal tawp nai sau zaw adingin sum a khol hi.

records.english: The residents' committee decided to spend the money on new street lights.
records.zomi: Teng mite' committee in sum te lampi meivak thak adingin zat dingin a khensat hi.

records.english: The school published its reasons for changing the uniform on its website.
records.zomi: Sang in uniform khekna a hang te a website tungah a suaksak hi.

records.english: Could you tell us how the committee made its decision?
records.zomi: Committee in a thukhensatna bangci-in a bawl hiam cih hong gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Why was the bus route changed?
records.zomi: Bang hangin bus lampi a kikhek hiam?

records.english: The old route was too slow, and most passengers wanted to reach the hospital directly.
records.zomi: Lampi lui a zawi lua a, khualzin tamzaw in damdawi inn ah a tang-in tun a deih uh hi.

records.english: The head teacher explained that the school day would start later so that children could sleep more.
records.zomi: Naupangte a ihmut tam zaw nadingin sang ni a phawng zaw-in a kipan ding hi, ci-in sangpi saya in a gen hi.

records.english: Why did the hospital decide to move the maternity ward?
records.zomi: Bang hangin damdawi inn in naungek suahna ward sawn dingin a khensat hiam?

records.english: The decision was unpopular, but the officer explained it patiently to every caller.

records.english: Who taught your son to play chess?
records.zomi: Na tapa chess kimawl kua in a sinsak hiam?

records.english: My children learned our village songs from their great-grandmother.
records.zomi: Ka tate in i khua la te a pu-pi' nu pan a sin uh hi.

records.english: Thank you for spending so much time with my children, Grandpa.
records.zomi: Pu aw, ka tate tawh hun tampi na zat manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Our family's elders and children eat at the same table, which isn't true in every family.
records.zomi: I innkuan-a upate leh naupangte taupi kibang tungah an a ne uh a, tua innkuan khempeuh ah a om kei hi.

records.english: When my grandparents argue, my children are the best peacemakers.
records.zomi: Ka pu leh pi a kiniam ciangun ka tate kilemsak siam pen ahi uh hi.

records.english: Grandma knits jumpers for every great-grandchild, even the ones abroad.
records.zomi: Pi in tu' ta khatciat, gamdang-a om te zong, adingin puan-ak a zial hi.

records.english: Grandma's advice about friendship has helped me more than any book.
records.zomi: Lawmta tawh kisai Pi' thuhilhna in laibu khat peuh sangin hong huh zaw hi.

records.english: Why do my grandparents and my children laugh at the same jokes?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ka pu leh pi leh ka tate nuihzak thu kibang-ah a nui uh hiam?

records.english: I do want to learn my grandmother's recipes before it's too late.
records.zomi: Hun a nunung lua ma-in ka pi' an huan dan te sin ka deih taktak hi.

records.english: Grandpa says that his grandchildren keep him young.
records.zomi: A tute in amah a neu lai bang-in a om sak uh hi, ci-in Pu in a gen hi.

records.english: Many Christians keep a journal of what they learn from the Bible.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in Laisiangtho pan a sinsa uh ciamtehna laibu khat a kem uh hi.

records.english: Does your grandmother read a chapter of the Bible every morning?
records.zomi: Na pi in zingsang simin Laisiangtho cang khat a sim taktak hiam?

records.english: Dad says that discipleship is learning to forgive, again and again.
records.zomi: Nungzui hihna pen kik-in kik-in maisak sinna ahi hi, ci-in Pa in a gen hi.

records.english: Auntie Lun shows her faith by visiting sick people every Saturday.
records.zomi: Ni Lun in Kiginni simin a cina mite veh-in a upna a lak hi.

records.english: Shall we help someone in need this week, as our pastor encourages?
records.zomi: I pastor' hanthawnna bang-in hih kal-in kisapna nei mi khat i huh ding hiam?

records.english: Our youth group talks about what it means to follow Jesus today.
records.zomi: I tangvalte' pawl in tu-in Jesu nung zui cih bang ahi hiam cih a kikum uh hi.

records.english: My brother decided to be baptised after a year of learning in a discipleship group.
records.zomi: Nungzui hihna pawl khat sungah kum khat a kisin khit ciangin ka u pasal kibaptaiz dingin a khensat hi.

records.english: Dad reads the Bible with us before dinner.
records.zomi: Pa in nitak an ma-in eite tawh Laisiangtho a sim hi.

records.english: Many Christians fast and pray during certain seasons of the year.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in kum sung-a hun khenkhat-in an ngawl-in thu a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Thank you for teaching me how to read the Bible.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho bangci-in sim ding hiam cih hong sinsak manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Christians believe that following Jesus can be costly but worth it.
records.zomi: Jesu nung zui in a man a sang thei a, ahi zongin a phu hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: Who were Jesus' first disciples?
records.zomi: Jesu' nungzui masate kua te hiam?

records.english: According to the Gospels, several of them were fishermen.
records.zomi: Lungdamna Thu te bang-in amaute khenkhat ngabeng mi ahi uh hi.

records.english: Is being a disciple only for church leaders?
records.zomi: Nungzui hihna pen pawlpi makaite adingin bek ahi hiam?

records.english: No, Christians believe that every believer is called to be a disciple.
records.zomi: Hi lo hi, upmi khempeuh nungzui hi dingin kisam hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: Why does a disciple need to read the Scriptures regularly?
records.zomi: Bang hangin nungzui khat in Laisiangtho tawntung-in a sim kul hiam?

records.english: They believe the Scriptures shape their thoughts, their choices and the way they treat others.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho in a ngaihsutna uh, a teelna uh leh midangte tungah a om dan uh a bawl hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Children, Jesus said that we should be kind to everyone.
records.zomi: Naupangte aw, Jesu in mi khempeuh tungah hehpihna nei ding hi, a ci hi.

records.english: In the Gospels, Jesus washes his disciples' feet to show them how to serve.
records.zomi: Lungdamna Thu te sungah Jesu in na sepsak dan lak nadingin a nungzuite' khe a silsak hi.

records.english: Following Jesus, many Christians believe, changes how a person treats their family.
records.zomi: Jesu nung zui in mi khat in a innkuan tungah a om dan a khek hi, ci-in Khristian tampi in a um uh hi.

records.english: Christians believe that Jesus called people to follow him.
records.zomi: Jesu in mite amah nung zui dingin a sam hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: Who will lead the Bible study this week?
records.zomi: Hih kal-in Laisiangtho sinna kua in a makaih ding hiam?

records.english: My little brother asked whether he could be a disciple too.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal in amah zong nungzui khat a hi thei hiam cih a dong hi.

records.english: Our pastor says that small daily choices show who we are following.
records.zomi: Ni sim teelna neute in kua nung i zui hiam cih a lak hi, ci-in i pastor in a gen hi.

records.english: The pastor reminded us that Peter made mistakes but was still Jesus' disciple.
records.zomi: Piter in khialhna a bawl a, ahi zongin Jesu' nungzui ahi lai hi, ci-in pastor in hong phawksak hi.

records.english: Discipleship means learning, and learning takes time and patience.
records.zomi: Nungzui hihna cih pen sinna ahi a, sinna in hun leh thuakzawhna a ngai hi.

records.english: Serving at the church kitchen is one way our family tries to follow Jesus.
records.zomi: Pawlpi an huanna inn-a na sep pen i innkuan in Jesu nung a zui sawmna lampi khat ahi hi.

records.english: Can our small group pray for you this week?
records.zomi: Hih kal-in i pawl neu in nang adingin thu a ngen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Having followed Jesus for fifty years, my grandmother still says she is learning.
records.zomi: Kum sawmnga sung Jesu nung a zui khit ciangin ka pi in ka sin lai hi, a ci lai hi.

records.english: The new believers asked their mentors many questions about prayer.
records.zomi: Upa thakte in a lampi lakpate kiangah thungetna tawh kisai dotna tampi a dong uh hi.

records.english: Our church has small groups where people learn together how to follow Jesus.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in Jesu bangci-in nung zui ding hiam cih mite a kikhawm-in a sinna pawl neute a nei hi.

records.english: How can I follow Jesus at school?
records.zomi: Sang ah Jesu nung bangci-in ka zui thei ding hiam?

records.english: Many Christians would say by being honest and kind, even when it's hard.
records.zomi: A haksa ciang zongin thuman leh hehpihna nei-in, ci-in Khristian tampi in a gen kha ding uh hi.

records.english: The disciples left their nets to follow Jesus, according to the Gospel of Mark.
records.zomi: Marka' Lungdamna Thu bang-in nungzuite in Jesu nung zui dingin a ngen uh a nusia uh hi.

records.english: Many Christians try to pray, read the Bible and serve others every day.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in ni simin thu ngen, Laisiangtho sim leh midangte adingin na sem a sawm uh hi.

records.english: Many Christians believe that discipleship includes caring for the poor.
records.zomi: Nungzui hihna sungah mi zawngte kemna a kihel hi, ci-in Khristian tampi in a um uh hi.

records.english: Jesus taught his disciples to pray, according to the Gospel of Luke.
records.zomi: Luka' Lungdamna Thu bang-in Jesu in a nungzuite thungetna a sinsak hi.

records.english: Jesus told his disciples to love one another, according to the Gospel of John.
records.zomi: Johan' Lungdamna Thu bang-in Jesu in a nungzuite khat leh khat ki-it dingin a gen hi.

records.english: Does our church give every new believer a mentor?
records.zomi: I pawlpi in upa thak khempeuh lampi lakpa khat a pia hiam?

records.english: The youth group went to the hospital to sing for patients as part of their discipleship.
records.zomi: Tangvalte' pawl in a nungzui hihna sung-a khat-in cinate adingin la sa dingin damdawi inn ah a pai uh hi.

records.english: Following Jesus at work means being honest, even when no one is watching.
records.zomi: Nasepna-a Jesu nung zui cih pen kuamah in a en kei ciang zongin thuman ahi hi.

records.english: When my uncle became a Christian, an older man from the church met him every week.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu Khristian a suah ciangin pawlpi pan pasal upa khat in kal simin a mu hi.

records.english: They read the Bible together, prayed and talked about everyday problems.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho a sim khawm uh a, thu a ngen uh a, ni sim buaina te a kikum uh hi.

records.english: Years later, my uncle began meeting young men in the same way.
records.zomi: Kum tampi khit ciangin ka pa neu in tangval neute tua bang mahmah-in a mu kipan hi.

records.english: Is it hard to follow Jesus when your friends don't believe?
records.zomi: Na lawmte in a um kei uh ciangin Jesu nung zui a haksa hiam?

records.english: Shall we memorise a verse together this week?
records.zomi: Hih kal-in Laisiangtho cang khat i kisin khawm ding hiam?

records.english: Mum taught me to pray before I go to school.
records.zomi: Sang ka pai ma-in thu ngen dingin Nu in hong sinsak hi.

records.english: Discipleship, our pastor says, is a journey rather than a single decision.
records.zomi: Nungzui hihna pen thukhensatna khat bek sangin khualzinna khat ahi zaw hi, ci-in i pastor in a gen hi.

records.english: Our youth leader meets with each of us once a month to pray and talk.
records.zomi: I tangvalte' makaipa in thu ngen leh kihoupih dingin kha khat-in khatvei i khatciat a mu hi.

records.english: A disciple is someone who learns from a teacher and follows him.
records.zomi: Nungzui pen saya khat kiang pan a sin a, amah nung a zui mi ahi hi.

records.english: Some disciples in the Bible doubted, and Jesus was patient with them.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho sung-a nungzui khenkhat in a lungmuang kei uh a, Jesu in amaute tungah a thuakzawh hi.

records.english: Christians believe that the Holy Spirit helps them to follow Jesus.
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho in Jesu nung a zui nadingun a huh hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: I do want to grow in my faith this year.
records.zomi: Hih kum-in ka upna-ah khan ka deih taktak hi.

records.english: Please pray for me as I try to be a better disciple.
records.zomi: Nungzui hoih zaw khat hih ka sawm lai-in kei adingin thu hong ngen sak in.

records.english: Grandpa says that a disciple's life should match his words.
records.zomi: Nungzui khat' nuntakna a kammal tawh a kituak ding hi, ci-in Pu in a gen hi.

records.english: Following Jesus, our pastor says, means loving God and loving your neighbour.
records.zomi: Jesu nung zui cih pen Pasian it leh na inn veng it cihna ahi hi, ci-in i pastor in a gen hi.

records.english: What does it mean to be a disciple?
records.zomi: Nungzui hih cih bang cihna hiam?

records.english: Christians say it means following Jesus and learning from him every day.
records.zomi: Ni simin Jesu nung zui-in amah pan sin cihna ahi hi, ci-in Khristiante in a gen uh hi.

records.english: Who taught you to pray?
records.zomi: Thu ngen dingin kua in hong sinsak hiam?

records.english: Christians believe that every believer can share their faith with others.
records.zomi: Upmi khempeuh in a upna midangte tawh a hawm thei hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: Did Dad practise the test questions with your little brother?
records.zomi: Pa in na nau pasal tawh sitna dotna te a kisin hiam?

records.english: Our family celebrated every step of the application, from the test to the ceremony.
records.zomi: I innkuan in ngetna kalsuan khempeuh, sitna pan a kikhopna dong, a lungdampih hi.

records.english: Our family's citizenship certificates are kept in the same box as our wedding photos.
records.zomi: I innkuan' gam mi hihna lai-ciam te i mopawi photo te tawh bawm kibang sungah kikem hi.

records.english: Grandma keeps her old and new passports side by side in a drawer.
records.zomi: Pi in a passport lui leh thak kiang tuak-in khawlmuh sungah a kem hi.

records.english: Why did your parents decide to become citizens?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na nu leh na pa gammi suak dingin a khensat uh hiam?

records.english: They wanted to vote and to feel that this country was really home.
records.zomi: Vote a deih uh a, hih gam pen a inn taktak uh ahi hi, cih kisak a deih uh hi.

records.english: My husband's application was approved, but mine is still being checked.
records.zomi: Ka pasal' ngetna kiphal a, ahi zongin keimah' kien lai hi.

records.english: Did your grandmother learn the national anthem for her ceremony?
records.zomi: Na pi in a kikhopna adingin gam la a sin hiam?

records.english: Your help with the forms meant a great deal to my parents.
records.zomi: Form te-ah na huhna in ka nu leh ka pa adingin a thupi mahmah hi.

records.english: My sister helped our parents fill in the application in the evenings.
records.zomi: Ka u numei in nitak simin ka nu leh ka pa ngetna dimsak dingin a huh hi.

records.english: My little brother asked whether he would need a new name when he became a citizen.
records.zomi: Gammi a suah ciangin min thak a kul ding hiam cih ka nau pasal in a dong hi.

records.english: Who is going to check the application before we post it?
records.zomi: Ngetna i khak ma-un kua in a en ding hiam?

records.english: Do we need to bring the children's birth certificates to the appointment?
records.zomi: Kimuhna-ah naupangte' pianna lai te i paipih kul uh hiam?

records.english: My brother took a day off work to go with Dad to the interview.
records.zomi: Pa tawh interview ah pai dingin ka u pasal in nasep pan ni khat a tawl hi.

records.english: The children asked whether they would get new passports too.
records.zomi: Amaute zong passport thak a ngah ding uh hiam cih naupangte in a dong uh hi.

records.english: Our family's journey to citizenship took fifteen years from start to finish.
records.zomi: I innkuan' gam mi hihna khualzinna a kipat pan a tawp dong kum sawm le nga a la hi.

records.english: Dad says that citizenship is a promise as well as a right.
records.zomi: Gam mi hihna pen thuneihna bek hi lo-in kiciamna zong ahi hi, ci-in Pa in a gen hi.

records.english: We framed my father's citizenship certificate and hung it in the living room.
records.zomi: Ka pa' gam mi hihna lai-ciam frame-in i koih a, tutna inn ah i khai uh hi.

records.english: We practised the interview questions at the kitchen table every Sunday.
records.zomi: Nipini simin an huanna inn taupi ah interview dotna te i kisin uh hi.

records.english: Did you remember to sign the citizenship form?
records.zomi: Gam mi hihna form na signature ding na phawk hiam?

records.english: Can Grandma take the citizenship test in her own language?
records.zomi: Pi in gam mi hihna sitna amah pau-in a bawl thei hiam?

records.english: No, so I'm helping her practise the questions every evening.
records.zomi: Thei lo, tua hangin nitak simin dotna te kisin dingin ka huh hi.

records.english: My cousin's application asked for every address he had lived at for ten years.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam' ngetna in kum sawm sung a teenna mun khempeuh a ngen hi.

records.english: Dad wore a tie for the first time in years for his ceremony.
records.zomi: A kikhopna adingin Pa in kum tampi sung-a a masa pen-in tie a bulh hi.

records.english: The ceremony was short, but my father talked about it for weeks.
records.zomi: Kikhopna a tom a, ahi zongin ka pa in kal tampi sung tua thu a gen hi.

records.english: The whole family went to watch my parents' citizenship ceremony.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa' gam mi hihna kikhopna en dingin innkuan bup a pai uh hi.

records.english: We celebrated our new citizenship with a picnic in the park.
records.zomi: I gam mi hihna thak park sungah picnic tawh i lungdampih uh hi.

records.english: The day my parents became citizens, they called every relative abroad.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa gammi a suah ni-in gamdang-a sanggam khempeuh a sam uh hi.

records.english: We had to send copies of our passports with the application.
records.zomi: Ngetna tawh i passport copy te i khak kul uh hi.

records.english: Having become a citizen, my mother joined the parents' committee at our school.
records.zomi: Gammi a suah khit ciangin ka nu i sang-a nu leh pate' committee ah a kihel hi.

records.english: The officer asked my mother how long she had lived in the town.
records.zomi: Nasempa in ka nu kiangah khuapi sungah bangzah sawt a teng khin hiam cih a dong hi.

records.english: Our family's application was delayed because one document had expired.
records.zomi: Lai khat a bei khin manin i innkuan' ngetna a phawng hi.

records.english: Mum still keeps the pen she used to sign her citizenship form.
records.zomi: A gam mi hihna form signature-na a zat laigelhna Nu in a kem lai hi.

records.english: My grandparents decided not to apply, because they still hope to go home one day.
records.zomi: Ni khat ni-in inn ah a kik ding a lamen lai uh ahih manin ka pu leh pi in ngen lo dingin a khensat uh hi.

records.english: Mum was worried that her accent would affect the language test.
records.zomi: A pau ngaihzia in pau sitna a khoih ding hi, ci-in Nu a lungkham hi.

records.english: Getting citizenship gave my parents the confidence to buy a house.
records.zomi: Gam mi hihna ngah in ka nu leh ka pa inn lei dingin hanna a pia hi.

records.english: Auntie Hoih became a citizen on the same day as her daughter.
records.zomi: Ni Hoih a tanu tawh ni kibang-in gammi a suak hi.

records.english: Our family's citizenship application was thicker than a school textbook.
records.zomi: I innkuan' gam mi hihna ngetna sang sinna laibu sangin a tah zaw hi.

records.english: Do the children become citizens when we do?
records.zomi: Eite gammi i suah ciangin naupangte zong gammi a suak uh hiam?

records.english: In our case, yes, because they're under 18 and live with us.
records.zomi: Eite adingin suak uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh kum 18 nuai ahi uh a, eite tawh a teng uh hi.

records.english: Dad asked a lawyer to check his application because of an old traffic fine.
records.zomi: Lampi tunga sum lepna lui khat hangin Pa in a ngetna en dingin thukham siam khat a ngen hi.

records.english: Mum cried when she held her citizenship certificate for the first time.
records.zomi: A gam mi hihna lai-ciam a len masa pen ciangin Nu a kap hi.

records.english: My parents saved for months to pay the application fees for the whole family.
records.zomi: Innkuan bup adingin ngetna man pia dingin ka nu leh ka pa kha tampi sum a khol uh hi.

records.english: Grandpa says he became a citizen so that his grandchildren would never feel like strangers.
records.zomi: A tute in mi theih loh bang-in a kisak ngei loh nadingun gammi a suak hi, ci-in Pu in a gen hi.

records.english: Should my wife apply at the same time as me, or wait until mine is approved?
records.zomi: Ka zi kei tawh hun kibang-in a ngen ding hiam, ka ngetna a kiphal dong a ngak ding hiam?

records.english: Becoming citizens meant my parents could finally vote in national elections.
records.zomi: Gammi suah in ka nu leh ka pa a tawp-in gam bup teelna-ah vote a thei sak hi.

records.english: Shall we invite the whole family to the ceremony?
records.zomi: Kikhopna-ah innkuan bup i sam ding hiam?

records.english: My parents asked the advice centre whether they could keep their old nationality.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in a gam lui mi hihna a kem thei lai ding hiam cih thuhilhna office a dong uh hi.

records.english: How long did you wait for your citizenship decision?
records.zomi: Na gam mi hihna thukhensatna adingin bangzah sawt na ngak hiam?

records.english: When will Dad find out whether he's become a citizen?
records.zomi: Gammi a suak hiam cih Pa in bang hun-in a thei ding hiam?

records.english: The letter should arrive within six months, according to the office.
records.zomi: Office bang-in laikhak kha guk sungin a tung ding hi.

records.english: The citizenship letter arrived on my brother's birthday, which made the day even better.
records.zomi: Gam mi hihna laikhak ka u pasal' suahni-in a tung a, tua in ni a hoih semsem sak hi.

records.english: My uncle needed his old school records to prove how long he had lived here.
records.zomi: Hih mun ah bangzah sawt a teng khin hiam cih kipsak nadingin ka pa neu in a sang ciamtehna lui te a kul hi.

records.english: My test asked about the country's history, its laws and its geography.
records.zomi: Ka sitna in gam' tangthu, a thukham te leh a gam pianzia tawh kisai a dong hi.

records.english: My sister studied history so that she could help our parents with the test.
records.zomi: Ka u numei in ka nu leh ka pa sitna-ah a huh theih nadingin tangthu a sin hi.

records.english: How did the citizenship ceremony go?
records.zomi: Gam mi hihna kikhopna bangci-in a kalsuan hiam?

records.english: It was very moving, and Grandpa wore his best suit.
records.zomi: Lungsim a khoih mahmah a, Pu in a puan hoih pen a silh hi.

records.english: Our neighbour, who became a citizen last year, explained the process to us.
records.zomi: Kum bei-in gammi a suak i inn veng in a kalsuan dan hong gen hi.

records.english: Will the children wave small flags at the end of the ceremony?
records.zomi: Kikhopna tawp-ah naupangte in gam puan neute a vai ding uh hiam?

records.english: Mum studied for the citizenship test every evening for three months.
records.zomi: Nu in kha thum sung nitak simin gam mi hihna sitna adingin a kisin hi.

records.english: Where can I see the results of the residents' survey?
records.zomi: Teng mite' dotna kankanna gah te koi-ah ka en thei hiam?

records.english: What evidence does the council have that the new bus lane is working?
records.zomi: Bus lampi thak in na a sem hi, cih council in bang kipsakna a nei hiam?

records.english: The pharmacist asked to see my prescription before giving me the medicine.
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakpa in damdawi hong piak ma-in ka damdawi lai a et nop hi.

records.english: Have you kept the receipt from the repair shop?
records.zomi: Bawlkikna sumbuk pan man piakna lai na kem hiam?

records.english: The clinic asked to see my vaccination record.
records.zomi: Clinic in ka vaccine ciamtehna et nop a ngen hi.

records.english: The council officer asked for evidence that the tree was dangerous.
records.zomi: Council nasempa in singkung a lauhuai hi, cih kipsakna a ngen hi.

records.english: The shopkeeper showed us the delivery note as proof that the bread was fresh.
records.zomi: Sumbuk neipa in moh a thak hi, cih kipsakna-in van tunna lai hong lak hi.

records.english: Do you have the email confirming my booking?
records.zomi: Ka koih khol a kipsakna email na nei hiam?

records.english: How do you know the old bridge is unsafe?
records.zomi: Lei lui a lauhuai hi, cih bangci-in na thei hiam?

records.english: Has anyone measured how loud the factory is at night?
records.zomi: Zan-in factory bangzah a ging hiam cih kuamah in a teh khin hiam?

records.english: We need written proof before we can refund your ticket.
records.zomi: Na ticket man kong piak kik ma-un kigelh kipsakna i kul uh hi.

records.english: Could you send me the inspection report for the playground?
records.zomi: Naupang kimawlna mun' enna report hong khak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Before we sign the petition, can we see the evidence for what it says?
records.zomi: Ngetna lai i signature ma-un a gen thu' kipsakna i en thei ding hiam?

records.english: Residents asked the council to publish the figures behind its decision.
records.zomi: Teng mite in council kiangah a thukhensatna nung-a nambat te suaksak dingin a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Is there any record of my complaint?

records.english: Our children help us read notices that are written in very formal language.
records.zomi: I tate in pau zahtak huai mahmah tawh kigelh theisakna lai te sim dingin hong huh uh hi.

records.english: Mum circled the important dates on the notice with a red pen.

records.zomi: Bawlkikna khit ciangin nai tawm khat sung i tui a nawng ding hi, ci-in theisakna lai in a gen hi.

records.english: Having misread one notice, my father now asks me to check every letter.

records.zomi: Hi hi, bawlkikna adingin Laizing ni zingsang-in tui kikhak ding hi.

records.zomi: Kha thum sungin i inn man a khang ding hi, ci-in theisakna lai in a gen hiam?

records.zomi: Bawlkikna adingin khal bup lei kikhak ding hi, ci-in theisakna lai in kidopna a pia hi.

records.english: After the training, the staff felt confident about following the emergency instructions.

records.zomi: Ka manager in lauhuai lo nading thuhilhna te amah kiangah kik-in gen dingin hong ngen hi.

records.zomi: Hih antibiotics ka nek lai-in nasepna-ah ka kik thei hiam?

records.english: Yes, as long as you feel well and finish the whole course.

records.english: The instructions for the eye drops said to wait five minutes between each one.
records.zomi: Mit damdawi thuhilhna in khat leh khat kikal-ah minit nga ngak ding hi, a ci hi.

records.english: The lifeguards practise following emergency instructions every month.

records.english: Did the school nurse explain how to use your inhaler during PE?

records.english: Yes, two puffs before I start running and one more if I need it.
records.zomi: Gen hi, ka tai kipat ma-in nihvei, leh ka kul leh khatvei beh.

records.zomi: Factory' first-aid thuhilhna te khawl khempeuh kiang-ah kikhai hi.

records.english: Should I take this tablet before my night shift or after it?

records.zomi: Shift a kipat ma-in na nitak an tawh ne in.

records.english: The trainer used a dummy to show us how to do chest compressions.
records.zomi: Kisinsakpa in awm nawtna bangci-in bawl ding hiam cih lak nadingin mihing lem khat a zang hi.

records.zomi: Thuhilhna tak te in nasemte lauhuai hun-in a manlang-in a bawl thei sak hi.

records.zomi: Siangsakna van te tunga thuhilhna te in khut hum silh dingin hong kidopsak hi.

records.english: Our school nurse uses pictures to explain instructions to the youngest pupils.
records.zomi: I sang nurse in sangnaupang neu pen te kiangah thuhilhna gen dingin lim a zang hi.

records.zomi: Damdawi thak' thuhilhna te laimal neu mahmah tawh kigelh ahih manin mit-et lian khat ka kul hi.

records.english: The doctor wrote the instructions in simple words because I'm still learning the language.
records.zomi: Pau ka sin lai ahih manin siavuan in thuhilhna te kammal baihlam tawh a gelh hi.

records.english: The nurse asked me to show her how I would use the inhaler.
records.zomi: Nurse in inhaler bangci-in ka zang ding hiam cih amah lak dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: The first-aid trainer showed us how to put someone in the recovery position.
records.zomi: First-aid kisinsakpa in mi khat damna lupna dan-in bangci-in koih ding hiam cih hong lak hi.

records.english: Thank you for explaining the instructions so patiently.
records.zomi: Thuhilhna te thuakzawh takin na gen manin ka lungdam hi.

records.zomi: I sang ah damdawi a nei sangnaupangte in nu a hih kei leh pa pan kigelh thuhilhna nurse kiangah a pia kul uh hi.

records.english: The doctor's instructions were to avoid lifting anything heavy at work for a month.
records.zomi: Siavuan' thuhilhna te pen kha khat sung nasepna-ah van gik dawn lo ding ahi hi.

records.zomi: Thuhilhna te hong gelh sak thei ding hiam?

records.zomi: A bawm hong inla, hong inla, a pau thuhilhna te zui in.

records.english: Did anyone check the instructions before giving the child the medicine?

records.english: The library let us hold our book club meeting in the study room.

records.english: Could I leave my bags behind the counter while I shop?

records.english: Excuse me, may I sit at this table?
records.zomi: Maisak in, hih taupi ah ka tu thei ding hiam?

records.english: Could we have permission to plant flowers along the edge of the car park?

records.zomi: Gamdang-a i khuasung pan innkuante a tun masa ciangun inn a kihawm zel uh hi.

records.english: Grandma's greatest wish is to see all her grandchildren in one room.
records.zomi: Pi' deihna lian pen a tute khempeuh inndan khat sungah muh ahi hi.

records.english: Some of our relatives abroad have not been home for more than twenty years.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a i sanggam khenkhat kum sawmnih val inn ah a kik nai kei uh hi.

records.english: Auntie Lun cooks our village dishes for her neighbours abroad, who love them.
records.zomi: Ni Lun in gamdang-a a inn vengte adingin i khua an te a huan a, amaute in a deih mahmah uh hi.

records.english: Our family's community abroad celebrates the same festivals as we do at home.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a i innkuan' khuasung in inn-a i bawl pawi kibang te a lungdampih uh hi.

records.english: Our family group chat has members in more countries than I can count.
records.zomi: I innkuan group chat in ka sim zawh loh gam tampi-ah kihel mi a nei hi.

records.english: Was last year the first time your parents visited their relatives abroad?
records.zomi: Kum bei pen na nu leh na pa gamdang-a a sanggamte a veh masa pen uh ahi hiam?

records.english: When my sister's family came home for a visit, the whole village came to see them.
records.zomi: Ka u numei' innkuan inn veh dingin a hong ciangin khua bup amaute mu dingin a hong uh hi.

records.english: My uncle helps newcomers from our region fill in forms when they arrive abroad.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu in i gamkhen pan mi thakte gamdang-ah a tun ciangun form dimsak dingin a huh hi.

records.english: The cousins abroad asked us to teach them the traditional dance before the wedding.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a sanggamte in mopawi ma-in ngeina lam sinsak dingin hong ngen uh hi.

records.english: Families from our region abroad often name their children after grandparents back home.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a i gamkhen pan innkuante in a tate uh inn-a a pu leh pi' min tawh a phuak zel uh hi.

records.english: Living far apart, our family relies on phone calls and occasional visits.
records.zomi: Gamla-ah i teen manin i innkuan in phone sam leh khatveivei vehna tungah a kinga hi.

records.english: Does Grandpa still write to his old friends who moved abroad?
records.zomi: Pu in gamdang-a a pai a lawm lui te kiangah lai a gelh lai hiam?

records.english: My cousin abroad says she feels at home whenever she hears our language at church.
records.zomi: Pawlpi ah i pau a zak simin inn-a om bang-in a kisa hi, ci-in gamdang-a ka sanggam in a gen hi.

records.english: Does your aunt abroad send photos of her children every week?
records.zomi: Gamdang-a na ni in kal simin a tate' photo a khak hiam?

records.english: My brother says that our community abroad keeps the old customs even more strictly than we do at home.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a i khuasung in inn-a i kem sangin ngeina lui te a khauh zaw-in a kem uh hi, ci-in ka u pasal in a gen hi.

records.english: Does Grandma's sister really call every Sunday from the other side of the world?
records.zomi: Pi' sanggam numei in leitung lam dang pan Nipini simin a sam taktak hiam?

records.english: When are the cousins from abroad coming to visit?
records.zomi: Gamdang pan sanggamte bang hun-in veh dingin a hong ding uh hiam?

records.english: Next summer, if they can all get time off work.
records.zomi: Khal hong tung ding-in, nasep pan a khempeuh uh tawlngakna a ngah thei uh leh.

records.english: When my nephew visited the village, he couldn't understand the older people's jokes.
records.zomi: Ka tanau khua a veh ciangin mi upate' nuihzak thu a theisiam kei hi.

records.english: Who in your family lives the furthest away?
records.zomi: Na innkuan sungah kua in a gamla pen-ah a teng hiam?

records.english: Does your cousin's family speak our language at home?
records.zomi: Na sanggam' innkuan in inn ah i pau a zang uh hiam?

records.english: Yes, although the children often answer in the local language.
records.zomi: Zang uh hi, ahi zongin naupangte in mun-a pau tawh a dawng zel uh hi.

records.english: My brother's children were born abroad, but they love our village food.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal' tate gamdang-ah a suak uh a, ahi zongin i khua an te a deih mahmah uh hi.

records.english: My uncle's family celebrates Christmas with other families from our region in their new city.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu' innkuan in a khuapi thak ah i gamkhen pan innkuan dangte tawh Christmas a lungdampih uh hi.

records.english: My brother's children speak three languages, which amazes their grandparents.
records.zomi: Ka u pasal' tate in pau thum a gen thei uh a, tua in a pu leh pi a lamdang sak hi.

records.english: Our family's wedding was streamed online for relatives on four continents.
records.zomi: I innkuan mopawi tuileng gam li-a om sanggamte adingin online-in a kikhak hi.

records.english: Our pastor taught us that kindness should not depend on how others treat us.
records.zomi: Hehpihna pen midangte in hong bawl dan tungah kinga lo ding hi, ci-in i pastor in hong sinsak hi.

records.english: Dad taught us to pay every debt on time, because he says it's a matter of honesty.
records.zomi: Thuman thu ahi hi, a ci ahih manin Pa in leiba khempeuh a hun-in thuk dingin hong sinsak hi.

records.english: Jesus told a story about a Samaritan who helped a stranger in need, according to Luke.
records.zomi: Luka bang-in Jesu in kisapna nei a theih loh mi khat a huh Samaria mi khat tawh kisai tangthu khat a gen hi.

records.english: My grandparents' honesty earned them the trust of the whole village.
records.zomi: Ka pu leh pi' thuman in khua bup' upna a ngah sak hi.

records.english: Jesus taught his followers to love their enemies, according to the Gospel of Matthew.
records.zomi: Matthai' Lungdamna Thu bang-in Jesu in a nungzuite a galte it dingin a sinsak hi.

records.english: Is it ever right to break a promise?
records.zomi: Kiciamna phiat a dik ngei hiam?

records.english: Auntie Hoih says that patience is a virtue she is still learning.
records.zomi: Thuakzawhna pen a sin lai hoihna khat ahi hi, ci-in Ni Hoih in a gen hi.

records.english: Our pastor reminded us that anger is not wrong, but what we do with it matters.
records.zomi: Hehna a khial kei a, ahi zongin tua tawh bang i bawl hiam cih a thupi hi, ci-in i pastor in hong phawksak hi.

records.english: Christians in different traditions sometimes disagree about difficult moral questions.
records.zomi: Ngeina tuamtuam-a Khristiante in khatveivei thu dik leh dik lo dotna haksa te tungah a kilem kei uh hi.

records.english: When I was ten, a shopkeeper gave me too much change.
records.zomi: Kum sawm ka cin ciangin sumbuk neipa khat in sum kikheksak tam lua hong pia hi.

records.english: My mother made me walk all the way back to return the extra money.
records.zomi: Ka nu in sum tamlua piak kik dingin a tawp dong hong ciahsak kik hi.

records.english: The shopkeeper was so surprised that he told the story to everyone in the market.
records.zomi: Sumbuk neipa a lamdang sa mahmah ahih manin sumbuk mun-a mi khempeuh kiangah tua tangthu a gen hi.

records.english: Many Christians believe that marriage vows should be kept for life.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in kiteenna kiciamna te nuntak sung kem ding hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Shall we help our neighbour with her shopping, as our faith teaches us?
records.zomi: I upna' sinsak bang-in i inn veng numei a van leina-ah i huh ding hiam?

records.english: Children, it's important to share with others, as Jesus taught.
records.zomi: Naupangte aw, Jesu' sinsak bang-in midangte tawh kihawm a thupi hi.

records.english: Many Christians try to follow the Ten Commandments in their daily lives.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in a ni sim nuntakna-ah Thukham Sawm zui a sawm uh hi.

records.english: Christians believe that faith should be shown in actions, not only in words.
records.zomi: Upna pen kammal bek hi lo-in nasep tawh kilak ding hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: Christians believe that every life has value, from the youngest to the oldest.
records.zomi: A neu pen pan a upa pen dong nuntakna khempeuh in manpha a nei hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: Our Bible study group talked about how to be fair at work.
records.zomi: I Laisiangtho sinna pawl in nasepna-ah bangci-in dik ding hiam cih a kikum uh hi.

records.english: How should a Christian treat people who are different from them?
records.zomi: Khristian khat in amah tawh kibang lo mite tungah bangci-in a om ding hiam?

records.english: With respect and kindness, just as Jesus treated everyone he met.
records.zomi: Zahtakna leh hehpihna tawh, Jesu in a muh mi khempeuh tungah a om bang-in.

records.english: Please be kind to the new boy at school, as you'd want others to be to you.
records.zomi: Midangte in nang tungah hong bawl na deih bang-in sang-a tangvalno thak tungah hehpihna nei in.

records.english: Why do Christians try to tell the truth?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Khristiante in thuman gen a sawm uh hiam?

records.english: They believe that honesty pleases God and builds trust between people.
records.zomi: Thuman in Pasian a lungdamsak a, mite kikal-ah kingakna a lam hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: What does the Bible say about helping the poor?
records.zomi: Mi zawngte huh tawh kisai Laisiangtho in bang a gen hiam?

records.english: Many passages, especially in the Gospels, call believers to care for people in need.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho mun tampi in, a tuamtuam-in Lungdamna Thu te in, upmite kisapna nei mite kem dingin a sam hi.

records.english: Many Christians believe that work should be done honestly and well.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in nasep pen thuman takin leh hoih takin kisem ding hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Some Christians refuse to gamble because they believe it harms families.
records.zomi: Khristian khenkhat in innkuan a siatsak hi, a cih manun kiloh a nial uh hi.

records.english: Our pastor said that forgiveness is a choice, not just a feeling.
records.zomi: Maisakna pen lungsim kisakna bek hi lo-in teelna khat ahi hi, ci-in i pastor in a gen hi.

records.english: Christians believe that every person has worth in God's eyes.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh Pasian mitmuh-ah manpha a nei hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: Why does Grandpa always forgive people so quickly?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pu in mite a manlang-in a maisak den hiam?

records.english: He says that Jesus forgave him, so he must forgive others.
records.zomi: Jesu in amah a maisak ahih manin amah in zong midangte a maisak kul hi, ci-in a gen hi.

records.english: Our pastor encourages us to visit people in prison and in hospital, as Jesus taught.
records.zomi: Jesu' sinsak bang-in thong leh damdawi inn-a om mite veh dingin i pastor in hong hanthawn hi.

records.english: Grandma says that true kindness is often done quietly.
records.zomi: Hehpihna taktak pen dai takin kibawl zel hi, ci-in Pi in a gen hi.

records.english: The Bible teaches that pride often comes before a fall, my grandfather says.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho in kiphatsakna pen kiamna ma-in a hong zel hi, ci-in a sinsak hi, ci-in ka pu in a gen hi.

records.english: Our church collected warm clothes for families who lost their homes in the fire.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in meikang-ah inn a mansuah innkuante adingin puan lum te a kaikhawm hi.

records.english: Many Christians believe that respecting parents is one of God's commandments.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in nu leh pa zahtak pen Pasian' thukham khat ahi hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Who taught you that honesty is important?
records.zomi: Thuman a thupi hi, cih kua in hong sinsak hiam?

records.english: Our family gives thanks before meals and tries to waste no food.
records.zomi: I innkuan in an nek ma-in lungdam a gen a, an mansuah lo dingin a sawm hi.

records.english: Does your father really refuse to cheat, even at board games?
records.zomi: Na pa in board game ah zong a khem nuam kei taktak hiam?

records.english: Christians believe that stealing is wrong, even if no one finds out.
records.zomi: Kuamah in a theih kei zongin guta a dik kei hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: Our youth group discussed whether it's ever right to tell a white lie.
records.zomi: I tangvalte' pawl in zuau neuno khat gen a dik ngei hiam cih a kikum uh hi.

records.english: Many Christians try to speak gently, even when they disagree.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in a kilem kei uh ciang zongin nem takin pau a sawm uh hi.

records.english: The Golden Rule, to treat others as you want to be treated, is found in the Gospels.
records.zomi: Nang tungah hong bawl na deih bang-in midangte tungah bawl in, a ci Kham Thukham Lungdamna Thu te sungah a om hi.

records.english: Our church encourages members to give part of their income to people in need.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in pawlpi mite a sum ngah uh khenkhat kisapna nei mite adingin pia dingin a hanthawn hi.

records.english: Is it right to forgive someone who keeps hurting you?
records.zomi: Hong natsak den mi khat maisak a dik hiam?

records.english: Having made a mistake at work, my uncle went to his boss and admitted it straight away.
records.zomi: Nasepna-ah khialhna khat a bawl khit ciangin ka pa neu a makaipa kiangah a pai a, a pulak pah hi.

records.english: Is it wrong to keep money you find in the street?
records.zomi: Lampi tungah na muh sum na kem a khial hiam?

records.english: Our church teaches that you should try to return it to its owner.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in a neipa kiangah piak kik sawm ding hi, ci-in a sinsak hi.

records.english: Our family tries to say sorry before we go to sleep after an argument.
records.zomi: I innkuan in kiniamna khit ciangin i ihmut ma-in maisakna ngen a sawm hi.

records.english: I do want to be honest even when it's hard.
records.zomi: A haksa ciang zongin thuman ka deih taktak hi.

records.english: Thank you for teaching our children to be honest and kind.
records.zomi: I tate thuman leh hehpihna nei dingin na sinsak manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Did your parents teach you never to lie, even when the truth is difficult?
records.zomi: Thuman a haksa ciang zongin zuau gen ngei lo dingin na nu leh na pa in hong sinsak uh hiam?

records.english: My little brother learned at Sunday school that sharing is a way of showing love.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal in Nipini sang ah kihawm pen itna lakna lampi khat ahi hi, cih a sin hi.

records.english: Grandma believes that how we treat strangers shows what we really believe.
records.zomi: A theih loh mite tungah i om dan in bang taktak i um hiam cih a lak hi, ci-in Pi in a um hi.

records.english: Christians believe that God cares about justice for the poor.
records.zomi: Pasian in mi zawngte adingin thudikna a ngaihsun hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: What does it mean to love your neighbour?
records.zomi: Na lawmte na it in cih bang cihna hiam?

records.english: Christians believe that caring for creation is part of their faith.
records.zomi: Piansakna kem pen a upna sung-a khat ahi hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: Does our church still run a free meal every Friday for anyone who is hungry?
records.zomi: I pawlpi in Laithai ni simin gilkial mi kuapeuh adingin a man om lo an a pia lai hiam?

records.english: Mum says that gossip can hurt people as much as a blow.
records.zomi: Mi gensiatna in mi a vuak bang-in a natsak thei hi, ci-in Nu in a gen hi.

records.english: Is there room for one more family on the coach to the coast?
records.zomi: Tuipi gei pai bus lian sungah innkuan khat beh adingin mun a om lai hiam?

records.english: Are there any spaces left in the after-school club for September?
records.zomi: September adingin sang khit naupang kipawlna-ah mun a awng a om lai hiam?

records.english: Are there any allotment plots free at the moment?
records.zomi: Tu-in huan mun awng khat peuh a om hiam?

records.english: The waiting list is about two years, but you could share a plot with another gardener in the meantime.
records.zomi: Ngakna ciamtehna kum nih dek a sau a, ahi zongin tua kikal-in huan neipa dang khat tawh huan mun na kihawm thei hi.

records.english: How soon can a locksmith get here?
records.zomi: Tawh bawlpa bangzah manlang-in hih mun ah a tung thei ding hiam?

records.english: Please let me know if a place on the course becomes available.
records.zomi: Sinna-ah mun khat a awng leh hong theisak in.

records.english: Before the move, we phoned the water company to check whether they could connect us on the same day.
records.zomi: I sawn ma-in ni kibang-in hong zom thei ding uh hiam cih en dingin tui company i sam uh hi.

records.english: Please check whether the hall has a kitchen we can use before you pay the deposit.
records.zomi: Lomkhol sum na piak ma-in inn lian in i zat theih an huanna inn a nei hiam cih en in.

records.english: Do they close the youth club for the whole summer, or only for August?
records.zomi: Tangvalte' kipawlna khal bup a khak uh hiam, August bek hiam?

records.english: Will the recycling centre be open on the bank holiday?
records.zomi: Gam tawlngakni-in recycling centre a kihong ding hiam?

records.english: Do you know if the ferry still runs when the river is high?
records.zomi: Lui a let ciangin tembaw a pai lai hiam cih na thei hiam?

records.english: Many councils now let residents check bin collection dates online.
records.zomi: Council tampi in tu-in teng mite online-in eek lakna ni a en thei sak uh hi.

records.english: Can we reserve the barbecue area in the park, or is it first come, first served?
records.zomi: Park sung-a barbecue mun i koih khol thei ding uh hiam, a hih kei leh a hong masa in a ngah hiam?

records.english: It's worth checking whether the museum's free entry day is still the first Sunday of the month.
records.zomi: Museum' lut man om lo ni kha khatciat' Nipini masa pen ahi lai hiam cih en a phu hi.

records.english: Has the council confirmed whether the market square is free for our charity fair?
records.zomi: I hehpihna fair adingin sumbuk mun laizang a awng hiam cih council in a kipsak khin hiam?

records.english: Is the post office counter open during the lunch hour?
records.zomi: Sun an hun sungin post office taupi a kihong hiam?

records.english: Yes, but only one window, so expect a short queue.
records.zomi: Kihong hi, ahi zongin tawhkhang khat bek, tua ahih manin kigual tomno khat ngak in.

records.english: I rang the leisure centre to ask whether the climbing wall could be booked for a youth group.
records.zomi: Tangvalte' pawl adingin kahna bang koih khol theih hiam cih dong dingin tawlngakna inn ka sam hi.

records.english: The receptionist said that groups need an instructor, who is free only on Tuesdays.
records.zomi: Pawlte in sinsakpa khat a kul uh a, amah Pithai ni bek-in a awng hi, ci-in receptionist in a gen hi.

records.english: We moved our weekly meeting to Tuesday so that the young people wouldn't miss out.
records.zomi: Tangvalte in a mansuah loh nadingun i kal sim kikhopna Pithai ni ah i sawn uh hi.

records.english: Volunteer drivers are in short supply, so book hospital transport at least a week ahead.
records.zomi: Thalawp mawtaw tawlpa a tawm ahih manin a tawm pen-in kal khat ma-in damdawi inn mawtaw koih khol in.

records.english: Is the community centre's minibus available for the seniors' outing on the 14th?
records.zomi: A ni 14-a upate' khualzinna adingin khuasung inn lian' bus neu a awng hiam?

records.english: It's away for repairs until the 20th, so you might ask the school whether you can borrow theirs.
records.zomi: A ni 20 dong bawlkikna-ah a om ahih manin sang kiangah a bus uh na pukip thei hiam cih na dong kha ding hi.

records.english: Is there a free parking space near the clinic, or should we take a taxi?
records.zomi: Clinic kiang-ah mawtaw khawl theih mun awng khat a om hiam, a hih kei leh taxi i la ding hiam?

records.english: Does the chemist on the high street open on Sundays?
records.zomi: Lampi lian tunga damdawi zuakna Nipini-in a kihong hiam?

records.english: Thank you for checking the dates with the caretaker for us.
records.zomi: Inn kempa tawh ni te hong en sak manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Could you tell me whether the vaccination clinic takes walk-in patients?
records.zomi: Vaccine clinic in kimuhna om lo cinate a sang hiam cih hong gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Does the citizens' advice office see people without an appointment?
records.zomi: Gammite' thuhilhna office in kimuhna om lo mite a mu hiam?

records.english: Our neighbourhood group never prints posters until the church hall's availability has been confirmed in writing.
records.zomi: I khuasung pawl in pawlpi inn lian' awng ni kigelh-in a kipsak mateng poster a print ngei kei uh hi.

records.english: Our residents' association keeps a shared list of which members can lend tools and when.
records.zomi: I teng mite' kipawlna in kua in nasepna van bang hun-in a pukip thei hiam cih kihawm ciamtehna khat a kem hi.

records.english: Do you have a wheelchair we could borrow for a visitor this weekend?
records.zomi: Hih kal tawp-in khual khat adingin i pukip theih wheelchair khat na nei hiam?

records.english: When I asked about the tool library, I was told the only ladder was on loan until Friday.
records.zomi: Nasepna van laibu inn tawh kisai ka dot ciangin kahlei khat bek a om a, Laithai ni dong kipukip hi, ci-in hong gen uh hi.

records.english: I asked whether the council could send someone to fix the street light, and they promised to come within ten days.
records.zomi: Lampi meivak bawl dingin council in mi khat a sawl thei hiam cih ka dong a, ni sawm sungin hong ding hi, ci-in a kiciam uh hi.

records.english: I'm calling to check whether the hall has enough chairs for sixty guests.
records.zomi: Inn lian in khual sawmguk adingin tutphah a cing a nei hiam cih en dingin kong sam hi.

records.english: Is the nursery able to take our daughter for three days a week instead of two?
records.zomi: Naupang kemna mun in i tanu kal khat-in ni nih sang-in ni thum a la thei ding hiam?

records.english: Can I reserve a computer at the library, or do I just turn up?
records.zomi: Laibu inn ah computer khat ka koih khol thei ding hiam, a hih kei leh ka hong bek ding hiam?

records.english: Can the vet see our cat today, or is it an emergency-only day?
records.zomi: Ganhing siavuan in tuni-in i zawhngeu a en thei ding hiam, a hih kei leh lauhuai hun bek ni ahi hiam?

records.english: Are there any appointments available at the passport office before the end of the month?
records.zomi: Kha a bei ma-in passport office ah kimuhna awng khat peuh a om hiam?

records.english: Do you know if the mobile library still stops in our village on Fridays?
records.zomi: Pai thei laibu inn Laithai ni-in i khua sungah a khawl lai hiam cih na thei hiam?

records.english: The sports centre has no courts left for Saturday, so we've booked one for Sunday instead.
records.zomi: Kimawlna inn lian in Kiginni adingin kimawlna mun a nei nawn kei ahih manin a sang-in Nipini adingin khat i koih khol uh hi.

records.english: The online booking page says the gym class is full, but it's worth phoning to ask about cancellations.
records.zomi: Online koih kholna page in gym class a dim hi, a ci a, ahi zongin kiphiatna te tawh kisai dong dingin phone sam a phu hi.

records.english: Has anyone booked the town hall's wedding room for a Saturday in October?
records.zomi: October-a Kiginni khat adingin khuapi office' mopawi inndan kuamah in a koih khol khin hiam?

records.english: Will the repair café be open again before Christmas?
records.zomi: Christmas ma-in repair cafe a kihong kik ding hiam?

records.english: The garage can't look at the car until Monday, so I'll take the bus this week.
records.zomi: Garage in Pizing ni dong mawtaw a en thei kei ahih manin hih kal-in bus ka la ding hi.

records.english: Would the fire station be able to show the children around during their school visit?
records.zomi: Naupangte' sang vehna lai-in mei-sih inn in naupangte a sung a lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Does the dentist accept new patients at the moment?
records.zomi: Tu-in ha siavuan in cina thakte a sang hiam?

records.english: Some community centres publish their room bookings online so that anyone can see when a space is free.

records.english: Grandpa's prayer came out of the app sounding like a business letter.

records.english: Thank you for translating the doctor's letter for Grandpa, because the app made it very confusing.

records.english: When my husband's relatives visited, the translation app was on the kitchen table all week.

records.english: Some families use AI translation every day, while others use it only in emergencies.

records.english: My grandparents were surprised that the phone could speak their language.

records.english: Uncle Thang sends long messages to his wife's family through an app, and they reply with lots of hearts.

records.english: Why do you start work an hour before everyone else?

records.english: Some companies let staff choose their own hours, arguing that trust improves motivation.

records.english: Could you look over my tax form before I submit it?

records.english: Let's find out whether we can claim tax relief on the new insulation.

records.english: Our elderly neighbour asked me to explain her tax letter, because it was full of technical words.

records.english: The tax deadline is next week, and Dad hasn't even found his papers.

records.english: Did you include the money from renting out the spare room?

records.english: Our family keeps all its tax papers in one folder, so that nobody panics at tax time.

records.english: My sister started selling cakes online and had to learn how to register as self-employed.

records.english: Running a family shop means dealing with sales tax, payroll tax and income tax.
