records.english: I sent an angry email to my boss once, and I learned to wait a day before replying.
records.zomi: Khatvei ka makaipa kiangah email heh khat ka khak a, dawn ma-in ni khat ngak ka sin hi.

records.english: Can we go through my mistakes in the test together?
records.zomi: Sitna sung-a ka khialhna te i kikhawm-in i en thei ding hiam?

records.english: When the software update failed, the team traced the problem back to a single typing error.
records.zomi: Software update a siat ciangin team in buaina pen type khialhna khat bek pan a hong hi, cih a mu uh hi.

records.english: Thanks for pointing out my mistake before the meeting.
records.zomi: Kikhopna ma-in ka khialhna hong lak manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Is it all right to ask the teacher again if I still don't understand?
records.zomi: Ka theisiam nai kei leh saya kik-in ka dong leh a hoih hiam?

records.english: The best managers treat mistakes as chances to improve the system, not to blame people.
records.zomi: Manager hoih pen te in khialhna te mi mawhsak nading hi lo-in dan hoihsak nading hun-in a mu uh hi.

records.english: How do you remember not to make the same mistake again?
records.zomi: Khialhna kibang kik-in bawl lo dingin bangci-in na phawk hiam?

records.english: I write it on a sticky note and keep it on my screen for a month.
records.zomi: Sticky note khat tungah ka gelh a, kha khat sung ka screen tungah ka kem hi.

records.english: Next time, I'll ask for feedback before the work is finished.
records.zomi: A nungzui-ah nasep a zawh ma-in ngaihsutna ka ngen ding hi.

records.english: I forgot to back up my work and lost a week of research.
records.zomi: Ka nasep back up ka mangngilh a, kal khat kankanna ka mansuah hi.

records.english: A good apprentice asks questions instead of guessing.
records.zomi: Khutsiam kisinpa hoih khat in ngaihsun sang-in dotna a dong hi.

records.english: Learning from mistakes requires time to think, which busy workplaces don't always allow.
records.zomi: Khialhna pan sin in ngaihsun nading hun a ngai a, tua buai nasepna te in a phal den kei hi.

records.english: Our school encourages pupils to redo a piece of work after they get feedback.
records.zomi: I sang in ngaihsutna a ngah khit uh ciangin sangnaupangte nasep khat kik-in bawl dingin a hanthawn hi.

records.english: I learned more from my failed interview than from the job I got afterwards.
records.zomi: Ka ngah nasep sangin ka zawh loh interview pan tam zaw ka sin hi.

records.english: I mixed up two orders at the warehouse, so now I check the labels twice.
records.zomi: Van koihna inn ah order nih ka kihelsak ahih manin tu-in label te nihvei ka en hi.

records.english: Why don't you read your answers again before you hand them in?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na piak ma-in na dawnna te kik-in na sim kei hiam?

records.english: We lost the debate because we had prepared our own arguments thoroughly but ignored the other side's.
records.zomi: Eimah kipsakna thu dawm takin i kiginsak uh a, lam dang' thu i limsak loh manin kiniamna i zo kei uh hi.

records.english: Are you angry that I sent the wrong file to the client?
records.zomi: Khualzin kiangah file khial ka khak manin na heh hiam?

records.english: No, but let's call them now and send the right one.
records.zomi: Heh lo hi, ahi zongin tu-in sam unla a dik khak ni.

records.english: Our team meets every Friday to talk about what went wrong and what went well.
records.zomi: I team in Laithai ni simin bang a khial a, bang a hoih hiam cih kihoupih dingin a kikhop hi.

records.english: Pilots and surgeons use checklists because even experts make simple mistakes.
records.zomi: Siam mite zong in khialhna baihlam a bawl uh ahih manin vanleng tawlpate leh zatui siavuante in checklist a zang uh hi.

records.english: The company rewrote its training programme after a new employee made a costly but entirely understandable mistake.
records.zomi: Nasem thak khat in a man sang a, ahi zongin a theisiam theih khialhna khat a bawl khit ciangin company in a kisinsakna programme kik-in a gelh hi.

records.english: A failed exam showed me that I had been studying the wrong way.
records.zomi: Sitna zawh lohna khat in dan khial tawh ka kisin hi, cih hong lak hi.

records.english: Don't hide your mistakes from your supervisor, because they're easier to fix early.
records.zomi: Na khialhna te na supervisor pan selh kei in, bang hang hiam cih leh a manlang-in bawlkik a baih zaw hi.

records.english: Did the experiment fail because of the temperature?
records.zomi: Sat leh vot hangin kisitna a siat hiam?

records.english: Probably, so we'll repeat it with a thermometer in the water this time.
records.zomi: Kha ding hi, tua ahih manin tui sungah thermometer khat tawh kik-in i bawl ding uh hi.

records.english: Why did the teacher give our tests back without marks?
records.zomi: Bang hangin saya in mark om lo-in i sitna te hong pia kik hiam?

records.english: She wanted us to correct our own mistakes before we saw the scores.
records.zomi: Mark i muh ma-un i khialhna te eimah in bawlkik dingin a deih hi.

records.english: Every engineer on our team has broken something important at least once.
records.zomi: I team-a engineer khempeuh in a tawm pen-in khatvei van thupi khat a siatsak khin uh hi.

records.english: Why do you think the plan didn't work?
records.zomi: Bang hangin plan in na a sem kei hi, na ci hiam?

records.english: My chemistry teacher kept a jar of broken glassware to remind us to be careful.
records.zomi: Ka chemistry saya in kidawm ding hong phawksak nadingin glass kitam um khat a kem hi.

records.english: Shall we try the experiment again with smaller amounts?
records.zomi: Zah neu zaw tawh kisitna kik-in i bawl ding hiam?

records.english: Let's look at the errors one by one and see what caused them.
records.zomi: Khialhna te khat khit khat en unla, bang in a piangsak hiam cih en ni.

records.english: Please tell me straight away if you notice an error in my work.
records.zomi: Ka nasep sungah khialhna khat na muh leh hong gen pah in.

records.english: Students who review their marked homework make fewer mistakes in the exam.
records.zomi: A kiciamteh inn nasep uh a en kik sangnaupangte in sitna-ah khialhna tawm zaw a bawl uh hi.

records.english: I lost marks for not showing my working, so now I write every step.
records.zomi: Ka bawl dan ka lak loh manin mark ka mansuah ahih manin tu-in kalsuan khempeuh ka gelh hi.

records.english: Our manager laughed about his own first presentation, which went completely wrong.
records.zomi: I manager in a bup-in a siat a presentation masa pen tawh kisai a nui hi.

records.english: My tutor circled the same error in three essays before I finally noticed it.
records.zomi: Ka tawp-in ka muh ma-in ka saya in essay thum sungah khialhna kibang a kual hi.

records.english: Although the project failed, it taught the whole team how to manage risk far more carefully.
records.zomi: Project a siat zongin team bup lauhuaina bangci-in dawm zaw mahmah-in vaihawm ding hiam cih a sinsak hi.

records.english: If I hadn't missed that first deadline, I would never have learned to plan my time.
records.zomi: Tua hun tawp masa pen ka mansuah kei leh ka hun ciamteh ka sin ngei lo ding hi.

records.english: Who is allowed to give medicine to the children at nursery?
records.zomi: Naupang kemna mun ah naupangte kua in damdawi a pia thei hiam?

records.english: At our school, pupils may not carry painkillers in their bags and must hand them in at the office.
records.zomi: I sang ah sangnaupangte in natna kiamsak damdawi a ip uh sungah a paipih kei ding uh a, office ah a pia kul uh hi.

records.english: During my first week as a pharmacy trainee, I nearly gave a customer the wrong strength of tablets.
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakna-a kisin nasem ka hih kal masa pen-in khualzin khat damdawi hatna khial ka pia dek hi.

records.english: The pharmacist noticed and asked me to read the prescription aloud with her.
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakpa in a mu a, amah tawh damdawi lai aw ngingtakin sim dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: Now I teach every new trainee to read the prescription aloud before handing anything over.
records.zomi: Tu-in kisin nasem thak khempeuh bangpeuh a piak ma-un damdawi lai aw ngingtakin sim dingin ka sinsak hi.

records.english: I keep a copy of my prescription in my desk drawer in case I need a refill.
records.zomi: Damdawi beh ka kul leh nadingin ka taupi khawlmuh sungah ka damdawi lai copy khat ka kem hi.

records.english: My work phone reminds me about my afternoon dose.
records.zomi: Ka nasep phone in ka sun nung lam damdawi hong phawksak hi.

records.english: Clear medication instructions protect both the pupil and the member of staff who gives the dose.
records.zomi: Damdawi thuhilhna tak te in sangnaupang leh damdawi a pia nasempa a kem hi.

records.english: Some medicines can affect concentration, which matters for students sitting long exams.
records.zomi: Damdawi khenkhat in lungsim koih khawmna a khoih thei a, tua in sitna sau sit sangnaupangte adingin a thupi hi.

records.english: Are the children's medicines packed for the camping trip?
records.zomi: Puan inn khualzinna adingin naupangte' damdawi kikoih khin hiam?

records.english: Teachers on the school trip carried a copy of each child's medicine instructions.
records.zomi: Sang khualzinna-a sayate in naupang khatciat' damdawi thuhilhna copy khat a paipih uh hi.

records.english: The nursery asked us to label the bottle with our daughter's name and the dose.
records.zomi: Naupang kemna mun in um tungah i tanu' min leh damdawi zah ciamteh dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: Our school sends home a form every September asking about pupils' medicines.
records.zomi: I sang in September simin sangnaupangte' damdawi tawh kisai dotna form khat inn ah a khak hi.

records.english: The label on my new tablets says to avoid strong sunlight, which is hard for an outdoor worker like me.
records.zomi: Ka damdawi thak tunga label in ni tang hat pelh ding hi, a ci a, tua in ka bang pualam nasem adingin a haksa hi.

records.english: New staff are trained to use an adrenaline pen in case a pupil has a severe allergic reaction.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang khat in allergy lauhuai a neih leh nasem thakte adrenaline pen zat dingin kisinsak uh hi.

records.english: The doctor wrote a letter explaining that I need to eat at regular times because of my medication.
records.zomi: Ka damdawi hangin hun kiciamteh-in an ka nek kul hi, ci-in siavuan in laikhak khat a gelh hi.

records.english: Can the school give my son his eye drops at lunchtime?
records.zomi: Sang in sun an hun-in ka tapa a mit damdawi a pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, if you fill in the medicine form and bring the drops to the office in their original box.
records.zomi: Thei hi, damdawi form na dimsak leh mit damdawi a bawm tawh office ah na paipih leh.

records.english: The pharmacist printed the instructions in large letters for the elderly teacher.
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakpa in saya upa adingin thuhilhna te laimal lian tawh a print hi.

records.english: Could you remind me to take my antibiotics at lunchtime?
records.zomi: Sun an hun-in ka antibiotics ne dingin hong phawksak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Because the instructions warned against operating machinery, I arranged to swap shifts with a colleague for the first week.
records.zomi: Thuhilhna in khawl zang lo dingin a kidopsak ahih manin kal masa pen adingin nasem pih khat tawh shift kikhek dingin ka vaihawm hi.

records.english: Have you brought your son's medicine for the school trip?
records.zomi: Sang khualzinna adingin na tapa' damdawi na paipih hiam?

records.english: Don't keep your medicine in the car, because it gets too hot in summer.
records.zomi: Khal-in a sat lua ahih manin na damdawi mawtaw sungah kem kei in.

records.english: I take half a tablet before a long shift and half after it, as the doctor instructed.
records.zomi: Siavuan' thuhilhna bang-in shift sau ma-in damdawi a kim ka ne a, a khit ciangin a kim ka ne hi.

records.english: Our first-aid officer keeps a list of staff who carry emergency medication.
records.zomi: I first-aid nasempa in lauhuai hun damdawi a paipih nasemte' ciamtehna khat a kem hi.

records.english: Pupils with diabetes may need to eat snacks in class, and their teachers should know this.
records.zomi: Diabetes nei sangnaupangte in class sungah an neuno a ne kul kha uh a, a sayate in tua a thei ding uh hi.

records.english: The label says to take one tablet with food, so I eat a sandwich first.
records.zomi: Label in an tawh damdawi khat ne ding hi, a ci ahih manin sandwich khat ka ne masa hi.

records.english: Staff on this site must report any medication that could make them drowsy.
records.zomi: Hih mun-a nasemte in ihmut hong sak thei damdawi khat peuh a theisak kul uh hi.

records.english: My doctor timed my tablets so that they wouldn't make me sleepy at work.
records.zomi: Nasepna-ah hong ihmut sak lo nadingin ka siavuan in ka damdawi hun a ciamteh hi.

records.english: Night workers sometimes need help planning when to take medicines that are usually taken in the morning.
records.zomi: Zan nasemte in a tavuan-in zingsang-a kine damdawi te bang hun-in ne ding hiam cih ciamteh nadingin huhna a kul zel uh hi.

records.english: My colleague takes his tablets at exactly ten o'clock every morning.
records.zomi: Ka nasem pih in zingsang simin nai 10 taktak-in a damdawi a ne hi.

records.english: Where can I keep my insulin at work?
records.zomi: Nasepna-ah ka insulin koi-ah ka kem thei ding hiam?

records.english: There's a fridge in the first-aid room that only staff with a key can open.
records.zomi: First-aid inndan sungah tawh nei nasemte bek in a hon theih fridge khat a om hi.

records.english: Please don't share your painkillers with colleagues, even if they ask.
records.zomi: Nasem pihte in a ngen zongin na natna kiamsak damdawi amaute tawh hawm kei in.

records.english: When does the next dose need to be given?
records.zomi: Damdawi nungzui bang hun-in kipia kul hiam?

records.english: Read the leaflet before your first dose, especially the part about side effects.
records.zomi: Na damdawi masa pen na nek ma-in laithei sim in, a tuamtuam-in a gah dang tawh kisai mun.

records.english: Instructions in several languages helped the parents understand the school's medicine policy.
records.zomi: Pau tuamtuam-a thuhilhna te in nu leh pate sang' damdawi thukhun a theisiam sak hi.

records.english: Students with medical conditions should give the school clear written instructions.
records.zomi: Cidamna buaina nei sangnaupangte in sang kiangah kigelh thuhilhna tak te a pia ding uh hi.

records.english: Is it all right to take these with coffee?
records.zomi: Hih te coffee tawh ka ne leh a hoih hiam?

records.english: Do I need to tell my boss about my new medication?
records.zomi: Ka damdawi thak tawh kisai ka makaipa kiangah ka gen kul hiam?

records.english: Only if it affects your safety or your work, but otherwise it's your choice.
records.zomi: Na lauhuai lohna a hih kei leh na nasep a khoih leh bek, a hih kei leh nangmah teelna ahi hi.

records.english: Please sign the form each time you give a pupil medicine.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang khat damdawi na piak simin form signature in.

records.english: The camp leader read the medicine instructions twice before giving the children their doses.
records.zomi: Puan inn kikhopna makaipa in naupangte damdawi a piak ma-in damdawi thuhilhna nihvei a sim hi.

records.english: Did the school call you about the missed dose?
records.zomi: Damdawi a mansuah tawh kisai sang in hong sam hiam?

records.english: Is it safe to drive the forklift on these tablets?
records.zomi: Hih damdawi te tawh forklift tawl a lauhuai lo hiam?

records.english: No, they can cause drowsiness, so you'll need lighter duties for a few days.
records.zomi: Lauhuai hi, ihmut a piangsak thei ahih manin ni tawm khat sung nasep zang zaw na kul ding hi.

records.english: The school nurse keeps every pupil's medicine in a locked cabinet with their name on it.
records.zomi: Sang nurse in sangnaupang khatciat' damdawi a min om-in kikhak bawm sungah a kem hi.

records.english: I forgot my tablets at home, so I went back for them at lunch.
records.zomi: Ka damdawi te inn ah ka mangngilh ahih manin sun an-in ka va la kik hi.

records.english: My manager lets me take a short break to take my medicine.
records.zomi: Ka manager in ka damdawi ne dingin tawlngakna tomno khat hong la sak hi.

records.english: Can I take my eye drops during the exam?
records.zomi: Sitna lai-in ka mit damdawi ka nuh thei hiam?

records.english: The care home trains every new worker to follow the medication charts exactly.
records.zomi: Upate kemna inn in nasem thak khempeuh damdawi chart te a dik takin zui dingin a sinsak hi.

records.english: The pharmacist warned me that the tablets might affect my reaction time on the building site.
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakpa in damdawi te in inn lamna mun-ah ka kidawnna hun a khoih kha thei hi, ci-in hong kidopsak hi.

records.english: The new medicine made me so tired that I fell asleep at my desk.
records.zomi: Damdawi thak in hong gim mahmah sak ahih manin ka taupi-ah ka ihmu hi.

records.english: When should I take the tablet if I work nights?
records.zomi: Zan-in na ka sep leh bang hun-in damdawi ka ne ding hiam?

records.english: Take it at the same point in your day, such as when you wake up, whatever the clock says.
records.zomi: Nai-et in bang a ci zongin na ni sung hun kibang, na thou ciang bang, in ne in.

records.english: Please hand in the box as well as the medicine, so the office can read the instructions.
records.zomi: Office in thuhilhna a sim theih nadingin damdawi bek hi lo-in a bawm zong pia in.

records.english: My boss was very understanding when I explained the side effects of my new medicine.
records.zomi: Ka damdawi thak' gah dangte ka gen ciangin ka makaipa a theisiam mahmah hi.

records.english: Thank you for reminding me about my tablets during the meeting.
records.zomi: Kikhopna lai-in ka damdawi hong phawksak manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Write the time of each dose in the logbook, please.
records.zomi: Logbook sungah damdawi khatciat' hun gelh in.

records.english: The coach checked that the player's asthma spray was in the kit bag before every match.
records.zomi: Kimawlna khempeuh ma-in coach in kimawlpa' asthma spray kit bag sungah a om hiam cih a en hi.

records.english: When the council repaired the footpath, Grandpa could finally walk to the shops again.
records.zomi: Council in khe lampi a bawlkik ciangin Pu sumbuk ah khe-in a pai kik thei tawp hi.

records.english: Is there any money for repairing the bridge to Grandma's village?
records.zomi: Pi' khua pai lei bawlkik nading sum a om hiam?

records.english: Because of the library cuts, my children can no longer use the computers there after school.
records.zomi: Laibu inn sum kiamsakna hangin ka tate sang khit ciangin tua-a computer te a zang thei nawn kei uh hi.

records.english: Even small savings in public spending can mean a long wait for families who need help.
records.zomi: Mipite' sum zatna-a khol neute zong in huhna a kul innkuante adingin ngakna sau a suaksak thei hi.

records.english: When the council cut the youth club's budget, our son lost the one after-school activity that had kept him out of trouble.
records.zomi: Council in tangvalte' kipawlna sum a kiamsak ciangin i tapa in buaina pan a kem sang khit nasep khat bek a mansuah hi.

records.english: Who pays for the free school meals?
records.zomi: A man om lo sang an man kua in a pia hiam?

records.english: The money comes from public funds, which mostly come from taxes.
records.zomi: Sum pen mipite' sum pan a hong a, tua a tamzaw siah pan a hong hi.

records.english: The free bus pass has made a big difference to my grandparents.
records.zomi: Man om lo bus pass in ka pu leh pi adingin kibang lohna lian khat a bawl hi.

records.english: My daughter's class raised money for books because the school budget had run out.
records.zomi: Sang' sum a bei ahih manin ka tanu' class in laibu adingin sum a kaikhawm uh hi.

records.english: Public budgets seem far away until a service your family uses is cut.
records.zomi: Mipite' sum zatna te na innkuan in a zat nasepna khat a kiamsak mateng gamla bang-in a kilang hi.

records.english: Did you see the article about how much the new town hall cost?
records.zomi: Khuapi office thak bangzah a man hiam cih tawh kisai thuthak na sim hiam?

records.english: Our children's school had to cancel its music lessons because of budget cuts.
records.zomi: Sum kiamsakna hangin i tate' sang in a la sinna te a phiat kul hi.

records.english: Why are they closing the library where Grandma goes every week?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pi kal simin a pai laibu inn a khak uh hiam?

records.english: The council says it can't afford to keep three libraries open, so it's keeping the two busiest.
records.zomi: Laibu inn thum hong lai ding a man ka pia thei kei hi, ci-in council in a gen a, tua ahih manin a buai pen nih a kem hi.

records.english: Why does the council have money for new flower beds but not for the children's clinic?
records.zomi: Bang hangin council in pak huan thak adingin sum a nei a, naupangte' clinic adingin a nei kei hiam?

records.english: Do you know how much of our property tax goes to schools?
records.zomi: I inn leh lo siah bangzah in sang te ah a pai hiam cih na thei hiam?

records.english: Would you pay a little more tax if it meant the library stayed open?
records.zomi: Laibu inn a kihon lai nadingin siah tawm khat beh na pia ding hiam?

records.english: Let's go to the residents' meeting and ask about the plans for the park.
records.zomi: Teng mite' kikhopna ah pai-in park plan te tawh kisai i dong ni.

records.english: Has the council said whether the sports centre will reopen?
records.zomi: Kimawlna inn lian a kihong kik ding hiam cih council in a gen khin hiam?

records.english: Families with disabled children depend heavily on services paid for by public budgets.
records.zomi: Ci-na naupang nei innkuante in mipite' sum tawh kipia nasepna te tungah a kinga mahmah uh hi.

records.english: Our family voted for a new bench by the river in the council's community budget vote.
records.zomi: Council' khuasung sum vote ah i innkuan in lui gei-ah tutphah sau thak khat adingin vote a uh hi.

records.english: Thanks to a council grant, our church hall now has a ramp for Grandpa's wheelchair.
records.zomi: Council sum huhna hangin i pawlpi inn lian in tu-in Pu' wheelchair adingin ramp khat a nei hi.

records.english: Our neighbour, who used to be an accountant, helped us understand the council's spending plan.
records.zomi: Sum ciamtehpa a hih ngei i inn veng in council' sum zatna plan i theisiam nadingin hong huh hi.

records.english: The street lights in our road are switched off at midnight to save money.
records.zomi: Sum khol nadingin i lampi-a lampi meivak te zanlai-in a kimit hi.

records.english: Retired residents like my grandparents often have the most time to attend budget meetings.
records.zomi: Ka pu leh pi bang a tawlngak teng mite in sum kikhopna te-ah pai nading hun tam pen a nei zel uh hi.

records.english: Mum is worried that cuts to the care budget will affect Grandma's home visits.
records.zomi: Kemna sum kiamsakna in Pi' inn-a vehna te a khoih ding hi, ci-in Nu a lungkham hi.

records.english: Grandma still remembers when the town built its first public swimming pool.
records.zomi: Khuapi in a mipite' tuipeek mun masa pen a lam ni Pi in a phawk lai hi.

records.english: My grandparents' care home is paid for partly by the council and partly by their savings.
records.zomi: Ka pu leh pi' upate kemna inn' man council in khenkhat a pia a, a sum khol uh in khenkhat a pia hi.

records.english: Public budgets affect families in small ways, from street lighting to school buses.
records.zomi: Mipite' sum zatna te in lampi meivak pan sang bus dong innkuante lampi neute-in a khoih hi.

records.english: Mum thinks the council wastes money on big events, but Dad enjoys them.
records.zomi: Council in kikhopna lian te-ah sum a mangsak hi, ci-in Nu in a ngaihsun a, ahi zongin Pa in a deih hi.

records.english: The council's decision to keep the nursery open was a great relief to young families like ours.
records.zomi: Naupang kemna mun a kihon lai nadingin council' thukhensatna in ei bang innkuan neute adingin lungnuamna lian ahi hi.

records.english: Did you go to the budget meeting at the town hall last night?
records.zomi: Zan-in khuapi office-a sum kikhopna ah na pai hiam?

records.english: Yes, and I asked why the bus to our village was cut.
records.zomi: Pai hi, bang hangin i khua pai bus kiphiat hiam cih ka dong hi.

records.zomi: Ka pi' Laisiangtho lui in Late khempeuh dek a gei-ah ciamtehna te a nei hi.

records.english: Grandma reads a psalm every morning before breakfast.
records.zomi: Pi in zingsang simin zingsang an ma-in Late khat a sim hi.

records.english: Do you know the story of David and Goliath?
records.zomi: David leh Goliath tangthu na thei hiam?

records.english: Our children love the story of Noah and the ark.
records.zomi: I tate in Noah leh tembaw lian tangthu a deih mahmah uh hi.

records.english: Reading the Old Testament helps me understand the background to many of Jesus' teachings.
records.zomi: Thukham Lui sim in Jesu' sinsakna tampi nung-a thute hong theisiam sak hi.

records.english: My Bible has maps that show where the Old Testament events took place.
records.zomi: Ka Laisiangtho in Thukham Lui thu piang te koi-ah a piang hiam cih a lak map te a nei hi.

records.english: Who led the Israelites out of Egypt?
records.zomi: Isael mite Izipt gam pan kua in a paikhia hiam?

records.english: Moses, according to the Book of Exodus.
records.zomi: Moses, Paikhiatna laibu bang-in.

records.english: The Old Testament includes history, poetry, law and prophecy.
records.zomi: Thukham Lui sungah tangthu, la, thukham leh kamsang thu a kihel hi.

records.english: The Exodus story is remembered by many people as a story of freedom from slavery.
records.zomi: Paikhiatna tangthu mi tampi in sila hihna pan suahtakna tangthu-in a phawk uh hi.

records.english: Does the Old Testament talk about God's love, or only about his laws?
records.zomi: Thukham Lui in Pasian' itna a gen hiam, a thukham te bek a gen hiam?

records.english: Let's read the story of Joseph and his brothers tonight.
records.zomi: Tuzan-in Joseph leh a u le naute tangthu sim ni.

records.english: What is the first book of the Old Testament?
records.zomi: Thukham Lui' laibu masa pen bang hiam?

records.english: Genesis, which begins with the story of creation.
records.zomi: Piancilna, piansakna tangthu tawh a kipan pa.

records.english: Can you find the Book of Ruth for me?
records.zomi: Ruth laibu hong zong sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Is Genesis the oldest book in the Bible?
records.zomi: Piancilna pen Laisiangtho sung-a laibu lui pen ahi hiam?

records.english: Which part of the Old Testament do you read most often?
records.zomi: Thukham Lui' bang khen na sim tam pen hiam?

records.english: The Psalms, because they put my own prayers into words.
records.zomi: Late, bang hang hiam cih leh ka thungetna te kammal-in a koih hi.

records.english: Is the Old Testament the same as the Jewish Bible?
records.zomi: Thukham Lui pen Judah mite' Laisiangtho tawh a kibang hiam?

records.english: Mostly, although the books are arranged in a different order.
records.zomi: A tamzaw kibang hi, laibu te a kizui dan kibang lo zongin.

records.english: The Book of Psalms is the longest book in the Bible.
records.zomi: Late laibu pen Laisiangtho sung-a laibu sau pen ahi hi.

records.english: Our church reads one passage from the Old Testament and one from the New every Sunday.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in Nipini simin Thukham Lui pan mun khat leh Thukham Thak pan mun khat a sim hi.

records.english: The creation story in Genesis is read in different ways by different Christians.
records.zomi: Piancilna sung-a piansakna tangthu Khristian tuamtuam in lampi tuamtuam-in a sim uh hi.

records.english: Have you ever read the whole Old Testament?
records.zomi: Thukham Lui bup na sim ngei hiam?

records.english: Our pastor is preaching through the Book of Genesis this autumn.
records.zomi: Hih phalbi ma-in i pastor in Piancilna laibu bup a sinsak hi.

records.english: Christians and Jews share many of the same scriptures, although they read them differently.
records.zomi: Khristiante leh Judah mite in Laisiangtho kibang tampi a kihawm uh a, a sim dan uh a kibang kei hi.

records.english: Some parts of the Old Testament are difficult to understand without knowing their history.
records.zomi: Thukham Lui' khen khenkhat a tangthu theih lo-in theisiam a haksa hi.

records.english: Our youth group acted out the story of Esther at the church festival.
records.zomi: I tangvalte' pawl in pawlpi pawi ah Esther tangthu a lak uh hi.

records.english: The Book of Proverbs is full of short sayings about wisdom and everyday life.
records.zomi: Paunak laibu pilna leh ni sim nuntakna tawh kisai kammal tom te tawh a dim hi.

records.english: Our son asked why Jonah was swallowed by a big fish.
records.zomi: Bang hangin Jonah ngapi in a valh hiam cih i tapa in a dong hi.

records.english: Some of the stories in the Old Testament are violent, which troubles many readers.
records.zomi: Thukham Lui sung-a tangthu khenkhat a hiam a, tua in sim mi tampi a lungkhamsak hi.

records.english: The Old Testament is the first part of the Christian Bible.
records.zomi: Thukham Lui pen Khristian Laisiangtho' khen masa pen ahi hi.

records.english: My aunt says the Book of Ruth is the most beautiful story about loyalty she knows.
records.zomi: Ruth laibu pen a theih kizahna tangthu hoih pen ahi hi, ci-in ka ni in a gen hi.

records.english: The Ten Commandments are found in the books of Exodus and Deuteronomy.
records.zomi: Thukham Sawm te Paikhiatna leh Thukham Kikhiatna laibu te sungah a om hi.

records.english: According to the Book of Daniel, Daniel was thrown into a den of lions.
records.zomi: Daniel laibu bang-in Daniel humpi kua sungah kiseh hi.

records.english: Solomon is remembered in the Old Testament for his wisdom.
records.zomi: Thukham Lui sungah Solomon a pilna hangin kiphawk hi.

records.english: The prophets in the Old Testament often called people back to justice and faithfulness.
records.zomi: Thukham Lui-a Pasian kamsangte in mite thudikna leh muanhuaina-ah a sam kik zel uh hi.

records.english: Children often remember the story of the burning bush, where God spoke to Moses.
records.zomi: Naupangte in Pasian in Moses kiangah a pauna lopa kang tangthu a phawk zel uh hi.

records.english: The Old Testament was written mostly in Hebrew, with a few passages in Aramaic.
records.zomi: Thukham Lui a tamzaw Hebrew pau tawh kigelh a, mun tawm khat Aramaic pau tawh kigelh hi.

records.english: Old Testament stories are often taught to children through pictures and songs.
records.zomi: Thukham Lui tangthu te naupangte lim leh la tawh kisinsak zel hi.

records.english: Elijah is one of the best-known prophets in the Old Testament.
records.zomi: Elijah pen Thukham Lui-a Pasian kamsang minthang pen khat ahi hi.

records.english: Christians believe that God made a covenant with Abraham, as Genesis describes.
records.zomi: Piancilna in a gen bang-in Pasian in Abraham tawh thuciam a bawl hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: Grandpa knows the Twenty-third Psalm by heart.
records.zomi: Pu in Late 23 a phawk ngiat hi.

records.english: Please read the passage from Isaiah slowly, so everyone can follow.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh in a zuih theih nadingun Isaiah pan mun zawi takin sim in.

records.english: Is the Book of Psalms in the Old Testament or the New?
records.zomi: Late laibu Thukham Lui sungah hiam, Thukham Thak sungah a om hiam?

records.english: Shall we learn the names of the Old Testament books in order?
records.zomi: Thukham Lui laibu te' min a kizui-in i sin ding hiam?

records.english: The Book of Job asks why good people suffer.
records.zomi: Job laibu in bang hangin mi hoih te a thuak uh hiam cih a dong hi.

records.english: Many Christians see promises in the Old Testament that they believe are fulfilled in Jesus.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in Thukham Lui sungah Jesu-ah a tangtung hi, ci-in a um kiciamna te a mu uh hi.

records.english: Why do Christians read the Old Testament?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Khristiante in Thukham Lui a sim uh hiam?

records.english: They believe it tells the story of God's relationship with his people and prepares the way for Jesus.
records.zomi: Pasian leh a mite' kizopna tangthu a gen a, Jesu adingin lampi a kiginsak hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Protestant Bibles have thirty-nine books in the Old Testament, while Catholic and Orthodox Bibles include several more.
records.zomi: Protestant Laisiangtho te in Thukham Lui sungah laibu sawmthum le kua a nei a, Catholic leh Orthodox Laisiangtho te in a dang khenkhat a behlap uh hi.

records.english: We sang a song based on Psalm 100 at church on Sunday.
records.zomi: Nipini-in pawlpi ah Late 100 tungah kinga la khat i sa uh hi.

records.english: My Sunday school teacher remembers every child's birthday.
records.zomi: Ka Nipini sang saya in naupang khempeuh' suahni a phawk hi.

records.english: Can I ask you something privately after the class?
records.zomi: Class khit ciangin guk-in bangkhat kong dong thei ding hiam?

records.english: May I leave ten minutes early to catch the last bus?
records.zomi: Bus nunung pen ka mat theih nadingin minit sawm ma-in ka paisan thei ding hiam?

records.english: Thank you for being so patient with me.
records.zomi: Kei tungah na thuakzawh mahmah manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: The art teacher praised the colours in my painting in front of the whole class.
records.zomi: Lim saya in class bup mai-ah ka lim sung-a pianzia te a phat hi.

records.english: My driving instructor explains each mistake calmly, even when I'm nervous.
records.zomi: Ka mawtaw tawl sinsakpa in ka lau ciang zongin khialhna khatciat dai takin a gen hi.

records.english: Tell me what you found hardest today.
records.zomi: Tuni-in bang na haksa sa pen hiam cih hong gen in.

records.english: Don't worry about neatness for now; just get your ideas down.
records.zomi: Tu-in siangtho lohna lungkham kei in, na ngaihsutna te gelh bek in.

records.english: Our first-aid trainer asked each of us why we had joined the course.
records.zomi: I first-aid sinsakpa in bang hangin sinna-ah i kihel uh hiam cih i khatciat hong dong hi.

records.english: A volunteer tutor who listens well can give a learner the confidence to keep going.
records.zomi: Hoih taka a ngaikhia thalawp saya khat in sinmi khat a pai suak theihna hanna a pia thei hi.

records.english: Please tell me if I'm speaking too fast.
records.zomi: Ka pau manlang lua leh hong gen in.

records.english: Am I too old to start piano lessons?
records.zomi: Piano sinna kipat dingin ka upa lua hiam?

records.english: My oldest student started at seventy-two, so I don't think so.
records.zomi: Ka sangnaupang upa pen kum sawmsagih le nih-in a kipan ahih manin ka ngaihsun kei hi.

records.english: Our cooking teacher asks us to taste each other's food and say one kind thing.
records.zomi: I an huan saya in khat leh khat' an tep-in thu nem khat gen dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: Can you show me again how to log in to the library computer?
records.zomi: Laibu inn computer ah bangci-in lut ding hiam cih hong lak kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: How can I tell you if I'm finding the class too fast?
records.zomi: Class a manlang lua ka kisak leh bangci-in kong gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: You can catch me at the break or write it on the feedback card.
records.zomi: Tawlngak hun-in hong mu thei a, a hih kei leh ngaihsutna card tungah gelh thei hi.

records.english: Could I have a copy of today's handout to take home?
records.zomi: Inn ah paipih dingin tuni-a laithei copy khat ka ngah thei ding hiam?

records.english: I'm sorry I didn't do the homework, but I had a very busy week at work.
records.zomi: Ka inn nasep ka bawl loh manin maisakna ka ngen hi, ahi zongin nasepna-ah kal buai mahmah khat ka nei hi.

records.english: Our art teacher sends photos of our work to the group so everyone can see their progress.
records.zomi: I lim saya in mi khempeuh in a khanna uh a muh theih nadingin i nasep photo te pawl ah a khak hi.

records.english: The volunteer teacher wrote her phone number on the board in case anyone needed help.
records.zomi: Thalawp saya in kuamah in huhna a kul leh nadingin a phone nambat board tungah a gelh hi.

records.english: Is there someone I can talk to if I'm not happy with the course?
records.zomi: Sinna tawh ka lungkim kei leh ka kihoupih theih mi khat a om hiam?

records.english: When I joined the reading class at the library, I was too embarrassed to read aloud.
records.zomi: Laibu inn-a laisimna class-ah ka kihel ciangin aw ngingtakin sim dingin ka zum lua hi.

records.english: My tutor suggested that we read together in a quiet corner before the others arrived.
records.zomi: A dangte a tun ma-un ken dai khat ah i kikhawm-in sim dingin ka saya in a ngen hi.

records.english: After a month, I read a whole page to the group without stopping.
records.zomi: Kha khat khit ciangin pawl kiangah khawl lo-in page khat bup ka sim hi.

records.english: Did I make many mistakes in my driving lesson?
records.zomi: Ka mawtaw tawl sinna-ah khialhna tampi ka bawl hiam?

records.english: Only a few, and your parking has improved a lot since last week.
records.zomi: Tawm khat bek, leh kal bei pan na mawtaw khawl dan a hoih zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: Good community tutors adapt their teaching to the lives of the people in the room.
records.zomi: Khuasung saya hoih te in a sinsakna uh inndan sung-a mite' nuntakna tawh a kilawm sak uh hi.

records.english: Please call me if you can't come, so I don't wait for you.
records.zomi: Na hong thei kei leh hong sam in, kong ngak lo nadingin.

records.english: I told my tutor that I couldn't read well, and she found me easier books without making a fuss.
records.zomi: Laisim hoih takin ka thei kei hi, ci-in ka saya kiangah ka gen a, buai lo-in laibu baih zaw hong zong sak hi.

records.english: When I told the music teacher that I was afraid of performing, she let me play for her alone first.
records.zomi: La lak ka lau hi, ci-in la saya kiangah ka gen ciangin amah bek kiangah masa-in a sak hong phal hi.

records.english: Our coach texts every parent when training is cancelled.
records.zomi: I coach in kisinna a kiphiat ciangin nu leh pa khempeuh kiangah text a khak hi.

records.english: Why did you move me to the other group?
records.zomi: Bang hangin pawl dang ah hong sawn hiam?

records.english: Because you're ready for more of a challenge, and I think you'll enjoy it.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh haksa zaw adingin na kiging khin a, na nuam sa ding hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: I phoned the centre to ask whether the tutor could see me before the exam.
records.zomi: Sitna ma-in saya in hong mu thei hiam cih dong dingin office ka sam hi.

records.english: The library tutor speaks slowly and checks we've understood.
records.zomi: Laibu inn saya in zawi takin a pau a, i theisiam hiam cih a en hi.

records.english: My tutor at the community centre always asks what I want to learn next.
records.zomi: Khuasung inn lian-a ka saya in a nungzui-ah bang sin ka deih hiam cih a dong den hi.

records.english: When the instructor couldn't answer my question, she admitted it openly and promised to find out by the next lesson.
records.zomi: Sinsakpa numei in ka dotna a dawng thei kei ciangin a kilang takin a pulak a, sinna nungzui ma-in thei dingin a kiciam hi.

records.english: The swimming teacher spoke to my son so gently that he stopped crying.
records.zomi: Tuipeek saya in ka tapa nem mahmah-in a kiangah a pau ahih manin a kap khawl hi.

records.english: I finally felt confident enough to ask the instructor to repeat the safety section, although everyone else seemed to understand it.
records.zomi: A dang khempeuh in a theisiam bang-in a kilang zongin lauhuai lohna khen kik-in gen dingin sinsakpa ngen ding ka hanna a tawp-in a cing hi.

records.english: The teacher asked whether anyone needed the handouts in larger print.
records.zomi: Laimal lian zaw tawh laithei a kul mi a om hiam cih saya in a dong hi.

records.english: Some adult learners hide their difficulties because they were made to feel ashamed at school.
records.zomi: Sinmi upa khenkhat in sang ah zum-in kibawl a hih manun a haksatna uh a selh uh hi.

records.english: Did you understand the instructions, or shall I explain them another way?
records.zomi: Thuhilhna te na theisiam hiam, a hih kei leh lampi dang-in kong gen ding hiam?

records.english: I emailed the course leader to say I'd miss two classes.
records.zomi: Class nih ka mansuah ding hi, ci-in sinna makaipa kiangah email ka khak hi.

records.english: Our evening class teacher never makes anyone feel stupid for asking a question.
records.zomi: I nitak class saya in dotna dot manin kuamah a mawl bang-in a kisak sak ngei kei hi.

records.english: The teacher asked us how we preferred to receive feedback, in writing or face to face.
records.zomi: Saya in ngaihsutna laigelh-in hiam, kimaituah-in hiam bang a ngah nop zaw uh hiam cih hong dong hi.

records.english: Is it all right if my grandson sits with me for the first lesson?
records.zomi: Sinna masa pen-ah ka tu pasal kei tawh a tu leh a hoih hiam?

records.english: Write your questions on these cards, and I'll answer them next week.
records.zomi: Hih card te tungah na dotna te gelh in, kal hong tung ding-in ka dawng ding hi.

records.english: Your progress this term has been wonderful, and you should be proud.
records.zomi: Hih term-in na khanna a lamdang mahmah a, na kipak ding hi.

records.english: Learners who feel respected are more likely to come back the following week.
records.zomi: Kizahtak a kisa sinmite in a kal nungzui-ah a hong kik thei zaw uh hi.

records.english: My tutor noticed that I'd stopped coming and sent me a kind message.
records.zomi: Ka hong khawl hi, cih ka saya in a thei a, message nem khat hong khak hi.

records.english: Could you explain the homework again, because I missed the end of the class?
records.zomi: Class tawp ka mansuah ahih manin inn nasep kik-in na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Certainly, and I'll send the instructions to the group chat as well.
records.zomi: Thei hi, thuhilhna te group chat ah zong ka khak ding hi.

records.english: Adult learners often need encouragement as much as instruction.
records.zomi: Sinmi upate in sinsakna bang-in hanthawnna a kul zel uh hi.

records.english: The coach took the time to explain why I hadn't been picked, which made the disappointment much easier to accept.
records.zomi: Coach in bang hangin hong teel lo hiam cih gen dingin hun a la a, tua in lungkhamna a sang baih zaw sak hi.

records.english: Because the learners came from many countries, the tutor checked that her examples made sense to everyone.
records.zomi: Sinmite gam tampi pan a hong uh ahih manin saya in a entehna te mi khempeuh adingin a theisiam theih hiam cih a en hi.

records.english: Could we practise the conversation once more before the end of the class?
records.zomi: Class a tawp ma-in kihoupihna khatvei beh i kisin thei ding hiam?

records.english: Clear, kind communication is the reason many adults finish courses they once feared.
records.zomi: Tak leh nem taka kihoupihna pen upa tampi in a lauh ngeina sinna te a zawh nading a hang ahi hi.

records.english: Your comments on my essay were really helpful.
records.zomi: Ka essay tunga na ngaihsutna te a phattuam mahmah hi.

records.english: Would you mind writing the address of the centre on the board?
records.zomi: Office' teenna mun board tungah na gelh leh na lungkham ding hiam?

records.english: A wrongly labelled bottle can lead to a serious mistake in a busy clinic.
records.zomi: Label khial a kibelh um khat in buai clinic khat sungah khialhna lian khat a piangsak thei hi.

records.english: Which is the right label for the morning tablets?
records.zomi: Zingsang damdawi adingin label dik bang hiam?

records.english: Don't use that bottle, because the label doesn't match the prescription.
records.zomi: Tua um zang kei in, bang hang hiam cih leh label damdawi lai tawh a kituak kei hi.

records.english: Since the label on my eye drops says to keep them cold, I store them in the staff fridge with a note on the bag.
records.zomi: Ka mit damdawi label in vot-in kem in, a ci ahih manin nasemte' fridge sungah ip tungah lai khat tawh ka kem hi.

records.english: I couldn't read the label in the storeroom, so I took the box to the window.
records.zomi: Van koihna inndan sungah label ka sim thei lo ahih manin bawm tawhkhang kiang-ah ka paipih hi.

records.english: Labels with clear warnings help workers decide whether it's safe to do their job.
records.zomi: Kidopna tak nei label te in nasemte a nasep uh a lauhuai lo hiam cih a khensat theih nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Does the label say how long the cream can be kept after opening?
records.zomi: Cream a kihon khit bangzah sawt kem theih hiam cih label in a gen hiam?

records.english: Please don't remove the label from the bottle, even if it's peeling.
records.zomi: Label a kiphel zongin um pan phiat kei in.

records.english: Our school keeps a photocopy of every medicine label in the pupil's file.
records.zomi: I sang in damdawi label khempeuh' photocopy sangnaupang' file sungah a kem hi.

records.english: Who checks the labels before the medicines go out on the ward?
records.zomi: Damdawi te ward ah a pai ma-in label te kua in a en hiam?

records.english: Two nurses check every label against the chart, and both of them sign.
records.zomi: Nurse nih in label khempeuh chart tawh a kiteh uh a, a nih in signature uh hi.

records.english: Is the dose on this label for an adult or a child?
records.zomi: Hih label tunga damdawi zah upa adingin hiam, naupang adingin hiam?

records.english: My colleague explained the label to a patient who couldn't read the local language.
records.zomi: Ka nasem pih in mun-a pau a sim thei lo cina khat kiangah label a gen hi.

records.english: Teachers who give medicine on school trips must check each label carefully.
records.zomi: Sang khualzinna-ah damdawi a pia sayate in label khatciat dawm takin a en ding uh hi.

records.english: The label said the tablets might affect my judgement, so I postponed the important meeting.
records.zomi: Label in damdawi in ka thukhenna a khoih kha thei hi, a ci ahih manin kikhopna thupi ka sawn hi.

records.english: The label says the cream is for external use only, so don't swallow it.
records.zomi: Label in cream pen pualam zat adingin bek ahi hi, a ci ahih manin valh kei in.

records.english: My boss noticed the drowsiness warning on my label and changed my duties for a week.
records.zomi: Ka makaipa in ka label tunga ihmut kidopna a mu a, kal khat sung ka nasep a khek hi.

records.english: Pharmacy students learn to read labels quickly.
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakna sangnaupangte in label manlang takin sim a sin uh hi.

records.english: Clear labels matter even more in workplaces where several people handle the same medicines.
records.zomi: Mi tampi in damdawi kibang a khoih nasepna te-ah label tak te a thupi zaw lai hi.

records.english: Why does the label say not to operate machinery?
records.zomi: Bang hangin label in khawl zang kei in, a ci hiam?

records.english: Because the tablets can make you drowsy, which is dangerous on the factory floor.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh damdawi te in ihmut a piangsak thei a, tua in factory sungah a lauhuai hi.

records.english: Is this the label from the new pharmacy or the old one?
records.zomi: Hih label damdawi zuakna thak pan hiam, a lui pan hiam?

records.english: Take these with water, not with coffee, as the label says.
records.zomi: Label in a gen bang-in hih te coffee tawh hi lo-in tui tawh ne in.

records.english: The label was printed in my first language, which made it much easier to follow at work.
records.zomi: Label ka pau masa pen tawh kisuaksak ahih manin nasepna-ah zui a baih zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: Labels on children's medicines usually give the dose by age or weight.
records.zomi: Naupang damdawi label te in a tamzaw-in damdawi zah kum a hih kei leh gikna tawh a gen hi.

records.english: Have you checked the label on the painkillers in the first-aid kit?
records.zomi: First-aid kit sung-a natna kiamsak damdawi label na en khin hiam?

records.english: The pharmacist added a warning sticker about drowsiness.
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakpa in ihmut tawh kisai kidopna sticker khat a behlap hi.

records.english: The teacher refused to give my son his medicine, quite rightly, because the label had another child's name on it.
records.zomi: Label tungah naupang dang' min a om ahih manin saya in ka tapa a damdawi a pia nuam kei a, tua a dik mahmah hi.

records.english: Night-shift workers sometimes find labels like 'take in the morning' confusing.
records.zomi: Zan shift nasemte in 'zingsang-in ne in' bang label te a buai sa zel uh hi.

records.english: In our care home, any medicine without a clear label is returned to the pharmacy.

records.english: Because the label warns against driving, I've started taking the bus to work, which adds half an hour to my journey.

records.english: Who wrote these instructions on the label?

records.english: Is the label still readable after the bottle got wet?

records.english: On the school trip, a teacher noticed that two children's inhalers had swapped labels.

records.english: She phoned both families before giving either child a dose.

records.english: Since then, the school has kept each child's medicine in a separate named bag.

records.english: The label was too small for the dose instructions, so they came on a separate sheet.

records.english: Please make sure the label shows your child's full name and date of birth.

records.english: Can you read this label for me, because my glasses are in my locker?

records.english: It says one capsule three times a day, after food.

records.english: I left the office party early because my label warned against mixing the tablets with alcohol.

records.english: Care workers are trained to check the label three times before giving any medicine.

records.english: Because the printing had faded, the nursery asked for a new label.

records.english: Read the label aloud, and I'll check it against the chart.

records.english: The camp leader packed each child's medicine with its label facing outwards.

records.english: Check the label before you give the tablets to Mrs. Ciin.

records.english: The warning label on my new prescription says I shouldn't work at heights.

records.english: Does the school need the original pharmacy label on my daughter's inhaler?

records.english: Yes, we can only give medicine that has the child's name and dose printed on it.

records.english: Factory workers are told to report any medicine labelled as causing dizziness.

records.english: Why are there two labels on the same box?

records.english: The pharmacy added a new one when your dose changed, so follow the newer label.

records.english: The nurse highlighted the timing instructions on my label so I wouldn't forget at work.

records.english: Thank you for printing the label in large letters for our older staff.
records.zomi: I nasem upate adingin label laimal lian tawh na suaksak manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: The supply teacher checked the label on the epilepsy medicine before the trip.

records.english: Each label in the care home shows the resident's photo as well as their name.

records.english: Were you frightened when the lift stopped between floors?

records.english: Whistleblowers who expose wrongdoing are sometimes treated as troublemakers by their own employers.

records.english: Ask the manager for more training if you need it.

records.english: Would you have the courage to refuse an unsafe order at work?

records.english: Starting a new job in a country where you barely know anyone takes a special kind of courage.

records.english: I finally told my colleagues that I was struggling, and they were wonderfully supportive.

records.english: The intern questioned the plan in front of the directors, and she turned out to be right.

records.english: Why did you volunteer to give the speech?

records.english: Because I wanted to stop being afraid of speaking in public.

records.english: Facing a classroom of thirty teenagers on my first day was scarier than any exam I had taken.

records.english: The cleaner chased the thief out of the building and then calmly called the police.

records.english: The pupils who refused to join in the teasing showed real courage.

records.english: It takes courage to admit in front of the class that you don't understand.

records.english: It took me three months to find the courage to resign.

records.english: The bus driver kept the passengers calm until the police arrived.

records.english: She asked her boss for a pay rise with shaking hands.

records.english: Moral courage at work can mean refusing to sign figures you know are false.

records.english: Nurses on the night shift often face frightening situations with very little support.
records.zomi: Zan shift-a nurse te huhna tawm mahmah tawh dinmun lauhuai te a thuak zel uh hi.

records.english: Can you be brave and go into the exam room on your own?

records.english: It takes nerve to disagree with your teacher in front of the class.
records.zomi: Class mai-ah na saya tawh kilem lo-in gen hanna a ngai hi.

records.english: The pupil told the teacher that a classmate was carrying a knife.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang khat in class lawm khat in namsau khat a paipih hi, ci-in saya kiangah a gen hi.

records.english: The new employee pointed out a safety problem on her first day, which impressed the whole team.

records.english: You were brave to report the bullying.

records.english: When the factory was about to close, the workers found the courage to demand a meeting with the owners.
records.zomi: Factory a kikhak dek ciangin nasemte in a neite tawh kikhopna ngen dingin hanna a ngah uh hi.

records.english: The youngest member of the team was the only one who asked the difficult question.

records.english: Our son was brave enough to tell his teacher that he was being bullied online.

records.english: Let's go and talk to the head teacher together.
records.zomi: Sangpi saya kiangah i kikhawm-in va kihoupih ni.

records.english: The apprentice was afraid of heights, but she climbed the scaffolding with her supervisor beside her.
records.zomi: Khutsiam kisin numei mun sang a lau a, ahi zongin a supervisor a kiang-ah om-in mun sang-a kahna a kah hi.

records.english: I'm proud of you for presenting in front of the whole school.
records.zomi: Sang bup mai-ah na lak manin ka kipak hi.

records.english: Did anyone stand up for the new girl?

records.english: How did you find the courage to report your manager?

records.english: I kept thinking about the younger staff who were too scared to say anything.

records.english: Taking sick leave for stress took more courage than I expected, because I hated letting the team down.

records.english: Why do students who take risks with their ideas often learn the most?

records.english: The shy pupil read her poem aloud at the school assembly.
records.zomi: Zum sangnaupang numei in sang kikhopna-ah a la aw ngingtakin a sim hi.

records.english: Were you nervous before your first lecture?

records.english: So nervous that I couldn't eat breakfast, but it went better than I expected.
records.zomi: Zingsang an ka ne theih loh dong ka lau a, ahi zongin ka lametna sangin a hoih zaw hi.

records.english: The class clapped when the boy with a stammer finished his presentation.

records.english: Who was brave enough to tell the boss about the mistake?

records.english: Will you be brave enough to try out for the school team?

records.english: Brave teachers sometimes risk their own careers to protect their pupils.

records.english: The young doctor admitted that she wasn't sure and asked a senior colleague for help.
records.zomi: Siavuan tangvalnu in ka kip kei hi, ci-in a pulak a, nasem pih upa khat huhna a ngen hi.

records.english: Thank you for having the courage to speak up at the meeting.

records.english: At work, courage often means saying no politely.

records.english: Standing up for a colleague who is being treated unfairly can put your own job at risk.

records.english: Recommendations on local social media groups are useful, but they're not always reliable.

records.english: Which charity would you suggest for someone who wants to help refugees?

records.english: If you need an interpreter for a hospital appointment, the clinic can usually recommend one at no cost.
