records.english: Whose job is it to order the paper for the printer?
records.zomi: Printer adingin laimai order pen kua nasep hiam?

records.english: If you borrow a book from the school library, it's your job to return it on time.
records.zomi: Sang laibu inn pan laibu khat na pukip leh a hun-in piak kik pen na nasep ahi hi.

records.english: Accepting more responsibility at work usually comes with more stress as well as more pay.
records.zomi: Nasepna-ah mawhpuakna tam zaw la in khasum tam zaw bek hi lo-in lungkhamna tam zaw zong a paipih zel hi.

records.english: When the project failed, the director accepted responsibility instead of blaming the team.
records.zomi: Project a siat ciangin director in team mawhsak sang-in mawhpuakna a la hi.

records.english: The nurse in charge must hand over every patient's details at the end of her shift.
records.zomi: Makaih nurse in a shift tawp-ah cina khempeuh' thu a hawm kul hi.

records.english: The nurse on the night shift is responsible for checking every patient at two o'clock.
records.zomi: Zan shift-a nurse in nai 2-in cina khempeuh en a mawhpuak hi.

records.english: I've been asked to train the new staff, which is a big responsibility.
records.zomi: Nasem thakte sinsak dingin hong ngen uh a, tua pen mawhpuakna lian khat ahi hi.

records.english: Is it my job to clean the lab equipment after class?
records.zomi: Class khit ciangin lab van te siangsak ka nasep ahi hiam?

records.english: Yes, each pair cleans what they used before they leave.
records.zomi: Hi hi, pawl nih khatciat in a paisan ma-un a zat te a siangsak uh hi.

records.english: Our class monitor collects the homework and gives it to the teacher every Monday.
records.zomi: I class makaipa in inn nasep a kaikhawm a, Pizing ni simin saya kiangah a pia hi.

records.english: Students on work experience are often given more responsibility than they expect.
records.zomi: Nasep kisinna-a sangnaupangte in a lamen uh sangin mawhpuakna tam zaw a ngah zel uh hi.

records.english: As team leader, I'm responsible for making sure everyone has a fair share of the work.
records.zomi: Team makaipa ka hih manin mi khempeuh in nasep a kibang taka a ngah nadingin ka mawhpuak hi.

records.english: Please sign the logbook when you take a laptop from the cupboard.
records.zomi: Bawm sung pan laptop khat na lak ciangin logbook ah signature in.

records.english: Pupils who look after the school animals during the holidays learn real responsibility.
records.zomi: Tawlngakni lai-in sang ganhing te a kem sangnaupangte in mawhpuakna taktak a sin uh hi.

records.english: The bus driver is responsible for the safety of every child on board.
records.zomi: Bus tawlpa in a tunga naupang khempeuh' lauhuai lohna a mawhpuak hi.

records.english: If you realise you can't finish the task, tell me early, so that I can find someone to help before the deadline.
records.zomi: Nasep na zawh theih loh ding na theih leh hun tawp ma-in huh dingin mi khat ka zon theih nadingin a manlang-in hong gen in.

records.english: When the teacher was late, the class captain started the lesson with a quiz.
records.zomi: Saya a phawng ciangin class makaipa in dotna kidemna tawh sinna a kipatsak hi.

records.english: The prefects help the younger pupils find their classrooms in the first week.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang makaite in kal masa pen-in sangnaupang neute a sangdan uh zong dingin a huh uh hi.

records.english: Small jobs at school help children feel part of the community.
records.zomi: Sang-a nasep neute in naupangte khuasung sung-a khat ahi uh hi, ci-in a kisa sak hi.

records.english: Who should we tell if the printer breaks again?
records.zomi: Printer kik-in a sia leh kua kiangah i gen ding uh hiam?

records.english: The office manager, who keeps a record of every repair.
records.zomi: Office manager, bawlkikna khempeuh ciamtehna a kem pa.

records.english: Who left the fridge door open in the staff room?
records.zomi: Nasemte' inndan sung-a fridge kongkhak hong-in kua in a nusia hiam?

records.english: The student council is responsible for organising the end-of-year party.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang council in kum tawp poai vaihawm a mawhpuak hi.

records.english: I always double-check my figures, because other people rely on them.
records.zomi: Midangte in ka nambat te tungah a kinga uh ahih manin nihvei ka en den hi.

records.english: Who is going to take the minutes at today's meeting?
records.zomi: Tuni kikhopna ah kua in ciamtehna a lak ding hiam?

records.english: Could one of the older students mentor the new girl for her first term?
records.zomi: Sangnaupang upa khat in numei naupang thak a term masa pen adingin a lampi lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: The apprentice was trusted with the keys to the workshop after only a month.
records.zomi: Kha khat bek khit ciangin khutsiam kisinpa nasepna inn tawh kiap hi.

records.english: The safety officer is responsible for checking the fire extinguishers every month.
records.zomi: Lauhuai lo nading nasempa in kha simin mei-sih khawl te en a mawhpuak hi.

records.english: Some parents fear that speaking two languages will confuse their children, but ours cope well.
records.zomi: Nu leh pa khenkhat in pau nih gen in a tate a buaisak ding hi, ci-in a lau uh a, ahi zongin eite' tate in hoih takin a thuak uh hi.

records.english: Grandma worries that the children will speak only the local language one day.
records.zomi: Ni khat ni-in naupangte in mun-a pau bek a gen ding uh hi, ci-in Pi a lungkham hi.

records.english: Why did you write your wedding vows in our language?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na mopawi kiciamna te i pau tawh na gelh hiam?

records.english: Because my grandparents could understand every word, and that mattered to me.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh ka pu leh pi in kammal khempeuh a theisiam thei uh a, tua in kei adingin a thupi hi.

records.english: Grandpa's letters are full of words that young people no longer use.
records.zomi: Pu' laikhak te tangvalte in a zat nawn loh kammal te tawh a dim hi.

records.english: My brother's children speak our language better than he does, thanks to their grandmother.
records.zomi: A pi' hangin ka u pasal' tate in amah sangin i pau a gen siam zaw uh hi.

records.english: Mum cried when her granddaughter read a whole letter in our language.
records.zomi: A tu numei in i pau tawh laikhak bup khat a sim ciangin Nu a kap hi.

records.english: We decided to give our baby a Zomi name, so that she would carry the language with her.
records.zomi: I pau a paipih den nadingin i naungek Zomi min khat pia dingin i khensat uh hi.

records.english: Is it too late for me to learn to write our language properly?
records.zomi: I pau hoih takin gelh sin dingin kei adingin a nunung lua khin hiam?

records.english: My grandchildren and I are writing a little book of family sayings together.
records.zomi: Ka tute leh kei innkuan kammal te' laibu neuno khat i kikhawm-in i gelh uh hi.

records.english: Keeping a language alive at home takes patience, especially when children are tired.
records.zomi: Inn-ah pau khat kem in thuakzawhna a ngai a, a tuamtuam-in naupangte a gim ciangun.

records.english: Parents who are tired after work sometimes switch to the easier language without noticing.
records.zomi: Nasep khit-a a gim nu leh pate in a theih kei zongin pau baih zaw ah a kikhek zel uh hi.

records.english: We play word games in our language on long car journeys.
records.zomi: Mawtaw-a khualzinna sau te-ah i pau tawh kammal kimawlna i kimawl uh hi.

records.english: My daughter wrote her school project about the history of our language.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in i pau' tangthu tawh kisai a sang project a gelh hi.

records.english: Did you speak our language with your parents when you were little?
records.zomi: Na neu lai-in na nu leh na pa tawh i pau na gen hiam?

records.english: Our family's group chat is the only place my teenagers still write in our language.
records.zomi: I innkuan group chat pen ka tangvalnote in i pau a gelh lai mun khat bek ahi hi.

records.english: Is there a Zomi Bible for children?
records.zomi: Naupangte adingin Zomi Laisiangtho a om hiam?

records.english: Our church has a picture Bible in our language that the children can borrow.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in naupangte in a pukip theih i pau tawh lim Laisiangtho khat a nei hi.

records.english: Family recipes are written in our language so that the words survive with the food.
records.zomi: Innkuan an huan dan te an tawh kammal te a om lai nadingin i pau tawh kigelh hi.

records.english: Mum labels the photo albums in our language.
records.zomi: Nu in photo album te i pau tawh a ciamteh hi.

records.english: We keep a notebook of the old words our grandparents use.
records.zomi: I pu leh pi' zat kammal lui te notebook khat sungah i kem uh hi.

records.english: Shall we sing the old lullaby to the baby tonight?
records.zomi: Tuzan-in naungek adingin naungek lui la i sa ding hiam?

records.english: Our son is proud that he can read the hymn book at church.
records.zomi: Pawlpi ah la laibu a sim thei manin i tapa a kipak hi.

records.english: Does your daughter answer you in Zomi?
records.zomi: Na tanu in Zomi pau tawh hong dawng hiam?

records.english: Only when she wants something, which makes us all laugh.
records.zomi: Bangkhat a deih ciang bek, tua in i khempeuh hong nuisak hi.

records.english: Our children answer the phone in our language when they know it's Grandma.
records.zomi: Pi ahi hi, cih a theih ciangun i tate in i pau tawh phone a dawng uh hi.

records.english: Our family tree is written in our language, with every name spelled the traditional way.
records.zomi: I innkuan khangthu i pau tawh kigelh a, min khempeuh ngeina dan-in kigelh hi.

records.english: Please answer Grandma in our language, even if it's only a few words.
records.zomi: Kammal tawm khat bek hi zongin Pi i pau tawh dawng in.

records.english: I'm teaching my husband our language.
records.zomi: Ka pasal i pau ka sinsak hi.

records.english: Do your children know the names of their relatives in our language?
records.zomi: Na tate in a sanggamte' min i pau tawh a thei uh hiam?

records.english: My sister sends voice messages in our language so that her children hear it every day.
records.zomi: Ka u numei in a tate in ni simin a zak nadingun i pau tawh aw message a khak hi.

records.english: Thank you for teaching our children the songs you learned as a girl.
records.zomi: Numei naupang na hih lai-a na sin la te i tate na sinsak manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Shall we start a language evening for the families on our street?
records.zomi: I lampi tunga innkuante adingin pau nitak khat i kipatsak ding hiam?

records.english: On video calls, Grandpa teaches the grandchildren one new word each week.
records.zomi: Video call tungah Pu in kal simin tute kammal thak khat a sinsak hi.

records.english: Talk to Grandpa about the old farming words, because nobody else remembers them.
records.zomi: Lo nasep kammal lui te tawh kisai Pu tawh kihoupih in, bang hang hiam cih leh kuamah dang in a phawk nawn kei uh hi.

records.english: Our family speaks Zomi at home and the local language outside.
records.zomi: I innkuan in inn ah Zomi pau a gen a, pualam ah mun-a pau a gen hi.

records.english: When my daughter started school abroad, she stopped speaking our language at home.
records.zomi: Ka tanu gamdang-ah sang a kipat ciangin inn ah i pau gen a khawl hi.

records.english: Mum came to stay for a year and refused to speak anything else to her.
records.zomi: Nu kum khat teng dingin a hong a, amah tawh a dang bangmah gen nuam lo hi.

records.english: By the end of the year, my daughter was chatting with her grandmother as if she had never stopped.
records.zomi: Kum a bei ciangin ka tanu in a khawl ngei lo bang-in a pi tawh a kihoupih hi.

records.english: Don't worry about mistakes, because Grandma is just happy that you're trying.
records.zomi: Khialhna tawh kisai lungkham kei in, bang hang hiam cih leh na sawm manin Pi a lungdam bek hi.

records.english: When my nephew visited the village, he understood far more than he could say.
records.zomi: Ka tanau khua a veh ciangin a gen theih sangin a theisiam tam zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: Our children laugh when they mix two languages in one sentence, and so do we.
records.zomi: I tate in kammal tang khat sungah pau nih a kihelsak ciangun a nui uh a, eite zong i nui uh hi.

records.english: Every summer, our children spend a month in the village, where nobody speaks anything else.
records.zomi: Khal simin i tate in khua ah kha khat a om uh a, tua-ah kuamah in a dang pau a gen kei uh hi.

records.english: We bought a children's dictionary in our language for each of the grandchildren.
records.zomi: Tute khatciat adingin i pau tawh naupang kammal laibu khat i lei uh hi.

records.english: How can I help my children keep our language?
records.zomi: Ka tate i pau a kem nadingun bangci-in ka huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Speak it with them every day, even when they answer in another language.
records.zomi: Pau dang tawh a dawng uh zongin ni simin amaute tawh gen in.

records.english: Read the children a short story in our language before bed.
records.zomi: Lup ma-in naupangte kiangah i pau tawh tangthu tomno khat sim sak in.

records.english: Why do you record Grandpa every time he tells a story?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pu in tangthu a gen simin na khum hiam?

records.english: Because one day the children will want to hear his voice and his words.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh ni khat ni-in naupangte in a aw leh a kammal te zak a deih ding uh hi.

records.english: My cousin's family has a rule that the television is in our language on Sundays.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam' innkuan in Nipini-in television i pau-in a om ding hi, ci thukhun khat a nei hi.

records.english: Every word our children learn from their grandparents is a small piece of our history kept safe.
records.zomi: I tate in a pu leh pi pan a sin kammal khatciat pen i tangthu' tawm khat kikem ahi hi.

records.english: We were delighted when our son chose a song in our language for his school concert.
records.zomi: I tapa in a sang concert adingin i pau tawh la khat a teel ciangin i lungdam mahmah uh hi.

records.english: A family that stops speaking its language often loses its songs and sayings too.
records.zomi: A pau gen a khawl innkuan khat in a la leh a kammal te zong a mansuah zel uh hi.

records.english: Can you teach me how to say grace in our language?
records.zomi: An nek ma-a thungetna i pau tawh bangci-in gen ding hiam cih hong sinsak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our house is the only one in the family where both languages are spoken equally.
records.zomi: I inn pen innkuan sungah pau nih kibang-in kigen mun khat bek ahi hi.

records.english: My aunt corrects everyone's grammar at family gatherings, which annoys us all.
records.zomi: Ka ni in innkuan kikhopna te-ah mi khempeuh' pau gelh dan a bawlkik a, tua in i khempeuh hong hehsak hi.

records.english: I want my children to be able to pray in the language of their grandparents.
records.zomi: Ka tate in a pu leh pi' pau tawh thu a ngen thei nadingun ka deih hi.

records.english: Our son's accent in our language makes his grandparents smile.
records.zomi: I tapa' i pau-a pau ngaihzia in a pu leh pi a nuisak hi.

records.english: Let's ask Grandma what this old word means.
records.zomi: Hih kammal lui bang a cihna hiam cih Pi dong ni.

records.english: When Grandpa died, we realised how many words had gone with him.
records.zomi: Pu a sih ciangin kammal bangzah amah tawh a mang hiam cih i thei uh hi.

records.english: Shall we read one of Paul's shorter letters this evening?
records.zomi: Tuzan-in Paul' laikhak tom zaw khat i sim ding hiam?

records.english: Which Gospel should I read first?
records.zomi: Bang Lungdamna Thu ka sim masa ding hiam?

records.english: Many people start with Mark, because it's the shortest.
records.zomi: Mi tampi in Marka tawh a kipan uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh a tom pen ahi hi.

records.english: Many people know the story of the prodigal son even if they've never read the Bible.
records.zomi: Mi tampi in Laisiangtho a sim ngei kei zongin tapa mangthang tangthu a thei uh hi.

records.english: The last book of the New Testament is Revelation.
records.zomi: Thukham Thak' laibu nunung pen Mangmuhna ahi hi.

records.english: Our children learned the story of Jesus feeding five thousand people.
records.zomi: I tate in Jesu in mi tulnga an a pia tangthu a sin uh hi.

records.english: Christians call the message of Jesus the good news.
records.zomi: Khristiante in Jesu' thu pen Lungdamna Thu a ci uh hi.

records.english: The letter of James says that faith should be shown in good works.
records.zomi: James' laikhak in upna pen nasep hoih tawh kilak ding hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Jesus' teaching to love your neighbour is found in several places in the Gospels.
records.zomi: Na lawmte na it in, ci Jesu' sinsakna Lungdamna Thu te sung-a mun tampi ah a om hi.

records.english: Our youth group is reading the letter to the Philippians.
records.zomi: I tangvalte' pawl in Philippi mite' laikhak a sim uh hi.

records.english: Our son asked why there are four Gospels instead of one.
records.zomi: Bang hangin Lungdamna Thu khat sang-in li a om hiam cih i tapa in a dong hi.

records.english: The passage about love in First Corinthians is often read at weddings.
records.zomi: Korin Masa sung-a itna tawh kisai mun mopawi te-ah kisim zel hi.

records.english: The Book of Revelation is full of symbols that Christians interpret in different ways.
records.zomi: Mangmuhna laibu Khristiante in lampi tuamtuam-in a theisiam ciamtehna te tawh a dim hi.

records.english: According to Christian tradition, the Book of Acts was written by the same author as Luke's Gospel.
records.zomi: Khristian ngeina bang-in Sawltakte' Sepna laibu pen Luka' Lungdamna Thu a gelhpa mahmah in a gelh hi.

records.english: Does Grandma still keep a small New Testament in her handbag?
records.zomi: Pi in a khut ip sungah Thukham Thak neuno khat a kem lai hiam?

records.english: During Lent, our family read one chapter of Luke's Gospel every evening.
records.zomi: Lent lai-in i innkuan in nitak simin Luka' Lungdamna Thu cang khat a sim hi.

records.english: The children's favourite part was the story of the son who came home to his father.
records.zomi: Naupangte' deih pen mun pen a pa kiangah a ciah kik tapa tangthu ahi hi.

records.english: By Easter Sunday, we had read the whole Gospel together around the kitchen table.
records.zomi: Easter Nipini ciangin an huanna inn taupi kim a val-ah Lungdamna Thu bup i kikhawm-in i sim khin uh hi.

records.english: Many Christians read a passage from the Gospels every morning.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in zingsang simin Lungdamna Thu te pan mun khat a sim uh hi.

records.english: The Gospels describe Jesus healing the sick and welcoming outsiders.
records.zomi: Lungdamna Thu te in Jesu in cinate a damsak a, mi dangte a kisang hi, ci-in a gen hi.

records.english: Our pastor said that the parables were stories with a deeper meaning.
records.zomi: Thugentehna te pen a cihnopna thuk zaw nei tangthu te ahi hi, ci-in i pastor in a gen hi.

records.english: Our children acted out the story of Zacchaeus climbing a tree to see Jesus.
records.zomi: I tate in Jesu muh dingin Zakkhias singkung tungah a kah tangthu a lak uh hi.

records.english: How many books are there in the New Testament?
records.zomi: Thukham Thak sungah laibu bangzah a om hiam?

records.english: Twenty-seven, beginning with the four Gospels.
records.zomi: Sawmnih le sagih, Lungdamna Thu li tawh a kipan hi.

records.english: Which hymns are based on passages from the New Testament?
records.zomi: Bang Pasian phatna la te Thukham Thak sung-a mun te tungah a kinga hiam?

records.english: Some letters in the New Testament were written to individuals rather than to churches.
records.zomi: Thukham Thak sung-a laikhak khenkhat pawlpi te kiangah hi lo-in mimal kiangah kigelh hi.

records.english: Can you find the Gospel of John for me?
records.zomi: Johan' Lungdamna Thu hong zong sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our church reads from the Gospels every Sunday.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in Nipini simin Lungdamna Thu te pan a sim hi.

records.english: Did Paul write the Book of Acts?
records.zomi: Paul in Sawltakte' Sepna laibu a gelh hiam?

records.english: Our Bible study group compares how different Gospels tell the same event.
records.zomi: I Laisiangtho sinna pawl in Lungdamna Thu tuamtuam in thu piang kibang bangci-in a gen uh hiam cih a kiteh uh hi.

records.english: Paul wrote letters to churches in cities such as Corinth and Rome.
records.zomi: Paul in Korin leh Rom bang khuapi te-a pawlpi te kiangah laikhak a gelh hi.

records.english: Christians believe that the New Testament completes the story that the Old Testament begins.
records.zomi: Thukham Lui in a kipatsak tangthu Thukham Thak in a kicingsak hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: What are the Gospels about?
records.zomi: Lungdamna Thu te bang tawh kisai hiam?

records.english: They tell the story of Jesus' life, teaching and death, and of his resurrection, as Christians believe.
records.zomi: Jesu' nuntakna, sinsakna leh sihna, leh Khristiante' upna bang-in a thawhkikna tangthu a gen uh hi.

records.english: The Gospels of Matthew and Luke both tell the story of Jesus' birth.
records.zomi: Matthai leh Luka' Lungdamna Thu te in Jesu' suahna tangthu a gen tuak uh hi.

records.english: Scholars generally date the New Testament books to within about a century of Jesus' death.
records.zomi: Pilmite in a tamzaw-in Thukham Thak laibu te Jesu' sihna khit kum za khat sungah a koih uh hi.

records.english: Christians believe that the New Testament teaches salvation through faith in Jesus.
records.zomi: Thukham Thak in Jesu-ah upna tungtawn-in hotkhiatna a sinsak hi, ci-in Khristiante in a um uh hi.

records.english: Some passages in Paul's letters are hard to understand, as even another New Testament letter admits.
records.zomi: Thukham Thak laikhak dang khat in zong a pulak bang-in Paul' laikhak sung-a mun khenkhat theisiam a haksa hi.

records.english: Is the story of the lost sheep in Matthew or in Luke?
records.zomi: Tuu mangthang tangthu Matthai sungah hiam, Luka sungah hiam a om hiam?

records.english: Do you have a favourite parable?
records.zomi: Na deih pen thugentehna khat na nei hiam?

records.english: According to John's Gospel, who was the first person to see Jesus after the resurrection?
records.zomi: Johan' Lungdamna Thu bang-in thawhkikna khit-a Jesu a mu masa pen kua hiam?

records.english: Grandpa underlines his favourite verses in red ink.
records.zomi: Pu in a deih pen Laisiangtho cang te ink san tawh a nuai-ah khau a khai hi.

records.english: Many churches read from both Testaments in their services.
records.zomi: Pawlpi tampi in a biakna uh-ah Thukham nih pan a sim uh hi.

records.english: The first Christians met in each other's homes, according to the Book of Acts.
records.zomi: Sawltakte' Sepna laibu bang-in Khristian masate khat leh khat' inn ah a kikhop uh hi.

records.english: The Lord's Prayer appears in the Gospels of Matthew and Luke.
records.zomi: Topa' Thungetna Matthai leh Luka' Lungdamna Thu te sungah a om hi.

records.english: Reading the New Testament in context helps us understand the world in which Jesus lived.
records.zomi: Thukham Thak a tangthu tawh sim in Jesu a nuntakna leitung i theisiam nadingin hong huh hi.

records.english: Who wrote most of the letters in the New Testament?
records.zomi: Thukham Thak sung-a laikhak tamzaw kua in a gelh hiam?

records.english: Many of them are traditionally linked with the apostle Paul.
records.zomi: A tamzaw ngeina-in sawltak Paul tawh kizom hi.

records.english: Could you read the passage from Matthew slowly for the children?
records.zomi: Naupangte adingin Matthai pan mun zawi takin na sim thei ding hiam?

records.english: Let's read the Christmas story from Luke's Gospel tonight.
records.zomi: Tuzan-in Luka' Lungdamna Thu pan Christmas tangthu sim ni.

records.english: My Bible has the words of Jesus printed in red.
records.zomi: Ka Laisiangtho in Jesu' kammal te pianzia san tawh a suaksak hi.

records.english: We sang a song about the Last Supper at church on Thursday.
records.zomi: Laizing ni-in pawlpi ah Nitak An Nunung tawh kisai la khat i sa uh hi.

records.english: Our pastor is preaching on the Sermon on the Mount this month.
records.zomi: I pastor in hih kha-in Mual tunga Thuhilhna a sinsak hi.

records.english: What language was the New Testament first written in?
records.zomi: Thukham Thak bang pau tawh a masa-in kigelh hiam?

records.english: Greek, which was widely spoken across the eastern Roman Empire at the time.
records.zomi: Greek, tua hun-in Rom Kumpi gam ni suahna lam bup-ah kigen tampi pau.

records.english: The Beatitudes begin the Sermon on the Mount in Matthew's Gospel.
records.zomi: Thuphate in Matthai' Lungdamna Thu sung-a Mual tunga Thuhilhna a kipatsak hi.

records.english: The Book of Acts describes how the first Christians spread their message.
records.zomi: Sawltakte' Sepna laibu in Khristian masate in a thu uh bangci-in a zelh uh hiam cih a gen hi.

records.english: Each Gospel tells the story of Jesus from a slightly different point of view.
records.zomi: Lungdamna Thu khatciat in Jesu' tangthu en dan kibang lo neuno khat pan a gen hi.

records.english: Christians in different traditions read the same New Testament, although they sometimes understand it differently.
records.zomi: Ngeina tuamtuam-a Khristiante in Thukham Thak kibang a sim uh a, khatveivei tuamtuam-in a theisiam uh hi.

records.english: How long would it take to read the New Testament from start to finish?
records.zomi: Thukham Thak a kipatna pan a tawp dong sim nadingin bangzah sawt a la ding hiam?

records.english: Decisions about public spending should be explained clearly to the people they affect.
records.zomi: Mipite' sum zatna tawh kisai thukhensatna te a khoih mite kiangah tak takin kigen ding hi.

records.english: My parents decided to move into sheltered housing after a long talk with the warden.
records.zomi: Kemtupa tawh hun sau kihoupihna khit ciangin ka nu leh ka pa upate kemna inn ah sawn dingin a khensat uh hi.

records.english: It took the town three years to decide what to build on the empty land.
records.zomi: Mun awng tungah bang lam ding hiam cih khensat dingin khuapi kum thum a la hi.

records.english: The judges took an hour to decide which garden deserved the prize.
records.zomi: Bang huan in letsong a phu hiam cih khensat dingin thukhenpate nai khat a la uh hi.

records.english: We've decided to join the community garden this spring.
records.zomi: Hih spring-in khuasung huan ah kihel dingin i khensat uh hi.

records.english: We decided not to renew our gym membership, because we rarely went.
records.zomi: Pai tawm mahmah ahih manin i gym kihelna thak lo dingin i khensat uh hi.

records.english: Let the residents decide, since they're the ones who'll use the park.
records.zomi: Park zang ding mite ahi uh ahih manin teng mite khensat sak un.

records.english: We decided to pay a little more for the bins to be collected weekly.
records.zomi: Kal simin eek bawm lak nadingin tawm khat beh pia dingin i khensat uh hi.

records.english: Hard decisions about local services often come down to money.
records.zomi: Mun-a nasepna tawh kisai thukhensatna haksa te sum tungah a kinga zel uh hi.

records.english: Shall I decide where we meet, or do you have somewhere in mind?
records.zomi: Koi-ah i kimu ding hiam cih ka khensat ding hiam, a hih kei leh mun khat na ngaihsun hiam?

records.english: Why did the club decide to raise its fees?
records.zomi: Bang hangin club in a man khangsak dingin a khensat hiam?

records.english: The rent for the hall went up, and we had no other way to cover it.
records.zomi: Inn lian haai man a khang a, a pia nading lampi dang i nei kei uh hi.

records.english: Who decides which charities can collect money outside the supermarket?
records.zomi: Bang hehpihna pawl te in supermarket pualam-ah sum a kaikhawm thei uh hiam cih kua in a khensat hiam?

records.english: Do you know when the decision about the new road will be announced?
records.zomi: Lampi thak tawh kisai thukhensatna bang hun-in kigen ding hiam cih na thei hiam?

records.english: Who decides whether the library stays open on Sundays?
records.zomi: Laibu inn Nipini-in a kihon lai ding hiam cih kua in a khensat hiam?

records.english: The council's library service, although it listens to what users say in the survey.
records.zomi: Council' laibu inn nasepna in, dotna kankanna-ah zangte' gen a ngaikhia zongin.

records.english: The youth club let the teenagers decide how to decorate their room.
records.zomi: Tangvalte' kipawlna in tangvalnote a inndan uh bangci-in zep ding hiam cih a khensat sak hi.

records.english: Did the council explain why it decided against the cycle lane?
records.zomi: Bang hangin siiksakol lampi a nial dingin a khensat hiam cih council in a gen hiam?

records.english: Have you decided which doctor's surgery to register with?
records.zomi: Bang siavuan office tawh min ciamteh dingin na khensat khin hiam?

records.english: The one near the station, because it opens early.
records.zomi: Station kiang-a om pa, bang hang hiam cih leh a manlang-in a kihong hi.

records.english: Involving residents early can turn a difficult decision into a shared one.
records.zomi: Teng mite a manlang-in kihelsak in thukhensatna haksa khat kihawm thukhensatna ah a khek thei hi.

records.english: Some residents felt that the decision had been rushed through without proper discussion.
records.zomi: Teng mi khenkhat in thukhensatna kikupna kicing om lo-in kibawl manlang hi, ci-in a kisa uh hi.

records.english: The food bank decided to open on Saturdays as well, because demand had grown.
records.zomi: Kisapna a khan manin an huhna mun in Kiginni-in zong hong dingin a khensat hi.

records.english: Once the council had decided, there was very little that residents could do to change it.
records.zomi: Council in a khensat khit ciangin teng mite in a khek nadingin a bawl theih tawm mahmah hi.

records.english: Are you going to sign the petition against closing the library?
records.zomi: Laibu inn khakna langpanna ngetna lai na signature ding hiam?

records.english: The planning committee has postponed its decision until it receives more information.
records.zomi: Inn lam phalna committee in thu tam zaw a ngah dong a thukhensatna a sawn hi.

records.english: The housing association decided to replace all the windows on our street.
records.zomi: Inn kipawlna in i lampi tunga tawhkhang khempeuh khek dingin a khensat hi.

records.english: Who made the decision to close the swimming pool for the summer?
records.zomi: Khal sung tuipeek mun khak ding thukhensatna kua in a bawl hiam?

records.english: Shall we vote on the date for the clean-up day?
records.zomi: Siangsakna ni adingin ni tungah vote i a ding hiam?

records.english: The school and the council decided together to close the road outside the gates at home time.
records.zomi: Sang leh council in inn ciah hun-in kongkhak pualam-a lampi khak dingin a kikhawm-in a khensat uh hi.

records.english: We're still deciding whether to hold the festival indoors or outside.
records.zomi: Pawi inn sungah hiam, pualam ah hiam bawl ding hiam cih i khensat lai uh hi.

records.english: The church decided to open its hall to homeless families.
records.zomi: Pawlpi in inn om lo innkuante adingin a inn lian a hong dingin a khensat hi.

records.english: I've decided to volunteer at the library on Tuesday mornings.
records.zomi: Pithai ni zingsang simin laibu inn ah thalawp dingin ka khensat hi.

records.english: The decision to keep the clinic open was a relief to the whole village.
records.zomi: Clinic a kihon lai ding thukhensatna in khua bup adingin lungnuamna ahi hi.

records.english: How will the council decide where the new school goes?
records.zomi: Sang thak koi-ah lam ding hiam cih council in bangci-in a khensat ding hiam?

records.english: It will hold a public consultation and then vote at the March meeting.
records.zomi: Mipite' dotna kikhopna khat a bawl ding a, tua khit ciangin March kikhopna ah vote a ding hi.

records.english: I decided to take the bus to work after the parking charges went up.
records.zomi: Mawtaw khawlna man a khan khit ciangin nasepna-ah bus tawh pai dingin ka khensat hi.

records.english: The firefighters decided to hold an open day so that families could see the station.
records.zomi: Innkuante in station a muh theih nadingin mei-sih nasemte in kihonna ni khat bawl dingin a khensat uh hi.

records.english: Let's decide on the route for the charity walk tonight.
records.zomi: Tuzan-in hehpihna vak kidemna lampi i khensat ni.

records.english: Residents were disappointed that the decision was made before the public meeting.
records.zomi: Mipite' kikhopna ma-in thukhensatna a kibawl manin teng mite a lungkham uh hi.

records.english: My neighbour finally reported the broken street light herself.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng in a tawp-in lampi meivak kitam amah mahmah in a theisak hi.

records.english: I can't decide whether to complain to the council or just fix the fence myself.
records.zomi: Council kiangah ka phun ding hiam, keimah in huang ka bawl kik bek ding hiam cih ka khensat thei kei hi.

records.english: Our village had to decide whether to keep the old post office or turn it into a café.
records.zomi: I khua in post office lui a kem ding hiam, cafe-ah a khek ding hiam cih a khensat kul hi.

records.english: The meeting in the church hall lasted until midnight, and nobody would give way.
records.zomi: Pawlpi inn lian-a kikhopna zanlai dong a sau a, kuamah in a kiniam kei uh hi.

records.english: In the end, we chose to do both, with a post office counter at the back of the café.
records.zomi: A tawp-ah a nih bawl dingin i teel uh a, cafe nung lam-ah post office taupi khat tawh.

records.english: Before deciding where to put the new bus shelter, the council spoke to local shopkeepers.
records.zomi: Bus ngakna inn thak koi-ah koih ding hiam cih a khensat ma-in council in mun-a sumbuk neite tawh a kihoupih hi.

records.english: Each household was given one vote on the future of the village hall.
records.zomi: Khua inn lian' hun hong ding tungah innkuan khatciat vote khat a kipia hi.

records.english: Has the committee decided how to spend the money from the raffle?
records.zomi: Committee in raffle pan sum bangci-in zang ding hiam cih a khensat khin hiam?

records.english: Our tenants' group decided to write a joint letter rather than complain one by one.
records.zomi: I inn haai mite' pawl in khat khit khat phun sang-in kikhawm laikhak khat gelh dingin a khensat uh hi.

records.english: Why did the council choose Thursday for the new evening market?
records.zomi: Bang hangin council in nitak sumbuk mun thak adingin Laizing ni a teel hiam?

records.english: Did the residents' association decide about the Christmas lights?
records.zomi: Teng mite' kipawlna in Christmas meivak te tawh kisai a khensat khin hiam?

records.english: Yes, we're putting them up on the high street instead of the square this year.
records.zomi: Khensat khin hi, hih kum-in khuapi laizang sang-in lampi lian tungah i khai uh hi.

records.english: Have the volunteers decided who will run the stall at the fair?
records.zomi: Fair-a van zuakna mun kua in a kalsuan ding hiam cih thalawpte in a khensat khin uh hiam?

records.english: I made up my mind to complain after the third missed collection.
records.zomi: Eek lak mansuah thumna khit ciangin phun dingin ka khensat hi.

records.english: The parish council will make its decision about the playground next week.
records.zomi: Khua council in kal hong tung ding-in naupang kimawlna mun tawh kisai a thukhensatna a bawl ding hi.

records.english: The decision to plant more trees on our street was welcomed by almost everyone.
records.zomi: I lampi tungah singkung tam zaw suan ding thukhensatna mi khempeuh dek in a kisang uh hi.

records.english: We haven't decided yet, so please send us your ideas.
records.zomi: I khensat nai kei uh ahih manin na ngaihsutna te hong khak un.

records.english: Choosing a new name for the community centre turned into a lively public debate.
records.zomi: Khuasung inn lian adingin min thak teel pen mipite' kikupna nuam khat-in a kikhek hi.

records.english: Have you decided whether to stand for the parish council?
records.zomi: Khua council adingin na ding ding hiam cih na khensat khin hiam?

records.english: The library decided to stop charging fines for overdue children's books.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in naupang laibu phawng te adingin sum lepna la khawl dingin a khensat hi.

records.english: Politeness to the volunteers is expected from everyone who uses the centre.
records.zomi: Office a zang mi khempeuh in thalawpte tungah zahtakna nei dingin kilamen hi.

records.english: Wait for your turn to use the potter's wheel.
records.zomi: Beel bawlna khawl zat nadingin na hun ngak in.

records.english: Hands up if you'd like to answer the quiz question.
records.zomi: Dotna kidemna dotna dawn na deih leh na khut khang in.

records.english: The children were so excited at the science show that the presenter had to wait for silence.
records.zomi: Science lakna-ah naupangte a lungdam lua ahih manin a lakpa in a daih dong a ngak kul hi.

records.english: The puppet show worked like magic on the noisiest children in the room.
records.zomi: Puppet lakna in inndan sung-a naupang ging pen te tungah lamdang takin na a sem hi.

records.english: Take your muddy boots off before you come into the community centre.
records.zomi: Khuasung inn lian ah na lut ma-in na khedap nin te suah in.

records.english: The coach sent a player off the training pitch for swearing at the referee.
records.zomi: Coach in referee a hamsiat manin kimawlpa khat kisinna mualpi pan a khak hi.

records.english: Please put the chairs back in their rows before you go.
records.zomi: Na paisan ma-in tutphah te a kigual-in koih kik in.

records.english: Adults in evening classes sometimes behave worse than children, especially when they're tired.
records.zomi: Nitak class-a upate in khatveivei naupangte sangin a om dan uh a hoih lo zaw a, a tuamtuam-in a gim ciangun.

records.english: Who knocked over the paint water?
records.zomi: Lim zum tui kua in a sung hiam?

records.english: Learners in the computer class are asked not to print personal documents.
records.zomi: Computer class-a sinmite mimal lai te print lo dingin kingen uh hi.

records.english: Please don't shout across the sports hall; walk over and speak to the person.
records.zomi: Kimawlna inn lian sungah kikou kei in; pai inla mi tawh kihoupih in.

records.english: Well done for waiting so patiently in the queue.
records.zomi: Kigual sungah thuakzawh takin na ngak manin na hoih hi.

records.english: Visitors who break the library rules twice may lose their membership.
records.zomi: Laibu inn thukhun nihvei a phiat khualte in a kihelna uh a mansuah thei uh hi.

records.english: Quiet, everyone, because the speaker is about to begin.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh dai un, bang hang hiam cih leh thugenpa a kipan ding hi.

records.english: Is it all right if my son brings his tablet to the youth club?
records.zomi: Ka tapa in tangvalte' kipawlna ah a tablet a paipih leh a hoih hiam?

records.english: Yes, but only for the quiz, because the rest of the evening is for games.
records.zomi: Hoih hi, ahi zongin dotna kidemna adingin bek, bang hang hiam cih leh nitak a dang kimawlna adingin ahi hi.

records.english: Our Sunday school teacher has one rule: be kind to each other.
records.zomi: I Nipini sang saya in thukhun khat a nei hi: khat leh khat tungah hehpihna nei un.

records.english: Don't touch the exhibits unless there's a sign saying you can.
records.zomi: Na khoih thei hi, a ci ciamtehna a om kei leh lak van te khoih kei in.

records.english: Good behaviour at community events is mostly about remembering that the space belongs to everyone.
records.zomi: Khuasung kikhopna te-a om dan hoih pen mun pen mi khempeuh' ahi hi, cih phawk ahi hi.

records.english: Shall we start again, and this time listen to each other properly?
records.zomi: Kik-in i kipan ding hiam, leh hih vei-in khat leh khat hoih takin i kingaikhia ding hiam?

records.english: Our dance teacher stops the music whenever anyone is unkind to another dancer.
records.zomi: I lam saya in kuamah in lam mi dang tungah hehpihna a neih loh simin la a khawlsak hi.

records.english: Is chewing gum allowed in the library?
records.zomi: Laibu inn ah chewing gum nek kiphal hiam?

records.english: The tutor reminded us that jokes about religion can offend people in a mixed group.
records.zomi: Pawl kihel ah biakna tawh kisai nuihzak thu te in mite a lungsim natsak thei hi, ci-in saya in hong phawksak hi.

records.english: At the community choir, latecomers are asked to wait until the end of the song before coming in.
records.zomi: Khuasung la-sa pawl ah a phawng-a hong mite la a bei dong ngak dingin kingen uh hi.

records.english: Respecting the volunteers' time means arriving when the session starts.
records.zomi: Thalawpte' hun zahtak cih pen hun a kipat ciangin tun ahi hi.

records.english: Please clap at the end, not in the middle of the piece.
records.zomi: A kim-ah hi lo-in a tawp-ah khut beng un.

records.english: When the music class became too loud, the teacher simply sat down and waited.
records.zomi: La class a ging lua ciangin saya a tu a, a ngak bek hi.

records.english: Please keep your voices down, because there's a funeral gathering in the next room.
records.zomi: Kiang-a inndan sungah misi kikhopna khat a om ahih manin na aw niam takin pau un.

records.english: Why did the swimming teacher make the boys sit out?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tuipeek saya in tangvalnote a tusak hiam?

records.english: They kept pushing each other in, which is dangerous near the deep end.
records.zomi: Khat leh khat tui sungah a kinawt uh hi, tua pen a thuk lam kiang-ah lauhuai hi.

records.english: Can I eat my lunch in the art room?
records.zomi: Lim suaina inndan sungah ka sun an ka ne thei ding hiam?

records.english: Not in here, but there are tables in the café next door.
records.zomi: Hih sungah hi lo, ahi zongin a kiang-a cafe ah dawhkan te a om hi.

records.english: Children must walk, not run, on the side of the pool.
records.zomi: Naupangte in tuipeek mun kiang-ah tai lo-in pai bek ding uh hi.

records.english: The youth worker spoke calmly to the boy who had thrown a chair, and he soon calmed down.
records.zomi: Tangvalte' nasempa in tutphah a paikhia tangvalno kiangah dai takin a pau a, a manlang-in a dai kik hi.

records.english: Please don't feed the animals at the city farm, even if they look hungry.
records.zomi: Khuapi gan vulhna mun-a ganhingte a gil a kial bang a kilat zongin an pia kei un.

records.english: Because the drama group was performing in a church, the director asked everyone to dress modestly.
records.zomi: Lam pawl in pawlpi sungah a lak uh ahih manin a kalsuanpa in mi khempeuh zahtak huai takin puan sil dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: At our church's Sunday school, two boys started arguing over a toy.
records.zomi: I pawlpi' Nipini sang ah tangvalno nih in kimawlna van khat tungah a kinial uh hi.

records.english: The teacher asked them to think of a fair way to share it.
records.zomi: Saya in a kihawm nadingin lampi diktat khat ngaihsun dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: They decided to build something together, and it became the biggest tower in the room.
records.zomi: Khat vei khawm-in bawl dingin a khensat uh a, inndan sung-a inn sang pen a suak hi.

records.english: The library volunteer gently reminded the group that other people were trying to study, and they lowered their voices at once.
records.zomi: Laibu inn thalawp in mi dangte laibu a sim uh hi, ci-in pawl a phawksak nem a, a manlang-in a aw uh a niamsak uh hi.

records.english: Stay with your group during the museum visit.
records.zomi: Tangthu van kemna inn na veh lai-in na pawl tawh om in.

records.english: Thank you for being so well behaved during the visit to the fire station.
records.zomi: Mei-sih nasemte' station na veh lai-in na om dan hoih mahmah manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: A short list of rules on the wall saves arguments later.
records.zomi: Bang tungah thukhun tomno khat na koih leh a nung-ah kinialna a dalsak hi.

records.english: What should I do if a child keeps running around during story time at the library?
records.zomi: Laibu inn-a tangthu gen hun-in naupang khat a tai den leh bang ka bawl ding hiam?

records.english: Invite them to sit at the front and help you turn the pages.
records.zomi: Mai lam-ah tu dingin sam inla, laibu a mai heisak nadingin hong huh sak in.

records.english: The oldest member of the walking group always waits for the slowest walker.
records.zomi: Vak pawl-a upa pen in a kal niam pen mi a ngak den hi.

records.english: The scout leader praised the group for tidying the hall without being asked.
records.zomi: Scout makaipa in kuamah in a nget loh-in inn lian a siansak manin pawl a phat hi.

records.english: The museum guide stopped the tour until the teenagers at the back had finished their conversation.
records.zomi: Tangthu van kemna inn lampi lakpa in nung lam-a tangvalnote a kihoupihna uh a zawh dong a pai a khawlsak hi.

records.english: Please leave the toys in the play corner when you go home.
records.zomi: Inn na ciah ciangin kimawlna van te kimawlna mun ah nusia un.

records.english: Children who arrive late to swimming lessons have to warm up on their own.
records.zomi: Tuipeek sinna-ah a phawng-a hong naupangte in amau mah-in a pumpi uh a lumsak kul uh hi.

records.english: The ice-rink staff warned the teenagers that racing would get them banned.
records.zomi: Tuikhal tunga kimawlna mun nasemte in kidem-a tai leh a khak ding uh hi, ci-in tangvalnote a vaikhak uh hi.

records.english: Can we sit together if we promise to be quiet?
records.zomi: Dai takin i om ding hi, ci-in i ciam leh khawm-in i tu thei ding hiam?

records.english: The lifeguard blew the whistle at the boys who were diving into the shallow end.
records.zomi: Tuipeek mun kemtupa in a ciah lam-ah a tum tangvalnote a whistle tawh a mut hi.

records.english: The football coach makes every player shake hands with the other team after a match.
records.zomi: Football coach in kimawlna khit simin kimawlpa khempeuh team dang tawh a khut kilensak hi.

records.english: Our yoga teacher asks everyone to switch their phones off at the door.
records.zomi: I yoga saya in mi khempeuh kongkhak-ah a phone uh phiat dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: One rude member was asked to leave the book club after insulting another reader.
records.zomi: Laibu sim mi dang khat a simmawh khit ciangin a zahtak lo kihel mi khat laibu kipawlna pan pai dingin kingen hi.

records.english: The craft workshop leader politely asked parents not to finish their children's projects for them, which caused some grumbling.
records.zomi: Khut nasep sinna makaipa in nu leh pate in a tate' nasep uh a zawh sak loh nadingin zahtak takin a ngen a, tua in mi khenkhat a phunsak hi.

records.english: How do you deal with adults who talk over each other in your evening class?
records.zomi: Na nitak class-ah khat leh khat' thu a kituamsak upate bangci-in na kalsuan hiam?

records.english: I ask everyone to raise a hand, which they find funny at first but soon get used to.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh khut khang dingin ka ngen a, a kipat ciangin a nuih uh hi, ahi zongin a manlang-in a zang uh hi.

records.english: Can you report the broken street light on the council's website?
records.zomi: Council' website tungah lampi meivak kitam theisak thei ding hiam?

records.english: The new health centre is only a short walk from our flat.
records.zomi: Cidamna office thak pen i flat pan pai cik bek ahi hi.

records.english: How did your village get electricity, Grandpa?
records.zomi: Pu, na khua in electricity bangci-in a ngah hiam?

records.english: The government brought the power lines when I was twelve, and we all stayed up to watch the first light bulb.
records.zomi: Kum sawm leh nih ka hih lai-in kumpi in electricity khau a hong lak a, meivak masa pen en dingin i khempeuh ih lo-in i om uh hi.

records.english: Why doesn't the road outside our school have a proper crossing?
records.zomi: Bang hangin i sang pualam-a lampi ah kantanna kicing a om kei hiam?

records.english: Our family car is older than the motorway it drives on.
records.zomi: I innkuan mawtaw pen a tai na lampi lian sangin a lui zaw hi.

records.english: We moved here partly because the new railway station made the journey to work shorter.
records.zomi: Meileng station thak in nasepna-ah pai hun a tomsak hang khat-in hih mun-ah i hong teng uh hi.

records.english: When the old footbridge near our house was closed, the children had to walk an extra mile to school.
records.zomi: I inn kiang-a pai na lei lui a kikhak ciangin naupangte in sang-ah mile khat beh a pai kul uh hi.

records.english: The children love watching the workers repair the railway line behind our garden.
records.zomi: I huan nung-a meileng lampi nasemte in a bawl kik uh en pen naupangte in a ngaihsak mahmah uh hi.

records.english: Let's ask the council when the road works outside our house will finish.

records.english: The family took a photo on the day the new bridge opened.

records.english: Dad wrote to the council about the potholes after one burst his tyre.

records.english: New speed bumps on our road have made the children's walk to school much safer.
records.zomi: I lampi tunga lampi sang thak te in naupangte' sang pai lauhuai lo zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: When the main water pipe burst, our whole street queued at a tanker for drinking water.
records.zomi: Tuikhuam lian a puak ciangin i lampi bup in tui dawn ding adingin tui mawtaw khat kiangah a kigual uh hi.

records.english: Shall we take the new train line to visit my parents this month?

records.english: When the road to my parents' village is closed by snow, we can't visit for weeks.

records.english: Grandpa still talks about the day running water first reached his house.

records.english: The council finally built a ramp at the station, so Dad can travel in his wheelchair.
records.zomi: Council in a tawp-ah station ah kaltohna khat a bawl a, tua ahih manin Pa in a wheelchair tawh khualzin thei hi.

records.english: My grandparents' village got its first paved road the year I was born.
records.zomi: Ka pu leh pi' khua in ka suah kum-in lampi kibawl hoih masa pen a ngah hi.

records.english: Do you remember when the road to your village was just a mud track, Grandpa?
records.zomi: Pu, na khua lampi nin lampi neuno bek a hih lai na phawk lai hiam?

records.english: Did you report the fake website to the police?
records.zomi: A taktak hi lo website pen police kiangah na theisak hiam?

records.english: Our family group chat now has a rule: never send money because of a message alone.
records.zomi: I innkuan group chat in tu-in thukhun khat a nei hi: thukhak khat hang bek-in sum khak ngei kei un.

records.english: Don't send money to anyone who contacts you through a game.

records.english: Grandma proudly told us how she had recognised a scam call on her own.
records.zomi: Amah mah-in khemna phone khat a theih dan Pi in kisaktheih takin hong gen hi.

records.english: My husband reported the scam number so that it could be blocked.

records.english: It hurt Mum more that a stranger had lied to her than that she'd lost the money.
records.zomi: Sum a mansuah sangin mi theih lo khat in a juau a gen pen Nu adingin a na zaw hi.

records.english: Mum was nearly fooled by a caller who sounded exactly like a police officer.

records.zomi: Pi' phone tungah hong sam dingin a gen sticker khat ka kaap hi.

records.english: Can you look at this message before I reply?
records.zomi: Ka dawn ma-in hih thukhak hong en sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Call your cousin on their usual number first, because scammers copy profile photos.
records.zomi: Na sanggam a nambat zat den tawh a masa-in sam in, bang hang hiam cih leh mi khemmite in profile photo a teisawn uh hi.

records.english: Mum taught Grandpa to hang up whenever a caller says it's urgent.
records.zomi: Phone a sam mi in a manlang kul hi, a cih simin phone khak dingin Nu in Pu a sinsak hi.

records.english: Let's practise with Grandma what she'd say if a stranger called about her bank account.
records.zomi: Mi theih lo khat in a bank account tawh kisai a sam leh bang a gen ding hiam cih Pi tawh i kisin ni.

records.english: Our son's friend lost his gaming account to a stranger who offered free coins.
records.zomi: I tapa' lawm in coin man om lo a pia ding ci mi theih lo khat tungah a game account a mansuah hi.

records.english: Last year, Grandpa started chatting online with a woman who said she lived abroad.
records.zomi: Kum bei khin-in Pu in gamdang-ah ka teng hi, a ci numei khat tawh online-ah a kihoupih pan hi.

records.english: After a few weeks, she asked him to send money for a plane ticket to visit him.

records.english: My sister noticed the messages, and together we showed Grandpa that her photos belonged to someone else.

records.english: Is it safe to buy a second-hand pram from someone online?

records.english: Older relatives who live alone are often the first targets of phone scams.

records.english: The police officer who visited our street gave every family a leaflet about scams.

records.english: A fake charity asked for donations after the earthquake, and my aunt gave money before checking.

records.english: Has anyone in the family ever been tricked by a scam?

records.english: Did the bank give your money back after the scam?

records.english: Why does this message say my account will be closed today?

records.english: Our parents laugh at scam emails now, but they used to find them frightening.

records.english: The fake holiday cottage we booked online didn't exist, so we lost our deposit.

records.english: The children know not to post photos of our house keys online.

records.english: When my husband's social media account was hacked, his friends received messages asking for money.

records.english: We've told the children that a real friend will never ask them to keep secrets from their parents.

records.english: Just the short stretches, every couple of hours at your desk.
records.zomi: A cik khit cik ki-ngawng kisinna bek, na taupi kiang-ah nai nih simin.

records.english: The college counsellor helped me plan my revision around my treatment.
records.zomi: College lungsim huhpa in ka damsakna tawh kituak-in ka kisin kikna ngimna ka bawl nadingin hong huh hi.

records.english: The teacher was very kind when I explained why I needed to sit near the door.
records.zomi: Bang hangin kongkhak kiang-ah ka tut kul hiam cih ka gen ciangin saya in hehpihna a nei mahmah hi.

records.english: The plan allows me to return to full duties gradually over eight weeks.
records.zomi: Ngimna in kal giat sungah zawi zawi-in nasep bup ah ka ciah kik nading a phal hi.

records.english: My plan includes eating at regular times, so I've asked to have a fixed lunch break.
records.zomi: Ka ngimna sungah hun kician-in an nek kihel a, tua ahih manin sun an tawlngak hun kician khat ka ngen hi.

records.english: Following my plan at work was hard at first, but my colleagues made it easier.
records.zomi: Nasepna-ah ka ngimna zui pen a kipat ciangin a haksa a, ahi zongin ka nasem pihte in a baihsak uh hi.

records.english: My colleagues covered my calls on the afternoons I had treatment.
records.zomi: Damsakna ka neih sun nung lam te-in ka nasem pihte in ka phone sam te a dawn sak uh hi.

records.english: My plan says I need a short rest every two hours, which my supervisor has agreed to.
records.zomi: Ka ngimna in nai nih simin tawlngak cik ka kul hi, a ci a, tua pen ka makaipa in a phal hi.

records.english: HR helped me fit my physiotherapy around my working hours.
records.zomi: HR in ka physiotherapy ka nasep hun tawh a kituak nadingin hong huh hi.

records.english: Thanks to my treatment plan, I knew exactly which weeks I'd be away from work.
records.zomi: Ka damsakna ngimna hang-in bang kal te-in nasepna pan ka om lo ding hiam cih ka thei cing hi.

records.english: The supervisor checked that nothing in the apprentice's plan would require him to climb ladders or scaffolding.
records.zomi: Kisin nasempa' ngimna sungah kahlei hiam, scaffolding hiam a kahtoh kul nading bangmah a om lo hiam cih makaipa in a en hi.

records.english: Will my treatment plan be kept confidential at work?
records.zomi: Ka damsakna ngimna nasepna-ah kuku-in kikem ding hiam?

records.english: Can my treatment plan fit around my shifts?
records.zomi: Ka damsakna ngimna ka shift te tawh a kituak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, we can book your sessions for the mornings after your night shifts.
records.zomi: Hi, na zan shift khit zingsang te-in na hun te i laih thei hi.

records.english: The occupational therapist suggested a standing desk as part of my recovery plan.
records.zomi: Nasepna damsakna mi in ka damkikna ngimna khen khat-in ding-a nasepna taupi khat a hilh hi.

records.english: University students can ask for their treatment plan to be considered when exams are scheduled.
records.zomi: Sitna hun a kibawl ciangin university sangnaupangte in a damsakna ngimna uh ngaihsut dingin a ngen thei uh hi.

records.english: How long will I need to work part-time during the treatment?
records.zomi: Damsakna sungah bangzah sawt nai tawm-in na ka sem kul ding hiam?

records.english: About three months, and then we'll review it with your manager.
records.zomi: Kha thum bang, tua khit ciangin na manager tawh i en kik ding hi.

records.english: The school agreed that our son could leave lessons early on the days of his therapy.
records.zomi: I tapa' damsakna ni te-in sang pan a manlang-in a pai thei ding hi, ci-in sang in a phal hi.

records.english: A gradual return to work is often written into the treatment plan after a long illness.
records.zomi: Hun sau natna khit ciangin damsakna ngimna sungah zawi zawi-in nasepna ah ciah kikna kigelh zel hi.

records.english: The plan worked so well that I was back at my desk full-time a month early.
records.zomi: Ngimna in hoih takin na a sem ahih manin kha khat ma-in ka taupi ah nasep bup-in ka ciah kik hi.

records.english: Can I sit my exams during the treatment?
records.zomi: Damsakna sungah ka sitna te ka la thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, and the college will give you rest breaks if your doctor writes a letter.
records.zomi: Hi, na siavuan in laikhak khat a gelh leh college in tawlngak hun hong pia ding hi.

records.english: My manager adjusted my rota so that I could attend every session of my treatment.
records.zomi: Ka damsakna hun khempeuh ah ka pai thei nadingin ka manager in ka rota a khek hi.

records.english: The trainee missed practical sessions while his wrist healed.
records.zomi: Kisin nasempa in a khut ngawng a dam lai-in khut tawh kisinna hun te a mansuah hi.

records.english: Keep your treatment plan in your work bag in case anyone needs to see it.
records.zomi: Kuapeuh in a en kul kha leh, na damsakna ngimna na nasep ip sungah koih in.

records.english: I've told the team that I'll be in later on Mondays while I'm having physiotherapy.
records.zomi: Physiotherapy ka neih sung Pizing ni te-in a phawng-in ka tung ding hi, ci-in team kiangah ka gen hi.

records.english: My manager and I meet monthly to see which parts of the plan are working.
records.zomi: Ka manager leh kei kha simin ngimna khen bang in na a sem hiam cih en dingin i kimu hi.

records.english: The teacher keeps a copy of my daughter's plan in the classroom first-aid box.
records.zomi: Saya in ka tanu' ngimna copy khat sang inndan sung-a first-aid bawm sungah a koih hi.

records.english: The plan says I can't lift anything heavy for six weeks, so I've moved to office duties.
records.zomi: Ngimna in kal guk sung van gik ka dawm thei lo hi, a ci ahih manin office nasep ah ka kikhek hi.

records.english: My boss let me swap my early shifts so that I could keep my morning appointments.
records.zomi: Ka zingsang kimuhna te ka kem thei nadingin ka makaipa in ka zingsang shift te a khek sak hi.

records.english: A clear treatment plan protects both the employee and the employer.
records.zomi: Damsakna ngimna kician khat in nasem leh nasepsakpa a nih-in a kemcing hi.

records.english: Please tell us if your plan changes.
records.zomi: Na ngimna a kikhek leh hong theisak un.

records.english: Teachers find it easier to support pupils when the treatment plan is clear and realistic.
records.zomi: Damsakna ngimna a kician leh a taktak-a zui theih ciangin saya te in sangnaupangte huh a baih zaw uh hi.

records.english: My plan includes counselling every Tuesday evening after work.
records.zomi: Ka ngimna sungah Pithai ni nitak simin nasep khit ciangin lungsim huhna kihel hi.

records.english: Do I need to show my plan to my boss?
records.zomi: Ka makaipa kiangah ka ngimna ka lak kul hiam?

records.english: I do my breathing exercises in the staff room before my shift starts.
records.zomi: Ka shift a kipat ma-in nasemte' inndan sungah ka hu lak kisinna te ka bawl hi.

records.english: Discussing a treatment plan with your manager can feel uncomfortable, but it usually helps.
records.zomi: Na manager tawh damsakna ngimna kikupna in lungnuam lo-in a kisak thei a, ahi zongin a tamzaw-in a huh hi.

records.english: My tutor agreed to extend my deadlines while I followed my treatment plan.
records.zomi: Ka damsakna ngimna ka zui lai-in ka saya in ka nasep khak hun te a sausak dingin a phal hi.

records.english: Could I start later on the days after my injections?
records.zomi: Ka zatui sutna khit ni te-in a phawng zaw-in ka kipan thei ding hiam?

records.english: Are there any parts of the plan I can do during my lunch break?
records.zomi: Ka sun an tawlngak hun sungah ka bawl theih ngimna khen khat a om hiam?

records.english: Why did you choose to complain in writing rather than by phone?
records.zomi: Bang hangin phone tawh sangin laimal tawh phun dingin na teel hiam?

records.english: How come you volunteer at the food bank rather than the charity shop?
records.zomi: Bang hangin hehpihna sumbuk sangin an huhna mun ah thalawp na hih hiam?

records.english: I like meeting the families, and the charity shop is mostly sorting clothes.
records.zomi: Innkuante tawh kimuh ka ngaihsak a, hehpihna sumbuk ah a tamzaw-in puan teelkhen bek ahi hi.

records.english: When our club needed a new meeting place, I suggested the back room of the café.
records.zomi: I club in kikhopna mun thak a kisapna ciangin cafe' nung lam inndan ka hilh hi.

records.english: Some members preferred the church hall, so I explained that the café was cheaper and open later.
records.zomi: Kihel mi khenkhat in pawlpi inn lian a deih zaw uh ahih manin cafe a man niam zaw a, a phawng zaw dong a kihong hi, ci-in ka gen hi.

records.english: They agreed to try it for a month, and we've been meeting there ever since.
records.zomi: Kha khat sung zang sak dingin a kiciam uh a, tua pan tu dong tua mun ah i kikhop uh hi.

records.english: Why did you choose the library over the community centre for your class?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na class adingin khuasung inn lian sangin laibu inn na teel hiam?

records.english: The library has a lift, which matters for two of our learners.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in lift a nei a, tua pen i sinmi nih adingin a thupi hi.

records.english: I picked this route for the charity walk because it passes the hospital.
records.zomi: Damlo inn a pai kan ahih manin hehpihna vak kidemna adingin hih lampi ka teel hi.

records.english: Can you tell the members why you picked these dates for the trip?
records.zomi: Khualzinna adingin bang hangin hih ni te na teel hiam cih kihel mite kiangah na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Why did you move your appointment to the evening clinic?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na kimuhna nitak clinic ah na sawn hiam?

records.english: So that I don't have to take another morning off work.
records.zomi: Nasepna pan zingsang dang khat ka tawlngak kul nawn loh nadingin.

records.english: I use the walk-in centre because I never know in advance when I'll be free.
records.zomi: Bang hun-in ka awng ding hiam cih ka thei ma ngei loh manin a hong lut-a kimuh theih office ka zang hi.

records.english: I picked the Saturday class, since I work on weekdays.
records.zomi: Pizing ni pan Laithai ni dong na ka sep manin Kiginni class ka teel hi.

records.english: I joined the walking group instead of the gym, since it's free and sociable.
records.zomi: Man om lo a, mi tawh kithuahna a om manin gym sangin vak pawl ah ka kihel hi.

records.english: The housing officer explained why we had been offered a flat on the ground floor.
records.zomi: Inn office nasempa in bang hangin a nuai lam ah flat khat hong kipia hiam cih a gen hi.

records.english: The volunteers explained why they had painted the bench bright yellow.
records.zomi: Thalawpte in bang hangin tutphah sau gial tak-in a zep uh hiam cih a gen uh hi.

records.english: Residents asked the council to explain why it had chosen to close the smaller library.
records.zomi: Bang hangin laibu inn neu zaw a khak dingin a teel hiam cih gen dingin teng mite in council a ngen uh hi.

records.english: We chose the park for the festival because it's easy to reach by bus.
records.zomi: Bus tawh tun a baih manin pawi adingin park i teel uh hi.

records.english: Why do you always use the post office on Mill Street?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Mill Street tunga post office na zang den hiam?

records.english: The church explained that the hall fees had gone up to cover the cost of heating such an old building.
records.zomi: Inn lui hih bang lumsakna man a pia nadingin inn lian man a khang hi, ci-in pawlpi in a gen hi.

records.english: Could you explain why the clinic now asks for appointments online?
records.zomi: Bang hangin clinic in tu-in online-ah kimuhna a ngen hiam cih na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: I explained to the committee that the old minibus was no longer safe.
records.zomi: Minibus lui lauhuai lo nawn lo hi, ci-in committee kiangah ka gen hi.

records.english: Why are the recycling bins now collected on Tuesdays?
records.zomi: Bang hangin recycling bawm te tu-in Pithai ni-in kila hiam?

records.english: How come you vote by post these days?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tu hun-in post tawh vote na pia hiam?

records.english: What made you join the residents' association?
records.zomi: Bang hangin teng mite' kipawlna ah na kihel hiam?

records.english: The plans for the empty factory worried me, and I wanted a say.
records.zomi: Factory awng adingin ngimna te in hong lungkhamsak a, thu khat ka gen nop hi.

records.english: We chose the cheaper option, but only after checking it was safe.
records.zomi: Man niam zaw i teel uh hi, ahi zongin lauhuai lo hi, cih i en khit ciangin bek.

records.english: I gave my old furniture to the charity, because they collect it for free.
records.zomi: Man om lo-in a la uh ahih manin ka inn van lui te hehpihna pawl kiangah ka pia hi.

records.english: The local builder who fixed the church roof got our vote.
records.zomi: Pawlpi inn tung a bawl kik mun-a inn lam mi in i vote a ngah hi.

records.english: What persuaded you to sign up for the night bus scheme?
records.zomi: Zan bus ngimna ah min na piak nadingin bang in hong lungsim kihei sak hiam?

records.english: What was the thinking behind the youth club's trip to the coast?
records.zomi: Tangvalte' kipawlna' tuipi gei khualzinna ngaihsutna bang hiam?

records.english: The museum chose free entry on Sundays so that more families could visit.
records.zomi: Innkuan tam zaw in hong veh thei nadingin tangthu van kemna inn in Nipini-in man om lo-in lut theih a teel hi.

records.english: A written complaint leaves a record, which is why I always send one.
records.zomi: Laimal tawh phunna in ciamtehna a nusia a, tua ahih manin khat ka khak den hi.

records.english: Your notice made the change very clear.
records.zomi: Na theisakna lai in kikhekna a kician mahmah sak hi.

records.english: Why did you choose this café for the meeting?
records.zomi: Bang hangin kikhopna adingin hih cafe na teel hiam?

records.english: I chose that dentist because she's patient with nervous children.
records.zomi: Lau naupangte tungah thuakzawhna a neih manin tua ha siavuan ka teel hi.

records.english: A one-line reason on a notice can stop a hundred angry phone calls.
records.zomi: Theisakna lai tungah a hang tomno khat in heh mite' phone za khat a dal thei hi.

records.english: Can you explain why the clinic has moved to the other side of town?
records.zomi: Bang hangin clinic khuapi a dang lam ah a kitawn hiam cih na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: The organisers chose a Sunday afternoon so that families could come after church.
records.zomi: Pawlpi khit ciangin innkuante a hong thei nadingin vaihawmmite in Nipini sun nung lam a teel uh hi.

records.english: A plain-language explanation can prevent a lot of anger among residents.
records.zomi: Kam baih tawh gen-na in teng mite lak-ah hehna tampi a dal thei hi.

records.english: Is there a reason the market starts so early?
records.zomi: Sumbuk mun a manlang mahmah-a a kipat nading a hang khat a om hiam?

records.english: I chose the bigger allotment even though it's further away, because it gets sun for most of the day.
records.zomi: A gamla zaw hi napi, ni sung tampi ni a tang ahih manin huan mun lian zaw ka teel hi.

records.english: The newsletter explained the choice of venue.
records.zomi: Thuthak laithei in kikhopna mun teelna a gen hi.

records.english: We picked the community hall because it has a kitchen and a ramp.
records.zomi: Annek bawlna inn leh kaltohna a neih manin khuasung inn lian i teel uh hi.

records.english: The council explained that it had chosen a cheaper design to keep money for repairs.
records.zomi: Bawlkikna adingin sum a kep nadingin design man niam zaw a teel hi, ci-in council in a gen hi.

records.english: Why did the council pick that spot for the new bus stop?
records.zomi: Bang hangin council in bus khawlna thak adingin tua mun a teel hiam?

records.english: It's the only place where buses can stop without blocking the junction.
records.zomi: Tua pen lampi kikalna a dal lo-in bus te a khawl theihna mun khat bek ahi hi.

records.english: We chose a quiz night rather than a dinner, because more people could afford the tickets.
records.zomi: Mi tam zaw in lai man a pia thei uh ahih manin nitak an sangin dotna kidemna zan i teel uh hi.

records.english: I gave my vote to the playground plan, because our street has nowhere for children to play.
records.zomi: I lampi tungah naupangte kimawlna mun a om loh manin naupang kimawlna mun ngimna ah ka vote ka pia hi.

records.english: The cheaper caterer got the job, because the money is for the hospice.
records.zomi: Sum pen damlo kemna inn adingin ahih manin an bawl man niam zaw in nasep a ngah hi.

records.english: Officials rarely explain their choices as clearly as residents would like.
records.zomi: Ulianpite in a teelna uh teng mite' deih bang-in a kician-in a gen zel kei uh hi.

records.english: The library explained that it had replaced some books with computers because of demand.
records.zomi: Kisapna a om manin laibu khenkhat computer tawh a khek hi, ci-in laibu inn in a gen hi.

records.english: The charity explained that it chose the town centre so that homeless people could find the shelter easily.
records.zomi: Inn om lo mite in khawlna inn a baih takin a muh nadingin khuapi laizang a teel hi, ci-in hehpihna pawl in a gen hi.

records.english: Do you know what made the swimming club change its training night?
records.zomi: Tuipeek club in bang hangin a kisinna zan a khek hiam cih na thei hiam?

records.english: I chose the evening first-aid course so that my husband could look after the children.
records.zomi: Ka pasal in naupangte a kem thei nadingin nitak lam first-aid sinna ka teel hi.

records.english: Choosing the bus over the car saves me money, and I can read on the way.
records.zomi: Mawtaw sangin bus ka teel ciangin sum ka kem a, lampi tungah laibu ka sim thei hi.

records.english: Has the council said why it switched to wheelie bins?
records.zomi: Bang hangin khe nei eek bawm ah a khek hiam cih council in a gen khin hiam?

records.english: I switched to the smaller pharmacy because the staff there know my medicines and notice when something changes.
records.zomi: Nasemte in ka damdawi te a thei uh a, bangmah a kikhek ciangin a phawk uh ahih manin damdawi zuakna neu zaw ah ka kikhek hi.

records.english: The organisers explained that the fun run starts early to avoid the hottest part of the day.
records.zomi: Ni sung a sa pen hun pelh nadingin nuam-a tai kidemna a manlang-in a kipan hi, ci-in vaihawmmite in a gen uh hi.

records.english: The volunteer explained the tenancy agreement one paragraph at a time.
records.zomi: Thalawp in inn haai kiciamna lai paragraph khat khit khat-in a gen hi.

records.english: My friend thought the letter meant she owed money, but it was only a statement.
records.zomi: Ka lawm in laikhak pen sum ka ba hi, cihna hi, ci-in a ngaihsun a, ahi zongin sum kizatna lai bek ahi hi.

records.english: What does the sign at the park entrance say?
records.zomi: Park lutna mun-a ciamtehna in bang a gen hiam?

records.english: The book group argued for an hour about why the main character left her village.
records.zomi: Laibu pawl in bang hangin a tangthu sung-a numei lian in a khua a nusia hiam cih tawh kisai nai khat sung a kinial uh hi.

records.english: I didn't understand the end of the novel, so I'm glad we're discussing it tonight.
records.zomi: Tangthu laibu tawpna ka theisiam kei hi, tua ahih manin tuni zan-in i kikup ding uh hi, ka lungdam hi.

records.english: The children's librarian asks questions about the story halfway through, to keep them listening.
records.zomi: Naupangte' laibu inn kemtupa in a ngaikhia den nadingin tangthu a kim teng-in tangthu tawh kisai dotna a dong hi.

records.english: Could you read the instructions on the parking machine for me?
records.zomi: Mawtaw khawlna khawl tunga thuhilhna te hong sim sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Reading together in a group helps people who would never finish a book alone.
records.zomi: Pawl khat-in khawm-a sim in amau kia-in laibu a zo ngei lo ding mite a huh hi.

records.english: The library runs a reading group for adults who want to improve their understanding of newspapers.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in thuthak laibu a theisiam zawk nop upate adingin laibu sim pawl khat a nei hi.

records.english: My neighbour asked me to read a letter that had frightened her for a week.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng in kal khat sung a lausak laikhak khat sim dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: It turned out to be a simple reminder about a library book she had already returned.
records.zomi: Tua pen a ap kik khin laibu inn laibu khat tawh kisai phawksakna baihlam khat bek ahi hi.

records.english: We laughed with relief, and now she brings me every official letter before she starts to worry.
records.zomi: Lungnuam takin i nuih uh a, tu-in a lungkham ma-in kumpi laikhak khempeuh hong paipih hi.

records.english: Our book group reads one book from a different country every month.
records.zomi: I laibu pawl in kha simin gam tuam khat pan laibu khat a sim uh hi.

records.english: The volunteer went through my electricity bill with me line by line and discovered that I had been overcharged for months.
records.zomi: Thalawp in ka electricity man lai tawh khat khit khat-in ka kiangah a en a, kha tampi sung man tam lua ka pia hi, cih a mu hi.

records.english: Did you understand the museum label about the old map?
records.zomi: Gam lim lui tawh kisai tangthu van kemna inn ciamtehna na theisiam hiam?

records.english: Mostly, but I had to ask the guide what one of the words meant.
records.zomi: A tamzaw ka theisiam hi, ahi zongin kammal khat a khiatna lampi lakpa ka dong kul hi.

records.english: Volunteers read the local news aloud for people who can't see well.
records.zomi: Thalawpte in a mit a muh hoih lo mite adingin mun-a thuthak aw khang takin a sim uh hi.

records.english: Our reading group chose a short novel so that everyone could finish it.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh in a zawh theih nadingin i laibu sim pawl in tangthu laibu tomno khat a teel hi.

records.english: Read the menu first, and then decide what you want.
records.zomi: An laibu sim masa inla, tua khit ciangin na deih khensat in.

records.english: The citizenship handbook is long, so our tutor gives us one chapter a week.
records.zomi: Gam mi hihna laibu a sau ahih manin i saya in kal khat-in chapter khat hong pia hi.

records.english: What does the poster at the community centre say about next week?
records.zomi: Khuasung inn lian-a poster in kal hong tung ding tawh kisai bang a gen hiam?

records.english: Please read this leaflet before your first appointment.
records.zomi: Na kimuhna masa pen ma-in hih laithei sim in.

records.english: I find it easier to understand a leaflet when it has pictures.
records.zomi: Lim a neih ciangin laithei khat theisiam a baih zaw hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: When I finally understood the letter from the hospital, I felt much calmer.
records.zomi: Damlo inn pan laikhak ka theisiam ciangin ka lungsim a nuam mahmah hi.

records.english: Thank you for reading the letter with me; I understand it now.
records.zomi: Laikhak hong sim pih manin ka lungdam hi; tu-in ka theisiam hi.

records.english: Understanding a council letter can be the difference between keeping a benefit and losing it.
records.zomi: Council laikhak khat theisiam pen phattuamna kem leh mansuah kikal-a a kibatlohna ahi thei hi.

records.english: Read the safety notice by the pool before you get in.
records.zomi: Na lut ma-in tuipeek mun kiang-a lauhuai lo nading theisakna lai sim in.

records.english: Can you show me where it says the price on this menu?
records.zomi: Hih an laibu tungah man a gelhna mun hong lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Did the notice say the road was closed on Saturday or Sunday?
records.zomi: Theisakna lai in lampi Kiginni-in a kikhak hiam, Nipini-in hiam, a ci hiam?

records.english: Would you mind reading this form out to me?
records.zomi: Hih form hong sim sak leh na lungkham ding hiam?

records.english: The children's story time ends with a few questions about what happened.
records.zomi: Naupangte' tangthu gen hun in bang a piang hiam cih tawh kisai dotna tawm khat tawh a bei hi.

records.english: Reading the instructions on the voting slip carefully meant my vote counted.
records.zomi: Vote laikhak tunga thuhilhna te ka sim cian manin ka vote a kisim hi.

records.english: What did you think of the book we read for the reading group?
records.zomi: Laibu sim pawl adingin i sim laibu bang ci-in na ngaihsun hiam?
