records.zomi: Zomi pau-a innkuan laikhak lui te sim in i pu leh pite' nuntak dan taktak hong lak hi.

records.english: Does your family have a Zomi storybook for bedtime?
records.zomi: Na innkuan in ihmut ma-a sim ding Zomi tangthu laibu a nei hiam?

records.english: A Zomi calendar on the kitchen wall teaches the children the days and months without any effort.
records.zomi: Annek bawlna inn bang tunga Zomi calendar in naupangte ni leh kha te a hanciam lo-in a sinsak hi.

records.english: Our cousins abroad send us photos of their children's first Zomi handwriting.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a i sanggamte in a tate' Zomi laimal gelh masa pen photo hong khak uh hi.

records.english: Shall we write the family tree in Zomi and frame it?
records.zomi: Innkuan suan leh khak Zomi pau-in i gelh ding a, frame sungah i koih ding hiam?

records.english: My daughter wrote her grandmother's life story in Zomi for a school project.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in sang nasep adingin a pi' nuntak tangthu Zomi pau-in a gelh hi.

records.english: Every page my children read in Zomi is a small gift to their grandparents.
records.zomi: Ka tate in Zomi pau-in mai khat a sim simun a pu leh pite adingin letsong neu khat ahi hi.

records.english: When Grandma turned eighty, all the grandchildren wrote her a birthday card in Zomi.
records.zomi: Pi kum sawmgiat a cin ciangin a tu khempeuh in Zomi pau-in a suahni card a gelh uh hi.

records.english: Some of the youngest could only manage their names, but they wrote them carefully.
records.zomi: A neupen khenkhat in a min uh bek a gelh thei uh a, ahi zongin cian takin a gelh uh hi.

records.english: Grandma read every card twice and keeps them in a box beside her bed.
records.zomi: Pi in card khatciat nihvei a sim a, a lupna kiang-a bawm khat sungah a kem hi.

records.english: Read me the next page, and I'll help you with the hard words.
records.zomi: A zom mai hong sim sak in, kammal haksa te-ah ka huh ding hi.

records.english: Our son's spelling in Zomi is better than mine, which makes me laugh.
records.zomi: I tapa' Zomi laimal gelh dan keimah sangin a hoih zaw a, tua in hong nuihsak hi.

records.english: Some of the spellings in Grandpa's old letters are no longer used, which makes them a puzzle for the grandchildren.
records.zomi: Pu' laikhak lui te sung-a laimal gelh dan khenkhat kizang nawn lo a, tua in tute adingin a theih haksa a suaksak hi.

records.english: Can you check my spelling before I post this on the family chat?
records.zomi: Innkuan chat tungah ka koih ma-in ka laimal gelh dan hong en sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our family chat has become the place where the teenagers practise writing Zomi.
records.zomi: I innkuan chat pen tangvalnote in Zomi gelh a kisinna mun a suak hi.

records.english: My daughter reads the Zomi news to Grandpa.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in Pu kiangah Zomi thuthak a sim sak hi.

records.english: My cousin types in Zomi faster than anyone else in the family.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in innkuan sung-a mi dang kuapeuh sangin Zomi pau a manlang zaw-in a type hi.

records.english: Reading Zomi with my mother every evening slowly became the part of the day we both looked forward to most.
records.zomi: Nitak simin ka nu tawh Zomi laimal sim pen a zawi-in i nih-in i ngak pen ni sung hun a suak hi.

records.english: Learning to write our language helped my teenage son feel closer to his grandparents.
records.zomi: I pau gelh a kisin in ka tapa tangvalno a pu leh pite tawh a kinai zaw dingin a kisa hi.

records.english: Grandma corrects our spelling in red pen, just as she did for Dad.
records.zomi: Pa adingin a bawl bang-in Pi in i laimal gelh dan ink san tawh a bawl dik hi.

records.english: Dad writes a short prayer in Zomi in every birthday card he sends.
records.zomi: Pa in a khak suahni card khatciat sungah Zomi pau-in thungetna tomno khat a gelh hi.

records.english: Our family made a rule that birthday messages must be written in Zomi.
records.zomi: I innkuan in suahni thukhak te Zomi pau-in gelh ding hi, cih thukhun khat a bawl uh hi.

records.english: Mum keeps a notebook of the Zomi words the children misspell most often.
records.zomi: Nu in naupangte in a gelh khial tam pen Zomi kammal te' ciamtehna laibu khat a nei hi.

records.english: My brother texts our parents in Zomi.
records.zomi: Ka sanggampa in i nu leh pa kiangah Zomi pau-in text a khak hi.

records.english: I find it easier to read Zomi aloud than silently.
records.zomi: Zomi laimal dai takin sim sangin aw khang takin sim a baih zaw hi, ka ci hi.

records.english: Can you help me write a thank-you note to Auntie in Zomi?
records.zomi: Ni kiangah Zomi pau-in lungdamna lai tomno khat ka gelh nadingin hong huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Grandpa writes long letters in Zomi to his brother, who lives in another country.
records.zomi: Pu in gamdang-a teng a sanggampa kiangah Zomi pau-in laikhak sau te a gelh hi.

records.english: Our son was proud to read the Zomi Bible verse aloud at his grandfather's funeral.
records.zomi: I tapa in a pu' misi vuina ah Zomi Laisiangtho cang aw khang takin a sim theih manin a kisaktheih hi.

records.english: Is it all right if I send Grandpa a message in Zomi with mistakes?
records.zomi: Pu kiangah khialhna nei Zomi thukhak khat ka khak leh a hoih hiam?

records.english: He'll be thrilled, mistakes and all, so send it now.
records.zomi: Khialhna te tawh a kim-in a lungdam mahmah ding hi, tua ahih manin tu-in khak in.

records.english: Writing to my grandparents in Zomi forced me to learn words I had never needed before.
records.zomi: Ka pu leh pite kiangah Zomi pau-in ka gelh in a masa-a ka kisap ngei loh kammal te kisin dingin hong nawh hi.

records.english: How did your daughter learn to type in Zomi so quickly?
records.zomi: Na tanu in Zomi pau a manlang takin type bangci-in a kisin hiam?

records.english: Her cousins taught her on the family chat, one message at a time.
records.zomi: A sanggamte in innkuan chat tungah, thukhak khat khit khat-in a sinsak uh hi.

records.english: Let's read this Zomi story together, one line each.
records.zomi: Hih Zomi tangthu khawm-in i sim ding uh, khatciat in tang khat.

records.english: Thank you for writing back to me in Zomi, Grandma.
records.zomi: Pi, Zomi pau-in hong dawn kik manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: My grandparents never had the chance to learn to write, so they are proud that we can.
records.zomi: Ka pu leh pite in laimal gelh kisin nading hun a ngah ngei kei uh a, tua ahih manin i gelh theih manin a kisaktheih uh hi.

records.english: Grandpa reads a Zomi psalm aloud before every family meal.
records.zomi: Innkuan an nek ma simin Pu in Zomi Late khat aw khang takin a sim hi.

records.english: Can Grandpa still read the tiny print in his old Zomi hymn book?
records.zomi: Pu in a Zomi labu lui sung-a laimal neu mahmah te a sim thei lai hiam?

records.english: We bought our nephew a Zomi alphabet book for his third birthday.
records.zomi: I tanau a kum thumna suahni adingin Zomi laimal laibu khat i lei uh hi.

records.english: Is the Zomi on this wedding invitation spelled correctly?
records.zomi: Hih mopawi sapna lai tunga Zomi a dik-in kigelh hiam?

records.english: Why do you write the children's names in Zomi on their lunch boxes?
records.zomi: Bang hangin naupangte' min a an bawm tungah Zomi laimal-in na gelh hiam?

records.english: So that they get used to seeing their own names written in our language.
records.zomi: I pau-a kigelh a min mah uh muh a zat nadingun.

records.english: My wife can speak Zomi well, but she's only just learning to write it.
records.zomi: Ka zi in Zomi pau a pau siam hi, ahi zongin a gelh tu-in bek a kisin pan hi.

records.english: Please leave Grandma a note in Zomi before you go out.
records.zomi: Na pai khiat ma-in Pi adingin Zomi pau-in lai tomno khat nusia in.

records.english: Our children made rainbows out of paper after hearing the story of Noah.
records.zomi: Noah tangthu a zak khit uh ciangin i naupangte in lailep tawh sakhituihup a bawl uh hi.

records.english: Is it true that the covenant with Noah includes the animals too?
records.zomi: Noah tawh thuciamna in ganhing te zong a kihel taktak hiam?

records.english: We sang a song about God's faithful promises at church this morning.
records.zomi: Tuni zingsang-in pawlpi ah Pasian' thuman thuciamte tawh kisai la khat i sa uh hi.

records.english: Many Christians believe that the new covenant is open to people of every nation.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in thuciamna thak pen minam khempeuh mite adingin a kihong hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Christians believe that God keeps his promises.
records.zomi: Khristiante in Pasian in a thuciamte a tangtungsak hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: According to the prophets, the people often broke the covenant, but God did not abandon them.
records.zomi: Pasian kamsangte' gen bang-in mite in thuciamna a phiat zel uh hi, ahi zongin Pasian in amaute a nusia kei hi.

records.english: The story of God's covenant with Noah is found in Genesis.
records.zomi: Pasian in Noah tawh a thuciamna tangthu Piancilna sungah a om hi.

records.english: Grandma says the rainbow reminds her of God's faithfulness.
records.zomi: Sakhituihup in Pasian' thumanna hong phawksak hi, ci-in Pi in a gen hi.

records.english: Genesis calls Abraham the father of many nations.
records.zomi: Piancilna in Abraham minam tampi te' pa, ci-in a sam hi.

records.english: Tonight we'll read about Abraham and the stars.
records.zomi: Tuni zan-in Abraham leh aksi te tawh kisai i sim ding hi.

records.english: Grandpa reads the promise to Abraham at every family wedding.
records.zomi: Innkuan mopawi khempeuh ah Pu in Abraham kiang-a thuciamna a sim hi.

records.english: Some covenants in the Bible come with a sign, such as the rainbow or circumcision.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho sung-a thuciamna khenkhat in sakhituihup hiam, vunat hiam bang, ciamtehna khat a nei hi.

records.english: Do you know what the sign of the covenant with Noah was?
records.zomi: Noah tawh thuciamna' ciamtehna bang hiam cih na thei hiam?

records.english: Covenants in the Bible usually include promises, obligations and a sign.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho sung-a thuciamna te in a tamzaw-in thuciam, mawhpuakna leh ciamtehna a nei hi.

records.english: Why is there a rainbow in the story of Noah?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Noah tangthu sungah sakhituihup a om hiam?

records.english: According to Genesis, it's the sign of God's promise to Noah and to every living creature.
records.zomi: Piancilna bang-in, tua pen Pasian in Noah leh nuntakna nei ganhing khempeuh kiang-a a thuciamna' ciamtehna ahi hi.

records.english: The Last Supper is remembered in churches as the beginning of the new covenant.
records.zomi: Pawlpi te ah Nitak An Nunung pen thuciamna thak kipatna-in kiphawk hi.

records.english: What is a covenant in the Bible?
records.zomi: Laisiangtho sungah thuciamna cih bang hiam?

records.english: It's a solemn promise between God and his people, with commitments on both sides.
records.zomi: Tua pen Pasian leh a mite kikal-a thuciamna thupi khat ahi a, a langnih-ah mawhpuakna a om hi.

records.english: The prophets repeatedly reminded the people of the promises their ancestors had made to God.
records.zomi: Pasian kamsangte in a pu leh pate uh in Pasian kiangah a ciam thuciamte mite a phawksak den uh hi.

records.english: Our Bible study group compared the covenants with Noah, Abraham and Moses.
records.zomi: I Laisiangtho sinna pawl in Noah, Abraham leh Moses tawh thuciamna te a kiteh uh hi.

records.english: Is the new covenant mentioned in the Old Testament?
records.zomi: Thukham Lui sungah thuciamna thak kigen hiam?

records.english: The Ten Commandments are part of the covenant God made with Israel at Sinai, as Exodus describes.
records.zomi: Paikhiatna in a gen bang-in Thukham Sawm pen Pasian in Sinai mual tungah Isael tawh a bawl thuciamna khen khat ahi hi.

records.english: Can you find the passage in Jeremiah about the new covenant?
records.zomi: Thuciamna thak tawh kisai Jeremiah sung-a mun na zong thei ding hiam?

records.english: Christians remember the new covenant every time they share communion.
records.zomi: Khristiante in Topa' Nitak An a kihawm simun thuciamna thak a phawk uh hi.

records.english: Why did God choose Abraham?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pasian in Abraham a teel hiam?

records.english: Scholars compare the biblical covenants with ancient treaties between kings and their peoples.
records.zomi: Pilmite in Laisiangtho sung-a thuciamna te tangthu lui-a kumpite leh a mite kikal-a kiciamna te tawh a kiteh uh hi.

records.english: Where do Christians read about the new covenant?
records.zomi: Khristiante in thuciamna thak tawh kisai koi-ah a sim uh hiam?

records.english: In the prophet Jeremiah, and in the Gospels' accounts of the Last Supper.
records.zomi: Pasian kamsang Jeremiah sungah, leh Lungdamna Thu te-a Nitak An Nunung tangthu sungah.

records.english: God's covenant with David promised that his family line would continue, according to the books of Samuel.
records.zomi: Samuel laibu te' gen bang-in Pasian in David tawh a thuciamna in a suan leh khak a om den ding hi, ci-in a ciam hi.

records.english: Our pastor's sermon on God's promise to David was about trusting God for the future.
records.zomi: I pastor in Pasian in David kiang-a a thuciamna tawh kisai a thuhilhna pen hun hong tung ding-ah Pasian um tawh kisai ahi hi.

records.english: In Genesis, God renames Abram as Abraham when he makes the covenant with him.
records.zomi: Piancilna sungah Pasian in Abram tawh thuciamna a bawl ciangin a min Abraham-in a khek hi.

records.english: Have you read about Abraham leaving his home country?
records.zomi: Abraham in a gam a nusiat tawh kisai na sim khin hiam?

records.english: Some Christians renew their commitment to God in a special covenant service at the start of the year.
records.zomi: Khristian khenkhat in kum kipat ciangin thuciamna biakna tuam khat-ah Pasian kiang-a a kipiakna uh a thak uh hi.

records.english: The children performed a short play about Moses receiving the law on the mountain.
records.zomi: Naupangte in Moses in mual tungah thukham a ngah tawh kisai lam tomno khat a lak uh hi.

records.english: Many hymns celebrate God's faithfulness to his covenant.
records.zomi: La tampi in Pasian in a thuciamna tungah a thumanna a pahtawi uh hi.

records.english: Our children's Bible has a picture of the ark resting on a mountain.
records.zomi: I naupangte' Laisiangtho in mual tunga khawl tembaw lim khat a nei hi.

records.english: The Book of Hebrews describes Jesus as the mediator of a new covenant.
records.zomi: Hebrai laibu in Jesu pen thuciamna thak-ah a kikham mi ci-in a gen hi.

records.english: Our son asked whether God's promises still apply today.
records.zomi: Pasian' thuciamte tuni dong in a kizang lai hiam, ci-in i tapa in a dong hi.

records.english: Last Sunday, our pastor began a series of sermons on the covenants in the Bible.
records.zomi: Nipini bei khin-in i pastor in Laisiangtho sung-a thuciamna te tawh kisai thuhilhna zom khat a kipan hi.

records.english: He started with Noah and promised to finish with the new covenant at Easter.
records.zomi: Noah tawh a kipan a, Easter ciangin thuciamna thak tawh zo dingin a ciam hi.

records.english: Our son has drawn a timeline on the fridge so that we can follow along.
records.zomi: I zuih theih nadingin i tapa in fridge tungah hun kizom lim khat a bawl hi.

records.english: Why do Christians call the two parts of the Bible the Old and New Testaments?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Khristiante in Laisiangtho khen nih Thukham Lui leh Thukham Thak ci-in a sam uh hiam?

records.english: The covenants help Christians understand why the Old Testament matters to their faith.
records.zomi: Thuciamna te in bang hangin Thukham Lui a upna uh adingin a thupi hiam cih Khristiante a theisiam nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Jesus spoke of a new covenant when he shared bread and wine with his disciples, according to the Gospels.
records.zomi: Lungdamna Thu te' gen bang-in, Jesu in a nungzuite tawh khomun leh leenggahtui a kihawm ciangin thuciamna thak a gen hi.

records.english: Grandma calls the promises in the Bible the anchor of her life.
records.zomi: Pi in Laisiangtho sung-a thuciamte a nuntak' siklum ci-in a sam hi.

records.english: Do Jews and Christians understand the covenants in the same way?
records.zomi: Judah mite leh Khristiante in thuciamna te kibang-in a theisiam uh hiam?

records.english: A covenant in the Bible is more than a contract, because it involves a relationship.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho sung-a thuciamna pen kiciamna lai sangin a tam zaw hi, bang hang hiam cih leh kizopna a kihel hi.

records.english: Can you explain the covenant with Moses in simple words?
records.zomi: Moses tawh thuciamna kam baih tawh na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: What did God promise Abraham?
records.zomi: Pasian in Abraham kiangah bang a ciam hiam?

records.english: Genesis says God promised him a land, many descendants and a blessing for all nations.
records.zomi: Piancilna in Pasian in amah kiangah gam khat, suan leh khak tampi leh minam khempeuh adingin thupha a ciam hi, a ci hi.

records.english: The story of Abraham and Sarah waiting for a son is one of my favourites.
records.zomi: Abraham leh Sarah in tapa khat a ngak uh tangthu pen ka deih pen te lak-ah khat ahi hi.

records.english: Many Christians see the covenants as one long story of God's faithfulness.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in thuciamna te Pasian' thumanna tangthu sau khat-in a mu uh hi.

records.english: Our pastor said that the covenants show God choosing to bind himself to people.
records.zomi: Thuciamna te in Pasian in mite tawh amah le amah a kihen dingin a teelna a lak hi, ci-in i pastor in a gen hi.

records.english: Different Christian traditions explain the relationship between the old and new covenants in different ways.
records.zomi: Khristian ngeina tuamtuam in thuciamna lui leh thak kikal-a kizopna tuamtuam-in a gen uh hi.

records.english: God told Abraham to look at the stars and count them, if he could.
records.zomi: Pasian in Abraham kiangah aksi te en inla, na sim zawh leh sim in, a ci hi.

records.english: Shall we learn the names of the main covenants for the Sunday school quiz?
records.zomi: Nipini sang dotna kidemna adingin thuciamna lian te' min i sin ding hiam?

records.english: Let's draw the rainbow, the stars and the stone tablets to remember the covenants.
records.zomi: Thuciamna te i phawk nadingin sakhituihup, aksi leh suang pek te i lai ni.

records.english: Is the covenant at Sinai the one with the Ten Commandments?
records.zomi: Sinai-a thuciamna pen Thukham Sawm tawh a kizom pen hiam?

records.english: Yes, in the Book of Exodus, God gives Moses the law at Mount Sinai.
records.zomi: Hi, Paikhiatna laibu sungah Pasian in Sinai mual tungah Moses kiangah thukham a pia hi.

records.english: The interpreter asked the officer to repeat the question more slowly.
records.zomi: Pau let mi in ulian kiangah dotna a zawi zaw-in gen kik dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: The receptionist kindly repeated the address twice and then wrote it down.
records.zomi: Receptionist in hehpihna takin teenna nihvei a gen kik a, tua khit ciangin a gelh hi.

records.english: Could you say the pharmacy's opening hours again?
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakna' kihonna hun te hong gen kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: Nine until six on weekdays, and ten until one on Saturdays.
records.zomi: Pizing ni pan Laithai ni dong nai kua pan nai guk dong, leh Kiginni-in nai sawm pan nai khat dong.

records.english: Sorry, did you say the blue form or the green one?
records.zomi: Ka hepkhia ding, form dum na ci hiam, eng na ci hiam?

records.english: The automatic announcements at the station are so fast that tourists often ask staff to repeat them.
records.zomi: Station-a khawl aw theisakna te a manlang lua ahih manin khualzin mite in nasemte gen kik dingin a ngen zel uh hi.

records.english: Did the officer say we need to bring our passports or just a utility bill?
records.zomi: Ulian in i passport te i paipih kul hi, a ci hiam, electricity man lai bek, a ci hiam?

records.english: I didn't catch the end of the announcement about the road closure.
records.zomi: Lampi khakna tawh kisai theisakna a tawp ka za kha kei hi.

records.english: The pharmacist repeated the dosage instructions slowly and checked that I'd understood.
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakpa in damdawi zah thuhilhna te zawi takin a gen kik a, ka theisiam hiam cih a en hi.

records.english: Could you spell your surname, so that I can find your booking?
records.zomi: Na laih na ka muh theih nadingin na innkuan min hong gelh dan gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Please repeat the emergency number, just to be sure.
records.zomi: Kihaksat ciang phone nambat gen kik in, kip nadingin bek.

records.english: Sorry to ask again, but what time does the library close tonight?
records.zomi: Kik-in ka dot manin hong maisak in, ahi zongin tuni zan-in laibu inn bang hun-in a kikhak ding hiam?

records.english: Please say the bus number again, because I couldn't hear over the traffic.
records.zomi: Mawtaw ging hang-in ka zak theih loh manin bus nambat gen kik in.

records.english: Excuse me, did you just call my number?
records.zomi: Ka hepkhia ding, tu-in ka nambat na sam hiam?

records.english: At the town meeting, the microphone kept cutting out during the councillor's speech.
records.zomi: Khuapi kikhopna-ah council mi' thugenna sungah microphone a khawl zel hi.

records.english: People at the back kept calling out for her to repeat the figures.
records.zomi: Nung lam-a om mite in nambat te gen kik dingin a sam den uh hi.

records.english: In the end, she wrote the main numbers on a flip chart so that everyone could see them.
records.zomi: A tawp-ah mi khempeuh in a muh theih nadingin nambat thupi te flip chart tungah a gelh hi.

records.english: I'm afraid the line keeps breaking up, so could you say your postcode again, a little more slowly?
records.zomi: Phone a tan den ahih manin na postcode zawi zaw-in nihvei hong gen kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: Sorry, I was distracted, so could you remind me which window to go to?
records.zomi: Ka lungsim a lam dang-ah a om manin hong maisak in, bang tawhkhang ah ka pai ding hiam cih hong phawksak thei ding hiam?

records.english: How much did you say the ticket costs?
records.zomi: Lai man bangzah na ci hiam?

records.english: Would it be possible to have this information in writing as well, since I'll need to show it to my landlord?
records.zomi: Ka inn neipa kiangah ka lak kul ding ahih manin hih thu laimal tawh zong ka ngah thei ding hiam?

records.english: When the doctor repeated her advice, I realised that I had completely misunderstood it the first time.
records.zomi: Siavuan in a thuhilhna a gen kik ciangin a masa-in ka theisiam khial bup hi, cih ka thei hi.

records.english: Can you repeat the last part of the instructions about recycling?
records.zomi: Recycling tawh kisai thuhilhna te' a tawp khen hong gen kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: Visitors who don't hear the tour guide clearly should move closer rather than guess.
records.zomi: Lampi lakpa a kician-in a zak loh khualte in a ngaihsun sangin a kiang-ah a nai zaw ding uh hi.

records.english: I asked the clerk to go through the figures again, because they didn't add up.
records.zomi: Nambat te a kituak loh manin office nasempa kiangah kik-in en dingin ka ngen hi.

records.english: Speakers at public meetings should repeat each question so that the whole room can hear it.
records.zomi: Mipite' kikhopna-a thugente in inndan bup in a zak theih nadingin dotna khatciat a gen kik ding uh hi.

records.english: Is there another way you could explain that?
records.zomi: Tua thu gen nading lampi dang khat na nei hiam?

records.english: Hearing loops in public buildings help people who wear hearing aids follow what's said.
records.zomi: Mipite' inn-a hearing loop te in na za huhna khawl a zang mite in kigen te a zui thei nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: I asked the caller to repeat who she was before I gave any details.
records.zomi: Thu bangmah ka piak ma-in phone a sam numei kua ahi hiam cih gen kik dingin ka ngen hi.

records.english: What did the bus driver just say?

records.zomi: Ka sang lawm in ni haksa ka neih ciangin a phawk den hi.

records.english: The lecturer extended my deadline when I explained what was happening at home.
records.zomi: Inn ah bang a piang hiam cih ka gen ciangin saya in ka nasep khak hun a sausak hi.

records.english: The whole team signed a card when our colleague was in hospital.
records.zomi: I nasem pih damlo inn-a a om ciangin team bup in card khat ah a signature uh hi.

records.english: My colleague brought me soup when I was working late after my divorce.
records.zomi: Ka kikhen khit-a zanlai dong na ka sep lai-in ka nasem pih in an tui hong paipih hi.

records.english: Please let me know if there's anything I can do.
records.zomi: Ka bawl theih bangmah a om leh hong theisak in.

records.english: A colleague's kind words got me through my first terrible month in the job.
records.zomi: Nasem pih khat' kammal hoih te in nasep sung-a ka kha masa lauhuai pen a zawh nadingin hong huh hi.

records.english: My first-year students write anonymous notes about their worries, which I read every week.
records.zomi: Ka kum masa sangnaupangte in a lungkhamna uh min om lo lai tomno-in a gelh uh a, tua kal simin ka sim hi.

records.english: My tutor listened without judging when I told her about my family problems.
records.zomi: Ka innkuan haksatna te ka gen ciangin ka saya in mawhsak lo-in a ngaikhia hi.

records.english: The teacher noticed I was upset and asked me to help her after class, which gave me a chance to talk.
records.zomi: Saya in ka lungkham a phawk a, class khit ciangin amah huh dingin hong ngen a, tua in pau nading hun hong pia hi.

records.english: What should I say to a student who has failed an important exam?
records.zomi: Sitna thupi khat a nawk sangnaupang khat kiangah bang ka gen ding hiam?

records.english: Listen first, and then help them make a plan for the resit.
records.zomi: A masa-in ngaikhia inla, tua khit ciangin sitna kik adingin ngimna bawl dingin huh in.

records.english: Do firefighters talk together after every serious call?
records.zomi: Mei-sih nasemte in sapna thupi khatciat khit ciangin a kihoupih khawm uh hiam?

records.english: Good teachers notice when a cheerful pupil goes quiet.
records.zomi: Saya hoih te in lungdam den sangnaupang khat a dai ciangin a phawk uh hi.

records.english: Is there someone you trust at work that you could talk to?
records.zomi: Nasepna-ah na kihoupih theih na um mi khat a om hiam?

records.english: My classmates helped me catch up after I missed a month because of my mother's illness.
records.zomi: Ka nu' natna hang-in kha khat ka mansuah khit ciangin ka sang lawmte in ka tun kik nadingin hong huh uh hi.

records.english: Can we talk privately after the meeting?
records.zomi: Kikhopna khit ciangin kuku-in i kihoupih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Peer supporters are trained students who listen to classmates with problems.
records.zomi: Lawm huhmite pen haksatna nei sang lawmte' thu a ngaikhia dingin kisinsak sangnaupangte ahi uh hi.

records.english: Shall I walk with you to the counsellor's office?
records.zomi: Lungsim huhpa' office dong nang tawh ka pai ding hiam?

records.english: The class made a card for their teacher when she lost her father.
records.zomi: I saya in a pa a mansuah ciangin class in amah adingin card khat a bawl uh hi.

records.english: The school's chaplain is available for any pupil, whatever their faith.
records.zomi: Sang' pastor pen a upna uh bang hi ta leh sangnaupang khempeuh adingin a om hi.

records.english: Small gestures, like making someone a cup of tea, can show that you care.
records.zomi: Mi khat adingin tea khat bawl sak bang a neu te in na lungkhamna a lak thei hi.

records.english: The school held a quiet assembly after the death of a much-loved teacher.
records.zomi: Kingaihsak mahmah saya khat' sihna khit ciangin sang in dai taka kikhopna khat a nei hi.

records.english: Thank you for listening; I feel much better now.
records.zomi: Hong ngaikhia manin ka lungdam hi; tu-in ka lungsim a nuam mahmah zaw hi.

records.english: Is it all right if I cry for a moment?
records.zomi: Tawm khat sung ka kap leh a hoih hiam?

records.english: Is there someone at school I can talk to when I'm upset?
records.zomi: Ka lungkham ciangin ka kihoupih theih sang-ah kuapeuh a om hiam?

records.english: Yes, the counsellor, or any teacher you feel comfortable with.
records.zomi: Om hi, lungsim huhpa, a hih kei leh na lungnuam takin na om pih theih saya kuapeuh.

records.english: What would be a good example of a project for the community grant?
records.zomi: Khuasung sum huhna adingin nasep hoih khat' entelna bang ahi thei ding hiam?

records.english: Can you suggest a few short walks that are suitable for older people?
records.zomi: Upate adingin a kituak pai cik tawm khat na hilh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Examples help newcomers understand rules that seem obvious to everyone else.
records.zomi: Entelna te in a thak hong mite mi dang khempeuh adingin a kician thukhun te a theisiam nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: What kind of volunteering does the library need?
records.zomi: Laibu inn in bang thalawp nasep a kisam hiam?

records.english: Reading with children, helping at the computer sessions or shelving books, for example.
records.zomi: Entelna-in, naupangte tawh laibu sim, computer hun te-ah huh, a hih kei leh laibu koih.

records.english: An example of a good complaint is one that describes the problem and suggests a solution.
records.zomi: Phunna hoih khat' entelna pen haksatna a gen a, a bawl hoih nading lampi a hilh khat ahi hi.

records.english: The fire officer showed examples of chargers that had caught fire.
records.zomi: Mei-sih ulian in mei a kang charger te' entelna a lak hi.

records.english: The pharmacist showed me an example of the kind of pill box she recommended.
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakpa in a hilh damdawi bawm entelna khat hong lak hi.

records.english: What kinds of things can I borrow from the tool library?
records.zomi: Nasepna van laibu inn pan bang ka pukip thei ding hiam?

records.english: The community website gives examples of how residents can get involved.
records.zomi: Khuasung website in teng mite bangci-in a kihel thei uh hiam cih entelna te a pia hi.

records.english: The leaflet lists examples of emergencies, like a gas leak or a burst pipe.
records.zomi: Laithei in gas puak hiam, tuikhuam puak hiam bang, kihaksatna entelna te a gelh hi.

records.english: Can you give an example of a job that a ten-year-old could do at the fair?
records.zomi: Fair-ah kum sawm naupang khat in a sep theih nasep entelna khat na pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: When residents gave examples of near misses, the council agreed to build a crossing.
records.zomi: Teng mite in a kituak kha dek entelna te a gen uh ciangin council in kantanna khat lam dingin a kiciam hi.

records.english: Is there another example you could show me?
records.zomi: Hong lak theih entelna dang khat a om hiam?

records.english: The tutor brought examples of real bills for us to practise reading.
records.zomi: Saya in sim kisin nadingin man lai taktak entelna te a paipih hi.

records.english: The tenants' association collected examples of damp and mould from every flat in the block.
records.zomi: Inn haai mite' kipawlna in inn bup-a flat khempeuh pan nin leh mold entelna te a kaikhawm uh hi.

records.english: Concrete examples make a petition far more persuasive than general complaints.
records.zomi: Entelna taktak te in ngetna lai pen phunna tuamtuam sangin a lungsim heisak zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: What sort of things can I bring to the recycling centre?
records.zomi: Recycling mun ah bang van te ka paipih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Garden waste, old furniture and electrical items, but not paint or chemicals.
records.zomi: Huan eek, inn van lui leh electricity van te, ahi zongin lim zum leh chemical te hi lo.

records.english: Could you give me an example of a document that proves my address?
records.zomi: Ka teenna a kipsak lai khat entelna na pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: A recent utility bill or a letter from your bank would both be fine.
records.zomi: Electricity man lai thak hiam, na bank pan laikhak khat hiam, a nih-in a hoih hi.

records.english: Can you give us an example of a fair house rule for the shared garden?
records.zomi: Kihawm huan adingin inn thukhun diktat khat entelna hong pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: What sort of questions should I ask the landlord before I sign?
records.zomi: Ka signature ma-in inn neipa kiangah bang dotna te ka dong ding hiam?

records.english: What sort of food does the food bank need most?
records.zomi: An huhna mun in bang an a kisam pen hiam?

records.english: Could you describe a time when the service really helped someone?
records.zomi: Nasepna in mi khat a huh taktak hun khat na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: At the community meeting, residents kept saying that the street was unsafe at night.
records.zomi: Khuasung kikhopna-ah teng mite in zan-in lampi a lauhuai hi, ci-in a gen den uh hi.

records.english: The police officer asked them for specific examples, such as times and places.
records.zomi: Police in hun leh mun bang, entelna kician te a ngen hi.

records.english: Within a week, three new street lights had been put up exactly where people had described.
records.zomi: Kal khat sungah mite in a gen na mun taktak ah lampi meivak thak thum a kikoih hi.

records.english: The council used examples from other towns to show how the new market could work.
records.zomi: Sumbuk mun thak bangci-in na a sem thei ding hiam cih lak nadingin council in khuapi dangte' entelna te a zang hi.

records.english: For example, the community centre runs a free lunch on Wednesdays.
records.zomi: Entelna-in, khuasung inn lian in Nilai ni simin man om lo sun an khat a nei hi.

records.english: The coach showed the stroke before the children tried it.
records.zomi: Naupangte in a sit ma-un coach in tuipeek dan a lak hi.

records.english: Which festivals does the town hold during the summer?
records.zomi: Khal sungah khuapi in bang pawi te a bawl hiam?

records.english: What kinds of problems can the advice centre help with?
records.zomi: Thuhilhna office in bang haksatna te ah a huh thei hiam?

records.english: Housing, debts and benefits, mostly, but they'll point you elsewhere for anything else.
records.zomi: A tamzaw-in inn, leiba leh phattuamna, ahi zongin a dang khempeuh adingin mun dang ah hong lak ding uh hi.

records.english: The planning officer showed us examples of extensions that had been approved.
records.zomi: Inn lam phalna ulian in phalna a ngah inn behna entelna te hong lak hi.

records.english: The police gave examples of tricks that thieves use at cash machines.
records.zomi: Police in sum lakna khawl ah guta te in a zat khemna lampi entelna te a pia hi.

records.english: Which events would suit a family with young children?
records.zomi: Naupang neu nei innkuan khat adingin bang kikhopna te a kituak ding hiam?

records.english: The puppet show on Saturday and the nature trail in the park, for instance.
records.zomi: Entelna-in, Kiginni-a puppet lakna leh park sung-a gamlak lampi.

records.english: The gardening club brought plants that grow in shade.
records.zomi: Huan kemna club in limliam-ah a khang thei anlah te a paipih uh hi.

records.english: Last year's grants paid for projects such as a mural and a lunch club.
records.zomi: Kum bei khin-a sum huhna te in bang lim zep leh sun an club bang nasep te a man a pia hi.

records.english: Is there a practice test for the citizenship interview?
records.zomi: Gam mi hihna interview adingin kisinna sitna khat a om hiam?

records.english: Can you name a few charities that collect old clothes?
records.zomi: Puan lui a kaikhawm hehpihna pawl tawm khat' min na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Some volunteer jobs take only an hour a week.
records.zomi: Thalawp nasep khenkhat in kal khat-in nai khat bek a la hi.

records.english: Give me an example of when the bus was late, and I'll pass it on to the company.
records.zomi: Bus a phawng hun entelna khat hong pia in, company kiangah ka khak zom ding hi.

records.english: Would you fill in the first line with me, so I can see how it's done?
records.zomi: Bangci-in kibawl hiam cih ka muh theih nadingin a tang masa pen kei tawh na dim thei ding hiam?

records.english: The advice worker showed me examples of letters that had worked for other tenants.
records.zomi: Thuhilhna nasempa in inn haai mi dangte adingin na a sem laikhak entelna te hong lak hi.

records.english: What counts as antisocial behaviour, for example?
records.zomi: Entelna-in, bang om dan te mi dangte' lungsim natsak om dan-in a kisim hiam?

records.english: Examples of the children's art are in the library window.
records.zomi: Naupangte' lim suai entelna te laibu inn tawhkhang ah a om hi.

records.english: The noticeboard lists holiday activities for teenagers.
records.zomi: Theisakna bang tungah tangvalnote adingin tawlngakni nasep te kigelh hi.

records.english: Without a concrete example, I simply couldn't picture what the new playground would look like.
records.zomi: Entelna kician khat a om kei leh naupang kimawlna mun thak bang bang hi ding hiam cih ka ngaihsun thei lo bup hi.

records.english: The leaflet lists what can go in the green bin.
records.zomi: Laithei in eek bawm eng sungah bang a koih theih hiam cih a gelh hi.

records.english: The museum guide pointed to the old plough as an example of how farming has changed.
records.zomi: Tangthu van kemna inn lampi lakpa in lo nasepna bangci-in kikhek hiam cih entelna-in lo leh lui a lak hi.

records.english: Show me which bus timetable you mean.
records.zomi: Bang bus pai hun lai na ci hiam cih hong lak in.

records.english: What kinds of jobs are advertised at the job centre this week?
records.zomi: Hih kal-in nasep zonna office ah bang nasep te kitheisak hiam?

records.english: That example from the last festival made the plan much clearer.
records.zomi: Pawi nunung pan tua entelna in ngimna a kician mahmah sak hi.

records.english: Real examples from residents helped the council understand the parking problem.
records.zomi: Teng mite pan entelna taktak te in council mawtaw khawlna haksatna a theisiam nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: What's an example of a service the library offers that people don't know about?
records.zomi: Mite in a theih loh laibu inn' nasepna khat' entelna bang hiam?

records.english: Name one thing you'd like the council to change on our street.
records.zomi: I lampi tungah council in a khek dingin na deih khat gen in.

records.english: Could you give me an example of the kind of help a carer's allowance covers?
records.zomi: Kemmi sum huhna in a kihel huhna entelna khat hong pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: What are some ways that residents can save energy at home?
records.zomi: Teng mite in inn-ah electricity a kem theihna lampi khenkhat bang hiam?

records.english: My neighbour summarised the long letter from the housing association for me.
records.zomi: Ka inn veng in inn kipawlna pan laikhak sau khat a tom-in hong gen hi.

records.english: What are the main parking changes?
records.zomi: Mawtaw khawlna kikhekna thupi te bang hiam?

records.english: The citizenship tutor asked us to summarise a short article about local government.
records.zomi: Gam mi hihna saya in mun-a kumpi tawh kisai thu tomno khat a tom-in gen dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: Summaries of public meetings should include the decisions as well as the discussion.
records.zomi: Mipite' kikhopna a tom-a genna in kikupna bek hi lo-in thukhensatna te zong a kihel ding hi.

records.english: The librarian put the new opening hours on one poster.
records.zomi: Laibu inn kemtupa in kihonna hun thak te poster khat tungah a koih hi.

records.english: Long reports about local services are rarely read unless someone summarises them.
records.zomi: Mun-a nasepna tawh kisai report sau te kuapeuh in a tom-in a gen kei leh a kisim zel kei hi.

records.english: What's the main point of this leaflet from the water company?
records.zomi: Tui company pan hih laithei' thu thupi pen bang hiam?

records.english: Your water will be switched off for four hours next Tuesday morning.
records.zomi: Na tui kal hong tung ding Pithai ni zingsang-in nai li sung kiphiat ding hi.

records.english: The adult learning class practised summarising news articles about our town.
records.zomi: Upate' sinna class in i khuapi tawh kisai thuthak te a tom-in gen a kisin uh hi.

records.english: A summary written in simple language helps residents who are still learning the language.
records.zomi: Kam baih tawh kigelh a tom-a genna in pau a kisin lai teng mite a huh hi.

records.english: Our residents' group summarised its complaints in a single letter to the council.
records.zomi: I teng mite' pawl in a phunna te council kiang-a laikhak khat sungah a tom-in a gelh uh hi.

records.english: The library offers a short summary of each book club choice.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in laibu kipawlna teelna khatciat' a tom-a genna a pia hi.

records.english: In short, the swimming pool will be closed for repairs until June.
records.zomi: A tom-in gen leh, tuipeek mun June dong bawlkikna adingin a kikhak ding hi.

records.english: The advice worker summarised my options so that I could choose more easily.
records.zomi: Ka teel baih zawk nadingin thuhilhna nasempa in ka teel theih te a tom-in a gen hi.

records.english: Could you tell the new volunteers briefly what we do at the food bank?
records.zomi: An huhna mun-ah bang i sem hiam cih thalawp thakte kiangah tom takin na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: The guide's summary of the walk made the long route sound easy.
records.zomi: Lampi lakpa' vak lampi a tom-a genna in lampi sau a baih bang-in a kilatsak hi.

records.english: Can you summarise the safety talk for the children who arrived late?
records.zomi: A phawng-a hong naupangte adingin lauhuai lo nading thugenna a tom-in na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Would you explain the bus company's apology to Grandma in a sentence or two?
records.zomi: Bus company' maisak ngetna Pi kiangah kammal kizom khat nih tawh na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Summaries of long consultations sometimes leave out the parts residents care about most.
records.zomi: Mipite' dotna sau te' a tom-a genna in teng mite in a thupi sak pen khen te a nusia zel hi.

records.english: Could you put the main points of the leaflet on a card for my mother?
records.zomi: Ka nu adingin laithei' thu thupi te card khat tungah na koih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Can you sum up what the councillor said about the new road?
records.zomi: Lampi thak tawh kisai council mi in bang a gen hiam cih a tom-in na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Work starts in March, it will take a year, and the bus route will change while it's built.
records.zomi: Nasep March-in kipan ding a, kum khat a la ding a, a kilam sung bus lampi a kikhek ding hi.

records.english: The volunteer summarised a long government form into a checklist that anyone could follow.
records.zomi: Thalawp in kumpi form sau khat kuapeuh in a zuih theih en ding min khat-ah a tom-in a bawl hi.

records.english: The fire officer summarised the evacuation plan in three simple steps.
records.zomi: Mei-sih ulian in tai khiatna ngimna kalbi baih thum-in a tom-in a gen hi.

records.english: Summarising other people's views fairly is one of the hardest jobs in a community meeting.
records.zomi: Mi dangte' ngaihsutna te diktat takin a tom-in gen pen khuasung kikhopna-a nasep haksa pen te lak-ah khat ahi hi.

records.english: Write down the three main points from the talk, please.
records.zomi: Thugenna pan thu thupi thum gelh in.

records.english: Can you summarise what the museum's new exhibition is about?
records.zomi: Tangthu van kemna inn' lakna thak bang tawh kisai hiam cih a tom-in na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: What does the planning application actually propose?
records.zomi: Inn lam phalna ngetna in bang a ngen taktak hiam?

records.english: The residents' newsletter begins with a summary of last month's meeting.
records.zomi: Teng mite' thuthak laithei in kha bei khin kikhopna a tom-a genna tawh a kipan hi.

records.english: Is the clinic open on Saturday, in a word?
records.zomi: Kammal khat-in gen leh, clinic Kiginni-in a kihong hiam?

records.english: The radio station summarised the road closures every hour during the storm.
records.zomi: Huihpi sungah radio in nai simin lampi khakna te a tom-in a gen hi.

records.english: What did the doctor's letter say, in short?
records.zomi: A tom-in gen leh siavuan' laikhak in bang a ci hiam?

records.english: Your test results are normal, and you don't need to go back.
records.zomi: Na sitna gah te a pianzia hi, leh na pai kik kul kei hi.

records.english: The minutes are long, but the summary at the top tells you what was decided.
records.zomi: Kikhopna ciamtehna a sau hi, ahi zongin a tung lam-a a tom-a genna in bang kikhensat hiam cih a gen hi.

records.english: How do you summarise a long consultation for residents who are busy?
records.zomi: Hun nei lo teng mite adingin mipite' dotna sau khat bangci-in a tom-in na gen hiam?

records.english: One page with the three main changes, and a link to the full document for anyone who wants it.
records.zomi: Kikhekna thupi thum tawh mai khat, leh a deih kuapeuh adingin lai bup' link khat.

records.english: The tour guide summarised the history of the castle in five minutes.
records.zomi: Lampi lakpa in kulhpi' tangthu minit nga sungah a tom-in a gen hi.

records.english: The nurse summarised my care plan on a card that I keep in my wallet.
records.zomi: Nurse in ka kemna ngimna ka sum ip sung-a ka kem card khat tungah a tom-in a gelh hi.

records.english: The council published a short summary of the consultation results online.
records.zomi: Council in mipite' dotna gah te' a tom-a genna online-ah a koih hi.

records.english: The church secretary summarised the parish meeting for those who were away.
records.zomi: Pawlpi laigelhpa in a om lo mite adingin khua sung kikhopna a tom-in a gelh hi.

records.english: Can you sum up the councillor's answer in one sentence?
records.zomi: Council mi' dawnna kammal kizom khat-in a tom-in na gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Our tenants' association received a forty-page report about repairs to the flats.
records.zomi: I inn haai mite' kipawlna in flat te' bawlkikna tawh kisai mai sawmli report khat a ngah uh hi.

records.english: Three of us read it and wrote a one-page summary in plain language.
records.zomi: I lak-ah mi thum in i sim uh a, kam baih tawh mai khat a tom-a genna i gelh uh hi.

records.english: We pinned the summary in every hallway, and more people came to the next meeting than ever before.
records.zomi: Kahlei kiang khatciat ah a tom-a genna i khai uh a, a zom kikhopna ah mi a masa sangin a tam zaw-in a hong uh hi.

records.english: The police officer summed up the safety advice.
records.zomi: Police in lauhuai lo nading thuhilhna a tom-in a gen hi.

records.english: The short version is that bus fares rise next month.
records.zomi: A tom-in gen leh, kha hong tung ding-in bus man a khang ding hi.

records.english: Thank you for summing up the meeting so clearly.
records.zomi: Kikhopna a kician mahmah-in a tom-in na gen manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Could someone summarise the plans for people who can't read the small print?
records.zomi: Laimal neu a sim thei lo mite adingin kuapeuh in ngimna te a tom-in a gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: A summary at the top of a council letter saves residents a lot of worry.
records.zomi: Council laikhak' tung lam-a a tom-a genna in teng mite lungkhamna tampi a kemsak hi.

records.english: The volunteer wrote each family's needs on a card.
records.zomi: Thalawp in innkuan khatciat' kisapna te card khat tungah a gelh hi.

records.english: The local newspaper summarised the council's decisions in a box on page two, which many readers find more useful than the full report.
records.zomi: Mun-a thuthak laibu in council' thukhensatna te mai nihna-a bawm khat sungah a tom-in a gelh a, sim mi tampi in tua pen report bup sangin a manpha zaw sa uh hi.

records.english: Before you leave, could you sum up the advice you were given, so we know you've understood?
records.zomi: Na pai ma-in na kipiak thuhilhna a tom-in na gen thei ding hiam, na theisiam hiam cih i theih nadingin?

records.english: Could you write a short summary of the meeting for the newsletter?
