records.english: How would you describe a prophet's job to a six-year-old?
records.zomi: Kum guk naupang khat kiangah Pasian kamsang' nasep bangci-in na gen ding hiam?

records.english: This morning's opening hymn took its words from Isaiah.
records.zomi: Tuni zingsang-a la masa pen in a kammal Isaiah pan a la hi.

records.english: Let's learn the names of the major prophets for the quiz.
records.zomi: Dotna kidemna adingin Pasian kamsang lian te' min i sin ni.

records.english: Daniel's book includes visions as well as stories about his life in Babylon.
records.zomi: Daniel laibu in Babylon-a a nuntak tangthu te bek hi lo-in mangmuhna te zong a nei hi.

records.english: The prophet Hosea compared God's love to a faithful husband's love for an unfaithful wife.
records.zomi: Pasian kamsang Hosea in Pasian' itna pen zi thuman lo khat tungah pasal thuman khat' itna tawh a teh hi.

records.english: Many hymns use words from the prophets, especially at Advent.
records.zomi: La tampi in Pasian kamsangte' kammal te a zang uh a, a lian pen-in Advent hun-in.

records.english: The prophets' call for honest scales and fair wages still challenges Christians today.
records.zomi: Bukna dik leh khasum diktat adingin Pasian kamsangte' sapna in tuni-in zong Khristiante a lau sak lai hi.

records.english: Do you know which prophet faced the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel?
records.zomi: Carmel mual tungah Baal kamsangte a langpan Pasian kamsang kua hiam cih na thei hiam?

records.english: Did the prophets only predict the future?
records.zomi: Pasian kamsangte in a hun hong tung ding bek a genkholh uh hiam?

records.english: No, much of their message was a call to justice, faithfulness and care for the poor.
records.zomi: Hi lo, a thu uh tampi pen diktatna, thumanna leh mi zawngte kemna adingin sapna ahi hi.

records.english: The prophet Jeremiah is sometimes called the weeping prophet.
records.zomi: Pasian kamsang Jeremiah pen khatveivei a kap Pasian kamsang ci-in kisam hi.

records.english: The prophets spoke about God's justice and also about his mercy.
records.zomi: Pasian kamsangte in Pasian' diktatna leh a hehpihna tawh kisai a gen uh hi.

records.english: Prophecy in the Bible is less about telling fortunes and more about calling people back to God.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho sung-a genkholhna pen vangtat gen sangin mite Pasian kiangah sapkik ahi zaw hi.

records.english: Why do Christians read Isaiah at Christmas?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Christmas-in Khristiante in Isaiah a sim uh hiam?

records.english: Many Christians believe that some of Isaiah's words point to the birth of Jesus.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in Isaiah' kammal khenkhat in Jesu' suahna a lak hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Our Bible study group spent the autumn reading the Book of Amos.
records.zomi: I Laisiangtho sinna pawl in kum tawp lam sung Amos laibu a sim uh hi.

records.english: We were surprised by how strongly the prophet spoke against people who cheated the poor.
records.zomi: Pasian kamsang in mi zawngte a khem mite a langpan-a a hat takin a pau dan i lamdang sa uh hi.

records.english: One member said that Amos could have been writing about our own town.
records.zomi: Kihel mi khat in Amos in i khuapi tawh kisai a gelh pen thei hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Christians believe the prophets pointed to Jesus.
records.zomi: Khristiante in Pasian kamsangte in Jesu a lak uh hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Our son wanted to know whether prophets could see the future.
records.zomi: Pasian kamsangte in a hun hong tung ding a mu thei uh hiam cih i tapa in a theih nop hi.

records.english: Our pastor says the prophets ask us to look honestly at our own lives.
records.zomi: Pasian kamsangte in i nuntak mah uh thuman takin en dingin hong ngen uh hi, ci-in i pastor in a gen hi.

records.english: Some prophets used actions, not just words, to deliver their message.
records.zomi: Pasian kamsang khenkhat in a thu uh pulak nadingin kammal bek hi lo-in sepna zong a zang uh hi.

records.english: The children drew pictures of Elijah being carried up to heaven.
records.zomi: Naupangte in Elijah vantung ah a kipuak lim a suai uh hi.

records.english: The prophet Nathan bravely told King David that he had done wrong.
records.zomi: Pasian kamsang Nathan in a hang takin David kumpipa kiangah a khial hi, ci-in a gen hi.

records.english: The Psalms and the prophets are quoted many times in the New Testament.
records.zomi: Thukham Thak sungah Late leh Pasian kamsangte' thu tampi vei kigen kik hi.

records.english: Is the Book of Revelation a book of prophecy?
records.zomi: Mangmuhna laibu pen genkholhna laibu khat hiam?

records.english: Grandpa reads the prophecy about a child being born every Christmas Eve.
records.zomi: Christmas zan simin Pu in naupang khat suah ding genkholhna a sim hi.

records.english: The Bible describes Moses as a prophet too.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho in Moses zong Pasian kamsang ci-in a gen hi.

records.english: Many Christians see the Book of Micah's mention of Bethlehem as a prophecy about Jesus.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in Mikah laibu in Bethlehem a gen pen Jesu tawh kisai genkholhna khat-in a mu uh hi.

records.english: Who counts as a prophet, Grandma?
records.zomi: Pi, kua pen Pasian kamsang-in kisim hiam?

records.english: Someone who speaks God's message to the people, according to the Bible.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho bang-in mite kiangah Pasian' thu a gen mi khat.

records.english: Our pastor preached about the prophet Elijah on Sunday.
records.zomi: Nipini-in i pastor in Pasian kamsang Elijah tawh kisai thu a hilh hi.

records.english: Our youth group discussed what the prophets would say about our society today.
records.zomi: I tangvalte' pawl in Pasian kamsangte in tuni-a i khuasung tawh kisai bang a gen ding uh hiam cih a kikup uh hi.

records.english: The Book of Joel speaks of God's spirit being poured out on all people.
records.zomi: Joel laibu in Pasian' Kha mi khempeuh tungah a kibuak ding a gen hi.

records.english: Isaiah has sixty-six chapters, more than any other prophetic book.
records.zomi: Isaiah in chapter sawmguk leh guk a nei a, Pasian kamsang laibu dang kuapeuh sangin a tam zaw hi.

records.english: Some churches believe that God still gives the gift of prophecy today.
records.zomi: Pawlpi khenkhat in tuni-in zong Pasian in kamsanna letsong a pia lai hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Many Christians call John the Baptist the last prophet before Jesus.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in Baptisma Johan pen Jesu ma-a Pasian kamsang nunung pen ci-in a sam uh hi.

records.english: The prophet Amos was a shepherd before God called him.
records.zomi: Pasian in a sap ma-in Pasian kamsang Amos pen tuucing ahi hi.

records.english: Many prophecies in the Bible were first spoken to people in a particular time and place.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho sung-a genkholhna tampi pen a masa-in hun leh mun khat-a mite kiangah kigen hi.

records.english: Isaiah describes a servant who suffers for others, whom Christians link with Jesus.
records.zomi: Isaiah in mi dangte adingin a thuak sila khat a gen a, Khristiante in Jesu tawh a kizopsak uh hi.

records.english: Grandma underlines the comforting promises in Isaiah.
records.zomi: Pi in Isaiah sung-a lungnopsak thuciamte a nuai-ah khau a khai hi.

records.english: The prophets often warned kings.
records.zomi: Pasian kamsangte in kumpite a vaikhak zel uh hi.

records.english: Some readers try to match biblical prophecies to modern events, but many church leaders urge caution.
records.zomi: Sim mi khenkhat in Laisiangtho genkholhna te tu hun thu piang te tawh a kituaksak nop uh hi, ahi zongin pawlpi makaipa tampi in kidawm dingin a hilh uh hi.

records.english: Jonah was angry when God forgave Nineveh.
records.zomi: Pasian in Nineveh a maisak ciangin Jonah a heh hi.

records.english: Is the Book of Isaiah part of the Jewish scriptures as well?
records.zomi: Isaiah laibu pen Judah mite' Laisiangtho khen khat zong ahi hiam?

records.english: Yes, it is, although Jews and Christians often interpret its prophecies differently.
records.zomi: Hi, ahi zongin Judah mite leh Khristiante in a genkholhna te tuamtuam-in a theisiam zel uh hi.

records.english: Why did Jonah try to run away?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Jonah a tai khiat nop hiam?

records.english: Which prophet was swallowed by a great fish?
records.zomi: Bang Pasian kamsang ngapi in a valh hiam?

records.english: Jonah, who tried to run away from the task God gave him.
records.zomi: Pasian in a piak nasep pan a tai khiat nop Jonah.

records.english: The Book of Ezekiel describes a vision of dry bones coming back to life.
records.zomi: Ezekiel laibu in guh keu te a hong nungta kik mangmuhna khat a gen hi.

records.english: Christians interpret prophecies about the end of the world in many different ways.
records.zomi: Khristiante in leitung tawpna tawh kisai genkholhna te lampi tuamtuam tampi-in a theisiam uh hi.

records.english: Our Advent candles remind us of the prophets' hope for a coming king.
records.zomi: I Advent khawimeivaak te in Pasian kamsangte' kumpi hong pai ding lametna hong phawksak hi.

records.english: Our children's Bible tells the story of Samuel hearing God's voice at night.
records.zomi: I naupangte' Laisiangtho in Samuel in zan-in Pasian' aw a zak tangthu a gen hi.

records.english: Are there prophets in the New Testament too?
records.zomi: Thukham Thak sungah zong Pasian kamsangte a om uh hiam?

records.english: Where in the Bible is the Book of Daniel?
records.zomi: Laisiangtho sungah Daniel laibu koi-ah a om hiam?

records.english: You said you'd applied for the job at the leisure centre; have you had an interview?
records.zomi: Leisure centre-a nasep na ngen hi, na ci a; interview na nei khin hiam?

records.english: And what did the pharmacist say when you asked about the side effects?
records.zomi: Gah dang tawh kisai na dot ciangin damdawi zuakpa in bang a gen hiam?

records.english: She said they usually wear off after a week, but to call the surgery if they don't.
records.zomi: A tamzaw-in kal khat khit ciangin a bei zel hi, a ci a, a bei kei leh siavuan office sam dingin a gen hi.

records.english: Did the school ever reply about the crossing outside the gates?
records.zomi: Kongkhak pualam-a kantanna tawh kisai sang in a dawng ngei hiam?

records.english: When the receptionist said she'd call back, did she give you a time?
records.zomi: Receptionist in kik-in ka sam ding hi, a ci ciangin hun khat a gen hiam?

records.english: Is there any word from the youth club about places for next term?
records.zomi: Term hong tung ding adingin mun tawh kisai tangvalte' kipawlna pan thu khat a om hiam?

records.english: Last month, I asked the library whether they could start a homework club.
records.zomi: Kha bei khin-in inn-a nasep club khat a kipatsak thei uh hiam cih laibu inn ka dong hi.

records.english: The librarian said she would ask her manager and get back to me.
records.zomi: A manager a dong ding a, kik-in hong theisak ding hi, ci-in laibu inn kemtupa in a gen hi.

records.english: When I followed up a week later, she told me the club would open after the holidays.
records.zomi: Kal khat khit ciangin ka en kik ciangin tawlngakni khit ciangin club a kihong ding hi, ci-in hong gen hi.

records.english: Did the clinic ever send you the test results?
records.zomi: Clinic in sitna gah te hong khak ngei hiam?

records.english: Was the doctor any more helpful the second time?
records.zomi: A nihna vei-in siavuan in a huh zaw hiam?

records.english: What did the tenants' association decide after the meeting?
records.zomi: Kikhopna khit ciangin inn haai mite' kipawlna in bang a khensat hiam?

records.english: So did the vet think the dog needed an operation?
records.zomi: Tua ahih leh ganhing siavuan in ui zatui a kisam hi, a ci hiam?

records.english: Following up a complaint politely often gets results faster than shouting.
records.zomi: Phunna khat zahtak takin en kik pen kikou sangin a gah a manlang zaw zel hi.

records.english: You told me the landlord promised to fix the heating; has he done it yet?
records.zomi: Inn neipa in lumsakna bawl kik dingin a ciam hi, na ci a; a bawl khin hiam?

records.english: And what happened to the old man who fell in the market?
records.zomi: Sumbuk mun-a a puk pasal upa tungah bang a piang hiam?

records.english: Politely asking for an update can remind busy staff that your case is still waiting.
records.zomi: Thu thak zahtak takin dot in nasem buai te na thu a ngak lai hi, cih a phawksak thei hi.

records.english: You mentioned a waiting list for the allotments; how long is it now?
records.zomi: Huan mun adingin ngakna min khat na gen hi; tu-in bangzah a sau hiam?

records.english: About eighteen months, but it's shorter for the smaller plots.
records.zomi: Kha sawm leh giat bang, ahi zongin huan mun neu zaw te adingin a tom zaw hi.

records.english: Did the councillor ever visit the playground, as he promised?
records.zomi: Council mi in a ciam bang-in naupang kimawlna mun a veh ngei hiam?

records.english: The housing officer promised to ring back, but I had to chase her twice before she finally called.
records.zomi: Inn office nasempa in kik-in sam dingin a ciam a, ahi zongin a tawp-ah a sam ma-in nihvei ka sam kul hi.

records.english: And after you filled in the form, when did they say you'd hear back?
records.zomi: Form na dim khit ciangin bang hun-in na thu na za ding hi, a ci uh hiam?

records.english: Have they told you when the road works will finish?
records.zomi: Lampi nasep bang hun-in a zo ding hiam cih hong gen uh hiam?

records.english: Following up a week later, I discovered that my application had been lost somewhere between two departments.
records.zomi: Kal khat khit ciangin ka en kik ciangin ka ngetna lai department nih kikal-ah a mang hi, cih ka thei hi.

records.english: The charity called back to ask whether the advice had solved our problem.
records.zomi: Hehpihna pawl in thuhilhna in i haksatna a bawl dik hiam cih dot dingin kik-in a sam hi.

records.english: You said you'd ask about evening classes; did the college have any?
records.zomi: Nitak class tawh kisai ka dong ding hi, na ci a; college in a nei hiam?

records.english: What happened when you took the faulty kettle back to the shop?
records.zomi: Tui-um siat sumbuk ah na ap kik ciangin bang a piang hiam?

records.english: The volunteer rang me a week later to check that the food parcel had helped.
records.zomi: An bawm in hong huh hiam cih en dingin thalawp in kal khat khit ciangin hong sam hi.

records.english: Asking what happened next showed the officer that we were serious about the problem.
records.zomi: A zom-ah bang a piang hiam cih dot in haksatna tawh kisai i thupi sak hi, cih ulian a lak hi.

records.english: So the bank refunded the money after you complained?
records.zomi: Tua ahih leh na phun khit ciangin bank in sum hong pia kik hiam?

records.english: After my first enquiry had been ignored for a month, I went to the office in person and waited until someone saw me.
records.zomi: Ka dotna masa kha khat sung a kinusiat khit ciangin office ah keimah mah ka pai a, kuapeuh in hong muh dong ka ngak hi.

records.english: What happened after you reported the broken street light?
records.zomi: Lampi meivak siat na theisak khit ciangin bang a piang hiam?

records.english: Nothing for two weeks, so I phoned again, and it was fixed the next day.
records.zomi: Kal nih sung bangmah a piang kei a, tua ahih manin kik-in ka sam a, a zing ni-in a kibawl kik hi.

records.english: Did anyone from the council come to look at the fallen tree?
records.zomi: Council pan kuapeuh in singkung puk en dingin a hong hiam?

records.english: You told me the bin men missed your street; did they come back?
records.zomi: Eek bawm la mite in na lampi a mansuah uh hi, na ci a; a hong kik uh hiam?

records.english: I sent a short email to check whether the hall booking had been confirmed.
records.zomi: Inn lian laih na a kipsak khin hiam cih en dingin email tomno khat ka khak hi.

records.english: You said the repair team would come this week; has anyone booked a time?
records.zomi: Bawlkikna team kal hih-in a hong ding hi, na ci a; kuapeuh in hun a laih khin hiam?

records.english: Yes, they're coming on Thursday between eight and twelve.
records.zomi: Hi, Laizing ni-in nai giat leh nai sawm leh nih kikal-ah a hong ding uh hi.

records.english: Has the library found the book you ordered?
records.zomi: Laibu inn in na ngetsa laibu a mu khin hiam?

records.english: What did the advice centre tell you to do next?
records.zomi: Thuhilhna office in a zom-ah bang bawl dingin hong gen hiam?

records.english: Has the repair café managed to fix your radio?
records.zomi: Bawlkikna cafe in na radio a bawl kik zo hiam?

records.english: I phoned the council again, and someone took my number.
records.zomi: Council ka sam kik a, mi khat in ka nambat a la hi.

records.english: Any news from the housing association about the damp?
records.zomi: Inn kipawlna pan inn nin tawh kisai thu khat a om hiam?

records.english: Checking back after a month showed that the new bus timetable had made things worse.
records.zomi: Kha khat khit ciangin ka en kik ciangin bus pai hun lai thak in a hoih lo zaw sak hi, cih a lak hi.

records.english: When I asked for an update, the officer apologised and sent a team the same afternoon.
records.zomi: Thu thak ka dot ciangin ulian in maisak ngetna a gen a, sun nung lam kibang mah-in team khat a khak hi.

records.english: Did the dentist say whether you'll need another appointment?
records.zomi: Kimuhna dang na kisam ding hiam cih ha siavuan in a gen hiam?

records.english: You said the bus company apologised; did they offer a refund?
records.zomi: Bus company in maisak ngetna a gen hi, na ci a; sum hong pia kik ding uh hiam, a ci uh hiam?

records.english: Residents who follow up their requests in writing usually get a clearer answer.
records.zomi: A ngetna uh laimal tawh a en kik teng mite in dawnna kician zaw a ngah zel uh hi.

records.english: So what did the police say about the stolen bike?
records.zomi: Tua ahih leh kiguk siiksakol tawh kisai police in bang a gen hiam?

records.english: Have you heard whether the community grant was approved?
records.zomi: Khuasung sum huhna a kiphal hiam cih na za hiam?

records.english: I wrote down the name of everyone I spoke to, so that I could follow up properly.
records.zomi: Hoih takin ka en kik theih nadingin ka kihoupih mi khempeuh' min ka gelh hi.

records.english: Did the council ever reply to your letter about the bus stop?
records.zomi: Bus khawlna tawh kisai na laikhak council in a dawng ngei hiam?

records.english: They did, and they've promised to move it closer to the clinic next month.
records.zomi: Dawng uh hi, kha hong tung ding-in clinic kiang-ah a nai zaw-in sawn dingin a ciam uh hi.

records.english: Has the plumber worked out why the pipe kept leaking?
records.zomi: Tuikhuam bawlpa in bang hangin tuikhuam a zuk den hiam cih a thei zo hiam?

records.english: Following up on a missing parcel took four phone calls and two emails.
records.zomi: Bawm mangthang khat en kik nadingin phone sam li leh email nih a kisam hi.

records.english: Did you find out why the post office was closed on Monday?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pizing ni-in post office a kikhak hiam cih na thei khin hiam?

records.english: Thank you for getting back to me so quickly.
records.zomi: A manlang mahmah-in hong dawn kik manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: You mentioned that the bus was late again; did you report it?
records.zomi: Bus a phawng kik hi, na ci a; na theisak hiam?

records.english: Without a follow-up call, our complaint about the noise would have been forgotten.
records.zomi: Enkikna phone a om kei leh ging tawh kisai i phunna kimangngilh ding hi.

records.english: You mentioned that the swimming pool might close; is there any news?
records.zomi: Tuipeek mun a kikhak thei hi, na ci a; thu thak a om hiam?

records.english: Adults at the evening class practise working out percentages using real shop discounts.
records.zomi: Nitak class-a upate in sumbuk-a man niamsakna taktak te tawh percent zat a kisin uh hi.

records.english: The council's leaflet shows how every $100 of local tax is spent.
records.zomi: Council' laithei in mun-a siah $100 khatciat bangci-in kizang hiam cih a lak hi.

records.english: The council told us the new crossing would cost $40,000.
records.zomi: Kantanna thak in $40,000 a man ding hi, ci-in council in hong gen hi.

records.english: The parking meter takes coins only, so count your change before you go.
records.zomi: Mawtaw khawlna khawl in sum neu bek a la ahih manin na pai ma-in na sum kiciah kik sim in.

records.english: If the hall costs $25 an hour and we need it for three hours, we'll pay $75.
records.zomi: Inn lian in nai khat-in $25 a man a, nai thum i kisap leh $75 i pia ding hi.

records.english: The bus pass saves me about $15 a week compared with buying single tickets.
records.zomi: Bus pass in lai man khatciat lei sangin kal khat-in $15 bang hong kemsak hi.

records.english: Write the totals in this column and the dates in that one.
records.zomi: Hih tang-ah a vekpi te gelh inla, tua tang-ah ni te gelh in.

records.english: The repair café counts how many items it fixes.
records.zomi: Bawlkikna cafe in van bangzah a bawl kik hiam cih a sim hi.

records.english: How do you work out the water bill for the shared house?
records.zomi: Kihawm inn adingin tui man bangci-in na tuat hiam?

records.english: We divide the total by the number of people and round up to the nearest dollar.
records.zomi: A vekpi mite' zah tawh i khen a, dollar khat ah i khangsak uh hi.

records.english: The fun run is 5 kilometres, which is about three laps of the park.
records.zomi: Nuam-a tai kidemna pen kilometre 5 ahi a, tua pen park kim thum bang ahi hi.

records.english: Can you split the cost of the minibus between the six families?
records.zomi: Minibus man innkuan guk kikal-ah na khen thei ding hiam?

records.english: A small mistake in the treasurer's sums meant the club thought it had more money than it did.
records.zomi: Sum kempa' tuatna-a khialhna neu khat in club in a neih sangin sum a tam zaw nei bang-in a ngaihsun hi.

records.english: The library charges 20 cents a page for printing.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in print adingin mai khat-in cent 20 a la hi.

records.english: How long will the bus take if it stops at every village?
records.zomi: Bus in khua khempeuh-ah a khawl leh bangzah sawt a la ding hiam?

records.english: About 90 minutes, compared with 40 on the express.
records.zomi: Minit 90 bang, express tawh minit 40 sangin.

records.english: We need at least eight drivers to get everyone to the coast and back.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh tuipi gei ah paipih a, ciahpih kik nadingin mawtaw tawimi giat peuh i kisam uh hi.

records.english: Could you check whether I've been charged the right amount for my prescription?
records.zomi: Ka damdawi lai adingin man dik a kila hiam cih na en thei ding hiam?

records.english: We measured the community garden so that we could order the right amount of soil.
records.zomi: Lei zah dik ngen theih nadingin khuasung huan i teh uh hi.

records.english: Each volunteer packs 30 food parcels on a busy Friday.
records.zomi: Thalawp khatciat in Laithai ni buai khat-in an bawm 30 a thun hi.

records.english: When the club's accounts didn't balance, two members checked every receipt from the year.
records.zomi: Club' sum lai a kituak loh ciangin kihel mi nih in kum sung-a sum kipiakna lai khempeuh a en uh hi.

records.english: The food bank counts every tin before it goes on the shelves.
records.zomi: An huhna mun in dawh tungah a koih ma-un bawm khempeuh a sim uh hi.

records.english: Can you check the money from the bake sale?
records.zomi: Moh zuakna pan sum na en thei ding hiam?

records.english: We started with $50 in the tin and now have $187, so we made $137.
records.zomi: Bawm sungah $50 tawh i kipan a, tu-in $187 i nei uh hi, tua ahih manin $137 i ngah uh hi.

records.english: How many volunteers do we need if each shift lasts four hours?
records.zomi: Shift khatciat nai li a sau leh thalawp bangzah i kisam ding uh hiam?

records.english: The volunteer coordinator works out how many hours each person gives every month.
records.zomi: Thalawp makaipa in kha simin mi khatciat in nai bangzah a pia hiam cih a tuat hi.

records.english: If the pool costs $4 for adults and $2 for children, how much will two adults and two children pay?
records.zomi: Tuipeek mun in upate adingin $4, naupangte adingin $2 a man leh upa nih leh naupang nih in bangzah a pia ding uh hiam?

records.english: How much will the coach trip cost for the whole group?
records.zomi: Bus lian khualzinna in pawl bup adingin bangzah a man ding hiam?

records.english: Twenty people at $12 each comes to $240, plus a tip for the driver.
records.zomi: Mi sawmnih khatciat $12 in $240 a suak a, mawtaw tawipa adingin letsong neu khat beh.

records.english: Please add up the tickets sold at the door.
records.zomi: Kongkhak-ah a kizuak lai man te bawl khawm in.

records.english: How many chairs do we need for the community lunch?
records.zomi: Khuasung sun an adingin tutphah bangzah i kisam ding uh hiam?

records.english: We have 45 guests, so let's put out 50 in case more people come.
records.zomi: Khual 45 i nei uh ahih manin mi tam zaw a hong leh ci-in 50 i koih ding uh hi.

records.english: Our walking group measures each route in kilometres and keeps a total for the year.
records.zomi: I vak pawl in vak lampi khatciat kilometre tawh a teh a, kum khat adingin a vekpi a kem hi.

records.english: The leisure centre offers a 25% discount for pensioners.
records.zomi: Leisure centre in pension ngah mite adingin 25% man niamsakna a pia hi.

records.english: Our street worked out that the new speed bumps had cut average speeds by a third.
records.zomi: Lampi sang thak te in mawtaw tai manlang zah a thum khen khat a niamsak hi, cih i lampi in a tuat hi.

records.english: A community budget is easier to trust when anyone can check the figures.
records.zomi: Khuasung sum zatna pen kuapeuh in nambat te a en theih ciangin um a baih zaw hi.

records.english: The bake sale made twice as much this year as last year.
records.zomi: Moh zuakna in kum bei khin sangin hih kum-in a nihvei a ngah zaw hi.

records.english: Thank you for checking the club's accounts so carefully.
records.zomi: Club' sum lai te cian takin na en manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: The cashier at the market adds up prices in her head faster than I can on my phone, and she's never wrong.
records.zomi: Sumbuk mun-a sum lanu in ka phone tawh ka tuat sangin a lu sungah van man a manlang zaw-in a tuat a, a khial ngei kei hi.

records.english: How many litres of soup will we need for a hundred people?
records.zomi: Mi za khat adingin an tui litre bangzah i kisam ding uh hiam?

records.english: Divide the money we raised equally between the two charities.
records.zomi: I kaikhawm sum hehpihna pawl nih kikal-ah a kibang-in khen in.

records.english: How much does it cost to post a parcel weighing 2 kilos?
records.zomi: Kilo 2 a gik bawm khat khak man bangzah hiam?

records.english: The library's maths club helps adults with everyday calculations, like budgets and bills.
records.zomi: Laibu inn' maths club in upate sum zatna leh man lai bang ni sim tuatna te-ah a huh hi.

records.english: The quiz at the community centre always includes a round of mental arithmetic.
records.zomi: Khuasung inn lian-a dotna kidemna in lungsim sung tuatna khen khat a nei den hi.

records.english: The volunteers counted the birds in the park for the annual survey.
records.zomi: Kum simin kankanna adingin thalawpte in park sung-a vasa te a sim uh hi.

records.english: Can you count how many people are in the queue for the free lunch?
records.zomi: Man om lo sun an adingin kigual sungah mi bangzah a om hiam cih na sim thei ding hiam?

records.english: The children at the library practised counting money with a toy till.
records.zomi: Laibu inn-a naupangte in kimawlna till tawh sum sim a kisin uh hi.

records.english: Our residents' group raised money to plant trees along the main road.
records.zomi: I teng mite' pawl in lampi lian kiim-ah singkung suan nadingin sum a kaikhawm uh hi.

records.english: Each tree cost $35, and we had $1,000, so we could afford 28 trees with a little left over.
records.zomi: Singkung khatciat $35 a man a, $1,000 i nei uh ahih manin singkung 28 i lei thei a, tawm khat a om lai hi.

records.english: On planting day, local children helped dig every hole and named each tree.
records.zomi: Suan ni-in mun-a naupangte in kua khempeuh tou dingin a huh uh a, singkung khatciat a min a phuah uh hi.

records.english: Bins are now collected every 14 days.
records.zomi: Tu-in eek bawm te ni 14 simin kila hi.

records.english: Our tenants' group worked out that the rent had risen by 18% in three years.
records.zomi: I inn haai mite' pawl in kum thum sungah inn haai man 18% a khang hi, cih a tuat uh hi.

records.english: Comparing the price per kilo helped our neighbour save money on her weekly shop.
records.zomi: Kilo khat man kiteh in i inn veng a kal sim van leina-ah sum a kem nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Learning to calculate a tip has made eating out much less stressful for my grandmother.
records.zomi: Letsong neu tuat a kisin in ka pi adingin pualam-a an nek a lungkham huai lo mahmah zaw hi.

records.english: How far is it from the community centre to the hospital?
records.zomi: Khuasung inn lian pan damlo inn dong bangzah a gamla hiam?

records.english: The festival needs 12 tables, 40 chairs and 3 gazebos.
records.zomi: Pawi in dawhkan 12, tutphah 40 leh gazebo 3 a kisam hi.

records.english: Estimating the number of guests is harder than counting the money afterwards.
records.zomi: Khual bangzah a hong ding hiam cih ngaihsun pen a nung-ah sum sim sangin a haksa zaw hi.

records.english: The advice worker helped me work out how much I could afford to repay each month.
records.zomi: Thuhilhna nasempa in kha simin bangzah ka ciah kik thei hiam cih ka tuat nadingin hong huh hi.

records.english: What's the total for the raffle prizes?
records.zomi: Raffle letsong te' vekpi bangzah hiam?

records.english: Our church counts the collection after every Sunday service.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in Nipini biakna khit simin piakna sum a sim hi.

records.english: During my internship at the state assembly, I worked for a member who represented a rural district.
records.zomi: State vaihawmna inn-a ka nasep kisinna sungah lo gam district khat aiawh kihel mi khat adingin na ka sem hi.

records.english: Most of my days were spent answering letters from farmers about roads and water.
records.zomi: Ka ni tamzaw lampi leh tui tawh kisai lo neite pan laikhak dawn-in ka zang hi.

records.english: By the end, I understood that national debates often begin with very local problems.
records.zomi: A tawp-ah gam kikupna te a tamzaw-in mun-a haksatna neute pan a kipan hi, cih ka theisiam hi.

records.english: The teacher asked us to find out who our national representative is.
records.zomi: I gam aiawh mi kua hiam cih zong dingin saya in hong ngen hi.

records.english: Government interns sign an agreement not to share any confidential documents, even after the internship ends.
records.zomi: Kumpi nasep kisinmite in nasep kisinna a bei khit zongin kuku lai kuamah hawm lo dingin kiciamna lai ah a signature uh hi.

records.english: Our principal received a letter from the education ministry about the new curriculum.
records.zomi: I sang makaipa in sinna kalsuanna thak tawh kisai sinna vaihawmna office pan laikhak khat a ngah hi.

records.english: The national statistics office collects information on jobs, prices and population.
records.zomi: Gam nambat office in nasep, van man leh mi zah tawh kisai thu te a kaikhawm hi.

records.english: The state employment office helped me find my apprenticeship.
records.zomi: State nasep office in ka kisinna nasep a zon nadingin hong huh hi.

records.english: Government jobs often come with good pensions but slower promotion.
records.zomi: Kumpi nasep te in pension hoih a nei zel a, ahi zongin dinmun khanna a zawi zaw hi.

records.english: Why did the state close the training college?
records.zomi: Bang hangin state in kisinna college a khak hiam?

records.english: It said there weren't enough students, although many people disagreed.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang a tam kei hi, a ci hi, mi tampi in a lungkim kei uh hi napi.

records.english: The civics class compared how the state and national governments are elected.
records.zomi: Gam mi hihna class in state leh gam kumpi te bangci-in kiteel hiam cih a kiteh uh hi.

records.english: My aunt works as a translator for the national courts.
records.zomi: Ka ni gam thukhenna inn te adingin pau let mi-in na a sem hi.

records.english: Who pays teachers' salaries in your country?
records.zomi: Na gam-ah saya te' khasum kua in a pia hiam?

records.english: In our system, the state government pays them, but the national government sets the minimum.
records.zomi: I kalsuanna-ah state kumpi in a pia a, ahi zongin gam kumpi in a niam pen a koih hi.

records.english: Does your brother still work for the national tax office?
records.zomi: Na sanggampa gam siah office ah na a sem lai hiam?

records.english: Who should I contact at the ministry about my teaching licence?
records.zomi: Ka saya hihna phalna lai tawh kisai vaihawmna office-ah kua tawh ka kizom ding hiam?

records.english: How did you get a job in the civil service?
records.zomi: Kumpi nasepna-ah nasep bangci-in na ngah hiam?

records.english: I passed the national entrance exam and then had a long interview.
records.zomi: Gam lutna sitna ka zo a, tua khit ciangin interview sau khat ka nei hi.

records.english: Our trainee lawyers spent a week observing the state court.
records.zomi: I thukhen kisinmite in state thukhenna inn en-in kal khat a zang uh hi.

records.english: Which government department inspects the factories here?
records.zomi: Hih mun-ah bang kumpi department in factory te a en hiam?

records.english: The state's inspectors visit every school once every few years.
records.zomi: State' enkipate in kum tawm khat simin sang khempeuh a veh uh hi.

records.english: Did you know that the state police and the national police wear different uniforms?
records.zomi: State police leh gam police in puan tuam a sil uh hi, cih na thei hiam?

records.english: Does your job at the ministry involve travel?
records.zomi: Vaihawmna office-a na nasep in khualzinna a kihel hiam?

records.english: Only to the regional offices, about once a month.
records.zomi: Gamkhen office te-ah bek, kha khat-in khatvei bang.

records.english: Government departments are now expected to publish data that anyone can check.
records.zomi: Kumpi department te in tu-in kuapeuh in a en theih thu te a suaksak ding uh hi, cih kilamen hi.

records.english: My cousin works in the foreign ministry's visa section.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam gamdang vaihawmna office' visa khen ah na a sem hi.

records.english: Did state employees get the pay rise they asked for?
records.zomi: State nasemte in a nget uh khasum khanna a ngah uh hiam?

records.english: The civil service exam includes questions on law, economics and writing.
records.zomi: Kumpi nasepna sitna in thukham, sum leh paai leh gelh tawh kisai dotna te a kihel hi.

records.english: We watched the national budget speech in class.
records.zomi: Class sungah gam sum zatna thugenna i en uh hi.

records.english: Is the ministry hiring graduates this year?
records.zomi: Hih kum-in vaihawmna office in sang zo mite a lak hiam?

records.english: The pupils wrote letters to their state representative about school transport.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte in sang tuanna tawh kisai a state aiawh mi kiangah laikhak a gelh uh hi.

records.english: Our company can't export food without a licence from the national government, which takes months to arrive.
records.zomi: Gam kumpi' phalna lai a om kei leh i company in an gamdang ah a zuak thei kei a, tua a tun nadingin kha tampi a la hi.

records.english: Our class sent questions to the national parliament's education service.
records.zomi: I class in gam vaihawmna inn' sinna nasepna kiangah dotna te a khak uh hi.

records.english: The national weather service employs scientists, engineers and forecasters.
records.zomi: Gam khuamun nasepna in pilna mi te, engineer te leh khuamun genkholhmite a zang hi.

records.english: Why do so many young people want government jobs?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tangvalno tampi in kumpi nasep a deih uh hiam?

records.english: The graduates' fair had stands from several ministries and state agencies.
records.zomi: Sang zo mite' fair in vaihawmna office tuamtuam leh state office te' van zuakna mun a nei hi.

records.english: Our textbook explains which powers belong to the states and which to the nation.
records.zomi: I laibu in bang thuneihna te state te' ahi a, bang te gam' ahi hiam cih a gen hi.

records.english: National and state officials sometimes disagree publicly about who should pay for schools.
records.zomi: Gam leh state ulian te in sang te adingin kua in a pia ding hiam cih tungah mipite mai-ah a kinial zel uh hi.

records.english: The school trip to the capital included a visit to the supreme court.
records.zomi: Gam khuapi lian ah sang khualzinna in thukhenna inn sang pen veh zong a kihel hi.

records.english: Students on work experience at the state office learned how laws are drafted.
records.zomi: State office-ah nasep kisin sangnaupangte in thukham te bangci-in kigelh hiam cih a sin uh hi.

records.english: Dad found the civil service very different from his old company.
records.zomi: Pa in kumpi nasepna pen a company lui tawh a kibang lo mahmah hi, cih a mu hi.

records.english: Learning how government works helps young people understand the news.
records.zomi: Kumpi bangci-in na a sem hiam cih kisin in tangvalnote thuthak a theisiam nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: The state's new rules on working hours affect every shop in our town.
records.zomi: State' nasep hun tawh kisai thukhun thakte in i khuapi-a sumbuk khempeuh a khoih hi.

records.english: The governor's office answers thousands of letters from schoolchildren every year.
records.zomi: Governor' office in kum simin sangnaupangte pan laikhak tulsang tampi a dawng hi.

records.english: Why did your colleague leave the ministry for a charity?
records.zomi: Bang hangin na nasem pih in vaihawmna office a nusia a, hehpihna pawl ah a pai hiam?

records.english: The civil servant explained that her role was to advise ministers, not to decide.
records.zomi: Kumpi nasem numei in a nasep pen vaihawmmi makaite thuhilh ahi a, khensat hi lo hi, ci-in a gen hi.

records.english: When the national rules for lorry drivers changed, our company had to retrain everyone.
records.zomi: Lorry tawimite adingin gam thukhun a kikhek ciangin i company in mi khempeuh a sinsak kik kul hi.

records.english: Is it true that the state is building a new technical college?
records.zomi: State in khutsiam college thak khat a lam hi, cih a taktak hiam?

records.english: My first job was as a clerk in the state land registry.
records.zomi: Ka nasep masa pen state lei ciamtehna office-ah office nasem-in ahi hi.

records.english: Public servants must not use their position to help friends or relatives.
records.zomi: Mipite' nasemte in a lawm hiam, a sanggam hiam huh nadingin a dinmun uh a zang lo ding uh hi.

records.english: The students acted out a debate between the governor and the opposition.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte in governor leh a langpang pawl kikal-a kinialna khat a lak uh hi.

records.english: Working for the national government means following rules that apply everywhere in the country.
records.zomi: Gam kumpi adingin nasep pen gam bup-ah a kizang thukhun te zuih ahi hi.

records.english: Thank you for showing our students around the ministry.
records.zomi: I sangnaupangte vaihawmna office kim hong lak sak manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: Can our class visit the national parliament?
records.zomi: I class in gam vaihawmna inn a veh thei ding uh hiam?

records.english: Yes, schools can book a free tour, but you need to apply a few months ahead.
records.zomi: Hi, sang te in man om lo vak kim nading a laih thei uh a, ahi zongin kha tawm khat ma-in na nget kul hi.

records.english: How does a bill pass through both houses of parliament?
records.zomi: Thukham ding khat vaihawmna inn nih-ah bangci-in a kipel hiam?

records.english: In our country, national exams are set by the ministry of education, so every school sits the same papers.
records.zomi: I gam ah gam sitna te sinna vaihawmna office in a bawl ahih manin sang khempeuh in sitna lai kibang a la uh hi.

records.english: Students who visit parliament often say it looks smaller than on television.
records.zomi: Vaihawmna inn a veh sangnaupangte in television tungah sangin a neu zaw bang-in a kilang hi, a ci zel uh hi.

records.english: The minister visited our university and answered students' questions.
records.zomi: Vaihawmmi makaipa in i university a veh a, sangnaupangte' dotna a dawng hi.

records.english: How much does the university charge for counselling?
records.zomi: University in lungsim huhna adingin bangzah a la hiam?

records.english: Nothing, although there's sometimes a short wait in exam season.
records.zomi: Bangmah la kei hi, sitna hun-in khatveivei ngakna tomno khat a om zongin.

records.english: The student adviser gave me a list of services, from money advice to counselling.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang thuhilhpa in sum thuhilhna pan lungsim huhna dong nasepna te' min hong pia hi.

records.english: My colleague's therapist helped her return to work after a long absence.
records.zomi: Ka nasem pih' lungsim damsakpa in hun sau a om loh khit ciangin nasepna ah a ciah kik nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: The counsellor helped me prepare for a difficult conversation with my boss.
records.zomi: Lungsim huhpa in ka makaipa tawh kihoupihna haksa khat adingin kiman dingin hong huh hi.

records.english: After the fire at the factory, the company brought in trained counsellors for anyone who wanted to talk.
records.zomi: Factory-a mei kang khit ciangin company in kihoupih nop kuapeuh adingin kisinsak lungsim huhpa te a sam hi.

records.english: Do I need my manager's permission to use the support line?
records.zomi: Huhna phone zat nadingin ka manager' phalna ka kisam hiam?

records.english: Where can apprentices go for help if they're being bullied at work?
records.zomi: Nasepna-ah mi in a nuamsiat uh leh kisin nasemte huhna adingin koi-ah a pai thei uh hiam?

records.english: Seeking help early stopped my stress at work from turning into something worse.
records.zomi: Huhna a manlang-in ngen in nasepna-a ka lungkhamna a hoih lo zaw-ah a khek loh nadingin a dal hi.

records.english: Does our employer pay for counselling?
records.zomi: I nasepsakpa in lungsim huhna man a pia hiam?

records.english: Yes, the staff support line offers up to six free sessions a year.
records.zomi: Hi, nasemte' huhna phone in kum khat-in man om lo hun guk dong a pia hi.

records.english: Getting help for my drinking was the best decision I ever made for my career.
records.zomi: Zu ka dawn tawh kisai huhna ngah pen ka nasep adingin ka thukhensatna hoih pen ahi hi.

records.english: Professional help is not only for emergencies; it can help with everyday struggles too.
records.zomi: Siamna nei huhna pen kihaksatna adingin bek hi lo-in ni sim haksatna te-ah zong a huh thei hi.

records.english: Professional help is most effective when people feel safe enough to ask for it early.
records.zomi: Mite in a manlang-in a nget nadingin lauhuai lo a kisak ciangun siamna nei huhna in na a sem pen hi.

records.english: Can I bring a friend to my first appointment?
records.zomi: Ka kimuhna masa pen-ah lawm khat ka paipih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Is it confidential if I talk to the occupational health nurse?
records.zomi: Nasepna cidamna nurse tawh ka kihoupih leh kuku-a kikem hiam?

records.english: My boss gave me the number of the employee helpline without asking any questions.
records.zomi: Ka makaipa in dotna bangmah dong lo-in nasemte' huhna phone nambat hong pia hi.

records.english: Our office runs a workshop every year on looking after your mental health at work.
records.zomi: I office in kum simin nasepna-ah na lungsim cidamna kem tawh kisai sinna khat a nei hi.

records.english: My doctor wrote a letter asking for shorter hours.
records.zomi: Ka siavuan in nai tom zaw ngen-na laikhak khat a gelh hi.

records.english: Does the school have a counsellor who speaks other languages?
records.zomi: Sang in pau dang a pau thei lungsim huhpa khat a nei hiam?

records.english: It was brave of you to ask your manager for help.
records.zomi: Na manager kiangah huhna na nget pen na hang hi.

records.english: The nurse on the ward suggested I talk to someone about the stress of night shifts.
records.zomi: Damlo inndan-a nurse in zan shift' lungkhamna tawh kisai mi khat tawh kihoupih dingin hong hilh hi.

records.english: My manager suggested that I speak to the staff counsellor after the accident at the warehouse.
records.zomi: Van koihna inn-a accident khit ciangin nasemte' lungsim huhpa tawh kihoupih dingin ka manager in hong hilh hi.

records.english: After a few sessions, I went back to the classroom.
records.zomi: Hun tawm khat khit ciangin class inndan ah ka ciah kik hi.

records.english: Some pupils prefer online counselling because they can talk from home.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang khenkhat in inn pan a pau theih manin online lungsim huhna a deih zaw uh hi.

records.english: The school nurse can refer pupils for help.
records.zomi: Sang nurse in sangnaupangte huhna adingin mun dang ah a khak thei hi.

records.english: I asked my tutor to recommend someone I could talk to about my eating problems.
records.zomi: Ka an nek haksatna te tawh kisai ka kihoupih theih mi khat hong hilh dingin ka saya ka ngen hi.

records.english: I was nervous about asking, but my boss was kind.
records.zomi: Ngen dingin ka lau hi, ahi zongin ka makaipa in hehpihna a nei hi.

records.english: How do I book an appointment with the school counsellor?
records.zomi: Sang lungsim huhpa tawh kimuhna bangci-in ka laih ding hiam?

records.english: Leave a note in the box outside her office, and she'll find you during the week.
records.zomi: A office pualam-a bawm sungah lai tomno khat koih in, kal sungah hong zong ding hi.

records.english: The student union's peer listeners can direct you to professional help.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang kipawlna' lawm ngaikhiamite in siamna nei huhna ah hong lak thei uh hi.

records.english: Can I see the counsellor during my lunch break?
records.zomi: Ka sun an tawlngak hun sungah lungsim huhpa ka mu thei ding hiam?

records.english: Is there a waiting list for the student counselling service?
records.zomi: Sangnaupang lungsim huhna nasepna adingin ngakna min a om hiam?

records.english: Our sports coach encouraged the team to see a sports psychologist before the final.
records.zomi: I kimawlna coach in final ma-in kimawlna lungsim siavuan mu dingin team a hanthawn hi.

records.english: Our school's counsellor visits on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
records.zomi: I sang lungsim huhpa Pithai ni leh Laizing ni te-in a hong hi.

records.english: Many workers worry that seeking help will affect their chances of promotion.
records.zomi: Nasem tampi in huhna a nget leh dinmun khanna a ngah theihna a khoih ding, ci-in a lungkham uh hi.

records.english: Asking for help at work is easier when managers talk openly about their own experiences.
records.zomi: Manager te in amau mah' theihna tawh kisai kipelh lo-in a gen ciangun nasepna-ah huhna ngen a baih zaw hi.

records.english: The head teacher arranged for an educational psychologist to assess my son.
records.zomi: Sang makaipa in ka tapa en dingin sinna lungsim siavuan khat a bawl hi.

records.english: Your advice to see occupational health was exactly right.
records.zomi: Nasepna cidamna mu dingin na thuhilhna a dik taktak hi.

records.english: Teachers can see a counsellor too.
records.zomi: Saya te in zong lungsim huhpa a mu thei uh hi.

records.english: Will my tutors be told that I'm having counselling?
records.zomi: Lungsim huhna ka neih hi, cih ka saya te kiangah kigen ding hiam?

records.english: Only if you'd like extra support with deadlines, and even then it stays confidential.
records.zomi: Nasep khak hun te tawh kisai huhna beh na deih leh bek, tua ciangin zong kuku-in a kikem hi.

records.english: Professional advice helped me ask my employer for the changes I needed.
records.zomi: Siamna nei thuhilhna in ka kisapna kikhekna te ka nasepsakpa kiangah ka nget nadingin hong huh hi.

records.english: Is it all right to take time off for therapy appointments?
records.zomi: Lungsim damsakna kimuhna te adingin tawlngak hun la pen a hoih hiam?

records.english: Many students wait too long to get help.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang tampi in huhna ngah dingin sawt lua a ngak uh hi.

records.english: The college counsellor helped me plan how to manage my anxiety during exams.

records.english: Many companies now offer confidential support lines for their employees.

records.english: The trainee was relieved to learn that her sessions with the counsellor wouldn't appear on her work record.

records.english: Our union offers free legal advice to members with problems at work.

records.english: Who can help me if work is making me ill?

records.english: Start with your doctor, and then talk to occupational health about changes at work.

records.english: After months of panic attacks on the train to work, I finally spoke to my doctor.

records.english: Within a few months, I was travelling to the office again, and I wished I'd asked for help sooner.

records.english: The occupational health doctor recommended a few weeks of reduced duties, which my manager accepted without argument.

records.english: Our school's cleaner turned out to be a retired engineer with fascinating stories.

records.english: Was it strange to see your old teacher at the job fair?

records.english: I sat next to an editor on a train, and she offered me a week's work experience.

records.english: It was lovely to bump into you at the conference.

records.english: The new nurse on the ward had trained with my sister years ago.

records.english: Unexpected meetings at work are good reminders of how small the world can be.

records.english: The teacher who replaced ours for a week had taught my mother.

records.english: Who was the man who greeted you so warmly in reception?

records.english: Is the leak coming from our flat or from the one upstairs?

records.english: When the survey said 60% of people wanted longer opening hours, the library listened.

records.zomi: Saya hoih khempeuh in kal hoih lo mahmah a nei uh hi, ci-in hong phawksak lam lakpa khat.

records.english: When my son forgets a Zomi word, his little sister whispers it to him.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in Zomi kammal khat a mangngilh ciangin a nau numei neu in a kiangah a hilh sim hi.

records.english: Have you heard our daughter singing Zomi lullabies to her dolls?
records.zomi: I tanu in a milim te adingin Zomi naungek la a sak na za khin hiam?

records.english: The children laughed when Grandpa taught them the old Zomi counting rhyme.
records.zomi: Pu in Zomi sim la lui a sinsak ciangin naupangte a nuih uh hi.

records.english: Does the church youth group still run a Zomi quiz every month?
records.zomi: Pawlpi tangvalte' pawl in kha simin Zomi dotna kidemna a bawl lai hiam?

records.english: My niece now teaches Zomi to the younger children at the community centre.
records.zomi: Ka tunu in tu-in khuasung inn lian-ah naupang neu zaw te Zomi pau a sinsak hi.

records.english: Can the children learn to read Zomi before they speak it well?
records.zomi: Naupangte in Zomi pau a pau siam ma-un Zomi laimal sim a kisin thei uh hiam?

records.english: Some do, but most families find that speaking comes first and reading follows.
records.zomi: Khenkhat in a kisin thei uh hi, ahi zongin innkuan a tamzaw in pau a masa a, sim a zui hi, cih a mu uh hi.

records.english: How do you get the children to answer you in Zomi?
records.zomi: Naupangte Zomi pau-in hong dawn nadingin bangci-in na bawl hiam?

records.english: I pretend I don't understand the other language, which makes them laugh and try.
records.zomi: Pau dang ka theisiam lo bang-in ka kilim a, tua in a nuihsak a, a hanciamsak hi.

records.english: I was so proud when my son prayed in Zomi at the family dinner.
records.zomi: Innkuan nitak an-ah ka tapa in Zomi pau-in thu a nget ciangin ka kisaktheih mahmah hi.

records.english: We bought a Zomi storybook set for each of the grandchildren.
records.zomi: Tute khatciat adingin Zomi tangthu laibu bawm khat i lei uh hi.

records.english: Our teenager teaches his younger brother Zomi words through video games.
records.zomi: I tangvalno in video game te tungtawn-in a nau neu kiangah Zomi kammal te a sinsak hi.

records.english: We teach the children the Zomi names of the fruit while we shop.
records.zomi: Van i lei lai-in naupangte gah te' Zomi min i sinsak uh hi.

records.english: Our children watch Zomi videos made by young people abroad.
records.zomi: I naupangte in gamdang-a tangvalte' bawl Zomi video te a en uh hi.

records.english: Our son explained a Zomi proverb to his teacher, who asked him to share it with the class.
records.zomi: I tapa in a saya kiangah Zomi paunak khat a gen a, a saya in class kiangah hawm dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: The children made a Zomi alphabet poster for their bedroom wall.
records.zomi: Naupangte in a lupna inndan bang adingin Zomi laimal poster khat a bawl uh hi.

records.english: Shall we record Grandma telling the bedtime story, so we can play it every night?
records.zomi: Zan simin i zak sak theih nadingin Pi in ihmut ma tangthu a gen i ciamteh ding hiam?

records.english: The children love Grandpa's Zomi bedtime jokes, even when they don't get them.
records.zomi: A theisiam kei uh zongin Pu' Zomi ihmut ma nuihza thu te naupangte in a ngaihsak uh hi.

records.english: Our children's Zomi is better when they've spent a week with their grandparents.
records.zomi: A pu leh pite tawh kal khat a om khit uh ciangin i naupangte' Zomi a hoih zaw hi.

records.english: The little ones love the Zomi clapping games at church.
records.zomi: Naupang neute in pawlpi-a Zomi khut beng kimawlna te a ngaihsak uh hi.

records.english: Read the Zomi picture book to your little sister tonight.
records.zomi: Tuni zan-in na nau numei neu kiangah Zomi lim laibu sim sak in.

records.english: Teaching Zomi to our children is how we keep our grandparents' voices alive in the family.
records.zomi: I naupangte Zomi sinsak pen i pu leh pite' aw innkuan sungah a nungta den nadingin i bawl dan ahi hi.

records.english: Our teenager agreed to learn Zomi properly once he discovered his favourite singer used it.
records.zomi: A deih pen la sa in a zat hi, cih a theih ciangin i tangvalno in Zomi hoih takin kisin dingin a kiciam hi.

records.english: Why don't we speak only Zomi on our long car journeys?
records.zomi: Bang hangin mawtaw tawh i khualzin sau te-ah Zomi bek i pau lo hiam?

records.english: When my nephew was six, he refused to speak any Zomi at all.
records.zomi: Ka tanau kum guk a hih lai-in Zomi bangmah pau a nuam kei hi.

records.english: His grandmother started paying him one coin for every new Zomi word he used at dinner.
records.zomi: A pi in nitak an-ah a zat Zomi kammal thak khatciat adingin sum neu khat a pia pan hi.

records.english: Within a month, he had earned enough to buy a football, and he hasn't stopped talking since.
records.zomi: Kha khat sungah football khat lei tawk a ngah a, tua pan a pau khawl ngei kei hi.

records.english: My daughter acts out Zomi stories with her puppets for the younger cousins.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in a sanggam neute adingin a puppet te tawh Zomi tangthu te a lak hi.

records.english: Teaching our children Zomi abroad takes more effort than it did for our parents at home.
records.zomi: Gamdang-ah i naupangte Zomi sinsak pen i nu leh pate adingin inn-a a om lai sangin hanciamna tam zaw a kul hi.

records.english: When the children use Zomi with each other, I know the language has really taken root.
records.zomi: Naupangte in khat leh khat tawh Zomi a zat ciangun pau in zung taktak a kai khin hi, cih ka thei hi.

records.english: Let's ask the children to teach their cousins the words they learned this week.
records.zomi: Hih kal-in a sin kammal te a sanggamte sinsak dingin naupangte i ngen ni.

records.english: My husband isn't Zomi, but he learns alongside the children.
records.zomi: Ka pasal Zomi hi lo hi, ahi zongin naupangte tawh khawm-in a kisin hi.

records.english: Teaching the children has improved my own Zomi.
records.zomi: Naupangte sinsak in keimah' Zomi a hoih zaw sak hi.

records.english: Which Zomi songs do you teach your grandchildren first?
records.zomi: Na tute bang Zomi la te a masa-in na sinsak hiam?

records.english: The short ones with actions, because the little ones remember them by moving.
records.zomi: Sepna tawh a tom te, bang hang hiam cih leh naupang neute in a kihot ciangun a phawk uh hi.

records.english: It's never too late to start speaking Zomi with your children.
records.zomi: Na tate tawh Zomi pau kipat dingin a phawng lua ngei kei hi.

records.english: We let the children choose a Zomi film for family night.
records.zomi: Innkuan zan adingin naupangte Zomi film khat teel dingin i phal uh hi.

records.english: Our daughter's Zomi improved quickly once she started writing to her cousin in the village.
records.zomi: Khua-a a sanggam kiangah laikhak a gelh pat khit ciangin i tanu' Zomi a manlang-in a hoih zaw hi.

records.english: Should we send the children to the Saturday Zomi class?
records.zomi: Naupangte Kiginni Zomi class ah i khak ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, but it works best if we use what they learn at home during the week.
records.zomi: Hi, ahi zongin a sin te uh kal sungah inn-ah i zat leh a hoih pen hi.

records.english: Each grandparent teaches the children something different: songs, stories or farming words.
records.zomi: Pu leh pi khatciat in naupangte bangkhat tuam a sinsak uh hi: la te, tangthu te, a hih kei leh lo nasep kammal te.

records.english: Mum says the language survived because each generation taught the next.
records.zomi: Khang khatciat in a zom khang a sinsak manin pau a om den hi, ci-in Nu in a gen hi.

records.english: Do you think the children will still speak Zomi when they have their own families?
records.zomi: Naupangte in amau innkuan a neih ciangun Zomi a pau lai ding uh hi, na ci hiam?

records.english: My children learned more Zomi in one summer with their grandparents than in a year of classes.
records.zomi: Ka tate in class kum khat sangin a pu leh pite tawh khal khat sungah Zomi tam zaw a sin uh hi.

records.english: Grandpa's riddles are the children's favourite Zomi lesson.
records.zomi: Pu' khuai thu te pen naupangte' a deih pen Zomi sinna ahi hi.

records.english: My sister uses Zomi for all the household chores, so the children learn the words naturally.
records.zomi: Ka sanggamnu in inn nasep khempeuh adingin Zomi a zang a, tua ahih manin naupangte in kammal te a pianzia-in a sin uh hi.

records.english: Parents who speak Zomi at home give their children a gift that lasts a lifetime.
records.zomi: Inn-ah Zomi a pau nu leh pate in a tate uh nuntak sung a om den letsong khat a pia uh hi.

records.english: Let's write a Zomi word of the day on the fridge.
records.zomi: Fridge tungah tuni' Zomi kammal khat i gelh ni.

records.english: Will Grandma teach the children a Zomi prayer before bedtime?
records.zomi: Pi in ihmut ma-in naupangte Zomi thungetna khat a sinsak ding hiam?

records.english: Can you help the children practise their Zomi song for the wedding?
records.zomi: Mopawi adingin naupangte a Zomi la uh kisin dingin na huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: The children's Zomi teacher sends us a new song every month to practise at home.
records.zomi: Naupangte' Zomi saya in inn-a i kisin nadingin kha simin la thak khat hong khak hi.

records.english: Grandma taught the children to greet visitors in Zomi at the door.
records.zomi: Pi in kongkhak ah khualte Zomi pau-in dawnsawn dingin naupangte a sinsak hi.

records.english: Mum taught us that a smile works better than a correction when a child tries a new word.
records.zomi: Naupang khat in kammal thak khat a zat ciangin bawl dik sangin nuihmai in na a sem zaw hi, ci-in Nu in hong sinsak hi.

records.english: Why does Grandpa tell the same stories every visit?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pu in a hong vehna simin tangthu kibang a gen hiam?

records.english: Because he wants the children to remember them in Zomi, word for word.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh naupangte in Zomi pau-in kammal khat khit khat-in a phawk nadingin a deih hi.

records.english: Teaching Zomi through cooking means the children learn the words and the dishes together.
records.zomi: An huan tungtawn-a Zomi sinsak in naupangte in kammal leh an te khawm-in a sin uh hi.

records.english: Our son corrects my Zomi now, which makes me very proud.
records.zomi: I tapa in tu-in ka Zomi a bawl dik a, tua in hong kisaktheihsak mahmah hi.

records.english: Let's make Sunday lunch a Zomi-only meal.
records.zomi: Nipini sun an Zomi bek pau an nek-in i bawl ni.

records.english: My brother's children answer their grandmother in Zomi now, after years of refusing.
records.zomi: Kum tampi a nial khit ciangin ka sanggampa' tate in tu-in a pi uh Zomi pau-in a dawng uh hi.

records.english: We play a game where nobody may speak anything but Zomi until dinner is finished.
records.zomi: Nitak an a zawh dong kuamah in Zomi simloh bangmah pau lo ding cih kimawlna khat i kimawl uh hi.

records.english: Corinth and Ephesus were busy cities when Paul wrote to the Christians there.
records.zomi: Paul in tua mun-a Khristiante kiangah a gelh lai-in Korin leh Efesa pen mi tam khuapi ahi uh hi.

records.english: The walls of Jericho fell, according to the Book of Joshua.
records.zomi: Joshua laibu bang-in Jerikho khuapi kulh a puk hi.

records.english: Grandma brought back a small bottle of water from the River Jordan.
records.zomi: Pi in Jordan gun pan tui um neu khat a paipih kik hi.

records.english: Is the exact location of Mount Sinai known?
records.zomi: Sinai mual' mun taktak kithei hiam?

records.english: Our Bible study group made a timeline from Abraham to the early Church.
records.zomi: I Laisiangtho sinna pawl in Abraham pan pawlpi masa dong hun kizom lim khat a bawl uh hi.

records.english: Some places in the Bible can no longer be identified with certainty.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho sung-a mun khenkhat tu-in a kip takin kithei nawn lo hi.

records.english: Nazareth is the town where Jesus grew up, according to the Gospels.
records.zomi: Lungdamna Thu te' gen bang-in Nazareth pen Jesu' a khanna khua ahi hi.

records.english: The Bible was written over many centuries, in different places and situations.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho pen kum za tampi sungah mun leh dinmun tuamtuam-in kigelh hi.

records.english: The children traced the route of the Exodus on a map with their fingers.
records.zomi: Naupangte in a khutzung uh tawh gam lim tungah Paikhiatna lampi a zui uh hi.

records.english: Archaeologists have uncovered many ancient towns mentioned in the Bible.
records.zomi: Leitang kankanmite in Laisiangtho sunga kigen khua lui tampi a mu khia uh hi.

records.english: Why were so many biblical towns built on hills?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Laisiangtho khua tampi mual tungah kilam hiam?

records.english: Capernaum, by the Sea of Galilee, was an important town in Jesus' ministry.
records.zomi: Galile tuili kiang-a Kapernaum pen Jesu' nasep sungah khua thupi khat ahi hi.

records.english: Bethlehem means a lot to Christians because of the Christmas story.
records.zomi: Christmas tangthu hang-in Bethlehem pen Khristiante adingin a thupi mahmah hi.

records.english: The land between the Jordan and the sea is small, but many great stories happened there.
records.zomi: Jordan gun leh tuipi kikal-a gam a neu hi, ahi zongin tangthu lian tampi tua mun-ah a piang hi.

records.english: The Book of Exodus describes forty years in the wilderness.
records.zomi: Paikhiatna laibu in gammang-a kum sawmli a gen hi.

records.english: Why is Jerusalem important to so many faiths?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Jerusalem pen biakna tampi adingin a thupi hiam?

records.english: Which city did King David make his capital?
records.zomi: David kumpipa in bang khuapi a gam khuapi lian-in a bawl hiam?

records.english: Ancient papyrus from Egypt has helped scholars understand how early texts were copied.
records.zomi: Izipt pan lailep lui in pilmite in laigelh masa te bangci-in kiteisawn hiam cih a theisiam nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: The slides in Sunday's sermon showed the hills around Jerusalem.
records.zomi: Nipini thuhilhna sung-a lim te in Jerusalem kiim-a mual te a lak hi.

records.english: The Nile is mentioned in the story of baby Moses in a basket.
records.zomi: Nile gun pen bawm sung-a naungek Moses tangthu sungah kigen hi.

records.english: Is the River Jordan very wide?
records.zomi: Jordan gun a zai mahmah hiam?

records.english: In many places it's narrow enough to throw a stone across, which surprises visitors.
records.zomi: Mun tampi-ah suang khat a tung langkhat ah paikhiat theih dong-in a kawng a, tua in khualte a lamdang sak hi.

records.english: The kingdom of Israel was divided into two after the death of Solomon, according to the Bible.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho bang-in Solomon sih khit ciangin Isael gam nih-in a kikhen hi.

records.english: Which countries did Paul visit on his journeys?
records.zomi: Paul in a khualzinna sungah bang gam te a veh hiam?

records.english: Historians use ancient records and archaeology to understand biblical times.
records.zomi: Tangthu pilmite in Laisiangtho hun a theisiam nadingin tangthu ciamtehna lui leh leitang kankanna a zang uh hi.

records.english: My grandparents finally visited Jerusalem for their fiftieth wedding anniversary.
records.zomi: Ka pu leh pite in a kitenna uh kum sawmnga ciangin a tawp-ah Jerusalem a veh uh hi.

records.english: Grandma kept a notebook of every place they saw, with the Bible passage that mentioned it.
records.zomi: Pi in a muh uh mun khempeuh, a gen Laisiangtho mun tawh, ciamtehna laibu khat-ah a gelh hi.

records.english: Back home, she read her notes to the Sunday school, and the children asked questions for an hour.
records.zomi: Inn a tun kik uh ciangin Nipini sang kiangah a ciamtehna te a sim a, naupangte in nai khat sung dotna a dong uh hi.

records.english: Jerusalem is mentioned many times in both the Old and New Testaments.
records.zomi: Jerusalem pen Thukham Lui leh Thukham Thak a nih-in tampi vei kigen hi.

records.english: Abraham's journey began in a city called Ur, according to Genesis.
records.zomi: Piancilna bang-in Abraham' khualzinna Ur kici khuapi khat pan a kipan hi.

records.english: Paul was shipwrecked on the island of Malta, according to the Book of Acts.
records.zomi: Sawltakte' Sepna laibu bang-in Paul in Malta tuikulh tungah tembaw siatna a thuak hi.

records.english: Have you seen the map of Bible lands that Grandpa hung in the hall?
records.zomi: Pu in inn lian sungah a khai Laisiangtho gam te' gam lim na mu khin hiam?

records.english: Where is the Sea of Galilee?
records.zomi: Galile tuili koi-ah a om hiam?

records.english: In the north of Israel, and many of the Gospel stories take place around it.
records.zomi: Isael' mal lam-ah, leh Lungdamna Thu tangthu tampi tua kiim-ah a piang hi.

records.english: The Bible's stories stretch from Egypt to Persia.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho' tangthu te Izipt pan Persia dong a zai hi.

records.english: The first Christians spread their message along Roman roads and sea routes.
records.zomi: Khristian masate in a thu uh Rom lampi te leh tuipi lampi te tungtawn-in a zelh uh hi.

records.english: Many Christians find that visiting biblical places makes the stories feel more real.
records.zomi: Khristian tampi in Laisiangtho mun te veh in tangthu te a taktak zaw bang-in a kisaksak hi, cih a mu uh hi.

records.english: Did your cousin really study biblical archaeology at university?
records.zomi: Na sanggam university-ah Laisiangtho leitang kankanna a sin taktak hiam?

records.english: What happened on the road to Damascus?
records.zomi: Damasak lampi tungah bang a piang hiam?

records.english: According to the Book of Acts, Paul had a vision of Jesus there and his life changed.
records.zomi: Sawltakte' Sepna laibu bang-in tua mun-ah Paul in Jesu mangmuhna-in a mu a, a nuntak a kikhek hi.

records.english: Do you know where the Garden of Gethsemane is?
records.zomi: Gethsemani huan koi-ah a om hiam cih na thei hiam?

records.english: The Samaritans lived in the region between Galilee and Judea.
records.zomi: Samaria mite Galile leh Judah gam kikal-a gamkhen ah a teng uh hi.

records.english: Our church's pilgrimage group is planning a trip to the Holy Land next spring.
records.zomi: I pawlpi' mun siangtho veh pawl in spring hong tung ding-in Gam Siangtho ah khualzin dingin ngimna a bawl hi.

records.english: Why is the Dead Sea so salty?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Tuili Si a al mahmah hiam?

records.english: Scholars are still unsure exactly where Mount Sinai was.
records.zomi: Pilmite in Sinai mual a mun taktak koi-ah a om hiam cih a thei cian nai kei uh hi.

records.english: Egypt plays a big part in the stories of Joseph and Moses.
records.zomi: Josef leh Moses tangthu te-ah Izipt in mun lian a nei hi.

records.english: Is Babylon in modern-day Iraq?
records.zomi: Babilon pen tu hun-a Iraq gam ah a om hiam?

records.english: Learning some history makes the letters of Paul much easier to understand.
records.zomi: Tangthu tawm khat kisin in Paul' laikhak te theisiam a baih zaw sak mahmah hi.

records.english: Rome was the capital of the empire in which the first Christians lived.
records.zomi: Rom pen Khristian masate a nuntak na kumpi gam' gam khuapi lian ahi hi.

records.english: The Gospels describe Jesus travelling between Galilee and Jerusalem.
records.zomi: Lungdamna Thu te in Jesu Galile leh Jerusalem kikal-ah a khualzin a gen hi.

records.english: The Romans destroyed the Temple in Jerusalem in AD 70.
records.zomi: AD 70 kum-in Rom mite in Jerusalem-a Biakinnpi a susia uh hi.

records.english: Pilgrims have travelled to Jerusalem for many centuries.
records.zomi: Mun siangtho veh mite kum za tampi sung Jerusalem ah a khualzin uh hi.

records.english: Nineveh was the city that Jonah was sent to warn.
records.zomi: Nineveh pen Jonah a vaikhak dingin kisawl khuapi ahi hi.

records.english: How far is Bethlehem from Jerusalem?
records.zomi: Bethlehem pan Jerusalem dong bangzah a gamla hiam?

records.english: Only about ten kilometres, so you could walk it in a couple of hours.
records.zomi: Kilometre sawm bek bang, tua ahih manin nai nih bang sungah na pai thei hi.

records.english: Seeing the Sea of Galilee at sunrise was the highlight of our trip.
records.zomi: Ni suah hun-a Galile tuili muh pen i khualzinna sung-a a nuam pen ahi hi.

records.english: Is the Sea of Galilee salt water or fresh water?
records.zomi: Galile tuili pen tui al hiam, tui ham hiam?

records.english: Maps of Paul's journeys show how widely he travelled around the Mediterranean.
records.zomi: Paul' khualzinna gam lim te in Mediterranean kiim-ah bangzah a zai-in a khualzin hiam cih a lak hi.

records.english: Why did the people of Judah go to Babylon?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Judah mite Babilon ah a pai uh hiam?

records.english: According to the Bible, they were taken there as captives after Jerusalem was conquered.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho bang-in Jerusalem a kizawh khit ciangin sal-in tua mun ah kipuak uh hi.

records.english: The neighbourhood group's simplest idea, a shared gritting rota, worked best.
records.zomi: Inn veng pawl' ngaihsutna baih pen, kihawm cii hel hun kizom khat, in na a sem pen hi.

records.english: It's worth trying the cheapest idea first.
records.zomi: Ngaihsutna man niam pen a masa-in sit ding a hoih hi.

records.english: How can we get more young people to come to the residents' meetings?
records.zomi: Teng mite' kikhopna ah tangvalno tam zaw bangci-in i hong sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: The youth club moved the music to the back room.
records.zomi: Tangvalte' kipawlna in la te nung lam inndan ah a sawn hi.

records.english: Let's write down every idea before we decide which ones to try.
records.zomi: Bang te sit ding hiam cih i khensat ma-in ngaihsutna khempeuh i gelh ni.

records.english: What's the simplest change that would make the playground safer?
records.zomi: Naupang kimawlna mun a lauhuai lo zawk nadingin kikhekna baih pen bang hiam?

records.english: Would a suggestion box at the town hall help?
records.zomi: Khuapi office-ah ngaihsutna koihna bawm khat in a huh ding hiam?

records.english: Is there a cheaper way to heat the church hall?
records.zomi: Pawlpi inn lian lumsak nading lampi man niam zaw khat a om hiam?

records.english: Is it possible to share one minibus between the three community groups?
records.zomi: Khuasung pawl thum kikal-ah minibus khat kihawm thei ding hiam?

records.english: Planting hedges along the road reduced the noise for the houses behind it.
records.zomi: Lampi kiim-ah huang suan in a nung-a inn te adingin ging a niamsak hi.

records.english: What if residents could report potholes with a photo on their phones?
records.zomi: Teng mite in a phone tungah photo tawh lampi kua te a theisak thei uh leh bangci ding hiam?

records.english: Instead of a new car park, the council introduced a park-and-ride bus.
records.zomi: Mawtaw khawlna mun thak sangin council in mawtaw khawl-a bus tuan nading a bawl hi.

records.english: A shared tool library would save every household from buying its own ladder.
records.zomi: Kihawm nasepna van laibu inn khat in innkuan khatciat amau kahlei mah lei pan a kemsak ding hi.

records.english: Would a phone tree help us reach the older neighbours quickly in bad weather?
records.zomi: Khuamun hoih lo ciangin upa inn vengte a manlang-in i tun theih nadingin phone kizom pawl khat in a huh ding hiam?

records.english: Is there a way to make the bus stop safer at night?
records.zomi: Zan-in bus khawlna lauhuai lo zaw sak nading lampi khat a om hiam?

records.english: Brighter lighting and a shelter with glass sides would help a lot.
records.zomi: Meivak tang zaw leh glass bang nei ngakna inn khat in a huh mahmah ding hi.

records.english: Is there someone who could translate the council's leaflet for new residents?
records.zomi: Teng mi thakte adingin council' laithei a let thei kuapeuh a om hiam?

records.english: Why not ask the shops to share the cost of the Christmas lights?

records.english: The village primary school's garden won a regional prize.

records.english: Can you describe the village you grew up in for the class?

records.english: Researchers interviewed villagers about how the new road had changed their jobs.

records.english: The village is famous for its pottery, which is sold all over the country.

records.english: Most farm nearby, and the rest take the early bus to the factory in town.

records.english: Why did you choose to work in the village post office?

records.english: What's it like teaching in such a small village?
