records.english: I chose the wider one, which seemed more likely to be used by walkers, and kept checking the position of the sun.

records.english: An hour later, I came out at a farm I had never seen before, three villages from where I had started.

records.english: Could the parcel have gone to the wrong house?
records.zomi: Van bawm inn khial ah a pai kha thei hiam?

records.english: Do you think the ferry will sail in this wind?

records.english: Could the shop be closed for lunch?

records.english: It remains unclear whether the old bridge will be repaired or replaced.

records.english: The forecast says there's a forty per cent chance of rain, which tells us very little.

records.english: Could she be at her friend's house?

records.english: Somewhere between fifty and two hundred, depending on the weather.
records.zomi: Sawmnga leh za nih kikal, khuamun tungah a kinga hi.

records.english: Interviewing older workers helped the students see that changes they took for granted had been fought for.
records.zomi: Nasem upate dong in sangnaupangte a theih pen bang uh kikhekna te pen kidou-a ngah ahi hi, cih a muh nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: The factory where my grandfather worked is now a college where I study.

records.english: Were school uniforms stricter in your parents' time?

records.english: My grandfather learned his trade from his father.

records.english: My aunt was the first woman in her office.

records.english: The shift from manual work to service jobs has changed not only incomes but also family routines.

records.english: Young people today often need degrees for jobs that their grandparents did straight from school.

records.english: My father started work at sixteen.

records.english: What did your grandparents think about you going to university?

records.english: My grandfather was proud, but my grandmother worried that I would never come back to the village.

records.english: Nearly everyone in my class wants a job in the city.

records.english: Comparing school reports from three generations of one family showed how teachers' comments had become kinder.
records.zomi: Innkuan khat' suan thum pan sang report te teh in saya te' genna te a hehpihna nei zaw-in a kikhek hi, cih a lak hi.

records.english: My father worries that my generation will never own a home, though we have opportunities he never had.

records.english: Grandpa's first job paid very little.

records.english: Technology has given my generation more choice about where to work, but less separation between work and home.

records.english: Did your grandmother really walk two hours to school?

records.english: Our school's oldest teacher remembers when classes had more than fifty pupils.

records.english: Our teacher pointed out that every generation has worried that young people are lazy and disrespectful.
records.zomi: I saya in suan khatciat in khangnote a thadah a, zahtakna nei lo hi, ci-in a lungkham ngei uh hi, ci-in hong lak hi.

records.english: How many hours a week did your parents work?
records.zomi: Na nu leh na pa in kal khat-in nai bangzah a sem uh hiam?

records.english: Studying how work has changed across generations helps students imagine the jobs that might exist when they leave school.
records.zomi: Nasep suan tuamtuam-ah bangci-in a kikhek hiam cih sin in sangnaupangte in sang a nusiat ciangin a om thei ding nasep te a ngaihsun kholh thei nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Older colleagues often bring patience and experience, while younger ones bring new ideas, and good workplaces value both.
records.zomi: Nasem pih upate in thuakzawhna leh theihna a paipih zel uh a, khangno zawte in ngaihsutna thak a paipih uh a, nasep mun hoih te in a nih a manpha sak uh hi.

records.english: Our history project showed how the number of women working in our town had doubled since the 1970s.

records.english: Our class compared the jobs in our town today with the jobs listed in a newspaper from 1960.

records.english: Did people use phones at work when you were young?

records.english: Did you have homework when you were at school, Grandpa?

records.english: Hardly any, but we wrote on slates, and the teacher banged the desk when we talked.

records.english: The students were surprised that their teachers had been taught without calculators.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte in a saya uh calculator om lo-in kisinsak uh hi, cih a lamdang sa uh hi.

records.english: My grandfather can't understand why anyone would pay for a gym when they could work in the fields.
records.zomi: Ka pu in lou-ah a sem thei uh ciangin bang hangin kuapeuh in tha kisinna inn adingin man a pia ding hiam cih a theisiam zo kei hi.

records.english: My grandmother's generation saved for years before buying anything, while mine is used to paying by phone in seconds.
records.zomi: Ka pi' suan in na khatpeuh a lei ma-un kum tampi a kemsak uh a, ka suan pen second tawmno sungin phone tawh sum piak a zang uh hi.

records.english: Our school used to be a boys' school.
records.zomi: I sang pasal naupangte' sang ahi ngei hi.

records.english: Each generation in our family has moved further from the land, from farming to factories to offices.
records.zomi: I innkuan-a suan khatciat in lei pan a gamla zaw-in a pai uh hi, lou nasep pan van bawlna inn, office dong.

records.english: My mother still writes everything in a diary.
records.zomi: Ka nu in na khempeuh ni sim ciamtehna laibu-ah a gelh lai hi.

records.english: My grandfather says that a job used to be for life, but now nobody expects that.
records.zomi: Ka pu in nasep pen nuntak sung bup adingin ahi ngei a, tu-in kuamah in tua a lamen nawn kei uh hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Did your dad really work in the same factory for thirty years?
records.zomi: Na pa van bawlna inn kibang-ah kum sawmthum a sem taktak hiam?

records.english: Why do so few young people want to work on the farm now?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tu-in khangno tawm mahmah in lou-ah sem a deih uh hiam?

records.english: The pay is low, the hours are long, and the city offers jobs with weekends off.

records.zomi: Ahi thei hi, a thupi pen in naupangte-ah, tua ahih manin huhna phone pai-in sam in.

records.english: I keep getting headaches in the afternoon.
records.zomi: Sun nung lam-in lu natna ka nei den hi.

records.english: The interpreter helped my neighbour explain that her chest pain came on at night.
records.zomi: Pau letmi in ka inn kiang mi in a awm natna zan-in a hong kipan hi, cih gen dingin a huh hi.

records.english: Write down when the symptoms started.
records.zomi: Natna lim te bang hun-in a kipan hiam cih gelh in.

records.english: Volunteers at the drop-in clinic help patients who don't speak English describe their symptoms.

records.english: Telephone appointments rely heavily on how well a patient can put their symptoms into words.
records.zomi: Phone tungtawn-a kimuhna te in damlo khat in a natna lim kammal-in bangzah hoih takin a gen thei hiam cih tungah a kinga mahmah hi.

records.english: The walk-in centre sees patients with minor injuries, while the emergency department deals with serious ones.
records.zomi: Lut lel theih mun in liamna neu nei damlote a en a, hun haksa damsakna mun in a lian te a en hi.

records.english: My son has been sick three times today.
records.zomi: Ka tapa tu ni-in thumvei a lua hi.

records.english: A community health worker can often notice symptoms that a proud or lonely patient would never mention.
records.zomi: Khuasung cidamna nasempa khat in kisapna nei ahih kei leh a kikhat damlo khat in a gen ngei lo ding natna lim te a phawk thei zel hi.

records.english: Did the clinic nurse take your temperature?
records.zomi: Damdawi inn neu nurse in na pumpi lumna a teh hiam?

records.english: The helpline asked if I had any trouble breathing.
records.zomi: Huhna phone in huih haih haksatna ka nei hiam cih a dong hi.

records.english: Health visitors teach new parents which symptoms in babies need urgent attention and which can safely wait.
records.zomi: Cidamna ve nute in nu leh pa thakte naungek' natna lim bang in pai-in kien ding a ngai a, bang in bit takin a ngak thei hiam cih a sinsak uh hi.

records.english: Schools must balance the regulations on trips with the value of letting pupils learn outside the classroom.
records.zomi: Sang te in khualzinna tawh kisai thukham te leh sangnaupangte sinna inndan pualam-ah a sin theih nading manphatna a kikimsak ding uh hi.

records.english: Regulations protect customers and workers, but small businesses often find the paperwork harder than the rules themselves.
records.zomi: Thukham te in van lei mite leh nasemte a kem a, ahi zongin sumbuk neu te in thukham mah sangin lai nasep a haksa zaw sa zel uh hi.

records.english: When the rules on food allergies were tightened, many cafés printed new menus to show every allergen.

records.english: Hair salons must sterilise their tools between customers.
records.zomi: Sam tanna inn te in van lei mi kikal-ah a van uh a siangsak ding uh hi.

records.english: Every taxi driver must pass a local knowledge test.
records.zomi: Taxi tawipa khatciat in mun theihna sitna a zo ding hi.

records.english: Builders must cover open trenches at night so that nobody falls in.
records.zomi: Inn lam mite in kuamah a kia lohna dingin zan-in kua hong te a khuh ding uh hi.

records.english: Lorries can't use this road at night.
records.zomi: Mawtaw lian te zan-in hih lampi a zang thei kei uh hi.

records.english: The council offers free advice sessions to help new businesses understand the regulations before they open.
records.zomi: Council in sumbuk thak te a kihon ma-un thukham te a theisiam nadingin man om lo thuhilhna hun te a pia hi.

records.english: A good manager explains the reason behind each regulation, so staff follow it even when nobody is watching.
records.zomi: Makaipa hoih khat in thukham khatciat nung-a hang a gen ahih manin kuamah in a en kei zongin nasemte in a zui uh hi.

records.english: Do we need a licence to play music in the shop?

records.english: Is the market stall allowed to sell hot food?

records.english: Shop prices must include tax in our country.
records.zomi: I gam-ah van zuakna inn man te in siah a huam ding hi.

records.english: Why can't we serve customers after eleven?
records.zomi: Bang hangin nai sawm leh khat khit ciangin van lei mite an i pia thei kei hiam?

records.english: Our licence only allows us to open until then, and the council checks.
records.zomi: I phalna lai in tua hun dong bek a kihon dingin a phal a, council in a en hi.

records.english: Why does the café have to show its hygiene rating?
records.zomi: Bang hangin cafe in a siang zah ciamtehna a lak ding ngei hiam?

records.english: In our city, the rules say customers have a right to see how clean the kitchen is.
records.zomi: I khuapi lian-ah thukham te in van lei mite in an huanna inn bangzah a siang hiam cih a muh nading thuneihna a nei uh hi, a ci hi.

records.english: When I opened a small café, I thought the hardest part would be finding customers.

records.english: Instead, it was the regulations: a food hygiene course, a waste contract, a licence for tables on the pavement and a fire inspection.

records.english: Six months later, an inspector gave the kitchen the top rating, and I hung the certificate proudly by the door.

records.english: New regulations require shops to charge for plastic bags in our country.

records.english: The college's science labs follow strict rules for storing chemicals.

records.english: Regulations differ between countries, so firms that trade abroad need staff who understand each set of rules.
records.zomi: Thukham te gam khatciat-ah a kibang kei ahih manin gamdang tawh sumbuk a bawl company te in thukham khatciat a theisiam nasem te a ngai uh hi.

records.zomi: Nuntak nading-in van tawi mawtaw tawite in tawlngakna te a la den ding uh a, electricity tawh kiciamteh hi.

records.english: What do the building regulations say about fire doors in offices?

records.english: They have to close by themselves and must never be wedged open, even on hot days.

records.english: Clear, simple regulations are easier to follow and to enforce than long ones written in legal language.
records.zomi: Thukham cian leh baih te pen thukham pau tawh kigelh sau te sangin zuih leh zuihsak a baih zaw hi.

records.english: After the warehouse fire, the company went beyond the regulations and installed sprinklers in every building.

records.english: The bakery was fined for selling sandwiches without listing the ingredients.

records.zomi: Tuipeek mun in tuipeek mun kempa khat a om den ding hi.

records.english: Which month do the new safety rules come into force?

records.english: The fire inspector visited our office today.

records.english: Has the company registered the new delivery vans with the authorities?
records.zomi: Company in van tawi mawtaw thak te makaite kiangah a min a gelh khin hiam?

records.english: Schools need permission from parents before they share photos of pupils.
records.zomi: Sang te in sangnaupangte' photo a hawm ma-un nu leh pa te' phalna a ngai uh hi.

records.english: The council inspector measured the noise from the workshop after neighbours complained.
records.zomi: Inn kiang mite a phun khit uh ciangin council enkipa in nasep inn pan ging a teh hi.

records.english: Inspections can feel like a burden, yet they often catch problems before anyone is hurt.
records.zomi: Enkikna te puak gik bang a kisa thei a, ahi zongin kuamah a liam ma-in buaina te a mu zel hi.

records.english: Builders must wear hard hats on the site.

records.english: Does the hairdresser need a licence?

records.english: The inspector explained that the rule about fire doors exists because smoke, not flames, kills most people in a fire.

records.english: Our office's fire safety plan is checked by the landlord every year.

records.english: How do the new food labelling rules affect our bakery?

records.english: In our town, market traders need a licence and must display their name on their stall.

records.english: A misunderstanding that is cleared up quickly rarely causes lasting harm, while one left alone can grow for years.

records.english: Correcting a friend's mistake gently, perhaps with a joke, keeps the conversation friendly.

records.english: When I said the soup was interesting, I meant it was unusual, not that I didn't like it.

records.english: The neighbours assumed we were selling the house, but we were only having the roof repaired.

records.english: I think there's been a mix-up, because I booked a double room, not two singles.

records.zomi: Flat-ah a teng innkuan khat adingin ui in a hoih zaw hiam, zawhngeu in a hoih zaw hiam?

records.english: Would you rather have a party or a quiet dinner for your fortieth?
records.zomi: Na kum sawmli cin ni-in poai na bawl ding hiam, ahih kei leh dai taka nitak an na ne ding hiam, bang na deih zaw hiam?

records.english: A quiet dinner with a few close friends, without speeches.
records.zomi: Lawm kinai tawm khat tawh dai taka nitak an, thugenna om lo-in.

records.english: Which would be quicker, the motorway with tolls or the old road through the villages?
records.zomi: Bang in a manlang zaw ding hiam, man piak ding lampi lian hiam, ahih kei leh khua te kantan lampi lui hiam?

records.english: Is the new phone faster than your old one?
records.zomi: Phone thak in na phone lui sangin a manlang zaw hiam?

records.english: The second hotel was further from the beach but had a much quieter pool.
records.zomi: Zinbuuk a nihna in tuipi kiang pan a gamla zaw a, ahi zongin tuipeekna mun dai zaw mahmah a nei hi.

records.english: We chose the quieter street over the bigger garden, and we have never regretted the extra sleep.
records.zomi: Huan lian zaw sangin lampi dai zaw i teel a, ihmut behlap tawh kisai in i kisik ngei kei hi.

records.english: When neither option is clearly better, choosing quickly can be wiser than worrying for weeks.
records.zomi: Teel ding khat in a dang sangin a hoih zaw cian kei ciangin hamtang taka teel pen kal tampi sung lungkham sangin a pil zaw thei hi.

records.english: Is the pool emptier in the morning or the evening?
records.zomi: Tuipeekna mun zingsang-in mi a tawm zaw hiam, nitak-in mi a tawm zaw hiam?

records.english: The two laptops are almost the same, except that one has a much better battery.
records.zomi: Laptop nih a kibang dek hi, khat in battery hoih zaw mahmah a neih loh buang.

records.english: Do you like the mountains more than the sea?
records.zomi: Tuipi sangin mualte na deih zaw hiam?

records.english: Do you want tea or coffee?
records.zomi: Lakphak na deih hiam, coffee na deih hiam?

records.english: A simple list of what each option gives and what it costs can make a hard choice much clearer.
records.zomi: Teel ding khatciat in bang a pia a, bang man a la hiam cih lista neu khat in teel haksa khat a kician zaw mahmah sak thei hi.

records.english: Which park has the bigger playground?
records.zomi: Bang pawngpi in naupang mawlna mun lian zaw a nei hiam?

records.english: Is this film longer than the other one?
records.zomi: Hih film in a dang khat sangin a sau zaw hiam?

records.english: Would the children enjoy the zoo more than the science museum?
records.zomi: Naupangte in science museum sangin zoo a deih zaw ding uh hiam?

records.english: Is renting a car on holiday really cheaper than using taxis?
records.zomi: Tawlngakni-in mawtaw hai pen taxi zat sangin a man neem zaw taktak hiam?

records.english: Which of these two paints covers better?
records.zomi: Hih paint nih lakah bang in a khuh hoih zaw hiam?

records.english: The thicker one, though you'll still need two coats on that dark wall.
records.zomi: A tau zaw, ahi zongin tua bang vom lam kulh tungah nihvei na sat lai ding hi.

records.english: Which is healthier, cycling to work or swimming every evening?
records.zomi: Bang in cidamna adingin a hoih zaw hiam, nasepna-ah siiksakol tawh pai hiam, ahih kei leh nitak simin tuipeek hiam?

records.english: Do you prefer apples or pears?
records.zomi: Apple na deih zaw hiam, pear na deih zaw hiam?

records.english: Do you think the smaller flat with a balcony beats the bigger one without?
records.zomi: Tual tung nei flat neu zaw in tual tung nei lo flat lian zaw sangin a hoih zaw hi, na ci hiam?

records.english: The cheaper flight leaves at six in the morning, so the dearer one might be worth it.
records.zomi: Vanleng man neem zaw in zingsang nai guk-in a leng ahih manin a man tam zaw in a manpha thei hi.

records.english: Which pizza is spicier?
records.zomi: Bang pizza in a hai zaw hiam?

records.english: Comparing two holiday cottages online is difficult, because both sets of photos are taken on sunny days.
records.zomi: Online-ah tawlngakni inn neu nih tehkak a haksa hi, bang hang hiam cih leh photo khempeuh ni a sun ni-in a kila ahi hi.

records.english: Is the red sofa softer than the blue one?
records.zomi: Sofa san in sofa dum sangin a nem zaw hiam?

records.english: Shall we eat inside or in the garden?
records.zomi: Inn sungah i ne ding hiam, huan sungah i ne ding hiam?

records.english: The handmade shoes cost twice as much but should last for years.
records.zomi: Khut tawh kibawl khedap in man nihvei a tam a, ahi zongin kum tampi sung a ding ding hi.

records.english: My grandmother always compared two choices by imagining which one she would regret not taking.
records.zomi: Ka pi in teel ding nih a tehkak ciangin bang khat a lak loh leh a kisik ding hiam cih a ngaihsun den hi.

records.english: Choosing between two good friends' invitations for the same evening was harder than any choice at work.
records.zomi: Nitak khat mahmah adingin lawm hoih nih' sapna lak pan teel pen nasepna-a teelna khatpeuh sangin a haksa zaw hi.

records.english: When the reviews of two restaurants are equally good, the deciding factor is often simply which one is closer.
records.zomi: An ne inn nih' genna te a kibang hoih ciangin a khensatna pen a tamzaw-in bang in a nai zaw hiam cih bek ahi hi.

records.english: The second offer looked better until we added the cost of travelling to the further office every day.
records.zomi: Ni simin office gamla zaw-ah khualzinna man i behlap mateng a nihna sapna in a hoih zaw bangin a kilang hi.

records.english: We visit Grandpa's grave every Easter.
records.zomi: Easter simin Pu' han i va kan hi.

records.english: Belief in the resurrection has encouraged Christians across the centuries to care for the dying and the bereaved.
records.zomi: Thawhkikna upna in kum zalom tampi sung Khazih mite misi ding kuamte leh a sanggam si mite a kem dingin a hanthawn hi.

records.english: Easter is the most important Christian festival.
records.zomi: Easter pen Khazih mite' pawi thupi pen ahi hi.

records.english: Why is Easter so important to your church?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Easter in na pawlpi adingin a thupi mahmah hiam?

records.english: Because we celebrate our belief that Jesus rose from the dead on the third day.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh Jesu ni thum ni-in misi lak pan a thokik hi, cih i upna i lawm hi.

records.english: Is it all right to cry at a Christian funeral?
records.zomi: Khazih mite' misi vuina-ah kap pen a hoih hiam?

records.english: My son asked where Grandma went when she died.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in Pi a sih ciangin koi-ah a pai hiam, ci-in a dong hi.

records.english: Christians believe that Jesus' death on the cross was for the forgiveness of sins.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in singlamteh tunga Jesu' sihna pen mawhna maisakna adingin ahi hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Our church visits families in the weeks after a funeral, when the grief often feels heaviest.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in misi vuina khit kal tawm khat sung, dahna a gik pen hun-in innkuante a va kan uh hi.

records.english: Do Christians agree about what the resurrection body will be like?
records.zomi: Thawhkikna pumpi bangci ding hiam cih tawh kisai-in Khazih mite a kitup uh hiam?

records.english: They agree that Jesus rose, but they hold different views about what resurrected bodies will be like.
records.zomi: Jesu a thokik hi, cih ah a kitup uh a, ahi zongin a thokik pumpite bangci ding hiam cih tawh kisai-in ngaihsutna tuamtuam a nei uh hi.

records.english: Grieving with hope does not mean pretending that the loss does not hurt.
records.zomi: Lametna tawh dah cih pen mansuahna in a natsak kei hi, ci-in kilepna hi lo hi.

records.english: Christian teaching insists that death is an enemy, even though believers trust that it has been defeated.
records.zomi: Khazih mite' thuhilhna in sihna pen gal ahi hi, ci-in a ciptak hi, um mite in a kizo khin hi, ci-in a muan uh hangin.

records.english: My grandmother's faith gave her peace at the end.
records.zomi: Ka pi' upna in a tawp-ah lungnopna a pia hi.

records.english: Easter transforms how believers think about death, turning the cross from a symbol of defeat into one of victory.
records.zomi: Easter in um mite' sihna tawh kisai ngaihsutna a khek a, singlamteh pen lelhna lim pan zawhna lim-ah a suaksak hi.

records.english: We prayed for our neighbour's family after the funeral.
records.zomi: Misi vuina khit ciangin i inn kiang mi' innkuan adingin thu i ngen hi.

records.english: Christian funerals often combine sadness for the person who has died with hope for the future.
records.zomi: Khazih mite' misi vuina in a si mi adinga dahna leh a hong tung ding hun adinga lametna a gawm zel hi.

records.english: My grandmother chose the readings for her own funeral years before she died.
records.zomi: Ka pi in a sih ma kum tampi-in amah' misi vuina adingin sim ding Laisiangtho munte a teel khin hi.

records.english: At Easter, many churches hold a service at sunrise to remember the empty tomb.
records.zomi: Easter ciangin pawlpi tampi in han awng phawk nadingin ni suah hun-in pawlpi kikhopna a nei uh hi.

records.english: Will we know each other in heaven, Grandma?
records.zomi: Pi, vantung-ah i kithei kik ding hiam?

records.english: I believe we will, though nobody can describe exactly what it will be like.
records.zomi: I kithei kik ding hi, ka um hi, ahi zongin bangci ding hiam cih kuamah in a gen cian thei kei hi.

records.english: Why do Christians call Good Friday good?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Khazih mite in Good Friday pen 'hoih' a ci uh hiam?

records.english: The church was full of flowers on Easter morning.
records.zomi: Easter zingsang-in pawlpi in pak a dim hi.

records.english: Some believers find comfort in Jesus' words describing himself as the resurrection and the life.
records.zomi: Um mite khenkhat in Jesu in amah thawhkikna leh nuntakna hi, ci-in a gen kammal te-ah hehnepna a mu uh hi.

records.english: What does resurrection mean?
records.zomi: Thawhkikna in bang a cihna hiam?

records.english: Hymns sung at Christian funerals often speak more about the resurrection than about the person who has died.
records.zomi: Khazih mite' misi vuina-a kisa Pasian phatna la te in a si mi sangin thawhkikna thu a gen zaw zel hi.

records.english: Some Christians pray for those who have died, while others believe prayer for the dead is unnecessary.
records.zomi: Khazih mite khenkhat in a si mite adingin thu a ngen uh a, a dangte in a si mite adinga thungetna a kisam kei hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: The Gospels describe women going to the tomb early on Sunday morning and finding it empty.
records.zomi: Lungdamna Thu te in Nipini zingsang tung-in numeite hanah a pai uh a, a awng a mu uh hi, ci-in a gen hi.

records.english: Jesus' friends found the tomb empty.
records.zomi: Jesu' lawmte in han a awng a mu uh hi.

records.english: Grandma died last winter, but we believe she is with God.
records.zomi: Pi khuaphal beisa-in a si a, ahi zongin Pasian tawh a om hi, ci-in i um hi.

records.english: Many Christians say that facing death with faith does not remove fear but gives them a reason to hope beyond it.
records.zomi: Khazih mite tampi in upna tawh sihna maituah in launa a beisak kei hi, ahi zongin tua khit lam-ah lametna ding a pia hi, ci-in a gen uh hi.

records.english: My aunt says she is not afraid of dying.
records.zomi: Ka ni in sih ka lau kei hi, a ci hi.

records.english: We sing hymns about the resurrection.
records.zomi: Thawhkikna tawh kisai Pasian phatna la te i sa hi.

records.english: Sceptics and believers alike must explain why the disciples were so convinced that they had seen Jesus alive.
records.zomi: Um lo mite leh um mite in zong nungzuite in Jesu a nungta-in a mu uh hi, ci-in bang hangin a upna uh a kip mahmah hiam cih a gen ding uh hi.

records.english: The pastor spoke about hope at the funeral.
records.zomi: Misi vuina-ah pastor in lametna thu a gen hi.

records.english: Paul compared the resurrection body to a seed that is planted and grows into something far greater.
records.zomi: Paul in thawhkikna pumpi pen kituh khaici a kho-in a lian zaw mahmah khat-ah a suak tawh a tehkak hi.

records.english: When my grandfather was dying, he asked the family to sing his favourite Easter hymn by his bed.
records.zomi: Ka pu a sih kuan ciangin innkuan te a lupna kiangah a deih pen Easter Pasian phatna la a sak dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: We sang it quietly, our voices breaking, while he held my grandmother's hand.
records.zomi: Ka pi' khut a len laitakin i aw uh kitat-in dai takin i sa hi.

records.english: At his funeral, the pastor reminded us that the hymn was about hope, and that Grandpa had chosen it for us, not for himself.
records.zomi: A misi vuina-ah pastor in Pasian phatna la pen lametna tawh kisai ahi a, Pu in amah adingin hi lo-in eite adingin a teel hi, ci-in hong phawksak hi.

records.english: Many Christians believe that the dead will one day be raised with new, transformed bodies.
records.zomi: Khazih mite tampi in a si mite ni khat ni-in pumpi thak, kikheksa tawh kithokik sak ding hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Why do Christians believe that the resurrection is more than a beautiful story?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Khazih mite in thawhkikna pen tangthu hoih khat sangin a tam zaw hi, ci-in a um uh hiam?

records.english: What do Christians believe happens when we die?
records.zomi: I sih ciangin bang piang hi, ci-in Khazih mite in a um uh hiam?

records.english: Most believe that those who trust in Christ will be with God and one day raised to new life.
records.zomi: A tamzaw in Khazih a muang mite Pasian tawh a om ding a, ni khat ni-in nuntakna thak-ah kithokik sak ding hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Christians light candles to remember the dead.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in a si mite phawk nadingin khawimeivaak a tang uh hi.

records.english: Do Christians believe in life after death?
records.zomi: Khazih mite in sih khit nunga nuntakna a um uh hiam?

records.english: Christians believe Jesus rose from the dead.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Jesu misi lak pan a thokik hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: The Christian hope is not just that the soul survives but that God will make all things new.
records.zomi: Khazih mite' lametna pen kha a nungta lai hi, cih bek hi lo-in Pasian in na khempeuh a thakin a bawl ding hi, cih ahi hi.

records.english: For Christians, the resurrection of Jesus is the foundation of their faith, not an optional extra.
records.zomi: Khazih mite adingin Jesu' thawhkikna pen a upna uh' suangphum ahi a, behlap theih leh theih loh na khat hi lo hi.

records.english: The early disciples said that they had seen Jesus alive after his death.
records.zomi: Nungzui masate in Jesu a sih khit ciangin a nungta-in a mu uh hi, ci-in a gen uh hi.

records.english: How can you sing at a funeral?
records.zomi: Misi vuina-ah bangci-in la na sa thei hiam?

records.english: We grieve, but we also sing because we believe death is not the end.
records.zomi: I dah hi, ahi zongin sihna pen a tawpna hi lo hi, ci-in i um ahih manin la zong i sa hi.

records.english: Does God comfort people who are grieving?
records.zomi: Pasian in a dah mite a hehnep hiam?

records.english: Theologians distinguish between the immediate hope of being with Christ after death and the future resurrection of the body.
records.zomi: Pasian thu siamte in sih khit ciangin Khazih tawh om ding lametna leh a hong tung ding pumpi thawhkikna a khen uh hi.

records.english: The Christian view of death holds together real grief and real hope, rather than choosing one over the other.
records.zomi: Sihna tawh kisai Khazih mite' ngaihsutna in khat a teel sangin dahna taktak leh lametna taktak a tuamtuam a len khawm hi.

records.english: Paul wrote to the church in Corinth that Christ's resurrection gives hope to all who believe.
records.zomi: Paul in Korin khua-a pawlpi kiangah Khazih' thawhkikna in a um mite khempeuh lametna a pia hi, ci-in a gelh hi.

records.english: The promise that God will wipe away every tear is one of the most quoted hopes at Christian funerals.
records.zomi: Pasian in khitui khempeuh a nul siang ding hi, cih kamciamna pen Khazih mite' misi vuina-ah kigen kik pen lametna khat ahi hi.

records.english: Is heaven a real place?
records.zomi: Vantung pen mun taktak khat ahi hiam?

records.english: The Bible says death is not the end.
records.zomi: Laisiangtho in sihna pen a tawpna hi lo hi, a ci hi.

records.english: How do you explain death to a child who has just lost a grandparent?
records.zomi: Pu ahih kei leh pi a mansuah thak naupang khat kiangah sihna bangci-in na gen hiam?

records.english: Jesus died on a cross.
records.zomi: Jesu singlamteh tungah a si hi.

records.english: Why does the passport office give out numbered tickets?
records.zomi: Bang hangin passport office in nambat nei lai neu te a hawm hiam?

records.english: Missed appointments waste hours of staff time, which is why reminders have become standard at many clinics.
records.zomi: Kihona hun mansuah in nasemte' hun nai tampi a susia a, tua ahih manin damdawi inn neu tampi-ah phawksakna te ngeina a suak khin hi.

records.english: Can I renew my library books online?
records.zomi: Ka laibu inn laibu te online-ah ka sawt kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: When every volunteer knows their role in advance, a large event can be set up in less than an hour.
records.zomi: Thalawp khatciat in a sep ding a masa-in a theih ciangin thupiang lian khat nai khat sung bek-in a kibawl thei hi.

records.english: Who keeps the time at the meeting?
records.zomi: Kikhopna-ah hun kua in a ngak hiam?

records.english: Please bring your forms already filled in.
records.zomi: Kong ngen hi, na form te na dim khit-in hong paipih in.

records.english: The council now sends text reminders, so fewer people miss their appointments.
records.zomi: Council in tu-in phone tungah phawksakna lai a khak a, tua ahih manin a kihona hun uh mansuah mi a tawm zaw hi.

records.english: Why does the library ask people to book the computers?
records.zomi: Bang hangin laibu inn in mite computer zat ding a masa-in a ciamteh dingin a ngen hiam?

records.english: So that everyone gets a fair hour instead of a few people staying all day.
records.zomi: Mi tawm khat in ni bup a om sangin mi khempeuh in nai khat kilawm ciat a ngah nadingin.

records.english: The bus is faster than walking to the clinic.
records.zomi: Damdawi inn neu-ah pai-in kal sangin bus in a manlang zaw hi.

records.english: Book your appointment online to save time.
records.zomi: Hun kemsak nadingin na kihona hun online-ah ciamteh in.

records.english: Our residents' meetings used to drag on for three hours and decide almost nothing.
records.zomi: I khua mite' kikhopna te nai thum sung a sawt zel a, bangmah khensat lo dek hi.

records.english: The new chair introduced a printed agenda, a timer for each item and a rule that nobody could speak twice until everyone had spoken once.
records.zomi: Makaipa thak in kikhopna thu lista nam khat, thu khatciat adingin hun tehna khat, leh mi khempeuh in khatvei a gen mateng kuamah in nihvei a gen thei lo, cih thukham khat a piak hi.

records.english: The next meeting finished in under an hour, and more people came to the one after that.
records.zomi: A zom kikhopna nai khat sung bek-in a zo a, tua khit zom kikhopna-ah mi a tam zaw hong pai hi.

records.english: Let's plan the fair one week at a time.
records.zomi: Fair pen kal khat ciat-in ngimna i bawl ni.

records.english: Good time management at the community centre means the same room can host three groups in a single day.
records.zomi: Khuasung inn lian-a hun hoih taka zat in inndan khat mah ni khat sungin pawl thum a sang thei hi, cih a lak hi.

records.english: Online forms have saved many residents a trip to the town hall.
records.zomi: Online form te in khua mite tampi khuapi office-ah a pai loh nadingin a huh khin hi.

records.english: The mobile library keeps to a strict timetable so that villages know exactly when it will arrive.
records.zomi: Vakvai laibu inn in khuate in bang hun-in a tung ding hiam cih a theih cian nadingin hun lai khauh taka a zui hi.

records.english: Is the clinic quicker in the afternoon?
records.zomi: Damdawi inn neu in sun nung lam-in a manlang zaw hiam?

records.english: Our club meets for one hour every Tuesday.
records.zomi: I pawl Pithai ni simin nai khat a kikhawm hi.

records.english: A volunteer group's time is precious, so a short, focused meeting does more than a long, friendly chat.
records.zomi: Thalawp pawl khat' hun a manpha ahih manin kikhopna tomno ngim cian khat in kiho nuam sau khat sangin a sem tam zaw hi.

records.english: Our street party committee met only three times, because each member had clear tasks.
records.zomi: I lampi poai vaihawm pawl thumvei bek a kikhawm uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh mi khatciat in a sep ding a cian ciat hi.

records.english: The council meeting started late again.
records.zomi: Council kikhopna in a ngei bangin a nung tawng hi.

records.english: Why are appointments at the clinic only ten minutes long?
records.zomi: Bang hangin damdawi inn neu-a kihona hun minit sawm bek a sau hiam?

records.english: There are so many patients that longer slots would mean waiting weeks for a visit.
records.zomi: Damlo a tam mahmah ahih manin hun sau zaw pia leh siavuan kan dingin kal tampi ngak ding a suak hi.

records.english: We finished the litter pick before lunch.
records.zomi: Sun an ma-in nawi tawtawng i ciangsak khin hi.

records.english: Volunteers at the community kitchen prepare the vegetables the evening before.
records.zomi: Khuasung an huanna inn-a thalawpte in anlah te a ni ma nitak-in a bawl cip uh hi.

records.english: The health visitor plans her week so that the newest babies are seen first.
records.zomi: Cidamna kankan nu in nausen thak pente a masa-in a muh nadingin a kal sung nasep a ngimna a bawl hi.

records.english: The library's decision to open earlier helped commuters who could never visit after work.
records.zomi: Laibu inn' a masa zaw-in hong ding khensatna in nasep khit ciangin a pai zo ngei lo nasepna kal-a vak mite a huh hi.

records.english: The food bank cut its waiting times by asking families to book a collection slot instead of queuing.
records.zomi: An piakna mun in innkuante kituan sangin an lak hun a ciamteh dingin a ngen ciangin ngakna hun a tomsak hi.

records.english: The swimming pool has a timetable for each lane.
records.zomi: Tuipeekna mun in lampi khatciat adingin hun lai a nei hi.

records.english: The fire service checks its equipment at the same time every morning so that nothing is forgotten.
records.zomi: Meikang mitsuakna pawl in bangmah a mangngilh loh nadingin zingsang simin hun kibang-in a van te a en hi.

records.english: Ambulance crews are trained to use every minute between calls to restock and clean.
records.zomi: Ambulance nasemte in sapna kikal minit khatciat van guan kik leh siangsak nadingin zat ding a kisinsak uh hi.

records.english: The market opens at seven, before the shops.
records.zomi: Sumbuk mun pen nai sagih-in, van zuakna inn te ma-in a kihong hi.

records.english: Long waits for services can discourage the very people who most need help, so speed is a matter of fairness.
records.zomi: Nasep te-ah sawt taka ngak in huhna a kisam pen mite mah a lungkiasak thei ahih manin manlang pen kilawm taka bawlna thu ahi hi.

records.english: How does the food bank pack two hundred parcels in one morning?
records.zomi: An piakna mun in zingsang khat sungin van bawm za nih bangci-in a guan hiam?

records.english: Each volunteer does one job, like rice or tins, and the parcels move along the tables.
records.zomi: Thalawp khatciat in nasep khat ciat, buh ahih kei leh sik bawm bang, a sem a, van bawm te dohkan te tungah a kisuan zel hi.

records.english: How long is the queue at the pharmacy?
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakna inn-ah kituanna bangzah sau hiam?

records.english: The advice centre sees people in order of urgency rather than arrival time.
records.zomi: Thuhilhna mun in mite a tun hun bangin hi lo-in a manlan ding bangin a mu hi.

records.english: Public services that manage time well often do so by sorting tasks by urgency rather than handling them in order.
records.zomi: Hun hoih taka a zang mipite' nasep te in a tamzaw-in nasep te a kizui bangin bawl sangin a manlan ding bangin a teelkhen uh hi.

records.english: Planning the summer fair a year ahead meant we could book the best stalls.
records.zomi: Khal fair kum khat ma-in ngimna i bawl ahih manin van zuakna mun hoih pen te i ciamteh thei hi.

records.english: Has anyone worked out how long the clean-up will take?
records.zomi: Siangsakna in bangzah sawt la ding hiam cih kuapeuh in a tuat khin hiam?

records.english: The repair café gives each person twenty minutes.
records.zomi: Bawl kikna cafe in mi khatciat minit sawm nih a pia hi.

records.english: The school crossing patrol works only at the busiest half hours of the day.
records.zomi: Sang naupang lampi kantanna ngaktu in ni khat sung-a mi tam pen nai lang te-ah bek a sem hi.

records.english: How did the volunteers get the hall ready so quickly?
records.zomi: Thalawpte in inn lian bangci-in manlang takin a bawl cip uh hiam?

records.english: They made a list the night before and gave each person one job, so nobody wasted time asking what to do.
records.zomi: Zan ma-in lista khat a bawl uh a, mi khatciat nasep khat ciat a pia uh ahih manin kuamah in bang bawl ding hiam cih dong-in hun a susia kei uh hi.

records.english: The sports hall is booked in one-hour slots.
records.zomi: Lehdona inn lian pen nai khat ciat-in kiciamteh hi.

records.english: Residents appreciated the council's honesty about how long the new bridge would really take to build.
records.zomi: Khua mite in lei thak lam dingin hun bangzah taktak a la ding hiam cih tawh kisai-in council' thuman taka genna a lungdam sa uh hi.

records.english: Planning repairs during school holidays allowed the council to fix the roads outside every school without delays.
records.zomi: Sang tawlngakni sungin bawlkikna ngimna a bawl ahih manin council in sang khatciat pualam-a lampi te nungtawn om lo-in a bawl kik thei hi.

records.english: The food bank opens for two hours on Fridays.
records.zomi: An piakna mun Laithai ni-in nai nih sung a kihong hi.

records.english: The council's new system lets residents book a slot at the recycling centre.
records.zomi: Council system thak in khua mite recycling mun-ah hun khat a ciamteh thei dingin a phal hi.

records.english: The post office is quiet after two.
records.zomi: Post office pen nai nih khit ciangin a dai hi.

records.english: How do the bin crews finish their rounds before the traffic builds up?
records.zomi: Nawi khawm nasemte in mawtaw a tam ma-in a pai ding mun te uh bangci-in a zo zo uh hiam?

records.english: They start at six and follow routes planned to avoid the school runs.
records.zomi: Nai guk-in a kipan uh a, sang naupang paipihna hun a pelh nadinga ngimna tawh kibawl lampi te a zui uh hi.

records.english: When the council moved meetings to the early evening, more working residents were able to attend.
records.zomi: Council in kikhopna te nitak masa lam-ah a suan ciangin nasem khua mite tam zaw in a pai thei uh hi.

records.english: The library's self-service machines have shortened the queues at the desk.
records.zomi: Laibu inn' amah mah zatna khawl te in dohkan-a kituanna te a tomsak hi.

records.english: The night bus leaves every half hour.
records.zomi: Zan bus in nai lang khat ciat-in a pai hi.

records.english: Arrive ten minutes early for your appointment.
records.zomi: Na kihona hun adingin minit sawm ma-in hong tung in.

records.english: Is the bank busy on Monday mornings?
records.zomi: Pizing ni zingsang-in bank-ah mi a tam hiam?

records.english: Our volunteers work in two-hour shifts.
records.zomi: I thalawpte in nai nih ciat a kalsuan in a sem uh hi.

records.english: Cover your mouth when you cough.
records.zomi: Na khuh ciangin na kam khuh in.

records.english: The hospital has hand gel at every door.
records.zomi: Damlo inn in kongkhak khatciat-ah khut silna gel a nei hi.

records.english: Public health campaigns about hand washing can reduce the spread of common infections in schools and offices.
records.zomi: Khut sil tawh kisai mipite' cidamna kampau te in sang leh office te-ah natna kizel ngeinate a kizelna a tawmsak thei hi.

records.english: The council's leaflet reminds parents which illnesses mean a child must stay off school.
records.zomi: Council' laipek in nu leh pa te kiangah bang natna te in naupang sang a pai lo-in inn-ah a om ding ahi hiam cih a phawksak hi.

records.english: The town's food hygiene inspectors trace outbreaks of food poisoning back to their source.
records.zomi: Khuapi' an siansuahna enkite in an tawh kisai natna kizel te a kipatna mun dong a zui uh hi.

records.english: Clear advice in several languages helped families in the town understand when to keep children off school.
records.zomi: Pau tuamtuam-a thuhilhna kician in khuapi-a innkuante in bang hun-in naupangte sang a pai lo-in inn-ah a koih ding uh hiam cih a theih nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: The health centre is very busy in winter.
records.zomi: Cidamna inn pen khuaphal-in nasep a tam mahmah hi.

records.english: Hospitals sometimes limit visiting during winter outbreaks to protect patients.
records.zomi: Damlo inn te in damlo te a kem nadingin khuaphal natna kizel hun-in mite a kan theihna a khak zel uh hi.

records.english: Common illnesses can be dangerous for elderly residents, so community nurses check on them more often in winter.
records.zomi: Natna ngeina te in khua mi upate adingin a lauhuai thei ahih manin khuasung nurse te in khuaphal-in amaute a kan tam zaw uh hi.

records.english: Many parents struggle to decide when a child's illness needs a doctor and when it simply needs rest at home.
records.zomi: Nu leh pa tampi in naupang khat' natna in bang hun-in siavuan a kisam a, bang hun-in inn-ah tawlngak bek a kisam hiam cih khensat a haksa sa uh hi.

records.english: Clean your hands with gel when you enter the ward.
records.zomi: Damlo inndan na lut ciangin gel tawh na khut siangsak in.

records.english: Treating minor illnesses at the pharmacy frees doctors to see patients with more serious conditions.
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakna inn-ah natna neu te damsak in siavuan te natna gik zaw nei damlo te a muh theih nadingin a lawhsak hi.

records.english: Why does the clinic run a vaccination day every autumn?
records.zomi: Bang hangin damdawi inn neu in phal lam simin natna kham nading tun ni a bawl hiam?

records.english: Flu spreads fastest in winter, so the nurses want as many people protected as possible before it starts.
records.zomi: Flu pen khuaphal-in a manlang pen-in a kizel ahih manin a kipat ma-in nurse te in mi tam thei zah a kikem dingin a deih uh hi.

records.english: How long should my son stay off school with chickenpox?
records.zomi: Ka tapa chickenpox a nei ciangin sang a pai lo-in bangzah sawt inn-ah a om ding hiam?

records.english: Until all the spots have formed scabs, which usually takes about five days.
records.zomi: A bawk khempeuh a keu-in a tuap mateng, tua in a tamzaw-in ni nga bang a la hi.

records.english: Is the flu jab free at the pharmacy?
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakna inn-ah flu tun pen a man om lo hiam?

records.english: It's free for older people, pregnant women and people with some long-term conditions.
records.zomi: Mi upate, nau pai numeite leh natna sawt khenkhat nei mite adingin a man om lo hi.

records.english: The nursery has a list of common illnesses.
records.zomi: Naupang kemna inn in natna ngeina te' lista khat a nei hi.

records.english: Keep children with a high temperature at home.
records.zomi: Pumpi sa sang mahmah nei naupangte inn-ah koih in.

records.english: Should I go to the doctor for a cold?
records.zomi: Natna nemno ka neih manin siavuan kiangah ka pai ding hiam?

records.english: Usually not; the pharmacist can help, unless you have trouble breathing or a very high fever.
records.zomi: A tamzaw-in kisam lo hi; na hu a haksa kei leh, ahih kei leh pumpi sa sang mahmah na neih kei leh, damdawi zuakpa in hong huh thei hi.

records.english: Does the pharmacy treat earache in children?
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakna inn in naupangte' bil na a damsak hiam?

records.english: Our school had a week of tummy bugs.
records.zomi: I sang-ah kal khat sung gilpi natna a om hi.

records.english: The clinic's winter campaign encouraged people with colds to use pharmacies rather than the emergency department.
records.zomi: Damdawi inn neu' khuaphal kampau in natna nemno nei mite manlang taka damsakna mun sangin damdawi zuakna inn zang dingin a hanthawn hi.

records.english: The pharmacy offers a free check for minor ear and throat infections.
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakna inn in bil leh kawl natna neu te adingin a man om lo enna a pia hi.

records.english: The clinic gives free advice about allergies.
records.zomi: Damdawi inn neu in allergy tawh kisai thuhilhna man om lo a pia hi.

records.english: Outbreaks of stomach bugs in hospitals can close whole wards, which puts pressure on the rest of the service.
records.zomi: Damlo inn te-ah gilpi natna kizel in damlo inndan bup te a khak thei a, tua in nasep a dang te tungah vanghikna a piak hi.

records.english: Early reporting of food poisoning allowed inspectors to close a dirty kitchen before more people fell ill.
records.zomi: An tawh kisai natna a manlang taka genna in enkite mi tam zaw a cin ma-in an huanna inn nin khat a khak thei uh hi.

records.english: The pharmacist recommended rest, plenty of fluids and paracetamol for my fever.
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakpa in ka pumpi sa adingin tawlngak, tui tampi dawn leh paracetamol a hilh hi.

records.english: Health visitors explain to new parents how to tell a mild illness from a serious one.
records.zomi: Cidamna kankan te in nu leh pa thak te kiangah natna neu leh natna gik bangci-in a khen ding uh hiam cih a gen uh hi.

records.english: Is there a flu clinic this Saturday?
records.zomi: Hih Kiginni-in flu damdawi inn neu a om hiam?

records.english: My daughter caught a cold at nursery.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in naupang kemna inn-ah natna nemno a ngah hi.

records.english: The out-of-hours service gives advice by phone when the surgery is closed.
records.zomi: Nasep hun pualam nasep in damdawi inn a kikhak ciangin phone tawh thuhilhna a pia hi.

records.english: Is hay fever worse in the city?
records.zomi: Khuapi-ah lopa pak natna a gilh zaw hiam?

records.english: Is the walk-in clinic open at weekends?
records.zomi: Hong lut lel theih damdawi inn neu kal tawp-in a kihong hiam?

records.english: When schools share information about infections quickly, parents can watch for symptoms before an illness spreads.
records.zomi: Sang te in natna kizel thu manlang taka a hawm ciangin nu leh pa te in natna a kizel ma-in natna lim te a et thei uh hi.

records.english: When a stomach bug spread through our care home, the manager closed the doors to visitors for a week.
records.zomi: I upa kemna inn-ah gilpi natna a kizel ciangin a makaipa in kal khat sung mikhualte adingin kongkhak a khak hi.

records.english: The staff wore gloves and aprons, cleaned every handle twice a day and kept the sick residents in their rooms.
records.zomi: Nasemte in khut ip leh puan khak a silh uh a, ni khat-in nihvei khut len mun khatciat a siangsak uh a, a cina teng mite a inndan uh sungah a koih uh hi.

records.english: By the following week, nobody new had fallen ill, and families were welcomed back with tea and cake.
records.zomi: A zom kal ciangin kuamah a thak in a cina nawn kei a, innkuante lakphak leh cake tawh a kidawn kik uh hi.

records.english: The leaflet explains how to treat a cold at home.
records.zomi: Laipek in inn-ah natna nemno bangci-in damsak ding hiam cih a gen hi.

records.english: Many people catch colds in the autumn.
records.zomi: Mi tampi in phal lam-in natna nemno a ngah uh hi.

records.english: Vaccination programmes protect not only individuals but also people who cannot be vaccinated themselves.
records.zomi: Natna kham nading tun nasep te in mimal bek hi lo-in amau mah a kitun thei lo mite zong a kem hi.

records.english: The doctor said it was only a virus.
records.zomi: Siavuan in virus bek ahi hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Why has the nursery asked parents to keep children at home?
records.zomi: Bang hangin naupang kemna inn in nu leh pa te naupangte inn-ah koih dingin a ngen hiam?

records.english: Several children have a stomach bug, and it spreads very quickly between small children.
records.zomi: Naupang tampi in gilpi natna a nei uh a, naupang neute kikal-ah manlang mahmah-in a kizel hi.

records.english: Is it true that antibiotics don't work against colds and flu?
records.zomi: Antibiotic in natna nemno leh flu tungah a sem kei hi, cih a man hiam?

records.english: Why do so many children catch colds in their first year at nursery?
records.zomi: Bang hangin naupang tampi in naupang kemna inn-a a kum masa uh-ah natna nemno a ngah uh hiam?

records.english: Volunteers drive older residents to the flu clinic if they can't get there on their own.
records.zomi: Thalawpte in khua mi upate amau mah in a pai zo kei uh leh flu damdawi inn neu-ah mawtaw tawh a paipih uh hi.

records.english: The school sent a letter about head lice.
records.zomi: Sang in lu hik tawh kisai lai khat a khak hi.

records.english: Pollen counts are published in the local paper so that hay fever sufferers can plan their day.
records.zomi: Lopa pak natna nei mite in a ni uh ngimna a bawl theih nadingin pak vui tamna te mun thuthak lai-ah a kitangko hi.

records.english: The pharmacy sells medicine for sore throats.
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakna inn in kawl na adingin damdawi a zuak hi.

records.english: Antibiotics are kept for bacterial infections, because using them too often makes them less effective for everyone.
records.zomi: Antibiotic te bacteria natna adingin kikem hi, bang hang hiam cih leh a tam lua-in zat in mi khempeuh adingin a sepna a tawmsak hi.

records.english: My grandfather had his flu jab at the pharmacy.
records.zomi: Ka pu in damdawi zuakna inn-ah a flu tun a ngah hi.

records.english: The health centre's website explains which illnesses can be treated at the pharmacy.
records.zomi: Cidamna inn' website in bang natna te damdawi zuakna inn-ah a kidamsak thei hiam cih a gen hi.

records.english: The care home asks visitors with coughs or colds to stay away until they're well.
records.zomi: Upa kemna inn in khuh ahih kei leh natna nemno nei mikhualte a dam mateng a hong pai lo dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: The nurse gave my baby her first vaccination.
records.zomi: Nurse in ka nausen' natna kham nading tun masa pen a tun hi.

records.english: The school nurse taught the pupils to wash their hands for as long as it takes to sing a short song.
records.zomi: Sang nurse in sangnaupangte la tomno khat sak sung zah a khut uh sil dingin a sinsak hi.

records.english: Does the school nurse check for head lice?
records.zomi: Sang nurse in lu hik a en hiam?

records.english: Measles cases rose in the town, so the clinic offered extra vaccination sessions.
records.zomi: Khuapi-ah measles a tam semsem ahih manin damdawi inn neu in natna kham nading tun hun behlap a bawl hi.

records.english: Interpreters on the first day helped parents feel confident enough to ask questions about their children's education.
records.zomi: Ni masa pen-a pau letmite in nu leh pate a tate uh' sinna tawh kisai thu a dot ngam nadingin a huh uh hi.

records.english: Did the bus come on time on the first day?
records.zomi: Ni masa pen-in bus hun takin a hong tung hiam?

records.english: How did the school prepare the new children for their first day?
records.zomi: Sang in naupang thakte a ni masa pen uh adingin bangci-in a kisakcip hiam?

records.english: They held a summer picnic so that the families could meet the teachers and see the classrooms.
records.zomi: Innkuante in sayate a theih kim uh a, sang inndan te a et theih nadingin khal hun-in pualam an nekkhawmna a bawl uh hi.

records.english: The church held a blessing for new pupils.
records.zomi: Pawlpi in sangnaupang thakte adingin thupha ngetna a nei hi.

records.english: Why did the library give the new pupils a free book?
records.zomi: Bang hangin laibu inn in sangnaupang thakte laibu khat man om lo-in a piak hiam?

records.english: It wanted every child to start school with a story of their own and a library card.
records.zomi: Naupang khatciat in amah mah' tangthu khat leh laibu inn card khat tawh sang a kipat nadingin a deih hi.

records.english: The council's admissions office sent a map showing the safest walking route to the school.
records.zomi: Council' sangah lutna office in sang-ah pai-in kal ding lampi bit pen lakna map khat a khak hi.

records.english: The new pupils got free school bags.
records.zomi: Sangnaupang thakte in sang ip man om lo a ngah uh hi.

records.english: My son was nervous on the school bus.
records.zomi: Ka tapa sang bus tungah a lungphang hi.

records.english: Preparing children for school is now seen as a shared task for families, schools, libraries and health services.
records.zomi: Naupangte sang adinga kisakcipsak pen tu-in innkuan, sang, laibu inn leh cidamna nasep te' kikhen pih nasep khat ahi hi, ci-in kimu hi.

records.english: The crossing patrol knew my son's name by Friday.
records.zomi: Lampi kantansak in Laithai ni ciangin ka tapa' min a thei khin hi.

records.english: The council's school transport team arranged a minibus for the children from the farms.
records.zomi: Council' sang khualzinna pawl in lo mun pan naupangte adingin minibus khat a bawl hi.

records.english: The school sent us photos of the classroom before the first day.
records.zomi: Sang in ni masa pen ma-in sang inndan' photo te hong khak hi.

records.english: The library's welcome for new pupils showed that a school's first day can involve the whole community.
records.zomi: Laibu inn' sangnaupang thakte dawnna in sang' ni masa pen in khuasung bup a huam thei hi, cih a lak hi.

records.english: The charity shop gave every new pupil a coat when the winter term began.
records.zomi: Khuaphal sinna hun a kipat ciangin huhna pawl' van zuakna inn in sangnaupang thak khatciat puan khak khat a pia hi.

records.english: Who helped your daughter on her first day at the new school?
records.zomi: Sang thak-a na tanu' ni masa pen-in kua in a huh hiam?

records.english: The lollipop lady walked her across the road and told her the head teacher was very kind.
records.zomi: Lampi kantansak numei in lampi a kantansak a, sang makaipa a lungsim hoih mahmah hi, ci-in a gen hi.

records.english: Can parents stay for the first morning?
records.zomi: Nu leh pate zingsang masa pen-in a om thei uh hiam?

records.english: The bus company let parents travel free with their children during the first week of term.
records.zomi: Bus company in sinna hun' kal masa pen sungin nu leh pate a tate uh tawh man om lo-in a pai thei dingin a phal hi.

records.english: Our son's first day was easier because he had met his teacher at the summer play scheme.
records.zomi: I tapa' ni masa pen a baih zaw hi, bang hang hiam cih leh khal hun naupang kimawlna-ah a saya a theih khin hi.

records.english: The dentist at the community clinic gave each new pupil a free toothbrush and a sticker.
records.zomi: Khuasung damdawi inn neu-a ha siavuan in sangnaupang thak khatciat ha tawlna khat leh sticker khat man om lo-in a pia hi.

records.english: Did the bus driver help on the first morning?
records.zomi: Zingsang masa pen-in bus mawtaw tawipa in a huh hiam?

records.english: Yes, he waited at every stop until each new child had found a seat.
records.zomi: A huh hi, naupang thak khatciat in tutna a muh mateng khawlna mun khatciat-ah a ngak hi.

records.english: When our son started school, he arrived at the gate in a uniform from the second-hand shop at the community centre.
records.zomi: I tapa sang a kipat ciangin khuasung inn lian-a van lui zuakna inn pan sang puan kibang silh-in sang kongpi-ah a tung hi.

records.english: Volunteers there had found him shoes, a jumper and even a lunch box with a dinosaur on it.
records.zomi: Tua mun-a thalawpte in khedap, puan khak leh dinosaur lim nei sun an bawm khat zong a zon sak uh hi.

records.english: He walked in proudly, and nobody could have guessed that his parents had arrived in the town only a week earlier.
records.zomi: Kisaktheih takin a lut a, a nu leh a pa kal khat bek ma-in khuapi-ah a tung uh hi, cih kuamah in a ngaihsun thei kei ding hi.

records.english: When public services work together, a child's first day at school can be the start of support for the whole family.
records.zomi: Mipite' nasep te a kikhawm-in a sep ciangin naupang khat' sang ni masa pen in innkuan bup adinga huhna kipatna a suak thei hi.

records.english: Help with uniforms and school bags means that no child has to start school feeling different from the others.
records.zomi: Sang puan kibang leh sang ip tawh kisai huhna in naupang kuamah a dangte tawh kibang lo-in kisa-in sang a kipat lohna ding a lak hi.

records.english: The council sent us a letter about school places.
records.zomi: Council in sang-a lut theihna tawh kisai lai khat hong khak hi.

records.english: Our local library ran a 'starting school' story time for children who were nervous.
records.zomi: I khuasung laibu inn in a lungphang naupangte adingin 'sang kipatna' tangthu genna hun khat a bawl hi.

records.english: Free breakfast clubs ensure that children arrive for their first lessons ready to learn rather than hungry.
records.zomi: Man om lo zingsang an pawl te in naupangte a gil kial sangin sinna masa te uh adingin sin dingin a kisakcip in a tun nadingin a kem hi.

records.english: The school nurse met every new child.
records.zomi: Sang nurse in naupang thak khatciat a kimu hi.

records.english: The police community officer gave a talk to the new pupils about crossing the road safely.
records.zomi: Khuasung palik pa in sangnaupang thakte kiangah lampi bit taka kantan dan thu a gen hi.

records.english: Did you get help with the cost of the uniform?
records.zomi: Sang puan kibang man tawh kisai huhna na ngah hiam?

records.english: A friendly crossing patrol or bus driver can make a frightened child's first journey to school feel safe.
records.zomi: Lampi kantansak ahih kei leh bus mawtaw tawipa lawmhoih khat in lau naupang khat' sang-ah a pai masa pen a bit bangin a kisaksak thei hi.

records.english: Why do some councils offer free uniforms to families who have just arrived?
records.zomi: Bang hangin council khenkhat in a tung thak innkuante sang puan kibang man om lo-in a pia uh hiam?

records.english: Our neighbour drove the twins to school on their first day.
records.zomi: I inn kiang mi in apengte a ni masa pen uh-in mawtaw tawh sang-ah a paipih hi.

records.english: The police officer visited the class in the first week.
records.zomi: Palik pa in kal masa pen sungin class a hong kan hi.

records.english: The health visitor reminded us to check our son's vaccinations before he started school.
records.zomi: Cidamna kankan nu in i tapa sang a kipat ma-in a natna kham nading tun te en dingin hong phawksak hi.

records.english: On the first morning, a translator from the council stood with the parents who spoke little English.
records.zomi: Zingsang masa pen-in council pan pau letmi khat in English tawm khat bek a thei nu leh pate tawh a ding hi.

records.english: Community volunteers often notice families who are struggling long before official services do.
records.zomi: Khuasung thalawpte in a haksat innkuante nasep pawl te sangin hun sawt ma-in a mu masa zel uh hi.

records.english: The community centre ran a uniform swap the weekend before term started.
records.zomi: Khuasung inn lian in sinna hun a kipat ma kal tawp-in sang puan kibang kikhekna khat a bawl hi.

records.english: The headteacher stood at the gate to welcome everyone.
records.zomi: Sang makaipa in mi khempeuh a dawn nadingin kongpi-ah a ding hi.

records.english: What did the council do to help children who were new to the country?
records.zomi: Gam-ah a tung thak naupangte a huh nadingin council in bang a bawl hiam?

records.english: It paid for interpreters to meet the families on the first day and explain how the school worked.
records.zomi: Ni masa pen-in innkuante a kimu-in sang in bangci-in a sem hiam cih a gen nadingin pau letmite man a pia hi.

records.english: The uniform shop was very busy in August.
