records.english: Asking why an author made a particular choice helps students see that writing is planned, not accidental.
records.zomi: Gelhpa in bang hangin teelna tuam khat a bawl hiam cih dot in sangnaupangte in laigelh pen ngimna tawh kibawl ahi a, a piang lel hi lo hi, cih a mu nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: What is the last line of the poem?
records.zomi: La phuah' tang nunung pen bang hiam?

records.english: How many characters are in the play?
records.zomi: Lam-ah tangthu sung mi bangzah a om hiam?

records.english: Which picture matches the poem?
records.zomi: Bang lim in la phuah tawh a kituak hiam?

records.english: Which words in the advert are chosen to make the product sound exciting?
records.zomi: Thukhak sung-a bang kammal te in van pen lungdam huai bangin a kizak nadingin kiteel hiam?

records.english: Why does the writer repeat the same sentence at the start of each paragraph?
records.zomi: Bang hangin gelhpa in laigelh tang khatciat' kipatna-ah kammal tang kibang a gen kik hiam?

records.english: A single well-chosen question from a teacher can open up a story that a class had read only on the surface.
records.zomi: Saya pan kician taka kiteel dotna khat bek in class in a tung lam bek-a a sim tangthu khat a hong thei hi.

records.english: Discussing different interpretations of a poem shows students that there is often more than one reasonable reading.
records.zomi: La phuah khat' khiatna tuamtuam te kihoupih in sangnaupangte kiangah sim dan kilawm khat sangin a tam zaw a om zel hi, cih a lak hi.

records.english: Why do you think the author starts the story at the end?
records.zomi: Bang hangin gelhnu in tangthu a tawpna pan a kipan hi, na ci hiam?

records.english: Because she wants us to know the result, so that we pay attention to how it happened.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh a suak i theih nadingin a deih a, tua ahih manin bangci-in a piang hiam cih tungah lungsim i koih hi.

records.english: What is the title of the poem?
records.zomi: La phuah' min tang bang hiam?

records.english: Why did the family move house?
records.zomi: Bang hangin innkuan in inn a suan uh hiam?

records.english: How old is the girl in the story?
records.zomi: Tangthu sung-a nungak kum bangzah a hi hiam?

records.english: Health checks at festivals and places of worship can discover serious conditions early.
records.zomi: Pawi leh biakinn te-a cidamna enna te in natna gik te manlang takin a mu thei hi.

records.english: Do I need to fast before the free blood test?
records.zomi: Man om lo sisan sitna ma-in an ka tan ding a ngai hiam?

records.english: Screening programmes save money in the long run by catching illnesses before they become serious.
records.zomi: Natna enna nasep te in natna gik ma-in a mu ahih manin hun sawt ciangin sum a kemsak hi.

records.english: I got a letter inviting me for screening.
records.zomi: Natna enna adingin hong sapna lai khat ka ngah hi.

records.english: I had a free hearing test at the library.
records.zomi: Laibu inn-ah man om lo bil zakna sitna khat ka nei hi.

records.english: The pharmacist measured my waist as part of the check.
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakpa in enna kiang khat dingin ka kong a teh hi.

records.english: Why do some people avoid free screenings, even when they're offered nearby?
records.zomi: Bang hangin mi khenkhat in a kiang-ah kipia zongin man om lo natna enna te a pelh uh hiam?

records.english: When community leaders take part in screening themselves, others are more willing to join them.
records.zomi: Khuasung makaipate amau mah in natna enna-ah a kihel ciangin a dangte in amaute tawh kihel a nuam zaw uh hi.

records.english: The local football club arranged heart checks for all its young players.
records.zomi: Khuasung football pawl in a khangno mawlmite khempeuh adingin lungtang enna a bawl hi.

records.english: The screening van has a ramp, so wheelchair users can have their checks too.
records.zomi: Natna enna mawtaw in tou lampi a nei ahih manin tutna mawtaw zangte zong a kien thei uh hi.

records.english: The health visitor examined the babies at the children's centre every Tuesday morning.
records.zomi: Cidamna kankan nu in Pithai ni zingsang simin naupang inn-ah nausen te a en hi.

records.english: Is the scan done in the hospital or in the van?
records.zomi: Scan pen damlo inn-ah kibawl hiam, mawtaw sungah kibawl hiam?

records.english: My grandmother was nervous about the scan, so a volunteer stayed beside her the whole time.
records.zomi: Ka pi scan tawh kisai-in a lungphang ahih manin thalawp khat a kiangah hun bup a om hi.

records.english: Screening in community places reaches people who would never book an appointment at a clinic.
records.zomi: Khuasung mun te-a natna enna in damdawi inn neu-ah kihona hun a ciamteh ngei lo ding mite a tung hi.

records.english: Volunteers at the health fair helped people fill in forms before their examinations.
records.zomi: Cidamna fair-a thalawpte in a enna uh ma-in mite form dim dingin a huh uh hi.

records.english: Volunteers who explain what an examination involves can calm people who have never been tested before.
records.zomi: Enna khat bang a huam hiam cih a gen thalawpte in kien ngei lo mite a lungmuansak thei uh hi.

records.english: Can I have my blood pressure checked at the pharmacy without an appointment?
records.zomi: Kihona hun om lo-in damdawi zuakna inn-ah ka sisan tehna ka en thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, just ask at the counter, and the pharmacist will take you into the private room.
records.zomi: Thei hi, dohkan-ah dong lel in, damdawi zuakpa in mimal inndan sungah hong paipih ding hi.

records.english: Some people fear that a screening will find something wrong, so friendly staff make a real difference.
records.zomi: Mi khenkhat in natna enna in na khat a siat a mu ding, ci-in a lau uh ahih manin lawmhoih nasemte in kikhekna taktak a piangsak hi.

records.english: Free hearing tests at the shopping centre found many people who needed hearing aids.
records.zomi: Van zuakna inn lian-a man om lo bil zakna sitna te in bil zakna van a kisam mi tampi a mu hi.

records.english: The mobile unit does chest X-rays.
records.zomi: Vakvai mawtaw in awm X-ray a bawl hi.

records.english: Please wait in the queue for the eye check.
records.zomi: Kong ngen hi, mit enna adingin kituanna-ah ngak in.

records.english: The community centre invited a nurse to give free health checks to people over fifty.
records.zomi: Khuasung inn lian in kum sawmnga val mite adingin man om lo cidamna enna pia dingin nurse khat a sam hi.

records.english: Mobile screening units bring examinations to rural areas where hospitals are far away.
records.zomi: Vakvai natna enna mawtaw te in damlo inn gamla mahmah mun te-ah enna te a paipih hi.

records.english: Offering examinations in several languages helps make sure no group in the community is left out.
records.zomi: Pau tuamtuam-in enna te piak in khuasung-a pawl khatpeuh a kinusia lohna dingin a huh hi.

records.english: The pharmacist recommended a full examination after she noticed my irregular pulse.
records.zomi: Ka lungtang khaugui a kizui kei hi, cih damdawi zuakpa in a phawk khit ciangin enna kicing khat a hilh hi.

records.english: The volunteer wrote down my results.
records.zomi: Thalawp in ka suak te a gelh hi.

records.english: The women's group invited a female doctor so that members would feel comfortable being examined.
records.zomi: Numei pawl in a pawl mite a kienna-ah a lungmuan nadingin numei siavuan khat a sam uh hi.

records.english: The library's health week included free eye tests and advice on healthy eating.
records.zomi: Laibu inn' cidamna kal in man om lo mit enna leh cidamna an nek tawh kisai thuhilhna a huam hi.

records.english: Is it worth going to the free screening if I already feel perfectly healthy?
records.zomi: Ka cidamna a hoih kicing hi, ka cih leh man om lo natna enna-ah pai a manpha lai hiam?

records.english: Is the screening for men as well?
records.zomi: Natna enna pen pasalte adingin zong ahi hiam?

records.english: My father had his first skin check at the clinic.
records.zomi: Ka pa in damdawi inn neu-ah a vun enna masa pen a nei hi.

records.english: Could the mobile clinic visit the farms, since many workers can't travel into town?
records.zomi: Nasem tampi in khuapi-ah a pai thei kei uh ahih manin vakvai damdawi inn neu in lo mun te a kan thei ding hiam?

records.english: Is the hearing test at the library really free?
records.zomi: Laibu inn-a bil zakna sitna a man om lo taktak hiam?

records.english: Yes, it's run by a charity every first Saturday of the month.
records.zomi: Taktak hi, kha khatciat' Kiginni masa pen-in huhna pawl khat in a bawl hi.

records.english: Can I get my cholesterol checked at the health fair?
records.zomi: Cidamna fair-ah ka cholesterol ka en thei ding hiam?

records.english: When the diabetes team set up a stall at our temple's festival, my uncle agreed to a quick finger-prick test.
records.zomi: Sugar natna pawl in i biakinn' pawi-ah dohkan khat a koih ciangin ka pa neu in khutzung sisan sitna manlang khat a kipsak hi.

records.english: The nurse told him his blood sugar was much higher than normal and gave him a letter for his doctor.
records.zomi: Nurse in a sisan sung-a sugar a ngeina sangin a sang mahmah hi, ci-in a gen a, a siavuan adingin lai khat a pia hi.

records.english: He changed his diet that same month, and he says that festival stall may have saved his eyesight.
records.zomi: Tua kha mah-in a an nek dan a khek a, tua pawi dohkan in a mit a huhdam thei hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Can children have their eyes tested at the fair?
records.zomi: Naupangte in fair-ah a mit uh a kien thei uh hiam?

records.english: The nurse gave me a leaflet about my results.
records.zomi: Nurse in ka suak te tawh kisai laipek khat hong pia hi.

records.english: What happens at the free health check at the community centre?
records.zomi: Khuasung inn lian-a man om lo cidamna enna-ah bang a piang hiam?

records.english: A nurse measures your weight, blood pressure and blood sugar, and then talks to you about the results.
records.zomi: Nurse khat in na giklam, na sisan tehna leh na sisan sung-a sugar a teh a, tua khit ciangin a suak te tawh kisai hong kihoupih hi.

records.english: The sports club asks for a heart check.
records.zomi: Lehdona pawl in lungtang enna khat a ngen hi.

records.english: Can I bring my mother to the screening?
records.zomi: Natna enna-ah ka nu ka paipih thei ding hiam?

records.english: When is the breast screening van coming to our town?
records.zomi: Breast screening mawtaw i khuapi-ah bang hun-in a hong ding hiam?

records.english: It will be in the supermarket car park for two weeks from the tenth.
records.zomi: A ni sawm ni pan kal nih sung supermarket mawtaw koihna mun-ah a om ding hi.

records.english: Health checks for young athletes aim to find rare heart problems before they cause harm.
records.zomi: Lehdona khangnote adinga cidamna enna te in a buaina a piang ma-in lungtang buaina tawm te a mu dingin a ngim hi.

records.english: The nurse at the mosque checked my blood pressure.
records.zomi: Muslim biakinn-a nurse in ka sisan tehna a en hi.

records.english: The eye test at the optician's is free for children.
records.zomi: Mit enpa' mun-a mit sitna pen naupangte adingin a man om lo hi.

records.english: Pharmacies have become important places for simple examinations, such as blood pressure checks.
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakna inn te sisan tehna enna bang enna baih te adingin mun thupi khat a suak khin hi.

records.english: Is the van open on Sundays?
records.zomi: Mawtaw Nipini-in a kihong hiam?

records.english: A community that runs regular health fairs often sees people taking more interest in their own health.
records.zomi: Cidamna fair a bawl zel khuasung khat in mite amau cidamna tungah lungsim a koih zaw uh hi, cih a mu zel hi.

records.english: The dental nurse visits the school on Monday.
records.zomi: Ha damsakna nurse in Pizing ni-in sang a hong kan ding hi.

records.english: Our church hosted a screening day, and the nurses found several people with high blood pressure.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in natna enna ni khat a bawl a, nurse te in sisan tehna sang nei mi tampi a mu uh hi.

records.english: The health fair is in the town square.
records.zomi: Cidamna fair pen khuapi lai mun-ah a om hi.

records.english: Results from the community screening are sent to each person's own doctor.
records.zomi: Khuasung natna enna pan a suak te mi khatciat' amau siavuan kiangah a kikhak hi.

records.english: A free health check is only useful if people are told clearly what to do with the results.
records.zomi: Man om lo cidamna enna pen mite in a suak te tawh bang a bawl ding uh hiam cih kician taka a kigen leh bek a huh huai hi.

records.english: Why did the screening nurse tell me to see my own doctor?
records.zomi: Bang hangin natna enna nurse in ka siavuan mah mu dingin hong gen hiam?

records.english: Because your reading was a little high, and your doctor can do a fuller examination and look at your history.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh na tehna a sang deuh a, na siavuan in enna kicing zaw a bawl thei a, na tangthu a en thei hi.

records.english: Is it true that the council will charge for parking during the music festival?
records.zomi: La pawi sungin council in mawtaw koih man a la ding hi, cih a man hiam?

records.english: The town hall is giving free tours.
records.zomi: Khuapi office in man om lo vakna te a pia hi.

records.english: Accessible venues, quiet areas and clear signs allow more people to take part in local celebrations.
records.zomi: Lut baih mun te, mun dai te leh lim tangna kician te in mi tam zaw khuasung lawmna te-ah a kihel theih nadingin a phal hi.

records.english: The park café stays open until nine tonight.
records.zomi: Pawngpi cafe tu zan nai kua dong a kihong ding hi.

records.english: Who do I ask about volunteering as a steward at the parade?
records.zomi: Pawi vakna-ah ngaktu thalawp dingin kua ka dong ding hiam?

records.english: Contact the events office at the town hall, and they'll give you a short training session.
records.zomi: Khuapi office-a thupiang office sam in, tua ciangin sinna tomno khat hong pia ding uh hi.

records.english: Our community centre hosts a free lunch for older residents after the remembrance service.
records.zomi: I khuasung inn lian in phawkna kikhopna khit ciangin teng mi upate adingin man om lo sun an khat a bawl hi.

records.english: The ambulance service had two teams on duty at the food festival, just in case.
records.zomi: An pawi-ah ambulance nasep in a kisam leh cih in pawl nih a ngak sak hi.

records.english: The fire station has an open day next month.
records.zomi: Meikang mitsuakna inn in kha zom-in kihon ni khat a nei hi.

records.english: Are dogs welcome at the library's book fair?
records.zomi: Laibu inn' laibu fair-ah ui te a kisang hiam?

records.english: The street lights were decorated for the festival.
records.zomi: Pawi adingin lampi meivak te a kizepsak hi.

records.english: Councils that publish safety plans for events reassure residents and help prevent accidents.
records.zomi: Thupiang te adingin bitna ngimna a tangko council te in khua mite a lungmuansak a, lamdang piangna a kham uh hi.

records.english: Open days at fire stations and police stations help residents see public services as part of the community.
records.zomi: Meikang mitsuakna inn leh palik inn te-a kihon ni te in khua mite in mipite' nasep te khuasung' a kiang khat bangin a muh nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Is the library's storytelling festival suitable for toddlers?
records.zomi: Laibu inn' tangthu genna pawi in naupang neute adingin a kituak hiam?

records.english: Yes, there's a special session every morning for children under four.
records.zomi: Kituak hi, kum li nuai naupangte adingin zingsang simin hun tuam khat a om hi.

records.english: Is the parade route suitable for wheelchairs?
records.zomi: Pawi vakna lampi tutna mawtaw adingin a kituak hiam?

records.english: Emergency teams at community events rarely make the news, but their presence keeps thousands of people safe.
records.zomi: Khuasung thupiang te-a haksatna ciang pawl te thuthak-ah a kilang zel kei uh a, ahi zongin a om uh in mi tul tampi a bit sak hi.

records.english: The police gave out wristbands so that lost children could be reunited with their parents quickly.
records.zomi: Palik te in mang naupangte a nu leh a pa uh tawh manlang takin a kimuh kik theih nadingin khutzung kawikawi te a hawm uh hi.

records.english: The library's film night starts at seven.
records.zomi: Laibu inn' film nitak nai sagih-in a kipan hi.

records.english: At last year's carnival, the fire service opened its station so that children could climb into a real fire engine.
records.zomi: Kum beisa-a carnival-ah meikang mitsuakna pawl in naupangte meikang mitsuakna mawtaw taktak tungah a kah theih nadingin a inn a hong hi.

records.english: My son spent twenty minutes asking the firefighters questions about their helmets and hoses.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in a lukhu leh tuikhuam te tawh kisai-in meikang mitsuakpa te minit sawm nih sung dotna a dong hi.

records.english: When we got home, he made a fire escape plan for our flat and made us practise it before bedtime.
records.zomi: Inn-ah i tun ciangin i flat adingin meikang ciang taikhiatna ngimna khat a bawl a, ihmut ma-in hong sin sak hi.

records.english: Free events organised by public services help families who cannot afford expensive days out.
records.zomi: Mipite' nasep te' bawl man om lo thupiang te in man tam ni pualam a lei zo lo innkuante a huh hi.

records.english: Recycling and water stations at festivals show how community events can also care for the environment.
records.zomi: Pawi te-a recycling leh tui dawnna mun te in khuasung thupiang te in leitung zong a kem thei hi, cih a lak hi.

records.english: Could the organisers add more toilets near the children's area this year?
records.zomi: Bawlpa te in tu kum naupang mun kiang-ah ek inn behlap a koih thei ding uh hiam?

records.english: The council put up signs for the festival.
records.zomi: Council in pawi adingin lim tangna te a koih hi.

records.english: Do we have to register our cake stall for the summer fair?
records.zomi: Khal fair adingin i cake zuakna dohkan i ciamteh ding a ngai hiam?

records.english: Yes, every food stall must register with the council's health team first.
records.zomi: Ngai hi, an zuakna dohkan khempeuh a masa-in council' cidamna pawl kiangah a ciamteh ding hi.

records.english: The swimming pool has a family fun day.
records.zomi: Tuipeekna mun in innkuan nuam ni khat a nei hi.

records.english: Large community events depend on cooperation between councils, police, health services and volunteers.
records.zomi: Khuasung thupiang lian te council, palik, cidamna nasep leh thalawpte kikal-a kipawlna tungah a kinga hi.

records.english: The town's leisure centre hosted a free sports day for families on the bank holiday.
records.zomi: Khuapi' tawlngakna inn lian in kumpi tawlngakni-in innkuante adingin man om lo lehdona ni khat a bawl hi.

records.english: Volunteer stewards are often the unseen reason why crowded events run smoothly.
records.zomi: Ngaktu thalawpte pen mi dim thupiang te nuam taka a pai nading hangsan kimu lo ahi zel uh hi.

records.english: The recycling team sorted the festival rubbish, and almost nothing went to landfill.
records.zomi: Recycling pawl in pawi nawi te a teelkhen uh a, nawi vuina mun-ah bangmah dek a pai kei hi.

records.english: The fire service gave a smoke-alarm demonstration at the community fun day.
records.zomi: Meikang mitsuakna pawl in khuasung nuam ni-ah meikhu theihna khawl zat dan a lak hi.

records.english: Where can we park for the carnival?
records.zomi: Carnival adingin koi-ah mawtaw i koih thei ding hiam?

records.english: The library is holding a book fair on Saturday.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in Kiginni-in laibu fair khat a bawl ding hi.

records.english: Is the museum open late for the festival?
records.zomi: Pawi adingin museum zan dong a kihong hiam?

records.english: The library ran a storytelling tent where local authors read to children all afternoon.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in khuasung gelhpa te sun nung lam bup naupangte kiangah a sim tangthu genna puanin khat a bawl hi.

records.english: The recycling bins are by the food stalls.
records.zomi: Recycling bawm te an zuakna dohkan te kiangah a om hi.

records.english: The festival programme is on the council website.
records.zomi: Pawi ngimna lai council website tungah a om hi.

records.english: There's a first-aid tent near the stage.
records.zomi: Dinna sang kiangah hun haksa ciang huhna puanin khat a om hi.

records.english: Why did the council move the festival from the square to the park?
records.zomi: Bang hangin council in pawi khuapi lai mun pan pawngpi-ah a suan hiam?

records.english: Because the crowds grew too large for the square, and the park has better access for ambulances.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh mi kikhawm te khuapi lai mun adingin a tam lua a, pawngpi in ambulance te adingin lutna hoih zaw a nei hi.

records.english: When local services listen to residents' complaints, the next year's event is usually better for everyone.
records.zomi: Khuasung nasep te in khua mite' phunna te a ngaih uh ciangin a zom kum-a thupiang in mi khempeuh adingin a hoih zaw zel hi.

records.english: Will there be extra buses after the fireworks?
records.zomi: Meiva lim khit ciangin bus behlap a om ding hiam?

records.english: The council has arranged two extra buses from the park until midnight.
records.zomi: Council in pawngpi pan zan lai dong bus behlap nih a bawl khin hi.

records.english: The local radio station announced road closures for the marathon throughout the morning.
records.zomi: Khuasung radio in zingsang bup marathon adingin lampi kikhakna te a tangko hi.

records.english: The market has extra stalls this weekend.
records.zomi: Hih kal tawp sumbuk mun in van zuakna dohkan behlap a nei hi.

records.english: Small grants from the council often make the difference between a local event surviving or disappearing.
records.zomi: Council pan sum neu te in khuasung thupiang khat a nungta zom ding hiam, a mang ding hiam cih a khensat zel hi.

records.english: Why did the council refuse permission for the late-night concert in the square?
records.zomi: Bang hangin council in khuapi lai mun-a zan khuamial la kikhopna a phal kei hiam?

records.english: Is the concert in the park free?
records.zomi: Pawngpi-a la kikhopna a man om lo hiam?

records.english: The council provides free water stations at the summer festival to prevent people from overheating.
records.zomi: Council in mite a lum lua lohna dingin khal pawi-ah man om lo tui dawnna mun te a pia hi.

records.english: The organisers provided a sign-language interpreter for the speeches at the opening ceremony.
records.zomi: Bawlpa te in kipatna kikhopna-a thugenna te adingin khut pau pau letmi khat a bawlsak uh hi.

records.english: Libraries and museums that open their doors for festivals attract people who might never visit otherwise.
records.zomi: Pawi adingin a kongkhak uh a hon laibu inn leh museum te in a kan ngei lo ding mite a hong kan sak uh hi.

records.english: Who are the volunteers in yellow jackets?
records.zomi: Puan khak gial silh thalawpte kua te hiam?

records.english: The police closed the road for the parade.
records.zomi: Palik te in pawi vakna adingin lampi a khak uh hi.

records.english: Volunteer stewards guided the crowd safely out of the park after the fireworks.
records.zomi: Meiva lim khit ciangin ngaktu thalawpte in mi kikhawm te pawngpi pan bit takin a paipih khia uh hi.

records.english: The museum offered free entry to local residents during the heritage weekend.
records.zomi: Ngeina tangthu kal tawp sungin museum in khuasung teng mite man om lo-in a lutsak hi.

records.english: Good planning for transport and parking can decide whether residents enjoy an event or avoid it.
records.zomi: Khualzinna leh mawtaw koihna adinga ngimna hoih in khua mite in thupiang khat a lungdam ding uh hiam, a pelh ding uh hiam cih a khensat thei hi.

records.english: There's a quiet area for small children.
records.zomi: Naupang neute adingin mun dai khat a om hi.

records.english: When a recipe fails, changing one thing at a time is the surest way to discover the problem.
records.zomi: Huan dan khat a lawhcin loh ciangin vei khat-in na khat bek khek pen buaina mu nading lampi cian pen ahi hi.

records.english: Is the bulb broken?

records.zomi: 'And' zang lo-in hih kammal tang nih bangci ka kizom sak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Why does this sentence sound clumsy when I read it aloud?
records.zomi: Aw ngaingai-a ka sim ciangin bang hangin hih kammal tang a kizak hoih lo hiam?

records.english: Could you show me how to turn these notes into a proper sentence?
records.zomi: Hih ciamtehna neute kammal tang kicing khat-ah bangci ka khek thei ding hiam cih hong lak thei ding na hiam?

records.english: Students learning in a second language may build sentences in the order of their first language, which teachers can gently point out.
records.zomi: Pau nihna tawh a sinmi sangnaupangte in a pau masa uh' kizui dan bangin kammal tang a bawl thei uh a, tua pen saya te in nem takin a lak thei uh hi.

records.english: Why does the library record interviews with older residents?
records.zomi: Bang hangin laibu inn in khuasung upate tawh kihona-a kikup te a ciamteh hiam?

records.english: So that their memories of the town are kept for future generations.
records.zomi: Khua tawh kisai a phawkna uh suan hong tung ding te adingin a kikem nadingin.

records.english: The care home and the school share a garden.
records.zomi: Upate kemna inn leh sang in huan khat a zang khawm uh hi.

records.english: My father says the job centre used to have cards pinned on boards instead of websites.
records.zomi: Ka pa in nasep zonna inn in website sangin card te pheng tungah a tal zel uh hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Why do so many older people still prefer to bank in person?
records.zomi: Bang hangin upa tampi in tu-in zong bank-ah amah mahmah pai-in sum tawh kisai na a sem nuam zaw lai uh hiam?

records.english: Older residents told the planning meeting how the high street looked before the shopping centre was built.
records.zomi: Khuasung upate in khuapi lampi lian pen van zuakna inn lian a kilam ma-in bangci a kilang hiam cih ngimna kikhopna-ah a gen uh hi.

records.english: At what age do people get free bus travel here?
records.zomi: Hih mun-ah kum bangzah ciangin mite in bus tung ah a man pia lo-in a pai thei uh hiam?

records.english: Can my grandmother join the computer class at the community centre?
records.zomi: Ka pi in khuasung inn lian-a computer sinna-ah a kihel thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, the Tuesday class is for older beginners, and teenagers volunteer as helpers.
records.zomi: Thei hi, Pithai ni sinna pen a kipan thak upate adingin ahi a, khangnote in huhmi dingin thalawp-in a sem uh hi.

records.english: Libraries have become meeting places where people of every age can learn from one another.
records.zomi: Laibu inn te kum tuamtuam a mite in khat leh khat a kisin theihna kikhopna mun te ahi khin hi.

records.english: How has the post office changed since you started working there?
records.zomi: Lai khak inn-ah na sep kipat pan tu dong bangci a kikhek hiam?

records.english: When I began, people came in to pay every bill in cash, and now most of them come to send parcels they've sold online.
records.zomi: Ka kipat lai-in mite in man lai khempeuh sum tak tawh pia dingin a hong lut uh a, tu-in a tam zaw in online-a a zuak uh van te khak dingin a hong uh hi.

records.english: The school invited grandparents to a lunch.
records.zomi: Sang in pu leh pi te sun an ne dingin a sam hi.

records.english: The school's history project asked pupils to interview someone who had lived through the war.
records.zomi: Sang' tangthu nasep in sangnaupangte galpi sung-a a nungta khat tawh kiho dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: Projects that bring generations together help young people understand how their town has changed.
records.zomi: Suan tuamtuam a kikhawmsak nasep te in khangnote in a khua uh bangci a kikhek hiam cih a theisiam nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: My grandmother remembers when the only doctor in town held his surgery in his own front room.
records.zomi: Khua sung-a siavuan khat bek in amah inn mai lam inndan-ah damlote a en lai ka pi in a phawk hi.

records.english: Can young people join the history society?
records.zomi: Khangnote in tangthu pawl-ah a kihel thei uh hiam?

records.english: The library's reminiscence boxes contain old toys, coins and ration books for care home visits.
records.zomi: Laibu inn' phawkkikna bawm te sungah upate kemna inn kanna adingin naupang lawhna lui te, sum lui te leh an piakna laibu te a om hi.

records.english: Does your grandfather still volunteer at the museum?
records.zomi: Na pu in museum-ah thalawp-in a sem lai hiam?

records.english: Our town's oral history project is online.
records.zomi: I khua' kam tawh ciamteh tangthu nasep pen online-ah a om hi.

records.english: A town that values the memories of its oldest residents is better prepared to plan its future.
records.zomi: A upa pen khuasung mite' phawkna a manpha sa khua khat in a hun hong tung ding a ngimna bawl dingin a kiginna a hoih zaw hi.

records.english: The library collects old photos of the town.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in khua' lim lui te a kaikhawm hi.

records.english: Why do the nursery children visit the care home every week?
records.zomi: Bang hangin naupang neu sang naupangte in kal simin upate kemna inn a kan uh hiam?

records.english: Because the residents love their company, and the children learn to be patient and kind.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh a sung-a omte in naupangte tawh om khawm a nuam sa mahmah uh a, naupangte in thuakzawhna leh hehpihna a sin uh hi.

records.english: The museum has a room about our town's past.
records.zomi: Museum in i khua' tangthu lui tawh kisai inndan khat a nei hi.

records.english: Museums that invite residents to share objects create a more personal picture of local history.
records.zomi: Khuasung mite van te a pia khawm dingin a sam museum te in khua' tangthu lim kinai zaw khat a bawl uh hi.

records.english: Oral history recordings preserve memories that would otherwise disappear when older residents pass away.
records.zomi: Kam tawh ciamteh tangthu aw te in khuasung upate a sih ciangin a mang ding phawkna te a kem hi.

records.english: Who helps the older residents with their phones?
records.zomi: Kua in khuasung upate a phone uh tawh kisai a huh hiam?

records.english: Teenagers who volunteer at the care home say they've heard stories they will never forget.
records.zomi: Upate kemna inn-ah thalawp-in a sem khangnote in a mangngilh ngei lo ding uh tangthu te a za uh hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: When our town museum asked for objects from the 1960s, my grandfather brought in his old bus conductor's ticket machine.
records.zomi: I khua museum in kum 1960 hun lai-a van te a ngen ciangin ka pu in a bus conductor sep lai-a a zat ticket khawl lui a paipih hi.

records.english: The children on a school visit crowded round as he showed them how he used to punch tickets for every passenger.
records.zomi: Sang pan a hong kan naupangte in a kim ah a kikhawm uh a, khualzin mi khatciat adingin ticket a vih dan a lak hi.

records.english: Afterwards, one boy wrote to thank him and said he wanted to drive a bus one day.
records.zomi: A khit ciangin pasal neu khat in lungdam a gen dingin lai a gelh a, ni khat bus mawng ka nuam hi, a ci hi.

records.english: The museum's volunteers range in age from sixteen to ninety-one.
records.zomi: Museum' thalawpte kum sawm le guk pan kum sawmkua le khat dong ahi uh hi.

records.english: The youth club visits the day centre every month.
records.zomi: Khangno pawl in kha simin sun lam upate kemna mun a kan uh hi.

records.english: When councils consult different generations, they learn how the same service affects people in very different ways.
records.zomi: Council te in suan tuamtuam a dot ciangin nasep kibang khat in mite tuam takin bangci a lawh hiam cih a thei uh hi.

records.english: What happens at the memory café on Fridays?
records.zomi: Laithai ni-in phawkna cafe-ah bang a piang hiam?

records.english: Older residents and their families share old photos and songs over tea and cake.
records.zomi: Khuasung upate leh a innkuanpihte in tea leh cake ne khawm kawmin lim lui te leh la lui te a kipia khawm uh hi.

records.english: Care homes that welcome school visits often report that residents become more cheerful and active.
records.zomi: Sang pan kanmi a muak upate kemna inn te in a sung-a omte a lungdam zaw a, a hat zaw uh hi, ci-in a gen zel uh hi.

records.english: The council invited older and younger residents to plan the new park together.
records.zomi: Council in khuasung upate leh khangnote pawngpi thak ngimna kikhawm-in bawl dingin a sam hi.

records.english: Older people who are helped with technology by teenagers often teach those teenagers something in return.
records.zomi: Khangnote' huhna tawh technology zang thei upate in tua khangnote a lehlam-in na khat a hilh kik zel uh hi.

records.english: The day centre has a singing group.
records.zomi: Sun lam upate kemna mun in la sakna pawl khat a nei hi.

records.english: The local radio station broadcasts older residents' memories every Sunday morning.
records.zomi: Khuasung radio in Nipini zingsang simin khuasung upate' phawkna te a thulak hi.

records.english: How different was the fire service when you joined it in the 1970s?
records.zomi: Kum 1970 hun lai-in mei sihna nasep na kihel lai-in tu tawh bangzah in a kibang lo hiam?

records.english: Could the library run a session where young people teach older residents about online safety?
records.zomi: Laibu inn in khangnote in khuasung upate online bitna tawh kisai a hilh theihna hun khat a bawl thei ding hiam?

records.english: My grandmother was one of the first nurses at the new hospital when it opened.
records.zomi: Damlo inn thak a kihon lai-in ka pi pen tua mun-a nurse masa penpen te lakah khat ahi hi.

records.english: Grandpa told the class about the old railway.
records.zomi: Pu in sangnaupangte kiangah meileng lampi lui tawh kisai a gen hi.

records.english: The intergenerational choir brings together primary pupils and residents of the sheltered flats.
records.zomi: Suan tuamtuam la sakna pawl in sang neu sangnaupangte leh upate a tenna inn te-a omte a kikhawmsak hi.

records.english: My grandfather still uses the library every day.
records.zomi: Ka pu in ni simin laibu inn a zang lai hi.

records.english: My mother remembers when the swimming pool opened.
records.zomi: Tuipeekna mun a kihon lai ka nu in a phawk hi.

records.english: Did Grandma really pay every bill at the bank counter?
records.zomi: Pi in man lai khempeuh bank dohkan-ah a pia taktak hiam?

records.english: Intergenerational groups help reduce loneliness among older residents and build confidence in young people.
records.zomi: Suan tuamtuam pawl te in khuasung upate' kia-ngamna a niam sak a, khangnote' kihuaina a khangsak hi.

records.english: The community centre pairs students with older residents who want to learn how to use video calls.
records.zomi: Khuasung inn lian in sangnaupangte video tawh phone sap dan sin nuam khuasung upate tawh a kizop sak hi.

records.english: The new health centre replaced the old cottage hospital.
records.zomi: Cidamna inn thak in khua neu damlo inn lui a laih hi.

records.english: My father used to queue at the post office every Monday.
records.zomi: Ka pa in Pizing ni simin lai khak inn-ah a kizui-in a ding zel hi.

records.english: Many older people remember when local services were run by people everyone knew by name.
records.zomi: Upa tampi in khuasung nasep te mi khempeuh in a min uh a theih mite in a sep lai uh a phawk uh hi.

records.english: Does your grandmother still teach knitting at the library?
records.zomi: Na pi in laibu inn-ah puan khui dan a hilh lai hiam?

records.english: Stories about how health care used to be help young people appreciate services they take for granted.
records.zomi: Cidamna kemna a masa-in bangci a om hiam cih tangthu te in khangnote in a ngah kipah sa lo nasep te a manpha sak nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Public services look very different from one generation to the next, from paper forms to online accounts.
records.zomi: Mipite' nasep te form lai pan online account dong suan khat pan suan khat-ah a kibang lo mahmah hi.

records.english: My grandmother remembers the first clinic in our village.
records.zomi: I khua neu-a damdawi inn neu masa pen ka pi in a phawk hi.

records.english: Which retired miners did the students interview?
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte in nasep tawpsa suangtum tou mi kua te tawh a kiho uh hiam?

records.english: In our family, a symbol's meaning is learned not from books but from stories told at the kitchen table.
records.zomi: I innkuan sungah lim tangna khat' khiatna pen laibu pan hi lo-in an ne dohkan kiang-a kigen tangthu te pan i sin hi.

records.english: My aunt sewed a small piece of her mother's shawl into her daughter's wedding dress.
records.zomi: Ka ni in a nu' puan-ak tawmno khat a tanu' mopawi puan sungah a khui khawm hi.

records.english: My father gave me his hunting knife.
records.zomi: Ka pa in a sa mat temta hong pia hi.

records.english: When my brother married, my father gave him the family spear as a sign that he was now the head of his own home.
records.zomi: Ka sanggampa a ki-ten ciangin ka pa in amah inn a lu ahi khin hi, cih lim tangna dingin innkuan tei a pia hi.

records.english: My aunt gave the baby a small woven bag.
records.zomi: Ka ni in nausen kiangah a kituah ip neu khat a pia hi.

records.english: My parents chose my sister's name to remember an aunt who died young.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in a neu-in a si ni khat phawk nadingin ka sanggamnu min a teel uh hi.

records.english: My mother keeps the first lock of hair from each of her children in a carved wooden box.
records.zomi: Ka nu in a tate khatciat' sam masa pen sing kiat bawm khat sungah a kem hi.

records.english: Every child in our family has a name with a meaning.
records.zomi: I innkuan sung naupang khempeuh in khiatna nei min khat a nei uh hi.

records.english: My mother keeps her wedding basket on a shelf.
records.zomi: Ka nu in a mopawi bawm van koihna tungah a koih hi.

records.english: My grandmother never lets anyone put the family Bible on the floor, because she says it shows respect.
records.zomi: Ka pi in kua mah innkuan Laisiangtho leitungah koih a phal ngei kei hi, bang hang hiam cih leh zahtakna a lakna ahi hi, a ci hi.

records.english: My grandfather gave each grandson a knife and each granddaughter a necklace when they turned eighteen.
records.zomi: Ka pu in a tu pasal khatciat kum sawm le giat a phak ciangin temta khat a pia a, a tu numei khatciat ngawngkhih khat a pia hi.

records.english: Grandma gave me her beads before she died.
records.zomi: Pi in a sih ma-in a khi te hong pia hi.

records.english: In our family, the youngest child pours the first drink for the eldest guest at every celebration.
records.zomi: I innkuan sungah poai khempeuh-ah a neu pen naupang in a upa pen mikhual adingin dawn ding masa pen a sun hi.

records.english: Why does Dad wear Grandpa's ring only on special days?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pa in Pu' khutzungbuh ni tuamte-ah bek a bulh hiam?

records.english: My children now ask about the meaning of every object in Grandma's house, and she loves telling them.
records.zomi: Ka tate in tu-in Pi' inn sung-a van khempeuh' khiatna a dong uh a, amah in a gen nuam sa mahmah hi.

records.english: My father wore his father's beads at my wedding so that Grandpa would feel present.
records.zomi: Pu a om bangin a kizak nadingin ka pa in ka mopawi ni-in a pa' khi te a bulh hi.

records.english: Why does Grandpa keep that old spear above the door?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pu in tua tei lui kongkhak tungah a koih hiam?

records.english: His father gave it to him, and to him it means that the family is protected.
records.zomi: A pa in a pia a, amah adingin innkuan kikem hi, cihna ahi hi.

records.english: We keep Grandma's chair empty at dinner.
records.zomi: Nitak an ne ciangin Pi' tutphah i lawng sak hi.

records.english: My cousin had our family symbol carved on the door of her new flat in the city.
records.zomi: Ka sanggamnu in khuapi-a a inn thak kongkhak tungah i innkuan lim tangna a kiat sak hi.

records.english: Why did Grandma choose such an unusual name for your baby?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pi in na nausen adingin min lamdang mahmah khat a teel hiam?

records.english: She chose a name that means peace, because our family had just come through a very difficult year.
records.zomi: I innkuan in kum haksa mahmah khat a khen khit pah ahih manin nopna cihna min khat a teel hi.

records.english: My cousin wore our family's colours at the dance.
records.zomi: Ka sanggamnu in lam-na-ah i innkuan' pianzia puan a silh hi.

records.english: My uncle hits the gong when guests arrive.
records.zomi: Mikhual te a tun ciangin ka pa neu in dakbu a tum hi.

records.english: Passing down a family object can be more emotional than passing down money or land.
records.zomi: Innkuan van khat a suante kiangah pia pen sum ahih kei leh lei piak sangin lungsim a lawh zaw thei hi.

records.english: My aunt explained that the knot on our wedding gifts means the two families are now joined.
records.zomi: I mopawi letsong te tunga khau-khih in innkuan nih tu-in a kigawm khin hi, cihna ahi hi, ci-in ka ni in a gen hi.

records.english: Our family's old drum has a crack, but nobody wants to replace it.
records.zomi: I innkuan' khuang lui a kekta hi, ahi zongin kuamah in a thak tawh laih a ut kei uh hi.

records.english: Can I hold the old horn cup?
records.zomi: Ki haai lui ka len thei ding hiam?

records.english: Will I get Grandpa's spear one day?
records.zomi: Ni khat Pu' tei ka ngah ding hiam?

records.english: When my uncle died, the family gong was struck slowly so that the whole village would know.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu a sih ciangin khua bup in a theih nadingin innkuan dakbu nawl takin a kitum hi.

records.english: Grandma's beads are kept in a silk bag.
records.zomi: Pi' khi te silk ip khat sungah a kikem hi.

records.english: Family symbols give my children a sense of belonging, even though they are growing up far from our grandparents' village.
records.zomi: Innkuan lim tangna te in ka tate pu leh pi te' khua pan gamla takah a khan uh hangin kihel khawmna a pia hi.

records.english: When my grandmother explained why she kept the old spear, I finally understood what my father meant by family duty.
records.zomi: Ka pi in bang hangin tei lui a kem hiam cih a gen ciangin innkuan mawhpuakna, a cih ka pa' khiatna ka theisiam ta hi.

records.english: The names chosen in our family often carry a hope or a memory that only the older relatives fully understand.
records.zomi: I innkuan sungah kiteel min te in innkuan upate bek in a theisiam kim lamenna ahih kei leh phawkna khat a pua zel hi.

records.english: Grandma's necklace has seven colours.
records.zomi: Pi' ngawngkhih in pianzia sagih a nei hi.

records.english: My grandmother explains the meaning of each family object to every new bride and son-in-law.
records.zomi: Ka pi in mo thak leh mopa thak khatciat kiangah innkuan van khatciat' khiatna a gen hi.

records.english: My grandfather believes that if we forget the meaning of our family's objects, we lose part of our story.
records.zomi: I innkuan van te' khiatna i mangngilh leh i tangthu a khenkhat i mangsak ding hi, ci-in ka pu in a um hi.

records.english: Some of the symbols my parents treasure mean little to my teenage children, which worries my mother.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa' manpha sa lim tangna khenkhat in ka tate khangno te adingin khiatna tawm bek a nei a, tua in ka nu a lungkham sak hi.

records.english: We hang Grandpa's hat above his chair.
records.zomi: Pu' lukhu a tutphah tungah i khai hi.

records.english: When my brother left home to study abroad, my grandmother tied a small woven cord around his wrist.
records.zomi: Ka sanggampa gamdang-ah sang kah dingin inn a nusiat ciangin ka pi in a khut-ah khau kituah neu khat a khih sak hi.

records.english: She told him it was a promise that the family would be thinking of him every day.
records.zomi: Innkuan in ni simin amah a ngaihsun ding uh hi, cih kamciamna ahi hi, ci-in a gen hi.

records.english: Four years later, when he came home with his degree, the faded cord was still on his wrist.
records.zomi: Kum li khit ciangin a degree tawh inn-ah a hong ciah ciangin a mai-kaisa khau pen a khut-ah a om lai hi.

records.english: Why do we always use the old horn cup at weddings?
records.zomi: Bang hangin mopawi-ah ki haai lui i zang den hiam?

records.english: Because my great-grandfather drank from it at his own wedding, and it reminds us of the families before us.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh ka pu' pu in amah mopawi-ah tua pan a dawn a, i ma-a innkuan te hong phawk sak hi.

records.english: My mother says that a gift from a grandparent carries a blessing that a bought present never can.
records.zomi: Pu ahih kei leh pi pan letsong khat in a kilei letsong in a pua zo ngei lo ding thupha a pua hi, ci-in ka nu in a gen hi.

records.english: What do the beads on Grandma's necklace mean?
records.zomi: Pi' ngawngkhih tunga khi te in bang a cihna hiam?

records.english: Each colour stands for one of her children, and she added a new one when each was born.
records.zomi: Pianzia khatciat in a tate khat a ding a, khatciat a suah ciangin a thak khat a behlap hi.

records.english: Does my name really mean morning star?
records.zomi: Ka min in zingsang aksi cihna taktak hiam?

records.english: Why does my grandfather always face the east when he blesses the family?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ka pu in innkuan thupha a piak ciangin ni suahna lam a nga den hiam?

records.english: We use the old horn cup at weddings.
records.zomi: Mopawi-ah ki haai lui i zang hi.

records.english: My father blesses each child before a long journey.
records.zomi: Ka pa in khualzin sau khat ma-in naupang khatciat thupha a pia hi.

records.english: Our family plants a banana tree beside the house whenever a baby is born.
records.zomi: Nausen khat a suah ciangin i innkuan in inn kiangah banana kung khat a suan zel hi.

records.english: When I moved abroad, my mother gave me a handful of rice from our harvest to keep in my kitchen.
records.zomi: Gamdang-ah ka pai ciangin ka nu in i lo at pan buh khut-tawm khat ka an huan sungah kem dingin hong pia hi.

records.english: How old is our family gong?
records.zomi: I innkuan dakbu kum bangzah a pha hiam?

records.english: Why is the gong only used at funerals and weddings?
records.zomi: Bang hangin dakbu pen mi sihna leh mopawi-ah bek a kizang hiam?

records.english: Our family has a special song for weddings.
records.zomi: I innkuan in mopawi adingin la tuam khat a nei hi.

records.english: My sister named her son after our grandfather.
records.zomi: Ka sanggamnu in a tapa i pu' min a phuak hi.

records.english: My grandmother says that the pattern on our family cloth shows the hills around her village.
records.zomi: I innkuan puan tunga zia in a khua kim-a mualte a lak hi, ci-in ka pi in a gen hi.

records.english: Why did Mum give my bride a basket of rice and eggs?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Nu in ka mo buh leh ak tui bawm khat a pia hiam?

records.english: In our family, it's a way of wishing the new couple a home that always has enough food.
records.zomi: I innkuan sungah tua pen zi-pasal thak te an kicing den inn khat a neih nadingin deihsakna lampi khat ahi hi.

records.english: Some churches read Revelation as symbols.
records.zomi: Pawlpi khenkhat in Mangmuhna Lai pen lim tangna bangin a sim uh hi.

records.english: How can Christians with such different views about the future still worship together?
records.zomi: Hun hong tung ding tawh kisai ngaihsutna kibang lo mahmah a nei Khazih mite in bangci biakna a bawl khawm thei lai uh hiam?

records.english: What do Baptists believe about the last days?
records.zomi: Baptist te in ni nunung te tawh kisai bang a um uh hiam?

records.english: Is the thousand years in Revelation a real number?
records.zomi: Mangmuhna Lai sung-a kum tulkhat pen nambat taktak ahi hiam?

records.english: Several churches read the same passages but reach very different conclusions about the future.
records.zomi: Pawlpi tampi in Laisiangtho mun kibang a sim uh a, ahi zongin hun hong tung ding tawh kisai a kibang lo mahmah thukhupna te a tung uh hi.

records.english: Some Christians believe that many of the prophecies in Revelation were fulfilled in the first century.
records.zomi: Khazih mite khenkhat in Mangmuhna Lai sung-a kamsang thu tampi kum za masa pen sungin a tangtung khin hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Orthodox Christians pray for the dead.
records.zomi: Orthodox Khazih mite in mi site adingin thu a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Studying different Christian views of the end helps believers understand why their neighbours' churches teach differently.
records.zomi: Tawpna tawh kisai Khazih mite' ngaihsutna tuamtuam sinna in upmite in bang hangin a inn kiangte' pawlpi in a tuam takin a hilh uh hiam cih a theisiam nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Do Catholics believe in purgatory?
records.zomi: Catholic te in Purgatory a um uh hiam?

records.english: Why don't some churches try to predict when Jesus will return?
records.zomi: Bang hangin pawlpi khenkhat in Jesu hong paikik ding hun a gen kholh sawm kei uh hiam?

records.english: Because they point to Jesus' words that no one knows the day or the hour, and they focus on being ready instead.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh tua ni leh nai kuamah in a thei kei hi, cih Jesu' thugen a lak uh a, tua sangin kiginna tungah a lungsim uh a koih uh hi.

records.english: Different churches teach different things about the future.
records.zomi: Pawlpi tuamtuam in hun hong tung ding tawh kisai thu tuamtuam a hilh uh hi.

records.english: Our church's statement of faith says little about the details of the end, but a great deal about hope.
records.zomi: I pawlpi' upna thugen in tawpna tawh kisai a neuneu tawm bek a gen a, ahi zongin lamenna tawh kisai tampi a gen hi.

records.english: Christians have different views about the millennium.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in kum tulkhat tawh kisai ngaihsutna tuamtuam a nei uh hi.

records.english: My pastor says that arguments about the timing of the end should never divide Christians from one another.
records.zomi: Tawpna hun tawh kisai kinialna te in Khazih mite khat leh khat a khen ngei lo ding hi, ci-in ka pastor in a gen hi.

records.english: Orthodox Christians often speak of the last things with a strong emphasis on mystery and hope.
records.zomi: Orthodox Khazih mite in na nunung te tawh kisai thuthuk leh lamenna thupi takin a gen zel uh hi.

records.english: The Nicene Creed, which many churches share, says that Christ will come again in glory.
records.zomi: Pawlpi tampi in a zat khawm uh Nicene Upna Thugen in Khazih in thupina tawh hong paikik ding hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Why do some Christians feel anxious when they hear sermons about the end times?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Khazih mite khenkhat in tawpna hun tawh kisai thuhilhna a zak ciangin a lungkham uh hiam?

records.english: Why do Catholics pray for people who have died?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Catholic te in a si khinsa mite adingin thu a ngen uh hiam?

records.english: Catholic teaching includes purgatory, a time of final cleansing before entering heaven, so they pray for the departed.
records.zomi: Catholic thuhilhna sungah vantung a tun ma-in a nunung pen a kisiansuahna hun, Purgatory, a kihel a, tua ahih manin a si khinsa mite adingin thu a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Some Christians believe in the rapture.
records.zomi: Khazih mite khenkhat in 'rapture' a um uh hi.

records.english: Whatever their differences, most Christian traditions agree that the end will bring judgement, renewal and the victory of God's love.
records.zomi: A kibat lohna uh bangpeuh hi taleh, Khazih mite' ngeina tampi in tawpna in thukhenna, thakna leh Pasian' itna' zawhna a tun ding hi, cih a lungkim uh hi.

records.english: Many theologians warn that speculation about dates can distract believers from the call to love and serve now.
records.zomi: Pasian thu siam tampi in ni tawh kisai ngaihsun lel pen in upmite tu-a itna leh nasepna sapna pan a hei khiat thei hi, ci-in a vaukhak uh hi.

records.english: Many Protestant churches do not accept the idea of purgatory, though they may still remember the dead in prayer.
records.zomi: Protestant pawlpi tampi in Purgatory ngaihsutna a sang kei uh hi, ahi zongin thungetna sungah mi site a phawk lai thei uh hi.

records.english: Premillennial Christians believe that Jesus will return before a thousand-year reign on earth.
records.zomi: Kum tulkhat ma-a ngaihsutna nei Khazih mite in Jesu in leitunga kum tulkhat vaihawmna ma-in hong paikik ding hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Do all Christians believe the same thing about the end of the world?
records.zomi: Khazih mite khempeuh in leitung tawpna tawh kisai thu kibang a um uh hiam?

records.english: No, they share the hope that Christ will return, but they explain the details in different ways.
records.zomi: Um kei uh hi, Khazih in hong paikik ding hi, cih lamenna a kibang uh a, ahi zongin a neuneu te a tuam takin a gen uh hi.

records.english: My grandfather believes the end is near.
records.zomi: Tawpna a nai ta hi, ci-in ka pu in a um hi.

records.english: Why do some churches place great emphasis on the end times, while others rarely mention them?
records.zomi: Bang hangin pawlpi khenkhat in tawpna hun a thupi sak mahmah uh a, a dangte in a gen tawm mahmah uh hiam?

records.english: My cousin's church has a different view of heaven.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam' pawlpi in vantung tawh kisai ngaihsutna tuam khat a nei hi.

records.english: Christian views about the end differ in their details, yet most share the conviction that history is moving towards God's purpose.
records.zomi: Tawpna tawh kisai Khazih mite' ngaihsutna a neuneu-ah a kibang kei hi, ahi zongin a tam zaw in tangthu pen Pasian' ngimna lam-ah a pai hi, cih upna a nei khawm uh hi.

records.english: Some Christians are very interested in prophecy.
records.zomi: Khazih mite khenkhat in kamsang thu tungah a lungsim uh a koih mahmah uh hi.

records.english: Do all churches believe in the rapture?
records.zomi: Pawlpi khempeuh in 'rapture' a um uh hiam?

records.english: For some believers, the expectation of Christ's imminent return encourages urgent mission and evangelism.
records.zomi: Upmi khenkhat adingin Khazih' hong paikik pah ding lamenna in ma-a pai manlang nasepna leh Lungdamna Thu genna a hanthawn hi.

records.english: What is the millennium that some Christians talk about?
records.zomi: Khazih mite khenkhat in a gen uh kum tulkhat pen bang ahi hiam?

records.english: It's a thousand-year reign of Christ mentioned in the book of Revelation, which Christians interpret in different ways.
records.zomi: Mangmuhna Lai sungah kigen Khazih' kum tulkhat vaihawmna ahi a, Khazih mite in a tuam takin a khiatna a gen uh hi.

records.english: What does the word rapture mean in some churches?
records.zomi: Pawlpi khenkhat-ah 'rapture' cih kammal in bang a cihna hiam?

records.english: Some Christians believe that believers will be taken up to meet Christ before or during his return.
records.zomi: Khazih mite khenkhat in Khazih' hong paikik ma-in ahih kei leh hong paikik laitakin upmite Khazih dawn dingin tunglam-ah puaktohna a ngah ding uh hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Some scholars argue that apocalyptic writing in the Bible was meant to encourage persecuted communities, not to provide a timetable.
records.zomi: Pilmi khenkhat in Laisiangtho sung-a tawpna mangmuhna laigelh pen bawlsiat thuak mipite hanthawn nadingin ahi a, hun lista pia nadingin ahi kei hi, ci-in a gen uh hi.

records.english: Some evangelical Christians expect a period of great trouble on earth before Christ returns.
records.zomi: Evangelical Khazih mite khenkhat in Khazih' hong paikik ma-in leitungah gimna lianpi hun khat a om ding hi, ci-in a lamen uh hi.

records.english: Many Christians hope for a new heaven and earth.
records.zomi: Khazih mite tampi in van thak leh lei thak a lamen uh hi.

records.english: Amillennial Christians usually understand the thousand years as a symbol of Christ's present reign.
records.zomi: Kum tulkhat ngaihsutna nei lo Khazih mite in kum tulkhat pen Khazih' tu-a vaihawmna' lim tangna bangin a theisiam zel uh hi.

records.english: What does the book of Revelation mean?
records.zomi: Mangmuhna Lai in bang a cihna hiam?

records.english: What is the second coming?
records.zomi: Nihvei hong pai pen bang ahi hiam?

records.english: Our church teaches that Christ will return one day.
records.zomi: I pawlpi in Khazih in ni khat hong paikik ding hi, ci-in a hilh hi.

records.english: Our Bible study is reading the book of Daniel.
records.zomi: I Laisiangtho sinna in Daniel laibu a sim hi.

records.english: The way a church interprets the book of Revelation often shapes how it understands suffering and hope in the present.
records.zomi: Pawlpi khat in Mangmuhna Lai a khiatna a gen dan in tu-a thuakna leh lamenna bangci a theisiam hiam cih a bawl zel hi.

records.english: At university, my friends from three different churches argued late into the night about the book of Revelation.
records.zomi: University-ah pawlpi tuam thum pan ka lawmte in Mangmuhna Lai tawh kisai zan lai dong a kinial uh hi.

records.english: One believed in a future thousand-year reign, another saw the thousand years as a symbol, and the third thought most of it had already happened.
records.zomi: Khat in hun hong tung ding kum tulkhat vaihawmna a um a, a dang khat in kum tulkhat pen lim tangna bangin a mu a, a thumna in a tam zaw a piang khin hi, a ci hi.

records.english: In the end, we agreed that we all hoped for Christ's return, even if we read the details differently.
records.zomi: A tawp-ah a neuneu te i sim dan kibang lo hangin Khazih' hong paikik ding i lamen khempeuh hi, cih i lungkim hi.

records.english: My friend's church talks a lot about the end times.
records.zomi: Ka lawm' pawlpi in tawpna hun tawh kisai tampi a gen hi.

records.english: Postmillennial Christians hope that the gospel will spread and transform the world before Christ returns.
records.zomi: Kum tulkhat nung-a ngaihsutna nei Khazih mite in Khazih' hong paikik ma-in Lungdamna Thu a zeel a, leitung a khek ding hi, ci-in a lamen uh hi.

records.english: The Catholic Church teaches about heaven, hell and purgatory, and it encourages prayer for the dead.
records.zomi: Catholic Pawlpi in vantung, meidil leh Purgatory tawh kisai a hilh a, mi site adingin thungetna a hanthawn hi.

records.english: My pastor says nobody knows when Jesus will come back.
records.zomi: Jesu hong paikik ding hun kuamah in a thei kei hi, ci-in ka pastor in a gen hi.

records.english: My aunt reads books about the end of the world.
records.zomi: Ka ni in leitung tawpna tawh kisai laibu te a sim hi.

records.english: Debates about the millennium have divided some churches, but many Christians now hold their views with humility.
records.zomi: Kum tulkhat tawh kisai kinialna te in pawlpi khenkhat a khen hi, ahi zongin Khazih mite tampi in tu-in a ngaihsutna uh kiniamkhiatna tawh a len uh hi.

records.english: Some Christians hope that God's mercy will finally reach every person, though most churches do not teach this.
records.zomi: Khazih mite khenkhat in Pasian' hehpihna a tawp-ah mi khempeuh a tung ding hi, ci-in a lamen uh hi, ahi zongin pawlpi a tam zaw in hih thu a hilh kei uh hi.

records.english: Jesus told his followers to stay awake and be ready.
records.zomi: Jesu in a nungzuite kiangah khanglawh-in kigingkhol in om un, a ci hi.

records.english: Across many traditions, Christians pray for Christ to come, expressing hope rather than fear about the future.
records.zomi: Ngeina tampi sungah Khazih mite in Khazih hong pai dingin thu a ngen uh a, hun hong tung ding tawh kisai lauhna sangin lamenna a lak uh hi.

records.english: Why have some groups in history set dates for Christ's return, only to be disappointed?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tangthu sungah pawl khenkhat in Khazih' hong paikik ding ni a khensat uh a, a lungkiasa uh hiam?

records.english: Is there a way to keep the bread fresh for longer without a freezer?
records.zomi: Tuikhal khawl om lo-in moh sawt zaw a thak den nading lampi khat a om hiam?

records.english: Can we split the cost?
records.zomi: A man i khen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Comparing the cost of repairing something with the cost of replacing it is a sensible first step.
records.zomi: Na khat bawlphat man leh a thak tawh laih man kiteh pen kalsuan masa pil huai khat ahi hi.

records.english: Would a longer lead help the dog walk more calmly?
records.zomi: Ui khau a sau zaw in ui a dai zaw-in a pai nadingin a huh ding hiam?

records.english: Pet owners often have to try several solutions before they find the one that suits their animal.
records.zomi: Ganhing vulmite in a ganhing uh adingin a kilawm pen a muh ma-un lampi tuamtuam a sit zel uh hi.

records.english: Why not buy a smaller bag?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ip neu zaw khat na lei kei hiam?

records.english: Small changes, like moving a plant or a piece of furniture, sometimes solve problems that seemed serious.
records.zomi: Kung khat ahih kei leh inn sung van khat suan bang a neu kikhekna te in buaina lian bang a kilang te a phel zel hi.

records.english: What if we leave the car at home?
records.zomi: Mawtaw inn-ah i nusiat leh bangci ahi ding hiam?

records.english: What if we set off before breakfast?
records.zomi: Zingsang an i nek ma-in i pai khiat leh bangci ahi ding hiam?

records.english: Can we swap seats with someone?
records.zomi: Mi khat tawh tutna i kikhek thei ding hiam?

records.english: What if we eat outside tonight?
records.zomi: Tu nitak inn pua-ah an i nek leh bangci ahi ding hiam?

records.english: The best solution is often the one that you can actually keep doing week after week.
records.zomi: Lampi hoih pen pen kal khat zawh kal khat na sep zom taktak thei pen ahi zel hi.

records.english: Experienced gardeners usually suggest trying the gentlest solution first before buying chemicals.
records.zomi: Siam huan kemte in chemical a lei ma-un lampi nem pen a masa-in sit dingin a gen zel uh hi.

records.english: Why don't we go next weekend instead?
records.zomi: Bang hangin tua sangin kal tawp hong tung ding-ah i pai kei ding hiam?

records.english: Why not try a cheaper brand?
records.zomi: Bang hangin man neem zaw brand khat na sit kei hiam?

records.english: What are our options if the wedding venue we wanted is already booked?
records.zomi: I deih mopawi bawlna mun a kiciamteh khin leh i teel theih bang a om hiam?

records.english: You could choose a weekday, look for a smaller venue nearby, or hold the meal in a garden with a hired tent.
records.zomi: Kal sung ni khat na teel thei a, a kiang-a mun neu zaw khat na zong thei a, ahih kei leh puan inn khat zuan-in huan sungah an ne na bawl thei hi.

records.english: Could we try a slower setting on the washing machine to stop the shirts creasing?
records.zomi: Puan sil khawl-ah a nawl zaw setting khat i sit leh shirt te a kiton nawn lo ding hiam?

records.english: Is there a quieter route for cycling to the park?
records.zomi: Pawngpi-ah siiksakol tawh pai nadingin lampi dai zaw khat a om hiam?

records.english: How can I stop the cat from scratching the new sofa?
records.zomi: Zawhngeu in sofa thak a kawi lo nadingin bangci ka bawl thei ding hiam?

records.english: Put a scratching post right next to it, and rub a little catnip on the post.
records.zomi: A kiang mahmah-ah kawina sing khat koih inla, tua sing tungah zawhngeu' deih catnip tawmno nul in.

records.english: Shall we cook the soup in the big pot?
records.zomi: An tui pen beel lian-ah i huan ding hiam?

records.english: When slugs ate every lettuce in my garden for the second summer running, I was ready to give up.
records.zomi: A kizom khal nihna in ka huan sung-a lettuce khempeuh lawnghawi te in a nek ciangin ka nusia dingin ka kiging khin hi.

records.english: An old man at the allotments suggested a ring of crushed eggshells around each plant and a few saucers of cheap beer.
records.zomi: Huan neute mun-a pasal upa khat in kung khatciat a kim-ah ak tui kawm kisuk-a kual khat leh beer man neem tawh kuang neu tawmvei koih dingin a gen hi.

records.english: I doubted it would work, but that year I picked my first full basket of lettuces.
records.zomi: A sem ding hiam cih ka lungmuang kei a, ahi zongin tua kum-in lettuce bawm dim masa pen ka la hi.

records.english: Why don't we share a taxi?
records.zomi: Bang hangin taxi khat i zang khawm kei ding hiam?

records.english: Shall I bring a torch?
records.zomi: Mei-ek-tha ka paipih ding hiam?

records.english: Shall we ask a friend to lend us a tent?
records.zomi: Lawm khat kiangah puan inn khat hong pua dingin i ngen ding hiam?

records.english: Planning a celebration on a budget encourages people to find creative solutions they might never have considered.
records.zomi: Sum tawm tawh poai khat ngimna bawl pen in mite in a ngaihsun ngei lo ding uh lampi thak te zong dingin a hanthawn hi.

records.english: How about asking the neighbours to join us in buying a lawnmower?
records.zomi: Lopa atna khawl khat lei khawm dingin inn kiangte i sam leh bangci ahi ding hiam?

records.english: Could we put the bed by the window?
records.zomi: Lupna pen tawlet kiangah i koih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Could we take the train instead?
records.zomi: Tua sangin meileng tawh i pai thei ding hiam?

records.english: What if we sold the old bikes and bought one good one to share?
records.zomi: Siiksakol lui te i zuak a, i zang khawm ding a hoih khat i lei leh bangci ahi ding hiam?

records.english: Online videos offer many clever solutions, but some of them work better on screen than in real life.
records.zomi: Online video te in lampi siam tampi a pia hi, ahi zongin a khenkhat in nuntakna taktak sangin screen tungah a sem hoih zaw hi.

records.english: How else could we get to the festival if the trains are cancelled?
records.zomi: Meileng te a kinusiat leh pawi-ah bangci dang-in i pai thei ding hiam?

records.english: Could you try a different shop?
records.zomi: Van zuakna inn dang khat na sit thei ding hiam?

records.english: Asking an expert for options, rather than a single answer, gives you more control over the decision.
records.zomi: Siam mi khat kiangah dawnna khat bek sangin teel theih te ngen pen in thukhensatna tungah thuneihna tam zaw hong pia hi.

records.english: Could you call the hotel again?
records.zomi: Zinbuuk na sam kik thei ding hiam?

records.english: What can I do if the airline has lost my suitcase?
records.zomi: Vanleng company in ka van ip a mansuah leh bang ka bawl thei ding hiam?

records.english: Report it at the baggage desk before you leave the airport, and keep every receipt for things you have to buy.
records.zomi: Vanlengtual na nusiat ma-in van ip ngah kikna dohkan-ah gen inla, na lei kul van te' man lai khempeuh kem in.

records.english: A solution that suits one family's home may not suit another's, so it helps to test ideas before committing.
records.zomi: Innkuan khat' inn adingin a kilawm lampi in innkuan dang adingin a kilawm lo thei a, tua ahih manin na khensat ma-in ngaihsutna te sit a huh huai hi.

records.english: Can we fix the chair with glue?
records.zomi: Tutphah pen glue tawh i bawlphat thei ding hiam?

records.english: What if we planted a hedge to stop the wind from flattening the flowers?
records.zomi: Huih in pak te a sukzawl lo nadingin kung-kalh khat i suan leh bangci ahi ding hiam?

records.english: Could we use the balcony to grow herbs instead of buying them?
records.zomi: Ankam lei sangin balcony tungah i suan thei ding hiam?

records.english: When travel plans go wrong, travellers who calmly consider their options usually recover faster.
records.zomi: Khualzin ngimna te a khial ciangin teel theih te a dai taka ngaihsun khualzinmite in manlang zaw-in a kipan kik zel uh hi.

records.english: How could we make our tiny flat feel less crowded?
records.zomi: I inn neu mahmah pen a kiping lua bangin a kizak nawn lo nadingin bangci i bawl thei ding hiam?

records.english: Get rid of anything you haven't used for a year, and choose furniture with storage underneath.
records.zomi: Kum khat sung na zat loh van khempeuh paikhia inla, a nuai-ah van koih theihna nei inn sung van te teel in.

records.english: How about learning the language with a free app before we travel?
records.zomi: I khualzin ma-in a man om lo app khat tawh pau i sin leh bangci ahi ding hiam?

records.english: Could we rent a car for the day instead of booking a tour?
records.zomi: Kualna khualzin ciamteh sangin ni khat sung adingin mawtaw khat i zuan thei ding hiam?

records.english: Shall we ask the waiter for a bigger table?
records.zomi: An ne inn nasempa kiangah dohkan lian zaw khat i ngen ding hiam?

records.english: Could we borrow a ladder?
records.zomi: Kahlei khat i pua thei ding hiam?

records.english: Would a second-hand camera be good enough for a beginner?
records.zomi: A kizang khinsa camera khat in a kipan thak mi adingin a kicing ding hiam?

records.english: What could we cook for twenty guests without spending too much?
records.zomi: Sum tampi zang lo-in mikhual sawmnih adingin bang i huan thei ding hiam?

records.english: Would it help to pack everything in small cubes so the suitcase closes?
records.zomi: Van ip a kikhak theih nadingin van khempeuh bawm neute sungah i koih leh a huh ding hiam?

records.english: Is there a cheap way to get fit without joining a gym?
records.zomi: Gym-ah kihel lo-in pumpi a hat nading lampi man neem khat a om hiam?

records.english: Walk fast for half an hour every day, and use the stairs instead of the lift.
records.zomi: Ni simin nai langkhat sung manlang takin pai in kal inla, lift sangin kahlei zang in.

records.english: Friends who share their solutions to everyday problems save each other a great deal of money.
records.zomi: Ni sim buaina te' lampi a kipia khawm lawmte in khat leh khat adingin sum tampi a kem sak uh hi.

records.english: Exploring several solutions to a household problem often reveals one that is cheaper and simpler than expected.
records.zomi: Inn sung buaina khat adingin lampi tuamtuam a kan ciangin a lamen sangin a man neem zaw leh a baih zaw lampi khat a kilang zel hi.

records.english: What if we paint the room white?
records.zomi: Inndan pen a kang-in i zum leh bangci ahi ding hiam?

records.english: Would a thicker curtain stop the morning light from waking the baby?
records.zomi: Tawlet puan a tau zaw khat in zingsang khuavak in nausen a khanglawh sak lo nadingin a kham ding hiam?

records.english: Why does the work system lock me out after only three wrong passwords?
records.zomi: Bang hangin nasep system in password khial thum bek khit ciangin hong kha khia hiam?

records.english: Removing access promptly when staff leave is one of the simplest ways to protect a company's data.
records.zomi: Nasemte a pai khiat ciangin a lut theihna manlang taka la kik pen company' data kem nading lampi baih pen khat ahi hi.

records.english: Can I share my login with the temporary worker until his account is ready?
records.zomi: A account a kiging mateng hun sawtlo nasempa tawh ka login ka zang khawm thei ding hiam?

records.english: No, because everything done under your name is recorded, so ask the helpdesk for a temporary account instead.
records.zomi: Thei kei hi, bang hang hiam cih leh na min tawh kisem na khempeuh a kiciamteh hi, tua ahih manin huhna mun kiangah hun sawtlo account khat ngen zaw in.

records.english: The system asks me to change my password every month.
records.zomi: System in kha simin ka password khek dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: A single login for many systems saves time but means that one stolen password can open many doors.
records.zomi: System tampi adingin login khat bek in hun a kem sak hi, ahi zongin password khat a kiguk leh kongkhak tampi a hong thei hi, cihna ahi hi.

records.english: The teacher showed the class how to set up two-step verification on their school accounts.
records.zomi: Saya in sangnaupangte a sang account uh tungah kalsuan nih tawh kiciamtehna bawl dan a lak hi.

records.english: Why do I need a separate account for the online exam system?
records.zomi: Bang hangin online kisinna system adingin account tuam khat ka kisam hiam?

records.english: The teacher created accounts for the whole class.
records.zomi: Saya in sangnaupangte khempeuh adingin account te a bawl hi.

records.english: Contractors and temporary workers need accounts that can be created quickly and closed just as fast.
