records.english: An appointment with a careers adviser can help a student turn vague ideas into a realistic plan.
records.zomi: Nasep lam thuhilhpa tawh kihona hun khat in sangnaupang khat a ngaihsutna kician lo te ngimna taktak khat-ah a khek nadingin a huh thei hi.

records.english: I need a letter from my employer for the appointment.
records.zomi: Kihona hun adingin ka nasep nei pan lai khat ka kisam hi.

records.english: My enrolment appointment is on Monday.
records.zomi: Ka min kigelhna kihona hun pen Pizing ni-in ahi hi.

records.english: My boss gave me time off for the appointment.
records.zomi: Ka heutu in kihona hun adingin tawlngak hun hong pia hi.

records.english: Is it possible to have the appointment in the evening, since I work until five?
records.zomi: Nai nga dong ka sep ahih manin nitak lam-in kihona hun ka nei thei ding hiam?

records.english: The careers adviser has appointments every afternoon for students who want help with job applications.
records.zomi: Nasep lam thuhilhpa in nasep ngetna-ah huhna deih sangnaupangte adingin sun nung lam simin kihona hun te a nei hi.

records.english: The university office was very busy today.
records.zomi: Tuni-in university office ah mi a tam mahmah hi.

records.english: Please bring your passport to the HR meeting.
records.zomi: Kong ngen hi, HR kikhopna-ah na passport paipih in.

records.english: Professional registration appointments protect the public by checking that workers are properly qualified.
records.zomi: Siamna min kigelhna kihona hun te in nasemte a kician taka siamna a nei uh hiam cih en-in mipite a kem hi.

records.english: Can I bring my parents to the school admissions meeting?
records.zomi: Sang luttheihna kikhopna-ah ka nu leh ka pa ka paipih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, and it's often helpful, since they'll need to sign some of the forms.
records.zomi: Thei hi, a huh huai zel hi, bang hang hiam cih leh form khenkhat ah amau in a min uh a gelh ding uh a kisam hi.

records.english: The professional body interviewed me before adding my name to its register of engineers.
records.zomi: Siamna pawl in engineer te' min lista-ah ka min a gelh ma-in hong dong hi.

records.english: Do I need an appointment at the student office?
records.zomi: Sangnaupang office-ah kihona hun khat ka kisam hiam?

records.english: The admissions officer called my name.
records.zomi: Sang luttheihna heutu in ka min a sam hi.

records.english: Two days before term started, I realised I had never booked my enrolment appointment at the university.
records.zomi: Sangkah hun a kipat ma ni nih-in university-ah ka min kigelhna kihona hun ka ciamteh ngei kei hi, cih ka theisiam hi.

records.english: Every slot was full, so I went to the office at eight o'clock and waited until a student failed to turn up.
records.zomi: Hun khempeuh a dim khin ahih manin nai giat-in office-ah ka pai a, sangnaupang khat a hong kei mateng ka ngak hi.

records.english: By lunchtime, I had my student card and a timetable, and I promised myself I would never leave it so late again.
records.zomi: Sun an hun-in ka sangnaupang card leh sinna hun lista ka nei khin a, tua bangin a nunung lua-in ka nusia kik ngei lo ding hi, ci-in kei le kei ka kiciam hi.

records.english: I missed my appointment at the college.
records.zomi: College-a ka kihona hun ka mansuah hi.

records.english: Please wait in the corridor until you are called.
records.zomi: Kong ngen hi, hong kisam mateng lampi kawm-ah ngak in.

records.english: New teachers have an appointment with the local authority to complete their background checks.
records.zomi: Saya thak te in a nungzui tangthu en nading te a zawh nadingin khuasung heutu te tawh kihona hun a nei uh hi.

records.english: Flexible appointment times show that public offices understand the pressures of work and study.
records.zomi: A kikhek thei kihona hun te in mipite' office te in nasep leh sinna' gimna a theisiam uh hi, cih a lak hi.

records.english: When administrative offices are understaffed, students and workers often face delays that affect their lives.
records.zomi: Vaihawmna office te-ah nasem a tawm ciangin sangnaupangte leh nasemte in a nuntakna uh a lawh nunung tawnna te a tawng zel uh hi.

records.english: How long does the appointment at the work permit office usually take?
records.zomi: Nasep phalna office-a kihona hun in a tam zaw-in bangzah sawt hiam?

records.english: Employers who allow time off for official appointments make life much easier for new workers.
records.zomi: Kihona hun tak te adingin tawlngak hun a pia nasep neite in nasem thak te' nuntakna a baih sak mahmah uh hi.

records.english: Schools that explain what to bring to admissions appointments reduce stress for families.
records.zomi: Sang luttheihna kihona hun-ah bang paipih ding hiam cih a gen sang te in innkuan te' lungkhamna a niam sak hi.

records.english: What should I do if my appointment at the tax office clashes with an important meeting at work?
records.zomi: Siah inn-a ka kihona hun leh nasepna-a kikhopna thupi khat a kituah leh bang ka bawl ding hiam?

records.english: Rebook it online as soon as you can, because the next free slots usually go within a day or two.
records.zomi: Na theih theih pah-in online-ah ciamteh kik in, bang hang hiam cih leh a zom hun lawng te ni khat ahih kei leh nih sungin a bei zel hi.

records.english: Do I need an appointment to enrol at the college?
records.zomi: College-ah min ka kigelh nadingin kihona hun khat ka kisam hiam?

records.english: Yes, book a slot online, and bring your certificates and proof of address.
records.zomi: Kisam hi, online-ah hun khat ciamteh inla, na certificate te leh na tenna mun tettehna paipih in.

records.english: Students who prepare their documents before an enrolment appointment usually finish in minutes rather than hours.
records.zomi: Min kigelhna kihona hun ma-in a laigelh uh a kiginsa sangnaupangte in nai tampi sangin minit tawmno sungin a zo zel uh hi.

records.english: The school office opens at eight.
records.zomi: Sang office pen nai giat-in a kihong hi.

records.english: The nurse phoned to ask how I was feeling.
records.zomi: Nurse in ka cidam hiam cih dong dingin phone tawh hong sam hi.

records.english: The pharmacist reviews my tablets three months after each change in my treatment.
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakpa in ka damsakna khekna khatciat khit kha thum ciangin ka damdawi te a en kik hi.

records.english: My eye check is at the library this month.
records.zomi: Hih kha-in ka mit enna pen laibu inn-ah ahi hi.

records.english: Follow-up visits in the community allow patients to recover at home while still receiving expert care.
records.zomi: Khuasung-a zom en kankanna te in damlote siam mite' kemna a ngah lai kawmin inn-ah a dam kik thei nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Do I need to book my next visit?
records.zomi: Ka hong pai kik ding hun ka ciamteh ding hiam?

records.english: The health visitor weighs the baby at home and answers the parents' questions.
records.zomi: Inn kankan cidamna nasem in inn-ah nausen a gik a teh a, nu leh pa' dotna te a dawng hi.

records.english: When follow-up care is easy to reach, patients are far more likely to complete their treatment.
records.zomi: Zom en kemna tun a baih ciangin damlote in a damsakna uh a zo thei zaw mahmah uh hi.

records.english: Will the district nurse come back to check my leg?
records.zomi: Khuasung nurse in ka khe en dingin a hong kik ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, she'll visit every Monday and Thursday until the wound has healed.
records.zomi: Hong kik ding hi, liamna a dam mateng Pizing ni leh Laizing ni simin a hong ding hi.

records.english: Coordinating follow-up visits between hospitals and community teams requires clear and timely communication.
records.zomi: Damlo inn te leh khuasung pawl te kikal-a zom en kankanna te kituak sak nadingin thu kician leh hun taka kizopna a kisam hi.

records.english: The asthma nurse at the school checks the children's inhalers every term.
records.zomi: Sang-a hu natna nurse in kum khen simin naupangte' hu dawnna van te a en hi.

records.english: Can I have my follow-up blood test at the pharmacy?
records.zomi: Ka zom en sisan sitna damdawi zuakna inn-ah ka nei thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, the pharmacy on the high street takes blood on Tuesday mornings.
records.zomi: Thei hi, khuapi lampi lian-a damdawi zuakna inn in Pithai ni zingsang-in sisan a la hi.

records.english: Is the interpreter booked for my next visit?
records.zomi: Ka hong pai kik ding hun adingin pau letmi a kiciamteh khin hiam?

records.english: The mental health team checks on patients by phone in the weeks after they leave hospital.
records.zomi: Lungsim cidamna pawl in damlote damlo inn a nusiat khit kal te sungin phone tawh a en uh hi.

records.english: The health visitor comes back next week.
records.zomi: Inn kankan cidamna nasem a zom kal-in a hong kik ding hi.

records.english: District nurses often notice problems at home that a hospital visit would never reveal.
records.zomi: Khuasung nurse te in damlo inn kankanna in a lak ngei lo ding inn sung buaina te a mu zel uh hi.

records.english: My check-up is by video this time.
records.zomi: Hih vei-in ka cidamna enna pen video tawh ahi hi.

records.english: Does the mobile clinic come back to our village for check-ups?
records.zomi: Vakvai damdawi inn neu in cidamna enna adingin i khua-ah a hong kik zel hiam?

records.english: It returns every six weeks, and the dates are posted outside the shop.
records.zomi: Kal guk simin a hong kik a, a ni te van zuakna inn pua-ah a kitang hi.

records.english: My follow-up is at the community clinic.
records.zomi: Ka zom en pen khuasung damdawi inn neu-ah ahi hi.

records.english: My physiotherapy follow-ups take place at the leisure centre, where I can use the pool afterwards.
records.zomi: Ka pumpi sawlna zom en te pen lungnopna inn-ah a kibawl a, tua mun-ah a khit ciangin tuipeekna mun ka zang thei hi.

records.english: My follow-up after the operation was moved to a clinic nearer my home.
records.zomi: Zatui khit-a ka zom en pen ka inn tawh a nai zaw damdawi inn neu khat-ah a kikhek hi.

records.english: Group follow-up sessions can give patients practical advice and the encouragement of others in the same situation.
records.zomi: Pawl tawh zom en hun te in damlote thuhilhna taktak leh a mun kibang-a om mi dangte' hanthawnna a pia thei hi.

records.english: Please write the next date on my card.
records.zomi: Kong ngen hi, ka card tungah a zom ni gelh in.

records.english: Why did the community nurse phone me a week after my visit to the clinic?
records.zomi: Bang hangin damdawi inn neu ka kan khit kal khat ciangin khuasung nurse in phone tawh hong sam hiam?

records.english: Because the clinic asks her to check that patients who live alone are coping with their new treatment.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh a kia-a om damlote in a damsakna thak uh a thuak zo uh hiam cih en dingin damdawi inn neu in amah a ngen hi.

records.english: The diabetes nurse runs a group follow-up session where patients share tips about diet.
records.zomi: Sisan sugar natna nurse in damlote an nek tawh kisai thuhilhna a kipiakna pawl tawh zom en hun khat a bawl hi.

records.english: After my grandfather's heart attack, a nurse from the community heart team came to see him every fortnight.
records.zomi: Ka pu' lungtang natna a piang khit ciangin khuasung lungtang pawl pan nurse khat in kal nih simin a hong en hi.

records.english: She checked his blood pressure, looked at his medicines and walked with him to the end of the street.
records.zomi: A sisan tawlna a teh a, a damdawi te a en a, lampi tawp dong amah tawh a pai khawm hi.

records.english: By the end of the summer, he was walking to the park on his own and telling everyone about his nurse.
records.zomi: Khal hun a bei ciangin amah kia-in pawngpi-ah a pai thei khin a, a nurse tawh kisai mi khempeuh kiangah a gen hi.

records.english: Community clinics in familiar places, such as libraries and church halls, make follow-up visits less stressful.
records.zomi: Laibu inn leh pawlpi inn lian bang a theih ngeisa mun te-a khuasung damdawi inn neu te in zom en kankanna te a lungkham huai zaw lo sak hi.

records.english: Volunteer drivers take patients without cars to their follow-up visits at the hospital.
records.zomi: Thalawp mawtaw mawngmite in mawtaw nei lo damlote damlo inn-a a zom en kankanna uh-ah a paipih uh hi.

records.english: My dressing is changed every two days.
records.zomi: Ni nih simin ka liamna tuamna a kikhek hi.

records.english: Interpreters at follow-up visits help patients explain how they really feel about their recovery.
records.zomi: Zom en kankanna-a pau letmite in damlote in a dam kikna uh tawh kisai a lungsim taktak a gen thei nadingin a huh uh hi.

records.english: The district nurses visit my grandmother so often that they know where she keeps the biscuits.
records.zomi: Khuasung nurse te in ka pi a kan zel mahmah uh ahih manin biscuit a koihna mun a thei uh hi.

records.english: Is the mobile van back on Friday?
records.zomi: Vakvai mawtaw Laithai ni-in a hong kik ding hiam?

records.english: Can the nurse visit in the afternoon?
records.zomi: Nurse in sun nung lam-in a hong kan thei ding hiam?

records.english: Could the follow-up appointment be at the health centre in town instead of the hospital?
records.zomi: Zom en kihona hun pen damlo inn sangin khuapi-a cidamna inn-ah a om thei ding hiam?

records.english: The midwife will visit the baby tomorrow.
records.zomi: Nau-suak huhnu in zingciang-in nausen a hong en ding hi.

records.english: The clinic sends a text before each visit.
records.zomi: Damdawi inn neu in kankanna khatciat ma-in phone thukhak khat a khak hi.

records.english: Phone follow-ups after a hospital stay help catch problems before patients need to be readmitted.
records.zomi: Damlo inn-a om khit ciangin phone tawh zom en te in damlote damlo inn-ah a lut kik kisam ma-in buaina te a mu thei hi.

records.english: The nurse visits my mother at home.
records.zomi: Nurse in ka nu inn-ah a kan hi.

records.english: Health visitors play an important role in checking that new babies and their parents are doing well.
records.zomi: Inn kankan cidamna nasemte in nausen thak te leh a nu leh pa te a hoih uh hiam cih enna-ah mun thupi a nei uh hi.

records.english: The care home arranges for the doctor's follow-up visits to happen on the same morning each week.
records.zomi: Upate kemna inn in siavuan' zom en kankanna te kal simin zingsang kibang-in a piang nadingin a bawl hi.

records.english: Pharmacists who review medicines after a change in treatment help prevent harmful side effects.
records.zomi: Damsakna khekna khit ciangin damdawi te a en kik damdawi zuakpate in damdawi' lawhna hoih lo te a kham nadingin a huh uh hi.

records.english: The community team checks my blood sugar.
records.zomi: Khuasung pawl in ka sisan sugar a teh hi.

records.english: Is the interpreter able to join the follow-up by phone, since she lives in another town?
records.zomi: Pau letmi pen khua dang-ah a om ahih manin zom en hun-ah phone tawh a kihel thei ding hiam?

records.english: The volunteer drives me to my check-ups.
records.zomi: Thalawp in ka cidamna enna-ah mawtaw tawh hong paipih hi.

records.english: The community nurse takes photos of the wound at each visit to see how it is healing.
records.zomi: Khuasung nurse in liamna a dam dan en nadingin kankanna khatciat-in a lim a la hi.

records.english: Can I have my check-up at the pharmacy?
records.zomi: Ka cidamna enna damdawi zuakna inn-ah ka nei thei ding hiam?

records.english: The diabetes clinic meets at the community centre.
records.zomi: Sisan sugar natna damdawi inn neu pen khuasung inn lian-ah a kikhop hi.

records.english: Who will check on the baby after we leave hospital?
records.zomi: Damlo inn i nusiat khit ciangin kua in nausen a hong en ding hiam?

records.english: The health visitor will come to your home within ten days, and again when the baby is six weeks old.
records.zomi: Inn kankan cidamna nasem in ni sawm sungin na inn-ah a hong ding a, nausen kal guk a pha ciangin a hong kik ding hi.

records.english: Regular home visits from nurses can allow older people to stay independent for much longer.
records.zomi: Nurse te' inn-ah kankanna ngeina te in upate sawt zaw mahmah amau kia-in a om thei nadingin a huh thei hi.

records.english: The physiotherapist sees me at the leisure centre.
records.zomi: Pumpi sawlna siampa in lungnopna inn-ah hong mu hi.

records.english: Transport schemes run by volunteers help patients without cars keep their follow-up appointments.
records.zomi: Thalawpte' mawtaw khualzinna nasep te in mawtaw nei lo damlote in a zom en kihona hun uh a mansuah lo nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Why does the community clinic need my hospital letter before my follow-up visit?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ka zom en kankanna ma-in khuasung damdawi inn neu in ka damlo inn lai a kisam hiam?

records.english: The heart failure team holds its check-ups in a church hall so that patients don't have to travel far.
records.zomi: Lungtang natna pawl in damlote gamla taka a pai loh nadingin pawlpi inn lian khat-ah cidamna enna te a bawl uh hi.

records.english: Which nurse is looking after your father now?
records.zomi: Tu-in na pa kua nurse in a kem hiam?

records.english: When my brother bought a cheap second-hand car without having it checked, he was delighted with the price.
records.zomi: Ka sanggampa in en ma-in a man neem a kizang khinsa mawtaw khat a lei ciangin a man tungah a lungdam mahmah hi.

records.english: Three weeks later, the gearbox failed on the motorway, and the repair cost more than the car itself.
records.zomi: Kal thum khit ciangin lampi lian tungah gear bawm a siat a, a bawlphat man in mawtaw man sangin a tam zaw hi.

records.english: Now he tells everyone to pay a mechanic to inspect a car before handing over any money.
records.zomi: Tu-in sum na piak ma-in mawtaw en dingin mawtaw bawlpa man pia in, ci-in mi khempeuh a gen hi.

records.english: What are the risks of booking a holiday without travel insurance?
records.zomi: Khualzinna khamna insurance om lo-in tawlngakna khualzin ciamteh in bang buaina a om thei hiam?

records.english: Asking someone who has made the same choice can reveal consequences that no advert will mention.
records.zomi: Teelna kibang a bawl khin mi khat dot in kuamah thupuak in a gen ngei lo ding a suak te a lak thei hi.

records.english: What would it mean for our weekends if we bought a boat?
records.zomi: Long khat i lei leh i kal tawp te adingin bang cihna a hi ding hiam?

records.english: What if I lose my phone abroad?
records.zomi: Gamdang-ah ka phone ka mansuah leh bangci ahi ding hiam?

records.english: Will a bright colour make the room look smaller?
records.zomi: Pianzia tang taktak khat in inndan a neu zaw bangin a kilang sak ding hiam?

records.english: Some consequences can be reversed easily, while others, like a tattoo, are much harder to undo.
records.zomi: A suak khenkhat baih takin a kikhek kik thei a, a dangte, tattoo bang, a kikhek kik ding a haksa zaw mahmah hi.

records.english: What if the shoes don't fit?
records.zomi: Khedap te a kilawm kei leh bangci ahi ding hiam?

records.english: If we let the children choose the holiday, will they argue the whole time?
records.zomi: Naupangte tawlngakna khualzin a teel dingin i phal leh hun bup a kinial ding uh hiam?

records.english: What if it snows on our holiday?
records.zomi: I tawlngakna khualzin laitakin vuk a kia leh bangci ahi ding hiam?

records.english: If I cancel my gym membership, will I really keep exercising at home?
records.zomi: Ka gym member hihna ka nusiat leh inn-ah pumpi sawlna ka sem zom taktak ding hiam?

records.english: What happens if I don't charge the car tonight?
records.zomi: Tu zan mawtaw ka charge kei leh bang a piang ding hiam?

records.english: Would getting a tattoo on my hand affect my chances at a job interview?
records.zomi: Ka khut tungah tattoo khat ka bawl leh nasep kihona-a dotna-ah ka theihna tungah a lawh ding hiam?

records.english: What happens if I water the cactus every day?
records.zomi: Ni simin cactus tui ka buak leh bang a piang ding hiam?

records.english: Will cutting my hair very short make me regret it?
records.zomi: Ka sam tom mahmah-in ka at leh ka kisik ding hiam?

records.english: Maybe for a week, but it will grow back, and you might love how easy it is.
records.zomi: Kal khat sung ahi thei hi, ahi zongin a khang kik ding a, a kem a baih dan na deih mahmah thei hi.

records.english: Will the glue hold if we use the shelf tonight?
records.zomi: Tu zan van koihna i zat leh glue in a len zo ding hiam?

records.english: What would happen if I rented out our spare room to a student?
records.zomi: I inndan lawng sangnaupang khat kiangah ka zuan sak leh bang a piang ding hiam?

records.english: You'd have extra money each month, but you'd also have less privacy at home.
records.zomi: Kha simin sum behlap na ngah ding a, ahi zongin inn-ah na mimal hun tawm zaw na nei ding hi.

records.english: What would happen if we dug a pond where the children play?
records.zomi: Naupangte' lawhna mun-ah tuikhuk khat i tou leh bang a piang ding hiam?

records.english: What if nobody comes to my party?
records.zomi: Ka poai-ah kuamah a hong kei leh bangci ahi ding hiam?

records.english: Writing down the likely results of a choice can make a confusing decision much clearer.
records.zomi: Teelna khat' a suak ding te gelh pen in lungbuai huai thukhensatna khat a kician zaw mahmah sak thei hi.

records.english: Will my old laptop run the new game?
records.zomi: Ka laptop lui in game thak a zang thei ding hiam?

records.english: If I take a gap year before university, could it harm my chances later?
records.zomi: University ka kah ma-in kum khat tawlngak leng a nung-ah ka theihna te a susia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Not usually, as long as you use the year well and can explain what you learned from it.
records.zomi: A tam zaw in susia kei hi, tua kum hoih takin na zat a, tua pan bang na sin hiam cih na gen thei teng.

records.english: Will we save money if we cook at home?
records.zomi: Inn-ah i huan leh sum i kem ding hiam?

records.english: Pet owners who consider how a new animal will affect existing pets avoid much stress at home.
records.zomi: Ganhing thak khat in a om khinsa ganhing te tungah bangci a lawh ding hiam cih a ngaihsun ganhing vulmite in inn-ah lungkhamna tampi a pelh uh hi.

records.english: Travel decisions made only on price can lead to tiring journeys and unexpected extra costs.
records.zomi: A man bek en-a khualzinna khensatna te in khualzinna gim huai leh lamen loh man behlap te a piangsak thei hi.

records.english: People often overestimate how much a new possession will change their happiness.
records.zomi: Mite in van thak khat in a lungdamna uh bangzah a khek ding hiam cih a sang lua-in a ngaihsun zel uh hi.

records.english: What happens if I miss the last bus?
records.zomi: Bus nunung pen ka mansuah leh bang a piang ding hiam?

records.english: What would happen to the garden if we replaced the lawn with stones?
records.zomi: Lopa mun suang tawh i laih leh huan bangci a suak ding hiam?

records.english: A decision that seems exciting today may feel very different after a few months of daily reality.
records.zomi: Tuni-in lungdam huai bang a kilang thukhensatna khat ni sim nuntakna taktak kha tawmno khit ciangin a kibang lo mahmah-in a kizak thei hi.

records.english: Will a puppy wake us up at night?
records.zomi: Ui neu in zan-in hong khanglawh sak ding hiam?

records.english: Will a bigger garden mean more work?
records.zomi: Huan lian zaw in nasep tam zaw a cihna hiam?

records.english: Would moving the piano upstairs damage the floor?
records.zomi: Piano inn tung lam-ah i paipih leh inn sung leitang a susia ding hiam?

records.english: Small changes to a garden or home can have effects that last for years, so they deserve careful thought.
records.zomi: Huan ahih kei leh inn-a kikhekna neute in kum tampi a om lawhna te a nei thei a, tua ahih manin ngaihsutna cian a kilawm uh hi.

records.english: If we switch to a cheaper phone plan, will the signal be worse in the village?
records.zomi: Phone ngimna man neem zaw khat-ah i khek leh khua neu-ah signal a hoih zaw lo ding hiam?

records.english: Will the fish be all right in a smaller tank?

records.zomi: Pau letmite leh kilet lai neu te in damlo khempeuh in thupiak te bit takin a zui thei nadingin a huh hi.

records.zomi: Kal khat sung damdawi kituam te in a diakin upate adingin damdawi nek mansuah ahih kei leh nihvei nek buaina a niam sak hi.

records.english: A short conversation with a pharmacist can answer questions that patients feel too embarrassed to ask a doctor.

records.zomi: Gen ding hi, Pizing ni-in a hong ding a, nangmah mahmah in na bawl zo dingin na kihuai mateng a om ding hi.

records.english: Take-back schemes keep unwanted medicines out of homes, rubbish bins and rivers.

records.zomi: Damdawi zuakna inn in ka nu a damdawi tui adingin a kician tehna nei haai neu khat a pia hi.

records.english: The pharmacy's delivery driver always reminds my grandfather to take his evening tablets with food.

records.zomi: Damdawi zuakpa in inndan tuam khat sungah dotna te a dawng hi.

records.english: Community pharmacists play a vital role in helping patients understand complex medicine instructions.
records.zomi: Khuasung damdawi zuakpate in damlote in damdawi thupiak haksa te a theisiam nadingin a huh-na-ah mun thupi mahmah a nei uh hi.

records.english: Pharmacists who ask about herbal remedies can prevent dangerous interactions with prescribed medicines.

records.english: The leaflet comes in my language.

records.english: Outreach teams that help people without homes manage their medicines often prevent emergency hospital visits.
records.zomi: Inn om lo mite a damdawi uh a kem nadingin a huh pawl te in damlo inn-ah lauhuai taka pai kisam te a kham zel uh hi.

records.english: When my neighbour came home from hospital with a bag full of new tablets, she was too confused to start taking them.

records.english: A pharmacist from the local chemist came to her flat, sorted the tablets into a weekly pack and wrote a simple chart.
records.zomi: Khuasung damdawi zuakna inn pan damdawi zuakpa khat a inn-ah a hong a, damdawi te kal khat sung bawm-ah a khen a, lai baih khat a gelh hi.

records.english: A month later, my neighbour said it was the first time in years that she felt in control of her own medicines.
records.zomi: Kha khat khit ciangin ka inn kiang mi in kum tampi sung-ah amah damdawi a uk thei bangin a kizak masa pen ahi hi, a ci hi.

records.english: My medicine comes in a weekly pack.
records.zomi: Ka damdawi pen kal khat sung bawm-ah a om hi.

records.english: Can I get my medicine instructions in Arabic?

records.english: Yes, we can print the label in several languages, and we can call an interpreter if you have questions.
records.zomi: Thei hi, lai neu pen pau tuamtuam tawh i print thei a, dotna na neih leh pau letmi khat i sam thei hi.

records.english: Can the pharmacy put all my tablets in a weekly pack?
records.zomi: Damdawi zuakna inn in ka damdawi khempeuh kal khat sung bawm-ah a koih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, we can sort them into a blister pack with a separate box for each time of day.

records.english: Could the community nurse explain the new medicine to my daughter as well, since she looks after me?

records.english: The library hosts a monthly session where pharmacists answer questions about medicines.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in kha simin damdawi zuakpate in damdawi tawh kisai dotna te a dawnna hun khat a bawl hi.

records.english: My father's medicine pack is delivered every Friday, with the old one collected at the same time.

records.english: The homeless outreach team helps people keep their medicines safe and take them on time.
records.zomi: Inn om lo mite a huh pawl in mite a damdawi uh bit taka a kem a, hun taka a nek nadingin a huh uh hi.

records.english: When community services work together, patients are far more likely to take their medicines correctly.
records.zomi: Khuasung nasep te a kikhawm-in a sep uh ciangin damlote in a damdawi uh a dik taka a nek thei zaw mahmah uh hi.

records.english: The label is in large print now.

records.english: Volunteers at the community centre help older residents order their repeat prescriptions online.

records.english: What is a visa sponsor at work?

records.english: Clear explanations of words like sponsor, dependant and conditions can reduce a great deal of anxiety for newcomers.
records.zomi: Sponsor, dependant leh conditions bang kammal te' genna kician te in mi thak te' lungkhamna tampi a niam sak thei hi.

records.english: The university checked my visa.

records.english: Can my husband come with me on my student visa?

records.english: In some countries he can apply as your dependant, but the rules depend on your course and its length.

records.english: The college reports if students stop attending.
records.zomi: Sangnaupangte a pai nawn kei leh college in a gen hi.

records.english: My employer is my visa sponsor.

records.english: A working holiday visa let my cousin travel and work in cafés for a year after university.

records.english: Employers who sponsor visas take on legal responsibilities, such as checking that workers follow their conditions.

records.english: My student visa ends in July.

records.english: Breaking a condition on a visa, even unknowingly, can have serious consequences for future applications.
records.zomi: Visa' thukham khat a theih lo-in a palsat zongin ngetna hong tung ding te tungah buaina lian a piangsak thei hi.

records.english: Who is my sponsor on this form?
records.zomi: Hih form tungah kua in ka sponsor ahi hiam?

records.english: What does dependant mean on a visa?

records.english: During my first term abroad, I was offered extra shifts at the café where I worked.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a ka sangkah hun masa pen sungin ka nasepna cafe-ah nasep hun behlap hong kipia hi.

records.english: Before saying yes, I checked my visa conditions and realised the extra hours would take me over my weekly limit.
records.zomi: Ka sang ma-in ka visa thukham te ka en a, nai behlap te in ka kal khat sung ciang a khen ding hi, cih ka theisiam hi.

records.english: I explained this to my manager, who thanked me for being honest and found someone else to cover the shifts.

records.english: My visa expires after my exams.
records.zomi: Ka visa ka kisinna khit ciangin a bei ding hi.

records.english: What does it mean when my student visa says work is restricted?

records.english: It means you can only work a limited number of hours a week during term, so check the exact limit on your visa.

records.english: Workers whose visas are tied to one employer may feel unable to complain about poor conditions.

records.english: My internship needs a special visa.

records.english: Visa rules for students and workers vary greatly between countries, so official guidance should always be checked.

records.english: Changes to visa rules can affect whole industries that depend on workers from other countries.

records.english: Universities often employ advisers whose main task is to explain visa terms to students in plain language.

records.english: What does a post-study work visa allow me to do?

records.english: In countries that offer one, it usually lets graduates stay and work for a set period after their course ends.

records.english: My visa conditions say that I can't be self-employed, so I had to turn down a freelance offer.

records.english: Seasonal workers on the farm have visas that allow them to work only during the harvest months.

records.english: Is a working holiday visa for young people?

records.english: Can I change courses on my student visa?

records.english: A job offer can depend entirely on whether the employer is able to sponsor a visa.

records.english: Why does my student visa end several months after my course finishes?

records.english: The careers office explained the difference between a visa and the permission to work stamped inside it.

records.english: Because your permission to work depends on that company's sponsorship, so changing jobs may mean applying for a new visa.

records.english: The term right to work means proving that you are legally allowed to take a job in the country.

records.english: My visa says I must study full-time.
records.zomi: Ka visa in hun bup ka sin ding hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Visa schemes for graduates aim to keep skilled young people in the country after their studies.

records.english: A disappointing result is still useful if it shows you what to change next time.

records.english: My grandmother remembers carrying water up the hill to her family's house every morning.
records.zomi: Zingsang simin a innkuan uh inn-ah mual tungah tui a pua tou zel hi, ci-in ka pi in a phawk hi.

records.english: My great-uncle stayed behind in the old village when the rest of the family moved away.
records.zomi: Innkuan a dangte a pem uh ciangin ka pu' sanggampa khua lui-ah a om hi.

records.english: Grandma misses the river near her old home.
records.zomi: Pi in a inn lui kiang-a gun a ngaih hi.

records.english: According to Grandma, the houses in the old village were so close that you could hear your neighbours' conversations at night.
records.zomi: Pi' genna bangin khua lui-a inn te a kinai mahmah ahih manin zan-in inn kiang mite' kikupna na za thei hi.

records.english: My father says that every family in the old village helped when a new house was built.
records.zomi: Inn thak khat a kilam ciangin khua lui-a innkuan khempeuh in a huh uh hi, ci-in ka pa in a gen hi.

records.english: Did Grandma's house have a grass roof?
records.zomi: Pi' inn in lopa inntung a nei hiam?

records.english: My brother and I helped Grandpa clear the weeds from the old family graves last spring.
records.zomi: Spring bei-in ka sanggampa leh kei in innkuan han lui te-a lopa hoih lo te Pu tawh i khawl hi.

records.english: Visiting the place where my grandparents grew up helped me understand why they value the land so much.
records.zomi: Ka pu leh ka pi te' a khanna mun kan in bang hangin lei a manpha sa mahmah uh hiam cih ka theisiam nadingin hong huh hi.

records.english: Why does Grandma still call the old village home after sixty years away?
records.zomi: Bang hangin kum sawmguk sung a pai khit hangin Pi in khua lui pen a inn a ci lai hiam?

records.english: Because her parents and grandparents are buried there, and she says her memories of childhood all belong to that place.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh a nu leh pa te leh a pu leh pi te tua mun-ah a kivui uh a, a naupan lai phawkna khempeuh tua mun-ah a om hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Who should decide how the club spends the money it raised?
records.zomi: Pawl in a kaikhawm sum bangci a zat ding hiam cih kua in khensat ding hiam?

records.english: All the members should vote, so that nobody feels the decision was made behind their backs.
records.zomi: Member khempeuh in vote ding uh a, tua hi leh kuamah in a nung lam-ah thukhensatna kibawl hi, ci-in a ngaihsun lo ding uh hi.

records.english: Who has a ladder we can borrow?
records.zomi: Kua in i pua thei ding kahlei a nei hiam?

records.english: Who has a jump lead for the car?
records.zomi: Kua in mawtaw adingin battery khau a nei hiam?

records.english: Who is the right person to contact about mould in a rented flat?
records.zomi: Zuan inn-a mu tawh kisai kua kiangah ka gen ding hiam?

records.english: Who can mend a puncture on a child's bike?
records.zomi: Kua in naupang siiksakol' a kua khuang a bawlphat thei hiam?

records.english: Who can watch the stall while I fetch more change?
records.zomi: Sum neu behlap ka la laitakin kua in van zuakna dohkan a kem thei ding hiam?

records.english: Who knows how to restart the router?
records.zomi: Kua in router khawl a kipan kik sak dan a thei hiam?

records.english: Who knows how to unblock a sink?
records.zomi: Kua in tuilai kua a kitang a hon dan a thei hiam?

records.english: Who's going to tell the neighbours about the noise?
records.zomi: Kua in inn kiang mite kiangah ging tawh kisai a gen ding hiam?

records.english: When nobody knows who should act, problems in shared buildings can drag on for months.
records.zomi: Kua in a sem ding hiam cih kuamah in a theih kei ciangin a kizang khawm inn te sung-a buaina te kha tampi sung a om thei hi.

records.english: Who can help me carry the broken fridge downstairs?
records.zomi: Kua in siat dahkhawl inn nuai lam-ah ka pua nadingin hong huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Deciding who pays for a repair can be harder than deciding how to do it.
records.zomi: Bawlphatna man kua in pia ding hiam cih khensat pen bangci bawl ding hiam cih khensat sangin a haksa zaw thei hi.

records.english: Who should I ask about the parcel left out in the rain?
records.zomi: Vuah sungah kinusia van ip tawh kisai kua ka dong ding hiam?

records.english: Who should pay for the broken window if nobody saw what happened?
records.zomi: Bang a piang hiam cih kuamah in a muh kei leh tawlet kitam man kua in a pia ding hiam?

records.english: In many families, the person who solves practical problems is not the one who is asked first.
records.zomi: Innkuan tampi sungah na taktak buaina a phel mi pen a masa-in a kidot mi hi lo hi.

records.english: A list of neighbours and their skills makes it much easier to know who to ask for help.
records.zomi: Inn kiang mite leh a siamna uh lista khat in huhna adingin kua dong ding hiam cih theih a baih zaw mahmah sak hi.

records.english: Who decided that the bins should be collected so early, and can we ask them to change it?
records.zomi: Kua in nin bawm te zingsang ma mahmah-in kila ding hi, ci-in a khensat a, a khek dingin i ngen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Disputes between landlords and contractors often leave tenants unsure who will solve their problem.
records.zomi: Inn neite leh nasep lami te kikal-a kinialna te in inn zuanmite in kua in a buaina uh a phel ding hiam cih a thei kician lo sak zel hi.

records.english: Who will tell the coach that the pitch is flooded?
records.zomi: Kua in lawhna mual a tui lian hi, ci-in sinsakpa kiangah a gen ding hiam?

records.english: Who could check whether this electrical socket is safe before we use it?
records.zomi: I zat ma-in hih meivak tha kua a bit hiam cih kua in a en thei ding hiam?

records.english: Who knows a good electrician in town?
records.zomi: Kua in khuapi sung-a meivak tha siam hoih khat a thei hiam?

records.english: Who should apologise first when two friends have both said hurtful things?
records.zomi: Lawm nih in a nih tuak in lungsim na kammal a gen uh ciangin kua in maisak a ngen masa ding hiam?

records.english: Who will feed the hens while we're away?
records.zomi: I pai laitakin kua in ak te an a pia ding hiam?

records.english: Who can fix the leak under our kitchen sink this weekend?
records.zomi: Hih kal tawp-in kua in i an huan tuilai nuai-a tui suakna a bawlphat thei ding hiam?

records.english: My cousin is a plumber, and he could come round on Saturday morning.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam pen tuikhuang bawlpa ahi a, Kiginni zingsang-in a hong thei hi.

records.english: Who can drive Grandma to the clinic on Friday?
records.zomi: Laithai ni-in kua in Pi damdawi inn neu-ah mawtaw tawh a paipih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Who would be willing to help translate the leaflet for new families?
records.zomi: Innkuan thak te adingin laipek let dingin kua in huh nuam ding hiam?

records.english: Who could help us organise the volunteers more fairly?
records.zomi: Thalawpte dik zaw-in i koih khawm nadingin kua in hong huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Who could teach my dad to use his new phone?
records.zomi: Kua in ka pa a phone thak zat dan a hilh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Who could help my son with his maths before the exam?
records.zomi: Kisinna ma-in kua in ka tapa a maths-ah a huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: The retired teacher on the corner tutors pupils for free on Tuesday evenings.
records.zomi: Lampi kiim-a nasep tawpsa saya in Pithai ni nitak simin sangnaupangte man om lo-in a hilh hi.

records.english: Who took the last bag of salt for the icy path?
records.zomi: Tuikhal lampi adingin cii ip nunung pen kua in a la hiam?

records.english: Sometimes the most useful question is not who caused the problem but who can help solve it.
records.zomi: Pawlkhat vei-in dotna huh huai pen kua in buaina a piangsak hiam cih hi lo-in kua in a phel nadingin a huh thei hiam cih ahi hi.

records.english: When a problem involves several organisations, asking who will take the lead avoids confusion.
records.zomi: Buaina khat in pawl tampi a kihel ciangin kua in a makai ding hiam cih dot in lungbuaina a kham hi.

records.english: Asking who will be affected by a solution helps prevent new problems from appearing later.
records.zomi: Phelna khat in kua tungah a lawh ding hiam cih dot in a nung-ah buaina thak a piang lo nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Who has the number for the locksmith?
records.zomi: Kua in tawh siampa' nambat a nei hiam?

records.english: Who's responsible for clearing the blocked drain behind the flats?
records.zomi: Inn te nung lam-a tuilam kitang khawl ding kua in mawhpuakna a nei hiam?

records.english: The housing association, so report it to their repairs line and ask for a reference number.
records.zomi: Inn kemna pawl in, tua ahih manin a bawlphatna phone-ah gen inla, ciamtehna nambat khat ngen in.

records.english: Who on our street has experience with insurance claims after a break-in?
records.zomi: I lampi-ah kua in guk lutna khit ciangin insurance ngetna tawh kisai theihna a nei hiam?

records.english: Who could take over the youth club if the leader moves away next year?
records.zomi: A makaipa kum hong tung ding-in a pem leh kua in khangno pawl a la thei ding hiam?

records.english: Who can stay late to lock the hall?
records.zomi: Inn lian khak dingin kua in a nunung-in a om thei ding hiam?

records.english: Who should take charge of the first-aid box on the school trip?
records.zomi: Sang khualzinna-ah kua in damdawi bawm a kem ding hiam?

records.english: Who can lend us a tent for the camping trip?
records.zomi: Puan inn sung-a lupna khualzinna adingin kua in puan inn khat hong pua thei ding hiam?

records.english: Solving a shared problem often starts with finding out who is actually responsible for it.
records.zomi: Kikhawm buaina khat phelna pen kua in a mawhpuakna taktak a nei hiam cih zong-in a kipan zel hi.

records.english: Who can we ask to cover Maria's shift if her baby is still ill tomorrow?
records.zomi: Maria' nausen zingciang-in a cina lai leh a nasep hun sem dingin kua i ngen thei ding hiam?

records.english: When the heating in our block failed in the middle of winter, nobody knew who was supposed to fix it.
records.zomi: Khuaphal laitak-in i inn bawm sung-a lumsakna khawl a siat ciangin kua in a bawlphat ding hiam cih kuamah in a thei kei uh hi.

records.english: The landlord blamed the boiler company, and the boiler company said it was the landlord's job.
records.zomi: Inn neipa in tuilum khawl company a mawhsak a, tuilum khawl company in inn neipa' nasep ahi hi, a ci hi.

records.english: In the end, an advice worker found the contract, showed us who was responsible, and the heating was repaired within two days.
records.zomi: A tawp-ah thuhilhna nasem khat in kiciamna lai a mu a, kua in mawhpuakna a nei hiam cih hong lak a, ni nih sungin lumsakna khawl a kibawlphat hi.

records.english: Who should we call about the dead tree leaning over the road?
records.zomi: Lampi tunga a kun sing si khat tawh kisai kua i sam ding hiam?

records.english: The council's tree team, because the road belongs to them.
records.zomi: Council' sing pawl, bang hang hiam cih leh lampi pen amau' ahi hi.

records.english: Who left the freezer door open?
records.zomi: Kua in tuikhal khawl kongkhak a hon nusia hiam?

records.english: Good teams agree from the start who will handle each kind of problem.
records.zomi: Pawl hoih te in a kipat pan kua in buaina chi khatciat a sem ding hiam cih a lungkim uh hi.

records.english: Who's the best person to speak to if the landlord won't return my deposit?
records.zomi: Inn neipa in ka sum kikoih a pia kik nuam kei leh kua tawh ka kiho pen hoih ding hiam?

records.english: Who would know whether we need permission to cut down the hedge?
records.zomi: Kung-kalh i at nadingin phalna i kisam hiam cih kua in a thei ding hiam?

records.english: Who should we tell first if the old man next door doesn't open his curtains tomorrow?
records.zomi: Inn kiang-a pasal upa in zingciang-in a tawlet puan a hon kei leh kua kiangah i gen masa ding hiam?

records.english: Asking who has the right skills can turn a stressful problem into a quick fix.
records.zomi: Kua in siamna kilawm a nei hiam cih dot in lungkham huai buaina khat manlang taka phelna khat-ah a khek thei hi.

records.english: Who has spare chairs for the party?
records.zomi: Poai adingin kua in tutphah behlap a nei hiam?

records.english: Communities that know who to call in an emergency respond faster and more calmly.
records.zomi: Lauhuai hun-in kua sam ding hiam cih a thei khuasung te in manlang zaw leh dai zaw-in a dawng uh hi.

records.english: Who could we ask to repair the fence before the dog escapes again?
records.zomi: Ui in a taimang kik ma-in huang bawlphat dingin kua i ngen thei ding hiam?

records.english: My aunt says that knowing God sees everything helps her be honest even when nobody else is watching.
records.zomi: Pasian in na khempeuh a mu hi, cih theih in kuamah in a en kei hangin thuman dingin hong huh hi, ci-in ka ni in a gen hi.

records.english: We thank God for our food.
records.zomi: I an adingin Pasian tungah lungdam i ci hi.

records.english: Dad reads the Psalms to us at night.
records.zomi: Pa in zan-in Late laibu kote adingin a sim hi.

records.english: Why does our pastor say that God is both just and merciful?
records.zomi: Bang hangin i pastor in Pasian pen dik a, hehpihna nei ahi hi, a ci hiam?

records.english: Does Grandma trust God completely?
records.zomi: Pi in Pasian a muang bup hiam?

records.english: When my parents argue, my mother reminds us that God's love is steadier than human feelings.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa a kinial uh ciangin ka nu in Pasian' itna pen mihing' lungsim sangin a kip zaw hi, ci-in hong phawk sak hi.

records.english: My father says God is patient with us.
records.zomi: Pasian in eite hong thuak hi, ci-in ka pa in a gen hi.

records.english: What does eternal mean, Mum?
records.zomi: Nu aw, tawntung cih in bang a cihna hiam?

records.english: Mum, does God ever get tired?
records.zomi: Nu aw, Pasian a gim ngei hiam?

records.english: Christians believe God never gets tired or sleeps, so he can always listen to us.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Pasian a gim ngei lo a, a ihmu ngei lo hi, tua ahih manin eite hong ngai thei den hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Our family prays together on Sundays.
records.zomi: I innkuan in Nipini-in thu i ngen khawm hi.

records.english: Many Christians admit that God is beyond full human understanding, yet they trust what he has revealed.
records.zomi: Khazih mite tampi in Pasian pen mihing' theisiam kimna sangin a sang zaw hi, cih a san uh a, ahi zongin a hong lak thu te a muang uh hi.

records.english: How can God know what everyone is thinking?
records.zomi: Pasian in mi khempeuh' ngaihsutna bangci a thei thei hiam?

records.english: Christians believe God knows everything, including our thoughts, and loves us all the same.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Pasian in i ngaihsutna zong kihel-in na khempeuh a thei a, kibang takin eite khempeuh hong it hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Christians believe God is Father, Son and Holy Spirit, one God in three persons.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Pasian pen Pa, Tapa leh Kha Siangtho, mi thum-a Pasian khat ahi hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Christians believe that God reveals his character most clearly in the life of Jesus.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Pasian in a omzia Jesu' nuntakna-ah kician pen-in a lak hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: My little brother asked where God lives.
records.zomi: Ka naupang sanggampa in Pasian koi-ah a teng hiam, ci-in a dong hi.

records.english: Is God really all-powerful, Dad?
records.zomi: Pa aw, Pasian in thuneihna khempeuh a nei taktak hiam?

records.english: My sister drew a picture of God's creation.
records.zomi: Ka sanggamnu in Pasian' piansak na te' lim khat a gelh hi.

records.english: If God is holy, how can ordinary people like us come close to him?
records.zomi: Pasian a siangtho leh ei bang mi ngeina te amah kiangah bangci i nai thei ding hiam?

records.english: Christians believe that God's love and forgiveness, shown in Jesus, make it possible for anyone to come near.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Jesu-ah kilak Pasian' itna leh maisakna in kua peuh a nai thei dingin a bawl hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: My father explains God's holiness by saying that God is completely good and without any evil.
records.zomi: Ka pa in Pasian pen a hoih bup a, a hoih lo bangmah a nei kei hi, ci-in Pasian' siangthona a gen hi.

records.english: Our Sunday school taught that God is spirit and cannot be seen with our eyes.
records.zomi: I Nipini sang in Pasian pen Kha ahi a, i mit tawh kimu thei lo hi, ci-in a hilh hi.

records.english: My cousin asked if God has a body.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in Pasian in pumpi a nei hiam, ci-in a dong hi.

records.english: My parents named my brother after a Bible verse about God's faithfulness.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in Pasian' muanhuaina tawh kisai Laisiangtho kammal tang khat panin ka sanggampa min a phuak uh hi.

records.english: My grandmother says that God's patience with her has taught her to be patient with her grandchildren.
records.zomi: Pasian in amah hong thuak dan in a tu te tungah thuakzawhna nei dingin a hilh hi, ci-in ka pi in a gen hi.

records.english: Grandma, why do you say God is always with us?
records.zomi: Pi aw, bang hangin Pasian in eite tawh a om den hi, na ci hiam?

records.english: Because the Bible teaches that God is present everywhere, even when we feel alone.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh Laisiangtho in Pasian pen mun khempeuh-ah a om hi, a kia-a i kizak ciangin zong, ci-in a hilh hi.

records.english: In our family, prayers often begin by praising one of God's qualities, such as his kindness or his power.
records.zomi: I innkuan sungah thungetna te Pasian' a omzia khat, a hehpihna ahih kei leh a thuneihna bang, phat-in a kipan zel hi.

records.english: My mother believes that God's justice and mercy meet most clearly at the cross.
records.zomi: Pasian' dikna leh hehpihna singlamteh-ah kician pen-in a kituak hi, ci-in ka nu in a um hi.

records.english: Our family sings about God's goodness at dinner.
records.zomi: I innkuan in nitak an ne ciangin Pasian' hoihna tawh kisai la i sa hi.

records.english: My grandmother describes God's greatness and his closeness, held together, as a mystery of love.
records.zomi: Ka pi in Pasian' thupina leh a kinaina, a kikhawm-in, itna' thuthuk khat ahi hi, ci-in a gen hi.

records.english: Is God bigger than the whole world?
records.zomi: Pasian pen leitung bup sangin a lian zaw hiam?

records.english: For my family, believing that God is unchanging gives a sense of stability when everything else is uncertain.
records.zomi: Ka innkuan adingin Pasian a kikhel ngei lo hi, cih upna in na dang khempeuh a kician lo ciangin kipna a pia hi.

records.english: My grandmother teaches the children that God's wisdom is greater than any human plan.
records.zomi: Ka pi in naupangte Pasian' pilna mihing' ngimna khempeuh sangin a lian zaw hi, ci-in a hilh hi.

records.english: My mother prays to God every morning.
records.zomi: Ka nu in zingsang simin Pasian kiangah thu a ngen hi.

records.english: Can God be everywhere at once?
records.zomi: Pasian pen khat vei-in mun khempeuh-ah a om thei hiam?

records.english: Christians believe God is three in one.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Pasian pen thum-a khat ahi hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Is God always fair?
records.zomi: Pasian a dik den hiam?

records.english: Grandma says God is merciful to people who say sorry.
records.zomi: Pasian in maisak a ngen mite tungah hehpihna a nei hi, ci-in Pi in a gen hi.

records.english: My son asked at bedtime how God could have no beginning.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in a ihmut ma-in Pasian in bangci kipatna nei lo-in a om thei hiam, ci-in a dong hi.

records.english: Does God hear children's prayers?
records.zomi: Pasian in naupangte' thungetna a za hiam?

records.english: My little sister wanted to know whether God ever laughs, and my mother thought it was a lovely question.
records.zomi: Ka sanggamnu neu in Pasian a nuih ngei hiam cih a thei nuam a, ka nu in dotna hoih mahmah ahi hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Our family's favourite psalm describes God as a refuge and a strength in times of trouble.
records.zomi: I innkuan' deih pen Late in Pasian pen buaina hun-a bitna mun leh hatna ahi hi, ci-in a gen hi.

records.english: God knows every person by name, my aunt says.
records.zomi: Pasian in mi khatciat a min tawh a thei hi, ci-in ka ni in a gen hi.

records.english: Grandma calls God her shepherd.
records.zomi: Pi in Pasian pen a tuucing a ci hi.

records.english: Talking about the nature of God at the dinner table has helped our children ask honest questions about faith.
records.zomi: Nitak an ne dohkan-ah Pasian' omzia tawh kisai kikup in i tate upna tawh kisai thuman dotna te a dot nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: When my grandfather lost his farm in a drought, he still prayed every morning on the porch.
records.zomi: Khua keu-in ka pu' lo a mansuah ciangin zong zingsang simin inn mai-ah thu a ngen lai hi.

records.english: He told us that God had not changed, even though everything around him had.
records.zomi: A kiim-a na khempeuh a kikhel hangin Pasian a kikhel kei hi, ci-in hong gen hi.

records.english: Years later, my father said that watching Grandpa trust God in that hard season shaped his own faith more than any sermon.
records.zomi: Kum tampi khit ciangin tua hun haksa-in Pu in Pasian a muan a muh in thuhilhna khempeuh sangin a upna a lam zaw hi, ci-in ka pa in a gen hi.

records.english: Why does Dad always say God is faithful?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pa in Pasian a muanhuai hi, a ci den hiam?

records.english: Because he believes God keeps his promises, even when life is hard.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh nuntakna a haksat ciangin zong Pasian in a kamciamna te a kem hi, ci-in a um hi.

records.english: When my parents explain God's attributes to us, they always begin with love, because they believe everything else flows from it.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa in Pasian' a omzia te hong gen uh ciangin itna tawh a kipan den uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh na dang khempeuh tua pan a pai hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Christians believe that God is the same yesterday, today and forever, which comforts my grandfather.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Pasian pen zani, tuni leh a tawntungin a kibang hi, ci-in a um uh a, tua in ka pu a hehnep hi.

records.english: Why does Grandpa say God never changes?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pu in Pasian a kikhel ngei kei hi, a ci hiam?

records.english: Christians believe that God's knowledge of every person is not frightening but a sign of how deeply he cares.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Pasian in mi khatciat a theih pen lauhuai hi lo-in bangzah thuk-in hong ngaihsun hiam cih lakna ahi hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: When my uncle was ill, our family prayed together, trusting that God is good even in suffering.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu a cina ciangin thuakna sungah zong Pasian a hoih hi, cih muang-in i innkuan in thu i ngen khawm hi.

records.english: My father says that the more he learns about God's holiness, the more grateful he is for God's mercy.
records.zomi: Pasian' siangthona tawh kisai a sin tam semsem ciangin Pasian' hehpihna adingin a lungdam semsem hi, ci-in ka pa in a gen hi.

records.english: Christians often describe God as a loving father who cares for his children.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Pasian pen a tate a ngaihsun pa itna nei khat bangin a gen zel uh hi.

records.english: My grandfather often says that God's faithfulness is best understood by looking back over a whole life.

records.english: What does 100% mean?

records.english: What's the easiest way to compare 3/7 and 4/9?

records.english: What is two thirds of 12?

records.english: How do I work out the percentage increase when a price goes from 40 to 50?

records.english: Is there a service that records the label instructions for people who can't read?

records.english: My label is in my own language now.

records.english: When the label and the doctor's letter disagreed, the pharmacist phoned the surgery to check.
records.zomi: Lai neu leh siavuan' lai a kibat loh ciangin damdawi zuakpa in en dingin damdawi inn-ah phone tawh a sam hi.

records.english: First-aid training gives ordinary people the confidence to act bravely in an emergency.

records.english: Moral courage in public life means putting the needs of the most vulnerable above one's own comfort.

records.english: Asking the food bank for help after losing her job took my neighbour real courage.

records.english: The mother who campaigned for a crossing outside the school faced months of meetings before she succeeded.

records.english: When the mountain rescue team was called out at midnight, my sister left her warm bed without hesitation.

records.english: Some employers are nervous about hiring people whose residency is temporary, even when the law allows it.

records.english: When residency rules link permission to stay to one employer, workers may feel unable to report problems.

records.english: Schools often support families through residency renewals by providing letters about attendance and progress.

records.english: At many universities, no, because fees often depend on your residency status rather than your nationality.

records.english: The hospital checked the residency status of every new nurse before they could start their first shift.
