records.english: Do I need to draw what I see?
records.zomi: Ka muh ka lim suai ding a kisam hiam?

records.english: The tourist office recommended an app with offline maps for walkers in the hills.
records.zomi: Khualzinmite thuhilhna office in mual-a kalsuan mite adingin offline map nei app khat a gen hi.

records.english: The shopping centre's security team found a lost toddler within ten minutes using their cameras.
records.zomi: Van zuakna inn lian' bitna pawl in a camera te zang-in minute sawm sungin naupang neu mangthang khat a mu uh hi.

records.english: Offline maps and printed guides remain useful wherever phone signals are unreliable.
records.zomi: Phone signal muanhuai lohna mun khempeuh-ah offline map leh kikhen lamlakna laibu te a manpha lai hi.

records.english: A police officer showed us the way.
records.zomi: Palik khat in lampi hong lak hi.

records.english: Could the airport put up clearer signs for passengers changing terminals?
records.zomi: Vanlengtual in terminal a khek khualzinmite adingin lim tangna kician zaw te a koih thei ding hiam?

records.english: My elderly neighbour went to the shops one afternoon and couldn't remember the way home.
records.zomi: Ka inn kiang-a upa khat nitak lam khat-in kawlpi-ah a pai a, inn-a ciahna lampi a phawk thei kei hi.

records.english: A community police officer found her sitting on a bench and gently asked where she lived.
records.zomi: Khuasung palik khat in tutphah sau khat tungah a tu a mu a, koi-ah na teng hiam, ci-in nem takin a dong hi.

records.english: Since then, she carries a card with her address, and the officer stops by every few weeks to say hello.
records.zomi: Tua pan a tenna mun a nei card khat a paipih den a, palik in kal tawmno simin a kan a, a cibai hi.

records.english: Who can help me find the town hall?
records.zomi: Khuapi heutu inn ka muh nadingin kua in hong huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Search teams work best when communities share information quickly and calmly.
records.zomi: Zonna pawl te khuasung mite in thu manlang leh dai takin a hawm uh ciangin a hoih pen-in a sem uh hi.

records.english: The museum gave us a floor plan.
records.zomi: Museum in inn sung lim khat hong pia hi.

records.english: The council put up new street signs.
records.zomi: Council in lampi min tangna thak te a koih hi.

records.english: Who should we ask if we get lost in the city centre?
records.zomi: Khuapi lai-ah i mangthang leh kua i dong ding hiam?

records.english: Look for the information points with a big blue sign, or ask a police officer.
records.zomi: Lim tangna dum lian nei thuhilhna mun te zong in, ahih kei leh palik khat dong in.

records.english: The care home gives residents with memory problems a bracelet with a phone number on it.
records.zomi: Kemna inn in phawk theihna buaina nei a sung-a teng mite phone nambat a nei khut-a bulh khat a pia hi.

records.english: When residents report confusing signs, councils can make simple changes that help many people.
records.zomi: A sung-a teng mite in a lungbuai huai lim tangna te a gen uh ciangin council te in mi tampi a huh kikhekna baih te a bawl thei uh hi.

records.english: When does the visitor centre in the park open?
records.zomi: Park sung-a khualmite inn ciang-in a kihong hiam?

records.english: The park has signs at every gate.
records.zomi: Park in kongpi khempeuh-ah lim tangna a nei hi.

records.english: A volunteer walked us to the right ward.
records.zomi: Thalawp khat in dawhmun dik-ah hong paipih hi.

records.english: The council's walking guide marks the routes where phone signal is often lost.
records.zomi: Council' khekhawm lamlakna in phone signal a mang zel lampi te a ciamteh hi.

records.english: What happens if a child gets lost at the festival?
records.zomi: Pawi-ah naupang khat a mangthang leh bang a piang ding hiam?

records.english: Stewards take them to the lost children tent by the main gate and announce their name.
records.zomi: Kemmite in kongpi lian kiang-a naupang mangthang puanbuuk-ah a paipih uh a, a min uh a tangko uh hi.

records.english: Volunteers at the station help visitors who don't speak the local language find the right platform.
records.zomi: Station-a thalawp te in khuasung pau a ham thei lo khualmite platform dik a mu nadingin a huh uh hi.

records.english: Getting lost is often a reminder of how much we depend on the kindness of strangers and public workers.
records.zomi: Mangthang in i theih loh mite leh mipi nasemte' hehpihna tungah bangzah i kinga hiam cih a phawk sak zel hi.

records.english: Mountain and coastal rescue teams rely on walkers sharing their plans before they set out.
records.zomi: Mual leh tuipi gei hotkhiatna pawl te in kalsuan mite in a pai ma-un a ngimna uh a gen uh tungah a kinga uh hi.

records.english: The coastguard rescued two walkers who had lost their way on the cliffs in thick fog.
records.zomi: Tuipi gei kemmite in meii khauh sungah suangpang tungah lampi a mansuah kalsuan mi nih a hotkhia uh hi.

records.english: The hospital painted coloured lines on the floor so that patients could follow them to each department.
records.zomi: Damlo inn in damlo te in a zui-in khen khatciat a tun nadingin inn leitang tungah pianzia tuamtuam lam a hal hi.

records.english: Large events need clear plans for reuniting lost children with their families.
records.zomi: Pawi lian te in naupang mangthang te a innkuan uh tawh kimuh kik sak nadingin ngimna cian te a kisam hi.

records.english: The ferry staff pointed us to the right exit.
records.zomi: Tuiluang long nasemte in khiatna dik hong lak uh hi.

records.english: The search team found the missing child in the woods after neighbours joined the search.
records.zomi: Inn kiang mite zonna-ah a kihel khit-in zonna pawl in gammang sungah naupang mangthang a mu uh hi.

records.english: The guide counted us after every stop.
records.zomi: Lamlakpa in khawlna khatciat khit-in hong sim hi.

records.english: The station has a help point for lost travellers.
records.zomi: Station in lampi a mansuah khualzinmite adingin huhna mun khat a nei hi.

records.english: The taxi driver found our street.
records.zomi: Taxi mawngpa in i lampi a mu hi.

records.english: Is there an app that helps people find their way around the hospital?
records.zomi: Mite in damlo inn sungah lampi a muh nadingin a huh app khat a om hiam?

records.english: Yes, and there are also volunteers in green jackets at every entrance to guide visitors.
records.zomi: Om hi, khualmite lamlak nadingin kongkhak khempeuh-ah jacket eng a silh thalawp te zong a om hi.

records.english: Children who know to look for someone in uniform are more likely to be found quickly if they get lost.
records.zomi: Puan tuam a silh mi khat zong ding a thei naupangte a mangthang uh leh manlang takin a kimu thei zaw uh hi.

records.english: Public services that help lost visitors make a town feel safer and more welcoming.
records.zomi: Khualmi mangthang te a huh mipi nasep te in khuapi khat bit zaw leh kidawn nuam zaw bangin a kizak sak hi.

records.english: Volunteers at hospitals and stations play an important part in guiding confused or anxious visitors.
records.zomi: Damlo inn leh station-a thalawp te in a lungbuai ahih kei leh a lungkham khualmite lamlak-ah na thupi a sem uh hi.

records.english: Our hotel gave us a card with its address.
records.zomi: I zinbuuk in a tenna mun a nei card khat hong pia hi.

records.english: Ask the staff at the information desk.
records.zomi: Thuhilhna dawhkan-a nasemte dong in.

records.english: Why do so many visitors get lost in the old part of town?
records.zomi: Bang hangin khualmi tampi khuapi' a lui lam-ah a mangthang uh hiam?

records.english: People with memory problems can be helped to stay independent by simple measures such as address cards.
records.zomi: Phawk theihna buaina nei mite tenna mun card bang lampi baih te tawh amau' kibawl theih nadingin kihuh thei hi.

records.english: The lost children tent is by the stage.
records.zomi: Naupang mangthang puanbuuk pen dawhsang kiangah a om hi.

records.english: The steward helped my son find us.
records.zomi: Kemmi in ka tapa hong mu dingin a huh hi.

records.english: At the big concert, the organisers asked families to agree on a meeting point in case anyone got lost.
records.zomi: La pawi lian-ah a bawlmite in kuamah a mangthang leh kimuhna mun khat a lungkim khawm dingin innkuan te a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Police officers at the festival wore bright jackets so that lost children could find them easily.
records.zomi: Pawi-a palik te in naupang mangthang te in a mu baih nadingin jacket tang a silh uh hi.

records.english: Can the library give me a town map?
records.zomi: Laibu inn in khuapi map khat hong pia thei ding hiam?

records.english: Call this number if you get lost.
records.zomi: Na mangthang leh hih nambat sam in.

records.english: The bus driver told us where to get off.
records.zomi: Bus mawngpa in koi-ah i suk ding hiam cih hong gen hi.

records.english: Is there a help desk at the airport?
records.zomi: Vanlengtual-ah huhna dawhkan a om hiam?

records.english: The shopping centre has maps on every floor.
records.zomi: Van zuakna inn lian in a sung khempeuh-ah map te a nei hi.

records.english: A taxi driver noticed a confused elderly man at the bus stop and called the police to help him home.
records.zomi: Taxi mawngpa khat in bus khawlna-ah upa lungbuai khat a mu a, inn-ah a ciah nadingin palik a sam hi.

records.english: A town that thinks about how visitors find their way shows care for everyone who arrives there.
records.zomi: Khualmite in lampi bangci a mu uh hiam cih a ngaihsun khuapi khat in a tung mi khempeuh adingin a lungsim a tak hi.

records.english: Clear signs, maps and information points reduce the stress of finding your way in an unfamiliar place.
records.zomi: Lim tangna cian, map leh thuhilhna mun te in mun thak khat-ah lampi zonna lungsim gimna a kiam sak hi.

records.english: Could the council add more signs to the footpath, since so many walkers get lost there?
records.zomi: Kalsuan mi tampi tua mun-ah a mangthang uh ahih manin council in kalsuan lampi-ah lim tangna tam zaw a koih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Why did the mountain rescue team ask walkers to leave their route with someone at home?
records.zomi: Bang hangin mual hotkhiatna pawl in kalsuan mite a lampi uh inn-a mi khat kiangah nusia dingin a ngen uh hiam?

records.english: Because if a walker doesn't return, knowing the planned route helps the team find them much more quickly.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh kalsuan mi khat a ciah kei leh a pai ding lampi theih in pawl in manlang mahmah-in a mu thei hi.

records.english: Can the bus driver tell me where to get off?
records.zomi: Bus mawngpa in koi-ah ka suk ding hiam cih hong gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, just tell him the name of the street when you get on.
records.zomi: Thei hi, na tuan ciangin lampi min gen bek in.

records.english: The library offers free maps and gives directions to anyone who asks at the desk.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in a man om lo map te a pia a, dawhkan-ah a dong mi khempeuh lampi a lak hi.

records.english: Was your cousin born here?
records.zomi: Na sanggam hih mun-ah a suak hiam?

records.english: My mother misses the sound of rain on the tin roof of her childhood home.
records.zomi: Ka nu in a naupan lai-a inn' sik inntung tunga guah ging a phawk zel hi.

records.english: Why does Dad send money home every month?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pa in kha simin inn-ah sum a khak hiam?

records.english: He helps his parents and pays for his nephews' school fees in the village.
records.zomi: A nu leh pa a huh a, khua-a a sanggam te' tapa te' sangkah man a pia hi.

records.english: Did your uncle first come here as a student?
records.zomi: Na pa neu hih mun-ah sangnaupang hi-in a hong masa hiam?

records.english: My parents believe that the sacrifices they made in moving abroad have given their children a better future.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh pa in gamdang-a a pai uh hangin a nusiat uh te in a tate uh adingin a hun zom hoih zaw khat a pia hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: We celebrate our festival every autumn.
records.zomi: Kum simin autumn hun-in i pawi i bawl hi.

records.english: Where are the rest of our family photos?
records.zomi: I innkuan' photo a dang te koi-ah a om hiam?

records.english: What was your first winter in this country like?
records.zomi: Hih gam-ah na khuaphal masa pen bangci a om hiam?

records.english: Lost and cold, but our church welcomed us, and that made everything easier.
records.zomi: Lampi mansuah leh vot hi, ahi zongin i biakinn in hong dawn a, tua in na khempeuh a baih zaw sak hi.

records.english: My little sister sometimes mixes the two languages in the same sentence, which makes Grandma laugh.
records.zomi: Ka sanggamnu neu in kammal tang kibang sungah pau nih a hel khawm zel a, tua in Pi a nui sak hi.

records.english: Living abroad has made my family more determined to keep our language and traditions alive.
records.zomi: Gamdang-ah teng in ka innkuan i pau leh ngeina te nungta sak dingin a lungsim a khauh zaw sak hi.

records.english: Our family celebrates both our own festivals and the holidays of our new country.
records.zomi: I innkuan in eimau' pawi te leh i gam thak' tawlngakni te tuak in a bawl hi.

records.english: Could we spend a whole summer in Grandpa's village one day?
records.zomi: Ni khat-in Pu' khua-ah khal khempeuh i om thei ding hiam?

records.english: My aunt posts us tea leaves from her garden every spring.
records.zomi: Ka ni in spring simin a huan pan lapha hong khak hi.

records.english: My parents taught us that keeping in touch with relatives at home is a duty as well as a joy.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh pa in inn-a sanggam te tawh kizop den pen nopna bek hi lo-in mawhpuakna zong ahi hi, ci-in hong hilh uh hi.

records.english: I translate letters for my parents.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh pa adingin lai te ka let hi.

records.english: Mum keeps a calendar with both countries' holidays.
records.zomi: Ka nu in gam nih' tawlngakni te a nei calendar khat a kem hi.

records.english: Why does Grandma still wear her traditional shawl?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pi in a ngeina puan a silh lai hiam?

records.english: Being part of the diaspora has taught my family to treasure both our roots and our new home.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a teng mite lak-ah kihel in ka innkuan in i bulpi leh i inn thak tuak a manpha sak dingin a hilh hi.

records.english: My parents worked long hours in a factory so that we could go to university.
records.zomi: University i kah theih nadingin ka nu leh pa in sepna inn khat-ah hun sau a sem uh hi.

records.english: When my family first moved abroad, my little brother refused to speak our language at school.
records.zomi: Ka innkuan gamdang-ah i pai masa ciangin ka nau pasal neu in sang-ah i pau ham a nial hi.

records.english: My grandmother began telling him stories every evening, and slowly he started asking her to teach him new words.
records.zomi: Ka pi in nitak simin tangthu a gen sak a, zawlzawl-in kammal thak te hilh dingin a ngen pan hi.

records.english: Now he translates for her at the doctor's and says he's proud to speak both languages.
records.zomi: Tu-in siavuan kiangah amah adingin a let a, pau nih a ham thei ahih manin a kipak hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Do you dream in our language or in English?
records.zomi: I pau tawh na mang hiam, English tawh na mang hiam?

records.english: When my uncle died abroad, the whole community gathered to help the family with the funeral.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu gamdang-ah a sih ciangin khuasung mi khempeuh in misi vuina-ah innkuan te huh dingin a kikhawm uh hi.

records.english: Our neighbours are from many different places.
records.zomi: I inn kiang mite pen mun tuamtuam pan ahi uh hi.

records.english: My parents saved for years to bring my grandparents here for a visit.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh pa in ka pu leh pi te kan dingin hih mun-ah paipih nadingin kum tampi sum a kem uh hi.

records.english: Our community abroad has become like an extended family for people who left their own relatives behind.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a i khuasung pen amau' sanggam te a nusia mite adingin innkuan lian khat bang a suak hi.

records.english: When my father talks about the old country, I realise that home can be a memory as well as a place.
records.zomi: Ka pa in gam lui thu a gen ciangin inn pen mun khat bek hi lo-in phawkna khat zong ahi thei hi, ci-in ka theisiam hi.

records.english: Shall we call Grandma and Grandpa tonight?
records.zomi: Tu zan-in Pi leh Pu i sam ding hiam?

records.english: My cousin feels at home in the city where she grew up, but she still calls herself a hill girl.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in a khanna khuapi-ah inn bangin a kizak hangin amah leh amah mual nungak khat hi, ci-in a kici lai hi.

records.english: My grandmother worries that her great-grandchildren will grow up without knowing the village where our family began.
records.zomi: Ka pi in a tu' tate in i innkuan' a kipatna khua a theih loh-in a khang ding uh hi, ci-in a lungkham hi.

records.english: Our church abroad holds services in our language, so the older members feel at home.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a i biakinn in i pau tawh Pasian biakna a bawl a, tua ahih manin member upa te in inn bangin a kizak uh hi.

records.english: My father works two jobs to support the family.
records.zomi: Ka pa in innkuan a vak nadingin nasep nih a sem hi.

records.english: My sister teaches children our language on Saturdays.
records.zomi: Ka sanggamnu in Kiginni simin naupangte i pau a hilh hi.

records.english: Grandpa tells stories about the village.
records.zomi: Pu in khua tawh kisai tangthu a gen hi.

records.english: My father keeps a map of the old village on the wall of his bedroom.
records.zomi: Ka pa in a lupna inndan' kul tungah khua lui' map khat a kem hi.

records.english: My cousins abroad and I share recipes from our grandmother in a family group chat.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a ka sanggam te leh kei in innkuan group chat khat sungah i pi' an huan dan te i hawm uh hi.

records.english: Grandpa, do you miss the hills?
records.zomi: Pu aw, mual te na phawk hiam?

records.english: Every day, but I'm happy to be here with all of you.
records.zomi: Ni simin ka phawk hi, ahi zongin hih mun-ah note khempeuh tawh ka om ahih manin ka lungdam hi.

records.english: When my grandmother visits from the village, she is surprised by how quickly the children have grown.
records.zomi: Ka pi khua pan hong pai ciangin naupangte a khan manlang mahmah uh ahih manin a lamdang sa hi.

records.english: When we visit the village, my children are amazed by how quiet the nights are.
records.zomi: Khua-ah i pai ciangin ka tate in zan te a dai mahmah ahih manin a lamdang sa uh hi.

records.english: For my family, our church abroad is both a place of worship and a link to the culture we left behind.
records.zomi: Ka innkuan adingin gamdang-a i biakinn pen Pasian biakna mun leh i nusiat ngeina tawh kizopna tuak ahi hi.

records.english: Is it hard for you to explain our customs to your friends at school?
records.zomi: Sang-a na lawm te kiangah i ngeina te gen na haksa hiam?

records.english: Children in our family often feel that they belong to two places at once, which can be both a gift and a burden.
records.zomi: I innkuan-a naupangte in hun khat thu-in mun nih ah kihel bangin a kizak zel uh a, tua pen letsong leh puakgik tuak ahi thei hi.

records.english: Why do my parents still call the village home after twenty years here?
records.zomi: Hih mun-ah kum sawmnih a om khit uh hangin bang hangin ka nu leh pa in khua pen inn ci lai uh hiam?

records.english: My brother helps new families find homes.
records.zomi: Ka sanggampa in innkuan thak te inn a muh nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: My parents still listen to radio from home.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh pa in inn lam pan radio a ngai lai uh hi.

records.english: My grandfather was moved to tears when he heard our national songs at a community concert.
records.zomi: Khuasung la pawi khat-ah i nam la te a zak ciangin ka pu a kah hi.

records.english: Our family church abroad is very busy.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a i innkuan biakinn a buai mahmah hi.

records.english: When will we visit the old country again?
records.zomi: Gam lui ciang-in i kan kik ding hiam?

records.english: My father says that living abroad taught him how precious his family and faith really are.
records.zomi: Gamdang-ah teng in a innkuan leh a upna a manpha taktak zia a hilh hi, ci-in ka pa in a gen hi.

records.english: Our children switch between two languages without thinking.
records.zomi: I tate in ngaihsut lo-in pau nih kikal-ah a kikhek uh hi.

records.english: Mum, why do we speak a different language at home?
records.zomi: Nu aw, bang hangin inn-ah pau tuam i ham hiam?

records.english: Because it's the language of our family and our village, and we don't want you to lose it.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh i innkuan leh i khua' pau ahi a, na mansuah ding i deih kei hi.

records.english: The stories my grandparents tell about the journey abroad have become an important part of our family history.
records.zomi: Ka pu leh pi te in gamdang-a khualzinna tawh kisai a gen tangthu te i innkuan tangthu-a a thupi khat a suak hi.

records.english: My mother cooks food from home on holidays.
records.zomi: Ka nu in tawlngakni te-in inn lam an a huan hi.

records.english: Why do you want our wedding to include both our traditions and local customs?
records.zomi: Bang hangin i mopawi-ah i ngeina leh khuasung ngeina tuak hel na deih hiam?

records.english: Because our children will grow up between two cultures, and we want them to feel proud of both.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh i tate ngeina nih kikal-ah a khang ding uh a, a nih tuak tungah a kipak nadingin i deih hi.

records.english: Our family's habit of praying for people who have hurt us has slowly softened many old grudges.
records.zomi: Hong susia mite adingin thungen ngeina i innkuan in a neih in hehna lui tampi zawlzawl-in a nem sak hi.

records.english: My grandmother keeps a verse about God's love by her bed.
records.zomi: Ka pi in a lupna kiangah Pasian' itna tawh kisai Lai Siangtho cang khat a kem hi.

records.english: Our family read the story of the lost sheep and talked about how God searches for every person.
records.zomi: I innkuan in tuu mangthang tangthu i sim a, Pasian in mi khatciat bangci a zong hiam cih i kikum hi.

records.english: Grandma, why do you always pray for people who are unkind to you?
records.zomi: Pi aw, bang hangin hong hoih lo mite adingin thu na ngen den hiam?

records.english: Because I believe God loves them too, and he asks us to show them mercy.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in amaute zong a it hi, ci-in ka um a, amaute hehpihna lak dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: In my grandmother's view, God's mercy is greater than any wrong a person could ever commit.
records.zomi: Ka pi' ngaihsutna-ah Pasian' hehpihna pen mi khat in a bawl thei mawhna khempeuh sangin a lian zaw hi.

records.english: In our family, the story of the prodigal son is told whenever someone needs to be welcomed back.
records.zomi: I innkuan-ah mi khat a kidawn kik ding a kisam ciangin tapa mangthang tangthu a kigen zel hi.

records.english: We sing a song about God's mercy at bedtime.
records.zomi: Ihmut hun-in Pasian' hehpihna tawh kisai la khat i sa hi.

records.english: Mum, does God love me even when I'm naughty?
records.zomi: Nu aw, ka gitlohna hun-in zong Pasian in hong it hiam?

records.english: Christians believe God loves you all the time, even when you make mistakes.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Pasian in hun khempeuh-in hong it a, na khialh hun-in zong hong it hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: My parents taught us that receiving God's mercy should make us quicker to forgive others.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh pa in Pasian' hehpihna ngah in midangte maisak dingin manlang zaw sak ding hi, ci-in hong hilh uh hi.

records.english: How can God love everyone in the whole world at the same time?
records.zomi: Pasian in leitung buppi-a mi khempeuh hun kibang-in bangci a it thei hiam?

records.english: Christians believe God's love has no limits, so he can love each person completely.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Pasian' itna in a tawpna om lo a, tua ahih manin mi khatciat a bup-in a it thei hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: When my grandfather was in hospital, he told us that God's mercy had carried him through every hard year.
records.zomi: Ka pu damlo inn-ah a om laitakin Pasian' hehpihna in kum haksa khempeuh sung hong pua hi, ci-in hong gen hi.

records.english: Why did Jesus help people who were poor?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Jesu in mizawng te a huh hiam?

records.english: God loves every child, Grandma says.
records.zomi: Pasian in naupang khempeuh a it hi, ci-in Pi in a gen hi.

records.english: Many Christians find that God's love gives them a sense of worth that no failure can take away.
records.zomi: Khazih mite tampi in Pasian' itna in zawhlohna khatpeuh in a la thei lo manphatna a pia hi, ci-in a mu uh hi.

records.english: Dad says we should forgive like God forgives.
records.zomi: Pasian' maisak bangin i maisak ding hi, ci-in Pa in a gen hi.

records.english: My grandfather says that God's mercy is new every morning, like the sunrise.
records.zomi: Pasian' hehpihna pen ni suah bangin zingsang simin a thak hi, ci-in ka pu in a gen hi.

records.english: Christians believe Jesus showed God's love.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Jesu in Pasian' itna a lak hi, ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: My grandfather says that the older he gets, the more amazed he is by God's patience with him.
records.zomi: A teek semsem ciangin Pasian' a tungah thuakzawhna a lamdang sa semsem hi, ci-in ka pu in a gen hi.

records.english: Does God ever stop loving people?
records.zomi: Pasian in mite itna a khawl ngei hiam?

records.english: Why do some people find it hard to believe that God could love them?
records.zomi: Bang hangin mi khenkhat in Pasian in amaute a it thei hi, cih um a haksa sa uh hiam?

records.english: My mother says that God's love is the reason she welcomes every stranger to our table.
records.zomi: Ka nu in Pasian' itna hangin i an dawhkan-ah khualmi khempeuh a dawn hi, ci-in a gen hi.

records.english: My little sister asked whether God still loves people who don't believe in him.
records.zomi: Ka sanggamnu neu in Pasian in amah a um lo mite a it lai hiam, ci-in a dong hi.

records.english: Mum says God's love never runs out.
records.zomi: Pasian' itna a bei ngei lo hi, ci-in ka nu in a gen hi.

records.english: Our pastor says God welcomes everyone.
records.zomi: I pastor in Pasian in mi khempeuh a dawn hi, a ci hi.

records.english: My father explained that grace means receiving love that we haven't earned.
records.zomi: Hehpihna pen i ngah tak loh itna ngah ahi hi, ci-in ka pa in a gen hi.

records.english: Our family says sorry to each other before bed.
records.zomi: I innkuan in i ihmut ma-in khat leh khat maisakna i kingen uh hi.

records.english: My grandmother forgave the man who caused her accident, saying that she had been forgiven far more.
records.zomi: Ka pi in a tung-a kisiatna piangsak mipa a maisak a, amah in a tam zaw-in maisakna a ngah khin hi, a ci hi.

records.english: God's mercy is shown most clearly, Christians believe, when Jesus forgave the people who crucified him.
records.zomi: Khazih mite' upna-ah Jesu in amah singlamteh tunga khai mite a maisak ciangin Pasian' hehpihna a kilang pen hi.

records.english: The Bible often describes God as slow to anger and rich in love.
records.zomi: Lai Siangtho in Pasian pen heh baih lo a, itna a dim ahi hi, ci-in a gen zel hi.

records.english: Why did Grandpa forgive the man who cheated him, when he could have taken him to court?
records.zomi: Bang hangin Pu in amah a khem mipa thukhenna-ah a paipih thei hangin a maisak hiam?

records.english: He said that because God had shown him so much mercy, he wanted to give the man a second chance.
records.zomi: Pasian in amah hehpihna tampi a lak ahih manin mipa theihna nihna khat pia dingin a deih hi, a ci hi.

records.english: My aunt forgave her neighbour because of her faith.
records.zomi: Ka ni in a upna hangin a inn kiang mi a maisak hi.

records.english: Our church family brought us meals for a month after my mother's operation, saying it was God's love in action.
records.zomi: Ka nu' zatna khit-in i biakinn innkuan in kha khat sung an hong paipih uh a, tua pen Pasian' itna nasep sungah ahi hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: We visit lonely people to show God's kindness.
records.zomi: Pasian' hehpihna lak nadingin a khat bek-a om mite i kan hi.

records.english: Our family gives part of our income to the food bank as a way of sharing God's generosity.
records.zomi: Pasian' piakna lungsim hawm nadingin i innkuan in i sum ngah' a khenkhat an piakna mun-ah i pia hi.

records.english: Does God forgive big mistakes too?
records.zomi: Pasian in khialhna lian te zong a maisak hiam?

records.english: What does mercy mean, Dad?
records.zomi: Pa aw, hehpihna in bang a cihna hiam?

records.english: It means being kind and forgiving to someone instead of giving them the punishment they deserve.
records.zomi: Mi khat a ngah ding gawtna pia sangin amah tungah hehpih in maisak cihna ahi hi.

records.english: Every night we pray for friends who are sick.
records.zomi: Zan simin a cina lawm te adingin thu i ngen hi.

records.english: My sister asked if God loves animals.
records.zomi: Ka sanggamnu in Pasian in ganhing te a it hiam, ci-in a dong hi.

records.english: My little brother drew a heart for God.
records.zomi: Ka nau pasal neu in Pasian adingin lungtang lim khat a suai hi.

records.english: Many Christians teach that God's love reaches people before they turn to him, not only afterwards.
records.zomi: Khazih mite tampi in Pasian' itna in mite a kiang uh-a a hong kiheek khit bek hi lo-in a kiheek ma-un a tung hi, ci-in a hilh uh hi.

records.english: Shall we thank God for today before we eat?
records.zomi: I an ne ma-in tuni' adingin Pasian i lungdam ko ding hiam?

records.english: When my father forgave his brother after years of anger, he said it was the hardest and most freeing thing he had ever done.
records.zomi: Ka pa in kum tampi a heh khit-in a sanggampa a maisak ciangin a bawl ngeisa te lak-ah a haksa pen leh a suakta pen ahi hi, a ci hi.

records.english: For Christians, God's love and mercy are revealed most fully in Jesus' life, death and resurrection.
records.zomi: Khazih mite adingin Pasian' itna leh hehpihna pen Jesu' nuntakna, a sihna leh a thawhkikna-ah a kicing pen-in a kilang hi.

records.english: When my brother came home after years of not speaking to our family, my father ran out to meet him.
records.zomi: Ka sanggampa kum tampi sung i innkuan tawh a kiho loh khit-in inn-ah a ciah ciangin ka pa a dawn dingin a tai khia hi.

records.english: He hugged him on the doorstep and said that the story of the prodigal son had come true in our own house.
records.zomi: Kongkhak mai-ah a ngawng kawi a, tapa mangthang tangthu i inn mahmah-ah a tangtung hi, a ci hi.

records.english: That evening, we ate together for the first time in a decade, and my mother said it was the best meal of her life.
records.zomi: Tua nitak-in kum sawm sung-a a vei khatna-in an i ne khawm a, ka nu in a nuntakna sung-a an hoih pen ahi hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Does God really give second chances, Grandpa?
records.zomi: Pu aw, Pasian in theihna nihna a pia taktak hiam?

records.english: Will you read us a story about Jesus tonight, Dad?
records.zomi: Pa aw, tu zan-in Jesu tangthu khat hong sim sak ding na hiam?

records.english: Is it possible to accept God's forgiveness but still feel guilty?
records.zomi: Pasian' maisakna sang a, mawhsak kizak lai thei ahi hiam?

records.english: My cousin says that discovering God's mercy changed how she treated her own children.
records.zomi: Pasian' hehpihna a theih in amah' tate a kem dan a khek hi, ci-in ka sanggam in a gen hi.

records.english: For my family, God's love is not just an idea but something we try to show in how we treat one another.
records.zomi: Ka innkuan adingin Pasian' itna pen ngaihsutna bek hi lo-in khat leh khat i kikem dan-ah i lak ding i sawm na khat ahi hi.

records.english: When I failed my exams, my parents reminded me that God's love doesn't depend on success.
records.zomi: Ka kisinna te ka zawh loh ciangin ka nu leh pa in Pasian' itna pen zawhna tungah a kinga lo hi, ci-in hong phawk sak uh hi.

records.english: Is God's love like a parent's love?
records.zomi: Pasian' itna pen nu leh pa' itna bang ahi hiam?

records.english: Knowing that God loves her helps my aunt love her difficult neighbours.
records.zomi: Pasian in amah a it hi, cih theih in ka ni a inn kiang mi haksa te a it theih nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Why do we always share our food with visitors?
records.zomi: Bang hangin khualmite tawh i an i hawm den hiam?

records.english: A second opinion is a sensible way to check evidence when a quote seems unusually high.
records.zomi: Man genna khat a sang lua bangin a kilang ciangin mi dang khat' ngaihsutna ngen pen tettehna en nading lampi pil khat ahi hi.

records.english: Do you have a photo of the scratch?
records.zomi: Kikhetna photo na nei hiam?

records.english: Where does it say I owe this money?
records.zomi: Hih sum ka ba hi, cih koi-ah a kigelh hiam?

records.english: Dated photos and written records often settle disputes that would otherwise drag on for months.
records.zomi: Ni a kigelh photo leh laigelh ciamtehna te in kha tampi sung a pai zom ding kinialna te a phel zel hi.

records.english: Do you have the delivery note?
records.zomi: Van tunna lai na nei hiam?

records.english: Is there a record of my phone call?
records.zomi: Ka phone samna ciamtehna khat a om hiam?

records.english: Keeping receipts and confirmation emails makes it much easier to solve problems with purchases.
records.zomi: Sum pia lai leh lak cianna email te kem in van leina tawh kisai buaina te phel a baih zaw sak mahmah hi.

records.english: Is there a video of the accident?
records.zomi: Kisiatna video khat a om hiam?

records.english: Can I see the guarantee for the fridge?
records.zomi: Fridge' kamciamna lai ka en thei ding hiam?

records.english: Who signed for the package?
records.zomi: Van ip kua in min a gelh hiam?

records.english: How can I prove that the shop sold me an out-of-date product?
records.zomi: Van zuakna inn in a hun bei van hong zuak hi, cih bangci ka lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: How can we prove to the council that the street light has been broken for weeks?
records.zomi: Lampi meivak kal tampi sung a siat hi, cih council kiangah bangci i lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Take a dated photo each evening and keep a list of the times you reported it, with any reference numbers.
records.zomi: Nitak simin ni kigelh photo khat la in, na gen hun te leh nambat khatpeuh lista khat-ah kem in.

records.english: How do we prove to the school that our son's bus keeps arriving late?
records.zomi: I tapa' bus a nunung den hi, cih sang kiangah bangci i lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: How can we show the housing officer that the damp is getting worse?
records.zomi: Tui hual a hoih lo semsem hi, cih inn kem nasem kiangah bangci i lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Is there anything in writing that shows the landlord agreed to the repair?
records.zomi: Inn neipa in bawlphatna a lungkim hi, cih a lak laigelh khatpeuh a om hiam?

records.english: Do you have the repair report?
records.zomi: Bawlphatna report na nei hiam?

records.english: Evidence is most useful when it is recorded at the time, rather than remembered later.
records.zomi: Tettehna pen a nunung-a phawk sangin tua hun-a kiciamteh ciangin a manpha pen hi.

records.english: Can you show me proof that the boiler was serviced last year?
records.zomi: Kum bei-in boiler a kien hi, cih tettehna hong lak thei ding na hiam?

records.english: Yes, here's the engineer's certificate with the date and his signature.
records.zomi: Thei hi, hih pen ni leh a min gelhna a nei engineer' certificate ahi hi.

records.english: How can I check whether the online seller is a real business?
records.zomi: Online van zuakmi pen sumbawlna tak khat ahi hiam cih bangci ka en thei ding hiam?

records.english: Can you prove the parcel arrived?
records.zomi: Van ip a tung hi, cih na lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Can you show me where the crack is?
records.zomi: Kekna koi-ah a om hiam cih hong lak thei ding na hiam?

records.english: What evidence would the bank want before cancelling a payment I didn't make?
records.zomi: Ka pia lo sum piakna khat bank in a nusiat ma-in bang tettehna a deih ding hiam?

records.english: Asking for evidence before paying for a repair protects customers from unnecessary work.
records.zomi: Bawlphatna adingin sum pia ma-in tettehna ngen in lei mite nasep kisam lo pan a kem hi.

records.english: Can you show me the bank statement that proves the payment went through?
records.zomi: Sum piakna a tung hi, cih a lak bank statement hong lak thei ding na hiam?

records.english: Before we pay the plumber, could he show us the pipe he says was blocked?
records.zomi: Tuikuang bawlmi sum i piak ma-in a kitan hi, a cih tuikuang hong lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: What evidence does the insurance company need before they'll pay for the burst pipe?
records.zomi: Tuikuang kehna adingin a piak ma-un insurance company in bang tettehna a kisam hiam?

records.english: When the builder said our roof needed completely replacing, I asked him to show me the damage.
records.zomi: Inn lam in i inntung a bup-in a laih ding kisam hi, a cih ciangin a siatna hong lak dingin ka ngen hi.

records.english: He refused to climb up again, so we asked a second builder, who took photos of every tile.
records.zomi: A kah kik nuam kei ahih manin inn lam nihna khat i dong a, amah in inntung khuh khatciat' photo a la hi.

records.english: The photos showed that only a small section needed repair, which saved us thousands.
records.zomi: Photo te in mun neu khat bek bawlphat ding a kisam hi, cih a lak a, tua in sum tampi hong kem sak hi.

records.english: Do you have the old bill?
records.zomi: Man lai lui na nei hiam?

records.english: When residents collect evidence together, their complaints are more likely to be taken seriously.
records.zomi: A sung-a teng mite in tettehna a kaikhawm uh ciangin a phunna uh a kingaihsun zaw ding hi.

records.english: Can I check the oil level myself?
records.zomi: Situi ciang kei mahmah-in ka en thei ding hiam?

records.english: Could the council send us the report from the last inspection of the playground?
records.zomi: Council in naupang kimawlna mun' en nunung pen report hong khak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Can I see the test results?
records.zomi: Sitna suakna te ka en thei ding hiam?

records.english: Where is the receipt for the bike?
records.zomi: Siiksakol' sum pia lai koi-ah a om hiam?

records.english: Asking politely for proof keeps a conversation calm while still protecting your rights.
records.zomi: Zahtak taka tettehna ngen in na thuneihna te a kem lai kawmin kikupna a dai sak hi.

records.english: Do you have any proof that the dog bite happened in the park?
records.zomi: Park-ah ui in a hong ham hi, cih tettehna khatpeuh na nei hiam?

records.english: Can you show me the meter reading?
records.zomi: Meter simna hong lak thei ding na hiam?

records.english: What proof do you need before you'll replace the faulty kettle?
records.zomi: Tuikhuai siat na laih ma-in bang tettehna na kisam hiam?

records.english: Just the receipt or the bank statement, and a photo of the fault if you can take one.
records.zomi: Sum pia lai ahih kei leh bank statement bek, na lak thei leh a siatna' photo khat zong.

records.english: Is there a photo of the broken lock?
records.zomi: Khawlh siat photo khat a om hiam?

records.english: Can I see the damage myself?
records.zomi: Siatna kei mahmah-in ka en thei ding hiam?

records.english: Honest businesses are usually happy to show customers evidence, while dishonest ones tend to avoid it.
records.zomi: Sumbawlna dikte in lei mite tettehna lak a nuam zel uh a, a dik lo te in a pelh zel uh hi.

records.english: Is the price written down anywhere?
records.zomi: Man koi-ah zong a kigelh hiam?

records.english: How do you know the leak is coming from the flat above?
records.zomi: Tui luang pen a tung-a inn pan hong pai hi, cih bangci na thei hiam?

records.english: The water marks are on the ceiling, and they get bigger every time their shower runs.
records.zomi: Tui ciamtehna te inn tungpi-ah a om a, amaute' tuikuang tui a luan simin a lian semsem hi.

records.english: What records should I keep if I think my neighbour's tree is damaging my wall?
records.zomi: Ka inn kiang mi' singkung in ka kul a susia hi, ka ci leh bang ciamtehna ka kem ding hiam?

records.english: Who saw the car hit the fence?
records.zomi: Mawtaw in huang a sat kua in a mu hiam?

records.english: Many problems are solved simply because someone asked to see the evidence and found a mistake.
records.zomi: Buaina tampi pen mi khat in tettehna en a ngen a, khialhna khat a muh hangin bek a kiphel hi.

records.english: Can the phone company show me which calls caused the high bill?
records.zomi: Phone company in bang samna te in man lai a sang sak hiam cih hong lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Could the garage show me the old parts they replaced on the car?
records.zomi: Garage in mawtaw tunga a laih van lui te hong lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Clear evidence helps officials act quickly, because they do not need to investigate every detail themselves.
records.zomi: Tettehna cian in ukmite manlang takin a sem theih nadingin a huh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh thu khempeuh amau' mahmah-in a sui ding kisam lo hi.

records.english: Reference numbers from phone calls can be as valuable as written letters when a problem is disputed.
records.zomi: Buaina khat kinial ciangin phone samna pan nambat te pen laigelh lai te bangin a manpha thei hi.

records.english: Asking an online seller for proof of identity can prevent many scams.
records.zomi: Online van zuakmi kiangah a kua hiam cih tettehna ngen in khemna tampi a kham thei hi.

records.english: Could you send me the photos you took when we moved in, so we can compare them with the flat now?
records.zomi: I lut ciangin na lak photo te hong khak thei ding na hiam, tu-a inn tawh i khaikhin theih nadingin?

records.english: Is there any evidence that the new tyres were fitted properly?
records.zomi: Tyre thak te hoih takin a kibulh hi, cih tettehna khatpeuh a om hiam?

records.english: The garage gave us a printout showing the pressure and the date of fitting.
records.zomi: Garage in huih ciang leh a kibulh ni a lak lai khat hong pia hi.

records.english: Can you send me the booking email?
records.zomi: Ciamtehna email hong khak thei ding na hiam?

records.english: My first payslip showed tax, a pension contribution and a small payment for my union.
records.zomi: Ka khasum lai masa pen in siah, pension adingin sum piakna leh ka nasem pawl adingin sum tawmno a lak hi.

records.english: My payslip shows how much tax I paid.
records.zomi: Ka khasum lai in siah bangzah ka pia hiam cih a lak hi.

records.english: I got a tax refund after my summer job.
records.zomi: Ka khal nasep khit-in siah pia kik ka ngah hi.

records.english: Payroll mistakes are more common than many people think, so checking payslips is always worthwhile.
records.zomi: Khasum bawlna khialhna te mi tampi' ngaihsut sangin a tam zaw a, tua ahih manin khasum lai en pen a manpha den hi.

records.english: Workers who move between jobs can pay the wrong amount of tax for months unless they check their codes.
records.zomi: Nasep tuamtuam kikal-a a kikhek nasemte in a code uh a en kei uh leh kha tampi sung siah khial a pia thei uh hi.

records.english: Could the payroll team explain why my overtime was taxed at a higher rate?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ka hun behlap nasep siah sang zaw tawh a kila hiam cih khasum pawl in a gen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Many people are entitled to tax refunds but never claim them because they do not know the rules.
records.zomi: Mi tampi in siah pia kik a ngah thei uh hangin thukham te a theih loh uh hangin a ngen ngei kei uh hi.

records.english: Why did my teacher spend a whole lesson explaining taxes?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ka saya in siah gen-in sinna khat buppi a zang hiam?

records.english: Because most of us will start work soon, and she wanted us to understand where our money goes before our first payslip arrives.
records.zomi: Bang hang hiam cih leh ei tampi in nasep a sem pai ding i hih manin, i khasum lai masa a tun ma-in i sum koi-ah a pai hiam cih i theisiam nadingin a deih hi.

records.english: The college runs a tax workshop.
records.zomi: College in siah sinna khat a bawl hi.

records.english: Why does my tax code change when I start a second part-time job?
records.zomi: Hun tawmno nasep nihna khat ka kipat ciangin bang hangin ka siah code a kikhek hiam?

records.english: I registered my business with the tax office.
records.zomi: Ka sumbawlna siah inn-ah ka min ka gelh hi.

records.english: Understanding taxes before starting work helps young people avoid nasty surprises on their first payslip.
records.zomi: Nasep kipat ma-in siah theisiam in tangvalte in a khasum lai masa uh tunga lamdang hoih lo te a pelh thei uh hi.

records.english: My boss explained the deductions.
records.zomi: Ka heutu in a kila sum te a gen hi.

records.english: A basic understanding of tax helps workers judge whether a job offer is really as good as it sounds.
records.zomi: Siah tawh kisai theihna tawmno in nasemte in nasep piakna khat a kigen bangin a hoih taktak hiam cih a khen thei nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: My teacher showed us a sample payslip.
records.zomi: Ka saya in khasum lai ettehna khat hong lak hi.

records.english: My manager reminded us that bonuses are taxed in the same way as normal pay.
records.zomi: Ka manager in sum behlap te pen khasum ngeina bangin siah a kila hi, ci-in hong phawk sak hi.

records.english: Many apprentices don't realise they can claim tax back for some of their tools.
records.zomi: Nasep sinmi tampi in a nasep van khenkhat adingin siah a ngen kik thei uh hi, cih a thei kei uh hi.

records.english: Small businesses often benefit from professional advice when their income starts to grow.
records.zomi: Sumbawlna neu te in a sum ngah uh a khan pan ciangin siam mite' thuhilhna pan phattuamna a ngah zel uh hi.

records.english: Do apprentices pay income tax?
records.zomi: Nasep sinmi te in sum ngah siah a pia uh hiam?

records.english: Our school's enterprise club had to work out the tax on the profits from its cake stall.
records.zomi: I sang' sumbawlna pawl in a cake zuakna pan a ngah uh punna tunga siah a tuat ding uh a kisam hi.

records.english: When I started my first job, I couldn't understand why my take-home pay was so much lower than my salary.
records.zomi: Ka nasep masa ka kipat ciangin bang hangin ka khut-a tung sum ka khasum sangin a niam mahmah hiam cih ka theisiam kei hi.

records.english: My manager sat with me for ten minutes and explained each line of my payslip, from income tax to the pension.
records.zomi: Ka manager in minute sawm sung hong tutpih a, sum ngah siah pan pension dong ka khasum lai' a kigelh khatciat hong gen hi.

records.english: After that, I checked every payslip carefully and even spotted a mistake in my overtime the following year.
records.zomi: Tua khit-in ka khasum lai khempeuh cian takin ka en a, a zom kum-in ka hun behlap nasep-ah khialhna khat ka mu hi.

records.english: Is tax taken from my tips?
records.zomi: Ka letsong sum pan siah a kila hiam?

records.english: Learning how taxes fund public services can make young people more interested in how governments spend money.
records.zomi: Siah in mipi nasep te bangci a kepzawh hiam cih sin in tangvalte in ukpi te in sum bangci a zang uh hiam cih tungah a deih zaw sak thei hi.

records.english: Schools that teach basic tax knowledge give pupils a practical skill they will use all their lives.

records.english: Workers in public services must account for every coin they spend, because it belongs to taxpayers.
records.zomi: Mipi nasep-a nasemte in a zat uh dangka khatciat adingin a dawng ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh siah piamite' ta ahi hi.

records.english: Why does the council spend so much money on care for older people?
records.zomi: Bang hangin council in upa te kemna-ah sum tampi a zang hiam?

records.english: The council pays for the school buses.
records.zomi: Council in sang bus te a pia hi.

records.english: Who decides the school's budget?
records.zomi: Sang' sum zat ngimna kua in a thukhen hiam?

records.english: The finance officer explained that most of the school's budget is spent on staff salaries.
records.zomi: Sum makaipa in sang' sum zat ngimna a tam zaw pen nasemte' khasum-ah a kizang hi, ci-in a gen hi.

records.english: Teachers' pay comes from public money.
records.zomi: Saya te' khasum pen mipi sum pan a hong pai hi.

records.english: Where does the hospital's money come from?
records.zomi: Damlo inn' sum koi pan a hong pai hiam?

records.english: Most of it comes from the government's health budget, which is set every year.
records.zomi: A tam zaw pen kum simin a kikoih ukpi' cidamna sum zat ngimna pan a hong pai hi.

records.english: Workers at the council office must follow strict rules when they spend public money.
records.zomi: Council office-a nasemte in mipi sum a zat uh ciangin thukham khauh te a zui ding uh hi.

records.english: Students who practise making budget decisions learn that every choice has consequences.
records.zomi: Sum zat ngimna thukhensatna bawl a kisin sangnaupangte in teelna khatciat in a suakna a nei hi, cih a sin uh hi.

records.english: Many people only notice public budgets when a service they rely on is cut.
records.zomi: Mi tampi in a kinga uh nasep khat a kiat ciangin bek mipi sum zat ngimna te a phawk uh hi.

records.english: The research project was cancelled when the government cut funding for science.
records.zomi: Ukpi in pilna adingin sum piakna a kiat ciangin sui-sinna nasep a kinusia hi.

records.english: Sharing resources between schools and services can stretch limited public money further.
records.zomi: Sang te leh nasep te kikal-ah van hawm in mipi sum tawmno a sau zaw-in a zat theih sak hi.

records.english: The hospital's budget pays for equipment, medicines and the staff who work on every ward.
records.zomi: Damlo inn' sum zat ngimna in van, damdawi leh dawhmun khempeuh-a nasem nasemte a pia hi.

records.english: Budget cuts often affect the most vulnerable people first, which is why they are so hotly debated.
records.zomi: Sum zat ngimna kiatna te in a haksa pen mite a masa-in a khawng zel a, tua ahih manin a kinial mahmah zel hi.

records.english: Saving money in one service can increase costs in another, so budgets must be planned as a whole.
records.zomi: Nasep khat-ah sum kem in nasep dang khat-ah man a khan sak thei a, tua ahih manin sum zat ngimna te a buppi-in a kingim ding hi.

records.english: Why did the college close the evening language course?
records.zomi: Bang hangin college in nitak lam pau sinna a khak hiam?

records.english: Its funding was cut, and the fees alone couldn't cover the cost of the teachers.
records.zomi: A sum piakna a kiat a, sangkah man bek in saya te' man a dawng zo kei hi.

records.english: The council publishes its budget online.
records.zomi: Council in a sum zat ngimna online-ah a suah hi.

records.english: Could the student union ask the university to publish how it spends tuition fees?
records.zomi: Sangnaupang pawl in university kiangah sangkah man bangci a zang hiam cih suah dingin a ngen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Why do some councils spend more on roads while others spend more on schools?
records.zomi: Bang hangin council khenkhat in lampi-ah sum tam zaw a zang a, a dangte in sang-ah a zang tam zaw uh hiam?

records.english: Does the hospital need more money for nurses?
records.zomi: Damlo inn in nurse te adingin sum tam zaw a kisam hiam?

records.english: The library budget was cut again.
records.zomi: Laibu inn' sum zat ngimna a kiat kik hi.

records.english: Our department saved money by sharing equipment with the school across the road.
records.zomi: I khen in lampi galkhat-a sang tawh van hawm-in sum a kem hi.

records.english: Our teacher showed us the council's budget.
records.zomi: I saya in council' sum zat ngimna hong lak hi.

records.english: Who pays for the new library books?
records.zomi: Laibu inn' laibu thak te man kua in a pia hiam?

records.english: The fire service's new budget included money for training volunteers in rural areas.
records.zomi: Mei sihna nasep' sum zat ngimna thak in khuaneu te-a thalawp te hilh nadingin sum a hel hi.

records.english: The fire station got new equipment.
records.zomi: Mei sihna mun in van thak te a ngah hi.

records.english: Our economics teacher gave each group a pretend town budget and a list of services to fund.
records.zomi: I sum leh van sinna saya in pawl khatciat kiangah khuapi sum zat ngimna kibawl khat leh sum piak ding nasep te' lista khat a pia hi.

records.english: We argued for an hour about whether to cut the swimming pool or the late-night buses.
records.zomi: Tuipeek mun ahih kei leh zanlai bus te i kiat ding hiam cih tawh kisai hun khat sung i kinial uh hi.

records.english: By the end, we understood why real councillors find budget decisions so difficult.
records.zomi: A tawpna-ah council mi taktak te in sum zat ngimna thukhensatna a haksa sa mahmah uh hiam cih i theisiam hi.

records.english: Our school's governors meet every term to check that the budget is being spent wisely.
records.zomi: I sang' makai pawl in sum zat ngimna a pil takin kizang hiam cih en dingin sangkah hun simin a kikhawm uh hi.

records.english: Why can't our school buy new computers this year?
records.zomi: Bang hangin hih kum-in i sang in computer thak a lei thei kei hiam?

records.english: The budget from the council is smaller, so the money is needed for teachers' salaries first.
records.zomi: Council pan sum zat ngimna a neu zaw ahih manin sum pen saya te' khasum-ah a masa-in a kisam hi.

records.english: When councils publish their budgets clearly, residents can ask better questions about priorities.
records.zomi: Council te in a sum zat ngimna uh kician takin a suah uh ciangin a sung-a teng mite in a masa ding te tawh kisai dotna hoih zaw a dong thei uh hi.

records.english: Our business studies teacher showed us how a public budget is divided between different services.
records.zomi: I sumbawlna sinna saya in mipi sum zat ngimna khat nasep tuamtuam kikal-ah bangci a kikhen hiam cih hong lak hi.

records.english: Public budgets are as much about long-term planning as about this year's spending.
records.zomi: Mipi sum zat ngimna te pen hih kum-a sum zat bangin hun sau ngimna tawh zong a kisai hi.

records.english: Our manager explained the new budget.
records.zomi: I manager in sum zat ngimna thak a gen hi.

records.english: Schools and hospitals depend heavily on decisions made in government budgets.
records.zomi: Sang te leh damlo inn te in ukpi' sum zat ngimna-a thukhensatna te tungah a kinga mahmah uh hi.

records.english: Our office is cutting costs this year.
records.zomi: I office in hih kum-in man te a kiam sak hi.

records.english: Could our class look at the council's spending plans?
records.zomi: I sinna in council' sum zat ngimna te a en thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, the budget is published online, and we can look at it together in the next lesson.
records.zomi: Thei hi, sum zat ngimna online-ah a kisuah a, a zom sinna-ah i en khawm thei ding hi.

records.english: Who leads the dance class for older people?
records.zomi: Upa te' lamna sinna kua in a makai hiam?

records.english: Is there a group where carers can take a break and do something for themselves?
records.zomi: Kemtute in tawlngak-in amau' adingin na khat a bawl theih nading pawl khat a om hiam?

records.english: My doctor suggested an art class.
records.zomi: Ka siavuan in lim suai sinna khat hong gen hi.

records.english: The community centre's cooking class teaches healthy meals that are cheap and quick to make.
records.zomi: Khuasung inn lian' an huan sinna in man niam leh bawl manlang an hoih te a hilh hi.

records.english: The mosque runs a weekly football match that helps young men talk about their worries.
records.zomi: Muslim biakinn in tangval te a lungkhamna uh a gen theih nadingin kal simin football kimawlna khat a bawl hi.

records.english: Is there a free exercise class for people who feel stressed?
records.zomi: Lungsim gimna a kizak mite adingin pumpi sawlna sinna man om lo khat a om hiam?

records.english: Yes, the leisure centre runs a gentle movement class every Tuesday morning at no cost.
records.zomi: Om hi, kimawlna inn in Pithai ni zingsang simin man om lo-in pumpi sawlna nem sinna khat a bawl hi.

records.english: The pool has a quiet swim in the mornings.
records.zomi: Tuipeek mun in zingsang-in tuipeek dai hun a nei hi.

records.english: Can I bring my dog to the walking group?
records.zomi: Khekhawm pawl-ah ka ui ka paipih thei ding hiam?

records.english: When my anxiety got worse last winter, the health centre referred me to a choir that meets in the church hall.
records.zomi: Khuaphal bei-in ka lungsim lauhna a hoih lo semsem ciangin cidamna inn in biakinn inn lian-a kikhawm la sa pawl khat-ah hong sawl hi.

records.english: I was too nervous to sing at first, so I just sat at the back and listened.
records.zomi: A kipat-in la sa dingin ka lau lua ahih manin a nung lam-ah ka tu a, ka ngai bek hi.

records.english: Within a month, I was singing with everyone else, and the Tuesday rehearsals became the best part of my week.
records.zomi: Kha khat sungin mi dang khempeuh tawh la ka sa a, Pithai ni la sinna te ka kal sung-a hun hoih pen a suak hi.

records.english: Can I join the knitting group at the library?
records.zomi: Laibu inn-a khau pheh pawl-ah ka kihel thei ding hiam?

records.english: Does the park have a walking group on Sundays?
records.zomi: Park in Nipini simin khekhawm pawl khat a nei hiam?

records.english: The community garden helps me relax.
records.zomi: Khuasung huan in hong tawlngak sak hi.

records.english: Our church has a quiet prayer room.
records.zomi: I biakinn in thu ngetna inndan dai khat a nei hi.

records.english: Why did my doctor suggest the walking group instead of more tablets?
records.zomi: Bang hangin ka siavuan in damdawi tang behlap sangin khekhawm pawl a gen hiam?

records.english: Regular walks with others can lift your mood and help you sleep, and they have no side effects.
records.zomi: Midangte tawh kalsuan den in na lungsim a lungdam sak a, na ihmut a huh a, a lawhna hoih lo zong a om kei hi.

records.english: Could the leisure centre offer cheaper sessions for people on low incomes?
records.zomi: Kimawlna inn in sum ngah tawm mite adingin man niam zaw kikhopna te a bawl thei ding hiam?

records.english: Free or low-cost activities make healthy coping practices available to everyone, not only those who can afford them.
records.zomi: Man om lo ahih kei leh man niam nasep te in cidamna-a thuakzawh dan te a pia zo bek hi lo-in mi khempeuh adingin a om sak hi.

records.english: The walking group stops for tea halfway, which gives people time to chat.
records.zomi: Khekhawm pawl in a kikal-ah lapha dawn dingin a khawl a, tua in mite kiho theihna hun a pia hi.

records.english: The youth club runs football on Friday nights.
records.zomi: Tangvalte pawl in Laithai ni zan simin football a bawl hi.

records.english: Healthy coping is easier when there are welcoming places to go outside home and work.
records.zomi: Inn leh nasepna mun pua-ah pai ding mun kidawn nuam te a om ciangin cidamna-a thuakzawh a baih zaw hi.

records.english: Our council funds free swimming lessons for adults who want a healthier way to cope with stress.
records.zomi: I council in lungsim gimna a thuak zawh nading lampi hoih zaw a deih upa te adingin tuipeek sinna man om lo a pia hi.

records.english: How can the community centre help people who cope with stress by drinking too much?

records.english: It can offer alcohol-free social evenings, link people to support groups and make it easy to ask for help without shame.
records.zomi: Zu om lo kikhopna nitak te a bawl thei a, mite huhna pawl te tawh a kizom sak thei a, zahpih lo-in huhna ngen a baih sak thei hi.

records.english: The men's shed meets in the old garage.
records.zomi: Pasal upa te' nasepna inn pen garage lui sungah a kikhawm hi.

records.english: Is the meditation group free?
records.zomi: Lungsim ngaihsut daina pawl pen a man om lo hiam?

records.english: Through social prescribing, doctors can point patients towards local groups that improve both mental and physical health.
records.zomi: Siavuan te in khuasung pawl lamlakna tungtawn-in damlo te lungsim leh pumpi cidamna tuak a hoih sak khuasung pawl te-ah a lamlak thei uh hi.

records.english: The bowling club welcomes new members.
records.zomi: Bowling pawl in member thak te a dawn hi.

records.english: Our library started a board games evening for people who feel lonely after work.
records.zomi: I laibu inn in nasep khit-a a khat bek bangin a kizak mite adingin kimawlna nitak khat a kipan hi.

records.english: The cycling group rides every Saturday.
records.zomi: Siiksakol pawl in Kiginni simin a tuang uh hi.

records.english: Alcohol-free social events offer an alternative for people who want to cut down on drinking.
records.zomi: Zu om lo kikhopna te in zu dawnna kiam sak a deih mite adingin lampi dang khat a pia hi.

records.english: The leisure centre offers free swimming for carers.
records.zomi: Kimawlna inn in kemtute adingin tuipeek man om lo a pia hi.

records.english: Finding a healthy way to cope is often about trying several activities until one feels right.
records.zomi: Thuakzawh nading lampi hoih khat muh pen a kituak khat a mu ma-in nasep tuamtuam sitna ahi zel hi.

records.english: Is the museum free on Wednesday afternoons?
records.zomi: Nilai ni nitak lam-in museum pen a man om lo hiam?

records.english: The bike repair workshop at the youth centre gives teenagers a sense of achievement.
records.zomi: Tangvalte inn-a siiksakol bawlphatna sinna in naupang lianno te zawhna lungsim a pia hi.

records.english: When local services fund wellbeing activities, they often reduce pressure on health services later.
records.zomi: Khuasung nasep te in cidamna nasep te sum a piak uh ciangin a nunung-in cidamna nasep te tunga puakgik a kiam sak zel uh hi.

records.english: The health centre's social prescribing worker connects patients with local clubs and activities.
records.zomi: Cidamna inn' khuasung pawl lamlak nasempa in damlo te khuasung pawl leh nasep te tawh a kizom sak hi.

records.english: The community café serves free tea on Mondays.
records.zomi: Khuasung cafe in Pizing ni simin lapha man om lo a pia hi.

records.english: Community activities give people healthy ways to cope with stress while making new friends.
records.zomi: Khuasung nasep te in mite lawm thak a ngah laitak uh-in lungsim gimna thuak zawh nading lampi hoih te a pia hi.

records.english: The library lends out musical instruments so that people can try a new hobby for free.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in mite in man om lo-in nuamsakna thak a sit theih nadingin la tumna van te a puk hi.

records.english: The parish runs a quiet afternoon once a month for anyone who needs rest and reflection.
records.zomi: Biakinn pawl in tawlngakna leh ngaihsutna a kisam mi khempeuh adingin kha khat-ah vei khat nitak lam dai khat a bawl hi.

records.english: The library has books about sleep.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in ihmut tawh kisai laibu te a nei hi.

records.english: When does the choir meet?
records.zomi: La sa pawl ciang-in a kikhawm hiam?

records.english: The allotment society has spare plots.
records.zomi: Huan neu pawl in huan mun a lawn te a nei hi.

records.english: Is the yoga class suitable for beginners?
records.zomi: Yoga sinna pen a kipan mi thak te adingin a kituak hiam?

records.english: Groups that welcome beginners help people feel confident enough to try something new.
records.zomi: A kipan mi thak te a dawn pawl te in mite na thak khat a sit nadingin hanna a pia hi.

records.english: Why do so many doctors now recommend outdoor activities for stress?
records.zomi: Bang hangin siavuan tampi in tu-in lungsim gimna adingin pua-a nasep te a gen uh hiam?

records.english: The local art group welcomes people of any skill level, because the aim is to relax, not to compete.
records.zomi: Khuasung lim suai pawl in siamna bangzah a nei mi khempeuh a dawn a, bang hang hiam cih leh a ngim pen tawlngak ding ahi a, kidemna hi lo hi.

records.english: Gardening, singing and walking are simple activities that many people find surprisingly calming.
records.zomi: Huan nasep, la sak leh kalsuan pen mi tampi in a lamdang takin a lungsim a nem sakna nasep baih te ahi hi.

records.english: Activities that combine movement and conversation can be especially helpful for people who feel isolated.
records.zomi: Pumpi sawlna leh kikupna a kihel nasep te in a khat bek bangin a kizak mite adingin a phattuam mahmah thei hi.

records.english: Volunteering can give people purpose and connection during difficult periods of their lives.
records.zomi: Thalawp nasep in mite a nuntakna uh hun haksa sungin ngimna leh kizopna a pia thei hi.

records.english: Libraries and community centres play a growing role in supporting residents' wellbeing.
records.zomi: Laibu inn te leh khuasung inn lian te in a sung-a teng mite' cidamna huh-ah na thupi semsem a sem uh hi.

records.english: The community garden gives people with anxiety a calm place to work with their hands.
records.zomi: Khuasung huan in lungsim lauhna a nei mite a khut uh tawh nasep a sem theih nadingin mun dai khat a pia hi.

records.english: Can I join the community garden if I've never grown anything?
records.zomi: Bangmah ka suan ngei kei a hih leh khuasung huan-ah ka kihel thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, and the volunteers will show you everything.
records.zomi: Thei hi, thalawp te in na khempeuh hong lak ding uh hi.

records.english: Volunteering at the animal shelter helps my neighbour cope with the loss of her husband.
records.zomi: Ganhing kemna inn-a thalawp nasep in ka inn kiang mi a pasal sihna a thuak zawh nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Does the library run any relaxing activities for adults?
records.zomi: Laibu inn in upa te adingin tawlngakna nasep khatpeuh a bawl hiam?

records.english: There's a colouring and conversation group on Thursdays, and a reading circle on Saturdays.

records.english: Could I ask the bus company whether the community group can put a bench at the stop?

records.english: Would the neighbours mind if we used their wall for the climbing roses?

records.english: May I keep my bag behind the counter?
records.zomi: Ka ip dawhkan nung-ah ka koih thei ding hiam?

records.english: A polite request with a time limit is easier to accept than an open-ended one.
records.zomi: Hun ciang nei zahtak taka ngetna khat pen hun ciang om lo ngetna sangin san a baih zaw hi.

records.english: Asking permission shows respect for shared spaces, even when the answer seems obvious.
