records.english: What would you like to achieve before you turn forty?
records.zomi: Kum sawm li na phak ma-in bang tun na deih hiam?

records.english: Asking what someone hopes to do can reveal ambitions they rarely talk about.
records.zomi: Mi khat bang a bawl dingin a lamen hiam cih dot in a gen tawm a ngimna te a lak thei hi.

records.english: What would make you decide to move abroad?
records.zomi: Bang in gamdang-ah tai dingin hong khensat sak ding hiam?

records.english: Asking what will happen to old buildings helps communities protect their heritage.
records.zomi: Inn lui te bang a suak ding uh hiam cih dot in khuasung te in a ngeina lui uh a kem nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Young people's answers about their future careers often change many times.
records.zomi: Khangno te' hun ding nasep tawh kisai dawnna te vei tampi a kikhek zel hi.

records.english: Questions about retirement plans can start important conversations within families.
records.zomi: Nasep khawl khit-a ciamteh tawh kisai dotna te in innkuan sungah kikumna thupi te a kipatsak thei hi.

records.english: What are you doing next weekend?
records.zomi: A zom kal tawp-in bang na bawl ding hiam?

records.english: Questions about future plans help people think about what matters to them.
records.zomi: Hun ding ciamteh tawh kisai dotna te in mite amau adingin bang a thupi hiam cih a ngaihsut nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Community celebrations can turn an official ceremony into a shared local event.
records.zomi: Khuasung pawi te in official kikhopna khat khuasung-a kihawm pawi khat-ah a khek thei hi.

records.english: My neighbour's children made a banner to welcome her home after her ceremony.
records.zomi: Ka inn kiang mi nu a kikhopna khit-in inn-ah a ciah ciangin a ta te in amah dawn dingin puan-lai khat a bawl uh hi.

records.english: Warnings about unofficial websites protect applicants from unnecessary fees.
records.zomi: Official hi lo website te tawh kisai vaihawmna te in ngenmi te man kisam lo pan a kem hi.

records.english: When my application was delayed, the advice centre helped me write a polite letter asking for an update.
records.zomi: Ka ngetna a nawh ciangin, thuhilhna inn in thuthak ngen dingin zahtak huai lai khat gelh dingin hong huh hi.

records.english: Clear information about fees and documents reduces mistakes in applications.
records.zomi: Man leh lai te tawh kisai thu kician te in ngetna te-a khialhna te a niam sak hi.

records.english: Several community groups set up stalls at the ceremony to introduce local clubs to new citizens.

records.english: Can I borrow a practice test?

records.english: The advice centre warned us about websites that charge for forms that are free from the government.

records.english: The local college offers a language course that meets the level needed for citizenship.

records.english: Could the community centre run the practice class on Saturdays for people who work weekdays?

records.english: Why does the advice centre suggest getting a qualified adviser for some citizenship cases?
records.zomi: Gam mi suahna thu pawlkhat adingin thuhilhna inn in thuhilhmi siam khat zong dingin bang hangin a hanthawn hiam?

records.english: Cases with long absences or past convictions can be complicated, and a mistake on the form can cost the fee.
records.zomi: Hun sawtpi a om lo thu ahih kei leh nidang-a thukhenna a nei thu te a haksa thei a, lai lak-a khialhna khat in a man a mansuah sak thei hi.

records.english: Can the library help me prepare for the citizenship test?
records.zomi: Gam mi suahna sittelna adingin kiginkhol nadingin laibu inn in hong huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: Yes, there's a free practice class every Monday evening in the reading room.
records.zomi: Hi, Pizing ni nitak khempeuh-in laisimna inn-ah a man om lo sinna kilawh khat a om hi.

records.english: Do I need an appointment at the advice centre?
records.zomi: Thuhilhna inn-ah kihona hun ka kisam hiam?

records.english: The council's welcome pack for new citizens explains how to register to vote.
records.zomi: Mi thak te adingin council' dawnna lai in vote dingin min bangci a kiseh hiam cih a gen hi.

records.english: Why do some councils hold citizenship ceremonies in schools or museums?
records.zomi: Council pawlkhat in gam mi suahna kikhopna te sang ahih kei leh museum te-ah bang hangin a bawl uh hiam?

records.english: How many guests may come to the ceremony?
records.zomi: Kikhopna-ah zin mi bangzah a hong thei uh hiam?

records.english: Is there help with the language test?
records.zomi: Pau sittelna adingin huhna a om hiam?

records.english: Advice on registering to vote helps new citizens use their rights straight away.
records.zomi: Vote dingin min seh tawh kisai thuhilhna in mi thak te a thuneihna uh pai pai-in a zat thei nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: The library's practice class includes questions about local history as well as national history.
records.zomi: Laibu inn' sinna kilawh in gam tangthu bek hi lo-in khuasung tangthu tawh kisai dotna te zong a hel hi.

records.english: Rules for citizenship applications differ widely between countries.
records.zomi: Gam mi suahna ngetna adingin thukham te gam khat leh khat kikal-ah a kibang lo mahmah hi.

records.english: Public services that welcome new citizens strengthen trust between communities and institutions.
records.zomi: Mi thak te a dawn mipi nasepna te in khuasung te leh pawlpi te kikal-ah muanna a khauh sak hi.

records.english: Where can I find out the date of the next citizenship ceremony?
records.zomi: A zom gam mi suahna kikhopna' ni bang ahi hiam cih koi-ah ka thei thei ding hiam?

records.english: The council's website lists the dates, and the town hall can tell you by phone.
records.zomi: Council' website-ah ni te a kigelh a, khuapi inn in phone tawh hong gen thei hi.

records.english: Who signs the citizenship form?
records.zomi: Gam mi suahna lai lak-ah kua in khut a ngap ding hiam?

records.english: Is the practice class free?
records.zomi: Sinna kilawh a man om lo hiam?

records.english: When my neighbour decided to apply for citizenship, she was worried about the cost of the application.
records.zomi: Ka inn kiang mi nu in gam mi suahna nget dingin a khensat ciangin, ngetna man tawh kisai a lunghimawh hi.

records.english: A volunteer at the advice centre helped her find out whether she qualified for a reduced fee and checked her documents.

records.english: Six months later, our street held a small party for her on the evening after her ceremony.

records.english: Does the community centre check citizenship forms?
records.zomi: Khuasung inn in gam mi suahna lai lak te a et hiam?

records.english: A trained volunteer looks over forms on Thursday mornings, but they can't give legal advice.
records.zomi: Laizing ni zingsang te-in kisinsak thalawp khat in lai lak te a et a, ahi zongin thukham thuhilhna a pia thei kei hi.

records.english: The mayor spoke at the ceremony.
records.zomi: Khuapi ukpa in kikhopna-ah thu a gen hi.

records.english: Free practice classes reduce anxiety about citizenship tests.
records.zomi: A man om lo sinna kilawh te in gam mi suahna sittelna tawh kisai lunghimawhna a niam sak hi.

records.english: Accessible ceremonies show that citizenship belongs equally to people with disabilities.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh in a tel thei kikhopna te in gam mi suahna pen pumpi haksatna nei mite adingin zong a kibang-in ahi hi cih a lak hi.

records.english: Why did the council start inviting local groups to its citizenship ceremonies?
records.zomi: Council in a gam mi suahna kikhopna te-ah khuasung pawl te bang hangin a sap kipan hiam?

records.english: New citizens said they felt welcomed by officials but still didn't know anyone in the community, so groups now come to say hello.
records.zomi: Mi thak te in vaihawmmi te in a dawn uh hi a ci uh hangin khuasung-ah kua mah a thei kei uh hi a ci uh ahih manin, tu-in pawl te cibai buk dingin a hong uh hi.

records.english: Where is the citizenship ceremony held?
records.zomi: Gam mi suahna kikhopna koi-ah a kibawl hiam?

records.english: How can I find a registered adviser who specialises in citizenship applications?
records.zomi: Gam mi suahna ngetna-ah a siam min seh thuhilhmi khat bangci ka mu thei ding hiam?

records.english: The ceremony starts at eleven.
records.zomi: Kikhopna in nai sawm leh khat-in a kipan hi.

records.english: The council sent me the ceremony date.
records.zomi: Council in kikhopna ni hong khak hi.

records.english: Libraries and community centres make citizenship preparation accessible to more residents.
records.zomi: Laibu inn te leh khuasung inn te in gam mi suahna kiginkholhna mi tam zaw adingin a ngah thei sak hi.

records.english: Our church organises a lunch after each citizenship ceremony for anyone who wants to join.
records.zomi: I biakinn in gam mi suahna kikhopna khat khit ciangin tel nuam mi khempeuh adingin sun an a bawl zel hi.

records.english: The library lends tablets so that residents can practise the citizenship test online.
records.zomi: Mite in online-ah gam mi suahna sittelna a kisin thei nadingin laibu inn in tablet te a puksak hi.

records.english: My neighbour passed the test last week.
records.zomi: Ka inn kiang mi nu in kal bei-ah sittelna a zo hi.

records.english: A volunteer spotted a missing signature on my form.
records.zomi: Thalawp khat in ka lai lak-ah khut ngapna khat a kiam cih a mu hi.

records.english: The college runs a citizenship course.
records.zomi: College in gam mi suahna sinna khat a bawl hi.

records.english: The church held a party for new citizens.
records.zomi: Biakinn in mi thak te adingin pawi khat a bawl hi.

records.english: Ceremonies that involve local groups help new citizens feel part of their community.
records.zomi: Khuasung pawl te a hel kikhopna te in mi thak te amau' khuasung' khen khat ahi uh hi cih a kizak nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: My form needs a passport photo.
records.zomi: Ka lai lak in passport lim khat a kisam hi.

records.english: Why does the Spirit give different gifts?
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho in hehpihna tuamtuam bang hangin a pia hiam?

records.english: Does the Spirit help us forgive?
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho in i maisak nadingin hong huh hiam?

records.english: My little girl prayed for her sick friend.
records.zomi: Ka tanu neu in a natna a nei lawm adingin thu a ngen hi.

records.english: My daughter asked the Spirit for courage.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in Kha Siangtho kiangah hangsanna a ngen hi.

records.english: Family stories of reconciliation are often seen by believers as the work of the Spirit.
records.zomi: Innkuan kilemna tangthu te up mite in Kha Siangtho' nasep ahi hi ci-in a ngaihsun zel uh hi.

records.english: How did you know the Holy Spirit was helping you after Dad died?
records.zomi: Paa a sih khit-in Kha Siangtho in hong huh hi cih bangci na thei hiam?

records.english: I felt a quiet strength each morning that I couldn't explain, and I believe it came from the Spirit.
records.zomi: Zingsang khempeuh-in ka gen thei lo dai taka hatna khat ka zak a, tua pen Kha Siangtho pan a hong pai hi ka um hi.

records.english: Our teenager said that she felt the Spirit's comfort during a hard week at school.
records.zomi: I khangno nu in sang-ah kal haksa khat sungin Kha Siangtho' hehnemna a zak hi, a ci hi.

records.english: Christian parents often teach children that the Spirit helps them be kind and honest.
records.zomi: Khazih nu leh pa te in Kha Siangtho in hehpih leh thudik a gen thei nadingun a huh hi ci-in a ta te a hilh zel uh hi.

records.english: Grandpa reads Galatians every Sunday evening.
records.zomi: Pu in Nipini nitak khempeuh-in Galati laibu a sim hi.

records.english: Grandma prays for the Spirit's comfort.
records.zomi: Pi in Kha Siangtho' hehnemna adingin thu a ngen hi.

records.english: Did you pray before your exam, son?
records.zomi: Ka tapa, na sittelna ma-in thu na ngen hiam?

records.english: Does praying make you feel calmer, Mum?
records.zomi: Nu, thu ngetna in na lungsim a nem sak hiam?

records.english: My son learned about the fruit of the Spirit.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in Kha Siangtho gah tawh kisai a sin hi.

records.english: When my brother and I stopped speaking after an argument, our mother asked the whole family to pray for us.
records.zomi: Ka unau pasal leh kei i kiteel khit-in i kiho nawn lo ciangin, ka nu in innkuan bup in eite adingin thu ngen dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: Months later, I found myself wanting to call him, and I believed that the Holy Spirit had softened my heart.
records.zomi: Kha tampi khit-in, amah sam ka nuam a, Kha Siangtho in ka lungsim a nem sak hi ka um hi.

records.english: We met for coffee that week, and at Christmas our mother said that her prayers had been answered.
records.zomi: Tua kal-in coffee dawn dingin i kimu uh a, Christmas-in ka nu in a thungetna te a kidawng hi, a ci hi.

records.english: My mother prays that the Spirit will keep our family united, even though we live in different countries.
records.zomi: Gam tuamtuam-ah i om hangin, Kha Siangtho in i innkuan a kipumkhat sak dingin ka nu in thu a ngen hi.

records.english: My father says that the Spirit helped him stop drinking and become a better husband.
records.zomi: Zu dawn a khawl nadingin leh pasal hoih zaw khat a suak nadingin Kha Siangtho in hong huh hi, ci-in ka pa in a gen hi.

records.english: My wife believes that her gift of hospitality is a gift from the Holy Spirit.
records.zomi: Ka zi in a zin mi dawn siamna pen Kha Siangtho' letsong ahi hi ci-in a um hi.

records.english: Do your children know what Christians mean by the fruit of the Spirit?
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho gah ci-in Khazih mite in bang a ci nopna uh hiam cih na ta te in a thei uh hiam?

records.english: For many Christians, the Spirit's comfort is most deeply felt during grief.
records.zomi: Khazih mi tampi adingin, Kha Siangtho' hehnemna pen dah lai-in a thuk pen-in a kizak hi.

records.english: How do you explain to a child that the Spirit can help them be patient?
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho in thuakzawhna a nei thei nadingin a huh thei hi cih naupang khat kiangah bangci na hilh ding hiam?

records.english: For many believers, changes in a loved one's character are signs of the Spirit at work.
records.zomi: Up mi tampi adingin, a it mi khat' lungsim omdan khekna te pen Kha Siangtho a sep laitak cih lahna ahi hi.

records.english: Christians believe that the Spirit produces love, joy, peace and patience in believers' lives.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Kha Siangtho in up mite' nuntakna-ah itna, lungdamna, kilemna leh thuakzawhna a piangsak hi ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: When my son was afraid of starting a new school, we prayed together for the Spirit's courage.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in sang thak kipat a lau ciangin, Kha Siangtho' hangsanna adingin khawm-in thu i ngen uh hi.

records.english: Mum, what does the Holy Spirit do?
records.zomi: Nu, Kha Siangtho in bang a sem hiam?

records.english: Christians believe the Spirit comforts us, helps us pray and teaches us to love others.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Kha Siangtho in hong hehnem a, thu i nget nadingin hong huh a, mi dang te i it nadingin hong sinsak hi ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Every Pentecost, our family writes down one way the Spirit has helped each of us during the year.
records.zomi: Pentecost khempeuh-in, i innkuan in kum sung-in Kha Siangtho in i khat ciat hong huhna lampi khat a gelh uh hi.

records.english: We pray for Auntie's healing.
records.zomi: Ni' damna adingin thu i ngen uh hi.

records.english: Why does our family believe the Spirit is working in Uncle's life now?
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho in Pa Neu' nuntakna-ah tu-in a sem hi ci-in i innkuan in bang hangin a um uh hiam?

records.english: He used to be angry and bitter, but over the past few years he has become gentle, forgiving and generous, which we see as the Spirit's fruit.
records.zomi: Nidang-in a heh baih a, a lungsim a khah hi, ahi zongin kum tawm khat sungin a nem a, a maisak baih a, a pia nuam mi a suak a, tua pen Kha Siangtho' gah ahi hi ci-in i mu uh hi.

records.english: Why do we pray to the Spirit before family meetings?
records.zomi: Innkuan kikhopna ma-in Kha Siangtho kiangah bang hangin thu i ngen uh hiam?

records.english: Our family believes the Spirit can give us wisdom and patience when we have to decide something together.
records.zomi: Khawm-in bangmah khat i khensat kul ciangin Kha Siangtho in pilna leh thuakzawhna hong pia thei hi ci-in i innkuan in a um uh hi.

records.english: Why do Christians believe the Spirit helps them understand the Bible?
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Kha Siangtho in Lai Siangtho a theih nadingin a huh hi ci-in bang hangin a um uh hiam?

records.english: Our family prays before long journeys.
records.zomi: I innkuan in khualzinna sau te ma-in thu a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Will the Spirit help me stop shouting at my sister?
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu tungah ging taka ka kikou khawl nadingin Kha Siangtho in hong huh ding hiam?

records.english: After the family argument, my grandfather prayed that the Spirit would bring peace to the house.
records.zomi: Innkuan kiteelna khit-in, Kha Siangtho in inn sungah kilemna a tun nadingin ka pu in thu a ngen hi.

records.english: Many Christians see their talents for serving others as gifts from the Spirit.
records.zomi: Khazih mi tampi in mi dang te a nasep sak nadingin a siamna te uh Kha Siangtho' letsong ahi hi ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi.

records.english: Dad says the Spirit gives him patience.
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho in thuakzawhna hong pia hi, ci-in Paa in a gen hi.

records.english: When our daughter apologised to her sister without being asked, we thanked God for the Spirit's work.
records.zomi: I tanu in kua mah in a sawl lo-in a sanggam nu kiangah maisakna a ngen ciangin, Kha Siangtho' nasep adingin Pasian kiangah lungdam i ko uh hi.

records.english: My aunt believes that the Spirit led her to the job where she met her husband.
records.zomi: Ka ni in a pasal a mu nasepna-ah Kha Siangtho in a paipih hi ci-in a um hi.

records.english: Could we ask the Spirit to guide us before we decide whether to move house?
records.zomi: Inn tai ding hiam cih i khensat ma-in Kha Siangtho in hong lamlak dingin i ngen thei ding uh hiam?

records.english: Does the Holy Spirit help Grandpa when he's in pain?
records.zomi: Pu a nat ciangin Kha Siangtho in a huh hiam?

records.english: Grandpa says the Spirit gives him peace, even on the days when his back hurts most.
records.zomi: A nungzang a nat pen ni te-in zong Kha Siangtho in lungmuanna hong pia hi, ci-in Pu in a gen hi.

records.english: Grandma says the Spirit is her helper.
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho pen ka Huhpa ahi hi, ci-in Pi in a gen hi.

records.english: Our family prays for the Spirit's comfort whenever someone we love is in hospital.
records.zomi: I it mi khat damdawi inn-ah a om ciangin i innkuan in Kha Siangtho' hehnemna adingin thu a ngen zel uh hi.

records.english: My grandmother believes the Holy Spirit gave her the strength to raise six children alone.
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho in amah bekin ta guk a vak nadingin hatna a pia hi ci-in ka pi in a um hi.

records.english: Family prayers for courage and wisdom reflect trust in the Spirit's help.
records.zomi: Hangsanna leh pilna adingin innkuan thungetna te in Kha Siangtho' huhna a muanna a lak hi.

records.english: Dad asks the Spirit for wisdom at work.
records.zomi: Paa in nasepna-ah pilna adingin Kha Siangtho kiangah a ngen hi.

records.english: Mum bakes a dove-shaped loaf at Pentecost.
records.zomi: Pentecost-in Nu in vakhu lim mot khat a em hi.

records.english: Many Christian families pray for the Holy Spirit's guidance in everyday decisions.
records.zomi: Khazih innkuan tampi in ni sim khensatna te-ah Kha Siangtho' lamlahna adingin thu a ngen uh hi.

records.english: My uncle says the Spirit gave him the words to speak at his father's funeral.
records.zomi: A pa' misi vuina-ah a gen nading kammal te Kha Siangtho in a pia hi, ci-in ka pa neu in a gen hi.

records.english: Our choir practises the Pentecost hymn at home.
records.zomi: I la sakna pawl in Pentecost la inn-ah a kisin uh hi.

records.english: Where shall we put the new sofa?
records.zomi: Sofa thak koi-ah i koih ding uh hiam?

records.english: Asking where a community will build new services helps residents take part in planning.
records.zomi: Khuasung in nasepna thak te koi-ah a lam ding hiam cih dot in mite ciamtehna-ah a tel thei nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Where are they building the hospital?
records.zomi: Damdawi inn koi-ah a lam uh hiam?

records.english: Where will the church meet while the roof is being repaired?
records.zomi: Inn tung a kibawlphat lai-in biakinn koi-ah a kikhawm ding hiam?

records.english: Where will we stay in the city?
records.zomi: Khuapi-ah koi-ah i om ding uh hiam?

records.english: Where are you hoping your son will go to university?
records.zomi: Na tapa koi university-ah a pai dingin na lamen hiam?

records.english: Where are we meeting tomorrow?
records.zomi: Zingciang koi-ah i kimu ding uh hiam?

records.english: Where do you want to open your shop?
records.zomi: Na dawr koi-ah hon na deih hiam?

records.english: Where are you planning to retire?
records.zomi: Nasep na khawl khit-in koi-ah om dingin na ciamteh hiam?

records.english: Talking openly about where to go next can turn an uncertain future into a shared plan.
records.zomi: A zom-ah koi-ah pai ding hiam cih kiphong takin kikum in hun ding kician lo khat kihawm ciamteh khat-ah a khek thei hi.

records.english: Where will you work next year?
records.zomi: A zom kum-in koi-ah na sem ding hiam?

records.english: Where are you going to put all your books when you move into the small flat?
records.zomi: Inn neu sungah na tai ciangin na laibu khempeuh koi-ah na koih ding hiam?

records.english: Where shall we go on Sunday?
records.zomi: Nipini-in koi-ah i pai ding uh hiam?

records.english: Questions about where people will live often reveal their hopes for the future.
records.zomi: Mite koi-ah a om ding uh hiam cih tawh kisai dotna te in hun ding adingin a lametna uh a lak zel hi.

records.english: Where are you moving to?
records.zomi: Koi-ah na tai ding hiam?

records.english: Where do you want to study?
records.zomi: Koi-ah sin na deih hiam?

records.english: Where are you going after work?
records.zomi: Nasep khit-in koi-ah na pai ding hiam?

records.english: Asking where elderly relatives will live is an important part of family planning.
records.zomi: Upa sanggam te koi-ah a om ding uh hiam cih dot pen innkuan ciamtehna-ah khen thupi khat ahi hi.

records.english: Where will the concert be held?
records.zomi: Concert koi-ah a kibawl ding hiam?

records.english: Plans about where to retire often reflect childhood memories of a place.
records.zomi: Nasep khawl khit-a koi-ah om ding hiam cih ciamteh te in naupan lai-a mun khat phawkna te a lak zel hi.

records.english: Where should we take the visitors from abroad next month?
records.zomi: A zom kha-in gamdang pan hong pai zin mi te koi-ah i paipih ding uh hiam?

records.english: Where would you go if you could take a whole year off?
records.zomi: Kum khat bup tawlngak na lak thei leh koi-ah na pai ding hiam?

records.english: Where do you see yourself working in ten years?
records.zomi: Kum sawm sungin koi-ah na sem dingin na ngaihsun hiam?

records.english: Probably in a hospital in the capital, but I'd like to come back and open a clinic in our district one day.
records.zomi: Khuapi lian-a damdawi inn khat-ah ahi kha ding hi, ahi zongin ni khat-in hong ciah kik in i gam khen-ah damdawi inn neu khat hon ka nuam hi.

records.english: Where are you going to live after the wedding?
records.zomi: Mopawi khit-in koi-ah na om ding hiam?

records.english: We'll rent a small flat near my wife's school until we can afford a house.
records.zomi: Inn khat i lei zawh dong ka zi' sang kiangah inn neu khat i luak ding uh hi.

records.english: Which side of town will the new school be on?
records.zomi: Sang thak in khuapi' koi lam-ah a om ding hiam?

records.english: Where will the bus stop be moved to?
records.zomi: Bus khawlna koi-ah a kisuan ding hiam?

records.english: Where will your parents live when they can no longer manage the stairs?
records.zomi: Kahlei a kah zo nawn lo ciangin na nu leh pa koi-ah a om ding uh hiam?

records.english: Which corner of the park would suit a skate ramp for the teenagers?
records.zomi: Pawng koi kil in khangno te adingin skate ramp khat a kituak ding hiam?

records.english: Where might the family settle if your father's job moves abroad next year?
records.zomi: A zom kum-in na pa' nasep gamdang-ah a tai leh innkuan koi-ah a om ding uh hiam?

records.english: We're thinking about a town near the coast, where there are good schools and my aunt already lives with her children.
records.zomi: Tuipi gei kiang-a khuapi khat i ngaihsun uh hi, tua-ah sang hoih te a om a, ka ni zong a ta te tawh tua-ah a om khin hi.

records.english: Where will the baby sleep?
records.zomi: Naungek koi-ah a ihmu ding hiam?

records.english: Where new roads and markets are built can shape a town for generations.
records.zomi: Lampi thak leh sum-kuan mun thak te a kilamna mun in khuapi khat khang tampi sung a bawl thei hi.

records.english: Deciding where to settle usually involves balancing work, schools and family ties.
records.zomi: Koi-ah om ding hiam cih khensat pen nasep, sang leh innkuan kizopna te kibang takin a ngaihsut kul hi.

records.english: Where will the party be?
records.zomi: Pawi koi-ah ahi ding hiam?

records.english: Where might you go if the company closes its local office?
records.zomi: Company in khuasung office a khak leh koi-ah na pai ding hiam?

records.english: Where will the children go to school if we move to the city?
records.zomi: Khuapi-ah i tai leh naupang te koi sang-ah a pai ding uh hiam?

records.english: Families who discuss where they might move can prepare children for change.
records.zomi: Koi-ah a tai ding uh hiam cih a kikum innkuan te in naupang te khekna adingin a kiginsak thei uh hi.

records.english: Which site has the council chosen for the new market?
records.zomi: Sum-kuan mun thak adingin council in koi mun a teel hiam?

records.english: On the empty land beside the bus station, if the council approves the plan in May.
records.zomi: Bus khawlna inn kiang-a lei awng tungah, May kha-in council in ciamteh a phal leh.

records.english: Where would you live if you could choose?
records.zomi: Na teel thei leh koi-ah na om ding hiam?

records.english: Where are you planning to hold the youth conference next summer?
records.zomi: A zom khal hun-in khangno kikhopna koi-ah bawl dingin na ciamteh uh hiam?

records.english: Where shall we plant the apple tree?
records.zomi: Apple singkung koi-ah i suan ding uh hiam?

records.english: Where would be the best place for a second branch of your bakery?
records.zomi: Na mot bawlna dawr' a nihna adingin koi mun a hoih pen ding hiam?

records.english: Where do you think the family should hold Grandpa's ninetieth birthday?
records.zomi: Pu' kum sawm kua pianni innkuan in koi-ah a bawl ding hi, na ci hiam?

records.english: Where would you like to spend your first year of retirement?
records.zomi: Nasep na khawl kum masa pen koi-ah zat na deih hiam?

records.english: Where are you heading for the long weekend?
records.zomi: Kal tawp sau-in koi lam-ah na pai ding hiam?

records.english: Where are you hoping to find work once you finish your training?
records.zomi: Na sinna na zawh khit-in koi-ah nasep mu dingin na lamen hiam?

records.english: Young people's plans about where to study often change as they learn more about their options.
records.zomi: Koi-ah sin ding hiam cih tawh kisai khangno te' ciamteh te a teel theih te uh a theih beh ciangin a kikhek zel hi.

records.english: Which country is top of your travel list?
records.zomi: Na khualzin nop gam lista-ah koi gam a masa pen hiam?

records.english: Asking where someone sees themselves in the future encourages them to set goals.
records.zomi: Mi khat hun ding-ah koi-ah a om dingin a ngaihsun hiam cih dot in ngimna a seh nadingin a hanthawn hi.

records.english: When our landlord said he was selling the house, my wife and I sat down with a map to decide where to go next.
records.zomi: I inn neipa in inn a zuak ding hi a ci ciangin, a zom-ah koi-ah pai ding hiam cih khensat dingin ka zi leh kei gam lim khat tawh i tu uh hi.

records.english: We marked every neighbourhood within half an hour of our jobs and then crossed out the ones without a school nearby.
records.zomi: I nasep pan nai khen khat sung-a mun khempeuh i ciamteh uh a, tua khit-in a kiang-ah sang om lo te i khen uh hi.

records.english: In the end, only two places were left, and we chose the one closest to the river where the children love to play.
records.zomi: A tawp-in mun nih bek a om a, naupang te in a ngaih mahmah tuipi kiang-a mun i teel uh hi.

records.english: The choice of where to hold a celebration can matter as much as the celebration itself.
records.zomi: Pawi khat koi-ah bawl ding hiam cih teelna pen pawi mahmah tawh a kibang-in a thupi thei hi.

records.english: Where should the village build its new water tank?
records.zomi: Khua in a tui bawm thak koi-ah a lam ding hiam?

records.english: Possible moves abroad raise questions about language, work and belonging.
records.zomi: Gamdang-a tai thei te in pau, nasep leh kihelna tawh kisai dotna te a tun hi.

records.english: Where would you like to go for your sixtieth birthday?
records.zomi: Na kum sawm guk pianni-in koi-ah pai na deih hiam?

records.english: Back to the island where I was born, with all my children and grandchildren.
records.zomi: Ka pianna tuikulh-ah, ka ta te leh ka tu te khempeuh tawh ka ciah kik nuam hi.

records.english: My letter says I need an interview.
records.zomi: Ka lai in kidotna khat ka kisam hi a ci hi.

records.english: Clear deadlines in notices help residents respond correctly and on time.
records.zomi: Thu theisakna te-a hun ciang kician te in mite a dik takin leh hun takin a dawng thei nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: My neighbour nearly ignored a notice because she thought it was an advertisement.
records.zomi: Sumbawlna kiphongna ahi hi a ci ahih manin ka inn kiang mi nu in thu theisakna khat a pelh dek hi.

records.english: The centre copied my letter for me.
records.zomi: Inn in ka lai hong teh sak hi.

records.english: Community sessions show residents that they are not alone in finding letters confusing.
records.zomi: Khuasung kikhopna hun te in lai te a theih haksa mi a om bek lo uh hi cih mite a lak hi.

records.english: The volunteer showed me how to check whether a notice really came from the immigration office.
records.zomi: Thu theisakna khat gamdang mi omna office pan a hong tak hiam cih bangci et ding hiam cih thalawp in hong lak hi.

records.english: Advice centres help residents avoid missing deadlines in important letters.
records.zomi: Thuhilhna inn te in mite lai thupi te-a hun ciang a pelh lo nadingin a huh uh hi.

records.english: Our tenants' association asked the council to include a plain-language summary at the top of every notice.
records.zomi: I inn luak mite' pawl in thu theisakna khempeuh' a tung-ah pau baih tawh thukhupna tom khat koih dingin council a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Our church invited a legal adviser to explain the difference between a refusal and a request for more information.
records.zomi: I biakinn in nialna leh thu behlap ngetna kikal-a kibatloh na hilh dingin thukham thuhilhmi khat a sap hi.

records.english: Official notices can be difficult to understand even for fluent readers.
records.zomi: Kumpi thu theisakna te pen pau siam sim mite adingin zong a theih haksa thei hi.

records.english: Volunteers should know when to refer a notice to a qualified adviser.
records.zomi: Thalawp te in thu theisakna khat bang hun-in a siam thuhilhmi kiangah a pia ding uh hiam cih a thei ding uh hi.

records.english: Must I answer this notice in writing?
records.zomi: Hih thu theisakna gelh tawh ka dawn kul hiam?

records.english: Where do I send my reply?
records.zomi: Ka dawnna koi-ah ka khak ding hiam?

records.english: Does the library have a dictionary for official words?
records.zomi: Laibu inn in kumpi kammal te adingin kammal laibu a nei hiam?

records.english: We have a free leaflet that explains common terms used in government letters.
records.zomi: Kumpi lai te-a kizang kammal tam te a hilh man om lo lai-ek khat i nei uh hi.

records.english: The interpreter read the notice aloud in my language and then explained each part again slowly.
records.zomi: Pau letmi in ka pau-in thu theisakna ging taka a sim a, tua khit-in khen khat ciat zawi takin a hilh kik hi.

records.english: Explaining one term clearly can remove much of the fear a notice causes.
records.zomi: Kammal khat kician taka hilh in thu theisakna khat in a tun lauhna tampi a beisak thei hi.

records.english: What does "under review" mean on this notice?
records.zomi: Hih thu theisakna-ah "under review" in bang a ci nopna hiam?

records.english: Can you help me write a reply?
records.zomi: Dawnna khat gelh dingin hong huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: The library volunteer helped me write a polite email asking the office to explain one paragraph.
records.zomi: Laibu inn thalawp in office kiangah thu khen khat hilh dingin a ngen zahtak huai email khat ka gelh nadingin hong huh hi.

records.english: The volunteer read my notice with me.
records.zomi: Thalawp in ka thu theisakna kei tawh a sim hi.

records.english: Can I phone the office about this?
records.zomi: Hih tawh kisai office ka phone thei ding hiam?

records.english: Describing pain clearly helps doctors decide how urgently to act.

records.zomi: Damdawi dotna te' dawnna kician te in thu manlang nasem te natna nei mite a manlang zaw-in a en thei nadingin a huh hi.
