records.english: Yes, a Zomi parent has offered to visit and show the class how the family serves tea to elders.
records.zomi: Hi, Zomi nu leh pa khat in hong ve-in innkuan in upa te kiangah tui lum bangci a pia hiam cih class lak dingin a ciam hi.

records.english: The college thanked the Zomi families who had hosted students for a whole week.
records.zomi: College in kal khat bup sang naupang te a dawn Zomi innkuan te kiangah lungdam a ko hi.

records.english: Small gestures of hospitality can change how a whole team works together.
records.zomi: Zindo neu te in pawl khat bup bangci a kithuah uh hiam cih a khek thei hi.

records.english: Our class prepared a small welcome for the Zomi elders who visited the school.
records.zomi: I class in sang a hong ve Zomi upa te adingin dawnna neu khat a kiginkhol uh hi.

records.english: When a delivery driver arrived soaked from the rain, my Zomi colleague invited him into the staff room for tea.
records.zomi: Van paipihmi khat guah tawh a dimdiam-in a tun ciangin, ka Zomi nasep lawm in tui lum dawn dingin nasem te' tutna inn-ah a sap hi.

records.english: She explained that in her family nobody who comes to the door is sent away without a warm drink.
records.zomi: A innkuan-ah kongkhak-ah a hong kua peuh dawn ding lum om lo-in a kisawl kik ngei kei hi ci-in a hilh hi.

records.english: Now the driver stops for a quick cup every Friday, and the whole team has started keeping biscuits for him.
records.zomi: Tu-in van paipihmi Laithai ni khempeuh-in tui lum haai khat dawn dingin a khawl a, pawl bup in amah adingin biscuit a kem kipan uh hi.

records.english: The office had a lunch for the visitors.
records.zomi: Office in zin mi te adingin sun an khat a bawl hi.

records.english: Student societies often keep traditions of welcome alive far from home.
records.zomi: Sang naupang pawl te in inn pan gamla-ah dawnna ngeina te a nungta sak zel uh hi.

records.english: The Zomi youth group cooked for the volunteers who repaired the community centre.
records.zomi: Zomi khangno pawl in khuasung inn a bawlphat thalawp te adingin an a huan uh hi.

records.english: Did the visitors like the food?
records.zomi: Zin mi te in an a nuamsa uh hiam?

records.english: The school's guidebook for visitors now includes a page on Zomi customs of welcome.
records.zomi: Sang' zin mi te adingin lamlakna laibu in tu-in Zomi dawnna ngeina tawh kisai laimai khat a hel hi.

records.english: Who will welcome the new teacher?
records.zomi: Sia thak kua in a dawn ding hiam?

records.english: Did the visitors stay for lunch?
records.zomi: Zin mi te sun an adingin a om uh hiam?

records.english: Hosting visitors gives pupils a chance to share their family traditions.
records.zomi: Zin mi dawn in sang naupang te a innkuan ngeina uh a hawm nading hun a pia hi.

records.english: Explaining customs helps colleagues accept hospitality without embarrassment.
records.zomi: Ngeina te hilh in nasep lawm te zum lo-in zindo a san nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: My colleague walked the visitors all the way to the bus stop, just as her family does at home.
records.zomi: Ka nasep lawm in a innkuan in inn-ah a bawl bangin zin mi te bus khawlna dong a paipih hi.

records.english: Why do you always bring food for visitors to the office?
records.zomi: Office-a zin mi te adingin an bang hangin na paipih den hiam?

records.english: In my family, a guest is never left without something to eat, so I brought the habit to work.
records.zomi: Ka innkuan-ah, zin mi khat ne ding om lo-in a kinusia ngei kei a, tua ahih manin tua ngeina nasepna-ah ka paipih hi.

records.english: Our class made tea for the guests.
records.zomi: I class in zin mi te adingin tui lum a bawl uh hi.

records.english: My manager asked how to welcome Zomi visitors so that they would feel at home.
records.zomi: Ka nasep makai nu in Zomi zin mi te inn bangin a kizak nadingin bangci a dawn ding hiam ci-in a dot hi.

records.english: How can a workplace respect a colleague's tradition of hospitality without making it a burden?
records.zomi: Nasepna mun khat in nasep lawm khat' zindo ngeina a vanggik suak lo-in bangci a zahtak thei ding hiam?

records.english: We packed food for the guests to take home.
records.zomi: Zin mi te inn-a a paipih nadingun an i tuam uh hi.

records.english: The new nurse was welcomed with a meal.
records.zomi: Nurse thak an tawh a kidawn hi.

records.english: Could the college ask the Zomi student society to host the exchange students next spring?
records.zomi: A zom spring hun-in college in kikheng sang naupang te dawn dingin Zomi sang naupang pawl a ngen thei ding hiam?

records.english: Food shared at work can build friendships across different backgrounds.
records.zomi: Nasepna-a kihawm an in mun tuamtuam pan mite kikal-ah lawmta na a lam thei hi.

records.english: My colleague invited me to her home.
records.zomi: Ka nasep lawm in a inn-ah hong sap hi.

records.english: My boss asked for the recipe for the pork dish.
records.zomi: Ka nasep makaipa in vok sa an' bawl dan a ngen hi.

records.english: Hospitality customs brought into workplaces can make newcomers feel welcome.
records.zomi: Nasepna mun-ah a kipaipih zindo ngeina te in mi thak te a kidawn bangin a kizak sak thei hi.

records.english: We gave the visitors the best seats.
records.zomi: Zin mi te tutna hoih pen i pia uh hi.

records.english: Why did the Zomi nurses invite the new doctor to a meal?
records.zomi: Zomi nurse te in damdawi siam thak an ne dingin bang hangin a sap uh hiam?

records.english: In their community, welcoming a newcomer with food is a way of saying that they are glad to work together.
records.zomi: Amau' khuasung-ah, mi thak khat an tawh dawn pen khawm-in sem dingin a lungdam uh hi cih genna khat ahi hi.

records.english: My colleague brought rice cakes for the visitors.
records.zomi: Ka nasep lawm in zin mi te adingin buh mot a paipih hi.

records.english: The teacher was moved when Zomi parents sent home-cooked food for the staff party.
records.zomi: Zomi nu leh pa te in nasem te' pawi adingin inn-a kihuan an a khak uh ciangin sia in a lungsim a sukha hi.

records.english: At the end of the visit, the pupils gave each guest a small packet of food to take home.
records.zomi: Venna a bei ciangin, sang naupang te in zin mi khat ciat kiangah inn-a paipih ding an tom khat a pia uh hi.

records.english: Workplaces should make sure hospitality never becomes an unfair burden.
records.zomi: Nasepna mun te in zindo pen a dik lo vanggik a suak ngei lo nadingin a kipsak ding uh hi.

records.english: Who looks after the visiting Zomi students at the college?
records.zomi: College-ah a hong ve Zomi sang naupang te kua in a kem hiam?

records.english: The Zomi student society meets them at the station and finds them a place to stay.
records.zomi: Zomi sang naupang pawl in meileng khawlna inn-ah a dawn uh a, a omna ding mun a zon sak uh hi.

records.english: Why do Zomi employees sometimes feel uncomfortable letting guests pay for anything?
records.zomi: Zomi nasem te in zin mi te bangmah adingin man a pia sak uh ciangin bang hangin a nuam lo uh hiam?

records.english: The hospital canteen added a Zomi dish to the menu when the visiting nurses arrived.
records.zomi: Hong ve nurse te a tun uh ciangin damdawi inn' an nekna inn in a an lista-ah Zomi an khat a behlap hi.

records.english: Can our class serve food at the open day?
records.zomi: Kihonna ni-in i class in an a hawm thei ding uh hiam?

records.english: The students cooked for the visiting team.
records.zomi: Sang naupang te in hong ve pawl adingin an a huan uh hi.

records.english: Why did the school ask Zomi families to help host the visiting teachers from abroad?
records.zomi: Gamdang pan hong ve sia te dawn dingin sang in Zomi innkuan te bang hangin a ngen hiam?

records.english: The families offered rooms and meals, and the visitors said they learned more about the community in a week than from any book.
records.zomi: Innkuan te in inn sung leh an a pia uh a, zin mi te in laibu khat peuh sangin kal khat sungin khuasung tawh kisai tam zaw a sin uh hi, a ci uh hi.

records.english: My boss learned to accept a second helping after a Zomi colleague explained why it mattered.
records.zomi: Zomi nasep lawm khat in bang hangin a thupi hiam cih a hilh khit-in ka nasep makaipa in an nihna lak a sin hi.

records.english: The students showed the guests the library.
records.zomi: Sang naupang te in zin mi te laibu inn a lak uh hi.

records.english: Schools that learn about families' hospitality can host visitors more warmly.
records.zomi: Innkuan te' zindo a sin sang te in zin mi te lum zaw takin a dawn thei uh hi.

records.english: When the inspectors visited, the Zomi pupils served tea and showed them round.
records.zomi: Enmi te a hong ciangin, Zomi sang naupang te in tui lum a pia uh a, a kual-in a lak uh hi.

records.english: Visitors often remember the warmth of their welcome long after the visit.
records.zomi: Zin mi te in a venna khit sawt-in zong a dawnna lumna a phawk zel uh hi.

records.english: Which pupil welcomed the guests at the gate?
records.zomi: Koi sang naupang in kongpi-ah zin mi te a dawn hiam?

records.english: Who brought the snacks for the meeting?
records.zomi: Kikhopna adingin an neu te kua in a paipih hiam?

records.english: My manager thanked the Zomi families.
records.zomi: Ka nasep makaipa in Zomi innkuan te kiangah lungdam a ko hi.

records.english: The pupils carried the guests' bags.
records.zomi: Sang naupang te in zin mi te' ip te a pua uh hi.

records.english: The Zomi pupils explained to the class why guests are always offered the best food first.
records.zomi: Zomi sang naupang te in zin mi te an hoih pen a masa-in bang hangin a kipia den hiam cih class kiangah a hilh uh hi.

records.english: Who will show the guests around the school?
records.zomi: Zin mi te sang sung kua in a lak ding hiam?

records.english: We kept tea ready all afternoon.
records.zomi: Nitak lam bup tui lum i kiginsak uh hi.

records.english: Learning a community's customs helps managers respond with respect.
records.zomi: Khuasung khat' ngeina te sin in makai te zahtak takin a dawn thei nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: When I started my new job, my Zomi colleague invited me to her family's Sunday lunch.
records.zomi: Ka nasep thak ka kipat ciangin, ka Zomi nasep lawm in a innkuan' Nipini sun an-ah hong sap hi.

records.english: We fast together during Lent.
records.zomi: Lent sungin khawm-in an i ngawl uh hi.

records.english: Many Christians see changes in a loved one's character as the work of the Spirit.
records.zomi: Khazih mi tampi in it mi khat' lungsim omdan khekna te Kha Siangtho' nasep ahi hi ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi.

records.english: Our family pastor told us that small daily choices matter more than grand gestures.
records.zomi: I innkuan pastor in ni sim teelna neu te in gamtatna lian te sangin a thupi zaw hi ci-in hong gen hi.

records.english: Can I grow closer to God at school?
records.zomi: Sang-ah Pasian tawh ka kinai zaw thei ding hiam?

records.english: Can I become more patient?
records.zomi: Thuakzawhna tam zaw ka nei thei ding hiam?

records.english: Does God mind when I get things wrong?
records.zomi: Ka khial ciangin Pasian in a phawk hiam?

records.english: Mum prays for a gentle heart.
records.zomi: Nu in lungsim nem khat adingin thu a ngen hi.

records.english: We pray to grow more loving.
records.zomi: Itna tam zaw i neih nadingin thu i ngen uh hi.

records.english: My brother is kinder than he used to be.
records.zomi: Ka unau pasal in nidang sangin hehpihna a nei zaw hi.

records.english: My grandfather keeps a list of his faults and prays about one each week.
records.zomi: Ka pu in a khialhna te' lista khat a kem a, kal simin khat adingin thu a ngen hi.

records.english: Family practices such as fasting and prayer help many believers grow in faith.
records.zomi: An ngawlna leh thu ngetna bang innkuan ngeina te in up mi tampi upna-ah a khan nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Christians believe that the Holy Spirit gradually makes believers more holy.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Kha Siangtho in up mite zawi zawi-in a siangtho zaw sak hi ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: How can our family help each other grow in faith?
records.zomi: I innkuan in upna-ah khat leh khat i khan nadingin bangci i kihuh thei ding uh hiam?

records.english: Pray together, forgive quickly, and notice the small ways each person is becoming more loving.
records.zomi: Khawm-in thu ngen un, manlang takin kimaisak un, mi khat ciat in itna a tam semsem lampi neu te phawk un.

records.english: Does holiness really take a lifetime, Grandma?
records.zomi: Pi, siangthona in nuntakna bup a la tak hiam?

records.english: Grandma is the kindest person I know.
records.zomi: Pi pen ka theih mi te lak-ah hehpihna nei pen ahi hi.

records.english: When I was a teenager, I had a terrible temper and often shouted at my younger brother.
records.zomi: Khangno ka hih lai-in, ka heh baih mahmah a, ka nau pasal tungah ging taka ka kikou zel hi.

records.english: My grandmother prayed for me every night and told me that the Holy Spirit could slowly make me more gentle.
records.zomi: Ka pi in zan khempeuh-in kei adingin thu a ngen a, Kha Siangtho in zawi zawi-in hong nem zaw sak thei hi ci-in hong gen hi.

records.english: Years later, my brother said he couldn't remember the last time I had lost my temper with him.
records.zomi: Kum tampi khit-in, amah tungah ka heh nunung pen hun a phawk thei nawn kei hi, ci-in ka nau pasal in a gen hi.

records.english: Many Christian families pray together for growth in love and patience.
records.zomi: Khazih innkuan tampi in itna leh thuakzawhna-a khanna adingin khawm-in thu a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Does God want me to be good all the time?
records.zomi: Pasian in kei hun khempeuh-in hoih dingin a deih hiam?

records.english: Christians believe God helps us grow a little better every day, and forgives us when we fail.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Pasian in ni simin tawm khat hoih zaw-in hong khangsak a, i khial ciangin hong maisak hi ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Every Lent, our family gives up something small to make room for prayer.
records.zomi: Lent khempeuh-in, i innkuan in thu ngetna adingin mun a om nadingin bangmah neu khat a nusia uh hi.

records.english: When my son lost his temper, we prayed together for the Spirit to help him stay calm.
records.zomi: Ka tapa a heh ciangin, a lungsim a dai nadingin Kha Siangtho in a huh dingin khawm-in thu i ngen uh hi.

records.english: Christian teaching holds that sanctification lasts a lifetime.
records.zomi: Khazih sinsakna in siangtho sakna pen nuntakna bup a sau hi ci-in a gen hi.

records.english: Do your children know that Christians believe God forgives them when they fail?
records.zomi: Khazih mite in a khial uh ciangin Pasian in amau a maisak hi ci-in a um uh hi cih na ta te in a thei uh hiam?

records.english: My father says he learned to forgive his brother only after years of prayer.
records.zomi: Kum tampi thu a nget khit ciang bekin a unau pasal a maisak thei hi, ci-in ka pa in a gen hi.

records.english: Dad asks God to help him forgive.
records.zomi: Paa in a maisak thei nadingin Pasian kiangah huhna a ngen hi.

records.english: My sister forgave her friend today.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam nu in tuni-in a lawm a maisak hi.

records.english: My mother says that suffering during her illness made her more grateful and gentle.
records.zomi: A natna sung-a thuakna in lungdam kohna leh lungnemna tam zaw hong pia hi, ci-in ka nu in a gen hi.

records.english: Mum helps the neighbours every week.
records.zomi: Nu in kal simin inn kiang mite a huh hi.

records.english: For believers, holiness is shown in everyday kindness, honesty and forgiveness.
records.zomi: Up mite adingin, siangthona pen ni sim hehpihna, thudik gen leh maisakna-ah a kilang hi.

records.english: For many believers, suffering has deepened their faith and gentleness.
records.zomi: Up mi tampi adingin, thuakna in a upna uh leh a lungnemna uh a thuk zaw sak hi.

records.english: Why do Christians say that becoming holy is a journey rather than a single moment?
records.zomi: Khazih mite in siangtho suak pen hun khat bek hi lo-in khualzinna khat ahi hi ci-in bang hangin a gen uh hiam?

records.english: After years of bitterness, my uncle finally made peace with his neighbour.
records.zomi: Kum tampi lungsim khah khit-in, ka pa neu in a tawp-in a inn kiang mi tawh a kilem hi.

records.english: My aunt believes that serving the poor has slowly changed her heart.
records.zomi: Ka ni in zawng te nasep sak in zawi zawi-in a lungsim a khek hi ci-in a um hi.

records.english: My husband and I pray each evening that our home will become a more loving place.
records.zomi: Ka pasal leh kei in i inn itna tam zaw mun khat a suak nadingin nitak khempeuh-in thu i ngen uh hi.

records.english: Our family thanks God for growing us.
records.zomi: I innkuan in hong khangsak ahih manin Pasian kiangah lungdam a ko uh hi.

records.english: My son is learning to share his toys.
records.zomi: Ka tapa in a kimawlna te hawm a kisin hi.

records.english: Could our family choose one quality of the Spirit to pray for each month?
records.zomi: I innkuan in kha simin Kha Siangtho' gah khat adingin thu ngen dingin i teel thei ding uh hiam?

records.english: My daughter prayed to stop telling lies.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in zuau gen khawl nadingin thu a ngen hi.

records.english: Our children were encouraged when their grandfather admitted that he still struggles with pride.
records.zomi: I ta te in a pu uh in kiliansakna tawh a do lai hi ci-in a pulak ciangin a lungsim uh a hat hi.

records.english: Christians often say that growth in holiness is noticed only when looking back.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in siangthona-a khanna pen nunglam en ciang bekin a kiphawk hi ci-in a gen zel uh hi.

records.english: Is it hard to be holy?
records.zomi: Siangtho pen a haksa hiam?

records.english: Mum, why do you say that Grandpa has become kinder over the years?
records.zomi: Nu, kum te sungin Pu a hehpihna khang zaw hi bang hangin na ci hiam?

records.english: Christians believe the Holy Spirit slowly changes people, and we've seen Grandpa grow gentler and more patient.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Kha Siangtho in mite zawi zawi-in a khek hi ci-in a um uh a, Pu a nem zaw a, thuakzawhna tam zaw a nei hi cih i mu uh hi.

records.english: Christian families often encourage each other by naming signs of spiritual growth.
records.zomi: Khazih innkuan te in kha lam khanna lahna te gen in khat leh khat a kihanthawn zel uh hi.

records.english: My grandmother believes the Holy Spirit has made her more patient with each passing year.
records.zomi: Ka pi in Kha Siangtho in kum khat ciat a pai ciangin thuakzawhna tam zaw hong pia hi ci-in a um hi.

records.english: Shall we read the Bible together after supper?
records.zomi: Nitak an khit-in Lai Siangtho khawm-in i sim ding uh hiam?

records.english: Why does Grandma pray to become more patient?
records.zomi: Pi in thuakzawhna tam zaw a neih nadingin bang hangin thu a ngen hiam?

records.english: She says patience doesn't come easily, so she asks the Spirit to help her grow in it.
records.zomi: Thuakzawhna a baih takin a hong tung lo hi a ci a, tua ahih manin a khan nadingin Kha Siangtho kiangah huhna a ngen hi.

records.english: Why does our family believe that Uncle's change is the Spirit's work and not just his own effort?
records.zomi: Pa Neu' khekna pen amah' hanciamna bek hi lo-in Kha Siangtho' nasep ahi hi ci-in i innkuan in bang hangin a um uh hiam?

records.english: He tried for years to stop drinking on his own, but he says that real change came only after he began praying and asking God for strength.
records.zomi: Kum tampi sung amah bekin zu dawn khawl dingin a sin a, ahi zongin thu a nget kipat a, Pasian kiangah hatna a nget khit ciang bekin khekna tak a tung hi, a ci hi.

records.english: When my daughter told the truth even though it was hard, we thanked God for her honesty.
records.zomi: Ka tanu in a haksa hangin thudik a gen ciangin, a thudik gen adingin Pasian kiangah lungdam i ko uh hi.

records.english: We say sorry before we sleep.
records.zomi: I ihmut ma-in maisakna i kingen uh hi.

records.english: How do you explain to a teenager that growing in holiness doesn't mean being perfect?
records.zomi: Siangthona-a khanna in a bukim cihna hi lo hi cih khangno khat kiangah bangci na hilh ding hiam?

records.english: Dad says nobody is perfect yet.
records.zomi: Kua mah a bukim nai kei hi, ci-in Paa in a gen hi.

records.english: Christian parents often teach children that God forgives them when they fail.
records.zomi: Khazih nu leh pa te in a ta te uh a khial uh ciangin Pasian in amau a maisak hi ci-in a sinsak zel uh hi.

records.english: Grandpa says God is still changing him.
records.zomi: Pasian in kei hong khek lai hi, ci-in Pu in a gen hi.

records.english: Why do we confess our sins?
records.zomi: I mawhnate bang hangin i pulak uh hiam?

records.english: Did the council put the promise in writing?
records.zomi: Council in a ciamna gelh tawh a koih hiam?

records.english: Can the college show how many of last year's students found work?
records.zomi: Kum bei-a sang naupang bangzah in nasep a mu uh hiam cih college in a lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: How can residents check the council's claim that the new bins will save money?
records.zomi: Bawm-ek bawm thak te in sum a hum ding hi cih council' genna mite in bangci a et thei ding uh hiam?

records.english: What evidence does the school have that a longer day will improve pupils' results?
records.zomi: Sang ni sau zaw in sang naupang te' gah a hoih zaw sak ding hi cih sang in bang ettehna a nei hiam?

records.english: It points to a trial in three nearby schools, where marks rose slightly, but the report also says that pupils were more tired by Friday.
records.zomi: Kiang-a sang thum-a sittelna khat a lak a, mark te tawm khat a khang hi, ahi zongin report in Laithai ni-in sang naupang te a gim zaw uh hi ci-in zong a gen hi.

records.english: Evidence about the future is always uncertain, so it should be weighed carefully.
records.zomi: Hun ding tawh kisai ettehna te kician lo den ahih manin kilawm takin a kiteh ding hi.

records.english: Has anyone checked whether the developer kept its promises in other towns?
records.zomi: Inn lammi in khuapi dang te-ah a ciamna te a zui hiam cih kua hiam in a et hiam?

records.english: Where did you read about the new factory?
records.zomi: Factory thak tawh kisai koi-ah na sim hiam?

records.english: Is there any research showing that the new teaching method works in small schools?
records.zomi: Sinsakna lampi thak in sang neu te-ah a sem hi cih a lak research khat a om hiam?

records.english: Can the builder show us his past work?
records.zomi: Inn lammi in a nasep nidang te hong lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Checking a company's past work helps predict how it will behave in future.
records.zomi: Company khat' nasep nidang et in hun ding-ah bangci a gamta ding hiam cih a lamen thei sak hi.

records.english: Can I see the guarantee before I buy?
records.zomi: Ka lei ma-in kiciamna lai ka et thei ding hiam?

records.english: How do you know that the new bus route will really stop near the hospital?
records.zomi: Bus lampi thak in damdawi inn kiangah a khawl tak ding hi cih bangci na thei hiam?

records.english: How do you know the shop will close?
records.zomi: Dawr a kikhak ding hi cih bangci na thei hiam?

records.english: Is there evidence that the plan will work?
records.zomi: Ciamteh in a sem ding hi cih ettehna a om hiam?

records.english: Is there any evidence that the new clinic will open on time?
records.zomi: Damdawi inn neu thak hun takin a kihong ding hi cih ettehna khat a om hiam?

records.english: The builders have finished the roof, and the council published a progress report last week.
records.zomi: Inn lammi te in inn tung a zo uh a, council in kal bei-in a paina report khat a koih hi.

records.english: Before you move abroad, can you check the job offer with the embassy?
records.zomi: Gamdang-ah na tai ma-in nasep piakna embassy tawh na et thei ding hiam?

records.english: Can you show me the plans for the new school?
records.zomi: Sang thak adingin ciamteh te hong lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Who told you the rent will rise?
records.zomi: Inn man a khang ding hi ci-in kua in hong gen hiam?

records.english: Families who check claims together make wiser decisions about their future.
records.zomi: Genna te khawm-in a et innkuan te in a hun ding uh tawh kisai pil zaw takin a khensat uh hi.

records.english: Can I see the report before the meeting?
records.zomi: Kikhopna ma-in report ka et thei ding hiam?

records.english: Can you show me the figures for next year?
records.zomi: A zom kum adingin nambat te hong lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Is there evidence that the youth club's new plan will attract more teenagers?
records.zomi: Khangno pawl' ciamteh thak in khangno tam zaw a sawl ding hi cih ettehna a om hiam?

records.english: Could the bank show me in writing how much the loan will cost over ten years?
records.zomi: Sum puk in kum sawm sung bangzah a man ding hiam cih bank in gelh tawh hong lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Is there a contract for the new job?
records.zomi: Nasep thak adingin ciamna lai khat a om hiam?

records.english: Is there proof that the bus will run next year?
records.zomi: A zom kum-in bus a pai ding hi cih lahna a om hiam?

records.english: Is the new timetable on the website?
records.zomi: Hun lista thak website-ah a om hiam?

records.english: Past results can guide future plans, but they do not guarantee success.
records.zomi: Nidang gah te in hun ding ciamteh te a lamlak thei hi, ahi zongin zawhna a kipsak kei hi.

records.english: Where does it say the clinic will open in May?
records.zomi: Damdawi inn neu May kha-in a kihong ding hi cih koi-ah a kigelh hiam?

records.english: Independent sources are more reliable than evidence provided by a seller.
records.zomi: Tuam taka thu pan mun te zuakmi' piak ettehna sangin a muanhuai zaw hi.

records.english: Can you send me the forecast you mentioned?
records.zomi: Na gen lamenna lai hong khak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Is there a written promise from the landlord?
records.zomi: Inn neipa pan gelh tawh ciamna a om hiam?

records.english: What evidence would convince you that the new medicine is worth trying?
records.zomi: Zatui thak sin a phu hi cih bang ettehna in hong um sak ding hiam?

records.english: Asking for proof in writing prevents misunderstandings later.
records.zomi: Gelh tawh lahna ngen in a nung-ah kitheih khialhna te a kham hi.

records.english: Before we buy the land, should we ask to see the records of past landslides?
records.zomi: Lei i lei ma-in nidang-a lei pulna ciamtehna te et dingin i ngen ding uh hiam?

records.english: What proof is there that the new school will have enough teachers when it opens?
records.zomi: Sang thak a kihon ciangin sia a tamzah a nei ding hi cih bang lahna a om hiam?

records.english: Promises about the future are more convincing when they are backed by written records.
records.zomi: Gelh ciamtehna te tawh a kihuh hun ding ciamna te a muanhuai zaw hi.

records.english: How do you know it will rain at the festival?
records.zomi: Pawi-ah guah a zu ding hi cih bangci na thei hiam?

records.english: Questions about evidence encourage planners to think more carefully.
records.zomi: Ettehna tawh kisai dotna te in ciamtehmi te kilawm zaw takin a ngaihsut nadingin a hanthawn hi.

records.english: Who says the bridge will be finished soon?
records.zomi: Lei a manlang-in a zo ding hi ci-in kua in a gen hiam?

records.english: What makes you think the new road will bring more customers to the market?
records.zomi: Lampi thak in sum-kuan mun-ah lei mi tam zaw a tun ding hi ci-in bang in hong ngaihsun sak hiam?

records.english: The council's traffic survey shows that twice as many cars will pass the square once it opens.
records.zomi: Council' mawtaw simna in a kihon ciangin khuapi lai mun mawtaw vei nih tam zaw in a pai ding hi cih a lak hi.

records.english: Can the council show residents evidence that the new car park will reduce traffic?
records.zomi: Mawtaw koihna mun thak in mawtaw kiphun a niam sak ding hi cih council in mite kiangah ettehna a lak thei ding hiam?

records.english: Can you prove the course leads to a job?
records.zomi: Sinna in nasep-ah a paipih hi cih na kipsak thei ding hiam?

records.english: How do you know the company will still exist in five years to honour the guarantee?
records.zomi: Kiciamna zui dingin kum nga sungin company a om lai ding hi cih bangci na thei hiam?

records.english: When a salesman promised that solar panels would halve our electricity bill, my father asked to see the figures.
records.zomi: Sumzuak khat in solar panel te in i meivaak man a khen nih-in a niam sak ding hi ci-in a ciam ciangin, ka pa in nambat te et dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: The man showed bills from three houses in our town, and my father phoned each family to check the numbers were real.
records.zomi: Pasal in i khuapi-a inn thum' man lai te a lak a, ka pa in nambat te a tak hiam cih et dingin innkuan khat ciat a phone hi.

records.english: Only after all three confirmed the savings did we sign the contract, and our bill really did fall by almost half.
records.zomi: A thum in sum humna a kipsak uh khit ciang bekin ciamna lai i khut ngap uh a, i man lai a khen nih dekdek-in a niam tak hi.

records.english: How do you know the price will go up?
records.zomi: Man a khang ding hi cih bangci na thei hiam?

records.english: What would count as proof that the festival will make a profit next year?
records.zomi: A zom kum-in pawi in a phattuamna a ngah ding hi cih lahna-in bang a kisim ding hiam?

records.english: Before we invest in the new seeds, can we see proof that they grow well here?
records.zomi: Khaici thak te-ah sum i koih ma-un, hih mun-ah a khang hoih hi cih lahna i mu thei ding uh hiam?

records.english: The farm in the next valley tested them for two seasons, and its harvest records are open for anyone to read.
records.zomi: A zom guam-a lo in hun nih sung a et uh a, a gah lakna ciamtehna te kua peuh in a sim thei uh hi.

records.english: Asking for evidence before committing to a plan protects people from costly mistakes.
records.zomi: Ciamteh khat a kiciam ma-in ettehna ngen in mite man tam khialhna te pan a kem hi.

records.english: How can we be sure that the grant will arrive before the work starts?
records.zomi: Nasep a kipat ma-in sum huhna a tung ding hi cih bangci i kipsak thei ding uh hiam?

records.english: Trials and pilot schemes provide useful evidence for larger decisions.
records.zomi: Sittelna leh kisin ciamteh te in khensatna lian zaw te adingin ettehna phatuam te a pia hi.

records.english: How do you know the scholarship will cover all your fees next year?
records.zomi: A zom kum-in scholarship in na sinna man khempeuh a pia ding hi cih bangci na thei hiam?

records.english: The university sent me a letter listing exactly what it pays for, and I've kept a copy.
records.zomi: University in bang a pia hiam cih kician taka a gelhna lai khat hong khak a, a teh khat ka kem hi.

records.english: Good evidence often includes both benefits and disadvantages.
records.zomi: Ettehna hoih te in phattuamna leh haksatna a nih a hel zel hi.

records.english: Residents have the right to ask councils for the figures behind new plans.
records.zomi: Mite in ciamteh thak te nunglam-a nambat te council te kiangah a ngen thei uh hi.

records.english: The council received money for new pipes.
records.zomi: Council in tui pipe thak te adingin sum a ngah hi.

records.english: Is the community centre paid for by taxes?
records.zomi: Khuasung inn siah sum tawh a kipia hiam?

records.english: Why does the government spend more on hospitals in cities than in rural areas?
records.zomi: Kumpi in gam khua te sangin khuapi te-a damdawi inn te-ah sum tam zaw bang hangin a zang hiam?

records.english: Could the community centre apply for government money to repair its roof?
records.zomi: Khuasung inn in a inn tung bawlphat nadingin kumpi sum a nget thei ding hiam?

records.english: Who decides where the money goes?
records.zomi: Sum koi-ah a pai ding hiam cih kua in a khensat hiam?

records.english: Will the government fund more nurses at our clinic?
records.zomi: Kumpi in i damdawi inn neu-ah nurse tam zaw adingin sum a pia ding hiam?

records.english: The health ministry has promised two extra posts, starting in the spring.
records.zomi: Damna vaihawmna in spring hun pan kipan-in nasep mun nih behlap dingin a ciam hi.

records.english: Does the government pay for the library?
records.zomi: Kumpi in laibu inn adingin sum a pia hiam?

records.english: Delays in promised funding can leave communities waiting for years.
records.zomi: Kiciam sum huhna a nawh ciangin khuasung te kum tampi a ngak kul zel uh hi.

records.english: How can residents find out whether government money for the new road was spent properly?
records.zomi: Lampi thak adingin kumpi sum dik takin a kizang hiam cih mite in bangci a thei thei ding uh hiam?

records.english: The government publishes the project's accounts, and an independent auditor will report on the costs once the road is finished.
records.zomi: Kumpi in project' sum ciamtehna te a koih a, lampi a zawh ciangin tuam taka sum etmi khat in a man te tawh kisai report a gelh ding hi.

records.english: Will the government fix the old school?
records.zomi: Kumpi in sang lui a bawlphat ding hiam?

records.english: Clear information about grants helps small groups apply successfully.
records.zomi: Sum huhna tawh kisai thu kician te in pawl neu te a ngetna uh a zawh nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Our town got a grant for street lights.
records.zomi: I khuapi in lampi meivaak te adingin sum huhna khat a ngah hi.

records.english: Independent audits help ensure that large projects give value for money.
records.zomi: Tuam taka sum etna te in project lian te in sum a phu hiam cih a kipsak nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Grants can help communities build facilities they could never afford alone.
records.zomi: Sum huhna te in khuasung te amau bekin a lei zo ngei lo ding zatna te a lam thei nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Is it true that the government pays for free meals at the community lunch club?
records.zomi: Khuasung sun an pawl-a man om lo an te kumpi in a man a pia hi cih a dik hiam?

records.english: The new sports hall was built with government money but is run by local volunteers.
records.zomi: Kimawlna inn thak kumpi sum tawh a kilam a, ahi zongin khuasung thalawp te in a kem uh hi.

records.english: When the government announced money for village libraries, our community wrote an application in a single weekend.
records.zomi: Kumpi in khua laibu inn te adingin sum a pia ding hi ci-in a phuan ciangin, i khuasung in kal tawp khat sungin ngetna khat a gelh uh hi.

records.english: We explained how many children had no books at home and how far they travelled to the nearest town library.
records.zomi: Inn-ah laibu nei lo naupang bangzah a om hiam leh khuapi laibu inn a nai pen dong bangzah gamla a pai uh hiam cih i hilh uh hi.

records.english: Six months later, a small library opened in the old school room, and it now lends hundreds of books every month.
records.zomi: Kha guk khit-in, sang inn lui sungah laibu inn neu khat a kihong a, tu-in kha simin laibu za tampi a puksak hi.

records.english: Why does the government sometimes pay private companies to run public services?
records.zomi: Kumpi in mipi nasepna te kem dingin mimal company te bang hangin sum a pia zel hiam?

records.english: Who funds the village clinic?
records.zomi: Khua damdawi inn neu adingin kua in sum a pia hiam?

records.english: Residents were angry when the promised government money for the bridge arrived two years late.
records.zomi: Lei adingin kiciam kumpi sum kum nih nung-in a tun ciangin mite a heh uh hi.

records.english: The new playground was built with public money.
records.zomi: Naupang kimawlna mun thak mipi sum tawh a kilam hi.

records.english: Is the bus service paid for by the state?
records.zomi: Bus nasepna gam in a man a pia hiam?

records.english: Does the state fund the youth club?
records.zomi: Gam in khangno pawl adingin sum a pia hiam?

records.english: The government funds free vaccinations.
records.zomi: Kumpi in man om lo zatui sutna te a man a pia hi.

records.english: Did the government pay for the new health centre?
records.zomi: Kumpi in damna inn thak man a pia hiam?

records.english: Most of it, and the rest came from a charity and money raised by local churches.
records.zomi: A tam zaw, a dang te huhna pawl khat leh khuasung biakinn te in a kaikhawm sum pan a hong pai hi.

records.english: Rules about who pays for local services vary between countries and regions.
records.zomi: Khuasung nasepna te adingin kua in a man a pia hiam cih tawh kisai thukham te gam leh gam khen te kikal-ah a kibang lo hi.

records.english: Our residents' group asked why government spending on the town's roads had fallen for three years.
records.zomi: I khuasung mite' pawl in khuapi' lampi te tungah kumpi sum zatna kum thum bang hangin a kiam hiam ci-in a dot uh hi.

records.english: The health ministry sent extra money to clinics that had the longest waiting lists.
records.zomi: Damna vaihawmna in ngak mi tam pen a nei damdawi inn neu te kiangah sum behlap a khak hi.

records.english: Government money works best when communities help decide how it is used.
records.zomi: Kumpi sum bangci zang ding hiam cih khuasung te in a khensat huh uh ciangin a hoih pen hi.

records.english: Volunteers sometimes keep services running when public funding is reduced.
records.zomi: Mipi sum huhna a kiam ciangin thalawp te in nasepna te a kem den zel uh hi.

records.english: Our village applied for a road grant.
records.zomi: I khua in lampi sum huhna khat a ngen hi.

records.english: The government funded a scheme to fit insulation in older people's homes across the district.
records.zomi: Kumpi in gam khen bup-a upa te' inn lui te-ah insulation koih nading ciamteh khat adingin sum a pia hi.

records.english: The new clinic opened with public funds.
records.zomi: Damdawi inn neu thak mipi sum tawh a kihong hi.

records.english: Cuts in government spending often fall hardest on rural communities.
records.zomi: Kumpi sum zatna khiamna te gam khua te tungah a gik pen-in a tung zel hi.

records.english: Residents can ask representatives to explain government spending decisions.
records.zomi: Mite in a aw-palai te uh kiangah kumpi sum zatna khensatna te hilh dingin a ngen thei uh hi.

records.english: The school got new books from the government.
records.zomi: Sang in kumpi pan laibu thak te a ngah hi.

records.english: Who pays for the fire station?
records.zomi: Mei mitna inn adingin kua in sum a pia hiam?

records.english: Why did the government spend so much on the new water pipes in our district?
records.zomi: I gam khen-a tui pipe thak te tungah kumpi in sum tampi bang hangin a zang hiam?

records.english: The old pipes leaked so badly that a third of the water was lost before it reached anyone's tap.
records.zomi: Pipe lui te a vuk lua ahih manin kua kiangah a tun ma-in tui khen thum-a khen khat a mang hi.

records.english: The government paid for the new sea wall.
records.zomi: Kumpi in tuipi kham bang thak man a pia hi.

records.english: The government paid for the new bridge.
records.zomi: Kumpi in lei thak man a pia hi.

records.english: The government cut spending on the museum.
records.zomi: Kumpi in museum tungah sum zatna a khiam hi.

records.english: Government spending pays for many of the services residents use every day.
records.zomi: Kumpi sum zatna in mite in ni simin a zat nasepna tampi man a pia hi.

records.english: The government's spending report showed how much of the money for the new hospital had been used.
records.zomi: Kumpi' sum zatna report in damdawi inn thak adingin sum bangzah a kizang khin hiam cih a lak hi.

records.english: When government spending on libraries was cut, our village kept its library open with volunteers.
records.zomi: Laibu inn te tungah kumpi sum zatna a kiam ciangin, i khua in thalawp te tawh a laibu inn a hong den hi.

records.english: Who pays for the free school buses in the villages?
records.zomi: Khua te-a man om lo sang bus te adingin kua in sum a pia hiam?

records.english: In our region, the national government covers the cost, and the council organises the routes.
records.zomi: I gam khen-ah, gam kumpi in a man a pia a, council in lampi te a ciamteh hi.

records.english: Several schools received government money to build safer crossings outside their gates.
records.zomi: Sang tampi in a kongpi uh mai-ah lampi galkhat pai nading mun lauhuai lo zaw lam dingin kumpi sum a ngah uh hi.

records.english: How can a small charity find out which government funds it is allowed to apply for?
records.zomi: Huhna pawl neu khat in koi kumpi sum te a nget thei hiam cih bangci a thei thei ding hiam?

records.english: The ministry promised money for the roads.
records.zomi: Vaihawmna in lampi te adingin sum a ciam hi.

records.english: Our tenants' association invited a councillor to explain how government money for housing is shared.
records.zomi: I inn luak mite' pawl in inn adingin kumpi sum bangci a kihawm hiam cih hilh dingin councillor khat a sap uh hi.

records.english: Published accounts allow residents to check how public money is spent.
records.zomi: A kikoih sum ciamtehna te in mite in mipi sum bangci a kizang hiam cih a et thei nadingin a phal hi.

records.english: Spending on prevention, such as clean water, can save money in the long term.
records.zomi: Tui siang bang khamna tungah sum zatna in hun sawt-ah sum a hum thei hi.

records.english: The government's grant for rural transport means the village bus now runs twice a day.
records.zomi: Gam khua paina adingin kumpi' sum huhna hangin tu-in khua bus ni khat-ah vei nih a pai hi.

records.english: Who pays the nurses at the hospital?
records.zomi: Damdawi inn-a nurse te kua in a khasum a pia hiam?

records.english: Was maths your favourite subject?
records.zomi: Kisimna sinna na deih pen ahi hiam?

records.english: A single mistake in the accounts can teach a lesson that lasts a lifetime.
records.zomi: Sum ciamtehna-a khialhna khat bek in nuntakna bup sung a om sinna khat a sinsak thei hi.

records.english: Were you quick at mental arithmetic?
records.zomi: Lungsim sung-a kisimna-ah na manlang hiam?

records.english: Practical tasks such as measuring land helped earlier generations learn calculation.
records.zomi: Lei tehna bang nasep tak te in khang upa te kisimna a sin nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Did your teacher test your sums every day?
records.zomi: Na sia in ni simin na kisimna te a et hiam?

records.english: My uncle says he learned percentages by working out the discounts at his father's shop.
records.zomi: A pa' dawr-a niam sakna te tel in za-a khen sinna a sin hi, ci-in ka pa neu in a gen hi.

records.english: Did you help your parents with money?
records.zomi: Na nu leh pa sum tawh na huh hiam?

records.english: When I was eight, I counted every step from our house to the school and announced the total at dinner.
records.zomi: Kum giat ka phak lai-in, i inn pan sang dong kalsuan khempeuh ka sim a, nitak an lai-in a vekpi ka gen hi.

records.english: When I worked in a café as a student, I learned to work out change much faster than in class.
records.zomi: Sang naupang ka hih lai-in cafe khat-ah ka sep lai-in, class sangin a manlang zaw-in sum kik tel ka sin hi.

records.english: Do you remember the teacher who made us shout the times tables in a chorus every morning?
records.zomi: Zingsang khempeuh-in kisimna lista ging taka khawm-in hong kikousak sia na phawk hiam?

records.english: What was the hardest sum you remember from school?
records.zomi: Sang-a na phawk kisimna haksa pen bang ahi hiam?

records.english: Long division with numbers in the thousands, which took me a whole page every time.
records.zomi: Tul tampi nambat te tawh khenna sau, vei khempeuh-in laimai khat bup a la hi.

records.english: Older generations often relied on mental arithmetic rather than calculators.
records.zomi: Khang upa te in calculator sangin lungsim sung-a kisimna a muang zaw zel uh hi.

records.english: Memories of learning numbers often involve helping in a family shop or market.
records.zomi: Nambat sinna phawkna te in innkuan dawr ahih kei leh sum-kuan mun-a huhna a hel zel hi.

records.english: Who checked your homework sums?
records.zomi: Na inn-a sep ding kisimna te kua in a et hiam?

records.english: Years later, I found my old school maths book and laughed at all the red crosses.
records.zomi: Kum tampi khit-in, ka sang kisimna laibu lui ka mu a, cross san khempeuh ka nuih hi.

records.english: When I was twelve, my uncle let me keep the accounts for his small shop during the school holidays.
records.zomi: Kum sawm leh nih ka phak lai-in, ka pa neu in sang tawlngak hun sungin a dawr neu' sum ciamtehna kem dingin hong phal hi.

records.english: On the first evening, the money in the till was 5 dollars short, and I spent an hour finding a mistake in my own adding.
records.zomi: Nitak masa pen-in, sum bawm sung-a sum dollar nga a kiam a, keimah' kisimna-a khialhna khat zong dingin nai khat ka zang hi.

records.english: By the end of the summer, the books balanced every night, and my uncle paid me with a new calculator.
records.zomi: Khal hun a bei ciangin, zan khempeuh-in sum ciamtehna te a kituak a, ka pa neu in calculator thak khat tawh hong pia hi.

records.english: Did you count on your fingers?
records.zomi: Na khut zungno tawh na sim hiam?

records.english: Did you count the eggs at the farm?
records.zomi: Lo-ah aktui te na sim hiam?

records.english: Did you use calculators at school?
records.zomi: Sang-ah calculator na zang uh hiam?

records.english: No, we had an abacus at the front of the room, and we did everything else in our heads.
records.zomi: Hi kei hi, class inn mai-ah abacus khat i nei uh a, a dang khempeuh i lungsim sungah i bawl uh hi.

records.english: Teachers once used repetition and chanting to teach the times tables.
records.zomi: Nidang-in sia te in kisimna lista sinsak nadingin a kik kik leh khawm-a gen a zang uh hi.

records.english: Was your first calculator expensive?
records.zomi: Na calculator masa pen a man a tam hiam?

records.english: My brother failed his first maths exam but passed the second after practising every evening.
records.zomi: Ka unau pasal in a kisimna sittelna masa pen a sit hi, ahi zongin nitak khempeuh-in a kisin khit-in a nihna a zo hi.

records.english: Did you work in a shop as a teenager?
records.zomi: Khangno na hih lai-in dawr khat-ah na sem hiam?

records.english: Did you ever make a big mistake with change?
records.zomi: Sum kik tawh khialhna lian khat na bawl ngei hiam?

records.english: My grandfather remembers when a bus ticket to the city cost only 10 cents.
records.zomi: Khuapi dong bus lai-ek in cent sawm bek a man lai a phawk hi, ci-in ka pu in a gen hi.

records.english: How did the way you taught numbers change over your years of teaching?
records.zomi: Na sinsak kum te sungin nambat na sinsak dan bangci a kikhek hiam?

records.english: At first we drilled the times tables every morning, but later we used games, real money and shopping lists to make the numbers meaningful.
records.zomi: A kipat lai-in zingsang khempeuh-in kisimna lista i kisin kik uh a, ahi zongin a nung-ah nambat te a manpha nadingin kimawlna, sum tak leh lei ding lista te i zang uh hi.

records.english: Children who handle money at home often become confident with numbers.
records.zomi: Inn-ah sum a khoih naupang te nambat tawh a kiciamteh zel uh hi.

records.english: Were fractions hard for you?
records.zomi: Khenna nambat te na adingin a haksa hiam?

records.english: Did you use an abacus?
records.zomi: Abacus na zang hiam?

records.english: My cousin learned fractions by helping our grandmother divide her famous cake into equal slices.
records.zomi: Ka sanggam in i pi' cake minthang khen kibang-in khen dingin a huh tungtawnin khenna nambat te a sin hi.

records.english: Do you remember a time when your maths skills really helped you?
records.zomi: Na kisimna siamna in hong huh tak hun khat na phawk hiam?

records.english: When the shopkeeper overcharged my mother by 50 cents, I added up the bill in my head and showed the shopkeeper the mistake.
records.zomi: Dawr neipa in ka nu tungah cent sawm nga a la behlap ciangin, ka lungsim sungah man lai ka sim a, dawr neipa kiangah khialhna ka lak hi.

records.english: Real money and shopping made numbers meaningful for many children.
records.zomi: Sum tak leh van lei te in naupang tampi adingin nambat te a manpha sak hi.

records.english: My brother believes the Spirit helped him find the right words when he apologised to his wife.
records.zomi: Ka unau pasal in a zi kiangah maisakna a nget ciangin Kha Siangtho in kammal dik a muh nadingin a huh hi ci-in a um hi.

records.english: Do your children know that Christians believe the Spirit helps them when they don't know how to pray?
records.zomi: Bangci thu ngen ding hiam cih a theih loh uh ciangin Kha Siangtho in a huh hi ci-in Khazih mite in a um uh hi cih na ta te in a thei uh hiam?

records.english: Does Dad pray to the Spirit before work?
records.zomi: Paa in a nasep ma-in Kha Siangtho kiangah thu a ngen hiam?

records.english: Yes, he asks for wisdom every morning before he drives to the hospital.
records.zomi: Hi, damdawi inn lam-ah mawtaw a mawn ma-in zingsang khempeuh-in pilna a ngen hi.

records.english: Christians believe that the Spirit guides believers in small decisions as well as large ones.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in Kha Siangtho in up mite khensatna lian te bek hi lo-in neu te-ah zong a lamlak hi ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: My little sister prays for her goldfish.
records.zomi: Ka nau nu in a nga neu adingin thu a ngen hi.

records.english: Dad asks the Spirit for patience in heavy traffic.
records.zomi: Paa in mawtaw kiphun lai-in Kha Siangtho kiangah thuakzawhna a ngen hi.

records.english: How can our family live by the Spirit during a busy week?
records.zomi: Kal buai khat sungin i innkuan in Kha Siangtho tawh bangci i nungta thei ding uh hiam?

records.english: Start each day with a short prayer, speak kindly at home and stop to help someone when you can.
records.zomi: Ni khat ciat thu ngetna tom khat tawh kipan un, inn-ah hehpih takin gen un, na theih ciangin mi khat huh dingin khawl un.

records.english: Why does Mum hum hymns when she's worried?
records.zomi: Nu a lunghimawh ciangin bang hangin biakna la te zawi takin a sa hiam?

records.english: When my husband lost his job, our family began each evening by asking the Holy Spirit for strength.
records.zomi: Ka pasal in a nasep a mansuah ciangin, i innkuan in Kha Siangtho kiangah hatna ngen in nitak khempeuh a kipan uh hi.

records.english: Our children prayed in their own simple words, and slowly the house felt calmer even before anything changed.
records.zomi: I ta te in amau' kammal baih tawh thu a ngen uh a, bangmah a kikhek ma-in zong inn sung zawi zawi-in a dai zaw hi.

records.english: Months later, when he found new work, our son said the Spirit had helped us wait together.
records.zomi: Kha tampi khit-in, nasep thak a muh ciangin, Kha Siangtho in khawm-in i ngak nadingin hong huh hi, ci-in i tapa in a gen hi.

records.english: Why does Grandma say the Spirit guided her when she chose to forgive her brother?
records.zomi: Pi in a unau pasal a maisak dingin a teel ciangin Kha Siangtho in a lamlak hi ci-in bang hangin a gen hiam?

records.english: She believes the Spirit softened her heart after years of anger, so that forgiving him felt possible for the first time.
records.zomi: Kum tampi a heh khit-in Kha Siangtho in a lungsim a nem sak a, tua ahih manin a maisakna a masa pen-in a hi thei bang a kizak hi ci-in a um hi.

records.english: Our children were encouraged when their grandfather said that he still asks the Spirit for patience.
records.zomi: I ta te in a pu uh in Kha Siangtho kiangah thuakzawhna a ngen lai hi a ci ciangin a lungsim uh a hat hi.

records.english: When my son was bullied, we prayed together that the Spirit would give him courage and wisdom.
records.zomi: Ka tapa a kisawi ciangin, Kha Siangtho in hangsanna leh pilna a pia nadingin khawm-in thu i ngen uh hi.

records.english: Living by the Spirit, many believers say, shows itself in how they treat their families.
records.zomi: Kha Siangtho tawh nuntakna pen a innkuan uh bangci a bawl uh hiam cih-ah a kilang hi, ci-in up mi tampi in a gen uh hi.

records.english: Could our family choose one way each week to serve others as a sign of the Spirit's work?
records.zomi: I innkuan in Kha Siangtho' nasep lahna khat bangin kal simin mi dang te nasep sak nading lampi khat i teel thei ding uh hiam?

records.english: Our family sings one hymn after supper.
records.zomi: I innkuan in nitak an khit-in biakna la khat a sa uh hi.

records.english: When our family moved to a new country, we prayed for the Spirit to help us make friends.
records.zomi: I innkuan gam thak khat-ah a tai ciangin, lawm i ngah nadingin Kha Siangtho in hong huh dingin thu i ngen uh hi.

records.english: We pray before breakfast on school days.
records.zomi: Sang ni te-in zingsang an ma-in thu i ngen uh hi.

records.english: Will the factory have any jobs for students during the summer?
records.zomi: Khal hun-in factory in sang naupang te adingin nasep a nei ding hiam?

records.english: Is there any chance of a flat becoming available before the baby is born?
records.zomi: Naungek a suak ma-in inn khat a awng thei ding hiam?

records.english: Will the council have any allotment plots available next spring?
records.zomi: A zom spring hun-in council in huan mun awng a nei ding hiam?

records.english: Probably two or three, because some tenants are giving theirs up, but the waiting list already has forty names on it.
records.zomi: Nih hiam thum hiam ahi kha ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh luakmi pawlkhat in a nusia uh a, ahi zongin ngakna lista-ah min sawm li a om khin hi.

records.english: Is the band free on the date we've chosen for the wedding?
records.zomi: Mopawi adingin i teel ni-in band a awng hiam?

records.english: Will the college still have places on the evening course when my shifts change?
records.zomi: Ka nasep hun a kikhek ciangin college in nitak sinna-ah mun a nei lai ding hiam?

records.english: Is your brother free for the wedding?
records.zomi: Na unau pasal mopawi adingin a awng hiam?

records.english: Can the plumber come next Tuesday?
records.zomi: A zom Pithai ni-in tui pipe bawlmi a hong thei ding hiam?

records.english: Waiting lists can make it hard to plan around services such as allotments or nurseries.
records.zomi: Ngakna lista te in huan mun ahih kei leh naupang kemna inn bang nasepna te tungah ciamteh a haksa sak thei hi.

records.english: Will your sister be free to look after the children during the half-term holiday?
records.zomi: Sinna hun lai-a tawlngak sungin naupang te kem dingin na sanggam nu a awng ding hiam?

records.english: Is there room on the trip in July?
records.zomi: July kha-a khualzinna-ah mun a om lai hiam?

records.english: Will the doctor have time next week?
records.zomi: A zom kal-in damdawi siam in hun a nei ding hiam?

records.english: Questions about future availability help families coordinate busy lives.
records.zomi: Hun ding-a awnna tawh kisai dotna te in innkuan te a buai nuntakna uh a kizui sak nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Are you free next Saturday?
records.zomi: A zom Kiginni-in na awng hiam?

records.english: Are the guides free to lead a tour for our group in the spring?
records.zomi: Spring hun-in i pawl adingin lamlakmi te in en kualna khat a makaih thei ding uh hiam?

records.english: Is the photographer available for the anniversary party in October, or should we look for someone else?
records.zomi: October kha-a kiteenna kum pawi adingin lim lami a awng hiam, ahih kei leh mi dang khat i zong ding uh hiam?

records.english: The photographer has a wedding that morning but could come to the party from four o'clock onwards.
records.zomi: Lim lami in tua zingsang-in mopawi khat a nei a, ahi zongin nai li pan kipan-in pawi-ah a hong thei hi.

records.english: Asking whether someone is free shows respect for their time.
records.zomi: Mi khat a awng hiam cih dot in a hun a zahtakna a lak hi.

records.english: Will the community centre have a room free for our language class next term?
records.zomi: A zom sinna hun-in i pau sinna adingin khuasung inn in inn awng khat a nei ding hiam?

records.english: Can Grandma come for Christmas?
records.zomi: Christmas adingin Pi a hong thei ding hiam?

records.english: Will the hotel have rooms at Easter?
records.zomi: Easter-in zinbuuk in inn sung awng a nei ding hiam?

records.english: Planning around other people's availability is a skill that improves with practice.
records.zomi: Mi dang te' awnna tungah ciamteh pen kisin ciangin a hoih semsem siamna khat ahi hi.

records.english: Checking availability early gives people the best choice of dates.
records.zomi: Awnna a ma-in et in mite ni teelna hoih pen a pia hi.

records.english: Booking in advance is especially important during holidays and festivals.
records.zomi: Tawlngak hun leh pawi hun te-in a ma-in nget pen a thupi mahmah hi.

records.english: Is there a space at the nursery in September?
records.zomi: September kha-in naupang kemna inn-ah mun a om hiam?

records.english: Will the church hall be free for our wedding reception next June?
records.zomi: A zom June kha-in i mopawi an nekna adingin biakinn kikhopna inn a awng ding hiam?

records.english: The second Saturday is still open, but the rest of the month is already booked.
records.zomi: Kiginni nihna a awng lai a, ahi zongin kha' a dang khempeuh a kinget khin hi.

records.english: Will the tutor have time before the exams?
records.zomi: Sittelna ma-in sinsakmi in hun a nei ding hiam?

records.english: When we started planning my grandmother's ninetieth birthday, we asked every relative which weekends they were free in August.
records.zomi: Ka pi' kum sawm kua pianni i ciamteh kipat ciangin, August kha-in koi kal tawp te-in a awng uh hiam ci-in sanggam khempeuh i dot uh hi.

records.english: After three weeks of messages, only one Saturday suited everyone, including the cousins flying in from abroad.
records.zomi: Kal thum sung thu kikhak khit-in, gamdang pan vanleng tawh hong pai sanggam te zong hel-in, mi khempeuh adingin Kiginni khat bek a kituak hi.

records.english: We booked the hall that same evening, and Grandma said it was the best birthday of her life.
records.zomi: Tua nitak mah-in kikhopna inn i nget uh a, a nuntakna sung-a pianni hoih pen ahi hi, ci-in Pi in a gen hi.

records.english: Can you come to the party on Friday?
records.zomi: Laithai ni-in pawi-ah na hong thei ding hiam?

records.english: Popular venues and services are often booked many months ahead.
records.zomi: Mi tampi in a deih mun leh nasepna te kha tampi ma-in a kinget khin zel hi.

records.english: Is the coach free for the school trip?
records.zomi: Sang khualzinna adingin bus lian a awng hiam?

records.english: Asking about several dates makes it easier to find one that suits everyone.
records.zomi: Ni tampi tawh kisai dot in mi khempeuh adingin a kituak ni khat muh a baihsak hi.

records.english: Are there likely to be tickets for the final if we wait until next week?
records.zomi: A zom kal dong i ngak leh tawp pen kimawlna adingin lai-ek a om kha ding hiam?

records.english: Organisations that publish their availability save residents many phone calls.
records.zomi: A awnna uh a koih pawl te in mite' phone samna tampi a hum uh hi.

records.english: Is the pool open during the holidays?
records.zomi: Tawlngak hun-in tuipeekna mun a kihong hiam?

records.english: Will the teacher be free after the holidays?
records.zomi: Tawlngak hun khit-in sia a awng ding hiam?

records.english: Families spread across countries need extra time to agree on a date.
records.zomi: Gam tuamtuam-a a om innkuan te in ni khat tungah kithuhuah nadingin hun behlap a kisam uh hi.

records.english: Are there any seats left for the concert?
records.zomi: Concert adingin tutna a om lai hiam?

records.english: Are you free to help us paint the new flat next month?
records.zomi: A zom kha-in inn thak zial dingin hong huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: I can do the first weekend, but after that I'm away on a training course.
records.zomi: Kal tawp masa pen ka bawl thei a, ahi zongin tua khit-in sinna khat-ah ka om lo ding hi.

records.english: Is the football pitch available for a tournament at the end of the season?
records.zomi: Hun tawp-in kidemna khat adingin football mun a awng hiam?

records.english: Will the hospital have a bed for my father before the end of the month?
records.zomi: Kha a bei ma-in damdawi inn in ka pa adingin lupna khat a nei ding hiam?

records.english: Will the library's meeting room be available every Tuesday next year?
records.zomi: A zom kum-in Pithai ni khempeuh-in laibu inn' kikhopna inn a awng ding hiam?

records.english: Availability can change quickly, so plans should be confirmed as soon as possible.
records.zomi: Awnna manlang takin a kikhek thei ahih manin, ciamteh te a theih pai pai-in kipsak ding hi.

records.english: Are the tennis courts free on Saturday morning?
records.zomi: Kiginni zingsang-in tennis mun te a awng hiam?

records.english: Are you around during the summer?
records.zomi: Khal hun-in na om hiam?

records.english: Flexible plans cope better when a first choice is not available.
records.zomi: A masa teelna a om lo ciangin ciamteh kikhek thei te in a thuak zo zaw hi.

records.english: Is your father likely to be free to drive us to the airport next month?
records.zomi: A zom kha-in vanlengtual-ah hong paipih dingin na pa a awng kha ding hiam?

records.english: Will there be enough volunteers for the festival if it moves to a weekday?
records.zomi: Pawi kal sung ni khat-ah a tai leh pawi adingin thalawp a tamzah a om ding hiam?

records.english: Will the car be free on Sunday?
records.zomi: Nipini-in mawtaw a awng ding hiam?

records.english: Will the shop have the sofa next month?
records.zomi: A zom kha-in dawr in sofa a nei ding hiam?

records.english: Will there be any places left on the summer art course?
records.zomi: Khal hun lim zialna sinna-ah mun a om lai ding hiam?

records.english: A few, if you register before the end of April, when the list closes.
records.zomi: Tawm khat, lista a kikhak April kha tawp ma-in na min na seh leh.

records.english: Will the clinic have appointments available after the new doctor arrives?
records.zomi: Damdawi siam thak a tun khit-in damdawi inn neu in kihona hun a nei ding hiam?

records.english: Are any of the builders able to start before the rainy season?
records.zomi: Guah hun ma-in inn lammi te lak-ah kua hiam a kipan thei ding hiam?

records.english: Is the hall available in May?
records.zomi: May kha-in kikhopna inn a awng hiam?

records.english: Is the cottage available in August?
records.zomi: August kha-in inn neu a awng hiam?

records.english: The council posted an official warning.
records.zomi: Council in kumpi vaihawmna khat a koih hi.

records.english: Sharing the original post allows readers to see updates and corrections.
records.zomi: Post bulpi hawm in simmi te in thuthak leh bawlphatna te a mu thei sak hi.

records.english: The health centre's post explained why residents should check vaccine information with a nurse.
records.zomi: Damna inn' post in mite in vaccine thu nurse khat tawh bang hangin a et kul uh hiam cih a hilh hi.

records.english: The council thanked residents who reported a fake account using the town's logo.
records.zomi: Khuapi' logo zang account zuau khat a gen mite kiangah council in lungdam a ko hi.

records.english: Did you check the date on the post?
records.zomi: Post tung-a ni na et hiam?

records.english: The police thanked residents for checking first.
records.zomi: Palik te in a masa-in a et mite kiangah lungdam a ko uh hi.

records.english: What should our residents' group do before sharing a post that accuses a local shop of overcharging?
records.zomi: Khuasung dawr khat in man a tam lua-in a la hi ci-a post khat a hawm ma-in i khuasung mite' pawl in bang a bawl ding hiam?

records.english: Check the facts with the shop and other customers first, because a false accusation could damage a family's business unfairly.
records.zomi: Dawr leh lei mi dang te tawh thutak te a masa-in et in, bang hang hiam cih leh mawhsakna zuau khat in innkuan khat' sumbawlna a dik lo-in a siat sak thei hi.

records.english: Pausing to check before sharing is one of the simplest ways to protect a community.
records.zomi: Hawm ma-in et dingin khawl pen khuasung khat kem nading lampi baih pen khat ahi hi.

records.english: Is this post from the police?
records.zomi: Hih post palik te pan ahi hiam?

records.english: How can a small group stop members sharing scams without upsetting them?
records.zomi: Pawl neu khat in member te lungkham sak lo-in khemna te a hawm lo nadingin bangci a kham thei ding hiam?

records.english: Is it all right to share the council's warning about the water supply?
records.zomi: Tui piakna tawh kisai council' vaihawmna hawm pen a hoih hiam?

records.english: Yes, share the official post rather than a screenshot, so people see any updates.
records.zomi: Hi, mite in thuthak te a muh nadingin screenshot sangin kumpi post bulpi hawm in.

records.english: Who took this photo of the parade?
records.zomi: Pai khawmna' hih lim kua in a la hiam?

records.english: Please blur the faces in the photo.
records.zomi: Lim sung-a mai te a kilang lo dingin bawl in.

records.english: Don't share photos of other people's children.
records.zomi: Mi dang te' ta te' lim hawm kei in.

records.english: The clinic shares only official health advice.
records.zomi: Damdawi inn neu in kumpi damna thuhilhna te bek a hawm hi.

records.english: Ask before you share a neighbour's news.
records.zomi: Inn kiang mi khat' thuthak na hawm ma-in dot in.

records.english: Is it fair to share a video of a rude bus driver without knowing the whole story?
records.zomi: Tangthu bup theih lo-in zahtak lo bus mawngmi khat' video hawm pen a dik hiam?

records.english: Volunteer moderators often spend hours checking rumours before members see them.
records.zomi: Thalawp pawl kemmi te in member te in a muh ma-un thu zuau te et dingin nai tampi a zang zel uh hi.

records.english: Can I post photos from the library's children's party?
records.zomi: Laibu inn' naupang pawi pan lim te ka koih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Only the ones without children's faces, unless their parents have signed the consent form.
records.zomi: Naupang te' mai a kilang lo te bek, a nu leh pa te un phalna lai-ah khut a ngap kei uh leh.

records.english: The food bank corrected the false message.
records.zomi: An huhna inn in thu zuau a bawlphat hi.

records.english: Could the community centre post a guide to checking whether a story is true?
records.zomi: Tangthu khat a tak hiam cih et nading lamlakna khat khuasung inn in a koih thei ding hiam?

records.english: Children's images deserve special protection online.
records.zomi: Naupang te' lim te online-ah kemna tuam a kisam hi.

records.english: Why did the health centre ask people not to share a message about a new illness?
records.zomi: Damna inn in natna thak khat tawh kisai thu khat hawm lo dingin mite bang hangin a ngen hiam?

records.english: The message contained false advice, and the centre wanted residents to rely on information from doctors instead.
records.zomi: Thu in thuhilhna zuau a nei a, inn in mite damdawi siam te pan thu a muan nadingin a deih hi.

records.english: Our street group agreed not to share the address of the family who lost their house in the fire.
records.zomi: I lampi pawl in mei kang-ah a inn a mansuah innkuan' omna hawm lo dingin a kithuhuah uh hi.

records.english: Share the original post, not a screenshot.
records.zomi: Screenshot hi lo-in post bulpi hawm in.

records.english: I deleted the post after checking it.
records.zomi: Ka et khit-in post ka mai sak hi.

records.english: Our neighbourhood group asks members to say where they found information before sharing it.
records.zomi: I khuasung pawl in member te a hawm ma-un thu koi-ah a mu uh hiam cih gen dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: When a post claimed that the town's food bank was closing, dozens of worried families shared it within an hour.
records.zomi: Post khat in khuapi' an huhna inn a kikhak ding hi a ci ciangin, lunghimawh innkuan sawm tampi in nai khat sungin a hawm uh hi.

records.english: A volunteer phoned the coordinator, who confirmed that the post was false and wrote a clear message on the food bank's official page.
records.zomi: Thalawp khat in a makaipa a phone a, ama'n post zuau ahi hi cih a kipsak a, an huhna inn' kumpi laimai tungah thu kician khat a gelh hi.

records.english: The group's moderator removed the rumour and asked members to check the official page before sharing such news.
records.zomi: Pawl kemmi in thu zuau a mai sak a, member te tua bang thuthak hawm ma-un kumpi laimai et dingin a ngen hi.

records.english: The police warned residents that sharing a suspect's photo could affect a future trial.
records.zomi: Mawhnei kisu mi khat' lim hawm in hun ding thukhenna khat a tuak thei hi ci-in palik te in mite a vaihawm uh hi.

records.english: Don't share private messages in the group.
records.zomi: Pawl sungah mimal thu kikhak te hawm kei in.

records.english: Crediting creators shows respect for their work.
records.zomi: A bawlmi te' min gen in a nasep uh zahtakna a lak hi.

records.english: Don't post the volunteers' phone numbers.
records.zomi: Thalawp te' phone nambat koih kei in.

records.english: Check the source before you share.
records.zomi: Na hawm ma-in a hong pan et in.

records.english: The library's workshop showed older residents how to spot fake appeals for money.
records.zomi: Laibu inn' sinna kikhopna in upa te sum ngetna zuau te bangci thei ding hiam cih a lak hi.

records.english: Accusations shared without evidence can damage livelihoods unfairly.
records.zomi: Ettehna om lo-in kihawm mawhsakna te in mite' nuntakna a dik lo-in a siat sak thei hi.

records.english: The moderator removed the rumour.
records.zomi: Pawl kemmi in thu zuau a mai sak hi.

records.english: The council asked residents not to share photos of the accident until the families had been told.
records.zomi: Innkuan te kiangah a kigen ma-un lauhuaina' lim te hawm lo dingin council in mite a ngen hi.

records.english: Responsible sharing helps communities trust the information they receive.
records.zomi: Mawhpuakna nei taka hawmna in khuasung te in a ngah thu te uh a muan nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: The library asked us not to tag visitors.
records.zomi: Laibu inn in zin mi te tag lo dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: Official sources should be checked before sharing urgent news.
records.zomi: Thuthak manlang hawm ma-in kumpi thu pan mun te a kiet ding hi.

records.english: Why do public services sometimes ask people to share their posts rather than copy them?
records.zomi: Mipi nasepna te in mite a post te uh teh sangin hawm dingin bang hangin a ngen zel uh hiam?

records.english: Did the text really come from the council?
records.zomi: Text in council pan a hong tak hiam?

records.english: A quick message asking a neighbour's consent can prevent a painful public argument.
records.zomi: Inn kiang mi khat' phalna ngen thu tom khat in mipi mai-a kinialna lungkham huai khat a kham thei hi.

records.english: Several volunteers asked the charity to remove photos that showed their homes.
records.zomi: Thalawp tampi in a inn uh a lak lim te mai sak dingin huhna pawl a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Public services rely on residents to pass on accurate information.
records.zomi: Mipi nasepna te in thu dik te a hawm dingin mite tungah a kinga uh hi.

records.english: The youth club teaches teenagers to ask permission before posting pictures of friends.
records.zomi: Khangno pawl in khangno te a lawm te uh' lim a koih ma-un phalna ngen dingin a sinsak hi.

records.english: When a false rumour spread about the school closing, the head teacher posted a calm correction.
records.zomi: Sang a kikhak ding hi ci thu zuau khat a zel ciangin, sang makaipa in lungmuang takin bawlphatna khat a koih hi.

records.english: Why did the museum ask visitors to credit photographers when sharing pictures of the exhibition?
records.zomi: Museum in a kilakna lim te a hawm ciangun lim lami te' min gen dingin zin mi te bang hangin a ngen hiam?

records.english: Corrections should be shared as widely as the original mistake.
records.zomi: Bawlphatna te khialhna bulpi bangin a zai takin a kihawm ding hi.

records.english: Is this charity appeal real?
records.zomi: Hih huhna pawl' ngetna a tak hiam?

records.english: Should I share the post about the missing teenager?

records.english: Being angry isn't always wrong, but our church teaches us to speak kindly even when we're upset.

records.zomi: Kiciamna khat bawlsia pen mawhna ahi hiam?

records.zomi: Khazih nu leh pa te in mawhna in i it pen mite a natsak hi ci-in a sinsak zel uh hi.

records.zomi: Lawhna-ah zuau bawl pen mawhna ahi hiam?

records.zomi: Khazih sinsakna in innkuan sungah kuamah mawhna pan a suakta kei hi ci-in a gen hi.

records.zomi: Ka pa in thu khial khat sel in a puak ding a gik zawsak bek hi ci-in hong sinsak hi.

records.english: How does your family decide what to say when a child admits stealing?

records.english: Why is stealing wrong?

records.english: Christian parents hope their children learn to admit wrongs without fear.
records.zomi: Khazih nu leh pa te in a ta te uh in lau lo-in a thu khial uh a pulak thei nadingin a lamen uh hi.

records.english: Many Christian grandparents pray each day for their grandchildren to resist temptation.
records.zomi: Khazih pu leh pi tampi in a tu te uh in khemna a do thei nadingin ni simin thu a ngen uh hi.

records.english: Is it a sin to tell a small lie?
records.zomi: Zuau neu khat gen pen mawhna ahi hiam?

records.english: Is it wrong to call people names?
records.zomi: Mite min hoih lo tawh sam pen a khial hiam?

records.english: Why should I forgive my cousin?

records.english: Many Christians believe that hidden sins affect the people closest to them.
records.zomi: Khazih mi tampi in mawhna kisel te in amau tawh a kinai pen mite a nawngkaisak hi ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Can I pray when I feel guilty?
records.zomi: Mawhna ka kiphawk ciangin thu ka ngen thei ding hiam?

records.english: How can a Christian family talk about sin without making a child feel worthless?

records.english: Christians believe that sin in a home can be healed through honest forgiveness.
records.zomi: Khazih mite in inn sung-a mawhna pen thutak taka maisakna tawh a dam thei hi ci-in a um uh hi.

records.english: Can we say sorry to God together?

records.english: Christian families often see confession as a path to restored relationships.
records.zomi: Khazih innkuan te in mawhna pulakna pen kizopna kibawlphat kikna lampi khat bangin a en zel uh hi.

records.english: Did your parents talk to you about sin when you were little?
records.zomi: Na neu lai-in na nu leh na pa in mawhna tawh kisai hong hilh uh hiam?

records.english: Yes, mostly at bedtime, when we prayed and said sorry for the wrong things we had done that day.

records.english: Why do some Christian parents confess their own mistakes to their children?

records.english: How did your mother explain the difference between a mistake and a sin?

records.english: Do you think Christian teaching about sin changed the way you raised your children?

records.zomi: Banghang hiam cih leh zuau gen in mi dang te leh Pasian tawh i kimuanna a susia hi ci-in Khazih mite in a um uh hi.

records.english: Can a child sin?

records.english: Is being greedy a sin?

records.english: Did you forgive your brother?

records.english: The old people in our village remember winters when the lake froze solid enough to walk on.

records.english: Was the summer of your wedding hot?

records.english: Memories of hard winters shape how families prepare today.
records.zomi: Khuaphal haksa te phawkna in tu-in innkuan te kiginkhol dan a bawl hi.

records.english: My mother says that the springs were cooler and longer when she was a girl.
records.zomi: Ka nu in amah numei neu lai-in spring te a dai zaw a, a sau zaw hi a ci hi.

records.english: Was it hot when you were young?
records.zomi: Na khanglai-in khua a sa hiam?

records.english: Communities often remember a terrible storm for generations.
records.zomi: Khuasung te in huihpi lauhuai khat khang tampi sung a phawk zel uh hi.

records.english: Did the frost kill your mother's roses that year?
records.zomi: Tua kum-in khal in na nu' rose pak te a si sak hiam?

records.english: The hailstones that fell on our town were as big as eggs and dented every car.
records.zomi: I khuapi-a a tum guahsuang te aktui bangin a lian a, mawtaw khempeuh a khuk sak hi.

records.english: Comparing old and new records helps scientists measure climate change.
records.zomi: Ciamtehna lui leh thak kiteh in pilna siam te in khuahun kikhekna a teh thei nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Did school close because of the snow?
records.zomi: Vuk hangin sang a kikhak hiam?

records.english: Was there a rainbow after the storm?
records.zomi: Huihpi khit-in zuang a kilang hiam?

records.english: Traditional signs once helped farmers predict the weather before forecasts existed.
records.zomi: Khuahun thu-genna a om ma-in, ngeina lim te in lo neite khuahun a lamen thei nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Did it snow much when you were a child?
records.zomi: Na neu lai-in vuk tampi a tum hiam?

records.english: Every winter, and some years the snow came right up to the windows.
records.zomi: Khuaphal khempeuh-in, a kum pawlkhat-in vuk in tawlleng dongin a tung hi.

records.english: Did you have to walk to school in the rain?
records.zomi: Guah sungin sang-ah na kalsuan kul hiam?

records.english: Did the farm lose crops in the dry year?
records.zomi: Khuakhal kum-in lo in a gah te a mansuah hiam?

records.english: Stories about extreme weather help children understand the risks they may face.
records.zomi: Khuahun lauhuai tawh kisai tangthu te in naupang te in a tuah thei ding lauhuaina te a theih nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: How long did the heatwave last?

records.english: Was that winter colder than this one?

records.english: When the heatwave hit the city, the trains slowed down because the rails had bent.

records.english: When the fog came in, the fishermen used to ring a bell to guide the boats home.
records.zomi: Meikhu a tum ciangin, nga mantu te in long te inn-ah a ciah nadingin khuang a gen zel uh hi.

records.english: Our school kept records of the rainfall every day since it opened in 1965.
