records.english: Long-term records reveal changes that one person might never notice.
records.zomi: Hun sau ciamtehna te in mi khat in a phawk ngei lo ding kikhekna te a lak hi.

records.english: How did you stay cool without a fan?
records.zomi: Fan om lo-in bangci na kidai sak hiam?

records.english: Past droughts taught many villages to store water more carefully.
records.zomi: Khuakhal lui te in khua tampi tui a kem ding dan a sinsak hi.

records.english: Were the roads icy on your way to work?

records.english: Did the fog stop the boats from leaving?
records.zomi: Meikhu in long te a pai thei lo nadingin a kham hiam?

records.english: Did the old weather records show that the summers are getting hotter?
records.zomi: Khuahun ciamtehna lui te in khal te a sa semsem hi cih a lak hiam?

records.english: They watched the clouds over the hills and listened for the frogs calling at night.
records.zomi: Mual tung-a meiphual te a et uh a, zan-in utok te' ging a ngai uh hi.

records.english: Do you remember the year of the big hailstorm?
records.zomi: Guahsuang lian a tum kum na phawk hiam?

records.english: My grandfather kept a diary of the weather every day for over forty years.
records.zomi: Ka pu in kum sawmli val sung ni simin khuahun ciamtehna laibu khat a kem hi.

records.english: During the drought of my childhood, our well went dry for the first time anyone could remember.
records.zomi: Ka neu lai-a khuakhal sungin, kuamah' phawk theih sungah a masa pen-in i tuikhuk a kang hi.

records.english: Every morning before school, my brothers and I walked to the river with buckets, and the walk took over an hour.
records.zomi: Zingsang khempeuh sang pai ma-in, kei leh ka unau pasal te tuibeel tawh tuilui-ah i pai uh a, a pai in nai khat val a la hi.

records.english: When the rain finally returned in October, the whole village stood outside and let it soak us.

records.english: Did you see the snow on the mountains?
records.zomi: Mual tung-a vuk na mu hiam?

records.english: Many communities rebuilt more strongly after a devastating storm.
records.zomi: Khuasung tampi in huihpi lauhuai khat khit-in a khauh zaw-in a lam kik uh hi.

records.english: Did the wind blow down the big tree?
records.zomi: Huih in singkung lian a puk sak hiam?

records.english: What was the worst storm you remember, Grandma?

records.zomi: Kum sawm leh nih ka hih kum-a om, huih in i sang' inntung a laksak ciang.

records.english: After the great storm, neighbours helped one another repair their roofs for weeks.
records.zomi: Huihpi lian khit-in, innveng te in kal tampi sung khat leh khat inntung bawlphat dingin a kihuh uh hi.

records.english: The winter my parents married was so cold that the priest's ink froze in the church.
records.zomi: Ka nu leh ka pa a kiteen khuaphal pen a dai mahmah ahih manin, biakinn sungah siampi' khedawi tui a khal hi.

records.english: Did the storm break your windows?
records.zomi: Huihpi in na tawlleng te a kitamsak hiam?

records.english: Weather diaries kept by ordinary people are valuable to climate scientists.
records.zomi: Mi ngeina te' kem khuahun ciamtehna laibu te in khuahun pilna siam te adingin a manphat hi.

records.english: In the year of the drought, the government sent lorries of water to our village.
records.zomi: Khuakhal kum-in, kumpi in i khua-ah mawtaw lian tawh tui a khak hi.

records.english: Learning from past weather disasters can help save lives in the future.
records.zomi: Khuahun lauhuaina lui te pan sin in hun hong tung ding-ah nuntakna te a hotkhiat thei hi.

records.english: Did lightning ever hit your house?
records.zomi: Kilawn in na inn a sat ngei hiam?

records.english: Historical weather events are often linked to changes in how people built their homes.
records.zomi: Tangthu-a khuahun piangthu te mite' inn lam dan kikhekna tawh a kizom zel hi.

records.english: Did your family listen to the weather on the radio?
records.zomi: Na innkuan in radio tungah khuahun thu a ngai uh hiam?

records.english: My uncle still talks about the lightning that split the oak tree in two.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu in oak singkung kilawn in a khen nihsak thu a gen lai hi.

records.english: Do you remember the summer the reservoir was so low that we could see the old village under it?
records.zomi: Tui kikhawlna dil a niam lua-in a nuai-a khua lui i muh theih khal na phawk hiam?

records.english: Why did the village move its houses up the hill all those years ago?
records.zomi: Kum tampi a bei ma-in khua in a inn te mual tung lam-ah bang hangin a tai sak hiam?

records.english: After the river rose three springs in a row, the elders decided that the low fields were no longer safe to live on.
records.zomi: Spring thum zom-in tuilui a let khit-in, upa te in lo niam te-ah teng ding a bit nawn kei hi ci-in a khensat uh hi.

records.english: How has the weather changed since you started fishing forty years ago?
records.zomi: Kum sawmli a bei ma-in nga na man kipat pan khuahun bangci a kikhek hiam?

records.english: The storms come at different times now, and the sea is warmer, so some of the fish we used to catch have moved further north.
records.zomi: Tu-in huihpi te hun tuamtuam-in a hong uh a, tuipi a lum zaw a, tua ahih manin i man ngei nga pawlkhat in mal lam gamla zaw-ah a tai uh hi.

records.english: Was the harvest good that year?
records.zomi: Tua kum-in gah lakna a hoih hiam?

records.english: The first time I saw snow was the winter I moved to university.
records.zomi: Vuk ka muh masak pen pen university-ah ka tai khuaphal ahi hi.

records.english: When I was a child, the monsoon arrived on almost the same week every year.
records.zomi: Ka neu lai-in, kum simin guah hun pen kal kibang dekdek-in a tung hi.

records.english: Older people's memories of the weather can show how the climate has changed.
records.zomi: Upa te' khuahun phawkna te in khuahun bangci a kikhek hiam cih a lak thei hi.

records.english: How cold was your first winter abroad?

records.english: Simple changes at home can stop an infection from spreading.
records.zomi: Inn-a kikhekna baih te in natna kizel a kham thei hi.

records.english: Families who plan for winter illnesses cope better when they happen.

records.english: If the fever lasts more than three days, should we take her to the clinic?

records.english: Why does our family keep passing the same cold from one person to the next?
records.zomi: I innkuan in khuavot natna kibang mi khat pan khat-ah bang hangin a kizelsak den uh hiam?

records.english: You're probably sharing towels and cups, so give everyone their own and wash hands more often.
records.zomi: Towel leh haai te na kihawm kha uh ding a, tua ahih manin mi khempeuh in amau' ciat pia unla, khut tam zaw-in sil un.

records.english: Can a warm bath help my aching muscles?
records.zomi: Tui lum-a kisil in ka pumpi tha natna a huh thei ding hiam?

records.english: How can I sleep with a blocked nose?

records.english: My husband stopped getting migraines so often once he started drinking more water at work.

records.english: What should I do if the cough medicine isn't working after a week?

records.english: Good hygiene in shared spaces reduces illness at school and at work.

records.english: Small daily habits often prevent more illnesses than medicines do.

records.english: Is it better to treat a mild fever or let it run its course?

records.english: Repeated infections may point to a problem that needs a doctor's attention.

records.english: Treating symptoms early can prevent a small illness from becoming worse.

records.english: Clean the toilets and door handles several times a day, ask sick children to stay home for two days after the last symptoms, and tell parents quickly.

records.english: Simple solutions, such as better shoes, can relieve pain from long hours of standing.

records.english: Pain that affects sleep or daily tasks deserves medical attention.

records.english: Can a massage help my sore shoulders?

records.english: For months, my knees ached every time I climbed the stairs to our flat.

records.english: A physiotherapist gave me exercises to strengthen the muscles around them and told me to do them every evening.

records.english: Could a different chair help with the pain I get between my shoulder blades?

records.zomi: Physiotherapist te in mite amau le amau natna a kem thei nadingin pumpi kizatna te a sinsak uh hi.

records.english: The physiotherapist suggested a footrest, and the ache in my lower back disappeared within a week.

records.zomi: A zom kum-in pi in eite tawh hong teng ding hiam cih innkuan in khawm-in a khensat ding uh hi.

records.english: Are you going to decide about the extension before the winter?
records.zomi: Khuaphal ma-in inn behlap tawh kisai na khensat ding uh hiam?

records.english: Yes, because the builder can only start in March if we sign by December.
records.zomi: Hi, banghang hiam cih leh December ma-in i min i suai uh leh bek inn lam siam in March-in a kipan thei ding hi.

records.english: Will you choose the course this week?
records.zomi: Hih kal-in sinna na teel ding hiam?

records.english: I'd rather decide about my career after a year of work experience.
records.zomi: Kum khat nasep theihna ka neih khit-in ka nasep lampi tawh kisai khensat ka deih zaw hi.

records.english: Have you decided whether to apply for the job in the capital next spring?
records.zomi: A zom spring-in gam khuapi lian-a nasep na ngen ding hiam cih na khensat khin hiam?

records.english: Not yet, but I'll decide after I've visited the office and seen the rents there.
records.zomi: Khensat nai lo, ahi zongin office ka veh khit-in leh tua-a inn hal man ka et khit-in ka khensat ding hi.

records.english: What will help the committee decide whether to build the new hall in two years' time?
records.zomi: Kum nih khit-in inn lian thak a lam ding hiam cih committee in a khensat nadingin bang in a huh ding hiam?

records.english: In our village, the committee wants a survey of how many groups would use it and a clear plan for paying the running costs.
records.zomi: I khua-ah, committee in pawl bangzah in a zang ding hiam cih etna khat leh a sep man piak dan ciamteh kician khat a deih hi.

records.english: Deciding with care today can prevent many problems in the years ahead.
records.zomi: Tuni-in kidawm takin khensat in hong tung ding kum te-a haksatna tampi a kham thei hi.

records.english: Will you let me know your decision by Friday?
records.zomi: Laithai ni ma-in na khensatna hong theisak ding hiam?

records.english: Should we wait until the children are older before deciding where to settle?
records.zomi: Koi-ah i teen ding hiam cih i khensat ma-un naupang te a upat dongin i ngak ding uh hiam?

records.english: Setting a date to decide stops a choice from dragging on for months.
records.zomi: Khensat ding ni khat koih in teelna khat kha tampi sung a sau lo nadingin a kham hi.

records.english: Long-term decisions often balance security against opportunity.
records.zomi: Hun sau khensatna te in bitna leh hamphatna kikal-ah a kituaksak zel hi.

records.english: Have you decided where to live after university?
records.zomi: University na zawh khit-in koi-ah teng ding hiam cih na khensat khin hiam?

records.english: When do you think you'll decide whether to have the operation?
records.zomi: Operation na bawl ding hiam cih bang ciangin na khensat ding hi na ci hiam?

records.english: Have you decided to learn to drive?
records.zomi: Mawtaw mawng sin dingin na khensat khin hiam?

records.english: Shall we decide about the puppy after the holidays?
records.zomi: Tawlngakni khit-in ui neu tawh kisai i khensat ding uh hiam?

records.english: A good decision can still lead to disappointment if circumstances change.
records.zomi: Omdan a kikhek leh khensatna hoih khat in zong lungkiatna a tun thei hi.

records.english: Have you booked anything for next summer yet?
records.zomi: A zom khal adingin bangmah na ngen khin hiam?

records.english: Have you made up your mind about the new job?
records.zomi: Nasep thak tawh kisai na lungsim na khensat khin hiam?

records.english: When will you choose your college course?
records.zomi: Na college sinna bang ciangin na teel ding hiam?

records.english: Will you take the offer next month?
records.zomi: A zom kha-in a kipia na la ding hiam?

records.english: Have you decided whether to study part-time while you keep working?
records.zomi: Nasep na sep lai-in hun tawm-in na sin ding hiam cih na khensat khin hiam?

records.english: Before you decide to move abroad, would you like to talk to someone who has done it?
records.zomi: Gamdang-ah tai dingin na khensat ma-in, a bawl khin mi khat tawh na kikum nop hiam?

records.english: Have you decided what to study next?
records.zomi: A zom-ah bang sin ding hiam cih na khensat khin hiam?

records.english: When will you decide which university to accept?
records.zomi: University koi na la ding hiam cih bang ciangin na khensat ding hiam?

records.english: By the end of May, once I know how much the scholarship will cover.
records.zomi: May kha tawp ciangin, sinna huhna sum in bangzah a tuam ding hiam cih ka theih khit-in.

records.english: Families make better future decisions when everyone feels heard.
records.zomi: Mi khempeuh in a thu uh kiza hi ci-a a kizak uh ciangin innkuan te in hun ding khensatna hoih zaw a bawl uh hi.

records.english: Have you decided whether to retire?
records.zomi: Nasep na tawp ding hiam cih na khensat khin hiam?

records.english: Will the school decide about the new timetable before the summer holidays?
records.zomi: Khal tawlngakni ma-in sang in sinna hun lista thak tawh kisai a khensat ding hiam?

records.english: The council has promised to decide about the new bus route by the end of the year.
records.zomi: Council in kum tawp ma-in bus lampi thak tawh kisai a khensat ding hi ci-in a ciam hi.

records.english: Will you decide before the deadline?
records.zomi: A kiciang ni ma-in na khensat ding hiam?

records.english: Gathering information before a big decision reduces later regret.
records.zomi: Khensatna lian khat ma-in thu kaikhawm in nungsang-a kisikna a niam sak hi.

records.english: I'll decide about the promotion once I know whether it means more travel.
records.zomi: Zin tam zaw ahi hiam cih ka theih ciangin nasep kahtohna tawh kisai ka khensat ding hi.

records.english: Have you chosen a school for next year?
records.zomi: A zom kum adingin sang khat na teel khin hiam?

records.english: Have you decided whether to save for a house or pay off the car first?
records.zomi: Inn adingin na kikoih ding hiam, ahih kei leh mawtaw leiba na cingsak masa ding hiam cih na khensat khin hiam?

records.english: Will you decide about the house this year?
records.zomi: Hih kum-in inn tawh kisai na khensat ding hiam?

records.english: When will the club decide about the new pitch?
records.zomi: Pawl in lawhna mun thak tawh kisai bang ciangin a khensat ding hiam?

records.english: Decisions about the future are easier when you know the deadline.
records.zomi: A kiciang ni na theih ciangin hun ding khensatna te a baih zaw hi.

records.english: A decision that affects several people should involve them early.
records.zomi: Mi tampi a nawngkaisak khensatna khat in amau a ma-in a hel ding hi.

records.english: Have you decided whether to renew your lease or look for somewhere bigger?
records.zomi: Na inn hal kiciamna na thaksak ding hiam, ahih kei leh a lian zaw mun khat na zong ding hiam cih na khensat khin hiam?

records.english: Why do members sometimes walk out of the chamber during a debate?
records.zomi: Kikumna sungin member te in kikhopna inn pan bang hangin a pai khia zel uh hiam?

records.english: In our parliament, what happens if a vote is tied?
records.zomi: I parliament-ah, vote a kibat leh bang a piang hiam?

records.english: Can a member lose their seat?
records.zomi: Member khat in a tutna a mansuah thei hiam?

records.english: Can a law passed by parliament be challenged in the courts?
records.zomi: Parliament in a pom thukham khat thukhenna mun-ah a kinial thei hiam?

records.english: The quality of a democracy depends partly on how openly its parliament answers questions.
records.zomi: Democracy khat' hoihna pen a parliament in dotna te bangzah kiphong takin a dawng hiam cih tungah a kinga hi.

records.english: How many committees does parliament have?
records.zomi: Parliament in committee bangzah a nei hiam?

records.english: How can a citizen find out how their representative voted on a particular law?
records.zomi: Gam mi khat in a aiawhmi in thukham khat tungah bangci vote a pia hiam cih bangci a thei thei ding hiam?

records.english: Clear answers from representatives build trust in legislative institutions.
records.zomi: Aiawhmi te' dawnna kician te in thukham bawl pawl te tungah muanna a lam hi.

records.english: Petitions give ordinary people a formal way to raise issues in parliament.
records.zomi: Petition te in mi ngeina te parliament-ah thu a gen thei nadingin lampi kician khat a pia hi.

records.english: Who signs a law after parliament passes it?
records.zomi: Parliament in thukham khat a pom khit-in kua in a min a suai hiam?

records.english: How long is a member's term?
records.zomi: Member khat' nasep hun bangzah a sau hiam?

records.english: Who writes new bills?
records.zomi: Thukham gelh masa thak te kua in a gelh hiam?

records.english: Can the public send ideas to a committee?
records.zomi: Mipi in committee khat kiangah ngaihsutna a khak thei hiam?

records.english: Do members get paid?
records.zomi: Member te in khasum a ngah uh hiam?

records.english: Public question sessions bring members of parliament closer to the people they serve.
records.zomi: Mipi dotna kikhopna te in parliament member te a nasepsak mite tawh a kinaisak hi.

records.english: How do opposition members hold the government to account in parliament?
records.zomi: Opposition member te in parliament-ah kumpi bangci a mawhpuaksak uh hiam?

records.english: In our country, how many signatures does a petition need before parliament debates it?
records.zomi: I gam-ah, parliament in a kikum ma-in petition khat in min suaina bangzah a kisam hiam?

records.english: Rules about voting and debate differ from one country's parliament to another.
records.zomi: Vote leh kikumna tawh kisai thukham te gam khat' parliament leh gam dang' parliament a kibang kei hi.

records.english: What can a committee do if a minister refuses to answer its questions?
records.zomi: Minister khat in a dotna te a dawng nop loh leh committee in bang a bawl thei hiam?

records.english: In our country, a committee can call the minister back, publish a report criticising the refusal and ask the whole parliament to debate the matter.
records.zomi: I gam-ah, committee in minister a sam kik thei a, a nialna a gensia report khat a suah thei a, parliament bup in thu a kikum dingin a ngen thei hi.

records.english: Committees allow detailed examination of bills that full debates cannot provide.
records.zomi: Committee te in kikumna bup in a piak zawh loh thukham gelh masa te etna kicing a phal hi.

records.english: Can ordinary people watch a debate in parliament?
records.zomi: Mi ngeina te in parliament-a kikumna khat a et thei uh hiam?

records.english: In our country, yes, from the public gallery, though you usually need to book a seat.
records.zomi: I gam-ah, hi, mipi tutna pan, ahi zongin tutna khat na ngen masa kul zel hi.

records.english: A second chamber can slow down legislation and encourage more careful review.
records.zomi: Kikhopna inn nihna khat in thukham bawlna a dah sak thei a, kidawm zaw-in etna a hanthawn thei hi.

records.english: Parliamentary education programmes answer many questions from young people.
records.zomi: Parliament sinsakna nasep te in khangno te' dotna tampi a dawng uh hi.

records.english: Can a member of parliament introduce a bill without the government's support?
records.zomi: Parliament member khat in kumpi' huhna om lo-in thukham gelh masa khat a koih thei hiam?

records.english: Who records the debates?
records.zomi: Kikumna te kua in a ciamteh hiam?

records.english: How often do members vote?
records.zomi: Member te in bangzah vei vote a pia uh hiam?

records.english: How long can a debate go on before the speaker calls a vote?
records.zomi: Speaker in vote a sap ma-in kikumna khat bangzah sawt a om thei hiam?

records.english: When does parliament meet?
records.zomi: Parliament bang ciangin a kikhawm hiam?

records.english: During our class visit, a student asked a member of parliament how long it takes to pass a law.
records.zomi: I class veh lai-in, sang naupang khat in parliament member khat kiangah thukham khat pom nadingin bangzah sawt a la hiam ci-in a dong hi.

records.english: The member replied that a simple bill can pass in a few weeks, but a complicated one may take more than a year.
records.zomi: Member in thukham gelh masa baih khat kal tawm khat sungin a kipom thei a, ahi zongin a buai khat kum khat sang a sau zaw thei hi ci-in a dawng hi.

records.english: Another student then asked why, and the member explained that committees often ask experts and the public for their views.
records.zomi: Tua khit-in sang naupang dang khat in bang hangin hiam ci-in a dong a, member in committee te in siam te leh mipi' ngaihsutna a dong zel uh hi ci-in a hilh hi.

records.english: Opposition questions are an important part of holding governments accountable.
records.zomi: Opposition dotna te kumpi te mawhpuaksak nasep sung-a thupi khat ahi hi.

records.english: Asking questions about parliament helps citizens understand how laws are made.
records.zomi: Parliament tawh kisai dotna dot in gam mi te in thukham te bangci kibawl hiam cih a theih nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Where do the members sit?
records.zomi: Member te koi-ah a tu uh hiam?

records.english: Does parliament meet in the summer?
records.zomi: Khal-in parliament a kikhawm hiam?

records.english: What happens if the two chambers of parliament disagree about a bill?
records.zomi: Parliament kikhopna inn nih in thukham gelh masa khat tungah a kituak loh uh leh bang a piang hiam?

records.english: How does a bill become law?
records.zomi: Thukham gelh masa khat thukham-ah bangci a suak hiam?

records.english: Who decides which committee examines a new bill?
records.zomi: Thukham gelh masa thak khat committee koi in a et ding hiam cih kua in a khensat hiam?

records.english: How can young people give evidence to a parliamentary committee?
records.zomi: Khangno te in parliament committee khat kiangah ettehna bangci a pia thei uh hiam?

records.english: Why are some votes in parliament taken by secret ballot?
records.zomi: Parliament-a vote pawlkhat bang hangin kisel takin a kipia hiam?

records.english: Why does a bill have to be read more than once before it becomes law?
records.zomi: Thukham gelh masa khat thukham a suah ma-in bang hangin vei khat sang tam zaw-in a kisim kul hiam?

records.english: In our parliament, each reading gives members another chance to debate it, suggest changes and check the details.
records.zomi: I parliament-ah, simna khat ciat in member te kikum kik ding, kikhekna gen ding leh a cing te et ding hun a pia hi.

records.english: Who chooses the speaker of parliament?
records.zomi: Parliament' speaker kua in a teel hiam?

records.english: In our parliament, the members vote for the speaker at the start of each new term.
records.zomi: I parliament-ah, nasep hun thak khat ciat kipat-in member te in speaker adingin vote a pia uh hi.

records.english: Can I write to any member?
records.zomi: Member khempeuh kiangah lai ka gelh thei hiam?

records.english: Why do some committees meet in public while others meet behind closed doors?
records.zomi: Committee pawlkhat mipi mai-ah a kikhawm uh a, a dang te kongkhak kikhak sungah bang hangin a kikhawm uh hiam?

records.english: How is the speaker chosen?
records.zomi: Speaker bangci a kiteel hiam?

records.english: What does it mean when parliament is dissolved before an election?
records.zomi: Teelna ma-in parliament a kiphelh ciangin bang a cihnopna hiam?

records.english: Why does parliament publish a written record of every debate?
records.zomi: Parliament in kikumna khempeuh' ciamtehna gelh bang hangin a suah hiam?

records.english: Who keeps order in parliament?
records.zomi: Parliament-ah kizui dan kua in a kem hiam?

records.english: Written records of debates allow anyone to check what was said and decided.
records.zomi: Kikumna ciamtehna gelh te in kua peuh in bang kigen a, bang kikhensat hiam cih a et thei nadingin a phal hi.

records.english: Can a bill be changed after the first reading?
records.zomi: Simna masa pen khit-in thukham gelh masa khat a kikhek thei hiam?

records.english: Is there a second chamber in our country?
records.zomi: I gam-ah kikhopna inn nihna khat a om hiam?

records.english: Citizens who understand legislative procedures can influence laws more effectively.
records.zomi: Thukham bawl dan a thei gam mi te in thukham te tungah a thuneihna uh a zang thei zaw uh hi.

records.english: How many members sit in our parliament?
records.zomi: I parliament-ah member bangzah a tu uh hiam?

records.english: I'd have to check, but the parliament's website lists every member by district.
records.zomi: Ka et kul ding hi, ahi zongin parliament' website in member khempeuh a mun ciat-in a lista hi.

records.english: Can a member vote against their party?
records.zomi: Member khat in a pawl a nial-in vote a pia thei hiam?

records.english: Who can become a member of parliament?
records.zomi: Kua in parliament member a suak thei hiam?

records.english: Recording observations immediately prevents errors caused by memory.
records.zomi: Muhte pahin ciamteh in phawkna hang-a khialhna te a kham hi.

records.english: Traditional knowledge often depends on patient observation of the natural world.
records.zomi: Ngeina theihna in leitung lungduai taka etna tungah a kinga zel hi.

records.english: Did you ever keep a nature diary as a child?
records.zomi: Na neu lai-in leitung ciamtehna laibu na kem ngei hiam?

records.english: Yes, every summer I drew the insects I found and wrote down where I saw them.
records.zomi: Hi, khal simin ka muh lukhuk te ka khai a, koi-ah ka mu hiam cih ka gelh hi.

records.english: Did your teacher make you write down your prediction before each experiment?
records.zomi: Etna khat ciat ma-in na sia in na lamen gelh dingin hong bawlsak hiam?

records.english: My mother kept a notebook of the date the first frost came every year.
records.zomi: Ka nu in kum simin khal masa pen a tun ni ciamtehna laibu khat a kem hi.

records.english: When we compared our notes, my brother and I had recorded completely different numbers of birds.
records.zomi: I ciamtehna i kiteh uh ciangin, kei leh ka unau pasal in vasa zah tuamtuam mahmah i ciamteh uh hi.

records.english: Simple tools allowed earlier generations to make surprisingly accurate observations.
records.zomi: Zatna baih te in khang upa te in a dik mahmah etna te a bawl thei nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: My grandmother could tell from the colour of the sky whether rain would come by evening.
records.zomi: Ka pi in van' pianzia pan nitak lam ciangin guah a zuh ding hiam cih a thei thei hi.

records.english: Long-term records kept by families can reveal changes in nature over decades.
records.zomi: Innkuan te' kem hun sau ciamtehna te in kum sawm tampi sung leitung kikhekna a lak thei hi.

records.english: Did you collect leaves for your project?
records.zomi: Na project adingin teh-ek te na kaikhawm hiam?

records.english: Did your father teach you to read the clouds?
records.zomi: Na pa in meiphual sim dingin hong sinsak hiam?

records.english: Our class discovered that the plants by the window grew towards the light.
records.zomi: I class in tawlleng kiang-a kung te meivaak lam-ah a khang uh hi cih a mu hi.

records.english: Who taught you to look at the stars?
records.zomi: Aksi te et dingin kua in hong sinsak hiam?

records.english: Did you draw the moon each night?
records.zomi: Zan simin kha na khai hiam?

records.english: Years later, I realised that my childhood bird lists showed some species disappearing.
records.zomi: Kum tampi khit-in, ka neu lai-a vasa lista te in vasa nam pawlkhat a mang hi cih a lak hi cih ka phawk hi.

records.english: My grandfather noticed that the river was getting warmer long before the scientists reported it.
records.zomi: Pilna siam te in a gen ma-un sawtpi ka pu in tuilui a lum semsem hi cih a phawk hi.

records.english: How did the farmers in your village decide when to plant before there were forecasts?
records.zomi: Khuahun thu-genna a om ma-in na khua-a lo neite in bang ciangin a suan ding uh hiam cih bangci a khensat uh hiam?

records.english: They watched which birds arrived, how the trees budded and how warm the soil felt in their hands.
records.zomi: Vasa koi te a hong uh hiam, singkung te bangci a ngun uh hiam, leitang a khut-ah bangzah a lum hiam cih a et uh hi.

records.english: Learning how elders observed the world helps children appreciate careful attention.
records.zomi: Upa te in leitung bangci a et uh hiam cih sin in naupang te in kidawm taka etna a thupi sak nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: How did your grandmother know when the hens were ill?
records.zomi: Na pi in akpi te a cidam loh ciangin bangci a thei hiam?

records.english: She watched how they walked and ate every morning, and she noticed any change straight away.
records.zomi: Zingsang simin bangci a pai a, a ne uh hiam cih a et a, kikhekna khempeuh pahin a phawk hi.

records.english: During the school science fair, my group recorded the temperature every hour for two days.
records.zomi: Sang science pawi sungin, ka pawl in ni nih sung nai simin lumna a ciamteh uh hi.

records.english: When I was a child, I spent a whole afternoon watching a spider repair its web.
records.zomi: Ka neu lai-in, maam khat in a lenkhau a bawlphat kik et-in nitak lam bup ka zang hi.

records.english: My father photographed the same hillside every spring for twenty years.
records.zomi: Ka pa in kum sawmnih sung spring simin mual kibang khat lim a la hi.

records.english: Did you time how fast the ice melted?
records.zomi: Tuikhal bangzah manlang-in a tui hiam cih hun na teh hiam?

records.english: When I was at university, a careful observation by a classmate saved our whole experiment.
records.zomi: University-ah ka om lai-in, class lawm khat' kidawm taka etna in i etna bup a hotkhia hi.

records.english: Did you ever watch a chick hatch?
records.zomi: Akno khat aktui pan a suak na et ngei hiam?

records.english: Did you use a magnifying glass at school?
records.zomi: Sang-ah magnifying glass na zang hiam?

records.english: Many scientists say their interest began with childhood observations.
records.zomi: Pilna siam tampi in a ngaihnatna uh neu lai-a etna te pan a kipan hi a ci uh hi.

records.english: Repeating the same observation over time shows patterns that one visit cannot.
records.zomi: Hun sau sung etna kibang bawl kik in veh khat in a lak zawh loh kizui dan te a lak hi.

records.english: Did your class grow beans in jars?
records.zomi: Na class in bel sungah be a suan uh hiam?

records.english: Did you write down what you saw?
records.zomi: Na muh te na gelh hiam?

records.english: Old photographs and diaries can serve as valuable scientific evidence.
records.zomi: Lim lui te leh ciamtehna laibu te science ettehna manphatte ahi thei hi.

records.english: My uncle noticed that the bees left the orchard earlier every year.
records.zomi: Ka pa neu in khuai te in kum simin gah huan a nusiat ma semsem uh hi cih a phawk hi.

records.english: Did you watch the ants in the garden?
records.zomi: Huan sung-a sihthe te na et hiam?

records.english: When I was eleven, our teacher asked us to watch the same tree every week for a whole year.
records.zomi: Kum sawm leh khat ka hih lai-in, i sia in kum khat bup sung kal simin singkung kibang khat et dingin hong ngen hi.

records.english: I drew its branches, counted the birds that visited it and wrote down the date when each leaf turned yellow.
records.zomi: A bawk te ka khai a, a hong veh vasa te ka sim a, a teh-ek khat ciat a gial ni ka gelh hi.

records.english: At the end of the year, my drawings showed changes I had never noticed while walking past it.
records.zomi: Kum tawp ciangin, ka lim khaite in a kiang ka pai-in ka phawk ngei lo kikhekna te a lak hi.

records.english: What did your first year as a research assistant teach you about observation?
records.zomi: Zonna huhmi-a na kum masa pen in etna tawh kisai bang hong sinsak hiam?

records.english: That writing down every detail at once matters, because a note I skipped once meant repeating a whole week of measurements.
records.zomi: A cing khempeuh pahin gelh a thupi hi, banghang hiam cih leh vei khat ka nusiat thu gelh khat hangin kal khat bup tehna te ka bawl kik kul hi.

records.english: Did you notice when the swallows came back?
records.zomi: Swallow vasa te a hong kik ciangin na phawk hiam?

records.english: Did you watch frogs lay eggs?
records.zomi: Utok te in aktui a nei uh na et hiam?

records.english: Did your teacher let you use a thermometer?

records.english: Godparents often promise to support a child's growth in faith.
records.zomi: Upna nu leh pa te in naupang khat' upna khanna huh dingin a ciam zel uh hi.

records.zomi: Khazih innkuan tampi in kibaptaizna te an leh letsong tawh a nuamsa uh hi.

records.zomi: Hilhna hoih te in kalsuan khat ciat' nuai-a tettehna a gen zel uh hi.

records.english: Asking how a claim was tested is a reasonable question, not a challenge.
records.zomi: Thugen khat bangci a kiet hiam cih dong pen dotna kituak khat ahi a, a dona hi lo hi.

records.english: Can you show me the test results that prove this helmet meets safety standards?
records.zomi: Hi lukhu khauh in himna tehna a tun hi cih tettehna etna gah te hong lak thei hiam?

records.english: Outdated instructions can be dangerous even when they seem convincing.
records.zomi: Hun bei hilhna te a muanhuai bang a kilat hangin a lauhuai thei hi.

records.english: Does the box say it's suitable for children?
records.zomi: Naupang te adingin a kituak hi ci-in bawm in a gen hiam?

records.english: People learn to judge information wisely when they ask for evidence.
records.zomi: Tettehna a ngen uh ciangin mite in thu te pil takin khen a sin uh hi.

records.english: How do you know that the battery should be stored at room temperature?
records.zomi: Battery khan lumna-in kikem ding hi cih bangci na theih hiam?

records.english: Where did you read about this method?
records.zomi: Hi lampi tawh kisai koi-ah na sim hiam?

records.english: A reliable explanation can be checked by someone else.
records.zomi: Genna muanhuai khat mi dang khat in a et thei hi.

records.english: When my neighbour told me to water tomato plants only at night, I asked where that advice came from.
records.zomi: Ka innveng in mehtuuk kung te zan-in bek tui ciin dingin hong gen ciangin, tua thuhilhna koi pan a hong pai hiam cih ka dong hi.

records.english: My neighbour pointed me to the local gardening club's guide, which explained that evening watering loses less water to the sun.
records.zomi: Ka innveng in khuasung huan pawl' lamlahna hong lak a, tua in nitak lam tui ciin in ni-ah tui tawm zaw a mansuah hi ci-in a gen hi.

records.english: I tried both methods for a month, and the plants watered in the evening did grow better.
records.zomi: Kha khat sung lampi nih a vekpi ka zang a, nitak lam-a tui ka ciin kung te a khang hoih zaw takpi hi.

records.english: Can you point me to the rule that says the fire door must stay closed?
records.zomi: Mei kang kongkhak a kikhak den ding hi a ci thukham hong lak thei hiam?

records.english: How do you know the charger is the right one?
records.zomi: Charger pen a dik pen ahi hi cih bangci na theih hiam?

records.english: Can I see the page about cleaning the filter?
records.zomi: Filter siangsak tawh kisai mai ka et thei hiam?

records.english: What should I do if I can't afford a lawyer for my case?
records.zomi: Ka thu adingin thukham siam khat ka zat zawh kei leh bang ka bawl ding hiam?

records.english: When a shop refused to refund my broken washing machine, I decided to make a small claim.
records.zomi: Zuakna inn khat in ka puan sopna set siat man a pia kik nuam loh ciangin, ngetna neu khat bawl dingin ka khensat hi.

records.english: A volunteer at the advice centre showed me how to fill in the form and attach my receipt and photos.
records.zomi: Thuhilhna mun-a thalawp khat in lai bangci dimsak ding a, ka sum lak lai leh milim te bangci belh ding hiam cih hong lak hi.

records.english: Before the hearing date, the shop offered a full refund, so the case never went to court.
records.zomi: Thukhenna ni ma-in, zuakna inn in man bup a pia kik dingin a gen ahih manin, thu pen thukhenna mun-ah a tung ngei kei hi.

records.english: Can I ask for a new hearing date?
records.zomi: Thukhenna ni thak khat ka ngen thei hiam?

records.english: Do I need to bring my documents?
records.zomi: Ka lai te ka paipih kul hiam?

records.english: How long do I have to appeal if I disagree with the judge's decision?
records.zomi: Thukhen mangpa' khensatna tawh ka kituak kei leh ngen kik nadingin bangzah hun ka nei hiam?

records.english: Who will read my statement?
records.zomi: Ka thugen lai kua in a sim ding hiam?

records.english: Clear answers about legal steps help people take part fairly.
records.zomi: Thukham kalsuan te tawh kisai dawnna kician te in mite dik takin a kihel nadingin a huh hi.

records.english: Where do I send the court form?
records.zomi: Thukhenna mun lai koi-ah ka khak ding hiam?

records.english: Can I bring my daughter to the hearing?
records.zomi: Thukhenna-ah ka tanu ka paipih thei hiam?

records.english: Yes, she can sit in the public seats, but she must stay quiet.
records.zomi: Hi, mipi tutna-ah a tu thei a, ahi zongin a dai kul hi.

records.english: What time does the hearing start?
records.zomi: Thukhenna bang hun-in a kipan hiam?

records.english: Do I have to go to court for a parking fine?
records.zomi: Mawtaw koihna sum gawtna adingin thukhenna mun-ah ka pai kul hiam?

records.english: Not in our town, unless you want to challenge it, because you can usually pay online.
records.zomi: I khuapi-ah kei hi, na do nuam kei leh, banghangin cih leh online-in na pia thei zel hi.

records.english: What happens after I send my claim form to the small claims court?
records.zomi: Ka ngetna lai thu neu thukhenna mun-ah ka khak khit-in bang a piang hiam?

records.english: In our country, the court sends a copy to the other side, who usually has two weeks to reply.
records.zomi: I gam-ah, thukhenna mun in a lam dang kiangah khat a khak a, tua in a dawn nadingin kal nih a nei zel hi.

records.english: In our town, can a neighbour dispute be settled by mediation instead of going to court?
records.zomi: I khuapi-ah, innveng kinialna khat thukhenna mun-ah pai sangin kilemsakna tawh a kibawlphat thei hiam?

records.english: Asking questions early can prevent costly mistakes in legal procedures.
records.zomi: A hun ma-in dotna dong in thukham kalsuan te-a man tam khialhna te a kham thei hi.

records.english: Is there a free advice desk at the court?
records.zomi: Thukhenna mun-ah man om lo thuhilhna dawhkan khat a om hiam?
